abstract_en: The utility model discloses a constant-temperature dehumidifying air conditioner which comprises a casing and an evaporator, wherein the casing is provided with a containing cavity and an air outlet, the evaporator is contained in the containing cavity, part of the evaporator faces the air outlet, the part of the evaporator facing the air outlet and the air outlet are arranged at intervals to form a heating space, a heating component capable of sliding in or sliding out of the heating space along the part of the evaporator facing the air outlet is arranged on the casing, the heating component comprises a sliding rod and a heating tube, the sliding rod can slide in or sliding out of the heating space along the casing, one side, opposite to the sliding rod, of the casing is provided with a conducting strip, the sliding rod is provided with a conducting column which is abutted on the conducting strip and is electrically connected with the heating tube, and the conducting column slides along the conducting strip when the sliding rod slides along the casing. According to the utility model, the part of the evaporator, which is opposite to the air outlet, is arranged at intervals with the air outlet to form a heating space, and the heating pipe which can move into or out of the heating space is arranged on the shell, so that the air which is refrigerated and dehumidified by the evaporator is heated by the heating pipe and then blown out after being warmed, constant-temperature dehumidification is realized, and the indoor temperature reduction during dehumidification is avoided.

title_en: Low-carbon energy-saving assembled heat-insulating wall
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-carbon energy-saving assembled heat-insulating wall body, and relates to the technical field of assembled buildings. The water storage device comprises an outer wall plate and an inner wall plate, wherein the outer wall plate is arranged on the outer side of the inner wall plate, a certain interval is formed between the outer wall plate and the inner wall plate, the top of the water storage space is communicated with the outside, a plurality of cover plates are vertically and uniformly distributed in the water storage space, the water storage space is divided into a plurality of water storage tanks by the cover plates, one ends of the cover plates are provided with water inlets, the other ends of the cover plates are provided with evaporation holes, baffle assemblies are arranged at the bottoms of the cover plates and are used for controlling the opening and closing of the water inlets and the evaporation holes, a supporting plate is arranged above the cover plates, an inclined partition plate is arranged at one end of the supporting plate, and the top of the partition plate is located below the water inlets. The utility model can collect rainwater, absorb the heat of the wall body through the evaporation of the rainwater, realize natural heat dissipation, improve the comfort level of living, reduce the consumption of refrigeration equipment such as air conditioners and the like, and realize the aims of energy conservation, emission reduction and environmental protection.

title_en: Air inlet box of workshop dust removal system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air inlet box of a workshop dust removal system, and relates to the technical field of workshop dust removal. The air inlet device comprises a support, a box body is vertically fixed on the support, an air outlet is vertically formed in the top wall of the box body, a plurality of air inlet holes are formed in one side wall of the box body side by side, a plurality of guide plates are obliquely arranged in the box body from top to bottom, and the upper edges of the guide plates are fixed on one side wall of the box body. The utility model has reasonable structural design and convenient use, effectively improves the use effect of the air inlet box and has higher market application value.

title_en: Radiator for internal circulation cooling of vacuum dehydroxylation furnace
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the vacuum industry, and particularly relates to a radiator for circulating cooling in a vacuum dehydroxylation furnace, which comprises a cylinder made of metal and radiating components, wherein sealing covers are arranged at two ends of the cylinder, a circulating cooling inlet and a circulating cooling outlet are arranged on the sealing covers, the radiating components are arranged in the cylinder in a sealing manner along the length direction of the cylinder, connecting ports are symmetrically arranged on the cylinder wall at the central axis of the cylinder in the length direction, connecting flanges are welded on the connecting ports, the radiating components comprise two round steel plates with the diameter consistent with the inner diameter of the cylinder and heat exchange tubes, holes matched with the heat exchange tubes are arranged on the surfaces of the round steel plates, and the heat exchange tubes pass through the round steel plates in order and are welded and fixed with the round steel plates.

title_en: Oil tank pressure regulating system and centrifugal water chilling unit
abstract_en: The application provides an oil tank pressure regulating system and a centrifugal water chilling unit. According to an example of the application, an oil tank pressure regulating system comprises a centrifugal compressor, an oil tank and a first auxiliary compressor, wherein the centrifugal compressor comprises a bearing cavity, a motor cavity and a bearing arranged in the bearing cavity, the pressure in the motor cavity is higher than that in the bearing cavity, the oil tank comprises an oil supply port, an oil return port and an exhaust port, the oil supply port is communicated with the bearing and is used for lubricating the bearing, the oil return port is communicated with the bearing cavity, and the first auxiliary compressor is communicated with the exhaust port and is used for being communicated to an evaporator. The scheme can reduce the pressure in the oil tank, and then reduces the solubility of the refrigerant in the lubricating oil.

title_en: Automatic oil return system for refrigerating system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic oil return system for a refrigerating system, which comprises a base, an oil collector, an oil return pipe, a lower oil pipe, a balance pipe, a hot gas bypass pipe, a heating mechanism and a control mechanism, wherein the oil collector is provided with an inner cavity for storing lubricating oil, one end of the oil return pipe, one end of the lower oil pipe, one end of the balance pipe and one end of the hot gas bypass pipe are respectively communicated with the inner cavity of the oil collector, automatic regulating valves are respectively arranged on the oil return pipe, the lower oil pipe, the balance pipe and the hot gas bypass pipe, an active heater is arranged on one side of the oil collector, one end of the heating pipe is communicated with the inner cavity of the oil collector, the other end of the heating pipe is connected with the active heater, and the control mechanism is arranged on the base and used for controlling the operation or closing of the automatic regulating valves on the oil return pipe, the lower oil pipe, the balance pipe and the hot gas bypass pipe. The utility model can automatically collect lubricating oil into the oil collector, and automatically return to the refrigerating system after the lubricating oil is distilled, and the whole process is automatic, thereby reducing the burden of workers.

title_en: Integrated electrical appliance with energy storage module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric appliances, and provides an integrated electric appliance with an energy storage module, which comprises a shell component and the energy storage module, wherein at least two of a refrigerator component, a microwave oven component, an electromagnetic oven component and an electric kettle heating base are integrally arranged in the inner space of the shell component, the energy storage module can store energy when electric appliances in a valley and/or the shell component are used and the energy storage is insufficient, and instant high-power electric energy output is provided when electric appliances in the shell component are used in a concentrated mode. According to the utility model, the utilization rate of the space where kitchen electricity is located is remarkably improved by integrating various kitchen appliances in one shell assembly, so that the space where kitchen electricity is located is tidier and more orderly, and the integrated appliances with the energy storage modules can provide stable high-power electric energy output in the electricity utilization peak period by combining the introduced energy storage modules, thereby meeting the use requirement of the high-power appliances and avoiding the problem that the appliances cannot be normally used due to insufficient power.

title_en: Air conditioning system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air conditioning system which comprises a refrigerant circulation loop and a liquid storage tank, wherein the refrigerant circulation loop is formed by connecting a compressor, a four-way valve, an outdoor heat exchanger, an indoor heat exchanger and a gas-liquid separator through pipelines, the four-way valve is provided with a first port, a second port, a third port and a fourth port, the first port is connected to an exhaust port of the compressor, the second port is connected to the outdoor heat exchanger, the third port is connected to the indoor heat exchanger, the fourth port is connected to an inlet of the gas-liquid separator, the liquid storage tank is connected between the third port and the indoor heat exchanger through a first control valve and a second control valve respectively, and the liquid storage tank is also connected to an inlet of the gas-liquid separator through a third control valve. According to the utility model, the functions of refrigerant adjustment and refrigerant transfer are realized by simply connecting the single liquid storage tank with the parts of the air conditioning system and the pipelines by adding a proper number of control valves, thereby obviously simplifying the pipeline structure, reducing the cost and improving the utilization rate of the product space.

title_en: Air purifier with double motors and double wind wheels and top air outlet structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air purifier with a double-motor double-wind wheel top air outlet structure, wherein an air outlet is formed in the upper end of a purifier main body, a first fan is arranged below the air outlet, a first air inlet is circumferentially formed below the first fan, a second fan is arranged below the first air inlet, a second air inlet is formed in the bottom of the second fan, and wind power generated by the first fan and the second fan is vertically upward. The air purifier with the double-motor double-wind wheel top air outlet structure disclosed by the utility model can effectively increase the air purification amount in unit time, has low requirements on motors, low production cost, low power consumption, low use noise and the like.

title_en: Connection assembly for photovoltaic panels
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coupling assembling for photovoltaic board, coupling assembling includes the link, the link is used for detachably installing in the mount pad of photovoltaic board, the link has arranged the pressure equipment spare respectively along the opposite both sides of first direction, the pressure equipment spare all install in the link and with the mount pad interval sets up, the regulating part with the pressure equipment spare one-to-one arranges, the regulating part is used for adjusting the correspondence the pressure equipment spare to the interval of mount pad, in order to with the photovoltaic board pressure equipment is in between pressure equipment spare and the mount pad. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, this coupling assembling can connect not unidimensional photovoltaic board, and the commonality is good.

title_en: Semiconductor refrigeration cooling mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of semiconductor refrigeration, and discloses a semiconductor refrigeration cooling mechanism which comprises a refrigeration pad, a refrigeration pasting system and an air supply system, wherein the refrigeration pad comprises a contact layer, an air supporting layer and a heat insulation layer which are sequentially arranged, the refrigeration pasting system comprises a cold compress module and a refrigeration host, the refrigeration host is inlaid in the air supporting layer, the cold compress module is positioned on the outer side of the contact layer, the contact surface of the cold compress module is prevented from being provided with an air outlet, the cold end of the cold compress module is pasted with the cold end surface of a semiconductor refrigeration sheet of the refrigeration host after passing through the contact layer, the air supply system is inlaid in the air supporting layer after passing through the contact layer, and the air supply system is used for supplying air to the air supporting layer. The semiconductor refrigeration cooling mechanism is favorable for enhancing the cooling effect of the seat cushion, effectively improves the comfort and driving feeling of a driver and solves the technical problem that the cooling effect of the existing automobile seat cushion is limited.

title_en: Water inlet structure and gas water heater with same
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water inlet structure, includes heat transfer device, is used for connecting the water inlet joint of outside liquid source and is used for making the water route passageway that liquid carried to heat transfer device from the water inlet joint, be equipped with the water route on the water route passageway and open the water route passageway or close the water route passageway. The utility model provides a water inlet structure which can enable a user to acquire liquid with required temperature in real time and meet the use requirement of the user. The utility model also discloses a gas water heater with the water inlet structure.

title_en: Tunnel kiln cooling section ventilation cooling structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ventilation of a cooling section of a tunnel kiln, in particular to a ventilation cooling structure of the cooling section of the tunnel kiln, which comprises a blast device, wherein the output end of the blast device is communicated with a main pipeline, the outer side of the main pipeline is provided with a preheating mechanism, the outer side of the main pipeline is also provided with a temperature sensor for detecting the temperature of gas in the main pipeline, the other end of the main pipeline is communicated with a kiln inner wall pipeline, the outer side of the main pipeline is communicated with two groups of side pipelines, and the other end of the side pipelines is communicated with the kiln inner wall pipeline.

title_en: Protection device for heating furnace billet conveyor electromechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protecting device for heating furnace steel billet conveyor electromechanical equipment, belongs to the technical field of protecting devices, and solves the problem that the existing heating furnace steel billet conveyor electromechanical equipment is not protected and is easy to damage. The novel mechanical and electrical equipment comprises a U-shaped coaming and four upright posts, wherein the four upright posts are fixed on the ground around the mechanical and electrical equipment, four sliding holes corresponding to the four upright posts in position are vertically formed in the U-shaped coaming, the U-shaped coaming is arranged on the four upright posts through the sliding holes in a sliding sleeve mode, one end of an opening of the U-shaped coaming faces to one side far away from a conveying roller, each U-shaped coaming on one side of the sliding hole is connected with an anti-jacking screw through threads, one end of the anti-jacking screw penetrates into the sliding hole, and a supporting plate covering the top of the U-shaped coaming is further fixedly arranged at the top of the U-shaped coaming. The protection device can effectively protect the electromechanical equipment of the heating furnace billet conveyor, prolong the service life of the electromechanical equipment and reduce the maintenance cost.

title_en: Pipeline type rotary dehumidifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline type rotary dehumidifier, which relates to the technical field of rotary dehumidifiers and comprises a rotary dehumidifier main body, a hoisting mechanism and a supporting mechanism, wherein the hoisting mechanism comprises first adjusting screws, movable plates are arranged on the outer sides of the two first adjusting screws, the supporting mechanism comprises second adjusting screws, the second adjusting screws are arranged on the inner wall of the top of the rotary dehumidifier main body, movable seats are sleeved on the outer sides of two ends of the second adjusting screws, traction plates are arranged on the two sides of the top of each movable seat, and supporting plates are arranged on the tops of the four traction plates. According to the utility model, the height of the movable plate can be adjusted through the first adjusting screw, so that the movable plate can be adjusted conveniently and quickly according to the requirements, and the second adjusting screw rotates under the action of the movable seat and the traction plate, so that the height of the supporting plate can be adjusted, the top of the inner wall of the pipeline can be supported, and the main body of the rotary dehumidifier can be kept stable after being installed.

title_en: Novel structure copper pipe hanger
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel structural copper pipe hanger, and relates to the technical field of submerged arc furnace electrode systems. The novel structure copper pipe is hung, the novel structure copper pipe comprises a fixing frame, install the fixture fixed to copper pipe on the mount, fixture includes a plurality of fixed splint and a plurality of movable splint, and a plurality of fixed splint are installed respectively at the both sides face of mount, movable splint is installed through quick detach mechanism and is kept away from the one end of mount at fixed splint, and copper pipe centre gripping is between fixed splint and movable splint. The device changes the structure form of the clamping plate of the copper pipe hanger from integral type to split type, and a plurality of groups of fixed clamping plates and movable clamping plates are used for clamping and fixing a plurality of copper pipes separately, so that the relative position of the copper pipes in the furnace is unchanged, and only a specific clamping mechanism is required to be separated when copper tiles need to be replaced, the operation is simple, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Liquid distribution device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cloth liquid device, includes the base and installs the upper cover on the base, and the base encloses jointly with the upper cover and forms and be formed with cloth liquid chamber, is equipped with first water receiving mouth, second water receiving mouth and delivery port on the base, and first water receiving mouth is linked together through cloth liquid chamber and delivery port, and the port of first water receiving mouth is used for connecting the water pipe, and second water receiving mouth is mutually independent with first water receiving mouth, and the water inlet of second water receiving mouth is used for connecting the outer inlet tube that arranges, and the water outlet of second water receiving mouth is used for connecting the outer outlet pipe that arranges. The first water receiving port of the liquid distribution device is communicated with the water outlet, namely, the first water receiving port is used as an internal circulation consumption interface, the second water receiving port is an external drainage interface and is used for connecting an external drainage water inlet pipe and an external drainage water outlet pipe, when the refrigerating system works, condensed water enters the liquid distribution cavity through the first water receiving port and is uniformly distributed through the water outlet, when the use environment is in a high-humidity working condition, the internal circulation of the condensed water is possibly insufficient for complete consumption, and at the moment, the water pipe is connected with the external drainage interface to drain the condensed water.

title_en: Novel high-temperature sintering furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sintering furnace equipment, and discloses a novel high-temperature sintering furnace, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a furnace body is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a material taking mechanism and a plugging mechanism are respectively arranged on the furnace body, the material taking mechanism comprises a supporting plate, a rack, a rotating shaft and a displacement gear, the supporting plate is slidably connected to the inner wall of the furnace body, and the rack is fixedly connected to the bottom of the supporting plate. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the material taking mechanism and the motor, the rack is driven to move by utilizing the rotation of the displacement gear, and the supporting plate is further driven to horizontally slide along the inner wall of the chute, so that the supporting plate extends out of the furnace body, the fired ceramic product is conveniently and rapidly taken out, the ceramic product is prevented from being cooled in the furnace body, the waiting time is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Compressor fixed block, compressor and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides a compressor fixing block, a compressor and an air conditioner, wherein the compressor fixing block comprises a first pressing plate and a second pressing plate, notches are formed in the first pressing plate and the second pressing plate, a plurality of first supports are arranged on the first pressing plate and are arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction of the first pressing plate, a plurality of second supports are arranged on the second pressing plate and are arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction of the second pressing plate, and the second supports are arranged in one-to-one correspondence with the first supports. According to the utility model, the technical problem that the compressor fixing block is inconvenient to disassemble in the prior art can be solved.

title_en: Indoor spraying and sterilizing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of indoor disinfection, in particular to an indoor spraying disinfection device, which comprises a disinfection machine, wherein the front surface of the disinfection machine is provided with an exhaust hole, the inner wall of the exhaust hole of the disinfection machine is provided with an exhaust plate, the bottom of the disinfection machine is fixedly provided with a base, the top of the disinfection machine is fixedly provided with an operation screen, and the front surface of the disinfection machine is provided with an adjusting device which is convenient for adjusting a spraying angle.

title_en: Plate heat exchanger for ship
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a marine plate heat exchanger, which comprises a plurality of heat transfer plates, wherein a medium flow passage is formed between adjacent heat transfer plates, the edge of one side surface of each heat transfer plate is provided with an edge groove, the edge groove forms an edge bulge on the other side of the heat transfer plate, an edge sealing gasket is arranged in the edge groove, the middle area of each heat transfer plate is provided with at least one auxiliary fastening bolt hole, the periphery of each auxiliary fastening bolt hole is provided with an annular groove, the other side of each heat transfer plate is provided with an annular bulge, the annular groove is internally provided with an annular sealing gasket, and the plurality of heat transfer plates are fastened by the auxiliary fastening bolts penetrating through the auxiliary fastening bolt holes. By arranging the auxiliary fastening bolt holes in the middle area of the heat transfer plate and fastening each heat transfer plate by using the auxiliary fastening bolts, even if the heat transfer plate is larger and the distance between the clamping bolts is longer, the auxiliary fastening can be performed by the auxiliary fastening bolts, so that the earthquake resistance and the bearing capacity are improved.

title_en: High-pressure compressed air energy storage heat exchange device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of compressed air energy storage, and particularly discloses a high-pressure compressed air energy storage heat exchange device which comprises an inlet pipe box, an outlet pipe box and a plurality of compressed air communicating pipes, wherein one end of each compressed air communicating pipe is communicated with the inlet pipe box, the other end of each compressed air communicating pipe is communicated with the outlet pipe box, a heat medium water heat exchange pipe is arranged in each compressed air communicating pipe, one end of each heat medium water heat exchange pipe is communicated with a first communicating hole, and the other end of each heat medium water heat exchange pipe is communicated with a second communicating hole. More than two straight fins are arranged between the compressed air communicating pipe and the heat medium water heat exchange pipe, and the straight fins equally divide the pipeline space between the compressed air communicating pipe and the heat medium water heat exchange pipe along the circumferential direction of the heat medium water heat exchange pipe. The utility model is used for increasing the heat exchange efficiency.

title_en: Induced air device of low nitrogen combustor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of low-nitrogen burners and discloses an induced draft device of a low-nitrogen burner, which comprises an induced draft box, wherein a mounting plate is arranged on the front side of the induced draft box and consists of a first side wall and a second side wall, the first side wall and the second side wall are provided with an included angle of 100-120 degrees, an air outlet pipe is fixedly communicated with the outer wall of the first side wall and is positioned at an eccentric position below the center point of the mounting plate, an overhaul seat is arranged on the outer wall of the second side wall, an overhaul hole is arranged on the front side of the overhaul seat, and the overhaul hole is positioned at an eccentric position above the mounting plate. According to the utility model, the included angle between the first side wall and the second side wall is utilized to enable the included angle between the overhaul hole and the air outlet pipe to be 100-120 degrees, so that an overhaul worker can conveniently extend into the low-nitrogen burner connected with the air outlet pipe, overhaul or maintenance can be carried out on components in the low-nitrogen burner, such as the pilot nozzle in the low-nitrogen burner, the central nozzle on the flame stabilizing disc and the like, and the maintenance efficiency and accuracy of the overhaul worker are improved.

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner, which relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and comprises a casing, a shutter assembly and a motor assembly, wherein an air outlet cavity and a mounting cavity are formed in the casing, a partition plate is arranged between the air outlet cavity and the mounting cavity, a clearance hole is formed in the partition plate, the air outlet cavity is communicated with the mounting cavity through the clearance hole, an air outlet and a false air inlet are formed in the air outlet cavity, the air outlet and the false air inlet are sequentially arranged in the direction close to the partition plate, the shutter assembly is mounted at the air outlet, the motor assembly is mounted in the mounting cavity and is opposite to the false air inlet, and the shutter assembly is in transmission connection with the motor assembly through the clearance hole. The technical scheme provided by the utility model improves the service life of the air conditioner.

title_en: Gaseous cooling recovery unit of phosphorus trichloride
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of phosphorus trichloride recovery equipment, and discloses a phosphorus trichloride gaseous cooling recovery device which comprises a main body, wherein a water inlet is fixedly connected to the lower part of the front surface of the main body, a water outlet is arranged below the water inlet, the water inlet and the water outlet are arranged to facilitate water supplementing and water draining of a water tank, too much water accumulation in the device is prevented, supports are fixedly connected to the lower surface of the main body, and the number of the supports is four. Through the arrangement of the first cooling pipe, the fins and the spraying mechanism, the working personnel cool gaseous phosphorus trichloride through the first cooling pipe after introducing the gaseous phosphorus trichloride, then the gaseous phosphorus trichloride is shunted into the cooling branch pipes, the fins provide heat dissipation, the spraying mechanism sprays water onto the fins to improve the heat dissipation effect, the wind power port blows air into the device, the water evaporation efficiency is improved, the heat dissipation effect of the fins is improved again, and the recovery efficiency is improved through multiple combination heat dissipation cooling.

title_en: Smoke exhaust pipeline structure for fire engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a smoke exhaust pipeline structure for fire engineering, which comprises two first plates and two second plates, wherein the first plates are arranged left and right at intervals, the second plates are arranged up and down at intervals, a plurality of fixing frames are arranged between the left and right first plates in the front-back direction, the first plates are detachably connected with the fixing frames, the left and right sides of the second plates are detachably connected with the first plates, a sealing installation cavity is formed in the inner side of the joint of the first plates and the second plates, and sealing rubber strips are arranged in the sealing installation cavity. The utility model eliminates the use of the existing plug connector, effectively reduces the number of parts and reduces the production cost. Meanwhile, the sealing installation cavity is arranged, and the sealing rubber strip is inserted into the sealing installation cavity, so that sealing is realized, the sealing performance is enhanced, and the problem of air leakage is avoided.

title_en: Steam waste heat utilization device and steam integrated system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam waste heat utilization device and a steam integrated system, wherein the steam waste heat utilization device comprises a support, a heat exchange tank body, a heat exchange assembly and an agitating assembly, the heat exchange tank body is transversely arranged on the support, the heat exchange assembly is arranged in the heat exchange tank body, the heat exchange assembly comprises a heat exchange pipe and a deflector, the heat exchange pipe is communicated with an external steam pipe, the deflector is arranged in the heat exchange tank body, the agitating assembly is arranged at two ends of the heat exchange tank body, and the agitating assembly is used for agitating cooling mediums in the heat exchange tank body. After the outside steam is utilized by the steam utilization device, the steam waste heat utilization device can be utilized, and the utilized lower-temperature steam in the steam room can be recovered and utilized, so that the heat utilization rate of the steam is improved. Meanwhile, the stirring component in the steam waste heat utilization device can be utilized, so that the cooling medium in the heat exchange tank body can be driven to flow, the heat exchange of the heat exchange tube is uniform, and the heat exchange efficiency is improved.

title_en: Air cooling-evaporating cold series high-efficiency water-saving heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air cooling-evaporating cooling series efficient water-saving heat exchanger which comprises a substrate, wherein the upper end of the substrate is fixedly connected with a fixing table through a first fixing rod, the upper end of the fixing table is fixedly connected with fixing seats, the fixing seats are symmetrically distributed at the left end and the right end of the fixing table, and the front end of the fixing table is fixedly connected with a heat exchange tube through a second fixing rod. The water circulation mechanism is formed by the base plate, the water storage tank, the fixing rod, the fixing table, the water pump, the liquid inlet pipe, the liquid outlet pipe, the annular evaporation pipe, the recovery pump and the guide pipe, so that water for evaporating and cooling can be recycled, and water resources can be saved.

title_en: Fin tube adsorption coating and adsorption rotating wheel composite dehumidifier unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioning dehumidification equipment, in particular to a finned tube adsorption coating and adsorption rotating wheel composite type dehumidifier unit, wherein an air inlet cavity, a coating dehumidification cavity, a middle cavity, a rotating wheel dehumidification cavity and an air supply cavity which are sequentially connected are arranged in a machine case, the coating dehumidification cavity comprises two coating dehumidification channels which are arranged in parallel, coating coils are fixedly arranged in the two coating dehumidification channels respectively, one side of each of the two coating dehumidification channels is provided with a treatment air inlet channel and a regeneration air outlet channel which are arranged in parallel, the other side of each of the two coating dehumidification channels is provided with a treatment air outlet channel and a regeneration air inlet channel which are arranged in parallel, the coating coils are adopted to replace a front rotating wheel of a conventional double-rotating wheel dehumidifier unit, and a traditional low-dew-point dehumidification rotating wheel is adopted for secondary dehumidification, so that the requirement of ultra-low dew-point air supply is met.

title_en: Concentrating solar heat collection circulating hydrogen charging device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a concentrating solar heat collection circulation hydrogen charging device which comprises a gas flowmeter, a hydrogen charging one-way valve, a concentrating solar heat collection device, a hydrogen inlet valve, a pressure gauge, a hydrogenation kettle, a hydrogen outlet valve and a hydrogen exhaust valve which are sequentially connected, wherein a hydrogen charging circulation pipeline is arranged between a hydrogen outlet of the hydrogen outlet valve and a hydrogen inlet of the concentrating solar heat collection device, a gas circulation pump is arranged on the hydrogen charging circulation pipeline, the inside of the hydrogenation kettle is used for filling solid hydrogen storage materials, a feed valve is arranged on a feed pipe at the upper part of the hydrogenation kettle, and a discharge valve is arranged on a discharge pipe at the lower part of the hydrogenation kettle. The utility model has no risk of hydrogen fire or explosion caused by electric heating leakage in the heating process, can obviously improve the energy utilization efficiency of hydrogen energy storage and full chain utilization by using renewable solar energy as a heat source, and can obviously improve the heating efficiency of solid hydrogen storage materials by flowing hot hydrogen.

title_en: Industrial humidifier water tank sterilizing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of industrial humidifiers, and discloses an industrial humidifier water tank sterilization device which comprises a humidifier main body, wherein an ultrasonic atomizer is arranged in the humidifier main body, a connecting pipe is fixedly arranged at the top end of the humidifier main body in a penetrating manner, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the outer wall of one side of the humidifier main body, a water tank is placed at the top end of the supporting plate, a water pump and four underwater ultraviolet sterilization lamps are arranged at the top end of the water tank, the water pump is positioned at the middle positions of the four underwater ultraviolet sterilization lamps, a lamp tube of the underwater ultraviolet sterilization lamps extends into the water tank, and a water pumping end of the water pump is fixedly connected with a second water tube. According to the technical scheme, the four timing underwater ultraviolet germicidal lamps are additionally arranged in the water tank, the starting number and the starting time of the underwater ultraviolet germicidal lamps are adjusted according to the water consumption, the colony number of the humidifier water can be effectively reduced, and the effect of sterilizing the water is achieved.

title_en: Magnetic suspension panel structure and bathroom heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a magnetic suspension panel structure which comprises a panel, a motor module and a base body, wherein the panel comprises a panel main body and a luminous piece arranged in the panel main body, the panel main body is provided with an installation position, the motor module comprises a rotor component and a stator component, the rotor component is arranged on the installation position, the stator component comprises a stator base and a track arranged on the stator base, the base body comprises a base surface and a groove body arranged on the base surface, the center of gravity of the panel is positioned in the center of the installation position, and after the motor module is electrified, the panel is suspended on the base surface and is driven by the motor module to slide along the track. The panel sliding process has low noise and good stability, can yield more areas, and is convenient for better realizing the functions of ventilation and blowing. The utility model also provides a bathroom warmer comprising the magnetic suspension panel structure.

title_en: Explosion-proof organic heat carrier boiler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof organic heat carrier boiler, which comprises a boiler body, wherein a combustion hearth penetrates through the inside of the boiler body, an explosion-proof door is arranged at an opening at the upper end of the combustion hearth, a control panel is arranged on the outer wall of the boiler body, a first flue and a second flue penetrate through the side wall of the combustion hearth, one ends of the first flue and the second flue penetrate through the inner wall of the boiler body, a water guide pipe is wound on the side walls of the combustion hearth, the first flue and the second flue, one end of the water guide pipe penetrates through the top surface of the inside of the boiler body, a safety valve is arranged on the side wall of one end of the water guide pipe, the other end of the water guide pipe penetrates through the inner wall of the boiler body, and a control valve is arranged on the side wall of the other end of the water guide pipe. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the first air duct, the second air duct and the air storage cylinder are adopted, and whether the internal space of the boiler is sealed or not can be detected in advance through the arranged first air duct, the second air duct and the air storage cylinder, so that the use practicability of the explosion-proof organic heat carrier boiler is improved.

title_en: Fixing structure of spiral fin tube condenser
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixing structure of a finned tube condenser, which comprises a main bracket and a finned tube condenser main body, wherein the main bracket is arranged in a finned tube of the finned tube condenser main body. According to the utility model, the main support plate is connected in a clamping manner, and is arranged on the finned tube of the main body of the finned tube condenser, when the main support cover plate is clamped with the main support plate, the finned tube of the main body of the finned tube condenser can be fixed, so that the structure of the condenser is stronger and more stable, the main support cover plate at the top can enhance the strength of the main body of the finned tube condenser, and when the main body of the finned tube condenser is extruded, the deformation condition can not be generated.

title_en: Industrial air cooler adopting four-way valve system for defrosting
abstract_en: The industrial air cooler adopting the four-way valve system for defrosting comprises a compressor, an oil separator, a filter, a condenser, an evaporator, a centrifugal fan and an air outlet which are sequentially connected, and is characterized in that a four-way valve is arranged between the filter and the condenser, four ports of the four-way valve are respectively connected with the filter, the condenser, the compressor and the evaporator, and an expansion valve is connected between the condenser and the evaporator. The four-way valve and the expansion valve are arranged, so that the four-way valve conversion period and the defrosting period can be set according to the equipment operation frosting rule, and the frost layer on the evaporator can be rapidly removed, thereby ensuring the working efficiency of the air cooler.

title_en: Condensate water utilization system of industrial mobile air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a condensate water utilization system of an industrial mobile air conditioner, which comprises a receiving disc and is characterized in that an upper machine body and a lower machine body are arranged on the receiving disc, the back surfaces and/or the left side surfaces of the upper machine body and the lower machine body are provided with air inlets, the air inlets are provided with filter screens and outer covers, evaporators and condensers adjacent to the air inlets are respectively arranged on the upper machine body and the lower machine body, a plurality of first condensate water outlets and a plurality of second condensate water outlets are respectively arranged at the bottoms of the upper machine body and the lower machine body, the first condensate water outlets are uniformly distributed and are positioned right above the condensers, condensate water generated by heat exchange of the corresponding evaporators drops to the top of the condensers through the first condensate water outlets, the second condensate water outlets correspond to the receiving disc, condensate water storage cavities are arranged in the corresponding receiving disc, and water outlets and valves are arranged at the bottoms of the receiving disc. The air conditioner adopts a superposed structure, utilizes the condensed water generated by the evaporator to carry out auxiliary heat dissipation on the condenser, and improves the utilization rate of the condensed water.

title_en: Novel reflux cooler assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel reflux type cooler assembly, which relates to the technical field of coolers and comprises a cooler shell, wherein an air inlet, an air outlet, a refrigerant inlet and a refrigerant outlet are formed in the outer side of the cooler shell, when the outer side of a spiral reflux is required to be cleaned, an output end of a starting motor is controlled by a control panel to drive a threaded rod to rotate along the inner part of a threaded seat, so that the threaded seat drives a lifting plate to move upwards, a cleaning sleeve is driven to move along the outer side of the spiral reflux, the cleaning brush is enabled to clean the outer side of the spiral reflux, the starting motor is controlled to rotate reversely until a limit switch at the top of the lifting plate contacts a top supporting plate, the lifting plate is further enabled to descend, and then the cleaning brush is driven to repeatedly clean the outer side of the spiral reflux, scale caking is avoided, automatic cleaning is not required to be manually operated.

title_en: Clamp assembly for photovoltaic bracket
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamp assembly for a photovoltaic bracket, which comprises a first locking edge, a second locking edge and a connecting piece, wherein the first locking edge comprises a first main body and a first clamping part extending from the first main body, the second locking edge comprises a second main body and a second clamping part which are mutually connected, one side of the second clamping part, which faces the first clamping part, is defined as the inner side, the second clamping part is at least provided with a first step part, so that at least a first clamping groove is formed in the inner side of the second clamping part, the first clamping part is defined to extend along the longitudinal direction relative to the first main body, the longitudinal position of the second locking edge relative to the first locking edge is adjustable, and the clamp assembly can be adapted to a plurality of different tile types.

title_en: Steam turbine drainage heat recovery device of power plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam turbine hydrophobic heat recovery device of a power plant, and relates to the technical field of steam turbine hydrophobic heat recovery. The utility model comprises a recovery box, wherein the bottom of the recovery box is fixedly connected with an annular bottom shell, the bottom of the annular bottom shell is fixedly connected with a plurality of air inlet pipes, and the recovery box further comprises a filtering mechanism, wherein the filtering mechanism is arranged at the top of the recovery box and comprises two filtering boxes fixedly connected to the top of the recovery box. According to the utility model, by arranging the filtering mechanism, particularly, after waste heat of waste gas is utilized, the waste gas can enter the filtering box through the flowing port, the ceramic matrix composite in the ceramic matrix composite placing box can carry out first filtering interception on the waste gas, and then fine filtering is carried out through the double-layer high polymer filter core, so that the method can achieve finer filtering, has good adsorption and purification effects, and finally the filtered waste gas is discharged from the exhaust pipe, so that the influence on the surrounding environment can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Air conditioner convenient to adjust wind direction blade
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner convenient for adjusting wind direction blades, which comprises a shell, wherein a heat exchange tube is arranged on one side of the shell, a connecting frame is fixed on the front side of the shell, a wind adjusting frame is fixed on the front side of the connecting frame, wind adjusting blades are arranged on the inner side of the wind adjusting frame, first rotating shafts are fixed on the two sides of the wind adjusting blades, and the air conditioner convenient for adjusting the wind direction blades is characterized in that the wind adjusting blades are arranged through the shell, the connecting frame, the wind adjusting blades, the first rotating shafts, connecting strips, connecting blocks and an adjusting mechanism, and in the using process of the device, by opening switches of hydraulic cylinders on the upper side and the lower side, the hydraulic rods push the adjusting blocks to adjust the positions of the connecting blocks, so that the wind adjusting blades can be rotated along the first rotating shafts, a user can conveniently adjust the wind direction of the device to the direction required by the user, and the size of the wind adjusting frame can cover the whole connecting frame, thereby the blowing range of the device is enlarged, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Incinerator fire-viewing device with gas energy shock wave blowing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to garbage incinerator equipment, in particular to an incinerator fire viewing device with a gas energy shock wave purging function, which comprises a fire viewing window base, a fire viewing window and a shock wave cleaning assembly, wherein the shock wave cleaning assembly comprises a shock wave generator, a gas discharge pipe and a nozzle, one end of the fire viewing window base is connected to an incinerator outer side furnace wall guard plate, the fire viewing window base is positioned at the periphery of an end opening of a fire viewing hole, the fire viewing window is connected to one end of the fire viewing window base far away from the incinerator outer side furnace wall guard plate, one end of the shock wave generator is connected with a high-pressure gas source, the other end of the fire viewing window is connected with the gas discharge pipe, the gas discharge pipe is partially positioned at the end opening of the fire viewing hole, and the nozzle is connected to the part of the gas discharge pipe positioned at the end opening of the fire viewing hole and faces the direction of the fire viewing hole. The utility model adopts air shock wave to purge deposited ash, has small consumption of compressed air, can efficiently remove the deposited ash in the observation hole, and avoids the deposited ash from shielding the observation line of sight.

title_en: New energy area monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of monitoring and discloses new energy area monitoring equipment which comprises a supporting frame, wherein a mounting mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the supporting frame, a solar panel is arranged on one side of the mounting mechanism, a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the solar panel, the cleaning mechanism comprises right-angle plates, the right-angle plates are fixedly connected to the outer side of the solar panel, two right-angle plates are arranged, one side of each right-angle plate is fixedly connected with a protective cover, and a motor is fixedly connected inside each protective cover. This regional supervisory equipment of new energy, through the clearance mechanism that sets up, the rotary motion of threaded rod converts the linear motion of screw thread piece into, and the screw thread piece passes through the connecting block and drives the clearance piece and remove, and the clearance piece can strike off the clearance to the sticky impurity of solar panel, has guaranteed that solar panel can be stable accept solar energy, can guarantee effect and the efficiency of accepting simultaneously, and also be convenient for the staff and operate the use, reinforcing means's practicality.

title_en: Fresh air filter screen supporting frame structure with waterproof function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fresh air filter screen supporting frame structure with a waterproof function, which relates to the technical field of filter screen frames and comprises a supporting frame, wherein a filter screen main body is arranged on the inner side of the supporting frame, a fixing plate is arranged at one end of the supporting frame, mounting grooves are formed in the upper part and the lower part of two sides of the fixing plate, mounting plates are arranged on the upper part and the lower part of one end of the supporting frame, mounting blocks are arranged on the inner side of the mounting plates, positioning holes are formed in the mounting blocks, and mounting cavities are formed in the upper part and the lower part of one end of the fixing plate.

title_en: Refrigerant leakage detection system and refrigerator cabinet
abstract_en: The refrigerating fluid leakage detection system comprises a refrigerating module, a flow control valve, an infrared camera and a sensor assembly, wherein the refrigerating module comprises a compressor, a condenser and an evaporator, the compressor, the condenser and the evaporator are sequentially communicated to form a circulation loop, the flow control valve is arranged on the circulation loop and used for controlling on/off of the circulation loop, the infrared camera and the condenser are correspondingly arranged, the infrared camera can shoot the condenser and generate an infrared heat map, and the sensor assembly is used for detecting the working state of the refrigerating module and generating detection data. The refrigerant leakage detection system can be used for shooting the generated infrared heat map by the infrared camera to preliminarily judge whether the circulation loop leaks or not, and accurately judging whether the circulation loop leaks or not by using the detection data generated by the detection of the sensor component, so that the detection on whether the circulation loop leaks or not can be realized, and the refrigerant leakage detection system is also suitable for online detection in a production line and improves the detection accuracy.

title_en: Cold and hot electric energy underground energy storage system for park
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a park cold-hot electric energy underground energy storage system which comprises a low-pressure air storage tank and a plurality of high-pressure air storage tanks, wherein the low-pressure air storage tank is arranged below the ground and used for storing low-pressure carbon dioxide, the high-pressure air storage tanks are arranged in the low-pressure air storage tank and used for storing high-pressure carbon dioxide, a compressor, a heat exchanger and a heat accumulator for supplying heat to the park are arranged on the ground, heat generated by the compressor during working is transferred to the heat accumulator through the heat exchanger, a compressor inlet pipe of the compressor extends to the lower side of the low-pressure air storage tank, a gas transfer pipe of the compressor is communicated with an inlet branch pipe, a turbine and a recooler are arranged at the side part of the low-pressure air storage tank, cold storage devices for supplying cold to the park are arranged at the bottom of the low-pressure air storage tank, cold generated by the turbine is transferred to the cold storage devices through the recooler, a fluid receiving end of the turbine is communicated with an outlet branch pipe, and a turbine exhaust pipe of the turbine extends into the low-pressure air storage tank. On the premise of meeting the refrigeration and heat supply load, the utility model supplements the generated energy, adopts carbon dioxide environment-friendly gas, and is safe and reliable.

title_en: Inside does not have anti-condensation wind collector of dead zone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air coolers, and particularly discloses an anti-condensation air collector without dead zones inside, which comprises a flange plate, an air collector body and a base, wherein the flange plate is connected with an air cylinder of the air cooler, the air collector body comprises a plurality of sheet bodies which are sequentially and tightly connected, the top of each sheet body is smoothly and tightly connected with the inner wall of the flange plate, and the base is arranged at the bottom of the air collector body and is used for supporting the air collector body and the flange plate. The air cooler aims to solve the problems that the traditional air collector is easy to cause electrochemical corrosion to the inner wall surface of the air collector, the heat exchange tube bundles and the structural members and the whole service life of the air cooler is influenced due to the fact that the dead zone exists in the air collector, and small water drops are separated out and adhered to the inner wall surface of the air collector or drop onto the heat exchange tube bundles and the structural members due to cold-heat exchange of the external cold air and the internal hot air in the dead zone.

title_en: Anti-overturning component and photovoltaic flexible support system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-overturning component and a photovoltaic flexible support system, wherein a connecting frame of the anti-overturning component comprises two long rods which are connected with a steel cable and are arranged in parallel, two short rods which are connected with the anti-overturning cable and are arranged in parallel, inclined rods are connected between the end parts of the long rods and the end parts of the short rods on the same side, crosspiece rods are connected between the end parts of the parallel inclined rods, and an inclined baffle rod is connected between the parallel inclined rods, so that the connection of the connecting frame with the steel cable and the anti-overturning cable is enhanced, and the stability of the support system is enhanced.

title_en: Humidifier convenient for water injection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a humidifier convenient for water injection, which comprises a protective shell, wherein a partition plate is fixed at the upper part of the inner side of the protective shell, an atomization assembly positioned in the protective shell is arranged above the partition plate, a water storage box positioned in the protective shell is arranged below the partition plate, the water storage box is in an L-shaped structure, a mounting opening is formed in the middle of the side surface of the protective shell, and a detachable movable box is arranged in the mounting opening. This humidifier convenient to water injection is provided with two water storage containers of water storage box and removal box, and the fixed setting of water storage box is used in the humidifier main part, removes the box for dismantling the setting, when needs are with the humidifier water injection, will remove the box and can be used to flourishing water after removing, will contain the removal box of water and install in the humidifier after, the rivers can flow to the water storage box in for the humidifier supplements the water source voluntarily, and the water injection of the humidifier of being convenient for uses, and still can carry out the humidification when this humidifier water injection uses, the uninterrupted humidification operation of humidifier of being convenient for.

title_en: Air blower for purifying air in tobacco processing workshop
abstract_en: The application relates to an air blower for purifying air in a tobacco processing workshop, which comprises a shell, wherein universal wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the shell, an air inlet is formed in the lower part of the side wall of the shell, a first vertical filter layer and a second vertical filter layer are sequentially arranged at the air inlet along the air flowing direction, a first sterilization component is arranged at the position, corresponding to the air inlet, of the bottom in the shell, a third filter component is horizontally arranged above the first sterilization component in the shell, an air blowing component is arranged at the top in the shell, a second sterilization component is arranged at the inlet of the air blowing component in the shell, an air outlet is formed at the top of the shell, an outlet of the air blowing component is arranged under the air outlet, and a controller is further arranged on the shell and is electrically connected with the first sterilization component, the second sterilization component and the air blowing component. The application realizes effective filtration and sterilization of smoke dust, peculiar smell and harmful microorganisms in the air by arranging the multi-layer filtration and sterilization components, and improves the air purification effect.

title_en: Device for recovering high-temperature gas heat preheated sand
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for recycling high-temperature gas heat preheated sand, which relates to the field of waste heat recycling and comprises a first preheating cover and a second preheating cover, wherein a collecting hopper is fixedly arranged at the outer side of the bottom of the first preheating cover, an air inlet cover is fixedly arranged at the inner side of the bottom of the first preheating cover, an exhaust cover is fixedly arranged at the top of the second preheating cover, a sand inlet pipe penetrates through the outer part of the exhaust cover, and dispersing structures are arranged in the first preheating cover and the second preheating cover. The device for recycling the high-temperature gas heat to preheat the sand realizes that the sand material is preheated by utilizing the high-temperature tail gas before heating, on one hand, the utilization rate is higher by utilizing the waste heat in the high-temperature tail gas, and on the other hand, the preheated sand material can greatly reduce the energy supply amount, reduce the energy consumption and have higher practicability in the later heating process.

title_en: Silicon-containing organic waste gas heat accumulating type combustion furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a silicon-containing organic waste gas heat accumulating type combustion furnace which comprises a plurality of heat exchange areas, waste gas connecting air pipes and flue gas connecting air pipes, wherein a plurality of heat exchange pipes are arranged in each heat exchange area, a flue gas outlet air pipe and an air pipe valve group are arranged on the heat exchange area at the head end, a combustion area is arranged in the heat exchange area at the tail end, the waste gas connecting air pipes are used for connecting two adjacent heat exchange areas, the flue gas connecting air pipes are used for connecting the two adjacent heat exchange areas, each of the flue gas outlet air pipes and the flue gas connecting air pipes comprises a back blowing mechanism and a filtering mechanism, the back blowing mechanism is used for reversely blowing compressed gas into all the heat exchange pipes, and the filtering mechanism is used for filtering dust. The silicon-containing organic waste gas heat accumulating type combustion furnace provided by the utility model can automatically complete the ash cleaning work of the heat exchange tube, reduce the labor intensity of workers, and prevent excessive dust from flowing through the heat exchange tube along with flue gas by filtering silica dust.

title_en: Refrigerating system and drinking water equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses drinking water equipment and drinking water equipment, wherein a refrigerating system comprises a mounting seat, a compressor and a condenser, wherein the upper surface of the mounting seat is concavely provided with a mounting groove, the side wall of the mounting seat is provided with a mounting opening communicated with the mounting groove, the compressor is arranged on the mounting seat and positioned above the mounting groove, and the condenser is penetrated through the mounting opening and accommodated in the mounting groove and is connected with a refrigerant of the compressor. The technical scheme of the application can ensure the heat dissipation of the condenser, realize the miniaturization volume requirement and improve the installation and maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Novel indoor fire control of building is with preventing fume extractor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of smoke prevention and exhaust devices for indoor fire protection of buildings, in particular to a novel smoke prevention and exhaust device for indoor fire protection of buildings, which comprises a straight cylinder and a fan, wherein the front part of the inner wall of the straight cylinder is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the fan, the inner wall of straight section of thick bamboo is connected with filtration, filtration's top left and right sides is connected with the diaphragm respectively, the inner wall threaded connection of diaphragm has the bolt. Make the handle take the first screw rod to rotate upwards in the filtration, make the outer wall bottom of first screw rod break away from the top of support, then upwards pull the roof and take the otter board to reciprocate, make the otter board break away from the inside of support, clear up the otter board afterwards, after the end, make the otter board insert the inside of support, then the handle takes the first screw rod to rotate downwards through the roof, make the outer wall of first screw rod and the top threaded connection of support, realize the otter board clearance, guaranteed the indoor fire control of building with preventing fume extractor's life, use cost is reduced.

title_en: Cooling protection and smoke prevention device of flame identification camera for metallurgical furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling protection and smoke dust prevention device of a flame identification camera for a metallurgical furnace, which comprises an outer cover and an inner cover, wherein the inner cover is fixedly sleeved on the inner side of the outer cover, a cooling circulating water cavity is formed in the outer cover, compressed air blowback pipelines are annularly and uniformly distributed in the outer cover, nitrogen blowback pipelines are annularly and uniformly distributed in the inner cover, and an installation cavity for installing the camera is further formed in the inner side of the inner cover. According to the utility model, the compressed air blowback pipeline and the nitrogen blowback pipeline are arranged, so that the scouring and corrosion effects of on-site smoke and dust on the camera are effectively reduced, the camera can be protected from cooling, the shooting effect and the service life of the camera are effectively improved, and the centralized distribution and emission of the smoke in the kiln are promoted.

title_en: Energy-saving building curtain wall with photovoltaic power generation function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building curtain walls and discloses an energy-saving building curtain wall with a photovoltaic power generation function, which comprises a wall body and a photovoltaic panel, wherein an openable glass window is arranged on the wall body, an installation cleaning structure for conveniently cleaning the photovoltaic panel is arranged on the right side of the wall body, a limit locking mechanism matched with the installation cleaning structure is arranged on the installation cleaning structure, the installation cleaning structure comprises an installation support, the installation support is fixed on the right side of the wall body through bolts, and the energy-saving building curtain wall with the photovoltaic power generation function is convenient to clean by arranging the installation cleaning structure.

title_en: Furnace cover for preparing acetylene black
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of acetylene black preparation, and particularly relates to an acetylene black preparation furnace cover which comprises a cover body, an inner pipe and a blowing pipe, wherein an air inlet is formed in the cover body, an outer pipe is arranged on the air inlet, the inner pipe comprises a nozzle and a sleeve pipe which is arranged at one end of the nozzle in a sealing mode, one end of the nozzle is inserted into the outer pipe, a channel of 0.5mm to 2.0mm is formed between the nozzle and the outer pipe, a blowing opening is formed at one end of the channel, the blowing opening is located at one end of the nozzle, which is far away from the sleeve pipe, an auxiliary material feeding pipe is arranged on the sleeve pipe and used for adding auxiliary materials, the nozzle and the outer pipe are connected in a matched mode through a sealing piece, one end of the blowing pipe penetrates through the outer pipe, and the blowing pipe is communicated with a gas phase space of the channel. The scraper scraping mode is replaced by the inert gas blowing coking mode, the problems that the service life of the scraper is short and maintenance is difficult after the scraper is damaged and deformed under the high-temperature condition are solved, and meanwhile, auxiliary materials are more convenient to increase by increasing the auxiliary material feeding hole.

title_en: Efficient energy-saving device of impregnating machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficiency energy-saving device of a dipping machine, which comprises a box body, a first heat exchanger, a second heat exchanger, a third heat exchanger, a fan, a control air door and a work control device. The first heat exchanger, the second heat exchanger and the third heat exchanger in the box body are sequentially overlapped. The fan is arranged in the air box, an air outlet of the fan is communicated with an air inlet of the second heat exchanger, and an air outlet of the first heat exchanger is arranged at the upper part of the air box. The control air door is controlled to open and close through the air cylinder. The working process of the working control device is that when the first heat exchanger, the second heat exchanger and the third heat exchanger are connected in series and three overlapped, the control air door is in a closed working state. When the temperature control device of the working control device detects that the temperature of the exhaust gas in the first heat exchanger is too low, the air cylinder rapidly opens the control air door to prevent condensation, crystallization and scaling of the interior of the heat exchanger due to supercooling of the exhaust gas.

title_en: Boiler air inlet pipeline with impurity filtering function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boiler air inlet pipeline with an impurity filtering function, which comprises two pipeline bodies arranged in parallel, wherein a filtering module is arranged on each pipeline body, a first reversing valve is arranged between the head ends of the two pipeline bodies, a second reversing valve is arranged between the tail ends of the two pipeline bodies, the first reversing valve and the second reversing valve are two-position three-way reversing valves, the filtering module comprises a filtering shell and a filter screen, the filter screen is arranged in the filtering shell, and a plurality of filtering holes are formed in the filter screen. The boiler air inlet pipeline does not need to be stopped when the filter module is maintained, so that the boiler always keeps in a working state, and the working benefit can be improved.

title_en: Water leakage detection device for dehumidifier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dehumidifiers, and discloses a water leakage detection device for a dehumidifier, which comprises a detection mechanism, wherein the front end of the detection mechanism is provided with a collection mechanism, the detection mechanism comprises a dehumidifier body, a condenser is arranged in the dehumidifier body, a first support plate and a second support plate are respectively and fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the bottom wall in the dehumidifier body, and a first support rod is rotatably connected to the middle of the first support plate. This dehumidifier is with detection device that leaks, through built-in sensor that leaks, the device can real-time supervision condenser leak to touch audible and visual alarm immediately when detecting leaking, remind operating personnel to handle in time, effectively avoided leaking equipment damage and the potential safety hazard that leads to, the water collection frame is inside to separate into a plurality of spaces through the baffle, can accurately collect and distinguish the leaking from the condenser different positions, help operating personnel to fix a position the point of leaking fast, improve maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Novel circulation structure based on solar vacuum tube
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel circulation structure based on a solar vacuum tube, which comprises a heat preservation connecting box, the solar vacuum tube and a water tank, wherein a circulation conduit is inserted on the water tank, the circulation conduit is arranged in the heat preservation connecting box, the solar vacuum tube is positioned at two sides of the heat preservation connecting box and is uniformly distributed, the solar vacuum tube is in through connection with the circulation conduit, the circulation conduit is connected with the water tank, and a sealing cover is arranged between the circulation conduits. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the utility model can conveniently circulate the liquid in the solar vacuum tube, and can realize circulation by utilizing smaller power.

title_en: Central air conditioning atomizing economizer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of air conditioning systems, in particular to a central air conditioner atomization energy-saving device which comprises a plurality of air conditioner outer machine bodies, wherein the air conditioner outer machine bodies are mutually attached, a plurality of fixing blocks are fixedly arranged on two sides of each air conditioner outer machine body, an electric sliding rail is fixedly arranged between the fixing blocks, a sliding block is slidably arranged outside the electric sliding rail, a lifting plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the outer part of the sliding block, a plurality of fixing clamping plates are arranged inside one end of the lifting plate, a high-pressure pipeline is arranged between the fixing clamping plates, when a temperature sensor detects that the temperature of a certain area is too high, the electric sliding rail drives the plurality of high-pressure pipelines and an atomization nozzle to move, so that the effect of atomizing and cooling different areas is realized, the effect of cooling the air conditioner outer machine can be realized more comprehensively and uniformly, and the temperature of the air conveyed indoors is consistent.

title_en: Plate heat exchanger for recovering waste heat of flue gas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flue gas waste heat recovery plate heat exchanger, which comprises a plate heat exchanger body, wherein a liquid inlet pipe and a flue gas outlet pipe are respectively arranged above an end plate of the plate heat exchanger body, a liquid discharge pipe and a flue gas inlet mechanism are respectively arranged below the end plate of the plate heat exchanger body, the flue gas inlet mechanism is provided with a flue gas inlet pipe, the outer side of the circumference of the flue gas inlet pipe is fixedly provided with a pressure relief pipe, the inner circumferential wall of the interior of the pressure relief pipe is provided with a pressurizing seat, the top of the pressure relief pipe is provided with a mounting groove, the interior of the mounting groove is covered with a pressure relief piece, the surface of the pressure relief piece is covered with a compression ring, and the top of the compression ring is covered with a safety cover. The flue gas waste heat recovery plate heat exchanger can avoid the damage caused by overlarge pressure on the metal plate in the plate heat exchanger body, release the superfluous pressure, avoid the problems of deformation and rupture of the plate in the plate heat exchanger body, damage of the sealing element, loosening of the connecting part and the like caused by pressure holding, and prolong the service life of equipment.

title_en: Heat pump system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heating systems, and discloses a heat pump system. The heat pump system comprises a first heat exchange module, a multi-channel heat exchanger, a second heat exchange module and a third heat exchange module, wherein the first heat exchange module comprises a first compressor, the multi-channel heat exchanger comprises a first channel, a second channel and a third channel, the first channel is communicated with the first compressor to form a first circulation loop, the second heat exchange module comprises a second compressor and a first heat exchanger, the second compressor, a first flow path of the first heat exchanger and the third channel are sequentially communicated to form a second circulation loop, the third heat exchange module comprises a buffer water tank, a first circulation port of the buffer water tank, a second flow path of the first heat exchanger and a second circulation port of the buffer water tank are sequentially communicated to form a first heat supply loop, the heat storage water tank and the buffer water tank are communicated to form a second heat supply loop, and the heat storage water tank and the second channel are communicated to form a heat storage loop. The application can improve the stability of the heating temperature and has higher user comfort.

title_en: Underground heat exchange device for middle-deep geothermal heat
