abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medium-deep geothermal underground heat exchange device which comprises a geothermal well, a heat-taking inner pipe and a cyclone sand remover, wherein a water injection tank is fixedly arranged at an inlet of the geothermal well, a water injection port is arranged on the side wall of the water injection tank, the water injection port is connected with a water injection pipe, the heat-taking inner pipe penetrates through a through hole of the water injection tank to the inside of the geothermal well, the heat-taking inner pipe is fixedly connected with the top of the water injection tank through a fixedly connected flange ring, when the medium-taking inner pipe is used, heated medium is extracted from the bottom of the geothermal well, the extracted medium enters the heat-taking inner pipe through the filtration of a filter pipe, the output medium is conveyed into the cyclone sand remover through a connecting pipe, sand is removed again through the cyclone sand remover, and along with the increase of the medium in the cyclone sand remover, the medium flows out from a water outlet head through a filter cover fixedly arranged at the bottom of a barrel cover, so that the medium extracted from the geothermal well is filtered for multiple times, and the medium is beneficial to the cleaning of the output medium.

title_en: Wine heat exchange device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wine heat exchange device which comprises a rack, wherein the rack is provided with a heat exchange component, the heat exchange component is communicated with a hot wine liquid inlet pipe, a hot wine liquid outlet pipe, a cold wine liquid inlet pipe and a cold wine liquid outlet pipe, temperature measuring devices for measuring the temperature of wine liquid are arranged on the hot wine liquid outlet pipe, the cold wine liquid inlet pipe and the cold wine liquid outlet pipe, and an oxygen removal component is arranged on the cold wine liquid outlet pipe. According to the wine heat exchange device, through the arrangement of the heat exchange component and the temperature measuring device, the cold wine liquid can exchange heat with the hot wine liquid so as to cool the hot wine liquid and enable the cold wine liquid to return to temperature, and the effects of cooling the hot wine liquid and returning the cold wine liquid are ensured, so that energy consumption is reduced. Meanwhile, due to the arrangement of the deoxidizing component, the dissolved oxygen in the cold wine can be replaced by nitrogen, so that excessive oxygen in the wine can be removed, the oxidation and deterioration of the wine can be prevented, and the flavor of the wine can be maintained.

title_en: Rotary kiln air supply device
abstract_en: The application discloses an air supply device of a rotary kiln, and belongs to the technical field of rotary kilns. The utility model provides a rotary kiln air supply device, includes air supply module, air supply module fixed mounting in the barrel outside, barrel outside fixed mounting has the air supply to be responsible for, and the air supply is responsible for and is the heliciform setting, and the connecting pipe is installed to air supply module output, and air supply module output is responsible for the interior air supply of air supply through the connecting pipe, is equipped with a plurality of air supply branch pipes between air supply person in charge and the barrel, and the air supply is responsible for and is responsible for the air supply in the barrel through the air supply branch pipe. Through setting up the air feed main pipe that is the heliciform for this device can be with the help of air feed main pipe and air feed branch pipe to the different positions of barrel supply air, can increase the combustion efficiency in the barrel, promotes rotary kiln calcination productivity and energy saving and consumption reduction.

title_en: Biomass boiler capable of combusting double fuel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biomass boiler capable of combusting double fuel, and belongs to the technical field of biomass boilers. A biomass boiler capable of combusting double fuel comprises a boiler body arranged on a supporting part, wherein the boiler body consists of a hearth and a cooling chamber, the water cooling chamber is fixedly connected to the boiler body, a feeder is fixedly connected to the boiler body, a fire grate is fixedly connected to the boiler body, the boiler can simultaneously combust solid biomass fuel and liquid fuel, the problem that the biomass fuel is limited by regional productivity is effectively solved, the boiler is provided with a denitration part, the emission of nitrogen oxides in flue gas can be effectively reduced, and the environmental protection requirement is met, and meanwhile, a high-temperature superheater, a low-temperature superheater, a high-temperature economizer and a low-temperature economizer are arranged, so that heat in the flue gas is fully recovered, and the steam quality and the boiler thermal efficiency are improved. The air preheater heats air by utilizing the waste heat of the flue gas, so that the full combustion of fuel is further promoted, and the energy waste is reduced.

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner, which comprises a shell and an evaporator, wherein a first air inlet and a second air inlet are arranged on the shell, the first air inlet and the second air inlet are respectively positioned at two opposite sides of the shell in the width direction, the evaporator is arranged in the shell, the evaporator surrounds a V-shaped groove which is formed to extend along the length direction of the shell, and the opening of the V-shaped groove is inclined towards the first air inlet or the second air inlet. The air conditioner provided by the utility model has the advantages of small resistance when the internal air flow passes through the evaporator and high heat exchange degree of each area of the evaporator.

title_en: Power supply circuit and air conditioning equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a power supply circuit and an air conditioning apparatus. The power supply circuit comprises a detection module, a switch module and a control module, wherein the detection module is used for detecting electric information of the air conditioning equipment, the electric information is used for reflecting the working state of the air conditioning equipment, the switch module is electrically connected between a filter screen of the air conditioning equipment and a power supply, the switch module is used for enabling the filter screen and the power supply to be connected or disconnected, and the control module is electrically connected with the detection module and the switch module and is used for controlling the switch module according to the electric information so as to enable the filter screen and the power supply to be connected or enable the filter screen and the power supply to be disconnected. The detection module can detect the working state of the air conditioning equipment, and the control module controls the on/off of the switch module when the working state of the air conditioning equipment is changed, so that the working state of the filter screen is consistent with that of the air conditioning equipment, and the power consumption of the filter screen is reduced.

title_en: Kiln head cover of rotary kiln
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of kiln hoods of rotary kilns, in particular to a kiln hood of a rotary kiln, which comprises a base, wherein a feeding bin is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a rotary kiln main body is rotatably arranged at one side of the feeding bin, a kiln hood is movably arranged at one side of the rotary kiln main body, the kiln hood further comprises a cleaning mechanism for cleaning dust in the kiln hood, the cleaning mechanism comprises a second motor, the second motor is fixedly arranged at one side of the kiln hood, an output shaft of the second motor is fixedly connected with a connecting shaft, a third gear is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the connecting shaft, the connecting shaft drives fan blades to rotate through the output shaft of the second motor, the connecting shaft drives the fan blades to rotate so as to reduce the amount of dust in the rotary kiln main body entering the kiln hood, meanwhile, the connecting shaft drives the third gear to rotate, and the fourth gear drives a water pipe and a spray nozzle to rotate under the action of a water pump so as to clean the inner wall of the kiln hood.

title_en: Light seal for plate-fin heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a light seal for a plate-fin heat exchanger, which comprises a seal body, wherein the cross section of the seal body is of a bilateral symmetry structure, the left side of the outer part of the seal body is provided with a left waist surface, the lower part of the left waist surface is provided with a positioning clamping groove I along the length direction of the left waist surface, the right side of the outer part of the seal body is provided with a right waist surface, the lower part of the right waist surface is provided with a positioning clamping groove II along the length direction of the right waist surface, the bottom of the outer side of the seal body is provided with a concave surface, the left waist surface and the right waist surface can be accurately clamped between two side partition plates under the matching of the positioning clamping groove I and the positioning clamping groove II, the situations of linear deviation and clamping misplacement in the welding process are avoided, and a plurality of welding strengthening grooves are further arranged on the welding extension line of the clamping grooves, so that brazing materials can be automatically filled in the grooves, the connection strength of a welding line is improved, the welding firmness and the sealing performance of the seal are effectively improved under the mutual matching, and the normal use of the heat exchanger is ensured.

title_en: Electric steam generator
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electric steam generator, which comprises a water-steam separation module, an electric heating module, a first conveying pump, a second conveying pump and a control module, wherein the bottom of the water-steam separation module is provided with a water supplementing port and a water pumping port, the top of the water-steam separation module is provided with a steam inlet and a steam outlet, a water level sensor is arranged in the water-steam separation module, the first conveying pump is connected with the water supplementing port, the second conveying pump is connected with the water pumping port and a water inlet of the electric heating module, an output port of the electric heating module is connected with the steam inlet, and the control module controls the first conveying pump to start and stop according to feedback of the water level sensor. The electric steam generator provided by the utility model has the advantages of small volume and convenience in installation, and can recycle the water separated from the vapor and the liquid, thereby effectively improving the thermal efficiency of the equipment.

title_en: High-efficient semi-coke boiler that is difficult for coking
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-efficiency semi-coke boiler which is difficult to coke, and the high-efficiency semi-coke boiler comprises a base, wherein a heat recovery component and a combustion component are fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a top plate is fixedly arranged at the tops of the heat recovery component and the combustion component, a conveying cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of the top plate, an induced draft fan is fixedly arranged at the top of the conveying cylinder, a chimney is fixedly arranged at the output end of the induced draft fan, a fuel switch door is hinged at the top of the top plate, an ash removal door is hinged at the front of the heat recovery component, an air inlet is formed in the right side of the combustion component, the heat recovery component comprises a heat recovery box, and the heat recovery box is fixedly arranged at the left side of the top of the base. This difficult coking's high-efficient semi-coke boiler installs the collection can storehouse additional above the burning disc, and the conveyer pipe changes to collect can below the storehouse, gathers can the storehouse and reach behind the heat saturation and absorb the negative pressure away, remain the heat, and the burning disc slope increases, makes fuel burning abundant, and the lime-ash just easily drops, difficult coking.

title_en: Circulation heating device of water massager
abstract_en: The utility model provides a circulating heating device of a water massager, which relates to the technical field of water massagers and comprises a fixed box, wherein one side of the fixed box is connected with a water pipe connector, the inside of the fixed box is connected with a water pump, one side of the water pump is connected with a first connecting wire, the bottom of the first connecting wire is connected with a connecting box, the bottom of the connecting box is connected with a heating block, and the bottom of the heating block is connected with a second connecting wire. The utility model reduces the volume of the product to 50% of original volume, simplifies the structure by heating water at two sides, increases the heat dissipation area by adding ribs inside, has the same effect of heating, has about half of the original power consumption and higher heat efficiency ratio, ensures that the local temperature is less than 70 ℃ and no scale is generated, and has higher safety if the air-firing temperature is less than 200 ℃ under special conditions.

title_en: Adjustable water collector and cooling tower
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable water receiver and cooling tower, relates to cooling equipment technical field, and this adjustable water receiver includes the circulation route that supplies the air current in the cooling tower passes through to and be supported as rotatable receipts water board, the receipts water board makes adjustable water receiver has the first state that the circulation route is opened, and the second state that the circulation route is closed. The utility model can open or close the air flow path in the water spraying space, can play a role in water collection when being opened, and can cut off the upward air flow path in the water spraying space when the adjustable water collector is closed, and the adjustable water collector can also be adjusted to a proper opening degree so as to adapt to the change of climate conditions, thereby realizing the optimization of water saving and fog dissipating effects.

title_en: Warmer with hollow ignition disc and inner and outer injection pipes
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heaters, in particular to a heater with a hollow ignition disc and an inner injection tube, which comprises a heater combustion part, wherein the hollow ignition disc is arranged in the heater combustion part, the inner injection tube is arranged in an outer injection tube and is a hollow pipeline, the inner injection tube is arranged in the outer injection tube, a combustion head upper cover and a combustion head lower cover are arranged above the inner injection tube and the outer injection tube, hollow structures are arranged between the combustion head upper cover and the combustion head lower cover, the inner injection tube is fixedly connected with the combustion head upper cover, the outer injection tube is fixedly connected with the combustion head lower cover, and the combustion head upper cover and the combustion head lower cover are fixedly connected to form a hollow combustion head assembly structure, so that the effects of greatly reducing the space of a combustion head furnace chamber of a gas heater, optimizing a gas and air mixing path, improving the control precision of the mixing ratio, improving the combustion efficiency, remarkably improving the stability of external flame and reducing the tempering risk are achieved.

title_en: Plate cooler convenient to dismantle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plate cooler convenient to detach, which relates to the technical field of plate coolers and comprises a fixed plate, a movable plate, fastening bolts, a positioning rod, a plate group and a plurality of plates, wherein the plate group is formed by stacking the plates, the plate group is arranged between the fixed plate and the movable plate and is fixed by the fastening bolts, the plate cooler further comprises a plurality of stirring sheets, the stirring sheets and the plates are in one-to-one correspondence, the stirring sheets are arranged on the side surfaces of the plates in an equidistant and same-row mode, the vertical thickness of the stirring sheets is larger than the distance between the adjacent stirring sheets, the transverse thickness of the stirring sheets is smaller than the distance between the adjacent stirring sheets, the driving device is in driving connection with the stirring sheets, and the driving device is used for driving the stirring sheets to sequentially extend between the adjacent stirring sheets and rotate so as to separate the adjacent attached plates. The utility model provides a plate cooler convenient to detach, which is characterized in that the side surface of a plate is provided with the poking sheets, the poking sheets are controlled to sequentially extend between the adjacent poking sheets to push the adjacent poking sheets away from each other, so that the plate is quickly separated, and the detaching efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Air conditioner inner unit hanger positioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner indoor unit hanger positioner, which belongs to the technical field of air conditioner construction and is characterized by comprising a middle block, wherein two slide ways are arranged on the middle block, slide bars are arranged in the slide ways in a sliding manner, mounting plates are fixedly arranged at the outer ends of the slide bars, two positioning columns corresponding to hanger reserved holes are arranged on the inner walls of the mounting plates, when the outer walls of the hangers are contacted with the inner surfaces of the mounting plates, the inner walls of the hangers protrude out of the inner walls of the middle block or are flush with the inner walls of the middle block, and leveling bubbles are fixedly arranged on the outer walls of the middle block. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the mounting hole of the hanging frame can be positioned by means of the reserved hole on the hanging frame, the structure is simple, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Aluminum wafer stamping waste recycling smelting furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum wafer stamping waste recycling smelting furnace, which comprises a smelting furnace body and a smelting barrel, wherein the smelting barrel is arranged in the smelting furnace body, the top of the smelting furnace body is connected with a top cover through a rotating frame, a lifting handle is arranged at the top of the top cover, a control table is arranged on the side surface of the smelting furnace body, a placing frame is arranged on the outer side of the control table, a connecting plate is arranged on the inner side of the placing frame, the side surface of the connecting plate is connected with a round block, and a hook is fixedly connected in the round block. This smelting furnace is retrieved to aluminium disk punching press waste material through the internally mounted couple at the link, and the staff takes out the instrument of taking, inlays the couple inside the link, is holding the handle in the connecting rod outside, upwards removes the smelting barrel from the smelting furnace body inboard, and the smelting that will smelt is also taken out to the convenience like this, because take from both sides is balanced, the operation of taking is comparatively simple when using.

title_en: Air conditioner refrigerant knockout
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioners and discloses an air conditioner refrigerant liquid dispenser which comprises a refrigerant liquid dispenser, an installation bottom plate, a buffer rubber pad, a fixing screw hole, a sealing groove, a carbon fiber layer, a polyamide fiber layer, a cellulose nanofiber layer, a polypropylene fiber layer, a thermoplastic elastic layer and waterproof coating fibers, wherein the installation bottom plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the refrigerant liquid dispenser, the buffer rubber pad is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the installation bottom plate, the fixing screw hole is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the installation bottom plate, and an injection pipe is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the refrigerant liquid dispenser. According to the air conditioner refrigerant dispenser, through improvement of the refrigerant dispenser, the refrigerant dispensing capability of the refrigerant dispenser is improved, and in the actual use process of the refrigerant dispenser, the refrigerant dispenser can be rapidly dispensed according to requirements, so that the air conditioner refrigerant dispenser can be conveniently used for refrigerating, and the use experience of the air conditioner refrigerant dispenser is improved.

title_en: Hot gas bypass defrosting system of refrigerator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hot gas bypass defrosting system of a refrigerator, wherein an exhaust port of a compressor is connected with a condenser through a first pipeline, an air suction port of the compressor is connected with a return pipeline, an outlet of a throttling component is connected with a second pipeline, a coil pipe of an evaporator is divided into two independent sections, one section close to a fan of the evaporator is a first coil pipe, the other section is a second coil pipe, air inlet ports of the first coil pipe and the second coil pipe are respectively connected with a first diversion branch and a second diversion branch, the other ends of the two diversion branches are converged at the tail end of the second pipeline, a first node, a second node and a total air valve are sequentially arranged on the first pipeline at intervals, the first node is connected to the first diversion branch through a first bypass branch, the second node is connected to the second pipeline through a second bypass branch, and the two bypass branches are respectively provided with the air valves. The utility model has the advantages that the coil pipe of the evaporator is divided into a two-section structure, the sectional defrosting control of the coil pipe of the evaporator is realized, and the energy consumption and the refrigeration cycle heat load of the refrigerator are reduced.

title_en: Soot blower for improving heat exchanger efficiency of special waste fluidized bed incinerator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a soot blower for improving the efficiency of a heat exchanger of a special waste fluidized bed incinerator, which comprises a fluidized bed incinerator body with a dense-phase area of a combustion chamber and a dilute-phase area of the combustion chamber, wherein a flue gas output channel of the fluidized bed incinerator body is provided with an upper boiler barrel, a lower boiler barrel and a convection tube bundle connected between the upper boiler barrel and the lower boiler barrel, a gas pulse soot blower is arranged on the flue gas output channel at a position opposite to the convection tube bundle, the gas pulse soot blower is connected with a gas mixer through a pipeline, the input end of the gas mixer is respectively connected with the output end of an acetylene cylinder and the output end of a compressed air tank, and combustible gas sprayed by the gas pulse soot blower is ignited and deflagrated in a gap manner to realize the vibration and drop of fly ash attached to the convection tube bundle. The soot blower has reasonable design, is favorable for cleaning the accumulated ash and coking on the convection tube bundle connected between the upper boiler barrel and the lower boiler barrel, and ensures the heat exchange efficiency of the incinerator.

title_en: Cooking assembly and microwave oven
abstract_en: The application provides a cooking assembly and a microwave oven, wherein the cooking assembly is applied to the microwave oven and is provided with a cooking cavity, a plurality of first microwave feed openings are formed in the cavity bottom wall of the cooking cavity, the cooking assembly comprises a microwave generator and a waveguide channel, the microwave generator is used for generating microwaves, the waveguide channel is used for conducting the microwaves generated by the microwave generator to the cooking cavity through the plurality of first microwave feed openings, the waveguide channel comprises a plurality of standing waves which are arranged along the propagation direction of the microwaves, the cavity bottom wall is uniformly divided into a plurality of subareas along the propagation direction of the microwaves, the number of the subareas is the same as that of the standing waves, at least one first microwave feed opening is arranged in each subarea, the center of each subarea is taken as an origin of a corresponding four quadrant, and the first microwave feed openings of two adjacent subareas are arranged in pairs, wherein the absolute value of the difference of the number of quadrants in the subareas where the same pair of first microwave feed openings are positioned is 2. The cooking assembly and the microwave oven provided by the application can improve radiation efficiency.

title_en: Waste heat recovery system of setting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste heat recovery system of a setting machine. The waste gas incinerator comprises a setting machine, a waste gas incinerator, an exhaust port, a heat exchange coil, a filter screen plate and a filter screen plate, wherein the waste gas incinerator is communicated with the interior of the setting machine, the exhaust port is arranged on the surface of the waste gas incinerator and is communicated with the interior of the waste gas incinerator, the heat exchange coil is fixed in the interior of the exhaust port, the filter screen plate is arranged in the interior of the exhaust port, the filter screen plate is detachably connected with the exhaust port, and the filter screen plate is positioned on one side, close to the interior of the waste gas incinerator, of the heat exchange coil. The utility model has the advantages of well avoiding dust particles and other impurities from adhering to the heat exchange coil, ensuring the heat energy recovery efficiency, avoiding blockage, along with simple and convenient connection mode, convenient installation, disassembly and replacement and improving the installation stability of the filter screen plate.

title_en: Foot margin and air condensing units
abstract_en: The application discloses a foot and an air conditioner outdoor unit, wherein the air conditioner outdoor unit comprises a chassis, a plurality of installation areas are arranged on the bottom surface of the chassis, a plurality of first positioning parts are respectively arranged on the installation areas, the foot comprises a main body, a second positioning part is arranged on the main body and is configured to be matched with the corresponding first positioning parts when the main body is installed in any one of the installation areas of the chassis. According to the foundation, the second positioning parts which can be matched with the plurality of first positioning parts are arranged on the main body, so that a single kind of foundation can adapt to the installation requirements of different compression areas of the chassis, the universality of the foundation is improved, the management cost and the die sinking cost are reduced, and the management difficulty is reduced.

title_en: Crucible furnace for zinc oxide production
abstract_en: A crucible furnace for zinc oxide production. Relates to the field of zinc oxide production equipment. The device comprises a furnace body, a melting crucible and an evaporating crucible, wherein the melting crucible and the evaporating crucible are arranged at the top of the furnace body and are communicated through a flow guide pipe, the device further comprises a movable platform, a high-position sliding rail is arranged at the top of the platform, a baffle plate can slide on the high-position sliding rail, a sliding groove is formed in the baffle plate, an expansion body is arranged on one side, facing the baffle plate, of the baffle plate, a holding rod penetrates through the sliding groove and can slide in the sliding groove, an air pipe penetrates through the holding rod and is used for conveying air into the expansion body, and the expansion body can be inserted into the melting crucible. The application has the characteristics that the material can be pushed into the guide pipe through the expansion of the expansion body, so that the situation that the staff needs to add the material frequently is avoided.

title_en: Assembled open hearth furnace end
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembled open hearth furnace end, which comprises an open hearth furnace body, wherein the top end of the open hearth furnace body is provided with a connecting port, the connecting port is provided with a furnace end body, the furnace end body is provided with a fixing assembly, the top end of the open hearth furnace body is fixedly connected with telescopic chambers which are positioned on two sides of the connecting port, the telescopic chambers are connected with telescopic rods in a sliding manner, one end of each telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a supporting ring, and the top ends of the supporting rings are fixedly connected with a plurality of supporting blocks. According to the utility model, the height of the support ring can be flexibly adjusted through the adjusting component formed by the telescopic chamber, the telescopic rod, the first pin hole, the second pin hole and the pin shaft, and meanwhile, the air is actively fed by combining the fan fixed in the air conveying pipe, so that the adaptation to different use environments and the optimization of combustion efficiency are realized.

title_en: Water-cooling screw low-temperature brine machine set for chemical production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water-cooled screw low-temperature brine units, and discloses a water-cooled screw low-temperature brine unit for chemical production, which comprises a brine conveying pump, wherein two ends of the brine conveying pump are respectively communicated with a water inlet pipe and a water conveying pipe, the top of the water conveying pipe is fixedly connected with an equipment box, the bottom of the water conveying pipe is communicated with a side pipe, the side pipe and a trash discharging pipe are arranged at the bottom of the water conveying pipe, a piston is driven to lift by a servo electric cylinder to realize reciprocating driving of a scraping mechanism in the water conveying pipe, a scraping ring can be attached to the pipe wall to clean deposited salt and impurities, and a butterfly valve linkage mechanism is combined to conduct pipe sealing and cleaning flow passage switching, so that deposits are effectively removed, blockage is prevented, and meanwhile, the deposits are prevented from being reduced in efficiency along with flowing into a heat exchanger by timely discharging the trash discharging pipe.

title_en: Condensate recovery system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of condensate water recovery, in particular to a condensate water recovery system which comprises a condensate water recovery unit, a conveying unit and a temperature regulating unit, wherein the condensate water recovery unit is used for being connected with a vapor seal cooler of a vapor driven compressor so as to collect condensate water discharged by the vapor seal cooler, the conveying unit is communicated with the condensate water recovery unit and target utilization equipment which is an open system, the temperature regulating unit is used for regulating the temperature of the condensate water between the condensate water recovery unit and the target utilization equipment, and the condensate water recovery system provided by the utility model can reduce or avoid the direct discharge of the vapor seal condensate water of the vapor driven compressor, so that the resource waste and the influence on the environment are reduced.

title_en: Pipeline scale cleaning tool
abstract_en: The utility model aims to provide a tool for cleaning scale of a pipeline, which comprises an extension rod, a cutting head and liquid delivery and is characterized in that the front end of the extension rod is provided with the cutting head, the rear end of the extension rod is provided with a connector, a liquid spraying ring is arranged at the joint of the extension rod and the cutting head, the outer diameter of the liquid spraying ring is slightly larger than the diameter of the cutting head, a plurality of liquid spraying ports are arranged at the position, close to the outer circumference, of the front end surface of the liquid spraying ring, of the extension rod, a liquid channel is arranged in the extension rod, the rear end of the liquid channel is positioned at the rear part of the extension rod, the front end of the liquid channel extends to the position of the liquid spraying ring and is connected with the liquid spraying ports of the liquid spraying ring, and a plurality of liquid inlet holes communicated with the liquid channel are arranged at the rear part of the extension rod. The utility model can realize the function of safely cleaning the scale in the tube of the tube type water cooler.

title_en: Stepped household dehumidifier
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of dehumidifiers, in particular to a stepped household dehumidifier which comprises a dehumidifier body, a movable roller, a positioning convex part and a limiting part, wherein a dehumidification assembly is integrally arranged in the dehumidifier body and used for carrying out cooling, dehumidification, heating and drying circulation on indoor air, an external water tank is arranged on the outer side wall of the dehumidifier body, which is close to the lower side, and used for collecting moisture condensed from the air, the movable roller is arranged on the outer side wall of the dehumidifier body and is in rolling connection with the ground, and the positioning convex part is fixedly arranged on the surface of the dehumidifier body, which is close to one side of the movable roller, and when the other dehumidifiers are aligned and are mutually close to each other, the external water tank and the positioning convex part are mutually extruded to form the limiting part. The application has the effect of facilitating the arrangement and alignment of the household dehumidifier.

title_en: Distillation and layering extraction equipment for mugwort essential oil
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distillation and layering extraction device for mugwort essential oil, and belongs to the technical field of mugwort essential oil distillation. The utility model relates to a distillation layering extraction device for mugwort essential oil, which comprises a distillation kettle, a condensation tank body arranged on the vapor outlet end of the distillation kettle, an air inlet and a liquid outlet respectively arranged on the end surface of the condensation tank body, a water inlet pipe and a water outlet respectively arranged on the circumferential surface of the condensation tank body, a mounting piece rotatably arranged in the condensation tank body, a condensation area defined by the mounting piece, a spiral condensation pipe arranged in the condensation area in a crossed manner, two ends of the condensation pipe respectively communicated with the air inlet and the liquid outlet, and fins arranged on the periphery of the pipe wall of the condensation pipe.

title_en: Sintering equipment convenient to clearance frivolous air curtain brick processing is with
abstract_en: The utility model discloses sintering equipment for conveniently cleaning light and thin air curtain wall bricks, which comprises a sintering furnace, wherein door opening and closing devices are arranged on the left side and the right side of the sintering furnace, a sealing door is arranged on the front side of each door opening and closing device, a cleaning mechanism comprises a dust accumulation box fixedly connected to the front side of the sintering furnace, a cleaning frame is placed in the sintering furnace, a handle is fixedly connected to the front side of the cleaning frame, two vertical cleaning plates are fixedly connected to the surface of the cleaning frame, and four corner cleaning plates are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the cleaning frame. When the cleaning device is used, under the action of the cleaning mechanism, the safety mechanism and the releasing mechanism, the interior of the sintering furnace can be cleaned quickly, meanwhile, the safety of cleaning staff is ensured, the cleaning inconvenience and easy injury caused by difficult cleaning of the sintering furnace and great potential safety hazard are avoided, and the cleaning device has the advantage of convenient use.

title_en: Burner for mixing kiln gas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a burner for mixing kiln gas, which belongs to the technical field of combustion equipment and is technically characterized by comprising a burner assembly, a flow guide assembly and a mixing cavity assembly. When gas and air are injected into the kiln, the gas and the air can be injected into the mixing pipe through the gas injection pipe and the connecting pipeline in advance, then the air injected in advection can be guided into swirl air through the deflecting guide mechanism, so that subsequent air and the gas can be contacted conveniently, preliminary mixing can be carried out, and in the subsequent use, in order to enable the air and the gas to be further mixed, a mixing cavity assembly can be arranged in the mixing pipe at the moment, and the spiral guide plate is of a spiral structure, so that the gas and the air can have longer contact time, so that the gas and the air can be contacted more fully, and the gas and the air can be mixed more fully.

title_en: Photovoltaic-power grid dual-mode semiconductor thermoelectric refrigeration household temperature regulating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of temperature control, in particular to a photovoltaic-power grid dual-mode semiconductor thermoelectric refrigeration household temperature regulating device; the household thermoelectric refrigeration household temperature regulating device comprises a photovoltaic power generation module, a dual-mode power supply module, an intelligent temperature control module and a wireless transmission module, wherein the photovoltaic power generation module consists of a photovoltaic frame, a photovoltaic plate arranged on the photovoltaic frame and a regulating structure for driving the photovoltaic frame to rotate and regulate the azimuth, the dual-mode power supply module comprises a photovoltaic power supply unit, a national network power supply unit and a dual-power automatic transfer switch for automatic switching between the photovoltaic power supply unit and the national network power supply unit, the intelligent temperature control module is electrically connected with a thermoelectric semiconductor refrigeration component and a thermoelectric semiconductor heating component and is used for controlling a refrigeration/heating mode according to the ambient temperature and the target temperature, the wireless transmission module is in communication connection with the intelligent temperature control module and is used for receiving a temperature control instruction sent by an external terminal, and high-efficiency utilization of energy and rapid and accurate regulation of indoor temperature are realized.

title_en: Rotary kiln rolling ring fixing and limiting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary kiln rolling ring fixing and limiting structure, which comprises a rotary cylinder body, wherein a rolling ring is arranged on the outer side of the rotary cylinder body, a fixing and limiting assembly is arranged between the rolling ring and the rotary cylinder body, the fixing and limiting assembly comprises a plurality of wedge blocks I and wedge blocks II arranged on the rotary cylinder body, a plurality of limiting stop blocks are arranged on two sides of the rolling ring, a mounting gap is reserved between the limiting stop blocks and the rolling ring, and a mounting gap is reserved between the wedge blocks I and II and the inner ring of the rolling ring.

title_en: Welding torch with changeable spray head types
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding torches, and particularly discloses a welding torch with a switchable spray head type, which comprises a handle, wherein a fixed joint is arranged on the handle, an oxygen regulating valve and a gas regulating valve are arranged on the fixed joint, the oxygen regulating valve is used for connecting an oxygen cylinder, the gas regulating valve is used for connecting a gas cylinder, and an oxygen spray head or an oxygen-free spray head is detachably arranged at the front end of the fixed joint. The welding torch can be selectively provided with the oxygen spray nozzle or the anaerobic spray nozzle according to the use requirement, so that the welding torch is switched into the oxygen welding torch or the anaerobic welding torch, has the advantages of high flame temperature of the oxygen welding torch, can be used for welding and cutting, is portable, light in weight and long in gas use time, simultaneously eliminates the defects of the oxygen welding torch and the anaerobic welding torch, is convenient and quick to switch, meets the use requirement of various scenes, and is higher in universality.

title_en: Steam generating device with pressure relief structure and household appliance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam generating device with a pressure relief structure and a household appliance. The steam generating device with the pressure relief structure comprises a flow channel plate, a heating plate and a pressure relief structure, wherein the flow channel plate is provided with an opening, a first water inlet, a steam outlet and an opposite joint, a flow channel is arranged in the flow channel plate, the heating plate comprises a plate body and a heating piece arranged on one side of the plate body, which is away from the heating piece, is covered on the opening, and the pressure relief structure is connected with the flow channel plate and is provided with a pressure relief opening, and the pressure relief opening is communicated with the opposite joint. According to the steam generating device with the pressure relief structure, through the arrangement of the pressure relief structure, the excessive steam with the technical pressure can be discharged, and the use safety is ensured.

title_en: Guide plate for mixing gas
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas burners, in particular to a guide plate for mixing gas, which comprises a central ring part and an outer ring part which are integrally formed, wherein the outer ring part and the central ring part are concentrically arranged, the central ring part forms a central through hole matched with a guide plate, a plurality of guide ports are arranged at the edge of the central through hole, and the guide plate is lifted from the guide ports to the upper part of the guide plate when the mixed gas of gas and air is conveyed to the lower part of the guide plate from a gas injection pipeline. According to the utility model, through optimizing the structure of the guide plate, the mixed gas of the gas injection pipeline is guided to enter the mixing cavity above, so that uniform and stable flow of the gas is realized, and the subsequent stable combustion is promoted, so that the combustion efficiency is improved conveniently, the deflagration is avoided, and the explosion is eliminated.

title_en: Shell and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and provides a housing and an air conditioner, wherein the housing comprises a housing body and prefabricated hole pieces, the housing body is at least provided with a first end face, a second end face and a bottom face, the first end face, the second end face and the bottom face are provided with pipe passing holes, any one pipe passing hole is used for a drain pipe to pass through, each pipe passing hole corresponds to one prefabricated hole piece, the prefabricated hole pieces are arranged on the pipe passing holes, the outline shape of the prefabricated hole pieces is matched with the outline shape of the pipe passing holes, the edges of the prefabricated hole pieces are at least partially connected with the edges of the pipe passing holes, and the prefabricated hole pieces and the housing body are integrally formed. The prefabricated hole sheet of the outlet pipe hole corresponding to the outlet pipe end of the indoor unit on the bottom surface of the housing body can be removed for the indoor unit with the outlet pipe end needing to be abutted against the wall surface, so that the drain pipe penetrates through the bottom surface of the housing body, the gap requirement between the end surface of the indoor unit and the wall surface can be reduced or even avoided, and the installation requirement of the end surface of the indoor unit abutted against the wall surface is met.

title_en: Miniature portable potassium sulfate experiment reaction furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a miniature portable potassium sulfate experimental reaction furnace, which comprises a reaction furnace body, wherein the reaction furnace body consists of a reaction tank and a combustion tank, the reaction tank is inserted into the combustion tank, a sliding groove is formed in the inner wall of the combustion tank, a sliding block is arranged on the peripheral side surface of the reaction tank and is in sliding connection with the sliding groove, a second fixing hole and a third fixing hole are respectively formed in the two sides of the surface of the sliding block, a first fixing hole is formed in the peripheral side surface of the combustion tank, the reaction furnace body consists of the reaction tank and the combustion tank, and the reaction tank is fixedly arranged in the combustion tank through the sliding connection of the sliding block and the sliding groove and the penetrating of a fastening piece through the fixing holes. The design not only realizes the convenient disassembly and assembly of the reaction tank and the combustion tank and is convenient to carry, but also ensures the close fit of the reaction tank and the combustion tank when in use, so that the heat generated by the combustion tank is efficiently transferred to the reaction tank, and the stable reaction temperature is ensured.

title_en: Explosion-proof leak hunting device of hot-blast furnace ignition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ignition explosion-proof leakage detection device of a hot blast stove, which comprises a natural gas buffer tank, a gas pipe, a pressure measuring instrument A, a pressure measuring instrument B, a flowmeter, a switch valve A, a regulating valve and the hot blast stove, wherein the gas pipe is respectively connected with the natural gas buffer tank and a four-way pipe, the pressure measuring instrument A, the flowmeter, the switch valve A and the pressure measuring instrument B are arranged on the pipe, the four-way pipe is also connected with three gas pipes, the gas pipes are communicated with the hot blast stove, the three gas pipes are respectively provided with the switch valve B, the switch valve C and the switch valve D, and the pipeline where the switch valve D is also connected with the regulating valve. The device can accurately position the leakage point by utilizing the cooperation of the pressure measuring instrument and the switch valve, reduces maintenance cost, has safety, economy and practicability, and effectively ensures ignition safety.

title_en: Self-preheating type gas heating preheating furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-preheating type gas heating preheating furnace which comprises a furnace body, a transmission assembly, a plurality of circulation assemblies and a plurality of heating devices, wherein a furnace chamber is arranged in the furnace body, a workpiece is transmitted through the furnace chamber by the transmission assembly, the furnace chamber is divided into a plurality of sections along the workpiece transmission direction, each section is combined with the circulation assembly and the plurality of heating devices, the circulation assembly and the plurality of heating devices are arranged at the top of the transmission assembly, the plurality of heating devices are arranged at the bottom of the transmission assembly, and the heating devices are self-preheating type gas heating devices. The self-preheating type gas heating preheating furnace adopts a self-preheating type heating device, is efficient and energy-saving, and has higher energy utilization rate and lower energy consumption.

title_en: Water tank assembly and water vapor generating device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water tank assembly and a water vapor generating device, and relates to the technical field of water tanks. The water tank assembly comprises a tank body and a floating assembly, wherein a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the tank body, at least two annular abutting parts are arranged at the lower end of the tank body and at the water outlet, one of the at least two annular abutting parts comprises a sealing ring which is arranged at the water outlet and extends downwards, a matching part is arranged at the upper end of a floating piece of the floating assembly, the matching part is in sealing abutting connection with the two annular abutting parts to seal the water outlet, and at least part of the matching part is separated from the two annular abutting parts to open the water outlet. According to the embodiment of the utility model, the sealing state and the opening state are switched by arranging at least two annular abutting parts at the water outlet port and matching with the up-and-down floating action of the floating piece. The annular abutting parts are in sealing abutting connection with the matching parts to form a multi-layer sealing barrier, so that the sealing reliability is improved.

title_en: Fume collecting hood assembly, machine head and integrated kitchen
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a smoke collecting hood assembly, a machine head and an integrated kitchen, and relates to the technical field of cooking equipment. The fume collecting hood assembly comprises a front plate, a rear plate and a decoration strip, wherein the front plate is provided with a top wall in the height direction of the fume collecting hood assembly, the front plate is provided with a rear wall in the width direction of the fume collecting hood assembly, the rear plate is arranged opposite to the rear wall in the width direction of the fume collecting hood assembly, the decoration strip comprises a first connecting portion and a second connecting portion which are connected, the second connecting portion is in butt joint with the top wall, the first connecting portion is located between the rear plate and the rear wall, and the thickness of a portion, connected with the second connecting portion, of the first connecting portion is smaller than that of a portion, connected with the rear wall, of the first connecting portion. The smoke collecting hood assembly, the machine head and the integrated kitchen provided by the embodiment of the utility model can reduce the gap between the decorative strip and the front plate, and can prevent oil dirt and dust from accumulating between the decorative strip and the front plate.

title_en: Composite steel protection structure for high-temperature protection in building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a composite steel protection structure for high-temperature protection in a building, which relates to the technical field of building heat-insulating wall structures and comprises a keel, a backing plate and a heat-insulating brick layer which are sequentially arranged on a wall body from inside to outside, wherein the heat-insulating brick layer is formed by splicing a plurality of heat-insulating bricks, each heat-insulating brick comprises an inner layer and an outer layer, the edge part of one side of the inner layer protrudes out of the edge part of the outer layer, and the edge part of the opposite side is retracted into the edge part of the outer layer, so that the inner layer and the outer layer are staggered, and a meshed lap joint is formed between the heat-insulating bricks. The utility model obviously solves the problems of poor heat insulation effect, high smoke leakage risk, insufficient structural stability, complex construction maintenance and the like in the prior art by adopting a multi-layer composite, staggered occlusion and scientific fixing mode, has the obvious beneficial effects of excellent heat insulation performance, simple and convenient construction, reliable structure, strong applicability and the like, and has higher popularization and application values and economic benefits.

title_en: Dehumidifying device and air conditioning system
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to a dehumidifying apparatus and an air conditioning system. The dehumidifying apparatus includes a dehumidifier configured to dehumidify an air flow passing therethrough, a heat exchange assembly configured to cool the air flow passing therethrough, a first pipe having a first end connected to the heat exchange assembly and a second end configured to be connected to an outlet of a component to be dehumidified, a second pipe connecting the heat exchange assembly and the dehumidifier, and a third pipe having a first end connected to the dehumidifier and a second end configured to be connected to an inlet of the component to be dehumidified. The closed-loop airflow circulation path is constructed between the to-be-dehumidified component, the heat exchange component and the dehumidifier, external air is not required to be frequently introduced, the relative humidity can be stably controlled to be near a set value, the two-stage dehumidification is realized through the heat exchange component and the dehumidifier, the integral dehumidification capacity is improved, the high-temperature gas from the to-be-dehumidified component is cooled through the heat exchange component before entering the dehumidifier, and the protective shutdown triggered by overheating of the dehumidifier can be avoided.

title_en: Solar energy-wind energy-geothermal energy multi-energy complementary heating system
abstract_en: A solar energy-wind energy-geothermal energy multi-energy complementary heating system belongs to the field of energy conservation and environmental protection. The system comprises a solar heat collector, wind blades, a wind-magnetic heater, a middle-deep geothermal rock heat exchanger, a heat pump and other devices. The system is characterized by comprising three modes of solar heat supply, wind-magnetic heat supply and geothermal energy heat supply, wherein when the solar heat supply is adopted, solar energy is converted into heat energy by utilizing a solar heat collector, when the wind-magnetic heat supply is adopted, wind energy is converted into mechanical energy by utilizing a blade, then the mechanical energy is converted into heat energy by utilizing a magnetic field in a heater, when the geothermal energy heat supply is adopted, the geothermal energy is converted into heat energy by utilizing a medium-deep geothermal heat exchanger-heat pump system, and finally the heat is transferred to a building through a fluid medium, so that the heating energy requirement of the building in winter is met. The method has the advantages of high energy utilization efficiency, low operation cost, strong operation stability and the like, and is suitable for the fields of heating ventilation and air conditioning, industrial heat supply and the like.

title_en: Air duct system
abstract_en: The application discloses an air duct system, which belongs to the technical field of air ducts and adopts the technical scheme that the air duct system comprises a straight pipe, an elbow pipe, an embedded seat, a plurality of partition boards, a first fixing part and a plurality of second fixing grooves, wherein the embedded seat is arranged on one side of the elbow pipe, the partition boards are arranged on the embedded seat, the end parts of the partition boards are provided with the first fixing parts, the side walls of the partition boards are provided with the first convex strips which are uniformly arranged, the inner wall surface of the embedded seat is provided with the first fixing grooves which correspond to the first fixing parts, and the inner wall surface of the embedded seat is provided with the second convex strips which are uniformly arranged. The application can improve the flow stability of air at the turning position in the air pipe system.

title_en: Energy-saving heat-preserving type intermediate frequency steel shell furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an energy-saving heat-preservation type intermediate frequency steel shell furnace, which comprises a crucible, wherein an induction coil is sleeved at the lower part of the crucible, a protective layer is sleeved at the outer side of the crucible, a multi-layer heat-preservation structure is arranged between the protective layer and the crucible, the multi-layer heat-preservation structure comprises a magnesium-chromium brick layer, a honeycomb heat-insulation board layer and a silicon carbide fiber heat-preservation layer which are arranged from inside to outside in layers, a hopper is arranged above the crucible, a conveying pipe is arranged at the bottom of the hopper, the bottom end of the conveying pipe is positioned above the position of an opening at the top of the crucible, a screw conveyer is arranged in the conveying pipe, a support is arranged at the top of the crucible, and a combined driving assembly for driving the screw conveyer to rotate is arranged at the top of the support. The utility model ensures the stable high-temperature environment in the crucible, reduces the heat loss of molten metal, reduces energy consumption, prolongs the smelting operation time, improves the energy utilization rate, improves the operation convenience and the production efficiency, and has outstanding energy-saving advantage and economic value source utilization rate.

title_en: Energy-saving boiler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an energy-saving boiler which comprises an outer boiler, an inner boiler and a liquid inlet pipe, wherein a heating device is arranged at one end of the outer boiler, the inner boiler is arranged at the other end of the inner part of the outer boiler, one side of the top of the inner boiler is provided with an overflow hole, and one end of the liquid inlet pipe penetrates through the outer boiler and extends to the bottom of the inner boiler. The utility model combines the inner pot and the outer pot into a whole, the outer pot is a heating body, the inner pot is a pre-liquid storage device, after the liquid in the outer pot is reduced, the liquid inlet pipe supplements liquid to the bottom in the inner pot, the liquid at the upper part of the inner pot is automatically added into the outer pot, and the temperature of the liquid in the inner pot reaches the boiling point because the inner pot is positioned in the outer pot, the outer pot does not need to heat the added liquid from low temperature to boiling, and the integral heating efficiency is improved while the heat energy is effectively utilized.

title_en: Microwave oven door body and microwave oven
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of microwave ovens, in particular to a microwave oven door body and a microwave oven, comprising an outer door glass, an inner cover body, a shielding mesh part, a wave blocking part, an inner door glass and at least one central glass, wherein the inner cover body is fixed on the inner side of the outer door glass, the shielding mesh part and the wave blocking part are arranged on the outer edge of the shielding mesh part in the inner cover body, the inner door glass is fixed on the shielding mesh part of the inner cover body, and the at least one central glass is fixed in the inner cover body, and the inner cover body is made of metal materials. The inner cover body is made of metal materials, so that the inner cover body is of an integral structure, the temperature resistant effect of the metal inner cover body is better, the heat distribution is uniform, and the risk of melting materials on the door body due to overheating of the door body is effectively avoided in the operation process of the microwave oven. In addition, this patent has further strengthened thermal-insulated effect through installing interior door glass on the inner cover body, ensures that the door body temperature remains in the safe range, reduces the risk of scalding.

title_en: Gas water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas water heater, which comprises a shell, wherein an installation space is formed in the shell, a water tank and a combustion chamber are arranged in the installation space, the combustion chamber is configured to heat water flowing through the water tank, an installation cavity is formed in the shell of the combustion chamber, a semiconductor thermoelectric generation sheet is arranged in the installation cavity, one end of the semiconductor thermoelectric generation sheet is connected with the inner wall of the shell of the combustion chamber, the other end of the semiconductor thermoelectric generation sheet is provided with a heat dissipation part, and the heat dissipation part is connected with the outer wall of the shell of the combustion chamber. The scheme can realize the waste heat utilization of the combustion chamber and improve the cooling effect of the combustion chamber shell.

title_en: Modular combined ceramic sagger
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sagger, in particular to a modularized combined ceramic sagger which comprises an upright post made of ceramics, two vertical slots and two horizontal slots, a bottom plate made of ceramics and a side plate made of ceramics, wherein the upright post is provided with the vertical slots and the horizontal slots, the two vertical slots are mutually perpendicular, the bottom plate is arranged in the horizontal slots, two sides of the side plate made of ceramics are arranged in the vertical slots, and one end of the side plate abuts against the bottom plate, and the bottom plate and the side plate enclose the sagger. The ceramic sagger is assembled into the sagger through the upright post, the bottom plate and the side plates which are made of ceramics, the overall strength is high, the sagger parts can be independently stacked and fired, the production efficiency is high, the purity of the sagger materials is high, the sagger materials do not react with lithium battery materials, the service life is long, the efficiency is greatly improved, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: High-voltage direct-heating electric boiler
abstract_en: A high-voltage direct-heating electric boiler comprises a heat-preserving shell, a fireproof insulating barrel body, an electric heating wire, an air duct, an air equalizing structure, a heat exchange assembly, a circulating fan, an inner cavity, an outer cavity, a heat insulating structure, a circulating fan cooling system and an insulating foundation. The supporting structure of the electric heating wire is designed into a cylindrical or polygonal thin shell cavity structure which supports each other, so that the weight of the material for manufacturing the fireproof insulating barrel body for supporting the electric heating wire can be reduced, and the fireproof insulating barrel body structure can bear 7-grade intensity earthquake. Through setting up two cavity structures in the fire-resistant insulating staving, outside, the equilibrium of reinforcing circulation fan hot air convection current effect, the inside heating medium of high-efficient heating heat exchange assembly satisfies user's heat demand.

title_en: Refining furnace structure convenient for cleaning furnace mouth
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of refining furnace smelting, and discloses a refining furnace structure convenient for cleaning a furnace mouth, which comprises a rotating motor, wherein a lifting hook is arranged on one side of the rotating motor, a furnace mouth cleaning mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the rotating motor and is used for conveniently cleaning the furnace mouth of the refining furnace, an inner wall cleaning mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the lifting hook and is used for cleaning the inner wall of the refining furnace, the furnace mouth cleaning mechanism comprises a furnace mouth ring, the top of the furnace mouth ring is arranged at the bottom of the rotating motor, a furnace mouth epitaxial ring is arranged on the inner wall of the furnace mouth ring, the output end of the rotating motor is fixedly connected with a driving wheel, and the bottom of the driving wheel is fixedly connected with a bottom rotating shaft. According to the utility model, the residue generated in the smelting process is difficult to adhere to the inner wall of the furnace mouth by optimizing the structural design of the furnace mouth, and meanwhile, the cleaning mechanism is matched, so that the reciprocating scraping operation along the inner wall of the furnace mouth is realized by mechanical driving.

title_en: Fume exhaust fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a range hood. The smoke exhaust ventilator comprises a box body, a smoke collecting cavity, an oil cup and a drainage structure, wherein a fan assembly is arranged in the box body, the smoke collecting cavity is connected with the box body, the smoke collecting cavity is provided with a smoke collecting cavity with a downward opening, the smoke collecting cavity comprises a rear plate and a smoke sucking plate which enclose the smoke collecting cavity, the smoke sucking plate is provided with smoke sucking holes, the smoke sucking plate is obliquely arranged downwards in the direction from the rear side to the front side of the smoke collecting cavity, the oil cup is arranged on the surface of the front plate of the smoke collecting cavity facing the smoke collecting cavity and is located below the front end of the smoke sucking plate, the drainage structure is arranged on the smoke sucking plate and used for guiding condensed oil on the rear end of the smoke sucking plate to flow to the front end of the smoke sucking plate so as to prevent condensed oil from falling on the rear plate. In the range hood, dripping caused by condensation oil converging at the bottom of the rear plate can be avoided to a certain extent, so that the cleaning burden of a user can be reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Multistage tube plate type heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-stage tube plate type heat exchanger, which relates to the field of heat exchangers, and comprises a shell, tube plates, end covers and heat exchange tube bundles, wherein the tube plates are respectively arranged at two ends of the shell, one side of the tube plates, which is far away from the shell, is provided with the end covers communicated with the shell, the heat exchange tube bundles penetrate through the shell and penetrate through the two tube plates, at least one tube plate is of a multi-stage tube plate structure, the multi-stage tube plate structure comprises a plurality of tube plate units which are sequentially and concentrically connected and gradually reduced in diameter along the direction far away from the shell, each tube plate unit radially separates the heat exchange tube bundles into a plurality of heat exchange areas, and each heat exchange area is annularly provided with an expansion joint. The heat stress is removed by areas, the problem of different heat stress caused by different temperatures in the operation process of the heat exchanger is effectively solved, the damage of the heat exchanger is reduced, the operation cost is reduced, and meanwhile, the multistage tube plates can be arranged in a grading manner according to the production requirements, so that the adaptability is high.

title_en: Multistage waste heat utilization device for recovering zinc oxide in rotary kiln
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rotary kilns, in particular to a multistage waste heat utilization device for recovering zinc oxide in a rotary kiln, which comprises a heat exchange box, wherein an air inlet pipe is fixedly arranged at the air inlet end of the heat exchange box, the air inlet pipe is connected to a flue gas outlet of the rotary kiln, a snake-shaped heat exchange pipe for heat exchange operation is arranged in the heat exchange box, an insulation box is arranged on one side of the heat exchange box, the heat exchange box is communicated with the insulation box through a middle through pipe, a raw material box for storing raw materials is arranged in the insulation box, a feeding screw feeder is arranged at the top of the raw material box, a discharging screw feeder is arranged at the bottom of the raw material box, an auxiliary pipe is fixedly arranged on a side plate body of the insulation box, a vertical pipe is fixedly arranged at the end part of the auxiliary pipe, and a screw heat exchange pipe for heat exchange is arranged in the vertical pipe. The utility model has the effect of multi-stage waste heat utilization, improves the overall utilization rate of waste heat and reduces energy waste.

title_en: Drainage structure and range hood
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of household appliances, and discloses a drainage structure and a range hood, which comprise a shell, wherein an air outlet is formed in the top of the shell, an air inlet is formed in the front end of the shell, a glass panel is arranged at the front end of the shell, a plurality of peripheral drainage plates are obliquely arranged at the rear side of the glass panel, a central drainage plate is arranged at the inner side of all the peripheral drainage plates and spliced with all the peripheral drainage plates, two side drainage assemblies are arranged in the shell, each drainage assembly comprises at least one inclined surface for guiding oil fume to flow to the air outlet, the plurality of peripheral drainage plates are obliquely arranged at the rear side of the glass panel and form a drainage system with the central drainage plate, and the two side drainage assemblies are matched to guide the oil fume to flow to the air outlet, so that vortex and turbulent flow are avoided behind the glass panel, and efficient discharge of the oil fume is realized.

title_en: Inverted fragrance container
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inverted aromatic container, which belongs to the technical field of aromatic containers and comprises a base, an upper seat, a bottle body, an inner plug and a volatile core body, wherein a cavity is formed in the base, an air hole is formed in the wall surface of the base and is configured to be communicated with the cavity and outside air, the upper seat can be detachably covered on the top of the base, the upper seat is provided with a mounting hole, the bottle body can be detachably arranged on the upper seat, an opening is formed in the bottom of the bottle body and corresponds to the mounting hole, the bottle body is configured to contain an aromatic medium, the inner plug can be detachably covered on the opening, and the volatile core body can be detachably arranged on the inner plug. The utility model can ensure that the volatile core body can keep full and stable contact with the aromatic medium in the whole service period, thereby ensuring that the fragrance release is stable and consistent throughout, and providing stable, durable and economic high-quality aromatic experience for users.

title_en: Water inlet anti-drop rotary heat exchange device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water inlet anti-drop type rotary heat exchange device which comprises a bearing seat, ball bearings, a rotating shaft, a tie and a water inlet anti-drop mechanism, wherein the ball bearings are arranged in the bearing seat and used for allowing the rotating shaft to pass through, the first end of the bearing seat is used for allowing the rotating shaft to pass through, the inner wall of the first end of the bearing seat limits the ball bearings to be separated, the tie is arranged on the rotating shaft, the second end of the bearing seat is provided with the water inlet anti-drop mechanism, the first end of the water inlet anti-drop mechanism limits the ball bearings and the rotating shaft to be separated from the bearing seat, the second end of the water inlet anti-drop mechanism is arranged on an external heat exchange tube, the first end of the water inlet anti-drop mechanism is provided with a water inlet hole, the water inlet hole is communicated with an inner cavity of the bearing seat, a water flushing gap is formed between the first end of the water inlet anti-drop mechanism and the second end of the water inlet anti-drop mechanism, and the water inlet hole is communicated. The water inlet anti-drop rotary heat exchange device solves the problem that impurities at the rotating shaft can be cleaned only by disassembling the end cover due to the fact that the end cover is of a disc structure in the prior art.

title_en: Fluidized boiler assembly and method of burning at least two types of fuels in a fluidized boiler
abstract_en: A fluidized bed boiler assembly (1) for simultaneously introducing and combusting at least two types of fuels, which comprises a fluidized bed boiler (1) comprising a combustion chamber, a first conveyor (5) for feeding the fuel mixture to the fluidized bed boiler (1) and / or for introducing the fuel mixture into combustion chambers, a first fuel metering device (12) and a second fuel metering device (13), the first outlet of the first metering device (12) and the first outlet of the second metering device (13) opening onto or into the first conveyor (5) side by side or with each other.A method of simultaneously introducing and combusting at least two types of fuels in a fluidized bed boiler, in which a fluidizing medium is injected into the fluidized bed boiler (1), the first fuel is metered by a first dispenser (12) onto or into the first conveyor (5) and transported by the first conveyor (5) to the fluidized bed boiler (1) and subsequently the first fuel is introduced into the combustion chamber of the fluidized bed boiler (1), the second fuel is metered by the second metering device (13) onto or into the first conveyor (5), next to or at a distance from the area feeding the first fuel, the first conveyor (5) is transported to the fluidized bed boiler (1) and subsequently the first and second fuels are introduced together into the combustion chamber of the fluidized bed boiler (1) and then burned together in it.

title_en: Cooling system and refrigerator box
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cooling unit (30) for a transportable refrigerator box (10) having a storage space (24) for storing goods to be transported, the refrigerator box (10) comprising a front wall (12) and an opening (20) opposite the front wall (12), wherein the cooling unit is adapted for being positioned in the storage space (24) and comprises a separation structure (34) adapted for separating a first portion (36) of the storage space between the front wall (12) and the separation structure (34) from a second portion (38) of the storage space between the separation structure (34) and the opening (20); and the cooling unit (30) comprises a first cooling device (32) mounted on the separation structure (34), the first cooling device adapted to cool the first portion (36) of the storage space.

title_en: Total heat exchange element and total heat exchanger
abstract_en: A total heat exchange element includes a plurality of partitions (1) disposed in a state of being opposed to each other, and a spacer portion (2) keeping a space between the partitions (1) and forming a passage between the partitions. The spacer portion (2) has a laminate structure in which a nonwoven fabric base layer including a nonwoven fabric as a base material is laminated on each of both sides of a paper layer. A first nonwoven fabric base layer (221) that is the nonwoven fabric base layer of the spacer portion (2) laminated on one side of the paper layer is joined to the partition opposed to the first nonwoven fabric base layer (221), and a second nonwoven fabric base layer (222) that is the nonwoven fabric base layer of the spacer portion (2) laminated on another side of the paper layer is joined to the partition opposed to the second nonwoven fabric base layer (222). The total heat exchange element has the above-mentioned configuration thereby making it possible to improve the humidity exchange efficiency.

title_en: A cooling system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cooling system (1) enabling in particular cooling separate compartments to different temperatures. The cooling system (1) of the invention is characterized by the control unit (7) adapted to position the valve (4) according to the next cooling line (2, 3) to be activated and to enable the compressor (6) to be activated further for a predetermined duration once the operation in the currently operating cooling line (2, 3) is terminated.

title_en: Thermally enhanced heating
abstract_en: A thermally enhanced heating system (100) and a method for thermally enhancing a HVAC system are provided. The thermally enhanced heating system (100) preferably includes an outdoor HVAC unit (200) and an indoor HVAC unit (300).
