The indoor HVAC unit (300) includes a first heat exchanger (310) for transferring heat from a refrigerant, a second heat exchanger (320) for transferring heat from a fuel source, and a third heat exchanger (330) for transferring heat to the refrigerant. The outdoor HVAC unit (200) includes an outdoor heat exchanger (210) for transferring heat from an outdoor air to the refrigerant, a pump (220) configured to circulate the refrigerant, and an ejector (230) configured to combine the refrigerant from the outdoor heat exchanger (210) and the third heat exchanger (330). Preferably the outdoor HVAC unit (220) is operated to circulate the refrigerant through a first refrigerant circuit (500) and a second refrigerant circuit (400), and combine refrigerant in the first refrigerant circuit (500) and the second refrigerant circuit (400).

title_en: Fastening structure for electric heating panels of electric heater, and electric heater
abstract_en: An electric heating plate (1) fixing structure of an electric heater and an electric heater, the electric heating plate (1) fixing structure of an electric heater including a cross beam (2), an outer support (3) and a first support (4), the cross beam (2) being connected with the outer support (3), the electric heating plate (1) being connected with the first support (4), and the first support (4) being connected with the cross beam or/and the outer support (3).

title_en: Indoor environmental control system and method controlling the same
abstract_en: A method for controlling the temperature of an indoor environment, comprising the following steps: a) providing an air conditioning device intended to heat/cool the environment through the forced circulation of a carrier fluid inside a circuit associated with the environment; b) setting a comfort temperature associated with at least one reference point; c) calculating the surface area subtended by the comfort temperature curve over time; d) monitoring the trend curve of the temperature measured at the reference point; e) activating/deactivating the air conditioning device when the temperature measured during step d) has an instant value that is lower/higher than the comfort value set in step b); f) calculating the surface area subtended by the temperature curve determined in step c) and having respective end points whose value corresponds to the comfort temperature and intermediate points whose values correspond to values that are higher than the comfort temperature value; g) calculating the surface area subtended by the temperature curve determined in step d) and having respective end points whose value corresponds to the comfort temperature and intermediate points whose values are lower than the comfort temperature value; h) calculating a fictitious temperature value corresponding to the average value of an ideal sinusoidal curve of the temperature whose amplitude is suited to distribute in the two half waves the sum of the surface areas calculated in steps f) and g); i) calculating the ratio between the surface area subtended by a section of the temperature curve determined in step f) and the surface area subtended by a section of the temperature curve determined in step g) with respect to the surface area calculated in step c); j) transferring into the environment a predetermined amount of heat in order to vary the thermal power introduced in the environment according to the calculation made in step h) and in step i).

title_en: Cooling plate for a metallurgical furnace
abstract_en:
The invention relates to a cooling plate (1) for a metallurgical furnace, comprising 
- a cooling plate body (10) having with a front face (11) for facing the inside of the metallurgical furnace, an opposite rear face (12) and at least one coolant (17) channel inside the cooling plate (10), which coolant channel (17) communicates with a rear opening (13) on the rear face (12); and 
- a connection pipe (20) connected to the cooling plate (10) so that a pipe channel (21) of the connection pipe (20) communicates with the coolant channel (17). 
     In order to provide means for preventing leakage in a cooling system of a metallurgical furnace, the invention provides that the cooling plate body (10) comprises a receiving bore (14) that extends in a bore direction (B) from the rear opening (13) into the coolant channel (17) and an end portion (23) of the connection pipe (20) is form-fittingly received in the receiving bore (14) along at least a portion of a width (W) of the coolant channel (17) in the bore direction (B).

title_en: Constituent plate of a heat exchanger and heat exchanger comprising at least one such plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a constituent plate (105) of a heat exchanger, intended to delimit at least one fluid circulation channel (111a, 111b). The plate (105) comprises a bottom (106) and at least one raised edge (107) which surrounds the bottom (106). The plate (105) comprises at least one opening (110) that is configured to supply the duct (111a, 111b) with fluid. The opening (110) is formed with an opening profile (X1). The plate (105) is equipped with a fluid distribution means (300) formed with a distribution means profile (X2) which is homothetic with the opening profile (X1) of the opening (110).

title_en: Machine for producing liquid or semiliquid food products and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: Machine for producing liquid or semiliquid food products, comprising: a container (20) adapted to contain a liquid or semiliquid food product and/or a basic mixture and/or a semifinished product for producing said food product, said container (20) having a substantially vertical extension and a top opening (21); at least one tool (40) extending inside said container (20) to work said food product and/or said basic mixture and/or said semifinished product; an actuator (30) coupled to said tool (40) to move said tool (40) for the production of said food product; a thermal treatment system (50) comprising a thermal exchange structure (51) associated with said container (20). The thermal exchange structure comprises: an annular wall (510) surrounding said container (20) and having through holes (511) in the axial direction; substantially straight tubular ducts (520) housed in said through holes (511); joints (530) for jointing said tubular ducts (520) so as to form a path for a thermal fluid. A method for making said machine (1) is also described.

title_en: Steam boiler for waste incineration
abstract_en: Steam boiler for waste incineration, including a combustion chamber (1) comprising a combustion chamber cavity surrounded by combustion chamber walls, to the combustion chamber (1 ) by an opening for flue gas flow followed by at least one or more consecutive flue-gas ducts (2) interconnected by openings for flue gas flow, where each flue-gas duct (2) comprises a flue-gas duct cavity surrounded by flue- gas duct walls, where the steam boiler further comprises at least one evaporator (11) for steam production, a feed pump (8) connected to a water source (9), a steam drum (3), at least one heater (6) having an inlet connected through the feed pump (8) to a water source (9), at least one heater (6) having an outlet connected to the steam drum (3), wherein all included evaporators (11) have inlet and outlet connected to the steam drum (3), from which a steam piping (13) leads to the connection to the steam turbine the summary of the invention is based on that at least one heater (6) and/or at least one evaporating surface with its heat exchange surfaces form walls of the combustion chamber (1), wherein at least one evaporator (11), included in the steam boiler, is located in a flue-gas duct (2).

title_en: Precooling device for cryotherapy and cryotherapy system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a pre-cooling device for cryotherapy and a cryotherapy system. The device includes a gas inlet port, at least three vent branches, a single-stage-compression auto-cascade refrigeration system assembly and a pressure regulating assembly. The single-stage-compression auto-cascade refrigeration system assembly includes at least three-stage refrigeration cycles. For at least some of the refrigeration cycles, a refrigeration temperature thereof is lower than that of the previous stage refrigeration cycle. Each refrigeration cycle can exchange heat with a gas flowing in the corresponding vent branch to pre-cool the gas flowing in this vent branch. Each vent branch is provided with a branch control member configured to control connection and disconnection of this vent branch. The pressure regulating assembly is configured to control a pressure of a gas outlet end of the pressure regulating assembly, and the pressure of the gas outlet end of the pressure regulating assembly is associated with a vent branch to be pre-cooled. The pre-cooling device provided by the present invention can realize precooling to multiple temperatures of different levels, automatically and timely controls a ventilation pressure of the pre-cooling device according to the precooling to temperatures of different levels, as well as maintains the stability of the pressure.

title_en: Temperature control assembly and battery pack using the same
abstract_en: This application discloses a temperature control assembly and a battery pack. The temperature control assembly includes a first heat-conducting plate, a second heat-conducting plate, and a heating member. The first heat-conducting plate provided with a fitting surface. The second heat-conducting plate includes a flat part, and first bump portions and second bump portions that are connected the flat part and are arranged alternately. The flat part fits to the fitting surface. The first bump portions bump towards a side away from the fitting surface to form a flow channel between the first bump portions and the fitting surface, the flow channel being configured to flow a cooling medium through. The second bump portions bump towards a side away from the fitting surface to form a receiving cavity between the second bump portions and the fitting surface; and a heating member received in the receiving cavity. The temperature control assembly provided in this application integrates the heat dissipation and heating functions, to reduce the size of the battery pack.

title_en: Thermal energy storage
abstract_en: There is described a thermal energy storage comprising a housing (10) having a fluid inlet (12) and a fluid outlet (18), and a thermal energy storage structure (20) arranged within the housing (10) between the fluid inlet (12) and the fluid outlet (18), the thermal energy storage structure (20) comprising thermal energy storage elements and flexible separator elements (22), the flexible separator elements (22) being arranged such that the thermal energy storage elements are separated into layers (24), each layer (24) forming a channel between the fluid inlet (12) and the fluid outlet (18). Furthermore, a method of manufacturing a thermal energy storage and a power plant for producing electrical energy are described.

title_en: Perturbing air cooled condenser fin
abstract_en: An air cooled condenser fin comprises flow channel walls defining an air flow channel. Flow channel walls include planar sections separated by intermittent flow interruptions which are spaced apart along the air flow channel. Intermittent flow interruptions are defined by the flow channel walls. Intermittent flow interruptions may for example comprise splits formed by a staggered arrangement in which the planar sections of the flow channel walls before and after each split are staggered; or intermittent sinusoidal waves formed into the flow channel walls; or louvers formed into the flow channel walls to create openings passing through the flow channel walls at the louvers. Intermittent flow interruptions may be spaced apart along the air flow channel by at least 5 hydraulic diameters, and in some embodiments by 5-10 hydraulic diameters. A plurality of such air cooled condenser fins are suitably employed with the air flow channels arranged in parallel.

title_en: Disposable vaporizer
abstract_en: A vaporizer device including: 1) a body having a mouthpiece and an interior chamber, 2) a reservoir inserted into the interior chamber of the body for storing an aerosolizable material, 3) a housing inserted into the interior chamber including a heating chamber including a heating element and a pressure sensor for controlling operation of the heating element, 4) a power source for powering the heating element and pressure sensor, and 5) a vapor tube extending from the mouthpiece to the heating chamber. The vapor tube is integrally formed with the reservoir, or with the body. The device may in addition also include and a PCB tube extending from the mouthpiece to the pressure sensor, which is integrally formed with one of the reservoir or the body.

title_en: Sanitary evaporator assembly
abstract_en:
An evaporator assembly (100) for an ice maker comprising: 
an evaporator pan (120) comprising a back wall (300) and left, right, top and bottom sidewalls (310, 320, 330, 340) extending from the back wall; a freeze plate located within the evaporator pan; a serpentine tubing (200) thermally coupled to the back wall of the evaporator pan opposite the left, right, top and bottom sidewalls; a first layer of insulation (710) formed on the serpentine tubing; an evaporator housing formed attached to the evaporator pan and covering the serpentine tubing and the first layer of insulation , the evaporator housing formed using an ultrasonic process and comprising: housing left, right, top and bottom sidewalls (140, 150, 160, 170), wherein each sidewall comprises a groove (172, 174. 176, 178); and a housing back wall (180) seated into the grooves of the sidewalls, the housing back wall comprising a raised edge (182, 184, 186, 188) that melts during the ultrasonic welding process to seal the housing back wall to the housing left, right, top and bottom sidewalls.

title_en: Assembly comprising a base and a photovoltaic module and methods for manufacturing it
abstract_en: Assembly (1) comprising a base (2) and a photovoltaic module (3), the base comprising a concrete (12) enclosing at least one volume (20) filled with a second material (21) or a gas, the volume and the second material or gas being selected such that the density of the assembly (1) is less than 1000 kg/m 3 , the concrete comprising reinforcing fibres. The invention also relates to methods for manufacturing it.

title_en: Air conditioner starting frequency determining method and system
abstract_en: An air conditioner starting frequency determining method and system. The method comprises: comparing an acquired actual temperature value of the outdoor environment with preset first and second temperature thresholds, and determining the starting frequency of an air conditioner on the basis of the comparison result. The starting frequency of the air conditioner can be adjusted according to the actual temperature value of the outdoor environment, so that the air conditioner can be turned on normally without failure even when the outdoor temperature is high.

title_en: Respiratory pressure device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a respiratory pressure device (4000) comprising a pressure generator (4140) for supplying a flow of air at positive pressure and an apparatus (5000) for humidifying the flow of air integrated in the respiratory pressure device. The apparatus for humidifying the flow of air comprises a dock (5130) comprising a heater plate (5120) and a reservoir (5110). The reservoir comprises a chamber in fluid communication with the flow of air. The dock is configured to receive the reservoir. The reservoir further comprises a base (5112) structured to hold a volume of liquid and including a conductive portion (5152) in thermal engagement with the heater plate when the reservoir is received on the dock, a lid (5114) movably connected to the base, and a protrusion (5142) adapted to engage with a recess (5144) on the dock to retain the reservoir in the dock. The respiratory pressure device further comprises a first compliant portion (5116) configured to be compressed to enable engagement or disengagement of the reservoir with the dock.

title_en: Thermal cooker
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a heating cooker with improved usability. A heating cooker comprising: a heating unit that heats a cooking object; a temperature detector that detects temperature information about the cooking object; a controller that controls the heating unit based on heating conditions including at least a heating temperature and a heating time, and the temperature information; and a communicator that communicates with an external device, wherein the external device receives input information from a user, wherein the communicator transmits the input information received from the external device to the controller, and wherein the controller creates, when the input information is predetermined input information, update information about at least the heating temperature among the heating conditions based on the predetermined input information.

title_en: Receiver
abstract_en: The invention relates to a receiver (50) having an absorber (55) and an opening (53) for the solar rays incident on the absorber (55) during operation, wherein a window (52, 60, 61, 62) is provided, which covers the opening (53), and wherein a changing assembly (51) is provided, which interacts with said window to change the window (52) covering the opening (53) for another window (60, 61 62).

title_en: A housing for the radial fan of a range hood
abstract_en: The invention relates to a housing for the radial fan of the range hood (1), comprising a spiral hollow body (30) surrounding an inner chamber (2); an air outlet (31) disposed on an upper end (36) of the body (30) to reach the inner chamber (2); an air suction nozzle (40) disposed on a flat front wall (32) of the body (30) angular with the air outlet (31); a support plate (45) provided at the center of the air suction nozzle (40) and having a plurality of mounting holes (49) provided thereon; and a plurality of flat blade members (42) that hold on to the support plate (45) from its first end (421) and to the front wall (32) from its opposite second end (423) such that the support plate (45) is suspended at the air suction nozzle (40) creating a plurality of air inlets (43) there between reaching to the inner chamber (1). The blade members (42) have a curvilinear form that forms a spiral when placed together at the air suction nozzle (40) around the support plate (45).

title_en: Heat exchanger for heat pump applications
abstract_en: A heat exchanger (20), comprising: a first header (22); a second header (24) having at least a first volume and a second volume; a plurality of heat exchange tubes (26) arranged in spaced parallel relationship and fluidly coupling the first header (22) and second header (24); a flow restricting element (52) arranged within the first header (22) to define an inlet volume and an outlet volume thereof, the outlet volume being arranged in fluid communication with a portion of the plurality of heat exchange tubes (26), the flow restricting element comprising a thickness and a plurality of flow holes formed in the thickness to fluidly couple the inlet volume and the outlet volume, the plurality of flow holes being arranged at an angle relative to the portion of the plurality of heat exchange tubes (26).

title_en: Methods and systems for modulating energy usage
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a computer-implemented method of modulating energy consumption by a water provision system installed in a building, the water provision system comprising a heat pump configured to transfer thermal energy from outside the building to a thermal energy storage medium inside the building and a control module configured to control operation of the water provision system, the water provision system being configured to provide water heated by the thermal energy storage medium to one or more water outlets and further configured to supply heated water to a central heating system configured to raise an indoor temperature of the building, the method being performed by the control module and comprising: determining a level of energy demands of a geographical region comprising the building; and upon determining that the level of energy demands is low, operating the heat pump to store thermal energy in the thermal energy storage medium, and operating the water provision system to supply heated water to the central heating system using thermal energy stored in the thermal energy storage medium.

title_en: Air-conditioning control device
abstract_en: An object is to provide an air-conditioning control device capable of operating appropriate air-conditioning setting for a user. An air-conditioning control device (1) is the air-conditioning control device (1) that controls an air-conditioning device (2) that performs air conditioning indoor. The air-conditioning control device (1) includes an arithmetic device (12) and a display device (14). The arithmetic device (12) includes an airflow analysis unit (122) configured to perform airflow analysis based on at least one air-conditioning setting candidates selected by a user. The display device (14) includes a result display unit (141) and an operation unit (143). The result display unit (141) displays an analysis result (132) obtained by the airflow analysis unit (122). The operation unit (143) receives an operation related to an air-conditioning setting of the air-conditioning device (2) that the user performs based on the analysis result (132) displayed on the result display unit (141).

title_en: Dual flow ventilation unit with multiple functioning orientations
abstract_en:
The invention provides a dual-flow ventilation unit (10) for extracting exhaust air from at least one room and blowing fresh air into said at least one room, said unit having a casing comprising: 
- a thermal exchanger (42), 
- a first (17) and a second (21) flow circuits extending at least partially through the thermal exchanger (42), 
- ventilating means for moving air through said first and second flow circuits, 
- a drainage collector (60) for collecting by gravity water generated by condensation on the thermal exchanger (42), 
characterized in that each of said main walls (22, 24) comprises a receiving slot (62) configured to receive said drainage collector (60) so that said drainage collector (60) is configured to be selectively fixed to either one of said main walls (22, 24) depending on the orientation of the casing (12).

title_en: Heating and/or cooling module for a photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heating and/or cooling module (2) for a photovoltaic panel (1), comprising • - a 3D-textile core (3), having: • - a first main surface (4) and a second main surface (5) parallel thereto, together enclosing a volume (6), and • - a plurality of piles (7) attaching the main surfaces to each other; and • - an inlet (8) into the volume and an outlet (9) out of the volume, so that a fluid can flow from the inlet to the outlet through the volume. The module is characterized by at least one of the first main surface and the second main surface comprises a plastic sealing layer, and that the first and second main surface are connected to each other by melting of the plastic sealing layer. The invention also relates to a method of manufacturing such a module and a photovoltaic panel with such a module.

title_en: Feed forward flow control of heat transfer system
abstract_en: A heat transfer system (240, 300, 320) that includes one or more heat exchangers (118) and one or more variable control pumps (102, 122) that control flow through the one or more heat exchangers (118). At least one variable control pump (102, 122) is on the source side of the heat exchanger (118) for controlling flow of a first circulation medium and at least one flow controlling mechanical device is on the load side of the heat exchanger (118) for controlling flow of a second circulation medium. Sensors are used for detecting variables of the first circulation medium and the second circulation medium. At least one controller (116) is configured to control at least one parameter of the first circulation medium or the second circulation medium by controlling at least one of the variable control pump (102, 122) or the flow controlling mechanical device using a feed forward control loop calculated from the detected variables to achieve control of the at least one parameter.

title_en: Liquid hydrogen vaporizer, and generation method for generating hydrogen
abstract_en: A liquid hydrogen vaporizer generates hydrogen in a gaseous state or a supercritical state from liquid hydrogen. The liquid hydrogen vaporizer includes: an auxiliary heat exchanger that heats liquid hydrogen by heat exchange with a heating fluid having a freezing point lower than the freezing point of seawater or industrial water; and an open rack type main heat exchanger including heat transfer tubes that allows hydrogen to flow in and a trough that allows seawater or industrial water to flow down onto the outer surfaces of the heat transfer tubes. The main heat exchanger heats hydrogen flowing out from the auxiliary heat exchanger by heat exchange with seawater or industrial water.

title_en: Heat transfer plate
abstract_en: A corrugated heat transfer plate (5, 90, 92). It has opposing front and back sides (7, 9) and comprises a first end portion (11), a center portion (13) and a second end portion (15). It further comprises first and third portholes (17, 19) arranged within the first end portion (11), second and fourth portholes (27, 29) arranged within the second end portion (15), and a heat transfer area (4) comprising alternately arranged elongate ridges (6) and valleys (8) and being arranged within the center portion (13). An outer front field gasket groove (36) extends on the front side (7) and encloses the heat transfer area (4), while a back field sealing area (40) extends on the back side (9) and encloses the heat transfer area (4). The heat transfer plate (5, 90, 92) is characterized in that it further comprises a fifth porthole (21) arranged within the first end portion (11), a first transfer hole (25) arranged within a first half (h1) of the heat transfer plate (5, 90, 92), and a second transfer hole (35) arranged within a second half (h2) of the heat transfer plate (5, 90, 92). The first and second transfer holes (25, 35) are arranged within the outer front field gasket groove (36) and outside the back field sealing area 40. The first and second portholes (17, 27) are arranged within the back field sealing area (40), the third, fourth and fifth portholes (19, 29, 21) are arranged outside the back field sealing area (40), and the first, second, third, fourth and fifth portholes (17, 27, 19, 29, 21) are arranged outside the outer front field gasket groove (36).

title_en: Cascade unit and refrigeration cycle device
abstract_en: Provided are a cascade unit and a refrigeration cycle apparatus capable of cooling an electric component. The present disclosure is a cascade unit (2) of a refrigeration cycle apparatus (1) including a primary-side refrigerant circuit (5a) that includes a primary-side heat exchanger (74) and in which a primary-side refrigerant flows, a secondary-side refrigerant circuit (10) that includes a secondary-side compressor (21) and a utilization-side heat exchanger (52a, 52b, 52c) and in which a secondary-side refrigerant flows, and a cascade heat exchanger (35) that causes the primary-side refrigerant and the secondary-side refrigerant to exchange heat with each other, the cascade unit including the secondary-side compressor (21), the cascade heat exchanger (35), a first electric component (91), a second electric component (92), a third electric component (93), and an electric component fan (97), and a cascade casing (2x) that accommodates the secondary-side compressor (21), the first electric component (91), and the electric component fan (97).

title_en: Superconductor junction for a solid state cooler
abstract_en: A superconductor junction includes a normal metal layer having a first side and a second side, an insulating layer overlying the second side of the normal metal layer, and a first superconductor layer formed of a first superconductor material that overlies a side of the insulating layer opposite the side that overlies the normal metal layer. The superconductor junction further includes a second superconductor layer formed of a second superconductor material with a first side overlying a side of the first superconductor material opposite the side that overlies the insulating layer. The second superconductor material has a higher diffusion coefficent than the first superconductor material and/or the second superconductor material has a lower recombination coefficent than the first superconductor metal layer. A normal metal layer quasiparticle trap is coupled to a second side of the second superconductor layer.

title_en: A heat exchanger module mounted inside the room and method of installing a heat exchanger module
abstract_en:
A heat exchanger module mounted inside the room, characterized in that a module (1) has a sealed housing (12) with a cover (10) and a sealed connection (8) of the casing pipe (7) of the internal refrigeration pipe connections (16a, 16b). 
     A method of installing the heat exchanger module, which involves mounting the module inside the room, characterized in that the module (1) with a housing (12) is connected to the outdoor unit (2) by refrigeration pipes (6a, 6b), which are placed in the casing pipe (7) connected to the module (1) by a sealed connection (8).

title_en: Safety kit to be integrated into a cooking appliance to provide the cooking appliance with a safe operation mode, and method of operation in safe mode
abstract_en: Safety kit configured to be integrated into a cooking appliance (2) to provide the cooking appliance (2) with a safe operation mode, the safety kit (1) comprising a control module (10) comprising an algorithm of operating in safe mode, with the control module (10) being configured to exchange information with the control unit (21) of the cooking appliance (2), alarm means (11), and presence confirmation means (12), such that the control module (10) sends an operating instruction to the control unit (21) of the cooking appliance (2) in the event that the user does not confirm his/her presence after the alarm signal, said operating instruction being determined depending on the algorithm of operating in safe mode. The invention also relates to a method of operation in safe mode of a heating element (20a, 20b, 20c).

title_en: Air conditioner controller
abstract_en: Provided is an air conditioner controller having a high visibility of the operation state of an air conditioner and a high design quality as part of an interior decoration in harmony with a surrounding environment. The controller includes a main body including: a display unit disposed on a front surface of the controller; a display unit holder configured to hold the display unit; and a case including a holding member configured to support the display unit holder, and a protection member provided forward of the holding member and configured to cover an end surface of the display unit which end surface connects a front surface of the display unit to a back surface of the display unit. The display unit holder includes a rib provided along a direction where an outer periphery of the display unit extends, the rib projecting in a direction intersecting with the front surface of the display unit, and the case has a groove into which the rib is fitted.

title_en: Shutter device and ventilation device
abstract_en: Durability of a shutter device and a ventilation device is improved. Shutter device (1) includes window member (2) partially including vent (20), opening and closing member (3) that opens and closes vent (20), elastic body (4) located between window member (2) and opening and closing member 3, and moving mechanism (5) that moves opening and closing member (3) between a closed position where opening and closing member (3) closes vent (20) and open position where opening and closing member (3) opens vent (20). Moving mechanism (5) includes driving motor (6) that includes an output shaft connected to opening and closing member (3) and rotates opening and closing member (3), and an advancing and retracting mechanism that advances and retracts opening and closing member (3) with respect to window member (2). Moving mechanism (5) moves opening and closing member (3) in a manner that opening and closing member (3) at the closed position presses against a peripheral edge portion of vent (20) of window member (2) with elastic body (4) interposed between opening and closing member (3) and the peripheral edge portions to close vent (20). The ventilation device includes shutter device (1) and a blower that sends air to shutter device (1).

title_en: Method and device for detecting a water leak in a metallurgical melting furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting a water leak in a metallurgical melting furnace. The invention also relates to a device for carrying out the method. In the process, a water leak is detected in a cooling tube or a water tube of a furnace vessel in that a time-resolved measurement of an exhaust gas characteristic, such as the water quantity, at the exhaust gas outlet and a controlled pressure fluctuation, i.e. a variation of the pressure, of the cooling circuit are combined and correlated together. In the event of a leak, the variation of the water pressure leads to a variation of the discharge quantity of the water into the furnace vessel, said discharge quantity correlating chronologically to the variation of the pressure of the cooling circuit. By determining the correlation of the signals, an analysis device can ascertain a relationship based on a water leak.

title_en: Fuel container for a tabletop fire pit

By means of a fuel container of this type, the flame of a tabletop fire pit can burn particularly evenly at the desired height. The invention also relates to a tabletop fire pit.

title_en: Heating cooker, heating cooking method, and program
abstract_en: A heating cooker (500) includes: a heating chamber (100) that heats food (99) placed in the heating chamber (100); a first heater (102) that is disposed at a bottom portion of the heating chamber (100); a second heater (101) that is disposed at a top portion of the heating chamber (100); a temperature detector (detector (103)) that detects a temperature distribution by sensing an interior of the heating chamber (100) from above; and a heating controller (151) that controls heating performed by the first heater (102) and heating performed by the second heater (101), by using the temperature distribution detected. When the food (99) is heated, the first heater (102) starts heating before the second heater (101), the second heater (101) starts heating after the first heater (102) starts heating, and after the second heater (101) starts heating, the heating controller (151) adjusts a state of the heating performed by the first heater (102) and a state of the heating performed by the second heater (101) according to a change in the temperature distribution.

title_en: Heat exchanger and heat exchange system
abstract_en: Provided is a heat exchanger capable of increasing the installation density of a heat transfer medium in the heat exchanger while expanding the selectivity of the heat transfer medium usable as compared with the related art. The heat exchanger includes: a first heat exchange chamber including a first region filled with a granular heat transfer medium; a first introduction port configured to introduce a high-temperature first gas to be treated into the first region; a first discharge port positioned above the first introduction port in the vertical direction and configured to discharge gas from the first heat exchange chamber; a second heat exchange chamber positioned below the first heat exchange chamber in the vertical direction and including a second region filled with the granular heat transfer medium that has flowed in from the first heat exchange chamber; a second introduction port configured to introduce a second gas, having a temperature lower than that of the first gas, into the second region; a second discharge port positioned above the second introduction port in the vertical direction and configured to discharge gas from the second heat exchange chamber; and a regulating member disposed at one or more locations between the end of the first region on the side of the second heat exchange chamber and the end of the second region on the side of the first heat exchange chamber, the regulating member being capable of controlling a gas flow rate.

title_en: Heat-transfer fluid distribution structure

title_en: DEVICES AND PROCEDURES FOR THE EFFICIENT MANAGEMENT OF WATER AND ENERGY IN PLUMBING INSTALLATIONS (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to develop devices and operating methods for the efficient management of water and energy in plumbing installations, particularly for domestic hot water (DHW), as well as the utilization of water rejected by reverse osmosis purification systems. These devices and methods allow for: - Eliminating the waste of leaving hot water in the pipes after use, where energy is lost as it cools down, and eliminating the waste of letting the initial cold water run down the drain until the hot water reaches the point of consumption at the desired temperature. - Utilizing the water currently wasted by reverse osmosis purification systems, which can amount to several liters for every liter of filtered water. - Installed as a standalone module, it allows for the conversion of any existing conventional water heater, boiler, or tank into a smart water heater, boiler, or tank with the advanced water and energy saving functions of the present invention, which can be applied in industrial processes. The main advantage of this invention is that it offers a comprehensive solution for saving water and energy in hot water use with a unique, interconnected system and procedure. This allows for water and energy optimization, reduces duplicate components, and expands functionality compared to partial solutions, while also improving the available information. An additional objective is ease of operation and low cost, requiring no construction work, Wi-Fi, wireless connections, or electrical outlets at the point of consumption. This makes it accessible and cost-effective, enabling widespread use and significant social savings in water and energy. The system also leverages its components and available information to utilize water rejected by reverse osmosis water purification systems. In its preferred embodiment (Figure 3), the first part, called the operational part, is an electric water heater. However, it can also be installed in plumbing systems as an independent module connected via fittings and flexible hoses to the pipes entering and exiting electric water heaters, boilers, storage tanks, or industrial systems. title_en: Control systems and methods for managing rate of heat delivery in hydronic systems
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method for controlling rate of heat delivery in a hydronic system, which includes receiving, by a control unit, at least a first temperature, a second temperature from two spatially separated points in the hydronic system and a flow rate. The two spatially separated points correspond to inlet of heat transfer device and outlet of heat transfer device. The method also includes calculating at predefined interval, by the control unit, an actual rate of heat delivery to the heat transfer device based on flow rate and temperature difference between the two spatially separated points. The control unit determines heat delivery rate difference between actual rate of heat delivery and target rate of heat delivery. The control unit adapts flow rate of fluid into inlet of heat transfer device based on heat delivery rate difference to maintain target rate of heat delivery in heat transfer device.

title_en: Apparatus and method
abstract_en: Apparatus comprising an energy cell 200, a liquid supply system 100 and a work extraction system 300 is disclosed. The energy cell 200 is configured to apply electrical energy to liquid within to heat the liquid by generating bubbles of plasma therein. The liquid supply system 100 is coupled to the cell 200 and supplies the liquid to be heated. The work extraction system 300 receives heated fluid from the cell 200 and extracts useable work from it. The work extraction system 300 comprises a heated fluid to working gas heat exchanger 310 coupled to both the energy cell 200 and a supply of working gas, wherein the heated fluid to working gas heat exchanger 310 is configured to use heat from the heated fluid to raise the enthalpy of the working gas for extracting work therefrom. A method of operating such apparatus and a computer program product carrying the method is also disclosed.

title_en: Pellet heater operating without electricity

title_en: Adsorption type heat pump and cold heat generation method

title_en: Belt transmission mechanism for cooling tower blower
abstract_en: To provide a belt transmission mechanism for cooling tower blowers in which a tension regulation part suppressing meandering of a belt is adopted in a transmission mechanism for blowers using a flat belt and which is capable of preventing deterioration and damage of the belt even if a reverse running state of the belt is continued for a long time, by separately providing a belt guide part in the vicinity of a driven-side pulley.SOLUTION: With respect to a belt 13 which is a flat belt, bending of the belt 13 is prevented by a tension regulation part 14, meandering of the belt 13 under running is suppressed, and a belt guide part 15 is positioned in the vicinity of a driven-side pulley 12, such that a highest position of a guide surface is aligned to a lower limit position of a belt run enabled range on an outer peripheral surface of the driven-side pulley. Thus, even if a situation that the meandering suppression of the tension regulation part 14 cannot be controlled because of a reverse impeller rotation state is continued, a position of the belt 13 in contact with driving-side and driven-side pulleys can be appropriately regulated from being excessively lowered by the belt guide part 15, and it is possible to surely reduce the burden relating to maintenance such as to decrease an exchange frequency of the belt 13.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: To provide an air conditioner capable of exercising air conditioning capacity required by each outdoor machine even when pressure loss caused by difference in length of refrigerant pipe length varies.SOLUTION: A refrigerant circuit 10 is a cooling cycle and, after the refrigerant circuit 10 becomes stable, suction pressure Pl detected by a suction pressure sensor 32 is subtracted from each of liquid side pressure Prl obtained by using liquid side temperature Tl detected by a liquid side temperature sensor 61 of indoor machines 5-1 to 5-10, and gass pipe pressure losses ΔPp of the respective indoor machines 5-1 to 5-10 are obtained. Thus, it is possible to set optimum target temperature in accordance with the refrigerant pipe length connecting an outdoor machine 2 and the indoor machines 5-1 to 5-10, and sufficient air conditioning capacity can be exercised in the indoor machines 5-1 to 5-10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

The refrigerant sealed in a refrigerant circulation circuit 11, which is formed by sequentially connecting the turbo compressor, condenser, expansion valve, and evaporator, is HCFO-1233ydZ, HCFO-1233ydE, or a mixture thereof, and a bearing supporting a rotating shaft 19 of the turbo compressor is a magnetic bearing 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Refrigeration device, environment formation device and refrigeration method
abstract_en: To enable a more flexible operation while suppressing frost formation on an evaporator.SOLUTION: A refrigeration device 10 includes: a refrigeration circuit 15 in which a compressor 1, a condenser 2, an expansion valve 3, an evaporator 4 and a flow regulating valve 22 are disposed in this order and a refrigerant circulates; a valve control section 103 that controls the expansion valve 3 and the flow regulating valve 22; and a target value change section 102 for changing a target value of an evaporation temperature or evaporation pressure in the evaporator 4. The valve control section 103 controls one of the expansion valve 3 and the flow regulating valve 22 on the basis of the target value changed by the target value change section 102, and controls the other of the expansion valve 3 and the flow regulating valve 22 in accordance with a refrigeration request level or a temperature of a cooling object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Refrigerant Circulation System
abstract_en: To perform appropriate control taking into account friction heat generated in a sliding bearing of a motor in a refrigerant circulation system that lubricates the sliding bearing with the refrigerant.SOLUTION: A refrigerant circulation system 100 which circulates a refrigerant containing CO2 comprises: a compressor 3 which compresses the refrigerant; a motor 1 which includes a rotor 11 and a stator 12, a rotating shaft 13 connected to the rotor, and a sliding bearing 14 performing lubrication using the refrigerant compressed by the compressor and supporting the rotating shaft, and is configured such that the refrigerant passing through the inside of the motor is expanded after being discharged from the sliding bearing and used for cooling the stator; and a control device 50 which is configured to control at least the motor. The motor 1 also has a flow regulation valve 20 capable of adjusting a flow rate of the refrigerant. The control device 50 controls the flow regulation valve 20 to control the flow rate of the refrigerant according to a motor rotation speed detected by a motor rotation speed sensor 26.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Sealing structure, heat recovery steam generator, and sealing method
abstract_en: To reduce the amount of untreated gas flowing to the downstream side of a gas treatment device.SOLUTION: A Z-axis seal portion 22A and a Y-axis seal portion 22B, the Z-axis seal portion 22A including a Z-axis seal plate 21b disposed in contact with the first attachment surface 22Aa of the duct and a Y-axis seal plate 22Aa disposed to overlap the Z-axis seal plate 2Z, the Y-axis seal portion 22Ab including a Y-axis seal plate 22B disposed in contact with the second attachment surface of the duct and a Y-axis seal plate disposed to overlap the Y-axis seal plate, 1Y 22Bb 22Ba 22Ba 1Y, An end portion of the first side 1Y axial seal plate 22Ba on the side of the first mounting surface 21b has a first shape that matches the curved shape of the Z-axis seal plate 22Aa, and an end portion of the Y-axis seal plate 22Bb on the side of the first mounting surface 21b has a second shape that matches the curved shape of the first side 2Z axial seal plate 22Ab.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Baking apparatus
abstract_en: To improve a recovery rate of a volatile matter volatilized from an object.SOLUTION: The firing apparatus includes an accommodation portion having an internal space for accommodating an object, equipment to which the accommodation portion is detachably attached and which has an equipment flow path communicating with the internal space, a pump connected to the equipment flow path and configured to discharge gas in the internal space, a trap portion disposed in the internal space and configured to trap a volatile component volatilized from the object, a heating portion configured to heat the object, and a cooling portion configured to cool the trap portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Loop Seal damper apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a roof seal damper device. According to the present invention, the roof seal damper device comprises: a damper frame; a plurality of blades rotatably disposed in the damper frame and opening and closing an opening of the damper frame; a roof seal unit coupled to the damper frame adjacent to the blade; and a gap adjusting unit coupled to the blade and sealing an area between the damper frame and the blade together with the roof seal unit while adjusting a distance from the roof seal unit.

title_en: Fire fighting system for fire suppression in apartment houses
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting system for fire suppression in an apartment house. More specifically, the system with an improved structure enables a sprinkler member to be installed on a ceiling surface at a position avoiding a kitchen hood of an upper portion of a kitchen gas station to effectively extinguish initial fire and allows initially generated smoke to be easily and rapidly sucked and discharged.

title_en: Hybrid absorption heat pump system using renewable heat
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hybrid absorption heat pump system using a regeneratable heat source. In accordance with an embodiment of the present invention, the hybrid absorption heat pump system using the regeneratable heat source comprises: a regenerator which generates refrigerant steam by heating a mixed solution with a refrigerant dissolved by using waste heat; a condenser which liquefies the refrigerant steam generated by the regenerator into a liquid refrigerant and emits the heat to the outside; an evaporator which vaporizes the liquid refrigerant generated by the condenser into refrigerant steam, and absorbs the external heat; an absorber which absorbs the refrigerant steam generated by the evaporator into the mixed solution and emits heat to the outside; a mixed solution heat exchanger which exchanges heat between the mixed solutions moving between the regenerator and the absorber; and a control unit which controls the connection relation of pipes through a three-way valve in accordance with the operation mode of the hybrid absorption heat pump system, and controls the transfer direction of the mixed solution between the regenerator and the absorber, and the transfer direction of the liquid refrigerant between the condenser and the evaporator. The present invention aims to provide a hybrid absorption heat pump system using a regeneratable heat source, which is able to use waste heat and switch between a cooling mode and a heating mode.

title_en: refrigerant pipe structure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a new refrigerant pipe structure, wherein costs can be reduced and cooling efficiency can be improved owing to the simplified structure. The refrigerant pipe structure in accordance with the present invention comprises: a main pipe part (10) having one first low-pressure path (13) which is formed into a metallic bar shape and has low-pressure refrigerant passing inside, and two first high-pressure paths (14) which have high-pressure refrigerant passing inside, and is formed to penetrate front and rear ends; a branching pipe part (20) having a second low-pressure path (23) which is formed into a metallic bar shape and has low-pressure refrigerant passing inside, and a second high-pressure path (24) which has high-pressure refrigerant passing inside, and is formed to penetrate front and rear ends; and a branching part (30) consisting of a branching pipe (33) which includes a supply pipe part (33a) connected to the rear end part of the first low-pressure path (13) and a connection pipe part (33b) branching from the rear end part of the supply pipe part (33a) to be connected respectively to the front end part of the second low-pressure path (23), and a pair of connection pipes which connect the first high pressure paths (14) respectively to the second high-pressure path (24). Therefore, the structure can be simplified to reduce costs owing to the simplified structure of the whole refrigerant pipe, and refrigerant passing the first and the second low-pressure paths (13, 23) and refrigerant passing the first and the second high-pressure path (14, 24) exchange heat with each other to improve cooling efficiency.

title_en: Wet type multifunctional air filter
abstract_en: The present invention provides a wet type multifunctional air filter, which comprises: a lower tank (100) in which water is stored; an upper tank (200) which is detachably mounted on the lower tank (100) and stores water; and a blower (300) which is detachably inserted into and mounted on the upper tank (200). The present invention has the advantage of being able to provide air filtration through a filter and the blower, and provide humidification through an injector.

title_en: A support for an outdoor unit including a hole that can be fixed with a screw.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a support for an outdoor unit of an air conditioner, which is realized to stably support an outdoor unit of an air conditioner while the support installed in an outdoor space is not closely attached to a floor surface. The support comprises a main body unit formed in a rectangular parallelepiped box shape to enable a lower side of the outdoor unit of the air conditioner which is installed in the outdoor space to be supported and spaced upward from the floor surface.

title_en: Anion sterilizing module of air sterilization device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a negative ion sterilization module for an air sterilization device. More specifically, the present invention relates to a negative ion sterilization module for an air sterilization device that can be easily attached to and detached from the inside of the air sterilization device and, at the same time, makes it easy to replace and repair, by being configured to allow each component thereof to be manufactured in a modular state. The negative ion sterilization module for an air sterilization device is configured such that a filling case portion is filled with a plurality of zeolites, so that bacteria and viruses, which are adsorbed to or passed through the zeolites, are oxidized and destroyed by radicals generated by corona discharge, thereby being able to maximize sterilization and bacteriostatic effects.

title_en: Container lid with integrated vent blocking mechanism and operating the same
abstract_en: The present embodiment relates to a container lid that is closed for storage but has a vent hole that automatically opens when the container attached to the container lid is heated. When the container lid is heated, the pressure inside the container increases and pushes the top of the container lid up. When the top of the container lid is pushed up, the vent hole is opened and air or steam can escape through the vent hole. In this way, the container lid can seal the container during storage but also allows for automatic aeration during container heating to prevent excessive pressure from building up inside the container.

title_en: Potential heat using type cooling tank comprising cooling function and storage function applied at heat occuring apparatus, and heat occuring apparatus comprising the potential heat using type cooling tank comprising cooling function and storage function
abstract_en: According to a latent heat utilization type cooling tank having both cooling and storage functions, active temperature control for a heat exchange medium accommodated in a heat source tank casing can be easily performed and even when there is no or very little demand for hot water supply or heating at a consumer using heat generated in a solar heat panel suggested as an example of a heat source unit, it is possible to continuously exhibit a cooling function in the latent heat utilization type cooling tank having both cooling and storage functions and it is possible to continuously use the cooling tank throughout the year regardless of season.

title_en: Hydrogen heat exchange system using renewable energy
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a hydrogen heat exchange system using renewable energy that can be commercially operated by combining a liquefied hydrogen charging station and a gaseous hydrogen charging machine, and can improve the heat exchange efficiency of hydrogen gas and liquefied hydrogen, and can improve the vaporization speed, vaporization amount, safety, and installation area. A hydrogen heat exchange system utilizing renewable energy with a defrosting function includes a first heat exchange part for supplying hydrogen gas to a supply source; a heat exchanger for exchanging heat through at least one selected from geothermal and solar heat as a first heat medium; a second heat exchange part for supplying liquefied hydrogen to a supply source; a radiator for recovering the first heat medium to a supply circulation device; and a defrosting unit for heating the radiator with a second heat medium to remove frost.

title_en: Skirt type de-super heater
abstract_en: Disclosed is a skirt type desuper heater. The disclosed skirt-type desuper heater comprises: a rear end transfer pipe for transferring and guiding heating steam; and a desuper heating spray nozzle for inducing reduced pressure of the heating steam to a saturated steam state by spraying a reduced pressure fluid to the heating steam transferred through the rear end transfer pipe.

title_en: Dry cooling coil megamodule carrier
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a carriage for a dry cooling coil mega module. The carriage for a dry cooling coil mega module comprises: at least one pair of unit bodies extended in a longitudinal direction to support a lower frame of a dry cooling coil mega module and spaced apart in a width direction; and a width direction connection member extended in the width direction between the unit bodies spaced apart in the width direction to connect the unit bodies. The unit body includes: a support unit having a plurality of rollers arranged in the longitudinal direction to guide the longitudinal movement of the dry cooling coil mega module mounted on the unit body, and a support frame extended in the longitudinal direction from both sides in the width direction of the rollers and formed to surround at least a part of the lower frame of the dry cooling coil mega module; a driving unit allowing the carriage to move in the longitudinal direction and the width direction; and a height adjustment unit provided on a lower side of the support frame to adjust the height of the support frame by control.

title_en: Eco-friendly system furniture with improved space utilization and construction properties
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to implement a system which mounts a peltier element-based cooling system inside an upper plate to maintain a pleasant work space of a user and cool the surface of a desk without a separate cooling device. The present invention relates to eco-friendly system furniture with improved space utilization and constructability. The eco-friendly system furniture with improved space utilization and constructability comprises: an upper plate member having a predetermined area; a leg member mounted on a lower portion of the upper plate member; a head member mounted on an upper portion of the upper plate member; a power supply means provided on one side of the eco-friendly system furniture with improved space utilization and constructability; and a cooling means mounted in a space formed inside the upper plate member and the head member and operated by the power supply means.

title_en: Heat exchanger
abstract_en: A heat exchanger comprises: a tube formed with an inlet and an outlet, and extended between the inlet and the outlet to provide a flow path in which a refrigerant flows; a first heat transfer block equipped with a first heat transfer member realized with a composite material comprising a resin material and a carbon material, and a first electrode member coupled to the first heat transfer member; and a second heat transfer block equipped with a second heat transfer member realized with a composite material comprising a resin material and a carbon material, and a second electrode member coupled to the second heat transfer member. According to the present invention, all of the aforementioned objects of the present invention can be achieved. Specifically, since two heat transfer members made of a composite material comprising a resin material and a carbon material are coupled to each other with a tube through which a refrigerant flows therebetween to form a heat transfer structure, manufacturing of the heat exchanger is made easy.

title_en: Manufacturing method of heat sink unit having arbitrary shape
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a heat radiation device having an arbitrary shape. According to the present invention, the method for manufacturing a heat radiation device having an arbitrary shape comprises the steps of: preparing first and second metal plates; molding the first and second metal plates; punching an interior material; placing the interior material; primarily sealing the first and second metal plates; injecting a heat medium; and secondarily sealing the first and second metal plates. According to the present invention, a heat radiation device having excellent heat radiation efficiency can be easily manufactured.

title_en: Air cleaning apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air purifier. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the air purifier comprises: a main fan generating flow of air; a discharge unit formed on an outlet side of the main fan; and an air guide device disposed on the outlet side of the main fan and having an air flow passage formed toward the discharge unit. The air purifier can improve a suction capacity of the air sucked thereinto.

title_en: Revised Ventilation System Combining Air Cleaner Using Plate Type Heat Exchanger and Driving method thereof
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an improved concurrent air purification and ventilation system using a planar total heat exchanger comprises: a ventilation device which is operated by multiple operating modes, controls an exhaust amount passing a total heat exchanger and a path for ventilation of a bypass to be same with or larger than a supply amount according to differences between indoor and outdoor temperature and humidity, concentration of indoor fine dust, and concentration of indoor carbon oxide, and selectively and simultaneously performs ventilation and air purification; and a control unit operating the system by one mode among the multiple operating modes based on changes of the indoor and outdoor temperature and humidity, the concentration of the indoor fine dust, and the concentration of the indoor carbon oxide.

title_en: Air cleaning computer using IoT technology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air cleaning computer using IoT technology. In one embodiment of the present invention, the air cleaning computer using the IoT technology measures the fine dust concentration using a fine dust sensor installed indoors and purifies the indoor air using a fan inside the computer independent of whether the computer operates or not when the measured value exceeds a reference value. In addition, the result and operation status are notified to a user using a smartphone.

title_en: Kitchen air cleaning apparatus of removing noise and sick house syndrome
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kitchen air purifier having a noise removal and sick house syndrome material removal function, as shown in Fig. 1.

title_en: Assembly type booth
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a prefabricated booth, which can be simply installed and used as a booth for one-person broadcasting even at home by directly assembling a plurality of panels having a specific structure by a user. To this end, the prefabricated booth of the present invention comprises: a left plate having a plurality of panels coupled in a rectangular plate shape to form the left wall of a booth; a right plate having a plurality of panels coupled in a rectangular plate shape to form the right wall of the booth; a rear plate having a plurality of panels coupled in a rectangular plate shape to form the rear wall of the booth; a front plate having a plurality of panels coupled in a rectangular plate shape to form the front wall of the booth in a state that one side is opened; a bottom plate having a plurality of panels coupled in a rectangular plate shape to form a bottom surface of the booth; a ceiling plate having a plurality of panels coupled in a rectangular plate shape to form a ceiling surface of the booth; and a door installed on the open side of the front surface of the booth, and selectively opened and closed.

title_en: prefabricated brazier
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a prefabricated brazier and, more specifically, to a prefabricated brazier which can quickly and conveniently assemble a brazier to use the brazier and adjust the brazier to the size of an iron pot to use the brazier. According to the present invention, the prefabricated brazier comprises: a cylindrical body divided into three or more pieces; a connection plate installed to be overlapped with each divided boundary of the body; and a plurality of fastening members penetrating the connection plate to be helically fastened to both ends of the body. According to the present invention, the prefabricated brazier has a structure in which the body is divided into multiple pieces to be overlapped to be loaded to be transported in large quantities. The prefabricated brazier can be easily assembled to be used at a site. When assembling the prefabricated brazier, the intervals of the body can be separated to be assembled to allow the size of the brazier to be extended. Iron pots of various sizes can be used.

title_en: Secondary Tripod
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an auxiliary stove grate that does not deteriorate heat efficiency. According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is an auxiliary stove grate for use in a gas cooktop. The auxiliary stove grate according to one embodiment of the present invention includes a body part having an annular or polygonal shape, a support part extending from the top of the body part to the upper side of the body part, and a mounting part positioned at the bottom of the body part and having grooves, wherein the mounting part is formed in the shape of extending toward the center of the body part.

title_en: Ice making device
abstract_en: Disclosed is an ice maker capable of selectively generating ice having different transparency. According to the present invention, the ice maker comprises: an ice-making chamber having an ice-making container capable of accommodating ice-making water; a cooling unit for supplying cold air to the ice-making chamber to cool the ice-making water; an ice-making fan circulating the supplied cold air; an ice-making heater unit for supplying heat to the ice-making water when cooling the ice-making water; and a control unit configured to adjust a temperature change rate of the ice-making container by controlling at least one of the cooling unit, the ice-making fan, and the ice-making heater unit so that any one type of ice among different types of ice with different transparency is generated. According to the present invention, the ice maker can selectively make ice having the transparency desired by a user by adjusting the temperature change rate of the ice-making container.

title_en: Kitchen hood
abstract_en: A kitchen hood (1) has an air quality sensor assembly (500) sensing the quality of ambient air. The air quality sensor assembly (500) includes a plurality of sensors (500a, 500b, 500c). A sound signal generator (550) is located on an inner side in which the plurality of sensors (500a, 500b, 500c) are placed, and the plurality of sensors (500a, 500b, 500c) and the sound signal generator (550) can share an outer slit (510) formed on the surface of at least one side of an outer housing (110) forming the exterior of the kitchen hood (1). Outer through holes (511,512,513,514) are formed on the inner surface of the outer housing (110) so as to connect the sensors (500a, 500b, 500c) to the outside through the outer slit (510), and a fifth outer through hole (515) can be formed so as to connect the sound signal generator (550) to the outside.

title_en: A Walltype Air Conditioner For Greenhouse
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wall-type greenhouse air conditioner. According to the present invention, the air conditioner is formed with a frame used as a wall of a greenhouse, and thus installation and assembly can be performed with ease and efficient greenhouse space utilization is possible. In addition, the air inside the greenhouse is introduced and circulated with a heat exchange panel portion coated with an antibacterial fabric layer and a hydrophobic coating layer, and thus moisture removal can be performed in the greenhouse and sterilized air can be re-supplied into the greenhouse. The indoor air introduced through an air inlet, first to third inner circulation ports, and an air outlet is circulated in an extended manner in inner circulation and air purification spaces, and thus sufficient sterilization, deodorization, and dehumidification can be performed.

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air conditioner. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the air conditioner suppresses bacterial multiplication by intensively sterilizing a water collection unit positioned at the lowermost part of a drain fan. The air conditioner includes: a housing having an inlet and an outlet, wherein air is inducted through the inlet and discharged through the outlet; a fan arranged in the housing and enabling the air to flow from the inlet to the outlet; a heat exchanger arranged between the fan and the housing, and exchanging the heat between the air and a refrigerant contained inside; a drain fan positioned on the lower side of the heat exchanger, and collecting condensate water to a lower end by tilting downward, wherein the condensate water is formed on the surface of the heat exchanger; a lamp installed in the housing, and radiating sterilizing light to the drain fan by being arranged on the upper side of the lower end of the drain fan; and a display module installed in front of the housing, and outputting an image on the front by receiving the light from the lamp.

title_en: Ice maker and refrigerator including the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an ice maker, and a refrigerator having the same. The ice maker comprises: an ice maker main body installed in an inner space of a refrigerator having a door; a control box provided to one longitudinal end part of the ice maker main body and storing a plurality of electronic components; an ice making tray positioned on one side of the control box and having an ice making groove; a water supply unit supplying ice making water to the ice making tray; and a control unit controlling operation of the water supply unit. The control unit controls operation of the ice maker to be stopped for a predetermined period of time when the water supply unit supplies water more than the preset number of times.

title_en: Safety valve opening prevention fixture
abstract_en: Disclosed is a jig for preventing opening of a safety valve. The jig for preventing the opening of the safety valve according to the present invention comprises: a jig main body unit detachably coupled to a valve body of the safety valve; and a restraining head unit coupled to the jig main body unit so as to be relatively movable, provided in the safety valve, and connected to a central shaft for ejecting a steam by relative movement with respect to the valve body to limit movement of the central shaft. An objective of the present invention is to provide the jig for preventing the opening of the safety valve capable of preventing release of the steam.

title_en: Seawater Electric Boiler
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seawater electric boiler comprising multiple heating devices stacked in multiple up and down stages inside a case body. In each of the heating devices, multiple TCM heaters are installed left and right at regular intervals to discharging water, supplied to water intake pipes, to water discharge pipes while circulating the water in a zigzag and heating the water. The heating device includes: a water intake and discharge circulation mechanism which has multiple front covers each having multiple inlets and outlets capable of assembling the water intake pipes and the water discharge pipes, and has U-shaped connecting passages connecting multiple connectors formed at regular intervals therebetween; a water circulation connection mechanism which has multiple rear covers each having multiple connectors formed thereon at regular intervals and each of U-shaped connecting passages connecting respective pairs of the connectors; and a plurality of TCM heaters which disposed in parallel left and right at regular intervals between the water intake and discharge circulation mechanism and the water circulation connection mechanism to heat the water, supplied to the water intake pipes, while circulating the water in a zigzag and to discharge the same to the water discharge pipes. Therefore, the seawater electric boiler can increase the early growth and productivity of farmed fish species.

title_en: Steamer and apparatus for supplying steam thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a steamer and a steam supply apparatus including the same, capable of preventing malfunction, such as a stop caused by a lack of supply water or error due to voltage difference. The steamer includes: a water supply unit providing the supply water from the outside; a water supply tank having an inlet and an outlet; at least one water level sensor formed on one side of the water supply tank and sensing a water level of the supply water; and a water supply valve arranged to supply the supply water from the water supply unit to the water supply tank. A fixed amount of the supply water is supplied from the water supply unit to the inlet of the water supply tank, and the supply water heated by a heater formed on one side is discharged through the outlet of the water supply tank. The water supply valve performs ON/OFF operation by difference of inner water pressure between the water supply unit and the water supply tank.

title_en: Venturi equipment with cam damper
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a venturi device having a cam-type damper, which rotates a damper using a servo motor to supply air to a mixing passage such that the mixing passage is open, and presses an opening and closing rod using a rotating cam, which rotates integrally with the damper, toward the inside of an opening and closing valve, thereby simultaneously opening the mixing passage and a large diameter gas passage using the damper, and ensuring that the amount of gas supplied into the mixing passage through the large diameter gas passage corresponds to the amount of air supplied into the mixing passage. According to the present invention, the mixing passage is opened by the rotation of the single damper, and the rotating cam which rotates integrally with the damper presses and operates the opening and closing rod of the opening and closing valve to open the large diameter gas passage, such that the gas and the air are supplied to the mixing passage at the same time. In order to correspond to the rotation angle of the damper, the opening area of the mixing passage and the retracting distance of the opening and closing rod which is pressed by the rotating cam are adjusted simultaneously, such that the opening area of the mixing passage and the opening area of the opening and closing valve are automatically adjusted. In particular, by rotating the damper, the amount of air supplied through the large diameter gas passage is automatically adjusted to correspond to the amount of air supplied through the mixing passage, such that the mixing ratio of mixed gas mixed in an internal housing is maintained. The mixing ratio of the mixed gas is maintained, the ignition performance of a combustion device is improved and explosion ignition is prevented, thereby improving product reliability.

title_en: Smart awning apparatus and control method for the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart sunshade and a control method thereof, comprising: a vertical frame formed vertically from the ground in the shape of a pillar; a horizontal frame fixed horizontally to the top of the vertical frame and having a cross-shaped space inside; an awning part provided inside the horizontal frame and forming a shade while spreading in one direction; and a control part that controls the operation of the awning part in conjunction with weather information. Thus, the present invention can provide the smart sunshade and the control method thereof that are automated and actively operate by identifying environmental conditions.

title_en: Smart air sterilization and purification device for ship
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air sterilization and purification device for a ship, which comprises: an upper body including an inlet connected to a duct, and a sterilization lamp sterilizing the air introduced through the duct; a lower body arranged on a lower side of the upper body, and including an outlet discharging the sterilized air, and a filter arranged on the outlet and purifying the sterilized air; and a cover unit arranged on a lower side of the outlet apart from the outlet for a certain distance, and inducing the flow of the sterilized and purified air. The cover unit additionally includes a sensing module which includes: a sensor unit measuring the substances of the sterilized and purified air, and measuring the strength of the sterilization lamp; and a ballast checking the on/off and the presence or absence of a disorder of the sterilization lamp. The sensing module notifies the time for replacing the sterilization lamp in accordance with the measured strength of the sterilization lamp. The upper body additionally includes a control unit including: a sterilization chamber having the sterilization lamp inside, and having a space unit for allowing the introduced air to stay; and a control plate slide-movable through a handle on a lower side of the inlet. The sterilization of the air can be maximized by the space unit of the sterilization chamber. The opening rate of the inlet is controlled in accordance with the movement level of the control plate. Therefore, user convenience can be improved.

title_en: Rotary kiln
