The dehumidification unit (130) has a first separation membrane through which water vapor can permeate, and dehumidifies air to be treated. The composition adjustment unit (120) has a second separation membrane, and separates the air to be treated that has been dehumidified by the dehumidification unit (130) into first air and second air having mutually different compositions. The air conditioning device (100) supplies the first air or the second air that has exited the composition adjustment unit (120) to a storage chamber (2).

title_en: Pipe fitting for water heater, pipe assembly, and water heater
abstract_en: A pipe fitting (10) for a water heater, a pipe assembly (100), and a water heater (200). The pipe fitting (10) for the water heater is used for connecting to a corresponding joint (20). The pipe fitting (10) for the water heater comprises a pipe body (11), wherein one end of the pipe body (11) is provided with a butt-joint section (12) which is integrally formed with the pipe body (11) and is used for connecting to the joint (20); two protruding rings (121) are at least arranged on an outer side wall of the butt-joint section (12); and a recess (122) capable of accommodating sealing members (30) is formed between two adjacent protruding rings (121).

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air conditioner. The air conditioner of the present invention may comprise: a housing having an inlet formed at one side thereof and having an outlet formed at the other side thereof; a fan disposed in the housing to form air flow from the inlet to the outlet; and an electrostatic precipitator disposed in the housing to remove foreign matter in air introduced through the inlet. Accordingly, the air conditioner can filter air introduced through the inlet. The electrostatic precipitator comprises: at least one electrostatic precipitation filter including a first sidewall and a second sidewall arranged opposite to the first sidewall; a first filter handle coupled to the first sidewall; and a second filter handle coupled to the second sidewall.

title_en: Nanofluid for use in solar collectors
abstract_en: The present invention relates to nanofluids comprising nanoparticles from coffee, and processes to make such nanofluids. The invention also provides uses of such nanofluids for absorption of solar radiation in direct absorption solar collectors (DASCs) and as heat transfer fluids. Also provided is a DASC, and a DASC comprising a nanofluid of the invention.

title_en: Methods and devices for adapting a solar module support
abstract_en: Included are methods and devices of adapting a solar module support with pre-formed features that position and/or secure solar module clips. The adaptation may include forming new positioning and/securing features at new locations on the solar module support, or otherwise positioning the solar module clips on the solar module support at locations different from these pre-formed features. These methods and devices allow a solar module support with pre-formed features to accommodate solar modules of different dimensions than originally envisioned.

title_en: Air-conditioning device
abstract_en: An air-conditioning device comprising: an outdoor unit; and a plurality of indoor units having refrigerant piping connected thereto in which a refrigerant that has been delivered from the outdoor unit flows. Each indoor unit comprises: a refrigerant circuit in which at least an evaporator is connected to the refrigerant piping; an operation control unit which controls the refrigerant circuit in accordance with the operation state; a sensor which measures the indoor environment; and a plurality of indoor fans which send air to the evaporator. During a dehumidification operation, the operation control unit controls each of the indoor fans to have a different speed, on the basis of the measurement result from the sensor.

title_en: Plate-fin heat exchanger
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to plate-fin and manifold assemblies for heat exchangers. In some examples, an assembly includes a first plate and a second plate. The assembly also includes a plurality of fins disposed between the first plate and the second plate. In addition, the plurality of fins are spaced apart by a width large enough adapted for counter-flow of a plurality of fluids between adjacent fins of the plurality of fins. Further, the plurality of fins are configured to direct fluid flow across a length of the first plate and the second plate.

title_en: Refrigerant detection method and apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides a refrigerant detection method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium. After a refrigeration mode of an air conditioning system has begun operating, when the operating state of a compressor in the air conditioning system is a normal operating state and refrigerant is not leaking, a relatively large reasonable temperature difference will exist between the temperature of an air outlet of the air conditioner in the refrigeration mode and the temperature of the indoor environment. If the temperature difference between the temperature of the air outlet of the air conditioner in the refrigeration mode and the temperature of the indoor environment does not reach a target temperature difference, and if compressor operation is without issue and running normally, it can clearly be judged that at this time the refrigerant in the air conditioning system is leaking. It can thus be seen that the present refrigerant detection method can effectively judge whether refrigerant is low or leaking by merely detecting the temperature of the air conditioner air outlet and the temperature of the indoor environment, in combination with the operating state of the compressor. Relative to solutions in the prior art, the present refrigerant detection method is simple and effective.

title_en: Steel plant comprising an electric arc furnace and a carbon dioxide capturing system
abstract_en: A steel plant comprising - an electric arc furnace (2) suitable for generating fumes, - a capturing system (1) for capturing carbon dioxide from said fumes exiting said electric arc furnace (2); wherein said capturing system (1) comprises - a dedusting and cooling device (10) for dedusting and cooling the fumes coming from said electric arc furnace (2); - a carbon dioxide extraction apparatus (3) arranged downstream of said dedusting and cooling device (2); - at least one intermediate storage device (4) arranged between the dedusting and cooling device (10) and the carbon dioxide extraction apparatus (3), adapted to store the fumes coming from said dedusting and cooling device (10) and configured as a constant pressure container in order to maintain a constant supply flow of the fumes to said carbon dioxide capturing apparatus (3); wherein, downstream of the carbon dioxide extraction apparatus (3), there are provided - at least one filter (8) and one chimney (9) for the emission of fumes treated in said carbon dioxide extraction apparatus (3); - at least one pipe (22) to convey the fumes treated in said carbon dioxide extraction apparatus (3) towards said at least one filter (8) and said chimney (9).

title_en: Power generation system using hydrogen/oxygen gas production and combustion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power generation system using hydrogen/oxygen gas production and combustion, and, more specifically, to a power generation system using hydrogen/oxygen gas production and combustion, the system producing and separating hydrogen/oxygen gas, separating the separated hydrogen/oxygen gas into hydrogen/oxygen gas again through a cryogenic separation part, burning the separated hydrogen/oxygen gas through a high-temperature combustion burner so that high-speed spray air is generated and sprayed, causing the spraying force to rotate a high-speed turbine, causing a rotary shaft of the high-speed turbine to rotate a power generator so that electricity is generated, and supplying, to a high-temperature steam storage part, the used high-speed spray air that has rotated the high-speed turbine, and returning same to a hydrogen/oxygen gas generator again, such that high-temperature steam, which is a raw material, is circulated while electricity is produced, and thus the present invention can be economically operated at low cost.

title_en: Flexible heat input with spatial control and rate enhancement for metal ore reduction
abstract_en: In embodiments, a system for reduction of metal ore is provided. The system has entrance portion configured to receive the metal ore and a reductant, a reduction portion in fluid communication with the entrance portion configured to reduce the metal ore to a reduction stream. The reduction portion has a plurality of delivery tubes that extend into the reduction portion and are configured to receive at least a portion of the particles and gaseous species and deliver them into the reduction portion for ore reduction, a plurality of heat tubes configured to receive gaseous species for combustion and a second heat source proximate the heat tubes to further heat the particles and gaseous species inside the reduction portion.

title_en: Liquefied gas supercooling system using mixed refrigerant
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a liquefied gas supercooling system for supercooling a liquefied gas using a mixed refrigerant, the system comprising: a compressor for compressing the mixed refrigerant; a separator which is provided on the rear end of the compressor and phase separates the mixed refrigerant into a gas-phase refrigerant and a liquid-phase refrigerant; a fourth line through which the liquid-phase refrigerant separated by the separator flows by passing through a first pressure reduction valve; a fifth line through which the gas-phase refrigerant separated by the separator flows by being reintroduced to a first heat exchanger, a second heat exchanger, a second pressure reduction valve, and the second heat exchanger; a sixth line through which the mixed refrigerant joined from the fourth line and the fifth line flows by passing through the first heat exchanger, the compressor, and the separator; and a freezing prevention unit for controlling the temperature of the mixed refrigerant in the fifth line or the sixth line.

title_en: Heat pipe, electronic device, instrument, and method for manufacturing heat pipe
abstract_en: The present invention efficiently circulates heat irrespective of the orientation in which a heat pipe (20) is used. The heat pipe (20) comprises: a pipe body (21) in which a working fluid is sealed; a sintered body layer (22) formed by sintering a metal powder on the inner wall surface (21a) of the pipe body (21); an evaporation part (201) at which the working fluid evaporates; a condensation part (202) at which the working fluid condenses; and an intermediate part (203) located between the evaporation part (201) and the condensation part (202). At least the intermediate part (203) includes, in a cross section obtained by cutting the same in a direction intersecting the extending direction of the heat pipe (20), a first thickness section having a first thickness (t1) and a second thickness section having a second thickness (t2). The second thickness (t2) is more than the first thickness (t1). The first and second thickness sections in the intermediate part (203) at least partially face each other across the center of the pipe body (21). The second thickness section is formed by a combination of the pipe body (21) and the sintered body layer (22).

title_en: A closed fluid system
abstract_en: Described is, among other things, a closed system (10) withholding a circulating fluid (20). A partially gas filled barrier bag (30) is located inside the closed system5 to control expansion and or contraction of the fluid resulting from temperature variations.

title_en: Sliding block structure and reversing valve
abstract_en: Provided are a sliding block structure and a reversing valve. The sliding block structure comprises a sliding block body (100), a supporting pin rod (200), and supporting pin pieces (300); the sliding block body (100) is provided with an inner cavity (101), first mounting grooves (102) are formed in the cavity wall of the inner cavity (101), and second mounting grooves (103) are respectively formed in the bottoms of the first mounting grooves (102); protruding portions (201) are provided at ends of the supporting pin rod (200), the protruding portions (201) are connected to the supporting pin pieces (300), ends of the protruding portions (201) protrude from first surfaces (301) of the supporting pin pieces (300), and the first surfaces (301) face away from the supporting pin rod (200); and at least part of each supporting pin piece (300) is located in the corresponding first mounting groove (102), and the protruding portions (201) are respectively located in the second mounting grooves (103). The risk that the supporting pin rod (200) falls off the inner cavity (101) of the sliding block body (100) is reduced.

title_en: Methods and systems and apparatus to support reduced energy and water usage
abstract_en: METHODS AND SYSTEMS AND APPARATUS TO SUPPORT REDUCED ENERGY AND WATER USAGE A domestic hot water provisioning system includes a cold water inlet (302) for receiving cold water from a mains supply, a hot water outlet (304) connected for providing hot water on demand to a domestic hot water outlet activated by a user, a heat exchanger (308), the heat exchanger for heating water using a hot fluid received from a hot fluid source (306), an electric heater (326), a thermal storage appliance (342) for storing heat, a circulation pump (320) for pumping water from the thermal storage appliance (342) to the heat exchanger (308), and a controller (340) for controlling operation of the system such that when hot water is being demanded at the hot water outlet (304), then hot water is passed from the heat exchanger (308) to the hot water outlet (304), and, if the hot water at the hot water outlet (304) is determined to be hotter than a desired temperature, cold water from the cold water inlet (302) is passed to mix with the hot water to reduce the temperature of the mixed water passed to the hot water outlet (304), and when it is determined that hot water is not being demanded at the hot water outlet (304), then hot fluid received from the hot fluid source (306) is passed to a heating appliance to provide heating thereof.

title_en: Apparatuses and methods for modifying surfaces of microelectronic devices to promote boiling of a coolant liquid
abstract_en: Apparatuses and methods are disclosed herein to modify one or more surfaces of a microelectronic device by incorporating microstructures that promote boiling of a coolant liquid in a two-phase immersion cooling system. In one example, modifications are made directly to the surface(s) of a lid thermally coupled to a semiconductor die of the microelectronic device. In another example, modifications are made to the surface(s) of a boiler plate, which is thermally coupled to the lid. The modifications may be made using various subtractive, forming, and additive approaches. These approaches may generate less heat than conventional processes, resulting in less or, in some instances, no thermal damage to the microelectronic device. Accordingly, modifications may be made to the surface(s) of a microelectronic device while the device is mounted to a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) of a computing system, thus simplifying testing and validation.

title_en: Three-dimensional meshes and casings for thermal ground planes
abstract_en: Three-dimensional meshes and three-dimensional casings for thermal ground planes are disclosed. These three-dimensional meshes and three-dimensional casings can create a vapor core that has structural resiliency positive or negative pressure differential between the vapor space and external conditions. A thermal ground plane is disclosed that includes a first casing that is substantially planar and a second casing. The outer periphery of the first casing and the outer periphery of the second casing are bonded together to form a hermetic seal. The second casing may be deformed to create a vapor support structure within the thermal ground plane that includes a plurality of deformed portions (or rough pillars). A working fluid may be disposed within the first casing and the second casing. Permeable wicks may also be disposed on an inner surface of the first casing and/or the second casing for liquid transport that is disposed between the first casing and the second casing.

title_en: Portable multi-fuel stove
abstract_en: A portable cooking apparatus includes a plurality of panels configured into a box-like-structure that defines a combustion chamber. A plurality of slots formed in the panels. At least one slat removably installed into one or more of the plurality of slots and extending into the combustion chamber. A top grate operable between a first position and a second position, wherein the top grate is disposed over the combustion chamber in the first position and forms a shelf adjacent the combustion chamber in the second position.

title_en: Hybrid-powered heating plant and process for heating semi-finished metal products, particularly steel semifinished products
abstract_en: Plant (10) for heating metal semi-finished products (SM) comprising : - a furnace (20) comprising: a working chamber (201) with an inlet opening (202) and an outlet opening (203) for the metal semi-finished products (SM), - an advancing assembly (204) configured to advance the metal semi-finished products (SM) along the working chamber (201) from the inlet opening (202) to the outlet opening (203), at least one burner (30) coupled to the furnace (20) and provided with at least one outflow nozzle (301) for a combustible fluid and at least one outflow opening (302) for a comburent fluid in fluid communication with a combustion chamber, which is defined by the working chamber (201) or is in fluid communication or heat exchange therewith; - a first supply duct (40) and a second supply duct (50) for respectively supplying a combustible fluid and a comburent fluid to the outflow nozzle (301) and the outflow opening (302) and being adapted to be coupled at the inlet respectively to a source of a combustible fluid (400) and to a source of a comburent (500) at a feeding temperature T 0 , a suction duct (60) for at least one fraction of the combustion products from the burner (30) and/or of the atmosphere inside the working chamber (201), at least one heat-generating electric unit (70) arranged along the second supply duct (50) upstream of the outflow opening (302) of the burner (30), wherein the electric unit (70) is adapted to be coupled to an electric power source (700) and is configured to transform the electric power into thermal energy for generating heat for heating the comburent fluid to a final pre-heating temperature T 2  higher than the feeding temperature T 0 .

title_en: Method and system for boiler modification under deep peak regulation of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: A method and system for boiler modification under deep peak regulation of a coal-fired power plant, comprising: before deep peak regulation of a coal-fired boiler of a coal-fired power plant, conducting boiler performance calculations under deep peak regulation; carrying out laboratory tests on the combustion characteristics of pulverized coal under a low load to obtain kinetic parameters related to the combustion characteristics of the pulverized coal, and using a numerical simulation method to study and obtain design parameters of a burner under the low load; carrying out on-site optimization tests for deep peak regulation on the coal-fired boiler of the coal-fired power plant to obtain on-site test data; with reference to the kinetic parameters related to the combustion characteristics of the pulverized coal and the design parameters of the burner under the low load, on the basis of the results of boiler performance calculations and the on-site test data, carrying out engineering modification under deep peak regulation; and carrying out on-site optimization to achieve optimal operation. By studying and obtaining the combustion characteristics of the pulverized coal and the design parameters of the burner under the low load, the method provides a basis for on-site engineering modification and can adapt to boiler modification under low-load deep peak regulation.

title_en: Indoor unit, and heating and ventilation apparatus
abstract_en: An indoor unit (10), and a heating and ventilation apparatus. The indoor unit (10) comprises a housing (1), an electric motor bracket (5), an electric motor cover (6) and an electric motor (4), wherein the electric motor bracket (5) is connected to the housing (1), the electric motor cover (6) covers the electric motor bracket (5) and is detachably connected to the electric motor bracket (5), such that the electric motor (4) is fixed between the electric motor bracket (5) and the electric motor cover (6); and the electric motor cover (6) is exposed to the bottom of the indoor unit (10), so as to facilitate maintenance of the electric motor (4).

title_en: Nuclear energy heating system coupled with molten salt energy storage, and heating method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of peak regulation of nuclear energy heating systems. Disclosed are a nuclear energy heating system coupled with molten salt energy storage, and a heating method thereof. The system comprises a reactor, an intermediate loop, a heat utilization loop, a molten salt loop, and a molten salt-heating network loop; the intermediate loop comprises an intermediate loop-molten salt heat exchanger; the heat utilization loop comprises a primary heat user and a centralized heating network; the molten salt loop comprises a molten salt storage tank; the molten salt-heating network loop comprises a molten salt side heating network heat exchanger; when the heat used by the primary heat user is low, the reactor transfers part of heat to the molten salt storage tank in the molten salt loop by means of the intermediate loop-molten salt heat exchanger for temporary storage; when the heat demand of the centralized heating network is high, the heat stored in the molten salt storage tank is transferred into the centralized heating network. The molten salt energy storage loop of the present invention stores redundant heat when the heat demand of a user is low, and uses the heat for peak regulation in a loop with large heat demand fluctuation, thereby improving the flexibility of a nuclear energy system during heating.

title_en: Refrigerant-containing composition, use thereof, refrigerator having same, and method for operating said refrigerator
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a novel refrigerant mixture having a low GWP. Specifically, the present disclosure provides a refrigerant-containing composition, wherein the refrigerant comprises trans-1,2-difluoroethylene (HFO-1132(E)), propane, and 1,1-difluoroethylene (HFO-1132a) and may further include difluoromethane (R32), the proportions of these compounds being limited so as to be in certain ranges.

title_en: Heat exchanger
abstract_en: A header (21) of an outdoor heat exchanger (1) is formed with a divergent flow path (57) through which a refrigerant flows from one end (41) side toward another end (42) side, an inflow space (43) adjacent to the one end (41) side of the divergent flow path (57), an inflow port (61) through which the refrigerant flows from the inflow space (43) to the one end (41) side of the divergent flow path (57), and a plurality of insertion spaces (46) which are arranged in a header longitudinal direction (25) and in each of which one end of each of a plurality of heat transfer tubes (23) is disposed, wherein: the plurality of insertion spaces (46) include a first one-end-side insertion space (91) adjacent to the inflow space (43), and a second one-end-side insertion space (92) adjacent to the first one-end-side insertion space (91); the header (21) is formed with a one end-side communication passage (106) that provides communication between the first one-end-side insertion space (91) and the second one-end-side insertion space (92).

title_en: Ultra-long high-precision bright-finished stainless steel seamless heat exchanger tube
abstract_en:
An ultra-long high-precision bright-finished stainless steel seamless heat exchanger tube, comprising a tube body. A preparation method therefor comprises the following steps: preparation of a tube blank; acid pickling; polishing; solution treatment; rolling; degreasing; solution treatment; straightening and cutting; acid pickling; inspection; rolling; degreasing; oxygen-free bright solution treatment; straightening; fixed-length cutting; inspection of finished products; non-
destructive testing; hydrostatic testing; drying; and shipping. The present invention has the following advantage: an ultra-long high-precision bright-finished seamless heat exchanger tube can be manufactured by means of rational space arrangement and process design.

title_en: Anti-condensation control method for electric motor, anti-condensation control method, and electronic device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of air conditioning devices, and particularly relates to an anti-condensation control method for an electric motor, an anti-condensation control method, and an electronic device and an air conditioner. The anti-condensation control method for an electric motor comprises: when there are two sets of excitation windings, shielding one of the two sets of excitation windings, such that said set of excitation windings is in a de-energized state; or, when there are more than two sets of excitation windings, shielding at least two sets of excitation windings at asymmetric positions, such that the at least two sets of excitation windings are in a de-energized state; and energizing unshielded excitation windings in an electric motor, such that the electric motor is in a non-operating state and generates heat, thereby implementing an anti-condensation treatment for the electric motor.

title_en: Adsorption refrigeration device and server liquid cooling system
abstract_en: An adsorption refrigeration device, characterized by comprising an adsorption bed (7) and a condenser (9) arranged side by side in the horizontal direction. A first steam inlet is provided at the upper portion of the condenser (9), and a first steam outlet is provided at the upper portion of the adsorption bed (7), the first steam inlet leading to the first steam inlet. The described arrangement can well improve the overall efficiency and reduce the steam transfer resistance between the condenser (9) and the adsorption bed (7). Therefore, the adsorption refrigeration device can effectively solve the problem of poor steam transfer effects between condensers (9) and adsorption beds (7). Also disclosed in the present invention is a server liquid cooling system comprising the adsorption refrigeration device.

title_en: Heating device and manufacturing method therefor, and household appliance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of heating devices. Disclosed are a heating device and a manufacturing method therefor, and a household appliance. The heating device specifically comprises a heating accessory, water nozzles, and second supports. The heating accessory is provided with at least one fluid channel and fluid interfaces arranged at two ends of the fluid channel; the water nozzles are detachably connected to the respective fluid interfaces; the second supports are connected to the side of the heating accessory facing the water nozzles, a second through hole is formed in each second support, and one end of the corresponding water nozzle passes through and extends out of the second through hole, wherein the water nozzle can be moved into or out of the second through hole and can be detachably mounted to the fluid interface. The water nozzle can directly extend into the through hole and be mounted to the fluid interface, greatly simplifying the mounting steps of the water nozzle. In addition, the water nozzle can also be directly removed via the second through hole without removing the corresponding second support, thereby facilitating maintenance or replacement of the water nozzle.

title_en: Double acting boost arrangement
abstract_en: A valve assembly, is presented that has a seating member is slidably coupled to a valve body adjacent a valve body bore and has a metal seat located on a seating end thereof that is engagable against a ball valve member. The seating member has a vent port located there through to allow fluid to flow into a fluid chamber within the ball housing. A first piston is slidably located between the seating member and the ball housing and located over the vent port, and a second piston is slidably located between the seating member and the ball housing and is located downhole from the first piston. Sealing members are located between the first and second pistons and engaged against the seating member.

title_en: Fastener for canopy cover
abstract_en:
A mechanical fastener (40) for fastening a canopy cover (30) to a ceiling fan or light fixture (10) affixed to a 
ceiling comprises an elongate body member (51). The body member (51) has at least one engaging portion 
(44, 45, 46) configured to releasably engage with at least one corresponding engaging portion (33) located 
within the canopy cover (30). The body member (51) is shaped to enable progressive insertion of the 
fastener (40) through an opening (31) of the canopy cover (30), in an insertion direction (62), so that the 
engaging portion (44, 45, 46) releasably engages with the corresponding engaging portion (33) to prevent, 
or at least inhibit, movement of the fastener (40) through the opening (31) in at least a direction opposite to 
the insertion direction (62). The continued insertion of the fastener (40) in the insertion direction (62) causes 
the engaging portion (44, 45, 46) and the corresponding engaging portion (33) to fully disengage.

title_en: Apparatus for securing device to transmission lines
abstract_en: Apparatus adapted for attachment to transmission lines, the apparatus comprising a warning marker; and a warning marker application tool for applying the warning marker to transmission lines; wherein the warning marker comprises: at least one securing means adapted to engage the transmission lines; a first handle and a second handle each connected to the at least one securing means; a spring-biased clamp means adjacent the proximal end at the least one securing means; an attachment means adjacent the at least one securing means; and wherein the application tool comprises: a base means; a first protrusion and a second protrusion each protruding from a surface of the base means; a screw mechanism attached to the base means; wherein the first protrusion and the second protrusion are each adapted to releasably engage with the first handle and the second handle respectively, to position and clamp the warning marker to the transmission lines.

title_en: Mill liner bolt for a mill liner of an ore grinding mill
abstract_en:
There is disclosed a bolt and liner assembly for an ore mill. The bolt has a bolt head, 
an elongated cylindrical threaded shank, and a tapered neck extending from the bolt 
head to the shank. The liner has one or more countersunk through-holes for receiving 
5 the bolt, each through-hole having an entry opening, an exit opening, and a tapered 
side wall provided between the entry opening and the exit opening. The bolt head has 
opposed arcuate faces and opposed substantially flat faces, wherein the arcuate faces 
have a common central axis that extends co-linear with the longitudinal axis and 
defines a common rotational axis so that, during use, the tapered neck remains in 
10 contact with the side wall through a constant contact area during rotation of the bolt 
head relative to the mill liner.

title_en: A multi-conduit system
abstract_en: A multi-conduit system has a joiner section comprising a plurality of conduits in parallel and a joining end for connection to a plurality of exposed like conduits of an adjacent section in use. The conduits of the section terminate at a proximal end of the joining end which comprises a collar widens in diameter from the conduits to form an open mouth. The collar defines an inner profile having a plurality of lobes having respective inner profiles corresponding to outer profiles of respective exposed like conduits such that, in use, when the like conduits of the adjacent section are inserted into the mouth, the lobes of the collar non-rotatably engage the like conduits to correctly align each conduit of the section with a respective like conduit of the adjacent section.

title_en: Drive unit and personal care device with a drive unit
abstract_en: The present application is concerned with a drive unit arranged for converting a rotational motion into a linear reciprocating motion in operation that has a motor having a motor shaft arranged for providing a rotational motion of the motor shaft around a longitudinal axis of the motor shaft in operation, a motor shaft extension comprising at least a first eccentric shaft element that is arranged eccentrically with respect to the longitudinal axis of the motor shaft so that in operation the first eccentric shaft element moves on a circle around the longitudinal axis of the motor shaft, the circle extending in a plane being perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, at least one elastically deformable unit having a coupling element arranged for coupling with a driven element, wherein the first eccentric shaft element is coupled with the deformable unit to periodically deform the deformable unit so that a longitudinal position in the direction of the longitudinal axis of the motor shaft of the coupling element of the deformable unit periodically changes, and wherein the deformable unit has a first arm section having a first end and a second end and a second arm section having a first end and a second end, wherein the second end of the first arm section and the first end of the second arm section are connected with each other, wherein the first end of the first arm section is connected with a mounting structure that is fixed relative to the motor and the second end of the second arm section is arranged with a distance to the first end of the first arm section in the direction of the longitudinal axis of the motor shaft.

title_en: Disc brake, brake caliper of a disc brake, as well as hold-down piece and leaf spring for securing the brake linings of a disc brake
abstract_en:
The invention relates to a disc brake comprising a brake caliper (1), which engages over a 
brake disc that can rotate on an axis (A) and brake linings (2, 3) arranged on both sides thereof 
5 in a lining groove (6), comprising a hold-down arrangement (8) formed by a rigid hold-down 
piece (7) and a leaf spring (9) and leading transversely over the brake linings (2, 3), wherein 
the hold f4 down piece (7) has a central section (7b) forming the majority of its total length and 
leading over the lining groove (6), and two end sections (7a, 7c), wherein the hold-down piece 
is supported against the brake linings (2, 3) towards the disc brake axis (A), and wherein said 
10 hold-down piece extends at least partially into a slot (14) of the brake caliper (1) with the first 
end section (7a) thereof, and wherein the leaf spring (9) extends in the longitudinal direction of 
the hold-down piece (7) and is spring-elastically supported against the outer side of the hold
down piece (7) facing away from the brake linings (2, 3). In order to more simply configure the 
fixing of the elements.

title_en: Fastener driver
abstract_en: A fastener driver comprises a hexalobular shaped head that includes a front portion, a rear portion, and a curved intermediate portion disposed between the front portion and the rear portion. Protrusions and recesses extend along a first axial length of the front portion substantially parallel to the longitudinal axis, such that at least one of the apex diameter or the root diameter remain substantially constant along the first axial length. The protrusions and recesses extend along a second axial length of the rear portion and taper away from the longitudinal axis as they extend longitudinally toward the first end, wherein at least one of the apex diameter or the root diameter increase linearly toward the first end along the second axial length of the second portion. The protrusions and the recesses curve away from the longitudinal axis from the front portion to the rear portion in a concave manner.

title_en: Improved pulley apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pulley apparatus suitable for use in a tensioner assembly for a vehicles. The pulley apparatus includes a pulley body, a bearing arrangement and an outer "sleeve" or surface of the pulley body configured to substantially protect the pulley body form wear in use. In use the pulley body includes a sleeve 5 suitable to resist wear during use, to provide improved longevity of the pulley when compared to the prior art. The invention also relates to variants thereon and methods of use.

title_en: Piping unit for liquefied gas and method for assembling same
abstract_en: A piping unit (1) for transferring liquefied gas comprises a first straight pipe (3A) and a second straight pipe (3B). The first straight pipe (3A) extends linearly, and includes a first inner pipe (5A) that allows the liquefied gas to pass therethrough and a first outer pipe (9A) that covers the first inner pipe (5A) with a vacuum layer (7) therebetween. The second straight pipe (3B) includes a second inner pipe (5B) that allows the liquefied gas to pass therethrough and a second outer pipe (9B) that covers the second inner pipe (5B) with a vacuum layer (7) therebetween. The second straight pipe (3B) extends linearly in a direction different from the extension direction of the first straight pipe (3A). The piping unit (1) further comprises: a connection bent pipe (11) that connects the first inner pipe (5A) and the second inner pipe (5B); and a cover pipe (15) that covers a connection portion (13) between the first inner pipe (5A) and the second inner pipe (5B), the connection portion (13) including at least the connection bent pipe (11).

title_en: Systems and tools for use with surgical robotic manipulators
abstract_en: 45 SYSTEMS AND TOOLS FOR USE WITH SURGICAL ROBOTIC MANIPULATORS A tool for use with a surgical robotic manipulator that comprises an energy applicator including a shaft extending along an axis between a proximal end and a distal end. The shaft has an axial-force receiving surface. A tool assembly comprises a support structure to support the energy applicator, an axial connector assembly arranged to engage and releasably lock the energy applicator to the support structure in a locked state, a drive system coupled to the support structure to rotatably drive the shaft of the energy applicator about the axis, a collet assembly cooperating with the axial connector assembly and configured to apply a force to the axial-force receiving surface of the energy applicator in the locked state, and a reference surface. The force includes an axial component directing the energy applicator proximally into continuous contact with the reference surface in the locked state. SYSTEMS AND TOOLS FOR USE WITH SURGICAL ROBOTIC MANIPULATORS

title_en: Universal casket ornament attachment mechanism and method
abstract_en: A casket comprises a casket shell including at least one keyhole groove in an exterior surface thereof, a casket lid closeable on the shell, the lid including a magnetic cap panel mounted therein, a universal ornament base having a front side and a rear side, the rear side including at least one magnet mounted thereon and at least one fastener secured thereto, the fastener having a head thereon, and an ornament insert secured to the front side of the ornament base. The ornament base and ornament insert can be removably secured to the shell by inserting the head of the fastener in the keyhole groove of the shell and seating the head of the fastener in the keyhole groove, or the ornament base and ornament insert can be removably secured to the lid by positioning the magnet on the magnetic cap panel, as desired.

title_en: Valve device
abstract_en: A valve device includes a body in which a gas flow passage is provided; and a check valve provided in the gas flow passage, the check valve including a poppet and a valve seat. The poppet excluding a block portion is in a form of a hollow shaft, the block portion being located at a distal end of the poppet and having a taper shape, and the poppet has at least one side hole that provides communication between an inside and an outside of a portion of the poppet, the portion being in the form of the hollow shaft. The at least one side hole extends obliquely with respect to a central axis line of the poppet such that the at least one side hole extends along a gas flow direction inclined with respect to a direction in which the poppet moves when the check valve opens.

title_en: Multiple parts reed valve and method of manufacturing
abstract_en: An improved membrane valve and method for manufacturing such membrane valve. The improved membrane valve can be used for transferring fluids or gases in hermetic or semi-hermetic compressors, including a method and system for manufacturing a membrane valve and a membrane valve with applications for use in several motors, particularly in hermetic or semi-hermetic compressors which use, as a refrigeration fluid, an appropriate type of gas thus promoting the refrigeration physical affect. A body and a membrane of the membrane valve are produced from substantially thin metallic plates separately in accordance to an available process and can be subjected to rounding in order to eliminate live comers, and then juxtaposed thus composing the valve, with the above mentioned membrane on one side, fitted to the body which is fixed through a connection process and, on the other side, left free to oscillate

title_en: Channel lock fasteners and fastening system
abstract_en: A friction fit fastening system, that creates a firm and invisible connection between panels or substrates without the use of tools or glue, comprising a fastener and mating rout. The fastener has a ramp element that allows it to slide and connect to a mating rout. Different routs are used for different embodiments of the fasteners. The rout is formed directly in the panel face or edge or formed on a substrate by a router bit that has three cutting edges. The connections made by the friction fit fastening system are invisible. The fasteners can be installed at the manufacturing site so the user simply slides or inserts the fasteners into the appropriate slot or hole when assembling. The friction fit fastening system is easily removable from the panels making assembling and disassembling quick and easy because the fastener is made of one piece.

title_en: Turbine of a gas turbine engine comprising a labyrinth seal element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a turbine of a gas turbine engine. Said turbine includes a stator sealing ring element arranged so as to foirit a labyrinth sealing joint in combination with at least one wiper, rotatable about the axis of the sealing ring. The element includes an abradable material layer with a surface portion engageable with said movable wiper.  Said turbine is characterized in that the abradable material layer on said surface portion axially includes a first area having a first wiper penetration resistance, said first area corresponding to the axial position of the wiper during nominal operation of the turbine, and a second area adjacent to the first area and having lower wiper penetration resistance than the first area. Said second area is located downstream from the first area and corresponds to the axial position that the wiper takes when a flame goes out in the combustion chamber of the engine.

title_en: Sliding joint for load alleviation
abstract_en: Example methods and systems for isolating and alleviating load in an aircraft are described, comprising providing a sliding joint between a seat track and a flight deck floor panel. The sliding joint comprises a lug comprising a first end and a second end opposite the first end, wherein the first end is adapted to attach to the seat track and the second end comprises an elongate aperture, and a clevis comprising an oblate shaped slider bushing that is coupled to the lug.

title_en: Press connection system with fittings, a press tool, inserts therefore and a tubing system
abstract_en: A press connection system comprises a press tool (50, 60), a fitting (1) and at least a first tube (2) of a first tube diameter (R13), the press tool (50) to act with force on a deformation zone (3) of the fitting (1). The deformation zone (3) is pressed either on a first tube (2) of a first tube diameter (R13) or to a second tube (2) of a second tube diameter (R23), the second tube diameter (R23) being smaller than the first tube diameter (R13). Further, a press tool, inserts therefore and a tubing system and the use of these enable to connect tubes of more than one diameter to the fitting.

title_en: Nuclear fuel rod and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The nuclear fuel rod comprises nuclear fuel contained in a cladding (4), the cladding (4) comprising a tube (6) and two end caps (8), the tube (6) extending along a central axis (A) and having two ends, each end cap (8) being fastened to a respective end of the tube (6), sealingly closing this end. The tube (6) is covered by a tube coating (16) extending over the entire length of the tube (16), from one end of the tube (6) to the other.

title_en: Pressure regulating shut-off valve
abstract_en: A pressure regulating shut-off valve (PRSOV) for an aircraft anti-ice system is provided. The PRSOV (10) comprises: a valve body (11) defining an inlet (12) and an outlet (13), and a fluid flow path (14) between the inlet and the outlet. A  first piston (15) is operable as a shut-off piston, the first piston being actuable between a first position in which fluid flow between the inlet and the outlet is permitted, and a second position in which fluid flow between the inlet and the outlet is prevented.  A second piston (16) is operable as a shut-off piston and as a regulating piston, the second piston being actuable between a first position in which fluid flow between the inlet and the outlet is permitted and a second position in which fluid flow between the inlet and the outlet is prevented, and being actuable to regulate flow between the inlet and the outlet. A third piston (17) is operable as a regulating piston, the third piston being actuable to regulate flow between the inlet and the outlet.

title_en: Percussion drilling apparatus and torque transfer method
abstract_en: A drill rod for transferring torque comprises a casing for connection in a drill string. The casing is coupled to an internal body by a torque transferring mechanism at each end of the casing such that torque applied to an end of the drill rod is transferred through both of the casing and the body.

title_en: Ball valve with downstream residue purge
abstract_en: A downstream ball valve purging inlet directs purging fluid intentionally onto a downstream portion of the valve ball. The Coanda effect attaches some of the fluid to the ball's surface, so that it flows around the ball to an opposite side thereof, thereby purging the downstream valve cavity more efficiently than designs that avoid impacting the ball and depend on mixing to distribute the purging fluid onto the ball. The purging inlet can be downstream of the ball and directed at an acute angle, proximate the ball and directed perpendicular to the outlet axis, or some combination thereof. A central cavity purging drain can be connected with the purging inlet, so that the same fluid purges both the valve interior and the downstream cavity. Embodiments include a plurality of downstream purging inlets, which can have equal purging angles and can be equally spaced about the outlet axes.

title_en: External transportation system of liquefied natural gas receiving station
abstract_en: The invention relates to an external transportation system of a liquefied natural gas receiving station, which is characterized in that: the LNG low-pressure pump system comprises an LNG storage tank, an LNG low-pressure pump, an LNG gasification system, a BOG pressurization system and a high-pressure compression system; the LNG storage tank is used for storing LNG transported from the outside; the low-pressure pump is arranged at the bottom in the LNG storage tank and is connected with an LNG gasification system arranged outside the LNG storage tank through a low-pressure outward delivery main pipe inserted from a pipe orifice of a dome of the LNG storage tank; the BOG pressurization system is communicated with the interior of the LNG storage tank through a header pipe inserted from another pipe orifice on the dome of the LNG storage tank, and a pressure regulating valve is arranged at the outlet of the BOG pressurization system and used for regulating the pressure of an outlet pipeline of the BOG pressurization system; the LNG gasification system and the BOG pressurization system are connected with the high-pressure compression system through a tee joint, and the mixed gas is pressurized by the high-pressure compression system and then conveyed to an external conveying pipe network through an external conveying pipeline. The LNG receiving station external transmission system can be widely applied to the field of LNG receiving station external transmission systems.

title_en: Multifunctional safety valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional safety valve, comprising: the water inlet is arranged on the first shell, and the water outlet is arranged on the second shell; the inner cavity of the first shell is divided into a narrow cavity and a wide cavity which are connected together, and the water inlet is formed in the narrow cavity; a first step sealed with the wide cavity, a second step capable of being sealed with the narrow cavity and a third step smaller than the narrow cavity are formed on the second shell; a water outlet is arranged on the side wall of the second step, and a first sealing element and a pressure relief opening which can block the water inlet are arranged on the third step; an inner cavity which is used for communicating the water outlet, the pressure relief port and the water outlet is arranged in the second shell, and a pressure relief valve core which can separate the pressure relief port from the water outlet is arranged in the inner cavity. According to the invention, the switching of pressure resistance test, pressure relief and water drainage functions can be realized by adjusting the relative positions of the first shell and the second shell, and the pressure relief valve core only serves as a pressure relief function, so that the pressure relief value is stable.

title_en: Medical multifunctional support arm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a medical multi-functional support arm, includes the base, the base be U-shaped rotatory 90 degrees, use screw rod one as the rotation axis to be provided with left and right sides regulation seat in the U-shaped, be provided with a round cover in controlling the groove-shaped of regulation seat front portion, be provided with the sleeve pipe in round cover outer wall radial upward, be provided with screw rod two in the sleeve pipe, the regulating spindle is worn to establish by the screw rod lower extreme, the regulating spindle is arranged in the round cover, lower pressure spring sets up in the sleeve pipe, establish in the sleeve pipe interpolation and be connected with down the regulation pipe, upward the regulation pipe is inserted from the last port of down the regulation pipe and is established in down the regulation pipe, upward the regulation pipe is provided with the regulation locking sleeve pipe with down regulation pipe joint position, upward the regulation pipe upper end is connected with rotatory bulb, be connected with the connecting rod on the rotatory bulb. The support arm has multiple adjustment dimensions, adjustable locking force and flexible adjustment, and is convenient and reliable to use on medical instruments.

title_en: Energy-saving heating regulating valve
abstract_en: The invention provides a heating energy-saving regulating valve, which comprises a motor, a worm gear speed reducing mechanism, a packing seal, a valve plate, a worm shaft extending into the valve body, and a sector worm gear arranged in the valve body, wherein the worm gear of the worm gear speed reducing mechanism directly drives the worm shaft, the worm shaft is in transmission connection with the sector worm gear, the sector worm gear is vertically arranged and fixedly connected with the plate surface of the valve plate, and the sector worm gear rotates along with the worm shaft and drives the valve plate to rotate, so that the water flow area in the valve body is changed through the valve plate, and the water flow size is changed. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that: the primary speed change is arranged in the valve, so that the requirement of a large speed ratio can be met, the structure of a primary speed change box is reduced, meanwhile, the fan-shaped worm wheel directly pushes the valve plate to rotate, the valve plate shaft is only responsible for rotating and does not generate torque, and the adjusting capacity and the service life of the valve plate and the valve plate shaft are improved.

title_en: Pressure relief valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pressure relief valve, which aims at providing a pressure relief valve with compact structure and convenient installation, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a pressure relief opening and a pressure relief valve arranged opposite to the pressure opening, wherein the pressure relief valve comprises a pressure relief base, a sealing element, an elastic element and a clamping element; the pressure release base is inside to be equipped with a circular cavity, and cavity one end is linked together with the pressure release mouth, and the other end and joint spare joint leave certain clearance that is used for giving vent to anger between joint spare and the pressure release base, and the sealing member is located the cavity and laminates each other with the pressure release mouth, and the elastic component is located between sealing member and the joint spare, and the elastic component supports tight sealing member and joint spare. In the pressure release process, when gas gets into the cavity from the pressure release mouth, contradict on the sealing member, along with gaseous increase, sealing member upward movement promotes the elastic component, and the sealing member contradicts the joint spare and stops the motion, and gaseous outflow from the gap between cavity and the buckle reaches the purpose of pressure release.

title_en: Support system for gas exhaust pipe in underground comprehensive pipe rack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a support system for a gas exhaust pipe in an underground comprehensive pipe gallery, which relates to the field of municipal gas matching design and comprises a fixed support, a sliding support, an anti-seismic support and a spring support. The sliding support is fixed on the side wall of the cabin body, one end of the anti-seismic support is obliquely crossed and fixed with the sliding support, and the spring support is fixed on the bottom plate of the cabin body and is positioned at the position where the pipeline enters and exits the cabin. The invention well solves the problems of support, thermal expansion and non-uniform settlement of the gas exhaust pipes in the underground comprehensive pipe gallery.

title_en: Ball and socket joint for a vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ball and socket joint (20) for a vehicle, in particular for an off-road vehicle. The ball and socket joint has a housing (21) and a ball pin (22) mounted in the housing in a rotatable and pivoting manner, said ball pin extending with a shank (23) from an opening of the housing. The housing opening is protected by a sealing bellows (25) against undesired penetration of dirt and/or moisture. The ball and socket joint is characterized in that the sealing bellows is partially surrounded by a bellows shield (30) in order to prevent the sealing bellows from being damaged by mechanical action.

title_en: Gas sealing device for nuclear power heat-shrinkable sleeve
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas sealing device for a nuclear power heat-shrinkable tubing, which comprises a butt flange, a locking flange and a sealing structure arranged between the butt flange and the locking flange; the sealing structure comprises two pieces of foaming silicon rubber and a supporting structure arranged between the two pieces of foaming silicon rubber. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the foamed silicon rubber is supported by the supporting structure, so that the deformation of the foamed silicon rubber is avoided, and the internal pressure of the hot steel barrel is ensured not to be leaked.

title_en: Adjustable stop valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable stop valve, which comprises a main pipeline, wherein first flanges are arranged at two ends of the main pipeline, a first vertical pipe is arranged at the upper end of the right side of the main pipeline, a first valve core is arranged in the main pipeline corresponding to the first vertical pipe, a first valve rod is arranged on the upper surface of a partition plate of the first valve core, a clamping groove is arranged on the upper surface of the first valve rod, a circular plate is arranged at the upper end of the side surface of the first valve rod, four uniformly distributed limiting holes are arranged on the upper surface of the circular plate, a second flange is arranged on the upper surface of the first vertical pipe, and a valve cover is arranged on the upper side of the first vertical pipe. This adjustable stop valve can be adjusted the velocity of flow of the inside liquid of trunk line through the second case, still can improve the stability of second case through the guide arm, avoids liquid to drive the second case and rotates, can drive the first case through stepper motor is indirect moreover, can prevent the inside liquid refluence of trunk line, convenient to use.

title_en: Integrated high-power direction valve oil cylinder and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of an integrated high-power direction valve oil cylinder, which adopts the structural design and step control of a control valve and an integrated high-power direction valve to replace the traditional hydraulic pile hammer oil cylinder, so that the space volume and the cost are not greatly increased while the power and the hydraulic flow are increased, and the problems that the control and the assembly of the traditional oil cylinder control oil way are finished in a mode of integrating an upper guide sleeve or a lower guide sleeve of the oil cylinder by adopting a plurality of conventional hydraulic cartridge valves, and the pipeline is complex and the maintenance is troublesome are solved. The invention also provides an integrated high-power direction valve oil cylinder for implementing the method, which integrates the control valve and the oil cylinder, simplifies the oil way of the control valve group by adopting the structural design of the integrated high-power direction valve, reduces the number of cartridge valves, reduces the production cost and the occupied space of the oil cylinder, is convenient to install and detach, is convenient and efficient to maintain, and is widely applicable to the field of hydraulic pile hammers.

title_en: Engineering machinery hydraulic system and engineering machinery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic system of engineering machinery and the engineering machinery, relates to the field of engineering machinery, and is used for realizing real-time tensioning of a chain in the working process of the engineering machinery. The hydraulic system of the engineering machinery comprises a hydraulic pump, a control valve group, a first executing element and a second executing element. The first executing element is connected with the hydraulic pump through the control valve group; the second actuating element is connected with the hydraulic pump through the control valve group and is used for tensioning the chain wound on the first actuating element. Wherein the control valve block is configured to simultaneously supply oil to the first and second actuators. According to the technical scheme, the control valve group is arranged, and oil is continuously supplied to the first executive component and the second executive component in the working process of the first executive component. As soon as the chain is loose, the second actuating element pushes the chain to move to tension the chain. The technical scheme realizes real-time tensioning of the chain.

title_en: Assembling process of wireless charging module and assembling bonding wire
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assembly process and an assembly bonding line of a wireless charging module, wherein the assembly bonding line comprises a first indexing turntable, a second indexing turntable, a third indexing turntable and a fourth indexing turntable which are sequentially arranged from front to back, and a plurality of stations are arranged on the first indexing turntable, the second indexing turntable, the third indexing turntable and the fourth indexing turntable. The invention adopts a full-automatic and linear assembly process, can realize full-automatic assembly, automatic detection and automatic rejection of defective products with high efficiency in a large scale, is provided with four indexing turntables in total, and is provided with targeted assembly equipment around each indexing turntable, the whole assembly and lamination line has compact structure and high modularization, and part of the assembly and lamination line is provided with a shaping mechanism, so that the lamination precision is high, the lamination precision can reach +/-0.1 mm, the yield is high, and the production efficiency can reach 1200pcs/h. Defective products can be removed, finished product detection is realized, full-automatic assembly and automatic detection are realized, and defective products are automatically removed.

title_en: Overload oil supplementing valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overload oil supplementing valve, which comprises a valve block, an overflow valve and four one-way valves, wherein the overflow valve and the four one-way valves are arranged in the valve block, two oil ports and an overflow port are formed in the valve block, the two oil ports are in one-to-one correspondence with the positions of two valve ports on an oil port mounting platform of a superposition type balance valve, and any one of the two oil ports is a high-pressure side oil port and the other one is a low-pressure side oil port; the overload protection function is realized by utilizing the 3 rd one-way valve and the overflow valve or the 4 th one-way valve and the overflow valve, the function of supplementing hydraulic oil is realized by utilizing the 2 nd one-way valve or the 1 st one-way valve, and the overload protection function and the function of supplementing hydraulic oil are integrated on the overload oil supplementing valve, so that the integration of the valve is improved; the overload oil supplementing valve is directly additionally arranged on the oil port mounting platform of the superposition type balance valve, so that the overload oil supplementing valve is convenient to mount and saves mounting space; no additional pipeline is needed, so that not only are various costs caused by the pipeline saved, but also the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Sliding assembly
abstract_en: The invention provides a sliding assembly which can achieve the opposite conditions of sealing and lubrication when the high-pressure fluid side is gas and the low-pressure fluid side is liquid. The sliding module of the invention is characterized in that the sliding module is provided with a pair of sliding modules (3, 5) which slide relative to each other, high-pressure gas exists on one side of the pair of sliding modules (3, 5), and low-pressure liquid exists on the other side, wherein a positive pressure generating mechanism (10) provided with a positive pressure generating groove (11) is arranged on the sliding surface (S) of at least one sliding module (5), an annular deep groove (14) is arranged on the high-pressure gas side, and the annular deep groove (14) is isolated from the high-pressure gas side through a table surface part (R) and is communicated with the low-pressure liquid side through a radial deep groove (13).

title_en: Method for repairing and reinforcing fluid conveying pipeline without stopping production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repairing and reinforcing a fluid conveying pipeline without stopping production, which comprises the following steps: 1) detecting the position and the size of the defect of the pipeline; 2) performing metal pressurized plugging repair on the perforated part of the pipeline; 3) coating an impregnating compound on the to-be-repaired part of the pipeline once, adopting a high-temperature repairing compound, and fusing the cured high-temperature repairing compound and the steel pipe into a whole to form a repairing layer; 4) winding and lining the pipeline repairing part by adopting fiber or fabric soaked with high-temperature-resistant resin, and forming a reinforcing layer after curing; 5) winding and reinforcing the outside of the reinforcing layer by adopting high-strength fibers or fabrics thereof and combining body materials, and forming a reinforcing layer after curing; 6) and coating high-temperature-resistant protective paint on the outside of the reinforcing layer, and curing to form the protective layer. The invention has the advantages of safety, reliability, low repair cost, short repair period and excellent corrosion resistance of the composite repair layer, can ensure that the high-temperature pipeline is repaired and reinforced under the condition of no production stop, saves a large amount of engineering monitoring time and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Vessel for transporting liquefied gas and method of operating vessel
abstract_en: The present application provides a ship for transporting liquefied gas, comprising: -a hull; -at least one cargo storage tank arranged in the hull for storing liquefied gas; -at least one engine for propelling the vessel; -at least one compressor having a compressor inlet connected to the vapour space of the at least one cargo storage compartment for receiving boil-off gas at a first pressure and a compressor outlet for supplying pressurised boil-off gas to the at least one engine at a second pressure exceeding the first pressure; and-a boil-off gas (BOG) recovery system for recovering boil-off gas, the BOG recovery system comprising: -a cooling section having a cooling section inlet connected to the compressor outlet to recondense at least a portion of the pressurized boil-off gas; and-a BOG storage tank having a BOG storage tank inlet connected to the cooling section outlet for storing the re-condensed pressurized boil-off gas.

title_en: Inclination monitoring device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inclination monitoring device and method, the device comprises a frame and a laser detection device, the frame comprises a tripod, a movable sleeve mechanism and a bearing case, the laser detection device comprises a first laser ranging sensor, a second laser ranging sensor and a third laser ranging sensor, an electronic circuit board is arranged in the bearing case, and a microprocessor, an inclination sensor and a power module are integrated on the electronic circuit board; the method comprises the following steps: 1. installing a monitoring device and establishing a space coordinate system; 2. detecting the inclination angle of an object to be detected; 3. obtaining an error in the inclination angle of the object to be detected; 4. compensating the inclination state of the object to be detected. The invention has reasonable design, accurate and convenient detection, time and labor saving, low cost, and can acquire the inclination angles of buildings, structures and slopes, realize real-time monitoring, and thus, the invention provides forecast in time and is convenient for taking control measures.

title_en: Rapid detection device and evaluation method for leakage of heat exchange tubes and tube plates of heat supply network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid detection device and an evaluation method for leakage of a heat exchange tube and a tube plate of a heat supply network, wherein the detection device comprises a heat supply network steam extraction sampling tube, a steam extraction constant temperature device positioned on the heat supply network steam extraction sampling tube, a steam extraction water sample flow cell after passing through the steam extraction constant temperature device and a steam extraction ion selective detection electrode arranged in the steam extraction water sample flow cell; a heat supply network hydrophobic sampling tube, a hydrophobic constant temperature device positioned on the heat supply network hydrophobic sampling tube, a hydrophobic water sample flow cell after passing through the hydrophobic constant temperature device and a hydrophobic ion selective detection electrode arranged in the hydrophobic water sample flow cell; the invention also discloses a rapid evaluation method for the leakage of the heat exchange tube and the tube plate of the heat supply network, which comprises the steps of detecting the same ion of the steam extraction and the hydrophobic water sample by a detection device, and evaluating according to the calculation of the detection result; the device is simple and easy to operate, and can realize online continuous and accurate detection; the method is simple and accurate, and can rapidly evaluate whether leakage exists in the heat exchange tube and the tube plate of the heat supply network.

title_en: Drive module and transmission
abstract_en: A drive module, comprising: a housing; a solenoid including a shaft disposed within a housing to perform a linear motion; and a printed circuit board disposed on the solenoid, wherein the solenoid includes a stator, a plunger disposed inside the stator, a shaft coupled to the plunger, and a sensor magnet disposed on an upper side of the shaft, the printed circuit board includes a hole through which the shaft passes, and includes a position detection sensor disposed on the printed circuit board and adjacent to the hole.

title_en: Shock-absorbing structure and use this shock-absorbing structure's cloud platform subassembly, unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cloud platform shock-absorbing structure, cloud platform subassembly and unmanned aerial vehicle, cloud platform shock-absorbing structure are used for connecting fuselage and cloud platform load, cloud platform shock-absorbing structure sets up in the fuselage, include: the movable piece is fixedly connected with the load of the holder; the fixing piece comprises a positioning portion and a second connecting arm, the positioning portion is used for being fixedly connected with the machine body, and the second connecting arm is connected with the moving piece.

title_en: Liquid nitrogen recovery system and liquid nitrogen recovery method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a liquid nitrogen recovery system which comprises a liquid nitrogen tank, a heating device, a booster pump, a pressure tank and a refrigerator, wherein an output port of the liquid nitrogen tank is connected with an input port of the heating device through a first pipeline, an output port of the heating device is connected with a spiral coil through a second pipeline, the spiral coil is wound on the first pipeline, one end of the spiral coil is communicated with the second pipeline, the other end of the spiral coil is communicated with an input end of a third pipeline, an output end of the third pipeline is communicated with an input port of the pressure tank through the booster pump, an output port of the pressure tank is communicated with an input port of the refrigerator through a fourth pipeline, and an output port of the refrigerator is communicated with an input port of the liquid nitrogen tank through a fifth pipeline. The liquid nitrogen recovery system can recycle liquid nitrogen and has lower refrigeration cost.

title_en: Non-invasive wall diagnosis
abstract_en: The pipe diagnostic system includes a sensor capsule, a measurement circuit, and a controller. The sensor capsule is configured to be coupled to an outer surface of the pipe and has at least one temperature sensitive element disposed therein. Measurement circuitry is coupled to the sensor capsule and configured to measure an electrical characteristic of the at least one temperature sensitive element and provide an indicator of the measurement. A controller is coupled to the measurement circuitry and configured to obtain a transmitter reference measurement and utilize the transmitter reference measurement and the indicator to perform a heat transfer calculation to generate an estimated process fluid temperature. The controller is further configured to obtain an indicator of process fluid temperature and provide a piping diagnostic indication based on a comparison of the estimated process fluid temperature and the obtained indicator of process fluid temperature.

title_en: Air cushion device
abstract_en: The invention provides an air cushion device capable of obtaining high buffer force. The air cushion device is provided with: a cylinder (20); a piston (30) slidably fitted in the cylinder (20); a gas (G) sealed in the cylinder (20) and urging the piston (30); and an oil supply mechanism (11) which supplies lubricating oil (L) between the fitting parts (F1) of the cylinder (20) and the piston (30), wherein the cylinder (20) and the piston (30) are fitted in an interference fit state. In addition, the piston (30) is radially reduced from the inside of the cylinder (20) to the outside.

title_en: Electromagnetic type ship shafting transverse vibration active control device
abstract_en: An electromagnetic active control device for transverse vibration of a ship shafting comprises: the two permanent magnets are sleeved on the shaft system, and the N pole of one permanent magnet is opposite to the S pole of the other permanent magnet; the at least two iron cores are wound with coils, the at least two iron cores are positioned between the two permanent magnets and distributed along the radial direction of the shafting, an angle of 90 degrees is formed between every two adjacent iron cores, and one end of each iron core, which is far away from the shafting, is connected to a metal ring surrounding the shafting through a damping device; the magnetic resistance interlayer surrounds the shafting and separates the adjacent iron cores; the detection component is used for detecting the transverse vibration of the shafting; and the controller is used for controlling the current of the coil according to the transverse vibration information of the shafting detected by the detection part, so as to realize the control of electromagnetic force and inhibit the vibration of the shafting. The controller adjusts the frequency and the magnitude of the current of the coil according to the acceleration and the rotating speed of the shafting, and applies a reaction force to the shafting through the permanent magnet sleeved on the shafting to achieve the purpose of inhibiting the vibration of the shafting.

title_en: Thrust roller bearing
abstract_en: The invention provides a thrust roller bearing. The thrust roller bearing includes: a plurality of rollers arranged radially; an annular cage having a plurality of pockets for holding a plurality of rollers so as to be capable of rolling; and an annular raceway disk formed with a raceway surface on which a plurality of rollers roll, wherein the raceway disk has: an annular and plate-like raceway portion having a raceway surface and disposed on one axial side of the retainer; and a plurality of locking portions extending from one of radially outer and inner end portions of the raceway portion to the other side in the axial direction, and locking the retainer, the locking portions including: a first protrusion extending from the raceway portion to the other side in the axial direction; a second protrusion extending from an end of the other axial side of the first protrusion to the roller side in the radial direction and the other axial side; and a third projection projecting from an end portion of the second projection on the opposite side to the first projection further toward the roller side in the radial direction.

title_en: Hydraulic flush valve assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydraulic flushing valve assembly, comprising a flushing valve having a flushing piston which is guided in a longitudinally displaceable manner in a valve bore of a housing by means of two control cams spaced apart from one another by a piston neck, wherein a fluid connection between two inflow channels leading into the valve bore and an outflow channel leading into the valve bore between the two inflow channels can be controlled by the flushing piston together with two circular housing control edges, wherein the flushing piston is prestressed by means of at least one spring in an intermediate state in which the outflow channel is blocked relative to the inflow channel, and wherein the flushing piston can be moved out of the intermediate state starting from a defined difference between the pressure acting in one inflow channel and the pressure acting in the other inflow channel and thereby open the flushing piston by means of the control cams to a lower pressure acting thereon A fluid communication between the inflow channel and the outflow channel.

title_en: Gear shifting control method and device
