abstract_en: The invention provides a gear shifting control method and a gear shifting control device, which are applied to the technical field of automobiles, wherein the method directly controls an AMT to be in gear after the rotating speed of an engine is adjusted to a target gear shifting rotating speed, and if the AMT fails to be in gear, the following steps are repeatedly executed until the AMT is in gear successfully or a preset exit condition is reached: refreshing the target gear shifting speed; controlling the clutch to be separated to a first position set based on the sliding point, and adjusting the rotating speed of the engine to a refreshed target gear shifting rotating speed; and controlling the clutch to be separated to a separation termination position, and controlling the AMT to be engaged again. According to the method, after the rotating speed of the engine is adjusted to the target gear shifting rotating speed, the AMT is directly controlled to be in gear, and if the gear is successfully put in gear, the time for separating and engaging can be saved; if the gear engagement fails, the time for independently executing the separation and combination process can be saved, the influence of the long action time of the clutch executing mechanism on the gear shifting time is reduced, the gear shifting time of the AMT is further shortened, and the timeliness of the AMT for responding to the gear shifting instruction is improved.

title_en: High-pressure breather valve with 25MPa
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-pressure breather valve with 25MPa, the connecting cylinder is inside to be the step through-hole structure, the connecting cylinder is connected with cone disk seat and connecting seat respectively, cone disk seat upper end is in the same place with the water tank, be equipped with the inlet channel in the connecting seat lower part, the inlet channel upper portion is the circular conical surface hollow body, open on the circular conical surface has first runner, connecting seat upper portion center is equipped with the recess, the lower part and the recess inner wall alternate dress of cone valve core are in the recess, the cone valve core links together with the guide bar lower extreme, the guide bar dress is in the through-hole at cone valve seat center, cone valve seat center has the guiding hole and gas channel, the elastic component lower extreme of suit is in contact with the up end of cone valve core on the guide bar outside in the gas channel, open on the gas channel has the second runner, the guide bar upper end that stretches out the guiding hole is equipped with the floater of arranging in the water tank, simple structure, high-speed reliable exhaust, automatic tight seal, pressure can reach 25MPa, the scope is wide, it is innovative on the valve, and economic benefit is huge.

title_en: Device for controlling the swirl of a fluid flowing in a pipe
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for controlling the turbulence of a fluid (2) flowing in a pipe (1). The invention is based on the object of creating a device by means of which the swirl (2B) of a fluid (2) flowing in a pipe (1) can be adapted to the desired flow conditions in the pipe (1) even in the case of a constantly changing initial swirl (2B). The aim is achieved in that a vortex measuring device (4) and a vortex control device (6) are provided at predetermined positions of the pipe (1) and the device has an evaluation and coding unit (5), wherein, in the event of a difference between the measured actual vortex (2B) and the desired vortex, a correction value can be determined by means of the evaluation and coding unit (5), and the vortex control device (6) corresponds to the evaluation and coding unit (5), and by means of the vortex control device (6), the current vortex (2B) can be adapted to the predetermined desired vortex in accordance with the determined correction value.

title_en: Marine magnetic suspension vortex-induced vibration suppression device
abstract_en: The middle part of an upright post is surrounded by a magnetic ring, an annular shell is fixed on the periphery of the magnetic ring, the shell is of a sealing structure, and the annular plate can rotate along with the rotation of blades while the shell is sealed by the sealing structure. The vortex blade that a plurality of outsourcing are evenly fixed to the annular slab lower extreme along the circumferencial direction, a plurality of magnetic drum are evenly fixed along the circumferencial direction in the upper end of annular slab, still fixed battery in the shell, the vortex blade includes connecting axle and blade, connecting axle one end and blade are connected, and the other end agrees with in the draw-in groove of stand, and the upper and lower portion has ball bearing, and the ball is at its track inslot motion of injecing certainly in the ball bearing, the draw-in groove be the ring channel. The invention aims at the situation that the vortex-induced vibration can still restrain the vortex-induced vibration and provide electric energy under the condition of extremely low incoming flow speed, and provides certain electric power supply for the ocean with difficult electric power transmission.

title_en: Motor-driven automatic balancing system with autonomous regulation and control capability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor-driven automatic balancing system with autonomous regulation and control capability, which changes the driving mode of a balancing weight into the driving of a stepping motor and integrates and optimizes various functions of an electromagnetic balancing head. The driving structure has a self-locking function, is not required to be realized by an additional structure, is driven by a motor, does not need a large number of structures such as electromagnetic coils and the like, reduces the structural complexity and reduces the self weight of the balance head; the modularized design is adopted, the installation and the positioning among the modules are convenient, and a large amount of time is not needed for debugging; the minimum moving distance of the stepping motor can reach the micron level, and the precision requirement of the balance weight can be completely met; the invention adopts a controller (PLC) which can be independently regulated and controlled by an upper computer to complete all algorithms and control functions, and no extra device is needed outside the balance head to provide a high-power driving power supply, thereby simplifying the wiring of a control system, reducing the complexity and the use cost of the control system, and being capable of being operated by a computer.

title_en: Novel test joint
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel test joint which comprises a test joint body, wherein a channel is formed in the test joint body, a valve core and a fixed cushion block are installed in the channel, the valve core is positioned above the fixed cushion block, a vent hole is formed in the middle of the fixed cushion block, a spring is arranged between the valve core and the fixed cushion block, the valve core comprises a circular tube and a clamping block connected with one end of the circular tube, a detection channel is formed in the center of the circular tube, an opening is formed in the circular tube and communicated with the detection channel, four fan-shaped air outlet grooves are uniformly formed in the clamping block, four raised flanges are formed among the air outlet grooves, a spring buckle is formed in the center of each of the four flanges, and a ventilation step is formed between the spring buckle and the flanges. The invention changes the structure of the valve core, greatly increases the gas overflow quantity, enables the detection channel to be communicated with the air pressure loop in a short time and shortens the detection time.

title_en: Automatic pressing device used after polycrystalline silicon gluing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic compressing device after polycrystalline silicon gluing, and aims to solve the problems that the automation degree is low and the thickness of a glue layer cannot be accurately controlled in the compressing process after the polycrystalline silicon gluing; the first portion and the telescopic portion of first linkage board are fixedly connected, the protrusion is equipped with first guide rail on the first mounting panel, and first linkage board slides and sets up on first guide rail, and the telescopic link of telescopic portion pulls open the expansion end of side splenium from the polycrystalline silicon side back, and hold-down mechanism exerts pressure to the polycrystalline silicon, and hold-down mechanism's pressfitting resultant force is adjustable. The invention has the advantages of high automation degree, reduction of the reject ratio of products and guarantee of safe production.

title_en: Automatic speed change switching structure of gearbox and trowelling machine
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic speed change switching structure of a gearbox and a trowelling machine, which comprise a box body, a power input assembly, a power output assembly, a clutch switching assembly and a speed change assembly, wherein the box body is provided with a power input end and a power output end; the power input assembly is arranged on the box body; the power output assembly is arranged on the box body; the clutch switching assembly comprises a clutch assembly and a clutch driving part, and the clutch assembly is arranged on the power input assembly; the clutch driving part is in transmission connection with the clutch assembly; the speed change assembly comprises a gear shift driving part and a switching assembly, the switching assembly is arranged on the power input assembly, and the gear shift driving part is in transmission connection with the switching assembly; the gear shifting driving component is used for driving the switching component to perform switching speed regulation; the scheme provided by the invention can automatically realize the power clutch between the speed reducer of the troweling machine and the engine, can automatically change speed and shift gears in real time according to the working effect, achieves the best working effect, has compact and reasonable structure, can be better matched with the engine of the existing troweling machine, and realizes efficient speed change adjustment.

title_en: Pipeline leakage positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pipeline leakage positioning method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of arranging two detection devices for collecting pipeline signals on a pipeline at a certain distance; synchronizing the internal time of the two detection devices to the Beidou satellite reference time; matching the suspected water leakage signal with the first internal time and forming a suspected water leakage time sequence signal; matching the signal detected by the second detection device in the second internal time with the second internal time to form a pairing time sequence signal; and judging whether the pairing time series signal can be paired with the suspected water leakage time series signal, if not, judging the suspected water leakage signal as an error signal, not processing, and if so, positioning the water leakage position by using the time difference between the suspected water leakage time series signal and the pairing time series signal. The invention reduces the false alarm probability of the water leakage signal, improves the reliability of the system and solves the problem of high false alarm probability of the water leakage signal in the prior art.

title_en: Gas stove knob capable of displaying fire gear and gas stove using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas stove knob capable of displaying a fire gear, which comprises a knob mechanism connected with a gas stove valve body, wherein the knob mechanism comprises a knob assembly provided with a fire gear code, a fixed sleeve assembly capable of emitting a light source, a fixed seat and an elastic reset piece, the knob assembly is connected with a rotating shaft on the valve body and sleeved on the fixed sleeve assembly, the fixed seat is arranged below the fixed sleeve assembly, one end of the fixed seat is connected with the fixed sleeve assembly in a matched manner, the other end of the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a valve cover assembly on the valve body, and the elastic reset piece is arranged between the fixed sleeve assembly and the fixed seat and used for preventing the fixed sleeve assembly from being separated from the knob assembly and incapable of displaying the fire gear. By adopting the gas stove knob, the purpose of displaying specific firepower gears in real time is effectively realized, and the purpose of enabling a user to know the firepower at any time in the cooking process is also realized.

title_en: Sealing installation mechanism of ship cathode protection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sealing installation mechanism of a ship cathode protection system, which relates to the field of ship corrosion prevention and solves the problem that the sealing effect still has defects, and in the application, when the sealing is carried out, the cover plate position can be sealed only by adopting a single-layer sealing method, the water flow pressure cannot be reduced by reducing the pressure area, and the sealing effect is improved; long time consumption and poor firmness during fixing. A sealing installation mechanism of a ship cathode protection system comprises an anode bed; the anode bed is of a hollow frame structure with an open bottom, and an anode seat is fixedly connected with a bolt in the anode bed. The sealing cover structure is improved, firstly, the annular rubber gasket C is compressed when the sealing cover is screwed down, and the top of the sealing cover is of a conical structure, so that the sealing cover structure is similar to the sealing cover structure disclosed by the application number: cn201821494803.7. compared with the above, the compressed annular rubber gasket C can further improve the sealing effect, and the sealing cover with a cylindrical structure can reduce the pressure area.

title_en: Sand-water abrasion resistant polyurethane material for pipeline lining and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sand-water abrasion resistant polyurethane material for a pipeline lining, and a preparation method and application thereof. The polyurethane material is prepared from 100 parts by weight of oligomer polyol, 1.5-7 parts by weight of alkali-treated bamboo fiber, 20-45 parts by weight of 2, 4-toluene diisocyanate, 10-26 parts by weight of amine chain extender and 0.3-1.2 parts by weight of unsaturated fatty acid. The polyurethane material prepared by the invention is poured on the inner wall of the pipeline through a rotary pouring process, has uniform thickness, firm bonding, no deformation after curing, no influence on the interlinkage between the pipe ends, good wear resistance and long service life of the conveying pipe.

title_en: Tilting pad bearing
abstract_en: A tilting pad bearing (100) is provided with: a bearing (2) disposed so as to face the outer peripheral surface of the rotating shaft (90); a liner (3) that supports the bearing bush (2) radially outward of the axis (A) of the rotating shaft (90); and a fulcrum (4) that supports the lining (3) at a central position in the direction of the axis (A) of the rotating shaft (90) and radially outward of the axis (A) so as to allow the bush (2) to swing, wherein a recess (6) that is recessed in a direction away from the bush (2) is provided at least at the central position on either a surface of the lining (3) that faces the bush (2) or a surface of the bush (2) that faces the lining (3).

title_en: Fiber sling device for radar scattering cross section test
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a fiber sling device for radar scattering cross section testing, which comprises: the upper end of the open steel wire rope section is fixedly connected with the lower end of the steel wire rope; the upper rope wheel is arranged between the first connecting part and the second connecting part of the open type steel wire rope section, and the first connecting part and the second connecting part are sleeved on the pin shaft; the fiber sling is made of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber, the surface of the fiber sling is provided with a protective sleeve, an upper end annular hole of the fiber sling is sleeved on the upper rope pulley and is fixed to an upper end annular hole through an upper pressing plate, a lower end annular hole of the fiber sling is sleeved on the lower rope pulley and is fixed to a lower end annular hole through a lower pressing plate, and the lower rope pulley is sleeved on the stepped shaft through a sliding bearing; and the hanging tool is sleeved on the stepped shaft, two lifting lugs of the hanging tool are respectively positioned on two sides of the lower rope wheel, and a second locking piece is arranged at the end part of the stepped shaft. The fiber sling device has better safety, reliability and wave permeability.

title_en: Combined sealing device for bearing oil groove of vertical hydro-generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined sealing device for a bearing oil groove of a vertical hydraulic generator, belonging to the sealing field of hydraulic generators, comprising an oil groove, a rotating shaft and a sealing end cover, and being characterized in that: the sealing seat ring I is provided with a first cavity and a second cavity, the first sealing seat ring I and the rotating shaft form a third cavity, a fourth cavity is formed between the rotating shaft and the first sealing seat ring I, the first sealing brush is in contact with the rotating shaft, the first cavity is used for introducing high-pressure air, and the second cavity is used for introducing normal-pressure air. According to the oil mist sealing structure, the oil mist is matched with jet gas with opposite oil mist overflowing directions through the plurality of cavities with good sealing performance from the inside of the oil groove to the outside of the oil groove, and the multi-layer sealing tooth structure is combined, so that the oil mist can be effectively sealed, the oil mist is prevented from leaking, and the oil mist sealing effect is greatly improved.

title_en: Underground gas pressure regulating station
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground buried gas pressure regulating station, which comprises an inlet buried valve, an outlet module comprises an outlet buried valve, a filter module comprises a buried filter with an independent cylinder, a filter module box body is arranged at the top of the buried filter, a drain outlet of the buried filter extends upwards into the filter module box body through a pipeline, the top of the pipeline is provided with the drain valve, a differential pressure gauge and a pressure gauge of the drain valve and the buried filter are both arranged in the filter module box body, a cutting-off module comprises a buried cutting-off valve, the upper part of the cutting-off valve is arranged in the cutting-off module box body, the pressure regulating module comprises a pressure regulator and the pressure gauge is arranged in the pressure regulating module box body, the filter module box body, the cutting-off module box body and the pressure regulating module box body are exposed out of the ground, and the top end of the filter module box body is provided with a detachable sealing upper cover. The invention realizes the direct buried use of the gas pressure regulating station, reduces the noise of equipment operation and the difficulty of arrangement, and is convenient for maintaining and replacing parts.

title_en: High-strength anti-slip hexagonal nut
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength anti-slip hexagonal nut which comprises a hexagonal nut body, anti-slip reinforcing ribs, threaded holes, an upper storage ring groove, an upper shrinkage elastic sleeve, a lower anti-slip ring groove, a shaping ring and a lower anti-slip elastic sleeve. The invention can ensure that the hexagonal nut has good anti-skid effect, has strong structural stability, is not easy to loosen and deform, improves the safety of the fastening structure, and is beneficial to popularization and application.

title_en: Isolation sealing device for replacing thermometer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an isolation sealing device for replacing a thermometer, which is characterized in that the upper end of a ball valve connected with the pipe wall of a to-be-tested point of a test pipeline is provided with an isolation sleeve connected with a ball valve pipe joint by utilizing threads, a retainer ring is arranged at the proper position inside the isolation sleeve, sealing elements are arranged above and below the retainer ring, the sealing elements comprise an anti-leakage rubber pipe which is propped against the upper surface of the retainer ring, the outer surface of the anti-leakage rubber pipe is sleeved with an anti-shake rubber pipe, the upper end of the isolation sleeve is provided with external threads connected with a pressing cap, and the pressing cap is provided with a conical waterproof sleeve propped against the upper end of the isolation sleeve; the middle parts of the pressing cap, the waterproof sleeve and the anti-leakage rubber tube form a channel which is inserted through the PT100 thermometer in a sealing way, the channel is aligned with the central hole when the ball valve is opened and extends to the inside of the water pipe to be tested, and the PT100 thermometer is inserted into the channel.

title_en: Thermoplastic resin composition and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a thermoplastic resin composition comprising a fluororesin (A) and a crosslinked fluororubber (B), wherein the fluororesin (A) is a copolymer comprising a chlorotrifluoroethylene unit and a tetrafluoroethylene unit and having at least one functional group selected from the group consisting of a carbonyl group, an alkylene group and an amino group at a main chain end or a side chain end of the polymer, and the crosslinked fluororubber (B) is obtained by subjecting a fluororubber (B), a polyamine compound (c) having a pyrolysis temperature of 210 ℃ or higher and a crosslinking accelerator (d) to a dynamic crosslinking treatment together in the presence of the fluororesin (A) under melting conditions of the fluororesin (A).

title_en: Hydraulic system for bolt lifting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hydraulic system for bolt elevating gear belongs to the hydraulic control field. The hydraulic system comprises an oil tank, a hydraulic pump set, a lifting oil cylinder assembly and a bolt oil cylinder assembly, wherein the lifting oil cylinder assembly comprises a first three-position four-way reversing valve, a speed regulating valve, a lifting oil cylinder and a first two-position two-way reversing valve, and the bolt oil cylinder assembly comprises a second three-position four-way reversing valve, a hydraulic lock, a fixed ring beam bolt oil cylinder and a movable ring beam bolt oil cylinder. This openly can control bolt hydro-cylinder piston rod or lift cylinder piston rod dead lock through this hydraulic system, prevents that abnormal retraction.

title_en: Control device and control method for lifting system
abstract_en: The invention provides a control device and a control method of a lifting system, wherein the device comprises: the device comprises a body and four control devices; the body is arranged at the top of a main machine in the lifting system; the four control devices are arranged on the body and are used for being connected with the four supporting leg oil cylinders of the host in a one-to-one correspondence mode, the positions of the four control devices correspond to the positions of the four supporting leg oil cylinders in a one-to-one correspondence mode, and each control device is used for controlling the corresponding supporting leg oil cylinder to move in the host lifting process so that the host can lift in a preset state. According to the invention, the four control devices correspond to the four supporting leg oil cylinders of the main machine one by one, and each control device controls the corresponding supporting leg oil cylinder to move, so that the main machine is ensured to lift according to a preset state, the control precision can be effectively improved, the main machine is ensured to stably lift, manual operation is not required, and the lifting device is simple and convenient.

title_en: Design method for guide joint bearing channel structure of underground closed-loop controllable elbow joint
abstract_en: A design method of a guide joint bearing channel structure of an underground closed-loop controllable elbow joint is characterized in that according to the Hertz contact theory, the section of a channel is provided as an elliptical section, a geometric model of a steel ball and the elliptical channel section is established, and therefore a mathematical model of the elliptical channel section is established; and establishing mathematical models of the inner spherical surface channel of the guide frame and the outer spherical surface channel of the guide frame according to the geometric parameters of the inner spherical surface channel and the outer spherical surface channel of the guide frame, and calculating a curved surface equation of the channel. The contact form of the steel ball and the channel is one of the reasons for generating vibration and noise in the rotation process of the guide shaft, and provides a basis for improving the accuracy and stability of the offset angle of the guide shaft.

title_en: Modular facility system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a kit of parts for constructing a rail rolling module assembly. The tray assembly includes a tray bottom member, wherein each corner is at least partially internally radiused; and a plurality of portable modular support members. Each of the plurality of modular members comprises: (i) a hollow elongate body; and (ii) a pair of opposed ends, wherein (iii) both of the ends are provided with a male end, and/or (iv) both ends are provided with a female receptacle for releasably engaging therein a male end of another portable member, and/or (v) one end is provided with a male end and the other end is provided with a female receptacle. Each of the plurality of modular members has a diameter to slidingly engage one of the at least partially internally radiused corners of the tray base member and to be capable of slidingly engaging a collar member that provides stable support for the tray base member.

title_en: Foldable display device
abstract_en: The foldable display device includes a first body and a second body, and a hinge portion connected to the first body and the second body. The hinge part includes a first joint having at least one first recess, a second joint opposite to the first joint, a third joint located at one side of the first joint, a first leaf spring located in the first recess, and a first fastening connection member fixed to the third joint through the first leaf spring and the first joint.

title_en: Preparation process of clutch release pull ring assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a preparation process of a clutch release pull ring assembly, which comprises a pull ring body, an embedding groove, embedding blocks, pull hooks, a groove and a through groove, wherein the outer wall of the pull ring body is provided with the embedding grooves distributed in a circular array, the embedding blocks are welded in the embedding grooves, the pull hooks are welded on the upper surfaces of the embedding blocks, the groove is arranged on the upper surface of the pull ring body, the through grooves distributed in a circular array are arranged on the outer wall of the upper surface of the pull ring body, and the preparation process comprises the following steps: forming, grooving, welding, polishing and sand blasting. According to the utility model, by changing the drag hook treated by the traditional bending process into a welding process form, compared with the drag hook treated by the bending process, the mechanical strength is higher, the processing difficulty is lower, the processing difficulty of bending the drag hook and the breakage of the pull ring caused by bending can be effectively saved, and the reliability of practical use is effectively ensured.

title_en: Safety valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety valve (1) having an electronic control unit (2) for forming a control voltage; a pre-stage (3) of the electrohydrodynamic type, having a piezoelectric bending transducer (4); a hydrodynamic main stage (5) having an influencing device (6) for influencing the flow of a primary working fluid flow, wherein the influencing device (6) can be operated by means of a secondary control fluid flow which opens into a control chamber (10) of the main stage (5). The control unit (2) is provided for iteratively repeating a functional test of the electrohydraulic upstream stage (3), wherein, within the scope of the functional test, such a brief and/or slight change in the position of the piezoelectric bending transducer (4) is achieved with a suitable change in the control voltage that, on the one hand, the correct operating mode of the piezoelectric bending transducer (4) can be checked while the deflection movement actually performed by the latter is being determined, but, on the other hand, the flow rate of the primary working fluid flow is not influenced by the main stage (5).

title_en: Input device with active haptic feedback and interfering vibration suppression
abstract_en: The invention relates to an input device (1) comprising: a carrier (9); an input part (2) which is mounted on a carrier (9) so as to be able to move in an oscillating manner along at least one movement direction (B) by means of a mounting means (12), has an input surface (3) which is intended to be touched by an operator, and has a touch detection device (5) for detecting a touch of the input surface (3) by the operator; an electromagnetic actuator (4) for actuating a movement of the input part (2) in a movement direction (B) by means of an electrical control signal in order to generate a haptic feedback at the operator when touched by the operator, wherein the actuator (4) has an additional mass (10) which is mounted in a resilient manner and the actuator (4) is fixed to the input part (2) by means of a vibration insulator (6).

title_en: Internet-based teaching effect instant feedback evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of teaching evaluation systems, in particular to an internet-based teaching effect instant feedback evaluation system; the content display unit adopts a classroom projector and is used for displaying the content required by the teaching teacher to perform teaching evaluation; the data synchronization unit adopts a local area network and is used for synchronizing the electronic courseware data displayed by the teaching display terminal to the teaching evaluation terminal in real time; the evaluation display unit adopts a tablet personal computer and is used for displaying word documents formed by electronic courseware; the data tracking unit is used for tracking the electronic courseware content displayed by the content display unit in real time, and synchronizing the tracked content to the corresponding content in the word document displayed by the evaluation display unit, so that an evaluator can conveniently correspondingly watch the content of the electronic courseware explained by a teaching teacher and the content in the word document; the evaluator of being convenient for can carry out the instant evaluation show to the content that the teacher of imparting knowledge to students demonstrates fast and high-efficiently, improve the efficiency of teaching aassessment simultaneously.

title_en: Automobile engine crankshaft mounting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile engine crankshaft mounting device, which relates to the field of automobile engine assembly and comprises a mounting base, a crankshaft grabbing device, a transverse moving device, an engine positioning tool and a crankshaft positioning tool, wherein the mounting base is an installation carrier for other components of the device, the engine positioning tool is used for positioning an engine, the crankshaft positioning tool is used for positioning a crankshaft, the crankshaft grabbing device is used for grabbing the crankshaft, and the transverse moving device is used for conveying and mounting the crankshaft. This device degree of automation is high factor of safety height, snatchs the installation bent axle perpendicularly and avoids slope fish tail bent axle in the installation, and the frictional force avoids bent axle wearing and tearing in the installation when oil spout lubrication reduces the installation before the bent axle installation.

title_en: Circuit quick connect structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of line connection, in particular to a line quick connection structure. The circuit quick connection structure comprises two to-be-connected components, wherein at least two circuits can be arranged in each to-be-connected component, the two to-be-connected components are respectively provided with interfaces due to the fact that the circuits need to be mutually communicated, the circuit quick connection structure comprises an intermediate connection assembly, an intermediate connection circuit is arranged in the intermediate connection assembly, and the two ends of the intermediate connection circuit are respectively provided with the interfaces; two interfaces that wait to connect the subassembly expose to the integrated installation department of intermediate junction, two wait to connect the subassembly and connect between integrated installation to target in place then between the interface at interconnecting link both ends docks two interfaces that wait to connect the subassembly respectively to make two wait to connect the subassembly to realize the circuit intercommunication each other through between interconnecting link. The quick connecting structure for the circuit is convenient and quick to install.

title_en: Connecting device for smooth hose and smooth hard tube
abstract_en: A connecting device of a smooth hose and a smooth hard pipe relates to the field of pipeline connecting devices. The connecting device of the smooth hose and the smooth hard tube comprises a hollow connecting screw rod, a fixing nut and a connecting piece, wherein the inner wall of the fixing nut is provided with a circular truncated cone-shaped internal thread, one end of the connecting screw rod is connected with at least three elastic arc-shaped blades, and the outer walls of the arc-shaped blades are provided with external threads correspondingly connected with the internal threads; the connecting piece is including being used for dismantling the connecting portion of being connected, a plurality of elastic preforming and annular fixed part of supporting with connecting screw, in a plurality of preforming along connecting screw's circumference interval arrangement and locate connecting screw, connecting portion and support the preforming are connected respectively at the both ends of fixed part, form the chamber that holds smooth hose end portion between a plurality of preforming and the connecting screw, and smooth hard tube outwards extrudees each and supports the preforming when passing the fixed part. The connecting device of smooth hose and smooth hard tube can be in the same place smooth hose and the stable connection of the tip of smooth hard tube, avoids revealing or the hose is damaged.

title_en: Folding limiting shaft of flexible flat cable, flexible flat cable module and holder module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a folding limiting shaft of a flexible flat cable, a flexible flat cable module and a holder module, relates to the technical field of mobile phone cameras, and solves the technical problem of low folding efficiency caused by folding the flexible flat cable through a cushion block in the prior art. The folding limiting shaft of the flexible flat cable comprises a shaft body, wherein the shaft body is positioned between two opposite surfaces of the folded flexible flat cable; the flexible flat cable can move relative to the shaft body. According to the invention, the two opposite surfaces of the folded flexible flat cable bending part are supported by the shaft body, on one hand, when the flexible flat cable is folded, the supporting point position on the flexible flat cable is not required to be determined, the dispensing treatment is not required, and only the two opposite surfaces of the flexible flat cable are directly supported on the shaft body, so that the process of folding the flexible flat cable is simplified, and the folding efficiency of the flexible flat cable is improved; on the other hand, the adjacent bending parts of the folded flexible flat cable are supported by the shaft body, so that the folded flexible flat cable can be immediately molded and is not easy to deform.

title_en: U-shaped inner folding mechanism with four-axis sliding groove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a U-shaped internal turning mechanism with four-axis sliding grooves, which comprises a structural main body, wherein the structural main body comprises two groups of rotating shafts, the rotating shafts comprise a rotating mechanism, the rotating mechanism comprises a first fixing frame and a second fixing frame which are longitudinally distributed in parallel, and a first rotating frame and a second rotating frame which are respectively bridged with two sides of the first fixing frame and the second fixing frame, and an arc-shaped sliding block and a straight groove sliding block for realizing bending rotation are respectively arranged between the first fixing frame and the first rotating frame and between the second rotating frame; the arc-shaped sliding block is in sliding connection with the first fixing frame and the straight groove sliding block, the first rotating frame and the second rotating frame are respectively in sliding connection with the straight groove sliding block, and an inward folding movement track of cyclic stress is formed to realize 0-180-degree inward folding rotation.

title_en: Combined bolt
abstract_en: A combined bolt comprises a bolt head, a bolt rod and a bolt end which are independent, wherein the bolt head, the bolt rod and the bolt end can be assembled and fixed to form a bolt; a convex top block is arranged on the end face, facing the bolt rod, of the bolt head, and a top block positioning groove is arranged on the side face of the top block; the outer surface of the bolt rod is provided with threads, a first through hole is axially arranged in the bolt rod, a movable connecting column is arranged in the first through hole, and a first positioning groove and a second positioning groove are formed in the side wall of the connecting column; the side wall of the first through hole is provided with a first positioning piece and a second positioning piece which can radially extend out. The invention provides a novel combined bolt, which adopts a modular structure, can be assembled into a bolt with required length for use according to requirements, and is convenient to assemble and disassemble and convenient to carry.

title_en: Camera deicing defogging device based on monitored control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of closed circuit television monitoring systems, and discloses a camera deicing and defogging device based on a monitoring system. This camera deicing defogging device based on monitored control system drives first baffle through the U-shaped groove on the first baffle and carries out opposite direction and rotate for first pipeline is sealed, and the second pipeline is opened, thereby changes the trend of steam, then steam flows in the third pipeline along second pipeline, first axis of rotation, thereby blows steam to the lens, carries out the defogging, and this structure has reached can be to the good effect of lens defogging and control image quality.

title_en: Blade flexure assembly with replaceable element
abstract_en: A blade flexure assembly includes a first mounting structure and a second mounting structure. Two or more flex blades are connected to and extend between the first and second mounting structures. A clamp block clamps the flex blade to the mounting structure. The modular design of the assembly provides for replacement of one or more of the flex blades to adjust one or more functional aspects of the assembly.

title_en: Novel vibration/noise reduction device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel damping and noise reducing device, and relates to the technical field of damping and noise reducing. The damping support comprises a damping support and a mounting support, wherein a first spring and a first side plate are arranged on the upper surface of the damping support, a bidirectional threaded column is mounted between the first side plates, a movable threaded sleeve is arranged on the peripheral side surface of the bidirectional threaded column, the movable threaded sleeve is connected with a moving rod, the moving rod is connected with a moving block, a second spring is arranged on the upper surface of the mounting support, the second spring is connected with main equipment, a noise reduction bin is arranged inside the main equipment, a noise reduction box is mounted inside the noise reduction bin, noise reduction pipelines are arranged on two side surfaces of the noise reduction box, and a sound wave absorption wall is arranged inside the. The height of the support is convenient to install by arranging the bidirectional threaded rod to be in threaded fit with the movable threaded sleeve; the fixing spring is arranged, so that the fixing can be conveniently carried out according to the sizes of different devices; the arrangement of a plurality of springs is convenient for damping the equipment; and a noise reduction box is arranged, so that the equipment is conveniently silenced.

title_en: Horizontal pressure vessel with auxiliary locking structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a horizontal pressure container with an auxiliary locking structure, which comprises a pressure container body, wherein the top of the pressure container body is communicated with a pressure release valve, the output end of the pressure release valve is fixedly connected with a transmission rod, the surface of the transmission rod is sleeved with a rotating wheel, and the right side of the rotating wheel is fixedly connected with a sleeve. The limiting wheel is limited through the gear ring, an auxiliary locking effect can be achieved on the rotating wheel, the rotating wheel is prevented from rotating due to vibration, the rotating wheel is driven to be separated from the gear ring through the sleeve to be in contact with the limiting wheel through pushing the rotating wheel to move, a user can conveniently operate the pressure release valve, an operation mode that the locking structure needs to be opened independently is replaced, the opening difficulty of the locking structure is reduced, and the problems that an existing pressure container does not have the auxiliary locking structure, and when a valve is displaced due to vibration, the pressure in the pressure container is easy to generate unconventional change and accidents are caused are solved.

title_en: Sanitary valve assembly for beverage container
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valve assemblies, and discloses a sanitary valve assembly for a beverage container. A sanitary valve component for a beverage container comprises a water inlet pipe component, a valve body component, a water outlet pipe component and a water outlet, wherein the water inlet pipe component penetrates through the left side surface of the valve body component and is fixedly connected with the valve body component, the water outlet pipe component penetrates through the valve body component and is fixedly connected with the valve body component, and the water outlet is fixedly connected with the water outlet pipe component.

title_en: Dosing unit for plastic processing machinery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plastic machining batching, and relates to a batching device for plastic machining machinery, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a shock absorber, the top of the shock absorber is fixedly connected with a box body, the opposite surfaces of the base and the box body are respectively provided with a sliding chute, a shock absorption assembly is connected in the sliding chute in a sliding manner, a stirring bin is arranged in the box body, the top of the stirring bin is fixedly connected with a third bearing, and a third rotating shaft is arranged in the third bearing in a penetrating manner. Its beneficial effect is, this dosing unit for plastics processing machinery through first motor work, can drive the third pivot and rotate, and then can drive the puddler and rotate, realizes carrying out the purpose of preliminary stirring to the material after the ratio, rotates through first puddler, under the normal running fit of second pivot and second bearing, with the help of the frictional force between spiral rotation pole and the material, makes spiral rotation pole rotate, realizes carrying out the purpose of stirring from top to bottom once more to the batching.

title_en: Wallboard mounting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wallboard mounting machine, which comprises an electric drive vehicle, a small hydraulic pump station, a weight box operating platform, a manual operation valve, a battery box, a mechanical elevation arm, a mechanical upper arm, a position adjusting hydraulic cylinder, a position adjusting saddle, a clamping connecting plate, a transverse guide rail, a clamping hydraulic cylinder, a clamping base, a polyurethane cushion pad, an adjustable clamping claw, a rotary hydraulic cylinder, a transverse adjusting hydraulic cylinder, a saddle connecting rod, an upper middle arm adjusting hydraulic cylinder, a lower middle arm adjusting hydraulic cylinder, a mechanical lower arm, a mechanical lower part adjusting hydraulic cylinder and a mechanical arm base, and has reasonable structure, can realize the grabbing of two stacking states of side standing and horizontal lying of wallboards, the mechanical arm control system is a servo control system, realizes the vertical up-and-down movement of the clamps, has compact structure, adopts an arm type structure, and the arm is folded to form an S shape with a vehicle group in the non-working state, the fixture has strong applicability.

title_en: Rotary lifting type intelligent blackboard and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary lifting type intelligent blackboard and a control system thereof, and relates to the technical field of intelligent blackboards. The invention comprises a movable trolley and a mounting bracket; the upper surface of the movable trolley is rotatably provided with a rotating platform; the top of the rotary platform is fixedly provided with an electric lifting rod, and a pair of supporting plates are matched in the rotary platform in a sliding way; the pair of supporting plates are respectively matched with the driving device; a pair of mounting brackets are in sliding fit between the pair of support plates; the pair of mounting brackets are connected in a guide groove in a sliding manner; the guide groove is detachably arranged above the telescopic end of the electric lifting rod; the bottom of the movable trolley is provided with a driving wheel; the upper surface of the moving trolley is provided with a first annular groove. The invention solves the problems that the height of the existing intelligent blackboard is difficult to adjust and the installation components need to be fixed again when the intelligent blackboards with different sizes are installed by the aid of the rotary platform, the supporting plate, the driving device, the installation support and the electric lifting rod.

title_en: Method for mounting bushing with large interference amount on ultrahigh-strength steel part and used lubricant
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aircraft landing gears, and relates to a method for mounting a bushing with large interference amount on an ultrahigh-strength steel part and a used lubricant, wherein the method comprises the steps of sequentially using three extrusion rods with gradually-increased diameters of working ends to extrude the inner wall of a copper bushing for extrusion mounting, so that the inner wall of the bushing is subjected to plastic deformation and diameter expansion and forms an interference fit relation with the inner wall of a base hole; the lubricant is prepared from the following components in percentage by weight of 2: 1 molybdenum disulfide and epoxy resin which are uniformly mixed. The method of the invention is used for mounting the copper bushing on the ultrahigh-strength steel part, and can obtain larger interference amount than the traditional cold-shrinking method, therefore, the bushing is more firmly mounted in the part hole, and is not easy to rotate or be pulled out in the using process.

title_en: Multichannel quick-operation joint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel quick connector, in particular to the field of quick connectors, which comprises a female connector tail protector, a female connector assembly, a male connector assembly and a male connector tail protector which are sequentially connected, wherein the female connector assembly and the male connector assembly are detachably connected into a whole to form an intermediate connector, the top end of the intermediate connector is detachably connected with the female connector tail protector, and the bottom end of the intermediate connector is detachably connected with the male connector tail protector; the female head assembly comprises a female head threaded sleeve, a female head and a female head probe assembly, and the male head assembly comprises a male head threaded sleeve, a male head and a male head probe assembly. The invention can realize the quick connection of the multi-channel fluid pipeline, has small occupied space and ensures the sealing quality.

title_en: Instrument equipment and installation buckle thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses mechanical equipment and installation buckle thereof, the installation buckle includes: the button is provided with a first clamping part used for realizing clamping with a part to be connected, and the button is arranged in a sliding manner relative to the guide seat; the elastic component is arranged between the guide seat and the button and is in a compressed state in an initial state. Compared with the prior art, the installation buckle that this application provided only needs to press the button at the in-process that uses, just can make the button drive first joint portion and remove to realize the installation of installation buckle or remove the joint, simplified the process of installation and dismantlement, shortened the time of installation and dismantlement.

title_en: Double-opening plastic liner fiber full-winding gas cylinder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-opening plastic liner fiber fully-wound gas cylinder, which relates to the technical field of double-opening plastic liner fiber fully-wound gas cylinders and aims to solve the problems of sealing and production process flow. Move through the slide bar and extrude compression spring, can make the slide bar reciprocate, realize carrying out the effect of pressure release to the gas cylinder, cooperate compression spring's elasticity simultaneously, can make the inseparable laminating of baffle in the below of metal nozzle, at the kicking block that cooperation metal cylinder mouth top set up, and equal rigid coupling has sealed the pad on kicking block and the baffle, realizes the sealed effect of gas cylinder.

title_en: Wheel leg robot and leg joint driving device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheel leg robot and a leg joint driving device thereof, which belong to the technical field of wheel leg robots and comprise a hydraulic control system, wherein the hydraulic control system comprises a hydraulic cylinder, a piston rod, a main oil way, a secondary oil way, a servo motor and a hydraulic pump, a bearing cavity and a non-bearing cavity are arranged in the hydraulic cylinder, the piston rod separates the bearing cavity from the non-bearing cavity, the servo motor is used for driving the hydraulic pump, the non-bearing cavity, the main oil way, the hydraulic pump, the secondary oil way and the bearing cavity are sequentially communicated, and the elongation of the piston rod relative to the hydraulic cylinder is changed along with the change of the hydraulic oil capacity in the bearing cavity and the non-bearing cavity. The wheel leg robot and the leg joint driving device thereof have the advantages of no overflow loss, no throttling loss, system power saving, high transmission efficiency of a hydraulic system, high energy utilization rate, good buffering performance and long service life.

title_en: Transmission gear set of electronic component production equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission gear set of electronic element production equipment, which comprises a gear set, a rotating shaft inserted in the middle of the gear set and bearing seats erected at two ends of the rotating shaft, wherein the gear set comprises a gear body, teeth arranged on the gear body and an automatic oil supplementing device arranged on the side edge of the gear body, and each bearing seat comprises an upper base, a lower base and an elastic compensating piece arranged between the upper base and the lower base. The transmission gear set of the electronic element production equipment provided by the invention is simple in structure and convenient to use, the gear can be automatically supplemented with oil without paying attention to the gear lubrication condition in real time in the gear use process, the oil overflowing from the gear can flow into the oil storage tank, and the bearing seat is lubricated by the elastic compensation piece without independently lubricating the bearing seat.

title_en: Water inlet joint and gas water heater comprising same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water inlet joint and a gas water heater comprising the same. The water supply connector comprises: the joint body is of a cylindrical structure with a flow channel inside, and the side wall of the joint body is provided with a communication hole communicated with the flow channel; the flow blocking piece is matched with the communicating hole; the fixing piece is connected to the joint body, and the flow blocking piece can slide between a first position and a second position relative to the fixing piece under the action of water pressure; and (4) an adjusting device. When in the first position, at least a portion of the flow blocking member extends into the interior of the fitting body; when the connector is at the second position, one end of the flow blocking piece close to the connector body is positioned in the communicating hole; when the flow blocking member is in the second position and the water pressure exceeds a preset value, the flow blocking member acts on the regulating device to partially block or completely block the flow passage. When water pressure exceeds a preset value, the adjusting device can prevent the water inlet pipe from expanding and cracking when the water pressure is too high. The structure is simple, the integral structure of the gas water heater is simplified, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Pressure vessel of supplementary water conservancy diversion structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pressure vessels, and particularly discloses a pressure vessel with an auxiliary flow guide structure, which comprises a base, wherein first damping shock absorbers are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the base, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the tops of the first damping shock absorbers, frames are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the supporting plate, a second damping shock absorber is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the supporting plate, and a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the tops of the second damping shock absorbers. According to the invention, through the matched use of the base, the first damping shock absorber, the support plate, the frame, the second damping shock absorber, the bottom plate, the pressure container body, the pillar, the movable plate, the first spring, the first pin seat, the second spring, the limit block, the sliding groove, the sliding block, the third spring, the second pin seat and the connecting rod, the shock absorption can be carried out on the pressure container body when in use, the deformation and even the breakage of the pressure container body are avoided, and the service life of the pressure container body is prolonged.

title_en: Flow control valve and system for cleaning vehicle surfaces
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a flow control valve for controlling the flow of cleaning media, such as to nozzles positioned to distribute the cleaning media to a vehicle surface. The flow control valve includes a plunger and a deflectable diaphragm that operate to open and close a fluid passage through the valve. Vehicles and systems with flow control valves are also provided.

title_en: Air spring for automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air spring for an automobile, wherein a bag body of the air spring comprises an inner adhesive layer, a reinforcing layer and an outer adhesive layer; the outer adhesive layer comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 70-85 parts of neoprene, 9-17 parts of chlorohydrin rubber, 1-3.8 parts of ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber, 2-5 parts of polyaniline, 15-22 parts of carbon black, 2-9 parts of heavy calcium carbonate, 1-7 parts of talcum powder, 2-7 parts of fly ash, 8-16 parts of modified halloysite nanotube, 1-5 parts of zinc methacrylate, 2-6 parts of attapulgite, 0.5-2 parts of protective wax, 1-2 parts of stearic acid, 1-3 parts of zinc oxide, 2-7 parts of magnesium oxide, 1-2 parts of sulfur, 0.5-1 part of accelerator DETU, 0.3-1.1 parts of accelerator M, 0.1-0.8 part of accelerator NA-22, 1-2.8 parts of anti-aging agent and 0.3-0.8 part of coupling agent. The air spring for the automobile provided by the invention has the advantages of good ageing resistance, strength and flame retardance and long service life.

title_en: Refrigerator drawer plastic pressing strip assembly assembling tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refrigerator drawer plastic pressing strip assembly assembling tool which comprises a bottom plate (1) and a working platform (2) arranged on the bottom plate, wherein a rack (3) is arranged at the lower end of the bottom plate, a moving wheel (4) is arranged at the lower end of the rack, a fixing frame (5) is arranged at the side end above the working platform, a lighting lamp (6) is arranged at the upper end part of the fixing frame, an air cylinder assembly (7) and a pressure gauge (9) in adaptive connection with the air cylinder assembly are arranged at one side of the fixing frame, one end of the air cylinder assembly is connected with a piston rod (8) adaptive to the air cylinder assembly, a pressing plate (10) is arranged at one end of the piston rod, a control box (11) and an electromagnetic valve. The drawer main body assembly and the drawer cover plate assembly are simple in structure, convenient to limit and fix, high in assembly efficiency and convenient to operate and use.

title_en: Injection classifying and blanking device with inclined slide rail mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an injection classifying and blanking device with an inclined slide rail mechanism, and relates to the technical field of injection classifying and blanking. The material storage device comprises four first electric push rods, wherein supporting plates are arranged on the upper sides of the four first electric push rods, a material storage barrel is fixed on the upper side of each supporting plate, a circular bottom plate is arranged inside each material storage barrel, a material placing mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the circular bottom plate, a partition plate is matched with the upper side of the circular bottom plate in a sliding mode, a fixing plate is fixed on the upper side of the circular bottom plate, a buffer mechanism is arranged on one side of the fixing plate, and foam cotton is fixed on one side of the buffer mechanism. According to the invention, the four first electric push rods arranged on the lower side of the supporting plate can conveniently adjust the inclination angle of the circular bottom plate, so that a medicine injection can conveniently enter the circular limiting groove, the medicine injection entering the circular limiting groove can be limited to a certain extent through the partition plates in sliding fit, and the medicine injection is prevented from being directly contacted with the circular limiting groove to cause blockage, so that the classification speed is prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Flushing device of hydraulic mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flushing device of a hydraulic mechanism, which comprises an oil tank, wherein the oil tank is provided with an oil return cavity and an oil outlet cavity, the oil tank is provided with an oil return port connected with the oil return cavity, and the oil tank is also provided with an oil outlet connected with the oil outlet cavity; the flushing device also comprises at least two filtering structures, and the filtering structures are used for filtering the hydraulic oil; the flushing device also comprises an oil return bent pipe positioned in the oil return cavity, the oil return bent pipe is arranged on the oil return port, the oil return bent pipe comprises a transverse extending section and a vertical extending section, and the vertical extending section extends downwards; the oil tank comprises an oil tank bottom plate, and the oil tank bottom plate comprises bottom plate corresponding parts vertically corresponding to the vertical extending sections; the corresponding portion of the bottom plate extends obliquely to guide the flow of the hydraulic oil.

title_en: Exhaust manifold supplemental cooling system
abstract_en: The subject of the invention is an exhaust manifold additional cooling system comprising a cylinder head with a cylinder head flange, an exhaust manifold and a catalyst, wherein the exhaust manifold is connected with its first end to the cylinder head flange and with its second end to the catalyst, so that the inlet opening of the cylinder head and the outlet opening of the cylinder head on the cylinder head flange are connected to the engine central cooling system, and the exhaust manifold of the jacket with the at least one cooling channel of the exhaust manifold is connected with its first end to the cylinder head flange, such that the exhaust manifold input opening and the exhaust manifold output opening, which are connected to the cooling passages of the exhaust manifold, are connected to the cylinder head input opening and the cylinder head output opening.

title_en: Anti-seismic transformer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an antidetonation transformer relates to the technical field of transformer, and it includes the main part, and the below of main part is provided with the mounting panel, and the mounting panel is used for and rack connection, and the lower terminal surface of main part is provided with the erection column, is provided with the installation pipe that supplies the erection column vertical to slide on the mounting panel, and the lower terminal surface of erection column passes through the elastic component with the up end of mounting panel to be connected. Through setting up the mounting panel in the below of main part, and set up the erection column at the lower terminal surface of main part, and simultaneously, the mounting panel passes through the elastic component with the erection column and is connected, when the main part receives the impact, the vertical downstream of erection column makes the elastic component take place elastic deformation, the in-process of elastic component deformation can be absorbed the impact force, thereby realize the buffering shock-absorbing capacity of transformer, reduce the effort of main part to the rack as far as, thereby effectively weaken the counter-acting force of rack to the main part, thereby have good protection effect to the inside part of main part, and then have extension transformer life's advantage.

title_en: Multi-angle monitor rack
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-angle monitor frame, which comprises a frame barrel, wherein an annular frame is arranged at the upper end of the inner part of the frame barrel, the annular frame is connected with a main core rod through a bearing, and the main core rod is matched with three leg frames hinged with the annular frame; the upper end of the frame cylinder is provided with a motor which is connected with a U-shaped frame; an angle swing component is arranged on the U-shaped frame; the angle swing assembly comprises a movable base, and a probe is hinged to the movable base. The invention is convenient to use, can control the probe to rotate in 360 degrees annularly and adjust the height inclination angle on the basis of positioning and indirectly adjusting the height of the probe, and can control the probe to turn to monitor dead angles, thereby achieving the effect of monitoring the livestock farm in a comprehensive multi-azimuth angle.

title_en: High-altitude tree trimming and hoisting platform equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-altitude tree trimming and hoisting platform equipment, which comprises a machine body shell, wherein a closing block is fixedly arranged at the left end of the machine body shell, a closing hydraulic pump is fixedly arranged in the closing block, a closed sliding cavity which is symmetrical front and back is arranged in the closing block, the closed sliding cavity is connected with the closing hydraulic pump through a pipeline, a closing sliding block is arranged in the closed sliding cavity in a sliding manner, a triggering cavity is arranged in the closing block, and triggering blocks which are symmetrical front and back are arranged in the triggering cavity in a sliding manner. Prevent that the platform from dropping, reduce the injury, have higher integration degree.

title_en: High-precision reciprocating symmetrical type poking frame structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision reciprocating symmetrical type poking frame structure which comprises a driving device, wherein one side of the driving device is rotatably connected with a first driven device, the other side of the driving device is rotatably connected with a second driven device, the driving device comprises a bottom structure, a connecting structure and a transmission structure, the bottom structure is arranged at the bottom of the inner end of the driving device, one side of the upper end of the bottom structure is rotatably connected with the transmission structure, the other side of the upper end of the bottom structure is rotatably connected with the connecting structure, the bottom structure comprises a clamping plate frame, a bottom plate, a first limiting pin and a sleeve shaft frame, the bottom plate is arranged at the bottom position of the inner end of the bottom structure, the middle part of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the first limiting pin, and the clamping plate frame is fixedly connected to one side of the top of the bottom plate. The invention is a high-precision reciprocating symmetrical type poking frame structure, and achieves the purpose of adjusting poking at the inner end through the arrangement of a driving device.

title_en: Front-coarse deep-ploughing and rear-shallow fine-crushing hand-held rotary cultivator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a front-thick deep-ploughing and rear-shallow-fine-crushing hand-held rotary cultivator which comprises a fixed base, wherein a driving device is arranged on the fixed base, a damping and buffering structure is arranged below the fixed base, a front deep-ploughing structure is arranged below the damping and buffering structure, the front deep-ploughing structure is connected with the driving device, the damping and buffering structure comprises an upper connecting plate and a lower connecting plate, connecting blocks are symmetrically arranged on the upper connecting plate and the lower connecting plate, a telescopic buffering structure is connected between the connecting blocks, a fertilizer applying device is arranged at the tail end of the fixed base, and the fertilizer applying device comprises a fertilizer applying box and has the beneficial effects that: such device simple structure, convenient to use can effectually carry out the deep ploughing of soil and the breakage of clod is leveled, and can directly fertilize, and the during operation can reduce its vibrations, with the burden of its arm, raises the efficiency.

title_en: Device capable of automatically plugging gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device capable of automatically plugging a gas pipeline, which relates to the technical field of gas pipeline plugging and comprises a platform, a movable plate, a first rack guide frame, a gear, a first rack, a first hydraulic cylinder support frame, a first hydraulic cylinder, a second hydraulic cylinder support frame, a first hinged support, a transverse fixing rod, an arc-shaped groove frame, a baffle, a clamping push plate, a second hinged support, a second hydraulic cylinder, a fixing sleeve, a third hinged support, a third hydraulic cylinder, a support rod, a first connecting seat, a fourth hydraulic cylinder, a fifth hydraulic cylinder, a second connecting seat and a second rack guide frame. This device of automatic shutoff gas pipeline of ability makes the interior survey of arc cell rack and the pipeline contact completely through the rotatory certain angle of the arc cell rack that sets up to make the baffle shelter from this pipeline sky completely, realize the shutoff to the pipeline, realize that this plugging device for gas pipeline not only the shutoff is effectual, is convenient for remove easy operation moreover, need not destroy the body.

title_en: Electromagnetic valve is to many oil circuits control structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-oil-path control structure of a solenoid valve, which comprises a protective box, an underground diesel oil storage tank and a daily oil tank, wherein the bottom of an inner cavity of the protective box is fixedly connected with the bottom of the underground diesel oil storage tank through a supporting plate, two sides of the top of the underground diesel oil storage tank are respectively communicated with a first operating well and a second operating well, the top of the first operating well and the top of the second operating well penetrate through the protective box and extend to the top of the protective box, and one side of the first operating well, which extends to the top of the protective box, is communicated with a first fire-retardant vent cover through a fixing pipe. This solenoid valve has reduced submerged pump use quantity to many oil circuit control structure, great improvement fuel delivery efficiency, can be accurate control the distribution to the fuel, reduced pipeline quantity, reduced system complexity, reduced the cost that the user drops into to a certain extent, avoided the waste of a large amount of energy, the subsequent maintenance of convenient to use person, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Sliding bearing with sealing device and water pump with sliding bearing
abstract_en: A plain bearing (1) with a sealing arrangement (2) for a water pump, the plain bearing (1) being used for radially mounting and sealing a shaft (3, 30) in a housing between a wet side (4, 40) and a dry side (5, 50). A plain bearing (1) with a sealing device (2) comprises: a plain bearing bushing (11) made of sintered material for radially mounting the shaft (3, 30), and a dry-side shaft seal (25), said dry-side shaft seal (25) being arranged between the plain bearing bushing (11) and the dry side (5, 50); the wet-side shaft seal (24) is arranged between the wet side (4, 40) and the sliding bearing bush (11); and a screw reservoir (20) with an at least partially porous substrate (21) made of a non-sintered material is arranged between the wet-side shaft seal (24) and the plain bearing bushing (11); wherein, in the bore of the base (21), the lubricant reservoir (20) comprises a water-insoluble lubricant, the volume of the lubricant reservoir (20) and the volume of the lubricant filling occupying the total space between the wet-side shaft seal (24) and the dry-side shaft seal (25).

title_en: Mining anchor bolt and installation and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining foundation bolt, which comprises: the device comprises a threaded rod, an anchoring block, an anchoring force enhancing device and an adjusting nut, wherein the lower end of the threaded rod penetrates through the middle part of the anchoring block and is connected with the anchoring block, the upper end of the threaded rod penetrates through the adjusting nut and is in threaded connection with the adjusting nut, one end of the anchoring force enhancing device is hinged with the anchoring block, and the other end of the anchoring force enhancing device is connected with the bottom of the adjusting nut; the invention also discloses an installation and use method of the mining foundation bolt. The mine foundation bolt can be well suitable for the fixing mode of the foundation bolt of the underground equipment of the coal mine, has strong bearing capacity, and ensures the normal work and production safety of the underground equipment.

title_en: C219 steel cylinder with large grounding point excircle diameter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a C219 steel cylinder with large grounding point excircle diameter, which comprises a cylinder top, a cylinder body and a cylinder bottom; the bottle bottom comprises a convex part and a concave part, wherein the concave part is positioned at the center of the bottle bottom and takes a shape of being concave towards the bottle top, and the convex part is positioned at the position, close to the side wall of the bottle body, of the bottle bottom and takes a shape of being convex towards the direction away from the bottle top; in order to increase the stability of the steel cylinder when standing, the diameter of the outer circle of the bottom protruding part of the steel cylinder contacting the ground is increased. The protruding part is used for contacting with the ground so as to enable the steel cylinder to stand on the ground, and the diameter of the outer circle of the protruding part contacting with the ground is 162 and 170 mm. The grounding point area of the C219 steel cylinder is increased, the stability of the steel cylinder when the steel cylinder is placed in a standing mode is greatly improved, the steel cylinder is not prone to toppling, and potential safety hazards of the steel cylinder in the using process and the transporting process are eliminated.

title_en: Mobile device of plug-in telescopic traffic signal indicator lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of indicator lamp movement, in particular to a mobile device of a plug-in telescopic traffic signal indicator lamp. It at least comprises: the base, telescopic machanism and installation fixed establishment, the base outer wall slides and is provided with the regulation frame, it all is provided with a plurality of articulated forks to adjust frame both sides outer wall, the inside rotation of articulated fork is provided with the down tube, the down tube tip rotates through the pivot and sets up inside articulated fork, the down tube tip articulates there is the backup pad, backup pad bottom intercommunication has a intercommunication section of thick bamboo, intercommunication bobbin base intercommunication has the rubber suction cup, installation fixed establishment includes the fixed plate, the outer wall that the fixed plate is close to the bottom is provided with fixed fork, the fixed plate bottom is provided with places the board, the trilateral outer wall of fixed plate all slides and is provided with the limiting plate, fixedly connected with spacing spring between limiting plate tip and the fixed plate inner chamber, the fixing that can be stable is subaerial, avoid toppling, and be convenient for installation and disassembly signal indicator, and the practicality is stronger.

title_en: Novel multichannel valve for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel multichannel valve for hydraulic engineering, and relates to the technical field of valves. The invention comprises a valve body; the outer wall of the valve body is respectively provided with a water inlet channel and a plurality of water outlet channels; the center of the bottom in the valve body is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft; the peripheral side surface of the rotating shaft is provided with a first thread structure, and the peripheral side surface of the first thread structure is in threaded connection with a driving assembly; the bottom in the valve body is fixedly connected with an annular partition plate; a water inlet chamber and a plurality of water outlet chambers are respectively arranged between the outer wall of the annular partition plate and the inner wall of the valve body; the bottom in the valve body is fixedly connected with a plurality of first sealing mechanisms along the annular direction; the first sealing mechanism and the driving assembly are mutually clamped; and a second sealing mechanism is arranged in the water inlet chamber.
