According to the invention, the first sealing mechanism, the driving assembly, the water inlet cavity, the water outlet cavity, the rotating shaft and the driving assembly are arranged, so that the opening and the closure of a single water outlet channel can be realized, and the opening and the closure of a plurality of water outlet channels can be realized simultaneously.

title_en: Long service life's plateau is solenoid valve for oxygenerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solenoid valve for a plateau oxygen generator with long service life, which comprises a base body, wherein a handle penetrates through the top of the base body, an opening matched with the handle is formed in the surface of the base body, fixed plates are fixedly connected to both sides of the top of the handle, a vertical plate is fixedly connected to one side of each fixed plate, a movable rod penetrates through one side of each vertical plate, one end, extending to one side of each vertical plate, of each movable rod is fixedly connected with a movable block, a support plate is fixedly connected to both sides of the top of the base body and positioned between the two second movable blocks, a limiting block matched with the support plates is fixedly connected to both sides of the handle and positioned under a spring, a bearing seat is fixedly connected to one side of the top of the base body, a solenoid valve connecting body is fixedly connected to the top of the bearing seat, and the solenoid valve and, the maintenance personnel can use the device more conveniently, and the working efficiency is improved to a great extent.

title_en: Sewage discharge assembly convenient to install and detach
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sewage discharge assembly convenient to mount and dismount, which relates to the field of sewage discharge equipment, and comprises a sewage discharge port, a sewage discharge circular pipe and a limiting assembly, wherein an inner circular pipe and an outer circular pipe are arranged on the lower surface of a circular discharge pipe orifice, an annular connecting groove is formed between the inner circular pipe and the outer circular pipe, a fixing ring is arranged on the annular side surface of the sewage discharge circular pipe, an annular connecting plate is arranged on the upper surface of the fixing ring, the annular connecting plate is in plug-in fit with the annular connecting groove, the sewage discharge port and the sewage discharge circular pipe are in fit connection through a plurality of limiting assemblies, a limiting circular blind hole is formed in the inner circular pipe, a limiting circular rod movably penetrates through a first through circular hole and a second through circular hole, and one end of the limiting circular rod is in plug-in fit with the limiting circular blind hole. Through operating spacing subassembly, the installation dismantlement operation of sewage discharge pipe on the sewage discharge port of being convenient for.

title_en: Gas purifying device for paint drying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas purifying device for paint drying equipment, which comprises: the heat-conducting device comprises a cylindrical shell, wherein one end of the shell is an air inlet pipe, the other end of the shell is an air outlet end, one side of the shell is a heat-conducting area, other parts of the shell are non-heat-conducting areas, and the heat-conducting areas are made of materials with better heat-conducting performance than the non-heat-conducting areas; the rotary cylinder is arranged in the shell in a rotating mode through the rotating shaft and is close to the air inlet end, the rotating shaft is located on the axis of the shell, the inside of the rotary cylinder is divided into a plurality of mutually independent fan-shaped sealing spaces through a plurality of partition boards, magnetic fluid is filled in the sealing spaces, a semicircular shielding plate is arranged below the rotary cylinder, the shielding plate is located on one side close to the heat conduction area and made of non-heat conduction materials, and a permanent magnet is arranged outside the shell. And part of the heat of the gas is absorbed by the magnetic fluid and is finally converted into the kinetic energy of the rotating cylinder, so that the problem of the gas is reduced, and the subsequent filtering treatment is facilitated.

title_en: Oil-gas lubrication distributor assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil-gas lubrication distributor assembly, which comprises a distributor and a protection box, wherein the distributor is provided with an oil-gas inlet and a plurality of oil-gas outlets, the oil-gas inlet and the oil-gas outlets are respectively connected with transparent observation pipes, and each transparent observation pipe is connected with a joint; the protective box comprises a bottom plate, a frame body and a cover plate, wherein the frame body is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate, the bottom plate and the frame body form a hollow concave part, the cover plate is connected to the top of the frame body, a first through hole is formed in the bottom plate, the distributor is placed in the hollow concave part and is fixed on the bottom plate through the first through hole and a bolt matched with the first through hole, and a transparent observation tube connected to the distributor is positioned in the hollow concave part; the frame body is provided with a second through hole and a third through hole, the second through hole is arranged corresponding to the oil gas outlet of the distributor, and the third through hole is arranged corresponding to the oil gas inlet of the distributor. The invention can effectively reduce the corrosion, fracture, falling off and other conditions of the distributor joint, and can check the lubricating oil supply condition of the bearing through the transparent observation tube.

title_en: Expanding radiation flow mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an expansion radiation flow mechanism, which is provided with a bottom surface, wherein a fluid supply port is arranged on the bottom surface, when in use, a gap is formed between the bottom surface of the mechanism and the surface of an object to be adsorbed, fluid flows out from the fluid supply port, enters the gap and flows outwards along the gap, and the gap is an expansion gap and meets the following requirements: with the fluid supply port as the starting point for the flow, there is a radial length within which the height of the gap becomes increasingly larger, radially outward. The mechanism of the invention can further effectively improve the adsorption force of radiation flow by improving the parallel radiation flow mechanism, thereby being beneficial to the subsequent application.

title_en: Collecting device of electronic-grade chlorine trifluoride
abstract_en: The invention provides a collecting device of electronic-grade chlorine trifluoride, which comprises: the inner tank (10) comprises a Hastelloy tank body (101), a feeding pipe (102) and a discharging pipe (103) which are arranged at the top and the bottom of the Hastelloy tank body (101), and a pressure sensor (104) for measuring the internal pressure of the Hastelloy tank body (101); the outer jacket interlayer (12) comprises a stainless steel outer layer (120) wrapped on the inner tank (10), and an inert gas inlet pipeline (121) and an inert gas outlet pipeline (122) communicated with the stainless steel outer layer (120); the condensation component (11) is clamped between the outer jacket interlayer (12) and the inner tank (10) and comprises a condensation pipeline (111), and a liquid inlet pipeline (110) and a liquid outlet pipeline (112) which are communicated with the condensation pipeline (111) respectively; the analysis component is used for analyzing the content of chlorine trifluoride in the inert gas, and the alarm component is used for giving an alarm when detecting chlorine trifluoride.

title_en: Vehicle door lock mounting bolt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle door lock mounting bolt which comprises a bolt head and a screw rod, wherein a thread section is arranged on the screw rod and comprises a first thread and a second thread, the first thread is matched with an internal thread of a vehicle body, the second thread is in interference fit with the internal thread of the vehicle body, the crest height of the second thread is smaller than that of the first thread, the angle of the profile angle of the second thread is smaller than that of the first thread, a plurality of second threads and adjacent first threads form anti-loosening grooves together, the anti-loosening grooves are spiral and are distributed uniformly along the surface of the thread section. The paint has low cost and can play the roles of preventing looseness and water and preventing paint damage.

title_en: Damping disc structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a damping disc structure which comprises a floating cabin, wherein the floating cabin is in a circular ring shape, a plurality of water-gas exchange cylinders are arranged on the floating cabin in a circle, and the water-gas exchange cylinders are mutually communicated. The invention can be injected into a water tank in the process of lowering ocean, increase damping of the damping disk to ensure that the whole has better stability, realize the draft control of the whole floater by adjusting the ratio of air to water in the water-air exchange cylinder, achieve the aim by removing the counterweight adjusting block when the whole floater is excessively heavy and the water-air exchange cylinder and the buoyancy tank can not provide enough buoyancy due to the adhesion of marine organisms, and effectively avoid the damage of the torque to the oscillating floater type wave energy generating device by rotating the damping disk around the rotating center when the impact of wave current on the damping disk forms torque.

title_en: Planetary gear train, gear box and industrial robot
abstract_en: A planetary gear train (26), comprising: a ring gear (66) defining a central axis (40); a plurality of planet gears (68), each planet gear (68) being rotatable about a respective planet axis (74) and meshing with the ring gear (66), and each planet gear (68) comprising conical and helical planet gear teeth (78) defining a conical direction (84); a planet carrier (70) rotatably supporting the planet gears (68) for rotation about a planet axis (74), the planet carrier (70) being axially displaceable along the central axis (40); and a carrier force application device (88) configured to apply a force to the carrier (70) along the central axis (40) in the tapering direction (84). A gearbox (22) for an industrial robot (10) is also provided, the gearbox comprising a planetary gear train (26), and the industrial robot (10) comprising a planetary gear train (26) or a gearbox (22).

title_en: Electronic expansion valve
abstract_en: The invention provides an electronic expansion valve, comprising: a housing; the guide sleeve is arranged in the shell; the valve needle assembly is movably arranged in the guide sleeve in a penetrating mode, the outer wall of the valve needle assembly is arranged corresponding to the inner wall of the guide sleeve, and the guide sleeve is used for guiding the valve needle assembly; the guide sleeve and/or the valve needle assembly are made of non-metal materials; or part of the guide sleeve and/or part of the valve needle assembly are integrally formed by metal and non-metal materials, the inner wall of the guide sleeve is in contact with the outer wall of the valve needle assembly, and at least one surface of the guide sleeve is made of the non-metal materials. Through the technical scheme provided by the application, the problems of large noise and short service life in the prior art can be solved.

title_en: Test system and method of main steam quick isolation valve and fast reactor main steam system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test system of a main steam quick isolation valve, which comprises a local closing test device used for controlling each isolation valve on the same loop to perform local closing tests in sequence one by one. Correspondingly, a test method of the main steam quick isolation valve and a fast reactor main steam system are also disclosed. The test system can simplify the regular test operation of the main steam quick isolation valve of the nuclear power plant, improve the test efficiency and save the labor cost.

title_en: Pipeline leakage detection device based on wired sound shadow detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline leakage detection devices, and discloses a pipeline leakage detection device based on wired sound and shadow detection, which comprises a bottom plate and a detection head shell, wherein the inner wall of the bottom of the detection head shell is fixedly connected with a motor, one end of an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with a driving bevel gear, the inner walls of two sides of the detection head shell are fixedly connected with two sealing plates, one side of each sealing plate is provided with an insertion hole, a rotating shaft is movably connected in each insertion hole, one end of each rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a driven bevel gear, the driving bevel gear is meshed with the driven bevel gear, one side of each rotating shaft is fixedly connected with an installation block, one end of each installation block is embedded with a first camera, and the inner walls of two. The invention increases the stability of the detection device, thereby stabilizing the shooting picture of the camera when shooting the pipeline and improving the judgment accuracy of the leakage part.

title_en: Air conditioner and cleaning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioners, in particular to an air conditioner and a cleaning method thereof. The air conditioner includes: a housing; the air duct assembly is detachably arranged in the shell; the evaporator assembly is arranged on one side, close to the air inlet of the air duct assembly, in the shell; the camera device is rotatably connected to the position, corresponding to the air inlet, on the evaporator assembly through a hanging rod and is used for shooting an area to be detected in the air duct assembly in real time and sending a shot picture to a terminal for displaying; to sum up, the design user of this scheme of adoption can be through the terminal clear know wait to detect regional dirty degree in the wind channel subassembly to tear open the washing operation to the wind channel subassembly according to dirty degree, thereby effectively use manpower and materials sparingly, improve clean efficiency.

title_en: Overflow type pressure regulating tower for super-long gravity flow water delivery system and pressure regulating method
abstract_en: The invention provides an overflow type pressure regulating tower suitable for an ultra-long gravity flow water conveying system, which comprises a vertical drainage pipe, a horizontal connecting pipe, a top connecting groove, an overflow weir and a vertical drainage pipe; the drainage vertical pipe comprises an inflow vertical pipe and an outflow vertical pipe, and the bottoms of the inflow vertical pipe and the outflow vertical pipe are respectively connected with an upper water conveying pipeline and a lower water conveying pipeline; the connecting horizontal pipe is used for communicating the middle upper parts of the inlet and outlet vertical pipes and is used for overflowing under a steady-state working condition with lower water level; the top connecting groove is internally provided with an overflow weir which is divided into a flow guiding area and an overflow area, the flow guiding area is used for communicating the tops of the inflow vertical pipe and the outflow vertical pipe and is used for overflowing under the steady-state working condition with higher water level, the overflow weir is used for controlling the maximum water pressure, and the overflow area is provided with a drainage vertical pipe and is used for discharging external overflow water. In the transition process, the pipe explosion caused by the boosting water level is prevented through the overflow weir, and the transmission of the pressure reducing water hammer is blocked through the connecting transverse pipe; overflowing to control the maximum water hammer pressure and separating the system to control the accident influence range; not only can enhance the system safety, but also can greatly reduce the cost of pipeline engineering.

title_en: Automatic hydrogen and chlorine proportioning system for hydrochloric acid synthesis furnace and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical synthesis, and particularly discloses an automatic hydrogen and chlorine proportioning system and a control method for a hydrochloric acid synthesis furnace, which comprises a hydrogen buffer tank, hydrogen pipeline equipment, a chlorine buffer tank, chlorine pipeline equipment, a DCS control system and an SIS control system.

title_en: Financial big data storage device based on block chain and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial big data storage device based on a block chain and a using method thereof, belonging to the technical field of data storage devices. The financial big data storage device based on the block chain comprises a machine body, wherein the outer wall of the machine body is fixedly connected with a power box, the power box is connected with a driving assembly, the inner cavity of a clamping box is connected with a clamping mechanism, the clamping mechanism comprises a connecting rod, a telescopic shaft, an air cylinder and a clamping assembly, the outer wall of the clamping box is rotatably connected with the clamping assembly, the second rotating end of the driving assembly is connected with a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft is connected with a positioning mechanism, the positioning mechanism is matched with a supporting plate through the driving assembly, and the top of the clamping box is connected with a data storage; according to the invention, the lifting assembly is matched with the matching assembly, the vibration caused in the moving process can be absorbed by the damping assembly, and the supporting plate is matched with the positioning mechanism through the driving assembly, so that the data storage device is more conveniently placed in the machine body, the stability is improved, the placing difficulty is reduced, and the protection function is improved.

title_en: Can-shaped composite brake disc for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: A pot-shaped composite brake disc (1) for a motor vehicle combines at least one fastening component (2) as a hub interface with at least one friction ring component (4) as a friction partner for at least one friction lining (6). The invention provides a division of the task in an advantageous novel combination of features, namely a division based on the force flow of the working division, such that a distinction is made between pairs of components (2, 4), between devices, features and arrangements with a torque transmission function and devices, features and arrangements with a securing function, by providing a thermally conductive joint surface between the components on one side, wherein the components (2, 4) are assembled coaxially to one another and are rotationally secured in the axial direction (Ax), such that the fastening component (2) serves as a heat sink for the friction ring component (4), wherein at least one securing device is additionally provided separately between the components (2, 4) and takes over the securing function substantially only (nominal load) by means of a radially oriented engagement of at least one undercut by means of a form fit with one another, and wherein a press-fit connection (7) is present for transmitting torque between the fastening part (2) and the friction ring part (4).

title_en: Hydraulic oil source system of four-foot robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic oil source system of a quadruped robot, and belongs to the technical field of quadruped robots. This system includes mount pad and radiator unit, the bottom of mount pad is equipped with the motor pump, be equipped with high-pressure filter, the oil separating piece that produces, advance oil separating piece and closed oil tank on the mount pad, be equipped with a plurality of oil walking pipelines in the mount pad, the motor pump is connected with the closed oil tank through oil walking pipeline A, is connected with high-pressure filter through oil walking pipeline B, the oil separating piece that produces is connected with high-pressure filter through oil walking pipeline C, radiator unit's one end is connected with the oil feeding oil separating piece, and the other end is connected with the closed oil tank through oil walking pipeline D. The hydraulic elements are integrally installed on the installation seat, the structure is compact, the overall size of the hydraulic oil source system of the quadruped robot is small, and centralized maintenance is convenient. The hydraulic oil is subjected to shunting heat dissipation through the shunt tubes, the heat dissipation area is increased through the spiral heat dissipation fins, the heat dissipation effect is good, and the stability of system operation is improved.

title_en: Deep low temperature guide formula solenoid valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep low-temperature pilot-operated solenoid valve, which relates to the technical field of solenoid valves and comprises a pilot valve, a main valve body and a main valve core, wherein one end of the main valve body is an air inlet channel, and the other end of the main valve body is an air outlet channel; the main valve body is internally provided with an air inlet cavity communicated with the air inlet channel, an air outlet cavity communicated with the air outlet channel and a communication cavity communicated with the air inlet cavity and the air outlet cavity; the elastic piece is abutted against the main valve core and is in a natural state, and the air outlet channel is closed at the moment; the gap between the main valve core and the sliding cavity is used for gas to slowly pass through, the sliding cavity and the gas outlet channel are communicated with an independent gas channel, and the pilot valve is arranged on the main valve body and used for controlling the opening and closing of the gas channel; air inlet channel and highly compressed pipeline intercommunication, this application has the effect that improves the solenoid valve air tightness under dark low temperature and high-pressure state.

title_en: Driving mechanism for mini-tiller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving mechanism for a mini-tiller, which is provided with a front speed changing device, wherein the front speed changing device comprises a front gearbox, a clutch assembly is arranged at the front end in the front gearbox, one end of a main shaft A is penetrated through the middle part of the clutch assembly, the other end of the main shaft A penetrates through a rear cover of the front gearbox, a latch is arranged at the end of the main shaft A, a gear B and a shifter A are sequentially arranged on the main shaft A from front to back, an auxiliary shaft A is also arranged in the front gearbox, the rear end of the front gearbox is also connected with the front end of a middle speed changing device, and the rear end of the middle speed changing device is connected with a rear driving device. The multi-stage speed changing device is provided with multi-stage speed changing, the front speed is high, the back speed is low, the multi-purpose function of one machine can be realized, and the practicability is stronger.

title_en: Electromechanical anti-seismic detection device for building
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromechanical anti-seismic detection device for a building, which not only solves the problem of installation error caused by long-distance conveying in the use process, but also can absorb the vibration of a support, prevent the vibration force from being transmitted to the building, and can also not limit the use direction after the installation is finished, can randomly select the walking track of the support, and simultaneously ensure reliable supporting force, and the electromechanical anti-seismic detection device comprises a fixed disc and is characterized in that a semicircular supporting frame is spherically hinged on the lower end surface of a fixed plate, the lower end of the semicircular supporting frame is rotatably connected with an auxiliary supporting frame, the auxiliary supporting frame is connected with the upper end of the semicircular supporting frame through an automatic clamping device, the lower end of the semicircular supporting frame is fixedly connected with a bearing plate, an arc-shaped bracket is vertically and slidably connected with the bearing plate through a supporting spring, the left end of the arc-shaped bracket is rotatably connected with an auxiliary cover plate.

title_en: Bidirectional sliding pipeline buttress and assembling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bidirectional sliding pipeline buttress and an assembling method thereof, wherein the bidirectional sliding pipeline buttress comprises the following steps: the pipeline fixing assembly, the sliding assembly and the abutment assembly; the sliding assembly is fixedly arranged on the abutment assembly, the pipeline fixing assembly is slidably arranged on the sliding assembly, and the pipeline is arranged on the pipeline fixing assembly; the sliding assembly comprises a first sliding piece and a second sliding piece, the second sliding piece is fixedly arranged on the abutment assembly, the first sliding piece is arranged on the second sliding piece in a sliding mode, the pipeline fixing assembly is arranged on the first sliding piece in a sliding mode, and the sliding direction between the first sliding piece and the second sliding piece is perpendicular to the sliding direction between the pipeline fixing assembly and the first sliding piece. The pipeline is fixed between subassembly and the slip subassembly and is perpendicular with the slip direction between first slider and the second slider, and the department of sliding sets up the polytetrafluoroethylene piece, and the frictional force of polytetrafluoroethylene piece is less, and is not fragile, the requirement of the flexible volume of satisfying axial and two radial directions that can be more relaxed.

title_en: Parallel double-supporting-plate gate valve
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipeline valves and discloses a parallel double-supporting-plate gate valve which comprises a valve body, a valve rod, a wedge pressing block, a first valve plate, a second valve plate and a rotating shaft, wherein the valve rod is arranged on the valve body; the valve body is provided with a control hole, the wedge pressing block is positioned in the control hole and provided with a T-shaped hole, and the rotating shaft is a T-shaped shaft and positioned in the T-shaped hole and can rotate relative to the wedge pressing block; the first valve plate is a wedge-shaped plate, the wedge-shaped surface of the first valve plate is parallel and opposite to the wedge-shaped surface of the wedge-shaped block, and the wedge-shaped surface of the first valve plate is provided with a first connecting groove; the second valve plate is a wedge-shaped plate, a wedge-shaped surface of the second valve plate is parallel and opposite to the other wedge-shaped surface of the wedge-shaped block, and a second connecting groove is formed in the wedge-shaped surface of the second valve plate; the valve rod drives the wedge pressing block to move along the control hole; the wedge briquetting can enough drive first valve plate and second valve plate through the rotation axis and move, and the wedge briquetting also can move for first valve plate and second valve plate. The parallel double-supporting-plate gate valve can meet the requirements of different installation modes, and has better stability and reliability.

title_en: Metal ripple capable of being maintained and replaced on line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal corrugation capable of being maintained and replaced on line, which comprises a first pipeline, wherein a base is arranged on the outer side of the first pipeline, a metal corrugated pipe is connected to the right end face of the first pipeline, a second pipeline is connected to the right end face of the metal corrugated pipe, four fixing rods arranged in a cross shape are fixedly connected to the inner end face of the first pipeline, and fixing blocks are fixedly connected to the inner end faces of the fixing rods; based on the characteristics of the metal corrugated pipe, the invention singly isolates and seals a section of corrugated pipe to be maintained, so that the whole pipeline is still in a connection state, the conveying of the content in the pipeline is not influenced, the online maintenance effect is achieved, and when the whole section of metal corrugated pipe needs to be replaced, the content can be switched into the prepared interface through the shutoff valve, and the smoothness of the pipeline is maintained.

title_en: Planetary reducer with adjustable axial clearance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planetary reducer with an adjustable axial gap, which comprises a shell, wherein the bottom of the shell is connected with a bottom plate through a supporting plate, one end of the shell is provided with an output shaft, one side of the shell, which is far away from the output shaft, is provided with a shell rear seat, a coupler is arranged in the shell rear seat, and one side of the shell rear seat, which is far away from the shell, is detachably connected with an input end cover; the adjusting part is arranged in the casing, the driving part is arranged in the rear seat of the casing and used for driving the adjusting part to move so as to adjust the axial gap of the sun gear in the casing, the adjusting part is designed according to the existing requirement, the driving part can be driven to work through the rotation of the driving gear, so that the adjusting part can slide in the positioning seat and is convenient to be close to or far away from the cushion block, the axial gap of the sun gear is adjusted, the speed reducer does not need to be disassembled during operation, the adjusting part can stably slide, the cooling part can absorb the heat in the inner cavity of the casing, and the temperature of the inner cavity of the casing when the speed reducer works is reduced.

title_en: Microtubule hydrogen storage device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microtubule hydrogen storage device, which comprises a regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit (1), a miniature regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit protection tube bundle (2), a miniature regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit (3), a regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit shell (4), a regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit cone angle (5), a sealant (6), a metal cone angle sleeve (7), a hydrogen inlet and outlet (8), wherein the miniature regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit fixing (protecting) tube bundle (2) and the miniature regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit (3) are arranged in the regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit (1); the regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit shell (4) and the regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit cone angle (5) are connected with the metal cone angle sleeve (7) through a sealant, and finally hydrogen stored in the regular hexagon hydrogen storage unit (1) enters and exits through the hydrogen inlet and outlet (8); the invention improves the overall firmness and reliability of the hydrogen storage device and greatly improves the hydrogen storage capacity and the hydrogen storage rate in unit area.

title_en: Cloud deck and cloud deck control method
abstract_en: A cloud platform and a cloud platform control method, the cloud platform control method includes: acquiring attitude information of a holder; determining whether the holder is in a falling state or not according to the attitude information; and when the holder is in a falling state, triggering a protection mode to control the holder to rotate to a set posture. By the method, when the cradle head is determined to be in the falling state, the protection mode is triggered, the cradle head is controlled to rotate to the set posture, the posture that the cradle head is not easy to fall down can be understood, and the probability that the cradle head is broken down is reduced.

title_en: Single-ended universal joint and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-ended universal joint and an application method thereof, belonging to the field of fluid pipeline interface equipment. The single-ended universal joint comprises an inner pipe and a joint body with a containing cavity, wherein the joint body comprises a single-ended interface, an inner pipe connecting port and a pipeline connecting port, the inner pipe is provided with an inner port arranged in the containing cavity of the joint body and an outer port extending out of the joint body, the outer port extends out of the inner pipe connecting port on the joint body and is fixed with the inner pipe connecting port in a sealing mode, the single-ended interface and the inner port are in the same direction, the single-ended interface is assembled with an inner taper screw thread or a taper clamp, and the outer port, the pipeline connecting port and a fracture of a fluid pipeline are fixed in a sealing mode through welding or a screw thread structure. The single-end universal joint can be used independently or in pairs to adapt to different working conditions, any equipment device related to a pipeline can be installed, the practicability is high, the single-end universal joint can be adjusted freely according to the working conditions, and the installation and the disassembly are rapid and convenient.

title_en: Portable air charging stove
abstract_en: The utility model aims to provide a portable gas-filled furnace, which comprises a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a top wall, a bottom wall and a side wall, the top wall, the bottom wall and the side wall are encircled to form a fuel tank cavity for storing fuel, the bottom wall of the fuel tank is provided with a gas charging valve, the fuel tank is provided with a limiting assembly, the limiting assembly comprises a top limiting piece pressed against the top wall and a bottom limiting piece pressed against the bottom wall, and the top limiting piece and the bottom limiting piece are relatively and fixedly assembled together so that the top wall and the bottom wall are clamped between the top limiting piece and the bottom limiting piece. According to the utility model, the top limiting piece and the bottom limiting piece can play a role in limiting the expansion of the top wall and the bottom wall in a relatively far away mode, so that the fuel tank can be reinforced, has higher deformation resistance, and improves the safety.

title_en: Manufacturing equipment for bimetal sliding bearing
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment for manufacturing a bimetal sliding bearing, which relates to the technical field of sliding bearing processing and comprises an operation table, a horizontal moving assembly, a driver, a rotating assembly, a drill bit and a fixed table, wherein the driver is arranged on the horizontal moving assembly, the drill bit is arranged on the driver, when the drill bit moves to the surface of the bearing, a protective cover presses down on the bearing under the elastic action of a damping spring, the protective cover can block waste scraps generated by the work of the drill bit, the waste scraps are prevented from being sputtered out, an air deflector drives a baffle plate to be opened under the action of centrifugal force, the waste scraps can enter the collecting tank, and when the driver stops working, the baffle plate blocks the collecting tank under the action of an elastic frame, so that the waste scraps in the collecting tank are prevented from falling.

title_en: LED billboard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of billboards, in particular to an LED billboard, which comprises a supporting table, wherein a motor is fixedly installed in the supporting table through a fixing plate, the motor drives a rotating shaft to rotate, a special-shaped cam group, a magnetic ring and a planet wheel are arranged on the rotating shaft, the special-shaped cam group and the magnetic ring are fixedly connected through a fixing block, a groove is formed in the outer wall of the planet wheel, a guide rod is fixedly connected to the fixing plate, a slide rod is connected to the inside of the guide rod in a sliding mode and is in rolling connection with the groove through a connecting rod, the motor rotates to drive the planet wheel to rotate, so that the slide rod is driven to move up and down, the slide rod is in contact connection with the special-shaped cam group to drive the special-shaped cam group to move up and down, the rotating shaft rotates to drive the special-shaped cam group to rotate, and the special-shaped cam and a spring are matched with each other to drive a transmission rod to reciprocate an LED lamp panel fixedly connected with the transmission rod to achieve the effect of three-dimensional advertising.

title_en: Spinning equipment with antidetonation function
abstract_en: The invention discloses spinning equipment with an anti-seismic function, which comprises an equipment body, a base and a damping mechanism, wherein the damping mechanism is positioned between the equipment body and the base and comprises a plurality of damping columns which are uniformly distributed, the upper ends of the damping columns are fixed with the equipment body, and the lower ends of the damping columns are fixed with the base; the equipment comprises an equipment body and is characterized in that supporting plates are arranged on two sides of the equipment body, a base is provided with mounting grooves corresponding to the supporting plates, damping plates are arranged inside the mounting grooves, and the damping plates are located between the supporting plates and the bottom surfaces of the mounting grooves. The vibration-damping device can perform multiple vibration damping on spinning equipment, reduces damage to the spinning equipment caused by vibration, and ensures the service life.

title_en: Energy-saving self-opening and self-closing building door and window
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of doors and windows, and particularly relates to an energy-saving self-opening and self-closing building door and window, which comprises a door and window frame, a guide rail and a movable door, wherein the guide rail is arranged on the door and window frame, the movable door is connected on the guide rail in a sliding manner, and the energy-saving self-opening and self-closing building door and window also comprises: the moving assembly is arranged on the door and window frame and used for driving the moving door to move on the guide rail through mechanical transmission; and the cleaning structure is arranged on the moving assembly and the door and window frame. By arranging the cleaning structure, the invention can perform reciprocating wiping operation on the surface of the moving movable door by taking the moving assembly as power input while the moving assembly drives the moving door to move, so as to keep the surface of the moving door clean.

title_en: Worm gear mechanism and electric power steering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a worm and gear mechanism and an electric power steering system, and belongs to the technical field of vehicles. The worm and gear mechanism comprises a shell, a worm and a worm wheel which are rotatably arranged in the shell, and a supporting component, wherein the supporting component comprises a worm supporting unit and an axial elastic piece, one end of the axial elastic piece is elastically abutted against the input end of the worm, and the other end of the axial elastic piece is used for supporting an output shaft of a motor; the worm support unit comprises a self-aligning bearing, a floating bearing and an elastic support assembly, axial pretightening force is provided for the worm by utilizing an axial elastic piece, floating support is provided for the floating bearing by utilizing the elastic support assembly, and the position of the worm relative to the worm wheel can be adjusted in the radial direction and the axial direction. The electric power steering system comprises the driving gear shaft and the worm and gear mechanism, and friction torque loss between the worm and the gear is reduced and noise is reduced by applying the worm and gear mechanism.

title_en: Interval bicolor polycarbonate plugboard and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spacing bicolor polycarbonate plugboard and a production method thereof. According to the invention, the plug and the limiting block are arranged, the plug is matched with the slot, the limiting of the left and right sides and the upper line after the connection of the plates is realized, and the limiting block further enhances the limiting of the upper and lower sides after the connection of the plates; this application can obtain the double-colored plugboard in interval, and the panel that obtains has the function of automatically cleaning and preventing atomizing.

title_en: Medical treatment registration machine and using method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a medical registration machine of seeing a doctor belongs to accounting device, system or equipment field, including the registration machine main part, the front of registration machine main part is provided with the plug-in card mouth, and the back of registration machine main part is provided with the back lid, is equipped with in the registration machine main part and carries out sterile disinfection mechanism to the registration machine main part, and the bottom of registration machine main part is provided with the elevating system that drives the registration machine main part and rise or descend. Electric putter and scissor-fork frame through among the elevating system who sets up can drive supporting seat and the decline of registering machine main part, make this the whole height of registering machine of seeing a doctor reduce to some extent, thereby be convenient for sit the patient of wheelchair and use, realized the convenience of sitting wheelchair patient operation registering machine main part, the height of having solved among the prior art the registering machine of seeing a doctor can't be adjusted, the condition that can't touch the touch-sensitive screen can appear when using for some patients of sitting the wheelchair, thereby influence this type of patient to the problem of the use of registering machine of seeing a doctor.

title_en: Centrifugal oil pump assembly, pump body assembly and compressor
abstract_en: The invention provides a centrifugal oil pump assembly, a pump body assembly and a compressor, wherein the centrifugal oil pump assembly comprises an oil suction pipe, an oil guide sheet and a flow dividing structure, the oil guide sheet and the flow dividing structure are positioned in the oil suction pipe, lubricating oil can flow out through a first oil passage between the oil suction pipe and the flow dividing structure under the action of the oil guide sheet when the centrifugal oil pump assembly rotates at a speed lower than a first rotating speed, and the flow dividing structure can block part of the lubricating oil in the first oil passage when the centrifugal oil pump assembly rotates at a speed not lower than the first rotating speed. According to the invention, the oil pumping amount of the centrifugal oil pump assembly can be reduced when the compressor runs at a high frequency, so that the oil amount remained in the compressor is relatively sufficient, the internal parts of the compressor are fully lubricated, the abrasion of the internal parts of the compressor is reduced, the performance of the compressor is improved, meanwhile, the lubricating oil amount entering an external system is also reduced, and the performance of a corresponding system is improved.

title_en: Special high-strength towline system for ocean platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special high-strength towline system for an ocean platform, which comprises a fixed frame; the side wall of the fixing frame is connected with a drag chain group, the drag chain group comprises a plurality of main body frames, the main body frames are divided into two groups which are arranged in parallel, and two adjacent main body frames are connected through a fixing seat; the fixing seats are circular, the two fixing seats are connected through connecting columns, the surfaces of the fixing seats are provided with two semicircular turntables, through holes are formed in the turntables, riveting columns are arranged on the main body frame, and the riveting columns penetrate through the through holes in the turntables. The turned angle of drag chain passes through the carousel control in this device, and the carousel owing to link to each other with main body frame through the riveting, its turned angle is less to can effectually prevent because the stormy waves blows the big angle deformation condition in the twinkling of an eye that causes of hitting.

title_en: Vehicle-road cooperative edge sensing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle-road cooperative equipment, in particular to vehicle-road cooperative edge sensing equipment which comprises a base, wherein one side of the base is fixedly connected with a hollow upright post and a first motor, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first screw rod, the outer surface of the first screw rod is in threaded connection with a movable upright post, the top end of the movable upright post is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, one side of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with an installation plate, one side of the installation plate is fixedly connected with a second motor, and the output end of the second motor is fixedly connected with a second screw rod. The invention has the advantages that: through mobile station, perception equipment body, put thing groove, draw-in groove, mount pad, fixture block, locating hole, locating lever and positioning spring's cooperation setting for all comparatively simple and convenient to the installation of perception equipment body and dismantlement work, make the perception equipment body no longer is fixed connection's structure, has practiced thrift the time of installation and dismantlement perception equipment body.

title_en: Grease gun nozzle extension structure, grease gun and application method of extension structure of grease gun nozzle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grease gun nozzle extension structure and a grease gun thereof, wherein the grease gun nozzle extension structure comprises a shell, an electric cylinder and a grease storage gun barrel, the outer side of a piston head is sleeved with an upper group of sealing rings and a lower group of sealing rings, and the piston head extends into the grease storage gun barrel; the bottom of the grease storage gun barrel is inserted into the stepped hole, a lower connecting barrel is screwed outside the grease outlet at the top of the grease storage gun barrel, the top of the lower connecting barrel is connected with an upper connecting barrel, a positioning ring is arranged at the joint of the lower connecting barrel and the upper connecting barrel, and the positioning ring is clamped at the upper end of an open slot of the lifting seat; an internal thread cylinder is screwed on the outer side of the top of the upper connecting cylinder, a net-shaped filter disc is arranged in the internal thread cylinder, and the top of the internal thread cylinder is connected with an oil injection nozzle through an oil outlet pipe; the lifting seat is arranged, so that the mounting of the grease storage gun barrel with different heights can be met; through the arrangement of the mesh-shaped filter disc, impurities in the filter disc are filtered, so that the function of preventing butter blockage is achieved; the net-shaped filter disc is quickly disassembled, so that the net-shaped filter disc is convenient to replace or clean.

title_en: Projector adjusting device for ER50-6 welding wire steel production research and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a projector adjusting device for ER50-6 welding wire steel production research and a using method thereof, the projector adjusting device comprises an installation box, an electric telescopic rod, an arc-shaped ring, a driving assembly, a connecting frame, an installation frame and a clamping assembly, wherein one side of the top of the installation box is fixedly connected with the electric telescopic rod, the bottom end of the electric telescopic rod extends into the installation box and is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the projector adjusting device has a compact structure, is simple to operate and high in practicability, the driving assembly is matched with a rotating shaft and the arc-shaped ring for use, the projector can be driven to swing up and down, a second servo motor is matched with a third gear and a gear ring for use, the projector can be driven to rotate, the electric telescopic rod can adjust the height of the projector, thereby realizing multi-directional adjustment of the projector, greatly improving the flexibility of the use of equipment, the projectors of different specifications can be fixed through the clamping assembly, not only can improve the application range of equipment, make things convenient for the staff to carry out the dismouting moreover.

title_en: Gas supply system
abstract_en: The invention provides a gas supply system which can improve the detection accuracy of a pressure sensor and promote the weight and the cost reduction. In a gas supply system (10) according to an embodiment, a gas control ECU (22) performs an initial monitoring step of comparing 1 st detection information (I1) of a high pressure sensor (62) with a 1 st threshold value (T1), and performs 2 monitoring steps of comparing 2 nd detection information (I2) of a medium pressure sensor (64) with a 2 nd threshold value (T2) after determining that the 1 st detection information (I1) is equal to or less than the 1 st threshold value (T1). The gas control ECU (22) makes the valve opening period (To) and the valve closing period (Tc) of the injector (42) in the 2-time monitoring step longer than the valve opening period (To) and the valve closing period (Tc) of the injector (42) in the initial monitoring step.

title_en: Automatic assembling device for optical lens
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic assembling device for an optical lens, which comprises a shell feeding assembly, a shell loading assembly and a lens assembling mechanism, wherein the shell feeding assembly is used for placing a shell of an unassembled optical lens; the mirror feeding assembly is used for placing an optical mirror; the dispensing assembly is used for dispensing the shell placed on the shell feeding assembly; the lens taking assembly is used for placing the optical lens in the shell subjected to glue dispensing; the UV curing assembly is used for fixing the shell with the optical lens in a UV mode.

title_en: Mapping instrument positioning device for mapping engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mapping instrument positioning device for mapping engineering, which comprises a bearing box, wherein one side of the bearing box is provided with a rotating mechanism, the rotating mechanism is provided with a driving rod, and the driving rod is rotatably connected in the bearing box. The invention can rotate the whole gravity of the bearing box onto the supporting column, so that the surveying instrument can move the surveying instrument in a small range without moving the tripod in the surveying and mapping process, the surveying instrument is more convenient and faster in the surveying and mapping process, the stability and the safety of the surveying instrument can be improved, the surveying instrument can be positioned automatically after moving, the surveying instrument is more stable in the surveying and mapping process, and the surveying instrument can be automatically rotated and adjusted when the surveying and mapping direction of the surveying instrument is required to be changed, thereby effectively improving the convenience and the practicability of the surveying instrument, and ensuring that the surveying instrument is more convenient, rapid, stable and safe in the measuring process.

title_en: Data algorithm robot with panoramic shooting function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of inspection robots, in particular to a data algorithm robot with a panoramic camera function, which comprises a machine seat, a front camera mechanism and a camera rack, wherein the machine seat comprises a seat frame and moving wheels, the moving wheels are symmetrically arranged on the lower end surface of the seat frame, the moving wheels are rotatably connected with the seat frame, the front camera mechanism is arranged at the head of the seat frame, the front camera mechanism is rotatably connected with the seat frame, the camera rack is arranged on the upper end surface of the seat frame, and the camera rack is in sliding connection with the seat frame, so that a user can flexibly use the robot when needing to take pictures, can easily store the robot when not in use, can flexibly control the robot according to the need, can stably store the front camera mechanism and the camera rack when not in use, avoids being damaged in the process of carrying or placing, and can stably install an angle rack on the head of the seat frame, ensure that the user can stably install the connecting rotating rod through the side ring plate.

title_en: Transmission and engagement clutch
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission and an engagement clutch, which can further reduce impact and abnormal sound when the engagement clutch in a state of applying torque is disengaged. The transmission is characterized by comprising an engagement clutch (51) which engages one gear stage and is disengaged when the engagement is changed to the other gear stage through simultaneous engagement, a disengagement guide part provided on the tooth tops of one or the other engagement teeth (51 a, 25 a), a moving mechanism which generates an axial force for moving one rotating member (63) and releases the axial force through the generation of a sliding torque, an urging mechanism (1000) which urges the one rotating member (63) with a force smaller than the axial force generated by the moving mechanism so as to engage the engagement teeth (51 a, 25 a), an abutting body of the urging mechanism (1000) being disposed in a support hole formed in a torque transmission member (57) in the radial direction, and an urging conversion part which receives the abutting body urged in the radial direction by the urging function part (1000) and converts the urging force direction into the axial direction and urges the axial direction of the one rotating member (63).

title_en: Breathing device for clinical ophthalmic surgery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments and discloses a breathing device for ophthalmologic clinical operation, which comprises a base device, wherein an operating device is arranged on the upper side of the outer surface of the base device, the base device comprises a bottom plate, a wheel shaft is arranged on the lower side of the outer surface of the bottom plate, a device rod is arranged on the upper side of the outer surface of the bottom plate, a bearing is arranged at the upper end of the device rod, a supporting device is arranged on one side of the outer surface of the device rod, the supporting device comprises a device box, a threaded rod is arranged on one side of the outer surface of the device box, a threaded block is arranged at one end of the threaded rod, a shaft rod is arranged on the lower side of the outer surface of the threaded block, a movable rod is arranged at the lower end of the shaft rod, and a supporting plate is arranged on the lower side of the outer surface of the movable rod. This respiratory device is used in clinical operation of ophthalmology, when the left and right sides threaded rod rotates for the axostylus axostyle motion, and axostylus axostyle upper end position is unchangeable, thereby makes the axostylus axostyle lower extreme promote the movable rod downstream, thereby makes the backup pad downstream, when backup pad surface one side and ground contact, makes the device can be in the fixed use on ground.

title_en: DCT clutch pressure and gear shifting integrated control valve
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a DCT clutch pressure and gear shifting integrated control valve, which can reduce the number of electromagnetic valves used for clutch control and gear shifting control, thereby reducing the volume of a hydraulic control module and reducing the cost. The DCT clutch pressure and shift integrated control valve includes: the rotary motor, the valve body and the valve core are arranged in the rotary motor, the valve body is provided with a first cavity for the valve core to be slidably inserted, and the valve core can rotate relative to the valve body in the first cavity under the drive of the rotary motor.

title_en: Long-distance conveying natural gas valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valves, in particular to a long-distance natural gas conveying valve; comprises a first groove, a baffle, a second groove, a valve body, a support rod and a filter bag; when natural gas gets into an inslot, because a groove is trapezoidal setting, thereby make the lateral wall in a groove set up for the slope, when natural gas gets into an inslot portion, the lateral wall in natural gas and a groove contacts, thereby make the natural gas when a groove lateral wall flows, the natural gas gets into No. two grooves, get into the filter bag through No. two grooves afterwards inside, the natural gas flows the filter bag through the straining opening on the filter bag afterwards, the sand and dust that the natural gas carried stops in the inside of filter bag, thereby inside the sand and dust admission valve has been reduced, thereby the life of valve has been improved.

title_en: A lightweight support piece for aluminium system crane span structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge supports, and discloses a lightweight support for an aluminum bridge, which solves the problems that the existing bridge support cannot be adjusted in height and cannot be fixed after being supported, and comprises a boom assembly and a support assembly, wherein the lower end of the boom assembly is movably connected with the support assembly, the upper end of the boom assembly is embedded with a positioning assembly, and the boom assembly comprises a fixed plate; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the positioning assembly and the dial-down rod, the pressing frame drives the pressing plate to downwards press the bridge frame for fixing, and under the action of the spring, the bridge frame can be prevented from being firmly pressed and damaged while being pressed and fixed.

title_en: Protection device and protection method for building construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protective device and a protective method for building construction, belonging to the technical field of building construction, comprising a base, a protective column, a fixed protective rod, a support column, a top plate, a top protective component, an edge protective component, a containing box, an electric box and an adjustable protective door, wherein the adjustable protective door is convenient to move through the matched use of a safety plate, a protective door rod, a hydraulic box, a hydraulic cylinder, a hydraulic block and a placing plate, the protective door rod and the fixed protective rod are convenient to move up and down on the device, personnel are protected by the protective door rod and the fixed protective rod when working aloft, and through the matched use of a buffer plate, a bearing plate, a first elastic sheet, a second elastic sheet, a cushioning spring and a rubber layer, when working aloft, birds are prevented from being injured by falling objects at the high altitude, rain, sun and excrement can be shielded for the personnel, preventing it from influencing the mood of the staff.

title_en: Buried gas pipeline detection system based on Chirp signal and portable device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas pipeline position detection, in particular to a buried gas pipeline detection system based on a Chirp signal and a portable device. The device comprises a signal transmitting end and a signal receiving end; the signal transmitting terminal comprises a signal transmitting unit and a simulation receiving unit. According to the invention, a Chirp audio signal is used as a signal source to detect the position of the non-metal gas pipeline, the transmitted Chirp audio signal is subjected to analog receiving and judgment through the analog receiving simulation unit before detection so as to obtain the transmitted intensity of the Chirp audio signal, the received intensity of the Chirp audio signal is fed back to the analog receiving simulation unit through the signal receiving end, the analog receiving simulation unit judges the intensity of the signal, and the signal is amplified according to the judgment result, so that a user can remotely detect the gas pipeline and detect the gas pipeline with larger depth.

title_en: Double-acting self-unloading piston type oil cylinder
abstract_en: A double-acting self-unloading piston type oil cylinder is composed of a guide sleeve, a cylinder barrel, a piston assembly, a gasket, a back cap, a cylinder bottom, a valve core, a valve sleeve and a valve rod, and is characterized in that the cylinder barrel and the cylinder bottom are welded into a whole; the valve rod is arranged in the valve sleeve hole, then the valve core is riveted on the valve rod, and the valve core is arranged in the piston rod hole; the piston assembly is sleeved on the piston rod, the gasket is locked by the back cap and then is arranged in the cylinder barrel, and the gasket is tightly sealed by the guide sleeve; the right end of the piston rod is provided with an oil inlet groove, an oil inlet hole and a hole for installing a valve core, and is provided with an external thread; the right end of the cylinder of the valve rod is provided with a conical sealing surface, the round rod part is provided with 4 oil grooves, and the left end of the round rod part is riveted with a valve core; two ends of the valve sleeve are provided with taper holes for sealing; the back cap is provided with 2 oblique oil holes; pressure oil enters from a left end oil inlet and enters into a C hole through a B hole, the valve rod is pushed to move to the right to the conical surface on the valve rod to be matched with the conical hole on the valve sleeve to seal oil, the pressure oil pushes the piston to move to the right until the piston touches the cylinder bottom, at the moment, the valve core moves to the left, the pressure oil enters into the piston rod axial hole through the C cavity and 4 oil grooves on the valve rod to enter into the inclined hole on the back cap and flows out of an unloading port at the right end.

title_en: Friction-induced bistable buffer energy-absorbing unit and multistable buffer energy-absorbing structure
abstract_en: The application discloses bistable state buffering energy-absorbing unit, multistable buffering energy-absorbing structure of friction induction, bistable state buffering energy-absorbing unit includes: the three cylinders are rigid bodies, have the same diameter and length and are parallel to each other in axis; the elastic belt is sleeved outside the three cylinders, and provides certain pretightening force for the three cylinders, so that the three cylinders are kept close to each other and have a first stable state and a second stable state. According to the bistable buffering energy-absorbing unit with friction, the rigid component and the elastic component are combined, and the bistable buffering energy-absorbing unit with friction is designed by means of the internal friction of the structure, so that the bistable buffering energy-absorbing unit can realize a stable mechanical balance state no matter the unit is in a local minimum value or a local maximum value of elastic potential energy, the design domain of stable balance is expanded to a great extent due to the introduction of the internal friction, the plastic deformation of a cylinder or the buffering energy absorption is not needed to be damaged, the material damage of the cylinder is avoided, and the bistable buffering energy-absorbing unit can be repeatedly used.

title_en: School dining room is with bright kitchen light kitchen internet monitoring display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet monitoring and displaying device for a bright kitchen range used in a canteen of a school, which comprises a base, wherein a back plate is vertically and fixedly arranged on the upper part of the base, a mounting groove is formed in the upper part of one side of the back plate, a display screen group is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the mounting groove, a containing groove is formed in the bottom wall of the mounting groove, a cleaning mechanism is arranged in the containing groove, a rectangular groove is formed in the bottom of the base, third tooth columns are rotatably arranged at the four corners of the top wall in the rectangular groove, internal threads are formed in the third tooth columns along the inner walls of the third tooth columns, threaded columns are in threaded connection with the lower ends of the third tooth columns, universal wheels are arranged at the lower ends of the threaded columns, and a limiting assembly is arranged between the threaded columns and the base. According to the invention, after the four universal wheels are folded, the four supporting legs just extend out, and the four sides of the base form the auxiliary supporting frame, so that the supporting area is increased, the device is placed more stably, manual cleaning is not needed, and manpower is saved.

title_en: Transformer substation operation process violation management auxiliary system based on three dimensions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation operation process violation management auxiliary system based on three dimensions, relates to the technical field of violation management auxiliary device design, and solves the problem that parts are difficult to disassemble for maintenance and repair. The utility model provides a transformer substation operation process management auxiliary system violating regulations based on three-dimensional, includes the support column subassembly, the equal movable mounting in top of support column subassembly has the connecting column subassembly, the surface movable mounting of connecting column subassembly has movable ring subassembly, the surface movable mounting of activity ring subassembly has eight camera subassemblies, is close to the bottom the fixed surface of support column subassembly installs four sprags. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the arc limiting rod and the limiting disc, when the device is used, the arc limiting rod can move to one side when the camera rotates, so that the limiting disc moves in the inner groove of the shell, and the camera is prevented from colliding with an adjacent camera to be damaged when in work.

title_en: Display device is used in plastic products design
abstract_en: The invention relates to a display device for plastic product design, which comprises an installation base, a decorative layer, a lifting rod, a transparent frame body, an intelligent display screen and a double-layer display assembly, wherein the installation base is provided with a plurality of installation holes; the lifting rod arranged on the upper part of the mounting base can adjust the display height of the transparent frame body, the top of the lifting rod is fixedly connected with the bottom of the decorative layer, and the transparent frame body is placed on the top of the decorative layer; the bottom inside the transparent frame body is provided with a display bottom plate, and the display bottom plate is used for placing a plurality of double-layer display assemblies; the double-layer display assembly comprises an outer display frame connected with the display bottom plate in a clamping mode, the bottom of the outer display frame is arranged to be an opening structure, the inner layer display frame is connected with the inside of the opening structure in a sliding mode, and the bottom of the inner layer display frame is connected with the display bottom plate in a sliding mode. The invention has the advantages of space storage, stable display placement, firm fixation for placing displays with different formed structures, convenient use and stable protection when displaying the displays.

title_en: Fine processing screening installation of organic rice
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rice processing, in particular to organic rice fine-processing screening equipment which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a driving motor is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end face of the bottom plate, a first rotating shaft is fixedly sleeved on an output shaft of the driving motor, a screening equipment main body is arranged above the driving motor, the first rotating shaft penetrates through the screening equipment main body to the top end of the interior of the screening equipment main body and is movably connected with the first rotating shaft, a feeding hole is formed in the outer surface of the upper end of the screening equipment main body, and a first rice outlet and a second rice outlet are formed in the left side and the right side of the screening equipment main body respectively. The device structure not only can classify and screen the rice that does not screen, distinguishes complete rice and broken rice, improves the whole quality of rice, can also carry out effectual dehydration drying effect to the rice after the screening rice, makes the rice collect and store the storage easily, prevents to go mildy rotten, reduces economic loss.

title_en: Intelligent damping device and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent damping device and a control method thereof, wherein the intelligent damping device is fixed on a main body of a high-flexibility structure; the conducting mechanism is fixedly connected with the upper layer plate of the shell; an elastic member that generates a tensile force to the conductive mechanism; the measuring mechanism is used for measuring the absolute acceleration of the main body of the high-flexibility structure, the absolute acceleration of the conducting mechanism and the relative displacement of the elastic component; and the control mechanism is used for adjusting the damping force of the actuating mechanism through a fuzzy control algorithm, and reducing the vibration of the high-flexibility structural body through transferring the vibration energy of the high-flexibility structural body to the transmission mechanism. The intelligent damping device has clear functions among the elements, meets the performance requirements of different damping schemes, and is suitable for various high-flexibility structures such as wind towers, electrical equipment and the like; the fuzzy neural network is adopted in the control mechanism as a core to adjust the working performance of the execution mechanism, so that the intelligent damping device has reliable and stable performance under the input of different types of earthquake actions.

title_en: Water outlet control method and device of faucet and faucet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of taps, and provides a water outlet control method and a water outlet control device of a tap and the tap, wherein the tap comprises a rotary handle and an elastic piece for driving the handle to reset; the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the water faucet is in a water cut-off state, receiving a first input of a user for rotating a handle of the water faucet to a target direction, and resetting the handle after the handle reaches a target position; in response to the first input, the water outlet of the water faucet is controlled to discharge water, the method controls the water outlet of the water faucet to start and stop by rotating the handle to the target direction, automatic reset can be realized through the elastic part after the handle is rotated, the user does not need to perform handle reset operation, and the water taking process is more convenient and faster.

title_en: Adjustable pre-tightening hoop
abstract_en: The invention provides an adjustable pre-tightening hoop, which comprises a hoop main belt, a first mounting hole, a second mounting hole, an M-shaped elastic bow belt, a first auxiliary belt and a second auxiliary belt, wherein the hoop main belt is fixedly connected with the first mounting hole; the hoop main belt is of an annular belt-shaped structure comprising a notch, a first mounting hole is formed in one end of the hoop main belt, a second mounting hole is formed in the other end of the hoop main belt, and the first mounting hole and the second mounting hole are used for mounting an adjusting bolt; the elastic bow belt is positioned on the hoop main belt, the first auxiliary belt is used for forming a complete circular structure with the hoop main belt, and the second auxiliary belt is used for being connected with the inner side of the elastic bow belt; according to the invention, the inner diameter of the hoop can be adjusted and the pretightening force can be increased or decreased by screwing the bolt, so that the hoop can be matched with pipes with different outer diameters, the application range is wide, the main belt and the auxiliary belt of the hoop form a complete ring, no clamping blind area exists, the tightening effect is good, and the problem that the hoop is loosened can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Safety cut-off valve hydraulic control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic control system of a safety shut-off valve. The scheme comprises an energy accumulator, a first fireproof valve, a second fireproof valve, a valve closing control valve, a valve opening control valve, an oil way connected with the upper cavity of an execution oil cylinder, an oil way connected with the lower cavity of the execution oil cylinder and an oil return way connected with an oil tank; the valves are connected to form a valve opening oil path and a valve closing oil path. According to the invention, two fireproof relief valves are arranged in an oil way of a hydraulic system, and the fireproof valves are opened in the case of fire, so that the oil way is automatically communicated to realize the shutoff of the valves; the fireproof relief valve can automatically sense the ambient temperature when a fire disaster occurs, and the valve can be automatically turned off once the ambient temperature reaches the dangerous temperature no matter whether the accident site is electrified or powered off, so that the safety is very high. The system has an emergency shutdown function, and can recover the valve opening and closing functions by switching the oil way after emergency shutdown, and simultaneously can recover the fireproof function conveniently and rapidly.

title_en: Stop valve
abstract_en: The present invention provides a shut-off valve, comprising: the valve body is provided with a first flow passage and a second flow passage; the valve core is provided with an operating end and a plugging end, the valve core is movably arranged in the valve body so as to adjust the communication condition of the first flow channel and the second flow channel by utilizing the plugging end of the valve core, and the plugging end of the valve core is provided with a turbulent flow part. Through the technical scheme that this application provided, can solve the too big problem of noise of stop valve among the prior art.

title_en: Connection element and pipe connection comprising said connection element
abstract_en: A connection element (1) for establishing a pipe connection between the connection element (1) and a plastic pipe or a metal-plastic composite pipe, wherein the connection element (1) has at least one support body (2, 2 a) for sliding to a pipe end (14), which support body is provided with a plurality of circumferential outer ribs (3, 3a, 3b, 3 c), wherein the at least one support body (2, 2 a) has a central axis (4) and an open end (8), and at least two circumferential outer ribs (3, 3a, 3b, 3 c) are inclined at an acute angle (9, 9a, 9b, 9 c) relative to the central axis (4), wherein the acute angle (9, 9a, 9 b) of the circumferential outer ribs (3, 3a, 3 b) relative to the central axis (4) is different from the acute angle (9 a, 9 b) of at which at least one of the circumferential outer ribs is spaced apart from the circumferential outer ribs (3, 3a, 3 b) by an acute angle (3 a, 9 c) relative to the central axis (4).

title_en: Protection device is changed to oxygen bomb
