abstract_en: The invention discloses an oxygen bomb replacing and protecting device which comprises an oxygen bomb component, an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, wherein the air inlet pipe and the air outlet pipe are connected with the oxygen bomb component; the air exchange assembly is connected with the oxygen bomb assembly and comprises an air inlet box connected with the air inlet pipe and a liquid medium box connected with the air inlet pipe; the protection component is connected with the air outlet pipe and comprises a water storage area, a pressure release area connected with the water storage area, a valve core arranged in the pressure release area and a push rod connected with the valve core; the oxygen bomb replacing and protecting device can dilute harmful gas in the oxygen bomb, meanwhile, the harmful gas is absorbed by the liquid medium, the oxygen bomb is decompressed by the protecting device in the running process, the harmful gas can be prevented from overflowing in a seamless connection mode, meanwhile, the harmful gas can be discharged through the liquid medium, a human body is protected, and safety is improved.

title_en: Method for rapidly evaluating vibration damage and service life of high-low drainage pipeline of thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for rapidly evaluating the vibration damage and the service life of a high-low drainage pipeline of a thermal power plant, which comprises the following steps: determining a vibration fatigue weak part of the drainage pipeline according to the vibration form of the pipeline under the working condition of vibration of the drainage pipeline at high and low pressure; selecting a first measuring point on the vibration fatigue weak section, and selecting a second measuring point at a position which is L away from the first measuring point in the axial direction; when the pipeline vibrates, measuring the vibration frequency of the pipeline and the amplitudes of the first measuring point and the second measuring point, calculating the amplitude difference of the two measuring points, and simultaneously recording the duration of the operating condition causing the pipeline vibration; and calculating the damage of the pipeline, the accumulated damage of the pipeline and the residual vibration life of the pipeline. The evaluation is simple, convenient and quick, the measurement is accurate, the requirements of vibration damage and service life quick evaluation of the high-low drainage pipeline of the thermal power plant applied to practical engineering can be met, the occurrence of shutdown accidents caused by pipeline cracking leakage is effectively reduced, and the production safety factor is improved.

title_en: Parking mechanism and driving device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a parking mechanism and a driving device, wherein one mode of the parking mechanism comprises: a driven shaft rotatable about a central axis extending in a predetermined direction; a movable portion that moves in accordance with rotation of the driven shaft; a stopper member having a claw portion and moving in association with the movement of the movable portion; and a parking gear that is capable of meshing with the claw portion. The position of the stopper member is switched to a parking position where the pawl portion is engaged with the parking gear and a non-parking position where the pawl portion is away from the parking gear in association with movement of the movable portion. The portion of the driven shaft on the side opposite to the movable portion in the predetermined direction is connected to a drive source for rotating the driven shaft. The driven shaft has a first supported portion supported rotatably about a central axis. The first supported portion is located on the other side of the predetermined direction with respect to the movable portion.

title_en: Centrifugal pendulum device, rivet and torque transmission device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a centrifugal pendulum device for a torque transmission device, comprising a pendulum mass carrier that can be rotated about an axis of rotation and at least one multi-part pendulum mass that is arranged so as to be movable on the pendulum mass carrier, wherein the pendulum mass parts are connected by means of at least one riveted connection, the first pendulum mass part having a first axial outer surface, the second pendulum mass part having a second axial outer surface, the at least one riveted connection having a rivet head and a rivet stub, the rivet head being arranged at least almost completely axially inside the first outer surface and/or the rivet stub being arranged at least almost completely axially inside the second outer surface; a rivet for producing a riveted connection of pendulum mass parts of such a centrifugal pendulum device, wherein the rivet has a rivet head section and/or a rivet pier head section, the material of which is rich and which can be shaped to form an increased contact surface; and a torque transmission device for a drive train of a motor vehicle having such a centrifugal pendulum device.

title_en: Automatic air pressure balance type sealing ring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sealing rings, and particularly relates to an air pressure automatic balancing type sealing ring which comprises a sealing ring body and an air passage positioned on the sealing ring body, wherein the air passage is communicated with the inner side and the outer side of the sealing ring and is blocked by a liquid sealing part at one side of the sealing ring, the air passage is used for circulating air, and the liquid sealing part is used for sealing liquid and balancing air pressure. When the automatic air pressure balancing type sealing ring is used, the automatic air pressure balancing type sealing ring can play a role in sealing liquid, preventing the liquid in the container from being spilled outwards, and can play a role in balancing the pressure inside and outside the container, and preventing the pressure in the container from being too high or too low.

title_en: Oil way device and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil way device and a use method thereof, wherein the oil way device comprises: the pipeline group is respectively connected with a lubrication system of the gear box and the sliding bearing and is used for conveying lubricating oil in the lubrication system between an inner ring and an outer ring of the sliding bearing so as to form an oil film; the oil storage cavity is connected with the pipeline group and used for storing lubricating oil; and the energy accumulator is arranged in the oil storage cavity and used for storing and releasing energy so as to convey the lubricating oil in the oil storage cavity to a position between the inner ring and the outer ring of the sliding bearing when the lubricating system is abnormal. According to the invention, the energy accumulator can store energy when the lubrication system is normal and release energy when the lubrication system is abnormal, and the lubricating oil in the oil storage cavity can be conveyed between the inner ring and the outer ring of the sliding bearing through the pipeline group when the energy accumulator releases energy, so that the sliding bearing can be lubricated when the lubrication system is abnormal, and the reliability of the sliding bearing is improved.

title_en: Vibration system heat radiation structure
abstract_en: A vibration system heat dissipation structure comprises: one axle box with two driving wheels inside; a power motor, which is connected to one of the actuating wheels and drives the rotating shaft to rotate, characterized in that: the heat-removing system is provided with a circulating pipeline, a plurality of guide plates are connected with the circulating pipeline, and a plurality of flow guide spaces are formed; so far, the circulating pipeline is connected to the outer end of the axle box so as to be driven by a power source; therefore, the present disclosure relates to a vibration system heat dissipation structure, and more particularly, to a vibration device for a large machine, which can increase a heat dissipation area inside a lubricant tank to conduct heat out through a conduit, so as to maintain a stable temperature of the lubricant and improve work efficiency.

title_en: Building water supply and drainage leak-proof component
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building water supply and drainage leakage-proof component, which comprises a pipeline, wherein the outer surface of the pipeline is wrapped with a waterproof layer, one side of the waterproof layer, which is far away from the pipeline, is wrapped with a heat insulation layer, one side of the heat insulation layer, which is far away from the waterproof layer, is wrapped with a buffer layer, the waterproof layer is arranged, the pipeline can be isolated when leakage occurs, so that double sealing is formed, the pipeline can be insulated by arranging the heat insulation layer, the pipeline is prevented from being burst in cold weather, the pipeline can be effectively protected by arranging the buffer layer, the pipeline is prevented from being broken due to excessive extrusion, the external extrusion can be resisted by arranging a reinforcing layer, the pressure resistance of the pipeline is improved, the sun-proof capability of the pipeline can be improved by arranging the sun-proof layer, the structure has the advantage of improving the protection performance of the pipeline, and the problem of poor protection performance of the original pipeline is solved, thereby ensuring the normal operation of the water supply and drainage pipeline.

title_en: Building board secondary uses recovery unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a recovery device, in particular to a secondary use recovery device for building boards. The invention provides a building board secondary use recovery device which can remove cement on two sides of building boards with different thicknesses. The invention provides a secondary use recovery device for building boards, which comprises: the left side of the first fixing plate is provided with a guide frame; the guide frame is provided with a driving mechanism; and the driving mechanism is provided with a removing roller which can remove the cement on the surface of the building board and is used for driving the removing roller to rotate. Under the action of rotation of the removing roller and the auxiliary roller, the building board automatically moves leftwards, and meanwhile, cement on the building board can be quickly removed.

title_en: Equipotential locking static balance ball valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses an equipotential locking static balance ball valve which comprises a valve body, a valve core, a magnetic key and a pressure measuring hole, wherein the valve core is arranged in the middle in the valve body. Has the advantages that: through the pressure cell, the pressure-measuring pipe, the wide gear, the design of thin gear and magnetism key, make this valve can conveniently record the pressure differential of the inlet outlet end of valve and the aperture of valve when adjusting, thereby the pressure differential that has measured before the valve leaves the factory, flow, the corresponding relation table between the aperture three, the inside flow of valve is accurately learnt, thereby realize the accurate regulation of flow, the design through the case of VD type logical ball formula structure, increase the control interval of this valve, the resistance coefficient of valve has been reduced, make the valve be applicable to the pipe network system under the various different pressure difference operating modes, can make the heat consumer of pipe network near-end and the terminal heat consumer of pipe network in same pipe network system through adjusting, keep the uniformity of actual operation flow and design flow throughout.

title_en: Bonding structure for charging seat
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthing structure for a charging seat, which relates to the technical field of automobiles and comprises an earthing nut, a welding stud and an earthing terminal, wherein the earthing terminal is sleeved on the welding stud through an earthing hole, the welding stud is connected with the earthing nut through threads, a retaining snap ring is further arranged between the earthing nut and the welding stud, the welding stud is threaded with the earthing nut after penetrating through the retaining snap ring, the retaining snap ring is provided with a card which is in butt joint with a screw rod of the welding stud so as to prevent loosening of the earthing nut, and the retaining snap ring structure in the earthing nut deforms when being matched with the screw rod of the welding stud after tightening a connecting part, so that the central position of the retaining snap ring is deformed upwards, thereby clamping the external threads of the welding stud, limiting the relative displacement of the welding stud and the earthing nut, and ensuring that the retaining snap ring is not loosened with the earthing nut.

title_en: Clutch device
abstract_en: A clutch device for a hybrid module, comprising an electric machine and a couplable internal combustion engine, comprising a first, a second and a third sub-clutch (2, 3, 4), wherein the first sub-clutch (2) is used for switching on the internal combustion engine and the second and the third sub-clutches (3, 4) are used for distributing torque introduced via the internal combustion engine or the electric machine to different transmission stages of a downstream connected transmission, and a gear wheel (30) which is drivable via the electric machine and is arranged adjacent to a wall (36) of a transmission housing, is connected in a rotationally fixed manner to a rotor (27), which is coupled to all sub-clutches (2, 3, 4), and is supported at a housing bottom (34) of the transmission housing via a rolling bearing (31), wherein the housing wall (36) and the housing bottom (34) are a one-piece transmission housing part (32).

title_en: Socket structure pipe fitting with reinforced framework and welding mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bellmouth structure pipe fitting with a reinforced framework and a welding mode, and the bellmouth structure pipe fitting comprises a bellmouth structure pipe fitting body, wherein the bellmouth structure pipe fitting body is internally provided with the reinforced framework, one end of the bellmouth structure pipe fitting body is a bellmouth, the other end of the bellmouth structure pipe fitting body is a welding port, and a limiting stop piece is arranged in the welding port. The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline joint structures, in particular to a skeleton-reinforced socket structural pipe fitting and a welding mode.

title_en: Small loan monitoring device based on big data wind control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small loan monitoring device based on big data wind control, which comprises a substrate, wherein two sides of the top of the substrate are fixedly connected with supporting plates, a transmission mechanism is arranged in each supporting plate, the top of the substrate is movably connected with a network connector, a monitoring system is arranged in each network connector, and each monitoring system comprises a processor. The invention can monitor the borrower and the lending company by arranging the monitoring system, and prevents the interests of the borrower and the lending company from being infringed, thereby achieving the effect of ensuring the interests of the borrower and the lending company and solving the problem that the interests of the borrower and the lending company cannot be ensured by small loans.

title_en: Safety grating centering adjusting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety gratings, in particular to a safety grating centering adjusting device which comprises a light emitter main body and a receiver main body, wherein the light emitter main body and the receiver main body are provided with installation mechanisms; through the adjusting mechanism and the centering mechanism, the quick centering adjustment effect on the emission and the reception of the grating light source is conveniently realized; by the cleaning mechanism, the surfaces of the light emitter main body and the receptor main body are conveniently wiped and cleaned, and the influence on the sensitivity of the grating is avoided; through the connecting mechanism, the electric splicing part of the illuminator main body and the acceptor main body can be conveniently prevented from seepage and sealing, and water stains and waste residues are prevented from permeating.

title_en: Pile clamping force self-adaptive control device and static pile machine
abstract_en: A pile clamping force self-adaptive control device and a static pile machine comprise a pile clamping oil cylinder, a first pile pressing oil cylinder, a second pile pressing oil cylinder, a first oil port, a second oil port, a third oil port, a fifth oil path and a sixth oil path, wherein the first oil port is connected with a first cavity of the pile clamping oil cylinder through a first oil path, the second oil port is connected with a third cavity of the first pile pressing oil cylinder through a second oil path, the third oil port is connected with a fifth cavity of the second pile pressing oil cylinder through a third oil path, the fifth oil path and the sixth oil path are respectively provided with a first pressure reducing valve and a second pressure reducing valve, and the set pressures of the first pressure reducing valve and the second pressure reducing valve are sequentially increased. According to the pile clamping force self-adaptive control device and the static pile press, by arranging the pressure reducing valves with different pressure reducing values, the pile clamping force can be automatically increased along with the increase of the number of pile pressing oil cylinders participating in pile pressing, so that the pile clamping force self-adaptive pile pressing force is realized, the auxiliary working time is saved, slipping caused by too small pile clamping force is avoided, and pile clamping broken caused by too large pile clamping force is avoided.

title_en: Working valve block and forklift
abstract_en: The application relates to a working valve block and a forklift, wherein the working valve block comprises a valve body, the valve body is provided with an oil inlet channel, a working channel and an energy storage channel, the oil inlet channel is used for being communicated with a liquid pump of the forklift, the working channel is used for being communicated with an actuating mechanism of the forklift, the energy storage channel is used for being communicated with an energy storage device of the forklift, when the working channel is communicated with the oil inlet channel, pressure oil can enter the working channel from the oil inlet channel, and when the working channel is communicated with the energy storage channel, the pressure oil can enter the energy storage channel from the working channel so as to store kinetic energy of the pressure oil in the energy storage device of the forklift. The working valve block and the forklift provided by the application solve the problem that the existing forklift mast loses too much energy in the descending process.

title_en: Supporting rigidity adjustable GTF engine gear box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GTF engine gear box with adjustable supporting rigidity, belonging to the technical field of aircraft power; comprises a box body, an input shaft and an output shaft; the input shaft and the output shaft respectively penetrate through the upper box cover and the lower box cover and are transmitted in the box body through a gear mechanism; the gear mechanism comprises a sun gear, a star wheel combination device, an inner gear ring and an inner gear ring mounting disc, the sun gear is coaxially mounted at the inner end of the input shaft, and the inner gear ring is coaxially mounted on the end surface of the inner end of the output shaft through the inner gear ring mounting disc 8 and is coaxial with the sun gear 6; the star wheel combination devices are arranged between the sun wheel and the inner gear ring along the circumferential direction and are respectively meshed with the sun wheel and the inner gear ring; the lower box cover is provided with a rigidity adjusting device. The invention adopts the sectional planet wheel, thus solving the problem of uneven stress of the spline caused by manufacturing and mounting errors of the sectional sun wheel; the rigidity adjusting device can adjust the supporting rigidity of the annular gear of the Chinese character 'ren' and ensure that the annular gear always keeps the best supporting rigidity at different rotating speeds.

title_en: Low-energy-consumption air-flushing toilet system and toilet flushing control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-energy consumption air-flushing toilet system and a toilet flushing control method thereof, the system comprises a toilet unit, an air source unit and an air distribution unit, wherein a toilet negative pressure valve of a toilet drain outlet of the toilet unit is connected with a negative pressure pipeline through a negative pressure branch, an air storage cavity of the air source unit is respectively connected with a negative pressure pump and the negative pressure pipeline, a one-way valve is arranged on each connecting pipeline, the basic negative pressure of the air storage cavity is automatically maintained by means of the negative pressure pipeline, the negative pressure of the air storage cavity is increased to the required working negative pressure when needed, a toilet flushing controller detects and analyzes the negative pressure in the air source pipeline and the negative pressure branch which are communicated with the air storage cavity after a toilet flushing start signal is obtained, the corresponding negative pressure valve is opened for flushing the toilet when the toilet flushing conditions are met, and the toilet flushing is delayed until the toilet flushing conditions are met when any one of the negative pressure valve does not meet the toilet flushing conditions. The invention allows the negative pressure pipeline to maintain lower conveying negative pressure, and simultaneously provides higher working negative pressure for the negative pressure valve under the condition of not needing excessive energy consumption.

title_en: Low-noise road greening equipment and using method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a road greening of low noise uses equipment and application method thereof relates to road greening's technical field, and it is including setting up the steel stand on road both sides respectively, and the steel stand on every limit of road all is provided with many, and many the steel stand sets up along the length direction interval of road, adjacent two be provided with the screen board between the steel stand, the inside cavity that sets up of screen board, the direction of following screen board thickness sets gradually to plant groove, real empty room and plant the groove in the cavity, it is used for planting green planting to plant the groove. The application has the effects of noise reduction and greening.

title_en: Dish is detained support contactless elevation quick adjustment device with monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of constructional engineering, and particularly relates to a disc buckle support contactless elevation quick adjusting device with a monitoring system, which aims to solve the technical problems that automatic leveling is required to be manually carried out and automatic leveling cannot be carried out; can drive the inside side motion simultaneously of drive arc cooperation suit one and arc cooperation suit two through the transmission of cooperation arc pole and rack and pinion transmission group to make arc cooperation suit one and arc cooperation suit two detain the contact with the dish simultaneously, and the drive-disc is detained along the pole setting motion, and the motion of detaining through the dish drives adjusting part and height measuring instrument subassembly and carries out height control simultaneously.

title_en: Supporting component, transmission device and mobile device
abstract_en: The application provides a supporting component, a transmission device and mobile equipment, and belongs to the technical field of mobile platform transmission. The support assembly includes a rotating element, a support element, and a drive shaft. The rotating element comprises a rotating seat and a rotating sleeve which are fixedly connected; the roating seat is equipped with the first installation department that is used for being connected with the wheel. The supporting element comprises a supporting seat and a supporting sleeve which are fixedly connected; the supporting seat is provided with a second installation part used for being connected with the rack, and the supporting sleeve can be rotatably supported in the rotating sleeve. The transmission shaft is rotatably arranged in the supporting sleeve in a penetrating way; the first end of the transmission shaft can penetrate out of the supporting seat and is used for being in transmission connection with the driving assembly; the second end of transmission shaft can be fixed in the roating seat for to the roating seat transmission effort of rotating. It can effectively reduce the load of the output shaft.

title_en: Inertial container device with rod type structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inertial device with a rod type structure. The inertial container device comprises a box body, a track rod, a mass block, a sliding swing rod, a swing rod and an input rod; the top of the inner wall of the box body is provided with a fixed base, the top end of the swing rod is hinged with the fixed base, the bottom end of the swing rod is slidably connected with the top end of the sliding swing rod, and the bottom end of the sliding swing rod is hinged with the mass block; a guide groove is formed between the top end and the bottom end of the swing rod along the extending direction of the swing rod, an input channel is formed in the side wall of the box body and used for penetrating an input rod, and the input rod is connected with the swing rod through a hinge of the guide groove; the gauge block is provided with a circular channel penetrating through the body, the track rod penetrates through the circular channel along the direction parallel to the input rod, and two ends of the track rod penetrate out of the box body through small holes formed in the box body and are fixed, so that the mass block is fixed on the track rod inside the box body, and the freedom degree of the mass block is limited to be 1. The invention has simple structure and lower cost, and can reduce the requirement on the manufacturing precision and the working noise.

title_en: Monostable coupling system and torque transmission device for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: A coupling system (6) for a torque transmission device (10) of a motor vehicle comprises a sliding sleeve (63) intended to couple two engagement interfaces (61, 62) by translating parallel to an axis of rotation moving from a retracted position to a coupled position. An actuator (65) comprising a movable member (651) movable between a rest position and an activated position is linked to the sliding sleeve (63) by a rotary motion link (67) and by an elastic return member (66) which is fixed against rotation about the axis of rotation (100), the movable member (651) being able to drive the sliding sleeve (63) from the retracted position to the coupled position by the motion link (67) and being able to load the elastic return member (66) by moving from the rest position to the activated position, the elastic return member (66) being able to, when unloaded, return the movable member (651) from the activated position to the rest position and return the sliding sleeve (63) from the coupled position to the retracted position by the motion link (67).

title_en: Hinge assembly
abstract_en: A hinge comprises a base and at least one rotating shaft piece. The base is provided with at least one first axial concave-convex structure and at least one first radial concave-convex structure. At least one pivot piece is rotationally worn to locate the base, pivot piece has second axial concavo-convex structure to and the radial concavo-convex structure of second, wherein, first axial concavo-convex structure with second axial concavo-convex structure is followed the axial direction of pivot piece corresponds the cooperation, first radial concavo-convex structure with the radial concavo-convex structure of second is followed the radial direction of pivot piece corresponds the cooperation, in order to produce and prevent or force pivot piece for base pivoted torsion. Therefore, the variability of the torsion for preventing or forcing the rotating shaft piece to rotate relative to the base is increased, so that the hinge can meet the design requirements of various electronic products.

title_en: Single-phase earth fault traveling wave measuring device of distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traveling wave measuring equipment, and particularly relates to a traveling wave measuring device for a single-phase earth fault of a power distribution network. And then, theoretical bases and application conditions of various algorithms are analyzed, compared and discussed class by class, and the advantages of the various distance measurement algorithms and the existing problems are summarized on the basis, four groups of fixed blocks are fixedly connected to a bottom plate at intervals, two groups of first folding doors are transversely and rotatably connected to the four groups of fixed blocks, second folding doors matched with the first folding doors are longitudinally and rotatably connected to the four groups of fixed blocks, and locking devices matched with the first folding doors and the second folding doors are arranged on the four groups of fixed blocks and used for unlocking and locking the first folding doors and the second folding doors.

title_en: Sealing structure, shock absorber and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a sealing structure, a shock absorber and a vehicle, wherein the sealing structure comprises a framework, a first oil seal and a second oil seal which are supported on the framework, wherein the first oil seal and the second oil seal are respectively used for being attached to the outer surface of a part to be sealed and jointly limiting a pressure compensation cavity with the outer surface, the sealing structure also comprises a unidirectional pressure compensation channel used for communicating an external pressure source and the pressure compensation cavity, oil liquid of the pressure source flows into the pressure compensation cavity through the unidirectional pressure compensation channel, and the oil liquid presses the first oil seal and the second oil seal on the outer surface of the part to be sealed. According to the sealing structure disclosed by the invention, the common spring ring is replaced, and the reliable compression force can be provided through oil.

title_en: Wear-resistant plastic alloy applied at high and low temperatures and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wear-resistant plastic alloy applied at high and low temperatures, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of high polymer materials. The plastic alloy comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 16-20 parts of polyphenylene sulfide, 20.5-32.5 parts of nylon 66, 20-40 parts of basalt fiber, 5-8 parts of ethylene acrylate copolymer, 7-12 parts of molybdenum disulfide, 3-10 parts of calcium sulfate whisker, 0.7-1.5 parts of silane coupling agent, 1-2 parts of high-temperature lubricant and 0.5-1 part of antioxidant. The plastic alloy is obtained by compounding the plastic modification technology, and can reach various performance indexes required by plastic wear-resistant products used in high-low temperature resistant, high-strength and high-humidity environments.

title_en: Embedded high-strength stainless steel seamless steel pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded high-strength stainless steel seamless steel pipe, in particular to the technical field of seamless steel pipes, which comprises a stainless steel seamless steel pipe body, wherein a reinforcing component is embedded in the stainless steel seamless steel pipe body, and the reinforcing component comprises: the inner reinforcing pipe is embedded in the stainless steel seamless steel pipe body and used for supporting the stainless steel seamless steel pipe body; the number of the water-swelling water stop bars is three, and the water-swelling water stop bars are embedded in the stainless steel seamless steel tube body and are used for buffering fluid pressure to prevent leakage; the connecting insertion pipe is used for embedding two adjacent inner reinforcing pipes. The invention can support the stainless steel seamless steel pipe body from the inside, prevent the damage to the stainless steel seamless steel pipe body caused by fluid leakage, and integrally increase the strength of the stainless steel seamless steel pipe body.

title_en: Underwater oil and gas pipeline leakage detection and positioning method and control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a control system for detecting and positioning leakage of an underwater oil and gas pipeline, which comprises a signal acquisition module, a sound field modeling module and a signal processing module. The invention can effectively solve the technical problems of detection and positioning of the leakage of the underwater oil and gas pipeline, and has stronger practicability and higher positioning precision compared with the traditional detection method of the leakage of the pipeline.

title_en: Fixing base for mounting air storage tank based on rigid fixation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas storage tanks, in particular to a fixed base for mounting a gas storage tank based on rigid fixation. The automatic plate adjusting device comprises a bottom plate, a support and a fixing mechanism, wherein the support comprises two symmetrical bottom frames and two symmetrical movable frames, the lower ends of the movable frames slide in the bottom frames, the fixing mechanism comprises two symmetrical side frames, the outer walls of the side frames are connected with a rotary drum, the end parts of the rotary drum are rotatably arranged on the inner surfaces, close to the top, of the movable frames, the inner surfaces of the side frames are provided with two symmetrical grooves, adjusting plates are arranged in the grooves in a sliding mode, the end parts of the adjusting plates extend out of the grooves, and a clamping plate is arranged between the end parts of the two adjusting plates; adjusting screw rods are rotatably arranged in the slots, the four adjusting screw rods are respectively in threaded fit connection with the end portions of the four adjusting plates, and three meshed bevel gears are arranged between the end portions of the two adjusting screw rods in the same vertical direction. The dust collector clamps and fixes the air storage tanks with different sizes, and simultaneously conveniently drives the air storage tanks to overturn, thereby facilitating the subsequent uniform cleaning of dust on the outer walls of the air storage tanks.

title_en: Public regional computer display show fixed knot construct
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of display fixed structures, in particular to a public area computer display fixed structure which comprises a computer display body, a movable box, a height adjusting assembly and an angle adjusting assembly, wherein movable wheels are fixedly arranged on the periphery of the bottom of the movable box, a fixed box is fixedly arranged at the top of each movable wheel, and a movable block with one end extending to the outside of the fixed box is movably arranged in the fixed box; the height adjusting assembly comprises a mounting seat movably arranged at the bottom of the computer display body. This public regional computer display show fixed knot constructs, through setting up the altitude mixture control subassembly, when the height of computer display body needs to be adjusted, start the double-shaft motor and make it drive two screw thread blocks via the threaded rod and remove to one side relative or back of the body mutually, the connecting rod can jack-up promptly or put down the mount pad, can accomplish the regulation of computer display body height, makes the bandwagon effect better.

title_en: Centralized lubrication device with working condition identification function, loader and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centralized lubrication device with a working condition identification function, a loader and a control method thereof, wherein the centralized lubrication device comprises the following components: the control feedback circuit comprises a controller, a pressure sensor and a plurality of control wiring harnesses, and is used for judging working conditions according to the working pressure and the working period and automatically adjusting a lubrication mode; the lubrication pipeline comprises an electric plunger pump, a frame distributor, a movable arm distributor and a plurality of lubrication oil pipes, and is used for connecting all lubrication hinge points; the controller is connected with the electric plunger pump, the frame distributor and the pressure sensor respectively through control wiring harnesses, the electric plunger pump is connected with the frame distributor and the movable arm distributor respectively, the grease filter is installed at the oil filler of the electric plunger pump, and the frame distributor and the movable arm distributor are connected with the lubrication hinge point through the lubrication pipe respectively. The invention can automatically identify the working condition of the loader and automatically select the lubrication mode according to the actual working condition of the loader.

title_en: Brake suitable for slewing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brake suitable for a slewing mechanism, which comprises: the brake comprises a brake shell, a bearing, a coupler, a friction pair, a disc spring, an adjusting pad and a connecting disc; the stopper casing adopts two half arc structure fixed connection, and when the stopper casing assembled with other accessories: the brake device comprises a brake shell, a bearing, a coupling, a friction pair, a piston, a disc spring, an adjusting pad and a connecting disc, wherein the bearing is fixedly assembled in the brake shell, the coupling is inserted in the inner diameter of an inner ring of the bearing, the friction pair is meshed on the outer side surface of the coupling and is positioned on one end surface of the bearing, the piston is installed at one end of the friction pair, the disc spring is installed above the piston, the adjusting pad is arranged at the upper end of the disc spring, and the connecting disc is fixedly installed at one end, far away from the bearing, of the brake shell; the connecting disc is fixedly connected with the brake shell through a plurality of radially arranged bolts, and pretightening force is applied to the interior of the brake shell, so that the friction pair forms static friction force to brake the coupler; the brake shell is simple to machine, high in machining efficiency, simple in structure, compact in assembly, convenient to disassemble and high in reliability.

title_en: Heat treatment device for wafer
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a heat treatment apparatus for a wafer. Wherein, the heat treatment device of the wafer includes: cavity, tray, heating portion and pressure regulation pipeline. The cavity comprises a first opening; the tray is arranged in the cavity of the cavity, and the first end face of the tray is used for supporting the wafer; the heating part is connected with the cavity and used for heating the wafer; the pressure regulating pipeline comprises a vacuum pipe and a pump body, the vacuum pipe is arranged between the first opening and the pump body, a first valve, a vacuum gauge and a first pressure switch are arranged on the vacuum pipe, and the pump body is used for vacuumizing the cavity; the first valve is used for adjusting the pressure of the chamber according to the vacuum degree of the chamber detected by the vacuum gauge and the pressure of the chamber detected by the first pressure switch. According to this disclosed technique, carry out pressure regulation through the pressure regulation pipeline, can make and form the low pressure environment in the cavity, utilize heating portion to wafer radiant heating simultaneously, can effectively avoid the pattern effect, optimize wafer stress.

title_en: Double-cross arm suspension cross arm connecting device of mining dump truck and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross arm connecting device of a double-cross arm suspension of a mining dump truck, which comprises a seat sleeve, thrust bearings, a bushing, a pin shaft, a bolt and a pressing plate, wherein the end part of the seat sleeve is provided with a flange end face for rotationally connecting a truck frame, the two thrust bearings are respectively sleeved on the bushing and positioned at two ends, the two thrust bearings are respectively opposite to the flange end face and the pressing plate, the pin shaft is sleeved in the seat sleeve and the bushing, the pin shaft is axially provided with a through center hole at the center, the pressing plate is positioned at the outer side of the pin shaft, the center is provided with a pressing plate through hole, and the bolt is penetrated in the pressing plate through hole and the center hole. The invention also discloses a using method of the double-wishbone suspension wishbone connecting device of the mining dump truck. The invention can avoid abrasion of the cross arm caused by stress of the cross arm, effectively reduce the machining precision of the relative positions of the cross arm and the frame, and has reliable connection.

title_en: Simple high-frequency hydraulic vibration exciter
abstract_en: The invention provides a simple high-frequency hydraulic vibration exciter, which comprises a valve body, wherein a valve body through hole is arranged in the valve body, the valve body through hole is connected with a valve core in a sliding manner, two end faces of the valve body are respectively connected with a sealing end cover, a first pressure cavity and a second pressure cavity are respectively formed between the two sealing end covers and the valve core, one end of the valve core is fixedly connected with a shifting fork, and the shifting fork can reciprocate left and right to drive the valve core to rotate inside, so that the pressure intensity in the first pressure cavity and the second pressure cavity is changed, and the valve core reciprocates in the valve body through hole; the invention is small and portable, simple to install and convenient to disassemble, and can be used in various environments.

title_en: Power amplifier control method and device, magnetic suspension system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control device of a power amplifier, a magnetic suspension system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current of a main circuit of the electromagnetic bearing power amplifier detected by a bus current detection module, and recording the current as the bus current of the direct-current power supply; acquiring the current of the corresponding bearing coil of the electromagnetic bearing, which is detected by a coil current detection module at each bearing coil of the electromagnetic bearing, and recording the current as the coil current of each bearing coil of the electromagnetic bearing; and carrying out fault diagnosis on the electromagnetic bearing power amplifier, the n coil current detection modules and the bus current detection module according to the bus current of the direct-current power supply and the coil current of each bearing coil of the electromagnetic bearing. According to the scheme, the power amplifier is subjected to fault diagnosis according to the bus current and the coil current, so that the fault condition of the power amplifier can be determined in time, and the reliability of a magnetic suspension motor control system is improved.

title_en: Wifi camera based on face recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wifi camera based on face recognition, which comprises an L-shaped plate, wherein an electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the position, close to the left side, of the bottom of the L-shaped plate, the bottom end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, a chute is arranged at the position close to the right side of the top of the bottom plate, the inner cavity of the sliding chute is movably connected with two sliding blocks, the tops of the sliding blocks are fixedly connected with connecting blocks, the inner cavities of the connecting blocks are hinged with elastic plates, the right side of the L-shaped plate is provided with a limiting groove, and through the mutual matching of the structures such as the movable plate, the U-shaped plate, the movable plate, the swinging block and the like, can realize pulling the fixed column, the fixed column drives the fly leaf and removes, and the head of prisoner runs through the fly leaf, and the fly leaf carries on spacingly to prisoner's neck, places the chin inside the U template, and the weight of head drives the movable plate and removes, and the movable plate moves the elastic plate and compresses.

title_en: Rapid rush repair method for PE pipeline rupture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of PE pipe rush-repair, in particular to a quick rush-repair method for PE pipe breakage. S1, cutting off two ends of a broken part of a PE pipeline to obtain a near water end and a far water end which are opposite to each other in a pipe orifice; s2, freezing and plugging are carried out on the near water end on the PE pipe through a refrigeration technology; s3, cleaning the outer side surfaces of the near water end and the far water end of the PE pipe, and sleeving the heat shrinkage pipe on the PE pipe from the far water end; s4, overlapping the near water end and the far water end by using a pipe supplementing element; s5, winding a raw adhesive tape on the outer side of the pipe supplementing element, and coating the pipe supplementing element and a part of PE pipe positioned on the outer side of the end part of the pipe supplementing element; s6, sliding the heat shrinkage tube to enable the heat shrinkage tube to fully cover the pipe supplementing element, and then heating the heat shrinkage tube to enable the heat shrinkage tube to be tightly contracted on the PE tube; and S7, extruding and locking the pipe supplementing part on the PE pipe by using the PE pipe rush repair joint. The method is used for achieving the purpose of rapidly repairing the broken part of the PE pipeline.

title_en: Surveying instrument applicable to geological detection of different terrains
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surveying instruments, and discloses a surveying instrument applicable to geological detection of different terrains, which comprises a connecting disc and a surveying instrument on the connecting disc, wherein a supporting sleeve is further rotatably connected to the connecting disc, a sliding rod is slidably connected to the supporting sleeve, a taper rod is further mounted on the sliding rod, a supporting component is rotatably connected to the sliding rod and used for supporting the ground, the supporting component comprises a short shaft mounted on the sliding rod, a turnover plate is sleeved on the short shaft and used for abutting against the ground, a first adjusting groove is formed in the sliding rod, a second support is slidably connected to the inside of the first adjusting groove, and the second support is rotatably connected with the first support. The device supports the ground through the three turnover plates, and the stress condition of the sliding rod is greatly prolonged, so that the device has good supporting effect, cannot fall down easily, is convenient to install, and does not need to prolong the insertion of the conical rod into the deeper ground.

title_en: Visual positioning system for paper product processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of visual positioning equipment, and discloses a visual positioning system for paper product processing, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein wheels are fixedly connected at four corners of the lower surface of the cabinet body, push rods are fixedly connected at the middle parts of the left side and the right side of the cabinet body, a fixing mechanism is arranged below the cabinet body, an adjusting mechanism is arranged inside the cabinet body, the adjusting mechanism comprises a sliding groove, the sliding groove is arranged at the middle part of the top inside the cabinet body, a sliding block is arranged inside the sliding groove, and a fixing rod is fixedly connected at the bottom of the sliding block. This a visual positioning system for paper products processing, through the dead lever that the internal portion top of cabinet set up, sliding motion around the slider that the dead lever passes through the top can be carried out in the inside of spout, and the screw shaft carries out rotary motion at the middle part of U-shaped piece, and camera equipment can follow the screw shaft through the connecting rod and carry out screw thread rotary motion together to can reach the effect of adjusting the angle of the camera in the positioning device.

title_en: Switch control device, control method, fuel cell system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a switch control device, a control method, a fuel cell system and a vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of vehicles. The switch control device includes: the valve core is arranged on the fixed part of the plugging component, the valve core is provided with a first accommodating cavity penetrating through the valve core, and the action part of the plugging component is arranged in the first accommodating cavity in a sliding way; the valve seat is arranged on the valve core, an inlet flow passage and an outlet flow passage are arranged in the valve seat, and an air inlet of the inlet flow passage is communicated with a hydrogen loop of the fuel cell system; when the action part is positioned at the first position, the action part is abutted against the air outlet of the inlet flow passage to seal the inlet flow passage, and when the action part is positioned at the second position, the action part is separated from the air outlet of the inlet flow passage to open the inlet flow passage, so that the air outlet of the inlet flow passage is communicated with the air inlet of the outlet flow passage. The switch control device, the control method, the fuel cell system and the vehicle can integrate the switch and the release functions, thereby saving space and cost.

title_en: Thing networking security protection monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet of things security monitoring device, which belongs to the technical field of security monitoring and comprises a device main body, wherein the device main body consists of a lower mechanism, a middle mechanism, an installation mechanism, a monitoring camera and a top mechanism; the utility model discloses a monitoring camera, including fixed ring, bulge and connecting ring, the bulge is connected to the fixed ring, the bulge is connected to two semicircular middle part extension boards cooperation and is connected the swivel becket and use, it is spacing to connect the swivel becket to insert and utilize bulge and depressed part cooperation in the fixed ring of connection, and utilize gear and two semicircular outer ring gear cooperations to use, the motor during operation can drive the top extension board and rotate, and then drive the first rotation of surveillance camera, and utilize race cooperation gyro wheel two and articulated arm two and link on the top extension board to use, the surveillance camera can carry out the rotation when following the middle part extension board and carry out the revolution, cooperate a plurality of surveillance cameras to rotate all-round control operation, monitoring effect is good.

title_en: Coupling cap and quick coupling having the same
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are a coupling cap and a quick coupling having the same, which can improve coupling force and maintain a coupled state without a gap when the coupling cap is coupled with a male coupling, so as to more perfectly protect the coupling. The coupling cap includes: a cap body having one side that is open and has a receiving hole such that the male coupling is inserted into the cap body in an axial direction and the other side that is closed; a handle connected to the cap body so as to be rotatable in a radial direction as an axis; and a stopper linearly moved in a radial direction of the cap body by rotation of the handle, wherein the stopper is engaged to a coupling groove formed inwardly on an outer circumferential surface of the male coupling by rotation of the handle in a state where the male coupling is inserted into the cap body so as to lock the male coupling in an axial direction with respect to the cap body.

title_en: Hydraulic drive constant-pressure ball head pressurizing device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic drive constant-pressure ball head pressurizing device and a method thereof, and belongs to the field of rolling ball head pressurizing devices. The device comprises a movable cross beam module and a constant hydraulic system module, wherein the movable cross beam module comprises a movable cross beam and a processing ball head used for rolling contact with the lower end face of a sample, the movable cross beam is connected with the constant hydraulic system module capable of providing lifting force in the vertical direction, a piston rod of the constant hydraulic system module is of a stepped shaft-shaped structure, the cross section of a middle section is larger than that of a bottom section, the piston rod can slide in a sealing manner in the vertical direction under the limit of a piston sleeve and an end cover, an annular closed oil pressure action area is formed among the piston sleeve, the end cover, the bottom face of the middle section and the bottom section, and the oil pressure action area is communicated with an oil path system used for providing constant oil pressure. Under the action of the constant hydraulic system module, the hydraulic oil cylinder module applies loading force to the ball head, and constant load output by hydraulic loading ensures that the ball head does not jump under the condition of high-speed rolling processing.

title_en: Improved elevator guide rail and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved elevator guide rail and a processing technology thereof, and relates to the technical field of elevator guide rails. The elevator guide rail fixing device comprises a guide rail block, wherein a plurality of connecting holes are formed in the upper side and the lower side of the left surface of the guide rail block, extending openings are formed in the left side and the right side of the periphery of the inner walls of the connecting holes, sliding grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner walls of the extending openings, the inner walls of two corresponding sliding grooves are fixedly connected with chute blocks through one side surface of a sliding block, and threaded rods are connected to the inner walls of the chute blocks in a threaded manner.

title_en: Measuring device for earthquake disaster assessment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster assessment, in particular to a measuring device for earthquake disaster assessment, which comprises a measuring device and a fixed seat provided with the measuring device, wherein a connecting rail is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the measuring device, plug-in lock holes are formed at the end parts of the connecting rail, piston cavities are symmetrically formed at the lower sides of two ends of the fixed seat, matching holes are formed in the upper top surface of the piston cavities, a groove is formed in the middle position of the fixed seat, a guide inserted rod is welded in the groove, and when the measuring device is used, a movable sleeve block can be pressed downwards, so that a piston plate can be driven to move upwards to form negative pressure in the piston cavities to fix the fixed seat, the measuring device is not required to be held by a hand, and the measuring device is convenient to measure.

title_en: Working medium pressure acquisition and negative pressure protection device and method for negative pressure pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a working medium pressure acquisition and negative pressure protection device and method for a negative pressure pipeline, which comprises the following steps: the two ends of the sealing cover are sealed to form a sealing cavity; one end of the ball valve is hermetically communicated with the inside of the sealing cavity through a pipeline, and the other end of the ball valve is communicated with a vacuum generating device or a helium gas supply device; the vacuum electric connector is provided with signal pins and is hermetically communicated with the cavity; the vacuum connector comprises a pressure monitoring pipeline and a pressure detection mechanism, wherein the pressure detection mechanism is used for detecting a pressure signal, the pressure detection mechanism is newly connected with a pin signal on the vacuum electric connector, and the pin is used for outputting the pressure signal. The device and the method can be used for negative pressure protection at the connecting position of the helium low-temperature transmission pipeline and the pressure transmitter, and transmit a pressure signal to a control system.

title_en: Sealing structure
abstract_en: Provided is a seal structure which, in a planar seal, suppresses the seal member from overflowing when the seal member is pressurized, and which improves pressure resistance. A seal structure (100) is provided with a seal device (10) which is a planar seal that is disposed in an annular groove (15) provided in one of two members (11, 12) and seals an annular gap (S) between the two members (11, 12), and the seal device (10) is provided with: a sealing member (31) made of rubber-like elastic material and disposed on the high-pressure side; and a support ring (32) made of resin, which is adjacent to the sealing member (31) and is mounted on the low-pressure side of the sealing member (31), wherein the support ring (32) is an endless ring having a cut-out portion at one portion thereof, the cut-out portion extends parallel to the thickness direction of the support ring (32) and intersects the radial direction of the support ring (32), and the sealing member (31) and the support ring (32) are disposed between the two members (11, 12) in a state of being pressurized by the two members (11, 12).

title_en: Self-adaptive stop device for pin shaft and pin shaft installation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a pin shaft self-adaptive locking device and a pin shaft installation method, belonging to the technical field of pin shaft connection, wherein the pin shaft self-adaptive locking device comprises a main lug plate, a pin shaft, a limiting plate, a clamping baffle plate and a fixing screw; the main ear plate is provided with a main ear plate shaft hole and a main ear plate fixing hole; the two limiting plates are mutually parallel and symmetrically fixed at two sides of the main lug plate shaft hole and the main lug plate fixing hole; the pin shaft comprises a shaft lever and a connecting flange, a flange fixing hole is formed in the connecting flange, flange inclined planes are arranged on two sides of the connecting flange, the two flange inclined planes are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the shaft lever, the shaft lever penetrates through a main lug plate shaft hole, the connecting flange is tightly attached to a main lug plate, and a fixing screw penetrates through the flange fixing hole and the main lug plate fixing hole to connect the pin shaft and the main lug plate; the clamping and rotating baffle is a wedge-shaped plate, and the clamping and rotating baffle is inserted between the limiting plate and the connecting flange. The invention has self-compensation of clearance, realizes the self-adaptation of the installation position of the pin shaft and the reliable clamping and rotation of the pin shaft, and avoids the abrasion failure of the shaft hole of the main lug plate.

title_en: Shuttle formula goods shelves
abstract_en: The invention provides a shuttle type goods shelf, which relates to the technical field of goods shelves and comprises a goods shelf, wherein two sides of the inside of the goods shelf are welded with sliding rails, the inner wall of each sliding rail is connected with two pulleys in a sliding manner, the surfaces of the two pulleys are provided with connecting pieces, one ends of the two connecting pieces, which are close to each other, are fixedly connected with a vehicle body, a pallet is arranged above the vehicle body, one sides, which are far away from each other, of the two connecting pieces are provided with lubricating structures for lubricating the sliding rails, each lubricating structure comprises a material pipe for containing lubricating oil, a pipe plug, a dropper for titrating the lubricating oil, a clamping ball for smearing the lubricating oil and a node protrusion for spacing titration of the lubricating oil, the arc surface of the material pipe is in interference connection with a pipe plug, the arc surface of the lower end of the material pipe is communicated with the dropper, and the lower end of the dropper is conical. The invention solves the problems that the sliding rail of the goods shelf is not easy to lubricate and the goods shelf is required to be regularly maintained by operators.

title_en: High-efficient fuel sampling valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency fuel sampling valve which comprises a sampling pipeline, a first upright post, a first straight pipe, a first through hole, a first external thread, a second upright post, a limiting clamp, a second straight pipe, a second through hole, a first limiting ring, a second sealing ring, a second external thread, a U-shaped clamping plate, a limiting nut and an injector. The fuel oil pipeline media interception device is simple in structure and reasonable in design, and can be used for quantitatively and efficiently intercepting media in a fuel oil pipeline and avoiding excessive waste of fuel oil sampling.

title_en: Anti-interference type face recognition entrance guard device
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference type face recognition entrance guard device, which relates to the technical field of face recognition entrance guard and comprises a base, wherein a main body of the base is of a box body structure, the front side and the rear side of the base are of through structures, the left side and the right side of the base are all provided with through grooves in a linear array, the rear side of the base is clamped with a bottom plate, the problem that an existing entrance guard with face recognition is easily damaged by collision in the outside due to the lack of an effective protection structure is solved, atomized liquid is sprayed onto a central controller through an atomization hole formed in the right side of a supporting seat by a liquid supply box arranged in the supporting seat, and the surface of the central controller is subjected to rapid drying operation by synchronously starting a fan to spray air flow through an air shower groove formed in the outer side of the supporting seat, so that the service life of the central controller and parts of the central controller is prolonged.

title_en: Simple pressure-resistant water way valve diaphragm assembly structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simple pressure-resistant waterway valve diaphragm assembly structure, and relates to the technical field of waterway valve diaphragm assemblies. The diaphragm, the guide pillar and the water sealing boss sheath are assembled into a pressure resistant diaphragm assembly body; the diaphragm is provided with a water sealing boss extending downwards, and the center of the water sealing boss is provided with a pilot column fixing hole penetrating through the top and the bottom of the boss; the outer side surface of the water sealing boss is provided with a water sealing boss sheath fixing groove which is sunken towards the inner wall direction, and the diaphragm is used for fixing the water sealing boss sheath through the water sealing boss sheath fixing groove; a pilot hole penetrating through the top and the bottom of the pilot column is arranged in the middle of the pilot column; the side surface of the guide post is provided with a diaphragm fixing groove used for fixing the matched diaphragm, and the guide post is fixed in a guide post fixing hole of the diaphragm through the diaphragm fixing groove. The invention has strong compression and tensile resistance, is not easy to wear, has strong compression resistance and is not easy to deform, improves the stability of the diaphragm assembly in different water pressure environments, prolongs the service life of the diaphragm assembly, and has low production cost and wide application prospect.

title_en: Multi-air-path controller, massage armchair and transportation tool
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-air-path controller for a massage chair, which comprises a shell, a PCBA control board and an air valve assembly, wherein the air valve assembly comprises a plurality of connected electromagnetic air valves which are arranged on the shell in parallel, each connected electromagnetic air valve comprises an air inlet connected electromagnetic air valve used for being connected with an air pump and at least two air outlet connected electromagnetic air valves used for being inflated, each air inlet connected electromagnetic air valve and each air outlet connected electromagnetic air valve comprises an air inlet and an air outlet, the air inlet connected electromagnetic air valves and the air outlet connected electromagnetic air valves are suitable for controlling the opening and closing of the air outlets of the air inlet connected electromagnetic air valves through the PCBA control board, the air passage is integrated on the shell, each air passage comprises an air pump air inlet passage, an air valve air inlet passage and an air valve air outlet passage, and the PCBA control board is electrically connected with the connected electromagnetic valve group to control the circulation direction of air. Through this scheme, improved the holistic compact structure nature of pneumatic valve, and be convenient for management control. The invention also provides a massage armchair and a transportation tool.

title_en: Detection effect display device for wood microwave pretreatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection effect display device for wood microwave pretreatment, which relates to the field of wood, and aims to solve the problems that the height cannot be adjusted according to the height in the background technology, the detection result is inconvenient to publish, and meanwhile, the device cannot be lifted and lowered, so that the whole occupied space of the device is large, and the practicability is low. The device can be waterproof, can be buffered, improves the protection effect of the device, can adjust the height of the display board according to different heights, is convenient for pasting detection results, can reduce the occupied space of the device, and improves the practicability.

title_en: Hydraulic system with control strategy adapted to different load classes
abstract_en: A hydraulic system comprising: a hydraulic actuator; a command input element for inputting an operation command of the hydraulic actuator by an operator; a main pump that supplies working hydraulic oil to the hydraulic actuator; a main valve which controls the direction and pressure of the working hydraulic oil supplied from the main pump to the hydraulic actuator at the working valve position; a pilot valve that outputs a pilot pressure to the main valve to control an opening degree of the main valve; a load detection element that detects a load applied to the hydraulic actuator; a controller that determines a pilot pressure output from the pilot valve based on an operation command input from the command input element and a load detected by the load detection element, and thereby controls an opening degree of the main valve and a back pressure in the main valve such that: controlling the main valve pilot pressure within a range equal to or lower than the first pressure when the load is lower than or equal to the first load level; when the load is higher than the first load level, the control main valve pilot pressure is in a range equal to or lower than the second pressure.

title_en: Soil pH value detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil pH value detection, in particular to a soil pH value detection device which comprises a detector body, a protective frame fixedly arranged on one side of the detector body, and detection probes arranged at two ends of the inner side of the protective frame, wherein an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the detection probes is arranged on the inner side of the protective frame, the adjusting mechanism comprises a movable long block arranged on the inner side of the protective frame in a sliding manner, and a U-shaped clamping frame fixedly arranged at the bottom of the movable long block and connected with the protective frame in a sliding manner, and two ends of the inner side of the protective frame are provided with sliding long grooves. The soil pH value detection device is reasonable in structure, convenient and quick to store and operate, and beneficial to improving the safety of the detection probe when the detection device is stored, the service life of the soil pH value detection device is prolonged, the situation that the detection probe is difficult to store and protect by the detection device, the detection probe is damaged when being stored, and the normal use of the detection probe is influenced is effectively avoided, the application range of the detection device is expanded, and the detection device is more beneficial to detection personnel.

title_en: Motor anti-collision structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor anti-collision structure, which belongs to the technical field of fitness equipment and comprises a U-shaped bracket, wherein a fixed pipe is installed at the bottom of the inner side of the U-shaped bracket, the surface of the fixed pipe is connected with a sliding bracket in a sliding manner, and the two sides of the front surface of the top of the sliding bracket are hinged with fixed brackets; in the in-process of treadmill transportation, when the transport means appears the roll, make driving motor synchronous roll under inertial effect, driving motor can drive the fixed bolster roll, the fixed bolster drives the sliding support roll, the sliding support drives the carriage release lever and removes, the carriage release lever can compress respectively and tensile the damping spring who fixes the pipe inner chamber both sides when removing, cushion and the shock attenuation in the cooperation of damping spring and damping damper, the impact force of removing about having reduced the inside rotor of driving motor, the damage that the rotor led to the fact front end housing and bakelite end housing has been avoided, driving motor's life has been improved.

title_en: Electronic mechanical brake with active heat dissipation function and commercial vehicle comprising same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic mechanical brake with an active heat dissipation function and a commercial vehicle comprising the same, and relates to the technical field of electronic brakes; the brake body comprises a motor driving device and a top head, the motor driving device comprises a stator assembly, a rotor assembly and a rotating shaft, the rotor assembly is arranged on an inner ring of the stator assembly, the rotating shaft is fixed on the inner ring of the rotor assembly, and the top head is in threaded connection with one end of the rotating shaft; the heat dissipation device is arranged on the outer side of the stator assembly and comprises a gravity heat pipe, the gravity heat pipe is arranged on the outer ring of the stator assembly, and the heat pipe heat dissipation device is arranged above the gravity heat pipe. The commercial vehicle further comprises a vehicle body, wherein the wheels are provided with electronic mechanical brakes with active heat dissipation functions, the vehicle body is provided with a whole vehicle control unit and four brake control units, and the four brake control units are respectively electrically connected with the four electronic mechanical brakes with the active heat dissipation functions. The invention can realize the heat dissipation effect on the stator assembly.

title_en: Cylinder device
abstract_en: The cylinder device C1 of the present invention comprises a telescopic unit 1, a liquid storage tank 7, an actuator circuit A1 provided between a cylinder 2 of the telescopic unit 1 and the liquid storage tank 7, a shock absorber circuit D1 comprising an extension side passage 24, an extension side pressure reducing valve 25, a compression side discharge passage 26, a compression side pressure reducing valve 27, a suction passage 28 and a suction check valve 29, the extension side passage 24 communicating a rod side chamber 5 with a piston side chamber 6, the extension side pressure reducing valve 25 being provided in the extension side passage 24 and imparting resistance to the flow of liquid from the rod side chamber 5 to the piston side chamber 6, the compression side discharge passage 26 communicating the piston side chamber 6 with the liquid storage tank 7, the compression side pressure reducing valve 27 being provided in the compression side discharge passage 26 and imparting resistance to the flow of liquid from the piston side chamber 6 to the liquid storage tank 7, the suction passage 28 communicating the liquid storage tank 7 with the piston side chamber 6, the suction check valve 29 being provided in the suction passage 28 and allowing the liquid storage tank 7 to flow to the piston side chamber 6, and the liquid flow switching device 26 being capable of switching the liquid flow switching device.

title_en: Passive high-pass vibration isolation device based on mechanical-electrical analogy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passive high-pass vibration isolation device based on a force-electricity analogy. The device consists of a damper, an inertial container and other parts, and comprises the inertial container and the damper connected with the inertial container; one end of the inerter is connected with a vibration source, and the other end of the inerter is connected with a vibration isolator and a damper. The invention starts from mechanics-electricity analogy, is inspired by an electric high-pass filter, and connects the inerter-tube and the damper in series, thereby achieving the effect of isolating low-frequency vibration signals and reserving high-frequency vibration signals.

title_en: Push rod device
abstract_en: A push rod device comprises a rotating shaft, a driving motor and a telescopic assembly. The driving motor is connected with the rotating shaft and used for driving the rotating shaft to rotate. The telescopic component is movably arranged on the rotating shaft, and when the rotating shaft rotates, the telescopic component can move in a telescopic mode along the extending direction of the rotating shaft. The use is very convenient, and the structure is simple, the space required by the installation and the installation difficulty can be effectively saved.

title_en: Special deodorization sterilization equipment of refrigerator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deodorization and sterilization equipment, and discloses special deodorization and sterilization equipment for a refrigerator, which solves the problem that water vapor in the conventional refrigerator easily enters a USB jack; according to the invention, through the matching between the handle and the disc as well as between the movable rod and the sleeve, the movable plate can be moved, the spring is stretched, through the matching between the movable plate and the connecting rod as well as between the movable rod and the connecting block, the rubber block can be moved and rotated, and when the spring is reset, the rubber block can be positioned in the USB jack, so that the USB jack can be sealed, and the phenomenon that external impurities and water vapor enter the USB jack to influence the use of the USB jack can be avoided.

title_en: Synchronizer
abstract_en: The application relates to a synchronizer, including the joint ring gear, the joint ring gear has and is conical friction surface, friction surface department is equipped with leads to the oil groove, lead to the oil groove and run through the friction surface along the axial both ends of joint ring gear. The inner conical surface breaks an oil film after contacting with the friction surface, and the lubricating oil is discharged along the spiral groove at the inner conical surface and the oil through groove at the friction surface so as to improve the discharging efficiency of the lubricating oil and accelerate the synchronous rotation of the lock ring and the joint gear ring.
