Meanwhile, under the condition that the inner conical surface is separated from the friction surface, lubricating oil flows into the space between the inner conical surface and the friction surface along the spiral groove at the inner conical surface and the oil through groove at the friction surface to form an oil film.

title_en: Novel multi-station reversing valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel multi-station reversing valve which comprises a steering engine, a valve main body and an electromagnetic assembly, wherein the steering engine is connected with one end of the valve main body, the electromagnetic assembly is arranged at the other end of the valve main body, the valve main body comprises a valve body and a valve core, a main hole is formed in the axis of the valve body, P, T, A, B oil holes are formed in the radial direction of the valve body, two P oil holes are respectively formed in two sides of the middle section of the valve core, a P, A oil hole and a B, P oil hole are respectively formed in the two sides of the middle section of the valve core, a T oil hole is formed in the middle of the A, B oil hole, a crescent groove is formed in the inner wall of the main hole, the valve core is arranged in the main hole of the valve body and can move relatively in the main hole of the valve body, and a spring seat and a spring are arranged between the steering engine and the valve core. The invention symmetrically opens the invagination groove on the middle section of the valve core, realizes the on-off of the oil way by adjusting the relative positions of the invagination groove and the crescent groove, and realizes the switching of various working functions by the mutual matching of the valve core and the oil through holes of the valve main body.

title_en: Wireless network camera
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cameras.A containing groove is formed in the surface of a wireless network camera body, an insertion rod is inserted into the surface of the containing groove, and a limiting ball is arranged on the surface of the insertion rod and penetrates through the containing groove; the movable ball is arranged on the surface of the accommodating groove, a limiting hole is formed in the surface of the movable ball, and one end of the inserted rod is positioned in the limiting hole; the top supporting plate is sleeved on the surface of the wireless network camera body, a connecting plate is arranged on the surface of the top supporting plate, a rack is arranged on the surface of the connecting plate, and a positioning shaft is arranged on the surface of the wireless network camera body; the beneficial effects are that: the camera is in the middle of the process of adjustment, and under the effect of ball, the movable ball can not break away from accomodating the inslot, rotates the rack removal that the pull rod drove the top and holds the board surface, and two sets of tops are opposite direction along the locating lever and remove, and the spacing ball that holds the board surface in top leaves the spacing hole on movable ball surface, and the movable ball can move about, accomplishes the adjustment to the camera position.

title_en: Self-tapping locking screw
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-tapping locking screw, which is characterized in that a screw driving tool is connected with a clamping structure to drive a screw column body, so that the screw column body can be screwed into a workpiece to be fixed with the workpiece. Therefore, the self-tapping locking screw is simple in structure, convenient to achieve a threaded connection function and particularly suitable for workpieces which are large in wall thickness and not suitable for connection modes such as welding or riveting.

title_en: Flexible connection structure for connecting outer rotor motor and driven shaft and waterwheel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible connection structure for connecting an outer rotor motor and a driven shaft, which comprises the outer rotor motor and the driven shaft, wherein the outer rotor motor and the driven shaft are connected by a flexible connecting piece which allows the axial displacement and the radial displacement of a connection part. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the outer rotor motor is connected with the driven shaft through the flexible connecting piece which allows the connecting part to generate axial displacement and radial displacement, so that the vibration generated when the outer rotor motor works is prevented from being transmitted to the driven shaft, the abrasion of the driven shaft can be reduced, the driven shaft is prevented from being bent or broken, and the service life of the driven shaft is prolonged.

title_en: Alumina ceramic surface grinding machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alumina ceramic surface grinding machine, which relates to the technical field of alumina ceramic processing, and adopts the technical scheme that the surface grinding machine comprises a grinding machine body, wherein a driving mechanism, an installation mechanism, a dynamic and static pressure main shaft and a shaft sleeve are arranged in the grinding machine body, two ends of the shaft sleeve are respectively connected with a flange sealing cover through bolts, oil seals are respectively arranged at the axle centers of the two flange sealing covers, two ends of the dynamic and static pressure main shaft are arranged in a step shape, the dynamic and static pressure main shaft is arranged between the two oil seals, one end of the dynamic and static pressure main shaft is provided with a grinding wheel, the other end of the dynamic and static pressure main shaft is detachably arranged through the bolts and the installation mechanism, the dynamic and static pressure main shaft is connected with the driving mechanism through the installation mechanism, and the driving mechanism is used for driving the dynamic and static pressure main shaft to rotate to carry out grinding work. The invention has the advantages of convenient installation and disassembly, stable structure after installation, and no waste or pollution to working environment caused by lubricating oil during disassembly.

title_en: Neutral gear locking device for axle gear box
abstract_en: The invention provides a neutral gear locking device for an axle gear box, which belongs to the technical field of gear box control and comprises: the guide seat can be connected to an axle gear box of the screen scarifier; the extension rod is connected to the guide seat in a sliding mode, and one end of the extension rod can penetrate into the axle gear box and is connected with one end of a shifting fork rod in the axle gear box; the limiting mechanism is connected to the guide seat and can limit the extension rod to slide relative to the guide seat; operating device, operating device include flexible axle locking controller and flexible axle, and flexible axle locking controller can connect on the bogie of cleaning machine, and operating personnel only need operate on the bogie flexible axle locking controller just can lock or the unblock to the declutch shift lever, and operating personnel need not bore the bottom of cleaning machine and operate, has improved the security of operating personnel operation.

title_en: Using oversized threaded rods in locking oblong holes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for fixing a first part having a locking oblong hole to a second part, the method comprising passing a locking threaded rod through the locking oblong hole into the second part, wherein the locking threaded rod has an excessive width relative to the locking oblong hole, such that the locking threaded rod widens the locking oblong hole when passing through the locking oblong hole. The invention also relates to an arrangement obtainable using the method and to an installation kit that can be used to perform the method.

title_en: Fluid rectifying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluid rectifying device, which is arranged in an oil tank and forms a multi-section through flow channel in an oil return filter element and an oil absorption filter element; the fluid rectifying device comprises an oil return guide plate assembly, an oil suction guide plate assembly, an oil return flow channel, an oil suction flow channel, a middle rectifying channel and a front rectifying channel, wherein the oil return guide plate assembly is arranged outside an oil return filter element, the oil suction guide plate assembly is arranged outside the oil suction filter element, a through oil return flow channel is formed between the oil return guide plate assemblies, a through oil suction flow channel is formed between the oil suction guide plate assemblies, the oil return guide plate assembly and the oil suction guide plate assembly are provided with the middle rectifying channel and the front rectifying channel which are communicated with the oil return flow channel and the oil suction flow channel, and an S-shaped through flow cavity is formed inside an oil tank through the oil return flow channel, the front rectifying channel, the middle rectifying channel and the oil suction flow channel to buffer and filter fluid media of the oil tank, so that pollution of fluid media of a hydraulic system is reduced, and impact force is relieved.

title_en: Novel low-pressure methanol pipeline structure and process method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a novel low-pressure methanol pipeline structure and a process method. The novel low-pressure methanol pipeline structure comprises a common rail pipe and a supply pipe, wherein the common rail pipe comprises an inner layer pipeline and an outer layer pipeline, the two ends of the inner layer pipeline and the outer layer pipeline are fixedly sleeved through flanges, the inner layer pipeline comprises a first inner layer pipeline, an inner layer module and a second inner layer pipeline which are sequentially communicated, the inner layer module is provided with a connecting hole, the outer layer pipeline comprises an integral outer pipe and a two-half outer pipe which are communicated, the integral outer pipe coats the inner layer module, the integral outer pipe is provided with an outer pipe joint seat corresponding to the connecting hole of the inner layer module, the supply pipe comprises a third inner layer pipeline, a middle pipeline, an outer layer pipeline and a threaded joint, the end part of the third inner layer pipeline is exposed through the end part of the outer layer pipeline, at least part of the third inner layer pipeline is connected into the connecting hole to be communicated with the inner layer module, one end of the threaded joint is sleeved at the end part of the outer layer pipeline, the other end of the threaded joint is sleeved at the end part of the third inner layer pipeline through the two-half type clamping sleeve, and the outer pipe seat is sleeved at the end part of the threaded joint.

title_en: Centrifugal lift-off ratchet one-way clutch with rocker pocket
abstract_en: A one-way clutch, comprising: an outer race including a first outer race plate defining a first rocker pocket and a second outer race plate non-rotatably connected to the first outer race plate and defining a second rocker pocket; an inner race disposed axially between the first outer race plate and the second outer race plate; and a rocker assembly, the rocker assembly comprising: a rocker disposed to contact the inner race and including a first portion disposed in the first rocker pocket and a second portion disposed in the second rocker pocket; a spring guide retained by the first outer race plate and the second outer race plate; and a spring engaged with the spring guide and contacting the rocker.

title_en: Noise-reduction dry-type transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a noise-reducing dry-type transformer which comprises a fixed seat, wherein a plurality of universal wheels are installed on the lower side wall of the fixed seat, a supporting mechanism is arranged on the lower side wall of the fixed seat, a shell is fixedly connected to the upper side wall of the fixed seat, a door body is installed on the front wall of the shell, a plurality of heat dissipation holes are formed in the side walls of two sides of the shell, a transformer body is installed in the shell, heat dissipation mechanisms are arranged on the side walls of two sides of the transformer body, vertical buffer mechanisms are arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the transformer body, each vertical buffer mechanism comprises two vertical plates fixedly connected to the upper side of the inner wall of the shell, and a guide plate is fixedly connected to the side wall of one side, opposite to the two vertical plates. The invention can realize the fixation of the fixed seat and the whole position by the contact of the supporting plate and the ground, and simultaneously can play a role in buffering the transformer body, thereby greatly reducing the vibration amplitude of the transformer body and reducing the noise.

title_en: Camera and inertial sensor cooperative test equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a camera and inertial sensor cooperative test device, which comprises a rotating platform and a graphic card assembly, wherein the rotating platform comprises a first base, a first rotating assembly and a second rotating assembly, the first rotating assembly comprises a first supporting sheet and a first connecting part, the first rotating assembly rotates relative to the first base, the second rotating assembly comprises a second supporting sheet and a second connecting part, the second rotating assembly rotates relative to the first rotating assembly, a third motor is arranged on the second connecting part, and the output end of the third motor is connected with the second base; the graphic card assembly comprises a graphic card body. In the invention, a rotating platform makes a specific rotation angle and rotation speed, and compares the specific rotation angle and rotation speed with the rotation angle and rotation speed measured and calculated by an inertial sensor in VR equipment to detect the inertial sensor; and a camera in the VR equipment shoots an image of the graphic card body, compares the image with a real image of the graphic card body and detects the camera.

title_en: Speed reducer shell for fountain and processing equipment of speed reducer shell
abstract_en: The application relates to a speed reducer shell for a fountain and processing equipment of the speed reducer shell, and belongs to the technical field of speed reducers, the speed reducer shell comprises a shell body, the shell body is cast into a whole, a connecting hole, a mounting hole, a water diversion hole, a water inlet hole and a standby water hole are formed in the shell body, a motor is connected with the shell body through the connecting hole, the mounting hole is used for mounting a worm gear, water entering the shell body through the water inlet hole is sprayed out through the water diversion hole, the shell body is connected with a water inlet pipe through the water inlet hole, the standby water hole and the water inlet hole are coaxial and are respectively formed on two opposite sides of the axis of the water diversion hole, a connecting plate shell body is formed on the periphery of the outer walls of the connecting hole, the mounting hole, the water inlet hole and the standby water hole, and the shell body is cast into a whole, the self-assembling process of the shell body is reduced, each hole site can be directly formed, and the connection during the installation of a follow-up fountain can be facilitated; meanwhile, the water inlet hole and the standby water hole are integrally formed in the shell, and the assembling operation efficiency can be improved when the shell is assembled on a construction site.

title_en: Net rack for internal arc test
abstract_en: The application provides a rack for internal arc test, include: a test rack for internal arc testing; the lifting support is arranged on each of two opposite sides of the test net rack, and the lifting support can adjust the height of the test net rack; remove the wheel, it is a plurality of remove the wheel set up in test rack bottom is used for removing test rack. The application provides an experimental rack of using of inside electric arc can carry out the lift of high position through the lift support, when dropping test rack to the extreme low position, can make test rack remove through the removal wheel in test rack bottom, turn-ups test rack change test position. And can adjust the height of experimental rack according to experimental demand, reduce the preparation work load before the experiment, improve work efficiency.

title_en: Locking device and bearing device
abstract_en: The application relates to a locking device and a bearing device. The locking device comprises a fixed component and a moving component, wherein the fixed component comprises a base and a limiting component, the base extends along a first direction, the limiting component is arranged on the base, the moving component comprises a mounting seat and a rotating component arranged on the mounting seat, the mounting seat is arranged on the base and can move along the first direction relative to the base, the locking device comprises a first state and a second state, the rotating component can rotate around an axis of the rotating component for a first angle to enable the locking device to be in the first state, the rotating component can abut against the limiting component at the moment, the rotating component can rotate around the axis of the rotating component for a second angle to enable the locking device to be in the second state, the rotating component is separated from the limiting component at the moment, a gap is reserved between the rotating component and the limiting component, and the mounting seat and the base have the freedom degree along the first direction. The locking device improves the convenience of switching between the locking state and the unlocking state, and relieves the problem of high movement resistance of the locking device in the unlocking state.

title_en: Novel bearing with high bearing capacity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of bearings and discloses a novel bearing with high bearing capacity, which comprises an outer ring and a first magnetic absorption layer fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the outer ring, wherein the inner wall of the first magnetic absorption layer is connected with a cylindrical bearing in a sliding manner, the outer wall of the cylindrical bearing is fixedly provided with a second magnetic absorption layer, the inner wall of the cylindrical bearing is rotatably connected with a connecting column, the outer surface of the right side of the connecting column is rotatably connected with a protection ring, and the outer wall of the second magnetic absorption layer is connected with an inner ring in a sliding manner. According to the novel bearing with high bearing capacity, the outer ring is rotated, so that the inner cylindrical bearing is driven by the outer ring to rotate, meanwhile, the friction force between the inner cylindrical bearing and the outer cylindrical bearing is reduced through the principle that like poles repel each other between the first magnetic absorption layer and the second magnetic absorption layer, the original ball shape is changed, and the inner cylindrical bearing is replaced by the cylindrical bearing, so that the bearing capacity of the novel bearing is greatly enhanced while the contact area between the inner cylindrical bearing and the outer ring is increased.

title_en: Curved surface claw type coupling
abstract_en: The application discloses curved surface claw coupling, it is including first half-coupling, second half-coupling and elastic component, first half-coupling and second half-coupling are cylindricly, the terminal surface circumference equidistance evagination of the one end of first half-coupling has a plurality of first bosss, the terminal surface circumference equidistance evagination of the one end of second half-coupling has a plurality of second bosss, first half-coupling and second half-coupling coaxial coupling, adjacent first boss and the cooperation of second boss are formed with settles the cavity, the elastic component is along the radial demountable installation of first half-coupling in settling the cavity, the elastic component upwards laminates with first boss in the circumference of first half-coupling, and upwards laminate in the second boss in the circumference of second half-coupling. When the elastic element needs to be replaced after being worn, the elastic element only needs to be detached along the radial direction of the first half coupling, alignment operation is not needed, and the efficiency of replacing the elastic element is improved.

title_en: Self-adaptive tracking wire rod auxiliary moving system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wire rod auxiliary moving system and a method thereof with self-adaptive tracking; the animal positioning device comprises a real-time position calculation module for acquiring the real-time position of an animal in an ethology box body, a negative feedback motion control calculation module for calculating the relative position of a sliding table and the animal, and a sliding table motion control module for receiving the instruction of the negative feedback motion control calculation module so as to drive a wire holder to move to a specified position; the invention acquires the position of an animal in real time, and calculates the relative position of the sliding table and the animal, so that the sliding table with a wire welded thereon moves correspondingly with the real-time position of the animal, thereby solving the problem that the wired connection technology for recording and regulating and controlling the neural activity is incompatible with the animal freely moving in the ethological box body.

title_en: Sealing device
abstract_en: The sealing device is disposed between the inner member and the outer member which are relatively rotated. The sealing means includes a sealing lip slidably contacting the outer peripheral surface of the inner member and sealing the liquid in the inner space of the outer member. The seal lip has a liquid-side inclined surface, an atmospheric-side inclined surface, and a lip extending in the circumferential direction at a boundary between the liquid-side inclined surface and the atmospheric-side inclined surface. A plurality of spiral ribs are formed on the atmosphere side inclined surface and contact with the outer peripheral surface of the inner member, and the plurality of spiral ribs are inclined with respect to the lip and extend spirally. Each spiral rib has: a straight line portion having side walls parallel to each other; and a bottom shape portion that is curved to be wider than the side wall, the straight portion extending from the lip, the bottom shape portion being disposed farther from the lip than the straight portion. The height of each linear portion with respect to the atmosphere is 5 μm or more and 37 μm or less.

title_en: Wind turbine generator system base hoisting structure and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting structure and a lifting device for a wind turbine generator base, which belong to the technical field of lifting of wind turbine generator bases.

title_en: Novel non-impact noiseless check valve with damping buffer air chamber valve core
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel non-impact noiseless check valve with a damping buffer air chamber valve core. The valve core rod with the guide sleeve is inserted into the sleeve hole of the air chamber to form a damping buffer cavity with the closed volume changing along with the up-and-down movement of the valve core. When in operation, the valve core is flushed by the output gas, and the valve core reciprocates under the action of the pulsating gas flow; when the valve core is upward, the volume of the air chamber is reduced, the air is compressed, and is discharged from the fit clearance to block the valve core from upward movement, and the process is called compression damping; when the valve core descends, the volume of the air chamber is enlarged, air is sucked, the valve core is blocked from descending, and negative pressure damping is formed. The damping action of the buffer air chamber reduces the reciprocating motion amplitude of the valve core. When in operation, the valve core performs small-amplitude reciprocating pulsation in an open state, so that the valve core is not reset, and no impact and no noise are generated; the valve core is closed in time after the machine is stopped, the sealing performance is good, the service life is long, and the reliability is high. The method is favorable for the safe operation of the large-scale compressor and has good social and economic benefits.

title_en: Nitrogen supply system for multiple production lines and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrogen supply system for a plurality of production lines and a control method thereof, wherein the device comprises: the nitrogen supply systems of the two production lines are respectively communicated with the nitrogen supply pipelines of the corresponding production lines, a nitrogen lead-out pipeline is arranged on the nitrogen supply pipeline of the nitrogen supply system of each production line, and a switching device is arranged on the nitrogen lead-out pipeline; the nitrogen leading-out pipeline of each nitrogen internal supply pipeline is respectively communicated with the nitrogen supply pipelines of other production lines except for the two production lines in more than three production lines; the external nitrogen supply access pipeline is respectively communicated with the nitrogen supply pipeline of each production line; a pressure detection device and a regulating device are arranged in each of the nitrogen leading-out pipeline and the nitrogen supply pipeline. According to the scheme, two sets of liquid nitrogen tanks and gasifiers are used for supplying three production lines through the rearrangement and the debugging of pipelines of the nitrogen supply systems of the two production lines, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Four-beam eight-column mortise and tenon type crematory urn storage device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-beam eight-column mortise and tenon type crematory urn storage device which comprises a crematory urn cover, a crematory urn body and a crematory urn base. The crematory urn cover is provided with a sealing cover and an upper end beam, the inner wall of the upper end beam is connected with the outer wall of the sealing cover in a mortise-tenon mode, and a lower end beam is arranged below the upper end beam. The crematory urn body is provided with a side plate, a fixing column is arranged between the side plate and the side plate, a rectangular groove is arranged on the inner wall part of the upper end of the side plate, and a connecting block is arranged at the lower end of the fixing column. The cinerary casket base has the bottom plate, and the cinerary casket base still has first crossbeam, and first crossbeam upper end is equipped with the second crossbeam, and first crossbeam is connected with the bottom plate, and the upper surface of first crossbeam is equipped with a plurality of spread grooves, and the base is connected with first crossbeam. The multiple structures are tightly buckled to achieve tight sealing degree, and screws or additional bolts are not needed for fixing. Strengthen fixed connection, intensity is high between the structure for the structural rigidity is strong.

title_en: Rotary hollow glass production device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary hollow glass production device, which belongs to the field of hollow glass production and comprises a rotating arm rotating around a vertical axis, a rubberizing mechanism and an assembling mechanism, wherein the rubberizing mechanism and the assembling mechanism are arranged in an annular array along the rotating axis of the rotating arm, the tail end of the rotating arm is provided with a picking and placing mechanism, the picking and placing mechanism comprises a support and a clamping group, the support is connected with the rotating arm, the clamping group comprises clamping plates which are arranged transversely and oppositely, the distance between the two clamping plates is adjustable, the rubberizing mechanism comprises a workbench, the upper end of the workbench is provided with a movable seat, the upper end of the movable seat is provided with a sliding seat moving along the edge of a spacing frame, the sliding seat is provided with rubberizing parts at intervals along the vertical direction, and the moving direction of the sliding seat and the movable seat is vertical to a horizontal projection plane. The invention aims to provide a rotary hollow glass production device, which aims to improve the automation level of sizing and reduce the labor intensity of operators.

title_en: Underwater emergency electromechanical actuator
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electromechanical actuator, in particular to an underwater emergency electromechanical actuator, wherein a shell is connected with a buffer type sealing device, the buffer type sealing control device comprises a hydrophobic medium filled in the shell and a pressure control device arranged on the shell, and the pressure control device is arranged in such a way that when the hydrophobic medium is lost in the shell, the pressure control device drives the hydrophobic medium to be supplemented to the lost part, and as the shell is provided with a plurality of parts to be sealed, the sealing is usually realized by using a sealing ring, a sealing bearing, an oil seal and other structures, so that the leakage is difficult to judge specifically which part is leaked, the pressure of the hydrophobic medium at any sealing position can be simultaneously controlled through the buffer type sealing device, and the pressure of the hydrophobic medium can be supplemented in real time when the leakage occurs, thereby realizing the effect of dynamic sealing at any moment.

title_en: Balancer device
abstract_en: A balancer device (100) is provided with: a case (10) provided with a tubular body (11), and a front end plate (12) and a rear end plate (13) that close both ends of the body (11) in the axial direction (OL 1); a rod (20) which penetrates the front end plate (12) in the plate thickness direction and is supported so as to be movable along an axis (OL 1); a movable member (30) which is fixed to the lever (20) and is housed in the housing (10); a compression coil spring (40) disposed between the movable member (30) and the rear end plate (13); and a connecting member (50) that connects the lever (20) and the rear end plate (13) with a play larger than the stroke of the lever (20) in the upward direction of the shaft (OL 1).

title_en: Differential lubrication
abstract_en: The vehicle powertrain may include a differential assembly having a housing partially disposed in the lubrication reservoir. The differential assembly translates rotational movement of the pinion gear to a pair of axles extending from the housing and allows for different rotational speeds of the axles. One or more components of the differential assembly (e.g., one or more side gears) may include a plurality of radial grooves configured to distribute lubricant from the lubricant reservoir as the first side gear rotates.

title_en: Clamping type manipulator based on bolt processing
abstract_en: The application discloses a clamping type manipulator based on bolt processing, and particularly relates to the field of manipulators, which comprises an auxiliary clamping frame, wherein one side of the auxiliary clamping frame is hinged with a spherical connecting block, when a bolt clamping seat needs to be bent and adjusted to clamp the direction of the position of an auxiliary processing chassis, the spherical connecting block deflects through the auxiliary clamping frame, one end of the spherical connecting block is rotationally connected with the auxiliary connecting frame, one side of the spherical connecting block, which faces the auxiliary clamping frame, is fixedly connected with a motor, after a plurality of groups of bolts are adsorbed by an electromagnetic adsorption block, the clamping rotating frame moves upwards through the motor, the electromagnetic adsorption block drives the auxiliary processing chassis to be separated from a clamping connecting plate, and then the bolt clamping seat moves to the position of the next processing point along with the auxiliary processing chassis, so that a plurality of groups of large bolts are clamped conveniently to be transported to other processing points, and the processing efficiency of the bolts is improved.

title_en: Tractor radiator temperature control system and fan rotating speed control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a temperature control system of a tractor radiator and a fan rotating speed control method, wherein the temperature control system comprises a plurality of radiators and temperature sensors, a silicone oil clutch is connected between a fan and an engine, the rotating speed of the fan is controlled by a fan electric control unit, the combination rate of the silicone oil clutch is calculated by taking the outlet temperature of each radiator as a final control target, the upper limit is logically or controlled, the lower limit is logically and controlled, the middle value is logically controlled by a priority control strategy, the value is preferentially based on the inlet air temperature when the engine is partially loaded, the value is preferentially based on the water temperature when the engine is fully loaded, the unstable rotating speed phenomenon is avoided, the power consumption of the fan can be effectively reduced by the control of an ECU, the fan rotating speed can be operated at any working point, the severe fluctuation of the rotating speed of the fan can not be generated in the fan control, and the economical efficiency and the stability of the tractor are effectively improved.

title_en: Sealing anti-drop pressing ring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pipeline connecting fitting, in particular to a sealing anti-drop pressing ring, which comprises an anti-drop ring and a rubber ring, wherein a notch is formed between the head end and the tail end of the anti-drop ring, anti-drop lines or anti-drop teeth are arranged on the inner side wall of the anti-drop ring, the outer side wall of the anti-drop ring is provided with a first conical surface, the rubber ring comprises an upper ring body and a lower ring body, the outer side wall of the upper ring body is provided with a second conical surface, the inclination directions of the second conical surface and the first conical surface are the same, and the lower ring body is positioned at the small-diameter end of the first conical surface and is clung to the end surface corresponding to the anti-drop ring. Through with rubber ring cladding on the anticreep ring for sealing fitting and anticreep accessory in the pipeline joint can combine into one, helps reducing the cover and establishes the accessory quantity of the attach fitting on the pipeline, and only need once locking action just can realize sealedly and anticreep simultaneously, assembly efficiency is relatively higher, does not have the mutual interference problem simultaneously, and sealing and locking effect are relatively better.

title_en: Oval LNG gas cylinder
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oval LNG cylinder, which comprises an inner container and an outer container; reinforcing rings are respectively arranged at the top end and the bottom end of the inner wall of the outer container; reinforcing rings are respectively arranged at the top end and the bottom end of the outer wall of the inner container; the cross section of the reinforcing ring is triangular, semicircular or polygonal, and the number of sides of the polygonal is more than or equal to 5. According to the oval LNG gas cylinder provided by the invention, the stress concentration points on the surface of the gas cylinder are redistributed by adopting the reinforcing rings with specific shapes on the inner wall of the outer liner and the outer wall of the inner liner, so that the high stress concentration points of the gas cylinder body are avoided, the distribution of new stress in the use process can be optimized, the problem of local stress concentration in the use process is avoided, and meanwhile, the strength of the gas cylinder body is improved on site on the basis of realizing local thickening by adopting the specific design of the reinforcing rings.

title_en: Automatic transmission pressure filter blockage fault detection and treatment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting and processing blockage faults of a pressure filter of an automatic transmission, comprising the following steps: s1: calculating the blocking fault flag bit Fail of the pressure filter  filter  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S2: calculating pressure filter plugging failure trigger pressure P  b  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S3: based on pressure filter blocks up trouble zone Fail  filter  Clutch target pressure P  tgt_cl  And pressure filter plugging failure trigger pressure P  b  Calculating the main oil pressure lifting offset P  off_L  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S4: calculating a main oil pressure basic value P  base_L  According to the base value P of the main oil pressure  base_L  And a main oil pressure lift offset P  off_L  Calculating a main oil pressure command pressure P  demand_L  . The invention can detect and process the blockage fault of the pressure filter of the automatic transmission in real timeThe service life of the pressure filter is prolonged while protecting the transmission hardware and improving the driving comfort of the vehicle.

title_en: Sensor-based gas data detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sensor-based gas data detection method and a sensor-based gas data detection system, and relates to the field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: classifying pipelines in the target area based on pipeline layout lines and pipeline layout sequences to obtain multi-stage gas pipelines; configuring a plurality of sensors; outputting a plurality of integrated sensing modules; node detection is carried out according to the integrated sensing modules, and N data fusion results of each integrated sensing module are output; and inputting the N data fusion results into a pipeline state detection model, outputting N node state indexes of the multi-stage pipeline, performing pipeline switching decision analysis according to the N node state indexes, and outputting a first decision result. The technical problems that in the prior art, the state detection accuracy of the gas pipeline is not high, and then the state detection quality of the gas pipeline is not high are solved. The technical effects of improving the state detection accuracy of the gas pipeline, improving the state detection quality of the gas pipeline and the like are achieved.

title_en: Router control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a router control device, which belongs to the technical field of routers and comprises a router box body and a control frame, wherein the control frame comprises: a frame body; a moving wheel; pulling the pushing handle; a fixed module; the positioning buffer table is arranged at the middle position inside the control frame; a gas concentration sensor; the fire-fighting sand body is arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper part of the frame body. According to the router, the use environment of the router is detected and analyzed in real time through the gas concentration sensor, when the gas concentration reaches the warning state, the router is controlled to freely fall into the control frame for protection, and the router box body is subjected to heat insulation and fire prevention through fire control sand, so that the router box body is prevented from being damaged due to high temperature and nature in the control frame after underground explosion; the device is protected by triple buffering and damage prevention through the positioning buffer frame, the damping table, the buffer device table through the buffer pad and the buffer spring, and the positioning buffer table and the router box body.

title_en: Miniature electric locomotive servo driver with shockproof device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniature electric locomotive servo driver with a vibration-proof device, which belongs to the technical field of miniature servo drivers, wherein a first buffer cylinder assembly is hinged at the top of an upper top cover assembly close to a buffer plate assembly, a hook-type buffer frame is hinged at the top of the first buffer cylinder assembly, a second buffer cylinder assembly is hinged at the bottom edge of the hook-type buffer frame, and the other end of the second buffer cylinder assembly and the upper top cover assembly are connected with each other in a hinged manner.

title_en: Piston cylinder energy storage system with piston rod for discharging oil and pressurizing piston
abstract_en: The invention discloses a piston cylinder energy storage system with a piston rod for discharging oil and pressurizing the piston, which is characterized in that in the process of releasing energy, a first two-position three-way reversing valve is arranged, so that oil in a second inner cavity flows through the second two-position three-way reversing valve and is output to a hydraulic motor, the hydraulic motor drives a generator to work so as to generate electricity to feed back to a power grid, when the pressure of inert gas in the first inner cavity is reduced after the pressure is released for a certain period of time, the first two-position three-way reversing valve is reversed, so that the second inner cavity is in a pressure release state, the pressure of the inert gas is directly acted on the piston rod, and the pressure of the inert gas is correspondingly increased by only pushing the piston rod to move downwards, so that the output pressure of the inert gas is increased, and the energy release efficiency in the hydraulic energy storage technology is improved.

title_en: Valve body bottom sealing structure of butterfly-shaped water valve and butterfly-shaped water valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a valve body bottom sealing structure of a butterfly-shaped water valve, which comprises a valve body, wherein a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the valve body, a water valve matching part is arranged at the bottom of the valve body and is clung to the bottom plate, a plurality of corresponding flow holes are formed in the water valve matching part and the bottom plate, a sealing concave part is formed in one of the water valve matching part and the bottom plate on the opposite surface around the flow holes, a first sealing side wall is formed in the inner side of the sealing concave part around the flow holes, a sealing ring is clung to the outer side of the flow holes along the first sealing side wall, a sealing boss embedded into the sealing concave part is formed in the other one of the water valve matching part and the bottom plate, a radial sealing space is formed between a second sealing side wall of the sealing boss and the first sealing side wall, and the second sealing side wall and the first sealing side wall radially squeeze the sealing ring. The invention can solve the problems that the torque of the valve core is increased and internal leakage is easy to occur due to the adoption of axial sealing at the bottom of the existing electronic butterfly-shaped water valve.

title_en: One-key grid service terminal and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a one-key grid service terminal and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of power supply service, and comprising business hall public equipment, wherein the business hall public equipment is provided with a display screen, and the one-key grid service terminal further comprises: the storage tank is arranged on the business hall public equipment, the storage tank is slidably arranged in the storage tank, a keyboard is fixedly arranged in the storage tank, a storage barrel with an open top is fixedly arranged on the business hall public equipment, a microphone is arranged on the storage barrel, and a camera is arranged on the top of the business hall public equipment; the moving device is arranged in the storage groove and drives the keyboard to enter and exit the storage groove; the invention can rapidly realize one-to-one audio and video interaction of clients and one-to-one audio and video interaction of clients, rapidly solve the problems, and store and protect the keyboard and the microphone of the service terminal, effectively avoid pollution and damage of external impurities, and greatly prolong the service lives of the keyboard and the microphone.

title_en: Shape memory polymer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a shape memory polymer and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the shape memory polymer comprises the steps of taking polyethylene as a raw material, preparing a polyethylene plate through hot pressing, and performing programming to obtain the shape memory polymer, wherein the programming is that the polyethylene is heated for the first time, the polyethylene is uniformly stretched for 5-7 times under the action of external force, the stretching length is kept unchanged and is reduced to room temperature, the external force is removed, and the stretched sample strip is heated again and is reduced to room temperature, so that the shape memory polymer is obtained. The shape memory polymer prepared by the invention has better reversible strain capacity, can realize directional liquid delivery by applying the shape memory polymer to a liquid delivery device, can randomly control the liquid delivery effect of a switch, and is simple in installation and operation and beneficial to popularization and use.

title_en: Novel plane fixed wheel gate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel plane fixed wheel gate, and belongs to the technical field of gates. Including a plurality of walls that are located waters upper reaches and low reaches juncture, be provided with floodgate body and lifting beam between the adjacent wall body, be provided with a plurality of fixed pulleys through a plurality of fixed axles on the floodgate body lateral wall, wall body inner wall department is provided with and is used for the gliding track of floodgate body, and lifting beam installs at the top and is used for driving the gliding hoist of floodgate body, still includes: the supporting mechanism is arranged inside the wall body and comprises supporting pins sliding in the wall body, supporting grooves are formed in the bottoms of two sides of the gate body, and the driving mechanism is used for driving the supporting pins to slide by rotating water wheels between adjacent wall bodies, wherein the water wheels are located on one side, close to the downstream, of the gate body. According to the invention, the brake body is limited after the support pin is clamped into the support groove, so that the brake body is not easy to shake, the positioning between the fixed wheel and the track is not easy to generate errors, and the sealing effect of the brake body is ensured.

title_en: Flywheel assembly and flywheel thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flywheel assembly and a flywheel thereof, wherein the flywheel assembly comprises a flywheel and an internal magnetic control device. The flywheel comprises a flywheel body and a conductor, wherein a wheel ring of the flywheel body integrally extends from the edge of the wheel disc to the side part of the wheel disc so as to form a flywheel space of the flywheel body between the wheel disc and the wheel ring, an air flow channel of the flywheel body is arranged on the wheel disc and is communicated with the flywheel space and the outside, the conductor is arranged on the inner wall of the wheel ring, the inner magnetic control device comprises a shell, a magnetizer movably arranged on the shell and a magnetic element arranged on the magnetizer, wherein the inner magnetic control device is arranged in the flywheel space of the flywheel body in a manner that the magnetic element is arranged between the magnetizer and the conductor, and the flywheel is configured to generate rotation relative to the inner magnetic control device.

title_en: Electronic gear shifter gear character background light display control method, electronic gear shifter and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method for displaying background light of gear characters of an electronic gear shifter, the electronic gear shifter and a vehicle, which CAN be compatible with 3 types of background light illumination input signals of ILL+hard wire signals, PWM hard wire signals and CAN signals at the same time, and realize the brightness adjusting function of the whole vehicle under different background light brightness requirements at the same time; meanwhile, the universality of the electronic gear shifter backlight illumination module and the corresponding whole vehicle wire harness interface is realized, the management cost and the development cost are reduced, and the development efficiency is improved. The method comprises the following steps: periodically acquiring a hard wire signal and/or a CAN signal for representing the background light opening and closing requirements of gear characters; and carrying out the opening and closing control of the background light of the gear character of the electronic gear and the adjustment control of the background light brightness level of the gear character of the electronic gear based on the obtained hard wire signal and/or CAN signal.

title_en: Power transmission device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a power transmission device capable of transmitting torque of a driving vehicle in a cut-off manner, comprising: a rotating body that receives the torque and is rotatable about an axis; a clutch that is engaged with the rotating body and includes a clutch member that is movable in an axial direction and a clutch tooth that is coupled to the clutch member and is capable of transmitting the torque; a solenoid that generates magnetic flux in response to input of electric power; a stator coupled to the solenoid in such a manner as to guide the magnetic flux, and being stopped around the shaft; a rotor which is disposed so as to receive the magnetic flux from the stator and generates a rotational motion around the shaft by the received magnetic flux; and a conversion mechanism that is drivingly coupled to the rotor, converts the rotational motion into a linear motion in a direction along the shaft, and includes a thrust member that transmits the linear motion to the clutch member.

title_en: Mapping device suitable for many topography
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surveying instrument brackets, in particular to a surveying device suitable for multiple terrains, which comprises a bottom plate and a top plate which are arranged at intervals, wherein four corners of the bottom plate and the top plate are jointly provided with a rotating seat, the outer end of the rotating seat is rotatably provided with a supporting rod, the outer end of the supporting rod is provided with an extension rod in a threaded manner, the upper side and the lower side of the tail end of the extension rod are respectively provided with an upper claw and a lower claw, and the ends of the upper claw and the lower claw, which are close to the extension rod, are provided with bending grooves; the upper clamping jaw and the lower clamping jaw are in a cone rod shape, the upper end of the top plate is provided with a mounting box, the upper end of the mounting box is provided with a bracket, and the bracket is provided with a surveying and mapping instrument body. This device reasonable in design, the effectual topography that is in the difference all can make surveying instrument accomplish the purpose of steadily placing, and easy operation is convenient, can also accomplish effectively fixedly after steadily placing, has promoted the stability of surveying instrument in the use greatly, does benefit to going on of survey and drawing.

title_en: Gearbox integrated valve
abstract_en: The valve body is internally provided with a valve core cavity, the first air inlet is communicated with the valve core cavity through a first channel, and the first air outlet is communicated with the valve core cavity through a second channel; the second air outlet is communicated with the valve core cavity through a third channel, the right side of the valve core cavity is provided with a second air inlet, a valve core assembly is arranged in the valve core cavity, a reset spring is arranged between the left side of the valve core assembly and the left side wall of the valve core cavity, a pipe sleeve and a bushing assembly are sleeved outside the valve core assembly in sequence, and the valve core assembly is switched between the first air outlet and the second air outlet through the cooperation of the second air inlet and the reset spring on the pipe sleeve and the bushing assembly. The advantages are that: machining a single valve body; the assembly is simple, parts are few, and the assembly efficiency is high; the cost is reduced; the switching force is as low as 50% of the original switching force.

title_en: High-pressure oil pipe joint connection structure and use method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-pressure oil pipe joint connection structure and a use method thereof, the structure is formed by connecting an oil nozzle component and an oil pipe component, the oil nozzle component comprises a connection seat and a sleeve, the sleeve is arranged at the lower part of the connection seat, the sleeve and the lower part of the connection seat form an oil pipe component connection cavity, two sides of the cross section of the connection seat are respectively in a symmetrical three-layer reverse-ladder shape, an oil path channel penetrating through the connection seat is arranged in the connection seat, the oil path channel is formed by connecting a first straight part, an annular part, a second straight part and a conical part, the oil pipe component comprises a pipe joint nut, a joint and a connecting pipe, the pipe joint nut is in an inverted T shape, a groove matched with the bottom of the connection seat is arranged at the upper part of the pipe joint nut, the joint is arranged in the groove, a second conical surface matched with the conical part is arranged at the top of the joint, an interface penetrating the joint is arranged in the joint, the connecting pipe is installed at the bottom of the pipe joint nut in a penetrating way, and the joint is communicated with the interface. The structure can effectively reduce the gap between the joint and the connecting seat, avoid oil pressure leakage, and has simple structure and convenient use.

title_en: Coupling mechanism and anchor rod installation equipment with prestressing force is applyed and detection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of anchor rod installation, and aims to solve the problem that the prestress of an anchor rod cannot be detected during anchor rod installation. The invention comprises a connecting mechanism and anchor rod installation equipment with a prestress application and detection function. The connecting mechanism is arranged on the anchor rod installation equipment and comprises a connecting rod (32), a sliding sleeve (33) and a pushing spring (34), wherein an embedded nut (323) and a buffer spring (324) are arranged in a sliding inner hole at the front end of the connecting rod, and the embedded nut can be in threaded connection with an anchor rod body; the nut seat at the front end of the sliding sleeve can be embedded with the anchor rod nut; the sliding sleeve is sleeved on the outer side of the connecting rod, can slide relative to the connecting rod in the axial direction, and compresses the propelling spring at the rear side. Therefore, the embedded nut can be screwed on the anchor rod body, the anchor rod body is pulled to detect the prestress, then the embedded nut is separated from the anchor rod body, and the anchor rod nut is screwed by the nut seat to tightly press the baffle plate on the rock wall.

title_en: Low-temperature-resistant high-performance composite flexible pipe and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of oil delivery pipes, and particularly discloses a low-temperature-resistant high-performance composite flexible pipe and a preparation method thereof. The low-temperature-resistant high-performance composite flexible pipe comprises an inner liner layer, a reinforcing layer and a protective layer, wherein the reinforcing layer is coated on the outer side of the inner liner layer, and the protective layer is coated on the outer side of the reinforcing layer; the reinforcing layer consists of reinforcing filaments; the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, extruding and forming high-density polyethylene resin particles to obtain an inner liner; s2, uniformly winding the reinforcing wires along the outer wall of the inner liner layer to form a reinforcing layer; and S3, extruding the low-temperature modified polyethylene resin to obtain a protective layer, and coating the protective layer on the surface of the reinforcing layer to obtain the low-temperature-resistant high-performance composite flexible pipe. The low-temperature-resistant high-performance composite flexible pipe can be used for collecting and conveying oil on the ground in high-altitude areas, and has the advantage of excellent mechanical properties in low-temperature environments.

title_en: Wet dual clutch transmission control method, device, apparatus and readable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wet type double clutch transmission control method, a device, equipment and a readable medium. Determining whether a running gear of a wet dual clutch transmission of a target vehicle meets a preset control condition when a FASTOFF function of the target vehicle is in an activated state; when the driving gear meets the control condition, determining a current speed threshold value of the target vehicle; and controlling the driving gear according to the current vehicle speed threshold and the current vehicle speed of the target vehicle. According to the scheme, when the FASTOFF function is activated by the vehicle, the control information of the driving gear can be comprehensively judged according to the driving gear of the gearbox and the current vehicle speed, so that the problem of forced control of the driving gear when the FASTOFF function is activated at present is solved, and flexible control of the driving gear is realized.

title_en: Combined shaft and cutting part with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined shaft and a cutting part with the same, wherein the combined shaft comprises a shaft body, a sleeve body and a first connecting piece, at least one end of the shaft body is provided with a conical surface section, the inner cavity of the sleeve body is provided with a conical hole section, the conical hole section is the same as the conical degree of the conical surface section, the conical surface section of the shaft body is arranged in the conical hole section, and the first connecting piece is arranged between the shaft body and the sleeve body and is used for connecting the shaft body and the sleeve body and driving the sleeve body to move on the shaft body along the axial direction of the shaft body so as to enlarge the outer diameter size of the sleeve body. The combined shaft disclosed by the invention can change the assembly mode between the combined shaft and the shell, and reduce the abrasion degree between the combined shaft and the shell of the cutting part.

title_en: Hemispherical valve with sealing structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hemispherical valve with a sealing structure, and relates to the technical field of ball valves. The loading unit comprises a left half valve body, a right half valve body, a fixed rod, a sealing ring, a sealing port and a medium flow passage, the clamping unit comprises a fixed plate, a clamping plate, a threaded rod, a threaded sleeve and a sealing plate, and the driving unit comprises a rotary disc, a rotary shaft and a torsion valve. The sealing ring is positioned at one side of the sealing opening. According to the invention, the hemispherical valve is sealed more tightly by utilizing the left half valve body, the right half valve body, the fixed rod, the sealing ring, the sealing port, the medium flow channel, the fixed plate, the clamping plate, the threaded rod, the threaded sleeve and the sealing plate for use in a matching way, so that the sealing capability of the hemispherical valve is improved, and the hemispherical valve is convenient and quick to use when being sealed by utilizing the turntable, the rotating shaft and the torsion valve for use in a matching way, so that the requirement on manpower is reduced, and the convenience of the hemispherical valve is improved.

title_en: Hydrogen storage system
abstract_en: The present application relates to a hydrogen storage system including a storage container configured to accommodate a metal hydride material therein and having input and output ports through which hydrogen is introduced into or discharged from the storage container, and a partitioning unit made of a heat conductive material and configured to partition an inner space of the storage container into a plurality of independent spaces independently partitioned, thereby ensuring heat transfer efficiency and improving safety and reliability.

title_en: High-safety high-purity low-temperature liquid gas storage tank pressure stabilizing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of high-purity low-temperature liquid gas, and discloses a high-safety high-purity low-temperature liquid gas storage tank pressure stabilizing device which comprises a supporting seat, wherein the top of the supporting seat is provided with a mounting plate, the outer side of the top of the mounting plate is provided with a fastening bolt, the inner side of the top of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a storage tank body, the outer wall of the storage tank body is movably connected with a protection tank body, the bottom of the protection tank body is fixedly connected with a sealing gasket, the top of the protection tank body is provided with a through hole, the bottom of the storage tank body is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe, and the top of the storage tank body is provided with a detection mechanism. This high-purity low temperature liquid gas storage tank pressure stabilizing device of high security is favorable to realizing the function of protection through the protection jar body, has improved the security of storing then, has solved the damage condition that receives the vibration to lead to easily to be favorable to going up and down the function of dismantling the protection jar body, has made things convenient for subsequent maintenance work then.

title_en: Bearing device for wheel and method for installing bearing device for wheel
abstract_en: Provided are a bearing device for a wheel and a method for installing the bearing device for a wheel, wherein the bearing device for a wheel can restrain the restriction on the design of internal specifications and improve the maintainability. The bearing device for a wheel is provided with: an outer ring; an inner member (hub wheel and inner ring) having a double-row inner rail groove and a wheel mounting flange, the double-row inner rail groove being opposed to the double-row outer rail groove provided in the outer ring; double row ball rows; and a hub bolt that is press-fitted into a bolt hole of the wheel mounting flange, the outer ring having: the hub bolt comprises a first outer peripheral surface, a second outer peripheral surface with a smaller diameter than the first outer peripheral surface, and a step surface connecting the first outer peripheral surface and the second outer peripheral surface, wherein the outer diameter radius of the first outer peripheral surface is larger than the inscribed radius of the head part of the hub bolt pressed into the bolt hole, and the outer diameter radius of the second outer peripheral surface is smaller than the inscribed radius of the head part of the hub bolt pressed into the bolt hole.

title_en: Damping system for rebound process of drill rod of rock drill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damping system for a rebound process of a drill rod of a rock drill. The invention ensures the normal drilling force output of the rock drill by means of indirect fluid transmission, and can prevent the drill rod from directly striking the impact piston of the hydraulic cylinder in the rebound process of the drill rod, thereby reducing the vibration in the rebound process of the drill rod. The realization principle is summarized in that the energy of the rebound of the drill rod is converted into the kinetic energy of the transmission piston, the effect of 'delaying right movement' of the impact disc is realized through special geometric design, enough retraction time is obtained for the impact piston of the hydraulic cylinder, and finally the impact of the drill rod and the middle structural member on the impact piston of the hydraulic cylinder is completely avoided, so that the aim of reducing vibration is fulfilled. The damping system does not need an external power source, has stable structure and strong engineering applicability.

title_en: Frame box structure of wax melting furnace
abstract_en: The application discloses a wax melting furnace frame box structure, which comprises a keel frame, wherein a melting furnace mounting box and a controller mounting box are arranged in the keel frame; the water cooling curtain wall used for separating the smelting furnace installation box and the controller installation box is arranged in the keel frame and comprises heat insulation plates, a water cooling pipe is arranged between the two layers of heat insulation plates, a submersible pump is arranged in the water tank, a submersible pump outlet is connected with one end of the water cooling pipe, the other end of the water cooling pipe is connected into the water tank, the water cooling pipe comprises a heat absorption part and a heat dissipation part, the heat absorption part is arranged in the two layers of heat insulation plates, the water cooling pipe extends upwards and is provided with a heat dissipation part on the upper side of the controller installation box, a plurality of fin plates are uniformly arranged on the heat absorption part and the heat dissipation part at intervals, and a heat dissipation fan is arranged on one side of the heat dissipation part. This wax melting furnace frame box structure sets up the effect that is used for divided water-cooling curtain to play thermal-insulated cooling that is good, can provide better protection to the controlgear. The bottom is provided with the shovel foot that fork truck used, facilitates the use fork truck to remove whole box.

title_en: Radial rotary type snap-off valve and use method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a radial rotary type snap-off valve and a use method thereof, wherein the radial rotary type snap-off valve comprises a first valve body and a second valve body, and the first valve body and the second valve body are clasped through opposite clasping type hoops; a fixed valve core and a movable valve core are arranged in the first valve body and the second valve body; the movable valve core is provided with a boss, and guide posts corresponding to the boss are fixed on the first valve body and the second valve body; a reed is arranged on the inner side of the movable valve core; the application has the characteristics of simplicity, portability, simple and convenient manufacture, convenient maintenance and repeated use.

title_en: Compact type opening adjustable ventilation valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ventilation valves, in particular to a compact type opening-adjustable ventilation valve which comprises a rotary baffle plate, a rotating shaft, a cover plate, a limiting plate, a spring, a ball body, a baffle sleeve, a ball sleeve and a valve body. The compact opening-adjustable ventilation valve provided by the invention has the advantages of simple and compact structure, small volume, light weight and the like, obviously reduces the installation space and the weight, and is suitable for being applied to the field of aerospace.

title_en: Cold insulation module for ultralow-temperature liquefied gas storage and transportation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cold insulation module for ultra-low temperature liquefied gas storage and transportation, which is formed by compounding a stainless steel corrugated plate, high-density reinforced polyurethane foam, a glass fiber aluminum foil composite material and low-density reinforced polyurethane foam in sequence from top to bottom. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the cold insulation module for the storage and transportation of the ultralow-temperature liquefied gas, which specifically comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a cold insulation module superstructure; (2) preparing a cold insulation module lower structure; (3) The upper structure of the composite cold insulation module and the lower structure of the cold insulation module. The cold insulation module for the storage and transportation of the ultralow-temperature liquefied gas has excellent impact strength and tensile strength, can effectively prevent the low-temperature damage of the shell of the storage container caused by the leakage of the ultralow-temperature liquefied gas, and ensures the safety of the storage and transportation of the ultralow-temperature liquefied gas.

title_en: Partition type static pressure supporting disc
abstract_en: The invention provides a partitioned static pressure support disc which is provided with a total oil inlet and an oil return port, wherein a servo valve is connected to a total oil inlet pipeline connected with the total oil inlet, the static pressure support disc is composed of a plurality of axisymmetric or centrosymmetric static pressure support partitions, and the oil inlet of each static pressure support partition is independently connected with the total oil inlet; a plurality of layers of sealing and oil outlet grooves are formed in the static pressure supporting partition and the outer side of the static pressure supporting partition, a plurality of oil outlets are formed in the oil outlet grooves, and all the oil outlets are communicated to an oil return port through an oil outlet pipeline; the partition oil inlet pipe connected with the partition oil inlet is connected with an independent one-way valve, and each one-way valve is controlled by a servo valve respectively. The static pressure supporting disc provided by the invention adopts a technical scheme of dividing a plurality of static pressure supporting subareas, and is provided with independent subarea oil inlets in each subarea, so that the flow and the pressure in each subarea are independently controlled through the servo valve, and the static pressure supporting disc can bear the axial force action and resist the lateral bending moment.

title_en: Eccentric swing type speed reducer
abstract_en: The application provides a technology capable of realizing the light weight of a speed reducer and inhibiting the axial movement of an input shaft in a state that the speed reducer is separated from a motor. An eccentric swing type speed reducer includes an input shaft (26), an eccentric body provided to the input shaft (26), and an external gear (30) that is swung by the eccentric body, wherein an input shaft bearing that supports the input shaft (26) is not disposed on one side in an axial direction of the external gear (30), and the eccentric swing type speed reducer includes a 1 st regulating member (50A) that is disposed on the other side in the axial direction of the external gear (30) and that is regulated in axial movement relative to the input shaft (26), and at least a part of the 1 st regulating member (50A) overlaps the external gear (30) in the axial direction.

title_en: Metal rubber three-way impact-resistant composite shock absorber based on active control
abstract_en: The application discloses an active control-based metal rubber three-way impact-resistant composite damper which comprises a damping support framework, a top pressure plate, a top sealing plate, a top torsion spring shape memory alloy, a first vertical damping high-density metal rubber, a first lateral damping low-density metal rubber, a bottom sealing plate, a bottom pressure plate, a bottom torsion spring shape memory alloy, a second vertical damping high-density metal rubber, a second lateral damping low-density metal rubber and a power supply. The application adopts high-low density combined structural metal rubber with high damping performance and a torsion spring high-elasticity shape memory alloy as vibration damping elements, can control the rigidity characteristic of the shape memory alloy by changing the temperature through actively controlling the electrifying mode when bearing external high load so as to indirectly improve the rigidity of the metal rubber, thereby achieving overload protection, and adopts a high-low density composite metal rubber component to realize three-way vibration damping, thereby solving the phenomenon of poor horizontal vibration damping effect in the traditional high-speed centrifugal state.

title_en: Vibration-proof vibration-damping low-friction pipe support
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of vibration reduction supporting devices, in particular to an anti-vibration and vibration reduction low-friction pipe bracket, which comprises a pipe clamp, a heat preservation layer and a sliding supporting seat; the heat preservation layer is arranged at the inner ring part of the pipe clamp, and comprises a hard heat preservation layer and a soft heat preservation layer, wherein the soft heat preservation layer is arranged at the inner ring part of the hard heat preservation layer; the sliding support seat is arranged at the bottom of the pipe clamp and used for reducing friction and vibration received by the pipe when the pipe axially slides; according to the application, the vibration-damping ring is arranged, and the supporting arc plates uniformly arranged on the vibration-damping ring are propped against the soft heat-insulating layer, so that the soft heat-insulating layer is tightly propped against the pipeline, the pipeline is subjected to elastic limiting action, the stability of the combination of the pipeline and the pipe bracket is effectively ensured, and the elastic vibration-damping effect is exerted; therefore, when the pipeline starts vibrating due to factors such as material flow in the pipeline, the pipeline vibration caused by the rigid limit fixation or the elastic limit with smaller deformation allowance is forcedly restrained, and the abrasion degree of the pipeline is reduced.

title_en: High-purity liquid silane storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-purity liquid silane storage system, which relates to the technical field of silane storage and comprises a storage tank, a BOG condenser, a feed pipe, an evaporation gas inlet pipe, a downcomer and a safety valve, wherein liquid silane enters the storage tank from the feed pipe, when silane evaporation gas is generated in the storage tank, the silane evaporation gas enters the BOG condenser from the evaporation gas inlet pipe to be condensed, then flows back to the storage tank from the downcomer, when the pressure of the silane evaporation gas generated in the storage tank exceeds the pressure, the safety valve is opened, and the silane evaporation gas is sent to a torch pipe network to be burnt. The high-purity liquid silane storage system provided by the invention can improve the silane reserve, save the occupied area of a device, reduce the generation of silane evaporation gas, and is safer and more reliable, simple and compact in structure and low in cost.

title_en: Balance cylinder with safety protection blocking mechanism and safety state remote monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of balance cylinders, and relates to a balance cylinder with a safety protection blocking mechanism and safety state remote monitoring. The device comprises a cylinder body, a piston rod, a detection switch, a state acquisition module, a sending module and a state output module, wherein a piston is arranged in the cylinder body in a sliding manner, a piston connecting section is arranged on the piston rod, the piston connecting section is fixedly connected with the piston, one end of the piston rod is a sliding block connecting end, the sliding block connecting end extends out of the cylinder body and is sleeved with a sliding block, and the other end of the piston rod is provided with a blocking mechanism; the detection switch module is connected with the state acquisition module, the state acquisition module is connected with the sending module, and the receiving module is in communication connection with the sending module; the detection switch is arranged on the blocking mechanism and faces the piston and is used for detecting the distance between the detection switch and the piston. The cylinder can effectively ensure that the piston rod cannot fall off from the cylinder body, ensure the safety of a machine tool and a human body, and simultaneously can detect the distance between the blocking mechanism of the piston rod and the piston.

title_en: Vehicle gear switch fault diagnosis method, device and computer readable storage medium
