abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of vehicle fault diagnosis and discloses a vehicle gear switch fault diagnosis method, a device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a first state signal and a second state signal of each gear switch contact at the current moment by utilizing two Hall switch sensors corresponding to each gear switch contact of a vehicle respectively; determining a first integration state value according to each first state signal, and determining a second integration state value according to each second state signal; and performing fault diagnosis on a gear switch of the vehicle based on the first integrated state value and the second integrated state value. By applying the technical scheme of the invention, the functional safety requirement of the current state acquisition of the gear switch can be met, the accurate diagnosis of different fault types of the vehicle gear switch is realized, and the overall safety performance of the automobile is improved.

title_en: Device for changing and purifying SF6 gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of maintenance of electrical equipment, in particular to a device for changing and purifying SF6 gas. The device comprises a charging box, a purifying box, a charging control system and a purifying control system, wherein the charging box comprises an charging pipeline and an exhaust pipeline, the charging pipeline and the exhaust pipeline are respectively provided with a one-way valve, a power valve, a decompression pressure-stabilizing valve, a gas flow controller, a ball valve and other equipment, and the purifying box comprises an air suction pipeline, a leakage-proof cover, an induced draft fan, a steering engine, a telescopic motor, a purifying control system and other equipment. Compared with the prior art, the invention can automatically complete the replacement of SF6 gas in electrical equipment without power failure, and simultaneously, the original and leaked SF6 gas is subjected to harmless treatment, so that the operation process is simplified, the working efficiency is improved, the operation and maintenance cost is reduced, manual operation by workers is not required, the potential safety hazard is reduced, and the working intensity of maintainers is effectively reduced.

title_en: Gas pipeline inspection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline inspection equipment, in particular to a gas pipeline inspection device, which comprises a vehicle plate, a track and a motor unit, wherein the middle part of the vehicle plate is provided with a mounting opening, an I-shaped plate is detachably fixed on the mounting opening, a damage detection mechanism is arranged on the I-shaped plate and comprises a sliding cylinder, a transmitter and a receiver, the transmitter and the receiver are both positioned in the sliding cylinder and are in sliding fit with the inner wall of the sliding cylinder, a lifting assembly capable of driving the transmitter and the receiver to synchronously move up and down is arranged on the sliding cylinder, the vehicle plate is provided with a marking mechanism, the marking mechanism comprises a base fixed at the front end of the vehicle plate, a hydraulic cylinder and a sleeve are sequentially arranged in the base from top to bottom, a drilling motor in sliding fit with the sleeve is fixedly connected to a telescopic arm of the hydraulic cylinder, a drill bit is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the drilling motor, and a drill hole for the drill bit to penetrate through the vehicle plate right below the base. Therefore, not only can the inspection efficiency be improved, but also the fault point position can be quickly and accurately tracked by the point inspection personnel.

title_en: Dynamic and static pressure mixed foil bearing and shafting
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic and static pressure mixed foil bearing and a shafting, and relates to the field of transmission parts. The dynamic-static pressure mixed foil bearing comprises a bearing body and an end cover; the bearing body includes a plurality of foil units including an inner race, an outer race, an elastic connection member, and an elastic support member. The outer ring serves as a mounting base for other components. The inner ring is connected with the outer ring through elastic connecting pieces, gas channels are formed between the two adjacent elastic connecting pieces and the inner ring and between the two adjacent elastic connecting pieces and the outer ring, and elastic supporting pieces arranged between the inner ring and the outer ring form elastic supporting for the inner ring. The inner ring of the partial foil unit is provided with a fracture communicating with the gas channel. The end cover is provided with a gas inlet communicated with the gas channel. Compressed gas is injected into a gas inlet on the end cover, flows into the gas channel further, and then enters the inner side of the inner ring through the fracture. Simple structure, the reliability is high, and bearing capacity is good, can simply and conveniently, high-efficient realization sound pressure hybrid lubrication, reduced the processing and the installation degree of difficulty of bearing simultaneously.

title_en: Vehicle image recognition device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle image recognition and discloses a vehicle image recognition device which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a shell is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting plate, a box body is arranged at the top of the shell, a camera is arranged on the front surface of the box body, a connecting rod is arranged on the back surface of the camera, a dismounting mechanism is arranged on the connecting rod and comprises a fixing block, a groove, a fixing groove, a clamping rod, a round block, a spring and a round shell, and the fixing block is fixedly arranged on the back surface of the camera. According to the invention, the round block is pulled upwards, the round block drives the clamping rod to move upwards to be separated from the fixing groove, so that the fixing block can be released, the camera is convenient to disassemble, overhaul and maintain, the front end of the connecting rod is inserted into the groove during installation, the round block is pulled in the process, the round block is loosened after the round block is inserted, the clamping rod is automatically inserted into the fixing groove, and the device is convenient to assemble, disassemble and overhaul.

title_en: Metal hose with visual filtering function
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of filtering devices, in particular to a metal hose with a visual filtering function, which is characterized in that: the visual filter assembly comprises an outer pipeline piece and a detachable filter piece positioned in the outer pipeline piece; and a metal hose body connected to the outer pipe member through a flange; according to the application, cooling water flows into the main pipeline through the metal hose body, the cooling water enters the filter cartridge after passing through the blocking body, and the cooling water filtered by the filter cartridge enters the main pipeline again, so that the filter cartridge is continuously used, plugs remained in the filter cartridge can be seen through the bifurcation pipeline and the filter cartridge, when the plugs are excessive, the filter cartridge is removed, the blocking body moves to block the flow of the filter cartridge at the moment, the cooling water is prevented from continuously flowing, the filter cartridge is cleaned, the filter cartridge can be embedded into the bifurcation pipeline by sliding the filter cartridge, and when the filter cartridge abuts against the blocking body, the blocking body moves to prevent water flow from being blocked.

title_en: Joint structure of air conditioner connecting pipe and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a joint structure of an air conditioner connecting pipe, which comprises a joint, a connecting pipe and a copper nut, wherein the connecting pipe, the joint and/or a stop valve are connected together through the copper nut, a first sealing structure is arranged between the copper nut and the connecting pipe, a second sealing structure is arranged in the connecting pipe, and the first sealing structure and the second sealing structure are mutually matched to avoid the connecting pipe from contacting with the copper nut and/or the joint and/or the stop valve. According to the joint structure of the air conditioner connecting pipe, parts of the sealing structure are fewer and only comprise the first sealing structure and the second sealing structure, so that hidden danger of leakage is reduced, requirements on processing production and installation operation processes are reduced, installation steps are reduced, and production and installation efficiency is improved; through the cooperation of the first sealing structure and the second sealing structure, the sealing performance is improved, and electrochemical corrosion generated when the connecting pipe is contacted with the copper nut and/or the joint and/or the stop valve can be avoided.

title_en: Silencer for exhaust pipe
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of silencing devices, in particular to a silencing device for an exhaust pipe, which comprises a rotary silencing device arranged in the exhaust pipe, wherein the rotary silencing device comprises a rotary driving seat arranged in the exhaust pipe, a limiting driving shaft is arranged on the rotary driving seat, a plurality of limiting mounting grooves are formed in the outer side of the limiting driving shaft and are uniformly distributed at equal intervals, an assembly mark is further arranged at the top of the limiting driving shaft, a plurality of mutually-butted spliced silencing mechanisms are arranged on the limiting driving shaft, a limiting fixed cover is arranged at the top of the limiting driving shaft and is in positioning connection with the top of the driving shaft, a self-adaptive shielding mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the limiting fixed cover, and a noise detector is further arranged on the self-adaptive shielding mechanism.

title_en: Door-opening labor-saving refrigerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a door-opening labor-saving refrigerator, which relates to the technical field of horizontal refrigerators, wherein a handle is arranged on the opening side of a door body, a lifting handle is slidably arranged on the inner side of the handle, a push rod rocker arm and a pull wire rocker arm are respectively arranged on two sides of the lifting handle, the middle part of the push rod rocker arm is hinged to the door body, the rear end of the push rod rocker arm is arranged on the handle, the front end of the pull wire rocker arm is fixedly connected with a pull wire structure, the middle part of the pull wire rocker arm is arranged on the handle, the rear end of the pull wire rocker arm is hinged to the door body, a first air hole is formed in the upper end of the door body, a second air hole is formed in the lower end of the door body, the first air hole and the second air hole are communicated in the door body, a first plug and a second plug are slidably arranged on the door body, and the pull wire structure comprises a first pull wire connected with the pull wire of the pull wire rocker arm and a second pull wire connected with the first plug and the second plug respectively. The invention can balance the internal and external air pressure of the refrigerator before opening the door, so that the door body is opened in a time-saving and labor-saving manner.

title_en: Bearing device for wheel
abstract_en: A bearing device (10) for a wheel is provided with an inner shaft (12) having a wheel mounting flange (18 b) on one axial side and a double-row inner raceway surface (20) on the other axial side, an outer ring (11) having a double-row outer raceway surface (17) opposed to the double-row inner raceway surface (20), a plurality of first balls (13 a) provided between the first inner raceway surface (20 a) on one axial side of the double-row inner raceway surface (20) and the first outer raceway surface (17 a) on one axial side of the double-row outer raceway surface (17), and a plurality of second balls (13 b) provided between the second inner raceway surface (20 b) on the other axial side of the double-row inner raceway surface (20) and the second outer raceway surface (17 b) on the other axial side of the double-row outer raceway surface (17). The first balls (13 a) and the second balls (13 b) have the same diameter. The contact angle of the first balls (13 a) is smaller than the contact angle of the second balls (13 b).

title_en: Partition multipoint tracking exposure security protection camera monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a partitioned multipoint tracking exposure security camera monitoring device, which belongs to the technical field of monitoring devices and comprises a camera, an angle adjusting component and a heat radiating component, wherein: the camera is used for shooting and monitoring the target area; the angle adjusting component is arranged at the bottom of the camera and is used for adjusting the use angle of the camera so as to realize tracking shooting of a target object; the heat dissipation component is arranged on the shell of the camera; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the heat radiating assembly, the passive heat radiating module in the heat radiating assembly can play a role in discharging heat in the camera housing to the outside in normal use, and the active heat radiating module can cool the inside of the camera housing in an active mode when the passive heat radiating module cannot meet heat radiating requirements, and meanwhile, through the arrangement of the angle adjusting assembly, the camera can conveniently perform angle adjustment so as to meet the aim of tracking and monitoring a monitoring target.

title_en: Fireproof strut and spherical tank
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical storage equipment, and particularly relates to a fireproof strut, which comprises the following components: the pillar body is surrounded to form an inner cavity which is used for storing flame-retardant gas; the exhaust piece is arranged on the support body and is provided with an exhaust through hole which is communicated with the inner cavity, and the exhaust piece is communicated with the exhaust through hole when the external environment temperature is greater than the safety threshold value so that flame retardant gas is sprayed out. The invention also relates to a spherical tank. According to the invention, the flame-retardant gas is stored in the inner cavity of the support body, and the exhaust piece is arranged on the support body, so that the inner cavity is sealed in a normal state, and the inner cavity is communicated with the outside when the outside environment temperature is higher than the safety threshold value, so that the flame-retardant gas is sprayed out from the inner cavity to the periphery of the support body; the concentration of the flame-retardant gas around the prop body is rapidly increased to block the contact of the combustible material and the combustion-supporting material, so that the fire is controlled or gradually eliminated, and the threat of open fire to the spherical tank is eliminated.

title_en: Carbon dioxide gas cylinder and gas cylinder pressure maintaining valve
abstract_en: The application discloses a carbon dioxide gas cylinder and a gas cylinder pressure maintaining valve. The gas cylinder pressure maintaining valve comprises a valve body; the valve body comprises two communicated valve ports; two groups of pressure maintaining valve core components are arranged in the valve body; any pressure-maintaining valve core component comprises a valve core and an elastic body, the valve core is slidably arranged in the valve body, the elastic body and the valve core are mutually sleeved, and two ends of the elastic body are respectively abutted against the valve core and the valve body; the two groups of pressure maintaining valve core components are respectively arranged in the two valve ports, the two valve cores are coaxially connected and are in sliding seal, and the compression directions of the two elastic bodies are opposite; two gas cylinder leakage channels are arranged in the valve body and extend from the two valve ports to sliding sealing surfaces of the two valve cores respectively; the content in the gas cylinder flows in from one valve port to compress the elastomer in the other valve port, so that the gas cylinder is deflated, and the elastomer rebounds to realize the pressure maintaining of the gas cylinder. The pressure maintaining valve for the gas cylinder can be used in two directions, meets the air leakage requirement and the pressure maintaining requirement of the gas cylinder, and is higher in safety, more convenient to use and more various in use mode.

title_en: Pressure reducer
abstract_en: A pressure reducer (100) for reducing fluid pressure includes a reducer body (110) defining at least one reducer chamber (120). The reducer chamber (120) includes an inlet section (122) and an outlet section (124) fluidly coupled to the inlet section (122). The pressure reducer chamber (110) also includes a spring-operated piston rod (121), a sealing member (128) operatively coupled with the piston rod (121), and a valve (129). The valve (129) opens and closes due to the rocking action of the piston rod (121). Furthermore, a sealing element (130) is arranged between the valve (129) and the piston rod (121). The pressure reducer (100) is characterized in that the valve (129) defines a sealing seat (139) for the sealing element (130), and the piston rod (121) is radially sealed.

title_en: Rotating shaft device, folding shell and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a rotating shaft device which comprises a supporting mechanism, a rotating assembly and a driven assembly, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises two side supporting pieces, the rotating assembly comprises a positioning seat and two rotating mechanisms, each rotating mechanism comprises a first rotating piece, a second rotating piece and a connecting piece, two opposite ends of the first rotating piece and the second rotating piece are respectively and rotatably connected with the positioning seat and the connecting piece, a first rotating axis line between the first rotating piece and the connecting piece is parallel to a second rotating axis line between the second rotating piece and the connecting piece, the driven assembly comprises two driven pieces respectively corresponding to the two rotating mechanisms, the driven pieces are connected with the side supporting pieces and the connecting pieces on the same side of the positioning seat in a sliding and rotating mode, and the side supporting pieces are connected with the connecting pieces in a rotating mode, and the connecting pieces rotate relative to the positioning seat to drive the first rotating piece, the second rotating piece and the driven pieces to drive the two side supporting pieces to be mutually bent or mutually unfolded. The application also provides a folding shell with the rotating shaft device and electronic equipment.

title_en: Method for judging clamping degree of double-wedge rope locking device on steel wire rope guide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging the clamping degree of a double-wedge rope locker on a steel wire rope guide, which is used for judging the clamping degree of the double-wedge rope locker on the steel wire rope guide by measuring the height of the upper end surface of a wedge block from the upper end surface of a wedge box and the opening degree of the double wedge block.

title_en: Turntable for crane and convenient to maintain and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a turntable convenient to maintain and used for a crane, which comprises a turntable main body, a pipeline adjusting frame and a supporting component, wherein the pipeline adjusting frame is arranged on the bottom wall of the turntable main body, a support column is arranged at the bottom of the pipeline adjusting frame, an operation pedal is arranged at the inner side of a storage groove through a rotating shaft, and the supporting component is arranged at the top of the pipeline adjusting frame. According to the invention, the limiting plug post is arranged at the bottom of the operation pedal, the limit of the operation pedal is relieved by the rotating baffle, the operation pedal is rotated to the upper side of the supporting component through the rotating shaft, then the limiting post is pressed, the pressing plate is pressed by the limiting post to slide at the inner side of the movable groove and the reset spring is extruded to enable the limiting plug post to be inserted into the inner side of the plug hole, the limiting post is clamped at the inner side of the opening after the limiting post and the opening are positioned at the same horizontal position, the fixing of the limiting plug post is realized, the stability during maintenance is ensured by limiting and fixing of the operation pedal, and the maintenance efficiency of the control system in the turntable main body is improved.

title_en: Hydraulic control system and control method for comprehensive installation vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydraulic control system and a control method for a comprehensive installation vehicle, wherein the hydraulic control system comprises an oil cylinder, a hand pump, a motor pump group, an oil tank, an overflow valve and a three-stage speed control valve group, wherein a lifting device is arranged on the oil cylinder, the oil cylinder is connected with the oil tank through a liquid suction pipeline and a liquid return pipeline, the three-stage speed control valve group consists of a one-way throttle valve, a stop valve and a throttle device, the one-way throttle valve is arranged on the liquid suction pipeline, the stop valve and the throttle device are arranged on the liquid return pipeline, the hand pump and the motor pump group are arranged on the liquid suction pipeline, and the hydraulic system is divided into a lifting descending function and a manual emergency function. The hydraulic control system and the control method for the comprehensive installation vehicle solve the technical problems that in the prior art, speed is difficult to adjust and no emergency structure is arranged.

title_en: Round plug with adjusting element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a round plug (1) for industrial applications in the automation industry. The circular plug (1) comprises: a circuit board (20) which is located inside the circular plug (1) and has a sensor element (21) which is arranged on the circuit board (20); an evaluation circuit (22) which is disposed on the circuit board (20); an interface (S); a torus (30) located on the outer circumference of the circular plug (1); an axis of rotation (31); and a sleeve-type adjusting element (10) which rotates partially about a rotation axis (31), wherein: the adjusting element (10) consists of an inner sleeve (11), an outer sleeve (12), a spring wire (13) and a magnet (14), and the magnet (14) is inserted into the outer sleeve (12); the adjusting element (10) is press-fitted onto the circular plug (1) such that the inner sleeve (11) is firmly and interlockingly connected to the annular face (30) of the circular plug (1); the movable part of the adjusting element (10), i.e. the outer sleeve (12) and the magnet (14), is in a basic position (G) when the spring wire (13) is elastically balanced, wherein the sensor element (21) is able to detect the basic position (G) and is able to distinguish between a first rotational direction (A) and an opposite second rotational direction (B) when the adjusting element (10) is rotated out of the basic position (G).

title_en: Turbine transmission shaft and air cycle machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a turbine transmission shaft and an air cycle machine, wherein the turbine transmission shaft comprises a first shaft section, a second shaft section and a thrust section, the first shaft section, the thrust section and the second shaft section are sequentially connected, and the first shaft section, the thrust section and the second shaft section are integrally formed and can conduct heat; the axial one side of the thrust section facing the first shaft section is a first thrust disc surface, the axial one side of the thrust section facing the second shaft section is a second thrust disc surface, cooling gas can be introduced into the radial periphery of the thrust section and can be divided into at least two strands, one strand of cooling gas can pass through the first thrust disc surface and reach the peripheral wall of the first shaft section, and the other strand of cooling gas can pass through the second thrust disc surface and reach the peripheral wall of the second shaft section. According to the invention, flow distribution is not needed for cooling the first shaft section and the second shaft section, and the problem of flow distribution during cooling of the pneumatic bearings at different positions of the conventional air cycle machine is solved.

title_en: High-temperature insulating flange suitable for solid oxide electrolysis/power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature insulating flange suitable for a solid oxide electrolysis/power generation system, which comprises the following components: the upper flange plate, the lower flange plate, the flange extension tube welded with upper and lower flange plates respectively, a plurality of fastening bolts penetrating the upper and lower flange plates are arranged in pairs on the upper and lower sides of each fastening bolt and between the flange plates, a bolt insulating pad, a bolt protecting ring and a high-temperature sealing gasket arranged between the upper and lower flange plates; wherein, still be equipped with insulating treatment layer on the sealed face that upper flange and lower flange are relative, apply insulating material on sealed face through processes such as plasma spraying and form, the bolt protection ring includes: an annular base portion extending between the bolt insulating pad and the upper and lower flanges, and a cylindrical portion isolating the fastening bolts from the upper and lower flanges. In accordance with the present invention, the high-temperature insulating flange has good sealing performance, good insulativity and stable chemical and mechanical properties at 400-1200 ℃.

title_en: Water heating pipe mounting structure capable of measuring temperature in small area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water heating pipe installation. The invention discloses a water heating pipe installation structure capable of measuring temperature in a small area, which aims to solve the problem that when two water heating pipes are connected in the existing installation structure, the connecting part of the water heating pipes is wrapped by a sealing strip, and the water heating pipes are sealed, so that the installation is troublesome. The invention consists of a buckling component, a connecting component and a sealing mechanism. This but hot-water heating pipe mounting structure of little regional temperature measurement passes through sealing mechanism for when connecting pipe and two tip connector heads are connected, the inboard conflict board of connecting piece is contradicted in the articulated department at diamond folding leg both ends, makes diamond folding leg deflection and atress shrink, extrudees damping spring telescopic link and makes its slow shrink, drives four articulated slab deflection and promotes two sealing washer slow movement on it and contradicts in the sleeve joint department of sealing tube and tip connector head, increases the leakproofness of being connected between sealing tube and the tip connector head.

title_en: Method for storing and transporting hydrate with high natural gas storage capacity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for storing and transporting high natural gas storage capacity hydrate, which adopts a mode of hydrate low-temperature generation and high-temperature storage, and specifically comprises the following steps: and under the mode that the hydrate reaction tank is used as a transportation tank at the same time, placing the mixed hydrate reaction liquid into the hydrate reaction tank matched with a transportation vehicle, introducing natural gas, carrying out hydrate generation reaction under the condition of the temperature of 273.65-283.15K, and after the reaction reaches equilibrium, heating to the temperature of less than or equal to 298.15K for storage so as to carry out long-distance transportation. The invention adopts the technical scheme of 'hydrate low-temperature generation and high-temperature storage', can synthesize the hydrate with high natural gas storage capacity in a short time, and can safely, economically and efficiently convey the hydrate to a destination.

title_en: Gear unit, wave gear device, robot, and method for manufacturing gear unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a gear unit, a wave gear device, a robot and a method for manufacturing the gear unit. The gear unit used in the wave gear device includes a flexible gear, a bushing fixed to the flexible gear, and a spacer. The flexible gear has a plate-like diaphragm portion, a curved portion, a cylindrical body portion, and a plurality of external teeth. The diaphragm portion extends perpendicularly with respect to the central axis. The bending portion is bent from the radially outer end portion of the diaphragm portion toward one axial side. The main body portion extends from an end portion on one axial side of the bent portion toward one axial side. The plurality of external teeth are provided on the outer peripheral surface of the main body. The bushing extends perpendicularly to the central axis on one axial side of the diaphragm portion. The spacer extends perpendicularly to the central axis on the other axial side of the diaphragm portion. The spacer is fixed to the spacer with the diaphragm portion interposed therebetween in the axial direction. This makes it possible to fix the bushing to the diaphragm portion easily and with high accuracy.

title_en: Distribution network power equipment fault detection device and detection method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power monitoring, in particular to a distribution network power equipment fault detection device based on image recognition, which comprises an equipment platform, wherein the equipment platform comprises a support frame arranged on a power transmission tower, and the support frame is provided with a main controller for controlling the whole operation of equipment and a first wireless communication module for performing wireless communication. The detection equipment designed by the invention can complete refitting based on the existing transmission tower by additionally installing the simple main guide rail and the auxiliary guide rail, namely, corresponding detection instructions can be issued to the main controller by utilizing the remote terminal, the main motion device and the auxiliary motion device transport the detection device to a specified detection area along the main guide rail and the auxiliary guide rail to collect image signals, and then the collected image signals are subjected to image recognition or manual recognition at the remote terminal to complete detection diagnosis of faults or evaluation of fault risks, so that the trouble that maintenance personnel need to arrive at site personally to perform such detection is effectively avoided.

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-air-chamber stiffness-adjustable air spring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive multi-air-chamber stiffness-adjustable air spring, which comprises: main air chamber: the device is used for bearing, supporting and rigidity adjustment, and a second sensor module is arranged in the device; ventilation channel: controlling the flow of gas through an adjustable linkage to vary the stiffness of the spring; auxiliary air chamber number one: for stiffness adjustment and load balancing; no. two auxiliary air chambers: the invention is suitable for the technical field of air springs, and realizes the function of automatically adjusting the rigidity according to the motion state of a vehicle by arranging a plurality of auxiliary air chambers and adjustable ventilation channels and providing a sensor and an electronic control unit; in addition, the gas flow quantity is controlled by setting adjustable spring damping, so that the performance of the suspension system is further optimized; has the advantages of improving the performance of the suspension system, accurately adjusting the rigidity and providing better comfort.

title_en: Inspection robot for pipeline leakage detection and super-resolution acoustic wave imaging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a routing inspection robot for pipeline leakage detection, which belongs to the field of pipeline leakage detection and comprises a mobile robot body, a mobile navigation module and an acoustic imaging device; the mobile robot body is used for carrying an acoustic imaging device and a mobile navigation module, and mobile inspection is carried out on a factory through autonomous navigation; the mobile navigation module is used for realizing autonomous obstacle avoidance and autonomous planning of the mobile robot body; the sound wave imaging device is arranged on the mobile robot car body, sound source power spectrum is calculated by collecting sound wave signals of the surrounding environment of the mobile robot car body and using a super-resolution sound wave imaging algorithm, and the leakage position of the pipeline is positioned. The invention also provides a super-resolution acoustic imaging method for pipeline leakage detection. The inspection robot is simple in structure and high in intellectualization, the inspection cost is reduced, the inspection efficiency is improved, the safety of personnel and facilities is guaranteed, and the position of a leakage pipeline can be accurately identified by the super-resolution acoustic imaging method.

title_en: Digital hydraulic motor and hydraulic control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital hydraulic motor and a hydraulic control system, wherein the digital hydraulic motor comprises a hydraulic motor component, a valve core component, a planetary reduction component and a driving piece, the hydraulic motor component comprises a shell and a motor rotating shaft, the shell is provided with a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet, the motor rotating shaft is arranged in the shell in a penetrating way, one end of the motor rotating shaft extends out of the shell, the valve core component comprises a valve body, a valve core and a valve core screw rod, the valve body is provided with a liquid inlet communicated with the liquid inlet and a liquid return port communicated with the liquid outlet, the valve core is movably arranged in the valve body so as to control synchronous on-off of the liquid inlet and the liquid return port, the valve core screw rod is arranged in the valve core in a penetrating way and is in threaded fit with the valve core, a planetary support is sleeved on the motor rotating shaft, a sun wheel is sleeved on the valve core screw rod, a planet wheel is matched between an outer gear and a sun wheel, and the driving piece is meshed with the outer side of the outer gear. The digital hydraulic motor has high mechanical feedback precision, and is accurate in control of the rotation angle of the motor rotating shaft, and the valve core is not easy to wear.

title_en: Risk monitoring device for power grid operation and accurate management and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk monitoring device and a precise control method for power grid operation, and relates to the technical field of power grid safety control, wherein the risk monitoring device comprises a mounting assembly, a mounting assembly and a power grid monitoring system, wherein the mounting assembly comprises a pre-assembly button, a base, a first fastening bolt and a second fastening bolt; the fastening assembly comprises a first clamping piece, a second clamping piece and a rotating piece; the monitoring assembly comprises monitoring equipment, a rotating seat and a fixed inserted link; and a precise control method for operators. The method has the beneficial effects that: the monitoring assembly is conveniently connected with equipment for managing and controlling the risk at required moment in a factory through the installation assembly, the monitoring assembly and the installation assembly are firmly connected through the fastening assembly, risk management and control are carried out on corresponding operation equipment through the monitoring equipment, judgment feedback is carried out through a precise management and control method, error operation caused by that operators cannot master relevant operation knowledge in place is avoided, and potential safety hazards existing in each operation link are eliminated.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring device for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring device for a photovoltaic power station, which comprises a camera, wherein a transparent protective cover is connected to the bottom of the camera in a threaded manner, a connecting column is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the camera, the vertical center line of the camera coincides with the central axis of the connecting column, an annular groove is formed in the outer side of the connecting column, a connecting ring is rotationally connected to the top of the annular groove, and a first gear is fixedly connected to the top of the connecting ring. According to the invention, the second gear can rotate by starting the motor, and the connecting ring can rotate by matching with the use of the first gear to drive the arc-shaped frame to rotate, dust or dirt on the transparent protective cover can be automatically wiped through the cotton cloth pad on the arc-shaped frame, so that the camera is prevented from being influenced by the dust and the dirt when shooting, the monitoring quality is improved, meanwhile, the device is very convenient and fast to clean the dust and the dirt on the transparent protective cover without manually climbing for disassembly and cleaning, and the practicability of the device is enhanced.

title_en: Universal ball and automation equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic conveying equipment, in particular to a universal ball and automatic equipment, which comprises a shell, an auxiliary ball, a main ball, a sealing cover and a brake assembly, wherein the shell is provided with a plurality of grooves; wherein, a containing groove is concavely arranged on one end face of the shell, the auxiliary ball and the main ball are both arranged on the containing groove, and the lower part of the main ball is abutted with the auxiliary ball; the sealing cover is provided with a sealing cover through hole for exposing the main ball, and is matched with the notch of the accommodating groove; the braking component comprises a pushing piece, the pushing piece is movably arranged on the shell, one end part of the pushing piece is arranged in the accommodating groove and supports the main ball, and the auxiliary ball is arranged on the periphery of the pushing piece; the pushing piece can push the main ball under the action of external force, so that the upper part of the main ball is abutted with the hole wall of the sealing cover through hole. According to the embodiment of the application, the instant locking of the main ball is realized by utilizing the distance change from the pushing piece to the main ball, the effective locking of the main ball can be realized with lower manufacturing cost and simple structure, and the positioning of the carrying object is further realized.

title_en: Compact wire-collecting device for multi-head wire drawing machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wire drawing machines, and discloses a compact wire collecting device for a multi-head wire drawing machine, which comprises a machine body and supporting frames, wherein the supporting frames are arranged on two sides of the middle part of the top end of the machine body; the wire winding mechanism is arranged between the tops of the supporting frames and is used for winding the drawn filaments; the uniform wire collecting assembly is arranged at the rear end of the top of the machine body; the conveying mechanism is arranged at the top of the machine body and in front of the bottom of the wire winding mechanism; the wheel collecting mechanism is arranged at the front and rear parts of the bottom end of the machine body. According to the invention, the fixed block and the push plate are arranged, and the pneumatic cylinder can push the whole rectangular block to move forwards when running, so that the two push plates deflect and push the whole two supporting frames, the mounting shaft, the disc and the fixed block to move oppositely until the clamping and fixing effects on the wire-collecting roller are relieved, and finally the wire-collecting roller can slide to the top of the bracket integrally, thereby facilitating the follow-up picking treatment of filaments wound on the surface of the wire-collecting roller.

title_en: Push ring assembly convenient to processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a push ring assembly convenient to process, which relates to the field of clutches and comprises a push ring assembly, wherein the push ring assembly comprises a ring body, four adjusting rings are arranged on the front surface of the ring body, meshing teeth are uniformly arranged on the front surface of the adjusting rings, and a fixing assembly is arranged on the front surface of the ring body; the fixed subassembly includes the fixed orifices, the fixed orifices is offered in the fixed orifices openly and is used for connecting between meshing tooth and the adjusting ring, change the quantity of meshing tooth into even by the odd number for the position and the angle that the meshing tooth distributes on the adjusting ring are the integer, reduce the position calibration degree of difficulty when processing, reduce the processing degree of difficulty and processing cost, make single process speed promote, and make the processing disability rate can obtain effectual control, indirect control loss cost's increase, improve the fixed effect to thrust dish through the quantity that increases the meshing tooth, make the clutch still can keep stable when exporting great power.

title_en: Ultralow temperature preservation box capable of realizing gradient utilization of cold energy and application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultralow temperature preservation box capable of cascade utilization of cold energy and a use method thereof, wherein the ultralow temperature preservation box comprises a liquefied gas tank, wherein the liquefied gas tank is used for storing liquefied gas, and is respectively connected with a first-stage low-temperature box, a second-stage low-temperature box and a third-stage low-temperature box through pipelines, and the first-stage low-temperature box is connected with the second-stage low-temperature box, and the second-stage low-temperature box is connected with the third-stage low-temperature box through pipelines; the first evaporator is arranged in the first-stage low-temperature box, the second evaporator is arranged in the second-stage low-temperature box, the volume of the second evaporator is smaller than that of the first evaporator, the left side and the right side of the third-stage low-temperature box are respectively provided with a baffle, a left air channel and a right air channel are respectively formed between the two baffles and the left side wall and the right side wall, and a plurality of air inlets are formed in the baffles. The invention provides the concept of gradient utilization of the cold energy for the first time, realizes graded utilization of the cold energy, greatly improves the utilization efficiency of the cold energy and reduces the use of electric energy.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for compressed air pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent monitoring method and system of a compressed air pipeline, which belong to the technical field of pipeline damage monitoring, and the invention obtains real-time model parameter characteristic data information of the compressed air pipeline in each region according to a digital twin model of the compressed air pipeline, and tracks the real-time model parameter characteristic data information based on a twin network; and finally, carrying out abnormal state identification on the compressed air pipelines in each area to obtain the compressed air pipeline area with the abnormal state, and generating related early warning signals based on the compressed air pipeline area with the abnormal state. By integrating the normalized attention mechanism and the twin network, the tracking precision of the real-time model parameter characteristic data information of the compressed air pipelines in each region is improved, so that the real-time monitoring precision of the compressed air pipelines in each region is improved, the compressed air pipelines can be monitored for a long time, and phenomena such as damage and leakage of the compressed air pipelines can occur in time.

title_en: High-pressure high-flow cryogenic liquid air supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure high-flow cryogenic liquid air supply system, which at least comprises a low-pressure storage tank, a first small-sized pressurizing tank and a second small-sized pressurizing tank, wherein the first small-sized pressurizing tank and the second small-sized pressurizing tank are suitable for alternately working, the low-pressure storage tank is respectively connected with the first small-sized pressurizing tank and the second small-sized pressurizing tank so as to be capable of supplying air and replenishing liquid into the first small-sized pressurizing tank and the second small-sized pressurizing tank through the low-pressure storage tank, and the first small-sized pressurizing tank and the second small-sized pressurizing tank are suitable for receiving liquid conveyed by the low-pressure storage tank, pressurizing the pressure in the tanks to a set pressure and then conveying the pressure to a rear-end air end. The operation of the whole system is automatically controlled, the intervention of operators is not needed, and high-pressure liquid nitrogen can be continuously supplied without external power in the operation process.

title_en: Quick and slow pumping double-flow high-vacuum angle valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fast and slow pumping double-flow high-vacuum angle valve, which belongs to the technical field of vacuum valves and comprises a main valve body, wherein the bottom of the main valve body is provided with an air inlet, and one side of the outer wall of the main valve body is provided with an air outlet; the top cover is installed at the top of the upper valve seat, an adjustable main air inlet valve core is installed between the main valve body and the upper valve seat, and the adjustable main air inlet valve core comprises an airtight assembly, a main valve core, a step sealing gasket and a main valve rod. According to the invention, the main air inlet valve core is adjustable, compressed air can be stored in the airtight component, so that the compressed air can push the main valve core to seal the first step groove at the air inlet position, and the valve is in a normally closed state under normal conditions.

title_en: Pilot piston type pressure reducing valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pressure reducing valves, in particular to a pilot piston type pressure reducing valve which comprises a valve body, a second sealing cover and a first sealing cover, wherein a containing cavity is formed in the second sealing cover, an adjusting device is slidably arranged in the containing cavity, and the adjusting device comprises a driving assembly, a triggering assembly and a switching assembly. According to the invention, the regulating device is arranged, when the pressure behind the valve of the pressure reducing valve gradually rises, a medium enters the first channel of the regulating device through the throttling pipeline, after one end of the first channel is blocked by operating the switching component in advance, the medium flows into the second channel from the other end of the first channel, the driving component acts, and the triggering component acts to block the pilot pipeline after the driving component acts, so that the pressure at the rear end of the valve is not raised any more, the pressure at the front end of the valve and the pressure at the rear end of the valve cannot be kept balanced, and the pressure at the rear end of the valve is smaller than the pressure at the front end of the valve, so that the static pressure reducing state is avoided as much as possible, and the instant impact condition of a pipeline system at the rear end of the valve is slowed down.

title_en: Alarm device based on network security
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network safety, in particular to a warning device based on network safety, which comprises a transverse plate and a vertical plate, wherein the vertical plate is fixedly connected to one end of the transverse plate, a plurality of threaded holes are formed in the vertical plate, a protection cavity is formed in the transverse plate, a warning part is arranged in the protection cavity, the warning part comprises a moving block, an electromagnetic block, a connecting wire, a battery, a supporting rod and a warning device, a sliding groove is formed in the transverse plate, the moving block is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding manner, two batteries are respectively connected to the moving block in a sliding manner through the supporting rod, and a tension spring is arranged between the batteries and the moving block.

title_en: Structure for installing and protecting rotational speed velocimeter
abstract_en: The invention relates to a structure for installing and protecting a rotational speed velocimeter, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a rotational speed velocimeter bracket, a motor end cover, a bracket fixing device, a rotor rotating shaft, a rotational speed velocimeter fixing device, a protective cover and a protective cover fixing device. The rotational speed velocimeter bracket comprises a bracket fixing plate and a bracket connecting plate; the bracket fixing device includes: a plurality of full-thread bolts, flat washers and spring washers; the tachometer fixing device includes: a plurality of full-thread bolts, flat washers, spring washers and nuts; the protective cover fixing device includes: a plurality of full-thread bolts, a flat washer and a spring washer. The rotational speed velocimeter support is simple with motor end cover and rotational speed velocimeter connection in this patent, just can realize fixing through common standard components such as bolt, packing ring and nut, and rotational speed velocimeter support and protective cover simple structure in this patent, both can be realized with processing such as ordinary steel sheet bending drilling, and with the motor installation back, overall structure is compact stable and compromise certain protective capability.

title_en: Guide roller mounting structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of guide rollers, in particular to a guide roller mounting structure which comprises a guide roller assembly, wherein the guide roller assembly is provided with a fixed seat, a fixed shaft, a first bearing, a guide roller body and a retainer ring, the fixed shaft is inserted into the fixed seat and is fixedly connected with the fixed seat, the first bearing is sleeved at one end of the fixed shaft far away from the fixed seat, the guide roller body is provided with a roller part used for being sleeved at the outer side of the first bearing and a first baffle plate arranged at one side of the roller part far away from the fixed seat, the retainer ring is detachably arranged at one side of the roller part far away from the first baffle plate, and the fixed shaft is also provided with a mounting assembly used for rapidly dismounting the guide roller body. The invention can enable the bearing to be quickly installed inside the guide roller or taken out from the guide roller, thereby facilitating maintenance personnel to maintain and overhaul the guide roller.

title_en: Insert sintered part and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded sintered component and a manufacturing method thereof. A molding die having a fixed die and a movable die that moves along a parting surface with the fixed die is used, the movable die is moved along the parting surface, a sintered member is pressed and held between the movable die and the fixed die, a cavity is formed around each region except each region of the sintered member that is in contact with the fixed die and the movable die by the molding die, a molten material that becomes an exterior member is filled into the cavity, and the sintered member and the exterior member are integrated by insert molding.

title_en: Gear shifting control method and system for automobile AMT gearbox
abstract_en: The invention provides a gear shifting control method and a gear shifting control system for an automobile AMT gearbox, which relate to the technical field of driving and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of exchanging automobile positioning information to obtain road gradient information and road surface type information; loading rainfall information, and carrying out safe vehicle speed assessment by combining road gradient information and road surface type information to generate a safe vehicle speed threshold value; dividing the vehicle according to a safe vehicle speed threshold value based on a gear speedometer to generate a first gear dividing result; receiving the driving speed of the vehicle, dividing the driving speed based on a gear speed table, and generating a second gear dividing result; and after the gear judgment is carried out according to the first gear dividing result and the second gear dividing result, activating an AMT gearbox control component, and carrying out speed change control on the driving speed of the vehicle according to the safe vehicle speed threshold. The intelligent driving vehicle speed control method and the intelligent driving vehicle speed control system solve the technical problem that the existing intelligent driving vehicle speed control flexibility is poor due to the interference influence of special weather and special road conditions in the prior art.

title_en: Meteorological interactive observation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological observation, and provides a meteorological interaction observation device, which comprises: the utility model provides a backup pad, weather detection mechanism and dust detection mechanism, be provided with the control box in the backup pad, detection mechanism sets up in the backup pad, a plurality of weather observation devices are used for carrying out the weather and observe, dust detection mechanism sets up on weather detection mechanism, be used for detecting the dust in the air, detect temperature through weather detection mechanism when guaranteeing that weather observation device is balanced can not by the rocking of blowing, wind speed, wind direction and rainfall, detect the air of wind direction source direction through dust detection mechanism, carry out dust content detection, through above-mentioned technical scheme, most weather observation device among the related art has been solved and has been collected the back through collecting mechanism to high altitude air, rethread check out the too dust content detection to it through check out equipment, the step is loaded down with trivial details, waste time and energy problem.

title_en: Water-cooling leakage-proof connecting structure of motor
abstract_en: The invention provides a water-cooling leakage-proof connecting structure of a motor, which relates to the field of slip ring motors and comprises the following components: the leakage-proof assembly consists of a fastening mechanism and an on-off mechanism, the problem that the connecting structure of an inlet and an outlet of a cooling cavity of an existing slip ring motor and a pipeline is tightly connected by friction force and is easy to fall off, and a connecting piece is free of an automatic blocking structure when being removed from installation, so that cooling liquid can flow out to waste and pollute the working environment is solved.

title_en: Sheet metal panel
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal plate panel, which relates to the technical field of metal plate panels and comprises a metal plate panel structure, wherein a connecting body is arranged on the left side wall of the metal plate panel structure, a connecting groove is formed in the right side wall of the metal plate panel structure, a first mounting cavity is formed in the connecting body, limit groove structures are formed in the front face of the first mounting cavity and the back side of the connecting groove, a connecting and fixing structure is arranged in the connecting body, the connecting and fixing structure can be inserted into the limit groove structures of the metal plate panel structure, the two metal plate panel structures are spliced with each other, and meanwhile, after the connecting and fixing structure and the limit groove structures of the metal plate panel structure are combined with each other, the connecting and fixing structure can achieve adjustment of the limit fixing block in a rotating structure body, and further connection and disassembly of the limit fixing block and the limit groove structures of the metal plate panel structure can be achieved very conveniently.

title_en: Suspension frame hinge structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail transit, and aims to solve the problem that an embedded magnetic levitation running part with uniform bearing and dispersed traction type cannot meet the requirement that the running part passes through a flat curve in a hinged structure with three rotational degrees of freedom; the hinge structure of the invention releases three rotational degrees of freedom and translational degrees of freedom along the X direction between the suspension frames around the X, Y, Z axis, and simultaneously ensures the transmission of Y-direction force and Z-direction force between the suspension frames, so that the uniformly bearing and dispersed traction type embedded magnetic levitation running part has good flat curve trafficability.

title_en: Pneumatic hollow high-speed rotary joint assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pneumatic hollow high-speed rotary joint assembly. The rotary joint comprises a rotary shaft, wherein a joint body and a rotary block are sleeved on the rotary shaft, the joint body is rotationally connected with the rotary block, the rotary block is fixedly connected with the rotary shaft, a rotary block groove matched with the rotary block is formed in the joint body, the rotary block is installed in the rotary block groove and rotationally connected with the rotary block groove, a joint air hole I is formed in the side wall of the rotary block groove, a rotary block annular groove I communicated with the joint air hole I is formed in the outer side wall of the rotary block, a sealing ring I is installed on the inner wall of the rotary block groove, the sealing ring I is sleeved on the rotary block and is respectively arranged on two sides of the rotary block annular groove I, the sealing ring I is made of nitrile rubber, a valve body is fixed on the rotary block, an air passage is formed in the rotary shaft, and the rotary block annular groove I and the air passage are communicated through the valve body. The invention has the advantages of improving the continuity of workpiece processing, improving the processing efficiency, improving the sealing effect of the first sealing ring and the second sealing ring, along with simple structure and convenient control.

title_en: Composite planetary speed reducer with small tooth difference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite planetary reducer with small tooth difference, which comprises an input eccentric shaft, a planetary gear, a fixed annular gear, an output annular gear and a main shell; the input eccentric shaft consists of a supporting shaft section I, an eccentric shaft section II and a supporting shaft section II; the first supporting shaft section is supported in the first end cover through a first bearing, and the second supporting shaft section is supported in the second end cover through a second bearing; the first end cover is fastened with the output annular gear, and the second end cover is fastened with the main shell; the output annular gear is supported in the shell gland through a bearing III; the shell gland is fastened with the main shell; the planetary gear is arranged at the eccentric shaft section of the input eccentric shaft through a bearing IV; the planetary gear is provided with a first tooth part and a second tooth part which are axially arranged and attached; the tooth part I and the tooth part II are different in tooth top height coefficient only; the first tooth part is meshed with the output annular gear, and the second tooth part is meshed with the fixed annular gear fixed in the inner cavity of the main shell. The invention realizes large torque transmission, compact structure, high transmission efficiency, large transmission ratio, large torsional rigidity, good dynamic balance and high reliability.

title_en: Medical instrument assembly and method of connecting medical instrument assembly
abstract_en: The application discloses a medical instrument assembly, which comprises a body, wherein the body comprises a first surface and at least one first connector arranged on the first surface, the first connector comprises a first top part, a first bottom part and a first side part connected with the first top part and the first bottom part, the first top part is positioned on the first surface, the first bottom part and the first top part are arranged at intervals along the thickness direction of the body, and the section size of the first connector in the thickness direction is gradually increased along the direction away from the first surface. The application also discloses a connecting method of the medical instrument assembly, which is used for connecting the medical instrument assembly and the target part, wherein one of the medical instrument assembly and the target part is made of metal, and the other is made of high polymer material or plastic. According to the medical instrument assembly disclosed by the application, the first side part is provided with the accommodating groove which is recessed towards the inside of the first joint, and the adhesive is not easy to separate from the body due to the accommodating groove, so that the connection strength of the medical instrument assembly is improved.

title_en: Offshore wind power tower with lever type dynamic vibration absorber and assembly method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an offshore wind power tower barrel provided with a lever type dynamic vibration absorber and an assembly method thereof. The offshore wind power tower comprises: the device comprises a tower body, a lever module, a damping module and an auxiliary vibration module; the lever module comprises a plurality of levers arranged around the wind power tower, and the upper ends of the levers are connected with the wind power tower; the damping module comprises mass inertial dampers with the same number as the levers, and two ends of the mass inertial dampers are respectively connected with the lower ends of the levers and the platform; the auxiliary vibration module comprises a support rod assembly and a supporting mechanism, wherein the support rod assembly comprises support rods which are the same in number as the levers and are provided with protruding parts, and the protruding parts are hinged with the lever body parts; the supporting mechanism is arranged on the wind power platform and is fixedly connected with the supporting rod. The method is used for assembling the offshore wind power tower. The novel wind power tower structure provided by the invention can adapt to more complex wind, wave and current coupling and earthquake actions, and can improve the current situations of poor vibration resistance and the like of the existing offshore wind power structure.

title_en: Fixing frame and fixing device for vertical pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bus installation, in particular to a vertical pipeline fixing frame and a fixing device. The fixing device for the vertical pipeline comprises a pair of fixing frames, wherein the pair of fixing frames are oppositely arranged in the horizontal direction and form a space for clamping and restraining the vertical pipeline, the fixing frames comprise fixing supports for fixedly connecting with a wall body, a pair of centering arms are arranged on the fixing supports at intervals in the horizontal direction perpendicular to the wall body, at least one of the pair of centering arms is movably arranged on the fixing supports in the direction towards and away from the other, and the movable centering arms are provided with locking structures for being locked on the fixing supports after clamping and restraining the vertical pipeline.

title_en: Gas-liquid supercharging actuating mechanism
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of supercharging equipment, in particular to a gas-liquid supercharging executing mechanism. The device comprises a cylinder body, a booster cylinder, a gas-liquid storage tank, a piston rod, an output shaft, a first piston and a second piston, and a first accommodating cavity, a second accommodating cavity, a third accommodating cavity and a fourth accommodating cavity are formed. The piston rod, the first piston and the pressurizing piston are connected; the second piston is connected with the output shaft. The first accommodating cavity, the second accommodating cavity and the third accommodating cavity are communicated with an air source through an air source pipeline, and an electromagnetic valve is arranged on the air source pipeline; the pressurizing cylinder is communicated with the upper end of the gas-liquid storage tank through a first pressurizing pipeline; the top of the air source and the air-liquid storage tank are communicated through a second pressurizing pipeline, and the first reversing valve is also arranged on the second pressurizing pipeline; the bottom ends of the fourth accommodating cavity and the gas-liquid storage tank are communicated through a hydraulic oil pipeline, and a second reversing valve is arranged on the hydraulic oil pipeline; the first reversing valve and the second reversing valve are controlled by a controller. Through the arrangement, the valve opening and closing can be quickly completed.

title_en: Method for handling gear failure, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a gear-shifting fault processing method, a vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the gear-shifting fault processing method comprises the steps of responding to a gear-shifting instruction of a target gear, controlling a target gear-shifting operation assembly corresponding to the target gear to execute corresponding gear-shifting operation, and judging whether the target gear-shifting operation assembly has gear-shifting faults or not; and if the target gear-shifting operation assembly is determined to have a gear-shifting fault, controlling the target hydraulic oil mechanism to alternately change the pressure applied by the target hydraulic oil mechanism to the first piston block, so that the first piston block pushes a target piston rod in the target gear-shifting operation assembly to repeatedly impact the second piston block, and correcting the second piston block when the second piston block turns on one's side. The first piston block and the second piston block are respectively abutted to two ends of the target piston rod, and the second piston block is used for pushing the target piston rod in the process of hanging the target gear operation assembly to the target gear. The method can solve the problem of gear engaging faults caused by side turning of the piston block.

title_en: Flow stopping device for water supply equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow stopping device for water supply equipment, which comprises a bearing base, a power collecting mechanism and a hand-operated generator, wherein a water supply main body is fixedly arranged at the top of the bearing base, a water pipe is connected to the right side wall of the water supply main body, a flange plate is fixedly connected to the end part of the water pipe, and the power collecting mechanism is communicated with the water pipe through the flange plate. This a flow stopping device for water supply equipment can drive the connecting rod through the metal regulation pole and reciprocate to drive the manger plate piece and go up and down, utilize the manger plate piece to shelter from the tip of inlet tube and realize stopping, the intensity of cubic sealing member is higher, the joint gap is less, the flow stopping effect of device has been improved, and collect rivers power through power collection mechanism, turn power into electric energy through hand generator again, in order to supply water main part emergency use, simultaneously, be provided with damper, through the cooperation use of rubber pad, shock attenuation telescopic cylinder and attenuator, can cushion vibrations.

title_en: Integral jacket heat-insulating fire-retarding breather valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated jacket heat-insulating fire-retarding breather valve, which relates to the technical field of breather valves and comprises a shell unit, a fire retarding unit, a valve seat and a valve seat, wherein the fire retarding unit comprises a fire retarding seat arranged on a shell part, a fire retarding air passage arranged on the fire retarding seat and a fire retarding disk arranged between the fire retarding seat and the shell part; and the breathing unit comprises a ventilation end arranged at the shell part, a first conical valve core component, a second conical valve core component and a protective valve core component which is rotatably arranged on the top cover and connected with the second conical valve core component. The valve disc of the integrated jacket heat-insulating fire-retarding breather valve adopts a conical design, so that the change of air pressure can be timely felt when air flows pass through, the sensitivity of the breather valve is improved, meanwhile, the arrangement of the conical valve core assembly I and the conical valve core assembly II can greatly improve the operating pressure range of the storage tank, the phenomenon of leakage caused by overhigh air pressure is avoided, and illegal discharge of VOCs and nitrogen seal gas in the storage tank where the breather valve is located is effectively reduced.

title_en: Low-frequency broadband acoustic impedance mismatch muffler for liquid pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-frequency broadband acoustic impedance mismatch muffler for a liquid pipeline, which comprises the following components: the sound-absorbing device comprises an outer cylinder, a sound-absorbing inner runner, an elastic resonant cavity and an acoustic impedance mismatch layer; the silencing inner runner is arranged in the outer cylinder and comprises an inner runner pipe wall and a supporting framework, the inner runner pipe wall is provided with a cavity diameter opening, and the supporting framework is coated with an elastic wall surface; the elastic resonant cavity is arranged at a cavity diameter opening of the inner runner pipe wall and is used for low-frequency broadband noise elimination; the acoustic impedance mismatch layer is arranged outside the elastic wall surface and is used for silencing the middle and low frequency bands in a broadband manner; the elastic resonant cavity comprises a first layer cavity, a second layer cavity and a cavity diameter. The invention creatively invents a pressure self-adaptive low-frequency broadband acoustic impedance mismatch silencing structure by utilizing the combination of the inner wall acoustic impedance adjustment and the elastic resonance, realizes low-frequency silencing of a small-size structure, and can meet multiple requirements of silencing and pressure resistance of an aqueous medium pipeline.

title_en: Barrel type damper
abstract_en: The invention provides a cylinder type damper, and belongs to the technical field of dampers. The invention comprises the following steps: a housing; a rotor assembly provided in the housing and rotatable therein; the rotor of the rotor assembly is provided with two tangential planes, and the tangential planes are provided with oil holes; convex ribs are arranged on the outer wall of the rotating shaft in the shell; when the rotor rotates relative to the shell, the protruding ribs and the oil passing holes pass through the oil to shear damping oil to generate vortex, so that a force value is generated. According to the invention, the oil passing hole is formed in the tangential plane of the rotor, the convex rib is arranged in the shell, and the convex rib and the oil passing hole are used for shearing damping oil to generate vortex, so that a force value is generated, potential energy generated by the vortex is relatively small, the strength of the vortex is reduced, the energy loss is reduced, and meanwhile, the heat generated by rotation is reduced, so that the force value is more stable and the distribution is more uniform.

title_en: Preparation method of vortex-preventing rotation stopper
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of anti-swirl, in particular to a preparation method of an anti-swirl device; comprises a rotation stop main body, an extension bar and a stress application bar; the rotation stopper main body is arranged right above a water outlet pipe below the bottom surface of the water tank; the top center of the rotation stopper main body is fixedly connected with the lower end of the extension rod; the top of the extension rod is inserted with a stress application rod, and the upper end of the stress application rod is fixedly connected with the top surface of the water tank; a pump is arranged at the water outlet pipe; when the pump set works, the vortex is generated at the water outlet pipe at the bottom surface of the water tank and air is mixed into the pump set; the vibration noise of the pump set is increased, and even the pump is damaged.

title_en: BIM-model-based height-adjusting type remote safety monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of construction management monitoring equipment, in particular to a height-adjusting type remote safety monitoring device based on a BIM model, which comprises a rotating unit provided with a camera, wherein the rotating unit is positioned below a cleaning unit and can move along the vertical direction, the bottom of the cleaning unit is provided with a cleaning part which vertically penetrates through the rotating unit and faces the camera, when the camera is in a monitoring state, the rotating unit is positioned at a lower stop position, the rotating unit drives the camera to rotate around a designated rotating direction, a spacing gap is reserved between the camera and the cleaning part in the vertical direction, the camera reversely rotates to enable the camera to ascend and approach the cleaning part in the process of switching the camera from the monitoring state to the cleaning state, and when the camera is switched to the cleaning state, the cleaning part of the cleaning unit is contacted with the camera, and the rotating unit drives the camera to continue rotating and ascend to the upper stop position. The invention enables the cleaning part to effectively clean the camera.

title_en: Aerial survey laser ranging device for unmanned aerial vehicle mounting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser ranging and discloses a aerial survey laser ranging device for mounting an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine body and is characterized in that a support plate is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the machine body, a sleeve is connected to the lower surface of the support plate in a sliding manner, a sliding column is connected to the inner wall of the sleeve in a sliding manner, a first spring is connected to the outer wall of the sliding column in a sliding manner, a connecting shaft is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the connecting block, a first support shaft is rotatably connected to the outer wall of the connecting shaft, a damping plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the first support shaft, and a second spring is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the second support shaft. The sleeve slides on the lower surface of the support plate to enable the first spring to slide, the first spring is used for relieving impact caused by vibration, meanwhile, the sliding column is used for downwards pressing the second spring, and the second spring is compressed under the support of the second support shaft, so that the effects of improving the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, reducing the flight risk and ensuring safe and efficient aerial survey task execution can be achieved through relieving the vibration.

title_en: Hydraulic system and chamber filter press
