abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydraulic system and a chamber filter press, belonging to the technical field of hydraulic pressure, and comprising an oil supply system and an oil cylinder, wherein the oil cylinder comprises a cylinder body, a cooling jacket is arranged outside the cylinder body, a cooling cavity is arranged between the cooling jacket and the cylinder body, a cooling medium is arranged in the cooling cavity, and the volume of the cooling medium is smaller than that of the cooling cavity; the cylinder body is fixedly provided with a connecting sleeve at the bottom, the connecting sleeve stretches into the buffering cavity and is in sliding fit with the side wall of the buffering cavity, and a spring is arranged between the bottom walls of the connecting sleeve; the buffer cavity is connected with an air inlet one-way valve and a liquid discharge one-way valve, the air inlet one-way valve is communicated with the cooling cavity through a first hose, and the liquid discharge one-way valve is communicated with the cooling cavity through a second hose. The hydraulic oil cooling device does not need to be provided with power equipment, has low operation cost, can cool hydraulic oil, can play a good role in buffering and damping, has a simple structure, and is easy to produce and manufacture.

title_en: Reference air chamber for laser gas detector and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reference air chamber for a laser gas detector and a preparation method thereof in the field of laser gas detectors, wherein the reference air chamber consists of an air chamber cavity, a light-passing window sheet, a gas injection through pipe, a first sealing layer, a second sealing layer, a filling layer, a third sealing layer and an outer protective sleeve; the reference air chamber is prepared by welding and fixing the air chamber cavity, the light-passing window sheet and the air injection through pipe together in a heating and melting mode to form a structure with only one air injection port left unsealed and other parts sealed, so that the sealing difficulty is reduced, and the reference air chamber is prepared in a three-layer sealing mode after the air to be detected is filled. The invention solves the problems of the existing reference air chamber, can prepare the reference air chamber which is airtight for a long time, ensures that the prepared reference air chamber has better tightness, reliability, safety and practicability, can be used for a long time, has no pollution, no toxicity and no maintenance, and reduces the potential safety hazard in the process of preparing and using the reference air chamber.

title_en: Hydraulic oil filter equipment for hydraulic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic oil filtering device for hydraulic equipment, which belongs to the technical field of hydraulic equipment and comprises a bearing shell and a bottom connecting cover, wherein the bottom connecting cover is clamped at the bottom of the bearing shell, a plurality of oil outlet pipes and oil inlet pipes are respectively communicated with the bearing shell, an outer filter element is fixedly connected to the inside of the bearing shell, an outer protruding bearing pipe is integrally formed at the bottom of the bottom connecting cover, an auxiliary filtering structure is movably connected to the inside of the outer protruding bearing pipe, a filtering assisting barrel can gradually float upwards according to the blocking condition of the outer filter element, and alarm indication of different stages is realized by matching a magnetic suction connecting sheet and a magnetic suction alarm switch in the upward floating process, so that the blocking condition inside the bearing shell can be more intuitively observed.

title_en: Bridge beam detection device with counterweight mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of bridge beam detection, in particular to a bridge beam detection device with a counterweight mechanism. The device comprises a moving assembly, wherein a limiting assembly is arranged at one end of the moving assembly, a counterweight assembly is arranged on one side wall of the moving assembly, a detection assembly is arranged on one side wall, far away from the counterweight assembly, of the moving assembly, and the detection assembly comprises a second connecting plate and an elastic plate; according to the invention, the distance detection is carried out through the distance sensor, when the surface of the bridge has the convex and concave conditions, the elastic plate is initially adjusted according to the numerical value transmitted by the distance sensor, and then the elastic plate is driven to carry out bending angle adjustment, so that the accurate effect of the numerical value is improved; when the damage condition appears on the bridge surface, drive the mounting disc and remove to directly over the damage mouth, start the air bag structure later and fill spacing detection to the damage mouth, improved the detection effect of device.

title_en: Exhaust valve of vortex refrigeration compressor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exhaust valve of a vortex refrigeration compressor, relates to the technical field of refrigeration vortex compressors, and particularly relates to an exhaust valve of a vortex refrigeration compressor with high horsepower and high pressure ratio. The valve seat is arranged in a counter bore of the fixed vortex; the valve plate is arranged at the upper part of the valve seat and is fixed in the counter bore through the clamp spring, and meanwhile, the valve seat is encapsulated in the counter bore; the cylindrical surface B at the lower end of the cover plate is inserted into the counter bore and fixed on the fixed vortex by a screw; the spring is sleeved on the cylindrical surface B and is pressed on the upper surface B of the valve plate. The technical scheme of the invention solves the problems that the exhaust valve is correspondingly increased in size due to the increase of the area of the exhaust hole of the exhaust volume in the prior art, and the exhaust valve is installed close to the vortex teeth, so that a large-range thinner area is generated on the core part of the vortex back plate, and large downward bending deformation is generated under the action of high pressure; meanwhile, the clearance volume of the vortex cavity is reduced, the volumetric efficiency of the vortex plate is improved, and the energy efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-power charging pile liquid cooling cable and charging gun head adapter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy automobile charging equipment, in particular to a high-power charging pile liquid cooling cable and a charging gun head adapter, wherein the liquid cooling cable comprises an outer sheath and an inner sheath, and the outer sheath and the inner sheath are concentrically arranged; the direct current anode conductor, the direct current cathode conductor, the communication cable conductor and the grounding cable conductor are arranged in the inner sheath, insulating layers are arranged outside the direct current anode conductor and the direct current cathode conductor in a surrounding mode, a plurality of cavities are formed in the insulating layers, an anode cooling pipe is arranged in the cavity of the insulating layer outside the direct current anode conductor, and a cathode cooling pipe is arranged in the cavity of the insulating layer outside the direct current cathode conductor; the outer sheath is internally provided with a first cavity and a second cavity, the first cavity is internally provided with a positive electrode return pipe, and the second cavity is internally provided with a negative electrode return pipe. The high-power charging pile liquid cooling cable provided by the invention has high heat dissipation efficiency and light weight, and is suitable for use in a low-temperature environment.

title_en: Eccentric extrusion enhancement type magnetorheological clutch
abstract_en: The invention discloses an eccentric extrusion enhanced magnetorheological clutch, which comprises an input shaft, an output shaft and a shell, wherein the end part of the input shaft extends into the shell, the input shaft is connected with one side end wall of the shell through a bearing, and the output shaft is fixedly connected with the other side end wall of the shell; the housing is internally provided with a containing cavity, magnetorheological fluid and an eccentric rotor are arranged in the containing cavity, the eccentric rotor is in transmission connection with the input shaft, the axis of the eccentric rotor is parallel to and is not coincident with the axis of the containing cavity, and a coil is arranged in the eccentric rotor. The invention has the advantages that: when the eccentric rotor rotates, the eccentric rotor and the inner wall of the extrusion cylinder form a wedge-shaped convergence of a stable gap, so that extrusion force on the inner wall of the extrusion accommodating cavity is enhanced; in addition, in the extrusion process, the extrusion gap is reduced, so that the flux linkage is compressed into a body-centered cubic structure from a uniform flux linkage, the output moment is comprehensively improved by two extrusion strengthening effects, and the moment/mass ratio of the magnetorheological clutch is effectively improved on the premise of unchanged volume.

title_en: Face identification dormitory entrance guard looks into dormitory device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a face recognition dormitory entrance guard sleeping device which comprises a machine body and is characterized in that a camera is fixedly arranged on the machine body, a fixing groove corresponding to the camera is formed in the machine body, two plugboards are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the side wall of the camera, two limiting grooves corresponding to the plugboards are symmetrically formed in the side wall of the fixing groove, the two plugboards are slidably arranged in the two limiting grooves, third springs are fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the two limiting grooves, limiting mechanisms corresponding to the plugboards are arranged in the two limiting grooves, a cleaning mechanism corresponding to the camera is further arranged on the machine body, and a plurality of fixing plates are fixedly arranged on the side walls of the two sides of the machine body. The invention can quickly clean dust on the camera, ensure the face recognition effect of the camera, quickly detach the camera, facilitate maintenance and replacement, and avoid the need of detaching the whole machine of the equipment.

title_en: Diaphragm valve
abstract_en: The application relates to a diaphragm valve, and relates to the technical field of fluid pipeline accessories. The valve comprises a valve box, a valve body and a first diaphragm, wherein a first flow path and a second flow path are respectively arranged at an inlet and an outlet of the valve box, a valve seat is arranged between the first flow path and the second flow path, a diffuser part is arranged in the valve box, and the inner diameter of the diffuser part gradually expands along the direction of the first flow path towards the valve seat; the valve body comprises a seat part and a guide vane part, the seat part is positioned at one side of the valve seat, which is far away from the first flow path, the guide vane part is connected with one end of the seat part, which faces the valve seat, the outer diameter of the guide vane part gradually expands along the direction of the first flow path towards the seat part, and the flow path cross section between the valve seat and the seat part corresponds to the flow path cross section of the first flow path and the second flow path under the state that the valve body is separated from the valve seat; the first diaphragm is coupled between the valve housing and the valve body. The application has the effects of improving the problem of pressure loss increase caused by turbulence in a valve box and inhibiting the reduction of fluid flow.

title_en: Vertical length measuring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of substation construction auxiliary equipment, in particular to a vertical length measuring device which comprises a first adjusting seat, a second adjusting seat and a base; a U-shaped frame is arranged on the first adjusting seat, a mounting seat is arranged at the top end of the inner side of the U-shaped frame, a damping rotating shaft is fixed on the mounting seat, a mounting notch is formed in one end of the mounting seat, and an infrared laser range finder is arranged at the inner side of the mounting notch; the outer end of the damping rotating shaft is provided with a pointer along the radial direction of the damping rotating shaft, and the U-shaped frame is provided with angle scales; a first linear driving mechanism is arranged between the first adjusting seat and the second adjusting seat; the base is arranged below the second adjusting seat, and a second linear driving mechanism is arranged between the second adjusting seat and the base; a plurality of universal wheels are arranged below the base; the first adjusting seat is provided with an inclination angle sensor. The invention can realize the measurement work of high point positions, and has the advantages of small volume, convenient movement and accurate measurement.

title_en: Dense embedded elastic porous throttling air bearing
abstract_en: The invention provides a dense embedded elastic porous throttling air bearing which comprises an outer sleeve, a main shaft, a thrust disc, front and rear thrust shoes arranged on two sides of the thrust disc and separated by an adjusting ring, a radial bearing bush integrally designed with the rear thrust shoe, a thrust bearing elastic local porous throttler densely embedded in the thrust shoe, a radial bearing elastic local porous throttler densely embedded in the bearing bush, and front and rear end covers. The thrust bearing and the radial bearing elastic local porous throttler are both made of elastic porous materials, are of circular sheet structures with smaller diameters, can generate elastic bending deformation in the space range of the static pressure cavity under the action of pressure difference at two sides, provide additional damping for a bearing system, and do not change the size of a bearing gap. The invention further improves the bearing capacity, rigidity and high-speed stability of the porous throttling air bearing on the premise of ensuring high rotation precision, and greatly reduces the preparation, processing and assembly difficulties of the porous material.

title_en: Multi-stage motion connecting rod assembly for continuous stamping in hardware forging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage motion connecting rod assembly for continuous stamping in hardware forging, which relates to the technical field of hardware forging, and aims at setting a connecting rod assembly in a passive form for continuous stamping action, in particular to 'connecting' an upper moving shaft and a lower moving shaft through the passive assembly, wherein in the stamping action, the multistage motion connecting rod assembly comprises kinetic energy graded motions in two directions, and the multistage motion connecting rod assembly is different from a conventional buffer protection form in that: the hydraulic pressure based on lubricating oil medium in the overall structure to the reaction force in the punching press action is "kinetic energy" and directly feeds back in the kinetic energy dish, cooperates the kinetic energy dish and drives unrestrained board or the unrestrained board of going up and carry out non-directional motion, its aim at: the motion forms of the upper wave plate, the lower wave plate and the kinetic energy disk are matched to promote the flowing process of the lubricating oil medium in the upper wave plate, the lower wave plate and the kinetic energy disk, the lubricating oil medium directly bears the reaction force, the damage of the reaction force to the upper moving shaft and the lower moving shaft is reduced, and the stamping device is applicable to stamping actions of different degrees.

title_en: Vibration damping device with composite material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vibration reduction and damping, and discloses a vibration reduction and damping device with a composite material. The invention discloses a vibration reduction damping device with a composite material, which comprises a composite vibration reduction ring, wherein the composite vibration reduction ring comprises a ring-shaped hard inner ring, a soft vibration reduction layer is fully and hermetically wrapped outside the hard inner ring, and a glue layer is coated between the soft vibration reduction layer and the hard inner ring; the inside of the hard inner ring is provided with a gap, and the gap is filled with soft materials. By utilizing the composite material, the superior performance of the soft and hard materials is fully exerted, the performance short plate of the soft and hard materials is avoided, the requirements of rigidity, damping, frequency and temperature resistance and service life required by the vibration damping device are met, and the performance is stable in the whole service life cycle. The invention solves the technical problem of providing the vibration damping device with the composite material, which has high vibration damping capacity, strong damping and strong rigidity.

title_en: Mapping method for construction engineering cost
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mapping method for construction engineering cost, which relates to the technical field of engineering cost mapping, and comprises the steps of irradiating a bottom surface by utilizing a laser lamp, observing whether the three support plates and discs are located on a mapping place or not, then starting a motor, driving a sliding sleeve to move vertically downwards, driving the three support plates and the discs to be unfolded by a hinged plate, increasing the contact area with soil by the unfolded three discs, avoiding sinking and tilting of a mapping device, and pressing a supporting tube downwards before starting the motor to drive the three inner arc plates to move outwards radially, and then starting the motor.

title_en: System and method for locking an operating position of a valve
abstract_en: The method of controlling the valve may comprise monitoring the electrical power supplied to the valve and/or monitoring the pneumatic pressure supplied to the valve. In the event of a failure of electrical and/or pneumatic pressure, the operating position of the valve may remain in its final position and/or be moved to a fail-safe position. Whether the valve position is maintained or moved to a fail-safe position may be independent of or dependent on the position of the valve and/or the position error of the valve.

title_en: Integrated additive manufacturing method for improving damping performance of magnesium alloy thin wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated additive manufacturing method for improving the damping performance of a magnesium alloy thin wall, which comprises the steps of forming the thin wall with a closed cavity through selective laser melting, improving the damping performance of the magnesium alloy thin wall through powder retention in the cavity in the manufacturing process, optimizing the structural parameters of the cavity by combining a thin wall-particle dynamics model, an optimization algorithm and the like, and guiding the structural design of the cavity. The thin-wall magnesium alloy is integrally formed, has no defects of pore, inclusion, crack and the like on the surface structure, can also be used for customizing and manufacturing the thin-wall internal cavity structure, and provides greater freedom for structural design of the component. Meanwhile, the powder retained in the thin-wall cavity can effectively avoid the influence of external environment on the service life of the particles, has stronger fatigue service performance and has good application prospect.

title_en: Grain depot door and window gas tightness check out test set
abstract_en: The invention discloses grain depot door and window air tightness detection equipment, which relates to the technical field of air tightness detection and comprises an air inlet connector, wherein the air inlet connector is used for connecting an air pipe and is used as an air jet in the air tightness detection, a movable seal is arranged at the air jet of the air inlet connector, a sealing piece comprises a first baffle bar and a second baffle bar, a wall body and a door frame or a window frame and the door frame, the door frame and the door frame or the window frame and a window plate are respectively attached in the air tightness detection process, and meanwhile, liquid seal rings are arranged on the first baffle bar and the second baffle bar to seal gaps.

title_en: Longitudinally arranged speed variator
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of speed changers, and provides a longitudinally-arranged speed changer. The longitudinal transmission comprises a hydraulic torque converter, a main driving gear and a gear shifting mechanism, wherein a turbine of the hydraulic torque converter is in driving connection with the main driving gear, the main driving gear is in driving connection with an input shaft of the gear shifting mechanism, and an output shaft of an engine is in driving connection with a pump wheel of the hydraulic torque converter. According to the longitudinal transmission provided by the application, when a vehicle using the longitudinal transmission starts, the pump wheel drives the turbine to rotate through liquid, the rotation speed of the turbine is slowly increased, the starting of a clutch is not needed, and the overheat of the clutch is avoided.

title_en: Bone carrier for tibia
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tibia carrying equipment, and particularly relates to a bone carrier for tibia, which comprises a support frame, wherein one end of the support frame is provided with an upper attaching frame, the other end of the support frame is provided with a lower attaching frame, and the support frame is provided with a synchronous adjusting device for adjusting the upper attaching frame and the lower attaching frame; the output ends of the upper attaching frame and the lower attaching frame are connected with an installing frame, and the installing frame is detachably connected with a fixed bone needle; the lifting carrying frame is arranged on the supporting frame, and carrying spicules which are in sliding connection with the supporting frame are arranged on the carrying frame; the lower attaching frame comprises a lower driving rod and a lower driven rod which are rotationally connected with the supporting frame, and the other end of the lower driving rod is rotationally connected with a parallel rod which is rotationally connected with the lower driven rod; the lower driven rod is coaxially and fixedly connected with a large gear, and a small gear is meshed with the large gear; the invention effectively solves the problem that the moment for fixing the connection point of the bone needle and the tibia is larger when the existing bone carrier is used.

title_en: BIM-based movable auxiliary supporting platform for building design construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building design construction supporting platforms, and discloses a movable auxiliary supporting platform for building design construction based on BIM, wherein a lifting groove drives a rotating shaft to lift through a lifting mechanism, a special gear is arranged on the rotating shaft, the special gear is used for being converted into a vertical state from a transverse state after a display extends out of a protecting groove, the operation of the user is convenient, and the building design drawing is watched, after the operation, the display screen is lowered and turned to be in a parallel state, so that the front side of the display screen is downward, the display screen can be well protected, and damage to the display screen caused by false touch of a complex environment of a building construction site is avoided.

title_en: Carbon dioxide pressurizing system and carbon dioxide pressurizing method
abstract_en: The application discloses a carbon dioxide pressurizing system and a carbon dioxide pressurizing method, and belongs to the technical field of pipeline transportation. In the system, the multistage booster compressor boosts gaseous carbon dioxide for a plurality of times until the liquefied pressure of the carbon dioxide is reached, and heat generated by the pressurized gaseous carbon dioxide is transferred to the absorption refrigerator for heat exchange through the first heat exchange system. When the liquefaction pressure is reached, the multistage booster compressor transfers heat generated by the gaseous carbon dioxide reaching the liquefaction pressure to the absorption refrigerator through the second heat exchange system for heat exchange. And the second heat exchange system cools the gaseous carbon dioxide to obtain liquid carbon dioxide, the liquid carbon dioxide is conveyed to the pressurizing system, and the pressurizing system pressurizes the liquid carbon dioxide to the supercritical pressure. The system can cool the carbon dioxide by absorbing heat generated by pressurizing the carbon dioxide through the absorption refrigerator, does not need to additionally input energy, and can greatly reduce energy consumption.

title_en: Safety protection device for gaseous hydrogen storage device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety protection device for a gaseous hydrogen storage device, which relates to the field of hydrogen storage device protection and comprises a hydrogen storage device and a protection system, wherein the hydrogen storage device comprises an inner container and a carbon fiber shell, the protection system comprises an inner protection component, an outer protection component and an air pump, the carbon fiber shell is wrapped on the outer side of the inner container, the inner container is of a double-layer hollow structure, the inner protection component is arranged between the inner container and the carbon fiber shell, the outer protection component is arranged on the outer side of the hydrogen storage device, the inner protection component and the outer protection component are respectively connected with the air pump, the inner protection component is used for buffering the inner container and monitoring the state of the inner container when the hydrogen storage device collides, and the outer protection component is used for buffering the outer collision of the hydrogen storage device and protecting the hydrogen storage device from falling and toppling. The invention can provide collision protection and hot-pressing protection for the hydrogen storage device, and can balance the internal pressure at the same time, thereby improving the safety.

title_en: Light wheeled excavator with anti-resonance function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of excavators, in particular to a light wheel type excavator with an anti-resonance function, which comprises a chassis with tires and a connecting turntable arranged at the top of the chassis, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the connecting turntable, a cab and a movable arm are arranged on the left and right sides of the upper surface of the supporting plate in parallel, a bucket rod is hinged at the front end of the movable arm, a bucket is hinged at the front end of the bucket rod, and a rotation buffer mechanism and a support buffer mechanism are arranged on the upper surface of the chassis. This light-duty wheeled excavator with prevent resonance function, through setting up rotation buffer gear, be convenient for slow down the vibration that light-duty wheeled excavator produced in the rotation process, the elasticity that makes the expansion spring take place deformation to produce through rotating keeps apart vibration source and structure, reduces the transmission of vibration to absorb the vibration of specific frequency, avoid producing resonance, can also avoid the expansion spring to be in tensile state for a long time under driving motor's effect simultaneously, influence expansion spring's life, thereby improve damping efficiency.

title_en: Double valve plug gas electromagnetic valve
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-valve plug gas electromagnetic valve, which comprises an electromagnetic coil set, a fixed iron core, a first movable iron core, a second movable iron core, a main valve plug, an auxiliary valve plug and a valve opening part, wherein when the electromagnetic coil set is electrified, magnetic force can be generated to drive the first movable iron core and the second movable iron core to move towards the fixed iron core so as to respectively open the main valve plug and the auxiliary valve plug. The main valve plug and the auxiliary valve plug can slightly swing to doubly seal the valve port part, and even if the main valve plug and the auxiliary valve plug are relatively deviated from the valve port part due to machining tolerance or other reasons, the valve can be doubly tightly sealed to ensure that fuel gas cannot leak; in addition, the valve port part is provided with a detection hole for detecting whether fuel gas leaks relative to the position between the main valve plug and the auxiliary valve plug, so that whether the main valve plug and the auxiliary valve plug accurately close the valve port part is detected, and the safety is ensured.

title_en: Liquid carbon dioxide off-board system for ship
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a liquid carbon dioxide off-board system for a ship. The liquid carbon dioxide off-board system for a ship of the present invention comprises: the device comprises a sealing tank, a fixed frame, a positioning block, an injection interface, a hoisting structure and a monitoring system; the positioning block is arranged in the fixed frame, the sealing tank is arranged on the positioning block, and the injection interface is arranged on the sealing tank; the hoisting structure is arranged on the fixed frame and is used for being connected with external hoisting equipment; the monitoring system is arranged in the sealed tank and is used for monitoring the physical state and reserves of the liquid nitrogen dioxide in the tank. According to the liquid carbon dioxide off-ship system for ships, the tank box direct transfer mode is adopted to transfer the liquid carbon dioxide off-ship, so that the transfer efficiency is improved, and potential safety hazards caused by the fact that the pipeline is blocked by carbon dioxide due to pipeline bending can be avoided.

title_en: Viscous damper with variable damping strength and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a viscous damper with variable damping strength and a method thereof, comprising a cylinder, damping liquid sealed in the cylinder, a piston rod arranged in the cylinder, a centrally-arranged damping piston, two end pistons and two reset elastic pieces, wherein the damping liquid is filled in the cylinder; the piston rod moves towards one end, and the intermediate piston connected with the piston rod moves along with the piston rod, and the damping force is generated by viscous medium movement of a gap between the intermediate piston and the cylinder barrel. After the middle piston is contacted with the end piston, the middle piston and the end piston move together, which is equivalent to the increase of the width of the piston, the increase of viscous medium between the middle piston and the cylinder barrel, the increase of damping force generated by the movement of the viscous medium, the compression of the spring by the piston, the addition of spring force and the further increase of damping force. When the damping force adjusting device returns, the reset elastic piece can push the end piston to move and return to the initial position, the damping force can be adjusted in a self-adaptive mode according to the actual stress degree, the whole structure is stable, reliable and safe, and the multistage self-adaptive adjusting effect of the damping force is achieved.

title_en: Dynamic seal ring end face sealing mechanism and sealing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic seal ring end face sealing mechanism and a sealing method, wherein the dynamic seal ring end face sealing mechanism comprises a seal ring, an A seal body and a B seal body, a containing groove is formed in the A seal body, and the seal ring is movably arranged in the containing groove of the A seal body; a fluid channel is arranged in the sealing body, one end of the fluid channel is communicated with the accommodating groove, the other end of the fluid channel is communicated with a hydraulic or pneumatic control system outside the mechanism, so that the sealing ring is driven by fluid pressure, the sealing ring can move back and forth along the accommodating groove, one end of the sealing ring is a sealing end, the other end of the sealing ring is a fluid pressure driving end, the end face of the sealing end is a sealing surface, and the sealing surface is arranged corresponding to the sealing surface of the sealing body B; the space enclosed by the fluid pressure driving end and the A sealing body accommodating groove is a fluid pressure working cavity. When the B sealing body moves, the mutual abrasion of the sealing surfaces can be avoided, the service life of the sealing ring can be prolonged, and the moving resistance of the B sealing body can be reduced.

title_en: Low-temperature sealing ball valve device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-temperature sealing ball valve device, which comprises a spherical valve body, wherein the inner wall of the spherical valve body is rotationally connected with a hollow sphere, the inner wall of the hollow sphere is fixedly connected with an anti-blocking mechanism, the anti-blocking mechanism comprises a middle annular plate, both sides of the middle annular plate are fixedly connected with a reset spring, one end of the reset spring, which is far away from the middle annular plate, is fixedly connected with a sideslip annular plate, one side of the sideslip annular plate, which is far away from the reset spring, is fixedly connected with an annular arc piece, and the outer surface of the annular arc piece is provided with a side arc round hole.

title_en: Planet carrier for gearbox
abstract_en: A planet carrier (1) for a gearbox, in particular for a wind turbine, can receive a planet shaft (5), on which planet shaft (3) planet wheels are mounted, a sleeve (6) being arranged in a radial direction between the planet shaft (5) and the planet wheels (3). In order to be able to compensate irregularities in the teeth of the planet wheel (3) and to require as little installation space as possible for the planet carrier (1), it is proposed to arrange a lubricating layer between the sleeve (6) and the planet wheel (3).

title_en: Deepwater work resonance suppression device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deepwater work resonance suppression device, which belongs to the technical field of ocean engineering and comprises a hydraulic cylinder and an energy accumulator, wherein the hydraulic cylinder and the energy accumulator are connected with each other, a sealing plug is connected in a sliding manner in the hydraulic cylinder, the hydraulic cylinder is divided into a vacuum cavity and a hydraulic cavity by the sealing plug, hydraulic oil is arranged in the hydraulic cavity, one end of the sealing plug, which faces the hydraulic cavity, is fixedly connected with a hydraulic rod, one end of the hydraulic rod, which is far away from the sealing plug, is connected with equipment, a piston is arranged in the energy accumulator, the piston can slide relative to the energy accumulator, the energy accumulator is divided into an air cavity and an oil cavity by the piston, the oil cavity is communicated with the hydraulic cavity, and the air cavity is connected with an air storage component. The resonance suppression device disclosed by the invention can be used for rapidly and accurately suppressing possible resonance phenomena in deepwater operation by adjusting the rigidity of the operation system to enable the frequency of the operation system to be staggered from the natural frequency of the operation ship, so that the stability and the safety of the operation system are improved.

title_en: Multistage cylinder with high pressure rod stability and use method
abstract_en: The application relates to a multistage cylinder with high pressure rod stability and a use method thereof, wherein the multistage cylinder comprises the following steps: a cylinder base; the multi-stage cylinder barrel is sequentially arranged in a telescopic nested manner, one end of the outermost cylinder barrel is fixedly arranged on the cylinder seat, the innermost cylinder barrel is provided with a piston rod in a telescopic manner, and the end part of the innermost cylinder barrel is fixedly provided with a supporting piece; one end of the bending-resistant cylinder barrel is fixedly connected to the rod head of the piston rod, and the inner wall of the bending-resistant cylinder barrel and the supporting piece slide relatively; when the multi-stage cylinder barrel is completely contracted, the bending-resistant cylinder barrel is sleeved outside the outermost cylinder barrel; when the multistage cylinder is fully extended, the bending-resistant cylinder is sleeved outside the piston rod. According to the application, the bending stress born by the piston rod can be dispersed, and the effect of reinforcing the stability of the piston rod is achieved.

title_en: Cooling structure of bearing bush and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling structure of a bearing bush and a manufacturing process thereof, the cooling structure comprises a bearing bush main body, a coating and an inserting part, wherein the coating is covered on the inner wall of the bearing bush main body, the inserting part comprises an inserting rod and an inserting part main body, the inserting part main body is radially inserted into the coating along the coating, the inserting part main body is positioned on one side of the inner wall of the coating, the bearing bush main body is provided with a first through hole, the inserting rod penetrates through the coating and is inserted into the first through hole in an interference fit manner, the inserting part is provided with a second through hole, two ends of the second through hole are respectively communicated with a cavity of the first through hole and a cavity of the radial inner side of the coating, a one-way valve is arranged in the first through hole, the one-way valve is positioned on one side of the inserting rod far away from the coating, the allowable circulation direction of the one-way valve is radially outwards along the bearing bush main body, a plurality of through holes are uniformly distributed along the circumference of the bearing bush main body, and at least one through hole is used as an oil inlet. The invention provides a cooling structure of a bearing bush and a manufacturing process thereof, wherein cooling oil in the bearing bush is not easy to keep, and the working temperature of the bearing bush is reduced.

title_en: Self-adaptive vacuum time-delay reset valve
abstract_en: An adaptive vacuum delay reset valve, comprising a valve body, a valve seat, and a valve core assembly with an inner cavity. The top of the valve body is provided with an internal threaded through-hole, and the lower end is a mouthpiece through-hole connected to the upper open end of the valve seat; The valve core component is set inside the valve body, including an upper stop ring, rubber diaphragm, lower gasket, and pin. The top of the pin is equipped with an internal threaded blind hole, and the bottom is a grooved conical platform. The screw passes through the upper stop ring, rubber diaphragm, and lower gasket from top to bottom and is connected to the pin thread; The valve body includes an upper cover and a lower cover, with a vent hole on the lower cover. The rubber diaphragm is fixed between the upper and lower covers by bolts, and a compression spring is provided between the upper cover and the valve core assembly. The present invention can automatically adjust the delayed closing time of the vacuum diaphragm valve based on the negative pressure inside the vacuum pipeline, ensuring stable negative pressure at the end of the vacuum pipeline and maintaining the normal operation of the vacuum drainage system.

title_en: Strong-sealing full-welded bearing and welding process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a strong-seal full-welded bearing and a welding process thereof, wherein the bearing comprises an outer ring, a retainer and rolling bodies, the rolling bodies are arranged in the retainer, the bearing also comprises an inner ring and sealing elements, and the sealing elements are arranged at two sides of the bearing and are positioned between the outer ring and the inner ring; the bearing also comprises a baffle plate, and the baffle plate is arranged on one side of the bearing and is connected with the inner ring. Through setting up first notch on the inner race, rethread sets up first sealing part on the sealing member for the inner race with when the sealing member is joined in marriage first sealing part is in the axial of first notch is all adopted interference contact's mode with radial and is then realized sealed oil channeling prevention, improves sealing performance. The baffle plate is welded on the end face of the inner ring through the welding process, the baffle plate can block oil pressure on one side of the gear box, and the baffle plate rotates together with the inner ring and throws oil out when the inner ring rotates, so that lubrication failure caused by lubrication oil flowing out of a tool through a bearing is effectively prevented.

title_en: Bearing pedestal with sliding mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing seat with a sliding mechanism, which comprises a base, wherein two ends of the outer wall of one side of the base are fixedly connected with a first hollow frame, a first gear and a second gear can be connected in series through a gear belt, when a worker rotates a turntable, a second shaft core and the second gear can rotate along with the turntable, simultaneously, two groups of first gears and the first shaft core can also rotate along with the turntable, when a threaded rod rotates, a sliding block can move back and forth on the outer wall of the rotating threaded rod, simultaneously, a second bearing seat above a U-shaped platen and a movable roller can also move along with the movable roller, thereby playing a role of adjusting the distance between the fixed roller and the movable roller, playing a role of fixing the sliding block through the arrangement of a connecting structure between a long gear plate and a short gear plate, and when the long gear plate moves downwards and the tooth groove on the bottom surface of the short gear plate is separated from the gear convex groove, the sliding block can continue sliding, and the position of the movable roller can be adjusted.

title_en: Carrier brake assembly including adhesive layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carrier brake assembly including an adhesive layer. A vehicle brake assembly having a composite structure includes a brake core comprising an aluminum alloy defining a core surface, a thermal barrier layer comprising an insulating material, and an adhesion layer between the core surface and the thermal barrier layer to promote adhesion between the thermal barrier layer and the brake core. The adhesion layer comprises a metal. The vehicle brake assembly includes a wear layer on the thermal barrier layer. The wear layer comprises an iron-aluminum-silicon-zirconium alloy and defines a friction surface of the vehicle brake assembly.

title_en: Device for limiting lifting track of curtain wall plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for limiting a lifting track of a curtain wall plate, which comprises: the lifting assembly is arranged at the top of the top floor slab, and the track limiting assembly is arranged at the top of the ground. According to the invention, the first binding belt and the second binding belt are bound on the curtain wall body, the hook is hooked on the first binding belt, the hook pulley block on the surface of the second steel wire rope is hooked on the second binding belt, the steel wire rope is in a tensioning state through the winding of the second winding machine, the first winding machine winds the first steel wire rope, the curtain wall body is lifted through the hook, the two sides of the curtain wall body are limited by the second steel wire rope, the lifting can not float and rotate at will, the two steel wire ropes can determine the lifting and transporting track, the curtain wall is limited on the two steel wire ropes through the matching of the binding belt and the pulley block through the winch for lifting, the curtain wall transportation can not float and rotate, and the purposes of stabilizing and safety of curtain wall lifting are improved.

title_en: Ball screw pair with circulator embedded in outer circle of ball screw and circulation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ball screws, in particular to a ball screw pair with a circulator embedded in the outer circle of the ball screw and a circulation method thereof; the device comprises a ball screw, a screw nut and balls; a ball circulator is embedded on the outer circle of the ball screw; a spiral ball rolling way is arranged on the ball screw; a nut ball rolling way is arranged on the screw nut, and the nut ball rolling way is matched with the spiral ball rolling way; the ball circulator is provided with a ball raceway which spans two raceways adjacent to the spiral ball raceway and two raceway structures corresponding to the spiral ball raceway and a method thereof, so that occupied space of the ball screw pair on functional components such as a miniature electric cylinder, a power sliding table and the like can be greatly reduced, transmission efficiency of the miniature functional components is improved, and the effect of linear motion of the ball screw is realized through rotation of a nut.

title_en: Screw rod lifter with self-lubricating mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screw rod lifter with a self-lubricating mechanism, which is characterized in that an extruding ring which is linked with a threaded sleeve and moves up and down in a reciprocating manner and a communicating cavity which is arranged in the wall of a soaking cylinder are used for extruding lubricating oil in a matching manner by the extruding ring and a fixed column below the extruding ring when the screw rod lifter works, so that the lubricating oil circularly flows between the communicating cavity and the inner cavity of a rotating cylinder, the manual maintenance is reduced, the contact lubricating effect of the lubricating oil and the screw rod is improved, in addition, the circularly flowing lubricating oil fully absorbs the heat on the surface of the screw rod and brings the heat into the wall of the soaking cylinder, the efficient cooling is realized while the screw rod is fully lubricated, and the screw rod lifter with better cooling and lubricating effects for high-frequency lifting is realized.

title_en: Flexible transmission mechanism
abstract_en: Flexible drive mechanism belongs to drive mechanism field, includes: an input connection for connecting a drive device; an output connection for connecting a load device; the retainers are arranged between the input connecting piece and the output connecting piece at certain intervals; the two ends of the core ropes are respectively connected with the input connecting piece and the output connecting piece, and the main body of each core rope is connected with the plurality of retainers in series; the plurality of elastic members are connected between the input connecting member and the adjacent retainer, between the output connecting member and the adjacent retainer, and between the adjacent retainers by at least one elastic member. The flexible transmission mechanism realizes flexible transmission from the input connecting piece to the output connecting piece, reduces coaxiality requirements and machining precision requirements on the input connecting piece and the output connecting piece, can realize remote transmission by increasing the number of the retainers, has simple and compact integral structure, and can realize a larger load range.

title_en: Partition plate structure for double-layer direct-buried pipeline and construction method of double-layer direct-buried pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a partition plate structure for a double-layer direct-buried pipeline and a construction method of the double-layer direct-buried pipeline, wherein the partition plate structure for the double-layer direct-buried pipeline comprises two rows of support columns fixed on a foundation, the two rows of support columns extend along the length direction of a lower pipeline, the upper end of each support column is fixedly connected with the lower end of an elastic support piece, the upper end of each elastic support piece is connected with a support plate, the support plate is used for supporting an upper pipeline, and the elastic support piece is used for supporting the upper pipeline in the sedimentation process of the upper pipeline; and the support plate is used for supporting the support plate and the upper pipeline after the upper pipeline is settled and stabilized. The invention solves the protection problem of the parallel pipeline, can effectively isolate the upper pipeline from the lower pipeline, and prevents the upper pipeline and the lower pipeline from being pushed, thereby greatly improving the construction quality and shortening the construction time.

title_en: Isostatic pressing device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an isostatic pressing device and a forming method, wherein the forming device comprises a cylinder body, a sealing unit and a pressurizing cylinder, the pressurizing cylinder is connected with the sealing unit, the sealing unit is matched with the cylinder body, the pressurizing cylinder is used for driving the sealing unit to move in the cylinder body, the sealing unit comprises a sealing plug, an end cover, a first movable plate, a reset spring and a first sealing ring, and the interior of the first sealing ring is of a hollow structure; the sealing plug lower end face is provided with the mounting hole and is linked together with the mounting hole first cavity, and the sealing plug side is provided with first mounting groove, and first sealing washer fixed mounting is in the first mounting groove, first fly leaf sliding seal installs in first cavity, and the spring is located first cavity and is connected with first fly leaf, is provided with the connecting hole on the sealing plug, and the connecting hole is used for carrying out the intercommunication with first sealing washer and first cavity. The invention can solve the technical problem that the sealing between the cylinder body and the sealing plug is easy to lose efficacy in the prior art in actual use.

title_en: Mechanical anchor bolt
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mechanical anchor bolt, and belongs to the technical field of fasteners. The screw comprises a screw rod, a screw cap and a sleeve with an end part N1 and an end part N2, wherein the sleeve is sleeved on the screw rod, the end part N2 of the sleeve is provided with an expanding piece, a rod body of the screw rod is provided with a triggering piece, the triggering piece is configured to be abutted with the expanding piece, an embedding piece with a deformation arm and an embedding blade is arranged, the embedding piece is connected to the end part of the screw rod, and the deformation arm and the embedding blade are integrally formed. According to the technical scheme, the embedded locking mode is introduced, so that the fastening effect in the soft matrix material is improved. Compared with the traditional friction locking mode, the embedded locking mode does not depend on the strength or friction of the matrix material any more, but generates physical embedding and engagement with the hole wall directly through the embedded piece, so that a more stable fixing effect is provided.

title_en: Built-in double-mode chassis suspension damper for commercial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a built-in dual-mode chassis suspension damper for a commercial vehicle, which relates to the field of dampers and comprises the following components: an outer cylinder of the shock absorber; an oil sealing cover is arranged at the upper part of the outer cylinder of the shock absorber; a sealing oil seal is fixedly connected in the oil seal cover; the lower part of the sealing oil seal is provided with a shock absorber inner cylinder; a shock absorber bottom cover is arranged between the lower part of the shock absorber inner cylinder and the lower part of the shock absorber outer cylinder; a hollow connecting rod is connected in the inner cylinder of the shock absorber in a sliding way; the tail ends of the hollow connecting rods are fixedly connected with an installation seat; the mounting seat is connected in the inner cylinder of the shock absorber in a sliding way; the lower part of the mounting seat is connected with a piston sliding seat in a threaded manner; the shock-absorbing oil that spills can flow into and collect in the seat to make control floating plate float and let control kicking block extrude pressure switch, can start miniature audible and visual alarm and take place the warning after pressure switch receives the extrusion, solved when the oil blanket damages shock-absorbing oil can flow under pressure differential or the effect of vibration, through the clearance between oil blanket and the urceolus, form the problem of oil leak phenomenon.

title_en: High-temperature gate valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valves, in particular to a high-temperature gate valve, which comprises a valve body, wherein one side of the valve body is provided with a water inlet pipe, the other side of the valve body is provided with a water outlet pipe, a valve plate is arranged in the valve body, the valve plate is arranged between the water outlet pipe and the water inlet pipe and is used for controlling water inlet and outlet, and a valve cover is further arranged on the valve body and detachably connected with the valve body; the upper portion of valve gap is provided with the extension pipe, and extension pipe and valve gap an organic whole set up, still are provided with the valve rod on the valve gap, and the valve rod stretches into behind the extension pipe and valve plate fixed connection, and the valve rod rotates with the valve gap to be connected, corresponds the valve rod on the valve gap and is provided with the sealing seat, and the sealing seat is used for shutoff medium. The distance between the adjusting end of the valve rod and the valve body is heightened, heat conduction to the adjusting end of the valve rod can be reduced by increasing the heat conduction distance, so that the temperature of the end part of the valve rod is increased, the adjusting condition is influenced, meanwhile, the condition that a high-temperature medium flows out can be reduced by lengthening the main seal, the safety coefficient is further improved, and the condition that the valve is influenced by opening and closing is reduced.

title_en: Ship electrical equipment installation fixing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship electrical equipment installation fixing device, and relates to the field of equipment installation. The invention comprises a support frame and electrical equipment, wherein the support frame is provided with a moving mechanism, a fixing mechanism and a fastening mechanism, and the moving mechanism comprises a driving assembly and a limiting assembly; the driving assembly comprises a moving plate arranged on the inner wall of a supporting frame, a sliding groove is formed in the supporting frame, sliding rails are fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the moving plate, the inner wall of the sliding groove is in sliding connection with the sliding rails, pulleys are fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the moving plate, a threaded rod penetrates through the supporting frame in a rotating mode, the threaded rod extends to the inner portion of the moving plate in a sliding mode, an inner thread block is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the moving plate, and threads of the threaded rod penetrate through the inner thread block. By arranging the fixing mechanism, the invention effectively prevents loosening and deviation possibly occurring in the transportation of the ship and further improves the clamping reliability.

title_en: Electrical conversion device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrical conversion device, which belongs to the technical field of electrical conversion devices for valve positioners and comprises a fixed seat, a fixed magnetic path generating assembly, a control magnetic path generating assembly and a magnetic control elastic movable piece, wherein the fixed magnetic path generating assembly is fixed on the fixed seat to form a fixed magnetic field, the control magnetic path generating assembly comprises a control magnetic path assembly and a control coil, the control magnetic path assembly is fixed on the fixed seat, the control coil is wound on the control magnetic path assembly to form a control magnetic field, a magnetic field plane of the control magnetic field is perpendicular to a magnetic field plane of the fixed magnetic field, and the magnetic control elastic movable piece is positioned in an assembly hole and comprises an elastic piece and a magnetic assembly piece fixed on the elastic piece. The magnetic control elastic movable piece, the fixed magnetic path component and the control magnetic path component are connected into a magnetic path, so that the elastic sheet can be elastically twisted under the action of corresponding magnetic force to drive the magnetic assembly to rotate out of the assembly hole to seal the nozzle, and the aim of accurately regulating and controlling the opening of the valve hole of the nozzle is fulfilled.

title_en: Fan blade lifting appliance based on offshore fan unit
abstract_en: The application discloses a fan blade lifting appliance based on an offshore fan unit, which comprises a clamping assembly and an adjusting assembly, wherein the clamping assembly comprises a clamping box and a plurality of clamping base members, a fixing plate is arranged in the clamping box, the clamping base members are respectively and independently arranged at two sides of the clamping box, the clamping base members penetrate through the side wall of the clamping box and extend into the clamping box and are detachably connected with the adjusting assembly arranged in the clamping box, the clamping base members are used for clamping a fan blade, the adjusting assembly can control the clamping base members to freely move on the clamping box in the same or opposite directions, the adjusting assembly comprises a conveying member, a hydraulic barrel and a fixing barrel, the conveying member is arranged at the bottom end of the fixing plate, two sides of the conveying member are respectively and detachably connected with the clamping base members, the fixing barrel penetrates through the top end of the fixing plate and extends to the bottom end of the conveying member, the hydraulic barrel is sleeved in the fixing barrel, the fixing barrel is communicated with the conveying member, and the clamping base members are controlled to freely move. The lifting appliance has high butting accuracy, and the lifting process is not easy to shake.

title_en: Large-span steel structure bridge with anti-collision structure and pushing construction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge pushing, in particular to a large-span steel structure bridge with an anti-collision structure and a pushing construction process, comprising a bridge frame and a fixed plate, wherein the left lower side of the bridge frame is provided with a bridge opening, the bridge opening is provided with a sliding shoe, the lower end of the bridge opening is provided with a first hydraulic rod, the lower part of the sliding shoe is provided with the fixed plate, the upper end of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a track, the sliding shoe is in sliding connection with the track, the bridge opening tooth is provided with a telescopic hole, the telescopic hole is in sliding connection with an anti-collision telescopic mechanism, the anti-collision telescopic mechanism consists of a telescopic plate, a limiting groove, a rotating ring and an impact column, wherein the middle of the guide beam frame is connected with a connecting plate in a sliding manner, the right side of the sliding shoe is provided with a supporting plate which is of an L-shaped structure, the right side of the supporting plate is connected with a mounting plate in a sliding manner, and a second hydraulic rod is arranged between the lower end of the mounting plate and the supporting plate.

title_en: Canned liquid oxygen transportation stable jolt preventing device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a stable and bumpy-preventing device for canned liquid oxygen transportation, and relates to the technical field of liquid oxygen canning. The canned liquid oxygen transfer stable jolt preventing device comprises a liquid oxygen tank and a buffer mechanism, wherein a fixing frame is fixed at the bottom of the liquid oxygen tank, a base is arranged below the fixing frame, a hinge seat is arranged on the surface of the base, the end parts of a first supporting rod and a second supporting rod are respectively hinged with the hinge seat, a connecting block is hinged to one side of a connecting rod, the connecting block is connected with the fixing frame, and a shock absorber is connected between the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod. According to the canned liquid oxygen transportation stable anti-bumping device, the first support rod and the second support rod which are arranged in parallel are matched with the shock absorber, so that a good stable effect is achieved, meanwhile, the canned liquid oxygen transportation stable anti-bumping device has a good shock absorption and anti-bumping effect, guarantees are provided for transportation of canned liquid oxygen, damage to a tank body caused by bumping is prevented, the service life of the tank body is prolonged, and leakage accidents caused by tank body damage are prevented.

title_en: Backfill internal supporting structure of large buried water conveying pipeline
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of underground engineering construction, in particular to a backfill internal supporting structure of a large buried water conveying pipeline, which aims at solving the technical problems that the assembling and disassembling processes of the supporting structure are complicated and the time consumption is long in actual use, and the recycling and reutilization of the supporting structure after compaction are difficult, and the technical problem of increasing the construction cost is solved, and comprises a center seat, eight supporting rods which are arranged outside the center seat and are distributed in an equidistant and encircling manner, a supporting seat fixed on one end surface of the supporting rod, and a movable supporting mechanism for supporting the inner wall of the pipeline; the invention can effectively support the inside of a large buried water conveying pipeline, prevent the inner wall of the pipeline from being damaged in the backfilling compaction process, and can drive eight supporting seats to support through four hydraulic cylinders under the action of the arc inserting plate and the connecting pipe in the structure assembling and disassembling process, thereby saving the cost.

title_en: Control method and control system for lifting platform
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a control method and a control system for a lifting platform, and belongs to the technical field of ocean platforms. The control method comprises the steps of obtaining displacement of a first lifting oil cylinder in the plurality of lifting oil cylinders, calculating a displacement difference of the first lifting oil cylinder according to the displacement of the first lifting oil cylinder, wherein the displacement difference is a difference between displacement of a main oil cylinder and displacement of the first lifting oil cylinder, the main oil cylinder is one of the plurality of lifting oil cylinders, and controlling the expansion speed of the first lifting oil cylinder according to the displacement difference. The displacement error between the lifting cylinders can be reduced, and real-time synchronization of the lifting cylinders is guaranteed.

title_en: Fuel cell radiator support
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of radiators and discloses a fuel cell radiator support, which comprises a plurality of groups of installation racks, wherein any group of installation racks comprises a frame, a plurality of vertical supports for separating the frame are fixedly connected to the frame, support plates for installing a fan radiator are fixedly connected to vertical parts of the vertical supports and the frame, connecting plate groups for connecting and combining and installing the fixed installation racks are fixedly connected to transverse parts of the frame, and the connecting plate groups are arranged at intervals.

title_en: Graphitizing furnace supporting mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphitizing furnace supporting mechanism, which relates to the technical field of graphitizing furnaces and comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is provided with a graphitizing furnace, the lower wall of the base is rotationally connected with a plurality of hollow shafts, the lower end of each hollow shaft is fixedly connected with an n-type frame, the n-type frame is rotationally connected with a third rotating shaft, the side surface of each third rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a third gear and a movable wheel, a toothed plate can be driven to be far away from a first gear and a fourth gear through shortening by a hydraulic cylinder, the graphitizing furnace is convenient to move by the movable wheels, the n-type frame rotates when the graphitizing furnace moves to a required position, the fourth gear can be positioned through meshing of the lower part of the toothed plate and the fourth gear, the first gear can be positioned through meshing of the upper part of the toothed plate and the first gear, the movable wheels can be positioned through positioning the first gears, and the base can be positioned.

title_en: Preparation method of carbon fiber composite shell for shock absorber and shock absorber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon fiber composite shell for a shock absorber, which comprises the following steps of firstly, preparing a polydopamine modified layer, namely immersing carbon fiber cloth with sizing agent removed into a dopamine mixed solution to obtain polydopamine grafted modified carbon fiber, secondly, preparing a zinc oxide seed layer, namely adding the polydopamine grafted modified carbon fiber obtained in the first step into the zinc oxide seed solution to obtain carbon fiber fully coated by the zinc oxide seed layer, integrating an energy recovery mechanism into a magnetic spring, and not only retaining excellent damping performance of the shock absorber, but also endowing the shock absorber with a brand new function of energy recovery.

title_en: High-pressure large-caliber ball valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valves, in particular to a high-pressure large-caliber ball valve which comprises a valve body, a force increasing mechanism and a rotating shaft, wherein a valve core is arranged in the valve body, the force increasing mechanism comprises a fixed shell, a rotating shell and a force accumulating torsion spring, the fixed shell is fixedly arranged on the valve body, the rotating shaft penetrates through the fixed shell and is rotatably arranged on the valve body and is connected with the valve core, the rotating shell is rotatably arranged on the fixed shell around the axis of the rotating shaft, the rotating shell is sleeved outside the rotating shaft, a transmission assembly is arranged in the rotating shell, and the force accumulating torsion spring is rotatably arranged in the fixed shell around the axis of the rotating shaft. When the valve core is opened or closed, the force accumulating torsion spring rotates relative to the rotating shaft to enable the force accumulating torsion spring to open or close the valve core next time, so that the valve core is not influenced to be opened or closed quickly, and the valve core can be opened or closed next time to increase the force. And the structure is simple, and the operation is easy.

title_en: Stacked fixed differential pressure reducing valve
abstract_en: The invention provides a superposition type constant-difference pressure reducing valve which comprises a valve body, a valve core arranged in the valve body in a sliding manner and a shuttle valve arranged at one end of the valve body, wherein a left valve cavity is formed between one end of the valve core and the valve body, a right valve cavity which is separated from the left valve cavity is formed between the middle part of the valve core and the valve body, a large-aperture oil supply channel P which penetrates through the right valve cavity is arranged on the valve body, a first load port A and a second load port B are arranged on the valve body, the first load port A and the second load port B are communicated with the left valve cavity through the shuttle valve, and a damping structure is arranged on the valve core so as to enable the valve core to slide in the valve body in a damping manner. The valve core is provided with the damping structure so as to enable the valve core to slide in the valve body in a damping manner, so that the stability and the precision of the pressure reducing valve are improved, the constant-difference pressure reducing valve can slowly move even under high pressure, the stability under high pressure is further improved, and the constant-difference pressure reducing valve is suitable for the working condition of high flow and high pressure.

title_en: Water supply control system for 20% load dry running of supercritical coal-fired unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water supply control system for 20% load dry running of a supercritical coal-fired unit, which belongs to the technical field of dry running of supercritical coal-fired units, is connected to a water supply pipeline and comprises a pipe body, a supporting structure, a water outlet pipe and a regulating structure; the water supply pipe comprises a pipe body, a water outlet pipe, a regulating structure, a control unit and a control unit, wherein two ends of the pipe body are connected with a connecting piece for connecting a main pipe of the water supply pipe, the water outlet pipe is arranged inside the pipe body and fixed on the inner wall of the pipe body through a supporting structure, the regulating structure comprises the regulating unit and the control unit, one end of the water outlet pipe is closed, a plurality of water outlets are uniformly formed in the outer wall of the water outlet pipe, the other end of the water outlet pipe is opened towards the regulating unit, the regulating unit is arranged inside the pipe body and connected with the water outlet pipe for regulating the water outlet, the regulating unit is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the pipe body through the supporting structure, and the control unit is arranged outside the pipe body and penetrates through the pipe body and is connected with the regulating unit for controlling the regulating unit to regulate the water outlet pipe. The invention has the advantages of adjusting and controlling the water supply quantity by utilizing the enthalpy change and being capable of being accurately controlled.

title_en: Underwater propeller sealing structure for submarine operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of underwater propellers, in particular to an underwater propeller sealing structure for submarine operation, which comprises An Zhuangcang, wherein one end of a mounting cabin is connected with a pushing head, the mounting cabin is also coaxially connected with a sealing cabin, a driving shaft for driving the pushing head is penetrated out of the sealing cabin, and sealing ends for sealing are jointly connected among An Zhuangcang, the sealing cabin and the pushing head.

title_en: Assembly for an aircraft
abstract_en: An assembly for maintaining a pitch angle of a flight control surface of an aircraft is disclosed. The assembly includes a shaft including threads and defining an axis of the shaft, and a nut. The nut includes a housing, a barrel located in the housing and including threads for engaging the threads of the shaft, and at least one locking element located in the housing. The housing includes a radially inner cam surface adjacent the locking element. The barrel is configured to rotate relative to the housing when the threads of the barrel engage the threads of the shaft and rotate with the threads of the shaft, thereby moving the locking element along the cam surface from a disengaged position, in which the locking element is spaced apart from the threads of the shaft, to an engaged position, in which the locking element is wedged between the threads of the shaft and the housing, thereby preventing relative rotation between the shaft and the housing.

title_en: Integrated active cooling structure suitable for magnetic bearing of high-speed high-power motor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electromagnetic bearing cooling, and discloses an integrated active cooling structure suitable for a high-speed high-power motor magnetic bearing. According to the invention, the air in the electromagnetic bearing body can be discharged outwards along with the high-speed rotation of the fan blades, and the air can move along the spiral cooling groove when flowing, so that the direct heat exchange time between the air and the electromagnetic bearing body is longer, the cooling effect is better, and at the moment, part of the air flows through the cooling channel which is attached to the shell of the electromagnetic bearing body, so that part of heat can be carried out when the air flows, the cooling effect can be further improved through the air flowing of inner and outer multiple channels, and the cooling effect is synchronously improved through the liquid cooling and air cooling modes by arranging the cooling pipe filled with the cooling liquid in the electromagnetic bearing body.

title_en: Agricultural thing networking supervisory equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural Internet of things, in particular to agricultural Internet of things monitoring equipment which comprises a machine shell, a transmission module and a monitoring main body, wherein an upper strip-shaped opening and a lower strip-shaped opening are respectively formed in the upper surface and the lower surface of the machine shell, the transmission module is arranged in the machine shell and comprises a first movable plate and a second movable plate, a first rotary sleeve and a second rotary sleeve are respectively arranged on the first movable plate and the second movable plate in a rotating mode, first gears are respectively sleeved on the outer parts of the first rotary sleeve and the second rotary sleeve, a plurality of racks which can be meshed with the first gears are arranged on the two sides of the interior of the machine shell along the advancing direction of the first movable plate and the second movable plate, the racks on the two sides of the machine shell are arranged in a staggered mode, the monitoring main body is provided with a pair and is respectively arranged at the bottoms of the first rotary sleeve and the second rotary sleeve, and through integrating the two monitoring main bodies in the transmission module, synchronous movement which can be mutually close to or far away from each other can be realized, and thus monitoring blind areas can be effectively eliminated.

title_en: Novel brake pad, and mold and method for preparing brake pad
abstract_en: A novel brake block and a die and a method for preparing the brake block relate to the technical field of brake block production, a heat dissipation copper pipe is arranged in a heat dissipation groove through a net-shaped structure formed by arranging the heat dissipation groove on a positioning steel plate, heat generated by heating of a friction plate can be conducted through the heat dissipation copper pipe, the heat dissipation efficiency of the friction plate is improved, a copper sheet on the heat dissipation copper pipe is inserted into the friction plate, heat conduction inside the friction plate can be optimized, and furthermore, the copper sheet is bent due to the limitation of an arc-shaped clamping groove, the connection effect between the positioning steel plate and the friction plate can be increased when the copper sheet is inserted into the friction plate, and the stability of connection between the positioning steel plate and the friction plate is improved.

title_en: Composite material pipeline capable of preventing hydrogen leakage
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite material pipeline capable of preventing hydrogen leakage, and belongs to the technical field of pipeline preparation.
