The composite material pipeline comprises an inner pipe layer, a composite gas barrier layer positioned on the outer surface of the inner pipe layer, a high-temperature-resistant copolymer layer positioned on the outer surface of the composite gas barrier layer, a reinforcing layer positioned on the outer surface of the high-temperature-resistant copolymer layer and a corrosion-resistant polymer protective layer positioned on the outer surface of the reinforcing layer, wherein the composite gas barrier layer is of a multilayer co-extrusion structure and comprises a blending modified PVDC layer, a blending modified EVOH layer and a blending modified PA layer in sequence from inside to outside. The composite material pipeline for preventing hydrogen leakage has the characteristics of excellent gas resistance, high strength, corrosion resistance, high temperature resistance, good flexibility and the like by virtue of a multilayer composite structure, excellent material selection and optimized production process, can effectively solve the problems of hydrogen embrittlement, leakage and corrosion of the traditional steel pipe in the hydrogen transportation process, and has remarkable technical advantages and wide application prospect.

title_en: Oil drain screw plug and oil drain method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil drain plug screw and an oil drain method, which comprise an installation plug screw arranged at the bottom of an oil tank, wherein the inside and two ends of the installation plug screw are all in through arrangement, one end of the installation plug screw, which is close to the inside of the oil tank, is an oil drain port, one end of the installation plug screw, which is far away from the inside of the oil tank, is an oil outlet port, the oil drain port is provided with an oil drain mechanism, the oil outlet port is provided with a sealing element, and the oil drain mechanism is matched with the sealing element to drain or shut off oil in the oil tank.

title_en: Diagnosis method and device for electro-hydraulic system of miniature pile drilling machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a diagnosis method and device for an electrohydraulic system of a miniature pile drilling machine, comprising a hydraulic system and a fault analysis and diagnosis module, wherein the hydraulic system comprises a pump set, a valve group, an actuator, a filtering system, a cooling system and an oil pollution degree sensor, and the fault analysis and diagnosis module comprises a diagnosis display module, an analysis and diagnosis program module and a sensor signal module. The invention can be favorable for carrying out active fault diagnosis on key hydraulic and mechanical elements of the micro pile drilling machine, can judge working parameters of the micro pile drilling machine in real time, timely diagnose abnormal explanation of the system, is favorable for operators to correctly use the micro pile drilling machine, improves the reliability of the micro pile drilling machine system, prolongs the service life of key elements and is also favorable for convenient maintenance of equipment.

title_en: Low-vibration split threshing cylinder speed change gear box
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of speed changing gear boxes, and discloses a low-vibration split threshing cylinder speed changing gear box, which solves the problem that gear abrasion is easy to cause due to the fact that gears are repeatedly adjusted to mesh at present, and comprises a speed changing gear box body, wherein the top of the speed changing gear box body is hinged with a box cover, a speed changing adjusting mechanism and a dustproof mechanism are arranged on the speed changing gear box body, a transmission shaft is arranged on the outer side of the speed changing gear box body, a connecting mechanism is arranged between the transmission shaft and the speed changing gear box body, the speed changing gear box body comprises an output shaft which is rotationally connected to the inner side of the speed changing gear box body, one end of the output shaft extends to the outer side of the speed changing gear box body, two middle shafts are symmetrically rotationally connected to the inner side of the speed changing gear box body, and middle pinions and middle big gears are respectively fixedly arranged on the outer sides of the two middle shafts; the invention can realize the speed change of the output shaft, thereby avoiding gear abrasion without repeatedly adjusting gear engagement.

title_en: Full-drift-diameter eccentric ball valve with diversion holes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-drift diameter eccentric ball valve with a deflector hole, which relates to the technical field of ball valves and comprises a valve body and a T-shaped valve core, wherein two symmetrically distributed transmission assemblies are arranged outside the valve core, the transmission assemblies are respectively connected with sealing assemblies through second extrusion assemblies, stepped holes are formed at two ends of the deflector hole, sealing pipes are respectively and slidingly connected inside the two stepped holes, the two transmission assemblies are respectively connected with the two sealing pipes through two groups of first extrusion assemblies, and a flushing assembly is arranged outside a valve seat inside a second shell. The invention plays a certain protection role on the contact sealing part of the valve, prevents the whole sealing effect of the valve from being influenced by abrasion, can effectively prevent vortex, vibration and noise from being generated when water flows through the valve, ensures the stable flow of the water flow, and can scour the valve seat and the sealing assembly and the valve seat and the sealing pipe in the closing and opening processes of the valve, thereby removing impurities.

title_en: Hydraulic control driving mechanism for check butterfly valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic control driving mechanisms of check butterfly valves, and discloses a hydraulic control driving mechanism for a check butterfly valve, which comprises a check butterfly valve body and a fixing frame, wherein the inner side of the fixing frame is rotationally connected with a hydraulic rod, the telescopic end of the hydraulic rod is connected with a push head, the outer side of the push head is rotationally connected with a connecting plate, a rotary column is arranged in the connecting plate in a penetrating way, one end of the rotary column, which is close to the check butterfly valve body, is fixedly provided with a connecting cylinder, the inner part of the check butterfly valve body is rotationally connected with a valve rod in a penetrating way, and the hydraulic control driving mechanism also comprises a shake stopping part, which is arranged at one end of the connecting cylinder, which is close to the valve rod, and is positioned between the valve rod and the connecting cylinder; the connecting part is arranged at one end of the shake stopping part, which is close to the valve rod, and is connected with the valve rod; the invention utilizes the vibration-stopping part and the matching part to connect the hydraulic control driving mechanism with the valve rod, so that the rotation vibration generated by driving the valve rod due to the impact of water flow can be transmitted to the vibration-stopping part through the matching part, and the vibration-stopping part is utilized to prevent the rotation vibration of the valve rod from being transmitted to the hydraulic control driving mechanism.

title_en: Yaw brake and wind driven generator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a yaw brake and aerogenerator, wherein, yaw brake includes the pincers body, brake block, sets up at least partially pivot, drive assembly and the push rod in the pincers body, the pincers body is provided with the holding the mounting groove of brake block, the mounting groove has the export along the perpendicular to the first direction of the tight direction of clamp of brake block, the pivot can rotate in order to drive through drive assembly the push rod is followed the first direction removes, thereby makes the push rod is followed first direction orientation the export promotes the brake block breaks away from the mounting groove. Through the technical scheme, the mounting groove on the clamp body can allow the brake pad to enter and exit along the direction perpendicular to the clamping direction, and the brake pad can be pushed by the push rod to slide out, so that the replacement operation of the brake pad is simplified, the workload is reduced, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Biological closed valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biological closed valve which comprises a first valve body, a second valve body, blades and a linkage mechanism, wherein the first valve body and the second valve body are integrally formed by spinning, a first soft sealing gasket is arranged between the first valve body and the second valve body, the linkage mechanism is arranged on the second valve body and connected with the blades, the linkage mechanism drives the blades to realize the attachment or separation of the blades and the first soft sealing gasket after the blades linearly move in the axial direction of the second valve body, and the linkage mechanism drives the blades to realize overturning. The biological closed valve improves a blade sealing structure, adopts multi-connecting rod push-type sealing, reduces abrasion of a soft sealing gasket, prevents gas leakage in the long-term opening and closing use process of the valve, adopts multi-connecting rod push-type sealing, reduces required torsion, reduces requirements on an actuator, and accordingly reduces the overall cost of the valve, adopts spinning integrated blades, increases the strength of the blades, avoids welding blade reinforcing ribs, reduces materials, reduces welding quantity and reduces cost.

title_en: Lining nonmetallic composite steel pipe joint device with double sealing structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lining nonmetallic composite steel pipe joint device with a double sealing structure, which comprises two steel flanges, corrosion-resistant alloy compression rings, sealing gaskets and fixing parts, wherein the two steel flanges are respectively connected with steel base pipe ends in two lining nonmetallic composite steel pipes, the two steel flanges are oppositely arranged, first grooves are respectively arranged in the middle parts of sealing surfaces of the two steel flanges, the fixing parts fix the two steel flanges through bolt holes on the outer edges of the steel flanges, the corrosion-resistant alloy compression rings are arranged in the first grooves, and the sealing gaskets are arranged between the two steel flanges and are positioned at the inner edges of the steel flanges. By adopting the structure, double sealing of the lining nonmetallic composite steel pipe joint is realized, the on-site leakage risk is reduced, and the structure has the advantages of simplicity in operation and rapidness in installation.

title_en: Multistage maintenance-free hydraulic buffer device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic buffering, and discloses a multistage maintenance-free hydraulic buffering device and a multistage maintenance-free hydraulic buffering method, wherein the multistage maintenance-free hydraulic buffering device comprises a buffering base, a liquid cavity corrugated pipe, an air cavity corrugated pipe, a buffering piston and a pressure-bearing outer cylinder; the buffer base, the liquid cavity corrugated pipe and the buffer piston form a second-stage buffer liquid cavity, the buffer piston and the pressure-bearing outer cylinder form a first-stage buffer liquid cavity, the buffer base, the air cavity corrugated pipe and the buffer piston form a third-stage buffer liquid cavity, the buffer base and the air cavity corrugated pipe form a buffer air cavity, and the buffer piston is provided with a plurality of variable cross-section grooves and orifices. The invention effectively reduces the pressure pulse generated by the medium when the buffer device enters the buffer stage by utilizing the variable cross section groove and the buffer air cavity, improves the whole service life of the device, effectively realizes redundancy buffer by utilizing the variable cross section groove, the orifice and the buffer air cavity, and improves the reliability of the buffer.

title_en: Switching valve and clothes treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a switching valve which comprises a shell, wherein a water passing cavity is arranged in the shell, a valve plate is arranged in the middle of the water passing cavity and divides the water passing cavity into a water inlet cavity and a water outlet cavity which are coaxial, a water passing port which is communicated with the water inlet cavity and the water outlet cavity is arranged on the valve plate, and a switching plate is rotatably arranged in the water inlet cavity and is attached to the valve plate, and is provided with a switching port for closing or opening the water passing port. According to the invention, the water passing cavity is divided into the water inlet cavity and the water outlet cavity by the valve plate, water in the water inlet cavity flows into the water outlet cavity from the water passing port on the valve plate, and the switching plate for controlling the opening/closing of the water passing port is arranged in the water inlet cavity and is attached to the valve plate, so that the water pressure in the water inlet cavity can be utilized to press the switching plate on the valve plate, and the sealing effect of the water passing port on the valve plate is improved. The invention also provides a clothes treatment device provided with the switching valve.

title_en: Novel controllable two solenoid valve bumper shock absorbers of damping force
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic valve shock absorbers, and discloses a novel double-electromagnetic valve shock absorber with controllable damping force, which comprises a seal and an electromagnetic valve-restoring assembly, wherein the seal is connected with the inner surface of the left end of an oil storage cylinder assembly in a sealing way, the right end surface of the seal is attached with an oil seal, the right side surface of the oil seal is attached with a guide seat, when the current is low, the end cap is positioned at the middle position, the shutoff area is larger, the safety valve is in an opened state, the shutoff area is increased, the pressure difference between the P oil cavity and the P oil cavity generates low-speed damping force, the pressure difference between the P oil cavity and the P oil cavity is increased, the sealing valve plate is easier to open, and the P oil cavity and the backflow valve seat generate high-speed damping force; when the current is increased, the end cap is positioned at the lowest end position and is contacted with the upper end of the backflow valve seat, the interception area is minimum, the pressure difference between the P oil cavity and the P oil cavity generates low-speed damping force, the pressure difference between the P oil cavity and the P oil cavity is reduced, the sealing valve plate is difficult to open, and therefore the P oil cavity and the P oil cavity generate high-speed damping force.

title_en: Impact force testing device of electric tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to an impact force testing device of an electric tool, which is applied to the field of detection of the electric tool, and comprises a cylinder body, wherein oil is contained in the inner side of the cylinder body, a floating block is arranged in the inner side of the cylinder body, a connecting column is arranged at the upper end of the floating block, the connecting column penetrates through the cylinder body in a sliding mode and is fixedly provided with a bearing seat, a plurality of damping holes are uniformly formed in the floating block, a measuring channel is arranged at the side end of the bottom of the cylinder body, a pressure sensor corresponding to the measuring channel is arranged on the outer wall of the cylinder body, the electric tool impacts the bearing seat downwards during the test through the arrangement of the floating block, so that the oil on the lower side of the floating block is extruded upwards through the damping holes, a large amount of impact energy is consumed during the process, rebound of the impact energy is avoided, and after the test is finished, the oil on the upper side of the floating block automatically floats on the upper surface of the oil through the damping holes under the action of self gravity, so that the bearing seat is stably reset, the measuring error is reduced, and the measuring accuracy is improved.

title_en: Surface hardening method for screw drilling tool universal joint and related universal joint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface hardening method of a screw drilling tool universal joint and a related universal joint. The method comprises the steps of carrying out quenching and tempering and finishing on a rough-machined universal joint blank to obtain a universal joint body, preheating the universal joint body, spot-welding a tungsten-cobalt alloy block wrapped by nickel-based brazing filler metal on a wear-resistant contact surface at one end of the universal joint body, spraying nickel tungsten carbide powder and nickel-coated boron carbide composite powder on the wear-resistant contact surface to form a hardened layer on the wear-resistant contact surface, grinding the spray-welded working surface to a designed size after cooling, checking holes of the spray-welded working surface after grinding, filling the nickel tungsten carbide powder and the nickel-coated boron carbide composite powder in the holes, heating and melting to seal the holes, and carrying out fine grinding on the universal joint to the designed size after cooling. The invention greatly improves the wear resistance and impact fracture resistance of the universal joint, so that the universal joint can be matched with other screw drilling tool components resistant to the high temperature of 350 ℃ to form the screw drilling tool resistant to the high temperature of 350 ℃.

title_en: Composite gasket for steel structure high-strength bolt connection gap defect and filling repair method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite gasket for high-strength bolt connection gap defects of a steel structure and a filling repair method, wherein the composite gasket comprises a progressive combined gasket and epoxy structural adhesive, the progressive combined gasket comprises a plurality of annular segments, the annular segments are spliced to form an annular structure, the annular segments comprise a planar base layer and a plurality of planar supplement layers, the planar base layer and the planar supplement layers are symmetrically arranged on the top surface and the bottom surface of the planar base layer, a plurality of notches are formed in one sides, close to a steel pipe, of the planar base layer and the planar supplement layers, the notches are matched with the diameters of bolt holes, through holes are formed in the planar base layer, the epoxy structural adhesive is poured into the annular structure through the through holes, the side walls of the planar base layer and the planar supplement layers are abutted against the outer wall of the steel pipe, and the thickness of the planar base layer is larger than that of the planar supplement layers. The invention can repair the mechanical property and durability of the flange joint at the same time, and has the advantages of higher structural strength, good durability, wider applicability and the like.

title_en: Auxiliary working platform for geological survey
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary working platform for geological survey, which comprises a travelling assembly and a drilling assembly which are arranged on a chassis, wherein a positioning hole is formed in the center of the chassis, two long side sides of the upper surface of the chassis are fixedly connected with cross beams, two short side sides of the upper surface of the chassis are fixedly connected with supporting plates, and the middle section of each supporting plate is provided with a guide groove. According to the invention, the traveling assembly is arranged, so that the device is balanced and positioned while the moving function of the device is realized, and the accuracy of vertical drilling is ensured by reducing the included angle between the drilling assembly and the ground; through setting up the drilling subassembly, can freely adjust drilling degree of depth under the prerequisite that does not influence drilling efficiency, and then satisfy the sampling demand under the different scenes in order to widen the service scenario of device, through setting up sampling mechanism, collect drilling soil in the drilling, and collect the sample and be convenient for personnel observe the analysis according to the degree of depth distribution automatic layering of soil.

title_en: Thrust dynamic and static pressure mixed gas bearing
abstract_en: The invention provides a thrust dynamic-static pressure mixed gas bearing, and relates to the technical field of gas bearings. The bearing comprises a bearing base, a top foil support, a wave foil, a top foil and a high-pressure air supply assembly, wherein the top foil support is movably connected with the bearing base and forms a gap between the top foil support and the bearing base, the wave foil is connected to the bearing base, a first connecting part, a wedge-shaped part and a second connecting part are sequentially arranged on the top foil along the circumferential direction, the first connecting part is connected with the top foil support, the second connecting part is connected with the wave foil, an air vent is formed in the first connecting part, the high-pressure air supply assembly is connected with the top foil support and is communicated with the air vent, relative displacement can be generated between the top foil support and the bearing base, the bearing has the adjustment capability, the use requirements under different working conditions can be met, the dynamic adjustment capability is realized, the integral environment pressure of the bearing is improved through mutual cooperation of static pressure support and dynamic pressure support, the dynamic pressure effect is enhanced, and the stability and the bearing capability of an air film are improved.

title_en: Real-time monitoring device for environment of tower crane
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tower crane safety, in particular to a real-time monitoring device for the environment of a tower crane. According to the application, the sliding block can be driven to slide in the guide rail through the first motor, stable regulation and control of the movement of the sliding block are realized through the cooperation of the gear and the guide rail, the sliding block slides in the guide rail, the whole monitoring mechanism is promoted to flexibly move along the direction of the guide rail, different heights of the tower hanging frame can be accurately detected, in the detection process, the gyroscope sensor of the first detection assembly plays a key role, when the sliding block is lifted to the inclined position of the tower hanging frame, the gyroscope sensor instantly detects, once the inclination degree exceeds a safety range, a controller in the machine case controls the remote alarm to give an early warning, so that the monitoring effect of different heights of the tower hanging frame on inclination is effectively improved, and the operation safety of the tower hanging frame is ensured.

title_en: Crack detection instrument for concrete dam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crack detection instrument for a concrete dam, and relates to the technical field of crack width and depth detection. The device comprises a detection main body, a second screw is driven by a motor, a first vertical plate is lifted and lowered along a third sliding rail support by a movable block and the second screw, a pair of ultrasonic probes on a mounting support are attached to crack areas on the ground to perform detection, the height and the angle of the ultrasonic probes can be flexibly adjusted, the ultrasonic probes can be attached to crack areas including planes and slopes on different terrains to perform detection, and the multi-dimensional adjustment function enables the ultrasonic probes to cope with various complex detection scenes, namely on flat ground or on a slope of a soil dam, and can perform effective crack detection.

title_en: Maintenance device for driving rope of oil pumping unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a pumping unit driving rope maintenance device which comprises an oil storage component, a blocking component and an oil inlet component, wherein the oil storage component is relatively provided with a first central hole and a second central hole, a pumping unit driving rope penetrates through the first central hole and the second central hole of the oil storage component, the blocking component is arranged in the oil storage component and respectively surrounds the periphery of the first central hole and the second central hole, the oil inlet component comprises the oil inlet component and an oil inlet nozzle, the oil inlet nozzle is arranged on the oil storage component, the oil inlet nozzle is communicated with the inner space of the oil storage component, the oil inlet component is used for providing lubricating oil for the oil storage component, the blocking component can provide a certain blocking effect for the lubricating oil in the oil storage component, the lubricating oil is prevented from flowing in from the first central hole or the second central hole of the oil storage component, and when the oil storage component is used, the oil storage component is driven to move along the driving rope by applying force, and the lubricating oil storage component can be uniformly adhered with the lubricating oil in the moving process of the driving rope.

title_en: Heat-curing anti-loosening fastener and fastening method
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermosetting anti-loosening fastener and a fastening method. The heat-curing anti-loosening fastener comprises a stud, wherein at least one prefabricated groove is formed in the stud, a nut is provided with threads, the threads are sleeved on the stud, grooves are formed in the threads, a gasket is arranged on the nut, and anti-loosening bolts are connected with the stud and the nut through the prefabricated groove and the grooves, and comprise a base and anti-loosening pins, the anti-loosening pins are arranged on one side of the base and extend into the prefabricated groove and the grooves, and the number of the anti-loosening pins, the number of the prefabricated groove and the number of the grooves are corresponding. In addition, in the fastening method of the fastener, the locking bolt is inserted into the nut, and the locking bolt, the stud and the nut are fastened. In addition, when the fastening performance is required to be further enhanced, the locking bolt can be further fastened in a fastening mode that the locking bolt is heated, melted and filled with the prefabricated groove and the groove and then cooled.

title_en: Posture adjustment method, device and equipment of test platform and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for adjusting the posture of a test platform, wherein the test platform is a hydraulic control platform, the posture of the platform is adjusted by controlling the expansion and contraction of hydraulic columns, the response speed of a hydraulic control mode is high, the posture adjustment of the platform can be completed in a short time, the hydraulic control mode can process a larger load and is suitable for larger and heavier test samples, the application range of the test platform is widened, and when the posture of the test platform is adjusted, the posture of each hydraulic column can be fed back and adjusted in real time according to the pressure value and the hydraulic value of each hydraulic column, so that the posture adjustment speed and the adjustment precision are improved, the stability among different hydraulic columns is ensured, and unbalance of the test platform caused by local adjustment is avoided.

title_en: Cylindrical gear housing for accommodating a cylindrical gear stage
abstract_en: A spur gear housing (10) is disclosed that is configured to house a spur gear stage of a transmission. The spur gear housing (10) comprises a reinforcement structure (12; 112) configured for absorbing forces acting on the spur gear housing (10), a plurality of stop structures (14) each configured for receiving at least one stop means for the spur gear housing (10), and a plurality of coupling structures (16; 116) each configured for providing at least one supply element of a spur gear stage. The reinforcement structure (12; 112) comprises a radially outer absorption region (12 a) and a radially inner reinforcement region (12 b), which are arranged distributed in the circumferential direction of the spur gear housing (10). The stop structures (14) and the coupling structures (16; 116) are each distributed in the circumferential direction of the spur gear housing (10) and are provided in a number greater than the number required for the use of the spur gear stage.

title_en: Manpower resource filing cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of personnel file management, in particular to a manpower resource file cabinet which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a cabinet door is hinged to the front end of the cabinet body, a bearing frame is fixedly installed in the cabinet body, a supporting plate is fixedly installed in the bearing frame, an assembly cavity is formed between the outer side of the bearing frame and the inner wall of the cabinet body, a bearing locking assembly is arranged at the bottom end of the inner side of the assembly cavity on the left side, the bearing locking assembly comprises an electric cylinder fixedly installed at the bottom end of the inner side of the assembly cavity on the left side, a compression bearing rod is fixedly installed at the telescopic end of the electric cylinder, and a lifting plate is fixedly installed on the outer wall of the compression bearing rod. According to the invention, the lifting plate can lift a user, so that the user can be lifted to a certain height, the user can conveniently take and put the file box at the high position in the file cabinet, and the file box can be extruded and fixed from the top end of the file box by positioning the expansion of the compression bag.

title_en: Electromagnetic valve
abstract_en: The application provides an electromagnetic valve, relates to the technical field of electromagnetic valves, and aims to solve the problems of low control precision of the electromagnetic valve, poor reliability of the electromagnetic valve and the like in the related art. The electromagnetic valve comprises a first cover body and at least one second cover body, wherein a driving stator yoke, a driving piece, an ejector rod assembly and a driving coil group are arranged in the first cover body, a magnetic piece, a counter stator yoke and a counter coil group are arranged in the second cover body, the counter stator yoke is connected to the second cover body, when the electromagnetic valve receives a valve opening signal, part of the driving coil group and part of the counter coil group are electrified, the driving piece moves along a first direction, the first guide pipe and the second guide pipe are aligned and communicated in the first direction, when the electromagnetic valve receives a valve closing signal, part of the driving coil group and part of the counter coil group are electrified, and the first guide pipe and the second guide pipe are misplaced in the second direction. The application is beneficial to improving the control precision of the electromagnetic valve and improving the reliability of the electromagnetic valve.

title_en: Noise reduction base for medical instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a noise reduction base for medical equipment, which relates to the technical field of active noise reduction and comprises a base body, wherein the upper surface of the base body is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, the upper side of the base body is provided with a box body, the inside of the box body is provided with a player, the inner side of the fixing frame is connected with a toothed plate in a nested manner, the upper side of the toothed plate is provided with an adjusting plate, and an adjusting mechanism capable of driving the box body to swing is arranged between the upper side of the toothed plate and the adjusting plate. This base of making an uproar falls in medical instrument, the upper surface of base body is provided with the box, and the inside of box is provided with the player, utilizes the principle that the sound wave stack offset, through the built-in microphone real-time supervision ambient noise of device to with these signals turn into the sound wave (i.e. the antiphase sound wave) with antagonism mutually with it, then send the antiphase sound wave through the player accurately, because the antiphase sound wave is opposite with the phase place of original noise sound wave, thereby offset original noise sound wave, reach the effect of making an uproar.

title_en: Limiting protection device of valve actuator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mechanical engineering, in particular to a limit protection device of a valve actuator, which comprises the valve actuator for driving a valve to open and close, a mounting bracket and a limit protection device main body, wherein a driving piece is arranged in the valve actuator, the limit protection device main body comprises a shell and a limit switch unit, the interior of the shell is divided into a sensor cabin, a control cabin and a brake cabin, a detection unit is arranged on an output shaft, a control unit is arranged in the control cabin and is used for receiving angle and displacement data detected by the detection unit in real time and carrying out redundancy check according to the angle and displacement data detected in real time, a self-locking unit is arranged in the brake cabin, an early warning unit is arranged on the outer side wall of the shell, and the early warning unit is used for carrying out early warning according to the judgment result of the control unit. The invention solves the defects of the traditional limit protection device in the aspects of safety, adaptability, stability and operability, and remarkably improves the running reliability and maintenance efficiency of the valve actuator.

title_en: Intelligent adjustable high-static low-dynamic stiffness integrated active vibration isolator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent adjustable high-static low-dynamic stiffness integrated active vibration isolator which comprises a base frame and an active electromagnetic unit arranged on the base frame, wherein the active electromagnetic unit is used for outputting adjustable electromagnetic negative stiffness and controllable electromagnetic force and providing stable thrust for vibration isolation by utilizing the controllable electromagnetic force. The invention is applied to the technical field of precise vibration isolation, and utilizes the active electromagnetic unit to output large-stroke linear adjustable electromagnetic negative stiffness and controllable electromagnetic force, wherein the adjustable electromagnetic negative stiffness and the positive stiffness mechanical spring are linked to reduce dynamic stiffness, thereby realizing the expansion of vibration isolation bandwidth, reducing the natural frequency of a system to isolate base vibration, and stable controllable electromagnetic thrust is used for realizing flexible active vibration control, realizing the integrated design of high-static low-dynamic stiffness vibration isolation and active intelligent vibration isolation, and further improving the problem of multi-source vibration inhibition of the high-static low-dynamic stiffness vibration isolator.

title_en: Water pump water pressure resistance sealing performance test board
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pump test equipment, in particular to a water pressure resistance and tightness test board of a water pump, which comprises a main body mechanism, wherein the main body mechanism comprises a pedestal, the pedestal is provided with a limiting mechanism, the limiting mechanism comprises an air pump, the air pump is fixedly connected with a connector through an air duct, and a propping mechanism is arranged in the connector. In the invention, when the air pump fills air into the water pump to form pressure, a part of air enters the air passage, and then the high-pressure air pushes the piston disc to drive the push-pull rod to move, and when the push-pull rod drives the sliding block to move, the push-pull rod drives the push-pull rod to drive the push-pull block to push the water outlet of the water pump upwards, so that the water outlet of the water pump is in further tight contact with the sealing sleeve, gas leakage is prevented, and the test effect is influenced. Meanwhile, the sealing sleeve and the joint are in a truncated cone-shaped design, so that water outlets of water pumps with various specifications can be met, and the abutting rod and the abutting block slide along with the sliding block, so that the water outlets of the water pumps with various specifications can be extruded, and the tightness is ensured.

title_en: High-pressure-difference steam regulating valve with complex flow characteristic and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of regulating valves, and provides a steam regulating valve with high pressure difference and complex flow characteristics and a working method thereof, wherein a plurality of through holes formed in the side wall of a valve cage are spirally distributed along the side wall of the valve cage, and the apertures of the through holes are sequentially increased along one direction of an axis; during regulation, the through hole of the valve cage is gradually opened along the spiral direction, the aperture of the opened through hole is gradually increased, so that the fluid flow entering the valve cage through the inlet is gradually increased, the problem of regulation oscillation after the fluid is suddenly entered is avoided, the valve plug is elastically connected with the valve plug, the valve plug and the valve plug are respectively provided with a balance hole, the valve plug is driven by the valve rod to move, the valve plug is far away from the valve plug, the balance holes on the valve plug and the valve plug are communicated, after the pressure difference is balanced, the valve plug is driven by the valve rod and the valve plug to move, the flow regulation area is entered, and the pressure difference is increased and reduced by the balance valve plug before the flow regulation, so that the working condition requirements of high pressure difference and high flow can be met on the basis of meeting the flow characteristics.

title_en: Transverse stop assembled with non-metallic plates
abstract_en: The invention provides a transverse stop assembled with a non-metallic plate. The equipment has the horizontal backstop of nonmetal board including lower plate, rubber layer, upper plate subassembly and the antifriction plate that set gradually, the lower plate with all be equipped with the through-hole in the rubber layer, the upper plate subassembly includes the upper plate and locates it lean on the hard backstop of rubber layer one side, hard backstop passes the through-hole of rubber layer just penetrates the through-hole of lower plate, the side of hard backstop with the rubber layer with the through-hole inner wall of lower plate keeps there is the clearance. The transverse stop assembled with the nonmetal plate solves the problems of high use cost or assembly gaps of the conventional transverse stop.

title_en: Transcritical carbon dioxide energy storage system based on carbon dioxide trapping and energy supplementing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transcritical carbon dioxide energy storage system based on carbon dioxide trapping and supplementing energy, which comprises a transcritical carbon dioxide energy storage system and a carbon dioxide trapping system, wherein the transcritical carbon dioxide energy storage system comprises an exhausted oil gas storage unit, an energy releasing unit and a heat storage and waste heat utilization unit, the energy storage unit is used for compressing low-pressure carbon dioxide into a high-pressure state and storing the low-pressure carbon dioxide in the exhausted oil gas storage unit, the energy releasing unit is used for generating power by utilizing the high-pressure carbon dioxide and injecting the carbon dioxide after doing work into the exhausted oil gas storage unit, the heat storage and waste heat utilization unit is used for recovering compression heat in the transcritical carbon dioxide energy storage system and high-temperature waste heat in the carbon dioxide trapping system, and the carbon dioxide trapping system is used for trapping carbon dioxide in flue gas and injecting the trapped carbon dioxide into the exhausted oil gas storage unit. The invention has high circulation efficiency and good environmental benefit, and can solve the problems of greenhouse effect and energy shortage.

title_en: Bimodal electromechanical actuator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bimodal electromechanical actuator, which comprises a screw rod stator, an outer cylinder, a front locking ring, a rear locking ring, a screw rod, a sleeve, a piston rod and a retaining cylinder frame, wherein the screw rod, the front locking ring and the rear locking ring are all arranged in the outer cylinder, the screw rod penetrates through the front locking ring and the rear locking ring, the screw rod stator and the sleeve are all arranged on the screw rod, the screw rod stator is connected with the sleeve, the piston rod is connected with the retaining cylinder frame, the actuator further comprises a locking control unit and an emergency unlocking unit, the retaining cylinder frame is arranged on the sleeve through the locking control unit, the emergency unlocking unit is arranged on the outer cylinder, the emergency unlocking unit is connected with the locking control unit, and a common locking process or an emergency locking process is realized through the emergency unlocking unit and the locking control unit. The emergency locking is realized while the common locking is realized, the locking units are used in the locking process, so that the unlocking in the locking process is ensured to be simple and firm, the memory alloy spring does not move together with the locking units, and the alloy memory spring is prevented from being easy to fail.

title_en: Drainage pipeline repairing robot and drainage pipeline repairing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drainage pipeline repair and discloses a drainage pipeline repair robot and a drainage pipeline repair method, wherein the drainage pipeline repair robot comprises a pipe pulling vehicle, a pipe clamping structure is arranged on the outer side of the pipe pulling vehicle, a connecting hook is arranged at one end of the pipe pulling vehicle, a dredging robot host machine is provided with a movable end capable of moving forwards and backwards, a knife rest is connected to the movable end, a knife head is rotatably connected to one side of the knife rest, which is close to the pipe pulling vehicle, the knife head is provided with a clamping structure, a rotary driving device is arranged on the knife rest and is in transmission connection with the knife head, the rotary driving device can drive the knife head to rotate, and the clamping structure and the connecting hook can be mutually clamped or separated when the knife head rotates.

title_en: Integral vulcanization type acidizing fracturing hose joint assembly and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an integral vulcanization type acidizing and fracturing hose joint assembly and a preparation method thereof, wherein the hose joint assembly comprises a joint and a hose; the hose comprises an outer connector, an outer protective sleeve, a steel wire rope fixing table and a steel wire rope fixing pressing block, wherein the hose comprises a steel wire rope winding layer, a steel wire rope in the steel wire rope winding layer is fixed on the steel wire rope fixing table, the steel wire rope fixing pressing block is arranged above the steel wire rope fixing table and is fixedly connected with the steel wire rope fixing table, the contact surface between the steel wire rope fixing pressing block and the steel wire rope fixing table is a complementary special-shaped contact surface, the outer connector is in threaded connection with the front end of the steel wire rope fixing table, the outer protective sleeve is arranged above the outer connector and the steel wire rope fixing pressing block, the outer protective sleeve is in threaded connection with the outer connector, and the contact surface between the outer protective sleeve and the steel wire rope fixing pressing block is an identical-slope inclined surface.

title_en: Synchronous hydraulic system and hydraulic synchronous calibration method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-pressure high-flow hydraulic elements and hydraulic systems, relates to a theoretical model of a fluid pressure executing mechanism and practical application, and has the technical points that a speed reducing valve is used for controlling fluid supply on a backflow path to control the action of a servo hydraulic cylinder, and particularly provides a synchronous hydraulic system and a hydraulic synchronous calibration method. The invention has the working principle that the reducing valve is additionally arranged on the loop of the hydraulic cylinder, the reducing valve adjusts the relative position of the valve core through the screw, and the size of the oil flowing hole is changed, so that the oil flow rate is adjusted, the oil return flow rate of the corresponding oil cylinder is changed, and the descending actions of all the oil cylinders are controlled to be synchronous. The non-magnetic characteristic of the invention is especially suitable for high-precision environments such as medical treatment.

title_en: Generator rotor equipment lifting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses generator rotor assembling and hoisting equipment, which belongs to the technical field of generator rotor assembling and hoisting, and comprises a ground rail and a moving part, wherein the moving part is arranged on one side of the ground rail, the moving part comprises a plurality of supporting parts, a beam driving displacement part is arranged on the upper side of each supporting part, a hoisting adsorption part is arranged on one side of each beam driving displacement part, the beam driving displacement part is used for carrying out left-right movement adjustment on the hoisting adsorption part, and the hoisting adsorption part is used for carrying out hoisting adsorption on a generator rotor.

title_en: Pressure switch testing device capable of adjusting pressure range
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pressure testing, and particularly discloses a pressure switch testing device capable of adjusting a pressure range, which comprises a shell, wherein a pressurizing module is fixedly connected inside the shell, the output end of the pressurizing module is fixedly connected with a vent pipe, the top of the vent pipe is fixedly connected with an automatic blocking mechanism, the vent pipe can be connected with the pressurizing module and the automatic blocking mechanism, the automatic blocking mechanism can block an air passage when the pressure switch is not used for detecting, gas is prevented from escaping, the top of the automatic blocking mechanism is provided with a connecting mechanism, and the bottom of the automatic blocking mechanism is provided with a dismounting mechanism. The pressure switch to be tested can be simply and rapidly installed on the test equipment through the connecting mechanism, and the fastening piece of bolts is not required to be used for fixing, so that the phenomenon of sliding wire cannot occur, the installation mode is replaced and reduced, the installation efficiency is improved, and the test efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Bellows accumulator
abstract_en: The invention provides a diaphragm capsule energy accumulator, which comprises a diaphragm capsule assembly arranged in a shell, wherein one end of the diaphragm capsule assembly is provided with a connecting flange used for connecting the shell, and the connecting flange is provided with a medium inlet which is opposite to the end part of the diaphragm capsule assembly and a side opening which is communicated with the medium inlet and is communicated with the inside of the shell so as to enable fluid medium to flow into the space between the diaphragm capsule assembly and the shell. The diaphragm capsule assembly is fixedly connected in the shell through the connecting flange, the assembly mode is simple, the diaphragm capsule assembly is convenient to overhaul and replace, and the pressure medium can flow between the diaphragm capsule assembly and the shell through the connecting flange by arranging the medium inlet and outlet on the connecting flange, so that the energy accumulator has a more compact structure, a shorter energy transmission path and a lower delay time for releasing energy.

title_en: Soft water valve and water softener
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft water valve and a soft water machine, which relate to the technical field of water treatment equipment, wherein the soft water valve comprises a valve body and a driving mechanism, the valve body is provided with a piston and a valve cavity communicated with a plurality of channels, the piston is arranged in the valve cavity in a sliding manner to switch the channels communicated with the valve cavity, the driving mechanism comprises a mounting seat, a driving wheel and a driving rod, the mounting seat is connected with the valve body, the driving wheel is connected with the mounting seat in a circumferential direction in a rotating manner and is fixedly arranged relative to the mounting seat in the axial direction, the driving rod is slidably arranged on the mounting seat and is in transmission connection with the piston, the driving wheel is provided with a through hole, the wall of the through hole is provided with a first multi-thread, the driving rod is provided with a second multi-thread, the driving rod is arranged in the through hole in a penetrating manner, and the first multi-thread and the second multi-thread are in a screwing manner. The technical scheme provided by the invention aims to improve the sliding speed of the piston, so as to improve the efficiency of switching different waterway modes of the soft water valve.

title_en: Two-wire lubricant dispensing device and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-line lubricant distribution device and a control method, wherein the double-line lubricant distribution device comprises a fixed seat, an upper valve block and a lower valve block which are respectively arranged on two sides of the fixed seat, a metering pipeline, an oil outlet pipeline and a reversing pipeline are respectively arranged on the upper valve block and the lower valve block, the metering pipeline is provided with a metering plunger hole L, a metering plunger is arranged in the metering plunger hole L, the reversing pipeline is provided with a reversing plunger hole H, a reversing plunger is arranged in the reversing plunger hole H, and an indicating rod is connected to the outer side of the metering plunger.

title_en: Fastening system with sealing arrangement
abstract_en: A deformable fastening system includes a clamped component and a fastener including a bolt having a shaft portion extending along a longitudinal axis of the fastener, and a head portion having a surface including at least one engagement portion and one or more protrusions formed on the at least one engagement portion. The one or more protrusions are formed on the at least one engagement portion substantially adjacent to the shaft portion. One or more protrusions formed on the at least one engagement portion engage with a mating surface of the clamped component to clamp the clamped component as the bolt moves into the nut member, resulting in an increase in axial load to deform the clamped component during a tightening cycle.

title_en: Rotary door opening and closing system and method for embedded household appliance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of household electrical appliance actuators, and particularly relates to a rotary door opening and closing system and a rotary door opening and closing method of an embedded household electrical appliance. The system comprises a machine body, a door body, a rotary actuator and a thrust actuator, wherein the rotary actuator drives the door body to rotate through a swing arm and a transmission connecting rod, and the thrust actuator overcomes initial resistance when the door body is closed in an initial stage of opening the door. The rotary actuator has a bi-directional transmission characteristic. The opening and closing method comprises an electric door opening mode, an electric door closing mode and a manual opening and closing mode, wherein a thrust actuator and a rotary actuator work cooperatively when the electric door opening is carried out, the electric door closing is independently driven by the rotary actuator, the electric door closing is carried out by utilizing the bidirectional transmission characteristic when the electric door opening is carried out manually, the door body movement is detected by combining an angle sensor, and the rotary actuator can be triggered to output auxiliary torque to offset mechanical resistance or adjust the opening and closing speed. The invention realizes the compatibility of automatic and manual operation without high-cost clutch, and is suitable for embedded household appliances such as refrigerators, ovens and the like.

title_en: Multifunctional irrigation area telemetry terminal and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a multifunctional irrigated area telemetry terminal and a control method thereof, which belong to the technical field of hydrological telemetry and comprise a base, a mounting rod, a mounting plate, a mounting box and a telemetry terminal, wherein the bottom of the mounting rod is rotatably arranged on the base; the bottom of the mounting plate is provided with a floating piece which is used for enabling the mounting box to be positioned above the liquid level, the supporting effect of the supporting piece is released, the supporting rod is enabled to fall onto the ground, and the mounting box floats on the liquid level through the floating piece. The application has the effect of prolonging the service life of the telemetry terminal.

title_en: Multi-screen folding display
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of displays, in particular to a multi-screen folding display, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a supporting mechanism is rotatably connected to the bottom of the mounting frame, two sliding seats are arranged on the mounting frame in a sliding fit manner, a display screen A and a display screen B are rotatably connected to the sliding seats, a connecting block is rotatably connected between the two display screens B, a backboard is fixedly connected to the mounting frame, a transmission mechanism is rotatably connected in the backboard, a protective cover is arranged on one side of the backboard, and the foldable display screens A and B are arranged to be unfolded and used when in use, so that more working space is provided, the foldable display screen is very useful for application scenes requiring a larger display area when in the design work of multitasking, the foldable display screen is folded when not in use, one side of the screen is folded together, a desktop or a storage space is remarkably saved, the foldable display screen is convenient to move, the screen of the display screen A and the display screen B is effectively protected, and the risk of external physical damage is reduced.

title_en: Air environment protection quality monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses air environment protection quality monitoring equipment, which relates to the technical field of air quality monitoring and comprises a weight increasing and positioning mechanism, wherein the weight increasing and positioning mechanism comprises a rectangular canal frame, a monitoring and protecting mechanism is arranged at the top of the rectangular canal frame, a protecting top frame is fixedly connected to the top of the rectangular canal frame, and a drawing opening is formed in the surface of the protecting top frame. This air environment protection quality monitoring facilities carries out the use of combination formula through positioning mechanism and the monitoring protection mechanism that will increase weight, and the setting of these two mechanisms can be when the rainwater volume is great, utilizes the hydroscopicity of sponge piece to utilize the linkage between the structure to drive shielding protection frame and isolation barrier and fold and descend, thereby protect equipment box and air detector, avoid equipment to expose in the rain for a long time, and still need not the manual operation of staff, made things convenient for the use.

title_en: Hose assembly and assembling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hose assembly and an assembling method thereof, and relates to the technical field of gas conveying, wherein the hose assembly comprises a metal joint, a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece, wherein the metal joint comprises a core head and a core tail which are integrally arranged, and a plurality of first annular bosses are sequentially arranged on the outer side wall of the core tail along the axial direction of the core tail; the flexible pipe comprises a flexible pipe body, a metal sleeve, a second rubber ring, a core tail, a flexible pipe body, a flexible pipe sleeve and a second rubber ring, wherein the flexible pipe body is sleeved on the outer side wall of the core tail, the flexible pipe body comprises a flexible pipe inner layer, a fiber layer and a flexible pipe outer layer which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside along the pipe diameter direction of the flexible pipe body, a plurality of metal wires are woven in the fiber layer, tinfoil paper is coated on the peripheral outer side of the fiber layer, a plurality of first rubber rings are arranged on the peripheral outer side of the flexible pipe outer layer in an array manner, the metal sleeve is sleeved on the outer side wall of the flexible pipe body, and the outer side wall of the metal sleeve is sleeved with the second rubber ring. The hose assembly solves the technical problem that the existing hose assembly adopts a simple composite structure, and is difficult to meet the dual requirements of wear resistance and conductivity.

title_en: Friction material for brake shoe of washing machine, friction block and preparation method of friction block
abstract_en: The application provides a friction material for a brake shoe of a washing machine, a friction block and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of washing machines. The friction material for the washing machine brake shoe comprises, by volume, 8% -18% of organic silicon resin, 12% -18% of powdered styrene-butadiene rubber, 15% -25% of mineral fibers, 18% -28% of graphite lubricant, 10% -20% of calcium silicate and 10% -15% of aluminum oxide. The friction material for the brake shoe of the washing machine has the advantages of stable and silent braking, long self service life, prolonged service life of a braking pair, suitability for the brake shoe of the washing machine, and capability of greatly reducing the emission of volatile organic compounds and improving the environmental protection of the friction material by adopting the water-based organic silicon resin in the friction material.

title_en: Butt joint mechanism for pipeline installation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline installation butt joint mechanism which comprises an installed pipeline and a pipeline to be installed, and further comprises an external thread butt joint port, a horn-shaped internal thread butt joint port and an auxiliary butt joint unit, wherein the external thread butt joint port is arranged at a pipe orifice of the installed pipeline, the horn-shaped internal thread butt joint port is arranged at the pipe orifice of the pipeline to be installed, the auxiliary butt joint unit is arranged between the external thread butt joint port and the horn-shaped internal thread butt joint port, and the problem that the butt joint of the installed pipeline and the pipe orifice to be installed is difficult to manually lift up can be more conveniently realized through the arrangement of the external thread butt joint port and the horn-shaped internal thread butt joint port on the installed pipeline and the pipeline to be installed.

title_en: Pipeline detection robot applicable to multiple scenes
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-scene applicable pipeline detection robot, which comprises a robot main body, wherein two sides of the robot main body are respectively connected with a driving device through a telescopic bracket, two ends of the driving device are respectively provided with a spiral cylinder, the top of the robot main body is provided with an image acquisition device, two sides of the top of the robot main body are respectively provided with a lifting driving device, and the lifting driving devices are respectively connected with the telescopic bracket, so that the spiral cylinders can be lifted under the driving of the lifting driving devices, and the transverse span adjustment is realized under the driving of the telescopic brackets. When the invention is used, the spiral barrels on the two sides of the robot main body can be contracted and also can be extended, so that the detection robot can run in pipelines with different sizes, and therefore, the inspection of pipelines with different diameters is met, and the driving motor is arranged on the robot main body and is not directly connected with the spiral barrels, thereby avoiding the direct contact of the driving motor with water and protecting the driving motor.

title_en: High-strength anti-corrosion fastener for automobile engine and forming process of high-strength anti-corrosion fastener
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength anti-corrosion fastener for an automobile engine and a forming process thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fasteners. The high-strength anti-corrosion fastener for the automobile engine comprises a screw rod and a screw cap, wherein the screw cap is fixedly connected with the surface of the top end of the screw rod, the surface of the groove is connected with a connecting sleeve, the outer wall of the connecting sleeve is fixedly connected with a connecting block, and the surface of the connecting sleeve is rotationally connected with a circular ring. This high strength anti-corrosion fastener of automobile engine through with ring and groove connection and turning adapter sleeve for the extrusion piece extrudees and promotes and presses the briquetting, makes the surface of rubber pad extrusion screwdriver, thereby carries out the centre gripping to the screwdriver, has guaranteed still can accomplish the dismantlement to the bolt under the condition of smooth silk, extrudees the inside air of pressure gas storehouse through the inside connecting rod of rubber pad, thereby promotes the connecting rod that does not contact with the screwdriver and outwards slides, thereby extrudees the surface of screwdriver, still can accomplish the dismantlement to the bolt when using other models screwdrivers.

title_en: Hydrogen storage tank and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydrogen storage tank and application thereof, wherein the hydrogen storage tank comprises a tank body, a heat exchange system and a control system; the tank body adopts a multilayer composite structure and comprises an inner layer, an intermediate layer and an outer layer, the heat exchange system comprises a cooling pipeline, a radiating fin and a circulating pump, and the control system comprises a pressure sensor, a temperature sensor and a central control module. The hydrogen storage tank adopts the tank body with a multi-layer composite material structure, thereby improving the durability and the safety under high pressure and complex environment. The novel hydrogen storage material with high hydrogen storage capacity is adopted, so that higher hydrogen storage density is realized, and the hydrogen storage effectiveness is greatly improved. The heat exchange system is arranged in the hydrogen storage tank, so that the heat and mass transfer efficiency of the hydrogen storage tank is improved, and the hydrogen absorption and release process is faster and more uniform.

title_en: Pipeline shelled shrimp bent connection structure and preforming method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pipeline dried shrimp bending connection structure and a preforming method thereof, which belong to the technical field of dried shrimp bending, and comprise a plurality of bending sections which are sequentially connected, wherein each bending section comprises a bending part, two ends of each bending part are fixedly provided with flange parts, one of the two flange parts on the same bending section is provided with a slot, the slot is a through slot, one side of the other flange part, which is far away from the bending part, is fixedly provided with a plurality of inserting strips, the inserting strips and the inserting strips are in one-to-one correspondence and are matched, each inserting strip comprises an inserting section and a bending section, the radial positioning of the two bending sections after connection is realized through the matching between the inserting ends and the inserting slots, and the axial positioning of the two bending sections after connection is realized through the matching between the bending sections and grooves, so that the stability of the two bending sections after connection is improved, and the preforming effect of the pipeline dried shrimp is improved.

title_en: Power hydraulic control system of double-arm drilling trolley for tunnel surrounding rock construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power hydraulic control systems, in particular to a power hydraulic control system of a double-arm drilling trolley for tunnel surrounding rock construction, which comprises an acquisition module, an analysis module and a control module, wherein the acquisition module is used for acquiring state characteristic parameters of two oil pumps and state characteristic parameters of two drilling arm equipment; the method comprises the steps of analyzing oil pump state characteristic representation values and drill boom equipment state characteristic representation values through an analysis module, dividing fault risk grade trends based on the oil pump state characteristic representation values through a control module, and monitoring safe operation states of two drill booms based on dividing results. According to the invention, through the correlation analysis of the oil pump state characteristic parameters and the drill boom state characteristic parameters, the fault grade tendency is accurately divided, the accuracy of the power hydraulic control system is obviously improved, the occurrence of sudden shutdown is reduced, and the running efficiency of equipment is further improved.

title_en: Multi-degree-of-freedom heavy-load synchronous object moving machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-degree-of-freedom heavy-load synchronous object moving machine, which comprises at least two groups of synchronous walkers, wherein the two groups of synchronous walkers can alternately move, each synchronous walker comprises a sliding component, a jacking component and a rotary servo mechanism, the jacking component is arranged on the upper part of the sliding component, the rotary servo mechanism is arranged on the rear part of the jacking component, and two groups of servo rotating mechanisms consisting of a servo motor and a gear assembly are respectively arranged below jacking hydraulic cylinder assemblies of a first group of synchronous walkers and a second group of synchronous walkers based on the concept of double groups of walkers. The novel device can realize various translational movements, arc-shaped and even in-situ rotational movements on a plane, and the innovation avoids the use of a separate pushing hydraulic cylinder and continuously adjusts the pushing position, or a prefabricated movement guide rail can only rotate by a specific angle. The movement of the walking device becomes very flexible, the movement process is safe and reliable, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Pipeline supporting vibration isolation device, system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vibration isolation devices, in particular to a pipeline supporting vibration isolation device, a system and a method, which comprise a movable base; the pipe clamp comprises a movable base, a mounting frame fixedly connected to the movable base and comprising a bottom and upright posts standing on the left side and the right side respectively, an upper pipe clamp and a lower pipe clamp which are connected to the upright posts on the left side and the right side respectively and are separable relative to each other, two transverse springs, a first end of each of the two transverse springs is connected to the lower pipe clamp, a second end of one of the two transverse springs is connected to the upright post on the left side, a second end of the other transverse spring is connected to the upright post on the right side, and a vertical spring, a first end of which is connected to the lower pipe clamp, and a second end of which is connected to the bottom of the mounting frame. The invention forms a changeable internal structure through the two transverse springs and the vertical spring, and effectively isolates low-frequency vibration while providing effective supporting action for the pipeline.

title_en: Composite rolling bearing cage with improved behaviour
abstract_en: A rolling bearing cage (3) comprising an annular body (7) having a plurality of pockets or seats (8) for rolling bodies of a rolling bearing, the annular body having an axis of symmetry (A) and being made of a fibre-reinforced synthetic plastics material comprising reinforcing fibres (11) of a plurality of radial layers (18) embedded in a synthetic plastics material (13) and configured to form a predetermined angle (beta) with the axis of symmetry of the cage when the cage is viewed in plan, wherein an annular contact zone (22) of each pocket or seat configured for contact engagement with a rolling body (6) in use has an axial width defined by at least one or more layers or strips (18 c) extending in a radial direction with respect to the axis of symmetry of the cage, wherein the predetermined angle of the reinforcing fibres of the at least one or more layers or strips is substantially equal to 90 °.

title_en: Solenoid valve driving system, solenoid valve driving method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a solenoid valve driving system, a solenoid valve driving method and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of automobiles. The electromagnetic valve driving system comprises an expansion type domain controller, a first area control unit and a second area control unit, wherein the expansion type domain controller is respectively in communication connection with the first area control unit and the second area control unit and is used for respectively sending electromagnetic valve driving signals to the first area control unit and the second area control unit, the first area control unit is arranged on the first side of the automobile body and is electrically connected with an electromagnetic valve on the first side of the automobile body and is used for receiving the electromagnetic valve driving signals sent by the expansion type domain controller and driving the electromagnetic valve on the first side of the automobile body, and the second area control unit is arranged on the second side of the automobile body and is electrically connected with the electromagnetic valve on the second side of the automobile body and is used for receiving the electromagnetic valve driving signals sent by the expansion type domain controller and driving the electromagnetic valve on the second side of the automobile body. By the scheme disclosed by the application, the wiring complexity of the whole vehicle can be reduced.

title_en: Damping rotating shaft with self-locking function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of damping rotating shafts with a self-locking function, and discloses a damping rotating shaft with a self-locking function, which comprises a threaded ring, wherein the inner wall of the threaded ring is in threaded connection with a movable ring, a ring-shaped groove is formed in the movable ring, a slip ring is connected in the ring-shaped groove in a sliding manner, the surface of the threaded ring is fixedly connected with a limiting expansion plate, and the surface of the slip ring is fixedly connected with a driven expansion block. According to the invention, the self-locking mechanism is arranged, so that the friction plate is in contact with the surface of the damping rotating shaft more tightly when the stressed telescopic pipe is contracted, the whole self-locking of the rotating frame is more stable when the rotating frame rotates in place, and the larger the rotating angle of the rotating frame is, the larger the friction force generated by the friction plate and the damping rotating shaft is, so that the whole stability of the rotating frame is improved, the durability of the self-locking function is improved, and the phenomenon that the self-locking function is poor due to the fact that the gasket or the friction plate is used for a long time is solved.

title_en: Antistatic flexible connection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antistatic flexible connection and a preparation method thereof, wherein the antistatic flexible connection comprises a flange plate and a connecting piece for connecting the flange plate, the connecting piece is composed of a middle buffer layer and antistatic functional layers arranged on two sides of the middle buffer layer, and the antistatic functional layers comprise, by weight, 5-10 parts of conductive polymers, 2-5 parts of interface modifiers, 1-3 parts of self-made antioxidants, 35-45 parts of inorganic filler modified polyurethane elastomers, 10-18 parts of functional fillers, 3-6 parts of fluorosilicones, 5-9 parts of melamine cyanurate, 8-12 parts of nano kaolin and 2-5 parts of polyethylene glycol diacrylate. According to the invention, through reasonable collocation and synergistic effect of the components, the antistatic flexible connection is excellent in antistatic property, mechanical property, flame retardance, aging resistance and the like, and meets the use requirement under complex working conditions.

title_en: Multi-particle-size particle damping device based on double-chamber and electromagnetic regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-particle-size particle damping device based on double chambers and electromagnetic regulation, which comprises a damping shell, wherein the damping shell is divided into a first chamber and a second chamber which are mutually independent through an insulating partition plate, particles with different particle sizes are respectively arranged in the first chamber and the second chamber, an electromagnet is arranged at the end part of each chamber, an electromagnet coil is wound around the periphery of the electromagnet, and a current coil is arranged around the outer side part of each chamber. The device holds ferromagnetic particles with different particle diameters respectively through setting up two independent cavities to utilize electromagnetic control to realize intelligent release and the excitation of granule, thereby realize self-adaptation, the low energy consumption suppression to broadband vibration, show promotion damping efficiency and reliability, realized that damping frequency band is narrow, unable adaptation frequency variation and the high scheduling problem of energy consumption among the solution prior art through above-mentioned device.

title_en: Aviation opening support closing locking mechanism and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an aviation opening, supporting and closing locking mechanism and method, comprising a side guide rail main body, a base, a supporting lock sleeve and a supporting lock hook assembly; when the side guide rail main body rotates to a horizontal closing state, the supporting lock sleeve and the supporting lock hook component are clamped and locked, and when the side guide rail main body rotates to an opening supporting state, the bottom surface of the supporting lock sleeve is supported on the top surface of the supporting lock hook component to realize stable support. The invention has the advantages of small structure volume, light overall weight, convenient operation and convenient installation, and can realize the requirements of quick overturning, opening, quick closing and locking of the side guide rail, and the safety is increased by the buffer function in the closing process. The invention has complete whole function, reliable structure, high artificial efficiency and low failure rate.

title_en: Valve fault identification system based on flow calculation
