abstract_en: The invention relates to a valve fault recognition system based on flow calculation, wherein a light source emitter is arranged in the inner wall of a water inlet hole section of a flow passage hole of a valve, a light source receiver is arranged in the inner wall of a water outlet hole section of the flow passage hole, the light source emitter and the light source receiver can respectively extend into the hole section where the light source emitter and the light source receiver are positioned and synchronously move, each time a valve core moves by one millimeter, the flow increment is K, a controller controls the flow of the valve to be increased to M, namely the detection value of a second flow sensor is M, M-Q < 2 > = a, a/K= b is calculated, if b = c at the moment and c at the moment are the detection values of a displacement sensor for detecting the displacement of the valve core, the valve fault is not on an action executing mechanism of the valve core, then the controller opens the valve to the maximum, the light source emitter and the light source receiver synchronously extend into the lowest side in the hole section where the light source receiver is positioned, and if the light source receiver intermittently receives light source receiver during the period, the valve hole is blocked. The invention can accurately and efficiently carry out remote detection on the faults of the valve.

title_en: Design method of hydraulic elastic vibration isolator
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of a liquid spring vibration isolator, wherein the whole liquid spring vibration isolator comprises a liquid cavity surrounded by a vulcanizing body, the upper part of the liquid cavity is sealed by an upper cover plate, the inside of the liquid cavity is divided into an upper liquid cavity and a lower liquid cavity by a runner body, a liquid channel is arranged on the runner body to communicate the upper liquid cavity with the lower liquid cavity, a lower cover plate is assembled below the vulcanizing body, a rubber elastic sheet is arranged between the runner body and the lower cover plate, the rubber elastic sheet and the vulcanizing body form a lower liquid cavity, the rubber elastic sheet and the lower cover plate form an air cavity, the vulcanizing body is divided into four connected petals along the circumferential direction, the shape of rubber springs of two opposite petals is laminated rubber formed by an outer cylinder with an inner flange and an inner cylinder with an outer flange, the shape of the rubber springs of two opposite petals is a fan ring, and each size of the upper liquid cavity, the liquid channel and the laminated rubber is designed according to the following formula, and each size of the vibration isolator is further determined: 。

title_en: Folding device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a folding device and electronic equipment. The rotating mechanism of the folding device comprises a main shaft, a first shell support, a first rotating piece, a first sliding piece and a first limiting module, wherein the first limiting module is rotationally connected to the main shaft, the first limiting module comprises a fourth rotating center, the first limiting module is in sliding connection with the first sliding piece, the first limiting module is in sliding connection with the first shell support, and the sliding direction of the first shell support relative to the first limiting module is opposite to the sliding direction of the first sliding piece relative to the first limiting module in the relative folding or relative unfolding process of the folding device. According to the application, the first limiting module is arranged to restrict the track of relative sliding between the first sliding piece and the first shell bracket, so that the assembly virtual position between the first sliding piece and the first shell bracket is reduced.

title_en: Tunnel construction conveying pipeline installation device and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel construction and discloses a tunnel construction conveying pipeline installation device and an operation method, wherein the tunnel construction conveying pipeline installation device comprises a carrier vehicle, the bottom of the carrier vehicle is fixedly connected with a carrier vehicle chassis, the inner bottom wall of the carrier vehicle is fixedly connected with a plurality of mechanical arm bases, and a control system is arranged in the conveying pipeline installation device; the control system is respectively connected with the pipeline carrying system, the pipeline installation system, the traction system and the monitoring system in a signal manner and is used for uniformly scheduling the pipeline carrying system, the pipeline installation system and the traction system to cooperatively operate so as to complete automatic installation of the pipeline. The carrier loader bears pipeline materials, and utilizes the pipeline carrying system to realize automatic grabbing, carrying and lifting of the pipeline, and is matched with the pipeline installation system for installation, so that the problems of unstable standing and falling risk of operators caused by traditional manual carrying and lifting of the pipeline are avoided, and the operation safety of a tunnel construction site is improved.

title_en: Article mounting device and system including the same
abstract_en: An article mounting system includes an article mounting device and an article (e.g., an accessory article) including a first article mount integral therewith. The article mounting device includes a body and a first article attachment body. The first article attachment body is movably attached to the body for enabling the first article attachment body to move between a first use position relative to the body and a second use position relative to the body. The first article attachment body includes a set of retention members engageable with a set of mating retention members of the first article mount. This engagement releasably retains the first article mount in a selected one of a plurality of available mounting positions relative to the first article attachment body.

title_en: Top spraying and draining device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a top spraying and draining device, which relates to the technical field of bathroom equipment, and comprises a base, a valve seat and a movable valve, wherein the base is provided with a water inlet end and a water outlet end, a water guide channel is formed between the water inlet end and the water outlet end and is communicated with the water outlet channel, the valve seat is provided with a first connecting end and a second connecting end, the first connecting end is connected with the water inlet end in a conducting manner, a water passing channel is formed between the first connecting end and the second connecting end, the water passing channel is provided with a water through hole, the water through hole is communicated with the top spraying channel, the movable valve comprises a valve body and an elastic piece, residual water in the top spraying pipeline can be rapidly drained through the water outlet channel, the time of top spraying and dripping is reduced, the use comfort of a shower faucet is improved, meanwhile, the problems of bacterial breeding and the like caused by accumulated water remaining in the top spraying pipeline can be avoided, the smoothness of the top spraying channel can be kept in winter, and the use convenience of the shower faucet is improved.

title_en: Pressure vessel for storing a fluid medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pressure vessel (1) for storing a fluid medium, in particular hydrogen, comprising an inner liner (2) having a fluid-tight, in particular impermeable, storage space (4) for storing the fluid medium, a support sleeve (6) which supportingly accommodates the inner liner (2) in a receiving space (8), and a connecting element (14). The support sleeve (6) has a supply opening (10) which opens into the receiving space (8), the inner liner (2) has a storage opening (12) which is arranged coaxially to the supply opening (10) of the support sleeve (6) and opens into the storage space (4), and the connecting element (14) has a connecting opening (16) which extends coaxially to the supply opening (10) and the storage opening (12) and has a connecting geometry (18) for connection to the connecting fitting. The connecting element (14) is arranged with an annular neck section (20) lying against the supply opening (10) in the circumferential direction in the radial direction and with a flange section (22) adjoining the neck section (20) projecting into the receiving space (8) of the support sleeve (6), such that the flange section (22) lies against the inner wall of the support sleeve (6) in the edge region of the supply opening (10) and the inner liner (2) is connected in a fluid-tight manner with the flange section (22) in the edge region of the storage opening (12). The connection geometry (18) is arranged in a flange section (22) of the connection element (14).

title_en: High-performance powder metallurgy disc assembly for motor brake and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of motor brakes, in particular to a high-performance powder metallurgy disc assembly for a motor brake and a preparation process thereof, wherein the disc assembly comprises, by mass, 60-75% of copper powder, 3-8% of zinc powder, 2-8% of granular graphite, 5-10% of silicon carbide, 5-8% of tungsten carbide, 0.5-1.5% of graphene nano-sheets, 0.5-2% of rare earth oxide, and the like, wherein the silicon carbide and the tungsten carbide are uniformly embedded into a matrix material through a powder metallurgy process, the hardness is enhanced, the abrasion rate is reduced by 60% compared with that of a traditional material, the main component of the graphene nano-sheets is carbon atoms, the unique multilayer graphene three-dimensional structure endows good heat conductivity far better than that of the traditional metal material, and the heat is prevented from being locally accumulated, and the preparation process comprises raw material pretreatment, mixing, pressing, skeleton treatment, sintering and machining treatment, and has a short production period and a wide application prospect.

title_en: Clutch control method, device, vehicle, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clutch control method, a clutch control device, a vehicle, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the steps of determining initial control parameters of a clutch in a vehicle based on driving requirements of the vehicle, predicting target system pressure of the clutch based on the initial control parameters, adjusting the initial control parameters based on the target system pressure to obtain adjusted control parameters, controlling operation of the clutch based on the adjusted control parameters, adjusting the adjusted control parameters based on actual operation states of the clutch to obtain target control parameters, and controlling operation of the clutch based on the target control parameters. The invention solves the technical problem of poor control accuracy of the clutch in the related technology.

title_en: Integrated hydraulic pressure regulating system controlled by single chip microcomputer and pressure regulating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic control, in particular to an integrated hydraulic pressure regulating system controlled by a single chip microcomputer and a pressure regulating method thereof; acquiring coal mine range data, dividing a coal mine area into a plurality of detection areas, marking pressure regulating points in each detection area, and establishing a detection area-pressure regulating point mapping table; the system comprises a mapping table building module, a dynamic pressure regulating module and a hydraulic early warning module, wherein the real-time acquisition of the hydraulic data of the coal mine area and the dynamic regulation of pressure regulating parameters are realized, so that the safety and the efficiency of coal mining operation are improved.

title_en: Pipeline mobile robot positioning method and leakage detection system based on SCADA system
abstract_en: The application discloses a positioning method of a pipeline mobile robot and a leakage detection system based on a SCADA system, solves the problem of accumulation of positioning errors of the existing pipeline robot and the problem of how to realize efficient monitoring of a tap water pipeline, and belongs to the field of communication and intelligent pipeline monitoring. The method comprises establishing undirected graph model of pipeline network, using key position in the pipeline network as node, screening node set B of information source, and screening adjacent node pair set in B Finding And finding out the unique common point in the P as the robot position. According to the leakage detection system, the macroscopic monitoring capability of the SCADA monitoring module is combined with the microscopic detection capability of the pipeline robot, a full-link closed-loop linkage mechanism from data acquisition, anomaly analysis and task dispatch to on-site rechecking is formed, and an edge calculation module is utilized to distribute task instructions and process data for the pipeline robot, so that efficient monitoring is realized.

title_en: Rotating shaft device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a rotating shaft device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of folding structures, wherein the rotating shaft device comprises a base, a first rotating mechanism and a second rotating mechanism, the first rotating mechanism and the second rotating mechanism are respectively connected to two opposite sides of the base in a rotating way so that the rotating shaft device has a folding state and an unfolding state, the first rotating mechanism is connected with a movable mechanism through a first track rotating piece, a first synchronous rotating piece, a first sliding piece and a first sliding track piece, one end of the first sliding track piece is rotationally connected with the first track rotating piece, the other end of the first sliding track piece is slidingly connected with the first sliding piece, the first sliding piece can rotate relative to the first track rotating piece and slide relative to the first track rotating piece, and the required rotating angle of the first track rotating piece can be designed to be smaller under the condition that the rotating shaft device is switched between the folding state and the unfolding state.

title_en: Setting method of heat preservation system for solving corrosion under layer and heat preservation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a setting method of a heat preservation system for solving corrosion under a layer and the heat preservation system, which is characterized by comprising the steps of connecting adjacent independent heat preservation units, sealing two ends of each heat preservation unit by using sealing end plates, setting the starting point and the finishing point of each heat preservation unit, installing the sealing end plates, setting supporting blocks, heat preservation inner layer pipe shells and heat preservation outer layer pipe shells, forming an air cavity at the lower part of the heat preservation inner layer pipe shells, setting a moisture-proof layer and an outer protective layer, simultaneously setting an air pumping port, a drainage channel and a water draining and exhausting pipe, setting a pressure monitor and a water monitor, setting the pressure monitor and the pressure monitor in the heat preservation units, and replacing the air in the heat preservation units by using dry air to form a heat preservation environment which is slightly positive pressure of 0.5-1.0Kpa and dry, enabling the internal pressure to be detected to change, and restoring the pressure to a normal pressure sealing state. The invention eliminates the corrosive environment forming the CUI and realizes the passive monitoring and the timely intervention of the CUI.

title_en: Light-weight X-ray imaging detection device for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transmission line detection devices, and particularly discloses a lightweight transmission line X-ray imaging detection device which comprises a frame, two groups of travelling mechanisms and a detection mechanism. The frame is equipped with telescopic extension rod, and detection mechanism locates the extension rod end. The travelling mechanism comprises a travelling arm and travelling wheels which can synchronously move along the Y direction, and the detection mechanism comprises an imaging plate and a ray source which can be adjusted in multiple directions. The device realizes the light weight of the whole structure by simplifying the walking arm structure, adopting the translation driving device, optimizing the layout of the detection mechanism and the like. The design reduces the weight and the volume of the device, is convenient for transportation and high-altitude deployment, ensures the walking stability through reasonable gravity center arrangement, and can efficiently complete nondestructive detection of a power transmission line.

title_en: Shell-shaped inner wall layer pipeline and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shell-shaped inner wall cladding pipe and a processing technology thereof, wherein the inner wall of the conveying pipe is sequentially connected with a welding layer, a woven net and a shell hydrophobic layer from outside to inside, and the shell hydrophobic layer comprises a plurality of independent shell sheets with a blade-shaped structure, and the shell sheets are hinged to the inner side surface of the woven net in a staggered layer or a flat spreading manner. The invention can effectively solve the problems of pipeline blockage, conveying efficiency reduction, difficult cleaning and the like caused by coagulation in the concrete conveying process, and realize the functions of low adhesion between concrete and pipe wall, self-adaptive flow guiding and long-acting coagulation prevention.

title_en: Acid and alkali resistant super wear-resistant high-pressure rubber hose and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an acid and alkali resistant super wear-resistant high-pressure rubber hose and a preparation method thereof. The UPE lining is smooth and has good rigidity, the inner adhesive layer has good elasticity, the middle adhesive layer improves the adhesiveness, the layers cooperate, the internal pressure fluctuation can be effectively dispersed and buffered, and the reinforcing layer is protected. The reinforcing layer adopts the composite design of 'cord fabric and high-strength steel wires or steel wires', the inner layer cord fabric provides basic support and dimensional stability, the outer layer high-strength steel wires or steel wires serve as a main bearing layer, and the compression resistance of the hose is improved. The components of each layer are adjusted to improve the overall performance of the hose.

title_en: Hydrodynamic sliding bearing
abstract_en: Hydrodynamic slide bearing (1) for supporting a rotor (4), having a bearing bush (2) with a bearing surface (3) for supporting the rotor, wherein the bearing surface has at least one first sliding surface (10) and at least one second sliding surface (20), wherein the first sliding surface (10) has at least one first surface section (10 a) which is offset eccentrically with respect to a center point (M0) of the bearing bush, and the second sliding surface (20) has at least one second surface section (20 a), wherein a) in at least one axial section, the second surface section (20 a) has a circular-arc section with a radius (R2), the center point (M2) of which is not offset with respect to the center point (M0) of the bearing bush, and/or b) the second surface section (20 a) has at least one opening (8) in a recess (9) for supplying lubricating medium and/or cooling medium, b 2) has at least one section (24) whose radial depth is in the circumferential direction up to the second sliding surface (20) to an outlet (25) for the continuous lubrication medium or reducing the wedge medium (23) from the recess (9).

title_en: Actuator
abstract_en: The application provides an actuator, which comprises a shell, a driving assembly and an output assembly, wherein the driving assembly is at least partially positioned on the shell and is connected with the output assembly, the output assembly comprises a sleeve, a screw rod, rollers and a retainer, the rollers are in threaded fit with the screw rod, the rollers are at least partially positioned on the sleeve, the rollers are in threaded fit with the sleeve, the rollers are connected with the retainer along the axial direction of the screw rod, the retainer comprises a first end and a second end along the circumferential direction of the retainer, the first end and the second end are connected or an opening is formed between the first end and the second end, and the retainer is convenient to assemble with the screw rod.

title_en: Electromagnetic valve
abstract_en: The application relates to an electromagnetic valve, which comprises a valve body part and a diaphragm assembly, wherein the valve body part is provided with a valve cavity and a main valve port, the valve cavity can be communicated with the main valve port, the diaphragm assembly is positioned in the valve cavity, the diaphragm assembly comprises a diaphragm and a pressing plate, part of the diaphragm is positioned at the periphery of the pressing plate, the diaphragm is fixedly connected or in limit connection with the pressing plate, the diaphragm can elastically deform, the peripheral wall of the pressing plate is arranged at intervals with the wall forming the valve cavity, the diaphragm assembly can slide relative to the valve body part along the axial direction of the valve cavity so as to close or open the main valve port, and in the running process of the diaphragm assembly, an abutting part is in sealing abutting connection with the wall forming the valve cavity. The diaphragm structure is beneficial to reducing the influence of temperature difference on the sealing fit of the diaphragm and the inner cavity of the valve body, so that the sealing fit of the inner cavity of the valve body and the diaphragm assembly is more stable, and meanwhile, the structure of the diaphragm and the pressing plate is adopted, so that the structure is simpler and the use is more reliable.

title_en: Clamp type flange joint without bolt connection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flange connectors, in particular to a clamp type flange connector without bolt connection, which comprises two flange connector bodies, wherein the end parts of the two flange connector bodies are close together, an assembling groove is formed in the end part of each flange connector body, connecting components are sleeved in the assembling groove, two groups of connecting components are arranged, the two groups of connecting components are connected end to end and then wrap flange plates of the two flange connector bodies, and the flange plates are connected by the two groups of connecting components in an end-to-end mode and then wrap the flange plates of the two flange connector bodies. When the flange connector is detached, the fixing device is also only required to be loosened, and the connecting components are removed, so that the two flange connector bodies can be separated. The whole process is simple to operate, saves the time and labor cost of installation and disassembly, and is particularly suitable for occasions with narrow space or higher requirements on the installation and disassembly efficiency.

title_en: Integrated three-dimensional efficient cooling system and cooling method for high-speed permanent magnet motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated three-dimensional efficient cooling system and a cooling method of a high-speed permanent magnet motor, wherein the integrated three-dimensional efficient cooling system comprises a double-oil-way circulation assembly, a stator core annular cooling spray assembly, a shaft core double-end spray assembly and a bearing directional cooling assembly, the double-oil-way circulation assembly forms an oil way A and an oil way B which are mutually independent, the oil way A is communicated with a front bearing directional cooling assembly, the oil way B is communicated with the stator core annular cooling spray assembly, the shaft core double-end spray assembly and a rear bearing directional cooling assembly, the stator and the shaft core spray assembly form an inner and outer double-circulation three-dimensional cooling structure, the double-oil-way independent circulation is adopted to realize front bearing directional cooling, inner and outer side full-coverage spray cooling of a stator winding and rear bearing directional cooling, and a medium after heat absorption flows back through an oil pan for circulation.

title_en: Hydraulic control system for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vehicle hydraulic control, and discloses a vehicle hydraulic control system which comprises a hydraulic execution unit, an oil supply unit and a control unit, wherein the hydraulic execution unit is installed on a vehicle chassis, the oil supply unit comprises an oil tank connected with the hydraulic execution unit through an oil supply pipeline, the control unit is electrically connected with the hydraulic execution unit and the oil supply unit, and the control unit is configured to configure starting priority for the hydraulic execution unit according to the execution state of the hydraulic execution unit or the oil quantity in the oil tank. In conclusion, the control unit dynamically configures the starting priority according to the execution state of the hydraulic execution unit and the oil quantity in the oil tank, so that the response speed and efficiency of the system are improved, the pressure loss in the oil conveying process is reduced, equipment damage caused by insufficient oil quantity or overload is effectively prevented through real-time monitoring and intelligent adjustment, the reliability and stability of the system are improved, and the optimal performance and safety of the system under different working conditions are further ensured.

title_en: Self-loading and unloading generator set with automatic balancing capability and automatic loading and unloading system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of generator set transportation equipment, in particular to a self-loading and unloading generator set with automatic balancing capability and an automatic loading and unloading system. The movable assembly is adjusted to drive the foot frames to synchronously and outwards expand from the outer side of the protection frame group and automatically lock, then all foot frame electric push rods simultaneously act to push the supporting feet of each push rod to downwards move, each supporting leg sequentially stops descending according to the ground contact detection signal until all the supporting legs contact the ground, then the inclination sensor starts to monitor the posture of the platform, the control system drives each foot frame electric push rod to differentially stretch and retract according to real-time inclination data to automatically adjust the platform of the generator set to a horizontal state, after leveling is finished, all foot frame electric push rods synchronously lift to finish loading and unloading operation, and finally the system withdraws the supporting legs and folds the foot frames to an initial position.

title_en: Energy-saving crushing equipment for traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece production raw materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to crushing equipment, in particular to energy-saving crushing equipment for traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece production raw materials, which comprises a frame, wherein one side of the frame is provided with an inclined feed inlet, a group of crushing rollers are rotatably connected in the frame, a first full gear is fixedly connected to each crushing roller, adjacent first full gears are meshed with each other, a fixed shell is fixedly connected to the frame, a transmission shaft is rotatably connected to the fixed shell, one crushing roller is fixedly connected with the transmission shaft, a speed-reducing torque-increasing assembly is arranged in the fixed shell, a speed-increasing torque-reducing assembly is arranged on a movable frame, and the speed-reducing torque-increasing assembly and the speed-increasing torque-reducing assembly share the same transmission shaft. According to the invention, through the design of the speed reduction and torque increase and speed increase and torque reduction double transmission paths, the system can automatically switch between high torque and low speed and low torque and high speed according to real-time load, so that the self-adaptive dynamic switching of a crushing mode is realized, the motor is ensured to always operate in a high-efficiency load zone, and the energy consumption of the whole equipment is remarkably saved.

title_en: Active protection alarm system for vehicle based on thunder detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle active protection alarm system based on a thunder detection, which belongs to the technical field of near electric operation and comprises a base, a first lifting mechanism, a detection head and an audible and visual alarm, wherein the base comprises a shell, a power supply, a host and a router which are arranged in the shell, the router is connected with the host through a network cable, the first lifting mechanism is arranged at the top of the base, the first lifting mechanism is provided with a fixing seat capable of moving up and down, the detection head is connected with the fixing seat in a first axial direction in a rotating manner, the first axial direction is perpendicular to the up-down direction, the detection head is provided with a camera and two laser radars, the two laser radars are positioned on two opposite sides of the camera, the camera and the laser radars are all in communication connection with the router, the audible and visual alarm is arranged at the top of the detection head, and the audible and visual alarm is connected with a serial port on the host.

title_en: Suspension insulator string capable of preventing wind deflection and birds and installation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind deflection preventing and bird preventing suspension insulator string and an installation method, wherein a bird deflection preventing baffle plate and a damper are arranged on a connecting column and are matched with a flange plate at the top, so that the integration of bird deflection preventing and wind deflection preventing functions is realized, the operation safety of a power transmission line is improved, and the failure rate caused by bird damage and wind deflection is reduced; the anti-wind-deflection and anti-bird suspension insulator string comprises an insulator string main body, wherein the insulator string main body comprises an insulator string, a connecting column is arranged at the upper end of the insulator string, a sleeve assembly for a transmission line to pass through is arranged at the lower end of the insulator string, an anti-bird baffle is arranged at the bottom of the connecting column, a flange plate is arranged at the top of the connecting column, a damper is arranged between the flange plate and the anti-bird baffle, and the damper is sleeved on the connecting column.

title_en: Controller for controlling differential lock system, axle assembly, method, and computer readable instructions
abstract_en: Aspects of the present invention relate to a controller for controlling a differential lock system of a vehicle having a plurality of wheels. The controller includes one or more processors collectively configured to receive wheel state information specific to at least two wheels. Further, the controller is configured to determine a differential lock set point based at least on the wheel status information, the differential lock set point indicating whether the differential lock should be engaged or disengaged. In addition, the controller is configured to output a differential lock set point to the differential lock system to control the differential lock system to engage or disengage the differential lock based on the differential lock set point. The invention also relates to a differential lock system, an axle assembly, a method, and computer readable instructions.

title_en: Pipeline repairing robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline repairing robot which comprises a supporting cylinder, a reducing cylinder, a diameter adjusting assembly, a bearing assembly, a welding assembly and a walking assembly. The pipeline repairing robot provided by the embodiment of the invention can realize the integrated completion of deformation repairing of a pipeline, pipeline lining arrangement and pipeline lining welding, reduces the time and labor intensity of manual reciprocating transportation, and improves the repairing efficiency. The pipe diameter self-adaptive adjusting capability of the robot enables the robot to adapt to pipelines with different diameters, and the application range of the robot is increased. The robot can autonomously move and operate in the pipeline, so that the times of personnel entering the pipeline are reduced, and the risk and the severity of the operation environment are reduced. The robot automatically walks and operates, so that manual intervention is reduced, and human errors and risks in the repairing process are reduced. Through accurate lining position and welded fastening of adjusting, the robot can ensure lining and pipeline's inseparable laminating to reinforcing repair effect.

title_en: Sealing ring suitable for low-temperature high-pressure environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a sealing ring suitable for a low-temperature high-pressure environment, relates to the field of sealing, and solves the problem that a spring energy storage sealing ring is extremely easy to break when being used in an ultralow-temperature high-pressure coupling environment. The sealing ring comprises a clamping sleeve, a spring and a back pressure ring, wherein the clamping sleeve is provided with a clamping cavity, the spring is limited in the clamping cavity, the back pressure ring is arranged at the corner of the clamping sleeve, the corner is a junction area of the outer diameter of the clamping sleeve and the upper end face or a junction area of the outer diameter of the clamping sleeve and the lower end face, the back pressure ring is used for filling at least part of gaps between the clamping sleeve and a groove, the thickness of each part of the clamping sleeve is consistent, the clamping sleeve is provided with a first cantilever, and after the sealing ring is assembled in the groove, the back pressure ring, the first cantilever and the inner wall of the groove are tightly attached, so that each part of the sealing ring has no deformation space under the action of medium pressure. The invention is suitable for low-temperature high-pressure environment, and on the premise of forming a sealing structure, the invention effectively disperses ultralow-temperature high-pressure load and obviously reduces the fracture risk of the jacket from the concept of reducing the deformation of the sealing ring.

title_en: Hydrogen charging and/or discharging control system for hydrogen storage device
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydrogen charging and/or discharging control system for a hydrogen storage device, which comprises a hydrogen source, a hydrogen charging pipeline module and a hydrogen discharging pipeline module, wherein the hydrogen charging pipeline module comprises a first hydrogen charging pipeline unit and a second hydrogen charging pipeline unit, a first flow detection part for detecting the flow rate of hydrogen in the first hydrogen charging pipeline unit is arranged on the first hydrogen charging pipeline unit, a volume chamber is arranged on the second hydrogen charging pipeline unit, the cross section area of the first hydrogen charging pipeline and the cross section area of the second hydrogen charging pipeline are smaller than the minimum flow section area of the volume chamber, the second hydrogen charging pipeline unit is in a hydrogen conveying state when the flow rate of the hydrogen flowing to or out of the hydrogen storage device is larger than the maximum range of the first flow detection part, and the hydrogen discharging pipeline module is arranged on the hydrogen charging pipeline module and is used for discharging the pressure in the hydrogen charging pipeline module or outputting the hydrogen produced by the hydrogen storage device outwards.

title_en: Multidirectional impact-resistant paper-cut-folded-paper synergistic metamaterial
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paper-cut-paper-break synergistic metamaterial capable of resisting impact in multiple directions, which is formed by combining a regular octahedron paper-cut structure and a Kresling paper-break structure. In the compression process, the edge constraint of the octahedral paper-cut structure is utilized to promote the buckling of the paper folding panel, so that the energy absorption efficiency is improved. Compared with the traditional reverse chirality Kresling paper folding metamaterial, the structure has higher specific energy absorption characteristic. In addition, the structural geometric structure has rotation periodicity, and shows good multi-directional mechanical property consistency and rigidity adjustability under quasi-static compression load. The invention can solve the problem that the existing metamaterial is difficult to realize stable and controllable mechanical properties in a plurality of main bearing directions, and remarkably improves the energy absorption efficiency of the structure under the condition of large deformation.

title_en: Brake fluid-resistant hose and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rubber materials, and provides a brake fluid-resistant hose and a preparation method thereof. The brake fluid-resistant hose sequentially comprises, from inside to outside, an inner adhesive layer, a first reinforcing layer, a middle adhesive layer, a second reinforcing layer and an outer adhesive layer, wherein the outer adhesive layer comprises, by weight, 100 parts of ethylene propylene diene monomer, 60-70 parts of carbon black, 5-8 parts of white carbon black, 3-5 parts of a silane coupling agent, 4-6 parts of zinc oxide, 1-3 parts of stearic acid, 2-3 parts of a flow aid, 4-12 parts of a tackifier, 30-50 parts of a plasticizer, 1-2 parts of sulfur, 3-5 parts of an accelerator, 2-6 parts of 2-carboxyethyl phenyl hypophosphorous acid, 4-12 parts of piperazine pyrophosphate and 18-30 parts of hydrotalcite. Through the technical scheme, the problem of poor flame retardance of the brake fluid resistant hose in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Gearbox ventilation cap
abstract_en: A gear box ventilation cap relates to the technical field of gear boxes and comprises a plug body and a filter screen, wherein an air inlet hole, a first condensation oil cavity, a second condensation oil cavity and an exhaust hole are formed in the plug body, the air inlet hole, the first condensation oil cavity, the second condensation oil cavity and the exhaust hole are sequentially communicated, the filter screen is arranged in the air inlet hole, and the filter screen is used for filtering oil in an oil-gas mixture entering the first condensation oil cavity from the air inlet hole. The oil-gas separation device can improve the oil-gas separation effect while reducing the volume, increase the oil recovery quantity, reduce the operation cost and facilitate the disassembly and assembly in a limited space environment.

title_en: Connection assembly
abstract_en: The connection assembly comprises a connection member (4) comprising a shank (12), a bearing and a head (14 b) provided with two opposite faces through which a seat hole forms a receptacle for the bearing, a female connection fork comprising two arms arranged on either side of the head and each provided with a hole, a shaft extending through the arms and the bearing, and a pad (10) provided with a body (34) arranged axially between one arm of the female connection fork and one of the two opposite faces of the head (14 b), at least one protrusion (42 a,42 b) extending from the body (34) and axially beyond said face of the head, and at least one additional protrusion (44 a) extending from the body (34) and in contact with said face of the head (14 b).

title_en: Pipe system and energy storage system
abstract_en: The application discloses a pipe system and an energy storage system, and belongs to the technical field of energy storage. According to the application, the first pipe body of the pipe body system is provided with the first water inlet cavity and the first water outlet cavity which are mutually independent, the second pipe body is provided with the second water inlet cavity and the second water outlet cavity which are mutually independent, and then the first water inlet cavity of the first pipe body is directly communicated with the second water inlet cavity of the second pipe body, and the first water outlet cavity of the first pipe body is directly communicated with the second water outlet cavity of the second pipe body, so that the number of connecting points is greatly reduced, and the possibility of liquid leakage caused by a plurality of connecting points is reduced. Meanwhile, a more direct and concise connecting structure is formed, so that the connection of a pipe body system is more stable, and the leakage risk caused by loose or unstable connection is reduced.

title_en: Power transmission device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission device capable of suppressing unbalance of a first rotary member. The power transmission device is provided with a torque limiter and a vibration reduction unit. The torque limiter has a first side plate, a second side plate, and a friction plate. The vibration damping unit has a first rotating member, a second rotating member, and an elastic member. The first rotation member is configured to rotate integrally with the friction plate. The second side plate has an annular portion and a cylindrical portion. The annular portion extends in a circumferential direction. The cylindrical portion extends from an outer peripheral end portion of the annular portion toward the first side in the axial direction. The first rotating member has an outer peripheral surface that abuts an inner peripheral surface of the cylindrical portion.

title_en: Flexible display device
abstract_en: The flexible display device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may include a display panel, a link member disposed on a rear surface of the display panel and having a plurality of coupling grooves on one surface thereof, a cover having a plurality of coupling protrusions respectively inserted into the coupling grooves, and a driving unit connected to at least one of the link member and the cover to wind or unwind the cover to ascend or descend.

title_en: Anti-tripping automobile pipeline hose clamp
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-tripping automobile pipeline hose clamp, which relates to the technical field of automobile pipeline fasteners and comprises a lock seat, wherein a locking cavity with a cylindrical cavity structure is formed in the lock seat at the position corresponding to the axis of a semicircular structure, and a worm is coaxially arranged in the locking cavity; the invention discloses a worm shaft body, which is characterized in that a slot is formed in the axial center position of the left end face and the right end face of the worm shaft body, and non-standard elliptic special-shaped slots are formed in the axial center positions of the two ends of the worm, so that universal adjusting structures such as a unified word slot, a cross slot, a standard hexagonal slot and the like are abandoned, the conventional tool cannot be clamped and applied with force, the possibility of random adjustment and misoperation of unauthorized personnel is structurally blocked, the attenuation of the tightening force of a steel belt caused by unexpected loosening of the worm is effectively avoided, the stable tightening state of the automobile pipeline is ensured under the working conditions of long-term driving vibration and jolt, and the problem that the worm of the throat hoop of the traditional automobile pipeline can be randomly adjusted by the conventional tool, and the loosening of the worm is easy to occur due to misoperation and the vibration of the automobile, so that the tightening force of the steel belt is attenuated is solved.

title_en: Brake disc for disc brake and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disc for a disc brake, the disc comprising a braking band provided with opposite braking surfaces, the braking band being made of gray cast iron or steel, the disc comprising a base layer covering at least one of the two braking surfaces of the braking band. The base layer comprises a titanium matrix and/or titanium alloy containing one or more carbides and defining the tribological active surface of the disc, or the base layer comprises a layer of titanium and/or titanium alloy and is in turn covered by a coating layer comprising a layer based on one or more carbides and defining the tribological active surface of the disc. The one or more carbides are selected from titanium carbide, tungsten carbide, chromium carbide, niobium carbide, molybdenum carbide, and silicon carbide. At the junction between the base layer and the brake band of gray cast iron or steel, an intermediate fusion layer is provided with a mixed composition between the base layer and the brake band, the base layer having a crystal structure with a growth direction mainly orthogonal to the brake surface.

title_en: Speed reducer heat abstractor and engineering machine tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of speed reducer cooling, and discloses a speed reducer heat dissipation device and engineering machinery, wherein the speed reducer heat dissipation device is arranged on the engineering machinery, the engineering machinery comprises a heat dissipation fan, the speed reducer heat dissipation device comprises a driving piece, a cooling piece and a cooling piece, wherein the driving piece is suitable for driving lubricating oil in a speed reducer to circularly flow; the heat exchanger is suitable for cooling lubricating oil flowing out of the driving piece, and is communicated with the cooling fan, and the cooling fan is suitable for providing cooling airflow for the heat exchanger. The driving piece drives the lubricating oil in the speed reducer to realize circulating flow, and the heat exchanger is utilized to cool the circulating flowing lubricating oil, so that heat generated in the operation process of the speed reducer can be taken away, the problem that the speed reducer is overheated and invalid due to overhigh temperature is avoided, and the operation stability and the service life of the speed reducer are improved.

title_en: Valve device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The connecting piece of the valve device and the valve seat are welded, an included angle exists between the first welding surface and the second welding surface and the axial direction of the valve device, namely, the first welding surface and the second welding surface are obliquely arranged, the first welding surface and the second welding surface are in welding fit, under the condition that the axial dimension of the welding surfaces is unchanged, compared with the scheme that the first welding surface and the second welding surface extend along the axial direction, the area of the welding surfaces can be increased by obliquely arranging the first welding surface and the second welding surface, the welding strength is improved, in the process that the connecting piece is pressed into a mounting hole of the valve seat, the valve seat and the connecting piece are guided through the obliquely arranged second welding surface, the insertion of the connecting piece is facilitated, and due to the included angle exists between the first welding surface and the second welding surface and the axial direction of the valve device, the insertion depth of the connecting piece can be determined by matching the first welding surface and the second welding surface in the process that the connecting piece is not in place in the insertion process of the connecting piece, and the problem that the welding seam is overlarge is caused.

title_en: Sand risk judging method for multi-layer combined injection and production of sandstone oil and gas reservoir
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sand production control of oil and gas reservoir type gas storage wells in the oil and gas exploitation industry, and particularly provides a sand production risk judging method for multi-layer combined injection and production of a sandstone oil and gas reservoir type gas storage well. The multi-layer bit combined injection well is divided into the layered evaluation units, the sand-yielding degree, the pressure circulation disturbance, the flow scouring disturbance and the flow direction conversion disturbance of each layered unit are respectively represented, and then the layered sand-yielding risk index is constructed, so that the sorting, grading and main control sand-yielding risk layer identification of different layers relative to the sand-yielding risk are realized. The invention can pertinently represent the difference of the sand production risks of different reservoir layers under the multi-layer combined injection and production condition of the sandstone oil and gas reservoir type gas storage, and provides a basis for optimizing the injection and production degree of a combined injection and production well, designing layered sand prevention and monitoring sand production.

title_en: Anti-fatigue spherical tank structure for energy storage and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-fatigue spherical tank structure for energy storage and a processing method thereof, wherein the spherical tank structure adopts a bottom support column displacement supporting device, a telescopic tile, a high temperature difference medium mixed water distributor in the spherical tank, a spherical tank interlayer heat-insulating and temperature-resisting connecting pipe structure and the like, the spray device is arranged on the tank top, so that the fatigue failure resistant spherical tank structure under the working condition of high temperature difference and high pressure difference is developed. The fatigue spherical tank can adjust the internal temperature of the spherical tank in time, and is favorable for keeping small temperature difference. The invention improves the structure of the traditional spherical tank, can meet the use characteristics of the spherical tank structure under the use conditions of high temperature difference, high pressure difference and high fatigue life, greatly improves the stability and fatigue resistance of the whole structure of the spherical tank, and overcomes the problems of thermal displacement caused by inadaptable high temperature difference and shorter structural fatigue life caused by high pressure difference and high use cycle times of the traditional spherical tank.

title_en: Helium abnormal leakage identification method, device and remote identification system
abstract_en: The invention provides a helium abnormal leakage identification method, a device and a remote identification system, which belong to the field of industrial gas safety monitoring and Internet of things data processing, calculate the helium mass change rate and the temperature change quantity of each storage tank, and record the sampling cycle number that the helium mass change rate is smaller than an alarm threshold and the temperature change quantity is smaller than a fluctuation threshold continuously When (when) When it is judged that the disturbance is accidental When the storage tank is judged to have abnormal leakage risk, when And when the abnormal leakage of the storage tank is judged, the period is adjusted, and the accurate identification of the abnormal leakage under the temperature disturbance condition is realized.

title_en: Rotor blade bearing for an underwater turbine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rotor blade bearing arrangement (214) for an underwater turbine (1), wherein the rotor blade bearing arrangement (214) is designed to rotatably support a rotor blade shaft (204) in a rotor hub housing (202), wherein the rotor blade shaft (204) has a sea-side end (207) and a rotor hub-side end (208), which is designed to be connected to a rotor blade (4) for joint rotation, the rotor hub-side end is designed to be received by a rotor hub (2), and wherein the rotor blade bearing arrangement (214) comprises the rotor blade shaft (204) and a first sea-side bearing unit (220) and a second rotor hub-side bearing unit (230), wherein the first bearing unit and the second bearing unit (220; 230) are arranged with a distance W from each other, wherein the first bearing unit and the second bearing unit (220; 230) are designed as sliding bearings (225; 235), each having a sliding surface (282; 292) and an outer sliding surface (281; 291), wherein the sliding surface of the first sliding bearing (225) forms on the rotor hub (208) on the rotor hub (282) and the second sliding surface (208), the outer sliding surfaces (281; 291) of the first and second sliding bearings (225; 235) are formed by a rotor hub housing portion (252; 262), wherein the rotor hub housing portion (252; 262) is hollow tubular in form and has a sea end (255) and a rotor hub side end (254), a sliding layer (291) for the first sliding bearing (225) being formed on the sea end and a sliding layer (281) for the second sliding bearing (235) being formed on the rotor hub side end.

title_en: Composite pipeline based on chemical bonding and stress buffering and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite pipeline based on chemical bonding and stress buffering, which comprises a composite pipe body and a coupling connected with the composite pipe body, wherein a chemical bonding layer is formed between the inner surface of the coupling and the outer surface of the composite pipe body, one side of the chemical bonding layer is in coordination bond combination with the inner surface of the coupling, the other side of the chemical bonding layer is in covalent bond combination with a transition zone, the inner wall of the coupling and the outer wall of the composite pipe body are provided with composite mechanical interlocking structures, and the transition zone is filled in gaps of the composite mechanical interlocking structures and between the chemical bonding layer and the outer surface of the composite pipe body. In the technical scheme of the invention, the traditional purely physical adsorption gluing mode is abandoned, the atomic-level interface combination is realized through the chemical bonding layer constructed by the rare earth coupling agent, the problem of debonding of the adhesive layer and the matrix is thoroughly solved, and the retention rate of the interface strength after wet heat aging is more than 95%.

title_en: Underground drip irrigation device and method for alfalfa planting in arid region
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground drip irrigation device for alfalfa planting in arid regions, which relates to the technical field of drip irrigation devices and comprises a supporting plate, wherein a leakage-proof assembly is arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate and comprises a protective sleeve, and a conveying pipe is fixedly embedded in the protective sleeve. When the automatic drip irrigation device is used, in order to ensure normal growth of alfalfa, an underground drip irrigation technology is required to irrigate the alfalfa, in order to prevent the conveying pipe from leaking, the electronic leak detector is firstly opened, whether a pipeline leaks or not is detected, the negative pressure pump is started to drive the two clamping blocks to move to a leaking position, the two electromagnets are electrically connected with an external power supply, the two clamping blocks move in opposite directions to clamp the conveying pipe, glue flows into the surface of the conveying pipe, and meanwhile, the damaged part in the conveying pipe is extruded under the clamping action of the two clamping blocks, so that the damaged part in the conveying pipe is bonded.

title_en: Automatic cleaning valve with efficient cleaning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valves, in particular to an automatic cleaning valve with an efficient cleaning function, which comprises a valve component, wherein a cleaning component is arranged on the end face of the valve component in a matched manner, an induction component is arranged on the end face of the valve component in a matched manner, a spacer is arranged in an inner cavity of the valve component in a matched manner, a plurality of transmission parts II are arranged in the valve component in a matched manner, and a transmission part I is arranged on the end face of a connecting pipe in a matched manner.

title_en: Marine flue gas baffle valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine smoke baffle valve which comprises a valve body, a valve shaft, a valve plate and an opening and closing mechanism. When the valve plate is in a closed state, a double-side annular seal is formed between the valve plate and the inner wall of the valve body, an air cavity is formed between the double-side annular seals in a surrounding mode, and an air through hole communicated with the air cavity is formed in the valve body. The sealing structure is characterized in that a sealing gas cavity is formed by surrounding the sealing gas cavity through the annular sealing at the two sides when the valve is closed, external gas is introduced through the gas through holes, the local temperature of a sealing interface is reduced by utilizing the gas temperature difference effect, the sealing structure is prevented from being subjected to continuous thermal invasion of high-temperature smoke, thermal aging and physical deformation are delayed, meanwhile, the introduced gas establishes a positive pressure difference in the air cavity, micro-permeation flow from inside to outside is generated at the annular sealing interface at the two sides, an active annular fluid barrier is constructed, high-pressure pulse impact of smoke is effectively resisted, penetrating leakage is avoided, and the fluid cut-off reliability is remarkably improved.

The application has higher loading capacity, longer service life, better structural stability and better preparation consistency.
