abstract_en: The utility model discloses a proportional solenoid valve for controlling an actuating mechanism of a bypass valve of an automobile turbocharger, which belongs to the field of proportional solenoid valves and comprises a valve body and an electromagnetic head valve core component connected with the valve body, wherein a pressure regulating component positioned below the electromagnetic head valve core component is arranged in a central cavity of the valve body; an air inlet channel, an air outlet channel and an air outlet channel are respectively arranged in the valve body, an air outlet communicated with the air outlet channel is arranged on one side wall of the valve body, an air inlet and an air outlet communicated with the air inlet channel and the air outlet channel are respectively arranged on the other side wall of the valve body, and an air outlet and pressure relief assembly positioned below the pressure regulating assembly is arranged in the air outlet channel; a cover cap is installed on one side end face of the valve body, a control circuit board is fixedly installed in a cavity on the inner side of the cover cap, and a pressure sensor fixing assembly is connected between the control circuit board and the valve body. Simple structure is compact, and the maintenance of being convenient for can adjust gas outlet pressure, has improved solenoid valve response speed.

title_en: Electric control energy-saving valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatically controlled energy-conserving valve, including full latus rectum hydraulic valve, position sensor, feedback indicator and electromagnetic directional valve, the motion subassembly of feedback indicator and in the full latus rectum hydraulic valve is connected, position sensor corresponds the cooperation with the feedback indicator, an opening of electromagnetic directional valve passes through the pipeline and links to each other with the close valve interface on full latus rectum hydraulic valve upper portion, another opening of electromagnetic directional valve links to each other with the open valve interface of full latus rectum hydraulic valve lower part through the pipeline that is provided with electromagnetic flow control valve, position sensor is provided with and is used for removing the check point when closing on the valve closed position to the feedback indicator. The utility model discloses can reach the purpose that the governing valve closes reliably at a slow speed, realize fast slow double speed and close the valve, reduce head loss when eliminating water hammer harm, have simple structure, safe and reliable, it is convenient to maintain, reduces the loss and reduces the running cost for the user to improve the water yield and reduce the power consumption.

title_en: Fixing device for bearing base for 3D printing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a 3D printer auxiliary assembly technical field specifically is a 3D prints with fixing device who bears base, including supporting mechanism, supporting mechanism is including first double-layered frame, and the bottom fixed mounting of first double-layered frame has a fixing base, the inside of fixing base is inserted and is equipped with the long screw rod, and rotates between long screw rod and the fixing base and be connected, the right-hand member outside cover of long screw rod is equipped with the threaded sleeve. The utility model discloses a set up the supporting mechanism and support in 3D printing apparatus's bottom, effectually avoid direct contact between 3D printing apparatus base and the ground, be favorable to reducing the corruption influence of ground environment to 3D printing apparatus base, be connected through setting up threaded engagement between long screw rod and the threaded sleeve, and set up threaded engagement between first nut and the first bolt and be connected, be favorable to the 3D printing apparatus base of the fixed different specifications of the device centre gripping, the effectual suitable flexibility that has promoted the device.

title_en: Clothing cutting bed rack construction convenient to combination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clothes cutting bed frame structure convenient to combine, which comprises a frame leg, wherein one end of the frame leg is provided with a through clamping groove in a penetrating way, and a fixed beam is slidably clamped in the through clamping groove; a clamping groove penetrates through the inner wall of one side of the penetrating clamping groove, a cross beam is slidably clamped in the clamping groove, and the end part of one side of the cross beam is in friction connection with a fixed beam; the sliding clamping joint of the fixed beam and the cross beam is tightly installed through a screw, and a working table top is installed between the fixed beam and the cross beam in a friction mode; the other ends of the frame legs are rotatably provided with the adjusting assemblies, the whole rack is convenient to disassemble, assemble and transport through the splicing combination of the frame legs, the fixed beam and the cross beam, and meanwhile, the integral stability is ensured due to the clamping structure of the fixed beam and the cross beam; the fixing of the fixed beam and the cross beam can be completed by fixing the fixed beam through the screws, so that the part materials are saved; the cushion pad on the bearing plate can play a role in buffering and damping, and can prevent the noise generated by the large vibration in the use process of the working table.

title_en: Sludge cutting machine convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sludge cutting machine convenient to adjust, including casing, cutting mechanism, adjustment mechanism and damper, cutting mechanism sets up the inside at the casing, adjustment mechanism sets up the top at the casing, damper sets up the bottom at the casing, cutting mechanism includes fly leaf, inlet pipe and row's material pipe, fly leaf sliding connection is on the inner wall of casing, the inlet pipe is installed at the left top of casing. The utility model discloses a mutually supporting of fly leaf, set casing, servo motor, lug, movable plate, dead lever and buffer spring to make cutting blade not only can rotary motion also can relapse the up-and-down motion, thereby improved cutting blade's cutting effect greatly, through mutually supporting of base, antiskid ribbed tile, spout, slide bar, slider, dog, backup pad and damping spring, thereby greatly reduced the vibrations that the device during operation produced, brought very big facility for the user.

title_en: Forged connecting flange
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forge flange, including first flange and second flange, spring groove and first annular have been seted up to first flange inside, the inner wall of first annular is equipped with first spring, the one end of first spring is equipped with the limiting plate, be equipped with the ring on the limiting plate, the one end of ring runs through first flange and is equipped with waterproof gasket, the inner wall of spring groove is equipped with the second spring, the one end of second spring is equipped with the spacing ring, the inner wall of spacing ring is equipped with the inserted block, first flange is run through to the one end of inserted block, be equipped with the third spring on the second flange, the one end of third spring is equipped with the first in command, be equipped with the dead lever on the first in command. The utility model discloses a set up first spring, ring and waterproof gasket, play the purpose that improves first flange and second flange and connect the leakproofness.

title_en: Machine room inspection terminal equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a terminal equipment is patrolled and examined to computer lab can be applied to the finance field. The apparatus comprises: the terminal comprises a terminal body, a temperature sensor and a camera device, wherein the terminal body comprises an RFID reader, the temperature sensor and the camera device, the RFID reader is used for identifying and reading the content of an RFID label, the temperature sensor is used for acquiring the temperature of a machine room server, and the camera device is used for shooting the running state of the machine room server; a telescoping assembly comprising a telescoping piece and a controller, the telescoping piece configured to: changing the length of the telescopic member in response to a control instruction of the controller; the connecting block is used for connecting the terminal body and the telescopic assembly, wherein the top of the connecting block is fixedly connected with the terminal body; the bottom of the connecting block is in threaded connection with the telescopic assembly.

title_en: Battery support of multifunctional battery module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a battery module technical field specifically is a battery support of multi-functional battery module, the fixed four erection columns that are provided with of top symmetry of lower carriage, and the fixed three first recess that is provided with in inside of lower carriage, one of them the inside block of first recess has the baffle that links to each other with the lower carriage, the fixed buffer gear that is provided with in below of lower carriage, and the top of lower carriage is provided with the upper bracket, the fixed first fin that is provided with in top of upper bracket, and the fixed four screw thread posts that link to each other with the erection column that are provided with of below symmetry of upper bracket. The utility model relates to a novelty, the design of baffle makes this device can install fixedly to unidimensional battery module, and because twist through screw post and erection column between upper bracket and the lower carriage and close fixedly to be convenient for dismantle the maintenance or change the battery module, buffer gear can cushion the shock attenuation to the battery module, has increased the practicality.

title_en: Movable air-cooled diesel engine unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable forced air cooling diesel engine unit, including unit rack and universal wheel, the universal wheel is installed to the bottom of unit rack, and the inside of universal wheel is provided with the fixed plate, the one end of unit rack is provided with the filter layer, and one side of filter layer is provided with the layer of ventilating, the opposite side on layer of ventilating is provided with the protection stratum reticulare, and the opposite side on protection stratum reticulare is provided with the fan, the mid-mounting of fan has the pivot, and the outside of pivot is provided with the drive belt, the inside of filter layer is provided with the filter screen, the upper end on layer of ventilating is connected with air filter, and air filter's one end is connected with the air hose, the top of unit rack is provided with the combustion chamber, and the top of combustion chamber is provided with the ignition room of taking a breath. This movable forced air cooling diesel engine set is provided with the fan that sets up and can takes away a large amount of heats that produce when burning fast, and continues to pour into fresh air into to the ignition room of taking a breath, promotes the air-fuel ratio, improves combustion efficiency.

title_en: Adapter sleeve convenient to fix and anti-drop
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a convenient-to-fix and anti-drop adapter sleeve, which comprises a connecting bearing, an adapter sleeve body and a fixed seat, wherein one side of the inner surface wall of the adapter sleeve body is provided with a connecting hole, one end of the connecting hole is provided with a locking bolt, one side of the outer surface wall of the adapter sleeve body is provided with a fixture, one side of the bottom end of the fixture, which is positioned on the outer surface wall of the adapter sleeve body, is provided with a fixture block, and one side of the inner surface wall of the connecting bearing is provided with a mounting hole; this tight fit sleeve convenient to it is fixed and anti-drop, the mounting hole through setting up the interior table wall of connection bearing is in same horizontal plane with the connecting hole of the internal table wall of tight fit sleeve, it is connected with this body interlude of tight fit sleeve to pass through the connecting hole with locking bolt's one end, utilize the locking degree of locking bolt to prescribe a limit to the closed degree of tight fit sleeve body, fixture and tight fit sleeve body swing joint, utilize fixture to avoid the tight fit sleeve body after the closure to recover because of the tension bounce-back that inertia produced, the closed degree of utilizing to prescribe a limit to the tight fit sleeve body reaches the effect of being convenient for to fix.

title_en: Metal hydride hydrogen storage tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal hydride hydrogen storage tank, which comprises a tank body, a flange cover, a heat exchange tube and a radiating fin; a storage cavity is arranged in the tank body, a containing groove is arranged in the side wall of the storage cavity, and the containing groove is filled with a composite phase-change material; the flange cover is hermetically connected with the port of the tank body, and a hydrogen inlet and a hydrogen outlet are formed in the flange cover and are communicated with the storage cavity; the heat exchange tube is arranged in the storage cavity, and the input end and the output end of the heat exchange tube are communicated to the outside of the flange cover; the heat-radiating fins are arranged at intervals along the arrangement track of the heat exchange tube, and hydrogen storage materials are placed between the adjacent heat-radiating fins; therefore, the heat management of the first stage is realized by the arrangement of the composite phase-change material, the heat exchange tube realizes the heat management of the second stage, namely, the heat management efficiency is improved by different heat management modes, and the problem of poor heat management effect of the conventional hydrogen storage tank is solved.

title_en: Electrical equipment outlet box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrical equipment outlet box relates to outlet box technical field, including outlet box body, lid, the inside fixed mounting of outlet box body has two diaphragms, and first spout has all been seted up to two corresponding one sides of diaphragm, and the equal sliding connection in inside of two first spouts has first slider, and fixed mounting has the second outlet box between two first sliders, and the equal movable mounting in both sides of second outlet box has a spool, and two spool are detachable construction, and first outlet has all been seted up to the both sides of second outlet box, and the second outlet has all been seted up to the both sides of outlet box body, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: through utilizing first slider to slide in the inside of first spout to drive the inside removal of third slider at the third spout, make it can pull out the inside of second outlet box from outlet box body, and can dismantle the outlet tube simultaneously, easy operation is swift, has saved the time, has improved the installation effectiveness.

title_en: Rain-proof touch wireless doorbell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rain-proof touch wireless doorbell that drenches, it mainly through set up the screw post that supplies the screw to pass respectively in four bights of medial surface at the back lid, set up in the casing with the jack that the screw post corresponds sets up respectively from its inside surface arc arch to the lateral surface edge at the back lid simultaneously to set up respectively all around the inner wall of casing with the protruding complex arc portion of bearing of arc, set up seal ring on the arc portion of bearing. When the back lid passes through the screw closing cap on the casing from this, the arc arch is located the part of seal ring position in two adjacent screw posts and is pressed to the sunken of arc portion of bearing for thereby the partial seal ring of two adjacent screw posts takes place to warp and carries out in close contact with the arc arch, has guaranteed that casing and back lid can effectively seal the cooperation between the adjacent screw post position with the part of back lid between the adjacent screw post position, thereby improves the sealing performance between the back lid of wireless doorbell and the casing.

title_en: Double-layer sealing device for end plate of rotary reactor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-layer sealing device for end plates of a rotary reactor, which relates to the field of solid waste treatment equipment and comprises a rotary reactor shell, wherein sealing cover plates are fixed on two end surfaces of the rotary reactor shell; an outer sealing plate is arranged on the inner side of the sealing cover plate, a sealing cavity is arranged at the tail end of the outer sealing plate, sealing filler is filled in the sealing cavity, a front end plate is connected to the inner end of the outer sealing plate, and an air suction opening and a feed opening are formed in the front end plate; the inner sealing plate is arranged on the inner side of the outer sealing plate and is folded towards the front end plate in an L shape, the outer end of the inner sealing plate is fixed on the inner wall of the rotary reactor shell, and gaps are formed between the inner end of the inner sealing plate and the outer sealing plate as well as between the inner end of the inner sealing plate and the front end plate. The utility model discloses a set up double-deck seal structure and make the gap between end plate and the rotary reactor completely sealed, also can guarantee sealed effect when the material in the reactor is more, effectively prevent the contact of material and seal packing, reduce seal packing's loss.

title_en: Stamping equipment is used in bearing bush production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stamping equipment for bearing bush production in the technical field of bearing bush processing, which comprises a first workbench, a stamping mechanism, a base, a mold device and a second workbench, wherein the stamping mechanism is fixedly connected on the left side of the top of the first workbench, the base is fixedly connected in the middle of the top of the first workbench, the mold device is positioned in the middle of the inner side wall of the base, the second workbench is fixedly connected on the lower side of the left side wall of the first workbench, the bottom of the first workbench is fixedly connected with a first driving motor, the right side of the top of the first workbench is fixedly connected with a baffle plate, the stamping equipment for bearing bush production has reasonable structural design, the impact force generated by the workbench in the rapid pressing of the stamping mechanism is buffered, the influence on the stability of the whole device is avoided, and the precision of product processing is not reduced, need artifically carry out the unloading, avoid producing accidental injury to the people, improved production efficiency.

title_en: Link pin anti-fleeing device for mechanical fuel pump of truck
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a link pin anti-fleeing device for truck mechanical fuel pump, which comprises a main body, a fuel pump, a bottom pin, a rotating button, a top adjusting block, an anti-fleeing block, a top-arranged traction spring, a bottom-arranged traction spring and a wear-resisting ring, wherein an adjusting groove is arranged on the periphery of the top of the inner wall of the main body, an anti-fleeing cavity is arranged on the periphery of the bottom of the inner wall of the main body, the outer wall of the top end of the main body is provided with the rotating button, the top section of the main body is provided with a rotating screw rod by the inner wall of the adjusting groove, the bottom of the rotating button is fixedly connected with the rotating screw rod, the bottom of the rotating screw rod is provided with the top adjusting block by the inner wall of the adjusting groove, the anti-fleeing block is arranged at the position close to the middle end of the inner wall of the anti-fleeing cavity, the bottom of the main body is provided with the fuel pump, the inner wall of the fuel pump is provided with a longitudinal pin groove, a vertical pin is arranged in the longitudinal pin groove, which relates to the technical field of the mechanical fuel pump anti-fleeing device, and relieves the problem that the anti-fleeing force is reduced after long-escaping device is used for a long time, the problem of the device appear the internal friction damage after receiving vibrations jolting influence for a long time is alleviated.

title_en: Transmission mechanism provided with anti-falling device
abstract_en: The application discloses be provided with drive mechanism of anticreep device includes: the transmission mechanism body and the anti-falling device; the transmission mechanism body comprises a power shaft and a crank arm, and the crank arm is sleeved on the power shaft; the anti-disengaging device comprises an anti-disengaging plate, the anti-disengaging plate is arranged at the end part of the power shaft and fixed on the power shaft through bolts, and the anti-disengaging plate covers the end face of the power shaft and the crank arm surrounds part of the end face of the power shaft. This application makes the connecting lever can not deviate from the power axle through setting up the anticreep device at the power axle head, has improved the reliability of equipment, has eliminated the accident hidden danger of equipment.

title_en: Network security stability real-time monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a network security stability real time monitoring device, including the control display screen, the rear end face fixed mounting of control display screen has the dead lever, the bottom swing joint of dead lever has the connecting rod, the rear end face of connecting rod is provided with the slot, the preceding terminal surface of connecting rod evenly is provided with four spacing holes, the inside card of slot has the picture peg, the bottom fixed mounting of picture peg has the fixed block, the bottom fixed mounting of fixed block has the base, the position that the base up end is located the fixed block front side is provided with the switch. The utility model discloses a set up LED lamp area, make the staff when observing the monitor display screen at night, also have auxiliary light source on every side, avoid only monitor display screen's light source to cause the influence to the eyesight, through setting up connecting rod, dead lever and picture peg, be convenient for adjust monitor display screen's height and angle as required, it is more convenient.

title_en: Punching device for sheet metal machining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of punching devices, in particular to a punching device for sheet metal processing, which comprises a support frame and punching equipment, wherein the middle part of the inner side of the support frame is fixedly connected with an operation table, the middle part of the operation table is slidably connected with a hole-pressing grinding tool, the left side and the right side of the hole-pressing grinding tool are fixedly connected with fixed plates, and the fixed plates are slidably connected with the operation table, the middle part of the lower end of the fixed plates is fixedly connected with fixed blocks, the left side and the right side of the lower end of the outer side of the fixed blocks are fixedly connected with steel bars, in the utility model, when the punching equipment moves downwards, the upper buffer block is contacted with the fixed plates, the upper and the lower shock blocks are contacted, at the moment, the fixed plates are pressed downwards by force, the fixed blocks press the steel bars at the two ends of the outer side downwards, and the limit blocks limit the steel bars, thereby playing a role of simple buffering, set up like this and also improved the life of pressure hole grinding apparatus when having improved whole absorbing effect.

title_en: Torque limiting structure of electric actuator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electric actuator's torsion limit structure, including: a housing assembly having an accommodating space therein; a drive assembly positioned within the housing assembly; the power transmission unit is arranged at the lower section in the shell assembly and at least comprises an output shaft, and a first worm gear part is fixedly arranged at the upper section of the output shaft; the torque limiting assembly at least comprises a shaft part, a first shoulder part, a second shoulder part, a moving part and a transmission rod, wherein the shaft part is provided with a first outer diameter part, a sixth outer diameter part, a first shoulder part, a gear and a second shoulder part; and a sensing assembly.

title_en: Emergency leakage stopping device for gas pipeline emergency repair
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline leakage stopping, and discloses an emergency leakage stopping device for rush repair of a gas pipeline, wherein the middle part of a first circular ring is in threaded connection with a first screw rod, the top part of the first screw rod is rotationally connected with a first clamping block, one side of the bottom part of the first circular ring is rotationally connected with a second circular ring, the middle part of the second circular ring is in threaded connection with a second screw rod, the bottom part of the second screw rod is rotationally connected with a second clamping block, the side surfaces of the first circular ring and the second circular ring are provided with a main groove, the side wall of the main groove is provided with a secondary groove, the inner wall of the main groove is slidably connected with a clamping rod, the lower outer wall of the clamping rod is fixedly connected with a clamping ring, the outer wall of the clamping ring is slidably connected in the inner wall of the secondary groove, the top part of the clamping rod is welded with a connecting plate, one side of the side wall of the connecting plate is welded with a guide rod, the outer wall of the guide rod is slidably connected with a slide block, the center thread of the slide rod is connected with a third screw rod, the bottom part of the third screw rod is rotationally connected with a leakage stopping sticking block, flexible use and good universality.

title_en: Cylinder clamping device of operation is trailed to high accuracy
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cylinder clamping device of operation is trailed to high accuracy, which comprises a fixing plate and i, the fixed surface of fixed plate installs two sets of centre gripping cylinders, the detachable two sets of buffing pads that are connected with in surface of fixed plate, the inside of buffing pad is provided with buffer gear, and is two sets of centre gripping cylinder and buffing pad are about the central point central symmetry of fixed plate. Drive the connecting plate through the centre gripping cylinder and remove, drive splint synchronous motion when the connecting plate removes, the removal through splint drives baffle synchronous motion, carry out the centre gripping to the pipe fitting product through the baffle, when carrying out the centre gripping to the pipe fitting product, the baffle can drive the fixture block under the effect of gravity and take place the deflection in the inside of recess, the apron takes place for the angle of baffle this moment, thereby block the pipe fitting product through the baffle and realize the centre gripping, need not to change anchor clamps repeatedly, can use single anchor clamps whole journey to trail the object, the cost is reduced.

title_en: Buffer oil cylinder capable of being started quickly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil cylinders, in particular to a buffer oil cylinder capable of being started quickly, which comprises a cylinder barrel, a cylinder cover, a piston rod and a piston; the cylinder barrel is internally provided with a buffer device which has a buffer function on the piston rod, the buffer device comprises a spring sleeved on the piston rod and a buffer sleeve sleeved on the piston rod in a sliding manner, the front end of the spring is connected with the buffer sleeve, and the rear end of the spring is connected with the piston; the rear end part of the cylinder cover is provided with a pilot hole communicated with the inside of the cylinder barrel, and the pilot hole is communicated with the oil outlet. This hydro-cylinder combines spring and cushion collar mutually, utilizes the compressible principle of spring, assists the buffering with the help of the elasticity of spring for buffering effect is better, and material saving and reduce cost, and be provided with the pilot hole on the cylinder cap, when the piston rod reverse motion, fluid accessible pilot hole acts on cushion collar terminal surface and piston terminal surface simultaneously, thereby realizes the function of quick start.

title_en: Furniture frame connecting structure and office table
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a furniture frame connection structure and desk, this furniture frame connection structure includes vertical frame spare, horizontal frame spare and coupling assembling, coupling assembling includes V-arrangement groove piece, V-arrangement connecting block and connecting fastener, when horizontal frame spare is connected with vertical frame spare, the V-arrangement groove of V-arrangement connecting block's V-arrangement structure embedding V-arrangement groove piece, connecting fastener from the side with V-arrangement groove piece and V-arrangement connecting block fastening together, realize being connected of horizontal frame spare and vertical frame spare. The office table comprises a supporting frame which is composed of lifting upright columns and cross beams and used for supporting a table top plate, wherein the lifting upright columns and the cross beams are connected by adopting the furniture frame connecting structure. The utility model has the advantages that: the connecting assembly realizes connection limiting through the contact of the V-shaped surface of the side surface and the side fastening action of the connecting fastener, has stable connecting structure and convenient installation, and is particularly suitable for the connection of the end part of the long and flat transverse frame member and the vertical frame member.

title_en: Quick detach formula distributing device seal bearing frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quick detach formula distributing device seals bearing frame, which comprises a fixed base, the fixing base passes through fastening bolt and bearing housing is fixed mutually, be equipped with the bolt hole that is used for fastening bolt to alternate on bearing frame and the fixing base, be equipped with the jackscrew hole that is used for installing the jackscrew on the bearing frame of bolt hole one side, be equipped with the axis of rotation in the bearing frame, be equipped with seal groove and bearing chamber between axis of rotation and bearing frame, be provided with the bearing that supports the axis of rotation in the bearing chamber, be equipped with seal assembly in the seal groove, be equipped with the pressure-fired hole that blows off on the bearing frame, the pressure-fired hole that blows off is linked together with the bearing chamber. When the bearing is replaced, the fastening bolt between the bearing seat and the fixed seat is loosened, the bearing seat is ejected out by the jackscrew, and the replacement is very quick and convenient. The utility model discloses sealing device can effectively seal the powder material that the particle diameter is little, and the configuration is unique pressure-fired blows the hole and can effectively clear away a small amount of powder that permeates sealing device, has guaranteed the normal operation of bearing.

title_en: Carotenoid detects uses workstation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of detection device, in particular to a workbench for detecting carotenoid, which comprises a detector, a turntable, a sliding rod and a support rod, wherein the lower surface of the detector is fixedly connected with the upper surface of a support plate, the lower surface of the support plate is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the sliding rod, the inner surface of the support rod is provided with a chute, the surface of the sliding rod is movably connected with the inner surface of the chute, the left surface of the sliding rod is fixedly connected with the right surface of a second connecting rod, according to the detection requirement, a fastening screw is firstly unscrewed, the turntable is driven by a handle to rotate, the connecting plate is driven to rotate when the turntable rotates, the connecting plate further drives the second connecting rod to move upwards, the second connecting rod drives the sliding rod in the chute to move upwards together, thereby adjusting the detector to a proper position, and then the fastening screw arranged on the support rod, the slide rod is kept stable, so that the height of the workbench can be adjusted randomly.

title_en: Staff training explanation device for business administration
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of staff training and explaining device, in particular to a staff training and explaining device for enterprise management, which comprises a base, wherein walking wheel brackets are symmetrically arranged at the left side and the right side of the base, walking wheels are arranged at the bottom of the walking wheel brackets, a handwriting board is arranged on the front side of a supporting board, a lighting lamp tube is arranged at the inner side of the supporting board and above the handwriting board, a placing groove is arranged at the top of an operating platform and on the front side of the supporting board, a control panel is arranged at the top of the operating platform and on the right side of the placing groove, a push plate is arranged at the driving end of a telescopic cylinder extending into a liquid storage cylinder, and an observation cylinder is arranged at the top of the liquid storage cylinder, compared with the prior art, the device not only can conveniently adjust the display height and move the position, but also can be used under the condition of dark light, and possess and deposit the function and satisfy multiple mode of giving lessons, the practicality is strong, suitable popularization.

title_en: Horizontal siphon tank for refrigeration air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a horizontal siphon jar for refrigeration air conditioner, including the siphon jar body, still include the base that passes through coupling mechanism fixed connection with the bottom of siphon jar body, be used for making the locking mechanical system that coupling mechanism is fixed, be located the gyro wheel of base lower surface, be located the lower surface of base and be used for base and the supporting mechanism of siphon jar body at vertical direction height, the utility model discloses the height of siphon jar body is convenient for adjust in supporting mechanism's setting to be applicable to different operation requirements, coupling mechanism's setting, the quick installation and the dismantlement of siphon jar body and base of being convenient for alleviate installer's work burden.

title_en: Stud with high-strength supporting function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stud with high-strength supporting function, which comprises a stud body, wherein the front side and the rear side of the upper part of the stud body are both provided with a cutting groove, the upper screw thread of the stud body is rotatably sleeved with a nut, the upper part of the stud body is slidably sleeved with a fixed seat, the top end of the fixed seat is penetrated and provided with a through hole matched with the stud body, the front inner wall and the rear inner wall of the through hole are both fixedly provided with a lug matched with the cutting groove, the bottom end of the lug is both fixedly provided with a limit fixture block matched with the cutting groove, the front side and the rear side of the fixed seat are both penetrated, rotatably embedded with locking screws, a plurality of thread grooves matched with the locking screws are uniformly arranged in the cutting groove in an array manner, the upper part of the stud body is slidably sleeved with a gasket, the utility model has simple structure and convenient use, and can effectively improve the stability between the stud and the nut, thereby the stability of effectual improvement erection equipment.

title_en: Axial sealing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an axial seal structure, include: the connecting pipe flange assembly (1), the lens gasket sealing assembly (2), the double-clamping sleeve sealing assembly (3) and the rotating part (4); two sides of the rotating part (4) are sequentially connected with the double-cutting-sleeve sealing assembly (3), the lens gasket sealing assembly (2) and the connecting pipe flange assembly (1). The utility model discloses a lens pad seal assembly (2), two card cover seal assembly (3) realize inside rotating member's sealed and dismantlement, and this structure is applicable in the axial direction rotary device, and the installation is simple and easy convenient, and seal assembly can dismantle, simple structure, low in manufacturing cost.

title_en: Special mobile display for server aging room
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a special mobile display of server ageing room. The technical scheme is as follows: the utility model provides a special removal display in server ageing room, includes the display, still includes the support, and the support passes through the runner assembly at top to be connected with the display, and the runner assembly is provided with the locking piece, and the removal subassembly is installed to the support bottom. abstract_en: The utility model provides a double-blade motor mechanism, which comprises a rotating motor, a blade bracket, a first blade, a first connecting copper sleeve and a connecting shaft, wherein the output end of the upper end of the rotating motor is connected to the bottom of a motor seat in a penetrating way, the upper end of the motor seat is provided with the blade bracket, the double-blade motor mechanism can drive the second blade to rotate when the rotating motor rotates through the arrangement of a second connecting sleeve, and the second blade can drive the first blade to synchronously rotate through the arrangement of the first connecting copper sleeve and the connecting shaft, and can lubricate the rotation of the second blade and the first blade through the arrangement of an oil-containing copper sleeve, so that the internal air suction efficiency and the external air blowing efficiency of a blower are improved through the synchronous rotation of two groups of blades, the drying speed of a user on hair and clothes is improved, and the defect that the amount of cold air fed into the blower by the blower is insufficient is solved, so as to improve the hot air drying efficiency and the applicability of the hair dryer in use.

title_en: Image acquisition camera equipment with dustproof function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an image acquisition camera device with a dustproof function, which relates to the technical field of camera vision acquisition images and comprises a fixed seat, wherein an induction probe is arranged in a monitoring shell, an installation plate is fixed on one side of the lower end of the monitoring shell, a third motor is arranged on one side of the installation plate, one end of the third motor penetrates through the installation plate and is connected with a rotating block, the other end of the rotating block is hinged with a first connecting rod, the other end of the first connecting rod is hinged with a positioning rod, the other end of the positioning rod is hinged with a first fixed shaft and is connected with a second connecting rod, the other end of the second connecting rod is hinged with a clamping block, the other end of the connecting clamping block is hinged with a third connecting rod, the other end of the third connecting rod is hinged with a third fixed shaft, when the induction probe senses that the light transmittance of lens protective glass is poor (dirty), the third motor is started to drive the rotating block to rotate, so that a scraping rod makes a swinging arm move, the scraping strip scrapes the protective glass to remove dust, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted inflator pump convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of inflator pumps and discloses a vehicle-mounted inflator pump convenient to maintain. This on-vehicle pump convenient to maintain, through setting up walking board bottom swing joint's control wheel, and the control wheel comprises the limiting plate at top and bottom quantity for two splint, and the inside of two splint is rotated and is connected with the rotating wheel, thereby can the removal of stable control air pump, through the control surge tank that sets up control wheel side fixed connection, thereby can convenient fixed control wheel, reach the purpose that the air pump is convenient for to fix, through the shock attenuation control box that sets up walking board top fixed connection, and the shock attenuation control box comprises the leak protection block at leak protection case and the top of bottom, and the connected mode of leak protection case and leak protection piece is for sliding connection, thereby prevent the purpose that the shock attenuation board is convenient for the shock attenuation goes up and down, user's use has been made things convenient for.

title_en: Bearing linkage structure of transmission part assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bearing linkage structure of a transmission part assembly, which comprises a transfer case rear shell (1), wherein a connecting shaft (2) transversely penetrates through the transfer case rear shell (1), belt pulleys (3) are sleeved on the transfer case rear shell (1) and the connecting shaft (2), four rows of bearings (4) are embedded between the transfer case rear shell (1) and the connecting shaft (2), one end of the connecting shaft (2) is limited through the belt pulleys (3), the other end of the connecting shaft is provided with a transmission sleeve (5), an elastic connecting disc (6) is arranged on the outer side of the transmission sleeve (5), and an oil seal (18) is arranged between the transfer case rear shell (1) and the transmission sleeve (5). The device has the advantages of simplified structure, higher bearing capacity, higher rotating speed bearing capacity, low cost, convenience in assembly, low failure rate and prolonged service life.

title_en: Supporting base for intelligent cloud generator set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a supporting base for an intelligent cloud generator set, which comprises a base body, wherein a plurality of supporting cross beams are arranged on the base body, a plurality of fixing positions are arranged on the supporting cross beams, the fixing positions correspond to supporting parts of the intelligent cloud generator set, a plurality of buffer seats are further arranged on the lower part of the base body, vibration damping devices are arranged inside the buffer seats, and two ends of each vibration damping device are respectively abutted against the base body and a supporting plate. Through designing many supporting beams on base body upper portion, utilize unsettled supporting beam to reduce the produced vibration of generator operation, simultaneously at a plurality of independent buffing pads of base body's lower part installation, make every buffing pad independently cushion the produced vibration of generator operation, and then decompose and reduce the vibration range of generator operation through the mode of distributed buffering, thereby reducible high-frequency vibration is to the influence of all ring edge borders, also can avoid causing the influence because of lasting vibrations by a wide margin to the operation of generator self.

title_en: Portable mask machine supporting base
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable mask machine supporting base, which comprises a base, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged in the base, the lifting mechanism comprises a motor, a threaded rod, a fixed bearing, a lifting plate, a fixed plate and a lifting column, the motor is fixedly arranged in the center of the bottom of the base, the output end of the motor penetrates through the bottom of the base through a coupler and is fixedly connected with the bottom of the threaded rod, the top of the threaded rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the top end in the base through the fixed bearing, and the threaded rod is in threaded connection with the inner wall of the center of the lifting plate To adjust.

title_en: Laborsaving valve convenient to operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a labor-saving valve convenient to operate, which structurally comprises a valve body, a water outlet, a mounting seat, a support, a rotating shaft and a first hand wheel, wherein anti-rotation devices are horizontally and oppositely arranged on the upper end of the inner side surface of the support in a left-right horizontal mode, the second hand wheel is arranged on the lower left end of a shell, and drives a worm group to be matched with a pulley block so that a connecting rod group drives a push rod to drive a fixing mechanism to move, the fixing mechanism is abutted against the outer surface of the rotating shaft, the effect of preventing the rotating shaft from rotating is achieved, the rotating shaft is prevented from rotating, the device is convenient to use and simple to operate, the working efficiency is effectively improved, the fixing mechanism is arranged on the right end of the shell, the push rod drives a fixing seat to move through a movable rod, the fixing seat is abutted against the outer surface of the rotating shaft, the effect of fixing the rotating shaft is achieved, and the inconvenience in use is prevented.

title_en: Support of fixed real-time supervision equipment of side slope engineering
abstract_en: The utility model provides a support of fixed real-time supervision equipment of slope engineering, includes bottom plate, first dwang, soil nail, second dwang, dead lever, the dead lever on be equipped with the screw rod, the outside of screw rod be equipped with fixation nut, the second dwang one end of keeping away from first dwang be equipped with swing joint's turning block, the upper end of turning block be equipped with the monitoring facilities backup pad, the turning block be the spheroid structure. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: this thing is novel fixes on the inclined plane of side slope through the soil nail of bottom plate, through first dwang and second dwang according to actual conditions angle of adjustment, and it is fixed to form triangle-shaped through the dead lever, and the monitoring facilities backup pad can level and vertically angle of adjustment under the drive of the turning block of spheroid structure, simple structure, convenient operation, but angle of adjustment and direction let monitoring facilities accurate monitor.

title_en: Hydraulic test equipment based on hydraulic cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of test equipment, and particularly relates to hydraulic test equipment based on a hydraulic oil cylinder, which comprises a support, wherein a top plate parallel to the support is arranged above the support, support posts are connected at four corners between the support and the top plate, the hydraulic oil cylinder and an oil tank are arranged below the top plate, the oil tank is positioned on the right side of the support, a hydraulic pump is arranged above the oil tank, the lower end of the hydraulic pump is communicated with the inside of the oil tank, an oil inlet pipe is communicated between the left end of the hydraulic pump and the right end of the hydraulic oil cylinder, a pressure gauge is arranged outside the oil inlet pipe, a PLC (programmable logic controller) is arranged at the front end above the oil tank, a display screen and a loudspeaker are sequentially arranged in front of the oil tank from top to bottom, and the display screen, the loudspeaker and the pressure gauge are electrically connected with the PLC; the hydraulic oil pressure alarm device can give an alarm to remind a user when the hydraulic oil pressure entering the hydraulic oil cylinder is too high, so that the hydraulic oil cylinder is prevented from being damaged, the workpiece to be tested is driven to move, different positions of the workpiece to be tested can be conveniently tested, and the hydraulic oil pressure alarm device is more convenient.

title_en: Silica sol ball valve casting mould
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of casting molds, and particularly relates to a silica sol ball valve casting mold which comprises a mold front cylinder, a mold rear cylinder, a connecting round block, a screw, a mold base and a mold top seat, wherein the mold front cylinder is clamped between the mold base and the mold top seat, by arranging the reinforcing gasket between the connecting round block and the fastening nut and utilizing the contact action of the connecting ring part on the fastening nut and the anti-skid thread part on the reinforcing gasket, so that the fastening nut has better stability when being screwed to one side of the reinforcing gasket and is not easy to reversely move back, meanwhile, when the reinforcing gasket is arranged, the insertion and the fixation of the two limit blocks on the surface of one side of the reinforcing gasket in the corresponding limit grooves are utilized to match the blocking and the plugging action of the ring strip in the ring groove, the reinforcing gasket can keep good stability when in use, is not easy to deviate, and ensures strong connectivity between the fastening nut and the reinforcing gasket.

title_en: Novel bridge bolt
abstract_en: A novel bridge bolt comprises a bolt body and a bolt cap, wherein the upper end of the bolt body is provided with a positioning part, the upper end of the positioning part is provided with a thread fixing part, the lower end of the bolt cap is rotatably provided with a locking positioning ring, the middle part of the bolt cap is provided with an internal thread groove, the thread fixing part is matched into the internal thread groove and adopts threaded connection, after the bolt body is embedded into an automobile part needing to be fixed, a tool is used for screwing the bolt cap, the locking positioning ring can be attached to the automobile part when the thread fixing part is screwed to the bottom of the internal thread groove, then the locking positioning ring is rotated by the tool, an external thread ring on the locking positioning ring axially moves along an annular sliding groove, a gap is generated between the locking positioning ring and the bolt cap, the positioning groove on the locking positioning ring is tightly sleeved on the positioning part, meanwhile, the locking positioning ring is more tightly attached to the automobile part, the reciprocating vibration acting force generated by the automobile part can be led to the locking positioning ring, through the dual restriction of locking holding ring and cap, the effectual pine that prevents takes off.

title_en: Sealing end cover for tilting device gear box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing end cover for a gear box of a tilting device, which comprises an end cover body arranged in a counter bore of the end surface of a bearing seat of a gear box of a primary speed reducer, an inner cone ring arranged in the counter bore and positioned at the periphery of the end cover body, a sealing ring arranged between the outer peripheral surface of the bottom of the end cover body and the inner peripheral surface of the counter bore, and a tightening bolt for fastening the end cover body on the bearing seat of the gear box of the primary speed reducer. The sealing end cover structure can effectively improve the sealing effect and the sealing reliability of the gear box of the tilting device, solves the problem of oil leakage of the end cover of the gear box of the speed reducer of the tilting device, and reduces the maintenance cost of equipment.

title_en: Suspension steel ball type stop valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a suspension steel ball type stop valve which comprises a valve body, a valve cover arranged on the valve body, a valve rod rotationally connected with the valve cover, a ball arranged in the valve body, wherein the ball is matched with a valve port in the valve body, and the valve rod enables the ball to be positioned in the valve port by abutting against the ball. According to the utility model, the ball is arranged in the valve body and is matched with the valve port in the valve body, when the flow is required to be cut off, the valve rod is only required to be rotated to enable the valve rod to support the ball so that the ball is positioned in the valve port, so that the flow can be cut off, and the ball is an independent component and is separated from the valve rod, so that the ball can be independently replaced after the ball is worn, and the problem of high replacement cost caused by the fact that the valve rod is required to be integrally replaced is solved.

title_en: Platform for information technology display
abstract_en: The utility model provides a platform for information technology display, which comprises: the device comprises a base, a sleeve, an adjusting rod, a fixed seat, a handle bolt and a display screen; the upper part of the base is provided with a sleeve, and the base is connected with the sleeve through a bearing; the adjusting rod is arranged inside the sleeve, and the adjusting rod is sleeved with the sleeve in a clearance fit manner; the fixed seat is arranged at the top end of the adjusting rod and is connected with the adjusting rod in a welding mode; the handle bolt is respectively arranged on one side of the upper part of the sleeve and one side of the fixed seat, and the handle bolt is screwed with the sleeve and the fixed seat through threads; the display screen sets up on the upper portion of fixing base, and the display screen passes through clearance fit mode joint with the fixing base. Through the improvement of the structure, the multifunctional display device has the advantages of more comprehensive display angle and visual field, height adjustment function, great improvement on the functionality and practical value of the device and the like, thereby effectively solving the problems and the defects of the utility model.

title_en: Multistage receipts material machine of multistage ejection of compact of rice processing usefulness
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage discharging and multistage receiving machine for rice processing, which comprises a receiving box, a discharging pipeline and a supporting mechanism, wherein the receiving box comprises: the upper surface is open structure, and the symmetry is equipped with the baffle between the inner wall around receiving the workbin, and the discharge opening department that receives the horizontal array setting in workbin front surface upper end all has a baffle, ejection of compact pipeline through bolt fixed mounting: there are three and symmetric distribution, and ejection of compact pipeline's trailing flank all is equipped with the mounting panel, and the front surface four corners of mounting panel all is equipped with the fixed orifices, and ejection of compact pipeline's lower extreme is oblique type open structure, and ejection of compact pipeline's lower extreme is located the inside upper end in baffle and material collecting box formation space respectively, supporting mechanism: set up respectively in the inside of receiving the workbin, this multistage ejection of compact multistage material machine of receiving of rice processing usefulness avoids falling the impact force that produces from the eminence and causes the influence to the quality of rice, can guarantee that the rice of different qualities normally falls, is applicable to the multistage process of receiving the material.

title_en: Isolated column is used in civil engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an isolation fence for civil engineering construction, and belongs to the technical field of civil engineering construction. The utility model provides a fence is used in civil engineering, includes the mounting panel, and the mounting groove has been seted up to the mounting panel lower part, and the inside a plurality of rubber rollers that evenly are equipped with of mounting groove, slot have been seted up on mounting panel upper portion, are equipped with the warning sign in the slot. This device is through writing the warning sign to the warning sign that needs use, write in the warning sign inserts the slot after warning word, then put into the position that needs use to the device, after the device is put, if there is the pedestrian to touch when the device, the rubber roller can take place relative rotation with the pedestrian, reduces the injury of collision to the pedestrian. The utility model has simple and efficient design and good protection and isolation effects, and avoids collision and injury of pedestrians caused by crowding of more people.

title_en: Novel spring pressing rod structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel spring pressing rod structure, and aims to provide a novel spring pressing rod structure which is easy to replace and can adjust pressure easily. The utility model comprises a shell and a rod core, wherein an adjusting screw, a pressing sheet and a spring are arranged in the shell, the pressing sheet is arranged between the adjusting screw and the spring in a matching manner, one end of the rod core is movably matched in the shell and matched with the spring, and a limiting boss matched with one end of the rod core is arranged on the shell. The utility model is applied to the technical field of spring pressing rod structures.

title_en: Reinforced large-diameter spiral steel pipe
abstract_en: The utility model provides a reinforced large-caliber spiral steel pipe, which comprises a spiral pipe body and a connecting sleeve, wherein the spiral pipe comprises a first spiral pipe body and a second spiral pipe body, a first left side connecting body is arranged on the left side of the first spiral pipe body, a first right side connecting body is arranged on the right side of the first spiral pipe body, the first left side connecting body, the first right side connecting body and the first spiral pipe body are of an integral structure, a second left side connecting body is arranged on the left side of the second spiral pipe body, a second right side connecting body and a second left side connecting body are arranged on the right side of the second spiral pipe body, the second right side connector and the second spiral pipe body are of an integral structure, a sealing rubber ring is arranged between the first right side connector and the second left side connector, the connecting frame comprises a first connecting frame and a second connecting frame, the first connecting frame is arranged at the upper end of the spiral pipe body, and the second connecting frame is arranged at the lower end of the spiral pipe body. The utility model can effectively improve the characteristics of sealing property and firmness of the connecting part.

title_en: Pressure supply system of automobile oil pump function testing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressure supply system of an automobile oil pump function testing machine, which comprises an oil pump supply main body, wherein an oil liquid valve is fixedly arranged at the top of the oil pump supply main body, an oil pump detection motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the oil pump supply main body, a pump body is fixedly arranged on the other side of the top of the oil pump supply main body, an oil pipeline is connected and arranged between the oil liquid valve and the pump body, a heat insulation sleeve is wound on the outer side of the oil pipeline, and a sleeve belt is arranged at one end seam of the surface of the heat insulation sleeve; be provided with the lagging in the outside of this oil pipeline, the lagging sets up through the parcel, can play the effect that separates the temperature to oil pipeline through the lagging, reduce temperature's interference to a certain extent, thereby guarantee the stability of supplying the pressure, in the device use, there is the socket in the bottom welding of this oil pump supply main part, inboard fixed installing at the socket has the spacing angle, can guarantee to insert the stability of fortune in-process through the effect at spacing angle, prevent that the device from inclining and falling, the stability and the practicality of the device have been improved.

title_en: Anti-seismic support hanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-seismic support and hanger which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a plurality of support columns are fixedly connected to four corners of the top end of the bottom plate, a bearing plate is fixedly connected to the top ends of the support columns, springs are sleeved on the outer surfaces of the support columns, an electric telescopic machine is fixedly connected to the top end of the bearing plate, an electric telescopic rod is installed at the top end of the electric telescopic machine, and a main shaft is fixedly connected to the top end of the electric telescopic rod. The spring is sleeved on the outer surfaces of the support columns and the support columns which are fixedly connected with the four corners of the top end of the bottom plate, so that the anti-vibration capability of the device is enhanced, the electric telescopic machine fixedly connected with the top end of the bearing plate and the electric telescopic rod arranged at the top end of the electric telescopic machine are beneficial to adjusting the height of the device so as to adapt to different height requirements during construction, the first sleeve joint and the second sleeve joint are respectively and alternately connected with the first screw rod and the second screw rod which penetrate through the bearing plate and are fixedly connected with the top end of the bottom plate, and the stability and the bearing capability of the device are improved.

title_en: Clamping support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamping bracket which comprises a bracket main body, a clamping mechanism, a bottom supporting mechanism and a reset element for driving the clamping mechanism to reset; the clamping mechanism comprises a left lever, a right lever, a left linkage piece, a right linkage piece and a sliding piece; the lower ends of the left linkage piece and the right linkage piece are respectively and correspondingly hinged with the lower ends of the right lever and the left lever; the sliding piece can be arranged on the support main body in a sliding mode along the height direction of the support main body, the upper ends of the left linkage piece and the right linkage piece act on the sliding piece, and after the left linkage piece and the right linkage piece rotate, the upper ends of the left linkage piece and the right linkage piece can drive the sliding piece to move up and down along the height direction of the support main body; therefore, the bottom supporting mechanism can vertically move downwards under the action of gravity, so that the left and right shaking is not easy to occur, the clamping stagnation and damage phenomena caused by the fact that the left lever and the right lever are meshed by gears in the traditional technology are solved, the opening and closing action smoothness is improved, and the service life of the support is prolonged; meanwhile, the use noise is effectively reduced.

title_en: Mounting and fastening device for electric vehicle hub brake
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an installation fastening device for an electric vehicle hub brake, which relates to the technical field of hub brake installation and is used for solving the problems that the existing installation spring is high in difficulty and cannot adjust a back plate so that the brake effect is kept stable; the utility model can solve the problems that the first spring and the second spring are difficult to install and potential safety hazards of installation personnel are caused, and the problem of poor braking effect can be solved by adjusting the back plate through simple steps.

title_en: Silane unloading system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a silane unloading system, which comprises a silane pressurizing device, a silane storage tank, a condenser and an evaporator, wherein the condenser and the evaporator are matched with the silane storage tank; the outsourcing silane tank truck conveys silane gas to a silane pressurizing device through a pipeline for treatment, and the treated silane gas is conveyed to a silane storage tank for storage; when downstream debugging or generation is carried out, silane gas is respectively condensed and boosted through a condenser and an evaporator matched with the silane storage tank until the air pressure in the outsourcing silane tank car is consistent with the air pressure in the silane storage tank or the liquid level of the silane storage tank is kept unchanged, and silane unloading is finished. This embodiment can solve the problem that the prior art is not specifically applied to the silane unloading treatment.

title_en: WiFi wireless network tester
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a WiFi wireless network tester, which comprises a tester shell, an inserting hole and a fixing device, wherein the surface of the tester shell is provided with the inserting hole, a dustproof plate is connected in the inserting hole, the lower surface of the tester shell is provided with a first fixing groove, the side surface of the tester shell is provided with a first accommodating groove and a second accommodating groove, the fixing device is connected in the first fixing groove in a sliding mode through a sliding block, the sliding block is connected to the upper end of the side surface of the first fixing block, the lower surface of the first fixing block is connected with the second fixing block, the opening of the inserting hole is provided with a third accommodating groove, a rotating block connected with the dustproof plate is movably connected in the third accommodating groove through a rotating shaft, and the lower end of the rotating block is connected with a spring through a fixing hook. This wiFi wireless network tester can prevent effectively that the tester from because the unexpected landing leads to the damage, and the dust guard that plug hole department set up can prevent that the dust from getting into the plug hole simultaneously, avoids the dust of accumulation to influence equipment connection.

title_en: Hydraulic transmission mechanism with oil cylinder pull rod hinged support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic transmission mechanism with a hinge base of a pull rod of an oil cylinder, which comprises a hinge base body, wherein a fixing part is welded on the left side of the hinge base body, two connecting parts are welded on the right side of the top of the hinge base body, the two connecting parts are welded on the hinge base body and are symmetrical about the central position of the hinge base body, connecting holes are formed in two sides of the outer part of each connecting part, a pin hole is formed in each connecting part, an installation pin is inserted into each pin hole, the oil cylinder body is arranged on each installation pin, and one end of the oil cylinder body is connected with a fixing base through a pin. According to the utility model, the fixed seat is installed on a machine, and then the output end of the oil cylinder body is connected into the pin hole through the installation pin, so that by starting the oil cylinder body, the oil cylinder body drives the connecting piece to move through the installation pin, and then the hinge seat body moves, thereby achieving the purpose of convenient transmission.

title_en: Square pipe splicing multifunctional combined rod
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional combined rod for splicing a square tube, which comprises a base, a rod body and a hanging arm, wherein at least one layer of T-shaped clamping groove is fixedly arranged on the rod body, a sliding block is arranged in the T-shaped clamping groove, one end of the hanging arm is integrally provided with a clamping piece, and the clamping piece is connected with the sliding block through a fastening piece and is clamped and fixed with the outer side wall of the T-shaped clamping groove. The multifunctional combined rod for splicing the square pipes with the structure can conveniently and rapidly install various external devices on the same vertical rod without independently establishing the supporting rod, thereby not only reducing the quantity of urban road rod bodies, but also reducing the times of disturbing residents in construction and the damage to the environment, and simultaneously saving resources.

title_en: Heat storage type hot air tail gas waste heat recovery reversing device of flame combustion equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat storage type hot air tail gas waste heat recovery reversing device of flame combustion equipment, which is characterized by comprising an upper valve body and a lower valve body, wherein the upper valve body and the lower valve body are in movable surface contact, the upper valve body and the lower valve body are respectively provided with a plurality of groups of ventilation channels, the contact surfaces of the upper valve body and the lower valve body are provided with vent holes corresponding to the ventilation channels, the upper valve body is connected with a power source for driving the upper valve body to move and realizing reversing work, and the upper valve body and the lower valve body are respectively externally connected with working channels corresponding to the vent holes. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use and installation.

title_en: Explosion-proof type valve electric actuator control box convenient to overhaul
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flame-proof type valve electric device control box convenient to overhaul, which comprises a mounting substrate, wherein the top of the front surface of the mounting substrate is fixedly connected with a fixed box, the bottom of the front surface of the mounting substrate is fixedly connected with a placing plate, the top of the placing plate is provided with a control box body, and two sides of the top of the placing plate are fixedly connected with limit boxes. The flame-proof type valve electric device control box comprises a mounting base plate, a fixing box, a placing plate, a control box body, a limiting box, a vertical plate, a limiting rod, a pull plate, a first spring, a cam, a transverse plate, a second spring, a vertical rod, a fixing plate, a heat dissipation box and a heat dissipation fan, and has the advantages of being convenient to overhaul and improving heat dissipation effects.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering construction is with measuring pay-off
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a measurement pay-off device for hydraulic engineering construction, which comprises a measurement pay-off main body, wherein the middle part of the upper end of the measurement pay-off main body is fixedly connected with a measurement frame, the middle part of the upper end of the measurement pay-off main body and the middle part of the upper end of the measurement frame are jointly provided with a measurement groove which penetrates up and down, the inner groove wall of the measurement groove is connected with an adjustment structure in a sliding manner, the upper end of the adjustment structure is fixedly connected with a measurement display, the lower end of the adjustment structure is fixedly connected with a measurement head, the outer surface of the measurement pay-off main body is fixedly connected with four sliding frames which are uniformly distributed, and support leg structures are arranged inside the four sliding frames. The measurement pay-off device for the hydraulic engineering construction increases the flexibility of a measuring head on measurement pay-off equipment for adjusting the measurement height, avoids the phenomenon of blocking when the measurement pay-off equipment is used, and increases the flexibility and the convenience of the contraction and expansion of a supporting leg when the measurement equipment is used.

title_en: H-shaped steel convenient to assemble
abstract_en: The utility model discloses H-shaped steel convenient to assemble, and particularly relates to the technical field of H-shaped steel. The H-shaped steel assembling device is provided with the shifting block, the spring, the positioning block and the positioning hole, the shifting block drives the piston block to move and extrude the spring, the web plate enters the space between the upper wing plate and the lower wing plate, the piston block pushes the positioning block to enter the positioning hole, the web plate, the upper wing plate and the lower wing plate can be connected, the H-shaped steel can be assembled conveniently, the reinforcing plate is arranged, the arc-shaped end is inserted into the slot, the connection of the reinforcing plate, the upper wing plate and the lower wing plate is realized, the compression resistance is improved, and the compression strength of the H-shaped steel is improved.

title_en: Brake disc convenient to dismantle and maintain
abstract_en: The utility model provides a brake disc convenient to dismantle and maintain, includes a dish, No. two dishes, a fastening block and No. two fastening blocks, and a dish is close to No. two mounting panels of dish one side top fixedly connected with, and No. two dishes are close to No. two mounting panels of a dish one side top fixedly connected with, and a mounting panel and No. two mounting panel dismantlements are connected, and the equal fixedly connected with connecting block of one end is kept away from each other to a mounting panel and No. two mounting panels, and beneficial effect is: the brake disc dismounting device is simple to operate and convenient to use, can be used for quickly and effectively dismounting and maintaining, effectively saves the dismounting time of the brake disc, effectively avoids the inconvenience caused by the complicated steps of dismounting and mounting the brake disc for a user, improves the dismounting and mounting efficiency of the brake disc, can effectively guarantee the stability of the brake disc after being mounted, and effectively guarantees the use effect of the brake disc.

title_en: Anti-corrosion sealing ring for pipe port connection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-corrosion sealing ring for pipe port connection, which comprises a sealing ring base body, a flanging, a sealing ring and a plurality of rolling grooves formed in the outer ring wall of the sealing ring base body, wherein the flanging is arranged at one end of the sealing ring base body, the sealing ring base body is sleeved at one end of a composite pipe and is attached to the port surface of the composite pipe in a matching mode through the flanging, the sealing ring is sleeved in the rolling grooves in a matching mode, the sealing ring comprises a central section, edge sections symmetrically arranged at two sides of the central section and a connecting section connected between the central section and the edge sections, and the rolling grooves comprise a central groove and an edge groove which are respectively attached to the central section and the edge sections in a matching mode.

title_en: Electric control ball valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric control ball valve, which relates to the field of ball valves and comprises a ball valve body, wherein an installation shell is fixed at the top of the ball valve body, a control mechanism is arranged in the ball valve body, and the control mechanism comprises a regulating and controlling assembly, a valve ring in rotary fit with the inner wall of the ball valve body and a valve plate in rotary fit with the inner wall of the valve ring. According to the utility model, the crank is rotated to drive the threaded rod to rotate, so that the sliding block slides, the connecting rod and the double-layer driving gear are further driven to slide to be meshed with the inner ring gear, the servo motor drives the rotating shaft to rotate, the double-layer driving gear is driven to rotate, the driven gear can respectively drive the first gear or the second gear to rotate, and further the valve ring and the valve block can be respectively controlled to be opened and closed, so that the device can generate four states of two half-closed states, a full-open state and a full-closed state, a good flow rate control effect is achieved, the opening and closing efficiency of the valve is improved, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Self-locking rivet nut
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-locking rivet nut which comprises a body, wherein an installation cavity is formed in the body, the body is provided with a first end and a second end which are opposite, an internal thread is arranged on the inner wall of the first end, and a stamping deformation opening which enables the thread pitch of the internal thread to be reduced is formed in the body. The embodiment of the utility model provides a self-locking rivet nut, which solves the problem that the existing rivet nut is easy to loosen when being subjected to impact load.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted camera support for automobile crash safety test
abstract_en: The utility model aims to design a vehicle-mounted camera bracket which can adjust position and angle and is convenient to mount.
