This a vehicle-mounted camera support for car crash safety test includes: a base for securing to a floor of an automobile; the camera adjusting platform is used for realizing camera installation and is locked on the base through a locking block.

title_en: Waste water treatment equipment for paint production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste water treatment device for paint production, which comprises a box body, wherein the top of the box body is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor penetrates into the box body, a mixing rod is arranged inside the box body and fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a sewage draining outlet is formed in the left side of the box body, a sealing mechanism is arranged inside the sewage draining outlet, and a filter box is arranged inside the box body. The utility model solves the problems that most of the existing wastewater treatment equipment is of an integrated structure, and when coating wastewater is filtered, the large-particle-size filter residues are accumulated too much and are blocked easily due to large particle sizes of the waste residues, so that the filtering effect is poor and the cleaning is inconvenient.

title_en: Oil leakage prevention speed reducer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an oil leakage prevention speed reducer, which comprises a speed reducer main body, wherein the speed reducer main body comprises a box body, the right part of the top end of the box body is provided with a plurality of air holes, the box body is provided with an input shaft and an output shaft, the right part of the input shaft extends out of the outer side of the box body and is connected with a belt wheel, the lower part of the output shaft is sleeved with a bearing and an oil seal, the bearing and the oil seal are arranged in a circular through hole, the speed reducer also comprises a blank cap and a plurality of air pipes communicated with the air holes, the blank cap comprises a cap body and an extending part, the upper end surface of the cap body is provided with a first groove, the outer bottom surface of the box body is provided with a second groove, the second groove and the first groove form a closed circular hole cavity, an elastic ring is embedded in the circular hole, the elastic ring is a ring body, the right port of the horizontal pipe is connected with a filter screen, and the purpose is to solve the problems that the ventilation hole of the speed reducer is easily blocked by dust and lubricating oil leaks from the joint of the oil seal at the bottom of the speed reducer or the abrasion part easily in the prior art.

title_en: Multi-angle adjusting device of measurement and control instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-angle adjusting device of a measurement and control instrument, which comprises a placing base and a tubular lifting cylinder, the tubular lifting cylinder is vertically arranged at the upper end of the placing base, the outer wall of the lower end of the placing base is provided with an anti-skid bottom pad, a lifting pillar upwards penetrates through the vertical inner part of the tubular lifting cylinder, a height locking shaft penetrates through the inner part of the outer wall of one end of the tubular lifting cylinder, which is close to the upper side, by adding a novel angle reinforcing device at the bottom of the front end and the rear end of the instrument mounting seat of the multi-angle adjusting device of the measurement and control instrument, the novel angle reinforcing device can play a role in reinforcing the front and back use angles of the instrument mounting seat, avoids the condition that the instrument mounting seat is easy to loosen after being locked by the front and back angle locking shafts after the front and back angle adjustment, therefore, the condition that the measurement and control instrument has angle deviation due to the fact that the front angle locking shaft and the rear angle locking shaft are loosened after the measurement and control instrument is installed on the instrument installation seat is avoided.

title_en: Fork truck convenient to get and put battery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forklift convenient for taking and placing a storage battery, which relates to the technical field of forklifts and comprises a forklift body, wherein a placing cavity for storing the storage battery is arranged in the forklift, a taking and placing opening communicated with the placing cavity is formed in the side surface of the forklift, a dragging opening communicated with the placing cavity and the taking and placing opening is formed in the bottom of the forklift, and a manual hydraulic vehicle is matched with the dragging opening and used for placing the storage battery into the placing cavity or taking the storage battery out of the placing cavity. The utility model has the advantages of convenient storage battery taking and placing effect, labor saving and simple operation, and the hand-operated hydraulic vehicle can enter the dragging opening to place the storage battery into the placing cavity along the taking and placing opening or take the storage battery out of the placing cavity along the taking and placing opening.

title_en: Die casting for fixing carbon fiber pipe
abstract_en: The utility model provides a die casting for fixing a carbon fiber tube, which comprises a hollow cylinder and a base fixed at one end of the hollow cylinder, wherein a threaded hole is formed in the base, the carbon fiber tube is inserted into the hollow cylinder, and the base is in threaded connection with an outer frame so as to fix the carbon fiber tube on the outer frame. The die casting provided by the utility model is mainly used for fixedly connecting the carbon fiber pipe and the outer frame, the carbon fiber pipe is inserted into the hollow cylinder, and the base and the outer frame are detachably fixed through threads, so that the carbon fiber pipe is fixedly connected with the outer frame.

title_en: Wisdom traffic installing support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic, in particular to an intelligent traffic mounting bracket, which comprises a base, wherein a support column is vertically and upwards arranged on the base, a support rod is transversely fixed at the upper end of the support column, a rotating rod is hinged on the support column below the support rod, a rope drum is arranged at the lower side in the support column, the rope drum is rotatably connected with the support column, one end of the rope drum is provided with a rocking handle, a first fixed pulley is arranged at the upper end in the support column, a fixed seat is arranged at the lower side of one end of the support rod, which is far away from the support column, a through hole is arranged at the lower side of one end of the support rod, which is far away from the support column, a second fixed pulley is arranged at the position, which corresponds to the through hole, in the support rod, one end of a steel wire rope is fixedly connected with one end of the rotating rod, which is far away from the hinged seat, the other end of the steel wire rope sequentially passes through the through hole, the second fixed pulley and the first fixed pulley and then is connected with a barrel body on the rope drum, a first fixed hole is arranged on the rocking handle, the second fixed orifices that runs through around setting up on the support column, the one end that articulated seat was kept away from to the dwang sets up the functional module mounting bracket.

title_en: Snap-in connector and adjustable connecting assembly comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model aims to provide a clamping connecting piece capable of accurately adjusting the length of the clamping connecting piece in a telescopic way and an adjustable connecting structure comprising the clamping connecting piece, wherein the adjustable connecting structure is characterized in that a plurality of pairs of clamping connecting pieces which are symmetrical pairwise are arranged in the circumferential direction of a ball head connecting structure, and two ends of each clamping connecting piece are respectively fixedly connected with a movable connecting piece arranged on a ball head and a base fixed on the ground, so that when the movable connecting piece rotates to any angle position around the center of the ball head, each clamping connecting piece is in a tensioning state through rotating and adjusting a thread structure on the clamping connecting piece, and the movable connecting piece is completely fixed relative to the ball head and the base at the angle position.

title_en: Grease gun with magnet
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of grease guns, and particularly relates to a grease gun with a magnet. The utility model aims to provide a grease gun with a magnet, which has stable structure and convenient use and can be used for playing a grease ball and oil dispersion together.

title_en: Steering load sensing type multi-way valve for steering priority system
abstract_en: The utility model mainly relates to the technical field of hydraulic control elements, and provides a steering load sensing type multi-way valve for a steering priority system, which comprises an oil inlet P and an oil inlet duct, wherein the oil inlet P is connected with the oil inlet duct; the oil return port T is connected with an oil return duct; the PF port is connected with a shunt oil duct; the multi-way reversing valve supplies oil to the working oil port through the oil inlet of the middle oil duct; further comprising: a load sensing port LS and a spool valve; the utility model can maintain the flow rate necessary for the normal work of the full hydraulic steering system according to the requirement of the steering system, and the rest part is completely supplied to the other oil way, thereby eliminating the power loss caused by excessive oil supply of the steering oil way and improving the system efficiency.

title_en: Pipeline flange separating tool
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pipeline flange separating tool, which relates to the technical field of pipeline maintenance and comprises a first locking device, a second locking device and a separating device, wherein the first locking device and the second locking device are fixedly connected to a pipeline, and are respectively positioned on two sides of a flange; the flange separation device has the advantages that tools are specialized, flanges can be separated in the shortest time, safety of personnel can be guaranteed, and construction progress can be accelerated.

title_en: Inverted speed reducer
abstract_en: Inversion speed reducer, including from last output assembly, multistage planet subassembly and the stopper subassembly to coaxial arrangement down, the stopper subassembly includes the brake axle, through input bearing suit at the epaxial outer brake seat of brake, carry out the friction disc of braking and with the piston of the sealed complex of brake seat, its characterized in that to the brake axle: the multistage planet subassembly hoist and mount on output assembly, the friction disc is coaxial to be set up in the below of piston, and installs on the brake block and be used for adsorbing iron fillings and be located the adsorption component of friction disc below. The utility model can greatly reduce the axial force born by the input bearing, prolong the service life of the input bearing, improve the structural reliability of the inverted speed reducer, effectively prevent scrap iron generated by the friction plate from falling into the sealing ring of the piston, prevent the scrap iron from abrading the brake assembly and improve the structural reliability of the brake assembly.

title_en: Integrated machine with face recognition and big data interaction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an all-in-one machine with face recognition and big data interaction, and relates to the technical field of big data interaction machines. The large data interaction device comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a mounting plate through a telescopic mechanism, the upper surface of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a large data interaction machine through a clamping mechanism, a camera is fixedly mounted on the front end face of the large data interaction machine, two symmetrically-arranged insertion rods are fixedly connected to the lower surface of the large data interaction machine, two symmetrically-arranged insertion grooves are formed in the upper surface of the mounting plate, the insertion rods extend into the insertion grooves and are in sliding connection with the insertion grooves, through grooves are formed in the side wall of the mounting plate, mounting grooves are formed in the side wall of the part, extending into the insertion grooves, of the insertion rods, and clamping blocks are connected in the mounting grooves in a sliding mode. The utility model solves the problems that most of the existing data interaction integrated equipment is fixedly arranged, the existing data interaction integrated equipment is difficult to disassemble and overhaul in real time, and the existing data interaction integrated equipment lacks the function of identifying human faces when in use.

title_en: Mobile communication equipment is with adjusting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjusting structure for mobile communication equipment, which comprises a mounting plate and a mounting frame for mounting a mobile communication equipment body, wherein cavities for mounting the mobile communication equipment body are symmetrically formed in the mounting frame, a clamping structure is arranged in each cavity, hinged plates are hinged at the middle sections of two sides of the mounting frame, and a sliding block is fixed on one side edge of each hinged plate, which is far away from the mounting frame; two cushion chambers have been seted up to the symmetry on the mounting panel, are fixed with the slide bar in the cushion chamber, the slider cover is established and is installed on the slide bar, on the slide bar and the top of slide block and bottom department all be provided with buffer spring, be provided with the adjusting part of supplementary angle modulation on the outside limit of installing frame. This mobile communication equipment is with adjusting structure, reasonable in design can conveniently install the mobile communication equipment of equidimension not, and the angle that can remove communication equipment as required simultaneously carries out fine adjustment, is fit for using widely.

title_en: Firm novel antidetonation support
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of anti-seismic supports, and particularly relates to a stable novel anti-seismic support which comprises a mounting screw, wherein the outer wall of the mounting screw is movably connected with a first fixing plate, the top of the first fixing plate is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the top of the mounting plate is movably connected with a cover plate, and the outer wall of the mounting screw is movably connected with a gasket; through the installation screw rod, first supporting mechanism, first fixed plate, the mounting panel, the apron, the gasket, mounting nut, second supporting mechanism, first movable rod, the second movable rod, the installation piece, the mounting screw, the removable pin, the structural design of wall body and dog, the function of this antidetonation support being convenient for carry out quick installation has been realized, through nailing into the wall body with the mounting screw, then insert apron and first fixed plate and screw up mounting nut with the installation screw rod, people just can be quick with the support mounting that combats earthquake, thereby people's work efficiency has been improved, people's user demand has been satisfied, the work of giving people brings convenience.

title_en: Sealing structure for movable shaft of roller mill
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sealing structures, and particularly discloses a sealing structure for a movable shaft of a roller mill, which comprises the movable shaft of the roller mill arranged at the joint of a roller mill shell of the roller mill and a connecting frame detachably connected to the roller mill, wherein an accommodating hole for accommodating the movable shaft of the roller mill is formed in the connecting frame, an external sealing component for sealing is arranged on the outer part of the movable shaft of the roller mill far away from the roller mill, and an internal sealing component for secondary sealing is arranged on the inner part of the movable shaft of the roller mill close to the roller mill.

title_en: Stable camera support for news dissemination
abstract_en: The utility model provides a stable camera bracket for news propagation, which structurally comprises a chassis, a fixed seat, a supporting rod, an installation block and an adjusting body, wherein the upper end of the chassis is fixedly connected with the fixed seat, the supporting rod is embedded in the fixed seat, the lower end of the installation block is fixedly connected with the supporting rod, and the adjusting body is embedded in the installation block.

title_en: Energy-efficient air storage tank
abstract_en: The utility model provides an energy-efficient air storage tank belongs to air storage tank technical field for cause a large amount of gas overflow in the storage tank easily when solving the drainage, the cooling water produces the technical problem that needs to carry out the drainage many times slowly simultaneously. The water-cooling type water-cooling water tank comprises a base, wherein a round opening is formed in the outer portion of the top of the base, a gas storage tank is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the round opening, a water drainage tank is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the bottom of the gas storage tank, a water drainage valve is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the water drainage tank, an installation cover of a round platform structure is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the top of the gas storage tank, and a heat dissipation box is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the installation cover; this energy-efficient air storage tank is through the cooperation that sets up between heat pipe and the heat-conducting plate in the gas holder, collects the cooling water fast through the temperature difference on the heat-conducting plate, sets up the drain tank simultaneously again in the gas holder bottom, and the two segmentation cooperations of drain tank and drain valve conveniently drain off water simultaneously when the gas holder gas storage and improved the efficiency of drainage, effectively avoids appearing a large amount of gas excessive circumstances when the drainage.

title_en: Hydraulic oil cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hydraulic oil cylinder, which is provided with a cylinder body, a cylinder bottom, a sliding sleeve, a first piston rod, a first piston, an oil inlet and an oil outlet, wherein the first piston rod is movably connected to an inner cavity of the cylinder body through the first piston, the inner cavity of the cylinder body comprises a first cavity and a second cavity, the inner cavity of the first piston rod is provided with the second piston rod and a third piston rod, the second piston rod is positioned on the left side of the third piston rod, the inner cavity of the first piston rod comprises the third cavity and a fourth cavity, the cylinder bottom is provided with a second piston rod groove corresponding to the second piston rod, the second piston rod groove is provided with a second piston rod sealing sleeve corresponding to the second piston rod, the second piston rod groove is connected with a conduit communicated with the second cavity, and the conduit is provided with a valve. According to the utility model, the plurality of piston rods are arranged, when overpressure is generated during the operation of the hydraulic oil cylinder, overpressure can be generated inside the first piston rod, and acting force which is mutually offset with large machinery can be generated in the hydraulic oil cylinder through the overpressure, so that the damping problem is solved.

title_en: Porous pipe fitting with strong impact resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a porous pipe fitting with high impact resistance, relates to the technical field of impact-resistant porous pipe fittings, and aims to solve the problems that when a force is applied to one hole opening of the porous pipe fitting in the prior art, the force cannot be uniformly diffused, the porous pipe fitting is easily damaged, and the impact resistance of the porous pipe fitting is low. Be provided with the anticollision ring on the outer wall of pipe fitting main part shell, one side of anticollision ring is provided with the pipe fitting drill way, anticollision ring and pipe fitting drill way all have a plurality ofly, pipe fitting main part shell is strengthened the sheet layer including first enhancement sheet layer and second, first enhancement sheet layer is strengthened the sheet layer and is provided with the atress disperse layer with the second between the sheet layer, the atress disperse layer is including the balancing force board, and the balancing force board has two, two be provided with oblique even post between the balancing force board, and oblique even post has a plurality ofly, and is a plurality of oblique even post is range upon range of crisscross distribution.

title_en: Injection mold for heat-resistant plastic
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection mold for heat-resistant plastic, which comprises a supporting seat, a lower mold seat and a filling port, wherein the lower mold seat is fixed at the top end of the supporting seat, an upper mold seat is arranged above the lower mold seat, a guide structure is arranged at the corner position between the lower mold seat and the upper mold seat, a top mold disc is arranged inside the lower mold seat, and the top end of the upper mold seat is communicated with the filling port. According to the anti-leakage die, the clamping block, the stop block and the clamping groove are arranged, the clamping block is fixed at the bottom end of the upper die base, the clamping groove is embedded in the top end of the lower die base, and the size of the clamping groove is matched with that of the clamping block, so that when the upper die base and the lower die base are combined, the clamping block is inserted into the clamping groove, the sealing performance between the lower die base and the upper die base is improved, and after the lower die base and the upper die base are connected, the stop block seals the joint of the lower die base and the upper die base, so that the anti-leakage effect can be achieved.

title_en: Planning board convenient to public cause management analysis
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a planning plate convenient for public utility management analysis, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a lower mounting disc is arranged at the upper end of the mounting frame in an inserting manner, a mounting groove is formed in the upper end of the lower mounting disc, a first sliding groove is formed in the bottom surface of the mounting groove, an upper mounting disc is arranged at the upper end of the lower mounting disc, the upper mounting disc is of a T-shaped structure, the middle part of the lower end of the upper mounting disc extends into the mounting groove, a second sliding groove is formed in the middle part of the lower end of the upper mounting disc, the first sliding groove and the second sliding groove are both annular grooves, a rotating device is arranged between the lower mounting disc and the upper mounting disc in an inserting manner, a sleeve seat is arranged on the lower part of the outer cylindrical surface of the rotating device in a threaded manner, and a cross rod is fixedly arranged on the upper end surface of the rotating device. The planning plate convenient for public utility management and analysis can adjust the vertical height and angle of the planning plate, and is convenient to mount and dismount and use.

title_en: Hand-pulling type hydraulic forklift with damping function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of logistics transportation equipment, in particular to a hand-pulling type hydraulic forklift with a damping function, the hand-pulling type hydraulic forklift comprises a support plate and a driving assembly, the driving assembly comprises a connecting plate and rectangular plates fixedly connected at two ends of the same side of the connecting plate, jacks at the upper ends of the connecting plate are arranged, a handle for controlling the jacks and a main wheel arranged at the lower end of the connecting plate are arranged, the support plate comprises the connecting plate and the rectangular plates fixedly connected at two ends of the same side of the connecting plate, the top ends of the jacks and the lower ends of the connecting plate are fixedly connected, an auxiliary wheel assembly fixedly connected with the outer wall of the jacks and used for controlling the height of the rectangular plates is arranged below the rectangular plates, a partition plate is arranged on the upper end face of the rectangular plates, a damping assembly is arranged between the partition plate and the rectangular plates and comprises damping cylinders fixedly connected with the partition plate and sliding rods slidably connected with the damping cylinders, one ends of the sliding rods are fixedly connected with sealing rings in the damping cylinders, compression springs are further arranged outside the damping cylinders, and the problem that the goods are damaged due to shaking when the traditional hand-pulling type hydraulic forklift is moved is solved.

title_en: High-wear-resistance plunger type hydraulic oil cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-wear-resistance plunger type hydraulic oil cylinder, which belongs to the technical field of hydraulic oil cylinders and comprises a hydraulic cylinder body, wherein a connecting ring is fixedly connected to the lower end of the outer wall of the hydraulic cylinder body, a bottom plate is arranged on the lower surface of the connecting ring, a connecting column is in threaded connection with the lower surface of the bottom plate, an installation ring is fixedly connected to the lower end of the connecting column, and a connecting mechanism is arranged between the bottom plate and the connecting ring.

title_en: Motor bearing of robot sweeps floor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bearings, and discloses a motor bearing of a floor sweeping robot, which comprises an inner ring, wherein an oil cavity is annularly formed in the middle of the inner ring, three groups of oil ducts are annularly formed in the inner side of the oil cavity at equal intervals, balls are movably clamped in the outer ring of the inner ring at equal angles, and a shell is movably clamped in the outer side of the inner ring. The bearing provided by the utility model has the advantages that the purposes of long service life and good effect are achieved through the matching work of the reserved oil seam and the ball, which are formed by clamping the oil cavity, the inner ring and the shell, and the like, meanwhile, the bearing structure can be consumed through continuous extrusion, at the moment, oil can be stably discharged through the self hole of the inner ring and the preset oil duct, the oil is discharged to form an oil film area, the stable rotation of the bearing is ensured, meanwhile, the loss of parts can be reduced, in addition, the temperature enters the interior through the conduction effect and can be quickly absorbed and consumed by lubricating oil, the whole bearing can work in a matching way, and the service life is long, and the working effect is good.

title_en: Bracket for processing printed circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of printed circuit boards, and particularly relates to a bracket for processing a printed circuit board, which comprises a bottom plate; the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a supporting rod, one end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a first spring, one end of the first spring is fixedly connected with a spring tube, one end of the spring tube is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, and the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a fixing frame; through fixed frame, including a motor, an end cap, a controller, and a cover plate, the screw rod, the stopper, the screwed pipe, the connecting rod, the fly leaf, the centre gripping frame, the movable rod, the fixed block, the second spring, splint and protection pad's structural design, the function that this bracket is convenient for adjust has been realized, the problem of the regulation of being not convenient for of general bracket has been solved, make this bracket can make things convenient for people to adjust this bracket according to printed circuit board's not unidimensional, thereby make this bracket can be the printed circuit board who is used for various differences, people's work demand has been satisfied, the work efficiency of this bracket has been improved.

title_en: High appearance of clapping of wisdom blackboard
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of teaching aids, in particular to an intelligent blackboard high-speed shooting instrument which comprises a fixed seat, a mounting component and a shooting component, wherein the mounting component comprises a mounting seat, a turnover plate and an adjusting piece; the shooting assembly is rotatably arranged on the mounting seat and is positioned between the mounting seat and the turnover plate. The drawer type mounting assembly is adopted, the mounting assembly can be freely folded and unfolded, the classroom space is saved, the overall visual experience is improved, dust is not easy to accumulate, and the performance of the mobile phone is more stable; adopt foldable shooting subassembly, can realize freely opening and closing of shooting subassembly, simultaneously, the shooting subassembly can obtain good protection when not using.

title_en: Anti-shake 3D structure ray apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-jitter 3D structure optical machine, relates to the technical field of 3D structure light, and solves the technical problem of jitter generated by an internal heat dissipation module or an external environment of a 3D structure optical module. The three-dimensional optical module comprises a shell, a 3D structure optical module, a cooling fan and an anti-shaking structure, wherein the 3D structure optical module, the cooling fan and the anti-shaking structure are all arranged in the shell, and the anti-shaking structure is used for eliminating shaking generated when the cooling fan works and eliminating resonance of the 3D structure optical module. The device has simple structure, good anti-shaking effect and wide market application value.

title_en: Aircraft control cable sealing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing device for an airplane control steel cable, and relates to the technical field of airplane control system design. The device comprises a seal box, wherein rotating rods are arranged on two opposite side surfaces of the seal box, the rotating rods are in threaded connection with the seal box, a rotating handle is arranged at one end of each rotating rod, a fixing plate is connected to the other end of each rotating rod, a transmission block is arranged on the lower surface inside the seal box, a fixing rod is connected to the lower surface of each transmission block, a buffer plate is connected to the lower surface of each fixing rod, an expansion spring is connected to the lower surface of each buffer plate, the expansion springs are fixedly connected with the seal box, return springs are arranged on two opposite side surfaces inside the seal box, an inclined plate is connected to one surface of each return spring, the inclined plate is hinged to the transmission block through the connecting rods, a support plate is arranged on the lower surface of the inclined plate, and the support plate is in sliding fit with the seal box. According to the utility model, the rotating handle is rotated to drive the rotating rod to rotate, and the rotating rod drives the fixing plate to move back and forth, so that the steel cable is conveniently fixed, and the steel cable is prevented from shaking in the seal box to cause abrasion.

title_en: Tube connection structure of atomization device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipe connecting structure of an atomizing device, which comprises a fixed sleeve, a liquid guide pipe and a base body with a liquid conveying channel; the end part of the seat body is provided with a mounting hole, and the bottom wall of the mounting hole is provided with a liquid inlet pipe communicated with the infusion channel; one end of the liquid guide pipe is sleeved on the liquid inlet pipe, and the fixed sleeve is sleeved on the liquid guide pipe; the fixed sleeve is embedded in the mounting hole, the outer side wall of the fixed sleeve abuts against the inner side wall of the mounting hole, and the inner side wall of the fixed sleeve abuts against the catheter; the fixing sleeve is pressed against the liquid guide pipe to force the liquid guide pipe to be locked on the liquid inlet pipe so as to prevent the liquid guide pipe from being separated from the liquid inlet pipe accidentally.

title_en: A quick mounting platform for building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick mounting platform for buildings, which comprises a connecting column and a connecting plate, wherein the inner wall of the connecting column is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first connecting rod, and one end of the first connecting rod, which is far away from the rotating shaft, is movably connected with a second connecting rod. According to the utility model, one of the clamping blocks is pressed, the second connecting rod and the first connecting rod are rotated by the fixing plate through the rotating shaft, so that the other group of clamping blocks is driven to move inwards, then the upper end of the connecting column is inserted into the groove, the clamping blocks are loosened, the two groups of clamping blocks are reset by the spring, so that the clamping blocks enter the inner wall of the clamping groove, the purpose of quick installation is achieved, the problem that a large amount of time is consumed in installation is avoided, when the platform needs to be adjusted to be in a horizontal state, the four sleeves are respectively rotated, the screw rod is moved up and down through threads arranged on the inner wall of the sleeves, the four level gauges around the platform are observed at the same time, and when the horizontal state is displayed at the same time, the platform is in the horizontal state.

title_en: Silicone rubber injection molding extrusion device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a silicone rubber injection molding extrusion device which comprises a workbench, wherein a supporting device is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the workbench, a lifting support and a supporting frame are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the workbench, a supporting box is slidably connected to the surface of the lifting support, a lifting gear and a worm are rotatably connected to the inner wall of the supporting box through a bearing, a rotating handle is fixedly connected to one end of the worm, and a sleeve is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting box through a connecting block. According to the utility model, the mold is arranged in the mounting opening, the fixing rod is screwed down, so that the clamping plate clamps the mold, the rotating handle drives the worm to rotate to drive the lifting gear to rotate, the lifting gear is meshed with the tooth-shaped groove on the surface of the lifting support, the support box is driven to drive the sleeve to move up and down, the sleeve is convenient to align to the injection opening of the mold, the mold can be replaced, the manufacturing cost is reduced, and the economic benefit is increased.

title_en: Aerial camera and camera module for same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aerial photography instruments, and provides an aerial photography instrument and a camera module for the same. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved current aerial camera and can not set up the measure to aerial camera protection when not using to the visual angle automatic switch-over of aerial camera and having solved, lead to the problem that aerial camera life reduces.

title_en: Double-sealing structure suitable for vacuum coating machine equipment installation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vacuum coating machine equipment, in particular to a double-sealing structure suitable for a vacuum coating machine equipment installation device, which comprises a vacuum cavity, an installation device top surface, an installation device body, an end surface sealing ring and a locking nut, wherein the inner side of the vacuum cavity is connected with the installation device body in a sliding way, the left end surface of the installation device body is fixedly connected with the installation device top surface, the right end surface of the installation device top surface is jointed with the left end surface of the vacuum cavity, the outer side of the installation device body is spirally connected with the locking nut, the left end surface of the locking nut is jointed with the right end surface of the vacuum cavity, and the outer side of the installation device body is sleeved with a shaft sealing ring. The product quality can be improved, the maintenance cost is reduced for customers, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Pipe jacking device for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of auxiliary equipment of constructional engineering and discloses a pipe jacking device for hydraulic engineering. This a pipe jacking device for hydraulic engineering, through locking Assembly, make operating personnel stretch into the inside of having installed the pipe culvert with front side locking Assembly, start the locking pneumatic cylinder after the device installation is accomplished, the locking pneumatic cylinder drives the pipe culvert through the locking arc board and adjusts to with the pipe culvert coaxial position of having installed, simultaneously with reciprocal anchorage between two sets of adjacent pipe culverts, strengthened the installation accuracy between two sets of pipe culverts, effectively improved the quality that the pipe culvert was laid to the device to the practicality of device has been strengthened.

title_en: Flange structure with sealing and fastening functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flange structure with a sealing and fastening function, which comprises two flange plates, wherein the two flange plates are symmetrically arranged, concave blocks are arranged on two sides of each flange plate in a clearance fit mode, a spring is fixedly connected to one side of each concave block, a pushing block is fixedly connected to the other end of the spring, one side of each pushing block is in clearance fit with the corresponding flange plate, an annular groove is formed in the side wall of each flange plate, and a rubber ring is arranged on the inner wall of each annular groove. Can fix the ring flange both sides spacing, skew appears in the ring flange when avoiding installing, can fix the ring flange, then carries out the fixed fastening of bolt again, makes the installation more simple and convenient, avoids appearing the leakproofness behind the deviation influence flange joint, carries out supplementary seal by the rubber ring simultaneously, makes the ring flange efficiency after the installation better.

title_en: Suspension type touch screen display shows ware

title_en: Upper and lower layered casting sliding block
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an upper and lower layer-stepping casting slider, it includes: the sliding plate comprises a lower sliding plate, fixed plates which are integrally formed at the top of the lower sliding plate and are arranged at intervals, an upper sliding plate which is integrally formed at the top of the fixed plates, a connecting sliding plate which is connected to the inner side of the upper sliding plate, and a sliding chute which is formed by the lower sliding plate, the fixed plates, the upper sliding plate and the connecting sliding plate in a surrounding manner; the utility model discloses upper and lower layer-stepping casting slider passes through casting process integrated into one piece, and the cost of manufacture is low, and preparation cycle is short, and the spout is enclosed by lower floor's slide, fixed plate, upper slide and connection slide, and the slide rail passes confined spout, and when the slider moved on the slide rail, because the spout is confined, consequently the slider can not take place the side and move, can bear bigger load moreover, long service life practices thrift the cost.

title_en: Overhead anti-collision device of heating power pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overhead anti-collision device of a heating power pipeline, which comprises a support column, an anti-collision unit, a connecting unit, a pipeline platform and a ground mounting plate, wherein the support column is arranged on the upper surface of the support column; according to the utility model, the contact area of the support post and the ground can be increased through the ground mounting plate, so that the support post can bear larger gravity, the ground mounting plate can be connected with the ground through the ground hole by using the ground nail, the support post is protected by the anti-collision plate, the support post is prevented from being damaged due to collision at the first time, the spring is fixed by the spring sleeve, the general compression direction of the spring is limited at the same time, the damage caused by ejection of the spring at four places after collision is prevented, and the force of a part of the anti-collision plate is removed after the anti-collision plate is collided by the spring, so that the damage of the support post due to overlarge stress is prevented.

title_en: Swinging hose structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a swinging hose structure, in particular to the technical field of corrugated hoses, which comprises a right connecting flange used as a fixed end and a transition flange used as a swinging movable end, wherein the end part of the transition flange is connected with a left inner connecting flange; the connecting pipe is inserted inside the right connecting flange, a swinging hose outlet flange is sleeved outside one end, far away from the right connecting flange, of the connecting pipe, an outer corrugated pipe is connected between the swinging hose outlet flange and the left outer connecting flange, and an inner corrugated pipe is connected between the left inner connecting flange and the connecting pipe. The utility model discloses because corrugated hose adopts single section bellows welded structure, the free end can bear great interior pressure when big pivot angle swings, carries out displacement compensation to the pipeline system, and corrugated hose compact structure is simple, connects reliably, simple to operate, and withstand voltage is high, long service life.

title_en: Pipeline sealing device with automatic locking function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline sealing device with an automatic locking function, which comprises a pipeline body and an end cover, wherein the end cover is slidably sleeved in the pipeline body, a buffer mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the pipeline body on the end cover, a cavity is formed in the right side of the end cover, a self-locking mechanism is arranged in the cavity, and a fixing mechanism is arranged on the right side of the end cover. The self-locking mechanism and the fixing mechanism are matched for use, the extrusion block is driven to extrude the trapezoidal block through horizontal tension during sealing, the trapezoidal block is enabled to press the pipeline, the end cover is firmly fixed on the pipeline, the self-locking function of the worm wheel and the worm is utilized to avoid rotation of the rotating shaft, the extrusion block is prevented from being separated from the end cover, the sealing effect is achieved, meanwhile, when dismounting is conducted, the worm can be rotated to drive the worm wheel to rotate reversely, the connecting rope is discharged through the rope winding roller, the sealing device can be taken down quickly, the mounting structure is simple and convenient, and the sealing effect is further enhanced through the first sealing ring and the second sealing ring.

title_en: Environment-friendly heat preservation pipe with high corrosion resistance
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of the pipeline preparation, a environmental protection insulating tube that corrosion resistance is high is disclosed, including the inner tube, the outer wall cladding of inner tube has the anticorrosion pipe box, the anticorrosion pipe box is kept away from one side of inner tube and is pasted and have the fixed strip, the avris overlap joint of fixed strip has the heat insulating block, the outer wall cladding of heat insulating block has the tarpaulin, outer sleeve pipe has been cup jointed to the outer wall of heat insulating block. Through the setting of the epoxy powder coating of inner tube inner wall and the tarpaulin of inner tube outer wall, play the circumstances that reduces the inner tube corruption at outer bilayer, utilize the insulating block that components of a whole that can function independently combined use, set up at the inner tube outer wall, play the heat preservation effect, can effectively detach when the maintenance, only retrieve the damage part, play the effect of effective utilization of resource, accord with the environmental protection theory, utilize the setting of grafting piece and inserting groove, the convenience carries out quick assembly disassembly to outer sleeve pipe, it replaces the insulating block to reach the convenience.

title_en: Fastening device for water conservancy and hydropower construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fastening device for water conservancy and hydropower construction in the technical field of water conservancy and hydropower construction, which comprises a box body, wherein a motor and a bearing are respectively arranged at the left end and the right end of the bottom in the box body, the motor and the bearing are symmetrical, a left rod is fixedly connected with the top output end of the motor, a right rod is rotatably connected with the bearing, a first gear and a second gear are respectively and fixedly sleeved on the outer surfaces of the left rod and the right rod, the outer surfaces of the first gear and the second gear are jointly engaged and connected with a chain, the top ends of the left rod and the right rod rotatably penetrate through the box body and are connected with driving conical gears, the opposite sides of the two driving conical gears are respectively engaged and connected with driven conical gears, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the driving conical gears, two fixing plates which are opposite to the left side and the right side are arranged at the top end of the box body, and a stabilizing mechanism is arranged at the opposite side ends of the two fixing plates, the utility model has simple and convenient operation and is beneficial to improving the working efficiency and the use efficiency.

title_en: Hinge structure and reading rack of two-way damping
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hinge shaft structure with bidirectional damping and a reading rack, wherein the hinge shaft structure comprises a mounting seat, a rotating part, an outer side damping gasket and an inner side damping gasket, the mounting seat comprises two hinge seats which are symmetrically arranged, the two hinge seats are arranged at intervals, the rotating part is rotatably arranged between the two hinge seats through bolts, and the outer side damping gasket and the inner side damping gasket are arranged in each hinge seat, wherein the outer side damping gasket is attached to the outer side surface of the hinge seat and clamped with the rotating part, and the inner side damping gasket is arranged in the hinge seats, attached to the inner side surface of the hinge seat and clamped with the outer side damping gasket. According to the utility model, through the matching of the inner damping gasket and the outer damping gasket, larger damping is provided for the rotating part, and the stability of the support is ensured.

title_en: Filter equipment is used in flour production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filtering device for flour production, which comprises a base plate and a convex box body, wherein the top end of the base plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of first spring blocks which are distributed annularly and are vertically arranged, the convex box body is positioned above the first spring blocks and is vertically arranged, the bottom of the convex box body is fixedly connected with the plurality of first spring blocks which are distributed annularly, the top of the convex box body is fixedly connected with a plurality of second spring blocks which are distributed annularly and are vertically arranged, the tops of the plurality of second spring blocks are fixedly connected with the same second storage box and are vertically arranged, one end of the bottom of the second storage box is fixedly connected with a discharge port and is obliquely arranged, the discharge port is communicated with the second storage box, and the bottom end in the second storage box is provided with a plurality of support rings and is horizontally arranged. The utility model cleans the residual residue or sundries, is convenient for filtering, enhances the filtering effect and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Rotary plate valve for pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotation type plate valve for pipeline, include the valve main part that links to each other with the outside pipeline, drive assembly and fixed knot construct, the inside closing plate that is equipped with of valve main part, drive assembly includes the actuating lever, the transfer line, torsion spring and rotatory handle, the actuating lever is connected with the closing plate, the transfer line is connected with the actuating lever transmission, rotatory handle is connected with torsion spring and with transfer line fixed connection, torsion spring has power storage state and initial state, pivoted rotatory handle drives the transfer line and rotates, then drive the actuating lever and rotate, make the actuating lever drive the closing plate and rotate in order to realize the switching of valve main part, and, pivoted rotatory handle drives torsion spring and switches between power storage state and initial state, the torsion spring correspondence of power storage state is in the valve main part of opening, fixed knot constructs and is used for being fixed in torsion spring and holds the power state. The valve can be closed more easily by the stored state of the torsion spring.

title_en: Multidirectional adjusting mechanism and adjusting equipment applying same
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of adjusting tools, in particular to a multidirectional adjusting mechanism and adjusting equipment applying the same, the vertical guide rod comprises a vertically arranged vertical guide rod, a vertical guide block is slidably arranged on the vertical guide rod, a vertical guide hole for the vertical guide rod to penetrate through is formed in the vertical guide block, a first longitudinal guide hole perpendicular to the vertical guide hole is formed in the end portion of the vertical guide block, a longitudinal guide rod is slidably arranged in the first longitudinal guide hole, a longitudinal guide block is slidably arranged on the longitudinal guide rod, a second longitudinal guide hole for the longitudinal guide rod to slide is formed in the longitudinal guide block, a first transverse guide hole is formed in the second longitudinal guide block, a transverse guide rod is slidably arranged in the first transverse guide hole, one end, far away from the longitudinal guide rod, of the transverse guide rod is provided with a transverse guide block, and the transverse guide block is provided with a second transverse guide hole for the transverse guide block to move along the transverse guide rod. The multi-directional position adjusting device has the effect of achieving multi-directional position adjustment.

title_en: Boiler tail cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boiler tail cooling device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first box body is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the bottom plate, a second box body is fixedly connected to the right side of the top of the bottom plate, a water tank is fixedly connected to the top of the first box body, a heat conducting plate penetrates through the bottom of the water tank, a first heat conducting rod is fixedly connected to the bottom of the heat conducting plate, and a first heat exchange plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the first heat conducting rod. According to the utility model, through the matching of the bottom plate, the first box body, the second box body, the water tank, the heat conduction plate, the first heat conduction rod, the first heat exchange plate, the second heat conduction rod, the second heat exchange plate, the air inlet pipe, the conveying pipe, the one-way valve, the refrigerating plate, the third box body, the refrigerator and the water pump, the purpose of good use effect is realized, the efficient cooling advantage is achieved, the requirements of the current market are met, the practicability and the usability of the boiler tail cooling device are improved, and the problem of poor use effect of the conventional boiler tail cooling device is solved.

title_en: Metal sleeve with strong heat dissipation capacity
abstract_en: The application discloses metal sleeve with stronger heat-sinking capability relates to logistics equipment technical field. The pipe body before including the pipeline main part with connecting, the skin laminating of pipeline main part has closed ectosome, operating device has been seted up on the surface of closed ectosome, the preceding terminal surface of pipeline main part is installed and is connected the extension board, the laminating of one side of connecting the extension board has a body. The utility model discloses set up the side opening of a set of open design in pipeline main part's inside, thereby can open the heat dissipation that carries out the high strength when necessary, thereby reduce the heat in the body, and be in sealed closed state when using, keep the inside flow stability of body, two sets of great side openings have stronger heat dissipation, and in order to reduce the invasion of dust impurity in the radiating process, sunken butt joint hole groove has been seted up to the lateral wall bottom of connecting the extension board, the joint through filtering the screen board upper and lower extreme and butt joint hole groove can install the filter plate of fretwork in side opening department, thereby play detachable filter effect.

title_en: A study device for development of wisdom agricultural software
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a discussing device for intelligent agricultural software development, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first lead screw is inserted into one side of the top end of the bottom plate, one side of the top end of the bottom plate is in threaded connection with the outer wall of the first lead screw, a rotating knob is fixedly arranged at the top end of the first lead screw, the bottom end of the first lead screw is rotatably arranged on one side of the top end of an antiskid plate, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged on the other side of the top end of the antiskid plate, and one side of the outer wall of the connecting rod is inserted into the other side of the top end of the bottom plate. Thereby maintaining the overall stability of the device.

title_en: Security protection control pole setting subassembly
abstract_en: The application relates to a security monitoring vertical rod assembly, which comprises a base, wherein the base is installed on the existing ground through expansion bolts, a loop bar is installed at the upper end of the base, a core bar is arranged in the loop bar in a sliding manner, an installation assembly is arranged at the upper end of the core bar, sliding plates are symmetrically installed at the left end and the right end of the core bar, the sliding plates are arranged in a limiting groove in a sliding manner, the limiting groove is formed in the outer wall of the loop bar, one of the sliding plates is connected with a threaded rod in a threaded fit manner, and a driving mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the threaded rod; this scheme accessible manual mode waves the rocker, and the rocker cooperates with bevel gear, No. two bevel gears for the threaded rod is rotatory, and under the effect of spacing groove, the threaded rod drives the sliding plate and rises, and the sliding plate drives the core bar and the installation component rises in step, thereby realizes carrying out the function of altitude mixture control to the pole subassembly, and the transport of not only being convenient for, the assembly monitoring video recorder of still being convenient for.

title_en: Integrated gear transmission assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated gear transmission assembly, relates to the technical field of auxiliary devices for equipment transmission, and aims to solve the problem that the working strength of workers is increased due to insufficient lubrication when the conventional integrated gear transmission assembly is used. The inside intermediate position department of gear drive main part is provided with interior fixed block, one side of interior fixed block is provided with the slip spin, and slides the spin and pass through the draw-in groove with interior fixed block and rotate and be connected, one side of slip spin is provided with central circle piece, the both ends of central circle piece all are provided with the connection cylinder, the connection cylinder outside is provided with spacing excircle piece, and spacing excircle piece and gear drive main part welded connection, the inner wall of spacing excircle piece is provided with pad in the immersion oil, and pad and spacing excircle piece paste in the immersion oil and be connected, the top of spacing excircle piece is provided with the excircle piece, and excircle piece and connection cylinder welded connection.

title_en: Nitrogen injection conversion joint and nitrogen injection device for oil and gas pipeline maintenance operation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a nitrogen injection conversion joint and a nitrogen injection device for maintenance operation of an oil and gas pipeline, wherein the nitrogen injection conversion joint comprises a nitrogen injection conversion joint body, a plurality of connecting pipelines and a valve, wherein the interior of the nitrogen injection conversion joint body is hollow, and a plurality of through holes are formed in the circumferential direction; the plurality of connecting pipelines are respectively connected in the through holes to form different air inlet branches and air outlet branches; and each connecting pipeline is provided with a valve for controlling the on-off of the branch gas. The nitrogen injection device comprises a plurality of quick connector male heads, a plurality of gas connecting pipes and the nitrogen injection conversion connector. The utility model can realize the quick assembly of the nitrogen injection device and improve the nitrogen replacement efficiency during the pipe replacement and maintenance of the pipeline.

title_en: Quick adjustment type linear module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of linear modules, in particular to a fast-adjusting linear module, which comprises Contraband frames, wherein a first side plate and a second side plate are respectively fixed at two ends of each Contraband frame, a top plate is fixed between the first side plate and the second side plate, a limiting plate is fixed at a position, close to the second side plate, of each Contraband frame, a screw rod is rotatably connected between the limiting plate and the first side plate, the outer wall of the screw rod is rotatably connected with a nut block, a connecting frame in sliding connection with the Contraband frames is fixedly sleeved on the outer wall of the nut block, one end of the screw rod penetrates through the limiting plate, and a power module quickly separated from the screw rod is arranged on the outer wall of the second side plate. According to the utility model, through the combination of the clockwork spring, the one-way bearing and the traction rope, the continuous one-way transmission of the driving gear can be realized, and the two-way rotation of the lead screw is realized by combining the self-rotation characteristic of the U-shaped shell, so that the position of the moving unit at the upper part of the lead screw can be changed under the condition of no power supply, and the flexibility of installation and troubleshooting in peacetime is improved.

title_en: Flue gas denitration uniform sampling valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flue gas denitration uniform sampling valve, which relates to the technical field of valves used in a denitration system, and comprises the following components: the sampling tube is divided into two sections, a wedge-shaped gap is arranged between the two sections of sampling tubes, and the two opposite ends of the two sections of sampling tubes are respectively used for connecting the detection device and the flue gas pipeline; the wedge-shaped gap is arranged in the first sealing box; one end of the shaft sleeve is positioned in the first sealing box, and the other end of the shaft sleeve is positioned outside the first sealing box; the connecting shaft penetrates through the shaft sleeve and is in sealed sliding connection with the shaft sleeve; the telescopic mechanism is connected with one end of the connecting shaft; and the inserting plate is connected with the other end of the connecting shaft and is matched with the wedge-shaped gap. Compared with the traditional valve, the valve has simpler structure and simple processing technology, so the production cost is low; compared with the traditional ball valve butterfly valve and the like, the telescopic mechanism can be farther away from the flue gas pipeline, so that the high temperature resistance is better.

title_en: Bridge buffer stop based on bridge security performance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bridge anti-collision device based on bridge safety performance, which comprises outer protection blocks, wherein four outer protection blocks are arranged in a rectangular shape, the outer walls of the four outer protection blocks are all provided with a sliding chute in a penetrating way, the inner walls of the four sliding chutes are all connected with an inner protection block in a sliding way, and the bridge anti-collision device has the advantages that: surround four outer protection pieces in the bridge outside, with fixing bolt roll-over in the link, to protect the piece connection outward, the protection piece removes to the inboard in the impact thing drives, interior protection piece drives second connecting block and third connecting block and removes to the inboard, the third connecting block promotes first connecting block and removes and extrude the spring to the outboard, the spring slows down impact, when receiving impact great, the buffer block cushions impact for the third time, if outer protection piece is impaired seriously, take off fixing bolt, will change outer protection piece alone, need not to carry out the damage to the bridge and can install, can change according to impaired protection piece simultaneously.

title_en: Gyration bearing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary supporting structure, which comprises a seat ring and a moving coil, wherein a lower shaft mounting hole is formed in the center of the seat ring, an upper shaft mounting hole is formed in the center of the moving coil, a lower shaft is mounted in the lower shaft mounting hole, an upper shaft fixed with the lower shaft through a bolt is arranged in the upper shaft mounting hole, so that the seat ring is connected with the moving coil, a thrust bearing and a radial bearing are arranged at the joint of the upper shaft mounting hole and the lower shaft mounting hole, and a ball and an isolation block group connected with the moving coil are arranged on the outer edge of the seat ring; meanwhile, the utility model has simple structure and easy manufacture, and greatly reduces the manufacturing cost.

title_en: Combined type water pump device of ultra-wide water jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model provides a composite water pump device of an ultra-wide water jet loom. Super broad width hydraulic loom combined type water pump unit includes the bar shaped plate, the top fixedly connected with brace table of bar shaped plate, the top fixedly connected with shock attenuation box of brace table, sliding connection buffer board between the top of shock attenuation box inner wall both sides, the both sides of buffer board bottom front side all rotate and are connected with the connecting plate, fixedly connected with slide bar between the front side of shock attenuation box inner wall both sides. The ultra-wide water jet loom combined type water pump device provided by the utility model adopts a mode that two water pumps are connected in parallel, and a high-pressure waterline required by weft insertion is simultaneously provided for a nozzle through a one-way valve, so that the weft insertion effect is better, in addition, the abrasion of vibration to the inside of the water pump is effectively reduced through the shock absorption treatment of the water pumps, the service life is prolonged, in addition, the stability of water supply can be ensured through reducing the vibration, and the generation of noise is reduced.

title_en: Automatic soft plate bending machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic soft board bender, including bender main part, control panel, bending board, supporting leg and rotation groove, install control panel in the bender main part, and install the bending board in the bender main part, install unloading mechanism on the soft board in the bender main part, and install the unloading mechanism on the bender main part on the charging tray, be provided with the installation piece in the bender main part, the fixed orifices has been seted up on the installation piece, and installs the gyro wheel on the installation piece. This automatic soft board bender is provided with the installation piece, the gyro wheel is installed to the bottom of installation piece, when removing this bender, the accessible gyro wheel is gone on in the roll on ground, make the device's transport need not be with the help of other article, the device's the transport degree of difficulty has been reduced, the device's flexibility has been increased, and the supporting role through the supporting leg, make the gyro wheel can carry out the lifting when not using, support this bender through the supporting leg, the stability of placing of the device has been increased.

title_en: Warning device for road protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a warning device for road protection, including casing and transmission case, the top of casing and the bottom fixed connection of transmission case, the inside left side fixedly connected with motor of transmission case, the first band pulley of output fixedly connected with of motor, the surface cover of first band pulley are equipped with the drive belt, and the pot head that first band pulley was kept away from to the drive belt is equipped with the second band pulley, and the internal surface cover of second band pulley is equipped with dead lever, the front side of dead lever and the inside front side fixed connection of transmission case. The utility model discloses a set up the cooperation of casing, transmission case, motor, first band pulley, drive belt, second band pulley, dead lever, carriage release lever, fixture block, head rod, second connecting rod and clearance brush and use, reached and carried out the effect of clearing up to warning device for road protection's surface, solved because dust and muddy water on the road make dirty the surface of warning device for road protection, the pedestrian on the road of being not convenient for watches with the problem that the user cleared up.

title_en: Pipe day style of calligraphy frame quick connector and display screen installing support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipe day style of calligraphy frame high-speed joint ware and display screen installing support, wherein, pipe day style of calligraphy frame high-speed joint ware includes two installation component and connecting piece, two the tip of installation component all is equipped with the linkage segment with external connection. The mounting assembly comprises an inner ring piece and an outer ring piece, a mounting ring groove is formed in the inner ring piece, the outer ring piece is connected with the inner ring piece in a sleeved mode, the connecting section is arranged on the outer ring piece, a clamping convex portion is arranged between the inner ring piece and the outer ring piece, and the clamping convex portion protrudes out of the mounting ring groove. The two ends of the connecting piece are respectively inserted into the two installation ring grooves of the installation assemblies, the connecting piece is provided with a clamping groove, and the clamping convex part is clamped in the clamping groove. The utility model discloses technical scheme can realize the high-speed joint installation of the frame pipe of day word.

title_en: Wheel hub prevents muddy water sealing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of vehicle hub end sealing, in particular to a hub mud-proof sealing device, which comprises an oil seal and a mud guard, wherein the oil seal comprises a shell A, a shell B, a shell C, a spring, a rubber gasket and lubricating grease; the mud guard plate comprises a bottom plate, an outer ring side plate and an inner ring side plate. By designing the hub oil seal into a combined oil seal, a mud guard is additionally arranged outside the oil seal on the basis of the original sealing structure; the oil seal is provided with a first auxiliary sealing lip and a second auxiliary sealing lip; a rubber gasket is arranged between the shell B and the shell C, and a protrusion is arranged on the inner side of the shell C and corresponds to the position of the rubber gasket, so that the rubber gasket is extruded between the shell B and the shell C. When the vehicle works under the adverse condition, the muddy water at the wheel end can be effectively prevented from directly invading the oil seal, the muddy water is prevented from entering the oil seal, and the protective capability of the wheel hub to the muddy water is effectively enhanced.

title_en: Oil-immersed vacuum voltage-regulating switch cam mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tap changer technical field discloses oily vacuum tap changer cam mechanism, including top cap and bottom, inside one side of top cap and bottom is provided with the cavity, the inside of cavity is provided with the cam disc, top one side fixedly connected with connecting axle of cam disc, the bottom of connecting axle is run through the cam disc and is rotated and connect on the bottom, the top of connecting axle is run through the top cap and is extended to the outside of top cap, the inside opposite side of top cap and bottom is provided with the spacing groove, the inside sliding connection of spacing groove has the sliding block. The utility model discloses in, through setting up the spout in the periphery of cam disc to at the sealed post one end fixed connection slider that has shutoff rivers passageway function, through rotating the cam disc, in order to guarantee that the distance between sealed post and the cam disc is unchangeable, sealed post then seals the water course from the inside roll-off of spacing groove, otherwise then opens the water course, need not to use the spring during, and is more durable.

title_en: Remote sensing monitoring mechanism is administered in mine environment restoration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine environment restores and administers remote sensing monitoring mechanism relates to mine environment and administers technical field, set up four installation pieces of through-hole including bottom plate and symmetry, it is a plurality of the inner wall swing joint of through-hole has and buries the ground nail, and is a plurality of bury one side outer wall of ground nail and seted up the spacing groove, four the inside upper surface in one side of installation piece is provided with the installation axle that is used for installing the fly leaf, four the constant head tank that is used for installing the clamp plate is seted up to one side outer wall of installation piece, four the fixed surface is connected with the spring under one side of clamp plate. The utility model discloses, through trampling the clamp plate downwards to move down along the constant head tank, realize driving the fly leaf and rotate along installation axle, and through the cooperation with the spacing groove, drive and bury the perk that makes progress of ground nail, realize taking off with ground pine, realize device and ground quickly separating, can effectively promote the convenient degree when carrying out frequent shift position to the device.

title_en: Anti structure and laser striping machine that fall of laser striping machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-falling structure of a laser line marking instrument, which comprises a turntable structure, wherein the upper end of the turntable structure is provided with an upright post, the lower end of the turntable structure is fixedly connected with a shell, and a first protection mechanism for preventing the laser line marking instrument from being broken is arranged in the shell; the utility model also discloses a laser line marking instrument, which comprises a machine core arranged in the upright post, and the upper end of the upright post is provided with a universal suspension mechanism. According to the utility model, when the laser graticule falls to the ground, the first spring and the rubber elastic ball are extruded to deform to absorb impact energy, and when the top of the laser graticule is impacted, the third spring is extruded to deform to absorb energy caused by impact, so that the damage of the universal suspension mechanism is avoided.

title_en: Hinge structure and printer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hinge structure and a printer, and belongs to the technical field of financial self-service equipment. The hinge structure comprises a first connecting part and a second connecting part, wherein a plurality of first mounting holes are formed in the first connecting part, and the first mounting holes are circular; the second connecting portion are hinged to the first connecting portion, the second connecting portion are provided with adjusting holes and a second mounting hole, the second mounting hole is circular, the adjusting holes are arc-shaped strip-shaped holes, and the circle center of each arc-shaped strip-shaped hole is concentric with the circle center of the second mounting hole. This the hinge mechanism and printer can realize that go out paper access structure and exit slot relative position are adjustable, easy operation, labour saving and time saving, weak point consuming time has improved work efficiency.

title_en: Portable low-power piston compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable low-power piston compressor, which comprises a base, wherein a first fixing groove is formed in the top surface of the base, a compressor body is fixedly sleeved inside the first fixing groove, a cover is arranged on the top surface of the compressor body, two hinges are arranged on the excircle wall surface of the compressor body, and the compressor body is connected with the cover through the hinges; the maintenance subassembly, the maintenance subassembly sets up the top surface of compressor body, it is right to be used for the compressor body maintains, through the cover that sets up, when needs maintain the compressor body, through pressing the fixed column that sets up, when the fixed column enters into the inside in joint groove, through rotating the cover that sets up, can open the compressor body this moment, the staff of being convenient for maintains compressor body inside, need not use the instrument of dismantlement, and is convenient and swift.

title_en: Self-aligning roller bearing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-aligning roller bearing, which belongs to the field of bearing parts and comprises an inner steel ring, wherein the outer side surface of the inner steel ring is connected with a roller in a sliding manner; the oil absorption fiber wheel is sleeved in the bearing support in a sliding mode, so that a large amount of lubricating oil can be adsorbed and stored, the lubricating oil is released under the influence of centrifugal force when the bearing rotates to lubricate the roller, the inner steel ring, the lower outer steel ring and the upper outer steel ring, the flexibility of the bearing is improved, abrasion is reduced, the moving range of the oil absorption fiber wheel can be limited due to the design of the rotating shaft, the bearing is prevented from moving fast to extrude the oil absorption fiber wheel, and the rotating speed is reduced.
