title_en: Electric adjusting two-way valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrically-adjusted two-way valve which comprises a valve body, wherein connecting pipelines are arranged on two sides of the valve body, connecting flanges are arranged on the connecting pipelines, an upper support is arranged at the upper end of the valve body, a valve rod is arranged in the upper support, an electrically-controlled body is arranged at the upper end of the upper support, a plurality of upper sliding rods are arranged at the back side of the connecting flanges, lower sliding rods are arranged at the lower positions of the upper sliding rods on the connecting flanges, and T-shaped connecting blocks are arranged on the upper sliding rods and the lower sliding rods. The utility model relates to an electrically-adjusted two-way valve, which belongs to the field of valves.

title_en: Photographic frame is used in portable digital film preparation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of photographic stands, and particularly relates to a portable digital film production photographic stand which comprises a supporting seat, wherein three distributed supports are hinged to the supporting seat, the bottom of each support is hinged to a bottom plate, the bottom of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with a guide column, a sliding sleeve is sleeved outside the guide column in a sliding manner, three uniformly distributed hinged arms are hinged to the sliding sleeve, and one end, far away from the sliding sleeve, of each hinged arm is hinged to a support. The utility model pushes the sliding sleeve to slide downwards on the guide post through the displacement generated by the threaded motion of the threaded adjusting ring on the guide post, the sliding sleeve can drive one end of the hinged arm to move downwards, the other end of the hinged arm pushes the support to expand by taking the hinged position of the support and the supporting seat as an axis, the sliding sleeve can be pushed upwards by the elastic force of the first spring to reset by reversing the threaded adjusting ring in the same way, and the support is retracted, so the utility model is convenient to carry.

title_en: Lifting machine is used in building engineering construction convenient to remove
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conveniently-movable hoister for building engineering construction, which comprises a hoister body, wherein two sides of the bottom of the hoister body are fixedly connected with a U-shaped plate, a supporting plate is arranged at the bottom of the hoister body, slide blocks matched with slide grooves are fixedly connected with two sides of the inner surface of the U-shaped plate, one side of a movable block of an electric slide rail is fixedly connected with the U-shaped plate, so that the electric slide rail slides to drive the slide blocks on the U-shaped plate to slide in the slide grooves, the hoister body is driven to adjust the horizontal position on the supporting plate, the movement is facilitated by arranging a universal wheel, a lifting plate and a friction pad are driven to lift by an electric push rod, the friction pad is in contact with the ground, the contact surface is increased to realize the positioning, and the hoister is convenient to move and adjust and also convenient to fix, the use is convenient, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Package shaping machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a packaging and shaping machine, which relates to the technical field of packaging and shaping, and comprises an oil supply path, an oil return path and a plurality of shaping mechanisms, wherein each shaping mechanism comprises an electromagnetic directional valve and a shaping oil cylinder, the outlet of the oil supply path is respectively connected with the inlets of a plurality of electromagnetic directional valves, the outlet of each electromagnetic directional valve is connected with the oil inlet of the corresponding shaping oil cylinder, the oil outlet of the shaping oil cylinder is connected with the oil return path, each shaping oil cylinder is suitable for being arranged around a package to be shaped, and the piston rod of each shaping oil cylinder is suitable for extending out to extrude the package to be shaped. The packaging shaping machine realizes extrusion shaping of a packaging piece to be shaped by controlling the telescopic length of the shaping oil cylinder piston rod, the extrusion force is adjustable, and the leveling effect is poor.

title_en: Vehicle identification access control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle identification access control system which comprises a transmission case, wherein a base is fixedly installed at the bottom of the transmission case, a vehicle intercepting mechanism is arranged inside the transmission case, the vehicle intercepting mechanism comprises a supporting block, a pushing rod and a transmission wheel driven by a driving assembly, a supporting column is fixedly connected to the surface of the transmission wheel, and a buffer assembly is arranged on the surface of the supporting block. This vehicle discernment access control system, through being provided with vehicle interception mechanism, utilize drive assembly to drive the drive wheel and rotate, slide in the sliding tray of square piece through the pillar, with this removal that has driven the catch bar, and make a plurality of first bull sticks and second bull stick rotate and produce outside extension, with this traditional barricade pivoted mode can be avoided, can enough avoid not judging the problem that highly produces and automobile body bump, and can improve the age of its use, avoid the rupture problem that weight caused.

title_en: Pressure pipeline flange joint
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flange joints, and discloses a pressure pipeline flange joint which comprises a first sleeve, a first flange plate and a second flange plate, wherein one end of the first sleeve is provided with a first connecting pipe, the other end of the first sleeve is provided with a second connecting pipe, the first flange plate is sleeved on the first connecting pipe, and the second flange plate is sleeved on the second connecting pipe; a first rubber pipe sleeve is sleeved at the joint of the first connecting pipe and the first sleeve, and a first pressure reducing spring is mounted on the first rubber pipe sleeve; and a second rubber pipe sleeve is sleeved at the joint of the second connecting pipe and the first sleeve, and a second pressure reducing spring is mounted on the second rubber pipe sleeve. According to the utility model, the first rubber pipe sleeve, the second rubber pipe sleeve, the first pressure reducing spring, the second pressure reducing spring, the first sealing ring, the second sealing ring, the pressure reducing ring and the shunting hole are matched, so that the pressure of medium flowing in the pipeline is reduced, and the sealing property is improved.

title_en: Bearing seat sealing device for hot-rolling rough-rolling working roll
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing device for a bearing seat of a hot-rolled rough-rolled working roll, relates to the technical field of rolls, and solves the technical problems of short service life, quick failure and high consumption of a sealing ring at the transmission side of the bearing seat of the working roll in the related technology. The device includes the bearing frame body, install in the roll spiale of bearing frame body, the sealing ring, the seal cover, sealing plate and protection casing, the seal cover is fixed in the tip of bearing frame body, the roll spiale is located to the seal cover, sealing plate is fixed in the tip of bearing frame body, the outer peripheral edges department of seal cover is located to the sealing plate cover, the protection casing includes zhou huan and fender ring, the zhou huan extends the setting along the axial of roll spiale, keep off the ring and set up along the radial extension of roll spiale, the outside of sealing plate is fixed in to zhou huan one side, opposite side and the outer peripheral edges fixed connection who keeps off the ring. The baffle ring can shield the gap between the sealing sleeve and the sealing pressure plate, thereby reducing the cooling water entering the sealing lip, reducing the sealing abrasion and improving the related defects.

title_en: Petroleum pipeline protection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a petroleum pipeline protection mechanism, which comprises: a protective tube, comprising: the oil pipeline comprises a first half pipeline and a second half pipeline, wherein the first half pipeline and the second half pipeline surround the oil pipeline, the first half pipeline and the second half pipeline are both of circular arc structures, the first half pipeline and the second half pipeline are sunken to form a first annular groove, a second annular groove, a third annular groove and a groove, the second annular groove is positioned between the first annular groove and the third annular groove, and the inner wall of the first annular groove is sunken to form the groove; hug closely the mechanism, it includes: the first arm, the second of holding tightly holds arm, bolt, rack and nut tightly, holds the mechanism and puts into first ring channel tightly, and first arm one end of holding tightly is articulated with second arm one end tightly, and the first arm other end of holding tightly holds the arm other end with the second and supplies the bolt to pass. This petroleum pipeline protection mechanism solves the inconvenient problem of the supporting mechanism bearing height of adjusting among the prior art.

title_en: Fastening mechanism capable of being installed quickly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fastening mechanism capable of being installed quickly, which comprises: the fastener body comprises a first limiting part and an outer side wall, the outer side wall comprises a first end and a second end, and the outer side wall gradually inclines outwards from the first end to the second end; the locking unit comprises a second limiting part and an elastic sheet, the elastic sheet gradually inclines inwards from the first end of the fastener body to the second end of the fastener body, the fastener body penetrates through the locking unit, and the elastic sheet is abutted against the outer side wall; the hinge pin penetrates through the fastener body, the hinge pin sleeve is provided with an elastic part, and one end of the hinge pin extends out of the fastener body and is connected with the fixing part. The utility model avoids the process of threading, reduces the processing cost of the fastening mechanism and is more suitable for mass production. The whole locking process can be completed only by sleeving the locking unit on the fastener body, and an operator can complete the locking process in only 2-3 seconds in the actual installation process, so that the trouble and labor are saved.

title_en: Double-screw double-guide dustproof clamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-screw double-guide dustproof clamp, which has balanced clamping force, enlarged clamping space, precise clamping and greatly improved processing precision of a workpiece, a gear structure is arranged in a clamping block, a crank is arranged at the power input end of the gear structure, two power output ends of the gear structure are symmetrically arranged relative to the middle part of the clamping block, screws are arranged on the two power output ends, guide pipes are sleeved on the two screws, two guide sleeves are arranged on a worktable corresponding to the guide pipes, each guide pipe can be inserted into the corresponding guide sleeve in a matching way, a support pipe is correspondingly arranged along the axial extension direction of each guide sleeve, nuts are fixedly arranged on a nut mounting plate corresponding to the two screws, the thread end of each screw can be inserted into the corresponding nut in a matching way, the crank drives the double screws to synchronously rotate through the gear structure, so that the clamping block can reciprocate relative to the worktable, so as to achieve the purpose of clamping.

title_en: Stop valve for low-temperature medium
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stop valve for a low-temperature medium, which belongs to the technical field of valves and comprises a valve body; the bottom end of the valve cover is connected with the top end of the valve body through a flange; the valve core is arranged in the valve body, a first sealing ring is arranged on the surface of the bottom end of the valve core, and the valve core and the valve body form a sealing pair through the first sealing ring; the hand wheel is arranged above the valve cover; the lower end of the valve rod is connected with the valve core, and the upper end of the valve rod passes through the valve cover to be connected with the hand wheel; the sealing mechanism is arranged on the valve rod and forms sealing with the valve body and the valve cover; the vacuum jacket is sleeved on the valve body and forms a vacuum cavity with the outer side wall of the valve body; the outer side wall of the valve body is provided with glass fibers, and the glass fibers are coated with aluminum foils. The utility model provides a stop valve for a low-temperature medium, which can reduce heat conduction and heat radiation of the outside to a valve body, can greatly reduce the cold energy loss of a liquid helium medium in the valve and achieves the purpose of saving resources.

title_en: Structure of folding T-shaped article-holding rack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a structure of foldable T shape supporter, including backplate, folded sheet, spliced pole and slipmat, characterized by: the top of the back plate comprises an inverted semi-circular ring body; one end of the folding plate main body of the folding plate comprises a semi-closed groove with a downward opening; the groove of the folding plate main body of the folding plate is connected with the semicircular ring body of the back plate, and the shallow groove of the folding plate main body is connected with the non-slip mat. The beneficial effects are as follows: the back plate has smaller length, thereby having lower cost, and simultaneously adopts an anti-skid structure, thereby the folding plate has simple and beautiful appearance.

title_en: High-pressure oil injection nozzle
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a technical field of pump nozzle discloses a high pressure pump nozzle. The utility model provides a high-pressure oil injection nozzle, which comprises an oil pipe, a sleeve which is sleeved on the outer side of the oil pipe in a movable way and a connecting pipe which is arranged on one side of the oil pipe; one end of the oil pipe close to the oil outlet is integrally connected with a plurality of clamping pieces, the clamping pieces are circumferentially and uniformly distributed on the oil pipe, and a gap is formed between every two adjacent clamping pieces; the clamping piece expands radially in a direction away from the connection tube. The clamping piece and the oil pipe are integrally arranged, so that additional installation is not needed, and the assembly is more convenient.

title_en: Adjustable damping mechanism and camera shooting slide rail device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of damping device, specifically be an adjustable damping mechanism and camera slide rail device, including first adapter sleeve, and the universal driving shaft that the cover was established in first adapter sleeve, the lower extreme of universal driving shaft passes through damping end cover and first adapter sleeve fixed connection, the upper end fixed cover of universal driving shaft is equipped with spacing post, is equipped with the second adapter sleeve between spacing post and the first adapter sleeve, but second adapter sleeve and first adapter sleeve relative movement in vertical direction; a following valve is arranged between the first connecting sleeve and the linkage shaft, the following valve is positioned under the second connecting sleeve, the upper end of the following valve is in abutting connection with the lower end of the limiting column for limiting, and the lower end of the following valve is in abutting connection with the damping end cover for limiting through an elastic part; and a closed cavity is formed among the first connecting sleeve, the limiting column, the second connecting sleeve and the following valve, and is filled with damping oil. The utility model discloses a change the area of contact of first adapter sleeve and second adapter sleeve and damping oil, obtain the damping effect of rotating back continuous variation.

title_en: Adjustable support and hanger device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a gallows specifically is a gallows device is propped up in regulation flexibility, application scope is extensive regulation formula. The hanging bracket comprises a supporting and hanging bracket chassis and hanging posts arranged on the lower surface of the supporting and hanging bracket chassis, wherein a fixing hole is formed in the supporting and hanging bracket chassis, an installation groove is formed in the top surface of the supporting and hanging bracket chassis, and a stabilizing component is arranged inside the installation groove; the stabilizing assembly comprises a reinforcing plate and an inserting plate, a stabilizing groove is formed in the inner side of the mounting groove, the reinforcing plate and the arc-shaped plate are horizontally arranged in the mounting groove and the stabilizing groove in a sliding mode, and a mounting hole is formed in the reinforcing plate; the suspension posts comprise fixed suspension posts and rotating suspension posts, the fixed suspension posts are rotatably connected with the rotating suspension posts, and the lower ends of the rotating suspension posts are provided with connecting seats. The utility model discloses a gallows chassis is used with the cooperation of stabilizing the subassembly, can freely adjust the effective fixed area on a gallows chassis, is convenient for adjust effective fixed area according to waiting to hang the weight, and then can improve the bearing capacity of a gallows chassis when suspending in midair, improves the stability of a gallows chassis after fixing.

title_en: V-shaped clamp and pipeline structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a V type clamp and pipeline structure. The V-shaped clamp comprises a clamp body, an adjusting piece and a locking assembly. The clamp body is provided with a clamp tile, and the clamp tile is provided with a V-shaped groove; the adjusting piece is fixedly arranged on the bottom wall of the V-shaped groove and used for axially adjusting the positions of the first pipe fitting and the second pipe fitting in the V-shaped groove; and the locking assembly is used for locking the first pipe fitting and the second pipe fitting to the clamp body. This V type clamp can prevent that first pipe fitting and/or second pipe fitting from adorning partially along the axial to the clamp tile of avoiding V type clamp bears great assembly stress, has improved the life of V type clamp, also can avoid the junction of first pipe fitting and second pipe fitting to take place not hard up even leaking simultaneously, has improved pipeline structure's safety in utilization.

title_en: Automatic yard device of sweeping of square battery module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sign indicating number device is swept to square battery module automation of battery detection technical field, include: a lower frame; the upper rack is arranged at the upper end of the lower rack; the jacking positioning mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the lower rack; the transplanting mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the lower rack and is positioned right above the jacking positioning mechanism; at least one code scanning mechanism arranged on the transplanting mechanism; and the industrial personal computer is respectively connected with the jacking positioning mechanism, the transplanting mechanism and the code scanning mechanism. The utility model has the advantages that: realize that automatic two-dimensional code to square battery module sweeps the sign indicating number to very big promotion sweeps the compatibility of sign indicating number.

title_en: Convenient control device for man-machine interaction of LED screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a convenient controlling means of human-computer interaction of LED screen relates to LED screen controlling means technical field. The utility model provides a convenient controlling means of human-computer interaction of LED screen, includes base and LED screen, base top swing joint has the spliced pole, is provided with between base and the spliced pole and turns to the device, and the spliced pole top is fixed with the footstock, and the footstock both sides are provided with damping device, and damping device includes vibration damping mount and shock attenuation footstock, and vibration damping mount pegs graft mutually with the footstock, and vibration damping mount and shock attenuation footstock tip all are fixed with the fixed disk, and the fixed disk of vibration damping mount bottom is fixed mutually through the bolt with the footstock bottom. The utility model discloses be provided with the universal wheel and turn to the device, can remove the device to suitable position through the universal wheel to can turn to the LED screen through turning to the device, the device still is provided with the gyro wheel between base and spliced pole, thereby frictional force between base and the spliced pole when having reduced the rotation makes the device rotate more smoothly.

title_en: Portable support frock of scraper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable support frock of scraper, including the mount, two support frames of bottom outer wall fixedly connected with of mount, two mounting panels of one side fixedly connected with of support frame, two slide bars of top swing joint of mounting panel, the bottom fixedly connected with universal wheel of slide bar, one side swing joint of slide bar has the extension spring, and the both ends of extension spring are fixed mutually with slide bar and mounting panel respectively, a plurality of guide bars of top fixedly connected with of universal wheel, and guide bar and mounting panel sliding connection, two mount pads of the equal fixedly connected with in both sides of mount. The utility model discloses not only can use through the cooperation of support frame and universal wheel, make the frame obtain supporting and bear, improve the convenience of device, can increase the frictional force between auxiliary block and the mount pad through supplementary line moreover, improve the result of use of device, can also make the mounting panel be connected with the support frame more firm through the fixed plate, improve the steadiness of device.

title_en: Oxygen cylinder valve body
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the oxygen cylinder field discloses an oxygen cylinder valve body, including the valve body, be provided with integrated into one piece's outlet duct on the outer wall on valve body right side, the intake pipe is installed to the downside detachably of valve body, the fixed cover of having connect first spacing ring on the outer wall of valve body, the fixed cover of having connected the second spacing ring on the outer wall of intake pipe, a plurality of rings of fixedly connected with and equidistant distribution's first screw rod on the diapire of first spacing ring, set up the arc notch with first screw rod looks adaptation on the second spacing ring, threaded connection has the nut that offsets with the second spacing ring outer wall on the outer wall of first screw rod. Under the mutually supporting of valve body, intake pipe, first spacing ring, second spacing ring and sealing ring, through rotating the valve body, can change the position relation of valve body and oxygen cylinder outer wall sign, under the mutually supporting of first screw rod and nut, fix between valve body and the intake pipe, realized the adjustment of valve body and oxygen cylinder outer wall sign position relation.

title_en: Tablet personal computer support
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tablet computer support, including base, two supports, clamping mechanism to and locking mechanism, clamping mechanism include first pivot, second pivot, respectively with first pivot with two splint that the second pivot is connected, and with the clamping spring that the second pivot is connected, first pivot and second pivot are connected with the inboard of a support respectively, clamping spring one end with the second pivot is supported and is leaned on, and the other end and corresponding the support is supported and is leaned on, locking mechanism includes tool to lock body and bolt, the end of bolt is passed first pivot, contained angle between base and two supports is the acute angle, the middle part of splint is equipped with a plurality of buttons and dodges the hole. Above-mentioned panel computer support, when idle, rotates the panel computer, makes its upset downward, makes the button dodge the hole simultaneously and is shielded by the support, and rethread locking mechanism dies the first pivot lock of panel computer, prevents that children from touching the button of controlling of panel computer, and then prevents children's maloperation.

title_en: Alnico magnet for magnetic valve
abstract_en: The utility model provides an alnico magnet for magnetic valve, include: the baffle, magnetic force reinforcing shell structure is installed to the left wall of baffle, magnetic force reinforcing shell structure's internally mounted has two sets of magnetic force reinforcing magnet structures, magnetic force reinforcing shell structure's left wall installs magnet shell structure through two sets of buckle structures, the internally mounted of magnet shell has two sets of magnet structures. The utility model discloses a carry out the design of modularization to current solenoid valve, when current solenoid valve carries out the permanent magnet design, all need design the magnet, like this with regard to great promotion the cost of design to and prolonged the design cycle of current solenoid valve, the utility model discloses a design of solenoid valve provides the optimal design of a part, can let the designer directly use the utility model discloses a permanent magnet to can be according to the intensity in specific condition adjustment magnetic field and the scope of action in magnetic field.

title_en: Integrated river water purification device with butt joint sealing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integration river water purification installation with butt joint seal structure, include: the purifier is arranged on the surface of the bottom plate, a case is arranged on one side of the purifier, and butt joint pipes are connected to one side of the case and are arranged in two groups; the conveying pipe is arranged at the bottom of the opening end of the butt joint pipe, the top end of the conveying pipe is connected with a clamping ring, and the two sides of the butt joint pipe are connected with inserting blocks. This integration river water purifier with butt joint seal structure through cup jointing the snap ring block in the butt joint outside of managing, makes inside the inserted block correspondence inserts into the snap ring, readjusts the horizontal pole, drives and rotates the post and rotate in the snap ring is inside, and then inserts into the inserted block with the trace, promotes the push rod again, with inside the locating piece horizontal migration back insert into the snap ring, will transmit pipe both ends opening part and butt joint pipe one end opening part butt joint together, and then played and made the butt joint pipe have butt joint seal structure's effect.

title_en: Clutch driven plate disc hub convenient to dismantle installation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of clutches, in particular to a clutch driven disc hub convenient to disassemble and assemble, which comprises a disc hub body, wherein the middle part of the disc hub body is fixedly provided with a spline sleeve body, the surface of the disc hub body is provided with a rectangular through groove, a rectangular ring sheet is embedded and installed in the rectangular through groove, the surface of the disc hub body is fixedly provided with a cylinder body, and the surface of the disc hub body is fixedly provided with an internal thread sleeve; the utility model discloses a lead to groove separation with rectangle ring piece and rectangle, because the size that the rectangle leads to the groove is bigger than the spring size on the driven plate, can laminate the assembly with set hub body and driven plate easily, treat set hub body and driven plate fixed back, can compress the spring on driven plate surface in proper order and inlay the cooperation with the spring on rectangle ring piece and driven plate surface, it fixes to lead to inslot portion with rectangle ring piece embedding rectangle afterwards, such structure makes things convenient for the spring on set hub body and the driven plate to assemble.

title_en: Novel human resource management platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel human resource management platform, which comprises a bottom plate, a mounting post is arranged in the middle of the top of the bottom plate, a square opening is arranged in the front and the back of the mounting post in a through way, a power mechanism is arranged at the top of the mounting post, an identity recognizer is arranged at the front side of the mounting post, a lifting mechanism is connected between the identity recognizer and the mounting post, fixing mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the mounting post, counterweight mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the top of the bottom plate, the power mechanism comprises a motor box, a motor and a screw rod, the motor box is arranged at the top of the mounting post, the motor is arranged in the motor box, the screw rod is arranged in the square opening, the top end of the screw rod is connected with the output end of the motor, the utility model has simple structure and reasonable design, and can adjust the height of the identity recognizer for the human resource management platform according to the use requirement, and the stability of the identity recognizer is improved through the counterweight mechanism.

title_en: Long and narrow confined space gas electric monitoring facilities
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a long and narrow limited space gas electric monitoring device, which comprises an installation bracket and a monitoring host; the monitoring host comprises a box body, and the box body is arranged on the mounting bracket; the box body is provided with an air speed sensor, a methane sensor, a hygrothermograph and an ultrasonic sensor; be provided with the data processing unit in the box, wind speed sensor, methane transducer, warm and humid acidimeter and ultrasonic sensor all are connected to the data processing unit. The utility model has the advantages that: the monitoring data is more comprehensive, and the accurate detection of the data can be realized.

title_en: Fire prevention leak protection natural gas conveying pipeline of soft or hard double containment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soft and hard double-sealed fireproof and leakproof natural gas conveying pipeline, which comprises a base, wherein an arc-shaped groove is arranged in the base, the conveying pipeline is clamped in the arc-shaped groove, a protective shell is erected above the conveying pipeline, the bottom ends of the two sides of the protective shell extend downwards into a groove arranged at the corresponding position on the base, a protective sleeve is fixedly sleeved at the outer part of the bottom end of the protective shell, a protective mechanism is respectively connected between the outer surfaces of the two sides of the protective sleeve and the two side walls of the groove, the protective mechanism comprises disc springs symmetrically distributed on the outer surfaces of the two sides of the groove, one end of each disc spring is fixed on the groove, the other end of each disc spring is provided with a connecting plate, the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a fixed rod, the end part of each fixed rod is provided with a rotating ball, the two sides of the groove are respectively connected with a rotating groove, the rotating groove corresponds to the position of the rotating ball and is matched with the shape and the size of the rotating ball, the rotating ball is rotatably arranged in the rotating groove.

title_en: Self-lubricating flywheel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a self-lubricating type flywheel, including the flywheel body, set up a plurality of teeth of flywheel body lateral wall, and be located two sets of lubrication portion between the tooth, lubrication portion is including setting up the inlet of flywheel body one side is with installing the inside stock solution pipe of flywheel body, and set up two sets of liquid outlet between the tooth, wherein lubricated liquid warp the inlet flows in the stock solution pipe, and warp the liquid outlet is discharged, it is right tooth department is lubricated. The utility model discloses an installation lubrication portion between the tooth for the flywheel can lubricate the position of flywheel tooth when rotating, through the inside of injecting the stock solution pipe into with lubricated liquid through the inlet, on lubricated liquid discharges the tooth through the liquid outlet, right tooth department is lubricated, improves the rotational speed of flywheel, and the lubricated liquid of disposable storage can supply the flywheel longer time to use simultaneously, improves work efficiency.

title_en: Double-color spiral plastic pipeline and forming device and forming system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a double-color spiral plastic pipeline and a forming device and a forming system thereof, the double-color spiral plastic pipeline comprises an inner pipe, a first coating layer and a second coating layer, the first coating layer covers the outer surface of the inner pipe, and the second coating layer is spirally coated on the outer surface of the first coating layer; the coating layer on the outer layer has no influence on the pipeline and does not influence the normal performance of the pipeline. The forming device comprises a fixed body and a rotating body, wherein the front end of the fixed body sequentially extrudes a first coating layer, and the front end of the rotating body extrudes a second coating layer to form spiral patterns. The utility model also provides a double-colored spiral plastic conduit molding system. The molding device and the molding system of the double-color spiral plastic pipeline adopt the coating process of the spiral extruder head, the molding extrusion pressure is small, the coating effect is good, and the production efficiency is high.

title_en: Ground source heat pump buried pipe plugging device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground source heat pump buried pipe plugging device relates to ground source heat pump technical field, has solved plugging device and has remained the gap to the relatively poor easy of the pipeline laminating degree of out-of-round, to the relatively poor problem of the pipeline leaking stoppage effect of out-of-round. A ground source heat pump buried pipe plugging device comprises a main plugging ring body; the outer side of the main leaking stoppage ring body is provided with an outer fixing frame in a surrounding mode, the outer fixing frame is provided with outer fixing columns at intervals in an array mode, spiral lines arranged in the middle of the outer fixing columns and the outer fixing frames are in threaded connection, the outer fixing frames are of semicircular annular structures, the two outer fixing frames form an annular structure, the tail ends of the outer fixing columns are connected with the circular grooves in the middle of the outer reinforcing plate in a nested mode, and the tail ends of the outer fixing columns are connected with the circular grooves in the middle of the outer reinforcing plate in a rotating mode. The utility model discloses external fixation frame supports outer reinforcing plate and main leaking stoppage ring body through the external fixation post, and the adaptation is to the buried pipe laminating leaking stoppage of out of round.

title_en: Heat preservation and moisture preservation device for concrete
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a concrete is with heat preservation device of moisturizing, the utility model relates to a concrete is with heat preservation device of moisturizing technical field, including the staving, the below of staving is equipped with the bottom plate, the top surface of bottom plate and the underrun several supporting leg fixed connection of staving, the below fixed mounting discharge gate of staving one side, the discharge gate communicates with each other with the staving is inside, fixed mounting valve between discharge gate and the staving, and the top of staving is equipped with the bung, and the bung is type, and the bung can cooperate with the staving, the bottom surface fixed mounting several U type seat of bung, and U type seat cooperatees with the bucket wall of staving. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable design, convenient to use can be convenient for keep warm and moisturize the concrete, can heat when stirring the concrete and keep warm, and it is effectual to keep warm, can avoid the concrete to solidify, prevents to influence the result of use, can cushion the shock attenuation to the staving to can make its stability more in the course of the work.

title_en: Be applied to novel bearing heat-insulating and cooling device of cauldron that disinfects
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a be applied to novel bearing heat-insulating heat sink of cauldron that disinfects relates to the bearing field. This be applied to novel bearing heat-insulating cooling device of cauldron that disinfects includes: the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with an output shaft, and the end part of the output shaft is fixedly sleeved with a fan; the bearing seat, the output shaft pegs graft on the inner wall of bearing seat, the inside of bearing seat has seted up the bearing outer bin, the surface of bearing seat has seted up the oiling mouth, the oiling mouth is linked together with the inner circle part of bearing seat, the bearing seat is equipped with cooling mechanism. This be applied to novel bearing heat-insulating heat sink of cauldron that disinfects, through increasing inlet tube, outlet pipe and the outer storehouse of bearing, during the cooling water enters into the outer storehouse of bearing through the inlet tube from the cooling water import, then discharge from the cooling water export through the outlet pipe, reduce bearing body temperature, be difficult for scalding, prevent the thermal energy, increase life.

title_en: Lightweight integrated gear chamber
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lightweight integrated form gear room, including the gear room, gear room is integrated casting shaping's aluminum alloy system structure, is equipped with bent axle hole, oil pump hole and air compressor pump hole on the gear room, is equipped with lubricating structure on the gear room, is equipped with additional strengthening around bent axle hole, oil pump hole and the air compressor pump downthehole side and between the gear room. Has the advantages that: the utility model discloses well gear room is the light structure that the aluminum alloy was made, and the set has bent axle hole, oil pump hole, air compressor pump hole on the gear room, and oil pump hole mainly used engine oil pump installation, air compressor pump hole mainly used start the air compressor pump installation, have reduced the setting of independent oil pump support and independent air compressor pump support, have increased the space for the engine is arranged.

title_en: One-way mounting check valve of drinking equipment
abstract_en: The one-way installation check valve of the drinking equipment comprises a main body, wherein a partition plate is arranged in the main body, a through hole is formed in the partition plate, a first cavity is formed below the partition plate, a valve seat is arranged on the partition plate, a first sealing ring is arranged on the outer wall of the valve seat, an inclined table surface is formed on the inner wall of the valve seat, a seat cover is arranged below the valve seat, a through hole is formed in the seat cover, a valve rod is arranged in the valve seat, a convex ring is arranged below the valve rod, a spring is arranged between the convex ring and the seat cover, a second sealing ring is arranged on the outer wall of the convex ring, a limiting seat is arranged on the valve seat, the lower end of the limiting seat is contacted with the valve seat, the outer wall of the limiting seat is in limiting fit with the inner wall of the main body, a limiting ring is arranged on the inner wall of the upper opening of the limiting seat, a push rod is arranged in the limiting seat, a limiting rib is arranged on the outer wall of the push rod, the lower head of the push rod is matched with the valve rod, the upper head of the limiting seat is inserted into the second cavity of the drinking equipment through the limiting seat, a third sealing ring is arranged on the limiting seat, the upper port of the main body is provided with a fixed gland, and the fixed gland is fastened and fixed with the upper port of the main body.

title_en: Quantitative bromide conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bromide quantitative conveying device, which belongs to the field of bromide product production, and comprises a storage tank, bromide feed liquid is filled in the storage tank, a nitrogen input pipeline is arranged in the storage tank, the nitrogen input pipeline is communicated with a nitrogen tank, a feed liquid output pipeline is also arranged in the storage tank, the feed liquid output pipeline is communicated with a packaging tank, the utility model presses the bromide feed liquid into the packaging tank through the feed liquid output pipeline by nitrogen pressurization; for the consumption and the recovery cost who reduces nitrogen gas, the utility model discloses be equipped with the inflation bag at the inboard lateral wall of storage tank, the inner chamber intercommunication of inflation bag has the forcing pipe, the forcing pipe intercommunication has the nitrogen gas jar, be equipped with the pump on the forcing pipe, when the bromide feed liquid is more in the storage tank, the inflation bag shrink is at the storage tank lateral wall, and when the bromide feed liquid is less in the storage tank, in order to reduce the consumption of nitrogen gas, can directly fill into nitrogen gas through the pump in to the inflation bag, reduce the space in the storage tank, and then the pressure in the increase storage tank, continue to pass through the feed liquid output tube with the bromide and discharge.

title_en: Assembled suspension platform for electric hanging basket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic hanging flower basket pin-connected panel suspends platform in midair relates to construction technical field, including the chassis, the mounting bracket, guardrail I, the mounting bracket symmetry is in the top both sides of chassis, guardrail I becomes perpendicular mode with the mounting bracket, one side of guardrail I is equipped with guardrail two, be equipped with the truckle on the bottom four corners of chassis, the lateral wall periphery of chassis is equipped with the baseboard, chassis and baseboard are fixed connection, the side of baseboard is equipped with a plurality of fixture blocks, the inside of fixture block is equipped with square groove, and guardrail I and two swing joint of guardrail are in square groove, be equipped with pinhole and screw hole on guardrail I and the guardrail two, the side of fixture block is equipped with the L template, be equipped with the locating pin on the L template, the locating pin cooperatees with the pinhole, be equipped with reset spring on the locating pin. Has the advantages that: the device has simple structure, improves the installation speed of the hanging baskets, can splice hanging baskets with different lengths, and improves the flexibility of the device.

title_en: Centrifugal clutch with anti-slip protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifugal clutch with prevent protection device that skids, including clutch housing, clutch disc, drive shaft, first screw hole has been seted up to clutch disc's inside, first screw hole runs through the clutch disc, the inside of first screw hole is provided with first clamping screw, the clutch disc is through first clamping screw and clutch housing fixed connection, the inside of clutch disc is provided with second clamping screw, the top of clutch disc is provided with the centrifugation piece, the centrifugation piece passes through second clamping screw and clutch disc fixed connection. The utility model discloses in, through setting up antiskid groove and antiskid tooth, use through the cooperation of antiskid groove with the antiskid tooth, reduce with the area of contact of clutch dustcoat inner wall, consequently also reduced the friction rate of friction material to clutch dustcoat inner wall, the antiskid tooth can be deepened to the antiskid inslot portion, can increase the frictional force of centrifugal piece and clutch dustcoat inner wall like this to make the clutch have the effect of preventing skidding.

title_en: Pipeline silencing device
abstract_en: A pipeline silencing device comprises an expansion cavity, a first perforated plate, a second perforated plate and a first rotating shaft, the second pivot, the rotary rod, the both ends in expansion chamber communicate with upper reaches pipeline and downstream pipeline respectively, first perforated plate is located the expansion intracavity and just to the port setting of upper reaches pipeline, the second perforated plate is located the expansion intracavity and just to the port setting of downstream pipeline, first pivot is connected in the upper end of first perforated plate, the second pivot is connected in the upper end of second perforated plate, the outer peripheral face of rotary rod is all located to first pivot and second pivot, first perforated plate rotates through first pivot to be connected in the rotary rod, the second perforated plate rotates through the second pivot to be connected in the rotary rod, the one end of two sets of removal subassemblies in the expansion intracavity is connected respectively in first perforated plate, the lower extreme of second perforated plate, the other end all passes the expansion chamber and connects respectively in upper reaches pipeline and downstream pipeline. The noise reduction device is simple in structure and suitable for noise reduction of different frequencies.

title_en: Gas balance high-pressure rotary valve end cover
abstract_en: The end cover body is provided with a plurality of airflow ports which are communicated to the air cavity, and heating components are arranged in the air cavity. Cold air can enter the air cavity from any one of the airflow openings, and the cold air is mixed with the original air in the air cavity after entering the air cavity and flows out of the other airflow opening to play a role in blocking heat.

title_en: Water supply pipeline made of multilayer composite material
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multilayer composite material water supply pipeline, which belongs to the technical field of water supply pipelines and comprises a pipeline body, wherein a detachable protection component is sleeved on the pipeline body and comprises an upper sleeve ring and a lower sleeve ring which are respectively attached to the upper side and the lower side of the circumferential surface of the pipeline body, one ends of the upper sleeve ring and the lower sleeve ring, which are close to each other, are respectively fixed with a plywood, two plywoods are respectively provided with matched perforations, a plurality of perforations are respectively penetrated with bolts, a plurality of bolts are respectively connected with nuts by threads, the whole water supply pipeline structure is reasonable in arrangement, ingenious in concept and flexible in use, the detachable protection component sleeved on the surface of the upper sleeve ring and the lower sleeve ring is used for improving the quality, the protection performance and the service life of the whole pipeline, moreover, the silencing accessories arranged in the pipeline can avoid the overlarge noise caused by the water flowing through of the pipeline, and simultaneously the pipeline can play a role of inhibiting bacteria in the water inside the pipeline, has stronger practicability and market application prospect.

title_en: Supporting track for pipe jacking construction
abstract_en: The application relates to a supporting track for pipe jacking construction, include: pretension subassembly and two tracks are equipped with the horizontal adjustment mechanism who is used for adjusting two track intervals between two tracks, and the track lower extreme is equipped with a plurality of regulation supports, and the level of adjusting the support can be adjusted, and the pretension subassembly sets up between two tracks for exert the power that is close to each other to two tracks, in order to realize two track pretensions. This application simple structure can adjust track interval and level, and it is convenient to adjust, has improved the efficiency of construction.

title_en: Gas flow direction switching structure of high-altitude large-diameter pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas flow direction of high altitude major diameter pipeline switches structure. The gas conversion box comprises a gas conversion box body, wherein through holes are formed in three adjacent side plates of the gas conversion box body, a gas pipeline, a first outgoing gas pipeline and a second outgoing gas pipeline are respectively communicated with the three through holes and are coaxially arranged with the gas pipeline and the first outgoing gas pipeline, the second outgoing gas pipeline is perpendicular to the incoming gas pipeline, the inner ends of the three gas pipelines are located in the gas conversion box body, and flanges are fixedly connected with the outer circumferential surfaces of the inner ports of the three gas pipelines; a flange blind plate is hinged to the corner in the gas conversion box body on one side of the second outgoing gas pipeline and detachably connected with a flange of the first outgoing gas pipeline or the second outgoing gas pipeline; the closing plate of the gas conversion box body is provided with a manhole. The utility model discloses simple structure, with low costs utilizes same air supply, supplies two sets of system switching use, reduction equipment investment expense at the different times.

title_en: Easy-to-maintain magnetic turning plate liquid level meter mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an easy-to-maintain magnetic turning plate liquid level meter mounting structure, which comprises an energy accumulator and a magnetic turning plate liquid level meter vertically arranged outside the energy accumulator, wherein the magnetic turning plate liquid level meter comprises a liquid level meter body and a floater arranged in the liquid level meter body, the top and the bottom of the liquid level meter body are respectively provided with an air outlet and a sewage outlet, and a display turning column is arranged on the liquid level meter body; be equipped with liquid phase connecting pipe and gaseous phase connecting pipe between energy storage ware and the level gauge body, be equipped with the liquid phase shut-off valve on the liquid phase connecting pipe, be equipped with the gaseous phase shut-off valve on the gaseous phase connecting pipe, the gaseous phase connecting pipe is U-shaped structure and U-shaped notch upwards sets up, gaseous phase connecting pipe one end and gas vent intercommunication, the other end and the inside high-pressure gas intercommunication of upper end of energy storage ware, gaseous phase connecting pipe horizontal segment is located to the gaseous phase shut-off valve to be equipped with discharge valve on the gaseous phase connecting pipe horizontal segment between gaseous phase shut-off valve and gas vent. This mounting structure can effectively improve maintenance efficiency, reduces maintenance personal's intensity of labour, improves the maintenance security.

title_en: Agricultural is farmland calamity early warning device for meteorological
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a farmland calamity early warning device for agrometeorology belongs to agrometeorology early warning technical field, including support sleeve and monitoring early warning cloud platform, support sleeve's inside cover is equipped with the regulation post, support sleeve's top fixedly connected with backup pad, the last fixed surface of backup pad is connected with stores up the rain bucket, the interior diapire fixed of storing up the rain bucket is inlayed and is had level sensor, support sleeve's left surface fixedly connected with photovoltaic board monitors the rainfall through utilizing rain bucket and level sensor to utilize soil moisture analysis appearance and soil moisture test probe to realize the monitoring to the soil water content, with data transmission to monitoring early warning cloud platform simultaneously, synchronous transmission to early warning monitor terminal and removal end, realize monitoring often and the automatic early warning to weather rainfall and soil water content, effectively increase early warning equipment's intelligent effect, the early warning work of the early warning device of being convenient for the arid farmland.

title_en: Harvester transmission overload protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a harvester transmission overload protection ware device belongs to agricultural machine technical field, wherein, including left output friction seat, right output friction seat, power input gear shaft, synthetic friction disc, internal tooth iron sheet and pressurization subassembly, left side output friction seat and right output friction seat pass through the pressurization subassembly and connect, the activity of power input gear shaft is in right output friction seat. Through left side output friction seat, right side output friction seat, the power input gear shaft, synthetic friction disc, the setting of internal tooth iron sheet and pressurization subassembly, it rotates to realize that the power input gear shaft drives the internal tooth iron sheet, and the rotation of internal tooth iron sheet is through synthetic friction disc under the effect of pressurization subassembly, left side output friction seat and right side output friction seat rub and rotate, realize when equipment lock commentaries on classics or card are dead, overload protection ware skids, protect equipment effectively, prevent the damage of equipment, processing production adaptability has been increased, work efficiency and security.

title_en: Electronic audio amplifier screen of telescopic
abstract_en: The patent of the utility model aims at providing an electronic audio amplifier screen of telescopic, including screen shell and curtain spool, the screen shell is connected with the audio amplifier, it stretches out or the inside flexible actuating mechanism of retraction screen shell pipeline to be provided with the drive audio amplifier in the screen shell. The audio amplifier can stretch out screen shell and curtain spool when using, can retract in the curtain spool when not using, and tone quality when guaranteeing the audio amplifier to use is not disturbed.

title_en: Intelligent lock control valve on pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent lock control valve on a pipeline, which comprises an installation shell, a remote conveying device, a display screen, an exchanger, a storage battery, a stable driving frame structure, a valve body, a valve core, a detection frame structure which is convenient to disassemble, an upper side sealing ring and a lower side sealing ring, wherein the remote conveying device is installed on the upper part of the inner side of the installation shell; the upper part of the mounting shell is provided with a display screen; the upper part of the right side of the mounting shell is provided with an exchanger; the lower part of the inner side of the mounting shell is provided with a stable driving frame structure; the lower part of the mounting shell is provided with a valve body. The connecting pipe of the utility model is connected with the left side and the right side of the valve body through the thread of the threaded pipe, which is beneficial to conveniently dismounting the connecting pipe from the valve body according to the requirement when in use, and further convenient for maintaining the temperature sensor; one side of the limiting ring close to the valve body is glued with a sealing ring, so that the sealing effect of the joint of the connecting pipe and the valve body can be increased when the valve is used.

title_en: Lifting support and electronic equipment of adjustable lifting power value
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting support and electronic equipment of adjustable lifting force value for solve the technical problem of the unable compatible different weight's of present lifting support display. The utility model discloses a mounting hole is opened at the top of the bracket body, the lifting seat is arranged in the inner cavity in a sliding way and is connected with the bracket body through the constant force spring assembly, the elastic baffle is arranged at the top of the lifting seat, and the clamping groove is arranged on the lifting seat; the adjusting component is detachably assembled on the bracket body and comprises a first constant force spring, a fixed seat and a movable plate; the first constant force spring is connected in the fixed seat, and the movable plate is connected with the first constant force spring; when the fixed seat is clamped in the inner cavity through the mounting port, and the movable plate is pressed to move downwards and is inserted in the clamping groove, the elastic baffle abuts against the matching part of the movable plate so that the movable plate is locked on the lifting seat; when the elastic baffle is separated from the matching part of the movable plate by external force, the adjusting component can be separated from the bracket body from the mounting opening.

title_en: Video acquisition frame and device

Through the height of adjusting the montant and the position of camera fixing base on the horizontal pole and the luminance of light, the video acquisition frame can provide the best condition of gathering for the video of animal behavioural experiment to provide technical support for obtaining the best experimental result.

title_en: Quick-assembling structure of tap pressing handle
