The utility model discloses a hide at the connecting bush of handle inner chamber fixed case main part and handle interconnect, realize that the tap presses down the quick installation of handle, effectively solve the screw and expose outer problem, need not punch on hand, also need not cover the decoration that the screw was used in the installation outside the handle, it is more convenient, swift to install, effectual reduction installation cost makes the tap whole more clean and tidy, pleasing to the eye simultaneously.

title_en: Laminated rubber three-dimensional shock isolation support based on X-shaped friction rotation energy consumption
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-dimensional isolation bearing of stromatolite rubber based on X type friction rotation energy consumption, be in including stromatolite rubber bearing and setting respectively two power consumption device of stromatolite rubber bearing both sides, the top surface and the bottom surface of stromatolite rubber bearing are provided with upper junction plate and lower connecting plate respectively, power consumption device includes: the four rotating plates are respectively provided with a rotating hole at two sides and are respectively positioned at four rotating holes at one end of each rotating plate, a fixed pin shaft penetrates through the rotating holes, the four rotating plates pass through the fixed pin shaft and intersect at one point, a friction mechanism is arranged at the intersection positions of the four rotating plates, and the other ends of the four rotating plates are respectively provided with a fixing mechanism, wherein the fixing mechanisms are fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the upper connecting plate and the other two fixing mechanisms are fixedly connected to the top surface of the lower connecting plate. The problem of current support tensile strength poor, can't undertake too big vertical deformation and do not have vertical power consumption effect is solved.

title_en: Electromagnetic brake with locking device mounted in front
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a front-mounted electromagnetic brake with a locking device, which comprises a front-mounted assembly, wherein the front-mounted assembly comprises a front cover; the rear assembly comprises a rear cover; the front cover and the rear cover are respectively provided with a shaft hole when being placed on the axial central line; the front cover, the brake body and the rear cover are all provided with threaded through holes; the threaded through holes of the front cover, the brake body and the rear cover are linearly aligned; the bolt is sequentially connected with the front cover, the brake body and the rear cover; the front cover and the rear cover are provided with mounting holes; the axial center line of the brake body is provided with a shaft hole, a rotating shaft is connected in the shaft hole, and the rotating shaft sequentially penetrates through the rear cover, the brake body and the front cover; one end of the rotating shaft facing the rear cover is connected with a locking device. The utility model discloses an use a bolt to synthesize a whole with protecgulum, stopper body and back lid to set up the pivot on the axial direction line of protecgulum, stopper body and back lid, realize brake motor pivoted purpose, hold motor shaft tightly when making pivot and motor shaft be connected, solve the problem that the reliability is low.

title_en: Clip with adjustable fixed included angle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a checkpost with adjustable fixed contained angle belongs to pipeline construction technical field, and it is including the piece that deflects, the surface of the piece that deflects has rotatable movable bulb through round pin axle swing joint, the surface of activity bulb has the surface to establish the screwed spliced pole through round pin axle swing joint. This checkpost with adjustable fixed contained angle, when there is certain dislocation in the mounted position of its mounting panel and pipe laying position, rotate the thread bush through turning round the piece, make its thread bush remove under the effect of spliced pole surface screw thread, and press the vaulting pole through the sliding sleeve on surface, make two fastener position changes of it can, this kind of mode can be at the in-process that fixed contained angle changed, keep pipeline mounted position not in same horizontal plane with the mounting panel, and when the hookup location of activity bulb and spliced pole rotated, can realize the change of direction of connection, make it can be after the installation finishes, still can adjust the position of installation according to the needs of installation.

title_en: Shock-absorbing and buffering snow removing shovel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a snow removing shovel technical field, and a but shock attenuation buffering snow removing shovel is disclosed, it includes snow shoveling plate and handle, snow shoveling plate includes medium plate and two curb plates, and two curb plates are located the both sides of medium plate, there is the hinge at the equal fixed mounting in the junction of medium plate and two curb plates, the side fixed mounting of medium plate has the linking pole, the slot has been seted up to the one end of keeping away from the medium plate at the linking pole, the bottom of handle is pegged graft in the slot, the outside noose of handle has the linking ring, and there is first fixed block at the equal fixed mounting in both sides of linking ring, the utility model discloses, have a function to snow shoveling plate absorbing, when snow shoveling plate meets and stops, go up the spring, lower spring and damping spring can play a buffering effect to the impact force to can adjust the inclination of two curb plates on the snow shoveling plate, like this way when snow shoveling plate, snow shoveling plate just can push away snow to both sides, can clear out a road very fast in the snowfield.

title_en: Positioning and mounting device for turbine guide ring
abstract_en: A positioning and mounting device of a turbine guide ring comprises an eccentric pin and an eccentric bushing, wherein the eccentric pin comprises a cylindrical pin body, one end of the pin body is provided with an eccentric part, the other end of the pin body is provided with a driving part, the eccentric bushing comprises a bushing body, an eccentric hole which penetrates through the bushing body is axially arranged in the bushing body, and the axis of the eccentric hole deviates from the axis of the peripheral surface of the bushing body; the eccentric pin is arranged in the eccentric hole, and the pin body is matched with the eccentric hole; the eccentric part is of a cylindrical structure, the diameter of the eccentric part is smaller than that of the pin body, and the axis of the eccentric part deviates from that of the pin body. Adopt eccentric round pin and eccentric bush combination, it is bigger than the adjustable range who uses eccentric locating pin alone, consequently through the eccentric combination in two directions of eccentric round pin and eccentric bush, satisfy the assembly demand. Has the characteristics of simple structure and convenient installation.

title_en: Traffic engineering buffer stop
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traffic engineering buffer stop is provided with the bumping post on the top of base, the inner wall of bumping post is provided with the gag lever post, the lateral wall of gag lever post is provided with the slide bar, the one end of slide bar is provided with first spring, the other end of slide bar is provided with the crashproof board, the inner wall of crashproof board is provided with the air bag system, the lateral wall of crashproof board is provided with sealed lid, the top of base is provided with spacing sliding sleeve, the middle part of spacing sliding sleeve is provided with the fixed cone, the inner wall of fixed cone is provided with the second spring, the one end of second spring is provided with firm awl strip; the utility model provides an among the technical scheme, through setting up crashproof board and air bag system, reach and improve crashproof buffering protective properties, avoid the vehicle impaired serious purpose under huge impact force, through setting up firm awl strip, reach the steadiness that improves the structure, avoid the rail guard atress to take place to squint or collapse, influence the purpose of normal play effect.

title_en: Monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle probe is with lift cloud platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle is lift cloud platform for probe, including elevating platform and cloud platform, the elevating platform sets up and installs in the installation cavity in unmanned aerial vehicle cabin, the elevating platform includes mounting panel and lifter plate, mounting panel fixed connection is at the top in installation cavity, lifter plate sliding connection is in the installation cavity, it is connected with a pair of lead screw to rotate on the mounting panel, a pair of lead screw cover of lifter plate bottom fixedly connected with, the lead screw cover is connected with screw drive, the lead screw is driven by the micro motor of fixed connection on the mounting panel, the base fixed connection of cloud platform is in the bottom of lifter plate. The utility model discloses can effectively reduce the risk of unmanned aerial vehicle probe collision damage, the reliability is high, is worth promoting.

title_en: Hybrid power transmission
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hybrid power transmission, including engine, first motor, second motor, first synchronizer, second synchronizer and parallel arrangement's input shaft, output shaft, the engine is connected with the input shaft, is equipped with first synchronizer on the input shaft, and the input shaft is used with gear G1 when first synchronizer hangs one side gear, and the input shaft is used with gear G2 when first synchronizer hangs another side gear; the output shaft is provided with a second synchronizer, the second synchronizer can select gear shifting to be respectively connected with the gear G1 and the gear G3 to realize output, and the output shaft is further connected with the gear G2 through the gear to realize output. In the system, the engine has three gears, and the HEV working condition can be shifted without power interruption; one motor has two gears, the other motor has an intermediate speed ratio gear, and the EV working condition can be shifted without power interruption; two motors under the EV working condition can be driven simultaneously, so that the torque, the power requirement, the cost, the weight and the like of the motors are reduced.

title_en: Movable pressure container
abstract_en: A movable pressure container comprises a container main body, a detachable container cover and a supporting frame; the detachable container cover is arranged above the container main body, the support frame comprises a lower support part and a side support part, the lower support part comprises a support leg frame, support legs and universal casters, the support legs are uniformly distributed below the support leg frame, the universal casters are arranged below the support legs, and the side support part comprises a vertical support plate, a gear, a rocking handle, a fixed pin and an arc-shaped support arm; the vertical support plate is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the support bracket frame, one end of the arc-shaped support arm is fixedly arranged on the vertical support plate, the other end of the arc-shaped support arm is provided with a clamping structure, the outer wall of the container main body is provided with a clamping groove, and the clamping structure is clamped in the clamping groove; the outer wall of the container body is provided with a toothed plate, the gear is arranged on the vertical supporting plate and is meshed with the toothed plate in a matching mode, the rocking handle is fixedly connected with a shaft of the gear, and the fixing pin is arranged on the vertical supporting plate. The utility model discloses make things convenient for the special semi-manufactured goods of part to shift in the laboratory.

title_en: Software engineering-based multimedia equipment for man-machine interaction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a human-computer interaction uses multimedia equipment based on software engineering, comprising a base plate, the fixed electric lift rod that is provided with in bottom plate upper end rear middle part, the fixed seat that rotates that is provided with in electric lift rod upper end, it is provided with the dead lever to rotate on the seat, the dead lever is kept away from the fixed multimedia equipment that is provided with in one end of rotating the seat, the inside fluting of having seted up in the place ahead of bottom plate, the inside slip of fluting is provided with the backup pad, the inside fixed bearing block that is provided with in fluting lower extreme middle part that just is located of bottom plate. The utility model discloses a multi-media equipment is used in man-machine interaction based on software engineering, the device make the trigger head of backup pad lower extreme contact the sensor through pushing down the backup pad on, give the control end with signalling through the sensor, make whole device carry out start work, when not using multi-media equipment, make the device keep standby state, the effectual resource of having practiced thrift.

title_en: Bidirectional high-frequency isolated energy storage module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an energy storage module technical field specifically indicates a two-way high frequency isolated form energy storage module. The module comprises a shell, wherein a module body is arranged in the shell, the module body is connected with the bottom wall of the shell through a buffer component A, and the module body is connected with the side wall of the shell through a buffer component B; the buffer component A comprises a fixed block, a connecting seat, a connecting rod, a spring sleeve, a sliding sleeve, a connecting rod and a spring column; the buffer component B comprises a fixed rod, a buffer ball and a buffer spring; the module body is connected with the top wall of the shell through a buffer block, a heat dissipation box is embedded on the top wall of the shell, and a heat dissipation assembly is arranged in the heat dissipation box; the heat dissipation assembly comprises a motor limiting rod, a rotating rod, a bevel gear A, a bevel gear B, a rotating rod and a heat dissipation fan, and heat dissipation nets are arranged on the top wall and the bottom wall of the heat dissipation box. The to-be-solved technical problem of the utility model is to provide a two-way high frequency isolated form energy storage module that shock attenuation, radiating effect are good.

title_en: Hydraulic buffer device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hydraulic buffer device has that buffer device height and buffering power size are adjustable, prevents the characteristics that fluid temperature risees, reaches the effect that effectively reduces the forging and pressing device vibration. A hydraulic buffer device comprises a buffer cylinder device and a cooling oil tank, wherein the buffer cylinder device is connected with the cooling oil tank through a pipeline; the buffer cylinder device comprises an adjusting screw rod, a plunger, a cylinder body and a return spring; the plunger is arranged in the cylinder body in a sliding mode, is connected with one end of the adjusting screw rod through threads, the other end of the adjusting screw rod is in contact with the forging and pressing equipment sliding block, and can move in the cylinder body under the action of external force; the overall height of the buffer device can be adjusted by adjusting the screwing-out height of the adjusting screw rod, so that the buffer device is suitable for the die assembly heights of different dies; the plunger piston is matched with the cylinder body to form a buffer cavity, and the buffer cavity is filled with buffer solution; a buffer unit is arranged in the buffer cavity between the plunger and the cylinder body.

title_en: Alarm system based on disc brake
abstract_en: The application provides an alarm system based on a disc brake. The system comprises: the vehicle comprises a processing device, a first wireless communication module, at least two disc brakes and a wear displacement sensor arranged on each disc brake, and the display device comprises a display screen and a second wireless communication module, wherein the processing device is respectively connected with the wear displacement sensor and the first wireless communication module; the display screen is connected with the second wireless communication module, and the first wireless communication module is in wireless communication with the second wireless communication module; the display screen is used for displaying the residual abrasion loss of the disc brake obtained by the processing device. The system provided by the application has the advantages that the residual abrasion loss of the disc brake is displayed in real time, the functions of real-time monitoring and real-time early warning of the abrasion condition of the brake block are achieved, and the function of reminding a driver before serious abrasion is achieved.

title_en: Interior bushing pipe convenient to inside is changed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a welt pipe convenient to inside is changed, including chucking connection structure and protection connection structure, protection connection structure's inner position fixedly connected with chucking connection structure, chucking connection structure includes cooperation groove and first body, the cooperation groove has been seted up to the upper end position of first body, chucking connection structure still includes locating pin and cooperation ring canal, the side rigidity fixedly connected with cooperation ring canal of first body, the horizontal position department fixedly connected with locating pin of cooperation ring canal, protection connection structure includes the second body, first connecting end frame, first fastening component, second fastening component and second connecting end frame, the first connecting end frame of side symmetry fixedly connected with and the second connecting end frame of second body. The utility model discloses the interior bushing pipe of being convenient for inside change through chucking connection structure and protection connection structure's setting, realizes the purpose of inside change.

title_en: Fixed ball valve that valve rod was prevented to blow off
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixed ball valve that blew off is prevented to valve rod, its technical scheme main points are including the valve body, be located the case in the valve body, be located the last valve rod of case top and be located the lower valve rod of case below, it all is provided with a boss with lower valve rod to go up the valve rod, the counter sink of two coaxial settings is seted up to the case, the inner chamber intercommunication of one end and case that two counter sink diameters are big, it all is located the tip with lower valve rod boss on the two to go up the valve rod, it touches with the ladder face of two counter sink mutually respectively to go up the valve rod and pass two counter sink and two bosss respectively with lower valve rod, the problem of prior art valve rod being blown off the valve body easily and unable on-line maintenance has been solved.

title_en: Camera installing support and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a camera installing support and vehicle belongs to autopilot technical field, including installation base, shell body and interior switch frame. The utility model provides a camera installing support and vehicle, when the camera is fixed, the shell body is fixed to the outside of automobile body through the installation base to in fixing the installation space on the interior switch frame with the camera installation, then with the interior switch frame through the opening of stepping down fixed to the inside of shell body and with the inner wall dismantlement of shell body be connected, the camera can shoot the image through the opening of stepping down simultaneously. Only need pull down the interior switch frame from the shell body when need changing the camera, then change have with camera specification and size match installation space other interior switch frame can, make the change of camera convenient and fast while the multiple camera of adaptation more, also avoided the damage on vehicle surface that the dismantlement repeatedly caused between installation base and the automobile body.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mutual complementary incessant cover of rolling moves output device that is equipped with, provide and storage device and pneumatic subassembly intake pipe and mutual system interconnection device that is equipped with including pneumatic air supply, pneumatic air supply provides and the storage device side is connected with pneumatic subassembly intake pipe and mutual system interconnection device that is equipped with, pneumatic air supply provides and the storage device right side is provided with the cover and moves the terminal and carry out output and telescoping device, the cover moves the terminal and carries out output and telescoping device top and be connected with pneumatic subassembly valve accuse output trachea and mutual system interconnection device that is equipped with. The mutual-backup complementary non-stop rolling sleeving and outputting device is arranged on the two groups of shunt air inlet pipes through the left valve control terminal pneumatic assembly air inlet pipe and mutual-backup system interconnection switching device and the right valve control terminal pneumatic assembly air inlet pipe and mutual-backup system interconnection switching device respectively, when one group of shunt air inlet pipes of the device breaks down, on-site production stop and rolling stop cannot be caused, only the valve control terminal which breaks down needs to be stopped, and production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Valve heat preservation structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a valve heat-insulating structure, which comprises a valve body and a heat-insulating pipe mechanism, wherein the heat-insulating pipe mechanism comprises a first heat-insulating pipe, a second heat-insulating pipe and a damping rotating shaft, and the bottoms of the first heat-insulating pipe and the second heat-insulating pipe are rotationally connected through the damping rotating shaft; locating component is all installed to the top both sides of first insulating tube and second insulating tube, locating component is including first fixing base and second fixing base, the top avris at the second insulating tube is installed to the second fixing base, the first fixing base internal rotation is connected with the locating plate, the locating plate is kept away from first fixing base one end both sides and all is provided with the holding tank, install compression spring and location button in the holding tank, the both sides top of second fixing base is provided with the positioning groove hole, this device can make through locating component and accomplish convenient installation and dismantlement between insulating tube mechanism and the valve body, the problem that just need prefabricate again and reinstall after the heat preservation that can effectively solve current valve pipeline demolishs.

title_en: Damping stepless regulation's photographic cloud platform device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a damping stepless regulation photography holder device, which comprises a base, a fixed damping disc, a plurality of first ring pieces which are concentrically arranged and are arranged at intervals along the radial direction, and a first ring groove is defined between two adjacent first ring pieces; the holder main body is rotatably arranged on the base and is connected with a movable damping disc which can move along the axial direction of the fixed damping disc, the movable damping disc is provided with a plurality of second ring pieces which are concentrically arranged and are arranged at intervals along the radial direction, a second ring groove is defined between every two adjacent second ring pieces, and the outer peripheral wall of the movable damping disc is provided with external threads; the rotary driving piece is rotatably arranged on the base and is provided with an internal thread matched with the external thread. When the damping is adjusted, the depth of the first ring piece inserted into the second ring groove and the depth of the second ring piece inserted into the first ring groove can be adjusted by only rotating the rotary driving piece, so that the contact area of the first ring piece and the second ring piece is adjusted, the first damping oil is added or reduced, and the damping adjustment is more linear.

title_en: Quick connecting nut
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick connecting nut, which relates to the technical field of fasteners and comprises a limiting mechanism and a connecting mechanism, wherein the connecting mechanism is arranged above the limiting mechanism in parallel, the limiting mechanism and the connecting mechanism are connected into a whole through a connecting part, the connecting mechanism is used for connecting a screw rod, the limiting mechanism provides limiting and supporting functions for the connecting mechanism through the connecting part, the limiting mechanism and the connecting mechanism are integrally designed in use, when the screw rod is connected with the connecting hole on the connecting mechanism through a guide hole on the limiting mechanism, a first bottom plate on the limiting mechanism can be clamped to the outer bottom of C-shaped steel, the downward pulling force of the connecting part to the connecting mechanism is used for counteracting the upward pushing force of the screw rod to the connecting mechanism, so that the screw rod can be conveniently connected with the connecting mechanism, and meanwhile, the screw rod can freely slide back and forth in the C-shaped steel to conveniently adjust the position, the defect of blocking caused by contact with the C-shaped top is avoided, and the traditional spring nut is replaced.

title_en: Linear guide rail
abstract_en: The application discloses linear guide, linear guide include slide rail, slider and dust keeper, and the slide rail extends along first direction, and slider movable mounting is in the slide rail, along first direction, and the slider includes relative first end cover and the second end cover that sets up, and dust keeper includes first dust keeper and the second dust keeper of being connected with first end cover. Along the second direction, the first dustproof piece is in flexible contact with one side of the sliding rail, and the second direction is perpendicular to the first direction. Along the second direction, the second dustproof piece is in flexible contact with one side of the sliding rail, which is away from the first dustproof piece. Along the second direction, the connection position with first end cover can be adjusted to at least one of first dust keeper and second dust keeper to adjust first dust keeper and second dust keeper in the ascending distance of second, thereby can reduce the risk that leads to dustproof effect to descend because first dust keeper and second dust keeper wearing and tearing, can also let first dust keeper and second dust keeper be applicable to not unidimensional slider.

title_en: Mechanism for converting external kinetic energy into rotary mechanical energy
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mechanism for converting external kinetic energy into rotary mechanical energy, wherein a first unidirectional bearing and a second unidirectional bearing are fixedly arranged on a first gear and a second gear with the same tooth number modulus and are arranged on the same output shaft in the same rotation direction; the first gear and the second gear act through the first transition gear and the second transition gear, so that the second gear always rotates in the opposite direction to the first gear but at the same angular speed, and when the input part drives the first gear to rotate in any direction, the output shaft always keeps the same rotation acting state, bidirectional acting is realized, and the energy conversion efficiency is improved. The unidirectional bearing is used for replacing the traditional ratchet and pawl mechanism and is matched with the gear transmission structure to operate, so that swing and vibration energy with smaller amplitude can be collected and captured. The mechanism has simple structure and less parts, reduces the failure rate of equipment during operation, and ensures that the installation and maintenance are faster and simpler.

title_en: Trolley for repairing pipeline
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of pipeline internal repair and discloses a trolley for pipeline internal repair. The hydraulic cylinder comprises a connecting rod, a connecting block, a bottom plate, a vertical rod, a connecting cross rod, an output machine, a repairing liquid mixing box, holes, glass fiber cloth, rollers, a motor and a rotating rod, wherein the outer surface of the right side of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a circular plate, the outer surface of the right side of the circular plate is fixedly connected with two supporting rods, the supporting rods are connected with two groups of connecting sliding blocks in a sliding manner, the two groups of connecting sliding blocks are connected with the opposite inner walls of the supporting rods, one end of each connecting sliding block, which is far away from the circular plate, is connected with a circular fixing plate in a sliding manner, the outer surface of the left side of the circular fixing plate is fixedly connected with a connecting rod II, the outer surface of the right side of the circular plate is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, the inner end of the fixing frame, which is close to the circular plate, is fixedly connected with a second hydraulic cylinder, and the output end of the second hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with the outer surface of the left side of the connecting rod II; the pipeline can be repaired for many times by the cooperation of the repair trolley with the structure, so that repair time and manual output are reduced.

title_en: Variable frequency control cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of damping mechanisms of control cabinets and discloses a variable frequency control cabinet, which comprises a control cabinet and a foundation, wherein a damping device is fixedly arranged at the top of the foundation, the damping device comprises a fixing bolt, a fixing nut, a damping spring and a rubber pad, a resonance elimination device is fixedly arranged between the control cabinet and the foundation, the variable frequency control cabinet can be used for inserting the control cabinet on the fixing bolt by placing the damping spring on the fixing bolt, placing the rubber pad on the fixing bolt and fixing the control cabinet by using the fixing nut, when a tiny earthquake happens, the vibration wave from top to bottom can be absorbed by the damping spring, the vibration wave from front, back, left and right can be counteracted by the resonance elimination device, the vibration wave can drive a second connecting block to move, the second connecting block drives a piston rod and a piston plate to move through a piston cylinder, and the piston plate can further counteract the vibration amplitude by repeatedly compressing and extruding movements in the piston cylinder.

title_en: Compact universal joint with mutually opposite ball tracks
abstract_en: A compact universal joint with mutually opposite ball tracks. Mainly solves the problem that the ball channel of the shell of the current universal joint is easy to deviate after being shortened. The method is characterized in that: be equipped with on the star cover with spin rolling fit's first lane (21), shells inner wall be equipped with spin rolling fit's second lane (12), first lane includes first osculum end (211) and first osculum end (212), the second lane includes second osculum end and second osculum end, first osculum end with the second osculum end sets up relatively, first osculum end with second osculum end sets up relatively, first osculum end and second osculum end are used for spacing the spin. The utility model provides a compact universal joint with mutually opposite ball tracks, the ball tracks between the star cover and the shell are mutually opposite ball tracks, the limit function can be achieved on the steel balls, and meanwhile, the universal joint can be more stable in the swing angle.

title_en: Server protection equipment convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses server protection equipment convenient to install, which relates to the technical field of servers and comprises an installation base and a server body, wherein a connecting component is arranged in the installation base in a penetrating manner, the server body is fixedly arranged at the top end of the connecting component, the connecting component is arranged at four corners of the bottom of the server body, a buffer component is arranged at the four corners of the installation base in a penetrating manner, a protection component is fixedly arranged at the top end of the buffer component, and the protection component is used for protecting the server body. According to the utility model, the protection component is matched with the buffer component, so that the device has a certain buffer effect when being subjected to external force, the bolt slides in the support sleeve when being subjected to force, and the spring is compressed, so that the protection shell descends, and after the protection shell is contacted with the bottom plate, the protection shell can be used for secondary protection, so that the damage of the internal server body caused by the external force is avoided, and the device has a good protection effect.

title_en: Washing piece pelleter
abstract_en: The application discloses washing piece pelleter, including two at least fixed bolster and film-making subassembly, a plurality of fixed bolster parallel arrangement, film-making subassembly is installed on the fixed bolster and is rotated with the fixed bolster and be connected, and the film-making subassembly includes the portal frame, and the portal frame is installed on the fixed bolster, and the film-making subassembly still includes knurling piece and lower roll, and the knurling piece rotates with the portal frame to be connected, and the lower roll rotates with the fixed bolster to be connected, is provided with the regulating part of adjusting knurling piece and lower roll interval on the portal frame. Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the fixed bolster is as main bearing structure, and the film-making subassembly is used for forming into the laundry piece with the raw materials extrusion, and embossing template and laundry piece butt just are along with rolling together, will form decorative pattern on the laundry piece, adjusts the interval between embossing piece and the lower roll through the regulating part to realize the function of embossing to the laundry piece of different thickness.

title_en: Multi-mode-adjusting pressure regulating valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-mode regulating pressure regulating valve, which comprises an upper shell, a valve, a lower shell and a diaphragm, wherein the lower shell comprises a shell body, a pressure cavity is arranged in the shell body, the valve is arranged in the center of the interior of the pressure cavity, a sealing rubber ring is arranged between the lower end of the valve and the bottom of the pressure cavity, one side of the shell body is provided with a liquid inlet column communicated with the pressure cavity, the lower end of the pressure cavity is provided with a liquid outlet column communicated with a central through hole of the valve, the upper end of the shell body is connected with the upper shell in a threaded connection mode, a gasket is arranged between the upper shell and the upper end of the pressure cavity, the lower surface of the gasket is provided with the diaphragm attached to the upper surface of the valve, one side of the upper surface of the upper shell is provided with an air charging column, and the inner top surface of the upper shell is provided with a spring regulating seat.

title_en: Filling station and hydrogen filling system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a filling station and a hydrogen filling system. The hydrogen filling system comprises a connecting pipeline, at least two compressors, a sequence control panel, at least two hydrogen storage bottle groups, a plurality of hydrogenation columns, a plurality of flow detection devices and a controller, wherein the compressors are arranged at the downstream of the connecting pipeline in parallel. The connecting pipeline is used for being connected with the hydrogen supply device; the sequence control panel is arranged at the downstream of the compressor; at least two hydrogen storage bottle groups are connected in parallel to the sequence control panel to receive, store and provide hydrogen; the hydrogenation columns are arranged in parallel at the downstream of the sequence control disc and used for providing hydrogen outwards; each hydrogenation column is connected with all compressors at the same time; the flow detection devices are arranged at the hydrogenation columns in a one-to-one correspondence manner; each flow detection device is used for detecting the real-time flow value of the hydrogen provided by the corresponding hydrogenation column outwards; the controller is electrically connected with the flow detection device and the sequence control panel.

title_en: Retaining wall
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a retaining wall, which comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is fixedly connected with a retaining wall body, the outer surface of the retaining wall body is fixedly connected with a first layer of fixing plate, the outer surface of the first layer of fixing plate is fixedly connected with a second layer of fixing plate, and the outer surface of the second layer of fixing plate is fixedly connected with an isolation layer. According to the utility model, the baffle is connected to the upper surface of the base in a sliding manner, when the baffle is impacted, the baffle slides on the inner side of the chute through the sliding block, so that the baffle slides on the upper surface of the base, the sliding plate slides on the inner side of the inner chute, a retaining wall has a certain buffering effect, and when the impact is finished, the baffle and the sliding plate are restored to the original positions under the action of the spring and the inner spring, so that pedestrians and nearby buildings can be continuously protected.

title_en: Water paint processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water-based paint treatment device, which comprises a carrier plate, wherein a round rod is arranged in the middle of the lower surface of the carrier plate, a plurality of magnet strips for adsorbing iron powder are arranged on the outer surface of the round rod at equal intervals in an annular shape, a supporting seat is arranged on the lower side of the carrier plate, a connecting seat is fixedly connected on the lower side of the supporting seat, a first through hole is formed in one surface of the connecting seat facing the supporting seat, a second through hole overlapped with the first through hole is formed in the supporting seat, a plurality of threaded blind holes are formed in one surface of the supporting seat facing the carrier plate at equal intervals in an annular shape, a plurality of round holes matched with the threaded blind holes are formed in the carrier plate, and connecting bolts in threaded connection with the threaded blind holes are arranged in the round holes. The bolt for fixing the iron powder adsorption device is not in direct contact with the water-based paint production equipment, and replacement cost is reduced.

title_en: Suspension aluminum pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an aluminum pipe of a suspension system, which comprises an aluminum pipe body and connecting sleeves fixedly arranged at two ends of the aluminum pipe body, wherein the middle part of the aluminum pipe body is provided with a reinforcement, the reinforcement comprises connecting panels symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the circumferential side wall of the aluminum pipe body and connecting columns fixedly arranged between the two connecting panels, a connecting ring is fixedly arranged in the middle part of the aluminum pipe body, buffer units are arranged between the two connecting columns and the connecting ring, the aluminum pipe body is connected with other parts of an automobile through the connecting sleeves at two ends, the aluminum pipe body is reinforced through the two connecting panels and the connecting columns between the two connecting panels, and when the aluminum pipe body and the connecting panels vibrate to deform, the vibration of the aluminum pipe body can be reduced through the arrangement of the buffer units. The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum tubes of suspension systems. The aluminum pipe has the advantages of improving the strength of the aluminum pipe body, well reducing vibration and prolonging the service life of the aluminum pipe.

title_en: Anti-blocking valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of valves, in particular to an anti-blocking valve, which solves the problem that a structure capable of replacing a filter screen without disassembling the valve is lacking in the prior art when the filter screen is cleaned or replaced. The utility model provides an anti-blocking valve, includes the valve body and sets up the connector of section about the valve body, fixedly connected with ends the position ring in the connector, fixedly connected with three arc in the connector, and is three be equipped with the installing frame through sealing member between the arc, be equipped with first filter screen in the installing frame, be equipped with lifting unit and the drive unit that is used for taking out the installing frame on the connector. According to the utility model, the first filter screen can be taken out without dismantling the valve, so that the first filter screen can be dismantled and cleaned.

title_en: Portable skin management instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable skin management instrument which comprises a shell and a base, wherein a carrying mechanism is arranged on one side of the base and comprises a connecting block, a roller, a rotating shaft, an inclined plate, a fixing clamp and an anti-skid sleeve. According to the utility model, through the relation among the connecting blocks, the rollers, the rotating shafts, the inclined plates, the fixing clamps and the anti-slip sleeves, when the skin management instrument is required to be used for external customers, the skin management instrument is required to be carried out, so that the user rotates the rotating shafts and drives the two rollers to rotate, then drives the two inclined plates to semi-circle, then drives the fixing clamps to semi-circle, simultaneously drives the anti-slip sleeves to rotate, finally, when the fixing clamps rotate to ninety degrees, the user stops rotating the rotating shafts, then holds the anti-slip sleeves, pulls the anti-slip sleeves, drives the fixing clamps to move upwards, and finally drives the skin management instrument to move upwards, thereby being convenient for carrying the skin management instrument.

title_en: Control arm device and shaft sleeve assembly of double-A control arm suspension system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a control arm device and a shaft sleeve component of a double A control arm suspension system, wherein the shaft sleeve component comprises a bushing provided with a first perforation and an adjusting shaft which can be rotationally clamped in the first perforation by external force and is provided with a second perforation, the central axis of the second perforation deviates from the central axis of the first perforation in parallel, the control arm device comprises a control arm and two shaft sleeve components, the control arm comprises a front end part for installing a joint and two rear end parts, the rear end parts are respectively provided with a mounting hole, the mounting holes are coaxially corresponding, and the bushings of the shaft sleeve component are respectively arranged in the mounting holes of the control arm in a tight fit manner. The shaft sleeve assembly and the control arm device can be applied to an upper control arm of a double A control arm suspension system, can adjust the camber angle of a wheel, and have good structural strength.

title_en: Pressure-adjustable zero-leakage direct-discharge type hydraulic safety valve
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of airplane hydraulic transmission, and discloses a pressure-adjustable zero-leakage direct-discharge hydraulic safety valve, which comprises a shell, a valve core, a spring and a supporting seat, wherein the valve core is arranged on the shell; the valve core upwards seals an inner cavity of the upper end communicated with the shell through the elasticity of a spring arranged at the bottom of the valve core, wherein the lower end of the valve core is arranged on a supporting seat, the lower part of the supporting seat is in contact with the spring, and the lower end of the spring is fixed relative to the shell; according to the utility model, the internal leakage of the hydraulic oil of the existing safety valve is obviously reduced through the internal sealing structure formed by the contact of the sealing ring and the metal conical surface; the utility model has the function of adjusting the opening pressure of the safety valve through the adjusting rod, thereby saving the design cost; the utility model has simple principle, less parts, easy realization, small external shape and compact internal structure, and has wide application prospect in the aircraft hydraulic system with high power-to-weight ratio.

title_en: Double-hole hanging belt bolt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mask bolts, and particularly discloses a double-hole hanging belt bolt, which comprises the following components: the bolt housing is of a hollow structure, one end of the bolt housing is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the connecting plate is arc-shaped, and both ends of the connecting plate are provided with connecting slotted holes; one end of the X-shaped driving frame is fixedly connected with a sliding block, and the sliding block penetrates through the sliding groove and extends to the outer side of the connecting plate; a torsion spring fixedly connected with the bolt housing is arranged at the corner of the clamping assembly; the beneficial effects are as follows: through the curved connecting plate of tail end fixedly connected with at the bolt shell, the connection slotted hole has all been seted up at the both ends of connecting plate, and the sliding block stretches out the inner chamber of sliding tray, and sliding handle is located the connecting plate outside, can increase the joint strength between bolt shell and the bandage through setting up two connection slotted holes on the connecting plate symmetry, and can not influence the normal use of bolt shell and self intensity.

title_en: Wisdom guide to navigation card
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent navigation card, which comprises a base, wherein the base is of a hollow structure, a vertical card is arranged on the base, a display screen for displaying navigation information is arranged on the vertical card, and the intelligent navigation card further comprises: the air outlet plate is provided with air outlets, and two air outlet plates are respectively arranged at two sides of the display screen; the seat is movably arranged on the base; the air tank, the air tank sets up in the base, and two the air outlet board all passes through pipe connection with the air tank, the air storage subassembly sets up in the base and is connected with the seat transmission, and this wisdom guide sign through being provided with the seat on the base, not only can provide the place of rest for the visitor, also can order about the seat drive air storage subassembly to aerify in the air tank when the visitor is seated, when the air tank internal pressure is big enough, the gas in the air tank is followed air outlet blowout, and then blows away the dust on the display screen, keeps showing the clean that can cut open.

title_en: Novel oil recovery water injection metering device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field related to oil extraction and discloses a novel oil extraction water injection metering device which comprises a water injection cylinder, wherein an active carbon cylinder is fixedly connected inside the water injection cylinder, a water inlet tank is formed in one side of the water injection cylinder, a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected inside the water inlet tank, a water outlet tank is formed in one side of the surface of the water injection cylinder, a water outlet pipe is fixedly connected inside the water outlet tank, and a rotating tank is formed in the surface of the water outlet pipe. This novel oil recovery water injection metering device through the setting of inlet tube, active carbon section of thick bamboo, outlet pipe, play water valve and filter unit, when personnel use, in injecting active carbon section of thick bamboo with water through the inlet tube, then active carbon section of thick bamboo adsorbs the foreign matter in the water, and then opens out water valve, and water flows into the filter tube through the outlet pipe, when passing the filter screen, the filter screen filters water to the convenience personnel has been reached and has filtered the purpose of cleaing away the foreign matter to water.

title_en: Wind power gear box lubricating system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wind power generation equipment, and discloses a lubrication system of a wind power gear box. The wind power gear box lubrication system comprises a driving gear and at least two groups of lubrication components, wherein the driving gear is arranged on a shaft system of a gear box, the lubrication components comprise a mechanical pump, a driven gear, an oil suction pipe and an oil outlet pipe, the mechanical pump is arranged on the gear box, the driven gear is arranged on a pump shaft of the mechanical pump and meshed with the driving gear, an oil inlet of the mechanical pump is connected with an oil tank through the oil suction pipe, and an oil outlet of the mechanical pump is connected with an oil filling hole of the gear box through the oil outlet pipe. The wind power gear box lubrication system is provided with at least two groups of lubrication components, so that the flow of lubricating oil in the idle rotation state of the wind turbine is increased, and the daily lubrication requirement of the wind turbine with large installed capacity is met; in addition, each group of lubrication assemblies are mutually independent, and under the condition that one group of lubrication assemblies fails, other lubrication assemblies can still lubricate the gear box, so that the reliability and the practicability of the system are improved.

title_en: Multifunctional self-service terminal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioner control, in particular to a multifunctional self-service terminal, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the front side of the mounting plate is movably connected with an air conditioner terminal, the front side of the air conditioner terminal is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, the bottom of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, and the outer side of the rotating rod is rotatably connected with a protection plate. The utility model has the advantages that: through setting up installing frame and guard plate in the outside of air conditioner terminal machine, make the device in non-service condition, can cover it through the guard plate, also can hide the terminal machine when protecting the air conditioner terminal machine and reduce the improvement wall aesthetic measure, when needs use the air conditioner terminal machine to control the air conditioner, then rotate the guard plate make it naked can, through setting up the guard plate of taking the opening, when needs often use the air conditioner terminal machine, can accomplish the guard plate through the opening and demolish, avoid the guard plate to hinder the condition of air conditioner terminal machine normal use.

title_en: Antitheft bolt for connecting electric iron tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-theft bolt for connecting an electric iron tower, which comprises a bolt piece for connecting angle steel of the electric iron tower, wherein the bolt piece comprises a bolt column and a bolt head, a rice-shaped groove is formed in the bolt head along the vertical direction, a positioning groove is formed in the lower end of the bolt head, an anti-theft shell is arranged on the outer side of the bolt head, an elastic buckle extending towards the positioning groove is arranged at the lower end of the anti-theft shell and is connected in the positioning groove in an elastic buckle fit manner, an opening is formed in the middle of the anti-theft shell, a plurality of baffle plates are arranged in the opening along the vertical direction, and the anti-theft shell is arranged on the bolt head and is used for blocking part of the rice-shaped groove through the baffle plates, so that a locking groove for screwing the bolt is formed in the left area of the rice-shaped groove. Through the mode, the anti-theft bolt for connecting the electric power iron tower improves the anti-theft effect of the bolt, and an external person is difficult to normally disassemble through a conventional tool, but the anti-theft bolt can be disassembled and maintained through a special tool for a worker, has good anti-theft effect, and is convenient for later maintenance.

title_en: Gas self-closing valve controlled by thermosensitive spring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas self-closing valve controlled by a thermosensitive spring, which comprises a valve casing, wherein one end of the valve casing is provided with a gas outlet pipe, the outer end of the gas outlet pipe is connected with a gas outlet connecting seat, the other end of the valve casing is provided with a gas inlet pipe, a thermosensitive overcurrent device component is arranged between the gas inlet pipe and the valve casing, and when the temperature exceeds the preset temperature, the thermosensitive overcurrent device component can cut off a gas outlet pipe channel. The thermal-sensitive overcurrent device component comprises a tube body, a cut-off valve, a thermal-sensitive fusing spring front baffle plate and a thermal-sensitive fusing spring rear baffle plate; the air outlet end of the pipe body is provided with a front baffle, the center of the front baffle is provided with an air outlet, a cut-off valve, a thermal fusing spring and a rear baffle are sequentially arranged in the pipe body from the air outlet end to the air inlet end, and the center of the rear baffle is provided with an air inlet; the one end that the trip valve is close to the inside of valve casing is provided with the guide bar. Compared with the prior art, the technical scheme of the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, safety and reliability, and unconditionally cuts off the gas supply after the fire disaster occurs.

title_en: Coupler with stable installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coupler with stable installation, which belongs to the technical field of couplers and comprises a connecting shaft frame and two connecting shafts, wherein a first notch is formed in the outer surface of the connecting shaft frame, second notches are formed in the two sides of the connecting shaft frame, a connecting plate is fixed in the connecting plate, a square through hole is formed in the top end of the connecting plate, the square through hole is abutted with the first notch, two sliding notches are formed in the two sides of the square through hole, and two clamping grooves are formed in the side surfaces of one end of each connecting shaft; a bearing is fixed in the connecting shaft frame, a first screw rod is connected to the bearing, a second screw rod opposite to the first screw rod in thread is fixed at the other end of the first screw rod through a separation block, screw pipes are connected to the first screw rod and the second screw rod in thread, two sliding rods opposite in position are fixed on the side surfaces of the screw pipes, the sliding rods are in sliding connection with the sliding groove opening, and a clamping block positioned in the clamping groove is fixed at the inner side of the other end of the sliding rod; the coupling is stable in fixing of the two connecting shafts, and the falling-off condition can not occur.

title_en: Liquid cooling board inserts assembly, battery package and new energy automobile soon
abstract_en: The utility model provides a liquid cooling plate quick-plugging assembly which is used for connecting a plurality of liquid cooling plates, wherein the liquid cooling plates comprise a plurality of male connectors and comprise pipelines, first quick-plugging connectors, second quick-plugging connectors, first inner cores and second inner cores; the first inner core and the second inner core comprise a plurality of clamping grooves, the first quick connector and the second quick connector comprise a plurality of barbs, and the plurality of clamping grooves are connected with the plurality of barbs in a matched mode to connect the first inner core with the first quick connector and connect the second inner core with the second quick connector; the shape and the number of the plurality of clamping grooves are matched with the plurality of barbs.

title_en: U-shaped needle roller retainer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of guide rail retainers, and particularly relates to a U-shaped needle roller retainer. A U-shaped needle roller retainer comprises a U-shaped retaining frame and a plurality of needle rollers with cylindrical structures; the three sides of the holding frame are respectively provided with a plurality of needle roller grooves for installing needle rollers, and the needle roller grooves are distributed at equal intervals; the two sides of the needle roller groove are respectively provided with a clamping block, and the needle roller can be rotatably arranged and is clamped in the needle roller groove by the clamping blocks; each retention frame side includes a first planar surface and an inverted trapezoidal concave surface contiguous with the first planar surface, and a second planar surface contiguous with the inverted trapezoidal concave surface. The U-shaped needle roller retainer is formed by arranging three retaining frame side surfaces provided with the needle rollers in a U-shaped structure, and compared with the guide rail retainer in the prior art, the U-shaped needle roller retainer is more in needle roller arrangement and larger in retainer area, so that the guide rail is smoother and more stable in operation, and the problem of clamping is not easy to occur.

title_en: Anti-loose and leakage-proof packing sealing box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a locking leakage-proof packing seal box, which relates to the technical field of packing seal devices and comprises a shaft and a packing box body sleeved on the shaft, wherein the packing box body comprises a first box body, a second box body and a third box body which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, a stop ring is formed on the inner side of the bottom end of the first box body, and a first packing group is filled in a first ring cavity formed among the top surface of the stop ring, the inner wall of the first box body and the outer wall of the shaft; the top surface of the first filler group is provided with a compression ring; a second packing group is filled in a second annular cavity formed among the top surface of the compression ring, the inner wall of the second box body and the outer wall of the shaft; the periphery of the connecting bolt between the first box body and the second box body is sleeved with a first spring, and the periphery of the connecting bolt between the second box body and the third box body is sleeved with a second spring. The utility model can effectively prevent the connecting bolts between the box bodies from loosening, ensure the compression of the sealing filler and effectively prevent the leakage phenomenon of the lubricant.

title_en: Concentrated sedimentation device for rice processing dust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dust centralized sedimentation, and discloses a rice processing dust centralized sedimentation device, wherein an exhaust pipe is arranged at the top of a box body, a fan is arranged in the exhaust pipe, a fixed block is fixedly connected in the box body, the other end of the exhaust pipe penetrates through the top of the box body and the top and the bottom of the fixed block and extends into the box body, a filter plate is clamped in the box body, one side of the filter plate is provided with a filter hole penetrating through the filter plate, and a clamping groove matched with the filter plate is formed in the box body.

title_en: Rubber buffer cushion of air compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rubber buffer pad of an air compressor, which comprises a rubber ring main body, wherein a rib ring is arranged on the inner ring wall surface of the rubber ring main body; when the rubber cushion pad is used, the rib ring 2 is in interference fit with the screw rod, and the interference fit mode can avoid the separation of the rib ring 2 and the screw rod; because interference fit between muscle circle 2 and the screw rod, so the screw rod can prop up the internal diameter of rubber circle main part 1 at the during operation for the external diameter of rubber circle main part 1 grow thereupon, and rubber circle main part 1 outer lane is interference fit with the compressor hole also, consequently, screw rod, rubber blotter and compressor three are interference fit each other, thereby can effectively avoid the screw rod to drop and rock, reduce the noise simultaneously, this blotter still has simple structure under the prerequisite that satisfies above-mentioned function, powerful, low in manufacturing cost, simple and easy advantage of installation.

title_en: Never-loosening bolt
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a never-loosening bolt, and belongs to the technical field of fasteners. The never-loosening bolt comprises: the screw is pre-buried in the first workpiece and kept fixed, and passes through a through hole on the second workpiece; the annular disc is sleeved on the screw, and the upper surface of the annular disc is provided with an annular groove; the annular elastic ring is arranged in the annular groove, one end of the annular elastic ring is fixed on the inner wall of the annular groove, the other end of the annular elastic ring is fixedly provided with a stop block, and the back surface of the stop block is provided with a first slope; the nut threaded connection the screw, and the nut is located the top of annular bullet circle, the lower surface of nut is provided with around a plurality of pawl of screw circumference setting, the back of each pawl is equipped with the second slope. The never-loosening bolt has the advantages of easy tightening, easy dismounting, no damage to threads, reusability, simple processing, low cost and never loosening by using a mechanical structure.

title_en: Compressed air unit and compressed air system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compressed air unit and a compressed air system, and relates to the technical field of compressed air systems. A compressed air unit comprising: the air compressor is connected with the air treatment equipment through a first connecting pipe; the air treatment equipment is connected with the air storage tank through a second connecting pipe; the air storage tank is connected with the air utilization area through a third connecting pipe; the air compressor, the air treatment equipment and the air storage tank are arranged at intervals, and the air treatment equipment is positioned between the air compressor and the air storage tank; compressed air generated by the air compressor sequentially passes through the air treatment equipment and the air storage tank and is conveyed to the air utilization area. Compressed air is conveyed to the gas utilization area through the first connecting pipe, the second connecting pipe and the third connecting pipe, bending of the gas pipeline is reduced, setting of an elbow or a joint is reduced, flow resistance of gas in the pipeline is reduced, and energy utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Temperature controller installing support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temperature controller mounting bracket which comprises a cover body, wherein a temperature controller body is fixed in the cover body, one side of the cover body is provided with a back plate, a rotating seat is fixed on the back plate, a rotating disc is arranged in the rotating seat in a rotating mode, a mounting plate is fixed on the rotating disc, a mounting hole is formed in the mounting plate, and a wire arrangement hole is formed in the cover body. According to the utility model, the angle adjustment can be carried out according to the actual position through the rotatable mounting plates, the upper mounting plate and the lower mounting plate are positioned at two points, the mounting stability of the temperature controller body is ensured, the temperature controller body can be electrified and connected with redundant wires through the winding posts to be wound and stored, and the conditions of line dragging and line disorder are avoided.

title_en: Lock nut and test assembly for miniature bearing retainer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of shaft assembly, in particular to a test assembly for a lock nut and a miniature bearing retainer. The miniature test assembly for the bearing retainer comprises a lock nut and an adapter, wherein the lock nut comprises a nut base body, one axial end of the nut base body is provided with a blind hole, the other axial end of the nut base body is provided with a straight slot, the maximum radial dimension of the nut base body is between the inner ring dimension of a pressed bearing and the inner diameter dimension of the bearing retainer, and the adapter is provided with a flat insertion end and a spanner matching end. The nut base body is small in size, the straight groove is formed in the nut base body, shielding of the outer side of the nut base body to the retainer is avoided while strength of the nut base body is guaranteed, meanwhile, the maximum radial size of the nut base body is between the size of the inner ring of the pressed bearing and the inner diameter of the bearing retainer, the lock nut can press the inner ring of the bearing and expose the upper end of the bearing retainer, and obstacle to running track testing of the bearing retainer is avoided.

title_en: Novel prevent blockking up slip casting pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel anti-blocking grouting pipe, which comprises an A-type pipe and a B-type pipe; the pipe body is provided with an anchoring claw and a plurality of grouting holes; the tail part of the B-shaped pipe head is provided with an internal thread; when the anti-blocking grouting pipe is installed, the A-type pipe is connected with the B-type pipe, the B-type pipe is connected with the B-type pipe, and the B-type pipe is connected with the B-type pipe. The method is characterized in that: the pipe body of the A-type pipe is provided with a plurality of grouting holes, so that a single grouting hole can be prevented from being blocked by rock debris during installation, the outflow of slurry can be quickened during grouting, and the grouting time is shortened; the A-shaped pipe body is provided with an anchoring claw which can prevent the anchoring claw from falling off from a drilled hole. The grouting pipe plug is ingenious in design, convenient to carry, convenient to operate, safe and practical, and well solves the problem of grouting pipe plug.

title_en: Corrugated roller shaft head bearing structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a corrugated roller shaft head bearing structure, which comprises a corrugated roller main body, wherein a main shaft is arranged at the side end of the corrugated roller main body, a spherical shaft is fixedly arranged on the main shaft, a spherical sleeve is sleeved outside the spherical shaft, an outer shaft sleeve is arranged outside the spherical sleeve, and a sliding piece is arranged between the outer shaft sleeve and the spherical sleeve; compared with the prior art, the corrugated roller has a simple structure, the spherical shaft and the spherical sleeve can ensure that the corrugated roller automatically tilts for a certain angle when being subjected to offset deformation, and meanwhile, the outer shaft sleeve and the spherical sleeve can be offset on the axis under the cooperation of the sliding piece and the sliding groove, so that the abrasion of the corrugated roller during rotation is reduced, and the service life of the whole corrugated roller is prolonged.

title_en: Bracket assembly of camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bracket component of a camera, which comprises a base, wherein a mounting groove is formed in the center of the base, a first rotary driving piece is arranged in the center of the top end of the base, a screw rod is rotatably arranged at the output end of the first rotary driving piece, the screw rod is rotatably arranged in the mounting groove, a threaded sleeve is movably arranged outside the screw rod, a movable mounting plate is arranged on one side of the threaded sleeve, and sliding blocks are symmetrically arranged at one end of the movable mounting plate. According to the utility model, the first rotary driving piece is fixed at the top end of the base, and then the screw rod is rotatably arranged at the output end of the first rotary driving piece, so that the movable mounting plate is driven to longitudinally move by the threaded sleeve when the first rotary driving piece drives the screw rod to rotate, the height of the bracket component of the camera can be longitudinally adjusted, the problem that the height of the bracket component of the camera cannot be adjusted is solved, the applicability of the bracket component of the camera is stronger, and the use is more convenient.

title_en: Anti-seepage device
abstract_en: The application discloses an anti-seepage device. The anti-seepage device comprises a first pipeline, a second pipeline and ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber strips; a first flange piece is arranged on one side of the first pipeline, which is close to the second pipeline; a second flange piece is arranged on one side, close to the first pipeline, of the second pipeline; the ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber strip is arranged between the first flange piece and the second flange piece and used for preventing leakage at the joint of the first pipeline and the second pipeline. This application is through setting up the ethylene propylene diene monomer strip between first pipeline and second pipeline for the leakage problem can not appear in the junction of first pipeline and second pipeline.

title_en: Gas leakage exploration early warning device based on catalytic combustion sensor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of early warning devices, in particular to a gas leakage exploration early warning device based on a catalytic combustion sensor, which comprises: the surface of the gas early warning device is provided with a fixing frame, an oil-proof frame is arranged in the fixing frame, a supporting frame is arranged on the side face of the gas early warning device, and a clamping plate and a limiting rod are arranged on the side face of the baffle plate; the beneficial effects are as follows: the utility model provides a gas leakage surveys and uses precaution device based on catalytic combustion sensor, when needs gas precaution device is taken off from the wall in kitchen, at first pulling baffle, make the cardboard that the baffle side set up lose the fixed action to the stop collar, then just can take out the stop collar, just so can take out gas precaution device from the bracing piece, the gas precaution device is fixed on the wall in kitchen mainly utilizing multiunit bolt when having avoided traditional gas precaution device to the gas precaution device is fixed on the wall in kitchen when having avoided the installation like this, thereby need use the tool to rotate multiunit bolt and just can take out gas precaution device when leading to need overhauling gas precaution device at every turn, it is comparatively inconvenient.

title_en: Prefabricated sled dress supply station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prefabricated skid-mounted supply station, wherein a business room and a bottle room which are mutually independent are arranged in a supply station body; the wall surface of the supply station body at the back side of the bottle chamber is provided with an explosion-proof shutter and an explosion-proof exhaust fan, the wall surface of the supply station body at the front side of the bottle chamber is provided with a first door body, and the wall surface of the supply station body at the front side of the business chamber is provided with a second door body. The device can be integrally prefabricated, integrally hoisted and rapidly installed on site; the integrated assembly type building which is fireproof and can be prefabricated integrally is built by adopting a lightweight steel structure, a lightweight composite wall body and a fireproof coating technology to serve as a bottled gas supply station, so that the requirements of standard, convenient and mobile installation and setting requirements and safe operation of the bottled gas supply station of a residential community are met, and the problem of insufficient bottled gas supply facilities is solved.

title_en: Hydraulic control system of engine mounting vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hydraulic control system of an engine mounting vehicle, which comprises an oil storage mechanism, an electric conveying mechanism, an electric switching mechanism, a manual conveying mechanism, a manual switching mechanism and a lifting executing mechanism, wherein the electric conveying mechanism and the electric switching mechanism are arranged in the hydraulic control system, hydraulic oil is conveyed in an electric mode and the operation state of the hydraulic oil is switched, a lifting oil cylinder is driven to lift, the manual conveying mechanism and the manual switching mechanism are also arranged, hydraulic oil is conveyed in a manual mode and the operation state of the hydraulic oil is switched, and the lifting oil cylinder is driven to lift, so that the whole hydraulic control system has an electric control mode and a manual control mode, the operation is more flexible and convenient, the control mode can be selected according to actual conditions, and the application range of the hydraulic control system is further expanded.

title_en: Locking structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of locking structures, which comprises a female connector and a male connector, wherein a locking component is arranged between the female connector and the male connector, the locking component is used for fixing the female connector and the male connector when in use, a concave connecting pipe is arranged in the female connector, a first valve core is arranged in the concave connecting pipe, a notch is formed in the bottom of one end of the female connector, a convex connecting pipe and a second valve core are arranged in the male connector, in the locking structure, a water pipe is connected to the pagoda ends of the female connector and the male connector respectively, then the locking component is pressed, the female connector is abutted to the male connector, the concave connecting pipe is sleeved in the convex connecting pipe, the first valve core is abutted to the second valve core, the first valve core is tightly matched with the second valve core under the action of a first spring, then the locking component is released, and at the moment, the locking component clamps the female connector and the male connector, so that a butt joint channel of the female connector and the male connector is unblocked when in tight fastening is realized, and the effect that the female connector and the male connector are respectively self-closed when disconnected is realized.

title_en: Wall-through pipeline protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall-through pipeline protection device, and relates to the technical field of wall-through pipelines.
