The utility model comprises a protective shell, a limit seat and a protective component, wherein the protective shell comprises a connecting pipe and a connecting sleeve in threaded connection with the connecting pipe, the limit seat is fixedly connected to the outer surface of one end of the connecting pipe away from the connecting sleeve respectively, the protective component is arranged on the inner surface of one end of the connecting pipe away from the connecting sleeve respectively, the protective component comprises a fixed ring, an elastic telescopic piece and a clamping plate, the fixed ring is fixedly connected to the inner surfaces of the connecting pipe and the connecting sleeve respectively, the clamping plate is in an arc-shaped structure and is fixedly connected with the inner surface of the fixed ring through the elastic telescopic piece, and three groups of clamping plates are uniformly arranged along the circumference of the inner surface of the fixed ring. The utility model has simple structure and larger application range, and can avoid the connection of the wall body and the fixing nails, thereby avoiding the secondary damage to the wall body.

title_en: Air gun lifting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wind gun support and lifting device, which aims to solve the problem that a wind gun is required to be supported by hands when a counterweight of an existing engineering machine is installed; the upper arm beam and the lower arm beam are arranged in parallel up and down, and the first end of the upper arm beam and the first end of the lower arm beam are connected with the upright post through a pin shaft; the support is connected with the second ends of the upper arm beam and the lower arm beam through pin shafts, and the upper arm beam, the lower arm beam, the support and the upright post form a parallelogram link mechanism; the first end of the air cylinder is connected with the upright post, and the second end of the air cylinder is connected with one of the upper arm beam and the lower arm beam through a hinge seat; the bracket for fixing the air gun is connected with the support. The air gun lifting device is used for lifting the air gun when the weight bolt is pre-tightened, so that the labor intensity during assembly is reduced, and the labor efficiency is improved.

title_en: Drainage pipe heat insulation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heat-insulating structure of a drainage pipeline, which relates to the field of pipeline technology and comprises heat-insulating cotton sleeved on the outer side of a pipeline body, a fixed half pipe and a mounting half pipe, wherein the fixed half pipe and the mounting half pipe are tightly pressed on one side of the heat-insulating cotton far away from the pipeline body, a fixing device is arranged on one side, close to the fixed half pipe, of the mounting half pipe, and the fixing device is respectively clamped with the fixed half pipe and the mounting half pipe. The utility model has the effect of improving the stability of the connection between the heat-insulating cotton and the drainage pipeline.

title_en: Inner cone space deformation sealing filler structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of packing structures, and particularly discloses a packing structure with an inner cone space deformation seal, which comprises a base arranged on the side wall of a powder storage bin, wherein bosses are arranged on two sides of the base, a channel is arranged between the bosses, a central through pipe for discharging is arranged in the channel, a sealing structure is arranged on the boss and is in contact with the side wall of the central through pipe, a pressing plate for fixing the central through pipe is arranged at the free end of the sealing structure, and a connecting screw is detachably connected between the pressing plate and the base; the sealing structure comprises a supporting ring, a plurality of V-shaped rings and a supporting ring which are sequentially arranged from left to right, and the supporting ring uniformly compress the V-shaped rings.

title_en: Skid base damping device for vertical coating production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a skid base damping device for a vertical coating production line, belonging to the technical field of automobile coating production lines; the utility model is provided with two side beams which are arranged in parallel, a cross beam which is fixedly connected between the two side beams at intervals, and a support which is fixed at two ends of the cross beam, wherein the top end of the support is fixedly connected with a bearing beam which is parallel to the cross beam; the support comprises a fixed column and a movable column, one end of the movable column is connected with the fixed column, the other end of the movable column is connected with the bearing beam, and the end of the fixed column far away from the movable column is fixedly connected with the cross beam through an elastic piece.

title_en: Bellows decompression stop valve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bellows decompression stop valve, which belongs to the technical field of stop valves and comprises a valve body, a valve rod, a valve clack, a valve cover and a valve clack seat, wherein the valve clack seat divides the interior of the valve body into an upper flow passage and a lower flow passage; according to the utility model, the first sealing ring is detachably connected with the valve clack body, and the second sealing ring is detachably connected with the valve clack seat, so that when any sealing ring fails in sealing, only the failed sealing ring can be independently replaced, the use cost is effectively reduced, the first sealing ring and the second sealing ring with different specifications can be matched, the flow quantity of the through holes of the flow passage can be regulated within a certain range, and the practicability is strong.

title_en: Pipe section connecting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipe section connecting structure, which relates to the technical field of pipe section connection and comprises a base, wherein the base is fixedly connected with a slide bar mechanism, a first rotating bar mechanism and a second rotating bar mechanism are arranged on the slide bar mechanism, the first rotating bar mechanism is fixedly connected with a sleeve, a clamping plate mechanism is arranged on the sleeve, and clamping plates are fixedly connected with telescopic pipes.

title_en: Marine pipeline protection device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a marine pipeline protection device, which comprises a pipe body and a locking assembly, wherein the pipe body comprises a first side pipe part and a second side pipe part, the first side pipe part and the second side pipe part are enclosed to form a clamping space for clamping a pipeline welding seam, the locking assembly comprises a locking piece and a rotating piece, the locking piece is arranged on the first side pipe part, the rotating piece is rotationally connected to the second side pipe part, the rotating piece can rotate relative to the second side pipe part, the rotating piece is provided with a containing cavity for containing the locking piece, the locking piece is in threaded connection with the cavity wall of the containing cavity, the rotating piece rotates, the locking piece and the first side pipe part are driven by the rotating piece to be close to the second side pipe part, so that the pipeline welding seam is clamped in the clamping space, and the connecting mode between the first side pipe part and the second side pipe part is simpler and more convenient by arranging the locking piece and the rotating piece, the mounting and dismounting difficulties are reduced, and the working strength is relieved.

title_en: Peeling and flour-milling machine for food processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a peeling and flour milling machine for food processing, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein dampers are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the bottom plate, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the top of the dampers, an organism is fixedly connected to the top of the mounting plate, a feeding hopper is arranged at the top of the organism, a box body is fixedly connected to the left side of the feeding hopper, and a motor is fixedly connected to the bottom of an inner cavity of the box body. According to the peeling and flour milling machine, the problems that the peeling and flour milling machine for food processing in the prior art is not provided with a sealing mechanism, is easy to cause splashing of materials, is not provided with a cushioning structure, is easy to shake due to self vibration, and is poor in stability, so that the peeling and flour milling machine is unfavorable for practical use and low in practicability are solved through the matched use of the bottom plate, the damper, the mounting plate, the machine body, the feeding hopper, the box body, the motor, the screw rod, the threaded sleeve, the supporting rod, the sealing plate, the trapezoidal block, the first spring, the shell, the second spring, the limiting plate, the limiting rod and the extrusion wheel.

title_en: Oil way protection structure of high-frequency breaking hammer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of tunnel construction excavation, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, a pipeline is easy to damage in construction and an internal oil way block is easy to damage in pipeline pulling, and provides a high-frequency breaking hammer oil way protection structure, which comprises a breaking hammer shell; the breaking hammer shell is internally matched with a breaking hammer, an oil pipe window is formed in the bottom surface of the breaking hammer shell, and a first oil pipe interface is formed in the breaking hammer corresponding to the oil pipe window; the bottom surface of the breaking hammer shell is provided with a leading-out hose and a leading-out steel pipe, one end of the leading-out hose is fixedly connected with a first oil pipe interface, the other end of the leading-out hose is detachably connected with one end of the leading-out steel pipe, the other end of the leading-out steel pipe is connected with a second oil pipe interface, and the second oil pipe interface is fixed at the tail end of the breaking hammer shell; the leading-out hose and the leading-out steel pipe are both fixed on the bottom surface of the breaking hammer shell. The utility model has the advantages that the connecting pipe is convenient, the connecting pipe is not easy to scratch to the external environment or equipment, and the damage to the oil way block inside the high-frequency breaking hammer caused by the scratch of the leading-out hose is prevented.

title_en: Triangular support frame with bolt support legs for surveying and mapping
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a triangular support frame with bolt support legs for surveying and mapping, which is characterized in that: the device comprises supporting legs, a supporting plate, a lifting rod and a fixing seat, wherein the lower end of the lifting rod is fixedly connected with the supporting plate, the upper end of the lifting rod is fixedly connected with the fixing seat, and the fixing seat is used for installing and fixing a surveying and mapping instrument; three supporting legs are connected below the supporting plate; the lower ends of the supporting legs are provided with internal threads, screw feet are screwed into the internal threads, and the level of the supporting plate is adjusted by adjusting the screwing length of each screw foot; three bubble levels are arranged on the supporting plate, and each bubble level is positioned between two supporting legs. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the three bubble level gauges are arranged on the supporting plate, so that the level of the supporting plate can be conveniently adjusted, and the level of the surveying instrument arranged on the fixing seat can be adjusted. The support plate level is adjusted by adjusting the screwing length of each screw rod supporting foot in the support leg. The illuminating lamp is convenient for illuminating the bubble level and the screw rod support leg at the place with insufficient light to adjust the level.

title_en: Stand for photography
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photographing stand, which comprises a main column, wherein the lower end of the main column is provided with a moving structure, a fixing sleeve is sleeved on the main column, one side of the fixing sleeve is provided with a threaded hole I, threads are arranged in the threaded hole I to be buckled, connecting blocks are fixedly arranged on two sides of the threaded hole I, one ends of the connecting blocks, far away from the fixing sleeve, of the connecting blocks are fixedly provided with connecting plates, knob buckling is arranged on one side of the connecting plates, a moving block is arranged on the other side of the connecting plates, the upper end of the moving block is provided with an embedded groove, two ends of the inner side of the embedded groove are provided with protruding blocks, a jacking column is arranged in the embedded groove, two ends of the jacking column are provided with grooves corresponding to the protruding blocks, the protruding blocks are clamped in the grooves, a sealing plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the jacking column, and a tray is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end of the sealing plate; the utility model has convenient camera movement and can adjust the movement of the camera up, down, left and right.

title_en: Soil pollution separation structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a soil pollution blocking structure which comprises a box body, wherein a fixed post rod is connected to the right side surface in the box body, a connecting post barrel is rotatably connected to the left side surface of the post rod, the front surface of the box body is connected with a fixed bottom plate, a cutter is arranged on the upper side of the bottom plate, a rectangular strip is connected and fixed to the upper surface of the cutter, a supporting block is connected and fixed to the front surface of the box body, a fixed sliding rod is connected and fixed to the upper surface of the supporting block, a first elastic piece is sleeved on the outer peripheral surface of the sliding rod and connected and fixed to the rectangular strip, a fixed induction switch is connected and fixed to the upper surface of the rectangular strip at a position close to the right, an electromagnet is connected and fixed to the position close to the right side on the post barrel, and a fixed pressing and holding piece is connected and fixed to the upper surface of the post barrel.

title_en: Belt tensioning mechanism and silage machinery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a belt tensioning mechanism and silage machinery, wherein the tensioning mechanism comprises a first supporting plate, and the first supporting plate is connected with a mounting rack in a sliding manner along a first direction; the first locking piece is used for limiting the relative movement of the first supporting plate and the mounting frame; the second supporting plate is parallel to the first supporting plate and is connected with the mounting frame in a sliding manner along the first direction; the second locking piece is used for limiting the relative movement of the second supporting plate and the mounting frame; the main shaft is perpendicular to the first direction, one end of the main shaft is connected with the first supporting plate, and the other end of the main shaft is connected with the second supporting plate; and the tensioning belt wheel is coaxially and rotatably connected to the main shaft. According to the utility model, the angle of the tensioning belt wheel is regulated by changing the positions of the first supporting plate and the second supporting plate, so that the axis of the tensioning belt wheel is parallel to the belt, the tensioning belt wheel is prevented from generating thrust parallel to the belt surface on the belt, and the risk of the problem of belt deviation and groove removal is further reduced.

title_en: Anti-disassembly screw
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of screws, in particular to an anti-disassembly screw, which at least comprises a screw rod, wherein the screw rod cannot directly contact with a rotating point at the top of the screw rod through a protective layer after the screw rod is installed, a rotating protective component is movably connected with the screw rod and is used for driving the rotating protective component to idle on the surface of the screw rod, so that the rotating protective component does not drive the screw rod to rotate in the rotating process, a low-rod protective component is arranged at the bottom of the screw rod, the low-rod protective component enables the screw rod to be tightly pressed with an object through rotating on the surface of the screw rod, and meanwhile, the low-rod protective component is attached to the object, so that the rotating friction force between the low-rod protective component and materials is increased; through rotating the protection component to the screw rod top protective layer to avoid screwdriver contact screw rod top, improve the rotatory degree of difficulty to the screw rod, rotate protection component and screw rod swing joint simultaneously, thereby make when rotating the protection component and rotate not drive the screw rod and rotate.

title_en: Agricultural machinery camshaft power transmission device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an agricultural machinery camshaft power transmission device which comprises a fixed rod, a bearing piece and a shell, wherein the bearing piece comprises two ball bearings and a cylindrical roller bearing, clamping grooves formed in the inner ring of the shell are respectively sleeved outside the bearing piece, the fixed rod is positioned inside the bearing piece, a gasket is arranged between the inner ring of the shell and the bearing piece, and the gasket is positioned inside a limit groove formed in the inner ring of the shell; by arranging the limit groove on the outer shell and limiting the gasket arranged in the shell, the effect that the gasket cannot be separated from the shell along with the swing operation under the action of certain buffering and wear resistance can be realized, and the service life of the gasket is prolonged; meanwhile, compared with the traditional arc-shaped steel clamping plate, the bearing is additionally arranged in the arc-shaped steel clamping plate, so that the inner fixing rod can be better and smoother when rotating, friction force is reduced, and a good protection effect is achieved.

title_en: Object surface crack detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an object surface crack detector, which comprises a rotary tripod head, a tripod bracket and a remote camera, wherein the rotary tripod head and the remote camera are used for being connected with a terminal, the terminal is used for controlling the rotary tripod head to rotate and receiving video or image information transmitted by the remote camera; the rotary tripod head is fixedly arranged on the tripod bracket, and the remote camera is detachably connected with the rotary tripod head through the connecting component; the connecting assembly comprises a sliding block, a base and a stop block, wherein the base is fixedly connected with the rotary cradle head, a limiting sliding groove is formed in the base, the sliding block is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the remote camera and is in sliding fit with the limiting sliding groove, a side groove communicated with the limiting sliding groove is formed in the base, and the stop block is arranged in the side groove in a sliding mode; the stop block is connected with a first locking hand wheel through threads. The utility model can realize the purpose of quick assembly and disassembly in actual use.

title_en: Heat exchange system for vehicle electric drive system, vehicle electric drive system and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heat exchange system for a vehicle electric drive system, which comprises a controller, a heat exchanger, a first three-way valve, a filter, an oil pump, an oil reservoir, a speed reducer and a first motor; the oil storage device, the filter and the oil pump are sequentially connected, the input end of the first three-way valve is connected to the oil pump, the first output end of the first three-way valve can be connected to the first motor and/or the speed reducer and connected to the oil storage device, the second output end of the first three-way valve can be connected to the heat exchanger and then connected to the first motor and/or the speed reducer and connected to the oil storage device, wherein the controller disconnects the second output end of the first three-way valve from the heat exchanger when the temperature of lubricating oil is lower than a preset temperature, and disconnects the first output end of the first three-way valve from the first motor and/or the speed reducer when the temperature of the lubricating oil is higher than the preset temperature.

title_en: Nut
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nut, which comprises a nut body and a threaded hole formed in the nut body, wherein a protective shell is wrapped outside the nut body, the protective shell wraps the periphery of the nut body and one end face of the nut body and extends to the other end face close to the nut body, a through hole is formed in the position, corresponding to the threaded hole, of the protective shell, and a first sealing ring matched with a stud to form a seal is arranged on the outer ring of the through hole. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: the utility model has longer service life and more convenient later dismantling.

title_en: Horizontal transfer case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a horizontal transfer case, which comprises; the first box and second box, the one end integrated into one piece of first box has first end plate, and second box one end integrated into one piece has the second end plate, and the neat stack of second end plate is on first end plate, has all offered the screw hole on first end plate and the second end plate, and the fixed grafting of screw hole has the mounting. The fixing piece comprises a threaded bolt which is fixedly inserted into the threaded hole, and a gasket is sleeved on the threaded bolt. The first box and the second box are all offered flutedly, and first end plate and the equal integrated into one piece of second end plate one end have the locating piece, and the locating piece is all pegged graft in the recess. The fixing piece is installed in a orderly stacking mode through the first end plate and the second end plate, so that the size of the transfer case is reduced, the consumption of materials is reduced, the size and the appearance are reduced under the condition that the performance of the transfer case can be ensured, and support is provided for miniaturization of the transfer case.

title_en: Target ball positioning device capable of moving horizontally and vertically
abstract_en: The utility model provides a target ball positioning device capable of horizontally and vertically moving, which is provided with a horizontal base, three length-adjustable supporting legs, a stand column, a target ball, a horizontal platform, a cross round level, a switching platform, a sliding block and a vertical and horizontal moving device.

title_en: Automatic gear truck gearbox power takeoff
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gearbox power takeoff of an automatic transmission truck, which comprises a power takeoff main body and a gearbox gear connecting part, the power take off connecting portion, airtight room connecting seat, airtight room casing, inlet cover connecting seat and inlet seal lid, wherein: one end of the power takeoff main body is provided with a gearbox gear connecting part, the front side of the power takeoff main body is provided with a power output connecting part, and an airtight chamber connecting seat is arranged above the power takeoff main body; the airtight chamber connecting seat is connected with the airtight chamber shell, one end of the airtight chamber connecting seat is provided with an air inlet cover connecting seat, and the outer side of the air inlet cover connecting seat is provided with an air inlet sealing cover. When the sealing ring on the surface of the piston in the airtight chamber is damaged, the arrangement of the shell structure of the airtight chamber can prevent gas in the airtight chamber from leaking into the gearbox, and meanwhile, the shifting fork can still work through the arrangement of the electromagnet, so that the whole airtight chamber is very safe, reliable, convenient and flexible, and convenient for market popularization and application.

title_en: Quick-to-install connecting elbow
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quickly-installed connecting elbow, which belongs to the technical field of connecting elbow equipment and comprises an elbow body, wherein connecting pieces are fixedly installed at two ends of the elbow body, each connecting piece comprises a mounting plate fixedly installed on the elbow body, each mounting plate is communicated with the elbow body, a disc is rotatably installed in each mounting plate, channels are formed in each disc and each mounting plate in a penetrating manner, a circular ring is fixedly installed on one side of each disc, worm wheels are fixedly installed on the circular ring, a rotating shaft is rotatably installed on each mounting plate, a worm matched with the worm wheels is fixedly installed on the outer surface of each rotating shaft, and a hand wheel is fixedly installed at one end of each rotating shaft; the connecting rods are mutually close to each other, so that the pipeline connected with the elbow body can be clamped and fixed through the clamping blocks, the operation is simple, the clamping stability can be ensured by utilizing the self-locking characteristics of the worm wheel and the worm, the fixing effect is good, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Display screen display angle adjusting structure of network tester
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a display screen display angle adjusting structure of a network tester, which relates to the technical field of network testers and comprises a network tester body and a display screen arranged at one end of the network tester body, wherein a stabilizing component is fixedly arranged at the middle part of an adjusting support rod, so that the problem that the supporting stability of the adjusting support rod is poor due to the fact that the round rod support is easily slid between the round rod support and a placed tabletop in the placing process is solved, when an operator rotates the adjusting support rod to the lower end of the network tester body, a wrapping round block fixedly arranged at the middle part of the outer wall of the adjusting support rod and a contact mechanism fixedly arranged at one end of the wrapping round block can replace the middle part of the outer wall of the adjusting support rod to contact with the tabletop, and a rubber pad at one side of the expansion board is arranged on the tabletop.

title_en: Liquid cooling pipeline system of battery cluster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid cooling pipeline system of a battery cluster, which comprises: a primary pipe inlet; one end of the secondary inlet pipe is connected with the primary inlet pipe; the tertiary pipe that advances, tertiary pipe that advances is a plurality of, and every tertiary one end of advancing the pipe all with the second grade advance the union coupling, the other end is connected with the liquid cooling board, and a plurality of tertiary pipe that advance set up along the length direction interval of second grade advance the pipe, and the distance between the tie point that two tertiary pipes that are closest to the second grade advance the pipe and second grade advance the pipe is L2, and the distance between the tie point that other adjacent two tertiary pipes advance the pipe and the second grade advance the pipe is L1, and satisfies: l2 < L1. According to the liquid cooling pipeline system of the battery cluster, the travel of cooling liquid between the two tertiary inlet pipes closest to the secondary inlet pipe and the connection point of the secondary inlet pipe can be shortened, the resistance of the cooling liquid at the connection point is reduced, the effect of controlling the temperature difference among a plurality of battery packs by the liquid cooling plate is further improved, and the temperature difference among the plurality of battery packs is reduced.

title_en: Flaring connecting assembly of hydraulic oil pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil pipe connection, in particular to a hydraulic oil pipe flaring connection assembly, which comprises flaring connectors, wherein through holes are formed in the flaring connectors, two sides of each flaring connector are respectively inserted with an oil pipe, and the outer surface of each oil pipe is sleeved with a locking cap. The utility model has the advantages that: according to the utility model, the flaring connector, the locking caps and the like are arranged, the integral flaring connector is more stable in working, dislocation of two sides is avoided, the two locking caps in threaded connection can enable the installation process to be simpler, the trouble that bolts need to be fastened one by one in the process of bolt connection is avoided, the locking caps can be locked by holding the rotating handle under the condition of no tool through arranging the nuts and the rotating handle, the tightness of the joint of the two locking caps can be improved through arranging the sealing ring, and friction force between the two arranged first grooves and the second grooves and the oil pipe can be increased, so that the oil pipe is not easy to fall off.

title_en: Highway monitoring shell structure convenient to overhaul
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of expressway facilities, in particular to a shell structure for expressway monitoring, which has a protection function, is convenient to assemble, disassemble and maintain and improves practicability; including unable adjustment base, branch, high-speed control main casing, the control head groove, restraint rail frame, the pin frame, the casing lid, the mounting plate, the slide rail strip, catch and pin piece, unable adjustment base top middle part is connected with the branch bottom, the branch top is connected with high-speed control main casing bottom medial side through adjusting device, high-speed control main casing front end is provided with the control head groove, high-speed control main casing inside left and right sides middle part is connected with a set of restraint rail frame outer end respectively, high-speed control main casing rear side top middle part is connected with the pin frame top, casing lid front end lower part is connected with the mounting plate rear end, casing lid left and right sides end middle part is connected with a set of slide rail strip rear end respectively, casing lid rear end upside rotates with the catch inner and is connected, the casing lid output is connected with pin piece inner one side.

title_en: Novel connecting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydrogenation equipment, in particular to a novel connecting device. Including connecting tube, connecting tube's quantity is two, installs the fixed casing that is used for connecting between two connecting tube, and the inboard equipartition sliding connection of fixed casing has locating component, and drive assembly is still installed to the inside of fixed casing for drive locating component through drive assembly and remove, drive assembly includes spliced pole, screw thread section, first drive gear and transmission ring gear, and the inboard rotation of fixed casing is connected with the transmission ring gear. According to the novel connecting device, two connecting pipelines are contacted with the inner side of the center of the fixed shell, then the positioning assembly is driven to move through the operation of the driving assembly, the positions of the connecting pipelines and the fixed shell are positioned through the plurality of positioning assemblies through the movement of the positioning assembly on the inner side of the fixed shell, and meanwhile leakage between the two connecting pipelines is prevented.

title_en: Furniture convenient to assemble
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of furniture assembly, in particular to furniture convenient to assemble, which comprises a furniture main body, wherein a cabinet door is arranged on the front surface of the furniture main body, a side plate is arranged below the furniture main body, a base is arranged below the side plate, a reinforcing pipe is arranged on the inner wall of the side plate, a protective layer is arranged on the outer surface of the side plate, a clamping block is arranged on the top end of the side plate, a bayonet is arranged on the inner wall of the lower surface of the furniture main body, a sliding block is arranged at the bottom end of the side plate, and a limiting hole is arranged on the inner wall of one side of the sliding block.

title_en: Turning plate cylinder convenient to install
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flap cylinders, and discloses a flap cylinder convenient to install, which comprises a base and a cylinder body, wherein a telescopic rod is arranged on the cylinder body, an oil inlet and an oil outlet are formed in the top of the cylinder body, a sealing ring is arranged at the joint of the cylinder body and the telescopic rod, an installation mechanism is arranged on the base, the installation mechanism comprises a damper, a damping spring, a placing plate, an adjusting bolt, a knob, a clamping plate, a limiting plate, a fixing bolt and a fixing bolt, and the damper is fixedly installed at the bottom of the inner wall of the base. Through setting up base and mounting panel and being convenient for install the cylinder body on the vehicle, the base can protect the shell of cylinder body simultaneously, reduces the impact to the influence of cylinder body, can shock attenuation to the cylinder body through setting up attenuator and damping spring to it is more stable when making the cylinder body operate, can carry out the centre gripping fixed to the cylinder body through setting up adjusting bolt, knob and splint, thereby improve the stability of cylinder body.

title_en: Plaque fixing buckle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plaque fixing buckle which comprises a vehicle body connecting buckle head, wherein vehicle body connecting elastic pieces are respectively fixed at two sides of the vehicle body connecting buckle head, a clamping body connecting frame is arranged above the vehicle body connecting buckle head, a cavity is formed in the clamping body connecting frame, two ends of the bottom of the clamping body connecting frame are respectively and fixedly connected with two ends of the top of the vehicle body connecting buckle head, the cavity in the clamping body connecting frame is used for moving two groups of vehicle body connecting elastic pieces, plaque connecting elastic pieces are respectively fixed at two ends of the top of the vehicle body connecting elastic pieces, and a buckle top plate is fixed at the top of the vehicle body connecting elastic pieces. The connecting stability of the fixing buckle is improved through being provided with the automobile body connecting elastic piece, and simultaneously the operation of a user is convenient, the fixing buckle is convenient to take out through being provided with the inclined plane on one side of the top of the automobile body connecting elastic piece, so that the fixing connection between the decoration board and the automobile body is relieved, and meanwhile the decoration board connecting elastic piece is arranged, so that the fixing buckle and the decoration board are convenient to connect and fix.

title_en: Fire hydrant delivery pipe with stretching function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire hydrant water supply pipe with an automatic stretching function, which comprises a first pipeline and a second pipeline, wherein the outer side of the first pipeline is connected with a telescopic pipe sleeve in a sliding manner, the inside of the telescopic pipe sleeve is fixedly connected with a telescopic pipe body, the telescopic pipe body is connected with the inner wall of the first pipeline in a sliding manner, one end of the telescopic pipe body is fixedly connected with a second flange plate, the inside of the second flange plate is connected with two connecting rods in a sliding manner, the outer side of the telescopic pipe sleeve is provided with a displacement assembly, the displacement assembly is used for driving the connecting rods to move, the second pipeline is arranged at one end of the first pipeline, and one end of the second pipeline is fixedly connected with the first flange plate. The utility model solves the problems that when the fire hydrant water supply system is paved, the length of the pipeline is often found to be insufficient when the water supply pipeline is connected, so that other pipelines are intercepted, the working efficiency of the water supply system is reduced, and the practical use is not facilitated.

title_en: Double-rope-core V-shaped belt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of V belts, in particular to a double-rope-core V belt which comprises a V belt main body, wherein a reinforcing adhesive layer, a strong layer and a compression adhesive layer are arranged in the V belt main body from top to bottom, two rope cores are arranged in the strong layer, a plurality of connecting pieces are uniformly arranged between the two rope cores, each connecting piece comprises two lantern rings, and the two lantern rings are fixedly connected. The utility model has the advantage of being capable of bearing larger transverse force.

title_en: Full-automatic early warning device of forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of forest protection equipment, and particularly relates to a full-automatic forest fire prevention early warning device which comprises a fixing part, wherein the fixing part comprises a vertical rod, the bottom end of the vertical rod is fixedly connected with a mounting fixing plate, the outer wall of the middle part of the vertical rod is provided with an anti-climbing baffle, the top end of the anti-climbing baffle is provided with a lifting part, and the lifting part comprises an electric telescopic rod. According to the utility model, the electric telescopic rod is arranged to drive the air quality sensor to ascend or descend, so that environments with different heights in a forest can be detected, the detection range is enlarged, more data are provided for a monitoring room, and the monitoring room is beneficial to preventing fire disasters; the anti-climbing baffle is arranged to prevent animals from climbing to damage the anti-climbing system, the wireless controller can transmit detected conditions to a monitoring room or a mobile phone of a forest worker, the worker can discover and control the fire in time, and the harm caused by the fire is reduced.

title_en: Burner die of gas stove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of manufacturing of gas stove jambs and discloses a gas stove jamb die which comprises a base, wherein a workbench and a lower die are fixedly connected to the top of the base, a portal frame is fixedly connected to the top of the workbench, an air cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the portal frame, an upper die is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the air cylinder, a buffer guide assembly is arranged between the upper die and the lower die, a jamb cooling assembly is arranged between the lower die and the base, and a jamb ejection demoulding mechanism is arranged between the lower die and the workbench. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: be convenient for the efficient cools off gas-cooker furnace end, need not to wait for long time and can carry out the drawing of patterns, improve the efficiency that the furnace end was made, and be provided with ejecting demoulding mechanism, can give ejecting the furnace end from the below for the drawing of patterns is more convenient high-efficient, can not take place the condition that can't pull out the furnace end.

title_en: Switching device, steering wheel and carrying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a switching device, a steering wheel and a carrying device, wherein the switching device comprises a first bracket, a second bracket and an elastic ring; the first bracket and the second bracket are used for supporting the functional device; the first bracket is convexly provided with a connecting column, the second bracket is provided with a connecting sheet, and the connecting sheet is provided with a connecting hole; the elastic ring is provided with a through hole, at least part of the connecting column is arranged in the through hole, and at least part of the elastic ring is arranged in the connecting hole; so that the first bracket and the second bracket are fixedly connected. The utility model discloses an elastic ring which has the function of buffering vibration on one hand and can also have the function of connecting a first bracket and a second bracket on the other hand. Compared with the prior art that the first bracket and the second bracket are connected by the bolts, the production process is reduced, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Super-pressure pump structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ultra-high pressure pump structure, which comprises a stabilizing block with an inner cavity, wherein a water supply block is arranged in the stabilizing block, one end of the water supply block extends out of the stabilizing block to be connected with a water outlet head, cavities are arranged in the water supply block and the water outlet head, a water outlet one-way valve structure is arranged in the cavities, a central hole is arranged at one end of the water supply block far away from the water outlet head and is communicated with the cavity of the water supply block, a plurality of water inlets are arranged at one end of the water supply block far away from the water outlet head and take the central hole as a circle center, a water inlet cavity is arranged at the inner side of the stabilizing block and is communicated with the water inlets, an original water port is arranged at the outer side of the stabilizing block and is communicated with the water inlet cavity, a cylinder body is arranged at one end of the stabilizing block far away from the water outlet head, a connecting cylinder is arranged at the inner side of the cylinder body, a water inlet one-way valve structure is arranged at one end of the connecting cylinder far away from the stabilizing block, and a piston structure is arranged at one end of the connecting cylinder. The utility model has the advantages that: the water outlet pressure is high, the friction force is small, the sealing performance is good, and the service life is long.

title_en: Noise reduction type air source heat pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air source heat pumps and discloses a noise reduction type air source heat pump which comprises a mounting plate, wherein first telescopic columns are fixedly arranged at four corners of the top end of the mounting plate, first damping springs are fixedly arranged at the periphery of each of the four first telescopic columns, a bottom plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of each of the four first telescopic columns, a box body shell is fixedly arranged at the top end of the bottom plate, soundproof cotton is fixedly arranged at the inner side of the box body shell, and soundproof boards are fixedly arranged at the inner side of the soundproof cotton. According to the utility model, the third damping spring, the limiting plate and the limiting rod are matched, so that the stability of the two sides of the air source heat pump body is further enhanced, and the noise generated by vibration during working of the air source heat pump body is reduced.

title_en: Monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses monitoring equipment, which relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment and comprises a fixed plate, wherein the outer wall of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, the inner walls of two sides of the supporting frame are rotatably connected with rotating shafts, two ends of each rotating shaft penetrate through the inner walls of two sides of the supporting frame, the outer wall of the middle part of each rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a turbine, the outer wall of each turbine, which is far away from the fixed plate, is fixedly connected with a supporting arm, the outer wall of the top of each supporting arm is rotatably connected with a rotating column, the outer wall of each rotating column is sleeved with a mounting sleeve, and the outer wall of each mounting sleeve is provided with a limiting mechanism for limiting the corresponding rotating column.

title_en: Color code sensing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a color code sensing device which comprises a vertical mounting frame, a horizontal mounting frame, a color code sensor and a base, wherein the vertical mounting frame is vertically arranged on the base through the lower end of the vertical mounting frame, a T-shaped clamping groove rail is vertically arranged on the front side of the vertical mounting frame, a T-shaped clamping block which is matched with the T-shaped clamping groove rail in a proper manner is convexly arranged on the rear side of the middle part of the horizontal mounting frame, the horizontal mounting frame is horizontally arranged on the front side of the vertical mounting frame in a sliding manner up and down through the T-shaped clamping block, a long groove hole which is communicated with the bottom of the T-shaped clamping groove rail and has the same length is formed in the rear side of the vertical mounting frame, and a locking nut which is connected with the T-shaped clamping block in a threaded manner after the locking nut is matched with the T-shaped clamping block is arranged in the long groove hole; the front side of the horizontal mounting frame is provided with an adjusting rod which is parallel to the horizontal mounting frame at intervals, and two ends of the adjusting rod are connected with the horizontal mounting frame, and the color code sensor can be horizontally slidably arranged on the adjusting rod. The utility model aims to provide a color code sensing device which is simple in structure and convenient to adjust.

title_en: Electrothermal mulch film heating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrothermal mulching film heating device which comprises a solar panel, a heating guide mechanism and a bottom plate, wherein the output end of the solar panel is connected with the input end of a controller, the controller is in bidirectional connection with a storage battery, the output end of the controller is connected with the input end of an inverter, the output end of the inverter is connected with the input end of a junction box, the heating guide mechanism comprises a top plate, a buffer rod, an electric heating layer and the bottom plate, the upper surface of the top plate is fixedly connected with the buffer layer, a positioning groove is formed in the edge of the upper surface of the top plate, the upper end of the buffer rod is fixedly connected with a fixing plate I, a buffer groove I is formed in the edge of the upper surface of the bottom plate, the side surface of the buffer groove I is fixedly connected with a limiting block I, the limiting block I is in the limiting groove I formed in the buffer plate in a sliding manner, and the buffer plate is in the buffering groove I through a fixedly connected spring. This electric heat plastic film heating device can provide good buffering effect to avoid this heating device to damage because of the extrusion.

title_en: Air-cooled granulating mechanism based on EVA
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of a granulator, and particularly relates to an EVA-based air-cooled granulating mechanism, which comprises an air-cooled granulator body, wherein a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom side of the air-cooled granulator body, movable supporting components are arranged at the corners of the bottom end of the bottom plate, the movable supporting components comprise a top plate, the EVA-based air-cooled granulating mechanism supports the air-cooled granulator body when moving on the movable supporting components, in the moving process, if the air-cooled granulator body meets a rugged road surface, a first hydraulic rod on a supporting arm can provide a certain buffering effect for the air-cooled granulator body, the defect caused by severe jolt of the air-cooled granulator body is avoided, and in addition, the damping components can provide a certain buffering effect for the air-cooled granulator body so as to ensure that the air-cooled granulator body is not influenced by vibration, thereby effectively solving the problems in the prior art.

title_en: Equipment support with buffer structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an equipment support with a buffer structure, and particularly relates to the technical field of equipment supports. When the damping device is used, an operator takes down the sealing cover at the side end of the damping frame, the inner screw sleeve is exposed, the screw sleeve can be rotated by virtue of the holes on the surface of the screw sleeve, the position of the screw sleeve can be adjusted up and down by matching with the threads of the screw rod, the height positions of the screw sleeve are different, and the force of the compression springs is different, so that the elastic adjustment of the springs is realized, the integral buffering protection effect of the device is indirectly adjusted, and the buffering protection performance of the device bracket in use is enhanced.

title_en: Check valve with filter equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a check valve with a filtering device, which relates to the technical field of check valves and comprises a check valve body, wherein two sides of the check valve body are communicated with side pipelines, a supporting sleeve is fixed between the inner walls of one side pipeline, one side of the supporting sleeve is provided with an annular groove, an annular ring is arranged in the annular groove, one side of the annular ring extends to one side of the supporting sleeve, a filter box is fixed on one side of the annular ring, a plurality of openings are equidistantly arranged on the inner wall of one side of the filter box along the circumferential direction.

title_en: Seepage-proofing device for water supply and drainage pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water supply and drainage pipeline seepage-proofing device, which relates to the technical field of water supply and drainage pipelines and comprises a first water supply and drainage pipeline, a second water supply and drainage pipeline and a clamping ring, wherein flange plates are fixedly arranged at the opposite ends of the first water supply and drainage pipeline and the second water supply and drainage pipeline.

title_en: Anti-falling device of miniature mobile monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of monitoring equipment, in particular to an anti-falling device of miniature mobile monitoring equipment, which aims at the problems that the existing miniature camera can move everywhere and is generally protected by a shell when falling down accidentally, and the inside of the miniature camera contains various electronic elements required, and the miniature camera is small in size and high in precision and is easy to cause damage after falling down.

title_en: Electronic expansion valve
abstract_en: The embodiment provides an electronic expansion valve, which belongs to the technical field of expansion valves. The electronic expansion valve comprises a shell, a rotor assembly, a rotating shaft, a connecting block and a valve needle assembly. The casing has the installation cavity, and is provided with inlet and the liquid outlet with installation cavity intercommunication. The connecting block is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft, and a clamping part is arranged on the connecting block. The rotor assembly is provided with a through hole, and one end of the rotor assembly is provided with a matching part matched with the clamping part. The rotating shaft is inserted in the through hole and is rotationally connected with the shell. The clamping part is embedded with the matching part, so that the rotating shaft and the rotor assembly can synchronously rotate. The valve needle assembly is in transmission connection with the rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft can drive the valve needle to move so as to open or close the liquid outlet. The rotor and the rotating shaft can be assembled with reduced difficulty under the condition that synchronous rotation of the rotating shaft and the rotor is guaranteed.

title_en: CNG standard station capable of circularly cooling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circulating cooling CNG standard station, which comprises a cooling tower, wherein a fan is arranged at the top of the cooling tower, a cooling component and a control component are arranged in the cooling tower, the cooling component comprises a water tank arranged at the inner bottom end of the cooling tower, the circulating cooling CNG standard station is provided with the cooling component, the cooling component is provided with a heat exchange coil group, the working principle is that cooled water circulates in the heat exchange coil group of a closed cooling tower, heat is absorbed by the wall of a coil, a spraying system sprays water on the heat exchange coil to form a water film, the water exchanges heat with the heat exchange coil, and the heat of the wall of the coil is discharged outside a machine through the fan at the top. And meanwhile, the water film on the pipe wall absorbs heat and evaporates to become water vapor, the water vapor is discharged into the atmosphere by an exhaust fan at the top of the cooling tower, and water drops which are not evaporated fall into a water collecting tank for recycling. The water tank is made of stainless steel, so that the pressure resistance and the corrosion resistance can be effectively achieved. Meanwhile, the water-saving and water-saving device has the functions of supplementing circulating water and stabilizing pressure.

title_en: Telescopic rod convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of telescopic rods, and discloses a telescopic rod convenient to adjust, which comprises a main rod and a fixing assembly, wherein the fixing assembly is arranged at one end of the main rod and comprises a threaded joint, a threaded sleeve, a rotating shaft, a connecting sleeve, a second telescopic spring and a fixing sleeve, and the threaded joint is fixedly connected at one end of the main rod. This telescopic link that conveniently adjusts is favorable to the telescopic link to realize closely finely tuning in the use through being equipped with fixed subassembly, has enlarged the application range of telescopic link, then laminating fixed cover is at one side wall that needs to be fixed, then will adjust pole to fixed cover one end pressure, make the adapter sleeve draw in fixed cover through the second expansion spring, then with the one end card of adjusting subassembly at the opposite side wall, the adapter sleeve outwards pops out through the second expansion spring, then rotate the pivot, the pivot drives the thread bush and outwards twists out in screwed joint's one side, thereby make the second expansion spring receive the extrusion and wholly fix the telescopic link.

title_en: Anti-disassembly and anti-theft flange ball valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-disassembly and anti-theft flange ball valve, which comprises a ball valve main body, wherein a rotating rod is arranged in the ball valve main body, first clamping blocks are arranged at the top of the rotating rod at equal intervals, a guide column is fixedly connected to the top of the rotating rod, and grooves are formed in the outer wall of the guide column at equal intervals. This prevent tearing open formula flange ball valve open, through preventing tearing open the setting of mechanism, thereby in this prevent tearing open formula flange ball valve open use, can insert the protecting crust inside and be connected with the bull stick through the connecting rod, make through rotating the setting of handle alright control spheroidal open stop, simultaneously through first spring, stopper, spacing groove, further strengthen the connectivity of connecting rod and dwang, improve the stability of user in the rotation process, can retrieve the connecting rod after the user has used simultaneously, be convenient for store the handle, avoid the handle to take place to be stolen, thereby guaranteed this prevent tearing open the anti-theft nature of stealing formula flange ball valve.

title_en: Notebook computer extension placing plate with cooling capacity
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of computer auxiliary equipment, and discloses a notebook computer extending and placing plate with cooling capability. According to the utility model, the cooling effect of the device is good by the structural cooperation of the movable plate, the supporting plate, the adjusting plate, the spring, the clamping block, the limiting plate and the like, the limiting plate is pulled to the outer end, the adjusting plate is driven to move by the limiting plate, when the left end of the adjusting plate is clamped with the limiting block, the clamping block can be outwards ejected by the elasticity of the spring, the notebook computer is placed on the top side of the movable plate, and the cooling effect of the device is good by the structural cooperation of the movable plate, the supporting plate, the adjusting plate, the spring, the clamping block, the limiting plate and the like.

title_en: Quick-change connector for telescopic end of telescopic rod
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick replacement connector for a telescopic end of a telescopic rod, which is characterized in that two positioning blocks are aligned to two inlet grooves and inserted by holding a connector block, the connector block contacts with a clamping rod inclined plane at the moment, the clamping rod is extruded, along with the entering of the connector block, a subsequent clamping rod enters an arc groove and is abutted with a straight edge, so that a spring generates a reactive force action and the clamping rod to enable the clamping rod to clamp and fix the connector block, the subsequent rotating connector block drives the positioning blocks to slide along the rotating groove until the positioning blocks slide into an outlet groove, and the clamping rod is completely separated from the arc groove and contacts with the outer wall of the connector block at the moment, so that the connector block is conveniently taken out from the fixing groove to complete the quick disassembly of the connector block and a tool head.

title_en: Opening detection structure acting on butterfly valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an opening detection structure acting on a butterfly valve in the field of butterfly valves, which comprises a rotor assembly, an induction assembly and a sealing assembly, wherein the rotor assembly consists of a connecting rod, a short shaft and an induction sheet, and the induction sheet changes an angle along with the rotation of the short shaft; the sensing assembly consists of a valve position transmitter, a bracket, a flange and an end cover, wherein the valve position transmitter senses the angle change of the sensing piece; the sealing assembly consists of a sealing clamping table, sealing filler and a filler gland, and prevents water at the shaft side from leaking. According to the utility model, the angular displacement sensor is combined with the short shaft of the butterfly valve through structural design, so that the butterfly valve is mainly used for transmitting opening signals and can accurately detect the opening of the butterfly valve; the non-contact structure is simple in structure and low in failure rate; the structure has good sealing performance.

title_en: Cloud platform of robot is patrolled and examined to track
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a holder of a track inspection robot, which comprises a fixing mechanism, a main cabin body, a visible light cabin body and a thermal imaging cabin body, wherein the middle part of the main cabin body is provided with the fixing mechanism, the left side of the main cabin body is fixedly provided with the visible light cabin body, the right side of the main cabin body is fixedly provided with the thermal imaging cabin body, the main cabin body is internally provided with a horizontal driving mechanism, the thermal imaging cabin body is internally provided with a thermal imaging camera and a detection circuit board I, the main cabin body is internally provided with a holder rotation driving mechanism, the main cabin body is provided with a reinforcing rib, one side of the main cabin body is fixedly provided with an infrared sulfur hexafluoride sensor mounting plate, the lower part of the infrared sulfur hexafluoride sensor mounting plate is provided with a scram switch, and the lower part of the holder rotation driving mechanism is provided with an ultrasonic mounting plate.

title_en: Supporting platform for building design construction based on BIM
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a support platform for BIM-based building design construction, which relates to the technical field of building design construction equipment and comprises a box body, a BIM display screen, an automatic dustproof assembly and a lifting assembly.

title_en: Hydraulic valve block structure with sector section roll gap dynamic control function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic valve blocks, in particular to a hydraulic valve block structure with a sector section roll gap dynamic control function. The technical proposal comprises: the valve block comprises a valve block body, a constant flow regulating valve and an electromagnetic valve, wherein the two ends of the valve block body are fixedly connected with one-way valves, one side of the one-way valve at the other end of the valve block body is fixedly provided with an oil inlet, a filter screen is arranged in the oil inlet, the periphery of the oil inlet is fixedly connected with a connecting sleeve, the other end of the connecting sleeve is fixedly connected with the constant flow regulating valve, the bottom of the constant flow regulating valve is fixedly provided with a sleeve, the other side of the valve block body is fixedly provided with a boss, and two sides of the valve block body at the top of the boss are fixedly provided with sealing screws. According to the utility model, impurities in oil can be prevented from entering the valve block through the filter screen in the oil inlet, the valve block is damaged, and the pressure, the state, the flow and the temperature of hydraulic oil of the machine can be monitored through the equipment state monitoring diagnostic instrument.

title_en: Choke valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a choke valve which comprises a valve seat and a valve cover which is in adaptive sealing connection with the valve seat, wherein a water outlet port is arranged on the valve seat, a water inlet port is arranged on the valve cover, a water-proof sleeve is arranged in the valve cover, a pressing plate is arranged between the water-proof sleeve and the valve seat, an air cavity communicated with the atmosphere is arranged in the water-proof sleeve, a side hole communicated with the water inlet port is arranged on the pressing plate, and a water channel communicated with the water outlet port is provided with a flow control assembly for sensing water pressure at the side hole to regulate water flow. The utility model is used for adjusting the water yield according to the water pressure change, avoiding the phenomenon of pressure holding, so that the water pressure can be maintained within a set value range, and the utility model is not easy to be blocked by impurities.

title_en: Rotary hinge structure, camera device and 3D printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of rotary connection structures, and aims to solve the problems that the space occupation of the conventional rotary connection structure is large or the cost is high, and provides a rotary hinge structure, a camera device and 3D printing equipment. The rotary hinge structure comprises a first component, a second component and an elastic gasket. The first component comprises a first plate part, and the first plate part is provided with a matched through hole. The second component comprises a second plate part and a rotating shaft part, one end of the rotating shaft part is connected with the second plate part, and the other end of the rotating shaft part extends out in a direction away from the second plate part and radially expands to form a clamping part; the second plate part corresponds to the first plate part, the rotating shaft part rotatably passes through the matching through hole, and the clamping part is clamped at one side of the first plate part far away from the second plate part. The elastic gasket is matched between the first plate part and the second plate part and is used for applying elastic force for enabling the first plate part and the second plate part to be far away from each other. The utility model has the advantages of realizing the running fit with damping, having smaller occupied space and saving cost.

title_en: Industrial computer bracket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an industrial personal computer bracket, and relates to the technical field of industrial personal computer brackets; the utility model comprises a base, wherein a hollow rod is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, when the height of the placing rack is required to be adjusted, the first gear can be rotated to drive the first gear meshed with the first gear to rotate, the first gear can be rotated to drive the screw rod to rotate through the connecting block, the screw rod is rotated to drive the sleeve plate sleeved on the outer side surface of the first gear to move upwards, the connecting rod can be driven to move upwards through the connecting rod, finally the placing rack can be driven to move upwards to adjust the height, after the height is adjusted to a proper height, the end part of the second gear can be inserted into a through hole corresponding to the second gear through rotating the second threaded inserted rod, so that the second gear is limited to prevent the second gear from rotating again, the angle of the placing rack can be adjusted through a disc, the first threaded inserted rod can be fixed in a corresponding jack through rotating the first threaded inserted rod, the placing rack can be adjusted according to the requirement, and the practicability of the placing rack is improved.

title_en: Leveling device for mounting T-shaped bracket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of equipment installation and provides a leveling device for T-shaped bracket installation, which comprises a transmission mechanism, wherein the transmission mechanism comprises a motor, a first gear, an output shaft, a toothed belt, a driven shaft and a second gear, the output shaft is arranged at the bottom of the motor, the first gear is fixedly sleeved on the output shaft, the toothed belt is meshed on the first gear, the second gear is meshed on the right side of the inside of the toothed belt, the driven shaft is fixedly sleeved on the second gear, the top of the driven shaft is fixedly connected with a center bolt, the motor drives the output shaft to rotate, the output shaft drives the first gear to rotate, the first gear drives the toothed belt to rotate, the toothed belt drives the second gear to rotate, and the second gear drives the driven shaft to rotate. Through the technical scheme, the problems that only leveling operation can be performed manually in the prior art and the leveling effect is poor are solved.

title_en: Explosion-proof dolly transmission
abstract_en: The utility model provides an explosion-proof trolley transmission device. The device comprises: a trolley body and a base; at least one transmission piece arranged on the bottom surface of the trolley body; at least one set of sprocket drive structures; each group of the chain wheel transmission structures comprises at least two chain wheels arranged on the base at intervals and a transmission chain wound on the at least two chain wheels; the driving piece is connected with a first sprocket wheel of the at least two sprocket wheels, and drives the first sprocket wheel to rotate through the driving piece so as to drive the transmission chain to move around the sprocket wheels; the first height of the first end of the drive chain relative to the base is greater than the second height of the second end of the drive chain relative to the base along the length of the drive chain. The scheme of the utility model solves the problem that in the prior art, when the transmission member is meshed with or out of the transmission chain, the transmission member interferes with chain wheels positioned at two ends of the transmission chain, so that the explosion-proof trolley cannot be automatically separated from the transmission device.

title_en: Buzzer with anti-falling performance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a buzzer with anti-falling performance, which comprises a supporting device, wherein limiting devices are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the top end of the supporting device, a buffer device is arranged in the top end of the supporting device in a sliding mode, a buzzer is sleeved on the top end of the limiting device in a sliding mode, the limiting device comprises a nut, a threaded rod, a buffer spring, a gasket and an air bag, the buffer spring and the threaded rod are respectively and fixedly arranged on the top end of the gasket, the buffer spring is positioned on the outer ring of the threaded rod, the air bag is fixedly arranged on the top end of the buffer spring, the nut is sleeved on the threaded rod in a threaded mode, the supporting device comprises a mounting groove, a reinforcing support and a supporting substrate, the mounting groove is symmetrically formed in the top end of the supporting substrate, and the reinforcing support is symmetrically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the supporting substrate. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the limiting device and the buffer device, the purpose of falling protection of the buzzer is realized.

title_en: Bearing sealing ring of automobile belt pulley
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bearing sealing rings and discloses an automobile belt pulley bearing sealing ring, which comprises a bearing part body, wherein ball grooves are formed in the upper side and the lower side of the bearing part body, a first limiting ring and a second limiting ring are fixedly connected to the upper end and the lower end of the bearing part body, and the first limiting ring and the second limiting ring are positioned on the two sides of an inner ring and an outer ring at the opening of the corresponding ball groove.

title_en: Assembled kitchen cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of kitchen cabinets, in particular to an assembled kitchen cabinet which comprises a cabinet body, fixing mechanisms and a placing mechanism, wherein the two sides of the cabinet body are provided with the fixing mechanisms for firmly and efficiently connecting the cabinets. When the wall cabinet for kitchen is assembled, the side walls of the two groups of cabinet bodies are aligned, the inserting plates are inserted into the slots from front to back, the front ends and the rear ends of the inserting plates are completely flush with the slots, meanwhile, when kitchen ware or food materials are required to be stored in the cabinet body, the supporting plates are inserted between the front supporting plates and the rear supporting plates from front to back according to the requirements, the screw bolts are twisted to enable screw grooves formed in the front supporting plates to move downwards in a meshed mode, the supporting plates are fixed in the front supporting plates, the cabinet cabin is divided into multiple layers of separation from top to bottom through the multiple groups of front supporting plates and the rear supporting plates, and the classified storage of various kitchen ware is carried out, so that convenience is brought to the use of the cabinet.

title_en: Ocean engineering dredging pump
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dredging pumps, in particular to a marine engineering dredging pump, which can place an external pipeline at a siltation position of flood, then connect an output end of a pump body and a connecting pipe on the flange plate in a pair by pair through bolts by using the flange plate to finish fixation, and in the suction process, a vacuum generator utilizes a spray pipe to spray compressed air at a high speed to form jet flow at an outlet of the spray pipe. Under the action of entrainment, the air around the outlet of the spray pipe is continuously sucked away. The positive pressure air source in the use environment is subjected to a series of reaction treatments to obtain negative pressure, so that the deposition is sucked into the pump body, and the deposition can be sprayed out from the outer nozzle of the pump cavity connector under the pressurization of the pump body, so that the spraying lift of the pump body is improved, and the deposition pumping effect is improved; after the maintenance is finished, the electric cylinder can be reversely started, so that the initial section of the pump body is inserted into the jack of the limiting disc, and the sealing gasket in the initial section fills the gap at the joint, thereby preventing the accumulation from leaking along the bottom of the pump cavity connector.

title_en: Double-row crossed roller type slewing bearing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bearing assembly and manufacturing, and particularly relates to a double-row crossed roller type slewing bearing which comprises an inner ring, a first outer ring and a second outer ring, wherein an annular boss is formed on the outer diameter side of the inner ring, a first roller path is formed between the first end face of the annular boss and the first outer ring, stepped positioning is adopted between the inner diameter side of the first outer ring and the end face of the inner ring, a second roller path is formed between the second end face of the annular boss and the second outer ring, and a row of rollers are respectively assembled in the first roller path and the second roller path. The roller can independently bear radial load or axial load, effectively improves the bearing capacity and service life of the bearing, and meets the working condition requirements under different conditions.

title_en: Portal frame assembly structure and automobile inspection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portal frame assembly structure and automobile inspection equipment, wherein the portal frame assembly structure comprises: a base; the upright rod is of a hollow tube structure, a first end of the upright rod is used for being abutted with the base, and a first interface is formed at the first end; the first reinforcement is of a solid structure, is inserted into the first interface and is in interference fit with the first interface; a first fastener connecting the first stiffener and the base; and a second fastener connecting the first reinforcement and the upright. The upright rod is of a hollow tube structure, and the weight of the upright rod is light, so that the influence on the weak part of the upright rod is reduced due to the gravity action of the upright rod, namely the possibility of deformation of the upright rod after the automobile inspection assembly is hung is reduced, and meanwhile, the stability of the upright rod is improved; in addition, the first reinforcement is inserted into the first interface of the vertical rod, namely, the first reinforcement is positioned in the vertical rod, so that interference between the first reinforcement and the inspection assembly is avoided, and influence on the inspection range of the automobile inspection assembly is reduced.

title_en: Asphalt conveying improved system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an asphalt conveying improved system which comprises an asphalt storage pool, a heat conducting oil coil pipe, a motor, a conveying box, a receiving hopper, an asphalt pool, an asphalt pump, a conveying screw rod, a discharge port and a conveying pipe, wherein the heat conducting oil coil pipe is arranged in the inner cavities of the asphalt storage pool and the asphalt pool, the conveying box is arranged at the right end of the inner cavity of the asphalt storage pool, the conveying screw rod is arranged on the inner surface of the conveying box, and the top of the conveying screw rod is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the motor through a belt.
