The utility model is provided with an asphalt storage pool, a heat conducting oil coil pipe, a motor, a material conveying box, a material receiving hopper, an asphalt pool, an asphalt pump, a material conveying screw, a material outlet and a material conveying pipe, adopts a vertical spiral material conveying mode, and has the advantages that the material conveying box has large pipe diameter, no residual and solidification phenomenon of asphalt exists after the material conveying box is stopped, the material conveying pipe is additionally arranged at the material receiving hopper, the asphalt is ensured not to remain after the material conveying pipe stops producing and condensing, the material conveying pipe is not blocked, and a good effect is obtained.

title_en: Data analysis platform hardware protection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses hardware protection equipment for a data analysis platform, which comprises a protection shell, wherein the rear side of the top of the protection shell is movably connected with a cover plate through a shaft pin, the front sides of the protection shell and the cover plate are fixedly connected with handles, the two sides of the protection shell are provided with vent holes, the bottom of an inner cavity of the protection shell is provided with a data analysis equipment body, the two sides of the protection shell are fixedly connected with positioning components, the positioning components comprise a motor, one side of the motor, which is close to the protection shell, is fixedly connected with the protection shell, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, and the surface of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a threaded sleeve.

title_en: Clutch mechanism of winch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clutch mechanism of a winch, which comprises a clutch pull arm, a clutch link rod, a hydraulic master cylinder, a hydraulic sub-cylinder, a clutch lever, a clutch arm, a clutch friction belt and a clutch disc fixedly arranged on a side plate at one end of a winding drum, wherein the clutch pull arm, the clutch link rod, the hydraulic master cylinder, the hydraulic sub-cylinder, the clutch lever, the clutch arm and the clutch friction belt are sequentially connected with each other; the upper side and the lower side of the clutch pulling arm are respectively provided with a clutch manual operation handle and a clutch manipulator. The utility model has reasonable structural design, compact structure and convenient operation, can be manually operated by operators, can also be operated by robots instead of people, has safety and low failure rate, and greatly improves the operation efficiency.

title_en: Bolt of antiskid silk
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bolt of an anti-skid wire, which comprises the following components: the screwing block is polygonal; the threaded rod is used for fixing the part at the middle part of the screwing block; the screw block bottom has seted up the mounting groove, it is connected with flexible post to alternate in the mounting groove, flexible post and mounting groove are provided with first elastic component for flexible of flexible post, the flexible post is kept away from the one end of screwing the block and is connected with rotatable ball. According to the utility model, the mounting groove is formed on one side, opposite to the threaded rod, of the screwing block, the telescopic column capable of moving in a telescopic manner is arranged in the mounting groove, and the elastic resetting of the telescopic column by the first elastic piece between the telescopic column and the mounting groove is matched, so that the elastic telescopic action of the telescopic column can be utilized when the bolt is locked and fixed for use, the outer thread on the bolt can be tightly attached to the inner thread of the nut, the sliding wire is avoided, and the use quality of the bolt is improved.

title_en: Labyrinth double-guide regulating valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of valves, in particular to a labyrinth double-guide regulating valve, which comprises a valve body, a valve core, a valve rod, a valve seat and a valve cover connected with the valve body, wherein an inlet channel is arranged above the valve seat, a guide device is arranged in the inlet channel, the guide device is of a cylindrical structure with a hollow interior, one end of the guide device is propped against the valve seat, the other end of the guide device is propped against the valve cover, the inner wall of the guide device is matched with the outer wall of the valve core and is coaxially arranged with the valve core, the valve core moves back and forth along the inner channel of the guide device, the guide device comprises a labyrinth core bag and a sleeve, one end of the labyrinth core bag is propped against the other end of the sleeve, a plurality of groups of labyrinth flow channels which are internally and externally communicated are axially arranged on the labyrinth core bag, and the guide device and the valve seat form a double-guide balance structure for the valve core, so that vibration in the valve body and abrasion of the sealing surface of the valve core and the valve seat when the valve core is opened and closed are reduced.

title_en: Protective electrode induction gas atomization pulverizing device safety operation relief valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electrode induction gas atomization powder making devices, in particular to a pressure release valve for protecting safety work of an electrode induction gas atomization powder making device. The utility model can be automatically opened and closed according to the working pressure of the system, and when the pressure in the gas atomization powder preparation equipment exceeds the set pressure of the pressure release valve, the pressure release valve is automatically opened, so that the medium pressure of the gas atomization powder preparation equipment is ensured to be under the set pressure, the gas atomization powder preparation equipment is protected, and accidents are prevented.

title_en: High-stability shaking-prevention chest expander
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-shaking chest expander with higher stability, which comprises a supporting base, wherein the whole chest expander is of a square hollow structure; the standing plate is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the supporting base; the bottom end of the elastic band is fixedly arranged at the front end position of the upper surface of the supporting base; the guide sleeve is arranged above the front end of the support base; the control panel is fixedly arranged outside the guide sleeve; and the support pad is fixedly arranged outside the lower surface of the support base. This higher anti-shake chest expander of stability adopts novel structural design for the device utilizes the guide sleeve in middle part outside to carry out certain spacing to it when being pulled in the in-process elastic band of using, avoids it to appear rocking and leads to taking exercise personnel focus unstable, and utilizes small-size air pump and connecting tube to take out the inside air of through-hole when the device is used, thereby makes the inside vacuum that forms of back cushion, makes it adsorb subaerial, avoids appearing the condition of empting in the in-process of using.

title_en: Ball convenient to dismantle
abstract_en: The application discloses ball convenient to dismantle belongs to the ball field, and it includes the support frame, the top of one side of support frame is provided with power transmission mechanism, the inside rotation of support frame is connected with the lead screw, the outside rotation of lead screw is connected with rolling mechanism, rolling mechanism's bottom is provided with guiding mechanism, fixed box is installed to one side of support frame, fixed box's inside sliding connection has the gag lever post, one side of gag lever post is provided with the spring, the outside sliding connection of gag lever post has the stabilizing frame; this application modern design, the structure is ingenious, and this a ball convenient to dismantle is through setting up support frame, fixed box, gag lever post, spring and stabilizing frame, can be better dismantle fast ball, has avoided most ball, is difficult to carry out quick dismantlement's problem to the use of ball has brought convenience.

title_en: Electromagnetic combined air dividing valve
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic valves, in particular to an electromagnetic combined split air valve, which comprises an electromagnetic valve body, wherein a pair of connecting pipes are fixedly connected to the side wall of the electromagnetic valve body; the pair of connecting pipes are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the electromagnetic valve body; when using, open splint, afterwards with splint cover on the connecting pipe lateral wall, then grip the fixture block of second installation piece both sides, pull open the fixture block, afterwards grip the bolt with its insert first installation piece with in the second installation piece is inside, then loosen the fixture block, thereby insert on the draw-in groove lateral wall, afterwards be on the pipeline frame baffle top, thereby support the pipeline, this in-process, thereby reduce when docking pipeline and connecting pipe, produce and rock, cause and be difficult to carry out fixed connection to it, thereby cause to increase certain work load, support the pipeline through the baffle of both sides, and then increase the spacing effect when being connected fixedly pipeline and connecting pipe.

title_en: Information recording plate capable of expanding recording area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of recording plate structures, in particular to an information recording plate capable of expanding a recording area, which comprises a recording plate body, wherein the recording plate body comprises a main plate, an auxiliary plate is transversely inserted in the main plate, a lifting assembly is rotatably arranged on the back of the main plate, the lifting assembly comprises a shaft sleeve, the bottom end of the shaft sleeve is connected with a rotary disc, the rotary disc is embedded in a chassis through a rotary groove, and the bottom end of the chassis is connected with a guide wheel base. According to the utility model, the auxiliary plate is pulled outwards, so that the auxiliary plate can drive the guide rail to move in the guide groove on the inner wall of the main plate, after the auxiliary plate is pulled outwards, the recording area is expanded, the key content of marketing discussion can be recorded independently, the phenomenon that the discussion thought of marketing is influenced by mistaken wiping is avoided, the main plate is adjusted and adapted to a proper height through the inner shaft moving inside the shaft sleeve, meanwhile, the main plate can rotate and then drive the threaded column to move, so that the knob is locked after the surface of the threaded column moves, and then the inclination angle of the main plate can be adjusted.

title_en: High bolt of security
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-safety bolt, which comprises a device body, wherein a screw head is arranged on the device body, a fixing groove is formed in the screw head, a plug is arranged in the lower end of the screw head, a rotating groove is formed in the fixing groove, a bolt is arranged at the lower end of the plug, a screw hole is formed in the outer side wall of the plug, a threaded rod is screwed in the screw hole, a gasket is sleeved on the bolt, a nut is arranged below the gasket, a pressing plate is arranged at the upper end of the nut, a limiting hole and a limiting clamp are respectively arranged in the bolt, and an anti-slip strip is arranged on the upper end face of the pressing plate, so that the bolt and the screw head can be conveniently detached and fixed, later replacement or maintenance of the bolt can be conveniently performed, the input cost is saved for a user, the trouble that the traditional bolt is not easy to detach is avoided, the bolt can be fastened, the condition that the nut slides, the stability of the device is improved, and the safety of the device in use is ensured.

title_en: Automatic medical consumable fixing interface device that resets
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic resetting medical consumable fixing interface device, which comprises a shell, wherein a cavity is arranged in the shell, and openings are formed in the front and the rear of the shell; the handle seat is arranged in the shell and is rotationally embedded in a handle seat ferrule arranged at the front opening of the shell; the consumable interface seat is fixedly arranged in the shell and positioned at the rear side of the handle seat, and the rear part of the consumable interface seat extends out of the shell from the opening at the rear side of the shell; the handle seat is provided with a spring pull column extending out of an opening at the rear side of the shell, the rear side wall of the shell is provided with a limit column, and the spring pull column is connected with the limit column through a tension spring; the front side of the handle seat is fixedly provided with a handle which extends out of the front side opening of the shell; and a rolling friction mechanism is arranged between the handle seat and the consumable interface seat. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the device adopts the ball assembly, can realize that the friction resistance that resets is little, stable in structure can satisfy and use for a long time many times after the circulation, still can keep the effect that resets.

title_en: Buffering protection architecture of preceding brush
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a buffer protection structure of a front broom, which is arranged on a cleaning vehicle and comprises a front bumper arranged at the front lower part of the vehicle, wherein the end part of the front bumper is provided with a front broom buffer mechanism, the front broom buffer mechanism comprises a first connecting arm, a second connecting arm movably connected with the first connecting arm and a front broom mechanism fixed with the other end of the second connecting arm.

title_en: Composite pipe
abstract_en: The utility model provides a composite pipe, which relates to the technical field of composite pipes, wherein the composite pipe is provided with a screw rod structure, the two longitudinal adjacent adjusting rods are arranged in four places, the two groups of adjusting rods are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side of the inside of an inner pipe, the inner sides of the two groups of adjusting rods are respectively provided with clamping plates, the problem that when the water entering the inside of the pipe is too large due to the lack of an effective buffer structure, the inner wall of the pipe is easily broken due to the water hammer effect, the normal use of the pipe is further influenced is solved, the quick clamping and limiting operation on the pipe inserted into the inner pipe is realized through the transmission connection of the adjusting rods and the clamping plates, and in the practical use, corresponding internal threads are further formed on the inner wall of the clamping plates, so that when the device is used, the connection assembly can be carried out according to different selectivities of connection modes required by the pipe, and the overall practicality, stability and reliability of the device are further improved.

title_en: External-hanging general adjustable electric actuator of flange ball valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric ball valves, in particular to a flange ball valve externally-hung type universal adjustable electric actuator which comprises a servo motor and a reduction gearbox, wherein a vertical beam is fixedly connected to the front end of the outer wall of the reduction gearbox, an output shaft of the reduction gearbox is fixedly connected with a sleeve shaft, a long hole is formed in the inner wall of the rear side of a left part of a pipeline hoop frame, and the left part of the pipeline hoop frame can be fixedly connected with the tail end of the vertical beam through bolts, the long hole and a second threaded hole. The flange ball valves compatible with different specifications can be realized by changing corresponding parameters of a main board or a PLC of the electric actuator through the cooperation among the servo motor, the pipeline hoop frame, the reduction gearbox, the sleeve shaft, the vertical beam, the long hole and the square pit without being limited by the rotation angle of the angular travel sensor; the electric actuator is easy to detach and convenient to restore to the original shape of the flange ball valve for manual adjustment if emergency exists.

title_en: Adjustable supporting component and household equipment with same
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable supporting component and household equipment with the same. The mounting seat is provided with a fixing part and a supporting part; the footing swing joint in fixed part, the lead screw with set up to threaded connection between the supporting part, when the lead screw rotates relative supporting part, push away the structure with the lead screw moves in step relative mount pad, push away the structure and push away the footing motion, with adjust adjustable supporting component's supporting height, thereby adjust the gap about the domestic appliance in the cupboard, promote the aesthetic degree after the domestic appliance installs to the structure is more structural, adjusts convenient operation.

title_en: Electrohydraulic control system for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrohydraulic control system for a coal mine, belonging to the technical field of electrohydraulic control systems for the coal mine; the technical problems to be solved are as follows: an improvement of a hardware structure of an electrohydraulic control system for coal mines is provided; the technical scheme adopted for solving the technical problems is as follows: the front side of the control device is provided with a man-machine interaction display screen, function keys, a working state indicator lamp, a power supply change-over switch, a locking button and an infrared receiving port, and the back side of the control device is provided with a function interface; the controller is internally provided with a controller and a power management module, the power input end of the controller is connected with the power management module, and the controller is connected with a man-machine interaction display screen, a function key, a working state indicator lamp, a power change-over switch, a locking button and an infrared receiving port through wires; the functional device comprises a sensor module and a functional valve group, and the controller is respectively connected with the sensor module and the functional valve group through functional interfaces; the utility model is applied to electrohydraulic control sites for coal mines.

title_en: Connection structure of automobile tail plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting structure of an automobile tail plate, which comprises a mounting frame, a swinging oil cylinder, a lifting oil cylinder and the tail plate, wherein the swinging oil cylinder and the lifting oil cylinder are respectively used for carrying out angle swinging and height lifting on the tail plate, a lubricating mechanism used for lubricating the rotating connection parts of the swinging oil cylinder, the lifting oil cylinder and the tail plate is arranged on the mounting frame, the lubricating mechanism consists of an oil supply assembly and an oil outlet assembly, the oil supply assembly supplies oil to the oil outlet assembly through an oil supply hose, and an oil storage tank is fixedly connected with the front surface of the mounting frame through bolts. This connection structure car tailboard of car tailboard is used the time spent accessible oil feeding unit and is carried out the fuel feeding to play glib position department for lubricating oil enters into car tailboard and swing hydro-cylinder and lift cylinder rotation connection's position department to lubricate, avoided the car tailboard to rotate the connection position and take place the rust and produce noise and unable normal use's condition emergence.

title_en: Metering and voltage regulating cabinet with filtering membrane convenient to replace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fuel gas transmission and distribution, in particular to a metering and pressure regulating cabinet convenient for replacing a filtering membrane, which comprises a box body, a pipeline, a control assembly and a filtering and replacing assembly, wherein the filtering and replacing assembly comprises an outer box, a plurality of groups of filtering frames, a plurality of filtering membranes, a rotating piece, a cover body, two sealing rings, two fixing pieces and two control units, the outer box is fixedly connected with the pipeline, the plurality of groups of filtering frames are movably connected with the outer box, the plurality of filtering membranes are fixedly connected with the plurality of filtering frames, the rotating piece is fixedly connected with the outer box, the two sealing rings are respectively arranged below the cover body and above the outer box, the two fixing pieces penetrate through the cover body, and the filtering frames and the filtering membrane are mutually matched with the two control units.

title_en: Assembled lead screw transmission seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembled screw rod transmission seat, which comprises a transmission seat body, wherein one end of the transmission seat body is provided with a through hole; the bearing is fixed at the other end of the transmission seat body, a guide block is arranged at the bottom of the bearing, and a guide groove matched with the guide block is formed in the inner bottom of the transmission seat body; the pressing plate is fixed on the side surface of the bearing, and limiting components are arranged on the pressing plate and the bearing; the limiting component comprises a first limiting block, the first limiting block is arranged on the side surface of the pressing plate, and a second limiting groove is formed in the side surface of the first limiting block; the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the guide block is inserted into the guide groove, and the guide of the bearing assembly is increased by the cooperation of the guide block and the guide groove; through the limiting part of design, increase the restriction when clamp plate and bearing assembly, improved the efficiency of assembly, utilize the cooperation of threaded rod, fixed cover, screw thread portion, further increase the firm performance of bearing assembly.

title_en: Quick-opening pressure relief valve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quick opening pressure relief valve, and mainly relates to the technical field of pressure relief valves. The utility model provides a quick open pressure release valve, includes the valve body, the one end fixed mounting of valve body has pressure release to discharge flange, the other end fixed mounting of valve body has high-pressure medium flange, the cavity has been seted up in the valve body, sliding fit installs sealed case in the cavity, set up in the valve body with the communicating intercommunicating pore in the bottom of cavity one side, the valve body top is close to pressure release and discharges one side of flange and has been seted up with the communicating control source access & exit of cavity. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the device can realize the movement of the sealing valve core by controlling the thrust generated by the medium, and can be quickly opened or closed, so that the requirement of quick pressure relief of a user can be met.

title_en: Electro-hydraulic servo valve based on piezoelectric driver
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrohydraulic servo valve based on a piezoelectric driver, which relates to the field of piezoelectric drivers and comprises the following components: the electro-hydraulic servo valve comprises an electro-hydraulic servo valve body, wherein a valve rod is arranged in an inner channel of the electro-hydraulic servo valve body, a protective cover is fixed at the left side end of the electro-hydraulic servo valve body, a heat dissipation dehumidification box is connected to the upper end and the lower end of the protective cover in a threaded mode, a dust screen is fixed to the outer surface of the heat dissipation dehumidification box, a moisture absorbent is plugged into the inner side of the heat dissipation dehumidification box, a piezoelectric driver is attached to the inner side of the protective cover through a buffer block, and a valve rod is connected to the right side of the piezoelectric driver through a liquid blocking baffle. The utility model solves the problems that in the prior art, the vibration is large in gear transmission, so that the driven valve core collides with the valve wall, and the valve core is easy to wear and influence the adjusting precision.

title_en: Micro-pressure valve with pressure display function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a micro-pressure valve with a pressure display function, which comprises a valve body, wherein the top of the valve body is provided with a valve seat, two sides of the valve body are respectively provided with a connecting plate, the bottom of the valve body is fixedly connected with a shell, the inner cavity of the shell is provided with a pressure display screen, and the surface of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a mounting shell. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the valve body, the valve seat, the connecting plate, the casing, the pressure display screen, the mounting shell, the bolt, the adjusting disc, the movable rod, the transverse plate, the movable rod, the compression pad, the fixed shell, the spring, the movable block, the lifting rod, the lifting plate and the clamping block, the micro-pressure valve has the advantage of good sealing performance while having the pressure display function, and solves the problems that the existing pressure-adjustable micro-pressure one-way valve lacks a connecting structure with good sealing performance, and the micro-pressure valve is connected with a pipeline and is fixed only by using the bolt and the nut, so that the leakage risk is high.

title_en: Gas pitcher valve switching pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gas tank valve switching pipeline, which comprises: one end of the spiral bent pipe is connected with an instrument interface arranged on the air supply panel, a connecting interface is reserved at the other end of the spiral bent pipe, and the height of the spiral bent pipe is adjustable and is fixed on an air circuit pipeline through a fixing belt; the connecting pipe comprises a connecting bent pipe, wherein one end of the connecting bent pipe is provided with a VCR connector, the VCR connector is communicated with the connecting interface in a pairing mode, the other end of the connecting pipe is provided with a connecting connector, and the connecting connector is connected with a valve exhaust port of the gas tank. The gas tank valve switching pipeline is relatively fixed in overall shape, so that fatigue of the pipeline is avoided during use, and the safety of gas detection and the service life of the pipeline can be effectively improved.

title_en: Propaganda display device suitable for ocean characteristic tourism town
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of propaganda and display, in particular to a propaganda and display device suitable for a marine characteristic travel town, which aims at the problems that the existing propaganda and display device is usually fixedly arranged outdoors, has no protective device and is inconvenient to pack up and protect the propaganda device when encountering thunderstorm and strong wind, and the propaganda and display device comprises a base box, four feet are arranged at the bottom of the base box, two vertical rods are arranged at the top of the base box, shielding mechanisms are arranged at the tops of the two vertical rods, a rotating column is rotatably arranged at the top of the base box, a display terminal is arranged at the top of the rotating column, reset springs are fixedly arranged at two sides of the display terminal and are fixedly connected with the vertical rods, and the plurality of reset springs provide reset elasticity for the display terminal. The utility model has simple structure, can conveniently move the whole body by retracting and releasing the four universal wheels, and can conveniently retract and protect the propaganda device.

title_en: Cable crane anchor ingot deformation measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable crane anchor ingot deformation measuring device, which relates to the field of measuring equipment and comprises a support column, wherein the upper end of the support column is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, an ultrasonic sensor is placed on the mounting plate, a frame body is mounted on the top surface of the mounting plate, sliding rods are arranged on the left side surface and the right side surface of the frame body in a penetrating manner, the sliding rods are in sliding connection with the frame body, L-shaped clamping plates are fixedly connected to one end of each of the two sliding rods, opposite sides of the two clamping plates are fixedly connected with a plurality of springs; the lower extreme fixedly connected with bottom plate of support column. According to the utility model, the ultrasonic sensor is conveniently and rapidly installed on the mounting plate by arranging the frame body, the sliding rod, the spring and the clamping plate, and the ultrasonic sensor is conveniently and rapidly detached from the mounting plate, so that the ultrasonic sensor is conveniently overhauled or replaced in the later period.

title_en: Wind pressure sensor convenient to install and fix
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wind pressure sensor convenient to install and fix, which comprises a sensor bottom shell, a sensor panel and a sensor upper cover, wherein detachable structures are arranged among the sensor bottom shell, the sensor panel and the sensor upper cover, a clamping mechanism is arranged in the sensor bottom shell, a jogged clamping groove and a positioning groove pipe are respectively arranged in the clamping mechanism, a positioning frame is fixedly welded on the surface of the rear end of the sensor panel, the upper end surface of the positioning frame is fixedly connected with a sensor main body through a locking screw, the sensor main body is correspondingly clamped and fixed with the jogged clamping groove, a plurality of positioning guide posts are arranged on the positioning frame, and the positioning guide posts are correspondingly connected with the positioning groove pipe. The sensor is assembled and fixed conveniently and provided with a plurality of convenient clamping and positioning guide mechanisms, so that the sensor can be positioned and installed quickly, and the sensor has the advantages of high installation precision and convenience in disassembly, assembly and maintenance.

title_en: Treadmill with better heat dissipation effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a running machine with a better heat dissipation effect, which belongs to the technical field of running machines and comprises a frame and a running belt, wherein a driving box is fixedly connected to the front side of the frame, a supporting frame is arranged on the outer side of the driving box, a touch control screen is arranged at the top of the supporting frame, a hand frame is arranged on one side of the supporting frame, a cooling box is fixedly connected to one side of the inner wall of the driving box, a cooling pipe is arranged at the bottom of the cooling box, and an adjusting motor and a driving motor are arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the driving box.

title_en: Mine monitoring and early warning device with wide monitoring range
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine monitoring and provides a mine monitoring and early warning device with a wide monitoring range, which comprises a base, a box body and heat dissipation grooves, wherein the top end of the base is fixedly provided with the box body, sound outlets are formed in two sides of the top of the box body, speakers are arranged on the inner wall of the box body on one side of the sound outlets, and the two ends of the top of the box body are provided with the heat dissipation grooves. According to the mine monitoring and early warning device, the adjusting structure is arranged, the electric push rod is started, the electric push rod can drive the second hinging seat to move on the outer side of the guide rod, the guide rod can drive the moving plate to move, the moving plate rotates on the top of the first hinging seat through the fixing seat, the moving plate drives the camera to move, the angle of the camera is changed, the angle adjusting function of the device is realized, and therefore the applicability of the mine monitoring and early warning device with a wide monitoring range in use is improved.

title_en: Flame-retardant elastomer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of materials, and provides a flame-retardant elastomer which comprises a surface layer, a fireproof layer, a tpe layer, a combined buffer layer and a cushion layer, wherein the surface layer is arranged at the top of the fireproof layer, the fireproof layer is arranged at the top of the tpe layer, the tpe layer is arranged at the top of the combined buffer layer, the combined buffer layer is arranged at the top of the cushion layer, and the combined buffer layer is formed by combining a first buffer layer and a second buffer layer. Can be under the circumstances that the outside catches fire through a plurality of fire-retardant core boards of flame retardant coating inside, can effectively separate outside condition of a fire to spread downwards, simultaneously when meetting outside impact, a plurality of buffering balls of the inside elastic buffer piece cooperation of first buffer layer can effectively absorb impact force, during the elastic buffer cover receives the impact to be compressed, inside gas presses to the inside of the inside rigid housing of second buffer layer through venthole and inlet port, and then drives the piston board and slides downwards, realizes certain buffering damping effect, two segmentation buffering, increase buffering stability.

title_en: Non-magnetic corrosion-resistant piston rod
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of piston rods and discloses a non-magnetic corrosion-resistant piston rod. In this application, the inner wall lower extreme of upper boom is provided with the screw, the lower extreme spiral of upper boom is provided with the lower beam, the upper end surface of lower beam is provided with the screw, the lower fixed surface of lower beam is connected with the connecting piece, the intermediate position of piston rod is provided with screw and screw, upper and lower part link together of piston rod through rotatory, reach the function of mergence, in general piston rod, all have not been designed the structure that can upper and lower part separate with the piston rod, this can lead to objects such as greasy dirt or piece to get into the piston rod and influence the work, and be difficult to carry out the operation of clearance, if use the piston rod structure of upper and lower part separation, can open the piston rod through rotatory and clean, improve the life of piston rod, also can improve the efficiency of piston rod work simultaneously.

title_en: Novel motor rotating shaft for direct current motor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of motors, in particular to a novel motor rotating shaft for a direct current motor, which comprises a shaft rod, wherein one end of the shaft rod is provided with a connecting shaft, the other end of the shaft rod is fixedly provided with a tail shaft, the outer side of the tail shaft is sleeved with a heat dissipation fan connecting seat, the surface of the shaft rod is provided with an auxiliary supporting mechanism, the auxiliary supporting mechanism consists of a sliding groove and an auxiliary supporting component, the shaft rod is detachably connected with the heat dissipation fan connecting seat through a fastening mechanism, the fastening mechanism consists of a fastening component and a pin groove, the shaft rod is fixed with the surface of the connecting shaft through the connecting mechanism, and the connecting mechanism consists of a fixing member, a slot and an inserting strip. The utility model not only improves the convenience degree of the motor rotating shaft when the connecting shaft is arranged, improves the stability of the motor rotating shaft when the motor rotating shaft is used, but also improves the firmness degree of the heat radiation fan when the motor rotating shaft is used.

title_en: Gearbox and mini-tiller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery and discloses a gearbox, which comprises a box body and a main shaft positioned in the box body, wherein a first auxiliary shaft and a second auxiliary shaft are arranged in the box body; the main shaft is connected with a gear shifting gear and a duplex gear, the gear shifting gear is provided with a gear shifting mechanism for shifting the gear shifting gear to slide along the axial direction of the main shaft, a first driven gear, a triple gear and a second driven gear are sequentially arranged on the first auxiliary shaft, and a third driven gear is arranged on the second auxiliary shaft in an empty sleeve manner; the double gear comprises a first gear and a second gear, and the triple gear comprises a third gear, a fourth gear and a fifth gear; the fifth gear is normally meshed with the first gear, and the second gear is normally meshed with the second driven gear; the shift gear is engageable with the first driven gear; the shift gear is engageable with the third gear; the shift gear may be meshed with a third driven gear, which is in constant mesh with a fourth gear. The utility model can assist an operator to save more labor when operating the mini-tiller.

title_en: Single-piece valve head convenient to replace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a single-piece valve head convenient to replace, which comprises a pipeline body, a thread seat, a first connecting piece, a single-piece valve body and a second connecting piece, wherein the right end face of the pipeline body is welded with the thread seat, the right side of the pipeline body is provided with the first connecting piece, the right side of the first connecting piece is provided with the single-piece valve body, and the left end and the right end of the single-piece valve body are respectively provided with the second connecting piece.

title_en: Reinforced glass fiber reinforced plastic pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reinforced glass fiber reinforced plastic pipeline, which relates to the technical field of glass fiber reinforced plastic pipelines and comprises a first pipeline, wherein the outer wall of the first pipeline is fixedly connected with a first disk, the first disk is penetrated and connected with a push rod in a sliding manner, the left side of the push rod is fixedly connected with a limiting block, the outer wall of the first disk, which is close to the push rod, is penetrated and connected with a round sleeve in a sliding manner, the outer wall of the round sleeve is fixedly connected with a rectangular block, the rectangular block is elastically connected with the first disk through a spring, the inner wall of the round sleeve is provided with a circular sliding groove, the first pipeline and the second pipeline are connected through the second disk, at the moment, a bolt rod is rotated into a threaded hole through a rotating connecting block to further reinforce the first pipeline and the second pipeline, the stability of the pipeline is improved when the pipeline passes through the threaded hole, other bolts just prepare the threaded hole when the limiting block passes through an opening, the alignment is not needed one by one, the installation time is shortened, and the efficiency of the installation work is improved.

title_en: Projector with high-stability support structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a projector with a high-stability support structure, which comprises a projector body, wherein four sides of the bottom of the projector body are provided with supporting legs; further comprises: the top of the bracket stretches into and rotates on the side edge of the projector body, the bracket is arranged in a concave shape, a gap exists between the upper end face of the bottom end of the bracket and the bottom of the projector body, and the bottom of the bracket is attached to the desktop; the bottom of the bracket stretches into and rotates with a rotating rod, the rear end of the rotating rod is connected with a gear in a key manner, and the gear rotates in the bracket; the upper end and the lower end of the gear are respectively meshed with a supporting plate, and the outer ends of the supporting plates are slidably clamped in the bracket; the top of the bracket stretches into the sliding clamp to be provided with a push rod. The backup pad is installed to this projecting apparatus, through rotating the bull stick, makes the bull stick rotate then and drives the backup pad and remove to make the backup pad remove the area of contact of increase support and desktop, thereby improved the stability when the projecting apparatus body is used.

title_en: Adjustable bolt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bolts and discloses an adjustable bolt which comprises a screw rod, a nut, a groove, a positioning hole, a long tube and a positioning rod. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the groove, the positioning hole, the long tube and the positioning rod, the screw rod can rotate and stretch in the nut, when the long tube enters the groove, the positioning rod can achieve buckling of the positioning hole on the inner wall of the groove, the length of the bolt can be adjusted, meanwhile, the anti-loosening effect is achieved, and the problem that the bolt cannot be suitable for screw holes with different depths due to incapability of adjusting the length is solved.

title_en: Indoor transverse gas pipeline installation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of gas engineering, in particular to an indoor transverse gas pipeline installation structure, which comprises a vertical fixing structure, wherein the vertical fixing structure comprises a vertical fixing plate, a vertical strip-shaped through hole is embedded in the central position of the fixing plate, an expansion bolt transversely penetrates through the strip-shaped through hole, rectangular bosses are respectively fixedly arranged on the left side surface and the right side surface of a screw rod of the expansion bolt, and rectangular clamping grooves matched with the rectangular bosses in a clamping manner are respectively vertically arranged and embedded on the left side surface and the right side surface of the strip-shaped through hole; the lateral surface of the bottom of the fixed plate is fixedly provided with a transverse plate, and a bearing assembly is detachably arranged on the transverse plate. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the installation structure can adjust the upper and lower heights, is convenient for the end part of the transverse pipeline to be connected with the inlet of the gas meter, has simple operation and convenient use, and is suitable for various places.

title_en: Guide rail mechanism of camera
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of camera guide rails, in particular to a guide rail mechanism of a camera. The utility model comprises two fixing frames, wherein round holes are formed in two ends of each fixing frame, sliding rails are fixedly connected to two ends of each fixing frame, an adjusting device is arranged on the lower surface of each fixing frame, each adjusting device comprises a fixing block, each fixing block is fixedly connected with the lower surface of each fixing frame, the surfaces of the fixing blocks are rotationally connected with two strip-shaped blocks, the surfaces of the strip-shaped blocks are slidably connected with first screws, the first screws are in threaded connection with the surfaces of the fixing blocks, reserved holes are formed in the surfaces of the strip-shaped blocks, telescopic blocks are slidably connected with the lower surfaces of the strip-shaped blocks, bolts are slidably connected with the surfaces of the strip-shaped blocks, springs are sleeved on the surfaces of the bolts, and rectangular plates are fixedly connected with the lower surfaces of the telescopic blocks. The problem that a worker is difficult to place the camera guide rail stably on uneven ground outdoors is solved.

title_en: Gear box oiling equipment of wind driven generator
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of oiling equipment, and discloses oiling equipment for a gearbox of a wind driven generator. According to the utility model, the transmission assembly is matched with the oil outlet assembly and the oil injection assembly, so that the double filtration of lubricating oil can be performed, the quality of the lubricating oil is improved, the damage to the gear box is avoided, meanwhile, the transmission efficiency of the gear box can be improved, and in addition, the oil injection equipment can be disassembled according to the requirement through the mutual matching of the structure, so that the use convenience of the oil injection equipment can be improved.

title_en: Anti-deformation steel connecting piece
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-deformation steel connecting piece, which comprises a straight angle steel connecting piece, wherein the right angle steel connecting piece comprises a first connecting plate, a second connecting plate and an arc-shaped connecting section, connecting grooves are formed in the middle of the outer surfaces of one side of the first connecting plate and the second connecting plate, a reinforcing connecting rod piece is connected between the first connecting plate and the second connecting plate, the reinforcing connecting rod piece comprises a reinforcing rod, a rectangular inserting block, a second threaded hole and a dovetail clamping block, dovetail clamping grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the upper portion of the outer surface of the front end of the first connecting plate, rectangular slots are formed in the left side and the right side of the outer surface of the upper end of the second connecting plate, which is far away from one end of the arc-shaped connecting section, first threaded holes are formed in one end of the outer surfaces of the two sides of the second connecting plate, and the first threaded holes are communicated with the rectangular slots. The deformation-preventing steel connecting piece has the advantages of being convenient to improve the strength of the right-angle steel connecting piece, preventing deformation, prolonging the service life and the like.

title_en: Universal mobile device of field operations medical treatment health tent
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to a universal moving device for a field medical and sanitary tent. The utility model mainly relates to a universal mobile device of a field medical and health tent, which comprises: the tent comprises a tent body, a supporting seat, universal wheels, a universal wheel lifting mechanism and a hydraulic control device, wherein the universal wheels are fixedly arranged on the universal wheel lifting mechanism, and the universal wheel lifting mechanism is arranged in the supporting seat; the universal wheel lifting mechanism comprises a piston rod, a piston, a disc spring and a mounting seat; the whole set of mechanism is provided with six sets of universal wheel lifting mechanisms which are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the tent through supporting seats respectively; six universal wheels stretch out simultaneously under elevating system's effect, contact ground level back, and field operations medical treatment health tent just can freely remove the position that needs through the manual mode this moment, not only use manpower sparingly like this, have practicality and humanization, can also shorten the installation of field operations medical treatment health tent, the mobility time improves field operations medical treatment and goes out dynamic ageing by a wide margin.

title_en: Metal sealing ring
abstract_en: A metal seal ring comprising: the sealing ring comprises a sealing ring body, wherein 4 side lines of the cross section of a ring body of the sealing ring body are respectively formed into inwards concave curves. And the first auxiliary sealing piece is arranged on the outer wall of the sealing ring body. The auxiliary seal includes: the laminating ring and two inner folding rings, wherein, the laminating ring sets up on sealing washer body outer wall, and two inner folding rings set up respectively at the both ends of laminating ring, and the laminating face of laminating ring and the recess phase-match that the inside concave curve of sealing washer body outer wall formed. One end of the inner folding ring is connected with the attaching ring, and the bending part of the inner folding ring bends towards the direction of the sealing ring body, wherein the two inner folding rings are symmetrically arranged, and a gap exists between the two inner folding rings. Therefore, the sealing device has better pressure bearing performance and compression rebound characteristic, and can provide good sealing effect.

title_en: Novel pneumatic ventilation butterfly valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel pneumatic ventilation butterfly valve, which comprises a valve shell, wherein an upper gland and a lower gland are fixedly arranged at the top end of the valve shell and the bottom end of a valve cover, bearing supports are arranged at the opposite ends of the two upper and lower glands, a bearing fixed cover plate is arranged at the bottom end of one bearing support, the upper and lower glands are arranged at the top end of the other bearing support, a valve plate is arranged in the valve shell, an upper valve rod penetrating the bearing support and a lower valve rod penetrating the bearing support are respectively arranged at the two ends of the valve plate.

title_en: Mounting structure of projector
abstract_en: The application provides a mounting structure of a projector, which comprises a sliding rail; the first adjusting piece comprises a sliding block and a first adjusting rod, the sliding block is attached to the outer surface of the sliding rail and used for adjusting the position of the projector in the horizontal direction, the first adjusting rod is in a cylindrical ring shape and is attached to the adjusting block, and the adjusting rod is perpendicular to the sliding rail; the second adjusting piece comprises a second adjusting rod, a spherical adjusting piece and a fixing piece, wherein the second adjusting piece is arranged in a cylindrical shape in the first adjusting rod and attached to the inner surface of the first adjusting rod, the fixing piece is provided with a spherical groove, and the spherical adjusting piece is arranged in the spherical groove and attached to the second adjusting rod. The installation structure of the projector provided by the utility model adopts the combination of the sliding rail and the connecting rod, so that the projector can be freely adjusted in the horizontal and vertical directions, and the spherical adjusting piece has the rotation capability of multiple degrees of freedom, so that the angle adjustment is more flexible.

title_en: Alarm bell convenient to dismantle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of alarm bells and discloses an alarm bell convenient to detach, which comprises an alarm bell body, wherein the top end of the alarm bell body is fixedly connected with an alarm bell seat, the top end of the alarm bell seat is provided with a hanging mechanism, the hanging mechanism comprises two hanging angle blocks, the upper ends of the back surfaces of the two hanging angle blocks are respectively fixedly connected with a hanging inserting rod, the hanging mechanism also comprises two butt joint supporting seats, the lower ends of the front surfaces of the two butt joint supporting seats are respectively provided with a butt joint inserting hole, the upper ends of the two butt joint supporting seats are respectively movably inserted with a limiting pin rod, the front surfaces of the two limiting pin rods are respectively provided with a stable pressing plate, and the outer walls of the rear ends of the two limiting pin rods are respectively movably sleeved with a reset pressing spring. The hanging mechanism is arranged, so that the device can be stably fixed on the roof, the functions of convenient disassembly and installation of the device are effectively realized, and meanwhile, the device is simple in structure, easy to operate and convenient to disassemble for daily maintenance.

title_en: Mounting structure of high-precision resistance strain gauge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mounting structure of a high-precision resistance strain gauge, which comprises a fixed box, a sensing converter and a high-precision resistance strain gauge attached to a piece to be detected, wherein the sensing converter is electrically connected with the high-precision resistance strain gauge through two wires. According to the utility model, under the interaction of the fixed box, the sensor, the high-precision resistance strain gauge, the supporting plate, the first threaded rod, the supporting plate, the second threaded rod, the balancing weight and the pressing device, the supporting plate can support the fixed box, the balancing weight can fix the fixed box above the detection sheet, the second threaded rod can descend through the pressing plate in the pressing device until the pressing plate presses the detection sheet, the pressing mode is more time-saving and labor-saving, and meanwhile, the pressure applying ruler can measure the height between the bottom of the water plate and the high-precision resistance strain gauge, so that the pressing plate can apply stable pressing force to the high-precision resistance strain gauge, and the high-precision resistance strain gauge and the detection sheet can be better attached.

title_en: Sheet metal part for connection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sheet metal parts and discloses a sheet metal part for connection, which comprises a clamping cross rod, wherein a first connecting rod is movably sleeved inside one side of the clamping cross rod, a built-in cross rod is sleeved inside one side of the rear end of the clamping cross rod, a second connecting rod is movably sleeved outside one side of the front end of the clamping cross rod, a fixed vertical rod is sleeved outside one side of the front end of the clamping cross rod, a third connecting rod is movably sleeved at the lower end of the fixed vertical rod, a nut is fixedly arranged on one side of the inner wall of the built-in cross rod, a bolt is sleeved inside the nut, the clamping cross rod comprises a clamping connecting rod, a clamping groove is formed in one side of the clamping cross rod, and a first connecting groove is formed in the other side of the clamping cross rod. The sheet metal part can be connected with three objects, and is assisted by mutual clamping reduction tools during connection, and connection is realized only by fixing a single bolt, so that the operation is avoided, the sheet metal part is convenient to install and detach, and the waste can be reduced by recycling.

title_en: Connecting rod type opening and closing mechanism of ascending pipe water seal valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a connecting rod type opening and closing mechanism of a riser water seal valve, which comprises a water seal valve body, a valve disc shaft, a counterweight rod, a counterweight block and a connecting rod mechanism, wherein the valve disc is arranged on the water seal valve body through the valve disc shaft and is connected with the counterweight block through the counterweight rod; the connecting rod mechanism consists of a connecting rod, a driving rod and a connecting shaft; the actuating lever is L shape, and its inflection point department passes through connecting axle and water seal valve body coupling, and the valve disc is connected through the connecting rod to the one end of actuating lever, and the pull rod is connected to the other end of actuating lever. According to the utility model, the valve disc shaft and the connecting shaft in the connecting rod mechanism are arranged on the water seal valve body, so that the installation precision is effectively improved, the problem of installation and adjustment of the coke oven in a cold and hot state is solved, and the device has the characteristics of compact structure, low failure rate, high safety, accurate opening and closing positions and the like.

title_en: Support for land survey and drawing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a support for land mapping, which relates to the technical field of land mapping and comprises a supporting unit, a mapping unit arranged above the supporting unit, a rotation adjusting unit arranged between the supporting unit and the mapping unit, and a connecting unit arranged in the mapping unit, wherein the connecting unit is arranged on the connecting unit; the rotation adjusting unit comprises a fixed disc arranged at the top of the supporting unit, a rotating shaft movably arranged in the fixed disc, a gear disc arranged on the side wall of the rotating shaft, and a clamping piece arranged in the fixed disc; the connecting unit comprises a moving through hole formed in the side wall of the mapping unit, a moving column movably penetrating through the moving through hole and arranged in the moving through hole, a stretching seat arranged at one end of the moving column, and a clamping seat arranged at the other end of the moving column. The utility model relates to a support for land mapping, which is provided with an adjusting unit and a connecting unit through the adjusting unit and the connecting unit.

title_en: H-shaped steel structure oil supply device of gear box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vapor compressors, and particularly discloses an H-shaped steel structure oil supply device of a gear box, which comprises an oil station tail steel plate, a narrow flange H-shaped steel structure, an oil tank rear baffle, an oil tank upper baffle, a gear box base, an oil tank front baffle, an oil tank bottom baffle and rib blocks. The H-shaped steel is used for replacing plates, ANSYS is used for carrying out finite element analysis on the oil station structure, the design and use requirements are met, welding spots of the device are reduced, reliability is improved, weight is reduced, and meanwhile manufacturing cost, inventory cost and transportation cost can be reduced.

title_en: Automobile steering oil return pipe assembly
abstract_en: An automobile steering oil return pipe assembly belongs to the technical field of steering oil return pipe assemblies; the connecting device comprises an oil tank, a liquid outlet pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the oil tank, a first hose is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the liquid outlet pipe, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the outer end of the first hose, an installation component is installed on the outer portion of the connecting pipe, and the installation component comprises a first spiral pipe fixedly connected to the outer end of the connecting pipe. According to the automobile steering oil return pipe assembly, the positions of the assembly pipe and the steering machine are checked, the assembly pipe and the steering machine are positioned by rotating the nuts, the first spiral pipe and the second spiral pipe with conical structures are adopted, the conical structures are designed to enable the assembly pipe and the steering machine to be installed in a rotating mode to be tighter more behind, so that the booster pump can be installed with the connecting pipe and the second hose more stably and closely, oil leakage can be effectively prevented, and whether the nuts are hung on the outer wall of the assembly pipe all the time before or after installation, and the nuts can be achieved.

title_en: Cover-lifting locking protector for external CD driver
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cover lifting locking protection device of an external CD driver, which comprises a connecting seat, wherein the surface of the connecting seat is provided with a supporting mechanism, the supporting mechanism is used for enhancing the supporting capability of the cover lifting, the surface of the connecting seat is provided with a protection mechanism, the protection mechanism comprises an outer cover and a base, the outer cover is in an arch bridge shape, two ends of the outer cover are fixed with the top of the connecting seat, the connecting seat is connected with the base through a rotating assembly, and the surface of the base is provided with a limit groove. This lift lid locking protection device of external CD-ROM drive is accomplished through placing external CD-ROM drive, and the connecting seat is the flexible glue material and can entangle outside CD-ROM drive, then places the connecting seat on outside CD-ROM drive's surface, through when receiving outside heavy object to drop the striking, contact earlier at the dustcoat, thereby outside heavy object can realize the bullet and open under the effect of the shape of dustcoat and offset cap and offset post to realize the protection to the shell.

title_en: Hydraulic pipeline supporting and connecting device for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and discloses a hydraulic pipeline supporting and connecting device for hydraulic engineering, which comprises a bottom frame, wherein an inner threaded pipe is inserted in the bottom frame, a screw rod is connected in the inner threaded pipe, a first worm is movably connected in the bottom frame, a rotating shaft is inserted in the bottom frame, the outer surfaces of the first worm and the rotating shaft are fixedly connected with a driving sprocket, the outer surface of the driving sprocket is in transmission connection with a driving chain, the height of the device can be adjusted according to actual use requirements, the practicability of the device is improved, a sliding groove is formed in the upper surface of a supporting seat, a sliding block is movably connected in the sliding groove, a threaded sleeve is inserted in the sliding block, an arc supporting seat is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the sliding block, and the distance between the arc supporting seats can be adjusted, so that the device can be adjusted according to the specifications of a pipeline and can be ensured to stably support the pipeline.

title_en: Thermal pipeline heat preservation cloth and laying device thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses thermal pipeline heat-insulating cloth and a paving device thereof, and relates to the technical field of pipeline heat insulation; the glass fiber cloth main body has the characteristics of chemical stability, corrosion resistance, sealing property, high lubrication non-tackiness, electrical insulation and good ageing resistance, the polyurethane foam material is matched with the glass fiber cloth main body to provide multiple heat insulation for the pipeline, the corrosion-resistant coating can promote longer service life, and the corrosion-resistant coating can be adhered to the outer wall of the pipeline through the colloid layer.

title_en: Fire sound and light alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire sound and light alarm device which comprises a fire sound and light alarm and a mounting seat, wherein the fire sound and light alarm comprises an alarm lamp, an alarm main body and a wiring pipe, a plurality of clamping blocks are fixedly arranged on the side wall of the bottom of the alarm main body, four lug plates are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the mounting seat, threaded holes are formed in the lug plates, vertical grooves with the same number as the clamping blocks are formed in the inner side wall of the mounting seat, a sliding groove is formed in the inner side wall of the mounting seat and below the vertical grooves, clamping grooves for clamping the clamping blocks are formed in the inner side wall of the mounting seat, a sliding plate is arranged in the sliding groove, the mounting seat is fixed on a wall through bolts, the fire sound and light alarm clamping blocks slide into the vertical grooves, the sliding plate is pushed up to rotate the fire sound and light alarm until the clamping blocks are clamped in the clamping grooves, the sliding plate clamps are clamped, the fire sound and light alarm can be mounted in the mounting seat, and when the fire sound and light alarm is dismounted, the fire sound and light alarm can be dismounted by bare hands.

title_en: Pipeline stop valve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pipeline stop valve which comprises a valve body and a valve core, wherein a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet are respectively arranged at two ends of the valve body, a valve seat is arranged in a valve cavity, a driving unit is arranged at the front end of the valve core, the driving unit drives the valve core to linearly move relative to the valve seat to close or open a valve port between the liquid inlet and the liquid outlet, a diaphragm is arranged between the valve core and the valve seat to form a sealing structure, and the diaphragm is turned over to adapt to relative movement between the valve core and the valve seat when the driving unit drives the valve core to move. A diaphragm is arranged between the valve core and the valve seat to form a sealing structure, and the reliable sealing effect of the valve core relative to the valve seat in the moving process can be ensured through the overturning action of the diaphragm; the diaphragm cannot rub with the valve core and the valve seat, and abrasion is avoided; the valve port is opened and closed in a pneumatic mode, so that the response is rapid, and the quick on-off of the pipeline can be ensured; the whole driving unit is arranged in the pipeline stop valve, and the pipeline stop valve is small in size and beneficial to arrangement of pipelines.

title_en: Drag pipe obstacle crossing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a drag pipe obstacle crossing mechanism which comprises a drag pipe, a pipe clamping mechanism and a traveling mechanism, wherein the drag pipe is connected with the pipe clamping mechanism; the pipeline clamping mechanism clamps the dragging pipeline, the pipeline clamping mechanism is fixedly connected with the middle fixing plate and the lower base through the guide shaft and the fixing screw rod, the running mechanism and the supporting legs are fixedly connected with the middle fixing plate through the running mechanism fixing device, the supporting legs are located on the ground, and when the pipeline clamping mechanism works, the lifting handle is rocked to enable the whole device to move up and down with the dragging pipeline. The drag pipe obstacle crossing mechanism can realize crossing of obstacles through the interaction of the lifting handle, the turbine and the gear without an additional power source and matched with a tractor, and is simple and convenient to use; through setting up pipeline clamping mechanism and running gear, solved and pulled the pipe and stumbled the unable removal by the barrier easily, pulled the pipe outer wall damage that leads to under powerful dragging, appear pulling the pipe and roll, knot scheduling problem.

title_en: Automatic pressure release mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of oil cylinders, and particularly relates to an automatic pressure relief mechanism, which comprises an oil cylinder, wherein one side of the oil cylinder is communicated with a three-way pipe, one end of the three-way pipe is communicated with a hydraulic oil pipe, the other end of the three-way pipe is connected with one end of an oil storage shell, a pressure transmitter is arranged on the side face of the three-way pipe, an electric cylinder is arranged in the oil storage shell, a piston rod of the electric cylinder is connected with a piston, an air filter and a control mechanism are arranged on the side face of the oil storage shell, and the oil storage shell and the oil cylinder are clamped in a fixing piece. Under the feedback of the pressure transmitter, the electric cylinder stretches to drive the piston to move, so that the oil body in the oil cylinder can complete safe pressure relief, and the oil body can be supplemented into the oil cylinder to enable the oil cylinder to work normally.

title_en: Dual antidetonation cable support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double anti-seismic cable support, which belongs to the technical field of cable supports and comprises a U-shaped frame and a first adjusting rod, wherein a first connecting groove is formed in the side face of the U-shaped frame, first clamping holes are formed in the two opposite sides of the inside of the first connecting groove, a first connecting box is fixedly connected to the other side face of the U-shaped frame, mounting blocks are respectively and fixedly connected to the two ends of the first adjusting rod, and a second adjusting rod is fixedly connected to the bottom of the mounting block; the novel U-shaped frame has the beneficial effects that through the arrangement of the first connecting box and the first connecting groove, people can adjust the length of the bracket by increasing or reducing the number of the spliced U-shaped frames, and meanwhile, under the action of the second connecting box and the second connecting groove, people can conveniently install and connect the first adjusting rod with the U-shaped frames, and through the arrangement of the rubber block, the novel U-shaped frame plays a damping effect when an external vibration cable rises and falls, so that the damage of vibration to the cable is reduced.

title_en: Computer software platform convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of software platforms, in particular to a computer software platform convenient to adjust and a storage cabinet, which is a software platform supporting part, wherein both sides of the software platform supporting part are provided with a wire connection pipe, a sliding chute and a positioning hole. The utility model overcomes the defects of the prior art, a user can turn the sliding plates at two sides of the lifting platform to a horizontal position, the locating rods at the back of the sliding plates move out of the locating holes at two sides of the storage cabinet, the user can drive the lifting platform to move up and down through the sliding plates, the height of the software development platform can be fixed after the sliding plates and the locating rods are reset, the user can drive the rotating platform to rotate only by dragging the rotating rod, the damping balls at two sides inside the lifting platform can help the rotating platform to stagnate, the user drags the lug to translate through the thumb, the limit on the driving plate is eliminated, the driving plate is poked through the index finger or the middle finger, and the driving plate rotates to drive the software development platform to adjust the elevation angle.

title_en: Foot massage instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foot massage instrument, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an openable combined box body is arranged on the bottom plate; the combined box body comprises a first movable box body, a second movable box body and a limiting buffer device, wherein the first movable box body is slidably connected to the left half part of the bottom plate, the second movable box body is slidably connected to the right half part of the bottom plate, the first movable box body is in fit connection with the second movable box body, the limiting buffer devices are symmetrically arranged, and the limiting buffer device is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate; the utility model has the advantages that: external force is applied to the first movable box body and the second movable box body, and the first movable box body and the second movable box body slide on the bottom plate, so that the opening and closing of the combined box body are realized along with the sliding of the first movable box body and the second movable box body on the bottom plate, and the structure inside the combined box body is conveniently cleaned and overhauled quickly.

title_en: Anti-collision transfer box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transfer boxes and discloses an anti-collision transfer box which comprises a bottom plate and a box body, wherein the upper end face of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with the box body, the middle part of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a motor, the upper end face of the motor is fixedly provided with a rope sleeve, the outer part of the rope sleeve is provided with a steel wire rope, both ends of the steel wire rope are fixedly connected with buckles, both buckles are fixedly connected with storage seats, a plurality of storage mechanisms are fixedly arranged in both storage seats, a plurality of anti-collision mechanisms are fixedly arranged outside the box body, and one end, far away from the box body, of each anti-collision mechanism is fixedly connected with an anti-collision shell. According to the utility model, the plurality of independent storage mechanisms are arranged, the door stamping parts are placed in the storage mechanisms, collision between the door stamping parts is reduced, the anti-collision mechanism and the anti-collision shell are arranged to be used in a matched mode, rollover is prevented, objects can be respectively lifted and lowered from two directions, and the steel wire rope is electrically used for pulling the two storage seats, so that manual pushing is not needed, and the automobile door stamping parts are more convenient and labor-saving.

title_en: Brake disc and automobile
abstract_en: The application provides a brake disc and an automobile, wherein the brake disc comprises a brake disc body and radiating fins; the brake disc body is provided with a hollow ventilation cavity and a plurality of ventilation channels communicated with the ventilation cavity; the ventilation cavity is communicated with the outer space of the brake disc body through the ventilation channel; at least part of the ventilating channels are embedded with the radiating fins, and the heat conductivity coefficient of the radiating fins is higher than that of the brake disc body. In the technical scheme, the brake disc is changed into the hollow structure, and the radiating fins are additionally arranged in the brake disc, so that the radiating effect of the brake disc is improved.

title_en: Metal diaphragm valve
abstract_en: The application discloses a metal diaphragm valve, and relates to the technical field of valves. The application relates to a metal diaphragm valve which comprises a valve body, a valve groove, a diaphragm, an actuator, a valve cavity and a flow path, wherein the flow path is provided with a flow port communicated with the valve cavity, a valve seat is arranged in the valve cavity, the valve seat is annular and is wound on the periphery of the flow port, a mounting groove is formed in the valve seat along the surrounding direction of the valve seat, a soft valve core is embedded in the mounting groove, and the valve core protrudes out of the mounting groove. According to the metal diaphragm valve, the valve core replaces a valve seat I in the prior art, and the valve core is protected through the valve seat, so that fluid can only contact with the protruding end of the valve core when passing through a flow path, the flushing of the valve core by the fluid is reduced, the abrasion and aging of the valve core are reduced, and the stability of a CV value is improved; simultaneously, with the case holding in the mounting groove, the cell wall of mounting groove can wrap up the case, has effectually avoided the case to produce the deformation after long-term use, has further promoted the stability of CV value.

title_en: Movable pneumatic compression equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of pneumatic compression equipment, in particular to movable pneumatic compression equipment, which comprises a pneumatic compressor, wherein the bottom of the pneumatic compressor is provided with a mounting groove, the bottom of the mounting groove is provided with a bottom plate, the bottom of the bottom plate is provided with a cavity, and the inside of the cavity is provided with a connecting plate; this movable pneumatic compression equipment utilizes the wheel that can install the dismantlement to conveniently remove pneumatic compressor's position to can not influence pneumatic compressor's normal use, strengthen pneumatic compressor's practicality, need not carry pneumatic compressor through the manual work, solved general pneumatic compression equipment simple structure and the volume is great, the staff is more time consuming and laborious when need carrying pneumatic compression equipment, can increase the work burden of carrying pneumatic compression equipment, and reduced pneumatic compression equipment overall practicality's problem, improved this movable pneumatic compression equipment's efficiency.

title_en: Remote sensing monitoring device for flood control
