abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring and provides a remote sensing monitoring device for flood control, which comprises a monitoring device main body, wherein the monitoring device main body comprises a base, a control box body is arranged on the base, a mounting seat and a motor box are arranged in the control box body, a gear assembly is arranged on the mounting seat, a vertical rod assembly is arranged on the gear assembly, a transverse mounting rod is arranged at one end, far away from the control box body, of the vertical rod assembly, a plurality of mounting bases are arranged on the transverse mounting rod, radar water level sensors are detachably arranged in the mounting bases, a telescopic protection assembly is arranged on the vertical rod assembly, and fixing screws are arranged on two sides, located on the control box body, of the base; the integral height of the vertical rod assembly is adjusted through the adjusting bolt, so that the height of the radar water level sensor is conveniently adjusted.

title_en: Amplifier energy-saving device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving device of an amplifier, which comprises a first planet carrier shell and a second planet carrier shell, wherein a shell is fixedly connected to the outer part of the first planet carrier shell, a worm wheel is rotationally connected to the inner part of the shell, a rotating shaft is rotationally connected to the inner side of the shell, and a pressing plate is fixedly connected to one side, away from the worm wheel, of the outer part of the rotating shaft, and the beneficial effects achieved by the utility model are that: when planet carrier second shell and the first shell of planet carrier are assembled, the mounting panel will insert in the casing, forward screwing is carried out to the worm through the knob this moment, the worm will drive the worm wheel and rotate, the worm wheel utilizes inboard tooth and the pivot of four different positions of gear drive with it to rotate simultaneously, the pivot drives the clamp plate and rotates and get into in the recess in the mounting panel outside to compress tightly the bottom of recess inner wall, accomplish the connection between planet carrier second shell and the first shell of planet carrier at last, reverse screwing worm can when unpacking, convenient operation is laborsaving.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of displays, in particular to a display. Including base subassembly, adjusting part, installation component, grafting subassembly, base subassembly includes base, display screen, the lower extreme of base is connected with the universal wheel, adjusting part includes the electricity push rod, the output of electricity push rod is connected with braced bottom plate, braced bottom plate's top is connected with the supporting column, installation component includes the installation bottom plate, the inboard of sliding tray is provided with the sliding plate, the lower extreme of fixed plate is connected with grafting stand, the one end of grafting stand is connected with the plugboard. After inserting the stand that pegs graft to the first slot the inside and fixing the board of pegging graft, the lower extreme of display screen is located the supporting baseplate this moment above, through the setting of protection pad for with the direct laminating of display screen, improve the frictional force each other with the display screen when avoiding causing wearing and tearing to the display screen, and then guarantee supporting baseplate supports the steadiness of display screen.

title_en: High-speed power transmission test connection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed power transmission testing connection device, which comprises a connection shaft, wherein the left end and the right end of the connection shaft are respectively a loading motor connection end and a device to be tested connection end, and the connection shaft mainly comprises a first spline shaft, an oil seal shaft and a second spline shaft; the first spline shaft can be in spline connection with a power device to be tested, a flange plate with a shaft sleeve is connected to the second spline shaft, and the second spline shaft is in spline connection with the shaft sleeve; the oil seal shaft is arranged close to the first spline shaft and is used for being matched with a power device to be tested, a first pair of center shafts are arranged between the oil seal shaft and the first spline shaft, a second pair of center shafts are also arranged between the second spline shaft and the oil seal shaft, the first pair of center shafts and the second pair of center shafts are shaft bodies with large middle diameters and small diameters at two ends, the shaft faces of the shaft bodies are arc-shaped, and the middle parts of the second pair of center shafts are propped against the inner wall of a shaft sleeve center hole and are coaxial with the shaft sleeve and the first pair of center shafts.

title_en: Industrial lubricating oil injection device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of lubricating oil, and discloses an industrial lubricating oil injection device. According to the technical scheme, under the transmission action of the bidirectional screw rod and the transmission sleeve and the corresponding downward thrust provided by the pushing rod to the extruding plate, the driving force of the horizontal movement of the transmission frame can be transmitted to the extruding plate to enable the extruding plate to vertically descend in the oil storage tank to move a power source required by the vertical descending, so that semisolid lubricant in the oil storage tank is extruded and pushed down, and the lubricant discharging speed is increased.

title_en: Bearing with improved sealing performance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bearing for improving sealing performance, which comprises an outer ring, an inner ring and steel balls uniformly distributed at the gap between the outer ring and the inner ring, wherein arc grooves matched with the steel balls are formed in the inner cambered surface of the outer ring and the inner cambered surface of the inner ring, retainers are symmetrically arranged at the gap between the outer ring and the inner ring left and right, the two retainers are fixedly connected, the steel balls are distributed in arc openings correspondingly arranged on the opposite inner sides of the two retainers, annular plates are arranged on the outer sides of the retainers, sealing assemblies are arranged on the outer sides of the annular plates through uniformly arranged connecting assemblies, mounting grooves are formed in the inner cambered surface and the outer cambered surface of the annular plates, and sealing gaskets are arranged in the mounting grooves. This improve sealing performance's bearing carries out multistage seal through the gap department to outer lane and inner circle to improve bearing holistic sealing performance greatly, inner structure's installation convenient and fast more moreover.

title_en: Air source heat pump installing support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air source heat pump mounting bracket, which belongs to the field of pump mounting parts and comprises a base body and mounting hole sites, wherein the mounting hole sites are positioned on the side wall of the base body, the supporting part of the base body is a lower plate part, a waist hole is formed in the lower plate part, the lower part of the side end of the base body is an extension part, a fastening piece for fixing an air source heat pump is arranged between the extension part and the lower plate part, the fastening piece comprises a connecting plate and a connecting bolt, and the connecting plate is fixed on the extension part through a screw. The waist hole is formed in the end face of the base, the fastening piece matched with the air source heat pump is arranged at the waist hole, the fastening piece is connected with the air source heat pump in a fastening mode through the connecting plate, the screw rod and the fastening bolt, the compression resistance of the base is effectively improved due to the fact that the triangular stable design is formed between the connecting plate and the base, the plurality of sleeves are sleeved on the screw rod, the position of the connecting bolt at the waist hole can be adjusted according to the position of the screw hole at the lower end of the air source heat pump, and a user can conveniently adjust according to actual conditions.

title_en: Modularized underwater robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of underwater operation equipment, in particular to a modularized underwater robot which comprises an upper shell, a bottom plate, a lower shell and a mechanical arm, wherein the upper shell and the lower shell are respectively and fixedly connected to the upper side and the lower side of the bottom plate, the upper shell and the bottom plate enclose a closed upper chamber for accommodating an electric element, and the lower shell and the bottom plate enclose a closed lower chamber for accommodating a battery; the mechanical arm is arranged on the lower side of the bottom plate; the upper shell is provided with a lifting steering engine and a propeller. The battery and the electric element of the control part are arranged separately, so that the battery can be replaced conveniently, and the waterproof effect of the electric element part is improved; the device has the advantages of simple and reliable structure and convenient operation, can meet various operation requirements, and can be suitable for various fields of underwater shooting, illumination, searching, culture fishing and the like.

title_en: Rotatable coupling mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable connecting mechanism which comprises a lower gauge head bolt, wherein the inner wall of the lower gauge head bolt is provided with a shaft hole, a sealing bearing is fixedly embedded in the inner wall of the shaft hole, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected with the inner ring of the sealing bearing, an upper gauge head bolt is arranged above the lower gauge head bolt, a group of round holes are formed in the bottom surface of the upper gauge head bolt, a group of threaded holes are formed in the upper surface of the lower gauge head bolt, a sign is arranged below the lower gauge head bolt, and the back surface of the sign is fixedly connected with the outer surface of the connecting pipe. The device utilizes the cooperation of the sealing bearing and the shaft hole to drive the gauge body to rotate conveniently by the sealing bearing, the shaft hole, the connecting pipe, the lower gauge head bolt and the upper gauge head bolt, and the device can play a role in stabilizing sealing, so that the cooperation is combined, the staff can watch the content displayed by the gauge body conveniently, and the work of the staff can not be influenced.

title_en: Protection device for wind power coupling torque limiter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protection device for a wind power coupling torque limiter, which comprises: the apron, and set up two fixed plates of apron bottom, and set up the coupling assembling of apron and fixed plate both sides, with filter component and the installation mechanism of setting on the apron, coupling assembling includes: the utility model provides a torque limiter, including first draw-in groove, with the draw-in hole that sets up on first draw-in groove to and the connecting cover of setting on first draw-in groove, the below of connecting the lid is provided with the limiting plate, the both sides of limiting plate respectively with the homonymy fixed connection of two fixed plates, just one side of limiting plate is provided with sliding unit, through two fixed plates that the apron bottom set up, apron and fixed plate cover are established in the torque limiter outside, and the axostylus axostyle at torque limiter both ends is placed in placing the hole, later will install limiting plate and connecting cover and apron joint, thereby when protecting the torque limiter, avoid the protective housing to cause the friction to the pivot, improve the availability factor of pivot.

title_en: Fire alarm structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire alarm structure in the field of alarms, which comprises a shell provided with a cavity, wherein the outer side surface of the shell is connected with at least one broadcaster, a base is arranged below the shell, the base is connected with a first support shaft supported at the bottom of the shell, the top of the first support shaft is also provided with a second support shaft inserted into the bottom of the shell, the outer side surface of the top of the second support shaft is provided with an annular block horizontally extending to the inside of the shell, a lamp holder and a warning lamp assembled at the top of the lamp holder are arranged above the shell, the outer side of the warning lamp is covered with an explosion-proof net with the bottom fixed at the outer side surface of the lamp holder, the outer side surface of the lamp holder is provided with at least two sliding grooves sliding downwards from the top, the bottom of each sliding groove is provided with a sunken clamping position, and the bottom of each explosion-proof net is provided with at least two clamping joints which are clamped into the corresponding clamping positions after bending. The base of casing bottom can be according to the direction of broadcasting outside the position adjustment broadcaster of difference, need not dismantle the alarm and install again, and the explosion-proof net at top is fixed to the terminal through the spout quick landing, convenient dismantlement.

title_en: Full-rubber damping bushing
abstract_en: The utility model provides an all-rubber shock-absorbing bushing, and belongs to the technical field of automobile accessories. It has solved current car shock attenuation bush buffering shock attenuation effect subalternation problem. The full rubber shock absorption bushing comprises a full rubber bushing body, wherein an inner reinforcing sleeve is fixedly arranged at the center of an inner cavity of the full rubber bushing body, outer reinforcing sleeves are sleeved on the left side and the right side of the full rubber bushing body, a linear buffer assembly is arranged between the left side and the right side of the inner reinforcing sleeve and the outer reinforcing sleeve, and an inner hexagon bolt is arranged on one side, far away from the full rubber bushing body, of the outer reinforcing sleeve in a penetrating mode. The utility model has the advantage of linear buffering, ensures the whole damping and buffering performance of the component and effectively prolongs the service life of the full-rubber bushing body.

title_en: Electric furnace for smelting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric furnace for smelting, which comprises a furnace body, a furnace body cover plate, a stirring shaft and a stirring impeller, wherein the furnace body cover plate is arranged at the position of the mouth of the furnace body, the stirring shaft penetrates through the furnace body cover plate and is inserted into the furnace body, the stirring impeller is arranged on the stirring shaft and is used for stirring discrete smelting materials in the furnace body, a first fluid dynamic sealing assembly is arranged between the furnace body cover plate and the mouth of the furnace body, a second fluid dynamic sealing assembly is arranged between the insertion position of the stirring shaft and the stirring shaft on the furnace body cover plate, and an electric heating element for heating the smelting materials in the furnace body is arranged on one surface of the furnace body cover plate facing the inside of the furnace body. The utility model improves the production efficiency of smelting and has less equipment investment.

title_en: Preview display device for advertisement design and manufacture
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of display devices, in particular to a preview display device for advertisement design and production, which comprises an advertisement screen and a base for previewing and displaying advertisements, and further comprises a dustproof component for blowing air to the surface of the advertisement screen, wherein the advertisement screen is fixedly arranged on the dustproof component, and the dustproof component is rotationally connected to the base through a driving component, and the utility model has the beneficial effects that: under the effect of dustproof subassembly, can be to being used for previewing advertisement display screen to blow the operation continuously to can form the air current curtain on advertisement screen surface, can effectively keep off external dust adhesion at advertisement screen surface, be favorable to advertisement screen's show operation, and can carry out forced air cooling heat dissipation operation to advertisement screen simultaneously, under drive assembly's effect, steerable advertisement screen carries out 360 degrees forward and reverse rotations, thereby can effectively increase advertisement screen's show face, can show to the masses of different positions, effectively improve the bandwagon effect.

title_en: Prevent industry belt of fracture formula
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-fracture industrial belt, which comprises a belt body, wherein a plurality of friction ribs are arranged on the inner wall of the belt body, a plurality of friction protrusions are arranged on the surface of each friction rib, the belt body comprises a belt base material layer, an anti-fracture layer is arranged on the surface of the belt base material layer, a wear-resistant layer is arranged on the surface of the anti-fracture layer, the friction ribs are made of nitrile rubber, and the friction ribs and the belt body are integrally formed. This prevent cracked industrial belt, through the setting of fracture prevention layer, increased the holistic tensile properties of belt body, the cracked possibility appears in the effective belt body that reduces, and the setting of wearing layer has increased the holistic wear resistance of belt body, rubs arris and rubs bellied setting, effectively increases the skid resistance of belt body.

title_en: Reversing valve with spherical sealing structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of reversing valve sealing, in particular to a reversing valve with a spherical sealing structure, which comprises a reversing valve shell, an actuating element, a connecting rod, a valve body and the spherical sealing structure, wherein the spherical sealing structure comprises a spherical valve plate and an annular spherical base, the annular spherical base is fixed above a through hole of a valve body bin, the upper surface of the annular spherical base is provided with a sealing waterline of a whole circle, the center of the upper surface of the spherical valve plate is rotationally connected with the connecting rod through a universal connection structure, and the lower surface of the spherical valve plate is matched with the radian of the upper surface of the annular spherical base. The utility model improves the sealing effect through the arrangement of the spherical valve plate, the annular spherical base and the sealing waterline.

title_en: LCD display screen convenient to dismantle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an LCD display screen convenient to detach, which relates to the technical field of display screens, and comprises a fixed support, wherein one end of the fixed support is provided with a sliding support, two sides of one end of the sliding support are respectively provided with a fixing device, two first fixing plates are fixedly connected with the inner walls of two sides of the fixed support together, two second fixing plates are fixedly connected with the inner walls of two sides of the sliding support together, one ends of the opposite surfaces of the two first fixing plates and the two second fixing plates on the same side are respectively provided with a telescopic device, two stretching devices are jointly arranged between the fixed support and the sliding support, each stretching device comprises a first sliding plate and a second sliding plate, and a through first through groove is formed in the upper parts of one ends of the first sliding plate and the second sliding plate.

title_en: Platform mounting frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides a platform mounting frame, and relates to the technical field of petrochemical engineering construction. The utility model is used for solving the technical problems that the prior platform mounting frame is connected by welding or screws and has inconvenience and potential safety hazard. This platform mounting bracket, including landing leg and sleeve pipe, the slip type is provided with the sleeve pipe on the landing leg, installs first mount pad on the sleeve pipe, and limiting plate is all installed to first mount pad both sides, and limiting plate both sides all slip type is provided with first draw-in lever, first draw-in lever and first mount pad joint, around being equipped with two first elastic component on the first draw-in lever, installs a plurality of support crossbars jointly on two adjacent support longitudinal plates. The first clamping rods on two sides are slid and pulled along the limiting plate to the side far away from each other, the supporting longitudinal plates are embedded with the first mounting seat, the first clamping rods are pushed by the first elastic piece to fix the supporting longitudinal plates on the first mounting seat in a clamping manner, and the effect of being convenient for assembling and stabilizing the platform mounting frame is achieved.

title_en: Single screw air compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single-screw air compressor, which comprises an air storage tank and a machine body, wherein a placing rack is arranged above the air storage tank, a motor is arranged at the top of the placing rack, the side surface of the motor is connected with the machine body through an output shaft, an air inlet is formed in the top of the machine body, an isolation cover is fixedly connected to the top of the placing rack, a sealing cover is embedded in the side surface of the isolation cover, a filter screen is embedded in the side surface of the isolation cover, a placing net rack is embedded in the side surface of the isolation cover, a sealing cover, the filter screen and the placing net rack are respectively embedded in the side surface of the isolation cover through the isolation cover arranged outside the machine body, a bolt inserted in the top of the isolation cover penetrates through the sealing cover, the filter screen and the placing net rack to be filled with filter substances such as active carbon, when air enters the machine body, the filter substances on the filter screen and the placing net rack are used for carrying out double filtration on the air, so that dust and particle foreign matters entrained in the air are effectively avoided, and the filtering effect is better during use.

title_en: Sealing element applied to piston of refrigerant compressor and piston
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sealing element and a piston applied to a piston of a refrigerant compressor, comprising an inner ring and an outer ring, wherein the inner ring is a C-shaped elastic ring, the outer ring is provided with a certain elasticity, the outer ring is provided with a break, and two ends of the break adopt a staggered butt joint structure. The outer ring is sleeved outside the inner ring. According to the utility model, the outer ring is provided with the disconnection, so that the expansion range of the outer ring is increased, meanwhile, the sealing notch can be avoided through the staggered and butted disconnection design during expansion, in addition, the elasticity of the whole sealing element is increased through the C-shaped elastic inner ring, and when the outer ring is worn, the sealing element can be further expanded through the recovery deformation of the inner ring, so that a continuous and effective sealing effect is provided.

title_en: Sleeve type flexible pipe joint
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline connection, and discloses a sleeve type flexible pipe joint, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein the equipment main body comprises: the sleeve type flexible pipe joint comprises a sleeve type flexible pipe joint main body, wherein a plurality of thread grooves are formed in the top end of the sleeve type flexible pipe joint main body; through setting up thread groove, threaded rod and nut, can utilize the rotatory threaded rod of nut to be connected flange and the flexible coupling body of bushing, through setting up the rubber pad, when the threaded rod extrudees to thread groove bottom, the ascending resilience force of rubber pad can make the threaded rod receive the extrusion difficult not hard up, effectively increases the fastness of device, through setting up annular rubber recess and sealing rubber circle, can make sealing rubber circle and annular rubber recess closely laminate when flange is connected with the flexible coupling body of bushing, effectively increases the leakproofness of device.

title_en: Adjusting device for valve positioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides a regulating device for a valve positioner, which comprises an instrument detector, a fixed plate, a mounting base, an adjusting base, a control mechanism, two adjusting mechanisms and two clamping mechanisms, wherein the fixed plate is arranged on the mounting base; the two clamping mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at the upper end part and the lower end part of the fixed plate and are used for clamping the outer shell of the valve positioner; the adjusting base is in sliding connection with the front end face of the fixed plate through a sliding structure, the mounting base is fixedly connected with the adjusting base, the mounting base is provided with a groove which can be matched with the instrument detector, and the instrument detector is arranged in the groove; the two adjusting mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at the left end part and the right end part of the fixed plate. The adjusting device for the valve positioner solves the problem that a worker needs to hold the detector for a long time in the process of detecting the instrument on the valve positioner by the instrument detector, so that the labor intensity of the worker is increased.

title_en: Diamond grinding wheel matrix surface gluing device
abstract_en: The application discloses a diamond grinding wheel matrix surface gluing device which comprises a base, wherein an assembling mechanism for assembling a diamond grinding wheel matrix is arranged on the base, the assembling mechanism can drive the diamond grinding wheel matrix to rotate along the axis of the assembling mechanism, and a leveling gluing mechanism parallel to the surface of the diamond grinding wheel is also arranged on the base. The gluing device can realize rapid assembly of the diamond matrix through the assembly mechanism, and is convenient for continuous gluing of the diamond matrix. After assembly, the assembly mechanism can also realize uniform rotation of the diamond grinding wheel matrix in the circumferential direction, and can provide guarantee for subsequent gluing equalization under the rotation state. And the leveling gluing mechanism can be matched with the assembling mechanism to rapidly coat the adhesive with the uniform thickness on the surface of the diamond grinding wheel matrix, so that the problem that the grinding effect and the service life of the diamond grinding wheel are affected due to uneven thickness of the existing manual coating is solved.

title_en: Body-building accessory connecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a body-building accessory connecting device which comprises a buckle, a clamping seat and a connecting piece, wherein the buckle comprises a first connecting part and a second connecting part, one end of the connecting piece is connected with the first connecting part, and the other end of the connecting piece is connected with a body-building accessory; one end of the clamping seat is provided with a clamping groove, the second connecting part is clamped in the clamping groove of the clamping seat, and a limiting assembly is arranged between the clamping groove and the second connecting part and used for clamping the second connecting part in the clamping groove; the limiting assembly comprises a limiting piece and a spring, a mounting hole is formed in the clamping seat, the spring is positioned in the mounting hole, one end of the spring abuts against one end of the mounting hole, and the limiting piece is arranged in the mounting hole, and one end of the limiting piece abuts against the other end of the spring; the front section of the limiting piece is provided with a limiting part, the middle section of the limiting piece is provided with an avoiding part, the second connecting part is provided with an annular groove matched with the limiting part, and the limiting part is in surface contact with the two sides of the annular groove. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, safe and reliable connection and the like.

title_en: Large-displacement sand-proof compensator connected by reducer pipes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-displacement sand-proof compensator connected with a reducer pipe, which belongs to the field of expansion joints of metal corrugated pipes and comprises at least two corrugated pipes, connecting pipes arranged at two ends of each corrugated pipe and connected with two adjacent corrugated pipes, wherein each connecting pipe is a reducer pipe, a lining cylinder is arranged between each corrugated pipe and the connecting pipe positioned at the left side, one end of each lining cylinder is fixed on the inner wall of each connecting pipe, the other end of each lining cylinder is a free end, the free end of each lining cylinder extends towards the connecting pipe positioned at the right side of each corrugated pipe, and a bulletproof sealing body is arranged between the end of each free end and the connecting pipe positioned at the position; a flexible sand-proof body is filled between the lining cylinder and the connecting pipe and between the lining cylinder and the corrugated pipe. The variable-diameter connecting pipe is adopted to connect the corrugated pipe and the on-site pipeline, the structure is optimized, the quality is improved, at least two sections of corrugated pipes are arranged, larger axial displacement and transverse displacement can be compensated, the corrugated pipes can be arranged to be single-layer, double-layer and multi-layer wall thicknesses, the pressure bearing capacity of products can be improved by adopting the armor ring, and the requirements of different pressure working conditions are met.

title_en: Heat insulation sleeve capable of positioning, assembling and sleeving
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heat preservation and heat insulation, in particular to a heat insulation sleeve capable of being positioned, spliced and sleeved. Technical problems: common insulating sleeve is individual, lacks location mosaic structure for individual, needs to additionally connect with the help of connecting pieces such as support bolt and assemble in the location, perhaps connect in the mode of connecting position smearing glue, and work efficiency remains the problem that improves. The technical scheme is as follows: the utility model provides a but location is assembled sleeve's insulating sheath, is including first insulating sheath, second insulating sheath. The utility model can rapidly complete positioning and splicing through the positioning and splicing assembly, and improves the working efficiency, so as to solve the problems that the common heat insulation sleeve is usually an independent individual, a positioning and splicing structure is lacked, the positioning, connecting and splicing are required to be carried out by additionally using connecting pieces such as bracket bolts or the like, or the connecting parts are connected in a way of coating glue, and the working efficiency is required to be improved.

title_en: Constant temperature system suitable for food factory oil stores and carries
abstract_en: The utility model provides a constant temperature system suitable for oil storage and transportation in a food factory, and belongs to the field of heat exchange. The problem of traditional heat exchanger does not have buffer area to lead to the energy waste is solved. The device comprises a hot water buffer tank, wherein the upper part of the buffer tank is provided with a purified water inlet, a hot water return port and an overflow port, the lower part of the buffer tank is provided with a buffer tank water outlet, the inside of the buffer tank is provided with a liquid level sensor, and the purified water inlet is provided with an automatic water inlet valve; the tubular heat exchanger is provided with a heat exchanger water inlet, a hot water outlet, a steam inlet and a condensate outlet, the water outlet of the buffer tank is communicated with the heat exchanger water inlet through a hot water pump, a steam pressure reducing and regulating valve group is arranged at the steam inlet and used for reducing the pressure of steam and regulating the steam flow, and a drain valve group is arranged at the condensate outlet; and the liquid level sensor, the automatic water inlet valve, the hot water pump, the steam pressure reducing and regulating valve group and the drainage valve group are electrically connected with the control cabinet. It is mainly used for heating oil storage.

title_en: Interception device for marine organisms polluted by cold source of ship based on static environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an interception device for marine fouling organisms of a cold source of a ship based on a static environment, which belongs to the technical field of ship equipment, and the interception device comprises a shell, wherein a water inlet and a water outlet are respectively formed in the shell; the utility model has the advantages that the basket filter screen is arranged in the shell, so that the fouling organisms in the seawater can be intercepted, the fouling organisms are prevented from entering the cooling system of the ship, the upper cover of the shell can be opened, the basket filter screen is convenient to clean, and the good filtering performance of the basket filter screen is maintained.

title_en: Machine head sealing groove
abstract_en: The application relates to a machine head sealing groove, which comprises a box body, wherein an oil baffle is arranged on one side of the box body, one side of the oil baffle is connected with a side cover, six positioning fixing screw holes and six positioning through holes are uniformly and alternately arranged on the upper edge of the side cover, an annular side cover sealing groove is arranged on the side cover, positioning fixing screw holes formed in the oil baffle and the side cover can be aligned with positioning fixing screw holes formed in the box body through the arrangement of positioning rods and the positioning through holes, deformation and damage of the positioning fixing screw holes can not be caused when the oil baffle, the side cover and the box body are fixed through screws, and the practicability of the machine is improved.

title_en: Pressure relief door
abstract_en: The application relates to a pressure release door, which relates to the technical field of gas heating and comprises a connecting pipe fixedly connected to a hydrogen heating furnace, wherein the connecting pipe is communicated with the inside and the outside of the hydrogen heating furnace, and a rupture disc is arranged at one end of the connecting pipe extending to the outside of the hydrogen heating furnace so as to seal the hydrogen heating furnace and the connecting pipe.

title_en: Novel natural gas pipeline lays protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel natural gas pipeline laying protection device, which relates to the technical field of natural gas pipelines and comprises a first arc-shaped plate and a second arc-shaped plate, wherein a fixing mechanism is arranged between the first arc-shaped plate and the second arc-shaped plate and is used for fixing the first arc-shaped plate and the second arc-shaped plate together, one side of the outer wall of the first arc-shaped plate is provided with a buffering and damping mechanism which is used for supporting the pipeline, and the bottom surface of the first arc-shaped plate is provided with a supporting component. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the buffer damping mechanism, the buffer damping mechanism can absorb and disperse the vibration energy transmitted by the pipeline while supporting the pipeline, so that the vibration of the pipeline system is reduced, which is very important for protecting the pipeline and the connecting piece thereof and preventing the pipeline from being tired and damaged, and is helpful for reducing the stress and strain of the pipeline system and preventing the pipeline from being broken or seriously damaged.

title_en: Leak repairing joint
abstract_en: The application relates to a leak repairing joint, and relates to the field of leak repairing joints. The semi-circular pipe comprises two semi-circular pipes which are buckled relatively and a clamping frame for locking the two semi-circular pipes, wherein the semi-circular pipe comprises a middle pipe part, a first extension part and a second extension part, the first extension part and the second extension part are arranged at two ends of the middle pipe part, the first extension part, the second extension part and the middle pipe part are integrally formed, and right angle frames are symmetrically arranged on the outer side surfaces of the first extension part and the second extension part. According to the application, the traditional bolt connection mode is improved into the clamping frame locking mode, so that the condition that nuts are loosened during long-time use can be avoided, the sealing effect of connection between two ends of semicircular pipes is improved, meanwhile, the two ends of semicircular pipes can be positioned relatively before being buckled together by the positioning inserting frame and the sleeve ring frame, bolt hole alignment is not needed in the buckling process, the installation difficulty is reduced, and the device has the advantages of easiness in installation and difficulty in loosening.

title_en: Liquid carbon dioxide pumping device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a liquid carbon dioxide pumping device, which relates to the technical field of pumping devices and comprises a fixed base, a motor and a pump body, wherein the pump body is arranged at the position of an output end of the motor, the motor and the pump body are fixedly arranged at the position of the top end of the fixed base, a feeding pipe is fixedly arranged at the front end of the pump body, one side of the pump body is fixedly arranged on a discharging pipe, supporting columns are fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom end of the fixed base, and a level meter is fixedly arranged at two sides of the top end of the fixed base. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the threaded support rod, the support column, the rotating handle A and the rotating handle B, the height of the support column can be adjusted by rotating the threaded support rod, so that the liquid carbon dioxide pumping device has the characteristic that the four corners of the bottom end can be leveled, the stability and the safety of the device are improved, the vibration and unbalance in the running process of equipment are reduced, the service life of the equipment is prolonged, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Transmission shaft with torsion control device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transmission shaft with a torque control device, which has the technical scheme that: including torsion device main part, the surface fixed mounting of torsion device main part has the operation box, the surface fixed mounting of torsion device main part has the axis body, the sliding mouth has been seted up to the surface of operation box, the inner wall fixed mounting of sliding mouth has the fifth gear, sliding mouth inner wall fixed mounting has empty control panel, the surface fixed mounting of control panel has the dwang, the surface fixed mounting of dwang has the pivot, the sliding tray has been seted up to the inner wall of operation box, the inner wall fixed mounting pulley of sliding tray, the top fixed mounting of pulley has the dwang, set up the operation box, make things convenient for the torsion of staff control torsion device, also can provide a guard action for the transmission shaft, through setting up the control panel, make things convenient for the staff to adjust the size of torsion, through setting up resistance plate and rubber pad, realize torsion control device's torsion regulation, guarantee that the transmission shaft normally works.

title_en: High stability marble platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-stability marble platform which comprises a square steel frame component, a plurality of marble Dan Jianzhen mats arranged above the square steel frame component, a marble platform component arranged on a marble shock pad, and a plurality of limit shock absorption components arranged on the periphery of the square steel frame component, wherein the marble Dan Jianzhen mats are fixedly arranged on the square steel frame component, the marble platform component is fixedly arranged on the marble shock pad, and the limit shock absorption components are fixedly arranged on the square steel frame component. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure of the mechanism parts, convenient installation, low cost, good stability, high bearing capacity and good compatibility.

title_en: Valve cover of ball valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of ball valves, in particular to a valve cover of a ball valve, which comprises a cover body, a damping component, a cover body and a groove, wherein the cover body is provided with a groove; the damping component comprises a fixed block, an outer rod, an inner rod, a clamping block and a spring; a fixed block is arranged in the cover body, and an outer rod is arranged at the outer end of the fixed block; the inner rod is connected in the outer rod in a telescopic way; the outer end of the inner rod is provided with a connecting block; the clamping block is arranged at the outer end of the connecting block; the spring is sleeved outside the inner rod; the cover body is provided with a valve body outside; the groove is formed in the inner side of the valve body, and the outer end of the clamping block is movably clamped in the groove; the number of the damping components is multiple, and the number of the fixing blocks, the outer rods, the inner rods, the clamping blocks and the springs of the damping components are multiple; the outside of the cover body is provided with a flange a, the bottom end of the flange a is provided with a flange b, the outside of the cover body is provided with threads, and the flange b is connected with the threads. The utility model can buffer the impact in the operation process so as to reduce the influence on the valve.

title_en: Exhibition hall design service exhibition device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of exhibition hall exhibition, in particular to an exhibition hall design service exhibition device which comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the upper end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a first supporting frame, the upper end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a second supporting frame, the two sides of the lower end of the first supporting frame are fixedly connected with electric push rods, the lower end of each electric push rod is fixedly connected with a second universal wheel, and the lower end of the base is fixedly connected with a first universal wheel.

title_en: Pipeline reinforcement supporting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline reinforcing and supporting structure, which comprises a base, wherein the top end of the base is provided with two L-shaped plates through an adjusting component, a U-shaped groove is formed between the opposite surfaces of the two L-shaped plates in a surrounding mode, and the U-shaped groove is used for clamping and installing a U-shaped pipeline; the adjusting assembly comprises two groups of L-shaped hinge brackets, a fixed plate, side plates, studs and locking nuts; the U-shaped pipeline clamping device is simple in structure and convenient to manufacture, the U-shaped pipeline is clamped and fixed through the L-shaped plate, the locking nut, the side plate, the stud and the L-shaped hinged frame, and the U-shaped pipeline is fixed and loosened through rotating the locking nut, so that the U-shaped pipeline clamping device is convenient to use; carry out swing joint between L shaped plate and the base through L shape articulated frame simultaneously, can adjust the mounting height of L shaped plate, be convenient for adjust the L shaped plate to the bottom that can pass U-shaped pipeline to install U-shaped pipeline in the U-shaped inslot, accomplish the reinforcement support to U-shaped pipeline.

title_en: Crankshaft of gas engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas engine crankshaft, which has the technical scheme that a balance component is arranged, a connecting sleeve is arranged outside a connecting rod journal according to different vibration amplitude of an engine in test use, then a proper number of sliding blocks are inserted into a sliding groove, finally one or more weight blocks and the balance blocks are fixed together by locking bolts, the balance of the engine crankshaft is freely adjusted, the engine crankshaft is prevented from being broken due to unbalance, and the gas engine crankshaft is used for solving the problems that the balance of the engine crankshaft is difficult to freely adjust due to unbalance such as vibration of the engine in the use process of the existing engine crankshaft, and the engine crankshaft is likely to be broken due to unbalance; through setting up many pairs of balancing weights, cooperation main journal, connecting rod axle journal, front end axle and rear end flange are used for the motion of reciprocating motion's piston up-and-down is changed the motion of continuous rotation to drive the tire of vehicle.

title_en: Cement concrete pavement sensor mounting bracket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of concrete pavement construction, and provides a cement concrete pavement sensor mounting bracket which comprises a bearing plate, wherein the top of the bearing plate is rotationally connected with a threaded rod, the outer surface of the threaded rod, which is close to the top, is rotationally connected with a positioning plate, the bottoms of the positioning plates are fixedly connected with two limiting rods, one end of each limiting rod, which is far away from the positioning plate, is fixedly connected with the top of the bearing plate, the top of the threaded rod is fixedly connected with a rocker, the outer surface of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with two inner thread sleeves, the outer surface of each inner thread sleeve is fixedly connected with two connecting plates, and one side of each connecting plate, which is far away from each inner thread sleeve, is fixedly connected with a limiting sleeve. According to the utility model, the device is provided with the double-sensor variable-pitch adjusting structure, so that the condition of sensing concrete of different depth layers can be adjusted and compared, the depth layer is sensed by the device more flexibly, the measuring result is more accurate, and the device is suitable for high-precision measurement.

title_en: Shockproof support for watch processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shockproof support for watch processing, wherein two support rods which are symmetrically placed in front and back are arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end of a base, a damper is arranged in the middle of the upper top end of the base, a first buffer spring is respectively arranged at the top end of the support rod, a support block is arranged at the top end of the first buffer spring, the upper end of the support block is fixedly connected with an operation table, an installation seat is arranged on the front side and the back side of the support rod, a placing groove is dug at the top end of the operation table, a chute is respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom end of the operation table, a second buffer spring is arranged on the opposite side of the installation seat, a connecting shaft which is horizontally placed is arranged at the other end of the second buffer spring, one end of an X-shaped support is arranged on the side wall of the connecting shaft, a roller is arranged at the top end of the X-shaped support, and the roller is placed in the chute; through setting up first buffer spring, second buffer spring and X type support make the buffering process more steady, can not influence wrist-watch production normal operating, realization shock attenuation buffering that can be better.

title_en: Lifting mechanism, liquid suction assembly and sample pretreatment equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a lifting mechanism, a liquid suction assembly and sample pretreatment equipment, wherein the lifting mechanism comprises a gear, a rack meshed with the gear, a motor for driving the gear and an anti-rotation sleeve sleeved outside the rack, a first anti-rotation surface is locally arranged on the inner peripheral surface of the anti-rotation sleeve, and a second anti-rotation surface matched with the first anti-rotation surface is arranged at a position, corresponding to the first anti-rotation surface, of the rack. The lifting mechanism has the advantages of high lifting speed, stable lifting, compact structure and small space occupation.

title_en: Handling device for new energy power transaction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a new energy power transaction carrying device which comprises a base, a second mounting plate and a new energy lithium battery main body, wherein upright posts are fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the upper end of the base, a clamping device for clamping the new energy lithium battery main body is arranged at the lower end of the second mounting plate, and a moving device for driving the second mounting plate to move and carry the new energy lithium battery main body is arranged at the left end and the right end of the second mounting plate.

title_en: Convex roller bearing retainer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a convex roller bearing retainer, which comprises a plurality of window beams, wherein two ends of each window beam are respectively connected with an upper ring beam and a lower ring beam, window holes for accommodating rollers are formed by two adjacent window beams, the upper ring beam and the lower ring beam are arranged outside the upper ring beam, roller locking points are arranged on the lower side wall of the upper ring beam, two limiting protrusions are arranged on the upper side wall of the lower ring beam, and the two arc limiting protrusions are matched with the upper roller locking points to obliquely lock the rollers in the window holes for facilitating the installation of the rollers, so that the limiting capacity of the rollers is improved, and the retainer has long service life.

title_en: Glass processing double-swing-angle electric spindle assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glass processing double-swing-angle electric spindle assembly, which relates to the technical field of electric spindles and comprises a double-swing-angle box body, wherein a C shaft is arranged at the top of the double-swing-angle box body, a C shaft driving structure is arranged on the C shaft, a spindle head is arranged in the double-swing-angle box body, the spindle head and the C shaft are coaxially arranged, two sides of the spindle head are connected with an A shaft, the A shaft is rotationally connected to the double-swing-angle box body, one end of one A shaft is connected with the output end of a harmonic reducer through a switching disc, the input end of the harmonic reducer is in power connection with an A shaft servo motor through a synchronous belt, and the A shaft servo motor is arranged on the double-swing-angle box body. The A shaft of the utility model adopts a driving combination form of the servo motor, the belt pulley group and the harmonic reducer to amplify the motor torque, and the C shaft adopts a driving combination form of the servo motor, the planetary reducer and the transmission gear group to amplify the motor torque, so that the integral driving structure can effectively ensure the stability of the main shaft during processing.

title_en: Actuator, suspension assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an actuator, a suspension assembly and a vehicle, wherein the actuator comprises: a housing; a driving mechanism; the upper end of the linear motion component stretches into the shell and is connected with the driving mechanism, and the driving mechanism is suitable for driving the linear motion component to reciprocate along the action direction; and the first limiting buffer piece is arranged on the inner top wall of the shell and used for limiting the upward jumping movement stroke of the linear movement component. According to the actuator disclosed by the utility model, the upward jumping movement stroke of the linear movement part is limited, so that the movement stroke of the linear movement part is limited, and the reliability of the actuator and the use feeling of a user are improved.

title_en: Height-adjusting oil cylinder of coal mining machine
abstract_en: A shearer lift cylinder comprising: the cylinder barrel and the piston rod group are in linear sliding insertion connection in the cylinder barrel; the cylinder barrel lug plate is arranged at the end part of the cylinder barrel, which is far away from one side of the piston rod group, and is used for being rotationally connected with the coal mining machine body, a connecting hole is formed in the cylinder barrel lug plate, and a ball bearing is arranged in the connecting hole; the piston lug plate is arranged at the end part of one side, far away from the cylinder barrel, of the piston rod group and is used for being rotationally connected with the rocker arm; the lifting oil cylinder also comprises an angular displacement measuring assembly on the cylinder lug plate; comprising the following steps: the first gear is fixedly connected to the side face of the cylinder lug plate; the angle sensor is fixed on the coal cutter body and positioned on one side of the cylinder lug plate, and a second gear is arranged on the connecting shaft and meshed with the first gear. The position information of the height-adjusting oil cylinder can be detected, and the structure is simple, and the installation and maintenance are convenient.

title_en: Disassembly-free online check three-way valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disassembly-free online check three-way valve, belongs to the technical field of pressure detection, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, an SF6 density relay is required to be checked regularly, timely replacement is found out in time, the SF6 density relay is required to be disassembled in a checking mode in the prior art, leakage is easy to occur, and the working mode is inconvenient. The device comprises a valve body, wherein one side of the valve body is provided with a body connecting port, an adjusting valve rod is arranged on one side adjacent to the body connecting port, and a density relay is arranged on one side adjacent to the adjusting valve rod; the valve body is provided with a detection port adjacent to the body connection port, a sealing mechanism is arranged at the detection port, and the sealing mechanism closes the detection port. This dismantlement-free online check-up three-way valve through ingenious structural design, makes it can not dismantle in operation, and density relay alright conveniently implement the check-up, satisfies the demand that does not have a power failure, does not dismantle check-up density relay.

title_en: Anticorrosive screw vacuum pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of electric appliances, in particular to an anti-corrosion screw vacuum pump, which comprises a storage base, a vacuum pump main body and a power source main body which are arranged on the storage base, wherein the vacuum pump main body and the power source main body are connected through a transmission belt, pushing devices for assisting in transportation are arranged on two sides of the vacuum pump main body, supporting rotating rods are rotatably connected to two sides of the bottom of the storage base through rotating shafts, two groups of lifting struts are fixed at the bottom ends of the supporting rotating rods, and a bottom plate is fixedly connected between the two groups of lifting struts.

title_en: Hydraulic oil pipe sealing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic oil pipe sealing structure which comprises an oil pipe body, a connector and a thread sleeve, wherein the outer side of the oil pipe body is communicated with the inner side of the connector, the outer side of the surface of the oil pipe body is movably arranged in the thread sleeve, and a communicating sealing assembly is arranged on the outer side of the connector. According to the utility model, the connecting sealing effect of the outer side of the joint is improved conveniently by arranging the communicating sealing assembly, and the outer side of the oil pipe body is subjected to stable heat dissipation and cooling by the heat dissipation and cooling assembly, so that the problems that the sealing performance is poor, the pressure is insufficient easily caused in use of the existing hydraulic oil pipe, meanwhile, the heat dissipation effect of the hydraulic oil pipe is obviously poor due to the fact that the hydraulic oil pipe generates heat along with movement in use, the condition of temperature rise of the hydraulic oil pipe is caused, the service life of the sealing structure is influenced by continuous temperature rise, the sealing performance of the hydraulic oil pipe is poor in use, the use effect of the hydraulic oil pipe is reduced, and the heat dissipation sealing effect is achieved.

title_en: Detachable protective cover for water supply equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water supply equipment protection and discloses a detachable protective cover for water supply equipment, which comprises a base and a shell, wherein the shell is arranged at the top of the base, the bottom of the shell is fixedly connected with a positioning block, the positioning block is slidably connected to the middle part of the base, a spring is fixedly connected to the inside of the base, the other end of the spring is fixedly connected with a clamping block, the clamping block is contacted with the positioning block, a clamping groove is formed in the middle part of the positioning block, the clamping groove is in plug-in fit with the clamping block, a disassembling assembly is rotatably connected to the middle part of the base, the disassembling assembly comprises a rotating rod, and the rotating rod is rotatably connected to the middle part of the base. According to the utility model, the shell can be installed by only inserting the positioning block into the base, and the shell can be disassembled by rotating the rotating rod, so that the labor intensity of staff is reduced, and the convenience in assembling and disassembling the protective cover is improved.

title_en: AR navigation device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of navigation, and particularly relates to an AR navigation device which comprises a supporting plate, a supporting buffer component, a mounting plate, a mounting shell, a supporting guide component, an adjusting component and a bendable display screen for AR navigation, wherein the supporting buffer component is arranged on the supporting plate, the mounting shell is detachably and fixedly arranged on the mounting plate, an arc-shaped opening is formed in the mounting shell, the supporting guide component is arranged on the arc-shaped opening and the supporting plate, the adjusting component is arranged on the mounting plate, two supporting rods are hinged on a shell of the bendable display screen, and the two supporting rods are hinged on the mounting plate. The utility model has reasonable design, can be used for different users to meet the requirements on the state of the flexible display screen when carrying out AR navigation, has better supporting stability, is convenient to fix, can provide effective buffering for the flexible display screen, and greatly improves the practicability of the device.

title_en: Stop structure of punching machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stop structure of a punching machine, which belongs to the technical field of stop of punching machines and particularly relates to a stop structure of a punching machine, comprising a base, wherein an L-shaped mounting frame is arranged in the middle of the top wall of the base, a vertical electric cylinder is arranged at the top of the L-shaped mounting frame, and an output shaft of the electric cylinder penetrates through the top wall of the L-shaped mounting frame in a sliding manner and is provided with a pressing module; the top of base is located the both sides symmetry slip of pushing down the module and is provided with keeps off the platform that stops, and two keep off stop platform are close to the back and prop the bottom of pushing down the module. According to the utility model, the servo motor is started to drive the double-headed screw to rotate, so that the two sliding blocks synchronously move in opposite directions, the distance between the two stop platforms is adjusted through the connecting rod, the two stop platforms are positioned on two sides below the pressing module after being close to each other, the electric cylinder is started to descend the pressing module, the rubber buffer pad at the top of the stop platform is propped against the bottom of the pressing module to stop the pressing module, the limiting screw is driven to rotate through the hand wheel, and the limiting block is propped against the top of the L-shaped mounting frame, so that the pressing module is further prevented from falling down.

title_en: Combined screw sleeve
abstract_en: The combined screw sleeve comprises a screw and a bushing, wherein the screw comprises an outer hexagonal plum blossom flange and a screw rod connected with the outer hexagonal plum blossom flange, and an external thread is arranged on the outer surface of one end of the screw rod far away from the outer hexagonal plum blossom flange; the middle section of the screw rod is parallel to the head part and is provided with two annular teeth; the bushing is assembled outside the rod part of the screw, the bushing comprises a hollow cylindrical sleeve body, the inner diameter of the bushing is larger than the outer diameter of the annular thread rolling, an annular ring is arranged on the inner side wall of the bushing, and the inner diameter of the annular ring is larger than the outer diameter of the screw rod and smaller than the outer diameter of the annular thread rolling, so that the bushing is limited on the screw rod through the annular ring clamped between the annular thread rolling. The bushing is limited through the two thread rolling parts on the screw rod, so that the bushing can move freely on the rod part, the thread is protected through the bushing in the moving process, the screw is protected, and the risk of collision and damage of the screw in the turnover and transportation is reduced.

title_en: Easily install antiseep customization rubber tube
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rubber pipes and discloses an easily-installed anti-leakage customized rubber pipe which comprises a rubber pipe connector, wherein a connector clamping port is formed in the inner surface of the rubber pipe connector, a rubber pipe body is fixedly connected to the surface of the rubber pipe connector, a rubber pipe anti-corrosion coating is fixedly connected to the inner surface of the rubber pipe body, a limiting ring is fixedly connected to the surface of the rubber pipe anti-corrosion coating and the inner surface of the rubber pipe connector, a protective net fixing plate is contacted with the surface of the limiting ring, and a hinge is fixedly connected to the surface of the protective net fixing plate. According to the utility model, the rubber pipe connector is integrally designed with the rubber pipe, so that the connector can be prevented from falling off and leaking, the two ends of the rubber pipe connector are designed to be steps, the connector clamping connector can be directly clamped with the air faucet, the rubber pipe connector is convenient to install and detach, and the practicability in use is increased.

title_en: Marine tail shaft sealing ring
abstract_en: The utility model provides a marine tail shaft sealing ring, which belongs to the field of sealing rings and comprises a sealing ring main body, an inner ring groove, a rubber ring, a fixing mechanism and a convex ring.

title_en: Supporting and hanging frame capable of clamping pipelines in different shapes
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of support and hanging frames, in particular to a support and hanging frame capable of clamping pipelines in different shapes. The design and selection of the existing support and hanger are mainly carried out according to the shape and the size of a specific pipeline, the application range of the same support and hanger is small, the pipeline is installed in a troublesome manner, and the following technical scheme is provided: the fixing seat is provided with a fixing hole for fixing the fixing seat; the mounting plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the fixing seat; the mounting frame is arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate and is fixedly connected with the fixing seat through the mounting plate; a clamping assembly for clamping pipes, the clamping assembly enabling pipes of different shapes to be clamped. The clamping device can clamp pipelines of different shapes, has wide application range, avoids selecting a support and a hanger matched with the pipeline when the pipeline is installed, and ensures that the pipeline is more convenient to install and has strong practicability.

title_en: Anticorrosive sealing device for photovoltaic support upright post connection gap
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-corrosion sealing device for a photovoltaic support column connecting gap, which comprises a column end rubber sleeve, a transitional expansion section rubber sleeve and an embedded sleeve end rubber sleeve which are connected in sequence; the structure of the reducing rubber sleeve is composed of a column end rubber sleeve, a transitional expansion section rubber sleeve and an embedded sleeve end rubber sleeve, wherein a plurality of replaceable embedded zinc sheets are connected to the bottom of the embedded sleeve end rubber sleeve. According to the utility model, through the structure of the reducing rubber sleeve, gaps between the photovoltaic support upright posts and the embedded sleeve can be effectively sealed, and meanwhile, the expansion section additionally arranged in the middle can effectively adapt to uneven change of the gaps caused by adjustment of relative positions between the photovoltaic support upright posts and the embedded sleeve, so that the phenomenon that the lower sleeve cannot penetrate through the embedded sleeve is avoided; the replaceable embedded zinc sheet is arranged in the rubber sleeve at the end of the embedded sleeve, so that the corrosion of the saline-alkali soil to the embedded sleeve and the reinforcement cage in the foundation can be delayed.

title_en: Novel aluminum alloy track briquetting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy track pressing blocks and discloses a novel aluminum alloy track pressing block, which comprises a mounting block, wherein a box body is arranged at the bottom of the mounting block, a vertical plate is arranged at the top of the mounting block, a base plate is arranged at the top of the vertical plate, an adjusting component extending to the outer side of the box body is arranged in the box body, a mounting component is arranged at the bottom of the adjusting component, and the adjusting component comprises a bidirectional threaded rod. This novel aluminum alloy track briquetting, through setting up adjusting part and installation component, according to the condition when actually installing, adjust the interval of two arc fixed splint and accomplish fixedly, the twist grip drives worm rotation and makes the worm wheel of meshing rotate, drives two-way threaded rod and rotates, adjusts both sides thread block and drives the connecting rod and remove under the support of gag lever post to adjust the interval of connecting plate and arc fixed splint, realized the purpose of being convenient for install.

title_en: Device for maintaining pressure in radial plunger motor cavity
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for maintaining pressure in a radial plunger motor cavity, which is used for a walking machine taking the radial plunger motor as a driving component. When such a running machine drive system fails and needs to be towed, maintaining the pressure in the radial plunger motor cavity is a common condition. The device at least comprises a gas storage container, a pressure reducing valve, a pressure gauge for measuring the pressure of the pressure reduced by the pressure reducing valve and a pipeline connected with each other; the gas storage container provides an adjustable stable pressure gas source through a pressure reducing valve, and when the stable pressure gas source is communicated with the oil drain port of the radial plunger motor filled with oil through a pipeline, the stable pressure gas source is provided for the cavity of the radial plunger motor, and the pressure is stably maintained. The utility model also discloses a device for maintaining the pressure in the radial plunger motor cavity without the gas storage container, which simply and economically meets the pressure condition in the radial plunger motor cavity when the walking machinery is dragged.

title_en: Water distributor with good sealing performance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water distributors, in particular to a water distributor with good sealing performance, which comprises a water distributor body and a protective sleeve, wherein water distribution nozzles are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the water distributor body, sealing devices are arranged on the outer walls of the water distribution nozzles, and fixing devices are arranged on the outer walls of the protective sleeve. The protection sleeve can be installed on the water distributor body, the first connecting disc is installed on the water distribution nozzle through the oblique threads, the protection sleeve is blocked through the two first connecting discs, then the sealing ring and the first screw rod are driven to move through the second connecting disc, the sealing ring is installed on the water distribution nozzle, the first screw rod penetrates through the through hole of the first connecting disc, the position of the sealing ring is adjusted, then the second connecting disc is held up, the gasket and the nut are sequentially installed on the first screw rod, the position of the sealing ring can be fixed through the second connecting disc, the first screw rod, the nut and the like, the problem that the sealing ring is deviated and the like is avoided, and therefore the tightness of the joint is guaranteed.

title_en: Double-layer porous roller protective cover
abstract_en: The utility model provides a double-layer porous roller protective cover, which comprises: the protective cover rolling box assembly, the protective cover guide rail, the guide rail bracket and the roller bracket; the roller bracket is provided with a protective cover rolling box assembly and a guide rail bracket, one end of a protective cover guide rail is fixed on the protective cover rolling box assembly, the other end of the protective cover guide rail is fixed on the guide rail bracket, and the protective cover guide rail is arranged on the outer side of the roller; the double-layer porous rolling shutter plate is arranged in the protective cover rolling shutter box assembly, and is allowed to slide along the protective cover guide rail to be folded and unfolded and protect the roller. The utility model effectively solves the problems of risk hidden troubles such as mechanical injury, scalding, static striking and the like of operating rollers on production operators and the risk hidden troubles such as dropping of foreign matters existing on the rollers, damage of roller surfaces, static adsorption of dust and foreign matters and the like in the actual production process by providing the roller in a running state with the close-range protective cover.

title_en: Touch display support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a touch display bracket which comprises a base, a vertical plate, a lifting device, a placing plate, a touch display screen, a clamping device, an anchor post and a covering device, wherein the vertical plate is arranged on the base, the lifting device is arranged in the vertical plate, the placing plate is arranged on the lifting device, the touch display screen is arranged in the placing plate, the clamping device is arranged in the placing plate and can clamp the touch display screen, the anchor post is arranged on the placing plate, and the covering device is arranged at the uppermost end of the placing plate. The utility model belongs to the technical field of display supports, and particularly relates to a touch display support which can adjust the use height of a display and can cover and protect a used display screen.

title_en: Lithium electric material crushing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lithium battery material crushing mechanism, which comprises a case provided with an inlet and an outlet, wherein a crushing device is arranged at the upper part of the case, a conveying device and a lifting device are arranged at the middle part of the case, the conveying device comprises 2 conveying frames which are oppositely arranged, a plurality of long rotating shafts are respectively arranged at two ends of the 2 conveying frames, a plurality of short rotating shafts are symmetrically arranged on the conveying frames of the long rotating shafts arranged at two ends, lifting areas are formed among the short rotating shafts which are symmetrically arranged, the lifting areas are used for the lifting device to pass through and correspondingly cooperate with the crushing device, and the working areas of the crushing device are identical to the internal shapes of sagger. The utility model can primarily crush the blocked materials in a targeted way before recycling, so that the phenomena of uncleanness and blockage of the blocked materials can not occur before recycling the materials, the production efficiency is improved, and the working strength of online operators is reduced.

title_en: Rivet nut structure and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a rivet nut structure and a vehicle, wherein the nut structure comprises: the nut comprises a nut body, wherein the nut body comprises an anti-rotation section, a crumple section and a thread section which are sequentially arranged along a first direction, and the nut body is provided with a through hole which sequentially penetrates through the anti-rotation section, the crumple section and the thread section; wherein the outer contour of the cross section of the anti-rotation section is in a non-standard circle shape; the cross section of the crumple section is circular, and the wall thickness of the crumple section is smaller than that of the thread section and the anti-rotation section. The rivet nut structure and the vehicle of this scheme not only can prevent to draw rivet nut structure and the part that its assembly skidded and rotate, and can increase the yield of drawing the riveting process.

title_en: Piston rod with cooling structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a piston rod with a cooling structure, which has the technical scheme that: the piston rod comprises a piston rod main body and two threaded cooling through holes formed in the piston rod main body, wherein an internal thread notch is formed in one end of the piston rod main body, a water through block is arranged in the internal thread notch, a water inlet joint and a water outlet joint are respectively screwed at the other ends of the two threaded cooling through holes, two symmetrical plug-in connectors are connected to the water through block in a threaded manner, the plug-in connectors are plugged in the threaded cooling through holes, and a first sealing ring and a second sealing ring are respectively arranged on the circumferential surface of the plug-in connectors; two screw thread cooling through holes have been seted up in the piston rod main part for can increase the cooling route when the coolant liquid circulation, can improve the absorptive efficiency of heat, greatly reduced piston rod main part is surperficial heat, can prolong piston rod sealing ring life, and cooling structure's is small, and application scope is wide.

title_en: Explosion-proof online automatic oil filling equipment
