abstract_en: The utility model provides explosion-proof online oil automatic filling equipment, which relates to the field of lubricating oil filling and comprises an oil tank body, wherein a PLC (programmable logic controller) is arranged on one side of the oil tank body, a filtering unit is arranged on one side of the oil tank body, and the bottom of the oil tank body is fixedly connected with a mounting seat; according to the utility model, the oil tank body is arranged for storing lubricating oil, the filtering unit is arranged for filtering the lubricating oil when the lubricating oil is injected into the oil tank body, the injection mechanism is arranged for injecting the lubricating oil into equipment to be injected according to the requirement, meanwhile, the lubricating oil is stirred and heated according to the use requirement and the ambient temperature, so that the viscosity of the lubricating oil is prevented from greatly influencing the injection operation, and the injected lubricating oil quantity is detected through the injection mechanism, so that the residual quantity in the injection cylinder is known timely, the reinjection is performed through the oil tank body in time, and the injection is stopped timely when the liquid level is too high.

title_en: Hydrologic water resource drilling balancer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrologic water resource drilling balancer, which relates to the technical field of drilling balancers and comprises a shell and a lifting rope, wherein a lifting hook is fixedly connected to the surface of the lifting rope, a lubricating device is arranged on the surface of the shell and comprises a mounting seat, the mounting seat is fixedly connected with the shell, a bag bottle is placed on the inner wall of the mounting seat, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the mounting seat, a dropper is fixedly connected to the surface of the supporting plate, a spike is fixedly connected to the surface of the dropper, the spike is of a hollow structure, a smearing brush is slidingly connected to the inner wall of the dropper, the smearing brush is a sponge brush, and a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the smearing brush.

title_en: Automatic tracking light filling device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic tracking light supplementing device based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a supporting component, a lifting adjusting mechanism and a light supplementing component. The utility model discloses a setting is used for providing the triangular support frame, scalable adjustment's lifting adjustment mechanism that support to whole device to and the supporting frame of light filling lamp ring and light filling lamp plate is installed to the inboard, and be detachable structure between lifting adjustment mechanism and triangular support frame and the supporting frame, when needs place when ground, can carry out altitude mixture control through lifting adjustment mechanism, when needs are put at the desktop, dismantle lifting adjustment mechanism, directly be fixed in on the support column with last pillar, can constitute a structure smaller and more exquisite light filling device, therefore, the utility model has convenient operation, application scope wide characteristics.

title_en: Air door connecting rod of automobile air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile air conditioner air door connecting rod, which comprises a connecting rod body, wherein a connecting rod small-head hole is formed in one end of the connecting rod body, a semicircular connecting rod hole is fixedly formed in the other end of the connecting rod body, a connecting rod bushing is fixedly embedded in an inner ring of the connecting rod small-head hole, an oil cavity is formed in the connecting rod body, lubricating oil is injected into the oil cavity, the lubricating oil is adsorbed by a sponge strip in the oil cavity, the lubricating oil in the oil cavity is adsorbed into an annular groove on the outer wall of a connecting rod bearing bush, the inner wall of the annular groove is driven to rub with the sponge strip through rotation of the connecting rod bearing bush, the lubricating oil adsorbed by the sponge strip overflows to lubricate the connecting rod bearing bush, the sensitivity of rotation of the connecting rod bearing bush and balls is improved, friction loss of the connecting rod body can be reduced through cooperation of balls and lubricating oil, the service life of the connecting rod body is prolonged, manual addition of lubricating oil is not needed, and the connecting rod bearing bush is automatically lubricated on the premise that lubricating oil is arranged in the oil cavity, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Pipeline middle hanging device for greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of greenhouse pipeline installation, and discloses a pipeline middle hanging device for a greenhouse, which comprises a stand column, wherein a fixed seat is fixedly connected to the right side of the stand column, a fixing hole is formed in the upper end of the fixed seat, a hanging piece assembly is arranged on the front side of the stand column, a clamping hoop assembly is arranged on the rear side of the stand column, and a mounting piece assembly is fixedly connected to the lower end of the hanging piece assembly. This cable suspension device in middle of pipeline for greenhouse can hang different pipelines simultaneously through the rings subassembly at hanger subassembly and both ends, is fit for hanging the pipeline on both sides in the middle of being used for the greenhouse, and the looks adaptation structure through bolt hole one and bolt hole two can be convenient for use bolt nut fixed hanger subassembly and the clamp subassembly fast, the dismouting of being convenient for, and the looks adaptation structure through mounting hole one and mounting hole two can be convenient for be quick install rings subassembly on the mounting piece subassembly, the equipment of being convenient for hangs, and whole mounting structure is simple, low in cost easily promotes.

title_en: Bridge construction safety rope that facilitates use
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bridge construction safety rope convenient to use, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first connecting ring is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a steel wire rope tensioner assembly is connected to the inner side of the first connecting ring, a buffer mechanism is connected to the top end of the steel wire rope tensioner assembly, and a steel wire rope is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the buffer mechanism; the buffer mechanism comprises a connecting sleeve and two groups of telescopic rods, and the two groups of telescopic rods are connected to the two ends of the connecting sleeve in a sliding mode. According to the utility model, the bottom plate is fixed at the installation position through the expansion screw penetrating through the positioning hole, the safety belt is flexibly applied according to the comfort and operability of workers during site construction, the safety belt lock catch can slide on the steel wire rope at any time, the problem that the safety accident is caused by the fact that the sight stops the misoperation of a crane operating hand of a car making machine, and meanwhile, the problem that unsafe behavior of the workers is damaged due to the fact that safety facilities fall down or fall down caused by gusts of wind is avoided due to the fact that the ventilation area is wide is solved.

title_en: Anti-impact explosion-proof camera
abstract_en: The application relates to an impact-resistant and explosion-proof camera, which comprises: a housing; the installation rack is arranged at the lower end of the shell, a rotating column extending into the shell is arranged at the upper end of the installation rack, and the rotating column is rotatably arranged in the shell; the anti-explosion camera body is arranged at the lower end of the mounting frame, fixing columns which are rotationally connected with the mounting frame are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the anti-explosion camera body, and the axes of the fixing columns are mutually perpendicular to the axis of the rotating column; a first drive assembly; the transmission assembly comprises a worm wheel and a worm, the worm wheel is sleeved on the rotating column, the worm is rotatably arranged in the shell, and the worm is matched with the worm wheel; the second driving assembly is arranged in the shell and connected with the worm so as to drive the worm to rotate; according to the application, the explosion-proof camera body can be prevented from shaking when being severely jolted, so that the explosion-proof camera body deviates from the original monitoring angle, and the stability, safety and accuracy of the device can be ensured.

title_en: Oil-cooled permanent magnet motor rotor structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of motors, and relates to an oil-cooled permanent magnet motor rotor structure. The rotor core and the two balance rings are respectively positioned at two ends of the rotor core, and the rotor core is provided with magnetic steel; a plurality of oil inlet holes are formed in the rotating shaft, a plurality of groove shapes are formed in the inner side of the rotor core and are communicated with the oil inlet holes, a plurality of radial through holes and a plurality of axial through holes are formed in the balance ring, and the radial through holes and the axial through holes are communicated with the groove shapes. The utility model can cool the rotor of the motor and the magnetic steel through the cooling oil, thereby ensuring that the magnetic steel has proper working temperature; meanwhile, cooling oil is thrown out through the two ends of the rotor, and the oil is sprayed on windings at the two ends of the stator and support bearings at the two ends of the rotating shaft, so that the stator windings are cooled and the bearings are cooled and lubricated.

title_en: Fixed bolster subassembly and projection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical accessories, in particular to a fixed bracket assembly and projection equipment, wherein the fixed bracket assembly comprises a limiting assembly, a rotating part arranged in the limiting assembly and rotationally connected with the limiting assembly, and a supporting rod with one end connected with the rotating part; be provided with normal running fit structure and elastic component on the spacing subassembly, rotation portion includes smooth section and sets up in the gear section of smooth section at least one end, and smooth section and the coaxial setting of gear section, smooth section and normal running fit structure looks adaptation, the elastic component with the gear section supports and holds, this elastic component takes place deformation when elastic component takes place relative motion with the gear section. The smooth section of rotation portion and rotation portion shaft hole cooperation make can rotate relatively, and the elastic component makes the elastic component to rotation portion simultaneous movement with the gear section cooperation of rotation portion, and when the elastic component received external force to be fixed, rotation and the elastic component of rotation portion no longer simultaneous movement, carries out the multistage number adjustment of relative movement realization fixed bolster subassembly.

title_en: Tap water outlet device
abstract_en: The tap water outlet device comprises a water outlet part, wherein the water outlet part comprises an adapter and a water outlet pipe body, the adapter is provided with a first adapter part, a water inlet of the water outlet pipe body is provided with a second adapter part, the first adapter part and the second adapter part can mutually rotate and are in sealing fit, the water outlet pipe body can rotate relative to the adapter, and therefore the water outlet angle is adjusted; meanwhile, a limiting piece is arranged between the first switching part and the second switching part, so that the rotation angle of the water outlet pipe body is limited, and water splashing caused by the rotation of the water outlet pipe body outside the counter basin is avoided. Still include the water outlet joint, the water outlet joint is equipped with grafting convex part, is equipped with sealed axle in the adapter, and sealed axle is equipped with water inlet channel along its axis direction, and sealed axle outer wall forms the grafting recess with the adapter inner wall, and adapter external fixation has first decoration lid, and grafting convex part and grafting recess are sealed and can follow axial slip looks adaptation each other for the adapter can outwards slide along with first decoration lid, thereby the wall body of the different thickness of adaptation.

title_en: Roots type vapor compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Roots type vapor compressor, which has the technical scheme that a vapor mechanism is arranged for solving the problems of low air inlet rate and high noise at times, a compression mechanism is arranged for solving the problems of excessively heavy device and difficult shipment or movement, and a driving mechanism is arranged for solving the problem of low compression efficiency of the device; make the device be difficult for taking place to empty through setting up the base, cause the device to damage, the steam delivery capacity of device has been improved through setting up the evaporating chamber, make the device can realize steam cycle, through setting up integral type compression case, the closure of device has been improved, the work efficiency of device has been improved, through setting up the removal wheel, make the device be convenient for remove and transport, the convenience of device has been improved, make device impeller synchronous operation through setting up synchronous gear, realize vapor compression effect, through setting up the impeller of three blades, make the compressibility of device improve, the work efficiency of device has been improved.

title_en: Drum-shaped tooth coupling
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drum-shaped tooth couplings, and discloses a drum-shaped tooth coupling, which comprises a half coupling, wherein fastening bolts are movably connected between adjacent half coupling ends, threaded holes are formed in the other end of the half coupling, a connecting mechanism is arranged at the other end of the half coupling, an auxiliary positioning reinforcing mechanism is fixedly connected to the outer side of the surface of the other fastening bolt, positioning holes are formed in the adjacent half coupling ends, a transmission groove is formed in the half coupling, the connecting mechanism comprises a connecting sleeve block, and one end of the inner side of the connecting sleeve block is movably connected with the connecting bolts; according to the utility model, the connecting mechanism is arranged and can be connected with the half coupling through the threaded hole, and the connecting mechanism can be connected with the flange of the external part, so that transmission is performed, meanwhile, the original transmission groove is reserved, connection transmission with the transmission shaft is facilitated, and the overall practicability is improved.

title_en: Novel brake
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel brake, which comprises a first shell, wherein the end face of the first shell is fixedly connected with the end face of a second shell, a rotating plate is rotatably arranged on the end face of one section of the first shell, an eccentric shaft is fixedly arranged in the middle of the end face of the rotating plate, the eccentric shaft penetrates through a through hole in the end face of the first shell to extend to the outside of the first shell, three arc-shaped passive friction plates are fixedly arranged on the other end face of the rotating plate, and a movable ring is movably arranged in the other end of the first shell.

title_en: Flexible easy-to-install drag chain sheath
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexible easy-to-install drag chain sheath which comprises an upper protective layer, a lower protective layer, a keel layer and a fixed chuck, wherein the upper protective layer and the lower protective layer are fixedly connected along two sides of the length direction of the upper protective layer, the keel layer is arranged between the upper protective layer and the lower protective layer, the keel layer is connected with the upper protective layer and the lower protective layer through the fixed chuck, and the lower protective layer is provided with an opening and closing part along the length direction of the lower protective layer. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the cable and the dragon bone layer are conveniently placed on the opening and closing portion, the opening and closing portion is designed on the lower protective layer, bending stress born by the opening and closing portion is smaller than that born by the upper protective layer when the drag chain reciprocates, the whole structure is simpler, and production cost is saved.

title_en: CNC secondary grinding high concentricity full hard screw rod
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a CNC secondary grinding high concentricity full hard screw rod, which comprises a full hard screw head and a high concentricity full hard screw rod, wherein the full hard screw head is screwed at the front end of the high concentricity full hard screw rod, the high concentricity full hard screw rod is of a cylindrical structure, screw teeth are spirally arranged outside the high concentricity full hard screw rod around the circumference of the high concentricity full hard screw rod, and a cylindrical tail part is arranged at the rear end of the high concentricity full hard screw rod; the beneficial effects are that: according to the utility model, the CNC secondary grinding high-concentricity full-hard screw is reasonably arranged, and the full-hard screw head and the cylindrical tail end are conveniently screwed on the high-concentricity full-hard screw, so that the full-hard screw head and the cylindrical tail end can be flexibly assembled according to different requirements, and the full-hard screw is firm in structure and convenient and flexible to use.

title_en: Elastic rod driven rotary direct drive servo valve structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mechanical engineering, and discloses a rotary direct-drive servo valve structure driven by an elastic rod, which comprises: the spool valve comprises a spool valve shell, a spool valve, an elastic rod and a limited-angle torque motor; the elastic rod is arranged at the end part of the valve core, and the elastic free end is connected with an eccentric small ball at the end part of an output shaft of the limited-angle torque motor; the valve core is arranged in the shell; the output shaft of the limited corner torque motor outputs torque and a corner, and drives the elastic rod to do planar motion, so as to drive the valve core to reciprocate. The rotary direct drive servo valve structure of the utility model realizes the conversion from the rotary motion of the motor to the linear motion of the valve core through the elastic rod, can realize the continuous control of flow, reduces the friction loss between kinematic pairs and prolongs the service life of the servo valve. And the valve core only has linear motion and no rotary motion, so that the risk of clamping stagnation of the valve core is further reduced.

title_en: High-elasticity polytetrafluoroethylene modified sealing element
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of sealing elements, and discloses a high-elasticity polytetrafluoroethylene modified sealing element. The application discloses a high-elasticity polytetrafluoroethylene modified sealing piece, which comprises an outer ring sealing ring, wherein the inner side end of the outer ring sealing ring is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the inner side end of the outer ring sealing ring is fixedly connected with an inner ring sealing ring through the connecting block, the inner side end of the inner ring sealing ring is provided with an inner ring mounting groove, an inner ring extrusion piece is fixedly arranged in the inner ring mounting groove, the inner side wall of the outer ring sealing ring is provided with an outer ring mounting groove, the inner side of the outer ring mounting groove is fixedly provided with an outer ring extrusion piece, and the top end of the outer ring extrusion piece is fixedly connected with a first compression ring. The device is provided with the inner and outer high-elasticity polytetrafluoroethylene modified sealing parts, the compression resistance of the device can be improved while the sealing effect is improved, and when the inner sealing part is damaged, the outer sealing part is also protected, so that the possibility of leakage is reduced.

title_en: Projector mounting bracket suitable for mounting in different types
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of projector mounting brackets, and particularly discloses a projector mounting bracket suitable for mounting in different types, which comprises a stand column, wherein a fixing seat is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the stand column, a connecting block is hinged at the top of the stand column, a footstock is fixedly arranged at the top of the connecting block, a projector is movably arranged on the footstock, folding seats are fixedly arranged on two sides of the projector through bolts, the folding seats are fixedly arranged at the top of the footstock through bolts, a shaft body is clamped at the middle part of the connecting block, a positioning hole is formed in the outer surface of the shaft body in a surrounding manner, a clamping rod structure matched with the positioning hole is arranged on the outer part of the stand column, storage grooves are formed in the four vertical surfaces of the stand column, a supporting leg structure is rotatably arranged in the storage grooves through hinging pieces, and a stop block is fixedly arranged above each storage groove. According to the technical scheme, the installation can be switched into standing, hanging and wall hanging at will, so that the effect of adapting to different types of installation is achieved, and the application range is wide.

title_en: Municipal works sewer line strutting arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a municipal engineering sewage pipeline supporting device, in particular to the technical field of sewage pipeline construction, which comprises four wheels, wherein the upper ends of the two wheels on the left side and the right side of displacement are fixedly connected with a movable lifting mechanism together, two the equal fixedly connected with elevating system in one side that the mechanism is close to each other is raised in the removal, elevating system upper portion fixedly connected with supporting mechanism, supporting mechanism upper portion left side and right side all sliding connection have fixed clamping mechanism. The supporting device for municipal engineering sewage pipeline construction has the advantages that the lifting mechanism is used for controlling the up-and-down movement of the supporting shell under the effect that the lifting mechanism is used for lifting, moving, lowering and supporting equipment, so that the supporting device is suitable for the fluctuation of the terrain of a pipeline construction site and the connection position and the height of a sewage pipeline, the supporting mechanism is used for providing support and stabilization for the supporting pipeline, and the fixed clamping mechanism is used for clamping and fixing the sewage pipeline.

title_en: Split type easy loading and unloading valve body
abstract_en: The utility model provides a split type valve body easy to assemble and disassemble. The split type easy loading and unloading valve body includes: the valve body comprises a left valve body, a right valve body, a valve core, a valve rod and two water through holes, wherein the left valve body is connected with the right valve body in an adaptive manner, the valve core is arranged on the right valve body, and the valve rod is arranged on the valve core; the two connecting discs are fixedly arranged on the left valve body and the right valve body respectively; the two first sealing gaskets are respectively arranged on the two connecting discs and are matched with each other; the connecting and fixing mechanisms are arranged on the two connecting discs. The split type valve body easy to assemble and disassemble provided by the utility model has good tightness, effectively reduces the occurrence of water leakage, and further prolongs the service life of the whole valve body.

title_en: Screw connection structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a threaded connection structure, and relates to the technical field of detachable connection structures. The threaded connection structure comprises a base plate, a threaded sleeve and an anti-loosening assembly, wherein a first mounting hole is formed in the base plate; the thread sleeve is arranged in the first mounting hole and detachably connected with the hole wall of the first mounting hole, an inner thread is arranged on the inner side surface of the thread sleeve, and an outer thread is arranged on the outer side surface of the thread sleeve; the anti-loosening assembly is connected with the hole wall of the first mounting hole and the threaded sleeve, so that the threaded sleeve is fixed in the first mounting hole. The threaded connection structure provided by the application can prevent the loosening of the threaded sleeve, so that the threaded connection structure is more stable, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Two-stage adjustable support of worm and gear reducer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of speed reducers, and discloses a two-stage adjustable support of a worm and gear speed reducer, which comprises a main body mechanism and a positioning mechanism, wherein the positioning mechanism is positioned above the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a support body and a worm and gear speed reducer body, the worm and gear speed reducer body is positioned above the support body, and the main body mechanism further comprises a driving shaft, a driving sprocket, a roller chain, an electric sliding rail, an electric sliding block and a driven sprocket. This adjustable support of worm gear reducer two-stage has realized through installation main part mechanism that this support body is when using, and the staff can be through the operation to electronic slide rail, drives electronic slider and moves about, carries out suitable regulation to roller chain's rate of tension, and the drive mode of electric power makes the regulation of this support body more convenient, has improved the adjustment efficiency to worm gear reducer body, has improved the automation of this support body.

title_en: Mechanical arm of casting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a casting machine, in particular to a mechanical arm of the casting machine, which comprises a stand column and an operation plate, wherein a connecting piece is arranged at the top of the stand column, one side of the connecting piece is connected with a first movable arm through a rotating shaft, one side of the first movable arm is connected with a second movable arm through a rotating shaft, the bottom of the second movable arm is connected with an operation rod through the rotating shaft, one side of the operation rod is connected with a clamping arm, and the operation plate is connected to one side of the operation rod far away from the clamping arm; the top of connecting piece is installed the batch oil tank, and the internally mounted of batch oil tank has the fixed block, and the internally mounted of fixed block has driving motor. The connecting shaft inside the connecting piece can be lubricated without disassembly, and lubrication is convenient.

title_en: Gear drive type telescopic machining assembly
abstract_en: The application discloses a gear transmission type telescopic machining assembly, which relates to the technical field of coil production and comprises a machining table, a supporting table fixedly connected to the outer wall of the machining table, wherein a machining mechanism is arranged on the supporting table, a limiting mechanism is arranged on the machining mechanism, a motor is started, the output end of the motor drives a rotating shaft to rotate so as to drive a main gear to rotate, when the main gear rotates, a driven gear can be driven to rotate so as to drive a cam to rotate, when a protruding block of the cam rotates to contact and extrude a roller, a machining rod can be driven to move on the inner wall of a chute, meanwhile, the machining rod can drive a connecting column to move in the moving process so as to stretch a spring, at the moment, the machining rod close to a wire can perform a series of machining operations on the wire, and when the cam rotates and no longer contacts the roller, the spring at the moment can rebound to reset so as to repeatedly perform continuous machining operations.

title_en: Connecting rod mechanism transmission teaching demonstration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting rod mechanism transmission teaching demonstration device, which relates to the field of mechanical teaching aids and comprises a bottom plate and a demonstration mechanism, wherein a demonstration board is arranged on the upper wall of the bottom plate, the demonstration mechanism is arranged on the side wall of the demonstration board, the demonstration mechanism comprises a rotating disc, a connecting rod mechanism, a limiting plate and a sliding block, the rotating disc is rotatably arranged on the side wall of the demonstration board, the limiting plate is arranged on the side wall of the demonstration board, one end of the connecting rod mechanism is arranged on the side wall of the rotating disc, the other end of the connecting rod mechanism is arranged on the sliding block, a fixed cylinder is arranged on the side wall of the demonstration board, a rotating column is inserted into the fixed cylinder, a groove is formed in the side wall of the rotating column, and a magnet is arranged in the groove.

title_en: Grain processing beating structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grain processing beating structure, which comprises a base, wherein a damping mechanism is arranged on the base, the upper surface of a mounting plate is connected with a supporting rod, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the supporting rod, a cover plate is connected to the lifting mechanism, a beating mechanism is arranged on the cover plate, and an anti-accumulation mechanism is connected to the inside of a beating tank. According to the grain processing beating structure, the electric push rod is started to drive the bottom end of the connecting frame and the cover plate to move downwards, so that the fixing ring is driven to be inserted into the fixing groove, the beating tank is sealed to prevent grains from splashing out during beating, beating effect is affected, the beating motor is started to drive the gear I to rotate, the beating rod is driven to beat grains, the rotating rod can be driven to slide on the annular groove on the lower surface of the cover plate through the cooperation between the gear II and the annular rack, beating range of the beating rod can be enlarged, and grain beating is finer.

title_en: A remove frame for assisting video shooting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable frame for assisting video shooting, which comprises a mounting frame and a sliding frame, wherein the mounting frame is provided with a left mounting frame and a right mounting frame, the left end and the right end of the sliding frame are respectively fixed on the mounting frame on the same side, the movable frame also comprises a fixing plate, a motor, a first rotating shaft, a second rotating shaft, a driving belt, a limiting plate, a camera fixing seat and pulleys, the fixing plate is fixed on the upper side surfaces of the left end and the right end of the sliding frame, the motor is fixed on the fixing plate on the right side, the first rotating shaft is fixed at the output shaft end of the motor after penetrating through the fixing plate, the second rotating shaft is fixed at the lower side of the fixing plate on the left side, the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are in transmission connection through the driving belt, and the limiting plates are fixed at the rear sides of the left end and the right end of the sliding frame. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that: 1. the left end and the right end of the sliding frame are respectively fixed on the mounting frames on the same side, and the driving motor works to drive the camera to automatically move, so that the stability of the camera during movement is improved. 2. The camera can be firmly fixed. 3. The camera is smoother when moving, convenient and efficient.

title_en: Hydraulic cylinder with damping mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of hydraulic cylinders with damping mechanisms, and discloses a hydraulic cylinder with the damping mechanisms, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the damping mechanisms, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a base, the top of the base is provided with a hydraulic cylinder body, the top of the base is provided with a fixing mechanism, the damping mechanisms comprise fixing rods, positioning rods and damping springs, the bottoms of the fixing plates are fixedly connected with the bottom plate, the bottoms of the positioning rods are in sliding connection with the interiors of the fixing rods, the damping springs are sleeved on the surfaces of the fixing rods, and the top of the positioning rods and the base are fixedly connected with the damping springs.

title_en: Worm gear reduction box mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of worm gear reduction boxes, and relates to a worm gear reduction box mechanism, which comprises a reduction box body and a lubricating assembly arranged at the top end part of the worm gear reduction box body, wherein the lubricating assembly comprises a mounting shell, a rotatable oil storage cylinder is arranged in the mounting shell, a rotating cylinder extending out of the mounting shell is arranged on the oil storage cylinder, an oil inlet pipe is arranged on the outer side wall of the rotating cylinder extending out of the mounting shell, an oil storage cavity is arranged in the oil storage cylinder, a detachable bottom plate is arranged at the bottom end part of the oil storage cavity, a plurality of oil outlet holes are uniformly distributed on the bottom plate, an oil separation frame plate capable of moving up and down is arranged in the oil storage cavity, a plurality of oil leakage grooves are arranged on the oil separation frame plate, a plurality of lower piston rods are arranged on the bottom plate surface of the oil separation frame plate, and the lower piston rods can be arranged in corresponding oil outlet holes in a moving mode, and the oil separation frame plate moves up and down to be used for controlling the opening and closing of the oil outlet holes. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the lubrication assembly, the reduction gearbox body can be uniformly lubricated.

title_en: Flaring flange for ship pipeline connection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flaring flanges, in particular to a flaring flange for ship pipeline connection, which comprises a flaring flange body, wherein the flaring flange body is sleeved and fixed on a ship pipeline, a buckling groove and a bolt hole are formed in the surface of the flaring flange body, a first embedding groove is formed in the surface of the flaring flange body, the first embedding groove is communicated with the bolt hole, a second embedding groove is formed in the surface of the first embedding groove, and an elastic plug piece is fixed on the surface of the second embedding groove; the beneficial effects are as follows: according to the flaring flange for ship pipeline connection, after the elastic plug piece is additionally arranged on the inner side of the bolt hole, the elastic plug piece is elastically supported between the bolt hole and the screw rod of the bolt after the bolt passes through the bolt hole, namely, the shaking between the screw rod and the bolt hole caused by the existence of gaps is avoided, and the loosening of the bolt is effectively avoided; the problem of hidden danger of bolt loosening after the existing flaring flange is connected with the bolt is further solved; the loosening of the bolts in the bolt holes can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Clamping mechanism for head-mounted camera
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamping mechanism for a head-mounted camera, which comprises the following components: the aluminum alloy sheet is fixedly provided with an adjusting plate at the end head, the surface of the adjusting plate is provided with a limit groove, and the surface of the adjusting plate is sheathed with a connecting column in a sliding way; the limiting and fixing assembly is arranged on the side surface of the connecting column and is used for adjusting and fixing the adjusting plate; wear the subassembly, wear the subassembly and install spliced pole and aluminum alloy strip topside, wear the subassembly and be used for the user's head to wear. Make things convenient for fixture to correspond different users and wear, through buckling aluminum alloy piece, aluminum alloy and corresponding head position laminating, conveniently wear, carry out spacing placing through wearing the subassembly, be convenient for support the user's head to fixture is whole, guarantee fixture's place stably.

title_en: From pneumatic shock absorber of taking damping
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pneumatic shock absorber with damping, which comprises a working cylinder and a shell which are sleeved and connected, wherein the inner wall of the shell is provided with a first sealing component, the inner side of the first sealing component is abutted against the periphery of the working cylinder, the periphery of the working cylinder is provided with a second sealing component, and the periphery of the sealing component is abutted against the inner side of the shell to form a first air chamber in the shell; the working cylinder is internally provided with a bidirectional air valve which divides the inner cavity of the working cylinder into a second air chamber and a third air chamber, a plurality of first air holes are formed in the position of the third air chamber, the first air holes can discharge air between the first sealing component and the second sealing component, the space of the fourth air chamber is gradually reduced during rebound, the air of the fourth air chamber enters the third air chamber from the first air holes, the air flow rate determines the time for gradually reducing the four volumes of the air chamber when entering the second air chamber through the bidirectional air valve, the rebound speed in the prior art is slow, more time is required, and therefore the rebound speed is slowed down, and a damping effect is achieved.

title_en: Docking station support
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of docking stations, and provides a docking station bracket, which comprises: the docking station comprises a bracket body and a docking station main body, wherein the bracket body comprises a bottom plate and a backup plate which are connected, the backup plate is arranged on one side of the bottom plate, and the backup plate is provided with a first side face facing the bottom plate; the expansion dock main body is arranged on the side where the first side face is located, is rotationally connected with the backup plate, and is provided with a plurality of expansion ports on the circumferential side face; the docking main body has a supporting surface facing away from the first side surface. The expansion docking main body is rotatably connected with the backup plate, so that the expansion docking main body can rotate around the axis of the expansion docking main body relative to the backup plate, and when external equipment and an expansion port on a part of the expansion docking main body, which faces to the bottom plate, are required to be connected or separated, the expansion docking main body can be rotated, the orientation of the corresponding part of expansion ports is changed, namely, the expansion ports of the corresponding part are far away from the bottom plate, the operation space is enlarged, and the operation of a user is facilitated.

title_en: Movable live broadcast all-in-one
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a movable direct seeding all-in-one machine, which comprises a stand column, wherein the upper end of the stand column is fixedly connected with a fixed shaft, the surface of the fixed shaft is fixedly connected with a gear, a support frame is fixedly connected between two sides of the fixed shaft, the middle end of the front surface of the support frame is movably connected with a pull rod, the back surface of the pull rod is fixedly connected with a toothed plate, the toothed plate is meshed with the gear, a first spring is fixedly connected between the front surface of the toothed plate and an inner cavity of the support frame, and the left side of the support frame is fixedly connected with a mounting seat. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the pull rod, the toothed plate, the first spring, the gear, the mounting seat, the supporting frame and the fixed shaft, the effect of adjusting the use angle of the direct seeding integrated machine body is achieved, and through the arrangement of the rotating shaft, the cam, the L-shaped rod, the inserted link, the second spring, the jack and the L-shaped clamping plate, the effect of rapidly disassembling the direct seeding integrated machine body is achieved.

title_en: Anti-collision and automatic lifting walking driving device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of digital home systems, in particular to an anti-collision and automatic lifting walking driving device, which comprises wheel motors, wherein a base table is fixed between the symmetrically arranged wheel motors, a lifter for driving the wheel motors to lift and adjust is fixed in the base table, and an anti-collision buffer shell is wrapped on the outer wall of the base table through longitudinal adjustment of threads; the wheel motor comprises a fixed plate, a torsion spring, a connecting rotating piece, a flange and a motor shaft, wherein the fixed plate is rotationally connected to an extension shaft of the connecting rotating piece, the torsion spring is arranged between the fixed plate and the connecting rotating piece, the flange is connected to the connecting rotating piece through a plurality of first screws, and the flange is connected to the motor shaft through a plurality of second screws; the utility model has the beneficial effects of solving the problems that the prior art has weak anti-collision protection effect, can not effectively buffer protection, and can not effectively collect information in combination with collision so as to avoid collision.

title_en: Linear slider convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a linear sliding block convenient to mount, and relates to the technical field of sliding blocks. According to the utility model, when the sliding block is required to be installed, the first installation block and the second installation block are attached to the sliding rail, at the moment, the rotating shaft is inserted to enable the rotating shaft to be in sliding connection with the shaft body, so that the rotating shaft drives the shaft body to rotate, at the moment, the fixing part and the locking part work cooperatively to enable the first damping rotating shaft and the second damping rotating shaft to rotate reversely, and a spline structure is arranged between the rotating shaft and the first damping rotating shaft, so that the first installation block and the second installation block are fixed through rotation of the rotating shaft, and the aim of convenient installation is achieved. When needs take off, loose locking part, with the axis of rotation reverse rotation, the axis of rotation can take out and the position of first damping pivot and second damping pivot can not change this moment, can also realize convenient to detach's purpose.

title_en: Positioning mechanism for processing of cork pad pasting machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of cork pad pasting machines, and discloses a positioning mechanism for cork pad pasting machines, which comprises two limiting frames, a first movable positioning plate and a second movable positioning plate, wherein the first movable positioning plate and the second movable positioning plate are both positioned between the two limiting frames, and two corners at the top end of the first movable positioning plate and two corners at the top end of the second movable positioning plate are both welded with sliding blocks. This scheme is through being equipped with two spacing frames, all is provided with the drive assembly who is used for driving four sliders and removes at the interior middle part of two spacing frames for four sliders cooperation drive first movable locating plate and second movable locating plate and are close to each other, and three semicircular hole that the one end of first movable locating plate top was seted up and the three semicircular hole that one end of second movable locating plate top was seted up at this moment cooperate one by one respectively and form three locating hole, carries out centre gripping location to three sheet metal circular plates.

title_en: Connecting device and rack with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting device and a placing frame with the connecting device, which comprises a sleeve, a fastener and a protective sleeve, wherein the upper end and the lower end of the sleeve are of hollow structures, the protective sleeve is detachably sleeved in the sleeve, the fastener can move between abutting joint and disengaging abutting joint with the outer wall surface of the protective sleeve after penetrating through the sleeve, the protective sleeve is displaced during abutting joint, and the protective sleeve is arranged in the connecting assembly.

title_en: Bearing sealing ring
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of bearing sealing rings and discloses a bearing sealing ring, which comprises a sealing lip body, wherein a high-temperature-resistant lining is arranged in the sealing lip body, a sealing layer is arranged outside the high-temperature-resistant lining, a sealing ring is detachably arranged at the center of the inside of the sealing lip body, a convex strip is arranged on the outer wall of the sealing ring in an integrated structure, and a sealing inner ring is arranged at one end of the sealing ring. The sealing lip body is arranged in a combined way with the sealing ring, so that the sealing lip body can improve the contact tightness with the bearing, has a good sealing effect, can be detachably arranged and can be detached for use according to the use requirement, the sealing lip body enhances the durability and the sealing effect of the sealing ring by introducing a high-temperature-resistant and anti-aging middle layer between the metal base material and the sealing layer, and the sealing lip body combines the advantages of metal and rubber, has the advantages of high strength and high heat resistance of the metal, has the elasticity and the sealing performance of the rubber, adopts a multi-layer composite structure on the structure of the sealing ring, and enlarges the contact area with the bearing.

title_en: Air compressor machine pipeline interface structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air compressor pipeline interface structure, which relates to the technical field of air compressor pipeline interfaces and comprises an outer sleeve, an inner clamping assembly and a sealing assembly, wherein the outer surface of the inner clamping pipe is connected with the outer sleeve through screw threads in a rotating mode, the inner clamping assembly is arranged on the inner wall of the inner clamping pipe and used for clamping and connecting the pipeline interface, and the sealing assembly is arranged on one side of the inner clamping pipe and used for connecting, attaching and sealing the inner clamping pipe with an external pipeline. This kind of air compressor machine pipeline interface structure can utilize interior clamp assembly to follow the inside of pipeline and carry out the centre gripping to the object, can utilize the mode of inside centre gripping to prevent long-time centre gripping emergence not hard up condition at the in-process of centre gripping, improves the fixed stability of centre gripping of device, utilizes seal assembly to laminate between interior clamp pipe and the outside pipeline interface to utilize sealed absorptive effect to improve the stability of connection, with this emergence that prevents situations such as gas leakage, improves the leakproofness of device.

title_en: Synchronous oil cylinder with automatic exhaust structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a synchronous oil cylinder with an automatic exhaust structure, which comprises a first oil cylinder and a second oil cylinder, wherein the first oil cylinder and the second oil cylinder comprise a front cover, a rear cover, a piston rod penetrating the front cover and capable of moving, a piston connected with the piston rod, a cylinder pipe sleeved outside the front cover and the rear cover, and a check valve arranged between the piston and the rear cover, a first cavity is formed between the front cover and the piston, a second cavity is formed between the rear cover and the piston, a first oil inlet communicated with the first cavity and a second oil inlet communicated with the second cavity are arranged on the cylinder pipe, and the first oil inlet of the first oil cylinder is communicated with the second oil inlet of the second oil cylinder. The synchronous oil cylinder is additionally provided with the two-way actuation mechanical check valve in the oil cylinder, so that the first oil cylinder and the second oil cylinder can realize automatic exhaust, manual exhaust is avoided, the working efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the air in the first oil cylinder and the second oil cylinder is exhausted, so that the stability of the synchronous oil cylinder is greatly improved.

title_en: Adjustable correction equipment for face recognition
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of face recognition, and discloses adjustable correction equipment for face recognition, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a rotating column is rotatably connected to the top of the bottom plate, and an installation seat is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the rotating column. This correction equipment with adjustable face identification is with rotating through a starter motor drive bull stick, and the bull stick drives bevel gear two and rotates, and bevel gear two drives bevel gear one and rotate, and bevel gear one drives the lead screw and rotate to make the lead screw drive slider and move perpendicularly under the spacing of spout, the slider drives the bracing piece and removes, and the bracing piece drives the bottom plate and removes, thereby can be according to the user of different heights to the height of bottom plate and camera adjust, can make the camera accurately face fast, accomplish the discernment to different height people, improve the efficiency of discernment.

title_en: Bracelet formula clamping device that makes a video recording
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bracelet formula clamping device that makes a video recording, includes the centre gripping stabilizing mean, centre gripping stabilizing mean bottom both sides are connected with the clitellum pole that warp, the clitellum pole that warp includes a plurality of connecting joints that connect gradually. The connecting joint can rotate, so that the deformed endless belt rod is deformed into a bracelet type or a holding rod type. Compared with the prior art, the hand ring has the advantages that the hand ring can be deformed to be worn on the hand, the case is not required to be stored, and the hand ring is convenient to carry.

title_en: Lubricating assembly of wind power generation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lubrication assembly of wind power generation equipment, which comprises an oil tank, wherein a pump body is fixedly arranged on the inner bottom wall of the oil tank, the output end of the pump body is fixedly communicated with a transmission pipe, the output end of the transmission pipe penetrates through the oil tank and extends to the outside of the oil tank, two groups of mounting brackets are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the filter tank, and a magnetic filter and a filter screen are respectively and fixedly connected to one side surfaces, close to each other, of the two groups of mounting brackets. This device passes through the filter tank, the installing support, mutually supporting of magnetic filter and filter screen, can play filterable effect to the inside backward flow lubricating oil of back flow to avoid the inside that the residue was brought into the oil tank to the backward flow lubricating oil, ensured the normal work of the pump body, improved the work efficiency of the device, mutually supporting through sealing door and arm-tie can be convenient for the staff clear up magnetic filter and filter screen, avoid long-time use to take place the phenomenon of jam.

title_en: Low-noise hydraulic pump station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-noise hydraulic pump station, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic stations and comprises a hydraulic pump station assembly, a connecting mechanism and a sliding mechanism, wherein the sliding mechanism comprises a sliding limiting groove, a first magnetic block, a first arc-shaped plate, a sliding block, a second magnetic block, a second arc-shaped hole and a handle. According to the utility model, the sliding mechanism is arranged, so that when the hydraulic pump station is maintained and inspected, an operator can drive the sliding block to slide out of the sliding limiting groove through pulling the handle, the sliding block slides to drive the sliding plate to slide and separate the first magnetic block from the second magnetic block, the mute cover can move upwards, the operator can conveniently maintain and inspect the hydraulic pump station assembly, the situation that the operator needs to detach the connecting oil pipe and then operate when the operator maintains and inspects the hydraulic pump station is avoided, a large amount of time is saved, and the working efficiency of the operator is improved.

title_en: Alarm device anti-disassembly mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-disassembly mechanism of an alarm device, which belongs to the technical field of alarm devices and comprises a wall body and an alarm device body, wherein an installation seat with a protruding lower part is arranged in the wall body, a sleeve shell sleeved outside the installation seat is arranged above the alarm device body, telescopic rods are respectively arranged on the inner walls of the sleeve shell, a first magnet for enabling the telescopic rods to extend is arranged in the middle of the lower part of the installation seat, holes for enabling a plurality of telescopic rods to be inserted are formed in the outer side of the first magnet, the telescopic rods are shortened through control of a second magnet with magnetism larger than that of the first magnet, bolts are not needed when the alarm device is installed through the installation seat, the sleeve shell, the first magnet and the telescopic rods which are installed in the wall body, so that the problem that the alarm device body cannot be fixed due to sliding wires is avoided, and meanwhile, due to the fact that bolts are not used, some illegal persons cannot disassemble the alarm device.

title_en: Oil seal structure for reducing abrasion possibility of foreign matters on sealing lip
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an oil seal structure for reducing the possibility of abrasion of foreign matters of a sealing lip, which relates to the technical field of oil seals, and comprises an outer framework and a sealing body, wherein the outer framework is provided with a first subsection extending along a first direction and a second subsection extending along a second direction, the sealing body is provided with a main sealing lip extending to the first subsection and a secondary sealing lip extending to the second subsection, the main sealing lip, the secondary sealing lip, the first subsection and the second subsection enclose a first sealing space, a second sealing space is arranged adjacent to the first sealing space, the first sealing space and the second sealing space are mutually separated through the secondary sealing lip, and the second subsection is provided with a guide part for guiding the foreign matters to enter the second sealing space. The oil seal structure disclosed by the utility model can effectively reduce the abrasion of the main sealing lip.

title_en: Total powerstation auxiliary stay device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of total stations, in particular to an auxiliary supporting device of a total station, which comprises a tray and a placing table, the placing table is arranged above the tray, the supporting and adjusting device is arranged on the upper surface of the tray, and the clamping and fixing device is arranged inside the placing table. This total powerstation auxiliary stay device, when the height of total powerstation needs to be adjusted, press the joint piece, make its extrusion spring and slide into the spring intracavity portion, afterwards upwards pull the adjustment sliding sleeve, thereby adjust the height of the total powerstation on the platform of placing at its top, after the high adjustment is accomplished, the joint piece is corresponding with the joint hole of adjusting the sliding sleeve surface, afterwards, the inside of joint hole is gone into to the card under the elastic drive of spring, accomplish the fixed to the height, when the horizontal angle of total powerstation needs to be adjusted, rotate and place the platform, drive the bulb of its bottom in rotatory storehouse inside rotation, after accomplishing the angle adjustment, screw the bolt into the inside of screw hole, until its inner butt bulb, thereby accomplish the fixed of horizontal angle.

title_en: Disc brake assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a disc brake assembly which comprises a mounting plate and a brake disc, wherein a fixing frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate, a fixing block is fixedly arranged in the fixing frame, hydraulic cylinders are rotatably arranged at two ends of the fixing block, and connecting pieces are rotatably arranged at one ends of the two hydraulic cylinders. According to the disc brake assembly provided by the utility model, the brake is mounted with the automobile through the cooperation of the mounting plate and the bolts, when braking is needed, the two hydraulic cylinders are extended, because the hydraulic cylinders are rotatably mounted with the fixing blocks, the hydraulic cylinders are rotatably mounted with the connecting rods, the clamping plates are rotatably mounted with the fixing frame, so that the two clamping plates are mutually close, the two clamping plates are used for mounting the calipers, the calipers are in contact with the brake disc, the brake disc is further stopped to rotate, braking is effectively completed, the rotating part greatly improves the rotating stability of the clamping plates, further the braking effect is improved, and the disc brake assembly is simple in structure and convenient to use.

title_en: Coaxial electric drive system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric drive, and provides a coaxial electric drive system which comprises a motor shaft, an output shaft coaxially penetrating through the motor shaft, an oil input channel leading to the output shaft and the first end of the motor shaft and rotatably supported by bearings respectively, and a bearing channel and a shaft channel communicated with the oil input channel, wherein the bearing channel is formed at least by a first sealing structure, the first sealing structure is arranged between the bearing and the oil input channel, the shaft channel is formed between the output shaft and the motor shaft, and one end of the shaft channel, which is far away from the oil input channel, is provided with a second sealing structure in clearance fit with the output shaft or the motor shaft. According to the utility model, oil is reasonably distributed through the bearing channel formed by at least the first sealing structure, and leakage after the oil enters the gap between the output shaft and the motor shaft is reduced through the second sealing structure arranged in the shaft channel, so that effective lubrication and cooling of the output shaft, the motor shaft, the bearings and other parts are realized.

title_en: Basement waterproof outer wall backfill structure for constructional engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of constructional engineering, in particular to a basement waterproof outer wall backfill structure for constructional engineering, which comprises a waterproof wall and a waterproof structure arranged on the waterproof wall, wherein the waterproof structure comprises a water pipe, a waterproof baffle, a gasket, a rubber sealing ring and a pressing piece, the waterproof baffle is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the water pipe, and the gasket is arranged on the outer side wall of the water pipe. The utility model overcomes the defects of the prior art, and after the waterproof baffle is additionally arranged, when water vapor passes through the gap between the outer wall of the water pipe and the waterproof wall, the water vapor also needs to pass through the paths at two sides of the waterproof baffle, so that the transmission distance of the water vapor is increased, the waterproof performance of the waterproof wall is enhanced, after the waterproof gasket is arranged, when concrete is filled into the included angle between the water pipe and the waterproof wall, the concrete is filled smoothly and uniformly, the occurrence of hole gaps is reduced, and the stability of the water pipe and the waterproof baffle is enhanced.

title_en: Integrated valve plate for steam mould temperature machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated valve plate for a steam mold temperature machine, which comprises a valve plate main body, wherein a first pipeline and a second pipeline are arranged on the valve plate main body, a first interface is arranged at one end of the valve plate main body, a second interface is arranged at one end of the valve plate main body, which is positioned on the second pipeline, a plurality of first connectors and a plurality of second connectors are arranged on the valve plate main body at intervals, the first connectors are communicated with the first pipeline, and the second connectors are communicated with the second pipeline. The utility model is characterized in that one end of the valve plate main body, which is positioned on the first pipeline, is provided with a first interface, one end of the valve plate main body, which is positioned on the second pipeline, is provided with a second interface, the valve plate main body is provided with a plurality of first connectors and a plurality of second connectors, the first connectors and the second connectors can be connected with pipelines of different media, and the transmission of the media is facilitated by adopting arc tubular connectors.

title_en: Valve body equipment convenient to emergency cut-off
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of valve body equipment, and particularly relates to valve body equipment convenient for emergency cutting, which comprises a device main body, wherein a detection mechanism is arranged on the surface of the device main body, a closing mechanism is fixedly connected with the surface of the device main body, the detection mechanism comprises an outer ring, the surface of the outer ring is fixedly connected with the surface of the device main body, a sponge block is slidably connected with the inner wall of the outer ring, and a gasket is fixedly connected with the bottom surface of the sponge block. This valve body equipment convenient to emergency cut off, through the detection mechanism who sets up, when the inside sealed handle department that arrives of ball valve shell and interior spheroid is broken through to the inside liquid of transportation of device main part, the sponge piece absorbs liquid for sponge piece self weight increases, thereby makes the sponge piece promote the slope slider under the effect of gravity and removes, makes the slope slider move trigger spring switch, thereby activates closing mechanism, compares with artificial inspection, detects more accurate and rapid through detection mechanism.

title_en: Portable antibacterial tube butt joint device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable antibacterial pipe interfacing apparatus, including the slide bar, the both ends symmetry of slide bar is equipped with the base, the top of base is equipped with down the fluting, the top of base is equipped with the spacing hoop, the both ends symmetry of base is equipped with the limiting plate, the inside of limiting plate is equipped with first bolt, be equipped with the stiffening rod between two bases, be equipped with two down fastening hoops on the slide bar, down fastening hoop can be along the slide bar synchronous to the slide bar in the middle of or two tip removal of slide bar, the top of every down fastening hoop is equipped with fastening hoop, go up fastening hoop, the both ends symmetry of fastening hoop is equipped with the fixed plate down, the inside of fixed plate is equipped with the second bolt, the bottom of fastening hoop is equipped with the stopper down, the symmetry is equipped with the gag lever post on the stopper, the inside of gag lever post is equipped with the holding chamber, the both sides face of fastening hoop is equipped with the opening down. The utility model not only can realize the stable alignment of two pipelines, but also is convenient for the staff to process the interfaces of the pipelines, saves the butting time and improves the operation efficiency.

title_en: Non-contact sealed anemometer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of wind measuring devices, in particular to a non-contact sealed wind measuring instrument which comprises a fan blade, a connecting part and a base, wherein the fan blade comprises a fixing part and a plurality of blades arranged on the circumference of the fixing part, a rotating shaft is arranged at the middle of the lower end of the fixing part, a first through hole is arranged at the middle of the connecting part, a bearing connected with the rotating shaft is arranged in the first through hole, one side, far away from the fan blade, of the connecting part is connected with the base, a measuring circuit board is arranged in the base, one side, close to the connecting part, of the fixing part is provided with an annular first sealing component, an annular second sealing component is arranged on the connecting part, and the first sealing component and the second sealing component are arranged in a mutually crossed manner and are not in contact with each other. The non-contact penetrating design on the wind meter can effectively avoid dust and the like from entering, even a small amount of dust enters, the dust can be blocked by a curve, and meanwhile, multiple penetrating can effectively prevent water.

title_en: Self-tapping screw with damping ring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fasteners, in particular to a self-tapping screw with a damping ring, which comprises a cone tail, a screw body and a pan head, wherein a rotary damping ring is arranged on the outer ring of the pan head, steel shots are arranged between the cone tail and the pan head, 4-6 anti-skew mechanisms are arranged on the rotary damping ring, the rotary damping ring comprises a guide rod, a support rod and a support pad, the support pad is arranged above the support rod, and the guide rod is connected with the support rod through a bolt. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, low manufacturing cost, good damping effect and simple operation, and can avoid deflection from beginning to end.

title_en: Quick-opening blind plate anti-collision device and quick-opening blind plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a quick-opening blind plate anti-collision device and a quick-opening blind plate, which comprise a blind plate cover, a pressing plate fixedly arranged on the inner side of the blind plate cover and an anti-collision buffer pad fastened on the inner side of the blind plate cover through the pressing plate, wherein the anti-collision buffer pad protrudes out of the pressing plate, a protruding structure extending towards the axis direction far away from the blind plate cover is arranged on one side of the anti-collision buffer pad, a groove structure matched with the protruding structure is arranged on one side of the pressing plate close to the blind plate cover so as to press the anti-collision buffer pad, when a pipe cleaner collides with the blind plate cover, the anti-collision buffer pad can resist damage caused by impact of the pipe cleaner during working, the service life of the blind plate cover is prolonged, the whole safety of a pipe cleaner receiving device is also protected, and meanwhile, the anti-collision buffer pad is made of a non-metal material generally, compared with a spring adopted in the prior art, the anti-corrosion resistance and the stability of the anti-collision buffer pad are also remarkably improved.

title_en: High-precision gear
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the gear, concretely relates to high accuracy gear, including the gear main part, the gear main part is the annular structure of edge toothed, the keyway has been seted up along radial to gear main part inner wall, gear main part terminal surface is fixed with the cooling tube, the cooling tube is fan annular bending, two openings all communicate and are fixed with the hose of cooling tube, the port that the cooling tube was kept away from to two hoses all communicates and is fixed with the pipe, the one end of two pipes all extends into inside the keyway, two drainage tubes have been inserted in the centre of gear main part, two drainage tube ports respectively with two pipe one end interference fit, the inner ring is installed to the middle integration of gear main part, inner ring inward flange and keyway inward flange coincidence, two sleeves are installed in the inner ring outside running through, two sleeves all communicate in the keyway. The utility model discloses utilize cold wind passageway to continue to absorb heat, can be in the closed environment for high accuracy gear continuously cooling, compromise the heat dissipation and reduce impurity interference.

title_en: Multi-joint ball hinge linkage locking universal bracket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hardware tools, in particular to a multi-joint ball hinge linkage locking universal bracket which comprises a plurality of sub-joint systems and a plurality of connecting cylinders, wherein each sub-joint system comprises an upper ball head rod, a lower ball head rod and a connecting structure, one end of the connecting structure is hinged with the ball head part of the upper ball head rod, the other end of the connecting structure is hinged with the ball head part of the lower ball head rod, one end of each connecting cylinder is fixedly connected with the rod part of the upper ball head rod, and the other end of each connecting cylinder is fixedly connected with the rod part of the lower ball head rod. The utility model connects the plurality of sub-joint mechanisms through the connecting cylinder, greatly improves the degree of freedom which can be achieved by the universal bracket, and has high practicability.

title_en: Twist-off type anti-theft bolt and nut
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of anti-theft bolts and nuts, and provides a twist-off anti-theft bolt and nut, which comprises a nut, a bolt and a bolt, wherein the nut is provided with a sliding surface; the connecting cap is arranged on the nut and used for driving the nut to rotate, and the bolt is arranged in the nut and is separated from the nut main body after being connected with the nut. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the anti-theft nut in the related art does not change the characteristic that the outer eave of the polygonal nut has a clamping plane capable of applying moment and the anti-theft effect is not ideal is solved.

title_en: Main track belt anti-shake structure of automatic slitting and clamping machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-shake structure of a main rail belt of an automatic slitting and clamping machine, which comprises a bracket arranged on one side of the main rail belt of the automatic slitting and clamping machine, a bearing shaft which is arranged on the bracket and has adjustable height, the bearing shaft extends to the upper part of the main rail belt of the automatic slitting and clamping machine, and a belt pulley which is rotatably arranged on the outer side of the bearing shaft and is meshed with the main rail belt of the automatic slitting and clamping machine. According to the scheme, the belt pulley is meshed with the belt through the support and the bearing shaft, so that the belt is in a tensioning state, the belt is prevented from shaking, the normal operation of the machine is ensured, and the service lives of the belt and the machine are guaranteed.

title_en: Injection molding machine lock shaft changes lubricated cooperation structure of cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lock shaft rotating sleeve lubrication, and discloses a lock shaft rotating sleeve lubrication fit structure of an injection molding machine, which comprises a lock shaft and a rotating sleeve which is rotatably sleeved on the lock shaft, wherein an oil injection hole for injecting lubricating oil into a fit gap between the lock shaft and the rotating sleeve is formed in the rotating sleeve, a first oil storage part capable of increasing the lubricating oil storage amount is formed in the inner wall of the rotating sleeve, a second oil storage part capable of uniformly lubricating the lock shaft and the rotating sleeve while increasing the lubricating oil storage amount is formed in the lock shaft, and sealing pieces which are rotatably and hermetically matched with the lock shaft to prevent the fit gap between the lubricating oil self-locking shaft and the rotating sleeve from leaking are arranged at two ends of the inner wall of the rotating sleeve.

title_en: Toppling-proof gas cylinder trolley
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-toppling gas cylinder trolley, which relates to the technical field of gas cylinder transportation and comprises a handle frame, wherein the bottoms of the two handle frames are fixedly connected with a first fixing plate together, the upper surface of the first fixing plate is fixedly connected with a fixing cylinder, the side walls of the two handle frames are fixedly connected with a first connecting rod, two movable wheels are arranged on the two first connecting rods together, the anti-toppling gas cylinder trolley further comprises an anti-toppling component and a buffer component, the side walls of the two handle frames are fixedly connected with a second fixing plate together, and the anti-toppling component is arranged on the side walls of the second fixing plate and used for improving stability in the transportation process of the trolley. When the gas cylinder is transported in a bumpy road section, the energy generated by vibration is reduced through the buffer component, the gas cylinder is protected, the gas cylinder is prevented from colliding with the inner side wall of the fixed cylinder in the transportation process, and the impact force of the gas cylinder when the gas cylinder is bumpy is also reduced.

title_en: Hinge seat and arm body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hinge seat and an arm body, wherein the hinge seat comprises a connecting plate, a pitching hinge lug plate and a side swinging hinge lug plate, the connecting plate is used for connecting a first side face of the arm body, the pitching hinge lug plate is arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate and provided with a first hinge hole for pitching driving of the arm body, and the side swinging hinge lug plate is arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate and provided with a second hinge hole for side swinging driving of the arm body. The utility model is applied to the field of engineering machinery, and the connecting plates are used as the connection transfer between the pitching hinge lug plate and the side swinging hinge lug plate and the arm body, so that the direct welding of the pitching hinge lug plate and the side swinging hinge lug plate and the arm body is avoided, and the problems of false welding or infirm welding caused by the fact that the thickness of the arm body is too small and the welding angle is too thin can be effectively solved.

title_en: Rotatable mobile phone live broadcast device
