abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of mobile phone live broadcast devices, in particular to a rotatable mobile phone live broadcast device which comprises a chassis, a support column, a movable rod, a placing plate and a support plate; the support column is arranged on the chassis; the movable rod is arranged in the support column in a sliding manner along the up-down direction; the mobile phone comprises a mobile rod, a supporting plate, a placing plate, a clamping assembly and a holding assembly, wherein the mobile rod is arranged on the mobile rod in a rotating way, the supporting plate is arranged on the mobile rod in a rotating way through a rotating piece, the placing plate is arranged on one side of the supporting plate in a rotating way, the placing plate is provided with the clamping assembly which is fastened on the supporting plate, and the placing plate is provided with the clamping assembly which is used for clamping the mobile phone. According to the utility model, the placing plate is rotatably arranged on one side of the supporting plate and is fastened through the fastening component, so that the mobile phone can realize horizontal screen live broadcast display or vertical screen live broadcast display during live broadcast, the diversity during live broadcast is increased, the requirements under different conditions are met, and the rotating piece is arranged between the supporting plate and the movable rod, so that the mobile phone can change different angles.

title_en: Concrete consistency detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a concrete consistency detection device, which relates to the technical field of concrete detection equipment and comprises a detection box, an extrusion detection assembly and a water inlet pipeline, wherein the extrusion detection assembly is arranged at the top of the detection box, and has the beneficial effects that the detection box, an installation transverse plate, a fixing frame and the extrusion detection assembly are arranged, the extrusion detection assembly is matched for extrusion test, a first electric telescopic rod is operated to drive a sliding rack to move upwards to drive a rotating gear to rotate to drive a connecting shaft to rotate to drive a limiting plate to integrally rotate, so that the detected concrete can be conveniently and automatically cleaned, the universal wheel is used for controlling the integral convenient movement, the water inlet pipeline is used for conveying cleaning water into the detection box in combination with the operation requirements of different places, and the water inlet pipeline is matched for cleaning treatment in the detection box, so that the integral structure is simple and easy to operate, and the normal use requirements are met.

title_en: Jet lubrication device of ball mill
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of mineral separation ball mills, and discloses a ball mill jet lubrication device which comprises a motor and a gear pump, wherein the output end of the motor is fixedly connected to the right side of an input shaft of the gear pump, the rear side of the gear pump is fixedly connected with an oil suction pipe, the other end of the oil suction pipe is fixedly connected with an oil storage tank, the front end of the gear pump is fixedly connected with an oil discharge pipe, the other end of the oil discharge pipe is fixedly connected with an oil outlet pipe, the left side of the oil outlet pipe is fixedly connected with a lubricating oil distributor, the left side of the lubricating oil distributor is fixedly connected with an air compressing distributor, and the output ends of the air compressing distributors are all fixedly connected with nozzles. According to the utility model, through the mutual coordination among the motor, the gear pump, the oil storage tank, the injection plate, the lubricating oil distributor, the nozzle, the air compressing distributor, the water diversion air filter and the reversing valve, lubricating oil is continuously injected to the working surface of the gear, rapid abrasion of the gear caused by dry friction is avoided, and lubricating oil is saved.

title_en: Suspension type multidimensional adjustable projector bracket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of projection equipment, in particular to a suspension type multidimensional adjustable projector bracket which comprises an upper customizing component, a middle telescopic component, a lower installing component and two groups of adjustable connecting components, wherein the upper customizing component comprises a main body frame, a plurality of base installing bottom plates and a first connecting flange, the base installing bottom plates are hinged with the main body frame, the first connecting flange is fixedly connected with the main body frame, the middle telescopic component is connected with the first connecting flange through the corresponding adjustable connecting component, and the lower installing component is connected with the middle telescopic component through the corresponding adjustable connecting component.

title_en: Display screen wall hanging frame and display screen
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a display screen wall hanging frame and a display screen, wherein the display screen wall hanging frame comprises a connecting plate and a connecting piece, the connecting plate is L-shaped, the connecting plate comprises a transverse plate and a vertical plate which are connected with each other, the vertical plate is provided with a long-strip-shaped mounting hole which is used for penetrating through a fixing piece, the transverse plate is provided with a long-strip-shaped first sliding hole which is perpendicular to the vertical plate, the connecting piece penetrates through the first sliding hole and can slide in the first sliding hole in a reciprocating manner, and the connecting piece comprises a hook which is used for hanging the display screen. In the embodiment of the utility model, the connecting piece of the display screen wall hanging frame slides back and forth in the first sliding hole on the transverse plate, so that the display screen wall hanging frame can be adjusted in one direction, and the mounting hole which is in a strip shape and is arranged on the vertical plate along the length direction of the vertical plate is used for penetrating the fixing piece, so that the display screen wall hanging frame can be adjusted in the other direction, namely, the display screen wall hanging frame can be adjusted in a plurality of directions, and the mounting quality of the display screen can be improved.

title_en: Prefabricated wall bushing for electromechanical decoration engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prefabricated wall bushing for electromechanical decoration engineering, which relates to the technical field of conventional equipment installation and decoration engineering, and comprises an outer wall substrate, a prefabricated wall bushing and a prefabricated wall bushing, wherein at least one reserved hole is formed in the outer wall substrate; the wall-penetrating wall comprises an inner wall substrate, wall-penetrating sleeves, embedded parts, thin column-shaped components, fireproof blocking materials and surface coatings, wherein the reserved holes are formed in the inner wall substrate, the number of the reserved holes are the same as that of the outer wall substrate, the prefabricated sleeves are reserved with pipeline wall-penetrating holes, the embedded parts are fixed on the periphery of the wall-penetrating sleeves, the fireproof blocking materials are filled in cavities between the wall-penetrating sleeves and the two substrates, and the surface coatings are provided with corrosion resistance and fireproof performance and are arranged on the surface layers of the wall-penetrating sleeves and the two substrates. The utility model has simple integral structure, lower cost and wide application range, and can improve the process quality while meeting the functional requirement of fireproof blocking when the electromechanical pipeline of the building penetrates the wall. The problems of low installation and construction efficiency, more wall penetrating pipelines, high construction difficulty and high material consumption of the existing wall penetrating sleeve are solved.

title_en: High-pressure homogenizer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of biological extraction production equipment, and discloses a high-pressure homogenizer which comprises a tank body, wherein a feed inlet is fixedly connected to the top of the tank body, a driving assembly is arranged at the top of the tank body, a plurality of sleeves are fixedly connected to the outer part of the driving assembly, sliding rods are connected to the inner parts of the sleeves in a sliding manner, first springs are arranged in the sleeves, connecting blocks are fixedly connected to the outer parts of the sliding rods, two ejector blocks are connected to the inner parts of the connecting blocks in a sliding manner, second springs are arranged in the connecting blocks, a brush plate is detachably connected to the outer parts of the connecting blocks, a homogenizer body is fixedly connected to the bottom of a blanking pipe, and a discharge outlet is formed in the front side of the homogenizer body. According to the utility model, buffering can be provided for the homogenizing device, the processed material is stirred, and residues in the homogenizing device are cleaned, so that the problems of uneven homogenization caused by precipitation of the materials in the homogenizing device and unstable device caused by rotation are solved.

title_en: Electric clothes airing machine, power system and travel limiting device
abstract_en: The application provides an electric clothes airing machine, a power system and a travel limiting device, wherein the travel limiting device comprises a first switch, a second switch and a limiting control piece, the limiting control piece comprises a rotating disc, a first trigger piece and a second trigger piece, the rotating disc is connected with a driving mechanism and used for driving the first trigger piece and the second trigger piece to rotate, the first switch and the second switch are both used for sending out instructions for stopping the driving mechanism when being touched, the first trigger piece and the second trigger piece can respectively coaxially rotate relative to a rotating shaft of the rotating disc, and the relative included angles of the first trigger piece and the second trigger piece on the rotating disc are adjustable. According to the application, the control of the driving mechanism is realized through the cooperation of the limiting control piece, the first switch and the second switch, the first triggering piece and the second triggering piece which are arranged on the rotating disc can respectively touch the first switch and the second switch under the driving of the driving mechanism, so that the stroke limiting function of the electric clothes airing machine is realized, and the electric clothes airing machine is simple in structure and convenient to operate.

title_en: Detachable and replaceable pinion
abstract_en: The utility model provides a detachable and replaceable pinion, which belongs to the field of gears and comprises a disc, wherein a connecting seat is arranged on the inner wall of the disc, a plurality of mounting grooves are formed in the edge of one side of the disc, tooth assemblies are arranged on the inner walls of the mounting grooves, and wear-resistant protection assemblies are arranged on the surfaces of two ends of the connecting seat. The utility model discloses a with a plurality of fixture blocks and a plurality of mounting groove inner wall block to preliminarily fix a plurality of tooth and disc, with a plurality of arc limiting plate and a plurality of arc inslot wall block, a plurality of stopper and a plurality of mounting groove inner wall's edge block simultaneously, insert a plurality of groups spacer pin in a plurality of groups spacing hole and the mounting hole, thereby install fixedly a plurality of tooth and disc, so that follow-up dismantlement and change to single position.

title_en: Claw type three-way joint
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a claw-type three-way joint, which comprises a claw-type three-way joint body, wherein a reinforcing component is arranged on the outer side wall of the claw-type three-way joint body, the reinforcing component comprises a mounting plate I and an arc plate I, the mounting plate I is arranged on one side of the claw-type three-way joint body, the arc plates I are respectively and fixedly connected to two sides of the mounting plate I, a connecting plate I is fixedly arranged on the outer side wall of the arc plate I, one side of the connecting plate I is connected with a threaded rod I through threads, one end of the threaded rod I is fixedly provided with a knob I, and the mounting plate II is arranged on one side of the claw-type three-way joint body, which is far away from the mounting plate I.

title_en: Damping device for electrical cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vibration damper for an electrical cabinet, which belongs to the technical field of electrical cabinets and comprises a base, a first vibration damper assembly and a second vibration damper assembly, wherein a vibration damper is arranged on the base, a vibration damper space is arranged between the electrical cabinet and the vibration damper, a vibration damper plate is arranged on the first vibration damper assembly, two ends of the vibration damper plate are in sliding connection with the bottom of the vibration damper, one convex side of the vibration damper plate is in contact with the lower end face of the electrical cabinet, the two second vibration damper assemblies are arranged in the vibration damper space, a supporting plate and a vibration damper are arranged on the second vibration damper assembly, the supporting plate is arranged below the electrical cabinet and in contact with the lower end face of the electrical cabinet, and the vibration damper is arranged on the wall of the vibration damper and is connected with the supporting plate. According to the vibration damper for the electrical cabinet, the electrical cabinet is protected by the first vibration damper assembly and the second vibration damper assembly, and vibration generated by the electrical cabinet is absorbed by deformation of the vibration damper plate and the vibration damper, so that the purpose of protecting electrical components in the electrical cabinet is achieved.

title_en: Grass winding-proof oil-proof weeding machine
abstract_en: The grass winding preventing and oil leakage preventing weeding machine comprises an operating rod, a power transmission unit, a grass winding preventing protecting disc and a blade, wherein the power transmission unit is arranged in the operating rod, oil seals are respectively arranged on two sides of a transmission part, the grass winding preventing protecting disc comprises a large protecting disc and a small protecting disc, the large protecting disc and the small protecting disc are nested, the small protecting disc is arranged on a cutter, and a gap with an opening direction being in a vertical direction is formed during implementation, so that grass winding is avoided. The device has more reasonable structural configuration, realizes the oil leakage prevention of the transmission mechanism of the device through a simple structure, and has the grass winding prevention function of the cutting mechanism, and the blade packaging structure is optimized based on the prior art, so that grass winding on the bottom surface of the device is avoided, the running efficiency of the device is ensured, the operation is more handy, and the device has higher market popularization value.

title_en: Double-layer pipe spliced inner pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline products, in particular to a double-layer pipe spliced inner pipe. The technical scheme includes that the pipeline connecting device comprises a cylindrical main body matched stop column, wherein an integrally formed cylindrical pipeline connecting main body structure is arranged at the center of end faces of two sides of the main body matched stop column, a cylindrical main body conveying channel is arranged in the pipeline connecting main body structure, fastening combined thread grooves are formed in the outer cylindrical surface of the pipeline connecting main body structure, and conical sealing stop matched bosses which are integrally formed and uniformly distributed in circumference are arranged at the connecting positions of the pipeline connecting main body structure and the main body matched stop column. The utility model has the advantages that the matched sealing rings can realize matched sealing in different directions at two positions when in installation, the sealing safety during matching is better, the bearing capacity during use is stronger, and the compressive strength of the spliced tube position is higher.

title_en: Anti-slip butt welding flange
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-skid butt welding flange, wherein a first butt welding flange body is fixedly connected to the right side surface of a first base, a first convex pattern is fixedly connected to the surface of the first butt welding flange body, a connecting ring is connected to the surface of the first convex pattern in a threaded manner, a second convex pattern is connected to the connecting ring in a threaded manner at the same time, a second butt welding flange body is fixedly connected to the second convex pattern, a second base is fixedly connected to one end of the second butt welding flange body, and through holes are formed in the symmetrical two sides of the right side surface of the second base. The external pipeline is sleeved by the first main body and the second main body at a certain distance, and is welded, after the welding is finished, the control nut rotates on the surface of the threaded rod in a reverse time manner, so that the pipelines are more attached, at the moment, the first main body and the second main body are not attached, a gap is reserved for carrying out annular welding between the external connecting pipes, and the welding is carried out smoothly through positioning and under the action of the first base and the second base.

title_en: Bracket capable of being adjusted rapidly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of brackets and discloses a bracket capable of being quickly adjusted, which comprises a movable shell, wherein the inner side of the movable shell is movably connected with a bracket body, the bracket also comprises a cover plate and a supporting block, connecting rods are vertically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the lower surface of the cover plate, and the bottom ends of the two groups of connecting rods are fixedly connected with two sides of the upper surface of the bracket body respectively. According to the utility model, through the combination of the cover plate, the handle, the connecting rod and the connecting groove, the bracket body can be pulled to move upwards in the movable shell, the use height of the bracket body is adjusted, the screw rod is reversely rotated, the supporting block can be driven to be retracted into the sliding groove, the bracket body and the insulation resistance tester can be further retracted into the movable shell under the action of gravity, the through groove is blocked by the cover plate, and the problems of inconvenience in accommodating the insulation resistance tester and adjustment of the use position of the existing bracket can be solved.

title_en: Oilless guiding mechanism for medical mould
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical molds, in particular to an oilless guiding mechanism of a medical mold; in the use process of the traditional medical mould, the guide mechanism easily causes defects of the product, so that the medical appliance product is polluted by oil molecules, and the medical appliance product is scrapped and cannot be used, thereby being inconvenient to realize the problem of preventing the product from being polluted by oil; the utility model provides an oilless guide mechanism of a medical mould, which comprises an auxiliary component and a guide component; compared with the traditional medical mould in the use process, the guide mechanism easily causes the defect of the product, so that the medical instrument product is polluted by oil molecules, and the medical instrument product cannot be used, so that the problem of preventing the product from being polluted by oil is inconvenient to realize.

title_en: Construction vibrating rod for concrete
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vibrating rods and discloses a construction vibrating rod for concrete, which comprises a movable base, wherein a winding wheel is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top surface of the movable base, a tube binding mechanism is fixedly arranged on one side of the surface of the winding wheel, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the winding wheel, a hydraulic rod is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top surface of the fixing plate, grooves are formed in two sides of the top surface of the fixing plate, fixing rods are fixedly arranged in the grooves, damping mechanisms are symmetrically sleeved on two sides of the fixing rods, and the tops of the damping mechanisms are rotationally connected with connecting blocks. This construction vibrting spear for concrete, through damper's setting, when vibrating motor operation produced vibrations, the shock attenuation pole pressurized rotated, extrudeed damping spring and made its take place deformation, and the hydraulic rod follows and stretches out and draws back to reached and carried out the absorbing effect to vibrating motor, avoided long-time vibration to influence vibrating motor's life.

title_en: Explosion-proof electromagnetic valve box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof electromagnetic valve box, which relates to the technical field of electromagnetic valve boxes and comprises a box body, wherein a cavity is formed in the box body, a sensor is arranged at the top of a fixed frame, a first sensing block and a second sensing block which are matched with the sensor for use are arranged in the fixed frame, and a storage box which is matched with a material guide pipe and a spray head for use is arranged at the top of the box body. According to the utility model, the effect of radiating and cooling the inside of the box body can be achieved through the radiating opening, when the temperature in the box body is abnormal, the radiating opening is blocked through the first blocking block and the second blocking block, when the first sensing block is contacted with the second sensing block, the sensor starts to work, so that a professional can quickly know that the electromagnetic valve box is in an abnormal state, when the sensor starts to work, the mutual matching between the storage box and the material guide pipe and the spray nozzle is driven, the fire extinguishing dry powder in the storage box can be filled into the cavity, the effect of quickly extinguishing fire can be achieved, and the safety of the explosion-proof electromagnetic valve box is improved.

title_en: Flow monitoring device for valve tap
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flow monitoring devices and discloses a flow monitoring device for a valve tap, which comprises a valve pipeline, wherein the middle part of the valve pipeline is fixedly connected with a mounting base, mounting assemblies are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the interior of the mounting base, each mounting assembly comprises a push rod, each push rod is slidably connected in the interior of the mounting base, one end of each push rod is fixedly connected with a transverse plate, the front end and the rear end of each transverse plate are respectively and rotatably connected with a rotating rod, one end of each rotating rod, far away from each transverse plate, is respectively and rotatably connected with a connecting block, and one side, far away from each rotating rod, of each connecting block is respectively and fixedly connected with a clamping block. According to the utility model, the transverse plate is controlled to move through the push rod, the rotary rod rotates when the transverse plate moves, and the clamping block moves along the slide rod through the transmission motion of the connecting block, so that the clamping block slides out of the slot of the mounting rod, and the monitor can be removed from the mounting base.

title_en: Transmission for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a transmission (1) for a motor vehicle (2) having at least one component comprising a plurality of transmission wheels (3, 4, 5, 6), a transmission housing (7) having a transmission space (8), in which at least one transmission wheel of the plurality of transmission wheels (3, 4, 5, 6) is arranged, an oil line (9) for guiding transmission oil (10) into the transmission housing (7) for lubricating the plurality of transmission wheels (3, 4, 5, 6), wherein a leakage opening (11) for letting out the transmission oil (10) into the transmission space (8) of the transmission housing (7) is provided in the oil line (9).

title_en: Hinge for barbecue oven convenient to adjust and move
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of barbecue oven hinges, in particular to a hinge for a barbecue oven, which is convenient to adjust and move, and comprises a lower hoop U-shaped plate, an upper hoop connecting plate and a connecting side plate for connecting the lower hoop U-shaped plate and the upper hoop connecting plate; the lower hoop U-shaped plate comprises a left connecting plate, a right connecting plate and a first movable plate arranged between the left connecting plate and the right connecting plate, the upper hoop connecting plate comprises a left side plate, a right side plate and a second movable plate arranged between the left side plate and the right side plate, the connecting rod comprises a left rod, a right rod and a movable rod arranged between a sitting rod and the right rod, a plurality of connecting holes III are formed in the peripheral walls of the left rod and the right rod at equal intervals, and connecting columns III matched with the connecting holes III in size are arranged at the two ends of the movable rod at equal intervals through reset springs. The utility model aims to provide a hinge for a barbecue oven, which is convenient to adjust and move, and solves the problem that the size of the existing hinge is fixed and cannot be specifically adjusted according to specific manufacturing conditions.

title_en: Improved carbon fiber rubber roller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an improved carbon fiber rubber roller, which comprises a tubular roller body, wherein end covers are respectively arranged at two ends of the roller body, at least one end cover is internally provided with an air passage, the air passage is communicated with the inner side and the outer side of the end cover, an air bag is arranged in the inner cavity of the roller body, an air pipe is arranged in the air passage, one end of the air pipe is communicated with the air bag, and the other end of the air pipe is provided with a valve. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the air bags are added in the inner cavity of the carbon fiber rubber roller, the roller body is supported by the inflated air bags, so that the carbon fiber rubber roller can be applied in more scenes, and the inflation pressure of the air bags can be adjusted according to the deflection deformation required by roller shrinkage in the production process. So as to achieve the effect of adjusting deflection.

title_en: Drainage pipeline connection structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drainage pipeline connecting structure, which relates to the technical field of pipeline connecting structures and comprises a connecting pipe, wherein fastening mechanisms are fixed at two ends of the inside of the connecting pipe, two sealing mechanisms are arranged between the two fastening mechanisms in the connecting pipe, two rotating rings are rotatably connected at two ends of the outer side wall of the connecting pipe, and an anti-slip layer is arranged on the outer side wall of the rotating ring. This drainage pipe connection structure through setting up fastening mechanism, rotates the swivel becket, and the swivel becket makes the gear rotate through the tooth's socket, and the gear is rotated with a screw section of thick bamboo, and a screw section of thick bamboo rotates and makes the threaded rod remove, and the threaded rod is carried movable block and friction pad and is removed, and friction pad contacts with the drain pipe, and the movable block is cliied the drain pipe, just so fix the device on the drain pipe, can be with two drain pipe connection, and is simple and convenient.

title_en: Three-way PVC pipe with stable connection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipes and discloses a three-way PVC pipe with stable connection, which comprises a three-way pipe body, wherein a first joint is arranged at the bottom end of the three-way pipe body, and a second joint is arranged at the left side of the three-way pipe body. When this connect stable tee bend PVC tubular product passes through PVC tee bend tubular product installation and uses, usable rubber pipeline connects respectively and utilizes second flange dish, coupling nut and connecting bolt fixed mounting to connect behind the right side of the left side of first joint and second joint and third connector, then the rethread uses and installs between first flange dish of connection and the outside pipeline to be connected, through the rubber pipeline who sets up to connect, can make to be flexible connection state installation between outside pipeline and the tee bend tubular product, can absorb certain displacement and the vibration of pipeline, stability when improving PVC tee bend tubular product connection and use, what the solution was that tee bend tubular product connection stability in use is relatively poor problem.

title_en: Pipeline anti-seismic bracket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline earthquake resistance, in particular to a pipeline earthquake-resistant support, which comprises a first earthquake-resistant pipe and a second earthquake-resistant pipe, wherein the first earthquake-resistant pipe and the second earthquake-resistant pipe are hollow, compressible gas is sealed in the first earthquake-resistant pipe and the second earthquake-resistant pipe, two first compression rods which are vertically arranged are sleeved between the first earthquake-resistant pipe and the second earthquake-resistant pipe, a pipeline is fixedly connected above the second earthquake-resistant pipe, two third earthquake-resistant pipes are oppositely arranged on two sides of the pipeline, one side of each of the two third earthquake-resistant pipes is fixedly connected with the first compression rods, and a second compression rod which is horizontally arranged is sleeved on the other side of each of the two third earthquake-resistant pipes.

title_en: Vibration/noise reduction device of electric vacuum pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vacuum pumps, in particular to an electric vacuum pump vibration and noise reduction device, which comprises a machine body, wherein a vibration reducing component is arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the machine body, a noise reduction component is arranged at the outer side of the machine body, two bin gates are movably connected to the front side of the machine body, a vacuum pump is fixedly connected to the top of the noise reduction component through screws, two guide grooves are formed in the bottom surface of the inner side of the machine body, the improved vibration and noise reduction device absorbs noise generated by the vacuum pump during operation through sound insulation cotton on the inner wall of the machine body, the noise generated by the vacuum pump is primarily reduced, the rest noise can be transmitted to the inner wall of the machine body, resonance conversion and consumption acoustic energy can be cut off under the action of a cavity layer, the conduction of the resonance acoustic energy is not caused without contact, so that the purpose of noise reduction is achieved, the rebound speed and amplitude of a spring are limited through the vibration reducing component, the spring is recovered to balance more quickly, and the double vibration reduction design can enable the vibration reduction effect to be better.

title_en: Anti-loose anti-vibration screw rod connecting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of screw rod connection, in particular to a locking anti-vibration screw rod connection device. The technical scheme includes that the double-screw bolt connecting cylinder comprises a pair of nut fixing pieces, a pair of double-stack self-locking washers and a pair of self-locking washers, wherein the nut fixing pieces are respectively screwed with two screw rods to be connected, and the double-stack self-locking washers comprise a first self-locking washer fixed at one end of the nut fixing pieces and a second self-locking washer fixed at the end part of the double-screw bolt connecting cylinder. The screw rod connecting device can lock the connection of the screw rod through the added nut fixing piece and the double-stacked self-locking washer, so that the problem of loosening caused by vibration in long-time use is prevented, the screw rod can be prevented from being excessively screwed through the arrangement of the limiting disc at the middle section of the screw rod connecting cylinder, and the nut fixing piece can be connected to the end part of the screw rod connecting cylinder in a non-connection state through the design of the threaded sleeve and the anti-falling disc, so that the nut fixing piece and the screw rod connecting cylinder can be placed and carried along, and the screw rod connecting cylinder can be conveniently taken out while losing is prevented.

title_en: Sealing device for vehicle-mounted air conditioner and vehicle-mounted air conditioner
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a sealing device for a vehicle-mounted air conditioner and the vehicle-mounted air conditioner, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle-mounted air conditioners. The sealing device comprises a sealing ring and a pressing assembly, wherein the sealing ring is located in a sealing groove, an opening of the sealing groove is located at one side of the sealing ring in the axial direction of the sealing ring, the pressing assembly comprises a buffering extrusion piece and a connecting piece, the buffering extrusion piece is located in the sealing groove and located at one side of the sealing ring, which faces the opening of the sealing groove, in the axial direction of the sealing ring, the buffering extrusion piece is abutted to the sealing ring, in the axial direction of the sealing ring, one side of the connecting piece is inserted into the buffering extrusion piece, and the other side of the connecting piece is connected with the top of the cab. The sealing device provided by the embodiment of the disclosure can improve the sealing effect between the indoor unit and the cab.

title_en: Detection device for building waterproof material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building waterproof materials, and discloses a detection device of building waterproof materials, which comprises a base and a fixing component, the fixing component comprises a fixing column, a limiting block, a rotating handle, a threaded rod, a bearing, a clamping plate, a rubber pad and a placing plate. This building waterproof material's detection device uses down through the mutually supporting of the fixed subassembly that sets up to realized carrying out fixed effect to this material, through placing the material at the top of placing the board, drive the rotation of threaded rod through rotating the commentaries on classics handle, thereby drive the rotation of bearing, thereby be convenient for remove the grip block to the top of material, thereby be convenient for carry out the centre gripping fixedly to the material, increase the friction between with the material through setting up the rubber pad, thereby the messenger's material as far as possible is fixed more fastening, through the circumstances that takes place to remove and drop at the detection to the material that avoids as far as possible to the fixed of material, the steadiness of the device has been promoted.

title_en: Internal-meshing reduction gear with small tooth difference
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an internal meshing reduction gear with small tooth difference, which relates to the field of reduction gears and comprises a support main block, wherein an outer side edge of the support main block is horizontally and fixedly welded with a mounting outer ring, a fixing through hole is uniformly formed in the top surface of the mounting outer ring, a bottom main shaft rod is vertically inserted into the bottom surface of the support main block, a side cylinder is fixedly connected with an outer side edge horizontal symmetrical bolt of the support main block, a top through groove is horizontally formed in the top surface of the support main block, a sealing cover plate is horizontally and fixedly connected with an inner side edge horizontal thread of the top through groove, a transmission shaft rod is vertically inserted into the top surface of the sealing cover plate, a fixing inner block is horizontally and fixedly arranged on the inner side edge of the support main block, a sleeve joint bearing is fixedly sleeved on the inner side edge of the fixing inner block, and a detachable open structure is adopted so that the internal maintenance and replacement operation can be conveniently carried out, and the supporting stabilizing effect can be adjusted as required under an adjustable structure.

title_en: High-safety display shell structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-safety display shell structure, which relates to the technical field of display shells and comprises a mounting plate and a shell, wherein the front side of the mounting plate is in threaded connection with the shell, the front side of the shell is provided with a rectangular opening, and the rectangular opening is communicated with the inner side of the shell. The utility model adopts the structure, when in use, the inner side of the shell can be effectively ventilated and radiated due to the opening of the ventilation opening, the filter plate can effectively filter circulated air while protecting the inner side of the ventilation opening, and the dustproof cloth can block a large amount of dust and pollutants in the air without obstructing the radiation of the ventilation opening, so that the dust or pollutants can be prevented from entering the inner side of the shell and being adsorbed on the surface of the display, and the dustproof cloth is stuck on the sticking sponge, thereby facilitating the disassembly and replacement of the dustproof cloth by a user in the later period, and effectively improving the safety of the display shell.

title_en: Catheter gluing assembly mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conduit gluing assembly mechanism which realizes automatic conduit gluing operation and ensures even and reliable gluing. The glue spreading device comprises a base, a front initial positioning assembly and a back glue spreading assembly, wherein the base comprises a base seat body and an upper plate, the front initial positioning assembly comprises an upper lifting positioning plate and a lower lifting positioning plate, the back glue spreading assembly comprises a front and back moving seat body, single-row glue spreading heads, a front and back driving module and a glue feeding pump, the upper lifting positioning plate and the lower lifting positioning plate are spliced to form a plurality of positioning holes which are arranged at equal intervals in a combined state, the positioning holes are used for reliably positioning the end parts of a guide pipe and ensuring that part of the end parts of the guide pipe are protruded towards the corresponding glue spreading heads, the front and back moving seat body is supported on the upper surface of the upper plate through a front and back moving guide rail structure, the single-row glue spreading heads are transversely arranged at positions of the front and back moving seat body, and the number of the single-row glue spreading heads are the same, and the spacing distances are the same.

title_en: Pressing plate fixing structure for disc brake
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pressing plate fixing structure for a disc brake, which comprises a clamp body, wherein a pressing plate is arranged on the clamp body, a slot for inserting the pressing plate is formed in one side of the clamp body, a fixing seat for fixing the pressing plate is arranged on the other side of the clamp body, one side of the pressing plate is inserted into the slot, the other side of the pressing plate is fixed with the fixing seat, at least one vertically arranged fixing column is arranged on the fixing seat, a fixing through hole for allowing the fixing column to pass through is formed in the pressing plate, the fixing column is fixed through a C-shaped clamp spring after passing through the fixing through hole, and an annular fixing groove for inserting and fixing the C-shaped clamp spring is formed in the outer wall of the circumference of the fixing column. The clamp plate and the fixing seat are fixed by adopting the cooperation of the vertically arranged fixing column and the C-shaped clamp spring, the C-shaped clamp spring is directly inserted after the fixing column passes through the fixing through hole on the clamp plate, and the C-shaped clamp spring is only required to be taken down for installation and disassembly in the follow-up disassembly process, so that the clamp plate is very convenient to install and disassemble.

title_en: Control valve capable of realizing regulation of large and small flow by remote control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a control valve capable of realizing the adjustment of the flow rate by remote control. The device comprises a valve body B, a first air outlet channel, an air outlet cavity, an air outlet interface and a second air outlet channel, wherein the first cavity is communicated with the air outlet; the remote control rotary pressing type controller comprises a second electromagnetic valve, a round sealing gasket, a rotary pressing rod structure and a movable seat sealing assembly, wherein the movable seat sealing assembly is used for respectively realizing three states of sealing the upper end of the first air outlet channel, sealing the lower end of the first air outlet channel and releasing the two ends of the first air outlet channel under the action of the rotary pressing rod structure and the second electromagnetic valve.

title_en: Computer support frame is sold to building equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a computer support frame for selling building equipment, which relates to the field of support frames and comprises a base, wherein a rectangular frame is arranged at the upper end of the base, a circular groove is formed at the lower end of the base, a moving part is arranged in the circular groove and extends into the rectangular frame, a concave block is arranged at the front end of the moving part, an adjusting part is arranged in the concave block, and two fixing parts which are distributed symmetrically left and right are arranged at the upper end of the adjusting part. The utility model can adjust the height of the computer by arranging the movable part, ensures that a user keeps a comfortable posture when using the integrated computer for a long time, is beneficial to alleviating fatigue and discomfort of the neck, the shoulder and the back, ensures the working efficiency and the working performance of sales personnel, can quickly fix the computer by arranging the fixed part, has simple operation, short operation time, does not need to use a screw rod, and improves the installation efficiency.

title_en: Pressure relief type deep groove ball bearing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pressure relief type deep groove ball bearing, which relates to the technical field of bearings and comprises an outer ring and an inner ring, wherein two retainers are arranged between the outer ring and the inner ring, and a plurality of balls are arranged between the two retainers. When the running load of the bearing is overlarge, the spring can be compressed by the larger pressure, so that the movable plate is stressed upwards, at the moment, the lubricating oil is stored in the storage pipe, so that the lubricating oil can be pushed upwards through upward movement of the movable plate, the lubricating oil can circulate into the filling pipe through the one-way valve, at the moment, the lubricating oil can circulate through the position of the filling pipe, and the lubricating oil flows into between the outer ring and the inner ring from the position of the filling hole to lubricate. The injected lubricating oil can play roles of supplementing lubrication and cooling, so that the effect of automatically injecting the lubricating oil into the bearing for lubrication and cooling during high-load operation of the bearing is realized, and the stability of the operation of the bearing is improved.

title_en: Adjusting device for bearing locating pin
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of locating pins and discloses an adjusting device for a bearing locating pin, which comprises a locating pin body, wherein the outer side of the locating pin body is movably connected with a bearing body, the top of the bearing body is movably connected with a base, the top of the base is fixedly connected with a spring, the top of the base is fixedly connected with a telescopic rod, the spring and the top of the telescopic rod are fixedly connected with the same pressing block, the top of the pressing block is fixedly connected with a lifting block, and the inside of the lifting block is rotationally connected with a rotating block. This adjusting device for bearing locating pin possesses advantages such as regulatory function, has solved the locating pin in the in-process of using, because the locating pin is mostly through beating and the bearing is made up and current locating pin does not have regulatory function in most, produced time is longer when leading to the change locating pin, has reduced the running efficiency of equipment to the problem of satisfying the user demand that can not be fine.

title_en: Face identification equipment of registering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses face recognition signing equipment, which belongs to the technical field of face recognition and comprises a mounting plate, wherein an electric sliding rail is fixedly connected to the front surface of the mounting plate, a sliding block is connected to the inner wall of the electric sliding rail in a sliding manner, a positioning box is fixedly connected to the front surface of the sliding block, and an L-shaped frame is inserted into the inner cavity of the positioning box. According to the utility model, the positioning box can be driven to move up and down through the electric sliding rail under the cooperation of the sliding blocks, the L-shaped frame is driven to move up and down through the positioning box, the face recognition integrated machine is driven to move up and down through the L-shaped frame, the movement is stopped when the face recognition integrated machine moves to a designated position, the purpose of adjusting the height is achieved, the face recognition integrated machine is convenient to recognize faces of people with different heights, a user holds the rotating handle and rotates when the face recognition integrated machine needs to be dismantled, and the two screw sleeves are driven to move in opposite directions through the rotating handle and the forward and backward screw rods.

title_en: Packing gland double-screw bolt fracture prevention device for nuclear power pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a packing gland stud fracture prevention device for a nuclear power pump, which comprises a sleeve, wherein the sleeve is used for being inserted into a stud hole of a packing gland, the sleeve is provided with a through hole penetrating through the sleeve, the through hole is used for a fixing stud of the packing gland to pass through, the sleeve is arranged between the fixing stud and the packing gland, after a nut of the fixing stud of the packing gland is loosened, the sleeve can be used for sharing and bearing a part of radial shearing force instead of the fixing stud, so that the fixing stud is prevented from fracture, the service life of the fixing stud is prolonged, the safety and the reliability of pumping equipment are further improved, the availability of the pumping equipment is improved, the daily damage risk is reduced, and the maintenance cost and the maintenance times are reduced.

title_en: Base for friction press
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a base for a friction press, which comprises two support plates and guard plates, wherein the two support plates are symmetrically arranged and connected through the guard plates, the outer wall of a piston rod of a first hydraulic cylinder is fixedly provided with a lifting structure, the lifting structure is penetrated and assembled on the inner wall of the support plate, the side wall of each support plate is symmetrically provided with two support wheel structures, the whole equipment can be lifted up through the action of the support wheel structures, so that the whole equipment is lifted off the ground, the equipment is conveniently displaced, the friction press is conveniently moved, the transportation stability of the friction press is ensured, when the friction press is moved to a proper placement position, the first hydraulic cylinder is controlled to retract the piston rod, the clamping plate is adjusted to be separated from the side wall of the friction press, the lifting structure is withdrawn, the friction press is relocated on the ground, the process needs to be matched with lifting tools such as a gantry crane, the stability when the friction press is placed is controlled, the use is convenient, and the practicability is strong.

title_en: Telescopic folding hand wheel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a telescopic folding hand wheel, which relates to the technical field of mechanical accessories and comprises a body, wherein a connecting hole is formed in the lower shaft center of the body, the connecting hole is internally connected with the outside through a spline, a telescopic rod is slidably arranged on the body, the telescopic rod can be overlapped with the body and also can slide out, a limit is arranged at both positions, a handle is folded on the telescopic rod, and the handle can be attached to the telescopic rod and also can be perpendicular to the telescopic rod. The telescopic link slide and the articulated of handle can the furthest fold, can expand the increase moment simultaneously again completely, have increased portable degree, when the hand wheel is in folded condition, the bulb can block the telescopic link through the cooperation with the locating hole, prevents that the telescopic link from freely sliding when not using from causing storage and transportation inconvenient, and the constant head tank can be regarded as the direction to let the bulb accurately slide into the locating hole simultaneously.

title_en: Outdoor traffic safety monitoring camera
abstract_en: The utility model provides an outdoor traffic safety monitoring camera, which relates to the technical field of monitoring cameras and comprises a hanging frame, wherein a first rear fixing plate and a second rear fixing plate are arranged at the rear part of the hanging frame, the lower ends of the first rear fixing plate and the second rear fixing plate are fixed on a lower mounting plate, a rotating shaft is arranged at the lower end of a motor, the lower end of the rotating shaft is fixed on a mounting seat, a mounting cavity is formed in the mounting seat, a wireless camera is arranged in the mounting cavity, an explosion-proof glass cover is arranged at the front side of the mounting cavity, a front fixing plate is arranged at the front part of the hanging frame, three groups of first screw holes are formed in the lower parts of the front fixing plate, the second rear fixing plate and the first rear fixing plate, and a double-head inserting rod is arranged among the aligned first screw holes. The utility model is convenient to install or detach, convenient to rotate and adjust the road monitoring direction, and simultaneously carries out safety protection on the wireless camera, so that the wireless camera can avoid the impact of wind, rain and flying foreign matters, and is safe and stable.

title_en: Camera fixing device of false pressure jig
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera fixing device of a false-pressure jig, which comprises a fixing frame, wherein a camera which is horizontally arranged is arranged on the fixing frame through an adjusting structure, a positioning frame is arranged in front of the fixing frame, a reflecting triple prism which is positioned in front of the camera is arranged on the positioning frame, and the reflecting triple prism is additionally arranged between a camera and a flat cable to change the angle of the camera, so that the parallel operation of the camera can reduce a large amount of space and save materials. The adjusting structure can adjust the camera in multiple directions, so that the camera can focus quickly, and the time for adjusting the camera is saved.

title_en: Electronic irrigation valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electronic irrigation valve which comprises a main control module, a valve control module, a flow detection module and a power module, wherein the control end of the valve control module is connected with the main control module, the flow detection module comprises a first flow detection unit and a second flow detection unit, the first flow detection unit is arranged at a water inlet of the electronic irrigation valve, the second flow detection unit is arranged at a water outlet of the electronic irrigation valve, the first flow detection unit and the second flow detection unit are connected with the main control module, the display module is connected with the main control module, and the power module is connected with the main control module, the valve control module, the flow detection module and the display module. As the digital product with integrated control valve function and flow statistics function, the electronic irrigation valve is convenient for the user to install, and the display module visually displays the quantized data, so that the user can visually know the current flow of the electronic irrigation valve.

title_en: Large-scale fryer of built-in stirring structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-scale frying machine with a built-in stirring structure, which comprises a frying machine main body, wherein a stirring mechanism is arranged above the frying machine main body and consists of a servo motor, a protection box, a reversing gear I, a rotating rod, a reversing gear II, a driving gear, a driven gear, an annular chain and a stirring rod, an oil adding mechanism is arranged at the top of the protection box, the oil adding mechanism comprises an oil adding cylinder, a round hole, a drainage cotton sliver, an annular baffle plate, a sealing cover, a through hole and a piston rod, one side of the protection box is provided with an oil return mechanism, and the oil return mechanism consists of a mounting column, two combined holes, two drainage channels, a long drainage tube, a short drainage tube and a combined cylinder. According to the utility model, by means of the arrangement of the oil adding mechanism, the driving component inside the protection box can be added with lubricating oil through the cooperation among the oil adding cylinder, the drainage cotton sliver, the annular baffle plate, the sealing cover and the piston rod, so that the operation is simplified, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Dustproof oil seal and shield machine main driving sealing structure comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dustproof oil seal and a main driving sealing structure of a shield machine comprising the dustproof oil seal, which solve the problems of great structural change, high cost and long time of a sealing system repairing technology in the prior art. The dustproof oil seal comprises a seal base and a V-shaped seal dustproof lip part which are integrally formed, wherein the V-shaped seal dustproof lip part is connected to the lower part of the seal base through a seal waist part, when the dustproof oil seal bears pressure, the V-shaped seal dustproof lip part forms a triangular support, and the dustproof oil seal has the functions of external dustproof and internal bearing pressure through the structural design, so that the quick leakage-stopping effect is achieved. Compared with the prior art, the main driving sealing structure of the shield machine has the advantages that the outermost sealing and pressing rings are replaced, the sealing effect can be achieved rapidly, meanwhile, the oil consumption is saved in the using process, the sealing effect is achieved, and meanwhile, the sealing replacement procedure and the working difficulty are greatly reduced.

title_en: Sand dune migration detection device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a sand hill migration detection device, and relates to the technical field of sand hill migration detection. The sand dune migration detection device comprises a supporting seat, wherein a detection assembly is installed at the upper end of the supporting seat, a positioning rod with a hollow structure is arranged at the lower side of the supporting seat, a positioning piece is connected inside the positioning rod in a sliding mode, and an auxiliary piece is connected outside the positioning rod in a sliding mode. According to the utility model, the positioning rod is inserted into the sand dune to fix the whole measuring and detecting device, the auxiliary rod is sleeved in the annular sleeve to slide downwards, the auxiliary rod can increase the stability of the positioning rod after being inserted into the sand dune, meanwhile, the rack is pushed downwards to enable the rack to be meshed with the gear, the gear rotates with the bidirectional screw rod, the two vertical plates slide out of the positioning rod with the transverse inserting rod, and the transverse inserting rod is inserted into the sand dune after passing through the auxiliary rod, so that the stability of the whole measuring and detecting device is further improved, and meanwhile, the auxiliary rod is prevented from sliding mistakenly.

title_en: Novel rotational vibration anti-drop mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel rotary vibration anti-drop mechanism, which comprises a rotary shaft sleeve, a spring and a sliding pressing plate, wherein a fixed mounting main part is fixedly sleeved at the bottom of the rotary shaft sleeve, a stud sliding hole and a block sliding cavity which are communicated are respectively formed in the side surface of the fixed mounting main part, an adjusting clamping block is inserted in the block sliding cavity in a sliding manner, a screw hole is formed in the adjusting clamping block along the direction perpendicular to the axis line of the rotary shaft sleeve, an adjusting stud penetrates into the block sliding cavity from the stud sliding hole and is threaded in the screw hole in a penetrating manner, a cavity leakage arc opening which is communicated with the inner shaft wall of the rotary shaft sleeve is formed in the block sliding cavity, the shaft wall of the rotary shaft in the rotary shaft sleeve extends into the block sliding cavity from the cavity leakage arc opening, and a contact clamping surface which is used for being in close contact with the shaft wall of the rotary shaft is formed in the rear side surface of the adjusting clamping block.

title_en: Constant force disc spring support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline and equipment support, in particular to a constant force disc spring support, which comprises a box body, a pressing plate, pull rods, a pressing component, a linkage component, a disc spring group and a weighing sensor, wherein the box body is hollow and concave, the pressing plate is arranged right above the box body, the pull rods are symmetrically arranged at the left end and the right end of the box body, the pull rods slide through the top plate of the box body, the top ends of the pull rods are connected with the pressing plate, the pressing component slide through the middle part of the top plate of the box body and the middle part of the pressing plate, the bottom ends of the pull rods are respectively connected with the bottom ends of the two pull rods through the linkage component, the disc spring group is arranged between the box body and the pressing plate and sleeved on the pressing component, and the weighing sensor is arranged at the top end of the pressing component.

title_en: Header transmission case of two-gear green storage machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting table transmission case of a two-gear green storage machine, wherein an input gear and a first-stage driving gear are arranged on a power input shaft, the input gear comprises a first-stage input cylindrical gear, a second-stage input cylindrical gear and an input bevel gear, the first-stage driving gear comprises a first-stage main gear cylindrical gear and a second-stage main gear cylindrical gear, the engagement sleeve is switched under three states of being engaged with the first-stage main gear cylindrical gear, being engaged with the first-stage input cylindrical gear and no-load, a first-stage driven gear and a second-stage driven gear are fixedly arranged on the second shaft, the first-stage driven gear is engaged with the second-stage main gear cylindrical gear, the second-stage driven gear is engaged with the second-stage input cylindrical gear, an output bevel gear is fixedly arranged on the power output shaft, and the output bevel gear is engaged with the input bevel gear. Under the condition of limited space and the position constraint of an input shaft and an output shaft, the utility model realizes two-gear speed change and meets the production requirement.

title_en: Motor speed reducer of tire retreading device for rubber enterprises
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor speed reducer of a tire retreading device for a rubber enterprise, which comprises a speed reducing box, a lubricating oil adding port, a lubricating oil discharging port, a driving motor, a power output shaft and a damping support seat, wherein the middle part of the top end of the speed reducing box is provided with the lubricating oil adding port, the bottom of the right end of the speed reducing box is provided with the lubricating oil discharging port, the bottom of the rear end of the speed reducing box is provided with the driving motor which is hinged and fixed, the middle part of the front end of the speed reducing box is provided with the embedded power output shaft which is hinged and fixed, and the bottom of the speed reducing box is provided with the damping support seat which is fixed by bolts. The reduction gearbox is small in size through reasonable design, stable and reliable three-gear type adjustment is realized through the cooperation of the bevel gear and the synchronizer, and meanwhile, the noise is low and the damping effect is obviously improved.

title_en: Portable inverter power supply
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable inverter power supply, which relates to the technical field of inverter power supplies, and aims at solving the problems that a power supply body provided by the prior art is directly exposed in the external environment, can be vibrated during the transfer of the power supply body, is easy to damage during the impact and has low practicability, the utility model provides the following scheme which comprises a protection mechanism and two inverter power supply bodies, the protection mechanism comprises a mounting box with a plurality of ventilation openings on the outer walls of two sides, a baffle plate with two sides respectively and fixedly arranged on the inner walls of two sides of the mounting box, four limiting plates respectively and fixedly arranged on the outer walls of one side of the baffle plate, a plurality of elastic blocks respectively and fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the bottom of the mounting box and a box cover abutted on the outer walls of the top of the mounting box, and an extension mechanism is arranged outside the mounting box and comprises two mounting shafts respectively and fixedly arranged on the outer walls of two sides of the mounting box. The utility model can protect the inverter power supply on the premise of not influencing the heat dissipation efficiency of the inverter power supply, prevent the inverter power supply from being damaged and improve the practicability.

title_en: Surveying instrument frame for engineering surveying and mapping
abstract_en: The utility model provides a surveying instrument frame for engineering surveying and mapping, which comprises a mounting plate, three frames arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate and a surveying instrument body arranged at the top of the mounting plate and used for engineering surveying and mapping, wherein a fixed plate is arranged at the bottom of the frames, a movable sleeve is arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate, a supporting rod is arranged on the fixed plate, and a fixing frame is arranged on the peripheral wall of the supporting rod. The bottom in three group's frame all is provided with the bracing piece, is provided with the dead lever in the bottom of mounting panel simultaneously, is equipped with the connecting seat on the peripheral wall of dead lever to link together connecting seat and bracing piece through the connecting rod, consequently when needs adjust the height of this device, only need reciprocate the connecting seat can, fix connecting seat and dead lever through the screw alright spacing the bracing piece at last, reach the purpose of simultaneously adjusting three group's frame heights, can effectively improve engineering survey and drawing's mapping efficiency.

title_en: Adjust idler structure
abstract_en: The application discloses an idler wheel adjusting structure, which comprises a chain wheel tension block and an adjusting screw rod connected with the chain wheel tension block, wherein a chain wheel tension block chute is arranged on the chain wheel tension block, a tension rod for connecting an idler wheel is arranged in the chain wheel tension block chute, one side of the chain wheel tension block is provided with a tensioning structure, the adjusting screw rod is pressed against the tension rod under the action of external force, and the tensioning structure is used for tensioning the tension rod. The idler wheel structure is adjusted, so that the tension rod has the downward jacking effect of the adjusting screw rod and the upward supporting effect, the tension rod can be kept in a stable state, and the idler wheel is connected to the tension rod, so that the idler wheel has good stability, and the transmission chain can be adjusted to be in a stable state.

title_en: Reinforced abrasion-free main shaft rotary power head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reinforced abrasion-free main shaft rotary power head which comprises a gear box body, wherein a first single-sided framework oil seal and a first dust ring are arranged between a gear box cover and a main shaft gear, a first sealing steel sleeve is fixedly sleeved on an output main shaft, a second single-sided framework oil seal and a second dust ring are arranged between a bearing end cover and the output main shaft, a second sealing steel sleeve is fixedly sleeved on the output main shaft, and a main shaft outer spacer is abutted between tapered roller bearing outer rings. According to the utility model, the wear resistance of the surfaces of the first sealing steel sleeve and the second sealing steel sleeve is greatly enhanced, the service life is long, the replacement cost is low, the problem of abrasion between the outer ring of the tapered roller bearing and the bearing seat hole caused by irregular alternating load of the rotary output main shaft is solved, and the stability and the running rigidity of the output main shaft are improved.

title_en: Automobile half axle bearing
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automobile half shaft bearing, which relates to the technical field of automobile parts and comprises an inner ring, wherein an outer ring is arranged on the outer side of the inner ring, a baffle ring is fixed on the left side and the right side of the inner ring, eight rollers are arranged between the inner ring and the outer ring, a retainer is arranged on the outer side of each roller, an oil injection pipe is arranged on the left side of the top of the outer ring, an oil injection pipe cap is arranged on the top of each oil injection pipe, six air guide cylinders are annularly arranged on the outer wall of the baffle ring on the left side of the inner ring, and the outer ring is arranged in a bearing fixing seat. The bearing can improve the use stability, is very convenient to add lubricating oil, can cool the bearing, and prolongs the service life of the bearing.

title_en: Buffer clamp for overhead insulated cable erection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable clamp equipment, in particular to a buffer clamp for erecting an overhead insulated cable, which comprises a clamp buffer base assembly, a lower clamping seat assembly, an upper clamping seat assembly and an inner buffer clamping piece, wherein the lower clamping seat assembly is arranged above the clamp buffer base assembly, the upper clamping seat assembly is arranged above the lower clamping seat assembly, the inner buffer clamping piece is provided with two groups, the cable is erected on the inner buffer clamping piece in the lower clamping seat assembly, through holes are arranged at two ends of the upper clamping seat assembly, the inner buffer clamping piece in the upper clamping seat assembly is attached to the cable after long bolts are sleeved on the through holes, at the moment, the lower clamping seat assembly and the upper clamping seat assembly can be connected through screw nuts on the two groups of long bolts, at the moment, the inner buffer elastic piece in the inner buffer clamping piece can play a secondary buffer effect through screw nuts, and the long bolt nuts can be matched with cables with different specifications for buffer clamping work through screw nuts.

title_en: Quick positioning and mounting structure for sliding bearing of aero-engine fuel system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a quick positioning and mounting structure of a sliding bearing of an aeroengine fuel system, which comprises a bearing body and is technically characterized in that a pair of arc-shaped long grooves concentric with the bearing body are symmetrically arranged on the front end face of a bearing sleeve block of the bearing body, the bearing sleeve block is connected with a right-angle adapter plate by utilizing the arc-shaped long grooves and a first positioning bolt pair, a nut of the first positioning bolt pair is embedded in the arc-shaped long grooves, a horizontal plate section of the right-angle adapter plate is tightly connected with the front end face of the bearing sleeve block, a second positioning bolt pair is arranged on a vertical plate section of the right-angle adapter plate, a screw hole perpendicular to the screw cap of the second positioning bolt pair is arranged on the nut of the second positioning bolt pair, and a positioning screw is arranged in the screw hole. The adaptation degree with complicated installation environment is guaranteed to this structure on the one hand, and on the other hand strengthens the joint strength with mounted position, guarantees the operational safety.

title_en: Novel pressure release relief valve for reation kettle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of safety valves and discloses a novel pressure release safety valve for a reaction kettle, which comprises a valve seat, wherein a connecting sleeve is fixedly connected to the left side of the valve seat, a valve body is fixedly connected to the outer side of the connecting sleeve, a pressure release assembly is arranged in the valve body and used for releasing the pressure in the reaction kettle, an alarm assembly is arranged on the right side of the valve seat and used for monitoring and alarming the pressure in the reaction kettle, the pressure release assembly comprises a telescopic column, the telescopic column is fixedly connected to the inner side of the valve body, a spring is arranged on the outer side of the telescopic column, a plugging block is fixedly connected to one end of the telescopic column, which is far away from the valve body, and a plurality of exhaust grooves are uniformly formed in the outer side of the plugging block. According to the utility model, through the cooperation among the structures such as the air inlet pipe, the plugging block, the air exhaust groove, the plugging block, the valve body, the air exhaust pipe and the like, the safety valve can gradually release the internal pressure of the reaction kettle, and the service life of the pressure release safety valve is prolonged.

title_en: Site survey device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a site survey device which comprises a mounting seat, a supporting component and a stabilizing component, wherein the mounting seat is used for fixing a total station, the supporting component comprises at least three telescopic supporting legs, the at least three telescopic supporting legs are arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction of the mounting seat, each telescopic supporting leg is hinged with the mounting seat, the at least three telescopic supporting legs are used for supporting the mounting seat, the stabilizing component is connected with the mounting seat and is positioned between the telescopic supporting legs, the stabilizing component is hinged with each telescopic supporting leg, and the stabilizing component can ensure that the mounting seat and the telescopic supporting legs are stable, so that the total station is stably placed.

title_en: Punching-free snap fastener and writing board mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a punching-free snap fastener and a writing board mounting structure, which comprises a snap fastener (1) and a snap fastener (2), wherein a convex column (103) is arranged on the snap fastener (1), a connector is arranged at the end part of the convex column (103), a clamping groove (203) matched with the convex column (103) is arranged on the snap fastener (2), an embedded groove (207) matched with the connector is arranged on the side wall of the clamping groove (203), a guide surface (205) is arranged at an opening (204) of the clamping groove (203), and when the snap fastener (1) is fastened to the snap fastener (2), the convex column (103) is clamped into the clamping groove (203) and the connector is embedded into the embedded groove (207). When the writing board is installed, the female buckle (2) is installed on the back surface of the writing board (3), the sub buckles (1) are installed on the supporting surface, and the sub buckles (1) are buckled on the female buckle (2) in a one-to-one correspondence manner. This exempt from primary and secondary knot and clipboard mounting structure that punches can realize quick location, can conveniently smoothly realize back butt-joint installation, has promoted user experience and has felt.

title_en: Vehicle fastener with anti-loosening function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle fasteners, in particular to a vehicle fastener with a locking function, which comprises a pin, wherein a fastening driving assembly is jointly arranged at the inner part and the outer part of the pin, the fastening driving assembly comprises a hydraulic cylinder fixedly arranged in the pin, two communicating pipes are fixedly communicated with the outer wall of the bottom end in the hydraulic cylinder, a buffer attaching assembly is jointly arranged at the inner part and the outer part of the pin, the buffer attaching assembly comprises assembling grooves which are arranged at the inner part and the outer part of the pin and are distributed at equal angles, a liquid flow pipe is embedded in the assembling grooves, and the liquid flow pipe is mutually communicated with the hydraulic cylinder through the communicating pipes. According to the utility model, through the increase of the volume of the liquid flow pipe, the outer wall of the liquid flow pipe and the inner wall of the pin hole of the vehicle part are mutually attached and extruded, so that the friction effect between the pin column and the part is increased, the anti-loosening effect can be achieved through extrusion, and when the liquid flow pipe is subjected to external force, the liquid flow pipe is more tightly connected, so that vibration and impact can be better resisted.

title_en: Plug valve
