abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plug valve, which comprises a valve body, a valve cover, a valve rod, a plug, a lining, at least two sealing strips, an upper sealing ring, a lower sealing ring and a sealing strip, wherein the valve cover is arranged at an opening at the upper end of the valve body, the valve cover penetrates through the valve cover and stretches into the valve body to be connected with the plug, a flow channel and a plug cavity are arranged in the valve body, the plug is provided with an overflow hole corresponding to the flow channel, the lining comprises an upper sealing ring, a lower sealing ring and at least two sealing strips arranged between the upper sealing ring and the lower sealing ring, the outer peripheral surface of the plug is tightly attached to the inner peripheral surface of the plug cavity, the upper sealing ring and the lower sealing ring are respectively arranged at positions of the plug cavity corresponding to the upper end and the lower end of the flow channel, the sealing strips are arranged on the inner wall of the plug cavity, and the upper sealing ring, the lower sealing ring and the sealing strips are tightly attached to the outer wall of the plug. The utility model not only can avoid the cock from tilting when the valve is used, but also can limit the bushing in the circumferential direction, and can avoid the bushing from rotating under the action of the cock, and has the advantages of long service life and stable and reliable structure.

title_en: Linear driver
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a linear driver, which comprises a cylindrical shell, a motor coil and a motor magnet of a driving motor and a reverse circulation ball screw system, wherein the motor coil and the motor magnet are arranged in the shell, the periphery of the motor coil is fixed on the inner wall of the shell and is connected with a power supply and a signal wire, the motor magnet is inserted into the motor coil, the reverse circulation ball screw system comprises a ball screw, a ball nut and balls arranged between the ball screw and the ball nut, the periphery of the ball nut is fixed on the inner wall of the motor magnet, the ball screw is installed in the ball nut, and the front end of the ball screw extends out of the shell and is provided with a fixing seat. By integrating the miniature reverse circulation ball screw system and the driving motor, the whole linear driving size is greatly reduced, the power density is improved, and the device is suitable for high-precision operation in the fields of precision robots and mechanical arms.

title_en: Security protection monitoring device convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a security monitoring device convenient to install, which comprises a storage assembly, wherein the storage assembly comprises a movable groove, a limiting frame, a limiting plate, a connecting plate and an installing groove. According to the utility model, when the monitoring device body is required to be installed, the storage assembly is arranged, the toppling force is firstly applied to the mounting plate, the connecting plate is poured out from the inside of the movable groove, the pulling force is applied to the connecting plate, the limiting plate is attached to the surface of the limiting frame, the turning force is applied to the guide plate under the action of the connecting shaft, the guide plate is separated from the inside of the mounting groove, the upward pulling force is applied to the guide plate, the movable plate moves upwards, after the screws are taken out from the inside of the mounting groove, the mounting plate is placed at a required position, then the screws are fixed on the mounting plate, after four groups of screws are fixed in the mounting plate in sequence, the fixing plate is placed on the outer surface of the mounting plate, and the screws are fixed in the mounting plate and the fixing plate.

title_en: Display rack module and spliced display stand
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of exhibition stands, and particularly discloses an exhibition stand module and a spliced exhibition stand, wherein the exhibition stand module comprises a module unit and a connecting piece connected to the module unit, the connecting piece comprises a first connecting plate and a second connecting plate, the first connecting plate comprises a transverse plate and a vertical plate which are connected in an L shape, connecting rods are fixed on two sides of the end part of the second connecting plate, the connecting rods are hinged to the vertical plate, the transverse plate and the second connecting plate are detachably connected, the module unit comprises a frame with connecting holes, the connection Kong Gongdi is used for enabling the connecting plate or the second connecting plate to deflect and pass through, and the transverse plate and the second connecting plate are respectively used for being clamped on two sides of the frame. By adopting the scheme of the utility model, the problem that a great amount of materials are wasted because the exhibition stand which is designed and customized in advance can be used once only can be solved.

title_en: Remote electrodeless voltage regulation control system of closed system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a closed system remote stepless pressure regulating control system, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic systems and comprises an oil tank, a main oil pump, a first control oil pipe, an adjustable overflow valve and a hydraulic control valve. The hydraulic oil pump comprises a main oil pump, a first control oil pipe, an adjustable overflow valve, a hydraulic control valve, an oil tank, a control assembly, a hydraulic control valve and a hydraulic oil flow control assembly, wherein the main oil pump is connected with the control assembly, the first control oil pipe is connected with the main oil pipe, the first control oil pipe is connected with the second control oil pipe through a restrictor, the adjustable overflow valve is arranged between the oil tank and the second control oil pipe, two control ports of the hydraulic control valve are respectively connected with the first control oil pipe and the second control oil pipe, an outlet of the hydraulic control valve is connected with the oil tank, an inlet of the hydraulic control valve is connected with the control assembly, when the pressure difference of the two control ports reaches a preset value, the hydraulic control valve enables the control assembly to be communicated with the oil tank, and the hydraulic oil pressure in the control assembly is reduced, so that the hydraulic oil flow output by the main oil pump is reduced. The utility model can reduce the cost of production equipment and the overshoot.

title_en: Mechanical sealing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mechanical sealing device, which belongs to the technical field of sealing equipment and comprises a fine adjustment sealing module and an active adjustment sealing module, wherein the fine adjustment sealing module comprises a first ripple compensator, a first elastic piece and a cylinder, the active adjustment sealing module comprises a second ripple compensator and a second elastic piece, and the cylinder compresses the first elastic piece to a first position where dynamic and static sealing pieces are in sealing connection. The utility model solves the technical problem of tightness between the thermal cracking reactor and the front and rear structures, and has the characteristic of good tightness.

title_en: Multi-air duct regulating valve for stove fan
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-air-channel regulating valve for a stove fan, which is characterized by comprising a first side pipe and a second side pipe, wherein one ends of the first side pipe and the second side pipe are respectively and correspondingly provided with a plurality of first partition boards and second partition boards which are mutually butted, the first partition boards and the second partition boards divide pipelines to form a plurality of air inlets, a wind shield is rotatably arranged in the air inlets, a half ball valve is rotatably arranged between the first side pipe and the second side pipe, a vent is arranged on the half ball valve, the other ends of the first side pipe and the second side pipe are air outlets, and a gas interface is arranged at one end, close to the air outlets, of the first side pipe.

title_en: Highway is with sound insulation barrier with anticollision structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sound insulation barrier for a highway with an anti-collision structure, which comprises a mounting bottom plate, an anti-collision device and a sound insulation plate body, wherein a balancing weight is fixedly connected to the middle part of the upper surface of the mounting bottom plate, a storage groove is formed in the middle part of the upper surface of the balancing weight, the front side of the balancing weight is fixedly connected with the anti-collision device through bolts, connecting plates are fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the rear side of the upper surface of the mounting bottom plate, connecting through holes are formed in the middle part of the connecting plates, the upper surface of the balancing weight is fixedly connected with an outer frame through bolts, a connecting groove is formed in the upper end of the right side of the outer frame, a groove is formed in the upper end of the left side of the outer frame, an I-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the groove through bolts, and the sound insulation plate body is fixedly connected to the inner side of the outer frame. This highway is with sound insulation barrier with anticollision structure has anticollision structure, increases the buffering, and the sound insulation barrier of the fixed combination of connection of being convenient for is convenient for dismouting sound insulation barrier.

title_en: Magnet fixing structure of electronic actuator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a magnet fixing structure of an electronic actuator, which comprises an output shaft, half teeth, a magnet protecting cover and a support convex part, wherein the end parts of the half teeth are provided with magnet mounting grooves, a magnet is arranged in each magnet mounting groove, the magnet protecting cover covers the magnet, the bottom surface inside each magnet mounting groove is provided with the support convex part, the support convex part is used for guaranteeing the horizontal position of the magnet and isolating the magnet from being completely contacted with the magnet mounting grooves, the side wall inside each magnet mounting groove is provided with a plurality of positioning convex parts, the outer side wall of the magnet is contacted with the plurality of positioning convex parts, the end surface of each half tooth far away from the output shaft is provided with a plurality of first welding convex parts, and the first welding convex parts are used for welding with the magnet protecting cover. The magnet fixing structure of the electronic actuator does not need additional magnetizing procedures, is convenient to install, ensures that the magnet (including magnetism) is not damaged in the whole temperature working range, simplifies the complexity of the magnet installation process, and reduces the cost of magnet material selection and the production/assembly cost.

title_en: Pedal for flushing valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pedal for a flushing valve, which comprises a metal connecting rod connected with an external valve body, a metal pedal plate for trampling and driving the external valve rod to act, and a metal pedal cover plate for sleeving the metal pedal plate, wherein one end of the metal connecting rod is provided with a threaded hole connected with the external valve body, the other end of the metal connecting rod is fixedly connected with the metal pedal plate, the periphery of the metal pedal cover plate is downwards bent with a bending part for fixing the metal pedal plate, wherein a bending part on one side of the metal pedal cover plate is provided with a yielding port matched with the metal connecting rod, the surface of the metal pedal plate is provided with a supporting column for propping up the metal pedal cover plate, the metal pedal cover plate and the metal pedal plate of the pedal plate are fixed through punching assembly, and the support column is added between the metal pedal plate and the metal pedal cover plate, so that the problems of sinking and collapsing of the metal pedal cover plate and the like are not easy to cause when the pedal plate is stepped, the metal pedal plate has the advantages of improving the overall structural strength, along with simple manufacture, low manufacturing cost and portability.

title_en: High-tightness door valve
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of door valves, and particularly relates to a high-tightness door valve, which comprises a valve body, wherein a through groove is formed in the side wall of the valve body, a rotating shaft is hinged in the through groove, two ends of the rotating shaft extend out of the valve body to be connected with a driving mechanism, the side wall of the rotating shaft is connected with a turning plate, the turning plate can rotate to be vertical to seal an opening of a process chamber, the top of the through groove is connected with at least one limiting block, the side wall of the limiting block always abuts against the side wall of the rotating shaft to prevent the rotating shaft from bending, the turning plate is rotatably arranged in the through groove, when the turning plate is rotated to be in a vertical state, the turning plate abuts against an inlet and outlet of a process chamber to seal the inlet and the outlet, a limiting block is arranged at the top of the through groove, the side wall of the limiting block always abuts against the rotating shaft to prevent the rotating shaft from bending deformation caused by flexibility of the turning plate when the rotating shaft is stressed, and air leakage of the process chamber is avoided.

title_en: Connecting assembly for connecting actuator output shaft connecting rod and regulating valve rod
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting assembly for connecting an output shaft connecting rod of an actuator with a valve rod of a regulating valve, which comprises an output shaft connecting piece of the actuator, wherein the lower part of the output shaft connecting piece of the actuator is provided with a valve rod connecting piece of the regulating valve, the upper surface of the valve rod connecting piece of the regulating valve is provided with a groove, and the convex end of the output shaft connecting piece of the actuator extends into the groove. According to the utility model, the convex end of the output shaft connecting piece of the actuator extends into the groove, so that the bearing performance of the valve rod connecting piece of the regulating valve on large moment can be increased, the actuator and the regulating valve can be effectively prevented from falling off in the using process, the output shaft connecting piece of the actuator is limited by the cooperation of the directional pin, the first through hole and the second through hole, the separation is prevented, the square pin can be positioned by the cooperation of the spring chuck, the square pin is prevented from falling off, and the device has the advantages of being compact, reliable, convenient and fast to detach, improving the working efficiency and reducing the labor intensity.

title_en: Press-embedded preassembled cap-shaped nut
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a press-fit preassembled cap nut which comprises a nut main body, wherein a cap is arranged at the upper end of the nut main body, an auxiliary connecting mechanism is arranged between the nut main body and the cap, the auxiliary connecting mechanism consists of a butt joint clamping groove, a butt joint cylinder and a containing groove, the butt joint cylinder is fixedly connected with the nut main body, the connecting part of the butt joint cylinder and the nut main body is positioned in the butt joint clamping groove, when the nut is used, the lower end of the cap and the butt joint cylinder are respectively positioned in the butt joint clamping groove and the containing groove, a limiting mechanism is arranged between the butt joint cylinder and the cap, the lower end of the cap is fixedly connected with a reinforcing ring, and when the nut is used, the reinforcing ring is in close contact with the inner wall of the butt joint clamping groove. Through above device, improve nut dismouting convenience, stability and compactedness of nut self part when the effect are improved.

title_en: Spiral framework oil seal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a spiral skeleton oil blanket, relates to mechanical seal technical field, and oil blanket body (2) are annular, and the inner wall of oil blanket body (2) is equipped with helix (3), and the inner wall of oil blanket body (2) is equipped with inside bellied sealed lip line (4) near the mouth edge department in the outside, and between sealed lip line (4) and helix (3) and between helix (3) and helix (3) looks interval sets up, forms water conservancy diversion recess (5), and the terminal surface near inboard of oil blanket body (2) is equipped with skeleton and inserts groove (6), skeleton (1) are the hollow ring-shaped body that is equipped with one end open-ended "U" shape chamber (7), and skeleton (1) are inlayed in skeleton mosaic groove (6) of oil blanket body (2), and the opening direction of skeleton (1) is unanimous with skeleton mosaic groove (6), and water conservancy diversion recess (5) are equipped with oil return hole (8) and "U" shape chamber (7) of skeleton (1) in the bottom position and are linked together. Has the advantages of simple structure, reasonable design, reliable operation and good sealing effect.

title_en: A quick relief valve for large-scale energy storage cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick pressure release valve for a large energy storage cabinet, which comprises a valve main body, a gland, an inner special-shaped ring, an outer O-shaped ring, a guide block, a spring and a guide shaft, wherein the inner special-shaped ring is arranged in an upper groove of the valve main body, the outer O-shaped ring is arranged in a lower groove of the valve main body, the guide block is arranged in the middle of the valve main body, the spring is sleeved on the outer ring of the guide shaft, and the guide shaft passes through the guide block from the lower side of the valve main body and then is connected with the gland, so that the gland and the inner special-shaped ring form a seal. The technical scheme provided by the utility model can provide a larger pressure relief area, reduce the internal pressure and meet the rapid pressure relief requirement of the large-scale energy storage cabinet.

title_en: Butt-clamping pneumatic butterfly valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of butterfly valves, in particular to a butt-clamp type pneumatic butterfly valve, which comprises a pneumatic butterfly valve body, a main body and a valve rod, wherein the main body is used for bearing a butt-clamp type pneumatic butterfly valve assembly, the valve rod is arranged in the pneumatic butterfly valve body and used for opening and closing a plaice plate, and the butterfly valve plate is fixedly arranged outside the valve rod. The utility model is provided with the pneumatic butterfly valve body, the check valve core, the front filter element net, the torsion spring and the check core block, when gas or fluid medium passes through the pneumatic butterfly valve body, the gas or fluid medium is filtered by the front filter element net of the check valve core after passing through the space opened by the butterfly valve butterfly plate, and impurities contained in the medium are reduced, so that normal circulation of the medium can be ensured, normal use of the check capability can be ensured, then the check core block can be pushed to be separated from the check valve core due to the pushing force of the medium, and the extension of the torsion spring enables the check core block and the check valve core to expose a gap at the moment, so that the medium can normally circulate.

title_en: Novel intelligent electric ball valve actuator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel intelligent electric ball valve actuator, which comprises a shell cover, a base, a control motor, a control block, a first micro-switch and a second micro-switch, wherein the shell cover is covered with the base, a closed cavity is formed between the shell cover and the base, the control motor, the control block, the first micro-switch and the second micro-switch are arranged in the closed cavity, the control motor is arranged on the base, the control block is arranged on a main shaft of the control motor, the first micro-switch and the second micro-switch are fixedly arranged on the base, and the first micro-switch and the second micro-switch can be respectively triggered when the control block rotates. The control block has the advantages that the control block in the right-angle fan-shaped shape is mechanically contacted with the first micro switch and the second micro switch to trigger the switch, and the control block is stable in structure and large in contact area with the micro switch, so that the running stability and the running effectiveness of the actuator can be ensured.

title_en: Electric bicycle shock-absorbing frame
abstract_en: The electric bicycle shock absorption frame comprises a front frame, a rear frame and a motor installation shell, wherein the motor installation shell is arranged between the front frame and the rear frame, the front frame comprises a head pipe, an upper pipe, a middle pipe and a frame pipe, the lower end of the middle pipe is connected with the motor installation shell through a reinforcing box, the rear frame comprises an upper fork and a lower fork, a connecting seat, a connecting rod piece and a shock absorber are sequentially arranged at the front end of the upper fork, and the front end of the lower fork is hinged with a five-way pipe welded on the reinforcing box through a connecting plate. The utility model has stable structure and good comfort, and can bring good experience to users.

title_en: Anti-falling liner for air conditioner pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-falling liner for an air conditioner pipeline, which comprises a main liner, wherein one end of the main liner is provided with an auxiliary liner, the other end of the main liner is provided with a plurality of first arc-shaped baffles, one end of the auxiliary liner, which is far away from the main liner, is provided with a plurality of second arc-shaped baffles, the first arc-shaped baffles and the second arc-shaped baffles are used for being attached to a wall, the center of the main liner is provided with a containing groove along the axial direction, one end of the containing groove also extends to penetrate through the auxiliary liner, the containing groove is slidably connected with a threaded rod, and the center of the threaded rod is provided with a sliding through groove along the axial direction.

title_en: High leakproofness worm gear case end cover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-tightness worm gear case end cover, which comprises a worm gear case upper cover and a worm gear case lower cover arranged at the lower end position of the worm gear case upper cover, wherein a connecting installation ring is arranged at the outer side of a rotating shaft rod and positioned in an end cover built-in groove, fan bars are arranged at the side positions of the connecting installation ring, exhaust through holes are arranged at the inner side of the end cover built-in groove and the outer side of the worm gear case end cover, a pressing buckle is arranged on the connecting installation ring, a metal ball is arranged at the tail end position of the pressing buckle, a built-in extrusion spring is connected at the tail end position of the metal ball, the rotating shaft rod drives the connecting installation ring and the fan bars to rotate when rotating, and the rotating shaft rod can drive air inside the worm gear case end cover to circulate, so that the heat dissipation is accelerated.

title_en: Butterfly valve with auxiliary alignment structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of butterfly valves and discloses a butterfly valve with an auxiliary alignment structure, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a motor is fixedly connected to the rear left side of the top of the bottom plate, a screw rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, an adjusting seat is connected to the outer thread of the screw rod, a guide rod is penetrated through and connected to the front side of the adjusting seat in a sliding manner, supporting blocks are fixedly connected to the two sides of the top of the adjusting seat, a bidirectional threaded rod is penetrated through and connected between the two supporting blocks in a rotating manner, a knob is fixedly connected to the tail end of the left side of the bidirectional threaded rod, a movable frame is connected to the outer thread of the two sides of the bidirectional threaded rod in a threaded manner, a supporting arm is connected to the two sides of the movable frame in a rotating manner, and a lifting plate is connected to the top of the supporting arm in a rotating manner. According to the utility model, the left and right positions of the upper valve body can be finely adjusted through the motor, the screw rod, the adjusting seat, the knob, the guide rod and the moving frame, and the valve body can be conveniently detached after being aligned and installed by being matched with the limiting assembly.

title_en: Working device for use during elevator installation
abstract_en: A work apparatus for use during elevator installation, wherein the work apparatus is mounted on a mounting platform of an elevator, comprising a support plate mounted on the mounting platform extending in a first direction between two opposite hoistway walls of an elevator hoistway, a work tool mounted at an end of the support plate configured to perform a work task during elevator installation, wherein the work tool is configured to be vertically movable and rotatable relative to the support plate via a rotary translation mechanism.

title_en: Sealing structure, sealing assembly, valve body assembly, cover body assembly and cooking utensil
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sealing structure, a sealing assembly, a valve body assembly, a cover body assembly and a cooking utensil, wherein the sealing structure is arranged at a valve port and comprises a sealing ring main body, a flexible sealing surface, a first concave part and a second concave part are arranged on the flexible sealing surface at intervals, the first concave part and the second concave part extend along the circumferential direction of the sealing ring main body, at least part of the first concave part extends into the valve port and is contacted and matched with the outer end of the valve port, the second concave part is positioned outside the valve port, and a sealing convex part is formed between the first concave part and the second concave part. The technical scheme of the utility model effectively solves the problem that the sealing ring in the related technology is difficult to deform so as to influence the sealing effect.

title_en: Tap of integrative equipment of filter equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a faucet with a filtering mechanism integrally assembled, and relates to the field of bathroom building materials; the structure of the faucet comprises a filtering mechanism, a base, a handle mechanism and a faucet main body, wherein the filtering mechanism is integrally assembled with the faucet main body through the base and can be movably disassembled; the utility model solves the problems of light head and feet and occupied space caused by the separation and assembly of the traditional filter and the water tap by the design of installing the filter mechanism on the water tap base, and the utility model has the advantages of convenient installation and disassembly and changeable filter element materials by the design of detachably installing the filter mechanism and the base in a threaded connection way, and the shell of the filter mechanism is made of acrylic material, thereby being convenient for observing the filtering condition of the filter element barrel, being convenient for use and having higher practicability.

title_en: Connecting piece, connecting piece assembly and folding chair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting piece, a connecting piece assembly and a folding chair, which comprise a first connecting main body, wherein the first connecting main body comprises a first connecting part and a second connecting part, the first connecting part comprises a first abutting part, the second connecting part comprises a second abutting part, and the folding chair further comprises an adjusting abutting part, wherein the adjusting abutting part is arranged at the second abutting part and forms a first included angle with the second abutting part. Compared with the prior art, the folding chair has the advantages that the folding chair is simple in structure, the angle of the supporting legs of the folding chair can be adjusted, the angle of the chair back can be adjusted, the folding chair is suitable for various users, and the supporting rods are convenient to detach and install.

title_en: Circulation sealing mechanism for super-gravity bed and super-gravity rotating bed
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a circulating sealing mechanism for a hypergravity bed and a hypergravity rotating bed, wherein the hypergravity bed comprises an annular fixed disc and annular rotating moving discs which are distributed at intervals with the fixed disc, the circulating sealing mechanism for the hypergravity bed comprises an annular sealing liquid channel arranged between the fixed disc and the rotating moving discs, a sealing liquid inlet communicated with the sealing liquid channel is arranged on the fixed disc, and the circulating sealing structure also comprises sealing liquid collecting devices distributed on the lower side of the outer edge of the rotating moving discs. The utility model has the advantages that the sealing liquid channel can effectively prevent gas from flowing short circuit and escaping from the gap between the rotating moving disc and the fixed disc, and meanwhile, the sealing liquid channel distributed in a ring shape can improve the working stability of the rotating disc to a certain extent, so that the rotating moving disc can run more stably and shake is reduced.

title_en: Heating and ventilation pipeline fixing frame with buffering protection function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pipeline equipment, and particularly discloses a heating and ventilation pipeline fixing frame with a buffer protection function. The protection mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the heating pipeline installation and fixation module and comprises a base, a buffer plate and a buffer assembly arranged on the base and the buffer plate, wherein the base is of a U-shaped structure, springs and guide seats are symmetrically arranged at two ends of the limiting columns, one ends of the springs are fixedly connected with the inner wall of the U-shaped structure, the other ends of the springs are connected with the guide seats, and the guide seats are connected with the buffer plate through movable hinges. According to the utility model, the protection mechanism is used for buffering the collision of external force, so that the protection mechanism is prevented from loosening caused by the direct collision with the fixing frame, and the protection mechanism can be taken down only by moving the fixing seat, so that the time and the labor are saved, and the effects of convenient disassembly and buffering protection are achieved.

title_en: Anti-leakage structure for joint of pipeline and ground
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-leakage structure at a joint of a pipeline and the ground, which belongs to the technical field of pipeline anti-leakage and comprises a pipeline body, wherein an anti-leakage mechanism for preventing water leakage is arranged at the bottom of the outer surface of the pipeline body, a connecting ring is arranged on the outer surface of the pipeline body, a connecting mechanism for conveniently installing the connecting ring is arranged on the right side of an inner cavity of the connecting ring, the anti-leakage mechanism comprises a connecting membrane cloth sleeved on the outer surface of the pipeline body, a through hole is formed in the center of the upper surface of the connecting membrane cloth, and an annular sealing ring is fixed in the inner cavity of the through hole. This pipeline and ground junction antiseep structure can effectively avoid pipeline body and ground junction to produce the seepage through the linking membrane cloth that sets up, through-hole, ring seal and draw-in hole, and is convenient for the staff to install, if produce the cooperation of mutually supporting between seepage accessible limbers and the apopore between two pipeline bodies simultaneously for rivers are originally internal, avoid producing the security risk.

title_en: Trough for poultry drinking water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water tanks, in particular to a water tank for poultry drinking water, which comprises a main body, a water tank and a water tank, wherein the main body comprises a mounting frame, the surface of the mounting frame is provided with a tank body, and the surface of the tank body is fixedly connected with a protective fence; the cleaning mechanism comprises a scraping plate. According to the utility model, the scraping plate is arranged on the inner surface of the groove body and pulled by the pull rope, so that the scraping plate can slide on the inner wall of the groove body and can achieve the scraping and cleaning effects, further, the scraping plate is not blocked by the protective fence and is not required to be disassembled and assembled again during cleaning, meanwhile, the limiting effect on the inner surface of the groove body can be achieved by the scraping plate under the connection of the connecting groove and the connecting rod, the scraping plate can move along the direction of the connecting rod, and by arranging the drain holes at the two ends of the groove body and installing the mounting pipes, workers can avoid the phenomenon that the turnover groove body discharges the water source left in the water trough, so that the labor-saving effect is achieved.

title_en: Fixed fan silencing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixed fan silencer which is used for being covered outside a fan and comprises a silencing assembly, a pipeline silencer and a damping vibration absorbing assembly, wherein the silencing assembly comprises a silencing cover body, an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, the air inlet pipe and the air outlet pipe are connected to the silencing cover body, a containing space is formed in the silencing cover body, the output end of the air inlet pipe and the input end of the air outlet pipe are both positioned in the containing space and are both connected with connecting pipes for butt joint of the fan, the silencing cover body is further provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the air outlet is connected with an air outlet pipe, the air inlet and the air outlet pipe are both provided with silencing cotton plates, and the silencing cotton plates in the air outlet pipe are arranged at intervals. The air that makes the external portion of amortization cover can circulate to the amortization cover internal, dispel the heat of fan during operation, ensure that the fan can normally work to the cooperation all is provided with the amortization cotton board at air intake and play tuber pipe, carries out the amortization to the air that flows in and flow out the amortization cover body, lengthens the pipeline sound wave and amortization cotton contact time, further noise reduction.

title_en: High-strength light-weight steel for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of light-weight steel, and discloses high-strength light-weight steel for a new energy automobile, which comprises a first steel body, wherein a second steel body is arranged on the right side of the first steel body, a threaded groove is formed in the right end of the first steel body, a clamping block is arranged on the right side of the first steel body, the left end of the clamping block is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, the threaded groove is in threaded connection with the threaded rod, clamping grooves I are formed in the front side and the rear side of the right end of the first steel body, clamping columns are fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the left end of the second steel body, the clamping grooves I are clamped with the clamping columns, and springs are fixedly connected to the upper end and the lower end of the second steel body. According to the utility model, the threaded rod fixed on the left side of the clamping block is connected with the threaded groove of the first steel body, the clamping column on the left side of the second steel body is clamped with the clamping groove of the first steel body, and the clamping block is fixed by the clamping buckle, so that the two steel materials are firmly clamped, and the problem of unstable connection and clamping between the steel materials is solved.

title_en: Multi-disc brake
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of brakes, and particularly discloses a multi-piece brake which comprises a magnetic yoke, an armature and a flange, wherein a rotor unit and a brake unit are arranged between the armature and the flange, the rotor unit is arranged on the inner side of the brake unit, the rotor unit comprises a ring piece and a mounting disc, a serial part is connected between the ring piece and the mounting disc, the brake unit comprises at least two brake pieces and a guide cylinder, two ends of the guide cylinder are respectively connected with the magnetic yoke and the flange, the guide cylinder is connected with the brake pieces in series, the brake pieces slide along the guide cylinder in a straight line, and the outer edge of the ring piece is clamped and inserted between the two brake pieces. The utility model has lighter and thinner size, better braking effect and smaller installation space.

title_en: Pipeline laying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline laying, and discloses a pipeline laying device which comprises a base, wherein a turntable is fixedly connected to the bottom of the base, a second fixing plate is rotatably connected to the bottom of the turntable, a transmission assembly is arranged at the bottom of the second fixing plate, a first connecting plate is fixedly connected to the front side of the base, a rotating rod is rotatably connected to the front side of the first connecting plate, a second connecting plate is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the rotating rod, a ground digging cutter is fixedly connected to the front side of the second connecting plate, a pipe groove is formed in the inner side of the second connecting plate, a water pipe is slidably connected to the inner side of the pipe groove, and a storage mechanism is arranged at the top of the base. According to the utility model, the transmission assembly is used for automatically driving the device to walk without manual pushing, automation of the laying process is realized, the second connecting plate is connected through the rotating rod, the second connecting plate can be flexibly rotated to enable the ground digging cutter to contact the ground, the ground digging cutter digs a small gap for the ground, and space is provided for laying the water pipe.

title_en: Quick connector for high-density plasma equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the related field of high-density plasma equipment, in particular to a quick connector for the high-density plasma equipment, which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises a main conduit, a chamber branch pipe, a control valve, a flange component and a quick connector component, one side of the main conduit is connected with a plurality of groups of chamber branch pipes, the outer end of each chamber branch pipe is connected with the control valve, the flange component is arranged at the outer end of the control valve, the quick connector component is connected at the outer end of the flange component, the flange component comprises an inner flange, an outer flange and an inner connecting pipe, the quick connector component comprises a connecting seat, the front end of the connecting seat is provided with a threaded pipe, the front end of the threaded pipe is connected with an elastic sheet, the double sealing protection of the inner flange and the outer flange can be realized, the sealing effect of the flange joint is effectively improved, the quick connection of the outer connecting pipe can be realized, the time required for replacing the quick connector under the condition of damage of the quick connector is saved, and the production of other processing chambers is prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Prevent low temperature and reveal hatch board
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of floating natural gas liquefaction production facilities, and provides a hatch cover capable of preventing low-temperature leakage, which comprises a cover plate, a coaming and a flange, wherein the flange is arranged at the top of the coaming, and the cover plate is connected to the flange in a sealing manner; A circle of concave-convex fitting sealing structure is arranged between the cover plate and the flange and used for sealing between the cover plate and the flange. Through unsmooth seal structure design of fitting, strengthened the leakproofness between apron and the flange, effectively reduced the leakage risk because of material shrink or deformation leads to under the low temperature environment, ensured the reliability of hatch board under extreme temperature condition, this seal structure design is simple, not only is convenient for assemble and dismantle, can also keep good sealing state after opening and close the operation many times, helps reducing maintenance cost, promotes the economic nature and the simple operation nature of equipment.

title_en: Row-shaped combined weight for gravity energy storage system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a row-shaped combined weight for a gravity energy storage system, which belongs to the technical field of gravity energy storage and comprises a bearing frame, wherein an installation plate is arranged in the bearing frame, a connecting rod used for being connected with the gravity energy storage system is arranged at the center of the installation plate, a plurality of fixing components used for placing the combined weight are uniformly arranged at the outer side of the installation plate, each fixing component comprises a rotating column penetrating through the installation plate, one end of the rotating column is connected with a second gear, the other end of the rotating column is rotationally connected with a placing seat, two groups of second connecting columns are arranged at the outer side of the rotating column.

title_en: Barrel supply buffer device
abstract_en: The application discloses a barrel supply buffer device, relates to the technical field of chemical supply, solves the problem that a barrel direct supply system in the prior art can not supply liquid in a short time when switching barrel empty, comprises a buffer tank and a nitrogen source, wherein the buffer tank is provided with a liquid inlet, a vent and a liquid outlet, the liquid inlet is connected with a first liquid inlet pipe and a second liquid inlet pipe, the first valve and the second valve are respectively installed to first feed liquor pipe and second feed liquor pipe, and the nitrogen gas source is connected with first trachea, second trachea and third trachea, first trachea is used for connecting first storage tank, the second trachea is used for connecting the second storage tank, the third trachea is connected with the air vent, through being provided with the buffer tank, as long as guarantee to have the liquid all the time in the buffer tank can, just there is not the condition that will not get to the liquid when the bucket sky switches.

title_en: Loop resistance tester
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a loop resistance tester, which relates to the technical field of testing instruments and aims to solve the technical problems that dust and impurities are easy to be stained and enter into a slot when the prior loop resistance tester is used in a case opening process, the cleaning is inconvenient, the tightness between a machine cover and a case is reduced, the loop resistance tester comprises a case main body and a machine cover main body which is hinged and connected with the case main body, resistance testing equipment is fixedly arranged at the inner bottom of the machine cover main body, the utility model adopts an integrated arrangement mode to efficiently complete the test, and impurities in the sealing groove can be adhered out and filled in the sealing groove through the convexly arranged hollow rubber sealing strip, so that the cleaning and cleaning of workers are facilitated, and the sealing effect of the case main body and the cover main body is ensured.

title_en: Ultrapure diaphragm valve with multiple actuators
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ultrapure diaphragm valve with multiple actuators, which comprises a first pneumatic actuator, a second pneumatic actuator, a connecting plate, a diaphragm and a valve seat, wherein the first pneumatic actuator is connected with the second pneumatic actuator in a superposition way through the connecting plate, the driving end of the first pushing head of the first pneumatic actuator is connected with the top end of the second pushing head of the second pneumatic actuator, the bottom end of the second pushing head is connected with the diaphragm in the valve seat, and under the dual pressure driving of the first pushing head and the second pushing head, the diaphragm is used for blocking a pipeline between a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet under double pressure of the valve seat so as to realize the closing of the valve.

title_en: Solenoid valve, controller, seat assembly and car
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electromagnetic valve, a controller, a seat assembly and an automobile, wherein the electromagnetic valve comprises a valve body and an electromagnetic assembly, the valve body comprises a valve body, an air inlet part and an air outlet part, an air inlet channel which is suitable for being connected with an air source is arranged in the air inlet part, an air outlet channel is arranged in the air outlet part, a containing cavity is arranged in the valve body, and the containing cavity is communicated with the air outlet channel. According to the electromagnetic valve, the pretightening force of the spring is reasonably designed based on the maximum air pressure provided by the air source, so that the thrust of the spring to the moving iron assembly is always greater than or equal to the thrust of the air to the moving iron assembly when the coil is powered off. Therefore, when the coil is powered off, the electromagnetic valve is kept to be stably closed and cannot be opened by air pressure, and the electromagnetic valve is stable and effective.

title_en: Screw pair with limit protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a screw rod pair with limit protection, which comprises a screw rod, wherein nuts are rotationally connected to the surface of the screw rod, two end plates are rotationally connected to the surfaces of two ends of the screw rod through bearings, supporting components are fixed to the bottom ends of the two end plates, the end plates are fixedly installed through the supporting components, and limit components are installed on the adjacent sides of the two end plates. According to the utility model, the screw rod, the nut, the two end plates, the two supporting components and the two limiting components are arranged, two ends of the screw rod are respectively and rotatably connected with the two end plates through the bearings, the end plates are fixedly installed through the supporting components, when the nut moves along the screw rod and presses the sliding sleeve of any limiting component, the ring plate can press the contact switch, and then the control system of the contact switch triggering device stops driving the screw rod to continue rotating, so that the limiting protection effect is achieved. The height of the screw rod can be adjusted through the supporting component, and the installation is convenient.

title_en: Noise reduction gear box for silage machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gearboxes, and provides a noise reduction gearbox for a silage machine, which comprises a gearbox, wherein a left shell is arranged on the side surface of the gearbox, a noise reduction assembly is arranged on the inner wall of the gearbox, the noise reduction assembly comprises a right shell, the side surface of the right shell is arranged on the side surface of the gearbox, an upper output shaft is arranged on the inner wall of the gearbox, an intermediate gear is arranged on the inner wall of the gearbox, an output pinion is arranged on the inner wall of the gearbox, an output spark hole shaft is arranged on the inner wall of the gearbox, a joint bearing is arranged on the inner wall of the gearbox, a lower output bevel gear shaft is arranged on the inner wall of the gearbox, and an output large gear is arranged on the inner wall of the gearbox.

title_en: Joint assembly, cooling system and electric equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power batteries, and particularly provides a joint assembly which is connected with a liquid cooling plate and comprises a pipe body and a joint, wherein the pipe body comprises a pipe body and a sleeve connected with the pipe body, the joint comprises a main body part, an insert arranged on a first side of the main body part and a connecting pipe arranged on a second side of the main body part, the sleeve and the pipe body are enclosed to form a containing cavity, the insert is contained in the containing cavity, the insert is clamped and matched with the sleeve, and a floating space is reserved between the insert and the sleeve in the axial direction of the sleeve. The joint assembly of the present utility model can reduce flow resistance, reduce cost and reduce weight.

title_en: Forward rotation operation and reverse rotation braking gear box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forward running and reverse running braking gearbox, which relates to the technical field of oil pump gearboxes and comprises a gearbox shell and a box cover arranged on the outer side of the gearbox shell, wherein a driving shaft is arranged on the side part of the gearbox shell in a rotating and penetrating way, a transmission shaft is arranged in the box cover in a rotating and penetrating way, one end of the transmission shaft extending into the gearbox shell is fixedly provided with a plurality of connecting rods, an external gear is fixedly arranged through the connecting rods, one end of the driving shaft, which is close to the box cover, is fixedly provided with an internal fluted disc, the outer side of the internal fluted disc is provided with a plurality of unidirectional teeth which are arranged in a surrounding and symmetrical way, the unidirectional teeth are meshed with tooth grooves in the external gear, and a plurality of unidirectional driving mechanisms which are arranged in a surrounding and symmetrical way are arranged between the unidirectional teeth and the side part of the internal fluted disc. According to the utility model, the gear box can carry out forward and backward movement braking, and simultaneously, the unidirectional teeth on the outer side of the inner gear disc can be conveniently replaced, so that the unidirectional teeth can be continuously and stably meshed with the outer gear.

title_en: Support column driving structure on wafer supporting disc of single wafer cleaning device
abstract_en: The application relates to a supporting column driving structure on a wafer supporting disc of a single wafer cleaning device, and belongs to the technical field of wafer production equipment. The outer ring of the rotating piece of the support column driving structure on the wafer supporting disc of the single wafer cleaning device is provided with the outer teeth, the outer teeth are meshed with the support column driving gear and the counterweight body at the same time, the counterweight body plays a damping role in rotating the rotating piece, meanwhile, the damping acting direction is consistent with the rotating direction of the rotating piece, the rotating piece can be stably rotated, vibration is reduced, and the safety of the support column when clamping the wafer is improved.

title_en: High-density electromagnetic valve core
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-density electromagnetic valve core, which belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic valve cores and comprises a valve core main body, wherein a platform-shaped groove is formed in the bottom end of the valve core main body, a communicated cylindrical clamping groove is formed in the bottom of the platform-shaped groove, a sealing pad is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the valve core main body and used for sealing a valve port, the sealing pad comprises a clamping shaft, the lower end of the sealing pad is connected with a rubber pad, the clamping shaft is inserted into the cylindrical clamping groove, and the clamping shaft is fixedly connected with the valve core main body through an anti-disengaging bolt penetrating through the clamping shaft and the valve core main body. The valve core is characterized in that clamping connection can be realized through the clamping action between the cylindrical clamping groove and the clamping shaft, and then the firmness of clamping between the cylindrical clamping groove and the clamping shaft is ensured through the penetrating connection of the anti-falling bolt, so that the sealing pad cannot be separated from the valve core main body even if being deformed in the use process, the rubber pad is directly contacted with the valve port when the valve port is sealed, the sealing performance of sealing is ensured through deformation, and the rubber pad is tightly attached to the valve port, so that the sealing effect is improved.

title_en: Automobile brake clearance adjusting arm mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automobile brake clearance adjusting arm mechanism, which comprises an adjusting arm, wherein an installation groove is formed in the adjusting arm, a worm gear is embedded in the installation groove, an installation cavity is formed in the right side of the adjusting arm, a storage box is fixedly installed in the installation cavity, a connecting hole is communicated between the installation groove and the installation cavity, the same fixed shaft is fixedly installed between the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the connecting hole, friction wheels are sleeved on the outer side of the fixed shaft in a rotating mode, and the same partition plate is fixedly installed between the inner walls of the storage box. The felt cloth is extruded when the friction wheel rotates, so that lubricating oil is filtered out from the felt cloth and absorbed by the superfine fiber cloth, and then is transported to the worm gear through the superfine fiber cloth, so that the worm gear and the screw are lubricated, the lubricating oil in the storage box is slowly absorbed through the felt cloth, the effect of saving the lubricating oil is achieved, and the action time of the lubricating oil is prolonged.

title_en: Bellows ball valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corrugated pipe ball valve which comprises a ball valve body, a first flange plate, a metal corrugated pipe, a second flange plate, a lengthening plate and a telescopic adjusting mechanism, wherein the first flange plate is fixed at the right end of the ball valve body, the metal corrugated pipe is fixed at the left side of the ball valve body, the second flange plate is fixed at the left end of the metal corrugated pipe, the lengthening plate is fixed at the lower side of the ball valve body, the telescopic adjusting mechanism for driving the second flange plate and the metal corrugated pipe to stretch out and draw back is arranged on the lengthening plate, the telescopic adjusting mechanism comprises a threaded sleeve, a threaded rod, a supporting frame and a limiting guide rod, the threaded sleeve is rotatably connected to the lengthening plate, the threaded rod penetrating the threaded sleeve is arranged in the threaded sleeve, the supporting frame is fixed at the front end of the threaded rod, the upper end of the supporting frame is fixed with the second flange plate, and the limiting guide rod penetrating the lengthening plate is fixed on the threaded rod. The utility model has convenient overall length adjustment so as to meet different installation requirements.

title_en: Combined reducing butt joint pipe fitting structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a combined type reducing butt joint pipe fitting structure which comprises a reducing butt joint, wherein a butt joint mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the reducing butt joint, the butt joint mechanism comprises a first limiting frame, the inner wall of the first limiting frame is fixedly connected with the outer surface of the reducing butt joint, the inner wall of the reducing butt joint is slidably connected with an input pipe, four first extrusion springs are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the first limiting frame, first arc-shaped inserting blocks are fixedly arranged at one ends, close to each other, of two groups of first extrusion springs, the outer surface of each first arc-shaped inserting block is slidably connected with the reducing butt joint and the inner wall of the input pipe, and a first pull rod is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of each first arc-shaped inserting block. The elasticity that provides through first extrusion spring can extrude first arc inserted block for first arc inserted block can directly pass the input tube and get into in the reducing butt joint, thereby can carry out spacing fixed to the input tube.

title_en: Purification device of liquid chlorine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid chlorine purifying device which comprises a feed tank, a gasification tank and a buffer tank which are sequentially arranged from left to right, wherein a heat recovery mechanism is arranged between the gasification tank and the buffer tank and is used for recovering heat of gasified liquid chlorine, a stirring assembly for guaranteeing the fluidity of the liquid chlorine and avoiding wall hanging is arranged in the feed tank, the heat recovery mechanism comprises a water tank and a heat preservation tank, cold water is stored in the water tank, a gas pipe is fixedly communicated with the right side of the gasification tank, and one end of the gas pipe positioned outside the water tank is communicated with the buffer tank. When the liquid chlorine purifying device is used for gasifying the liquid chlorine and discharging the liquid chlorine from the gas transmission pipe, heat exchange is carried out between the liquid chlorine purifying device and cold water in the water tank, so that heat recovery is carried out on the gasified liquid chlorine, hot water after heat exchange can be used for gasifying the liquid chlorine or other processing flows, heat loss is reduced, and the use cost of the device is reduced.

title_en: Speed change structure of mini-tiller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mini-tiller, in particular to a speed changing structure of a mini-tiller, which comprises a machine shell, a driving assembly and a gear shifting assembly, wherein the gear shifting assembly comprises a first driving shaft, a first driving gear, a second driving gear, a first fixing shaft, a first transmission gear, a second transmission gear, a first working shaft, a second working shaft, a first gear shifting lever and a first transmission member, when rotary tillage operation is required, a furrow opener is replaced by a rotary tillage cutter, the gear shifting lever is rotated to drive the first driving gear to move, the first driving gear is staggered with the first transmission gear, the second driving gear is meshed with the second transmission gear, and because the diameter of the second driving gear is smaller, the rotation speed of the second transmission gear is reduced, the torque is increased, and then the rotation speed of the first working shaft is reduced, and the torque is increased, so that the rotary tillage operation of the rotary tillage cutter is adapted, and the aim that the mini-tiller can be used according to different working conditions is achieved.

title_en: Blade holder bearing double-sealing structure and stirrer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-sealing structure of a cutter holder bearing and a stirrer, which comprises a cutter holder, a cutter shaft, an oil-containing bearing, a bearing sleeve, an end face sealing ring and a radial sealing ring, wherein the cutter shaft is arranged in the oil-containing bearing, the oil-containing bearing is arranged in the bearing sleeve, the bearing sleeve is arranged on the cutter holder, the end face sealing ring is connected with the top face of the bearing sleeve in a sealing manner and is used for preventing liquid and impurities from entering the inner hole surface of the oil-containing bearing from the end face and preventing lubricating oil from leaking from the end face, the radial sealing ring is positioned between the inner top face of the bearing sleeve and the top face of the oil-containing bearing, an inner hole of the radial sealing ring is connected with the outer circle of the cutter shaft in a sealing manner, and the outer circumference of the radial sealing ring is connected with the inner wall of the bearing sleeve in a sealing manner, so that the radial sealing ring can prevent the liquid and the impurities from entering the inner hole surface of the oil-containing bearing from the radial direction and prevent the lubricating oil from leaking along the radial direction. The utility model can effectively prevent the liquid and impurities in the container from penetrating into the inner hole of the oil-containing bearing, and improves the service life of the oil-containing bearing and the use feeling of users.

title_en: Bearing cooling device for glass liquid stirrer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a glass liquid stirrer bearing cooling device, which relates to the technical field of bearing box cooling and comprises a left air ring, a right air ring and a right mounting frame, wherein the right mounting frame is assembled on the right side of the left air ring, a group of rubber sleeves are sleeved between the front end and the rear end of the left air ring and the right air ring, the left air ring and the right air ring are connected in a split mode, the outer part of the left air ring is sleeved in the front part of the left mounting frame, the outer part of the right air ring is sleeved in the front part of the right mounting frame, and one end of the left air ring is connected with a right air conveying pipe. The utility model adopts an annular air cooling structure, and introduces high-pressure air to continuously cool the stirring shaft so as to prevent very high radiation temperature from reaching the stirring tank and stronger heat transfer between metals, thereby being beneficial to uniform cooling, better protecting the structures such as the shaft body and the like, and being safer and more reliable.

title_en: Sprocket steel belt type lifting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chain wheel steel belt type lifting mechanism which comprises a shell, a motor support arranged on one side of the shell, a chain wheel motor mounting frame connected with the motor support, a chain wheel motor arranged on one side of the shell, a recovery wheel motor mounting plate arranged on one side of the shell, a telescopic rod formed by combining a plurality of sections of hollow square tubes and corresponding plugs, a 301 steel belt with holes, one end of the 301 steel belt is fixed on a recovery wheel, the other end of the 301 steel belt is matched with teeth of the chain wheel along a hole site and penetrates into the telescopic rod, limiting blocks are arranged on the bottom and two sides of the shell, and the output end of the microcontroller is connected with the input end of the recovery wheel motor and the input end of the chain wheel motor respectively. The utility model has the advantages that 1, the steel belt with 301 holes is elastic, has toughness and high durability, 2, the stainless steel thin-wall square tube or the carbon fiber thin-wall square tube is adopted, the weight is reduced, the volume is small, the stroke is large, the contraction ratio is large, and the multi-stage expansion and contraction can be realized.

title_en: Double-layer inflation tube device of vacuum coating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-layer inflation tube device of a vacuum coating machine, which relates to the technical field of vacuum coating machines and comprises a coating machine body, wherein a scraping and cleaning mechanism is arranged in the coating machine body and comprises a fixed block, and the fixed block is fixedly connected in the coating machine body. According to the utility model, the effect of scraping and cleaning the film layer on the double-layer inflation tube body can be achieved through the arrangement of the scraping and cleaning mechanism, in the use process, the scraping ring is driven by the starting motor to scrape and clean the film layer attached to the double-layer inflation tube body, in the moving process of the scraping ring, the sliding of the motor support on the sliding rail can enable the scraping ring to move more stably and smoothly, and the situation that the film layer on the double-layer inflation tube body can block the air outlet hole on the double-layer inflation tube body due to incapability of scraping and cleaning the film layer on the double-layer inflation tube body can be avoided, so that the condition that gas cannot be filled in occurs, and the practicability of the inflation tube is ensured.

title_en: Compression device of nitrogen making machine molecular sieve convenient to detach
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compression device of a molecular sieve of a nitrogen making machine, which is convenient to disassemble, and comprises an adsorption tower, wherein an adsorption tower end cover is arranged at the upper opening of the adsorption tower, a cylinder barrel is arranged at the upper end of the adsorption tower end cover, a cylinder barrel is arranged between the cylinder barrel and the adsorption tower end cover, an air outlet pipe is arranged on the side wall of the cylinder barrel, a piston is arranged in the sliding manner in the cylinder barrel, the lower end of the piston is connected with a lower pressure head through a piston rod, a through hole is arranged at the center of the adsorption tower end cover, the lower pressure head is freely inserted into the through hole up and down, a pressure distribution disc is arranged at the top in the adsorption tower, and the lower pressure head compresses the pressure distribution disc. The utility model can conveniently detach the compressing device at the top of the adsorption tower during transportation, reduce the whole height, and increase the effective nitrogen producing space of the adsorption tower.

title_en: Aluminum profile convenient to clean
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum profiles and discloses an aluminum profile convenient to clean, wherein a shielding component is arranged on the aluminum profile, a mounting block A is positioned on the right side of a mounting block B, the width of a shielding belt, the width of the mounting block A and the width of the mounting block B, the width of a pressing block A and the width of a pressing block B are all larger than the width of a clamping groove A, the pressing block A is sleeved on a stud A and positioned between the aluminum profile and a nut A, the mounting block A and the pressing block A are fixedly connected with the aluminum profile through the nut A, the pressing block B is sleeved on the stud B and positioned between the aluminum profile and the nut B, the mounting block B and the pressing block B are fixedly connected with the aluminum profile through the nut B, and the left end and the right end of the shielding belt are respectively connected with the pressing block B and the pressing block A, and the shielding belt are overlapped with the position of the clamping groove A and are in abutting connection with the aluminum profile. The aluminum profile cleaning device has the beneficial effects that dust and impurities are prevented from entering the clamping groove, the follow-up aluminum profile cleaning is convenient, and the problem that a large amount of dust and impurities are easily accumulated in the clamping groove after the aluminum profile is installed is solved, so that the aluminum profile is inconvenient to clean.

title_en: Pendulum-type milling machine sealing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing device of a pendulum type pulverizer, which comprises the pendulum type pulverizer, wherein a feeding pipe is fixedly connected to the side wall of the pendulum type pulverizer, and a sealing structure is arranged at the other end of the feeding pipe. When using pendulum-type milling machine, set up seal structure in advance at the tip of inlet pipe, the one end of sack pipe is the rubber tube other end for cloth, the sack one end and the piping connection of discharging equipment of sack pipe are provided with the rubber circle simultaneously, the inside of sack pipe is provided with the rubber circle, carry out the centre gripping by outside symmetry semicircle board again, fix the sack pipe in discharging equipment's pipeline outside and seal, also can select the semicircle board of different specifications with the specification according to the pipeline, ensure whole sealed effect, avoid can causing the dust to fly upward, be provided with the fan simultaneously in the one end of inlet pipe, inwards blow air when the unloading, increase the extra spacing to the material, avoid the material backward flow to produce the dust, moreover the sack pipe simple structure, easily install and dismantle, can wash and change the sack conveniently.

title_en: Wave crest non-interference dust cover suitable for high rotation speed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wave crest non-interference type high-rotation-speed dust cover, which relates to the technical field of dust covers and comprises a shell connecting part, wherein one end of the shell connecting part is provided with a peak-valley mechanism, the peak-valley mechanism comprises a large wave trough sleeve, a large wave crest sleeve, a small wave trough sleeve and a small wave trough sleeve, the large wave trough sleeve is connected to the end face of the shell connecting part and is concave, the large wave crest sleeve is connected to the end of the large wave trough sleeve and is convex, the large wave crest sleeve and the large wave trough sleeve are matched to form a large peak Gu Zujian, the small wave crest Gu Zujian is arranged on one side of the large wave trough sleeve, and the small wave crest assembly consists of a plurality of small wave crest sleeves and the small wave trough sleeves connected between the adjacent small wave crest sleeves. By arranging the peak-valley mechanism, the utility model can realize that the small wave crest sleeve, the small wave trough sleeve, the large wave trough sleeve and the large wave crest sleeve cannot be contacted when in large swing, thereby ensuring that the dust cover cannot lose the dust-proof effect due to heat damage caused by friction when in high rotating speed.

title_en: Tunnel measuring instrument fixing frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of surveying and mapping instruments, in particular to a tunnel measuring instrument fixing frame which comprises an upper fixing plate, a lower fixing plate, an upper supporting frame, a base bracket, a rotating shaft and a lower supporting rod. The upper support frame and the base bracket are sequentially arranged on one side of the upper fixing plate far away from the tunnel lining, the upper support frame is vertically and rotatably connected with the upper fixing plate, the rotating shaft is arranged between the upper support frame and the base bracket, the base bracket is rotatably connected with the upper support frame through the rotating shaft, the two lower supporting rods are obliquely arranged between the lower fixing plate and the base bracket, and two ends of the lower supporting rods are respectively connected with the lower fixing plate and the base bracket. The fixed plate is installed earlier during the installation, because the setting of axis of rotation can be adjusted the base bracket through rotating the base bracket after installing the fixed plate to because the vertical rotation of upper bracket and upper fixed plate is connected, consequently can adjust the base bracket to the level after the installation of upper fixed plate.

title_en: Bridge pier column pile foundation steel reinforcement cage transportation protection device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bridge engineering, and relates to a bridge pier pile foundation reinforcement cage transportation protection device, which comprises a supporting device, wherein the supporting device comprises a supporting table A and a supporting table B; the support table A is of an M-shaped structure with an arc-shaped edge, and the support table B is of a triangular structure with an arc-shaped edge. This bridge pier stud pile foundation steel reinforcement cage transportation protection device, through supporting bench A, supporting bench B, U shape pole, slide rail, slide, telescopic link, spring, rope hole and go-between isotructure's setting, can make up supporting bench A and supporting bench B when transporting the steel reinforcement cage, can improve the quantity to the steel reinforcement cage transportation, utilize the setting of rope hole and go-between simultaneously, can accomplish the fixed work to the steel reinforcement cage, can prevent the roll of steel reinforcement cage, also have damper's setting during the transportation simultaneously, improved the transportation protection effect to the steel reinforcement cage.

title_en: Turbine thrust bearing with high wear resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turbine thrust bearing with high wear resistance, which comprises a bearing inner ring and a bearing outer ring, wherein the bearing inner ring is arranged in the bearing outer ring, a retainer structure is arranged between the bearing outer ring and the bearing inner ring, rolling bodies are arranged in the retainer structure and respectively contacted with the outer side of the bearing inner ring and the inner side of the bearing outer ring, a lubricating structure is arranged on the retainer structure, and the rolling bodies in the retainer are lubricated through the lubricating structure. The retainer structure is provided with the lubricating structure, the lubricating structure fully lubricates the rolling bodies through the oil cavity, the oil inlet hole and the oil outlet hole, and the lubricating agent is uniformly distributed around the rolling bodies, so that friction between the rolling bodies and the inner ring and the outer ring of the bearing can be remarkably reduced, abrasion is reduced, and the running efficiency and the service life of the bearing are improved.

title_en: Connecting structure of decorative cover plate and driving box and transmission box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a connecting structure of a decorative cover plate and a driving box as well as a transmission box. The novel driving box solves the technical problems that an existing driving box and a transmission box are exposed and attractive and the like. Including drive box and the transmission box that adjacently set up, the corresponding one side of drive box and transmission box is equipped with decorates the apron, decorates the apron length and is not less than the total length of drive box and transmission box and decorates apron width and be not less than drive box or transmission box width, decorates the apron and links to each other with drive box and/or transmission box through buckle coupling assembling, decorates the apron and links to each other with drive box or transmission box through dismantling fixed connection structure. The curtain has the advantages that the driving box and the transmission box are shielded through the decorative cover plate, the attractive degree of the curtain is improved, and the decorative cover plate is connected with the driving box and the transmission box through the buckle connecting assembly and the detachable fixed connecting structure, so that the driving box, the transmission box and the decoration cover plate can be firmly connected.

title_en: Ray instrument placer
