abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ray instrument placement device, which belongs to the technical field of machining quality detection and comprises a support mechanism, a placement mechanism and an adjusting plate, wherein the placement mechanism is arranged on the support mechanism and is used for placing ray instruments, the adjusting plate is movably arranged on the placement mechanism and is used for placing ray instruments with different sizes, and the support mechanism can drive the ray instruments on the placement mechanism to adjust positions. The X-ray flaw detector is used for stably placing the X-ray flaw detector, can be conveniently and stably placed according to the X-ray flaw detector with different sizes through the adjusting plate arranged on the placing mechanism, and can also drive the ray instrument to adjust the position through the supporting mechanism, so that the ray instrument can be conveniently aligned with a part or a product to be detected for detection.

title_en: Pipeline joint with swift mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pipeline joint with a quick installation structure, which comprises the following components: the pipeline joint comprises a pipeline joint main body I, a pipeline joint main body II, a fastening assembly and an outer sealing ring, wherein a connecting pipe I is arranged on the right side of the pipeline joint main body I, and compared with the prior art, the pipeline joint has the following beneficial effects: through increasing pipeline joint main part one, pipeline joint main part two, outer sealing washer and pipeline body, pipeline body end department embedding gomphosis annular is in, connect sealing washer and the laminating of pipeline body outside, make the fastening double-screw bolt rotate in the fastening screw hole inboard, the fastening ring extrudees the sealing washer to connect and improves the sealing contact with the pipeline body, pipeline joint main part one is connected with pipeline joint main part two through connecting the external screw thread and connecting the internal screw thread cooperation, use outer sealing washer to strengthen sealed effect, can reach the effect of swift installation, through increasing pipeline joint main part one, pipeline joint main part two, fastening assembly and pipeline body, can improve the pipeline connection tightness.

title_en: Be used for centrifugal compressor shaft coupling respiratory oil leak to administer device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oil leakage treatment device for a breathing port of a centrifugal compressor coupling, which comprises a liquid level meter device, a breathing port connecting part, an oil mist collecting cylinder and an oil discharging valve of an oil discharging device, wherein the breathing port connecting part is used for being connected with the breathing port of the centrifugal compressor coupling, and the liquid level meter device, the breathing port connecting part and the oil discharging valve of the oil discharging device are all connected with the oil mist collecting cylinder.

title_en: Outdoor center oxygen supply device with convenient increase and decrease oxygen supply pipeline structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a convenient field center oxygen suppliment device that increases and decreases oxygen supply pipeline structure, include: oxygenerator body and oxygen therapy subassembly, oxygenerator body upper end left side, right side activity cartridge respectively have a set of oxygen therapy subassembly that is used for many people to supply oxygen, oxygenerator body left surface, right surface all are provided with an air inlet that is used for the oxygenerator to advance, compare with prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects of as follows: through setting up oxygenerator body and conveying component, oxygen therapy component places inside the oxygenerator body, the transportation convenience of lifting means greatly can take out practicality from the storage chamber at any time, has better flexibility of use, helps promoting operating personnel's simple operation, practices thrift outdoor time required to the oxygen suppliment of many people under the special circumstances, and the setting of oxygen therapy component, the connection structure of quick detach fast-assembling is adopted to whole structure, this increase and decrease oxygen supply pipeline that makes oxygen therapy component can be convenient, promotes the flexibility of in-service use.

title_en: Television set top box bracket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a television set top box bracket which comprises two groups of mounting blocks, wherein an adjusting mechanism is fixedly connected between the two groups of mounting blocks, one side of the adjusting mechanism is fixedly connected with two groups of supporting plates, one side of each supporting plate is fixedly connected with a fixing mechanism, the top of each supporting plate is provided with a sliding groove, the cross section of each sliding groove is of an inverted T-shaped structure, and the inside of each sliding groove is slidably connected with a corresponding sliding block.

title_en: Conical end socket for ship equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ship equipment, in particular to a conical sealing head for the ship equipment, which comprises a first semicircular shell and a second semicircular shell, wherein a connecting groove is formed in the inner wall of the first semicircular shell, the inner wall of the connecting groove is abutted against a first connecting strip, the outer wall of the first connecting strip is fixedly connected with the second semicircular shell, the upper end of the first semicircular shell is fixedly connected with a first triangular plate, and a limiting mechanism is connected with the inner wall of the first semicircular shell. The second triangular plates on the second semicircular shells and the first triangular plates on the first semicircular shells are in butt joint through the two groups of second triangular plates with the same structure, the second connecting strips on the second triangular plates can be inserted into the first semicircular shells, the limit ring threads are led to enter the first semicircular shells and the second semicircular shells, the limit ring is enabled to be fixed in position, the thread ring threads are transferred to the thread strips to be reinforced, multiple welding is not needed, and the working strength and labor waste are reduced.

title_en: Miniature relief valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a miniature safety valve which comprises a valve body, wherein a cavity is arranged in the middle of the valve body, a sealing column capable of moving along the axis of the valve body is arranged in the cavity, an air passage is arranged at the bottom of the valve body, a sealing ring is arranged at the outlet of the air passage, limit columns capable of moving along the axis of the valve body are arranged at the side of the valve body, each limit column is matched with a fine adjustment knob and is abutted with the limit column through a compression spring, the contact part of the limit column and the sealing column is an inclined plane, the limit column is perpendicular to the sealing column, the limit column is used for limiting the sealing column, the bottom of the sealing column is matched with the sealing ring to form a sealing structure for sealing the air passage, and the number of the limit columns is at least two. The utility model provides a miniature safety valve which has a mechanical structure, does not need electric control and can release air pressure to a safety value, and solves the problems that the existing mechanical safety valve cannot release the air pressure to the safety value and the electromagnetic safety valve can release the air pressure to the safety value but needs electric control.

title_en: Pre-buried nut assembly, block terminal and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses an embedded nut assembly, a distribution box and a vehicle, relates to the technical field of vehicles, and aims to solve the problem that an embedded nut and other parts are assembled abnormally due to precision errors. The embedded nut assembly comprises a nut body, an elastic piece and an embedded piece, wherein the embedded piece is provided with a containing cavity, at least part of the nut body is arranged in the containing cavity, and the elastic piece is connected between the nut body and the embedded piece.

title_en: Wear-resistant gate valve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wear-resistant gate valve, and belongs to the technical field of valve manufacturing. It has solved the easy scheduling problem of wearing and tearing of current gate valve. This wear-resisting gate valve includes valve body and valve gap, valve gap and valve body threaded connection, the inside of valve gap has linked firmly the locking cap, swing joint has been run through at the top of valve gap has the lead screw, the bottom of lead screw runs through the locking cap and extends to the inner chamber of valve body, the bottom thread bush on lead screw surface is equipped with the flashboard, the top of lead screw is seted up flutedly, the bottom of recess inner chamber runs through and has linked firmly the oiling pipe, the oiling passageway has been seted up to the inside of lead screw, the inner chamber threaded connection of recess has sealing bolt, the surface thread bush of valve gap is equipped with the hexagonal cap, the fixed cover in top on lead screw surface is equipped with the hand wheel, the cavity has been seted up to the inside of hand wheel, the positioning seat has all been riveted to the both sides at hexagonal cap top, the both sides of hand wheel bottom all run through swing joint has the locating lever, the top of locating lever runs through the inner chamber to the cavity and is riveted with the iron plate. The utility model has the advantages of long service life, safe use and the like.

title_en: Fixing device and track detection device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of track detection, in particular to a fixing device and a track detection device, wherein the fixing device is used for fixing a component, a bearing component and a slideway component, two ends of the slideway component in a second direction are respectively fixed with two steel rails through the fixing component, the bearing component is used for fixing the acquisition component, the bearing component is movably connected with the slideway component so as to enable the bearing component to be switched between a debugging state and a detection state, and the bearing component is in sliding connection with the slideway component along the second direction when the bearing component is in the debugging state. The support assembly is fixed relative to the ramp assembly in the testing position of the support assembly. According to the fixing device and the track detection device provided by the application, the influence of vibration of the steel rail on the testing device is effectively reduced, the position of the testing device in the second direction can be flexibly carried out according to the condition of the track in the field, the stability of the testing device in the testing process is ensured, and the reliability of the testing data is ensured.

title_en: Fork truck hoist
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forklift lifting appliance which is specially designed for a forklift, and is matched with the forklift to carry vertically, so that the damage risk of equipment in the short-distance carrying process is reduced, and the operation efficiency and quality are improved; the utility model comprises a forklift lifting appliance, which comprises two upper bearing brackets, two lower bearing brackets, four side bearing brackets, a bottom protection assembly and a top protection assembly, wherein the upper bearing brackets and the lower bearing brackets are oppositely arranged, the two upper bearing brackets and the two lower bearing brackets are mutually parallel and aligned in the vertical direction, the upper bearing brackets and the lower bearing brackets are connected through the four side bearing brackets, the lower bearing brackets are provided with cavities for inserting extension arms of a forklift, and one end of each lower bearing bracket is provided with a fork locking assembly.

title_en: Two-position two-way pilot pneumatic electromagnetic valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of pneumatic electromagnetic valves, in particular to a two-position two-way pilot type pneumatic electromagnetic valve, wherein an inlet is formed in one side of an electromagnetic valve body, an installation cavity is formed in the bottom of the electromagnetic valve body upwards, an installation plate is assembled in the installation cavity in an adapting mode, a filter screen is arranged on the installation plate in an adapting mode corresponding to the inlet, a fixing seat is fixedly arranged on one side of the bottom of the electromagnetic valve body, which is located on the installation plate, a pull plate is movably arranged on one side of the fixing seat, limit columns are vertically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the pull plate towards the installation plate, and limit cavities are formed on the installation plate in an adapting mode corresponding to the limit columns. According to the utility model, the mounting plate can be fixedly assembled in the mounting cavity through the adapting clamping between the limiting column and the limiting cavity, so that the filter screen can be mounted, the fluid can be filtered through the filter screen, the filter screen in the structure is convenient to assemble and disassemble, and a user can conveniently disassemble and clean the filter screen in the later period.

title_en: Connecting pipe and air conditioning equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fresh air channels, and discloses a connecting pipe and air conditioning equipment. The connecting pipe comprises a first pipeline and a second pipeline, wherein the first pipeline is used for penetrating through the installation foundation, the second pipeline can be sleeved on the outer side of the first pipeline and is detachably connected with the first pipeline, and when the first pipeline is inserted into the second pipeline, the second pipeline can be deformed and attached to the outer wall surface of the first pipeline. When first pipeline inserts in the second pipeline, the second pipeline can warp and laminate in the outside of first pipeline, has strengthened the connection leakproofness of first pipeline and second pipeline like this, prevents that the air current from leaking, improves the holistic stability of connecting pipe to can effectively resist vibration or external impact.

title_en: Spring pull rod and spring module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a spring pull rod and a spring module, wherein the spring pull rod comprises a pull rod body, a plurality of first reinforcing parts and a plurality of second reinforcing parts, wherein the first reinforcing parts and the second reinforcing parts are arranged on the pull rod body, the first reinforcing parts are arranged along the axial direction of the pull rod, the first reinforcing parts and the second reinforcing parts are staggered along the circumferential direction of the pull rod, and the width H1 of the first reinforcing parts and the width H2 of the second reinforcing parts meet the requirement that H1> H2 along the circumferential direction of the pull rod. The spring pull rod disclosed by the utility model can change the stress distribution of the spring pull rod when being stressed, strengthen the structure and the tensile strength of the spring pull rod, well avoid the problem of fatigue fracture of the spring pull rod, and enable the spring module and even the whole pneumatic actuating mechanism to have longer service life and good product quality.

title_en: Rotary reversing sealing ring applied to blood separator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary reversing sealing ring applied to a blood separator, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances; in order to solve the problems that sealing rings at the butt joint positions of the cavities of the existing blood separator are poor in sealing effect and have leakage risks, the technical scheme is provided that the sealing rings comprise a cover body, the cover body is clamped on the inner wall of the blood separator, a first pair of interfaces is arranged at the top of the cover body, a first sealing piece is arranged in the first pair of interfaces, a second pair of interfaces is arranged at the bottom of the cover body, a second sealing piece is arranged in the second pair of interfaces, the first pair of interfaces and the second pair of interfaces are communicated through eccentric through holes, and the first pair of interfaces and the second pair of interfaces are respectively communicated with two cavities of the blood separator in a butt joint mode. The utility model not only simplifies the die and reduces the cost, but also obviously improves the sealing performance and the application range of the equipment, and brings brand new solutions and broad market prospects for the medical equipment manufacturing industry.

title_en: Liquid nitrogen filling device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a liquid nitrogen filling device, and belongs to the technical field of gas processing. According to the utility model, the overturning shielding piece is arranged on the support frame and is positioned at the filling station, one side of the overturning shielding piece is hinged to the support frame, the first quick lock assembly is arranged between the other side of the overturning shielding piece and the support frame, and the overturning shielding piece is provided with the containing opening and the pipeline avoiding opening, so that the covering and opening of the filling station can be realized through overturning of the overturning shielding piece, the filling joint connected with the air tap of the liquid nitrogen cylinder to be filled is contained through the containing opening in the covering process, the air pipe on the filling joint passes through the pipeline avoiding opening conveniently, and a blocking structure is formed between the filling joint and the filling personnel, so that the safety risk caused by accidental falling of the filling joint due to the fact that the filling joint is not installed in place or structural fatigue fracture occurs after long-time use is avoided.

title_en: Insulator three-dimensional model scanning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an insulator three-dimensional model scanning device, which belongs to the field of digital detection of high-voltage insulation equipment and comprises a bottom support plate, a servo mechanism, a high-precision pitch angle regulating mechanism, a 2D industrial camera, a high-precision rotary table, a locking mechanism and an insulator clamp, wherein the servo mechanism is arranged on the left side of the bottom support plate, the high-precision rotary table is arranged on the right side of the bottom support plate, the high-precision pitch angle regulating mechanism is arranged on the servo mechanism, the 2D industrial camera is arranged on the lower part of the high-precision pitch angle regulating mechanism, the locking mechanism is arranged on the high-precision rotary table, the insulator clamp is specifically arranged at the using position of the high-precision rotary table, the high-precision three-dimensional scanning of an insulator is realized through the high-precision pitch angle regulating mechanism and the high-precision rotary table, and the problems that the three-dimensional scanning precision is insufficient, dead-angle scanning cannot be performed on the insulator, the traditional scanning angle optimizing method is single and the adaptability of the clamp system is poor are solved.

title_en: Power line clamp with improved structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of line cards and discloses a power line card with an improved structure, which comprises a first clamping seat, wherein a second clamping seat is arranged on the right side of the first clamping seat, a first fixing plate is fixedly connected to the right side of the first clamping seat, a second fixing plate is fixedly connected to the right side of the second clamping seat, a rotating shaft is movably connected between the first fixing plate and the second fixing plate, when only one power line is used, the first clamping seat and the second clamping seat are overlapped through the rotating shaft, and the power lines are placed in the first clamping seat and the second clamping seat through opening a first baffle plate and a second baffle plate, so that the power lines are fixed more stably.

title_en: Improved hexagonal expansion bolt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of expansion bolts, in particular to an improved hexagonal expansion bolt. The bolt comprises a bolt body, cone blocks, sleeves and a reset frame, wherein the bolt body is sleeved with the sleeves, grooves are formed in the sleeves, the cone blocks are mounted on the bolt body, connecting holes are formed in the bolt body, mounting blocks are mounted on the cone blocks, screw rods are welded on the mounting blocks, mounting grooves are formed in the reset frame, end covers are sleeved on the bolt body, mounting plates are mounted at two ends of the inner wall of each end cover through extrusion springs, limiting frames are mounted on the inner wall of each mounting plate, the reset frame is sleeved on the screw rods through the corresponding mounting grooves, limiting nuts are mounted on the screw rods through threads, and the screw rods are limited in the corresponding mounting grooves through the corresponding limiting nuts. The utility model satisfies the requirement of using the expansion bolt, can reset the expansion part after use, is convenient to take down, and can carry out secondary limiting to avoid loosening and falling.

title_en: Corrugated metal hose lined with flexible guide sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corrugated metal hose lined with a flexible guide sleeve, and particularly relates to the technical field of metal hoses. The corrugated metal hose comprises a corrugated pipe and a winding pipe lining, wherein the winding pipe lining is arranged in the corrugated pipe to be used as a lining, and two ends of the winding pipe lining are fixed at two ends of the corrugated pipe. The utility model can be used in high-temperature medium occasions, not only maintains the flexibility of the corrugated metal hose, but also has smaller pressure on medium loss, and simultaneously solves the problems that the traditional metal hose is easy to fall off under the condition of higher medium flow rate, causes damage to equipment, is not high-temperature resistant, causes pressure loss and the like.

title_en: Detachable anchor bolt structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detachable anchor bolt structure which comprises an embedded pipe, wherein the bottom of the outer wall of a connecting anchor bolt is in threaded sleeve joint with the embedded pipe, a locking nut is in threaded connection with the outside of the connecting anchor bolt, a protection assembly is arranged outside the connecting anchor bolt and the embedded pipe, a bottom plate is positioned between the embedded pipe and the locking nut, a protection shell is symmetrically arranged at the top of the bottom plate, the locking assembly is arranged in the protection shell, the protection shell is clamped at the top of the bottom plate through the locking assembly, a limiting assembly is arranged in the protection shell, and the limiting assembly is used for clamping and limiting the locking nut. According to the utility model, the embedded pipe, the connecting anchor rod, the locking nut and the protection assembly are matched, and the protection shell can be stably arranged on the bottom plate under the action of the locking assembly, so that the joint of the embedded pipe, the connecting anchor rod and the locking nut is shielded and protected, and the stability of the installation of the locking nut can be ensured under the action of the limiting assembly.

title_en: Breather valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a breather valve, which comprises a valve body and a flange arranged at the bottom, wherein a clamp for clamping is arranged between the valve body and the flange, the bottom of the valve body is integrally connected with a support boss, one side of the flange is provided with a fixing boss corresponding to the support boss in an extending manner, a sealing assembly is clamped between the support boss and the fixing boss, the sealing assembly comprises a sealing ring, one side of the sealing ring, facing the support boss, is in a cylindrical shape and protrudes, and the sealing ring, facing one side of the fixing boss, is in an inclined state.

title_en: Breather valve
abstract_en: The application provides a breather valve. The breather valve comprises a valve body, a valve cover, a valve rod, a valve membrane, a pilot valve, a three-way pipe, a valve seat, a valve rod, a valve diaphragm, a three-way pipe, a valve seat and a valve rod, wherein the valve body is provided with an air inlet, the valve cover is arranged in the valve body and divides the interior of the valve body into an upper cavity and a lower cavity, the lower cavity is communicated with the air inlet, the valve rod is arranged in the valve body and is in sliding fit with the valve cover, the valve rod is arranged at the bottom of the valve rod and is positioned in the lower cavity and can seal the communicating part of the lower cavity and the air inlet, the membrane is arranged on the valve rod and is positioned in the upper cavity, the pilot valve is arranged on the valve body and is connected with the valve rod, the three-way pipe is provided with a first interface, a second interface and a third interface, the first interface is connected with the valve body, the connecting position of the first interface and the valve body is positioned between the valve rod and the opening of the air inlet, and the second interface is connected with the pilot valve. The working state of the breather valve is detected online through an external air source, detection is more convenient and quick, and meanwhile, the breather valve is safer compared with the breather valve which uses a storage tank for air intake and exhaust.

title_en: Water conservancy and hydropower engineering pipe burying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, and discloses a hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering pipe burying device, which comprises a supporting platform, wherein a first driving rod is movably connected inside a first driving box, a first threaded rod is fixedly connected inside the first driving rod, a first threaded block is connected with the outer surface of the first threaded rod in a threaded manner, a first sliding block is fixedly connected with the bottom of the first threaded block, a sliding clamping block is connected inside a sliding groove in a sliding manner, and a second driving box is fixedly connected with the bottom of the sliding clamping block. According to the utility model, the two first thread blocks drive the lower second driving box to move to the proper positions towards the opposite sides respectively by rotating the rotating handle according to the length of the pipe, so that the effect of adapting to different pipe lengths is achieved.

title_en: Compact connecting cabin for hydrogen energy converter and power calculation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy conversion and discloses a compact connecting cabin of a hydrogen energy converter and power calculation equipment, which comprises a connecting piece A and a connecting piece B, wherein a first mounting plate is clamped on the left side of the inner side wall of the connecting piece A, a connecting assembly is arranged on the right side of the middle of the first mounting plate, the connecting assembly comprises a first fixing seat, the first fixing seat is fixedly connected to the right side of the middle of the first mounting plate, a slide rod I is slidably connected to the middle of the first fixing seat, and a thimble I is fixedly connected to one end, far away from the first fixing seat, of the slide rod I. According to the utility model, the side wall of the connecting piece A is provided with the plurality of uniformly distributed positioning steel balls, and the connecting piece B is provided with the positioning groove, so that when the connecting piece B slides into the connecting piece A, the thimble I and the thimble II can prop against each other and slide towards the rear end, and meanwhile, the positioning steel balls can slide into the positioning groove, thereby realizing the quick connection of the connecting piece A and the connecting piece B.

title_en: Far-image reading and writing table
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a far-image reading and writing table, which comprises an objective lens shell, an eyepiece and an objective lens, wherein the objective lens shell is connected with the eyepiece shell through a damping rotating shaft, folding and unfolding of the objective lens shell and the eyepiece shell are realized, a supporting piece is arranged between the objective lens shell and the eyepiece shell and comprises a first hinge plate, a second hinge plate, a rotating shaft and a torsion spring, the first hinge plate and the second hinge plate are respectively fixedly connected with the objective lens shell and the eyepiece shell, the first hinge plate and the second hinge plate are connected through the rotating shaft, the torsion spring penetrates through the rotating shaft, and when the reading and writing table is opened and closed, the torsion spring provides an elastic force supporting force to facilitate opening of the eyepiece shell, flexible unfolding and closing are realized through a folding structure, the opening and closing angle can be limited, the structural stability is ensured, and the reading experience of a user is effectively improved, particularly in the aspects of increasing the reading distance and reducing the eye fatigue, and the production cost is reduced through a simple structural design.

title_en: Air valve and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an air valve and electronic equipment. The air valve comprises a shell, an electromagnetic assembly, a movable piece, a conductive piece and an electric connector. The casing is equipped with the venthole, and electromagnetic assembly includes core and coil, and the core forms the chamber of holding with the casing lock, and the core is including inlet port and the installation cavity that the interval set up, and inlet port and venthole interval set up, and the coil is around locating the installation cavity. The movable piece is located in the accommodating cavity and located between the air outlet hole and the air inlet hole. The electric connector is located outside the shell, the electric connector is used for supplying power to the coil, and the electric connector is used for supplying power to the coil. The electromagnetic assembly is used for driving the movable piece to approach and close the air inlet hole when the coil is electrified, and the air inlet hole is disconnected from the air outlet hole. When the coil is de-energized, the movable piece is far away from the air inlet hole, the air inlet hole is communicated with the air outlet hole. The coil of the air valve is connected with the circuit board simply, and the air valve is convenient to assemble.

title_en: Self-lubricating composite shaft sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-lubricating composite shaft sleeve, and belongs to the technical field of shaft sleeves. A self-lubricating composite shaft sleeve comprises a copper sleeve, a split type outer sleeve structure and springs, wherein a plurality of through holes are formed in the copper sleeve, graphite columns are arranged in the through holes and can move along the axes of the through holes, the split type outer sleeve structure is sleeved on the copper sleeve and is provided with a plurality of grooves corresponding to the through holes, and the grooves are internally provided with the springs, and the split type outer sleeve structure coaxially rotates relative to the copper sleeve so that the springs correspond to the graphite columns one by one or the springs are staggered with the graphite columns. The utility model has the advantage of prolonging the service life.

title_en: Compensator for directly buried steam heat-insulating pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a direct-buried steam insulating pipe compensator, which relates to the technical field of insulating pipe compensators and solves the problem of lower installation efficiency of a plurality of groups of screws, and comprises a compensator body and an insulating pipe body, wherein the left side and the right side of the compensator body are fixedly connected with a first flange plate, one side of the insulating pipe body is fixedly connected with a second flange plate, the surface of the first flange plate is provided with an installation positioning mechanism, the outer surface of the compensator body is provided with an outer protective layer, according to the utility model, the first flange plate and the second flange plate are arranged, so that the compensator body and the heat-insulating pipe body can be conveniently connected, and the vertical plate, the threaded rod, the rotating handle, the threaded sleeve, the clamping plate and the clamping groove are arranged, so that the first flange plate and the second flange plate can be conveniently limited and fixed, and the compensator body and the heat-insulating pipe body are further installed and fixed.

title_en: Novel stop valve with flow regulating structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of valves and discloses a novel stop valve with a flow regulating structure, which comprises a valve body, wherein a support column is fixedly connected inside the valve body, a first hydrophobic plate is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the support column, a support sleeve is rotatably connected with the outer wall of the support column, a second hydrophobic plate is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the support sleeve, a support shell is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the valve body, an air cylinder is fixedly connected inside the support shell, a fixed plate is fixedly connected with the output end of the air cylinder, a connecting frame is fixedly connected inside the fixed plate, a sliding block is rotatably connected inside the connecting frame, and a limiting frame is slidably connected with the outer wall of the sliding block. According to the utility model, the air cylinder drives the fixed plate to rotate, and the supporting sleeve, the connecting frame, the sliding block and the limiting frame are mutually matched, so that the supporting sleeve rotates and drives the second hydrophobic plate to rotate, the second hydrophobic plate can adjust the angle, and the device is suitable for the requirements of different flow rates and is simple and convenient to use.

title_en: Servo valve
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of valves, and provides a servo valve which comprises a valve body, wherein a valve seat, a first water inlet and a second water inlet and outlet are arranged on the valve body, a servo motor is arranged on the valve seat, a communication port is arranged between the first water inlet and outlet and the second water inlet and outlet, a valve rod is arranged at the output end of the servo motor, the servo motor can drive the valve rod to move between a first position and a second position, a flow blocking part is arranged on the valve rod, when the valve rod is in the first position, the flow blocking part is closest to the communication port, the opening of the communication port is minimum, when the valve rod is in the second position, the flow blocking part is farthest from the communication port, and the opening of the communication port is maximum. According to the servo valve, the servo motor is used for controlling the movement of the valve rod, so that the fluid flow flowing through the communication port in the valve body can be adjusted more flexibly.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant steel pipe with heat preservation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of anti-corrosion steel pipes and discloses an anti-corrosion steel pipe with a heat-insulation structure. Compared with the prior art, the anti-corrosion steel pipe with the heat preservation structure has the advantages that the anti-corrosion assembly and the heat preservation assembly are used for conveniently carrying out anti-corrosion heat preservation protection on the steel pipe body, the service life of the steel pipe body is prolonged, the detachable assembly is used for conveniently detaching and replacing the heat preservation layer structure which is damaged locally, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the whole replacement is not needed.

title_en: Novel vacuum insulation panel
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel vacuum insulation panel which comprises a core material and a barrier film, wherein the core material is wrapped in the barrier film, the core material is a polyurethane foam board, the thickness of the core material is 5-100mm, the barrier film is an aluminum film barrier film or an EV film, and the thickness of the film is 15-120 mu m. The novel vacuum insulation panel discards pure glass fiber or fumed silica used throughout the year, effectively reduces the density of the product, and realizes light weight and stable performance.

title_en: Adsorbable display device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adsorbable display device, which relates to the technical field of household appliances and comprises a base, a display panel and an adsorption component, wherein the display panel is arranged on the base and protrudes from the top surface of the base, the height of the display panel protruding from the base is larger than that of the base, the adsorption component is arranged on the base and used for adsorbing an external support, and the adsorption component is configured so that the suction force of the adsorption component to the external support is larger than the separation force of the base to the external support under the action of the gravity of the display panel and the base. The adsorbable display device has the advantages of being more flexible in placement position, more stable in placement and the like.

title_en: Adjustable bearing spacer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable bearing spacer, which belongs to the technical field of petroleum drilling and production and comprises an inner spacer and an outer spacer, wherein a circular boss is coaxially connected to the inner spacer, an external thread is arranged on the outer wall of the circular boss, an annular groove is arranged on the outer surface of the lower part of the circular boss, holes which are distributed at intervals are arranged on the annular groove, the outer spacer is of an annular structure, an inner hole is arranged at one end of the outer spacer, an inner thread is arranged on the inner wall of the inner hole, and the circular boss is connected in the inner hole through the external thread and the inner thread. The inner spacer ring and the outer spacer ring can form the adjustable bearing spacer ring through the pins, so that the length of the adjustable bearing spacer ring can be adjusted in the application range, different installation requirements are met, meanwhile, the connection strength is ensured, the structural design is concise, and the adjustable bearing spacer ring is convenient to install, detach and adjust and convenient to maintain in the later period.

title_en: Three-dimensional laser scanning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-dimensional laser scanning device, which belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional laser scanning devices, and adopts the technical scheme that the three-dimensional laser scanning device comprises a scanning structure, wherein a bracket is arranged at the bottom of the scanning structure, an adjusting bracket is bolted to the bottom of the bracket, the inner wall of the adjusting bracket is rotationally connected with a supporting structure, the inner wall of the adjusting bracket is movably connected with a knob, the surface of the knob is in threaded connection with the inner wall of the supporting structure, and a fixing frame is bolted to the left side and the right side of the scanning structure.

title_en: BIM-based pipeline support structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a BIM-based pipeline support structure, which comprises a U-shaped support, wherein the top of the U-shaped support is fixedly provided with a mounting plate, screws are screwed on the mounting plate, a plurality of sliding blocks are connected to the U-shaped support in a sliding manner, each sliding block is sleeved on the U-shaped support, a first locking bolt is screwed on each sliding block, two clamping plates which are oppositely arranged are connected to each sliding block in a sliding manner through a positioning plate, the positioning plates are fixed on the top surfaces of the sliding blocks, and an adjusting assembly is arranged at the bottom of each positioning plate.

title_en: Magnetic contact arm fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a magnetic contact arm fixing device, which belongs to the technical field of contact arm fixing devices and comprises a lantern ring and a swivel, wherein the lantern ring and the swivel are arranged on a contact arm, the inner wall of the swivel is rotationally connected with the lantern ring, the outer wall of the lantern ring is provided with an extrusion fixing mechanism, the inner wall of the swivel is provided with a magnetic attraction fixing mechanism, the side end of the lantern ring is hinged with a supporting plate, the upper part of the side end of the supporting plate is fixedly provided with a gasket, the extrusion fixing mechanism comprises a rebound groove arranged on the inner wall of the swivel, the outer wall of the lantern ring is provided with a sliding groove, and the swivel is slidably connected with an arc chuck through the rebound groove. Through placing the lantern ring between touching the arm and touching arm installation base, rotate the swivel and make extrusion fixed establishment receive the constraint and fix both through the extrusion is diversified, can realize quick fixed operation, and rethread magnetism is inhaled fixed establishment and is avoided because the swivel rotates because of factors such as vibrations and makes extrusion fixed establishment lose effect.

title_en: Police audio and video acquisition device with hidden mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of audio and video acquisition devices and discloses an audio and video acquisition device with a hidden mounting structure, which comprises a protective casing, wherein the bottom of the protective casing is fixedly connected with a sleeve, the inner wall of the sleeve is fixedly connected with a lug, the inside of the sleeve is provided with a mounting base, the top of the mounting base is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the top of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a chuck, the inside of the chuck is provided with a fastening bolt, the surface of the chuck is provided with a groove, an inner chute is arranged between the mounting base and the chuck, the inside of the lug is provided with a limiting mechanism, the top of the protective casing is provided with a high-definition camera, and the top of the protective casing is provided with a microphone. According to the utility model, the mounting structure is hidden in the sleeve, so that the mounting structure is not easy to be perceived, the authenticity and reliability of the acquired evidence are improved, and the smooth development of police service work is facilitated.

title_en: Spherical spring washer structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spring washers and discloses a spherical spring washer structure, which comprises a washer main body, wherein a bottom pad is arranged at the bottom end of the washer main body, the washer main body is integrally connected with the bottom pad, the top end surface of the washer main body is spherical, the bottom end surface of the bottom pad is of a planar structure, the specification sizes of the bottom end outer surface of the washer main body and the top end outer surface of the bottom pad are the same, one sides of the washer main body and the bottom pad are provided with fractures with the same size, the washer main body and the bottom pad are made of carbon steel, and the top end outer surface of the washer main body is provided with a rust-proof layer. Through packing ring main part and bottom pad, increased the thickness of packing ring to the packing ring main part atress face is spherical, can effectively slow down the impact that the packing ring main part received, non-deformable has increased gasket result of use and life, and the bottom of bottom pad is embedded with the cushion, can effectively fill the space when the bolt is installed, increases the effect of buffering simultaneously.

title_en: Wear-resistant spring damper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of shock absorbers and discloses a wear-resistant spring shock absorber which comprises a cylinder barrel, wherein a piston is slidably arranged in the cylinder barrel, a piston rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the piston, the top end of the piston rod penetrates through the top of the cylinder barrel and extends upwards, a spring is sleeved on the surface of the piston rod, a mounting shell is fixedly connected to the surface of the cylinder barrel, a silica gel heat conducting pad and a heat conducting pipe are arranged in the mounting shell, the silica gel heat conducting pad is sleeved on the surface of the cylinder barrel, an electric heating wire is arranged on the silica gel heat conducting pad, a heat exchange component is arranged on the surface of the mounting shell, and a temperature sensor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the cylinder barrel. The utility model can adaptively adjust the temperature of the cylinder barrel, reduce the viscosity of damping oil in the cylinder barrel through temperature rise when the temperature is low, recover fluidity, and increase the wear resistance and the damping performance of the shock absorber through temperature reduction when the temperature is high.

title_en: Pneumatic cleaning valve and pneumatic cleaning system for storage bin
abstract_en: The pneumatic cleaning valve comprises a valve body with a gas channel inside, a valve rod penetrating through the valve body in the longitudinal direction and a reset spring arranged in the valve body, wherein one end of the valve body is a gas inlet, the other end of the valve body is a gas outlet, one end of the valve rod, which faces the gas outlet, extends outwards to form a blocking head, the blocking head is provided with a blocking part for blocking the gas outlet and a connecting part which is used for connecting the blocking part with the valve rod and is a conical surface, the reset spring is connected with the valve rod, the pipe diameter of the gas channel in the valve body is gradually reduced from the gas inlet to the gas outlet, and the outer circumferential surface of the blocking part outside the gas outlet is rounded. The pneumatic cleaning system comprises a compressor and a plurality of pulse valves, wherein the compressor is connected with the pulse valves one by one through a connecting pipeline, one of the pulse valves is communicated with the pneumatic cleaning valve, and the pneumatic cleaning valves are installed at conical sections of the storage bin at intervals. The utility model can spray and blow out along the axial direction of 360 degrees and reduce the air consumption.

title_en: Intelligent water-saving tap
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of electronic faucets, in particular to an intelligent water-saving faucet which comprises a faucet body, a water outlet pipe, a filter plate, a cleaning mechanism and a mounting mechanism, wherein the water outlet pipe, the filter plate, the cleaning mechanism and the mounting mechanism are arranged at the end part of the faucet body, the filter plate is arranged at the bottom of the water outlet pipe, the cleaning mechanism is arranged at the inner side of a water outlet blowing pipe, and the mounting mechanism is arranged at the top of the filter plate. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the cleaning mechanism, the motor drives the scraping rod to rotate, the scraping rod scrapes sundries, and sundries which are difficult to clean can be extruded upwards, so that the liquid storage box is opened to spray the cleaning agent, the cleaning agent is smeared on the scale by the cleaning brush to clean the scale, so that the scale is removed, most of dirt and scale on the surface of the filter screen can be physically removed by the scraping rod, and the parts which are difficult to scrape can be cleaned in a deeper level by spraying the cleaning agent, so that each fine part of the filter screen can be thoroughly cleaned, the blockage and abrasion of the filter screen caused by dirt accumulation can be effectively reduced, and the service life of the filter screen can be prolonged.

title_en: Eliminate oil tank of lubricating oil foam
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lubricating oil foam elimination, and particularly discloses an oil tank for eliminating lubricating oil foam, which comprises a tank body, wherein an oil return port is formed in the upper part of the tank body, an oil suction port is formed in the lower part of the tank body, a foam removing filter cylinder is arranged at the outlet of the oil return port, and the tank body is cylindrical; the oil suction port is positioned at the other side of the box body far away from the oil return port; the foam removing filter cylinder is internally provided with a detachable filter screen, the inner side wall of the box body is fixedly provided with a spiral oil groove, the inner side wall of the box body is fixedly provided with a foam remover positioned on the path of the spiral oil groove, the foam remover is of a bent plate-shaped structure, the horizontal section of the bending surface of the foam remover is a trapezoid plate, one side far away from the inner side wall of the box body is converged, and the side wall of the foam remover is provided with foam removing holes. The utility model ensures that the lubricating oil has sufficient residence time in the oil tank, eliminates bubbles residing in the lubricating oil, avoids the failure of lubricating equipment caused by the performance reduction of the lubricating oil, improves the running stability of the equipment and prolongs the service life of the equipment.

title_en: Pipeline bracket for building construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline bracket for building construction, which relates to the technical field of building construction and aims at solving the problems that the pipeline bracket under unified assembly is not easy to be suitable for pipelines with different diameters and the supporting height of the pipelines is not easy to be flexibly adjusted according to construction environments; according to the utility model, the movable blocks are pulled to move by the rotating disc through the arc-shaped swing rods by rotating the driving screw rod, the plurality of movable blocks simultaneously drive the plurality of clamping rods to clamp and fix the pipeline positioned in the hollow part, and the lifting screw rod is driven by the rotating threaded sleeve to move the fixing seat upwards, so that the supporting height of the pipeline is adjusted, and the problems that the pipeline support under unified assembly is not easy to be suitable for pipelines with different diameters and flexible adjustment of the supporting height of the pipeline is difficult to be carried out according to construction environments are effectively avoided.

title_en: Gate valve seal structure of preventing leaking
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sealing structure, in particular to a leakage-proof gate valve sealing structure. The technical scheme includes that the anti-leakage gate valve sealing structure comprises a valve body, valve seat rings, gate plates, sealing sheets, valve rods and the like, wherein the valve body is internally communicated left and right, a cylindrical cavity structure is arranged at the upper part of the valve body, the valve seat rings are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the inner wall of the valve body, the gate plates are connected between the two valve seat rings in a sliding mode, the sealing sheets are fixedly connected to the two side walls of the gate plates in an embedded mode, the two side walls of the gate plates and the sealing sheets are kept in close contact with the side faces of the valve seat rings, the gate plates are located in the valve body, and the valve rods are fixedly connected to the top of the gate plates. According to the utility model, the inner wall of the base is provided with the honeycomb holes, the surface modification treatment is carried out on the inner surface of the base, a pit structure of 5-20 mu m is formed on the inner surface of the base, and meanwhile, the laser texturing treatment is carried out on the surface of the honeycomb holes, so that impurities are more easily attached to the top of the base and the inside of the honeycomb holes, and the effect of effectively adsorbing the impurities is achieved.

title_en: High-pressure ball valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-pressure ball valve which comprises a valve body, wherein a valve core is rotatably connected inside the valve body, a valve rod is rotatably connected inside the valve body, the bottom end of the valve rod is fixedly connected with the outer side wall of the valve core, a rotating hand is fixedly arranged at the top of the valve core, a sealing mechanism is arranged inside the valve core, and the sealing mechanism comprises two sealing rings. This high pressure ball valve, when closing the valve, rotate the case, the case is brought ejector pin, solid fixed ring and is rotated the slope piece, rotates the slope piece and offsets with solid fixed slope piece and make and rotate the slope piece and upwards move, rotates the slope piece and is brought gu fixed ring and ejector pin and upwards move, ejector pin extrusion connecting rod, connecting rod promote movable rod and clamping ring removal, make the clamping ring insert the inside in extrusion groove like this and make the sealing washer outwards expand, can increase the leakproofness when the valve is closed like this.

title_en: Water hammer preventing structure of water inlet valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water hammer preventing structure of a water inlet valve, which comprises a water inlet pipeline and a flow restrictor arranged in the water inlet pipeline, wherein the flow restrictor comprises a body, the body is provided with a plurality of flow restricting holes, the flow direction of water in the water inlet pipeline after a water stopping rubber cushion opens the water inlet pipeline is defined as a water supplementing direction, the water hammer preventing structure also comprises a buffer part arranged in the water inlet pipeline, the flow restrictor is positioned at the upstream of the buffer part in the water supplementing direction, the buffer part is of a conical tubular structure, the direction of a small end is consistent with the water supplementing direction, an open opening is formed at a large end, and a plurality of flow dividing holes are uniformly arranged on the side wall at intervals along the circumferential direction. After the backflow water passes through the diversion holes, a plurality of diversion water flows are formed, the diversion water collides with each other to consume energy, and then the restrictor is used for resisting and consuming energy on the backflow water, so that the energy of the backflow water is obviously reduced, the pressure in the pipeline is obviously reduced, and the occurrence of a water hammer effect is effectively prevented.

title_en: Can accurate control low pressure's overflow valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overflow valve capable of accurately controlling low pressure, and relates to the technical field of valves, comprising an oil cylinder, an air cylinder and an air pressure control device, wherein an oil piston is arranged in the oil cylinder in a sliding manner, the oil cylinder is divided into a first rod cavity and a first rodless cavity by the oil piston, an oil inlet is formed in the inner wall of the first rodless cavity far away from the oil piston, and an oil outlet is formed in the peripheral wall of the first rodless cavity; the cylinder is internally provided with an air piston in a sliding manner, the cylinder is divided into a second rod cavity and a second rodless cavity by the air piston, the air piston is connected with the oil piston through a piston rod, the air pressure control device is connected with the second rod cavity and the second rodless cavity and is connected with a compressed air source, and the air pressure control device is used for controlling air pressure in the second rod cavity and the second rodless cavity. The hydraulic oil pressure control device can accurately control the pressure of hydraulic oil in the oil cylinder.

title_en: Combined water collecting shell of faucet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of faucet water collecting shells and discloses a combined faucet water collecting shell which comprises a bottom pipe, wherein a filter pipe is connected to the top surface of the bottom pipe in a threaded manner, and a cavity is formed in the filter pipe. This combination formula tap catchment casing, when tap will spray water and use, because the inside of running water is doped with the impurity, in order to increase the quality of running water, so installed the filter tube at the top of tap bottom tube, because the internally mounted of filter tube has the filter vat, the running water passes through the filter screen of filter vat bottom, filter great impurity, afterwards the running water continues upwards transmission, carry out the filtration of deep with the running water through ceramic filter core and active carbon filter layer, improve the quality of tap water, the effect of impurity in the filtration running water has been played, avoided unable filtration, make the running water middle part impurity that uses too much, the health and safety that can influence outside personnel, the practicality of device has also been increased.

title_en: Double-seal high-temperature rotary compensator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-seal high-temperature rotary compensator, which belongs to the field of pipeline connection and compensation and comprises a rotary inner pipe, wherein a shell is arranged on the right side of the rotary inner pipe, a filler flange is arranged outside the rotary inner pipe, a plurality of fastener assemblies are connected with circumferential threads of the filler flange, the fastener assemblies are connected with the shell in a threaded manner, an auxiliary piece is arranged inside the shell, and a connecting device is arranged on one side, far away from the filler flange, of the rotary inner pipe and the shell. According to the utility model, the rotary inner pipe and the shell are arranged, the packing flange is arranged between the rotary inner pipe and the shell, the auxiliary piece is arranged in the shell, the rotary inner pipe can rotate and displace in the shell through the mutual matching of the packing flange and the auxiliary piece, the displacement of the pipeline caused by expansion and contraction due to heat and contraction, vibration or installation errors at high temperature is compensated, the compensator is conveniently connected with the pipeline through the connecting device, the connecting device also has a compensation effect, the compensation pressure of the compensator is reduced, and the compensation effect is better.

title_en: Guide pin for brake calipers
abstract_en: The utility model provides a guide pin for a brake caliper, and belongs to the technical field of brake calipers. It has solved the inconvenient problem of current guide pin maintenance. The guide pin for the brake caliper comprises a caliper body, a brake block and a support, wherein guide pins are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the support, a first mounting hole for mounting the guide pins is formed in the support, the guide pins are composed of floating pins and fixed pins, a second mounting hole for mounting the fixed pins is formed in the floating pins, a connecting hole for the fixed pins to penetrate through is formed in the caliper body, a clamping mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the second mounting hole, a first movable space for the clamping mechanism to move is formed in the floating pins, the clamping mechanism comprises a clamping block and a clamping spring, a clamping part matched with the clamping block is arranged at the front end of the fixed pins, and an unlocking piece is movably arranged between the fixed pins and the connecting hole. The utility model has the advantage of convenient maintenance.

title_en: Water conservancy pipeline strutting arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic pipeline supporting device, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and comprises a positioning frame, wherein a base is arranged right above the positioning frame, and a top seat is arranged right above the base. The supporting component is arranged between the footstock and the locating rack, the supporting component comprises a traction rod fixedly connected to the bottom end of the footstock, the top surface of the base is fixedly connected with a supply moving pipe, the traction rod is in sliding connection with the supply moving pipe, the inner wall of the supply moving pipe is fixedly connected with a spring, the device can utilize the upward traction footstock to enable the traction rod to follow upward movement, the spring is extruded to shrink, the pipeline is placed on the base, and then the traction of the footstock is loosened, so that the spring is rebounded, the traction footstock is buckled to the base, and the pipeline is further fixed rapidly, so that the pipeline fixing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Storage tank wall thickness detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of storage tank detection, in particular to a storage tank wall thickness detection device which comprises a connecting block, wherein two clamping blocks are arranged on the connecting block, a rotating assembly is arranged on the top surface of each clamping block, a sliding block is fixedly arranged on one clamping block, a sliding rail is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the connecting block, a detection assembly is connected onto the sliding rail in a sliding manner, the detection assembly comprises a moving block, the lower end of the moving block is respectively connected with the outer wall of the sliding rail and the top surface of the connecting block in a sliding manner, a pushing block is connected onto the upper end of the moving block in a sliding manner, a supporting block is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the pushing block, a rotating shaft is connected onto the upper end of the supporting block in a rotating manner, a rotating block is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft, and an ultrasonic thickness gauge body is arranged on the outer wall of one side of the rotating block. Through ultrasonic thickness gauge body transmission and receipt ultrasonic signal, the wall thickness of measurement storage tank has avoided rocking and the error that handheld operation brought, has improved detection precision, and rotating assembly and detection assembly have adapted to the storage tank wall thickness detection demand of different height and angle, have improved detection efficiency.

title_en: Hydraulic system heat abstractor of hydraulic press
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heat dissipation of hydraulic presses, and discloses a hydraulic system heat dissipation device of a hydraulic press. In the use process of the hydraulic system heat dissipation device of the hydraulic machine, the pump can be started to utilize the oil pumping pipe to pump out hydraulic oil from the inside of the hydraulic oil tank to the inside of the heat dissipation pipe after the hydraulic oil tank is used, heat is absorbed and led out of the heat inside the hydraulic oil through the heat dissipation pipe and the heat dissipation fins outside, meanwhile, the fan can be started to blow the heat dissipation pipe and the heat dissipation fins to accelerate the heat dissipation efficiency, in the heat dissipation treatment process, the front end of the fan inside the air inlet cover is inserted and connected with the filter screen, the filter screen can be utilized to carry out auxiliary filtration and removal and purification on irregular large-volume flocked sundries and the like contained in the externally pumped air, dust sundries entering the inside of the device in the heat dissipation process are reduced, the inside of the device is assisted and the problem of being inconvenient to assist and dustproof the inside the heat dissipation device is solved.

title_en: Gas circuit structure for accelerating response speed of analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas circuit structure for accelerating response speed of an analyzer, which comprises a gas circuit pipe, wherein a throttle valve is connected to the inner side of a bypass pipe in a sliding manner, a filter, a sucking pump, a needle valve, a flowmeter and a sensor are respectively arranged on the inner side of the gas circuit pipe, and a second dismantling seat is fixedly connected to one side of the filter, the sucking pump, the needle valve, the flowmeter and the sensor. Through the structure, the gas circuit pipe both sides are provided with intake pipe and outlet duct respectively, the inboard laminating of bypass pipe is provided with the choke valve, the gas circuit pipe inboard is provided with filter and aspiration pump respectively in intake pipe one end, the gas circuit pipe inboard is provided with needle valve respectively in outlet duct one end, the flowmeter, the sensor, filter and aspiration pump, needle valve, the flowmeter, the second of all fixedly connected with of sensor one side demolishs the seat, symmetrical threaded connection has the third bolt on the seat is demolishd to the second, make it be convenient for carry out the dismouting to gas circuit pipe inner structure, and realize can accelerate the response speed of analysis appearance.

title_en: Adjustable transmission mechanism and straightener
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of straightening equipment, in particular to an adjustable transmission mechanism and a straightening machine, wherein the adjustable transmission mechanism comprises a first rotating member, a mounting assembly, an adjusting assembly and a switching assembly, wherein the mounting assembly comprises a first vertical plate arranged on the side part of the first rotating member, a second vertical plate is arranged on one side of the first vertical plate, the adjusting assembly comprises an end seat arranged on the first vertical plate, the first rotating member is rotatably arranged on the end seat in a penetrating manner, a limiting member is arranged between the end seat and the first vertical plate, the switching assembly comprises a deformation element, the first rotating member is connected with the deformation element through the end seat, one end of the deformation element is rotatably arranged on the second vertical plate in a penetrating manner, and the straightening machine can adapt to the straightening of workpieces with different thicknesses and simultaneously can keep the common rotation of an upper roller and a lower roller instead of the rotation of the lower roller driven by the workpieces, so that the straightening effect is obviously improved.

title_en: Anti-crossing energy storage type backup power supply
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-crossing energy storage type backup power supply, which comprises an energy storage backup power supply body, wherein both sides of the top of the energy storage backup power supply body are fixedly connected with fixing blocks. According to the utility model, the linkage structure of the fixed block, the gear, the locking block and the pressure spring is adopted, when an operator needs to adjust the inclination angle of the display screen, the locking of the display screen can be released only by moving the locking block downwards, and the display screen can be easily held by hands to adjust the angle. The display screen rotates the in-process and drives the gear and rotate synchronously, after adjusting to suitable angle, unclamp the locking piece, under the elastic restoring force effect of pressure spring, the locking piece moves up and meshes with the gear again, locks the angle of display screen firmly. The design greatly meets the requirement that an operator flexibly adjusts the angle of the display screen according to different use scenes and own requirements, the convenience and the comfort of operation are obviously improved, the operation is more in accordance with the human engineering principle, and the device has the advantage of being convenient to use.

title_en: Electromagnetic pressure reducing valve for circulating water pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electromagnetic pressure reducing valve for a circulating water pipeline, which comprises a main valve, wherein the bottoms of two sides of the main valve are communicated with valve ports, one ends of the valve ports, which are far away from the main valve, are communicated with fixed pipes, one ends of the fixed pipes, which are far away from the valve ports, are sleeved with connecting sleeves A, two opposite sides of each connecting sleeve A are bolted with connecting sleeves B, movable grooves are formed in the connecting sleeves A and the connecting sleeves B, movable heads are movably sleeved in the movable grooves, one sides, which are far away from the two movable heads, of the two movable heads are communicated with each other, the tops of two sides of the main valve are provided with connecting mechanisms, the electromagnetic pressure reducing valve is not required to be integrally disassembled for replacement, and the efficiency is better.

title_en: Science popularization interactive turntable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of public entertainment and discloses a popular science interactive turntable which comprises a base assembly, a turntable assembly and a power generation sounding assembly, wherein a turntable is driven to rotate through a grip handrail structure, when the turntable rotates, a second gear is meshed with a first gear and rotates along with the turntable, a gear shaft is used as a center to rotate, and the rotation is transmitted through a belt structure, so that a main shaft of a generator synchronously rotates, the generator can generate power by converting mechanical energy of the rotation of the main shaft into electric energy and transmitting current to a player, and the player plays a stored record after being electrified, thereby realizing the playing of the popular science record through the rotation interaction of a user and the turntable, providing a practical children interactive device for old community residents, and further solving the problem that the old community in the city lacks the children interactive device.

title_en: Non-contact five-point leveling mechanism for exposure machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a non-contact five-point leveling mechanism for an exposure machine, which relates to the technical field of leveling of exposure machines, and comprises an exposure machine main body, a workbench and laser ranging sensors, wherein the five laser ranging sensors are uniformly distributed, the workbench is arranged on one side of the upper part of the exposure machine main body, an adjusting mechanism for detecting and leveling the workbench is arranged on one side of the upper part of the exposure machine main body, the adjusting mechanism comprises an installation component, a universal damping ball head support and a laser ranging sensor, wherein the installation component comprises a universal damping ball head support arranged below the fixing component.

title_en: Simple flange connection liquid-cooled tube
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simple flange connection liquid cooling pipe, which relates to the technical field of liquid cooling pipelines, and comprises a first flange and a second flange, wherein a pre-installation mechanism is connected to the first flange and the second flange and comprises an insert block and a clamping seat, the insert block is matched with the clamping seat, liquid cooling pipes are fixedly connected to the first flange and the second flange, a buckle is elastically connected to the insert block, a bayonet matched with the buckle is formed in the clamping seat, a positioning ring is arranged on the first flange, a positioning groove is formed in the second flange, the end parts of the insert block are provided with bevel edges, therefore, the width of the end parts of the insert block is smaller than the width of the opening of the clamping seat, the two buckles are slidably connected to the left end and the right end of the insert block, arc-shaped trimming edges are formed in the outer wall of the buckle, and an elastic piece is arranged in the insert block.

title_en: Sealed universal joint
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealed universal joint, and belongs to the technical field of universal joints. The device comprises a water inlet connector, a swinging connector, a sealing ring, a clamping ring and a clamping spring. The top of the water inlet joint is provided with a ball head and a water inlet through hole penetrating the ball head, the swing joint is internally provided with a water outlet through hole, and after the ball head is inserted into the water outlet through hole, the sealing is realized through a sealing ring in the sealing ring groove. The upper groove wall of the sealing ring groove extends to form an inner abutting ring, the bottom of the clamping ring abuts against the sealing ring, the top of the clamping ring limits the upward movement of the ball head through the upper abutting end face, the lower groove wall of the sealing ring groove extends to form a locking ring, the clamping spring is arranged in the inner ring hole, and the lower abutting end face of the clamping ring limits the downward movement of the ball head, so that the up-down dual dynamic seal is formed. According to the utility model, through the synergistic effect of the clamping ring and the clamping ring, the axial displacement of the ball head is effectively prevented, the tightness is improved, different pipeline systems are adapted, the structure is simple, and the installation is convenient.

title_en: Large circulation valve device of coke oven fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coke oven equipment technical field specifically is a big circulation valve device of coke oven fan, include: the rear connecting pipe is connected with the valve body, the valve body is connected with the front connecting pipe, and the front connecting pipe is provided with a filtering mechanism main body; an upper mounting groove is formed in the filtering mechanism main body; the beneficial effects are as follows: after installing the device on appointed equipment, ensure that gas flows into in the valve body through preceding connecting pipe and flows out the direction through back connecting pipe in, through preceding connecting pipe and the back connecting pipe that set up for special-shaped reducing nozzle stub, filter the gas through the filter on the filter structure main part that sets up on preceding connecting pipe on the installation frame, prevent that contaminants such as impurity in the gas from getting into in the valve body and influencing its normal work and then being difficult to carry out accurate regulation and can not reach the purpose of balanced gas collecting tube pressure and the gas collecting tube fluctuation is too big can lead to PRoven the poor phenomenon of segmentation pressure set value control carbonization chamber pressure stability during the coking of system, improve the stability of during operation.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring instrument installing support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological disasters, in particular to a mounting bracket for a geological disaster monitoring instrument.
