Including base, mounting plate, the baffle, small-size pneumatic cylinder, first screw rod, telescopic bracket and monitor body, the recess has been seted up at the base top, first through-hole has been seted up to the recess side, mounting plate sets up in the recess, the mounting plate sets up at the mounting plate top, the second through-hole has been seted up to the inside of mounting plate, the baffle is fixed to be set up in the second through-hole, two small-size pneumatic cylinders set up in the both sides of baffle, two first screw rods are fixed to be set up at small-size pneumatic cylinder's output, two first screw rods set up in first through-hole, telescopic bracket is fixed to be set up at the top of mounting plate, monitor body is fixed to be set up at telescopic bracket's top, when the support is about to be torn open in the maintenance, start small-size pneumatic cylinder, make first screw rod withdraw second through-hole, make support and base separation, efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water outlet pipe of cooler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water outlet pipe of a cooler, and particularly relates to the technical field of water outlet pipes of coolers, which comprises a water outlet pipe, wherein a filtering mechanism for filtering impurities in cooling liquid is arranged outside the water outlet pipe, a sealing mechanism for connecting one side of the water outlet pipe with a pipeline on the cooler is arranged outside the water outlet pipe, the water outlet pipe comprises a substrate layer, a corrosion-resistant layer is arranged inside the substrate layer, a reinforcing layer is arranged outside the substrate layer, a high-temperature-resistant layer is arranged outside the reinforcing layer, a wear-resistant layer is arranged outside the high-temperature-resistant layer, the sealing mechanism comprises a sealing ring arranged at one end of the water outlet pipe, two limiting plates are arranged at one end of the water outlet pipe, a placing groove is formed in each limiting plate, the placing groove is matched with the sealing ring, and threaded holes are formed in two sides of each limiting plate. According to the utility model, the pressure resistance of the water outlet pipe can be increased through the reinforcing layer, the service life of the water outlet pipe is prolonged, and the joint of the water outlet pipe and the cooler connecting pipe can be sealed through the sealing mechanism, so that liquid leakage is avoided.

title_en: Substation modeling device for point cloud data
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of image processing and computer vision, and relates to a transformer substation modeling device for point cloud data, which comprises a scanner body, wherein the top and the bottom of the scanner body are respectively provided with a mounting shell, the outer walls of the two sides of the mounting shells are respectively and movably connected with a connecting plate, the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the scanner body, a vertical pipe is arranged below the scanner body, and the side wall of the vertical pipe is fixedly connected with a mounting plate near the top.

title_en: Axle housing structure of automobile drive axle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automobile driving axle housing structure, which comprises an axle housing, wherein an expansion housing is arranged in the middle of the axle housing, a buffer mechanism is arranged on the axle housing and comprises two positioning seat sleeves and arc buffer plates, the two positioning seat sleeves are respectively sleeved on the axle housing and are close to two ends, and the two arc buffer plates are respectively positioned at the front side and the rear side of the arc buffer plates and are close to the lower positions. In the utility model, the positioning seat sleeves close to the two ends are sleeved on the bridge shell, then the arc-shaped buffer plates are arranged at the positions, close to the lower parts, of the front side and the rear side of the bridge shell, and the two ends of the arc-shaped buffer plates are respectively connected with the adjacent positioning seat sleeves in an axial elastic sliding manner, so that the front side, the rear side and the lower part of the bridge shell are in a buffer protection state, and the buffer protection comprehensive degree of the bridge shell is greatly improved.

title_en: Improved generation short pitch precision sprocket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sprockets, in particular to an improved short-pitch precise sprocket, which comprises a sprocket body, wherein a plurality of sprocket teeth are arranged on the circumferential surface of the sprocket body, a plurality of first sliding cavities in a circumferential array are formed in the sprocket body, a sealing device is arranged in each oiling hole, a second sliding cavity is communicated with the inner side of each first sliding cavity, a piston is connected with the inner wall of each first sliding cavity in a sliding manner, an operation groove is communicated with each second sliding cavity through a strip-shaped hole, a connecting rod is arranged on the upper surface of a sliding column, the connecting rod penetrates through the strip-shaped holes and is provided with an operation cap, a covering device is arranged above the operation cap, and a locking device is arranged on the surface of the connecting rod. The chain wheel is convenient to operate by injecting lubricating oil and then operating the arranged operating cap to refuel the chain wheel when the chain wheel needs to be lubricated, and meanwhile, the chain wheel is not provided with a pull rope to be used as a drive and is operated through the connecting rod and the sliding column, so that the problem that the chain wheel cannot be filled with lubricating oil is avoided.

title_en: High-stability inner sealing structure of stop valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-stability inner sealing structure of a stop valve, which is characterized in that the bottom of a reverse sealing thread sleeve is provided with a limiting surface and a sealing surface which is connected with a valve rod and limits the movable stroke of the valve rod and has sealing performance; according to the utility model, the sealing surface is arranged on the inverted sealing thread sleeve, when the stop valve is opened, the sealing angle on the valve rod is matched with the sealing surface, the movable stroke of the valve rod is limited, meanwhile, when the sealing angle on the valve rod contacts the sealing surface, the inverted sealing thread sleeve is extruded, so that the inverted sealing thread sleeve is extruded outwards, the sealing performance and stability of the connection between the inverted sealing thread sleeve and the valve body are improved, the friction between the valve core and the valve body in the opening and closing of the stop valve is avoided through the arrangement of the high-strength sealing ring and the high-strength sealing groove, the abrasion of the lower valve core caused by long-time friction can influence the sealing performance, and the sealing performance and stability of the stop valve are improved, so that the service life of the stop valve is prolonged.

title_en: Stop valve
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a shut-off valve. The shut-off valve of the present utility model includes a valve body, a valve stem, a connector, and a first seal. The valve body is provided with an opening and an outlet. The first end of the valve rod is arranged in the valve body. The connecting piece sets up inside the valve body, and the connecting piece is connected in the valve body, and the connecting piece is provided with the screw hole, and the valve rod is provided with first external screw thread, and the screw hole is worn to establish by the valve rod and with connecting piece spiro union. The first sealing member is arranged at the opening and is in sealing connection with the valve body, the first sealing member is provided with an inlet, and the valve rod can be close to or far away from the first sealing member, so that the valve rod can be communicated with or separate from the inlet and the outlet. The stop valve is simple in structure, low in cost and convenient to assemble.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle is with handheld support
abstract_en: The utility model provides a handheld bracket for an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a middle frame, a mounting plate, two handles, a cross rod, a handle and a mounting assembly, wherein the mounting assembly is fixedly arranged at the top of the middle frame. The utility model provides a handheld bracket for an unmanned aerial vehicle, which is characterized in that the unmanned aerial vehicle is fixed through a middle frame, a remote control is fixed through a mounting plate, the unmanned aerial vehicle is picked up through two handles matched with a cross rod and a mounting assembly, handheld shooting is carried out, meanwhile, one-hand handheld operation can be carried out through the handles, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle which can only fly originally is converted into a device form capable of being held by hand, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be conveniently and flexibly operated like a handheld camera in short distance, low height or special scenes, such as indoor shooting, close-up shooting and the like.

title_en: Traceless high-strength press riveting screw
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fastening connectors, in particular to a traceless high-strength press-riveting screw which comprises a stud and a head which are coaxially arranged, wherein the outer wall surface of the head is inclined, and in the press-in direction of the head, the outer wall surface is gradually inclined towards one side close to a central axis, so that the final embedding traceless of the press-riveting screw is realized in the press-in process, and the attractiveness is ensured. The embossing teeth are uniformly distributed on the outer wall surface of the head, so that the press riveting screw can be completely embedded, the safety can be ensured in an application scene, accidents caused by the protrusion of the screw head are avoided, the interference in space can be reduced, and the normal assembly and operation among all parts are ensured. The extrusion component is arranged between the stud and the head, so that the workpiece between the stud and the head is extruded and deformed in the embedding process of the press riveting screw, the annular concave part is embedded, the phenomenon of upward warping of the workpiece is avoided, the screw is prevented from generating axial looseness, and the connection tightness is ensured.

title_en: Water conservancy pipeline device for water conservancy engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water conservancy pipelines, in particular to a water conservancy pipeline device for water conservancy projects, which comprises a first water conservancy pipeline and a second water conservancy pipeline which are distributed from left to right, wherein a mounting groove is formed in one end, close to the second water conservancy pipeline, of the first water conservancy pipeline, and an annular mounting plate with a shape matched with the mounting groove is fixedly connected to one end, close to the first water conservancy pipeline, of the second water conservancy pipeline. According to the utility model, the positioning block is matched with the positioning groove in a clamping way, and the unlocking rod is used for controlling the disassembly, so that the pipeline can be easily separated only by pulling the unlocking rod during the later maintenance and replacement of the pipeline, the maintenance efficiency is greatly improved, the problem of difficult disassembly caused by rust and sliding of the bolt is solved, and the good maintainability and replaceability can be maintained all the time in the long-term operation process of the water conservancy pipeline, and the operation and maintenance efficiency and the sustainability of the water conservancy project are effectively ensured.

title_en: Battery box, battery and power consumption device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a battery box, a battery and an electric device. The battery box body comprises a lower box body and a plurality of connecting pieces, wherein the plurality of connecting pieces are arranged on the periphery side of the lower box body at intervals, the connecting pieces penetrate through the lower box body and are connected with the support through first fasteners in a threaded mode, and the connecting pieces are made of steel materials. The connecting piece made of steel materials can remarkably improve torque transmission efficiency, avoid torque attenuation, reduce plastic deformation and thread abrasion of the lower box body at the bolt fastening position, prolong service life, and has the advantages of simple structure, low production cost, convenience in disassembly, assembly and maintenance and low maintenance cost. By applying the battery box body, the plastic deformation and the screw abrasion of the lower box body at the bolt fastening position can be avoided, the service life of the battery is prolonged, and the maintenance and production cost is reduced. The electric device ensures the service life of the electric device and reduces the maintenance and production cost by applying the battery.

title_en: Anti-collision connecting sleeve structure for bolt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bolt anti-collision connecting sleeve structure, which belongs to the technical field of bolt anti-collision, and comprises a mounting seat and a protective sleeve, wherein the mounting seat comprises a ring pad and a boss, a clearance hole for a bolt to pass through is formed in the mounting seat, a notch is formed in the boss, a spring pad for the bolt is arranged in the notch, the protective sleeve is sleeved on the boss, and the protective sleeve coats the bolt.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant high-pressure fire extinguisher valve structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corrosion-resistant high-pressure fire extinguisher valve structure, which comprises a valve body, wherein a nozzle communicated with the inside of the valve body is arranged on the side wall of the valve body, a vertical pipe seat is detachably connected to the lower end of the valve body, a handle is arranged at the upper end of the valve body, a convex ring is arranged on the outer side wall of the valve body, the convex ring is positioned between the handle and the vertical pipe seat, the top of the convex ring is close to the handle, the bottom of the convex ring is far away from the handle, an O-shaped ring is sleeved on the valve body, the O-shaped ring is positioned at the bottom of the convex ring, the part of the valve body positioned at the bottom of the convex ring is wedge-shaped and sleeved with the O-shaped ring, the inner side of the convex ring is fixedly connected with the valve body, a plurality of L-shaped locking blocks are arranged at the outer side of the convex ring, the plurality of locking blocks are uniformly distributed along the circumference of the convex ring, one side of the locking blocks is in damping sliding connection with the convex ring, a magnetizer and a pull ring are fixed at the other side of the locking blocks, the magnetizer is positioned at one side of the locking blocks and forms a U-shaped structure together with the locking blocks, and is positioned at the other side corresponding to the locking blocks. The utility model has the beneficial effect of being convenient for the disassembly of the valve body.

title_en: Rubber shear spring assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rubber shear spring assembly, which relates to the technical field of springs, shock absorbers and shock absorbing devices. The rubber shear spring assembly comprises a rubber body, the upside and the downside of the rubber body are all fixedly connected with steel plate, five lugs are fixedly connected with the upside of the rubber body, five lug grooves are formed in the downside of the steel plate, the five lug grooves are respectively matched with the five lugs, four bolt holes are formed in the upside of the steel plate, the four bolt holes are arranged in a rectangular array, the downside of the four bolt holes extends out of the steel plate, four fixing bolts are arranged on the downside of the steel plate, the four fixing bolts are distributed and extend through the four bolt holes, the steel plate is connected with a vibrating screen through the four fixing bolts, and a fixing structure is arranged on the steel plate.

title_en: MXS pneumatic sliding table cylinder with buffer function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an MXS pneumatic sliding table cylinder with a buffering function, which comprises a base, wherein a cylinder is fixedly connected to one side surface of the base, a cylinder rod is arranged at the output end of the cylinder, a connecting plate is fixedly connected to one side surface of the cylinder rod, a sliding seat is fixedly connected to one side surface of the connecting plate, the upper end of the sliding seat is fixedly connected with a sliding table, and one end of the sliding seat is movably connected to the upper end of the cylinder.

title_en: Speed reducer assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a speed reducer assembly, which comprises a hollow feedback shaft and an inner gear ring shell, wherein an inner gear ring is arranged on the inner wall of the inner gear ring shell, a plurality of groups of planetary gear sets are sequentially arranged in the inner gear ring shell along the axial direction of the feedback shaft, each group of planetary gear sets comprises a sun gear, a planet wheel and a rotating frame, the planet wheels of each planetary gear set are meshed and connected with the inner gear ring shell, the sun gear of a first-stage planetary gear set is connected with a rotor of a motor, the rotating frame of a first-stage planetary gear set is connected with the sun gear of a later-stage planetary gear set through a spline pair, the rotating frame of a last-stage planetary gear set is synchronously connected with the feedback shaft in a rotating manner and is connected with an end cover through a bearing, the sun gear and the rotating frame of each group of planetary gear sets are sleeved on the outer side of the feedback shaft, and a first encoder is arranged on the feedback shaft.

title_en: Special-shaped sealing ring for automobile oil pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special-shaped sealing ring for an automobile oil pump, which relates to the technical field of sealing rings and comprises a shell, a sealing ring body, an upper cover and a boss, wherein the boss is convenient for fixing the sealing ring body, the sealing ring body comprises a lower end face and an upper end face, the boss is connected with the lower end face, the shell is arranged below the sealing ring body, a groove is formed in the top end of the shell, and the upper cover is arranged above the sealing ring body. According to the utility model, through the design of the boss with the lower end surface of the sealing ring body being in a circle, the width of the boss is narrower than the inner space of the groove, so that the sealing ring body can be more easily fixed in the groove, and the abnormal sealing ring is ensured not to shift and deform in the gap between the oil pump and the plug after the cylinder body is assembled.

title_en: Liquid nitrogen low temperature container heat insulation layer structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat insulation layer structure of a liquid nitrogen low-temperature container, which relates to the technical field of liquid nitrogen low-temperature containers and comprises a cylinder body and a top cover at the top of the cylinder body, wherein a second outer ring is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the top end of the cylinder body, a plurality of locking mechanisms are arranged on the outer side of the second outer ring, a mounting cavity is formed in the cylinder body, a heat insulation plate is arranged on the inner side of the mounting cavity, and the top of the heat insulation plate is fixedly connected with the mounting ring.

title_en: Three-way sealing assembly structure of gas insulation equipment drum
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gas-insulated equipment drum tee bend seal assembly structure, including drum tee bend body and 3 external connecting pipes that meet with drum tee bend body, drum tee bend body all is equipped with dual seal structure with every junction of external connecting pipe, dual seal structure includes sealed rubber ring and metal seal ring, sealed rubber ring is located between drum tee bend body and the external connecting pipe interface, metal seal ring is located drum tee bend body and external connecting pipe interface outer ring, metal seal ring's both ends are equipped with the same elastic rubber packing ring, be equipped with locking reinforcing apparatus around the metal seal ring, be fixed with the drainage plate on the drum tee bend body interface inner wall, the other half of drainage plate extends to external connecting pipe in, and the extension annular plate that the other half is connected goes deep into in the spacing annular plate, spacing annular plate is fixed on external connecting pipe inner wall, this seal assembly structure has promoted sealing performance through dual seal design, through drainage plate, locking reinforcing apparatus's design, sealing structure intensity has been promoted.

title_en: Plastic packaging bag processing device capable of leveling
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of packaging equipment, and discloses a flattening type plastic packaging bag processing device which comprises a frame, wherein the left end of the frame is fixedly connected with a feeding device, and the left end of the inner side wall of the frame is provided with a tensioning assembly. According to the utility model, the plastic film can be fed into the processing area through the feeding device arranged at the front end of the frame, meanwhile, the advancing direction of the plastic film can be guided through the cooperation of the first guide roller, the second guide roller and the third guide roller, the middle parts of the two support frames fixed at the top end of the frame are respectively provided with the sliding blocks, meanwhile, the middle parts of the two sliding blocks are connected through the tensioning roller, and the front end sliding blocks are in threaded connection with the screw rod, so that the height of the sliding blocks with the tensioning roller can be controlled to be adjusted through rotating the rotating handle fixed at the top end of the screw rod, the plastic film can be kept in a tight state all the time, and the formation of wrinkles is reduced.

title_en: Limiting and protecting device for transmission shaft of coal mining machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a limit protection device for a transmission shaft of a coal mining machine, which aims to prevent a motor from being damaged due to misoperation of the coal mining machine, and comprises the transmission shaft, a handle shaft, a baffle cover, a round nut stop washer and a pin, wherein threads and key grooves are arranged on the handle shaft, the transmission shaft, a bearing and the handle shaft are assembled, the round nut stop washer is installed through the key grooves, and the round nut is screwed, and finally, the handle shaft assembly is connected with the blocking cover, the structure enables the transmission shaft to keep a safe distance from the blocking cover through the round nut as axial limiting, so that the phenomenon that the transmission shaft rubs with the blocking cover to damage a motor due to the fact that the transmission shaft is not conveyed into a working position is avoided, and meanwhile, a double anti-loosening structure is formed by the round nut stop washer and the pin, so that limiting reliability is ensured.

title_en: Flat plate supporting structure and tablet personal computer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electronics, and particularly relates to a flat plate supporting structure and a flat plate computer, wherein the flat plate supporting structure comprises a keyboard main body, a keyboard protecting cover and a first rotating shaft, and a connecting part for detachably connecting with a flat plate is arranged on the keyboard protecting cover; the first rotating shaft is a two-section rotating shaft and comprises a first sleeve and a second sleeve which are connected in a rotating way, wherein the first sleeve is connected with the keyboard main body, and the second sleeve is connected with the keyboard protective cover. The utility model realizes the bearing of the flat plate through the structure, thereby being convenient for the combination of the flat plate and the keyboard, and being convenient to operate and carry, and improving the use experience of users.

title_en: Hardware connecting piece with excellent shock resistance
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hardware connecting piece with excellent shock resistance, which belongs to the technical field of hardware connecting pieces and comprises a first fixing piece, wherein the left end and the right end of the outer side surface of the first fixing piece are fixedly provided with first fixing sleeves, the left side and the right side of the inner side surface of a second fixing piece are fixedly provided with second fixing sleeves, central shafts are inserted into the first fixing sleeves and the second fixing sleeves, when a cabinet door is opened, the second fixing piece is driven to rotate along the central shafts by the cabinet door through the second fixing sleeves through the buffer assembly, the second fixing piece drives the two fourth fixing sleeves on the buffer assembly to rotate, and as the third fixing sleeve is inserted into a slot through an inserting block, the third fixing sleeve cannot rotate along the central shafts, so that a torsion spring between the third fixing sleeve and the fourth fixing sleeve is in a torsion state, the torsion force of the torsion spring can buffer the force of the cabinet door when the cabinet door is opened, the impact force on the cabinet body and the hardware connecting piece when the cabinet door is opened is slowed down, and the service life of the cabinet body, the cabinet door and the hardware connecting piece is prolonged.

title_en: Variable pitch anti-drop screw
abstract_en: The utility model provides a variable-pitch anti-falling screw, which belongs to the technical field of hardware and comprises a bolt assembly and an anti-falling assembly, wherein the bolt assembly comprises a stud, the top end of the stud is connected with a bolt cap, the stud passes through a through hole in the middle of two gaskets, so that the gaskets are fixed between the stud and a connecting body, cams are correspondingly arranged on the inner sides of the two gaskets, the inclination angles of the two cams are larger than the pitches of a first thread groove and a second thread groove, a wedge effect is generated below the bolt cap or the nut, the friction of the contact surface of the bolt cap and a fixed body is increased by radial saw teeth on the outer sides of the two gaskets, the stud is fixed through the gaskets, the stud is prevented from loosening in a vibration environment, and when the stud is required to be disassembled, the upper gasket is screwed to drive the cams to exceed the lower cams to increase the force in the stud, so that the stud can be unscrewed, and the stud is replaced by fixing modes such as double nuts or locking glue.

title_en: Novel bushing-free structure guider
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel bushing-free structure guider, and belongs to the technical field of powder metallurgy. The guide device comprises a guide device body, wherein both sides of the guide device body are provided with integrally formed mounting openings, an inner adjusting plate is arranged in the mounting openings, a movable pressing plate is arranged at the front end of the inner adjusting plate, and a spring damping rod is arranged between the movable pressing plate and the inner adjusting plate. The utility model solves the problems that the prior powder metallurgy guide adopts the lubricating rubber ring to assist in the guide, looseness, crushing or poor installation can be generated when the guide works for a long time while the strength is influenced, the utility model supports and limits the surface of a piston rod by the ball sleeve and the guide ball on the surface of the movable pressing plate, the spring damping rod gives the whole certain supporting strength of movable clamp plate, and at piston rod activity in-process, the direction ball gives spring damping rod with pressure transmission and cushions to carry out shock attenuation work, improve position stability, make things convenient for long-term work.

title_en: Multistage seal protection structure of axle gear box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage sealing protection structure of an axle gear box, which comprises a gear box shell, wherein end faces of the gear box shell are respectively connected with an end cover A and an end cover B through bolts so as to seal two ends of the gear box shell and support rotation of an internal shaft, a first-stage sealing assembly is closely attached to the inner wall of the gear box shell and is used for sealing a joint of the gear box shell and the end covers A and B, and a second-stage sealing assembly is movably extruded in the first-stage sealing assembly so as to be matched with the first-stage sealing assembly to further seal the gear box shell. According to the utility model, the primary sealing assembly is arranged at the joint of the inner wall of the gear box, so that the gear box can be preliminarily sealed, and the secondary sealing assembly is arranged in the primary sealing assembly, so that the gear box can be further extruded and sealed by matching with the primary sealing assembly, and the sealing effect of the whole gear box is improved.

title_en: Adjustable needle valve of velocity of flow that regulation linearity is high
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flow rate adjustable needle valve with high adjustment linearity, which relates to the technical field of needle valves and comprises a valve body, wherein a circulation channel is formed in the valve body, the middle part of the circulation channel is vertically arranged, a valve cover is connected with the top of the valve body through threads, a valve rod is arranged in the valve cover, a sealing structure is arranged at the bottom of the valve rod and is matched with the top of the circulation channel, the surface of the valve rod is connected with the inner threads of the valve cover, a compression nut is sleeved on the surface of the valve rod, and the inner part of the compression nut is connected with the top of the surface of the valve cover through threads. According to the needle valve, the valve body, the flow passage, the valve cover, the valve rod, the sealing structure, the compression nut and the hand wheel are arranged, so that the problems that the sealing structure is in contact with fluid, the sealing part is aged, the sealing is not tight, the internal or external leakage is caused, and the replacement is inconvenient in the use process of the existing needle valve are solved.

title_en: Rotary eccentric butterfly valve with low torque and high sealing performance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rotary eccentric butterfly valves, in particular to a rotary eccentric butterfly valve with low torque and high sealing property, which comprises a main valve body, wherein the top of the main valve body is fixedly connected with a top connecting seat; the utility model forms circulation of the cooling liquid in the liquid storage tank along the cooling cylinder, the liquid outlet pipe and the liquid inlet pipe through starting the liquid inlet pump and the liquid outlet pump, improves the cooling efficiency of the cooling cylinder by the cooling liquid, reduces the ageing influence of high temperature on the sealing filler on the surface of the cooling cylinder by cooling the cooling cylinder, prolongs the service life of the sealing filler, improves the sealing property of the rotary eccentric butterfly valve, and utilizes the blocking net on one side of the liquid inlet valve pipe to filter, blocks hard particles in a medium, reduces abrasion of metal sealing surfaces caused by sand particles or pipeline rust and stripping matters, improves the sealing effect of the butterfly valve, and simultaneously scratches and disturbs the surface of the blocking net by matching with the stirring brush to prevent particles from accumulating and blocking on the upstream face of the blocking net.

title_en: Coupling mechanism and anesthesia machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting mechanism and an anesthesia machine. The connecting mechanism comprises a pedal, a connecting frame, a linkage assembly and a braking piece, wherein the pedal is suitable for being connected to a base of the anesthesia machine in a rotating mode around a first axis, the connecting frame is fixed to the pedal, the linkage assembly is connected to the connecting frame in a rotating mode around a second axis, the braking piece comprises a transmission rod and a braking rod, the transmission rod is connected with the linkage assembly, one end of the braking rod is connected with the transmission rod in a power mode, the other end of the braking rod is suitable for being connected with a braking assembly of a castor, and the transmission rod can be driven to rotate around a third axis through stepping on the pedal, so that the transmission rod can brake the castor on the base through the braking rod. The utility model adopts a multi-axis rotation connection mode, the pedal can realize effective braking of the castor without a larger swinging angle, and the stability of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Straight pipe plugging tool
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pipeline construction, and discloses a straight pipe plugging tool which comprises a clamping flange, a plugging piece and an adjusting component, wherein the clamping flange is provided with a connecting part, a first installation part and a second installation part which are arranged at intervals along a first direction, the first installation part is connected with the second installation part through the connecting part, the plugging piece is arranged on one side of the first installation part, which faces the second installation part, the adjusting component is arranged on the second installation part, the adjusting component comprises a first driving piece and a locking piece, the first driving piece is movably connected with the second installation part, the first driving piece can push a straight pipe to move along the first direction and tightly abutted and sealed with the plugging piece, and the locking piece is used for selectively fixing the first driving piece. According to the straight pipe plugging tool, the first driving piece is fixed through the locking piece, so that the relative position of the first driving piece after the straight pipe is pushed by the first driving piece to be abutted against the plugging piece can be effectively ensured, the plugging piece can always and stably plug a leakage point, and the plugging stability of the straight pipe plugging tool is ensured.

title_en: Liquid cooling soft connection sealing sleeve for battery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery liquid cooling flexible connection sealing sleeve, which comprises a pipe joint, a rotating sleeve and a reinforcing component, wherein the rotating sleeve is fixed on one side of the pipe joint, the reinforcing component comprises a fixed frame, two sliding holes, two connecting holes and movable columns, the fixed frames are respectively fixed on two sides of the outer surface of the rotating sleeve, the sliding holes are formed in the center of one side of the outer surface of the fixed frame, the connecting holes are formed in the outer surface of the rotating sleeve, the sliding holes correspond to the connecting holes in the forward direction, the movable columns penetrate through the sliding holes and the connecting holes in a sliding manner, a baffle plate is fixed in the middle of the outer surface of the movable columns, the tail end of each movable column extends into the rotating sleeve, a first spring is fixed on one side of each baffle plate and is positioned in the fixed frame, and an annular groove is formed in the rear side of the outer surface of the fixed sleeve. Under the action of the elastic force of the first spring, the tail end of the movable column is automatically clamped into the annular groove to form a mechanical self-locking structure, so that the pipe joint is firmly connected with the pipe sleeve, and the loosening is prevented.

title_en: Gas sampling pipe joint with drainage and gas washing functions
abstract_en: A gas sampling pipe joint with drainage and gas washing functions belongs to the technical field of gas sampling and testing equipment and is used for high-quality gas sampling. The upper end of the drain valve body is connected with a sampling tube ball valve, one end of a valve core is connected in a valve core mounting hole on the side wall of the drain valve body, the other end of the valve core is connected with a sampling joint through the valve core ball valve, the front end of the sampling joint is connected with an opening of a gas collecting bag, a floating ball is arranged above a water outlet at the lower end of the drain valve body, two gas collecting bag gas inlet channels and gas collecting bag gas outlet channels which are arranged in parallel along the length direction are arranged in the valve core, and sealing balls and compression springs with opposite directions are respectively arranged in the two gas channels in sequence. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use, can realize the integrated operation of drainage, gas washing and collection, has simple and convenient operation process, shortens the operation time, improves the working efficiency, reduces the workload of operators and eliminates the potential safety hazard of gas leakage.

title_en: Reversing valve with noise reduction function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a reversing valve with a noise reduction function, which relates to the technical field of reversing valves, and comprises a reversing valve body, wherein a trapezoid cavity is formed inside the reversing valve body and close to the top of the reversing valve body, the top of the reversing valve body is fixedly connected with a feeding pipe, the feeding pipe is communicated with the trapezoid cavity, the inside of switching-over valve body just is close to the bottom symmetry and has seted up the round chamber, all be linked together between trapezoidal chamber and the round chamber and have had the connecting hole, the apopore has all been seted up to the bottom in round chamber, the round hole has been seted up in the inside of switching-over valve body and in round chamber department. According to the utility model, through the synergistic effect of the fluid steady flow design (the cooperation of the trapezoid cavity, the cone head and the fixed sleeve, the addition of the mechanical vibration buffer (the spring and the convex rod structure) and the noise transmission isolation (the sound insulation cylinder), the effects of effectively reducing the fluid impact noise and the mechanical vibration noise can be achieved, so that the production environment can be improved, and the scene requirements of precision equipment, a mute workshop and the like can be met.

title_en: Drainage pipeline protection support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drainage pipes, in particular to a drainage pipeline protection bracket. The technical scheme includes that the support frame comprises at least one group of support frame supporting plates, a plurality of first inserting posts are arranged on one side of each support frame supporting plate at equal intervals, a plurality of first inserting holes for the first inserting posts to be inserted are formed in the other side of each support frame supporting plate, the support frame supporting plates are connected with corrugated pipes through the first inserting posts, one group of support transverse plates are welded on one side, far away from the first inserting posts, of each support frame supporting plate, a first clamping plate and a second inserting post are fixedly connected to one end of each support transverse plate, and clamping grooves and second inserting holes for the corresponding insertion of the first clamping plates and the second inserting posts are formed in the side faces of the other ends of the support transverse plates. According to the utility model, the support plate is used for jacking and reinforcing the damaged end part of the corrugated pipe, so that the support strength of the port of the corrugated pipe is effectively improved, the load generated by rolling of the heavy object above can be resisted, the deformation of the corrugated pipe is obviously reduced, and the service life of the corrugated pipe is prolonged.

title_en: Warning receiving device for ship navigation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a warning receiving arrangement for ship navigation relates to ship navigation auxiliary assembly technical field, including warning receiving equipment organism, the outside of warning receiving equipment organism is provided with the carrier, the both sides of carrier have all been seted up the rotary groove, warning receiving equipment organism rotates with the rotary groove to be connected, polygon notch has all been seted up to the both sides of warning receiving equipment organism, the screw thread groove has been seted up to the one end of polygon notch, the utility model discloses a setting of polygon notch and polygon, can be when using, according to the restriction of polygon, make warning receiving equipment organism unable continue to rotate, stability is higher, can not appear warning receiving equipment organism's angle appearance change when boats and ships rock, and installs through the mode of pegging graft, can convenient to detach assembly, through the split setting of polygon and hexagonal prism, can be convenient for with the assembly between the warning receiving equipment organism, convenient to use.

title_en: Multi-stage hydraulic cylinder with leakage prevention function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic cylinders, in particular to a multi-stage hydraulic cylinder with a leakage-proof function, which comprises a cylinder bottom, wherein an outer cylinder barrel is arranged at the top of the cylinder bottom, a first telescopic cylinder is slidably arranged in the outer cylinder barrel, a second telescopic cylinder is slidably arranged in the first telescopic cylinder, a first sealing fixing plate is arranged at the top of the outer cylinder barrel, a second telescopic cylinder is arranged at the top of the first telescopic cylinder, and an oil inlet pipe is communicated with the inside of the cylinder bottom. When the oil seal is replaced, only the first sealing clamping plate and the fourth sealing clamping plate are required to be disassembled, and the first sealing clamping plate and the fourth sealing clamping plate can slide along the installation direction of the first support sliding rod, so that the space between the first sealing clamping plate and the fourth sealing clamping plate is enlarged, a sufficient maintenance space is provided for maintenance personnel, parts can be prevented from being lost, the subsequent installation speed is increased, and the maintenance efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligence stereo garage parking stall occupies detection sensor fixing base
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sensor fixing seats and discloses an intelligent three-dimensional garage parking space occupation detection sensor fixing seat which comprises a mounting seat, wherein a rotating sleeve is arranged on the side wall of the mounting seat, a mounting frame is fixedly connected to the side wall of the rotating sleeve, a sensor body is slidably connected to the inside of the mounting frame, an adjusting assembly is arranged in the mounting seat, a limiting assembly is arranged on the side wall of the mounting frame, the adjusting assembly comprises a fixing rod, the side wall of the fixing rod is fixedly connected to the inside of the mounting seat, and the inner wall of the rotating sleeve is rotatably connected to the side wall of the fixing rod. According to the utility model, the sliding disc is driven to compress the spring by pressing the pressing rod in the mounting seat so that the clamping block is separated from the clamping plate clamping groove, the rotating sleeve is released from locking and then rotates around the fixing rod, the pressing rod is released after the rotating sleeve is regulated to a target angle, and the spring pushes the clamping block to be embedded and locked again, so that the flexible adjustment and stable fixation of the sensor angle is realized, and the adjustment convenience and accuracy are improved.

title_en: Angle-adjustable power cable bridge fixed supporting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an angle-adjustable power cable bridge fixing and supporting device, which relates to the technical field of supporting devices and comprises a base, wherein a support column is fixedly connected to the upper side of the base, a fixing frame is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the support column, a lifting column is connected to the upper side of the support column in a penetrating and sliding manner, a fixing frame is fixedly connected to the upper end of the lifting column, a fixing block is fixedly connected to the upper side of the fixing frame, rotating frames are respectively connected to the left end and the right end of the inner surface of the fixing frame in a rotating manner, bolts are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the rotating frames, and a bridge is movably connected to the inner surface of the rotating frames. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the knob, the threaded rod, the movable block, the chute, the thread bush, the connecting rod, the inserting column and the slot, the angle of the bridge frame adjustment can be locked, the locking function can ensure that the bridge frame keeps a fixed angle after being installed, the inclination or the angle change of the bridge frame caused by external force is avoided, and the stability and the safety of cable laying are ensured.

title_en: Wire drawing machine is used in overhead conductor production
abstract_en: The application relates to a wire drawing machine for producing an overhead wire, which relates to the technical field of wire production equipment and aims to solve the problem that the surface quality of the overhead wire is affected by the accumulation of broken scraps of the wire drawing machine; the novel wire drawing box is characterized in that an inner protection cylinder is arranged in the wire drawing box body, a plurality of wire drawing wheels are arranged in the inner protection cylinder, chip removal guide holes are formed in the cylinder walls on two sides of the inner protection cylinder and correspond to the wire inlet positions of each wire drawing wheel, the chip removal guide holes are long waist holes, the axis of each long waist hole is inclined downwards towards the bottom of the wire drawing box body, and a lubricating assembly is further arranged in the inner protection cylinder.

title_en: Power system for electric non-road engineering machinery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power system for an electric non-road engineering machine, which comprises a first motor, a second motor and a speed reducer, wherein the first motor and the second motor are arranged left and right, the speed reducer is provided with a first input shaft, a second input shaft, an intermediate shaft and an output shaft, input shaft gears are respectively sleeved on the first input shaft and the second input shaft, an intermediate shaft pinion and an intermediate shaft large gear are sleeved on the intermediate shaft in a front-back mode, an oil pump power taking gear and an output shaft gear are sleeved on the output shaft in a front-back mode, and the first input shaft and the second input shaft are respectively connected with the output shafts of the first motor and the second motor through splines. The power system for the electric non-road engineering machinery adopts a scheme of double motors and double input speed reducers, and the two motors are used as input sources to be matched with the speed reducer with a single gear, so that the low-speed traction requirement of the whole vehicle can be ensured under the condition that gear switching is not needed, and the high-speed requirement of the whole vehicle can be ensured.

title_en: Leveling device for house reconstruction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of house reconstruction, and discloses a leveling device for house reconstruction, which comprises a connecting seat, wherein the front end of the connecting seat is fixedly connected with a laser level meter, the rear end of the connecting seat is provided with a flexible movable adjusting assembly, the adjusting assembly comprises a first pressing plate and a second pressing plate, and two groups of adjusting screws are arranged in the connecting seat in a penetrating manner. This a leveling device for house transformation is through being provided with first clamp plate, second clamp plate, adjusting screw, cushion, hand wheel and link, conveniently fills when can carrying out quick leveling to the wall and handle, promotes work efficiency, avoids the cushion to take place the displacement during the use and influences balance degree measurement, replaces the knob with the hand wheel, makes things convenient for staff's rotatory operation, and what the solution is that the device can not carry out the roughness monitoring according to the wall adaptation is adjusted, appears hollowing, fracture, the problem such as upwarp easily, greatly reduced device practicality's problem.

title_en: Wireless ann critical biography is bearing bracket for sensor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sensor mounting brackets, and particularly relates to a bearing bracket for a wireless critical biography sensor, which comprises a fixing plate, wherein a guide rail is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the fixing plate, a mounting plate is connected to the guide rail in a sliding manner, a fixing assembly and an adjusting mechanism are arranged on the mounting plate, the adjusting mechanism comprises a screw rod, the screw rod is rotatably connected to the mounting plate, and a handle is fixedly connected to the end part of the screw rod. The wireless mounting critical biography sensor is used for bearing the support, the fixing assembly is matched with the adjusting mechanism, the rotating handle drives the screw rod to rotate, the movable seat slides along the guide rod, the horizontal position of the sensor can be adjusted, the mounting plate slides on the guide rail through the guide block, the integral mounting position of the sensor can be adjusted by matching the T rod of the fixing assembly with the clutch of the socket, the monitoring angle and the monitoring range of the sensor can be optimized without disassembling and reinstalling, the problem that the monitoring vision is limited due to the position fixing of the traditional support is solved, and the sensor is ensured to be aligned to the monitoring area.

title_en: Supercharging oil cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil cylinders, in particular to a booster oil cylinder. A pressurizing oil cylinder comprises a cylinder body, a piston rod, a core tube, a middle oil tube, a core tube small cavity, a pressurizing cavity guide sleeve, a pressurizing cavity piston, a piston rod head and a core tube large cavity, wherein the piston rod is fixedly arranged at one end side of the cylinder body, the piston rod head is fixedly arranged at the other end of the cylinder body, the core tube is axially arranged in the piston rod, the core tube is provided with a core tube inner cavity, the middle oil tube is axially arranged in the piston rod and sleeved outside the core tube, the core tube small cavity is formed between the outer side of the middle oil tube and the piston rod, the core tube small cavity is communicated with the middle oil tube, the pressurizing cavity guide sleeve is slidably arranged at one end of the middle oil tube, the pressurizing cavity piston is fixedly arranged at the other end of the middle oil tube, and the piston rod head form the core tube large cavity, and the core tube large cavity are communicated with the core tube inner cavity, and the technical limitation that the pressurizing oil cylinder can be pressurized when the pressurizing oil cylinder stretches out and retracts in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Bearing with widened inner ring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bearing with a widened inner ring, which relates to the field of bearings and adopts the technical scheme that the bearing comprises an inner ring and an outer ring, wherein a sliding groove is formed in one side of the inner ring, a mounting block is arranged in the sliding groove, a mounting hole is formed in one side of the mounting block, the inner ring is detachably connected with the widened ring, the mounting groove is formed in one side of the widened ring, a through hole is formed in the peripheral wall of the widened ring, a limiting hole is formed in the peripheral wall of the inner ring, and a fixing bolt is arranged in the limiting hole. When the bearing needs to bear higher axial load, people slide out of the sliding groove, one side of the widened ring is abutted against the inner ring, and then the fixing bolt passes through the through hole and is in threaded connection with the mounting hole, so that the widened ring is fixedly connected with the inner ring, the contact area between the inner ring and the shaft shoulder is increased, the axial load capacity of the bearing is improved, the inner ring, the outer ring and the widened ring are all made of high-carbon chromium steel, and the integral strength of the bearing is ensured.

title_en: Fan check valve structure and exhaust system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fan check valve structure and an exhaust system, comprising an exhaust mechanism, wherein the exhaust mechanism comprises a first shell and a fan, a first channel is formed in the first shell in a surrounding manner, the fan is arranged in the first channel, the check mechanism comprises a second shell, a rotating shaft and a valve blade, the second shell is connected with the first shell, the second channel is formed in the surrounding manner, an input port of the fan is communicated with the second channel, the rotating shaft is arranged on the second shell, the valve blade is provided with a hinge position, the valve blade is rotatably connected in the second shell through the rotating shaft at the hinge position, and the distance from the hinge position to one end of the valve blade is larger than the distance from the hinge position to the other end of the valve blade. Through the arrangement, the partition sealing is realized through continuous lap joint, so that unnecessary air supply and air leakage are avoided, and the valve blades can deflect along the air flow direction to reduce resistance, thereby ensuring ventilation efficiency.

title_en: Oil pipe connecting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an oil pipe connecting device, which relates to the technical field of pipeline connection and comprises a connecting pipe, wherein a connecting inner pipe is arranged in the connecting pipe, connecting plates are fixedly connected to two ends of the connecting inner pipe, the connecting pipe fixedly connects the connecting inner pipe with the connecting pipe, an extension pipe is communicated with the outer side of the connecting inner pipe, a locking component for locking an external oil pipe is arranged on the extension pipe, an indicating plate is arranged on the outer side of the connecting pipe, an indicating rod is arranged on a connecting wheel and is in sliding fit with the indicating plate, and the locking state is judged through the position of the indicating rod in a circular groove or an elliptical groove. The device realizes the quick and reliable connection and the visual prompt of the locking state of the oil pipe, and improves the connection safety and the operation convenience.

title_en: Underground suspended fixing support of static pressure type liquid level meter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a static pressure type liquid level meter underground suspended fixing support, and relates to the technical field of underground fixing of liquid level meters. The well head inner wall is fixedly arranged on a well head inner wall, a suspended base is horizontally and fixedly arranged under the bearing base through a suspension assembly, a liquid level meter socket vertically penetrating through the whole suspended base is arranged on the suspended base, a liquid level meter which is in clearance fit with the liquid level meter socket and the lower end of which extends into a drainage groove is inserted into the liquid level meter socket, and the upper end of the liquid level meter is connected with a windlass assembly arranged on the bearing base through a pull rope. The utility model provides a static pressure type liquid level meter underground suspended fixed support which can conveniently and rapidly lift a liquid level meter to a wellhead and is convenient for daily maintenance of the liquid level meter.

title_en: Buckle assembly type hardware support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hardware supports, in particular to a buckle assembly type hardware support which comprises a support body, wherein an assembly device is arranged on the support body and comprises a first ring body fixed at the upper end of the support body, a second ring body is arranged above the first ring body, rotating rings are rotatably connected to the inner walls of the first ring body and the second ring body, positioning parts capable of positioning the rotating rings are arranged on the surfaces of the first ring body and the second ring body.

title_en: Aluminum pipe convenient to location
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum pipes, in particular to an aluminum pipe convenient to position, which comprises an aluminum pipe body, a positioning lug assembly and a positioning groove assembly, wherein the positioning lug assembly is fixedly arranged at one end of the aluminum pipe body, the positioning groove assembly is fixedly arranged at the other end of the aluminum pipe body, the positioning lug assembly comprises a fixing sleeve, the fixing sleeve is connected with the aluminum pipe body through welding, the top of the fixing sleeve is rotationally connected with a rotating sleeve, positioning lugs are equidistantly welded at the top of the rotating sleeve, a protruding part is welded at one end of each positioning lug, a limiting column is equidistantly welded at the periphery of the rotating sleeve at the top of the fixing sleeve, and an auxiliary positioning mechanism is added to replace a traditional connecting piece in a splicing, rotating and combining connection mode, so that the convenience and stability of aluminum pipe positioning are improved, and the use effect is improved.

title_en: High-strength PE water supply pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength PE water supply pipe which comprises a first water supply pipe and a second water supply pipe, wherein the first water supply pipe is spliced with the second water supply pipe and is connected with the second water supply pipe through a limiting cylinder, a locking assembly is arranged on the limiting cylinder, protective assemblies of protective assemblies are arranged outside the first water supply pipe and the second water supply pipe and comprise a first protective plate and a second protective plate, the sections of the first protective plate and the second protective plate are of semicircular structures and are sleeved on the outer walls of the first water supply pipe and the second water supply pipe, and two ends of the first protective plate and two ends of the second protective plate are fixedly connected with the limiting cylinder. The utility model can form protection on the surface of the pipeline, improve the strength of the water pipe, prolong the service life, improve the connection strength of the water pipe and avoid loosening.

title_en: Ship bottom monitoring and processing system at cargo hold of low-temperature gas ship
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ship bottom monitoring and processing system at a cargo hold of a low-temperature gas ship, which relates to the technical field of ship safety and comprises a double-phase jet pump, a sensor component and a ship central controller, wherein the double-phase jet pump is arranged at the bottom of the ship hold at the cargo hold, a driving port of the double-phase jet pump is respectively connected with a fire sea water pipeline, a liquid cargo pipeline and a compressed air pipeline at the cargo hold through driving pipelines, a suction inlet is connected with a sewage well arranged at the cargo hold, a discharge outlet is respectively connected with an outboard discharge pipeline and a liquid cargo collecting pipeline through discharge pipelines, and the sensor component comprises a liquid level sensor, a temperature sensor and a combustible medium sensor and is electrically connected with the ship central controller. The utility model discloses a ship bottom monitoring and processing system at a cargo hold of a low-temperature gas ship, which can effectively realize the emergency leakage treatment when condensate water is discharged, residual water is emptied and liquid cargo is leaked, and has the advantages of compact structure, high functional integration and the like.

title_en: Low-impact low-pressure opening axial flow type check valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-impact low-pressure opening axial flow check valve, which comprises a valve body, wherein a guide shaft and a guide sleeve are arranged in the valve body, a valve clack is arranged on the guide shaft, the valve clack is fixedly connected with the guide shaft, the guide shaft and the valve clack are movably matched with the valve body, the valve clack comprises a closing position which is in sealing fit with the inner wall of the valve body and an opening position which moves along with the direction of the guide sleeve in the guide shaft, the valve body is provided with a guide seat in the guide direction, a front guide matching structure is formed by guiding fit between one end of the guide shaft and the guide seat, a fixed ring is also arranged in the guide sleeve, a positioning ring is also arranged in the fixed ring, and a rear guide matching structure is formed by guiding fit between the other end of the guide shaft and the positioning ring.

title_en: Splicing structure and spliced valve cover protection frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spliced valve cover protection frames, in particular to a spliced structure and a spliced valve cover protection frame, which comprise two groups of bolt seats, wherein the bolt seats are fixed on the surface of a second protection frame, bolt holes are formed in the surfaces of the bolt seats, bolts are movably inserted in the bolt holes, the bolts are rotationally connected to a servo motor, the servo motor is arranged on the surface of the first protection frame, plugs are movably inserted in the surfaces of the servo motor, and the plugs are arranged on a controller; the splicing structure and the spliced valve cover protection frame have the beneficial effects that the servo motor is arranged on the surface of the first protection frame, the servo motor controls the expansion and the contraction of the bolts, the bolt mechanism controls the splicing and the separation between the first protection frame and the second protection frame, the servo motor is controlled by the controller externally connected with the battery, and the controller is stored by a maintenance person, so that the maintenance person can conveniently maintain the maintenance person regularly and the protection frame is prevented from being stolen.

title_en: Air supply pipeline valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a valve of an air supply pipeline, which comprises a valve body, rotary switches and valve cores, wherein an air inlet end pipe and a plurality of air outlet end pipes are arranged on the valve body, an air flow channel and a plurality of valve core channels are arranged in the valve body, the air inlet end pipe and the air outlet end pipe are communicated with the air flow channel, the valve core channels are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence manner with the air outlet end pipe, the valve core channels are communicated with the corresponding air outlet end pipe and the air flow channel, a valve core is arranged in each valve core channel, each valve core is provided with a rotary switch, each valve core comprises a valve rod, a stud and a valve plug, the stud and the valve plug are respectively arranged at the top end and the bottom end of the valve rod, and the stud is in threaded connection with one rotary switch. The valve has the technical effects that the valve is suitable for a multi-pipeline oxygen supply pillow, can independently control the opening and closing and flow of each pipeline respectively, is convenient for realizing regional oxygen supply, has high integration level of the whole valve, has simple structure, can control the opening and closing and flow of the corresponding pipeline by rotating the rotary switch in the use process, and is convenient for use and operation.

title_en: Pipe coupling with seal
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assembly of a synthetic cylindrical pipe and a pipe coupling for connecting to the synthetic pipe, wherein the pipe coupling comprises a circumferential insertion wall into which the pipe fits, wherein via a first diameter step the insertion wall merges into a first circumferential accommodation wall having a larger inside diameter than the insertion wall, wherein the first accommodation wall bounds a first rebate in which a grip ring is accommodated that engages around the inserted pipe and that can be moved in the insertion direction in the first rebate between a first position in which the pipe can be inserted through the grip ring towards the insertion wall, and a second position in which the grip ring fixedly engages around and onto the inserted pipe, wherein the first accommodation wall merges into a circumferential confining wall having an inside diameter that decreases towards the insertion opening, wherein the insertion part comprises a circumferential seal within the confining wall, which seal engages around and onto the pipe.

title_en: Method of generating vehicle control data, vehicle control device, and vehicle control system
abstract_en: A method of generating vehicle control data includes: storing, with a storage device (96a; 156a), relationship prescription data; operating, with an execution device (92, 94; 152, 154), an operable portion (16, 18, 28, 30, 46, 50, 54, 64, 68) of an internal combustion engine; acquiring, with the execution device, a detection value from a sensor that detects the state of the vehicle; calculating, with the execution device, a reward; and updating, with the execution device, the relationship prescription data using update mapping determined in advance, the update mapping using the state of the vehicle based on the detection value, an operation amount used to operate the operable portion, and the reward corresponding to the operation as arguments, and returning the relationship prescription data which have been updated such that an expected profit for the reward calculated when the operable portion is operated in accordance with the relationship prescription data increases.

title_en: Vacuum adiabatic body and refrigerator
abstract_en: Provided is a vacuum adiabatic body. The vacuum adiabatic body includes a supporting unit configured to maintain an inner vacuum space part and a pipeline disposed in the vacuum space part. A pipeline is spaced apart form a third space by the supporting unit, and movement of the pipeline in a horizontal direction is restricted by the supporting unit. According to an embodiment, a heat exchange pipeline through which a refrigerant flows may be stably supported by an interaction between the spacing member and the support unit.
