title_en: Safety valve and radiator using such safety valve
abstract_en: A safety valve (1), particularly adapted to be applied to equipment (30) containing a pressurized fluid that comprises a tubular sleeve (2) in which the following are identified: a tubular body (2a) provided with an inlet hole (3) and an outlet hole (4) of the pressurized fluid; a shutter unit (5) of the inlet hole (3) slidably housed within the tubular body (2a) and comprised between the inlet hole (3) and the outlet hole (4); retaining means (6) of the shutter unit (5) present at the outlet hole (4). The safety valve (1) also comprises a tubular flange (9) belonging to the tubular body (2a), arranged coaxially and radially distanced externally to the outlet hole (4) and provided internally with a shaped zone (10) arranged coaxially and above the retaining means (6) and configured to house a manoeuvring key.

title_en: An electrical actuator
abstract_en: An electrical actuator (20) is provided. The actuator (20) comprises an electric drive means (22) and a drive member (26) being rotationally driven upon activation of the electric drive means (22), an output member (24) being rotationally connected to the drive member (26) by means of a first spring (28), and a second spring (32) being connected to the output member (24) and forming a one way clutch between the output member (24) and a fixed tube (34), wherein the electrical actuator (20) further comprises a regulation cup (30) being configured to engage with the second spring (32) to disconnect the output member (24) from the fixed tube (34).

title_en: Method for monitoring the shut-off valve of a gas meter and gas meter thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for monitoring a state of a shut-off valve (21) of a gas meter (1). The gas meter (1) comprises a hollow body (10), which delimits a measuring compartment (11), an inlet conduit (13) and an outlet conduit (15) in fluid communication with the measuring compartment (11). Furthermore, the gas meter (I) comprises an actuator (23) coupled to the shut-off valve (21), to switch it between an open state, in which it allows the flow of gas into the measuring compartment (11) and a closed state, in which it blocks the flow of gas into the measuring compartment (II). The method comprises the steps of monitoring an electric absorption of the actuator (23), and determining the switching from one state to the other of the shut-off valve (21), based on the detection of a change in the electric absorption of the actuator (23) above a threshold. The method comprises measuring an operating temperature of the shut-off valve (21), and, based on the temperature measured, determining a minimum acceptable time and a maximum acceptable time for the switching, from one state to the other, of the valve. Thus, the method comprises the step of counting a time elapsed from the start of a switching from one state to the other, and checking if the time elapsed is comprised between the minimum acceptable time and the maximum acceptable time.

title_en: Fall protection locking system and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: A locking system for fall protection and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. An example locking system includes a housing (130). The housing (130) defines a guide path through which the housing is slideably attached to a guide member (300). The locking system also includes a braking lever (115) having a braking end (210) that is configured to engage the guide member (300). The braking lever (115) includes a shock absorber (185) configured to deform during a fall instance. The locking system further includes a secondary braking feature (200) configured independent from the braking lever. The secondary braking feature (200) is an inertial structure configured to rotate into engagement with the guide member (300) during the fall instance. A corresponding method of manufacturing is also provided.

title_en: A display support arm assembly for mounting a display
Hybrid screw with buffer zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screw having a shank, wherein the shank has a tip end and a rear end, and a screw thread, which is connected to the shank, and which winds around the shank, wherein a wedge groove is provided in the shank, which wedge groove winds around the shank and extends alongside at least a section of the screw thread, wherein the wedge groove is delimited by a rearwardly tapered wedge flank forwedging a grout shell surrounding the shank, characterized in that the shank has a buffer zone, which extends alongside the wedge flank and alongside the screw thread, and which adjoins the wedge flank and which adjoins the screw thread, wherein the rearward taper of the wedge flank is larger than the rearward taper of the buffer zone.

title_en: Guiding and centering device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a guiding and centering device (10) for a forming tool (2), in particular an injection molding or die-casting tool, comprising a first mold half (1) and a second mold half (5) which are guided by guide means (7) from a closed position in which the respective separating surfaces of both mold halves (1; 5) are pressed against one another into an opened position and vice versa. This guiding and centering device (10) comprises a protruding guiding body (4) formed as a circular cylindrical bolt (12) provided at the first mold half (1), a guiding recess (6) formed as a bush (14) with an circular cylindrical inner surface (20) provided at the second mold half (5) and a rolling element cage (16) with rolling elements (17) inserted in rows (18), by means of which the two mold halves (1; 5) are guided and precisely centered in the closed position. The rolling element cage (16) is supported by the circular cylindrical inner surface (20) of the bush (14) and positioned via positioning means (30) in such a way that when closing the forming tool the circular cylindrical bolt (12) runs practically simultaneously in a first row of rolling elements (18.1) and a second row of rolling elements (18.2) of the rolling element cage (16).

title_en: Compact conduit for clean room applications, and production method and sleeve unit for same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a conduit for a clean room application, comprising electric cables and comprising an elongate, flexible sheath which can be moved back and forth, in particular so as to form a deflecting bend between two towers, wherein the flexible sheath has a number of parallel receiving portions, each for at least one cable, wherein each receiving portion extends in the manner of a channel in a longitudinal direction from a first end to a second end; the method comprising at least the steps of: - providing at least one cable bundle of contiguous cables; and - providing the flexible sheath; characterised in that the sheath is prefabricated and the cable bundle is introduced into a receiving portion of the prefabricated sheath, wherein - the prefabricated sheath comprises at least one sleeve unit having two interacting closure profiles of a closure in order to close an open state in a dust-tight manner, and the cable bundle is inserted into the opened sheath transversely to the longitudinal direction; or - the prefabricated sheath comprises at least one sleeve unit which is produced so as to be circumferentially closed, and the cable bundle is drawn into the closed sleeve unit in the longitudinal direction.

title_en: Angle adjustment metal fitting and legless chair and sofa using same
abstract_en: An object is to provide an angle adjustment metal fitting enabling an angle to be adjusted without unfolding two unfoldable components to the horizontal position. A claw control member (60) has a position restricted so as not to rotate together while a second member (20) relatively rotates in a folding direction, and a meshing state between a gear portion (26) of a second member (20) and a toothed surface (35) of a claw member (30) is released. While the second member (20) then relatively rotates in an unfolding direction, the toothed surface (35) of the claw member (30) has a position restricted so as not to mesh with the gear portion (26) of the second member (20). When the second member (20) is then operated to be relatively rotated by a predetermined small angle in the folding direction, the toothed surface (35) of the claw member (30) mesh with the gear portion (26) of the second member (20) to restrict the relative rotation of the second member (20) in the unfolding direction.

title_en: Electrical connection plug, electrical connection device and electric vehicle
abstract_en: An electrical connection plug, an electrical connection device and an electric vehicle are provided in the present disclosure. The electrical connection plug includes a first fixing plate, a mounting base, an electrical connection assembly and a plurality of plug-in assemblies, the electrical connection assembly and the plurality of the plug-in assemblies are all connected to the mounting base, and the mounting base is in floating connection with the first fixing plate. The electrical connection device includes an electrical connection socket and the above electrical connection plug, the electrical connection assembly and the plurality of plug-in assemblies are all connected to the electrical connection socket. The electric vehicle includes a battery pack, a vehicle body and the above electrical connection device, the electrical connection plug is connected to the vehicle body, and the electrical connection socket is connected to the battery pack. The present disclosure realizes the water connection and the electrical connection at the same time, thereby reducing the actual usage space, solving the problem of the actual mounting space, and reducing the cost. Further, abnormalities such as electrical connection failure or burnout, as well as liquid outflow and splashing, are effectively avoided.

title_en: Pipe joint
abstract_en: To provide a pipe joint that can immediately shut off a hydrogen gas flow path at an initial stage when a plug (nozzle side member) comes out of a socket (filling apparatus side member) to prevent release of outgas. A pipe joint (100) of the present invention includes: a cylindrical nozzle side member (10) with a shutoff valve (5), in the cylindrical nozzle side member (10) being formed a passage (1A); and a cylindrical filling apparatus side member (20) with a shutoff valve (24), in the cylindrical filling apparatus side member (20) being formed a passage (21A), wherein when the nozzle side member (10) and the filling apparatus side member (20) are connected with each other, central axes of the passages (1A, 21A) of the nozzle side member (10) and the filling apparatus side member (20) do not form a same straight line, and the central axes of the passages (1A, 21A) are offset without intersecting, and the shutoff valves (5, 24) of the both members (10, 20) open to communicate the passages (1A, 21A) of the both members (10, 20) with each other, and when the nozzle side member (10) is separated from the filling apparatus side member (20) , the shutoff valves (5, 24) of the both members (10, 20) close.

title_en: Reduction/reverse gear
abstract_en: To optimize a clutch connection control for clutches (15, 16) of a forward/reverse rotation switching mechanism (17). A reduction reverse gear (9) includes a hydraulic clutch-type forward/reverse rotation switching mechanism (17) that converts rotation power of a main engine (7) mounted on a hull (2) to an output of forward rotation, neutral, or reverse rotation and transfers the output to a propeller (5), a forward/reverse rotation switching valve (24) that controls operation of the forward/reverse rotation switching mechanism (17), and a trolling device (36) that controls pressure of working oil into the forward/reverse rotation switching mechanism (17). When the forward/reverse rotation switching valve (24) is switched to a forward (F) or reverse rotation position (R) during normal propulsion, the trolling device (36) controls a pattern that reduces pressure of working oil into the forward/reverse rotation switching mechanism (17) so that the pattern is different between when the forward/reverse rotation switching valve (24) is in the forward rotation position (F) and when it is in the reverse rotation position (R).

title_en: Disposable cartridge and pump track mechanism
abstract_en: Disclosed are example embodiments of a dialysis machine having a frame, a cartridge cassette, one or more alignment-locking features, and an actuation mechanism. The frame is fixedly coupled to the dialysis machine, and the cassette is slidably coupled to the frame. The cassette can have one or more track structures, with each of the one or more track structures having a rotor and one or more rollers. The one or more alignment-locking features extend from the frame and are configured to be inserted into one or more alignment features of a disposable cartridge that functions to secure or release the disposable cartridge. The actuation mechanism is made to slide the cassette with respect to the one or more track structures.

title_en: Interface device for an inflatable individual safety device
abstract_en: Interface device (25) for an inflatable individual safety device (10) designed to hold a gas generator (30) in a receiving part (20) of the inflatable individual safety device (10), characterized in that it comprises: - at least one positioning element (26) designed to position and hold the gas generator (30) in a final mounting position in the receiving part (20), - a sealing element (28) arranged between the receiving part (20) and the gas generator (30) positioned and held by the at least one positioning element (26), in order to obtain a seal in an internal space of the safety device to be inflated by the gas generator (30).

title_en: Foldable electronic device including display
abstract_en: An electronic device including a foldable housing including a first housing, a second housing, and a connection structure; a flexible display; a first plate including at least a portion disposed on a lower end of a first area of the display and a first periphery; a second plate including at least a portion disposed on a lower end of a second area of the display, and a second periphery; and a protection layer. When the electronic device is in an unfolded state, the first periphery and the second periphery are configured to be in contact with the display. When the electronic device pivots from the unfolded state to a folded state, the first periphery and the second periphery are configured to be spaced apart from the display, and the protection layer is configured to cover an area of the display exposed between the first periphery and the second periphery.

title_en: Axle assembly
abstract_en: An axle assembly for a working machine is provided. The axle assembly has an axle housing comprising a central portion housing a gear, wherein the gear is configured to rotate about an axis and is configured to be partially disposed in a lubricant reservoir, and at least one arm portion extending from the central portion, the arm portion housing at least one driveshaft. The axle assembly further comprising a conduit assembly configured to direct lubricant from the central portion to the arm portion, the conduit assembly comprising a lubricant catcher having an inlet disposed in an interior volume of the central portion.

title_en: Limited volume coaxial valve block
abstract_en: A compact valve block for a chemical container wherein the coaxial valve block has a housing that can accommodate three valve control mechanisms thus allowing for quick and effective purging without the need for an additional external conduit, valves, and coaxial injector. The advantage is a greatly reduced amount of wetted surface area inside the valve block leading to a significant decrease in the time it takes to purge a system thus allowing for quicker times to change chemical containers.

title_en: Roller bearing
abstract_en: A generatrix shape to which crowning is applied includes a first generatrix shape which is formed in a central portion in an axial direction of at least one of an outer ring raceway surface, an inner ring raceway surface, and a rolling surface of a roller and is composed of a straight line, a pair of second generatrix shapes which are formed from both ends in the axial direction toward the outside in the axial direction of the first generatrix shape and are composed of a single arc curve, and a pair of third generatrix shapes which are formed from both ends in the axial direction toward the outside in the axial direction of the second generatrix shape and are composed of a composite curve of a single arc curve and a logarithmic curve.

title_en: Fuel storage module assembly
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for producing a hydrogen storage vessel that is lightweight. The hydrogen storage vessel may comprise an inner body and an outer body structured as concentric rings with a conic interface. The vessel may have four material layers, including a barrier layer, an insulation layer, a fiber knit, and an abrasion layer. The fiber knit may be braided to trap the hydrogen, as the barrier layer may not be completely impermeable. Additionally, the fiber braid may be clamped to the outer body, enabling pressure pushing on the inner body to wedge and seal the storage vessel.

title_en: Unloading valve and combined-valve-type buffer oil cylinder
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of hydraulic cylinders and in particular to an unloading valve and a combined valve type buffer cylinder. The unloading valve includes a valve body, a valve trim, a return spring, a damping hole, and an unloading groove. A combined valve includes the unloading valve and a throttling valve. The throttling valve includes a buffer stopper and a buffer chamber. A piston rod assembly of the combined valve type buffer cylinder is provided in a cylinder body. The cylinder body includes a cylinder head flange, a cylinder bottom, and a cylinder barrel. The piston rod assembly includes a guide sleeve, a piston, and a piston rod. The combined valve is provided on the cylinder. According to the technical solutions, the present disclosure increases an unloading function of an oil inlet chamber, achieves a desirable buffering effect, and reduces buffering pressure. The system is located in an unloading state in a buffering process, so the present disclosure reduces the energy loss and heat buildup of the system, prevents the pressure impact of buffering on the system, makes the system more reliable, and lowers the difficulty of the original buffer valve in performance matching, installation and debugging.

title_en: Friction spacer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a friction spacer adapted to be interposed between two mechanical components in order to be able to transfer a force between the two mechanical components, the friction spacer comprising a flat part (20) having two opposite surfaces (18) defining a thickness, and a plurality of protuberances (16) projecting from at least one of the surfaces (18), the protuberances (16) of the plurality of protuberances extending from said at least one of the opposite surfaces (18) by a determined average height. The flat part (20) and the protuberances (16) are produced from the same metal material, and the same metal material continuously extends between the flat part (20) and the protuberances (16).

title_en: Electromechanical braking mechanism for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electromechanical braking mechanism (1) for a motor vehicle, comprising an adjusting device (5) and a brake part (32) which is connected thereto and can be adjusted by the adjusting device (5) along an axis (A) and brought in braking engagement with a counter-brake part (2), wherein: the adjusting device (5) has a first adjusting drive (6) and a second adjusting drive (7) serially coupled thereto; the first adjusting drive (6) has a first drive wheel (65) that can be driven to rotate and that can in turn drive a first output element (62), and a first drive element (61) which can be axially adjusted in relation thereto, in such a way that they rotate in relation to each other, and the second adjusting drive (7) has a rotatingly drivable second drive wheel (75) that is coaxial with the first drive wheel and that can rotatingly drive a threaded spindle (71) having a spindle thread (77) that engages an internal thread (78) of the first adjusting drive (6). In order to create a more compact and less complex design, according to the invention, the threaded spindle (71) and the second drive wheel (75) have corresponding, meshing form-fitting elements (73, 76) that are designed to produce a form-fit effective in the peripheral direction with respect to the rotation about the axis (A) and that can be axially moved in relation to each other.

title_en: Systems and devices for controlling and monitoring liquid applications of agricultural fields
abstract_en: Described herein are systems and devices for controlling and monitoring liquid applications of agricultural fields. In one embodiment, an implement (200; 1240) has a fluid storage tank (250; 1290) and row units (210-217), each row unit has a flow device (1600; 1700; 1900; 2000) including an offset ball valve (1650; 1750; 1850; 1950; 2050). The offset ball valve has multiple openings (1751, 1753; 1851, 1853; 1951, 1953; 2051, 2053) that rotate in position to control flow of liquid through the offset ball valve to an outlet passage (1630; 1730; 1830; 1930; 2030) for an application of the liquid to the field. The multiple openings each comprise a cylindrical shaped bore and are positioned in relation to each other with a configurable angle of 10 to 40 degrees.

title_en: Pressure vessel comprising an interior chamber, and method for manufacturing a pressure vessel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pressure vessel (1) comprising an interior chamber (30), in particular for storing hydrogen, said vessel comprising a vessel wall (12) which has a composite material unit (14, 22, 26) that comprises reinforcing fibres (16) and a thermoplastic plastics matrix (18) or consists thereof, wherein the composite material unit (14, 22, 26) is arranged and designed such that the reinforcing fibres (16), in the form of continuous fibres, are removable, in particular non-destructively, such that the composite material unit is reusable.

title_en: Electronic expansion valve
abstract_en: An electronic expansion valve, including: a valve seat (10), wherein the valve seat (10) is provided with a first mounting channel extending in an axial direction, and a valve port is provided in the first mounting channel; a valve needle (20), which is movably mounted in the first mounting channel to block or avoid of the valve port, wherein a mounting gap is provided between a wall surface of the first mounting channel and an outer wall of the valve needle (20); and a first sealing piece (41), which is mounted on the valve needle (20), wherein the first sealing piece (41) is located in the mounting gap, so as to seal the mounting gap by means of the first sealing piece (41). The electronic expansion valve can solve the technical problems in the related art of poor sealing performance of an electronic expansion valve and a valve needle being prone to moving.

title_en: Deflecting arc
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deflecting arc (1) for a downpipe (2) for discharging a multi-phase flow medium (S), in particular a flow medium made of water, solids, and air, comprising a first pipe section (3) which extends along a first central axis (M1); a curved section (4) which adjoins the first pipe section (3) and has a curve outer section (5) and a curve inner section (6), said curved section extending along a central line (M) which is curved about at least one curve axis (K); a second pipe section (7) which adjoins the curved section (4) and which extends along a second central axis (M2); a flow divider (8) which is arranged on the interior of the first pipe section and which comprises two guide surfaces (9, 10) that run away from each other, wherein the flow divider (8) is designed to break down the film flow of the flow medium; and a guide structure (11) which is arranged on the interior of the curve outer section (5) for guiding the flow medium in the curved section (4). The guide structure (11) has a channel-shaped guide section (12) and at least two guide steps (13) with step surfaces (14) on each face of the channel-shaped guide section (12), and the guide surfaces (9, 10) of the flow divider (8) and the step surfaces (14) are arranged relative to one another such that a sub-volume of an annular flow which has been broken down by the flow divider (8) is guided to the step surfaces (14).

title_en: Line clamp
abstract_en: The present invention generally relates to line clamps designed to be utilized in a variety of applications including, but not limited to, aerospace applications, vehicle applications, marine applications, etc. In one embodiment, the line clamp of the present invention satisfies the performance requirements as specified in MIL-DTL-85052/1C and MIL-DTL-85052B. In another embodiment, the line clamp of the present invention is comprised of a line clamp core component and a line clamp cushion component that together form a line clamp with improved longevity and fitment.

title_en: Pierce nut
abstract_en:
A pierce nut includes a main body, a plateau portion, and a pilot portion. 
     The plateau portion is provided around the center of a flat surface of the main body and has a thin-plate shape. The pilot portion protrudes in an extending direction, around the center of a terrace surface of the plateau portion. The terrace surface of the plateau portion is formed to be raised from the flat surface. A gap (16, 116, 216) is formed around a neck portion (15, 115, 215) between the plateau portion and the pilot portion, due to connection between an outer circumference surface (32, 132) of the pilot portion and the terrace surface of the plateau portion through the neck portion (15, 115, 215). On a first intersection plane (PL11, PL21) intersecting the extending direction, the pilot portion has a first cross-sectional shape with n corners, n being a natural number that is equal to or larger than 4.

title_en: Damper with attached valve
abstract_en: A damper (102) includes an outer tube (104) elongated along an axis (A), a cylinder (106) elongated along the axis (A) within the outer tube (104), a piston (108) disposed in the cylinder (106) and movable along the axis (A), an intermediate tube (110) attached concentrically around the cylinder (106), a ring (112) press-fitted around an outer diameter of the intermediate tube (110), and a valve (114) attached to the outer tube (104). The intermediate tube (110) and the cylinder (106) define an intermediate chamber (116) radially between the cylinder (106) and the intermediate tube (110). The valve (114) is in fluid communication with the intermediate chamber (116). The intermediate tube (110) includes an intermediate-tube opening (118) extending radially through the intermediate tube (110). The ring (112) includes a ring opening (120) extending radially through the ring (112). The ring opening (120) is aligned with the intermediate-tube opening (118. The valve (114) is in fluid communication with the intermediate chamber (116) through the ring opening (120) and the intermediate-tube opening (118).

title_en: Harmonic drive, method of measuring torque in harmonic drive, and robot
abstract_en: A harmonic drive includes: a wave generator; a circular spline provided with internal teeth; a flexible spline provided between the wave generator and the circular spline and configured to be engaged with the internal teeth of the circular spline; and a plurality sets of torque sensors. Each set of torque sensors includes a plurality of strain gauges, each set of torque sensors is respectively configured to measure torque transmitted by the harmonic drive during rotation of the flexible spline. Signals measured by each of the plurality sets of torque sensors include a torque ripple, and the plurality sets of torque sensors are alternatively arranged. The harmonic drive further includes a processor configured to calculate a true torque transmitted by the harmonic drive based on signals measured by the plurality sets of torque sensors. The torque ripple is excluded from the true torque.

title_en: Transmission for a wind turbine
abstract_en: A transmission comprises a fixed gear ring, a first drive member that defines a plurality of bores, each of which accommodates a tooth element. A second drive member extends within the first drive member, and defines a cam surface or profile which engages each of the plurality of tooth elements. A body region of the tooth elements comprises: a generally cylindrical first body portion proximate the tooth tip region, a generally cylindrical second body portion distal from the tooth tip region, wherein the first body portion and second body portion are spaced apart along a body axis (A), a reduced-mass portion intermediate the first and second body portions. The reduced mass portion comprises an external surface. An imaginary cylindrical surface extends between the generally cylindrical first body portion and the generally cylindrical second body portion, and wherein the external surface of the reduced mass portion shares less than 95% of its surface area with the imaginary cylindrical surface.

title_en: A twist device regulator
abstract_en: This invention relates to a rotation regulator for twist devices used in applications such as levers, joysticks, or handbrakes. It features a central stem (1) that withstands rotational forces, with a static enclosure (4) securely fixed to the top of the stem and a dynamic enclosure (3) that rotates around the same axis, supported by a bearing (12) for smooth motion. A spring (5) is attached to the static enclosure, generating the necessary load during rotational movements. The device also includes a gasket (7) positioned on the stem to minimize friction and provide rotational resistance. Lower and upper brackets (8, 9), attached to the dynamic enclosure, form a movable jaw-like structure around the stem. A socket head cap screw (16) adjusts the pressure applied by the brackets, allowing for precise control of the dynamic enclosure's rotational resistance. This adjustable resistance makes the device highly customizable, offering fine-tuned control for various manual applications requiring smooth and regulated rotational movement.

title_en: Side collision buffering mechanism and child safety seat
abstract_en: A side impact buffering mechanism and a child safety seat including the same are provided. A locking portion on a buffer member can be inserted into an accommodating cavity on a base through an insertion port on the base, and then rotated to cause an elastic locking member in the accommodating cavity to engage with a locking groove on the locking portion, so that the buffer member is kept in a locked position relative to the base. As such, the reliability of connection between the buffer member and the base can be improved, and the buffer member does not easily fall off during use, and can be conveniently mounted. To remove and replace the buffer member, a user only needs to apply a force to the buffer member to rotate the buffer member and the locking portion, so that the locking portion causes the elastic locking member to deform, and the locking groove is gradually separated and misaligned from the elastic locking member; and then pull the buffer member outward to cause the locking portion to exit the accommodating cavity through the insertion port, thus removing the buffer member from the base. As such, the buffer member can be more conveniently removed.

title_en: Joint and furniture
abstract_en: The invention relates to a joint (1) and to furniture with the joint. The joint comprises at least one first connection element (12, 12', 72, 15, 19) and the at least one second connection element (32, 32', 33, 36, 37) arranged to form a mortise and tenon joint between a first joint member (10, 70) and a second joint member (30). The first joint member (10, 70) is provided with a first shaft hole (20) formed as a long hole. The second joint member (30) is provided with a second shaft hole (40). A first shaft (50) arranged to the first and second shaft holes (20, 40) and arranged to lock the first and second joint members (10, 70, 30) to each other. The first shaft (50) being arranged stationary to the second shaft hole (40) and displaceable in the first shaft hole (20).

title_en: An actuator based on magnetic shape memory material
abstract_en: An actuator comprises a toothed rack (101) and a body element (102) such that the toothed rack and the body element are moveable with respect to each other. The actuator comprises tooth plates (104-107) moveably supported with respect to the body element. Each tooth plate is moveable back and forth towards and away from the toothed rack. The actuator comprises magnetic shape memory elements (108-111) between the body element and the tooth plates, and coils (112-115) for directing a magnetic field to each magnetic shape memory element to change its length (L108). The toothed rack and/or the tooth plates have oblique tooth surfaces so that forces directed by the tooth plates to the toothed rack cause forces for moving the toothed rack and the body element with respect to each other. A motion range of the actuator is not limited by properties of the magnetic shape memory elements.

title_en: Continuously variable transmission with both equal-difference output and equal-ratio output
abstract_en: A continuously variable transmission comprising an input mechanism 1, a hydraulic transmission mechanism 2, a planetary-gear-set convergence mechanism 3, an equal-difference output mechanism 4, an equal-ratio output mechanism 5, a clutch assembly C1-11, and a brake B. The clutch assembly connects an output end of the input mechanism to an input end of the hydraulic transmission mechanism and the planetary-gear-set convergence mechanism and connects an output end of the hydraulic transmission mechanism to the planetary-gear-set convergence mechanism. The clutch assembly connects the planetary-gear-set convergence mechanism to the equal-difference output mechanism and the equal-ratio output mechanism. The clutch assembly connects the equal-ratio output mechanism to the equal-difference output mechanism. A continuously changing transmission ratio between the input mechanism and the equal-difference output mechanism and/or between the input mechanism and the equal-ratio output mechanism is provided by adjusting a displacement ratio of the hydraulic transmission mechanism and selectively controlling engagement of the clutch assembly and the brake. The hydro-mechanical hybrid transmission of the present application may be used in agricultural machinery and military vehicles.

title_en: A method and system for enhanced braking in a tractor unit
abstract_en: A method and control system for controlling the braking effort of a tractor unit relative to the braking effort of a trailer. The vehicle may be an agricultural tractor including a hydrostatic continuously variable transmission (CVT) with a speed control mode (e.g. for cruise control), and the trailer brakes may be hydraulic. The method comprises activating an enhanced braking mode in the tractor unit, e.g. “trailer stretch mode” to prevent jack-knifing by increasing the distance between the tractor and trailer. Whilst in the enhanced braking mode, a braking command is received from an operator input device (e.g. brake pedal, joystick) and the method includes increasing a tractor speed demand whilst receiving this braking command. Due to the increased speed demand, the braking effort applied to the tractor unit is reduced relative to the trailer braking. The increased speed demand may cause a vehicle speed set-point to be set above the current vehicle speed (i.e. tractor vehicle required to accelerate despite braking command). The vehicle transmission may be controlled by the system, with application of a transmission ratio providing the increase in speed demand, for example based on transmission ratio gradients from look-up tables.

title_en: Cryogenic thermo-structural insulation system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a cryogenic storage tank including an inner wall 50 and an outer wall 54 defining a space, wherein the space is filled at least in part with dried-in-place hollow glass microspheres 58 which provides both insulating and structural properties to maintain the space, and methods for forming the cryogenic storage tank. In some embodiments, the glass microspheres may be applied by wrapping the first wall in a flexible bladder (52, figure 3) then injecting a putty comprising the glass microspheres in a volatile organic solvent, before driving off the solvent to form a high angle of repose material.

title_en: Control method for reducing water waste in water heating systems, and corresponding control device and recirculation valve
abstract_en: The present patent of invention aimed at environment protection relates to a control method for reducing water waste in hot water installations, implemented by a recirculation valve and/or control device, by the temperature-dependent control and direction of the flow of water, for use at any point where hot water is made available, in order to recirculate the cold water or the water that has not been heated to the desired temperature in the hot water pipes between the consumption and heating points, avoiding any waste and with the advantage of being entirely mechanical, dispensing with all electrical installations and dedicated hydraulic installations.

title_en: Developing roller, developing device, and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a developing roller that prevents the occurrence of white stripes and is excellent in storage stability, a developing device, and an image forming apparatus.SOLUTION: A developing roller comprises an elastic layer 12, an intermediate layer 13, and a coating layer 15 on an outer peripheral surface of a shaft body 11. The elastic layer 12 is formed of solid silicone rubber having semiconductivity. The intermediate layer 13 is formed of a urethane resin containing restorable particles 14 with a restoration rate of 16% or more and 100% or less. The coating layer 15 is formed of a thermosetting resin.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Fuel pump
abstract_en: To provide a fuel pump which prevents a metal worn piece from exerting an adverse effect on a movable part of the fuel pump without making the metal worn piece resulting from slide rotation hardly generated since a washer is held on a bearing, and slide-rotates with respect to an intermediate member even if the bearing is formed by sintering metal powder, in the fuel pump in which a rotor of a motor part has the synthetic resin-made intermediate member interposed between a magnet and a motor shaft, and connecting the magnet to the motor shaft, and the metal-made washer is gripped between relatively-opposing faces of the intermediate member and the bearing which is fixed to a pump case.SOLUTION: When setting a friction coefficient between a washer 40 and an intermediate member 37 as μ1, setting a friction coefficient between the washer 40 and a bearing 51 as μ2, setting an outside diameter of a contact part between the washer 40 and the intermediate member 37 as D1, and setting an outside diameter of a contact part between the washer 40 and the bearing 51 as D2, the washer 40, the intermediate member 37 and the bearing 51 are constituted so as to satisfy a relationship of D1/D2<μ2/μ1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Check valve
abstract_en: To provide a check valve where a valve element can be arranged in a spray liquid supply path of a spray lever so that the inclination and decentering of the valve element are reliably prevented to stably actualize the slide of the valve element and the contact with a valve seat.SOLUTION: The check valve includes a valve seat 4, a valve element 5 including a disc-shaped body part 5a, a boss part 5b and a seal member 5c for contacting/departing the valve seat, and a coil spring 6 for energizing the valve element 5 toward the valve seat 4, in which a first centering component 7 connected to the boss part 5b of the valve element and a second centering component 8 assembled in a second pipe joint are provided. A movement guide 7b of the first centering component 7 is made to slidably contact a guide hole 2a, and additionally a guide shaft 5d of the valve element 5 is slidably inserted through a shaft hole 8a of the second centering component 8 to position the valve element 5 at both front and rear sides on the axial center of the check valve.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Conical rolling bearing
abstract_en: To restrict the amounts of depression of a conical roller and a holder due to their dead weights to reduce a generation amount of a gap between a large end surface of a conical roller and a flange surface of a flange part, upon assembling an outer ring so as to install a flange side of the outer ring on a top side and install a small diameter side of the outer ring on a ground side.SOLUTION: In a conical roller bearing 1, of four end parts of a small diameter side end part and a large diameter side end part of an outer ring raceway surface 2a of an outer ring 2, and a small diameter side end part and a large diameter side end part of an inner ring raceway surface 3a of an inner ring 3, a flange part 2b protruding inward in a radial direction is formed at the large diameter side end part of the outer ring raceway surface 2a of the outer ring 2. The conical roller bearing is configured such that a large diameter ring part 5a of a holder 5 is provided with a protruding part 5f that engages with the large diameter side end surface of the outer ring 2, to restrict the amounts of depression of a conical roller 4 and the holder 5 due to their dead weights, to reduce a gap generated between the large end surface of the conical roller 4 and the flange surface of the flange part 2b.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Control device
abstract_en: To suppress the erroneous detection of an abnormal condition of an SLC.SOLUTION: A vehicle is equipped with: a forward/backward traveling switching device that switches rotations from a power source of the vehicle in a forward/backward traveling direction of the vehicle to output it; a shift lever that receives forward/backward traveling switching operation from a user; a forward/backward traveling switching valve that outputs hydraulic pressure for switching in the forward/backward traveling direction according to the switching operation to the forward/backward traveling switching device; an SLC that adjusts supply hydraulic pressure to the forward/backward traveling switching valve; a sequence valve that switches the supply hydraulic pressure to the forward/backward traveling switching valve to hydraulic pressure adjusted to a predetermined pressure or another hydraulic pressure; and a sensor for detecting difference of input/output rotation speed of the forward/backward traveling switching device. An ECU controls the sequence valve to switch the supply hydraulic pressure to the forward/backward traveling switching valve from the hydraulic pressure from the SLC to the other hydraulic pressure (S111 to 113) when the difference of the input/output rotation speed is a predetermined value or more, and determines that the SLC is not under an abnormal condition (S115 and 116) when the difference of the input/output rotation speed is kept at the predetermined value or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Tensioner lever
abstract_en: To provide a tensioner lever not needing an extra component and preventing an arm portion of a coil spring from striking a worker.SOLUTION: When a tensioner lever 5 is mounted on a cylinder block 1 in a state in which an arm portion 16 at a cylinder block 1 side, of a coil spring 13 is locked by a locking portion 12 of a lever main body 10, a projection 18 disposed on the arm portion 16 of the coil spring 13 is brought into contact with the cylinder block 1, and the arm portion 16 is pushed out from an opening side of the locking portion 12 of the lever main body 10, thus the locking of the arm portion 16 is released, and the released arm portion 16 is brought into contact with the cylinder block 1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Lockup device of torque converter
abstract_en: To provide a lockup device of a torque converter which can easily and surely establish spline fitment for reducing the mutual rotation of a lockup piston and an input-side clutch holding part.SOLUTION: A lockup device of a torque converter has a mutual rotation prevention mechanism for preventing the mutual rotation of a lockup piston and an input-side clutch holding part 20, and the mutual rotation prevention mechanism is constituted by the spline fitment of outer teeth arranged at an external periphery of a first retainer plate 61 of a spring pack, and inner teeth arranged at an internal periphery of the input-side clutch holding part adjoining an external periphery of the first retainer plate, and engaged with the outer teeth arranged at the external periphery of the first retainer plate. When assembling the lockup piston to the input-side clutch holding part, the fitment of a portion of the spline fitment of the first retainer plate and the input-side clutch holding part precedes the connection of the other portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9A

title_en: refrigerator
abstract_en: To provide a refrigerator hardly conducting heat conducted through a vacuum heat insulating material to an appearance surface, suppressing temperature reduction, improving moisture condensation proof, and increased in flexibility in the shape of the appearance surface.SOLUTION: A refrigerator includes a heat insulation door 17 opening/closing a front surface opening part (not shown) of a refrigerator body (not shown). The heat insulation door 17 includes an inner panel part 32, a front panel part 33, an edge frame part 34 covering the outer peripheries of the inner panel part 32 and the front panel 33, and a vacuum heat insulation material 35 provided among the inner panel part 32, the edge frame part 34 and the front panel part 33. A left side surface 34c constituting part of the edge frame part 34 includes: an appearance surface 81 forming an appearance; an inside surface 82 forming the inner side of the heat insulation door 17 on the reverse side of an appearance surface 81; and an adhesive surface 83 bonded to the vacuum heat insulation material 35. A space part 84 is provided between the inside surface 82 and the adhesive surface 83.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8A

title_en: Service vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a service vehicle which enables downsizing of a power transmission unit.SOLUTION: A service vehicle includes: a power transmission unit 22 having a differential gear 24 which transmits power to left and right axles 21 and a power transmission mechanism 25 which transmits power to the differential gear 24; and a transmission shaft 23 which transmits power to the power transmission unit 22. The power transmission mechanism 25 has: a first gear mechanism 28 to which power from the transmission shaft 23 is transmitted; and a second gear mechanism 29 which transmits power from the first gear mechanism 28 to the differential gear 24.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Frictional engagement device
abstract_en: To provide a frictional engagement device capable of suppressing deterioration of responsiveness in torque transmission caused by deformation of a disc and a plate, while suppressing increase of inertia mass.SOLUTION: In a frictional engagement device 1 including: first discs 3 mounted on first members 5, 5a; second discs 2 mounted on second members 9, 9a; a stopper 7 receiving pressing force by a pressing member 12 and holding each of the discs 2, 3 with the pressing member 12; and a coming-off prevention member 6 for preventing coming-off of the stopper 7, a supporting portion 8 for supporting the stopper 7 by contact with an inner peripheral portion of the stopper 7 or an outer peripheral portion of the stopper 7 with respect to a part of contact of the coming-off prevention member 6 and the stopper 7 in a radial direction, in a state that the discs 2, 3 are pressed by the pressing member 12 and the stopper 7 and the coming-off prevention member 6 are kept into contact with each other, is disposed on at least one side of the first members 5, 5a and the second members 9, 9a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Pressure-resistant device and fluid pressure cylinder
abstract_en: To improve molding accuracy and durability of a pressure-resistant device.SOLUTION: A cylinder 100 includes: a cylinder bottom 120 which has a base part 121 and an annular wall part 122 protruding from the base part 121 and in which the wall part 122 is joined to a cylinder tube 110 to close an opening of the cylinder tube 110; a back ring 140 which is provided facing at least one of an inner peripheral surface 110b of the cylinder tube 110 and an inner peripheral surface 122b of the wall part 122 and which determines a relative position between the cylinder tube 110 and the cylinder bottom 120; and a groove part 124 formed on an inner surface of the cylinder bottom 120. The groove part 124 has: a first groove part 124a formed on the inner peripheral surface 122b of the wall part 122; and a second groove part 124b which is continuous with the first groove part 124a and formed on a bottom surface 121a of the base part 121.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Recirculating ball screw rotary actuator
abstract_en: To provide a compact rotary actuator having high torque efficiency and low friction features.SOLUTION: A rotary actuator for a hinged panel assembly of a fixed-wing aircraft includes ball bearings, an outer cylinder, a piston and an inner shaft. The cylinder admits fluid pressure from a fluid pressure supply device. The piston is surrounded by the cylinder. The piston, the cylinder and the ball bearings integrally form an outer ball screw. The piston translates along a longitudinal center axis according to the fluid pressure. The shaft is surrounded by the piston, and the shaft, the piston and the ball bearings integrally form an inner ball screw that is concentric with the outer ball screw. The ball screws form an interlaced ball circuit with one or more shared ball paths. Piston translation rotates the piston and the shaft to recirculate the ball bearings between the outer and inner ball screws through the interlaced ball circuit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Refrigeration cycle device
abstract_en: To provide a small refrigeration cycle device.SOLUTION: A refrigeration cycle device includes: a compressor 21 compressing a refrigerant; a decompression part 23 decompressing the refrigerant; heat exchangers 22, 24 exchanging heat between the refrigerant and ambient air; and refrigerant piping 70 providing an annular refrigerant flow passage by connecting the compressor, the decompression part and the heat exchanger. The refrigerant piping includes: compressor side piping 71 extending continuously from the compressor; heat exchanger side piping 72 extending continuously from the heat exchanger; and vibration isolating piping 80 provided between the compressor side piping and the heat exchanger side piping and reducing vibration transmitted from the compressor to the heat exchanger. The vibration isolating piping is piping configured by using a softer material than that of the compressor side piping. Length from an axial end part to a central part of the vibration isolating piping is shorter than an outer dimension of the vibration isolating piping. Due to this configuration, the small refrigeration cycle device can be provided.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Ball joint
abstract_en: To reduce a mold width of a housing mold for insert molding of a ball joint.SOLUTION: A ball joint J1 includes: a ball stud 10 formed by integrally joining a ball part 10b to the other end part of a stud part 10s connected at one end part with a structure; and a resin housing 21 which has an inner spherical surface 21a including the ball part 10b through a ball seat 30 and has an opening space from which the stud part 10s joined to the ball part 10b protrudes. The housing 21 includes: a body part 21b having the inner spherical surface 21a; a flange part 21d protruding in an annular form on an outer peripheral surface of the body part 21b; a dome part 21g protruding in a semi-spherical form below the flange part 21d; and a bar grip part 21j having a connection part 21h connected to the flange part 21d.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Apparatus for fixing pressure vessel
abstract_en: To provide a pressure vessel fixing apparatus for fixing a pressure vessel to an object.SOLUTION: The apparatus includes: a frame member to be fixed to the object; a first locking part to lock one axial end of the pressure vessel to the frame member; and a second locking part to lock another axial end of the pressure vessel to the frame member. Therefore, it is possible to obtain an advantageous effect of simplifying the structure and improving the degree of design freedom and spatial utilization.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: power transmission device
abstract_en: To inhibit directions of torque of respective output shafts from being opposed to each other when transmitting power via a differential device.SOLUTION: A power transmission device includes: a first input shaft for inputting power from a first power source; a second input shaft for inputting power from a second power source; a first output shaft for transmitting power to a first driving wheel; a second output shaft for transmitting power to a second driving wheel; and a differential device having a first rotary element to which the second input shaft is connected; a second rotary element to which the second output shaft is connected, and a third rotary element to which the first input shaft and the first output shaft are connected, as three rotary elements, and further includes an engagement device for selectively connecting any two of the three rotary elements.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: bracket
abstract_en: To provide a bracket which enables improvement of workability of a connection end.SOLUTION: A bracket includes: a vehicle body fixture part fixed to a vehicle body; a connection fixing part which is connected to the vehicle body fixture part and to which a connection part connecting a connection end of an extension part disposed in a vehicle is fixed; and a rib disposed in a contact inhibition range from a fixing position of the connection part to a tool engagement portion of the connection end in the vehicle body fixture part and the connection fixing part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Angular ball bearing
abstract_en: To provide an angular ball bearing which can make sufficiently compatible both high-speed rotation performance and a load capacity while being the same as a prior art in fundamental dimensions of an inside diameter, an outside diameter and a width of the bearing.SOLUTION: An angular ball bearing has a plurality of balls 3 interposed between raceway surfaces 1a, 2a of an inner ring 1 and an outer ring 2, and the balls 3 are held in pockets Pt which are formed in a plurality of points of a cylindrical cage 4 in a circumferential direction. Then, a ratio of an inter-ball distance Pd which is obtained by subtracting a diameter Da of the ball 3 from a distance PC between centers of the adjacent balls 3, 3 with respect to a dimension Da of the ball 3 is equal or larger than 0.16, and equal to or smaller than 0.35. Also, a ratio of an inner-ring groove curvature radius Ri which is obtained by dividing a diameter Di of a groove 1g of the raceway surface 1a of the inner ring 1 by the diameter Da of the ball 3 with respect to an outer-ring groove curvature radius Ro which is obtained by dividing a diameter Do of a groove 2g of the raceway surface 2a of the outer ring 2 by the diameter Da of the ball 3 is equal to or larger than 0.97, and equal to or smaller than 0.99.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2C

title_en: Flow control valve and cooling system
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a flow control valve capable of reducing the torque when a valve body in a housing is driven to rotate. 
     SOLUTION: A flow control valve of a cooling circuit for a motor or inverter for vehicle driving comprises: a housing which has a valve body accommodation part, a main communication hole, and a sub communication hole; a valve body which has a fluid inflow part, a main opening part that the fluid inflow part and the main communication hole communicate with, and a sub opening part which links the fluid inflow part and sub communication hole; a driving mechanism; and a seal member. The valve body is driven to rotate to have: a first rotational position where the main communication hole and main opening part, and the sub communication hole and sub opening part do not overlap each other; a second rotational position where the main communication hole and main opening part overlap each other and the sub communication hole and sub opening part do not overlap each other to cause a fluid to leak out through a gap part; and a third rotational position where the main communication hole and main opening part, and the sub communication hole and sub opening part overlap each other, in which the gap part always communicates with the sub communication hole, and at the second rotational position, the main communication hole and fluid inflow part communicate with each other, the fluid inflow part and gap part communicate with each other, and the gap part and sub communication hole communicate with each other. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: regulator
abstract_en: To provide a regulator for avoiding the influences of a change in supply pressure on discharge pressure even when the front end inner peripheral face on the valve seat side of a relief valve element has a flat shape.SOLUTION: A front end inner peripheral face 51 of a relief valve element 5 at its contact side with a valve seat 31 is flat, an annular groove 55 having predetermined depth L1 and width L2 is formed at an installation site of a high pressure fuel airtight seal 9 on an outer peripheral face 54 of the relief valve element 5, and the diameter (seat diameter) 53 of the front end surface of a thickness center as a contact part of the relief valve element 5 with the valve seat 31 is the same as the inner diameter of the high pressure fuel airtight seal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Falling prevention tool
abstract_en: To provide a falling prevention tool capable of being mounted easily, and hard to come off from a bolt or nut.SOLUTION: A falling prevention tool 1 prevents a bolt or nut from falling out. The falling prevention tool 1 has an annular part 2 that is press-fitted onto a screw part of the bolt.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Air control device
abstract_en: To provide an air control device which enables air to freely flow in a bidirectional manner between a first air guide passage and a second air guide passage and is also capable of surely preventing air from flowing between the first air guide passage and the second air guide passage.SOLUTION: When a forward/backward drive mechanism 57 moves a shaft member 51 forward to a first position in an X direction, a first valve body 35 is pressed by the shaft member 51 and moved to one side in the X direction such that air flows from a suction passage 33 into an air filling chamber 45 and a second valve body 36 is moved to the other side in a Y direction, such that a first air guide passage 37 and a second air guide passage 38 are internally communicated. When the backward drive mechanism 57 moves the shaft member 51 backward to a second position in the X direction, the first valve body 35 is moved to the other side in the X direction by an air pressure and seated on a valve seat 41a, such that the air filling chamber 45 is communicated with an exhaustion passage 34, the second valve body 36 is moved to one side in the Y direction by the air pressure, and the first air guide passage 37 and the second air guide passage 38 are internally cut off.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Sound absorption structure of vehicular drive device
abstract_en: To provide a sound absorption structure of a vehicle drive device which enables reduction of working hours for attaching a sound absorption member to a bracket and enables improvement of workability of attachment work of the sound absorption member.SOLUTION: In a sound absorption structure of a transfer device 14, a sound absorption member 23 is attached to a left bracket 21 which attaches the transfer device 14 to a left side frame. The sound absorption member 23 has: a cylindrical part 23G into which the left bracket 21 is inserted; and a boss part 21F which is engaged with the left bracket 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Fixture for wire harness and wire harness
abstract_en: To provide a fixture for a wire harness and a wire harness which can easily change the configuration of an electric line member.SOLUTION: A fixture 13 for a wire harness includes: a first retainer 20 for retaining a first electric line member 11; and a second retainer 30 for retaining a second electric line member 12. The second retainer 30 can be removably attached to the first retainer 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: furniture
abstract_en: To provide a furniture component coupling member which can additionally couple a component forming a piece of furniture in a flexible manner, and to provide the piece of furniture.SOLUTION: A furniture component coupling member 10 couples a first component 70 and a second component 80, which form a piece of furniture and are long, to each other in a vertical direction and includes: a first coupling surface 20 which contacts with a side surface 71 of the first component 70 to be fixed; a second coupling surface 30 which extends in a direction orthogonal to the first coupling surface 20 and contacts with a side surface 81 of the second component 80 to be fixed; and an engagement claw part 50 protruding to the side surface 71 side of the first component 70 farther than the first coupling surface 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Vehicle slide door opening/closing device
abstract_en: To improve the accuracy of engagement between a first gear and a second gear, and simplify and miniaturize the configuration of a drive unit in a vehicle slide door opening/closing device.SOLUTION: A drive unit 6 capable of outputting power includes: a motor 20; a deceleration gear group 24 that decelerates the rotation of a rotational shaft 20a of the motor 20; a motor casing 22 that surrounds the motor 20; a gear casing 25 that is joined to the motor casing 22 and surrounds the deceleration gear group 24; and a support plate 21 which is fixed to the motor 20 and the motor casing 22. A shaft 243 of a second gear 24 which engages a first gear 201 fixed on the rotational shaft 20a of the deceleration gear group 24 is supported on the support plate 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Fluid manifold and method of making the same
abstract_en: To provide a fluid manifold with improved performance.SOLUTION: A body 110 of a fluid manifold 100 includes a proximal end 112, a distal end 114, and a primary manifold component 120. The primary manifold component extends from the proximal end of the body to the distal end thereof and encloses a primary channel 122. The fluid manifold may further include at least one auxiliary manifold component 130. The at least one auxiliary manifold component diverges from the primary manifold component and encloses an auxiliary channel 132 connected to the primary channel at a primary channel exit port. The fluid manifold may further include at least one compression valve region. The compression valve region may be operable between an open position and a closed position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Fastening structure
abstract_en: To obtain a fastening structure capable of improving holding force of holding two fastened members.SOLUTION: Bolts 30, 32 are inserted into first bolt holes 18X, 18Y and second bolt holes 26X, 26Y to fasten caliper mounting parts 18A, 18B of a knuckle 18 to arm parts 26A, 26B of a caliper bracket 26. Bolt insertion parts 40, 42, each composed of the first bolt holes 18X, 18Y and the second bolt holes 26X, 26Y, are provided in pairs. Each of the bolt insertion parts 40, 42 is formed so as to penetrate inclined contact surfaces 18C, 26C, 18D, 26D, which are contact surfaces between the knuckle 18 and the caliper bracket 26 and are inclined relative to a direction perpendicular to axial lines of the bolts 30, 32. Each of the inclined contact surfaces 18C, 26C, 18D, 26D is inclined toward the knuckle 18 side toward a center side between the paired bolt insertion parts 40, 42.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Linear motion guide device
abstract_en: To provide a linear motion guide device including a seal member capable of suppressing damage and the like of a sliding portion, for example, at a time including a trial operation.SOLUTION: A linear motion guide device is provided with a side seal for sealing a space between a slider and a guide rail, the side seal has a holding plate disposed at a slider side, a cover, and a seal member disposed between the cover and the holding plate along a longitudinal direction of the guide rail, the seal member has a main body held between the holding plate and the cover, and a lip portion extending from the main body toward the guide rail side, and a connection portion between the lip portion and the main body at a prescribed part in a width direction of the guide rail is separated from the guide rail with respect to a connection portion between a lip portion excluding the prescribed part and the main body in a state that the lip portion is kept in contact with the guide rail.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Base isolation foundation structure, and construction method of the same
abstract_en: To provide a base isolation foundation structure in which a base isolation foundation part to be placed on a plurality of base isolation devices can be constructed with high precision in a short construction period.SOLUTION: A base isolation foundation structure 1 includes a plurality of base isolation devices 20 and an upper base isolation foundation 30 made of reinforced concrete and provided on the plurality of base isolation devices 20. The upper base isolation foundation 30 comprises: a lower precast concrete member 31; a middle precast concrete member 32 placed on the lower precast concrete member 31; and a lower horizontal joint portion 34 formed by filling a space between the lower precast concrete member 31 and the middle precast concrete member 32 with grout material. The base isolation devices 20 and the upper base isolation base 30 are joined via anchor bolts 42.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Root portion holding force improvement method of flexible tube
abstract_en: To improve a bend holding force of a root portion of a flexible tube by attaching a coil spring to the root portion of the flexible tube, and to prevent the damage of the root portion of the flexible tube caused by an excessive bend.SOLUTION: A holding force of a root portion of a flexible tube is improved by attaching a coil spring to an external peripheral part of the root portion of the flexible tube, and reinforcing the root portion of the flexible tube, and the damage of the root portion of the flexible tube caused by an excessive bend of the root portion of the flexible tube is prevented by using the elasticity of the coil spring.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Bearing suspension tool
abstract_en: To provide a bearing suspension tool that enables a large bearing to be suspended without machining, the bearing lifting tool being configured at a low cost and in a compact form.SOLUTION: A bearing suspension tool is capable of suspending, in a suspended posture in which the axial direction is oriented vertically, an assembly including: a rolling element composed of a conical roller or a cylindrical roller; and a race ring having a raceway surface formed using a retainer to dispose the rolling element between flange portions arranged on both axial sides. The bearing suspension tool includes: a base portion that faces the upper surface of the race ring; a locking portion that extends downward from the base portion and is locked to the flange portion; and an eye bolt that is fastened to a screw hole in the vertical direction formed in the base portion and has a pressing portion that is pressed against the upper surface of the raceway surface. The locking portion is locked to the flange portion at a gap formed between adjacent rolling elements.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Method for manufacturing tank and hydrogen tank
abstract_en: To provide a technology achieving both of sufficient impregnation of resin and securement of quality of a tank in manufacturing the tank.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a tank comprises: a preparation process for preparing a preform where a plurality of layers of fiber bundles are wounded around the outer surface of a liner partitioning the inside space of the tank and provided with a tubular trunk, a metal mold, and a sheet constituted of three-dimensional net-state fibers; a winding process for winding the sheet around the outer surface of the preform by one round or more along a peripheral direction of the trunk of the preform; an injection process for injecting resin to the inside of the metal mold in an arrangement state of arranging the sheet-wound preform in the metal mold; and an impregnation process for impregnating the resin into the sheet and the fiber bundles. In the winding process, the sheet is wound around at least a part of the trunk, the sheet-wound preform is provided with a gap extending in a direction different from a direction where the fibers of the fiber bundle extend on the outer surface of the preform.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Liquified hydrogen transfer system and intermediate transfer facility and purge method of the same
abstract_en: To enable gas exhaustion through a vent line to be properly performed in a system which transfers liquified hydrogen.SOLUTION: A liquefied hydrogen transfer system TS1 comprises: a first facility 1 including a first tank 11 capable of storing liquefied hydrogen; a second facility 2 including a second tank 21 capable of storing the liquefied hydrogen; and an intermediate transfer facility 3 disposed between the first facility 1 and the second facility 2. The intermediate transfer facility 3 includes a transfer line 4 that transfers the liquefied hydrogen between the first tank 11 and the second tank 21, a purge line 5 that supplies purge gas to the transfer line 4, a vent line 6 that exhausts gas containing the purge gas from the transfer line 4, a branch line 7 that branches from the vent line 6 and merges with the vent line 6 at a downstream position in an exhaust direction with respect to a position of the branch, and a thermometer 8 that is disposed in the branch line 7 and measures the temperature of the gas flowing through the branch line 7.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fuel cell vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a fuel cell vehicle that regulates the temperature of hydrogen gas inside a hydrogen tank while suppressing the complexity of the configuration and the increase of the cost.SOLUTION: The fuel cell vehicle includes: a hydrogen tank 3 disposed outward in a vehicle width direction D2 relative to a chassis frame 22; a radiator 4 disposed outward in the vehicle width direction D2 relative to the hydrogen tank 3; and a fan 7 installed along the radiator 4. The fan 7 is capable of blowing air in both a first direction F1, which is from the radiator 4 toward the hydrogen tank 3, and a second direction F2, which is from the hydrogen tank 3 toward the radiator 4, and directs air toward the radiator 4. The fuel cell vehicle further includes: a determination unit that determines whether it is necessary to raise or lower the temperature of hydrogen gas in the hydrogen tank 3; and a control unit which causes the fan 7 to blow air in the first direction F1 when the determination unit determines that heating is necessary, and which causes the fan 7 to blow air in the second direction F2 when the determination unit determines that cooling is necessary.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Ceramic sintered compact, bearing ball, and cutting tool
abstract_en: To provide a technique for enhancing strength of a ceramic sintered compact.SOLUTION: This ceramic sintered compact contains: alumina crystal particles having pores; and zirconia crystal particles. The total surface area of the pores in the alumina crystal particles is at least 95% of the total surface area of pores contained in a cross section of the ceramic sintered compact.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Electron-generating member
abstract_en: To provide an electron-generating member capable of reducing a friction coefficient.SOLUTION: An electron-generating member capable of reducing a friction coefficient is provided, the member comprising: an electron-generating portion made of an electron-generating material comprising powder of a natural mineral containing a radioactive substance and powder of an electron-generating substance that generates electrons when subjected to alpha rays emitted from the natural mineral; and a magnet laminated on the electron-generating portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Oil lubrication structure
abstract_en: To provide an oil lubricating structure capable of sufficiently lubricating a bearing immediately after starting a vehicle.SOLUTION: An oil lubrication structure includes a bearing that rotatably supports a rotor shaft, an oil pump that circulates oil, a lubricating pipe that supplies the oil from the oil pump to the bearing, and an oil reservoir that is located between the lubricating pipe and the bearing and stores the oil.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electronic device holder
abstract_en: ELECTRONIC DEVICE (MOBILE PHONE) CAPABLE OF ARBITRARILY ROTATING RELATIVE TO THE ELECTRONIC DEVICE AND FURTHER ADJUSTING INSTALLATION ANGLE OF THE ELECTRONIC DEVICE WHEN USED IN PORTRAIT MODE AND LANDSCAPE MODE To provide a holder.SOLUTION: The electronic device holder 10 includes a base 20, a first connecting member 30, a second connecting member 40, and a supporting member 50, wherein the first connecting member 30 and the base 20 are rotatable relative to each other, one end of the supporting member 50 is rotatably connected to the first connecting member 30, and the other end of the supporting member 50 is rotatably connected to the second connecting member 40.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Low-voltage cable integral insulating tensile grip for power distribution
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an insulated tensile grip integrated with a low-voltage wire for power distribution, capable of significantly reducing maintenance costs, which comprises: a C-shaped rack; an insulator shaft-fixed by a fixed shaft at the center of upper and lower end surfaces of the rack; a U-shaped support (10) in close contact with the insulator (30); a low-voltage wire (60); and upper and lower wire fixing plates (20, 20a).

title_en: A folding type rudder apparatus and ship including the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a foldable rudder device, comprising: a rudder member; a rudder receiving part provided on the inner side of the bottom of a hull and for accommodating the rudder member; a steering member that is provided in the rudder receiving part and is shaft-coupled with the rudder member to adjust the rotation angle of the rudder member; and a folding driving part provided on one side of the rudder receiving part, and operating to receive the rudder member inside the rudder receiving part or to protrude the rudder member to the outside of the hull, thereby capable of improving the maneuverability of ships.

title_en: Structure for preventing high-speed rotation deformation of composite shaft using vacuum pressure
abstract_en: A structure for preventing high-speed rotation deformation of a composite shaft using vacuum pressure according to the present invention comprises: a composite shaft rotating at a high speed to transmit power; a vacuum pump for applying vacuum pressure into the composite shaft; and a control part for adjusting the vacuum pressure depending on the rotating number of the composite shaft. The composite shaft includes: a tube formed as a hollow cylinder and composed of composite materials; and a flange combined with both ends of the tube and connected to the vacuum pump. The present invention minimizes the expansion of the composite shaft in a radial direction due to a centrifugal force during rotation and accordingly an increase in a clearance between the composite shaft and a sliding bearing for supporting the composite shaft by applying vacuum pressure into the rotating composite shaft. Accordingly, a change in the clearance between the bearing and the shaft is minimized to increase the capacity of the bearing to endure a load, i.e., a critical load capacity, thereby enabling the stable drive of the composite shaft.

title_en: Cap assembly and joint pipe including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fixing cap assembly capable of maintaining the connection of a pipe by strong binding power while facilitating connection work between the pipe and a target main body (for example, a joint pipe, a wastewater receiver, and a small manhole) to which the pipe must be connected and a joint pipe including the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the fixing cap assembly comprises: a fixing cap fastened to a connection portion of a main body to which at least one pipe is connected, and fixing the gap between the main body and the pipe; a washer positioned in the fixing cap, compressing a sealing member (120) interposed between the main body and the pipe as the fixing cap is fastened, and allowing the diameter thereof to be contracted and restored in a radial direction; and a binding member including a plurality of tooth-shaped protrusions fixing the pipe by pressing the outer circumferential surface of the pipe as the washer contracts, and radially protruding from the inner circumferential surface of the washer toward the outer circumferential surface of the pipe.

title_en: Actuator for parking brake, a vehicle having the same and method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is an actuator for a parking brake which can fix the position of a rod in a housing even if a current is not supplied to a driving unit.
