According to one aspect of the present invention, the actuator for a parking brake comprises: a reduction gear transferring power of a motor to a parking part realizing parking braking; a lever allowing or blocking rotation of the reduction gear; and a driving unit moving the lever to a position for allowing or blocking rotation of the reduction gear. The driving unit includes a first member made of a magnetic substance, a second member facing the first member and made of a magnetic substance, and a rod wherein the end of one side thereof is coupled to the second member, and the end of the other side thereof can be attached to or separated from the lever. At least one between the first member and the second member consists of an electromagnet to attach or separate the rod to or from the lever by an attractive force or a repulsive force formed between the first member and the second member depending on the direction of an applied current.

title_en: Prefab tray for installing wires
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a prefabricated tray for installing electric wires. More specifically, the present invention is invented to prevent worker injuries or damage to cables during wire installation work, improve tray strength, and reduce the number of parts and assembly time to provide excellent durability and economic efficiency for economic products. The present invention comprises: a side rail (10) on which an upper bending part (13) and a lower bending part (16) are bent as one body in a 'ㄷ' cross-sectional shape, extended in the longitudinal direction and arranged side by side, spaced apart while maintaining the distance; a rung (20) whose both ends are assembled against an inner surface of the side rail (10) to support the wire and to be fixed in position while maintaining a certain distance from each other; and a connecting member (30) which overlaps a joint part of the side rails (10) and is connected through a fastening bolt (31) and a nut (32). A support beam part (14) overlaps the upper bent part (13) of the side rail (10) by being integrally molded toward a lower surface to form a round part (15) at an end. A gap (D) is maintained between an end surface of the support beam part (14) and an inner wall of the side rail (10) with a dimension corresponding to the thickness (T) of the connecting member (30) so that the connection member (30) is installed by fitting inside the side rail (10) through the gap (D).

title_en: escape route direction indicator interlocking with fire alarm sound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an escape route direction indicator interoperated with a fire alarm sound. In accordance with a purpose thereof, the escape route direction indicator includes a direction indication light emission unit capable of direction adjustment, a laser module capable of angle adjustment, and a quick installation unit to be conveniently installed on a random position and freely adjusted so as to directly indicate an escape route to an adjacent emergency exit across a space, and, when a fire alarm sound rings, a control module unit recognizes the sound to promptly actuate the direction indication light emission unit and the laser module, thereby guiding a quick and accurate evacuation in case of an emergency such as a fire. In accordance with the present invention, the escape route direction indicator interoperated with a fire alarm sound, includes: an indicator body (1); a direction indication light emitting unit (2) installed on the indicator body to emit light to indicate an escape route direction; a quick installation unit (3) conveniently coupled to any point to enable the indicator body (1) to be rotated; a laser module (4) coupled to the indicator body to radiate a laser by freely adjusting the direction to a random evacuation spot direction; and a control module unit (5) recognizing a fire alarm sound to actuate the direction indication light emitting unit and the laser module.

title_en: Ventilation System of Underground Power Line Interconnecting with a Transformer
abstract_en: A ventilation system of an underground distribution line pipeline connected to a transformer is provided to install a device for controlling the temperature and humidity of an underground space to bury the transformer underground and to control the temperature and humidity of the underground space in which the transformer is buried by introducing compressed air around the transformer as needed.

title_en: Constant velocity joint
abstract_en: A constant velocity joint includes an outer race, an inner race disposed within the outer race, a plurality of balls disposed between the outer race and the inner race and acting as a medium for transmitting rotational power between the outer race and the inner race, a ball cage accommodating the plurality of balls, a boot adapter disposed on one side of the outer race, and a ball retainer disposed on the other side of the outer race. The outer race is joined with the boot adapter and the ball retainer through a contact surface on which a sealing material layer is formed. The sealing material layer is formed by pressing a pre-sealing material pattern applied on the contact surface. The contact surface has a 10-point average surface roughness (Rz) in a range of 10 to 50 ㎛.

title_en: Hole Stopper for Electric Cable Manhole
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hole stopper for an electric cable manhole. The hole stopper for an electric cable manhole comprises: a pair of brake arms (42) installed in a radial direction from a semicircular bolt (41) toward an inner circumferential surface of a hole (21) and forming a T-shape in opposite directions; a brake pad (43) installed at an end of the brake arm (42) and coming in close contact with the inner circumferential surface of the hole (21) to stop the semicircular bolt (41); and a ring nut (44) coupled to the semicircular bolt (41) of which the center is matched to prevent the semicircular bolt (41) from being dislocated.

title_en: A geothermal system capable of reducing the machine room and its construction method
abstract_en: A geothermal system capable of reducing a machine room comprises a geothermal hole which is formed under the ground to open the top; an upper protection hole which is installed on the top of the geothermal hole; a connection pipe which protrudes from the circumference of the upper protection hole to be connected to the inside of the upper protection hole; a pump housing which is formed around the upper protection hole; a circulation pump which is mounted inside the pump housing, has a suction part connected to the connection pipe, and has a discharge part connected to a heat exchanger and a pipe of a heat pump; a replenishment unit which replenishes replenishment water to make the water level or water pressure for the operation of the circulation pump; and an appendix sensor which senses the water level or water pressure inside the upper protection hole to control the circulation pump and the replenishment unit. The present invention reduces the area of a machine room, improves energy efficiency and space utilization, and reduces operation costs by applying groundwater direct heat exchange and a ground-type circulation pump.

title_en: Bushing device with an internal PT (Pipe Taper Thread) structure that is connected to a pumping pipe fitting
abstract_en: A bushing device (100) of the present invention comprises a main body (101), an outer fluid inlet (102), an opening hole (103), a main body support part (104), and a lower part protrusion part (105); is realized with an insert screw thread (202), an insert support part (203), and an inner fluid inlet (204) in an insert (201); and has an opening hole (104) in the outer fluid inlet. There is no need to have a separate fastener for fastening the main body (101) and the insert (201) since the insert support part (203) is supported by the main body support part (104). In addition, the present invention is the invention related to the bushing device having an internal pipe taper thread (PT) structure that couples to a pumping pipe joint inside that is characterized in enabling the main body (101) and the insert (201) of the bushing device to be firmly fixed so that the coupling area does not easily loosen and is stably maintained even with vibrations or pressure changes that may occur in the pipe system by providing a strong coupling strength while being engaged with each other since the main body (101) and the insert (201) are coupled with an uneven part, enabling component replacement or maintenance to be convenient by enabling coupling and decoupling to be relatively simple, increasing the efficiency of installation and repair work by being easily tightened and loosened using a dedicated tool, and maintaining firmness even with long-term use.

title_en: Gasket sealing device for shipbuilding offshore plant piping and high temperature gasket including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sealing member used for a gasket provided between pipe flanges used in an offshore plant to prevent leakage, and a gasket including the same. According to the present invention, a gasket sealing member for offshore plant piping is a band-shaped sealing member having a C-ring part (410) opened in an inward direction at an inner end thereof, wherein the C-ring part (410) is made of a material having a restoring force, and a lower end (4102) of the C-ring part does not move and an upper end (4101) can be opened or closed. The gasket sealing member further comprises a band-shaped spring part (412) accommodated in the C-ring part (410).

title_en: fluid control apparatus and semiconductor manufacturing apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fluid control device capable of ensuring a supply flow rate while realizing miniaturization and integration. According to the present invention, provided is the fluid control device in which first block arrays (BA1, BA2) and second block arrays (BA3, BA4) consisting of a plurality of joint blocks arranged along a first direction (A1, A2) while having the width (W) of the standard size are arranged at predetermined intervals in a second direction (B1, B2) orthogonal to the first direction. Each of the plurality of joint blocks constituting the first block arrays (BA1, BA2) has a large-diameter flow path for forming a single line (L), and each of the plurality of joint blocks constituting the second block arrays (BA3, BA4) has a small-diameter flow path having a smaller diameter than a large-diameter flow path for forming a first line (L1) and a second line (L2).

title_en: Energy saving fuel gas heating system and method
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fuel gas heating method and a system for heating liquefied gas supplied as fuel to an engine through a fuel supply line. The fuel gas heating method includes the steps of: heating a heating medium by the heat of steam generated in a boiler by heat exchanging heat between the steam generated in the boiler and the heat medium in a main heat exchanger; heating the heating medium heated in the main heat exchanger with liquefied gas in a vaporizer to heat the liquefied gas and cooling the heating medium; preheating the heating medium cooled in the vaporizer by the heat of an engine coolant heated in an engine room cooling device; and supplying the preheated heating medium to the main heat exchanger.

title_en: Crankshaft and marine engine including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a crankshaft and a marine engine including the same, which are able to avoid the excessive expansion of an engine room, provide a good torque transfer, and suppress the damage of a main bearing metal. The crankshaft (5) is made by engaging a crank journal (51) and a crank arm (53) by being reduced and inserted. The crank arm (53) has a circular-shaped opening unit (53a) into which the crank journal (51) is inserted. When the crank arm (53) is viewed along a central axis (A3) of the opening unit (53a), a direction connecting a central axis (A2) of a crank pin (52) and the central axis (A3) of the opening unit (53a) is set to be a first direction, and a direction at right angles to the first direction is set to be a second direction. The difference between the length from the central axis (A3) of the opening unit (53a) to an outer surface (53b) of the crank arm (53) and an inner radius (R) of the opening unit (53a) is set to be a thickness around the opening unit (53a). Then, among the thicknesses around the opening unit (53a), the thickness (T2) in the second direction is greater than the thickness (T1) of the part placed on the opposite side to the crank pin (52) with the opening unit (53a) in the first direction in the middle.

title_en: Wedge Type Tension Clamp for Prevention Power Line Breaking Away
abstract_en: A wedge type tension clamp for preventing a power line from separating is configured such that a lock groove (31) is formed on one side of an inner surface of a guide part (3a and 3b), a coil spring (33) is elastically supported as a medium in a mounting groove (32) formed on one side of an outer surface of a wedge (9a and 9b), and a lock pin (34) locked when reaching the lock groove (31) to hold the wedge (9a and 9b) from the guide part (3a and 3b) is installed. Thus, when a power line (11) is sandwiched between the wedges (9a and 9b) and a long period of time elapses after the fastening operation the wedges (9a and 9b) are endured without separation out even when the wedges (9a and 9b) generate a pushing stress from the guide portions (3a and 3b) due to external factors such as corrosion, changes in ear canal, and weakening of tension of the tension clamp (1), so that the separation of the power line (11) from the wedges (9a and 9b) is prevented.

title_en: Redundant system and method of hydraulic servo valve for safety control of turbine control actuator for power plants
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a redundant system of a hydraulic servo valve for safety control of a turbine control actuator for power plants and an operating method thereof. The redundant system of a hydraulic servo valve according to the present invention, which is a redundant system of a hydraulic servo valve for safety control of a turbine control actuator for power plants, comprises a redundant valve block installed on a servo actuator, a dual servo valve coupled to the redundant valve block and including at least two servo valves that are connected in parallel to each other and determine whether to supply a fluid to the servo actuator, and a selective valve that changes a flow path to select at least one of the servo valves to operate.

title_en: A display device and operating method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure is to determine whether to start rotation of a display device by sensing an adjacent object before starting rotation of the display device. The display device of the present invention comprises: at least one sensor for sensing an adjacent object; a display that outputs rotation-related information; a motor that rotates the display about at least one axis; and a processor restricting the rotation of the display using the motor when an object is detected within a preset first distance through the at least one sensor, and sensing the object within a preset second distance through the at least one sensor.

title_en: Underwater propulsion device using air with high safety
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underwater propulsion device using air with high safety. More particularly, the underwater propulsion device using air with high safety uses the air of an air container (100) to fix a thruster (300) to the user's waist so that it can have a propulsive force due to air discharge, and can maintain the thrust by additionally providing a separate small-scale auxiliary thruster so as not to lose the thrust due to blocking of air discharge by a control unit (500) when a certain amount of air is exhausted and the amount of air left in the air container is less than the set value, and enables rapid movement through a structure that reduces the resistance to water and the firm holding force of the air container.

title_en: Tire and control method the same
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a tire comprises: a tread extended in a circumferential direction of the tire and having a groove; an axle disposed on an inner surface of the tread and storing fluid; a valve connected to the axle and opening and closing the axle; and a control unit closing the valve when an absolute value of acceleration of a vehicle exceeds a set value (a) during driving of the vehicle.

title_en: Cable hanger with adjustable length and angle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a length-adjustable and angle-adjustable cable hanger, which can increase or decrease the length according to the number of supporting power cables, or adjust a holding angle of a cable according to a trajectory of a cable. According to the present invention, the length-adjustable and angle-adjustable cable hanger, of which one end part is fixed to a frame (20) installed on a wall surface and which is extended in a direction vertical to the wall surface to support a power cable (30), comprises: a fixed hanger unit (11) of which one end part is fastened to the frame (20) in a cantilever shape and in which a plurality of through holes (11a) along a longitudinal direction are formed; and an extended hanger unit (13) which is installed to be overlapped on the fixed hanger unit (11) and in which a plurality of fastening holes (13a) are formed in the longitudinal direction.

title_en: Railing Binding Structure For Preventing Vibration Noise
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a railing installation structure for preventing vibration and noise caused by wind and, more specifically, to a railing installation structure for preventing vibration and noise caused by wind, in which when installing a railing, an anchor bolt is installed in a position where the railing is to be constructed, a vibration-proof pad is constructed between a concrete floor and a base plate of the railing, and a vibration-proof plug is inserted between the anchor bolt and the base plate so as to eliminate friction between the base plate of the railing and the concrete floor. Therefore, vibration and noise caused by wind can be prevented. A preferred embodiment of the present invention relates to an installation structure of a railing, in which an anchor bolt is installed in a concrete structure of an outer wall of an apartment house, and a railing is fixed by inserting the base plate into the anchor bolt, wherein the railing includes a plurality of pillars, a crossbar connecting the pillars, and the horizontal plate-shaped base plate disposed below the pillars and having a plurality of anchor fastening holes passing therethrough. A vibration-proof pad having a predetermined thickness and including through-holes corresponding to the anchor fastening holes is formed below the base plate. A vibration-proof plug includes a cylindrical upper mounting part and a cylindrical lower insertion part having a cross-section smaller than that of the upper mounting part and disposed below the upper mounting part, wherein anchor through-holes are formed to perforate a central part of the vibration-proof plug, and the vibration-proof plug is formed of the same material as the vibration-proof pad. The lower insertion part of the vibration-proof plug is inserted into the anchor fastening holes of the base plate. The anchor bolt passes through the through-holes of the vibration-proof pad and the anchor fastening holes of the vibration-proof plug to be fastened at an upper portion of the vibration-proof plug with nuts.

title_en: Shock absorber for median strip
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a shock absorber for a median strip that can effectively attenuate the impact of a median strip collision accident to minimize human casualties and can be continuously used. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a shock absorber for a median strip comprises: a housing including a cylinder containing a predetermined oil; a main body part including a pedestal supporting the housing and fixing it to the bottom surface; and a shock absorbing part which can reciprocate forward and backward within the cylinder and, when moved to the rear of the cylinder due to an external collision, compresses the oil contained in the cylinder and alleviates the impact caused by the collision.

title_en: Auto leveling apparatus for headlamp of vehicles
abstract_en: The present invention provides a leveling apparatus for a vehicle headlamp, which has a tilting sensor capable of scanning the road surface and a light source module for emitting light, which are integral with each other, thereby simply controlling adjustment of a light emitting position and increasing the accuracy and reliability of changes in the light emitting position. In other words, the leveling apparatus allows the angles of the tilting sensor and the light source module to be adjusted together by a motor, thereby simplifying leveling conditions as the relationship between an optical module and the road surface. In addition, the leveling apparatus can provide feedback on the road surface as the sensing direction of the tilting sensor matches the road surface when performing aiming of the light source module by operation of the motor, thereby identifying the road surface without a separate structure and determining a failure when continuous sensing errors are detected. In addition, the leveling apparatus can perform only control so that an actuator is operated until sensing of the tilting sensor reaches a normal range when performing aiming of the light source module, thereby simplifying the control, and allows a rotating device constituting the actuator to use a friction method or a driving method using a belt to minimize mechanical noise, thereby reducing discomfort caused by the noise.

title_en: Universal joint dust cover coupling device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a universal joint dust cover coupling device. A moving plate moved forward and backward by a moving means is formed on the upper surface of one side of a base plate. A first mounting part, on which a hollow shaft with a yoke joint is mounted, is formed on the upper surface of the moving plate. A fixed plate is formed on the upper surface of the other side of the base plate to correspond to the moving plate. A second mounting part, on which a solid shaft with a yoke joint is mounted, is formed on the upper surface of the fixed plate. A cover support means supporting the outer circumferential surface of a dust cover provided on the sold shaft and withdrawn by a withdrawal means is formed on the upper surface of the base plate on both sides of the fixed plate. Since the dust cover maintains the state in which the dust cover is fixed on the outer circumferential surface of the solid shaft by the cover support means in the process in which the hollow shaft is coupled to the outer circumferential surface of the solid shaft by the moving means, the dust cover can be easily coupled to the outer circumferential surface of the hollow shaft, thereby preventing an end of the solid shaft from colliding with an inlet end of the dust cover to dent and damage a cover body. A support part with a support groove provided to be positioned on the same horizontal line as the cover support means is formed on the upper surface of the base plate. Since the support part is installed to be vertically moved by a lifting means, the initial position of the dust cover of which the outer circumferential surface is supported by the cover support means can be easily designated, and the cover support means can firmly fix the outer circumferential surface of the dust cover.

title_en: A vessel which has a vibration reducer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ship equipped with a vibration damper, and more specifically to the vibration damper (hereinafter "balancer"), comprising: a means for measuring the magnitude of vibration of the ship; a means for measuring a rotational speed of an engine (E_RPM) and a rotational speed of the balancer (B_RPM); a means for detecting a zero phase (ZE) of the engine and the zero phase (ZB) of the balancer; and a control means that causes a phase (ZBE) of the balancer with respect to the phase (ZE) of the engine to change per unit time (degree/sec) by a predetermined value, thereby capable of automatically finding an optimal phase and a control order.

title_en: Regulator using permanent magnet spring module
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a regulator having a shielding structure and including a permanent magnet module, wherein the regulator comprises: a main body including a fluid inlet into which fluid from a pipe is introduced, a cylindrical fluid receiving space connected to the fluid inlet to receive the introduced fluid, and a fluid outlet which discharges the fluid in the fluid receiving space into the pipe; a main valve provided on a fluid inlet side of the main body to control the flow of fluid through the fluid inlet; a piston installed to vertically move the fluid receiving space; and a pressure adjustment module which is inserted into a module insertion portion at the upper end of the main body which receives a force applied to the piston by the fluid introduced through the fluid inlet to adjust the pressure of the fluid within the pipe and absorb shock. The pressure adjustment module comprises: a cylindrical module body fixed and installed in the module insertion portion; a second shielding member configured to be slidably inserted into the lower end of the module body and fixed to the piston to move together therewith; a second permanent magnet fixed onto the upper surface of the second shielding member; a first shielding member fixed onto the upper end of the module body; and a first permanent magnet fixed onto the lower surface of the first shielding member. Therefore, a flexible response is possible depending on the magnitude of fluid impact.

title_en: A spiral solar cell charging system installed on the support
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a spiral solar cell charging system installed on a support, comprising: a support; solar cell panels arranged in a spiral shape along the outer peripheral surface of the support are installed; and a charging unit provided at the lower end of the support to charge the energy of sunlight incident from the solar cell panel, and has the effect of increasing the charging efficiency by providing a solar cell charging system for charging solar power that can be installed even in a relatively small area, increasing the efficiency of concentrating sunlight incident on the solar cell panel according to the position of the sun by configuring the solar cell panel in a spiral shape along the outer peripheral surface of the support, reducing installation costs by eliminating the need for a positioning process for solar cell panels to track and enter the sun according to the position of the sun as before since the solar cell panels are installed in a spiral manner along the outer circumferential surface of the support, and by eliminating the need for installation costs to meet the structure, since there is always an area where solar incidence is possible despite changes in the sun's position.

title_en: Fiber reinforcing plastic hinge and method for preparing the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to a fiber-reinforced plastic hinge and a method for manufacturing the same. According to the present application, a fiber-reinforced plastic hinge which not only has good durability but also has a smaller thickness and curvature when folded compared to the prior art is provided. In addition, the present application provides a method for manufacturing the fiber-reinforced plastic hinge, which can reduce process costs. The fiber-reinforced plastic hinge comprises a first area including a polymer resin and fiber; a second area including a polymer resin and fiber; and a folding part including a polymer resin and fiber and located between the first and second areas.

title_en: Fluid supply system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a fluid supply system. According to various embodiments of the present invention, a fluid supply device includes: a tube for enabling a fluid to flow, wherein the tube is formed of a flexible material; a housing including a storage space in which at least a part of the tube is stored, and having an outlet on the outer surface thereof, wherein the tube is drawn out from the storage space through the outlet; a support unit supporting at least a part of the tube in the storage space and changed so that the position thereof in the storage space becomes closer from an initial position to the outlet depending on a drawn rate of the tube through the outlet; and a position maintaining unit connected to the support unit and applying a return force to the support unit so that the support unit is returned to the initial position. While the support unit is positioned at the initial position, the state of the tube in the storage space can be maintained to be substantially uniform.

title_en: Power train of automatic transmission
abstract_en: The present invention provides a power train of an automatic transmission, wherein a first carrier is integrated with a single pinion toothing with a first sun gear and a first ring gear, a second carrier is integrated with a single pinion toothing with a second sun gear and a second ring gear, a third carrier is integrated with a single pinion toothing with a third sun gear and a third ring gear, a fourth carrier is integrated with a single pinion toothing with a fourth sun gear and a fourth ring gear, and the reverse drive of a motor is transmitted through an input shaft via the same power transmission path with first gear, thereby realizing reverse gear. Therefore, provided is a power train of an automatic transmission, wherein all planetary gear sets are configured in a single pinion structure, and the reverse drive of a motor is transmitted via the same power transmission path with first gear, thereby realizing reverse gear.

title_en: X-type folding frame for Covering cargo box of Freight Car
abstract_en: Disclosed is an X-shaped folding frame for a cargo box cover of a freight vehicle. According to the present invention, an X-shaped folding frame for a cargo box cover of a cargo vehicle comprises an X-shaped folding frame in which a first member and a second member having a predetermined length are folded and unfolded with respect to a rotation center axis. The X-shaped folding frame is formed of a mixture of synthetic resin and stone powder to maintain predetermined strength and reduce weight. According to the present invention, the X-shaped folding frame is injection-molded with polyethylene and stone powder or a mixture of polypropylene and stone powder, thereby reducing the weight while maintaining a predetermined strength, and a reinforcing structure is applied to the central area of the X-shaped folding frame to prevent bending deformation or cutting due to accumulation of fatigue during a folding operation, thereby improving durability.

title_en: Automatic Tidal Pressure Variation for Fluid Circulation and Pressure Relief of Power Spray System
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic pressure relief valve for power sprayers, which is connected to a discharge port of a right housing of the automatic pressure relief valve in power sprayers, and when the use of high-pressure fluid is stopped, causing the internal pressure of the right housing to rise, or when the internal pressure of the right housing rises since foreign substances are caught in an internal flange and the discharge port of the right housing, or the flange and spring are worn or damaged, makes a drain valve installed in a left housing manually open blocking of a vent hole of a boundary wall which is boundary-installed in the left and right housings, thereby allowing the high-pressure fluid moving from the right housing to the discharge port to be easily manually switched to an outlet of the left housing through the vent hole.

title_en: Breake device, and vehicle
abstract_en: A brake device includes: a caliper body; a brake pad seated in the caliper body; and a lower return spring having one end coupled to a lower portion of the brake pad and the other end coupled to a lower portion of the caliper body, wherein the lower return spring includes a bent portion, and when an angle of the bent portion increases from an initial angle, the brake device providing elasticity to restore to an original size can obtain sufficient restoring force for the brake pad through the lower return spring having a simple structure.

title_en: Device for opening and closing armrest of console box
abstract_en: The present invention proposes an opening and closing device capable of opening an armrest of a vehicle from both the front and rear sides. A front opening knob (12a) and a rear opening knob (12b) are installed on the front and rear sides of a lead frame (10), respectively, and operate in conjunction with each other. A pair of front interlocking bars (20) and rear interlocking bars (30) are respectively provided with hooks (2c, 2d) at their ends, which move inward when either opening knob is pressed, thereby releasing a locked state with locking protrusions formed on the lead frame. In the interlocking mechanism of the present invention, when either the front or rear opening knob is pressed, the opposite knob also moves inward to release the locked state with the locking protrusion, thereby allowing both leads (2a, 2b) to elastically open.

title_en: Pressure vessel
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to a pressure vessel, which comprises: a liner having a boss provided at an end portion thereof and storing a target fluid; a reinforcing layer provided to surround a circumference of the liner; and a heat conductive member provided between the liner and the reinforcing layer so that one end thereof is in contact with the boss and the other end thereof is in contact with the liner at a predetermined target position, and transmitting heat applied to the boss to the target position. therefore, safety and reliability can be improved.

title_en: Shock Absorbing Pad Elastic Structure
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed is an elastic structure of a shock-absorbing pad. According to the present invention, a cover member is filled with at least one elastic ball, and a planar interconnected structure in which the filled elastic balls are continuously coupled in a transverse direction is formed. Moreover, a whistle member can be applied. Accordingly, the elastic structure of the shock-absorbing pad can efficiently absorb shock and enables rapid recovery to an original shape when the applied shock is removed. In particular, the elastic structure of the shock-absorbing pad protects a player during an athletic game against an opponent. Furthermore, the elastic structure of the shock-absorbing pad allows a user to promptly and effectively recognize whether an opponent has been struck.

title_en: Top mount and top mount assembly for air spring for vehicle
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a top mount for an air spring for a vehicle comprises: an upper part; and a lower part coupled to the upper part. An inner partition forming a plurality of chambers by dividing an inner space surrounded by the upper part and the lower part is formed as one piece in the upper part. An inner partition groove into which the inner partition is inserted is formed in the lower part. A sealing member may be interposed between the inner partition wall and the inner partition wall groove, and the upper part and the lower part may be coupled by mechanical coupling.

title_en: The divided and taper type metal bearing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a split-type tapered metal bearing. Specific configuration is provided with a plurality of tapered bearings (30) divided to surround a shaft (21), and the outer surface of the tapered bearing (30) is formed as an outer radial inclined surface (31) to which an inclination (S_1) is applied so that the thickness (t_1) on one side and the thickness (t_2) on the other side are different (t_1 > t_2), and the inner surface of the body part (32) into which the tapered bearing (30) is fitted is formed as an inner radial inclined surface (33) to which an inclination (S_2) is applied so that the thickness (t_3) on one side and the thickness (t_4) on the other side are different (t_3 < t_4) so that they contact the outer radial inclined surface (31) of the tapered bearing (30).

title_en: Standing cable mounting device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a support fitting for a standing cable, which comprises: a body; a crossarm fixing unit provided on one side of the body and mounted on a crossarm; and a cable fixing unit provided on the other side of the body and to which a standing cable is fixed by the weight of the standing cable. Therefore, installation work is easy and the standing cable can be stably fixed.

title_en: Hydrogen storage tank for high purity hydrogen storage from water electrolysis and system having the same
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a hydrogen storage tank used for storing hydrogen produced in a water electrolysis facility and for storing hydrogen produced by water electrolysis with high purity, and a water electrolysis system having the same. According to the present invention, a hydrogen storage tank for high-purity storage of hydrogen produced by water electrolysis is divided into a first chamber and a second chamber by a moisture separation plate. The moisture separation plate comprises: an inlet hole unit connected to an inlet pipe to introduce hydrogen produced in a water electrolysis facility into the first chamber; and a discharge hole unit through which the hydrogen introduced into the first chamber through the inlet hole unit is discharged to the second chamber. While the hydrogen introduced into the first chamber moves to the second chamber, the hydrogen is brought into contact with the moisture separation plate to separate moisture from the hydrogen.

title_en: Device for detecting abnormalities in landfill gas transfer device using flow rate changes and its operating method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for detecting an abnormality of a gas transfer device of a landfill using a change in a flow rate and an operating method thereof and, more specifically, to an apparatus for detecting an abnormality of a gas transfer device of a landfill for stably maintaining gas combustion efficiency and an operating method thereof. In order to achieve the above object, the present invention provides an apparatus for detecting abnormality of a gas transfer device of a landfill using a change in a flow rate, the apparatus including: a collection unit installed in a landfill to collect gas; a manifold unit connected to a plurality of collection units and provided to collect the gas collected by the connected collection units; a transfer unit for transferring the gas collected by the collection unit to the manifold unit; a combustion unit provided to burn the gas; a transfer unit for transferring the gas collected in the manifold unit to the combustion unit; and a control unit provided to detect abnormality of the transfer unit by comparing a difference between a collection flow rate measured by the collection unit and an inflow flow rate introduced into the manifold unit.

title_en: Automatic pressure regulating device for supplying liquefied natural gas fuel
abstract_en: An automatic pressure regulating device for supplying liquefied natural gas (LNG) fuel includes a base. A mounting seat is fixedly connected to a bottom end of the base, mounting plates are fixedly connected to the base, support frames are fixedly connected to the mounting plate, and a storage tank is fixedly mounted on the support frames. A pressure sensor is fixedly mounted at a top end of the storage tank, a first pipeline is fixedly connected to one side of the storage tank, a second pipeline is fixedly connected to one side of the storage tank, and a first connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the other side of the storage tank. The device provided by the present invention maintains normal air pressure in a liquid storage tank and ensures the safe use of normal fuel supplied to ships. FIG. 1

title_en: Bolted joint using deformable sleeve with longitudinal grooves.
abstract_en: A bolted joint providing a "zero-clearance" fit formed from a bolt including a shoulder that works during installation to cold form a deformable sleeve. The bolted joint joins a bolt receiving member to a clamped component. One or more bolted joints may be used and as the bolts are installed, shoulders on each of the bolts dilate deformable sleeves until the outer diameters of the sleeves contact internal walls of through holes in the clamped component. Each of the deformable sleeves includes at least one groove or flute on its interior surface that results in: reduced radial load on internal walls of the clamped component and the bolt receiving members, and less friction between the sleeve and both the clamped component and a counter bore disposed within the bolt receiving member, thereby allowing for smaller percentage of the bolt's tensile strength capability required to deform the sleeve.

title_en: Systems and methods for assembling and repairing chains
abstract_en: A chain assembly system can include an inner chain link and an outer chain link. The inner chain link and the outer chain link can define a pair of bores. The chain assembly system can include a pin including a head end that defines a head, and a thread end opposite the head end having threads. The chain assembly system can include a nut configured to threadingly engage the threads of the thread end of the pin and an axial stop that is configured to block further advancement of the nut along the thread end of the pin towards the head end of the pin when the pin contacts the axial stop.

title_en: Control valve for fluid treatment apparatus
abstract_en: A control valve is provided for a fluid treatment apparatus, including a housing with at least one cylinder defining a fluid flow path in the apparatus, each cylinder having an associated reciprocating piston valve. The valve includes a first piston valve half; a second piston valve half complementary to the first piston valve half; and a resilient seal constructed and arranged for being sandwiched between the first and second piston valve halves. The first piston valve half is constructed and arranged for engaging the cylinder before the second piston valve half, and having an exterior peripheral edge defined by a plurality of peripherally spaced teeth creating flow spaces between the teeth.

title_en: Thermoplastic composite
abstract_en: A method of making a flexible pipe layer, which method comprises: commingling polymer filaments and carbon fibre filaments to form an intimate mixture, forming yarns of the commingled filaments, forming the yarns into a tape, and applying the tape to a pipe body to form a flexible pipe layer.

title_en: Internal combustion engine
abstract_en: AN INCOMING PATH CHAIN GUIDE (23) THAT GUIDES THE TIMING CHAIN (11) ON AN INCOMING PATH THEREOF IS FIXED TO A FORWARD-FACING RECESS (20) OF A CYLINDER HEAD (2) AND A CYLINDER BLOCK (1). AN OIL DROP HOLE (39) FOR RETURNING OIL COLLECTED IN THE FRONT PART OF THE CYLINDER HEAD (2) IS OPEN AT A PORTION OF THE FORWARD-FACING RECESS (20) IN THE CYLINDER HEAD (2) HIDDEN BY AN UPPER END OF THE INCOMING PATH CHAIN GUIDE (23). THE OIL FLOWS DOWN A RIB (32). THE FOLLOWING OIL IS COVERED WITH THE CHAIN GUIDE (23) TO PREVENT THE OIL FROM COMING INTO CONTACT WITH THE TIMING CHAIN (11) AND TURNING INTO MIST.   FIGURE 2

title_en: Moulded sealing device, truck comprising the moulded sealing device, and method for manufacturing the moulded sealing device
abstract_en: A moulded sealing device for sealing an opening in a cabin floor of a truck. The sealing device comprises a cabin connector, comprising a mounting surface for connecting to the cabin floor, a shaft connector for connecting With a steering shaft extending through the opening, and an extendible sleeve extending between the shaft connector and the cabin connector, folded in a fold pattern, and extendible from a neutral position. At least the extendible sleeve is moulded from an elastically deformable material. In the neutral position, the fold pattern comprises first fold flanks oriented normal to the mounting surface and second fold flanks oriented coaxial With a centreline, and the centreline is at an angle to the mounting surface, thereby providing at least one of the first or second fold flanks With a negative draft angle.

title_en: Valve assembly
abstract_en: With the construction of new buildings and building renovations, pipework is tested to ensure that it holds water or air and there are no leaks. To test the pipework, a plumber usually positions a plug in a discharge pipe above or in an inspection outlet. Water then fills the pipework and the pipework can be inspected and certified. After the inspection, the plumber removes the plug. The accumulated water is under pressure and can force the plug towards the plumber as it is being removed. This poses a potential injury risk for the plumber and is a safety concern. Furthermore, as the plug is removed from the inspection outlet, some of the accumulated water can discharge via the inspection outlet. The current method of testing pipework is not safe for the plumber or person testing for leaks. A valve assembly and a method of testing pipework using a valve assembly including a valve housing having an inlet, an outlet and an opening. The valve assembly including an insert removably insertable in the opening, the insert having a first side facing upwards and a second side facing downwards when positioned in the opening, the first side and the second side have a conduit positioned therebetween. The control valve located at least partially within the conduit and movable between an open position and a closed position, the control valve in the closed position stops fluid from passing through the conduit. When the insert is inserted in the opening and the control valve is in the closed position. The insert substantially seals the inlet and stops fluid flowing to the outlet. The fitting is separate from the control valve.

title_en: Seismic dissipator
abstract_en: A seismic device (3) that provides dissipation and recentering without deformation, comprising a housing (4) configured to be engaged with a supported structure (1) and a plurality of pairs of crossmembers (8), each pair of crossmembers (8) being configured in a radial arrangement to receive an elongate assembly (7) that is part of a baseplate member (5), where the baseplate member (5) is configured to be engaged with a supporting structure (2). The crossmembers (81, 82) of each pair are biased toward each other by a springing mechanism (9) to provide a frictional force in a movement control region (11) to the elongate assembly (7) that is part of the baseplate member (5), which resists axial movement of each crossmember pair (8) relative to the baseplate member (5).

title_en: Protection system for cryogenic tanks inside the body of the underwater vehicle
abstract_en:
FIELD: cryogenic technology. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to cryogenic technology. The safety valve protection system is made of two bodies, while the first body is fixed through a gasket on the outer side of the body of the underwater vehicle and a power drive in the form of a spring and two parallel bellows are installed in it, while the effective area of ​​the inner bellows is equal to the sealing area of ​​the shutoff valve, and the bellows cavity is filled with a filler to reduce volume. The second body is mounted inside the body of the underwater vehicle and has a seat and a shut-off valve connected by a flexible rod with a power drive, while the cavity above the control valve is connected by a cryogenic pipeline with a gas cushion of a cryogenic tank and filled with thermal insulation, and the cavity after the shut-off valve is connected by a pipeline with a reverse valve additionally installed on the outer side of the underwater vehicle body. The body and the pipeline are surrounded by a casing for the coolant, and the pulse valve is also made in the form of two bodies which are fixed on the outer side of the underwater vehicle body. The first body contains a saddle and a valve for supplying a working medium, a saddle and a valve for dumping a working medium, connected to the bellows cavity power drive. In addition, an ordering device is made in the body from the side of the seat and the valve for dumping the working medium, consisting of a cylindrical chamber, bellows and a rod interacting with the piston. The cavity between the cylindrical chamber and the bellows is connected through a nozzle to a pipeline for withdrawing the working medium from the cavity after the valve for dumping the working medium into a container installed inside the body of the underwater vehicle, while the container is equipped with a level gauge and communicated with the atmosphere of the body of the underwater vehicle. A saddle and a valve for filling the working medium through a pipeline into the cavity between the cylindrical chamber and the bellows of the ordering device are installed in the second body. 
     EFFECT: creation of a system for the protection of cryogenic tanks and reservoirs located inside the underwater vehicle that is reliable, safe in operation and easy to repair.  
     1 cl, 1 dwg

title_en: End bayonet valve
abstract_en:
FIELD: closures. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to closures for pressure vessels mounted by means of movable mountings on hinged arms. The end bayonet valve contains a hollow cylindrical body, on the end of which, equipped with a sealing collar located in an annular groove, connected to the inner cavity of the body through holes, plugged with plugs, a cover is put on, installed on the ball bearing assembly of the folding lever with the possibility of rotation around its axis. The lever is pivotally mounted in a support fixed on the side surface of the body, on a rod equipped with a pulley, with the possibility of fixing in a fully open position. The lid together with the body form a locking device made in the form of a bayonet connection, the lid being provided with projections covered by grooves made on the body. On the outer surface of the cover, an axial rotation unit is fixed, consisting of a toothed bar-sector with a handle and a drive toothed gear mounted on the first or second axes, fixed on the body, while the bar-sector is made to mesh with the said drive toothed gear, ensuring the possibility of preliminary and complete mutual rotation of the cover and the body. The valve is equipped with a first safety assembly and a second safety assembly. At the end of the pre-rotation section, the lid can be axially displaced to the height of the steps made on the lid projections. To monitor the current state of the fluid in the pipeline, a pressure sensor and a temperature sensor are introduced into the valve body; the outputs of the said sensors are connected to the measuring inputs of the telemetry unit, made on the basis of the microcontroller, while the said unit can be equipped with a wireless communication module. 
     EFFECT: increasing reliability of the structure. 
     9 cl, 5 dwg

title_en: Fluid supply faucet including a faucet body, a plurality of fluid supply ports arranged on the faucet body, and a supply control module arranged on the faucet body
abstract_en: A fluid supply faucet includes a faucet body, a plurality of fluid supply ports arranged on the faucet body, and a supply control module arranged on the faucet body. The plurality of fluid supply ports face the same supply position, the plurality of fluid supply ports respectively provide a fluid, the plurality of fluids provided by the plurality of fluid supply ports are different. The supply control module includes a camera facing the supply position, and an information processing component connected to the camera. The information processing component performs image recognition of the image data outputted by the camera, a human body surface area contained in the image data is used to determine one of the plurality of fluid supply ports supplying the fluid to the supply position. The information processing component performs at least one of the following feature recognition of the human body surface area: a non-skin color highlight feature and a circular foam feature.

title_en: Quick-release stand and quick-release electronic device
abstract_en: A quick-release stand and a quick-release electronic device are provided. The quick-release stand includes a supporting pillar, a first positioning component, a base and a second positioning component. The first positioning component is movably disposed at an end of the supporting pillar and includes a first positioning portion. The supporting pillar is inserted into the base by the first positioning component. The second positioning component is movably disposed on the base and includes a second positioning portion. The second positioning component can be moved between a first position and a second position. When the second positioning component is at the first position, the second positioning portion is separated from the first position portion of the first position component. When the second position component is at the second position, the second position portion is positioned on the first position portion of the first position component.

title_en: Water leakage circuit breaker device
abstract_en: A water leakage circuit breaker device includes a base, a valve body, a valve plug assembly, and an expansion body. The base can be fixed at an installation position through methods such as double-sided tape or screw locking. The base has two first engaging parts. The valve body has a valve chamber, a water inlet, and a water outlet. The water inlet and the water outlet are communicated to the valve chamber. The valve body has two second engaging parts, and the two second engaging parts are located on the bottom side of the valve body. The valve plug assembly is disposed between the water inlet and the water outlet. The expansion body is arranged on one side of the valve body. The expansion body is made of a water-absorbing material with a high expansion ratio. After absorbing water, the expansion body can push the valve plug assembly to block the flow between the water inlet and the water outlet. The two second engaging parts of the valve body can be pushed and engaged with the two first engaging parts of the base, so that the valve body, the valve plug assembly, and the expansion body can be quickly installed in the installation position. As a result, the water leakage circuit breaker device can be easily installed, completely attached to a wall to save space, and assembled in multiple directions without using screws and damaging the installation location (such as a cabinet), so that the water leakage circuit breaker device can be easily repaired and replaced.

title_en: Diaphragm valves
abstract_en:
A diaphragm valve includes an inlet port, an outlet port, and a valve seat proximate one of the inlet port or the outlet port. A diaphragm is positioned relative to the valve seat and has an open state wherein the diaphragm is spaced from the valve seat to enable a fluid path between the inlet port and the outlet port. The diaphragm has a closed state wherein the diaphragm is seated on the valve seat to block the fluid path. A coupling member is coupled between the diaphragm and a reciprocatable member and configured to maintain the diaphragm in the open state while the reciprocatable member is in the opened position. The coupling member may have a clearance gap relative to the reciprocatable member when the reciprocatable member is in the closed 
position. Other diaphragm valves and methods of operating diaphragm valves are also disclosed.

title_en: Fluid control valve
abstract_en:
In a fluid control valve (10), a cylinder chamber (14) includes a first pilot chamber (64) extending from a piston (18) in one of sliding directions. An opening (86) of a first pilot port (84) allowing supply and discharge of fluid is formed in the inner wall of the first pilot chamber (64). The fluid is accommodated in the first pilot chamber (64) when the piston (18) is in a valve open position, and discharged via the opening (86) when the piston (18) is displaced toward a valve closed position. At least one of the piston (18) and a valve body (16) includes a throttle 
portion (70) forming, between the piston (18) and the valve body (16), a throttle path (104) having a cross-sectional area smaller than the area of the opening (86), after the piston (18) starts being displaced from the valve open position toward the valve closed position.

title_en: A method for forming an inner tank structure of a gas-loaded pressure vessel and its inner tank structure
abstract_en:
A method for molding the inner bladder structure of a gas-loaded pressure vessel, which sequentially includes: providing a composite material embryo, which is sequentially composed of a first high-density thermoplastic plastic, a second high-density thermoplastic plastic, and a first The adhesive layer, a gas barrier layer, a 
second adhesive layer, and a third high-density thermoplastic are laminated; an inner tank structure molding mold is provided, and the inner tank structure molding mold is composed of two left and right symmetrical After the mold is closed, a cavity is formed; the composite material embryo is placed in the cavity, and the cavity is blown into shape. After the left-right symmetrical mold is closed, the composite material embryo is melted and joined, and A hollow liner structure is formed; it is characterized in that a stitching line is generated at the joint of the liner structure, and the liner structure with the stitching line as the center point has a W-shaped cross-section.

title_en: Multiaxial hinge device and electronic device using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a multiaxial hinge device, which can avoid wrinkles or loose parts of the cover during the opening and closing operation, thereby allowing smooth opening and closing. The multiaxial hinge device has a hinge shaft installed on one housing of the electronic device, and a hinge shaft installed on the other housing of the electronic device. The pair of hinge shafts are connected to each other for relative rotation, allowing the pair of housings to connect to each other and to relatively open and close within 360 degrees. The multiaxial hinge device includes: a basic frame, which is configured with a multiaxial hinge device; a mounting plate having one end mounted on the basic frame to be waved and another end mounted on the housing; a cover body mounted below the mounting plate; a cover rail mechanism installed at the end of the long side of the mounting plate to exert force on the cover body.

title_en: Computing device and method for low pressure molding for display module retention and sealing
abstract_en: An example computing device includes a display module comprising a glass cover and one or more components, wherein the one or more components include one or more attachment fittings that attach the display module to one or more other modules of the computing device. The computing device further includes a filling comprising resin molded around the one or more components and against a portion of an interior of the glass cover.

title_en: Hydraulic piston assembly
abstract_en: A piston assembly for a transmission includes a piston and a washer connected to the piston. In one embodiment, the washer includes a circumferential ring that extends continuously about an inner diameter, wherein a cavity is defined between the piston and the washer. A bearing element is retained and centered on the washer by the circumferential ring.

title_en: Washer assembly with seal for lightning-protection fasteners and method of manufacture
abstract_en: A washer assembly including a metallic washer and a polymer seal. The metallic washer defines a cylindrical void and an axis therethrough. The polymer seal is attached to the metallic washer and is positioned radially inward thereof. The polymer seal includes a lower seal portion positioned at least partially within the cylindrical void and defining a counter-bore, and an upper seal portion extending axially from the lower seal portion. The lower seal portion is configured to engage, at the counter-bore, a fastener to form a seal to reduce escape of energized particles. The upper seal portion is configured to engage a counter-bore of a counter-bored nut to form a seal inside the counter-bored nut to reduce escape of energized particles.

title_en: Clutch for a construction machine
abstract_en: In a clutch ( 14 ) for a construction machine ( 1 ), comprising a drive-side end ( 58 ) and a driven-side end ( 60 ), a driven shaft ( 22 ), wherein, at the drive-side end ( 58 ), a drive-side bearing ( 40 ) is arranged at the driven shaft ( 22 ), it is specified for the following features to be achieved: that a lubricant line ( 42 ) for lubrication of the drive-side bearing ( 40 ) is specified which leads from the driven-side end ( 60 ) to the drive-side bearing ( 40 ) and extends, at least sectionally, through the driven shaft ( 22 ).

title_en: Low-profile casing spacer roller for high-capacity loads
abstract_en: A casing spacer equipped with low-profile, high-load-capacity roller assemblies that require less force to install a carrier pipe inside a casing pipe. The low-profile, high-load-capacity roller assemblies are manufactured from a material designed to carry a heavy load, which material will not wear away as the carrier pipe is pushed or pulled through the casing pipe. The wheels of the low-profile, high-load-capacity roller assemblies are manufactured from an electronically isolating material to prevent contact of dissimilar metals, thereby mitigating galvanic corrosion.

title_en: Quick release tensioning device
abstract_en: A tensioning system for a shade structure is presented. The tensioning system comprises a shade membrane coupling portion configured to couple to a shade membrane of the shade structure. The tensioning system also comprises a movement axis, along which the shade membrane coupling portion moves. In a first direction, the shade membrane coupling portion applies tension to the shade membrane and, in a second direction, releases tension applied to the shade membrane. The tensioning system also comprises a force translation mechanism configured to receive a rotational force and translate it into linear movement of the shade membrane coupling portion along the movement axis in the first and second direction.

title_en: Torque converter clutch control system health estimation
abstract_en: A method of, and a system for, controlling and predicting the health of a torque converter clutch control system is provided. The method includes determining, via a controller, rotational input and output speeds of the torque converter and a torque converter clutch slip. The method also includes determining, via the controller, whether a set of predetermined conditions are met for predicting the health of the torque converter clutch control system. The method includes gathering a plurality of initial features of the vehicle propulsion system, determining statistical information about the plurality of initial features, and selecting at least one feature of the vehicle propulsion system based on the statistical information. Furthermore, the method includes classifying the health of the torque converter clutch control system based on the selected feature or features. In some forms, principal component analysis is used to select the feature or features used for classification.

title_en: Hand-held device
abstract_en: A hand-held device is a portable device configured to be attached to and detached from a metal board, and includes a casing and a magnet disposed inside the casing so as to be attracted to the metal board via an attachment face of the casing. The hand-held device further includes an urging element for urging the magnet so that the magnet moves in a direction away from the attachment face when the casing is detached from the metal board.

title_en: Portable video screen
abstract_en: A portable video screen for displaying images utilizes a pivoting frame system for holding a plurality of LED panels. The portable video screen rotates on rolling video units to enable users to roll the video units through doorways and readily setup and tear down the portable video screens as needed. Folding handles rotate into and out of the system to enable users to move the video units without touching the LED panels.

title_en: Conveyor idler and support structure and methods for constructing the same
abstract_en: This invention provides an idler for use in conveyor systems and associated shaft and support structure that reduces the potential for infiltration of contaminants into the bearing assemblies at the opposing ends of the shaft. By use of stampings, co-molded polymer with sealed metal end caps, press-fit end shafts and stamped-metal support structures a more contamination-resistant and efficiently constructed idler assembly is provided. A hollow shaft center section can be used. The polymer defines at least three sealing structures. The shaft defines a multi-piece unit, with the end shafts press-fit onto the center shaft section and held in place by the bearing subassemblies—affixed to the idler sleeve. The support framework includes three stamped and/or cut, and folded sheet metal pieces—a center section with a pair of opposing central risers that engage end shafts, and two opposing, separately attached, end risers, that engage outermost idler end shafts.

title_en: Shunt valve for a bidet and a toilet cover plate including the shunt valve
abstract_en: A shunt valve for a bidet includes a valve body and a valve core. The valve body is provided with a water inlet port and a water outlet port. The valve core includes a movable valve plate and a fixed valve plate. The movable valve plate and the fixed valve plate abut against each other, and are rotatably matched with each other. The water outlet port includes a washing water outlet port and a self-cleaning water outlet port. The fixed valve plate is provided with a washing water outlet hole communicating with the washing water outlet port and a self-cleaning water outlet hole communicating with the self-cleaning water outlet port. The movable valve plate is provided with an overflowing hole communicating with the water inlet port. A toilet cover plate including the shunt valve is provided.

title_en: Compact, motorized, height-adjustable, software-controlled desktop system
abstract_en: An improved, height-adjustable desktop system that accommodates various postures including, but not limited to, seated in a chair at a desk, or standing upright on a floor, or various possible positions in between fully-seated or fully-standing, according to a user's preference. Systems and methods for providing computer-control for height adjustments allowing automatic or remote adjustment or both. The desktop system further providing minimalized footprint and upright design to allow placement in small spaces.

title_en: Evaporator device, consumable unit, inhaler and method for manufacturing electrically heatable heating bodies and seal carriers
abstract_en: An evaporator device for an inhaler, in particular for an electronic cigarette product comprises an electrically heatable heating body having at least one passage opening for evaporating liquid contained in the passage opening and a carrier for retaining the heating body. The evaporator device has a sealing device, and the sealing device is arranged between the heating body and the carrier and encloses the at least one passage opening in a sealing manner.

title_en: Rotary actuator including a housing
abstract_en: In at least some implementations, a rotary actuator includes a drive assembly including a motor and one or more gears coupled to and rotated by the motor, an output rotated by the drive assembly and a housing. The housing includes a first portion and a second portion coupled to the first portion to define an interior in which at least part of the drive assembly is received. The housing also includes a first motor locating feature that engages the motor and positions the motor within the housing and prevents rotation of the motor, and a first gear locating feature that locates and retains the position of at least one of said one or more gears. The first motor locating feature and first gear locating feature are both integrally formed in the housing.

title_en: Valve for aircraft inflation system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a pneumatic inflation valve assembly, having: a valve housing defining a valve cavity and including an axial proximate end and an axial distal end, the proximate end including an outlet from the valve cavity and the distal end including an inlet into the valve cavity, the proximate end includes a motion hole, the distal end includes a receiving volume; and a poppet is disposed in the valve cavity that includes an axial proximate stem extending through the motion hole, an axial distal stem is disposed in the receiving volume and is moveable within the valve cavity between an opened position and a closed position, when the poppet is at the opened position the distal stem extends further into the receiving volume than at the closed position, and the center body is axially spaced from the proximate end and the distal end of the valve housing.

title_en: Vehicle power management system
abstract_en: An apparatus comprising an interface, a memory and a processor. The interface may be configured to receive sensor data samples during operation of a vehicle. The memory may be configured to store the sensor data samples over a number of points in time. The processor may be configured to analyze the sensor data samples stored in the memory to detect a pattern. The processor may be configured to manage an application of brakes of the vehicle in response to the pattern.

title_en: Vehicle transmission
abstract_en: A transmission for a motor vehicle includes an electric motor and a flexible traction drive mechanism which includes a first traction mechanism wheel, such as, a gear or pulley, which is rotationally fixed to a rotor shaft of the electric motor, a second traction mechanism wheel which can be rotationally fixed to a transmission component and which is drivingly connected to the first traction mechanism wheel by a traction mechanism, such as, a belt or chain, and a bearing journal for supporting the first traction mechanism wheel. An oil line extends through the bearing journal, and oil can be fed to the electric motor via the oil line.

title_en: Electroconductive roll
abstract_en: An electroconductive roll includes a core member, a rubber base material disposed around the core member, and a surface layer disposed around the rubber base material. The density of peaks S pd  of the surface of the surface layer is equal to or greater than 93,406 (1/mm 2 ), and is equal to or less than 153,027 (1/mm 2 ).

title_en: Vehicle power management system
abstract_en: An apparatus comprising an interface, a memory and a processor. The interface may be configured to receive sensor data samples during operation of a vehicle. The memory may be configured to store the sensor data samples over a number of points in time. The processor may be configured to analyze the sensor data samples stored in the memory to detect a pattern. The processor may be configured to manage an application of brakes of the vehicle in response to the pattern.

title_en: Cage nut fastener and methods for tool-less installation of same
abstract_en: A cage nut fastener, capable of installation against a frame member without the aid of tools, includes a spring cage and a nut retained within a space defined by the spring cage and prevented from rotation therein. The spring cage includes a back wall with a wall aperture therethrough, a cage arm extending in a forward direction from a side of the back wall, and a lever arm disposed at a side of the back wall that is opposite the cage arm. The nut includes a nut aperture therethrough that is generally aligned with the wall aperture of the back wall. The lever arm includes an extension portion that extends in a rearward direction behind the back wall of the spring cage. Application of a compression force upon the lever arm, without the aid of tools, manipulates the spring cage to a compressed state that facilitates positioning of a distal end of each of the cage arm and the lever arm through an aperture of a frame member so that, upon release of the compression force, the spring cage and the nut are secured against the frame member.

title_en: Socket assembly and method of making a socket assembly
abstract_en: The socket assembly has a housing with an inner bore which extends from a first end to a second end. A ball portion of a ball stud is received in the inner bore. A backing bearing is disposed in the inner bore and presents a curved bearing surface in surface-to-surface contact with the ball portion. A first spring biases the backing bearing against the ball portion. The socket assembly also includes an exit bearing with a cylindrical portion that is in contact with an equator of the ball portion and a semi-spherical portion that is in surface-to-surface contact with an opposite hemisphere from the first bearing surface. A second spring biases the exit bearing into a predetermined location established by the housing. The exit bearing is movable from the predetermined location in a direction towards the second end of the housing against a biasing force of the second spring.

title_en: Roller chain inner plate
abstract_en: A bicycle chain is used to transmit the drive force to at least one chain wheel and contains chain rollers and inner and outer plates which are connected to each other by means of pins. As a result of a corresponding shaping of the extremely hard inner plate, the wear on the teeth which cooperate with the inner plate can be reduced on the chain wheels or sprockets.

title_en: Systems and methods for assembling or disassembling a hammer tool
abstract_en: Systems and methods can include applying, using a nut assembly including a first nut and a plurality of fasteners provided in respective threaded holes of the first nut, a first tensioning force for a stud of a hammer assembly. The systems and methods can also include applying, using the nut assembly, a second tensioning force for the stud of the hammer assembly. The first tensioning force can be applied with the first nut in a first orientation whereby a first end surface of the first nut faces a first direction and a second end surface of the first nut faces a second direction opposite the first direction. The second tensioning force can be applied with the first nut in a second orientation whereby the first end surface of the first nut faces the second direction and the second end surface of the first nut faces the first direction. The second tensioning force can be greater than the first tensioning force.

title_en: Mainspring for a movement of a timepiece and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A mainspring includes a spiral metal strip and a hooking area formed in an inner face of an inner end of the strip, the hooking area including at least one shaped portion and at least one cavity in the inner face of the inner end.

title_en: Cable management on marine drilling risers
abstract_en: A drilling riser cable management system includes a plurality of clamping mechanisms pre-installed on riser joints and a robotic arm. The robotic arm has a cable handling mechanism that is configured to securely install the cable on each clamping mechanism without relying on human manipulation of the cable during installation.

title_en: Furniture bracket assembly
abstract_en: A bracket assembly includes a bracket, such as a flat plate bracket, including a first surface, a second surface opposite the first surface, and a number of apertures through the bracket extending from the first surface to the second surface. The first surface engages at least one table top board. The bracket assembly also includes a number of studs protruding from the second surface of the bracket, the studs to selectively attach the bracket to a second bracket structure, such as a leg support system. The bracket assembly can be used in furniture assemblies to secure table tops, shelves, or other structures to a support structure.

title_en: Aircraft cable routing system and method of installation thereof
abstract_en: A cable routing system is disclosed including a routing fixture and an exit fitting. The routing fixture defines a channel for a cable. The channel is engaged by the exit fitting and a cable in the channels exits through an exit channel defined by the exit fitting. The exit channel is directed away from the channel in the routing fixture. The resulting assembly allows low profile cable runs that can conform to a structural surface and in which cables can be broken out easily, without a requirement to cut the cable. A clamp may be provided to further secure the exit fitting to the routing fixture. A method of installation involves installing a cable into a routing channel before installing the exit fitting. The cable routing system can be used in an aircraft, including space constrained areas such as within an aircraft wing.

title_en: Metal roof mounting brackets
abstract_en: An adjustable bracket for a metal roof includes a bolt and a top platform with a hole sized to receive the bolt. The top platform provides a flat surface on which can be attached an L bracket. A left bracket has a curved portion with a slot for receiving the bolt. A right bracket has a curved portion with a slot for receiving the bolt. A bottom nut is sized to fit and secure the bolt. Once the top platform, the slot in the left bracket and the slot in the right bracket receive the bolt, the slot in left bracket and the slot in right bracket allow adjustment of an angle of attachment of the angle-adjustable bracket to the metal roof, until the bolt is tightened by the bottom nut.

title_en: Box made of single-layer plastic composite board
abstract_en: A single-layer plastic composite board ( 20; 30; 40 ) is disclosed.
