title_en: Wheel built-in power system for electric golf bag trolley
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wheel built-in power system for an electric golf bag trolley, including a motor, and a worm wheel engaged with an output worm of the motor, a spindle of the worm wheel being connected to a hub of any wheel of the electric golf bag trolley. The wheel built-in power system for an electric golf bag trolley of present invention is small in size and light in weight, and can be installed in wheels of an electric golf bag trolley, thereby effectively reducing the size of the electric golf bag trolley after being folded, facilitating movement and storage.

title_en: Safety belt automatic adjustment apparatus and child safety seat therewith
abstract_en: 22631399_1 (GHMatters) P118944.AU.2 Abstract of Disclosure A safety belt automatic adjustment apparatus includes a safety belt buckle fastening assembly, a safety belt retractor and a linking component. The safety belt buckle fastening assembly is rotatably 5 connected to a seat body of a child safety seat and for connecting with a safety belt buckle. The safety belt retractor is used for retracting a safety belt, and the safety belt retractor includes a restraining assembly for restraining a movement of the safety belt in a predetermined direction. The linking component is installed between the safety belt 10 buckle fastening assembly and the safety belt retractor, and the safety belt buckle fastening assembly rotates to drive the linking component and the restraining assembly, so as to restrain or release the safety belt winding around the safety belt retractor. The safety belt automatic adjustment apparatus has advantages of automatic adjustment for the 15 safety belt, simple structure, convenient operation and enhanced safety. title_en: System for increasing energy efficiency and assisting recovery energy from electric vehicles powered by a dc contact grid
abstract_en: The present utility model finds application in electric power facilities (energy and transport) supplying electric vehicles, which are supplied by a direct current contact network. The system includes a control module (6), to which one or more photovoltaic modules (1.1, 1.2 … 1.n) are connected, the central power supply (7), connected to a rectifier station (2), which in turn is connected to common buses (8), the control module (6) is connected via a bidirectional connection to the common buses (8) and to a supercapacitor (5), the common buses (8) being connected to one or more sections (3.1, 3.2 … 3.n), which represent separate sections of the power supply contact network, which includes direct and reverse feeders. Each section (3.1, 3.2 … 3.n) in turn is connected to one or more electric vehicles (4.1, 4.2 … 4.n).

title_en: Ifs including control arm and strut supported by steering knuckle load arm
abstract_en: An IFS assembly having a single lower control arm having an inboard end pivotally secured to a chassis support structure, an air spring supported by an air spring seat relative to the lower control arm, a strut having an upper end pivotally secured to the chassis support structure and a lower end coupled to the lower control arm outboard end, and a steering knuckle fixed to the strut lower end, the steering knuckle disposed below the lower air spring seat and whose rotative movement about the strut axis is unconfined by proximity between the steering knuckle and the lower air spring seat, whereby available wheel cut is maximized. Also an IFS module including right and left side IFS assemblies and adapted for installation into a vehicle.

title_en: Manual brake release mechanism for rail vehicles
abstract_en: A spring-biased lever arm mechanism for operating an operating lever of a parking brake release mechanism. The lever arm mechanism includes a lever arm mounted on a pivot pin, a torsion spring disposed on the pivot pin, and first and second cable release mechanism. A manually operated parking brake release mechanism is also provided for a railway vehicle including a brake actuator, an operating lever associated with the brake actuator to manually release an applied braking force, and the spring-biased lever arm mechanism for operating the operating lever.

title_en: Multimode gas delivery for rail tender
abstract_en: Disclosed is an liquid natural gas supply and delivery system with a multimode fuel gas delivery system and process. The tender is capable of supplying gaseous methane fuel to an cryogenic tank via direct pumping, pressure transfer, or any combination mode due to a configuration of pumps, heat exchangers, and piping and controls. There is redundancy in the tender and it can operate with saturated or unsaturated liquid

title_en: Passive system and method for venting and reducing moisture within a window cavity
abstract_en: A window system for an enclosure subjected to a change in air pressure, the enclosure having a window having an air-filled cavity, the system including a first path configured to allow air within the cavity of the window to vent out of the cavity, a second path configured to allow air to flow into the cavity, and a drying agent disposed within the second path, where moisture in the air entering the window cavity through the second path is reduced by the drying agent.

title_en: Establishing electronics in composite parts by locating electronics on lay-up mandrels
abstract_en: A method for forming composite materials and associated apparatuses is presented, including positioning at least one electronic component on a lay-up surface. The method also includes positioning a composite on the lay-up surface, where the composite comprises resin and fibers. Additionally, the method includes causing a flow of the resin between the lay-up surface and the fibers. Yet further, the method includes curing the resin to form a cured resin, where the electronic component and the fibers are located in the cured resin. The composite material includes a resin having a shape based on a surface of a lay-up system. Additionally, the composite material includes fibers contained within the resin. Further, the composite materials includes at least one electronic component. The electronic component of the composite material is located in the resin based on a flow of the resin around the electronic component on the surface of the lay-up.

title_en: Retractable cover with guided axial bearing
abstract_en: A tonneau cover system, comprising: (a) a retractable tonneau cover having a plurality of interconnected panels; (b) a first retainer secured to a first sidewall of a cargo box of a vehicle; and (c) a second retainer secured to an opposing second sidewall of the cargo box, wherein the first retainer and the second retainer are substantially parallel to each other so that the tonneau cover spans between the first retainer and the second retainer; and wherein the plurality of panels each include a bearing positioned within the first retainer to guide the tonneau cover in a direction substantially parallel to a longitudinal axis of the first retainer.

title_en: Medical cart for use in patient care
abstract_en: A medical cart for use in patient care is provided, the medical cart comprising: a front; a back; sides; four legs which have a distal end, a proximal end and a bore at least partially therebetween terminating in an aperture at the proximal end; a spring plunger mounted on each leg for releasably retaining a pole in the bore; a bracket attached to each leg proximate to the distal end; a caster rotatably attached to each bracket; a lower shelf attached to the legs and extending between the legs; a ballast sleeve below the lower shelf for releasably retaining weight plates; and an upper shelf attached to the legs and extending between the legs, the upper shelf including a recess at the front extending towards the back.

title_en: Aircraft fuselage longitudinal splice for joining half barrel fuselage sections and other spliced fuselage sections
abstract_en: An aircraft fuselage body is constructed of an upper body section having a curved cross-section configuration and a lower body section having a curved cross-section configuration. The upper body section and the lower body section are joined together to form an aircraft fuselage body by splice straps that are secured, end to end along interior surfaces of the upper body section and the lower body section. The aircraft fuselage body being constructed of an upper body section and a lower body section enables installation of systems separately into the upper body section and the lower body section prior to the upper body section and lower body section being joined together.

title_en: System and method for allocating propulsion load power drawn from high-energy and high-power batteries
abstract_en: System and method for allocating load power drawn from multiple batteries for powering propulsion of a vehicle. The system includes: high-energy and high-power batteries respectively designed for optimal production of DC power during high-specific-energy and high-specific-power propulsion; and battery health management systems configured to monitor state of charge and state of health of the batteries and generate battery status signals. The system further includes a propulsion load configured to produce propulsion force using power converted from power generated by at least one of the batteries and a system controller configured to allocate load power drawn from the high-energy and high-power batteries for use by the propulsion load in dependence on a propulsion phase of the vehicle and the battery status.

title_en: Land vehicles incorporating brake systems and methods therefor
abstract_en: Land vehicles and methods of operating land vehicles are disclosed. A land vehicle includes a frame structure, a plurality of wheels, and a brake system. The frame structure includes a front cage that at least partially defines an operator cabin and a rear compartment positioned rearward of the front cage in a longitudinal direction. The plurality of wheels are supported by the frame structure. Each of plurality of wheels is sized to permit direct integration of an electric motor therein.

title_en: Controlling gaseous fuel flow
abstract_en: A fuel control system for an aircraft engine, comprises a fuel feed conduit including an inlet end and an outlet end. A fuel metering mechanism is disposed in the fuel feed conduit between the inlet end and the outlet end operable to regulate flow through the fuel feed conduit.  A position feedback sensor is operatively connected to the fuel metering mechanism and operable to generate a signal indicative of a position of the fuel metering mechanism.

title_en: Hybrid steering system and method implementing virtual and mechanical stops
abstract_en: A steering system and method can determine one or more position- related characteristics of a steering column (214) of a machine, determine that the one or more position-related characteristics indicate that a resistive force is to be applied to the steering column, and control operation of an electric motor (220) to apply the resistive force to the steering column (214), wherein a mechanical end stop can be provided to restrict rotation of the steering column. One or more virtual stops may be set to limit rotation of the steering column (214) by way of controlling the operation of the electric motor (220) to apply the resistive force.

title_en: Compact vertiport with efficient space utilization
abstract_en: Embodiments provide a compact vertiport system. The vertiport system may be efficient and compact by combining, into one space and time period, multiple activities that typically take place in different spaces and different times. For example, when an aircraft is being moved from a landing zone to a takeoff zone, the aircraft may also be charged simultaneously. Also, passenger exchange may take place while the aircraft is being moved. As a result, compact vertiport systems may fit into smaller spaces (e.g., tops of buildings, or smaller plots of land).

title_en: Panel device
abstract_en: A panel device (10), particularly a roof light for a recreational vehicle, comprises an at least substantially polygonal frame (11, 12) which surrounds an opening (15).  A  window (20) is connected to the frame for pivoting about a pivot axis and comprises a panel (21) which extends over the opening. Provided between the frame and the window is a stay device (50) which is manipulable between a first position, in which the window is forced into a flat state and closes the opening, and at least one second position in which the window is raised by the stay device and leaves the opening at least partially clear. The stay device comprises a stay (51, 52) which extends movably from an elongate guide (61, 62) at a first outer end and is connected pivotally to the window at an opposite, second outer end. The stay (51, 52) is adjustable in the guide and is coupled to an actuator (78) via a flexible transmission (71..83). The transmission comprises at least one tension-resistant pull member (71-73) which is coupled to the stay (51, 52) and which is movable in an axially at least substantially rigid yet flexible sleeve (81-83), a first outer end of which is fixed to or close to the stay (51, S2) and a second outer end of which is attached to or close to the actuator (78).

title_en: Communication protocol for treatment devices
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for providing operation data for treatment devices for treating an agricultural field (14), wherein the treatment devices include at least a first treatment device (21) and a second treatment device (22) for treating the agricultural field (14), the method comprising the steps: obtaining field data for at least one section of the agricultural field at least from the first treatment device; based on the field data associated with the at least one section providing selection data for selecting the second treatment device associated with the at least one section of the agricultural field.

title_en: Emergency response barrier
abstract_en: An emergency response barrier is shown and described, the barrier having a frame with reinforcing bracing; two axles coupled to the frame with wheels attached thereto; a king pin coupled to the frame; wherein the frame is covered with a substantially planar skin that extends along the right and left sides of the frame, from a top of the frame down to a lower edge and covers a majority of the wheels on each side of the barrier; an impact attenuator coupling on the frame, having a vertical pin received in a bore disposed on an impact attenuator, and configured for rotation about the vertical axis of the pin; and a hydraulic cylinder connected between the frame and the impact attenuator, wherein retraction and extension of the hydraulic cylinder moves the impact attenuator through an arc of rotation about the vertical pin.

title_en: Determining state of charge, molarity and oxidation state in a flow battery and controlling a flow battery
abstract_en: A system and method for measuring the state of charge (SOC), molarity and concentrations of active species and oxidation state of a flow battery, such as a Vanadium Redox Flow Battery (VRFB). A reference electrolyte is circulated through a reference cell in conjunction with one or both charged electrolytes (in respective conduits). The electric potential of charged electrolyte relative to a reference electrolyte is measured. This measurement is directly convertible to SOC. An equation allowing for the calculation of the molarity, concentration of vanadium ions on both anolyte and catholyte sides of the flow battery and oxidation state is also taught. A flow battery may be controlled in response to such a determination, for example to manage oxidation state, or to charge or discharge a battery.

title_en: Handcart
abstract_en: One embodiment of the invention provides a cart comprising a frame with casters underneath and sockets located above the casters with longitudinal grooves for receiving and locating uprights formed from square tubing. The frame of the cart provides storage for unused tubing in a way that forms a load-bearing surface for the cart. In one embodiment two carts can be connected side by side by square tubing to accommodate large loads.

title_en: Electrical vehicle
abstract_en: An electrical vehicle (1) comprising a battery system (3) configured to generate electrical energy to operate the electrical vehicle, a control system (5) configured to control various systems of the electrical vehicle, a temperature monitoring system (7) configured to monitor at least one temperature of said battery system (3), and to generate a temperature signal (9) comprising said at least one temperature, wherein said battery system is provided with a thermal energy arrangement (11) arranged to supply thermal energy to keep the battery system (3) within an optimal operating temperature interval. The thermal energy arrangement (11) comprises a mechanical vapor recompression, MVR, unit (13) and an absorption cooler unit (15). A working liquid, preferably having a freezing temperature less than -40 ºC, is applied. A control system (5) is configured to receive the temperature signal (9), and to control the thermal energy arrangement (11) in dependence of the at least one temperature, to supply said generated thermal energy to the battery system (3) via a cooling line (35) and a heating line (39) to keep the temperature of said battery system (3) within said predetermined temperature interval.

title_en: Continuously variable transmission and vehicle including same
abstract_en: A method of controlling a continuously variable transmission (CVT) of a vehicle that includes an engine operative to drive the CVT, includes: determining a speed of the engine of the vehicle; detecting at least one of a throttle demand and a throttle valve position; determining a clutch control variable based on an operator input device, the CVT of the vehicle including a first clutch and a second clutch, the first clutch being moveable by an actuator to modulate a gear ratio of the CVT; calculating a target engine speed based on the at least one of the throttle demand and the throttle valve position and the clutch control variable; determining an acceleration of the vehicle; and calculating a target position of the first clutch of the CVT based on the calculated target engine speed, the determined acceleration of the vehicle, and the determined speed of the engine.

title_en: Semi-autonomous refuse collection
abstract_en: Operating a refuse collection vehicle to collect refuse from a refuse container includes positioning a refuse collection vehicle with respect to a refuse container to be emptied. The positioning includes positioning the refuse collection vehicle in a fore-aft direction while observing images on a graphical display within the vehicle obtained from a camera directed at the refuse container, to align a feature of an image of the refuse container on the graphical display with a visual marker positioned on the graphical display. The visual marker comprises a first guideline and a second guideline positioned on the graphical display. The present invention enables a refuse collection vehicle to operate with semi-autonomous functionality for refuse collection and ejection

title_en: Railroad freight car access fittings
abstract_en: A railroad freight car may have external fittings, such as trackside-accessible ladder fittings that permit personnel to climb onto the decks and walkways of the car. Several embodiments of movable ladder assemblies are described that provide an extended or deployed or raised position of a handhold, and a retracted or lowered, or stored position. In other embodiments, the assembly is provided with a compliant member that allows the handhold resiliently to flex when encountered by solid objects such as shipping containers.

title_en: Starting self-balancing control method for electric balance swing car
abstract_en: The invention relates to a starting self-balancing control method and a starting self-balancing control system for an electrodynamic balance swing car. It has solved unable automatic balance class of technical problem of current electrodynamic balance car start. Including the balance car automobile body that is formed by two pedal seat pin joints, be equipped with in-wheel motor on the pedal seat respectively, be equipped with control circuit in the balance car automobile body, control circuit is connected with the power module that sets up in the balance car automobile body and link to each other with in-wheel motor respectively, thereby be equipped with between control circuit and the power module and enable control circuit and power module intercommunication and enable two in-wheel motor respectively rotate under the control circuit effect and rotate the inclination that makes two pedal seats all keep unanimous with the initial setting inclination thereby make the balance car automobile body carry out balanced state's start self-balancing button. Has the advantages that: the degree of automation is high, realizes the balance of two foot rest automatically after the start, and the method of playing is diversified, has both driving modes for the user to select.

title_en: Hill starting system and using method thereof
abstract_en: A hill start system comprises a two-position three-way electromagnetic valve, a load sensing valve, an ABS valve, a gearbox controller and a hill start switch, wherein an air inlet of the two-position three-way electromagnetic valve is communicated with an air outlet of an air compressor sequentially through a foot valve, an air storage cylinder, a four-protection valve and a dryer, an air outlet of the two-position three-way electromagnetic valve is communicated with an air inlet of the ABS valve through the load sensing valve, the two-position three-way electromagnetic valve and the ABS valve are in signal connection with a hill start controller, the hill start switch and an engine are in signal connection, when the hill start system is used, the hill start switch is pressed down firstly, the manual control valve is closed, then an accelerator is stepped down, and the hill start controller automatically controls the clutch combination depth according to calculated hill resistance which needs to be overcome currently and coordinates the output torque of the engine, so that a vehicle can be started stably. The design not only simplifies the structure and improves the starting response speed, but also realizes the integrated control of the brake, the clutch and the engine.

title_en: Wireless charging power coil, wireless charging system and wireless charging control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless charging power coil, a wireless charging system and a wireless charging control method, wherein the wireless charging power coil comprises a first coil, a second coil and a switching device; the first coil is connected with the second coil; the current rotation direction in the first coil is the same as the current rotation direction in the second coil, and the current rotation direction in the first coil is a polar charging mode; the current rotation direction in the first coil is opposite to the current rotation direction in the second coil in an electrodeless charging mode; the switching device switches the wireless charging power coil to work in the polar charging mode or the electrodeless charging mode.

title_en: Clamping structure for attaching rotary operating device to bicycle and rotary operating device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a clamping structure (1) for attaching a rotary operating device to a bicycle. The clamping structure (1) comprises a clamping portion (2) and an operating member support portion (3), the clamping portion (2) having a clamping axis (X) and being configured to clamp to a bicycle, the operating member support portion (3) being configured to support an operating member (101) of a bicycle rotational operating device (100), wherein a rigid weakened portion (4) is formed between the clamping portion and the operating member support portion in an axial direction parallel to the clamping axis. Further, the invention relates to a clamping structure having a slit (4), the slit (4) being formed between the clamping portion (2) and the operating member support portion (3) in an axial direction parallel to the clamping axis (X). In addition, the present invention relates to a bicycle rotation operating device including such a clamping structure.

title_en: Method for passive access control
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for passive access control by means of a mobile device (14) used as a key and an interaction unit, wherein the mobile device (14) and the interaction unit (12) each have at least one data communication device (20) provided for exchanging authorization information. The following steps are provided here: -implementing electronic ranging (18) between the mobile device (14) and the interaction unit (12); access and/or interaction is only allowed when the distance (30) between the mobile device (14) and the interaction unit (12) is within the allowable distance (28). The invention is based on the object of increasing the comfort and security of passive access control by means of a mobile device used as a key.

title_en: Opening mechanism and opening method for drag parachute cabin door of airplane
abstract_en: The opening method of the aircraft drag parachute cabin door comprises a cabin door, a door frame and a lock rod mechanism, wherein the cabin door is connected to the door frame through a hinge, the lock rod mechanism comprises a pull rod, a front support, a rear support, a limit bolt and a limit spring, the pull rod is longitudinally embedded in the cabin door through the front support and the rear support, the limit bolt is arranged on the front support and corresponds to a pull rod oblong limit hole, the limit spring is fixed on the pull rod through a bushing and is limited by the rear support, the rear end of the pull rod is designed into a wedge countersink groove shape, the rear sleeve is of an opening structure matched with the wedge countersink groove, the opening of the rear sleeve is downward, and the door frame below the opening of the rear sleeve is provided with a square hole; when the cabin door is opened, the front end of the pull rod is impacted by external force, the pull rod moves backwards, the front end of the pull rod is separated from the front sleeve and is retracted into the cabin door, the rear end wedge countersink of the pull rod is separated from the opening of the rear sleeve and is square Kong Huala of the door frame, and the pull rod is opened along with the cabin door around the hinge shaft of the door frame.

title_en: Marine mechanical arm oscillation stopping mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a marine mechanical arm swinging stopping mechanism which comprises a lifting tool frame and a locking head, wherein the lifting tool frame is used for lifting equipment or objects, the locking head is used for locking the lifting tool frame, in addition, the swinging stopping device also comprises a mechanical arm with adjustable gesture, the locking head is arranged below the mechanical arm, the mechanical arm is connected with a shipborne A-shaped frame, a pulley is arranged on the A-shaped frame, and a traction cable bypasses the pulley and passes through the locking head to be connected with the lifting tool frame. The equipment or the heavy object is lifted by the lifting tool frame, the locking head locks the lifting tool frame to perform preliminary oscillation stopping, and the mechanical arm can perform corresponding posture adjustment along with the oscillation of the equipment or the heavy object after the lifting so as to reduce the oscillation amplitude.

title_en: Hybrid energy storage
abstract_en: A system includes a first energy storage device; a second energy storage device coupled to the first energy storage device and charged via a charging current from the first energy storage device; a power controller having a processor, a memory coupled to the processor and having stored thereon charging current instructions, and a converter coupled to the processor and directed via a switch control signal from the processor; and an output terminal via which power is provided to a load of the system. The converter is arranged between the first energy storage device and the output terminal. The converter is disposed between the first energy storage device and the second energy storage device and is configured to control a level of the charging current according to the switch control signal. The charging current instructions are executed by the processor to cause the processor to generate the switch control signal such that the level of the charging current is adjusted.

title_en: Variant supersonic aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of general design of airplanes, in particular to a variant supersonic aircraft. The method comprises the following steps: fuselage, two wings (1) and landing gear. The variant supersonic aircraft can realize the mode conversion from a low-speed flight state to a supersonic flight state through the sweepforward changing mechanism (2), and when the aircraft is in a low-speed flight state and a take-off and landing state, the wing with the large aspect ratio at the front edge is adopted, so that the induced resistance is reduced, and the low-speed flight path is increased; in a supersonic flight state, the wing with a sharp front edge and a small aspect ratio is adopted, so that the wave resistance is reduced, and the maneuverability is improved. The airplane can well meet the use requirements of high speed and low speed, and the passenger cabin, the cargo hold, the oil tank and the landing gear hold are all arranged in the two wings (1), so that no obvious airplane body exists, and the weight of the airplane is reduced to a certain extent.

title_en: System and method for controlling vehicle turning
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a system and method for controlling turning of a vehicle. The method of controlling turning of a vehicle may include: determining whether a turning control condition is satisfied based on the lateral acceleration; detecting a displacement of an accelerator pedal when a turning control condition is satisfied; calculating a motion index based on the displacement of the accelerator pedal and a predetermined value; and setting an operating mode of the powertrain and an operating mode of the suspension system based on at least one of the kinematic index or the lateral acceleration.

title_en: Composite material anti-creeping energy-absorbing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite material anti-creeping energy absorbing device, which comprises a fixed seat, a composite material pipe, an anti-collision plate, a connecting rod and a connecting rod, wherein one end of the composite material pipe is fixedly connected with the fixed seat, and the anti-collision plate is fixedly connected with the other end of the composite material pipe; the fixing seat comprises a seat body connected with the composite material pipe and first mounting holes penetrating through two opposite end surfaces of the seat body, the aperture of one end of each first mounting hole is larger than that of the other end of each first mounting hole, and one end of the composite material pipe extends into each first mounting hole from one end of the first mounting hole with a larger aperture; an end face of the anti-collision plate is provided with anti-creeping teeth. According to the invention, the composite material pipe is used as the energy absorbing element, and can bear axial force and radial force and absorb energy generated by axial impact force through crushing under the condition of bearing deflection extrusion, namely the composite material pipe has good guiding performance, and the energy absorbing element does not occupy a retreating space after absorbing energy, so that the problem that the anti-creeping energy absorber needs to be matched with a guiding component to guide the energy absorbing element is solved.

title_en: Vehicle impact safety system and method and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a vehicle collision safety system, a method and a vehicle, wherein the vehicle collision safety system comprises the following components: the device comprises a gas generator, a monitoring module, a controller and an airbag, wherein the gas generator is used for lifting a crashed vehicle to enable the crashed vehicle to crash into the airbag on a threshold of the crashed vehicle, the gas generator supplies gas into the airbag, the monitoring module is used for monitoring the speed of the crashed vehicle and the distance between the crashed vehicle and the pre-crashed vehicle and sending the speed and the distance to the controller, and the controller is used for controlling the gas generator to work when the speed is larger than a preset speed and the distance is smaller than the preset distance. The embodiment of the invention can lift the crashed vehicle before the side collision occurs, so that the pre-crashed vehicle can collide with the threshold of the crashed vehicle, the strength of the threshold position is higher, the energy of the side collision can be absorbed to the maximum extent, the expanding space of the air bag in the automobile can be ensured, the air bag in the automobile can be better expanded, passengers can be better protected, the safety performance is improved, the structure is simple, and the production cost is low.

title_en: Working method of bionic air bag neck protection device for airborne passenger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a working method of a bionic airbag neck guard device for an airborne passenger, wherein the bionic airbag neck guard device comprises an upper neck support air chamber, a middle air chamber and a lower shoulder support air chamber; the upper neck brace air chamber can exhaust air to the outside for pressure relief through an exhaust valve of the upper neck brace air chamber, and can also exhaust air to the middle air chamber through a combined exhaust valve, and the middle air chamber expands to realize first-stage buffering; the middle air chamber can exhaust air outwards for pressure relief through the middle air chamber exhaust valve, and can also exhaust air to the lower shoulder supporting air chamber through the combined exhaust valve II, and the lower shoulder supporting air chamber expands to realize secondary buffering; the lower shoulder supporting air chamber can exhaust air to the outside through the lower shoulder supporting air chamber exhaust valve to release pressure, so that three-level buffering is realized; the multi-stage buffering method of the bionic airbag neck guard device can prevent the head and the neck of a human body from secondary collision with interior trim of a chariot, can realize multi-stage release of internal pressure of an air chamber, and can prevent the airbag neck guard from blasting, thereby effectively ensuring safe landing of airborne passengers.

title_en: Friction shoe for railway vehicle bogie
abstract_en: A railway car truck includes two parallel side frames, a suspension spring assembly supported by the side frames, and a bolster mounted laterally between the side frames and supported by the suspension spring assembly. Each side frame has at least one vertical support surface and the bolster has at least one inclined support surface. The friction shoe includes a base engaging and supported by the support spring and a sloped wall engaging a sloped support surface of the bolster. The friction shoes prevent wear of the friction shoe sidewalls and help eliminate the possibility that wear of the friction shoes on the bolster sidewalls will interfere with normal movement during their service life.

title_en: Method for in-situ isomerization of polybutadiene
abstract_en: The method of in situ isomerization in the case of polybutadiene may include adding a mixture component of the cross-linkable rubber composition to a mixer, the mixture component comprising at least 10phr of a polybutadiene rubber having at least 80 weight percent cis-bonds and up to 90phr of a second rubber component having at least some diene unsaturation, and mixing the mixture component during a non-productive phase. Such methods may include treating the mixture components on a mill during the productive phase, adding at least 3phr of the disulfide isomerization agent, and mixing the disulfide isomerization agent with the mixture components. The mixing may be done in an internal mixer, where the isomerization agent is added to the mixer, or it may be added to the mill after the mixture components fall from the mixer to cool on the mill.

title_en: Underbody structure for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underbody structure for a vehicle, having an underbody assembly bounding a vehicle interior space, the floor assembly has a floor panel (1) and a seat cross member (5), the seat cross member (5) being connected to a door sill (3) on the vehicle exterior in the vehicle transverse direction (y) with a sill-side seat receiver panel (11) in the middle, wherein the rocker-side seat receiver plate (11) is an angle profile in cross section, which is connected to the rocker (3) by means of a horizontal mounting arm (13), and is connected to the base plate (1) by means of vertical supporting arms (17), and wherein the seat cross member (5) projects with its outer end in the vehicle transverse direction (y) through a through-opening (21) of the rocker-side seat receiver panel (11) into a cavity (25) bounded by the rocker-side seat receiver panel (11).

title_en: System and method for cleaning clogged HVAC exhaust
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for cleaning clogged HVAC exhaust pipes. A vehicle system is provided. The vehicle system may include a tube configured to provide an outlet for condensed water collected within an air chamber connecting the cabin plumbing to the ventilation manifold arrangement. The vehicle system may further include a cleaning duct bypassing the air chamber and connecting the tube and the ventilation manifold device, and a controller configured to block a passage between the air chamber and the cabin duct and activate a blower of the ventilation manifold device to build pressure within the air chamber and the cleaning duct to clean the tube.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted motor vehicle electrical system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an onboard motor vehicle electrical system (1) comprising a first power supply system (2 a) and comprising a second power supply system (2 b). The first power supply system (2 a) has a first power supply with a relatively low voltage, while the second power supply system (2 b) has a second power supply with a relatively high voltage. Furthermore, the first power supply system (2 a) and the second power supply system (2 b) are DC-insulated from each other and are connected to each other in a signal-transmitting manner by a coupling element (3). The second power supply system (2 b) has at least one electrical switching element (4) for a load (5), and the onboard motor vehicle electrical system (1) has a control device (6), which control device (6) is used to control the load (5) by means of the respective switching element (4). According to the invention, the coupling elements (3) are connected in signal-transmitting manner to the respective switching element (4) via the control device (6).

title_en: Component transfer trolley and transfer system
abstract_en: The invention provides a component transfer trolley and a transfer system, wherein the component transfer trolley comprises a trolley body, a feeding mechanism is arranged at one side of the upper end of the trolley body, clamping mechanisms are oppositely arranged at the upper ends of the trolley bodies at two sides of the feeding mechanism along the feeding direction, travelling mechanisms are arranged at two sides of the lower end of the trolley body, a guide mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the trolley body between the travelling mechanisms, and supporting mechanisms are arranged at two sides of the trolley body along the travelling direction; the component transfer system comprises a conveying line and a component transfer trolley, wherein the conveying line comprises a feeding rail and a discharging rail, a feeding rail is arranged on one side between the feeding rail and the discharging rail, a return rail is arranged on the other side, and the feeding rail and the return rail are I-shaped rails matched with the guide mechanism. The automatic transfer device realizes automatic transfer of the components from a workshop to a storage yard, the transfer process is stable and safe, the risk of tilting and side turning of the component transfer trolley is avoided, the manpower input is reduced in the whole transfer process, and the transfer efficiency is improved.

title_en: Lightweight unmanned aerial vehicle shock attenuation landing gear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light-weight unmanned aerial vehicle damping landing gear, which can greatly improve the damping effect when an unmanned aerial vehicle is landed, ensure the landing stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle and improve the adverse effect of landing on parts of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the horizontal buffering damper in bottom can be at horizontal displacement to realize front and back direction and the ascending shock attenuation of vertical side, like this, not only can realize vertical shock attenuation, can realize horizontal shock attenuation moreover, effectively realize unmanned aerial vehicle's protection, reduce the impact property when its organism receives to rise and fall, simultaneously, guarantee the reliability of inner circuit structure, reduce the fault rate.

title_en: Mounting structure of automobile seat safety belt lock catch
abstract_en: The invention discloses an installation structure of a car seat belt lock catch, which comprises a seat belt lock catch, a slide rail upper bracket, an upper slide rail, a lower slide rail, a slide rail rear supporting leg, a lock catch support, lock catch claws and torsion springs, wherein the lock catch support is integrally in a door shape, the upper part of the lock catch support is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the slide rail upper bracket, the lower end of the seat belt lock catch passes over the upper part of the lock catch support and stretches to the hollow part of the lock catch support and then is connected with the upper end of the lock catch claws through a fixed shaft, the lower end of the lock catch claws are provided with claws which are exactly corresponding to a row of clamping teeth arranged on the slide rail rear supporting leg along the length direction, one end of each torsion spring is fixedly arranged on the rear side part of the lock catch support, the other end of each torsion spring is hung on the fixed shaft, and the front ends of the lock catch claws partially extend to the front side part of the lock catch support and are hinged with the lock catch support through the rivets. The operation of personnel can be facilitated, and the strength requirement on the sliding rail can not be improved.

title_en: Vehicle seat arrangement for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle seat arrangement (1) for a motor vehicle having a seat cushion (6) and having a flap assembly (7) arranged on the seat cushion (6), which has a foam layer (9), a viewing flap (8) arranged on a first side of the foam layer (9) and fixed to the foam layer (9) by means of at least one seam (10), and at least one pull-in strip (17) fixed to a second side of the foam layer (9), which is pulled into a recess (22) of the seat cushion (6) in order to fix the flap assembly (7) to the seat cushion (6) and/or to a vehicle seat part (23) carrying the seat cushion (6). At least one particularly flexible retaining strip (14) is arranged on the second side of the foam layer (9) and is fastened by at least one seam (10) to a plurality of fastening points (16) spaced apart from one another at the flap assembly (7), and the pull-in strip (17) is fastened between the fastening points (16) at the retaining strip (14).

title_en: New energy automobile inner room ventilation unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile inner chamber ventilation device which comprises a ventilation pipeline, wherein an exhaust through groove is fixedly connected to the bottom end outside the ventilation pipeline, a swinging blade is uniformly and rotatably connected to the surface of a supporting swing rod, an adjusting turntable mechanism is fixedly connected to the left end of the ventilation pipeline, a flow adjusting rotating block is rotatably connected to the right side of the supporting swing rod inside the ventilation pipeline, a disinfection drip chamber is fixedly connected to the middle position of the top of the ventilation pipeline, a disinfection dipping net is fixedly connected to one end of the disinfection drip chamber inside the ventilation pipeline, and wind direction guide plates are fixedly connected to the upper end and the lower end of the right side and the lower end of the outer side inside the ventilation pipeline. This new energy automobile inner room ventilation unit has reached in time to get rid of the interior air of car to twice disinfection avoids the virus to follow air cycle reentrant, improves the air circumstance of taking, has improved the selectivity of wind hole diameter and wind direction, increases the mesh of the travelling comfort of ventilation.

title_en: Automobile skylight control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method and a system of an automobile skylight, belonging to the technical field of automobile electronics, wherein the control system of the automobile skylight comprises a skylight controller, an automobile body controller, an automobile remote control module and a mobile terminal, wherein the mobile terminal is used for sending target indication information to the automobile remote control module through a mobile communication network, and the target indication information is used for indicating a target position which needs to be reached by the skylight; the automobile remote control module is used for sending the target indication information to the automobile body controller through the CAN bus; the vehicle body controller is used for sending the target indication information to the skylight controller through the LIN bus; the skylight controller is used for searching a target control instruction corresponding to the target indication information from the preset corresponding relation and controlling the position of the skylight according to the target control instruction, so that the problem of low skylight control flexibility in the related technology is solved, the effect of improving the skylight control flexibility is achieved, and the skylight controller is used for controlling the automobile skylight.

title_en: Torque transmission device
abstract_en: A torque transmission device (1) for a drive train of a motor vehicle, comprising an input region (25) which is rotatable about a rotational axis (A) and an output region (35) which is rotatable about a rotational axis B, a torque path (M) which extends from the input region (25) to the output region (35), wherein a torsional vibration damper unit (15) is first positioned between the input region (25) and the output region (35) along the torque path (M) and a gear unit (33) is subsequently positioned, wherein the torsional vibration damper unit (15) is provided with a first spatial region (17) and an adjoining second spatial region (19) along the torque path (M) and the gear unit (33) is provided with an adjoining third spatial region (28).

title_en: Anti-skid wheel and automatic walking equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-skid wheel, which comprises a wheel body and further comprises: the sliding groove is arranged on the inner side and/or the outer side of the wheel body; the anti-skid rod comprises a rod body, a limiting table arranged at the tail part of the rod body and an anti-skid flange arranged at the head part of the rod body; the rod body is arranged in the sliding groove and can slide in the sliding groove; and in the sliding process of the rod body in the sliding groove, the anti-skid flange can be attached to the outer side wall of the wheel body. The invention can realize good anti-skid effect without obviously increasing the weight of the machine, is suitable for lawns with dense or high grass, and can not damage the lawn ground. When the antiskid wheel is used as a driving wheel, the situation that the driving wheel of the mower slips can be effectively solved, various complex terrains and working conditions can be adapted, the intellectualization of products is improved, a user is not required to manually operate and maintain the lawn, the lawn can be more comprehensively maintained, and the problem that local areas cannot be trimmed is avoided.

title_en: Multi-group wheel slide rail type unmanned aerial vehicle launching device and launching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-group wheel slide rail type unmanned aerial vehicle throwing device, which comprises a mother machine, a slide rail throwing device and a plurality of wheel type storage racks, wherein the slide rail throwing device and the wheel type storage racks are arranged at the tail part of the body of the mother machine, the plurality of wheel type storage racks are sequentially arranged at the tail part of the body of the mother machine to form a throwing channel of an unmanned aerial vehicle, the slide rail throwing device is arranged behind the wheel type storage rack at the tail end of the throwing channel of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the wheel type storage rack comprises a rotary wheel, a main rotary shaft, a storage rack front support and a storage rack rear support, the rotary wheel is fixed between the storage rack front support and the storage rack rear support through the main rotary shaft, the rotary wheel can rotate around the main rotary shaft, and a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle hangers are uniformly distributed on the outer circumference of the rotary wheel, the invention can provide the storage capacity of a large unmanned aerial vehicle in the same configuration with not less than 4 frames, and depends on the slide rail throwing device and the wheel type storage mode, the medium and large unmanned aerial vehicles can be quickly released by separating from the main machine by means of self gravity. The aerial delivery work of the fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle with higher efficiency than that of the existing delivery mode can be realized by virtue of the advantages of large navigational speed, large range and large quantity loading of the aircraft platform.

title_en: Matching method for automobile braking energy recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a matching method for recovering automobile braking energy, which is applied to a quick charge-discharge storage unit of an automobile and comprises the following steps: 1, acquiring m road working conditions of vehicle running test evaluation; 2, processing road working condition data; 3, establishing a data fitting model; 4, calculating the maximum braking speed value under the expected probability; 5, establishing a longitudinal dynamic model of the whole vehicle during braking; 6, obtaining the actual vehicle braking energy transmission efficiency; and 7, obtaining the maximum capacity matched with the rapid charge and discharge storage unit. The invention can solve the problem of universality of the automobile braking energy recovery system, thereby more efficiently recovering energy generated during braking and ensuring that the automobile braking energy recovery has wider applicability.

title_en: Safety belt height adjuster
abstract_en: The application provides a safety belt altitude controller relates to automobile parts technical field, and this safety belt altitude controller includes: the device comprises a guide rail, a sliding piece, two locking blocks, a T-shaped push rod, an adjusting block and a plurality of springs; the compressed first spring upwards supports the T-shaped push rod, so that the T-shaped push rod acts on the two locking blocks, the two locking blocks expand towards two sides, and the clamping part is clamped into the square opening on the sliding chute to limit the relative sliding of the sliding part; so that the slide is at a fixed height. The adjusting block is pulled to slide downwards, the T-shaped push rod is pulled to move downwards, the second spring pulls the clamping parts of the two locking blocks to withdraw from the square holes in the two sides of the guide rail, so that the sliding part can slide up and down along the guide rail, and the height of the safety belt is adjusted. The safety belt height adjuster provided by the application relates to fewer parts and is compact in structure.

title_en: Sun capturing method based on angular velocity estimation information and sun sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sun capturing method based on angular velocity estimation information and a sun sensor. The method comprises the following steps: estimating the inertial angular velocity of the satellite in real time by using the dynamics and kinematic equations of the satellite; measuring the specific azimuth of the sun appearing in the satellite and the estimated value of the satellite inertial angular velocity by using the 0-1 type sun sensor, and searching the sun to enable the simulated sun sensor to face the sun; calculating a two-dimensional attitude angle according to the measurement information of the simulated sun sensor; the satellite attitude capture is controlled by utilizing the two-dimensional attitude angle of the simulated sun sensor and the satellite inertial angular velocity estimation information, and the included angle between the sun vector and a certain axis of the satellite body is reduced, so that the sun is captured by the sun-facing orientation plane of the satellite. The invention utilizes the inertial angular velocity estimation information and the 0-1 type sun sensor to search the sun, and then utilizes the inertial angular velocity estimation information and the simulated sun sensor to capture the sun, thereby realizing the satellite from the abnormal attitude to the sun capture, and ensuring the energy supply and the satellite attitude stability of the satellite in the full attitude mode.

title_en: Mobility device attachment system with winch arrangement
abstract_en: An electronically controlled wheelchair securing system is provided herein having a winch arrangement adapted for pulling and maneuvering a mobility device (e.g., a wheelchair, a scooter, a stretcher, etc.) up and down a walk-behind wheelchair accessible ramp of a vehicle and for providing securement to the mobility device during transport. The system includes two motorized front tie-down units adapted to be positioned in a vehicle in front of a wheelchair securing area. The front tie-down unit has an expandable/retractable restraint adapted to be connected to a front corner of the mobility device frame. The mobility device can be maneuvered up the ramp by changing the motor speed between the two front tie-down units. For example, when pulling the mobility device up a hill, the mobility device may be directed to the left by increasing the speed of the right tie-down unit, slowing the speed of the left tie-down unit, or both. Similarly, the mobility device may be directed to the right by increasing the speed of the left tie-down unit, slowing the speed of the right tie-down unit, or both. Similar adjustments to the speed of the motor may be made when the mobility device is directed down a hill.

title_en: Brake device of air bus
abstract_en: The invention relates to a brake device of an air bus, which solves the problems of poor brake effect and poor stability of the existing brake device of a vehicle and comprises a wheel frame body, wherein a traveling wheel is rotatably arranged on the wheel frame body, a cylinder frame is arranged on the wheel frame body, a disc brake disc frame which is arranged above the traveling wheel and takes an arc shape is movably arranged on the cylinder frame through an elastic movable mounting structure, the disc brake disc frame is provided with a brake component, the upper end of the disc brake disc frame is provided with a rectangular through hole, movable longitudinal frame bodies which are respectively propped against two ends of the rectangular through hole along the length direction and take a curved shape are movably arranged on the disc brake disc frame, movable transverse frame bodies which are mutually perpendicular to the movable longitudinal frame bodies are arranged above the movable longitudinal frame bodies, two ends of the movable transverse frame bodies are respectively provided with drivers which are connected with the wheel frame bodies, and the upper ends of telescopic shafts of the drivers are respectively connected with the ends of the movable transverse frame bodies. The invention has the advantages of good braking effect, high stability, difficult blocking of the braking device and the like.

title_en: Flow guide cover opening and closing mechanism and flow guide cover
abstract_en: The invention provides a guide cover opening and closing mechanism which comprises a transmission mechanism and an auxiliary power mechanism, wherein the transmission mechanism is connected to a guide cover body, one end of the auxiliary power mechanism is connected with the transmission mechanism, the other end of the auxiliary power mechanism is connected to a vehicle body, the guide cover opening and closing mechanism further comprises a buffer device for buffering the closing speed of the guide cover body, one end of the buffer device is connected to the vehicle body, and the other end of the buffer device is connected with the transmission mechanism. The invention also provides a guide cover comprising the guide cover opening and closing mechanism. The invention has simple and reliable structure and convenient operation, can effectively reduce the operation force when the cabin door is opened and the falling speed of the cabin door when the cabin door is closed, and protects the personal safety of operators.

title_en: Vehicle and control method for the same
abstract_en: A vehicle and a method of controlling the vehicle using a predetermined travel pattern of a travel route are disclosed. The vehicle includes: an engine; a speed detector configured to detect a running speed; and an inclination detector configured to detect an inclination of the road. The vehicle further includes: and a controller configured to control driving of the engine using a predetermined running mode. When controlling the vehicle according to a predetermined travel mode, the controller acquires current road condition information based on a travel speed of the vehicle and an inclination of a road, and determines whether the vehicle deviates from a route based on the current road condition information and the reference road condition information. When it is determined that the vehicle deviates from the route of the predetermined travel mode, the controller ends the predetermined travel mode and starts the normal travel mode.

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting object in vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an apparatus and a method for detecting an object in a vehicle. The apparatus for detecting an object in a vehicle includes a seat position determining device configured to determine whether a position of a front seat is a reference position, a seat position adjusting device, an object detecting device, and an alarm controller; the seat position adjusting device is configured to adjust the position of the front seat to a reference position according to whether the seat position determining device determines that the position of the front seat is the reference position; the object detection device is configured to detect an object around the rear seat when the position of the front seat is a reference position; the alarm controller is configured to output an alarm when the object detection device detects an object around the rear seat.

title_en: Energy recovery braking system and method for hydraulic braking electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic braking electric automobile energy recovery braking system and method, comprising a brake pedal arm, wherein the middle part of the front section of the brake pedal arm is rotationally connected with a pedal support body through a pedal shaft, the front end of the brake pedal arm is hinged with a brake master cylinder, and the rear end of the brake pedal arm is provided with a brake pedal; the brake master cylinder is connected with the service brake and the wheel assembly; a stroke sensor is arranged in the middle of the rear section of the brake pedal arm and is sequentially connected with a whole vehicle motor controller, an energy recovery motor and a wheel assembly; the electric automobile energy recovery braking is divided into an initial state section, a pressure building state section and a braking state section, so that the energy recovery braking system and the hydraulic braking system exert maximum energy recovery performance and braking performance in different braking stages, the energy recovery efficiency is high, the service frequency of a service brake is reduced, the service life of the braking system is prolonged, and the reliability, the safety and the comfort are high.

title_en: Frequency modulation sound induced electric propulsion purse seiner and fishing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a frequency modulation sound induction electric propulsion purse seiner and a fishing method, the frequency modulation sound induction electric propulsion purse seiner mainly comprises an electrically driven mother ship and an unmanned ship, the mother vessel is equipped with a control platform, fish finder and other specialized fishing equipment, and the boats are equipped with frequency-adjustable acoustic induction emitters. According to the invention, the purse seiner is trapped in a frequency modulation sound trapping mode, meanwhile, the sound trapping effect is considered due to overlarge vibration noise of a common diesel engine, and the mother ship and the unmanned ship are driven in a low-noise electric propulsion mode, so that a good fishing effect is ensured.

title_en: Fastening structure of air bag rigid package
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fastening structure of an air bag rigid package, which comprises a fastening assembly, a pontoon cabin body and a pontoon skin. The fastening assembly consists of a compression seat, a bolt mounting seat and a bolt. The pontoon cabin body and the pontoon cabin body are thin-wall parts made of composite materials, and hole sites are arranged at the edges of the pontoon cabin body and are used for installing the fastening components. The invention can ensure that the helicopter emergency air bag is not influenced by flying pneumatic load, can meet the requirement of emergency quick unlocking of the emergency air bag, effectively solves the technical problem of helicopter emergency air bag packaging, and fills the blank of China in the technical field of emergency air bag rigid packaging.

title_en: Transformer device for a charging station for charging a vehicle having at least two charging points
abstract_en: A transformer arrangement (10) of a charging station (100) for charging a vehicle having at least two charging points (110), having an input interface (20) for electrical connection to a power supply, having at least one primary winding (30) and electrically connecting at least three secondary windings (40) which are isolated electrically in parallel with one another, wherein the secondary windings (40) are connected to at least two output interfaces (60) of the at least two charging points (110) by means of a switching logic (50), and the switching logic (50) electrically connects the at least two secondary windings (40) in parallel with the output interfaces (60) of the charging points (110).

title_en: Vehicle and vehicle pedal bar equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle, which comprises a vehicle body, a pedal lever, a telescopic device, a locking seat and a locking swing arm, wherein the telescopic device comprises a pedal lever support and an arm assembly, the pedal lever is installed on the pedal lever support, the arm assembly is respectively and pivotably connected with the bottom surface of the vehicle body and the pedal lever support to drive the pedal lever to move between an extending position and a retracting position, and the locking swing arm can swing between a locking position and a releasing position, wherein in the locking position, the locking swing arm and the locking seat lock the pedal lever in the retracting position, and in the releasing position, the locking swing arm and the locking seat release the pedal lever. The vehicle can improve the stability of the pedal lever and reduce the damage to the telescopic device when the pedal lever is impacted by external force.

title_en: Lift-type door reinforcing device
abstract_en: A liftgate structure having a composite inner panel with an outer surface having a lower peripheral surface area extending across the width of the composite liftgate structure. Connectable to the inner panel is a composite outer panel having an inner surface with a lower peripheral surface area extending over substantially the entire width of the composite liftgate structure. A cushion curtain is arranged between the inner panel and the outer panel. The padded curtain is connected to the outer surface of the inner panel such that the padded curtain is positioned between the outer panel and the inner panel and extends substantially over both the lower perimeter surface area of the inner panel and the lower perimeter surface area of the outer panel. The padded curtain prevents splinters of the outer panel from moving past the padded curtain in the event of an impact to the composite liftgate structure.

title_en: Vehicle control method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a vehicle control method and device. The method comprises the following steps: judging the running state of the unmanned controller according to the network signal of the vehicle; and under the condition that the unmanned controller enters an abnormal operation state, terminating the operation of the unmanned controller, and controlling a transverse controller and a longitudinal controller of the vehicle to stop the vehicle within a set stop time. The embodiment of the invention can improve the safety of the unmanned vehicle, ensure that the vehicle can be stopped in time after the unmanned controller is abnormal, and avoid accidents.

title_en: Electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric vehicle. The abnormality in the decrease in the charging efficiency is more appropriately determined. The electric vehicle is provided with: the electric vehicle includes a motor, an electric storage device, a first power supply device connected to an electric power line connecting the electric storage device and the motor, a charging device charging the electric storage device with electric power from an external power supply, and a second power supply device supplying a part of the electric power from the external power supply to an auxiliary device via the charging device. The electric vehicle executes a charging efficiency determination process of calculating a charging efficiency that is a ratio of charging power of the power storage device to input power of the charging device and determining whether the charging efficiency is less than a predetermined efficiency. When the charging efficiency is less than the predetermined efficiency in the charging efficiency determination process, the electric vehicle stops the second power supply device to execute the charging efficiency determination process again.

title_en: Distributed automobile multi-working-condition identification differential steering method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed automobile multi-working-condition identification differential steering method and a distributed automobile multi-working-condition identification differential steering system, wherein the system comprises four modules, a data acquisition and analysis module is responsible for acquiring and diagnosing real-time information of a vehicle, the multi-working-condition identification module firstly identifies the working condition, namely, the vehicle is in a straight-going or steering mode, and if the vehicle is in a steering working condition, the vehicle is further identified to be in-situ steering, driving steering, braking steering and sliding steering; after the identification of the steering working condition is finished, the torque distribution control module completes the reasonable distribution of the torque of the inner and outer motors in the corresponding working condition, establishes a fuzzy control rule base, outputs a torque distribution coefficient/a sliding torque coefficient, introduces a yaw velocity for correcting the torque distribution coefficient/the sliding torque correction coefficient in real time for further considering the steering safety and the operation stability, thereby changing the target torque difference of the inner and outer motors and ensuring the steering safety and stability under the limit working condition; and the final data output module outputs target torques of the motors at the inner side and the outer side for controlling the motors in real time.

title_en: Tracked vehicle for preparing a ski run
abstract_en: A tracked vehicle for preparing a ski run, comprising: a frame (2); two wheel assemblies (3) arranged on opposite sides with respect to the frame (2); two tracks (4) each wound around one of the two wheel assemblies (3); at least one support device (15; 115) for each wheel assembly (3) which is coupled to at least two wheels (3 c) of the wheel assembly (3) and is connected to the frame (2) by means of a hinge joint, so as to couple at least two wheels (3 c) of the wheel assembly (3) to the frame (2), wherein the support device (15; 115) has: a first support element (16; 116) supporting one of at least two wheels (3 c) of the wheel assembly (3); and a second support element (17; 117) which supports the other of the two wheels (3 c) of the wheel assembly (3), and wherein the first support element (16; 116) and the second support element (17; 117) are connected to each other at a first point (19) by a first articulation joint (18).

title_en: Method for operating a hybrid electric vehicle cooling system including a liquid coolant transfer circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for operating a cooling system (10) of a hybrid electric vehicle comprising at least one heat engine (12) and an electric motor (14), the method for operating the cooling system (10) in electric mode comprising at least the following steps: -a step "E1" comprising determining whether the temperature of the liquid coolant in the high-temperature cooling circuit (100) is lower or higher than a threshold operating Temperature (TF) of the low-temperature cooling circuit (200)  Maximum of  ) (ii) a And-when the temperature of the liquid coolant in the high temperature cooling circuit (100) is lower than the threshold operating Temperature (TF) of the low temperature cooling circuit (200)  Maximum of  ) Comprises a step "E2" comprising opening a control device (302, 306) for controlling a transfer circuit (300) interconnecting the high-temperature cooling circuit (100) and the low-temperature cooling circuit (200).

title_en: Vehicle cleaning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle cleaning method and a vehicle cleaning system, wherein when an object to be cleaned is cleaned, a fluid driving device is controlled to output fluid matched with a first preset cleaning force and a preset pressure pulse frequency to clean the object to be cleaned, namely, the fluid with the amplitude of the first preset cleaning force and the frequency of the preset pressure pulse frequency is output to the object to be cleaned.

title_en: Vehicle transverse position control method and device
abstract_en: A vehicle lateral control method, the method comprising: acquiring information of a vehicle; acquiring environment information, and carrying out data fusion on the acquired information; judging an object which can be identified by the information after data fusion, and selecting different road driving strategies according to a judging result; the driving strategy is used in a degradation way and comprises a plurality of grades. The vehicle acquires the vehicle self information as vehicle state information and environment information, generates different transverse control strategies, and can upgrade or downgrade the strategies according to the environment change. The invention can adapt the vehicle to different environmental changes, adjust the use of the transverse position strategy, improve the applicable scene of the automatic driving function of the vehicle, adapt the vehicle to various complex road conditions encountered in the running process, and improve the safety of the transverse position maintenance auxiliary function of the vehicle.

title_en: Novel motion intelligence bracelet based on action record is rescued by oneself
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel intelligent sports bracelet capable of automatically rescuing based on action record, which structurally comprises a watchband, a watch frame and a watch head, wherein the watchband is locked with the watch frame, the watch head is embedded on the watch frame and consists of an action transmission device and an intelligent outer frame, and the action transmission device is matched with the intelligent outer frame; when a user sinks to a certain depth in the water, the intelligent outer frame performs induction starting on the operation of the inner scratch recording device, so that the wrist of the user can float out of the water; then, the bracelet can take notes the rhythm of the heart data when motion, and the action data of arm when also can the record motion can inquire whether standard in the action of arm when swimming through the record of bracelet, can test the degree of depth that the user is located the swimming pool when swimming simultaneously, can obtain the rescue by the very first time when meetting danger.

title_en: Current collector of vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a current collector of a vehicle, which comprises a base, an insulating arm, a driving assembly, a current collector part and an elastic piece, wherein the insulating arm is rotatably connected with the base, the driving assembly is respectively connected with the base and the insulating arm and drives the insulating arm to rotate relative to the base, the current collector part is rotatably connected with the insulating arm, the elastic piece is connected with at least one of the current collector part and the insulating arm, and the elastic piece is used for providing damping for the rotation of the current collector part relative to the insulating arm. According to the current collector of the vehicle, the elastic piece can adaptively adjust and reset the current collecting surface of the current collecting part, so that the current collector of the vehicle can stably collect electricity.

title_en: Lighting device
abstract_en: The invention provides an illumination device capable of forming an optimal light distribution pattern under the condition that the running of a vehicle is automatically controlled. Provided is an illumination device (100) that forms a light distribution pattern: in the virtual projection plane (VP), regions having the highest luminous intensity when the luminous intensity is equally divided into 3 regions from the minimum value to the maximum value are separated in the left-right direction by a V line, and at least a part of the region having the highest luminous intensity is located in a first central portion (M1) of the virtual projection plane (VP).

title_en: Automobile safety seat with safety belt guide piece
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile safety seat with a safety belt guide piece, wherein the safety belt guide piece is arranged on one side of a seat body, when the automobile safety seat is placed on the automobile seat, and a safety belt passes through and fixes the automobile safety seat, the safety belt guide piece is used for guiding a shoulder belt in the automobile safety seat, so that the symmetry of force applied by the automobile seat is strengthened when an automobile accident happens, and the dynamic performance of the automobile safety seat is strengthened. The breakaway structure of the belt guide may effectively absorb the impact force at different points in time of the car accident, so that the force generated by the impact may be dispersed without being concentrated on the belt path in all embodiments.

title_en: Vehicle safety control method based on information interaction of unmanned vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle safety control method based on unmanned vehicle information interaction. When an emergency happens, the vehicles are adjusted according to the collected information, and the information requesting the cooperative adjustment is sent when the surrounding vehicles need to be cooperatively adjusted, so that the damage of the vehicles can be reduced as much as possible. Therefore, the control method can realize information interaction between unmanned vehicles and control on vehicle safety. In addition, the invention also discloses a control device and a system based on the information interaction of the unmanned vehicle, and the effects are as described above.

title_en: Information display method, device and system for voice question answering
