abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent automobiles, in particular to a method and a device for displaying information of voice questions and answers, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring voice search information of a user, and acquiring corresponding service display information according to the voice search information; the service display information is information which needs to be displayed on a vehicle-mounted system; if the current interface of the vehicle-mounted system is in an occupied state, pausing display of the service display information and generating prompt information for pausing display of the service display information; when the vehicle is detected to be in the parking state, reminding a user to check the service display information according to the prompt information; according to the scheme, the phenomenon that the service display information covers the relevant interface being displayed in the vehicle-mounted system is avoided, so that the driving operation of a user is influenced, the traffic accident caused by the fact that the user checks the service display information in an improper time can be prevented, and the personal safety of the user is improved.

title_en: Energy-saving optimization method under train interconnection and intercommunication overline operation
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy-saving optimization method under the condition of train interconnection and intercommunication cross-line operation. The method comprises the following steps: respectively obtaining traction processes of the local train and the cross-line train according to the traction characteristic curves of the local train and the cross-line train, and establishing a driving strategy energy-saving optimization model of the local train and the cross-line train in different traction processes; solving a driving strategy energy-saving optimization model by using a genetic algorithm to obtain a most energy-saving driving strategy, obtaining a relation between the running time and the running energy consumption of the local train and the cross train based on the most energy-saving driving strategy, and establishing an energy-saving optimization model of a rail train interconnection and intercommunication line timetable; and solving an energy-saving optimization model of the rail train interconnection and intercommunication line timetable by adopting a particle swarm algorithm to obtain an energy-saving optimization scheme which minimizes the total train operation energy consumption. The invention can coordinate the mutual restriction relationship between the local line and the overline line on the premise of safely and efficiently finishing the overline operation, improve the utilization rate of regenerative braking energy and achieve the aim of energy conservation.

title_en: Coaxial sprocket wheel rail structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coaxial sprocket wheel rail structure, and relates to the field of rail transit and traction transmission. The device comprises wheels, a track, chain wheels at the outer sides of the wheels and toothed rails at the outer sides of the track; the tread of the wheel is contacted with the rail; the chain wheel is coaxially connected with the wheel; a needle bearing is arranged between the chain wheel and the axle and can rotate freely; sprocket tooth tips are uniformly distributed on the outer edge of the gear, and a roller-type tooth-shaped structure is uniformly arranged on the rail surface of the toothed rail along the longitudinal direction; the chain wheel is meshed with the roller-type tooth-shaped structure; the side of the wheel is provided with a steel column, the side of the chain wheel is provided with a slotted hole, the steel column is inserted into the slotted hole, and the interaction of the steel column and the slotted hole can prevent the wheel from skidding and provide insufficient traction force or braking force for the train. The invention has simple structure, reliable technology and easy implementation.

title_en: Bicycle brake state visualization device and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bicycle brake state visualization device and a working method thereof, wherein the bicycle brake state visualization device comprises a brake handle, a brake connecting sleeve, a brake cable, a brake pad, a pressure sensor, a tri-color lamp, a controller, a wireless transmission module, a wireless receiving module and a distance sensor; the brake connecting sleeve is connected with a grip of the bicycle, the three-color lamp is arranged on the surface of the brake connecting sleeve, the brake handle is movably connected with the brake connecting sleeve, one end of the brake cable is connected with the brake handle, the other end of the brake cable penetrates out of the brake connecting sleeve, the pressure sensor is used for detecting the stress of the brake cable, the pressure sensor is electrically connected with the controller, and the controller is electrically connected with the three-color lamp; the brake pad is provided with a distance sensor and a wireless transmission module, the distance sensor is electrically connected with the wireless transmission module, the distance sensor is used for detecting the distance between the brake pad and the brake disc, the wireless transmission module is communicated with a wireless receiving module, and the wireless receiving module is electrically connected with the controller.

title_en: Cooling device for cooling an electric power unit motor and at least one further component, and vehicle comprising such a cooling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooling device for an electric machine (2) and at least one further component (4, 5) of an electric power unit: the cooling arrangement comprises an oil circuit (16), an oil pump for circulating oil to the electric machine (2), a first coolant circuit (6) configured to cool further components (5) of the electric power unit, and coolant radiator means (8 a, 8 b), wherein the coolant (6) in the first coolant circuit is cooled by air, the oil circuit (16) comprises an oil radiator (46), an oil radiator fan (47) configured to provide an adjustable air flow through the oil radiator (46), and a heat exchanger (15), wherein heat is transferred between the coolant in the first coolant circuit (6) and the oil in the oil circuit (16).

title_en: Automatic calibration method for vehicle-mounted radar, vehicle with driving assistance function and radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle, wherein an angle radar of the vehicle is prestored with a unique serial number and a plurality of communication identification codes, and the communication identification codes can be automatically distributed as follows: determining a fixed communication identification code of each angle radar and position automatic identification by randomly using one of a plurality of communication identification codes to send information to the control host to realize binding with the control host: and determining the self installation position according to the information of the gear, the speed and the direction angle of the vehicle and the information of the speed and the azimuth angle of the target detected by the self, and storing the self installation position. The automatic calibration method for the vehicle-mounted radar can automatically distribute the communication identification code (communication ID) and automatically identify the installation position after the radar is assembled on the vehicle, thereby realizing the radar with indifference production and assembly angles, saving the labor and material cost, reducing the management and control cost of production and assembly links, and avoiding manual errors through automatic identification.

title_en: Method for producing a connecting element and connecting element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a connecting element (1, 30), in particular for the articulated connection of components arranged in a chassis, wherein the connecting element (1, 30) is formed by a profiled element (6, 31) having a hinge section (2) for receiving a hinge component (5), an intermediate section (4) and a connecting section (3), wherein the profiled element (6, 31) is formed by an assembly of at least one first profiled section (7, 32) and at least one second profiled section (8, 33), which assembly is held in its position by means of at least one fixing element (9, 10) by a form-fitting connection; a hinge member (5) is inserted into the hinge section (2); and the molding element (6, 31) and the hinge component (5) are partially encapsulated with plastic by injection molding.

title_en: Fixing of an airbag in a vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fastening device for fastening an airbag module (46) having an airbag receiver (30) to an instrument panel carrier (10) of a vehicle, which fastening device is designed to form at least one mechanical connection (41) and at least one welded connection (35) between the airbag module (46) and the instrument panel carrier (10), wherein the instrument panel carrier (10) has at least one projection (24) and a flange (19) projecting from the projection (24), which delimit a chamber (23) and form a fastening bracket (12) for the mechanical connection (41) of the airbag module (46) to the instrument panel carrier (10), the instrument panel carrier (10) and the airbag receiver (30) having a weld (16, 35) for the welded connection (35) between the airbag receiver (30) of the airbag module (46) and the instrument panel carrier (10), 36). The invention also relates to a device for preparing an instrument panel support and a corresponding instrument panel support. The invention also relates to a method for fixing an airbag to an instrument panel carrier and to a vehicle having a corresponding instrument panel carrier.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling anti-lock brake system of ESC integrated brake system
abstract_en: An apparatus and method for controlling an ABS of an ESC integrated brake system are provided. The apparatus comprises: a master brake cylinder that generates hydraulic brake pressure by a piston that is moved forward/backward by an actuator that is operated when a brake pedal of a vehicle is depressed; and a controller that controls a forward/backward movement direction change of the piston by controlling a driving current applied to the actuator by determining whether a direction change condition is satisfied according to a control state of the wheel pressure when a braking mode of the vehicle is an ABS mode and the piston has reached a predetermined direction change position for a forward/backward movement direction change.

title_en: Intelligent cabin system with accident sensing and active safety functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent cabin system with accident sensing and active safety functions, which comprises a seat, a safety belt, a flexible touch sensor and a seat supporting table, wherein the seat supporting table is arranged at the bottom of a cabin; the contact surfaces of the seat and the safety belt with the human body are provided with the flexible touch sensors; according to the intelligent cabin with the touch perception, the driver posture is judged, the safety belt is tightened when the driver posture is suddenly changed and the emergency stop of the accident happens, the seat base, the backrest and the headrest are adjusted, the distance between the seat and the steering wheel is changed, and the intelligent cabin is more intelligent, efficient and safe.

title_en: Suspension system for a vehicle axle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a suspension system for a vehicle axle, comprising: a leaf spring (11); a rear attachment device (24) configured to be fixed to the vehicle frame (2) and comprising two parallel walls (40) spaced apart by a distance (d) in a transverse direction. A rear end portion (14) of the leaf spring (11) is accommodated in the rear attachment means (24) between the walls (40) and is longitudinally slidable relative to the rear attachment means. The rear end portion (14) of the leaf spring has a first width (w 1) smaller than the distance (d), and the leaf spring (11) has a second width (w 2) larger than the distance (d) at least in a blocking portion (30) of the leaf spring (11) located forward of the rear end portion (14).

title_en: Multifunctional amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a multifunctional amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine body, wherein a plurality of propellers are connected to the machine body, a pair of support frames are connected to the lower end of the machine body, a water-drawing mechanism is further arranged at the lower end of the machine body, the water-drawing mechanism is arranged between the pair of support frames and comprises a telescopic cylinder, a mounting plate, a first motor and a water-drawing frame, the telescopic cylinder is fixed on the lower surface of the machine body, a piston of the telescopic cylinder is vertically downward, the end part of the piston is connected with the mounting plate, the first motor is mounted on the left side surface and the right side surface of the mounting plate, a rotating shaft is fixed at the rotating output end of the first motor, and the water-drawing frame is connected to the rotating shaft. The unmanned aerial vehicle can run on the water surface, the running flexibility of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be in close contact with the water surface, required data are collected, and the application and adaptability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in hydrologic monitoring are improved.

title_en: Control method and control device of double-planet-row hybrid power system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method and a control device of a double-planet-row hybrid power system and a vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: the control method comprises the following steps: calculating an engine stop demand torque curve according to a fastest engine stop rotating speed curve; calculating the set rotating speed of the ISG motor according to the rotating speed of the TM motor and the set rotating speed of the engine and the lever relation of a double-planet-row hybrid power system, and calculating a speed regulation demand torque curve of the ISG motor according to the set rotating speed of the ISG motor and the actual rotating speed of the ISG motor; calculating a negative maximum value of the ISG motor generating torque limited by the system according to the battery charging power limit, the motor recovery power and the ISG motor characteristic; and taking a large value for each control time point in an engine stop demand torque curve, an ISG motor speed regulation demand torque curve and a negative maximum value of ISG motor generating torque limited by a system, thereby obtaining a set torque curve of the ISG motor.

title_en: Survival system of lunar base extreme environment
abstract_en: The survival system of the lunar base extreme environment is arranged at a constant temperature layer of the moon, the temperature of the constant temperature layer is kept constant, the survival system comprises opposite ceilings, floors and side walls connected with the ceilings and the floors, the ceilings, the floors and the side walls are enclosed to form an accommodating space for human activities, the ceilings are covered by the constant temperature layer, and the accommodating space and the lunar surface are provided with channels for human to enter and exit the accommodating space. Through setting up accommodation space, the smallpox is covered by the constant temperature layer, sets up the passageway again and supplies the human business turn over for accommodation space has comparatively invariable temperature, can regard as the shelter of human under the extreme environment, as the base that human survived and scientifically surveyed.

title_en: Rail train automobile body thin-wall aluminum profile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thin-wall aluminum profile of a rail train body, which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 0.66-0.72% of Si, 0.18-0.24% of Fe, 0.24-0.3% of Mn, 0.42-0.46% of Mg, 0.04-0.08% of Cr, 0.04-0.08% of Ti, 0.03-0.05% of Cu, 0.14-0.2% of La, 0.12-0.16% of Sr, 0.05-0.08% of Ce and the balance of Al. The thin-wall aluminum profile for the rail train body has the advantages of excellent tensile strength, fatigue strength, elongation and corrosion resistance, good comprehensive performance, capability of better meeting the use requirement of the rail train body and prolonging the service life and safety of the rail train body.

title_en: Display system, display control method, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a display system, a display control method and a storage medium, which can enable passengers to identify road conditions at more proper time. The display system is provided with: an identification unit that identifies a surrounding situation of the vehicle; a display unit that displays an image; and a display control unit that causes the display unit to display an image representing a road shape around the vehicle recognized by the recognition unit, wherein when a lane that can be traveled in the same direction as the traveling direction of the vehicle increases, the display control unit causes the display unit to display an image related to the increased lane on the outside of the image representing the road shape and on the side on which the lane increases, before displaying the image representing the shape of the increased lane.

title_en: In-vehicle device, management method, and management program
abstract_en: An in-vehicle device mounted on a vehicle includes: a processing unit; a determination unit that determines whether the vehicle is in a predetermined stop state; and a secure area accessible from the processing unit when the processing unit has output the predetermined information. Control information for controlling the in-vehicle device by the external device is stored in the security area. When the determination unit makes a positive determination, the processing unit accesses the secure area and executes acquisition processing, thereby acquiring the control information from the secure area.

title_en: Electronic device and control method thereof
abstract_en: Provided are an electronic device and a method for controlling the electronic device, which contribute to improvement in usability. An electronic device for controlling one or more bicycle components in accordance with an operation of an operating device, comprising a receiving unit for receiving operation information corresponding to the operation of the operating device, a 1 st wireless transmission unit for storing an operation command for the bicycle component in association with the operation information, a storage unit for transmitting the operation command corresponding to the received operation information from the 1 st wireless transmission unit when the receiving unit receives the operation information, and a control unit for changing the operation command stored in association with the operation information.

title_en: Bearing device for wheel and vehicle having the same
abstract_en: Provided are a bearing device for a wheel, which can mount a power unit that can obtain output satisfactorily with a small number of parts without largely changing the mounting structure of a bearing for a wheel to a vehicle body, and a vehicle having the bearing device for a wheel. The wheel bearing apparatus (1) includes a wheel bearing (2) and a power unit (3). The power unit is of an outer rotor type, wherein a stator (18) is positioned on the outer periphery of a wheel bearing (2), and a rotor (19) is positioned radially outward of the stator (18). The radial range (L2) of the power unit (3) as a whole is smaller than the diameter of the outer peripheral part of the brake rotor (12), and the axial range (L1) of the power unit (3) between the hub flange (7) and the vehicle body mounting surface on the inner side of the wheel bearing (2) is located on the whole except for the mounting part to the hub flange. The rotor (19) has an outer contour magnetic body (15) and a permanent magnet (14), the outer contour magnetic body (15) constitutes the outer contour of the power unit (3) and is formed of a soft magnetic material, and the permanent magnet (14) is provided on the outer contour magnetic body (15).

title_en: Rocker arm connecting mechanism and windscreen wiper
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rocker arm connecting mechanism and a wiper blade, wherein the rocker arm connecting mechanism is used for connecting a rocker arm with the wiper blade, the wiper blade comprises a connecting frame provided with a hinge shaft along the width direction of the connecting frame, the rocker arm connecting mechanism comprises a connecting piece and a locking piece, the connecting piece is assembled on the connecting frame, a hinge hole with an inlet is formed in the connecting piece, the hinge shaft is suitable for being arranged in the hinge hole from the inlet, and the width of the inlet is smaller than the diameter of the hinge shaft; the locking piece is provided with a locking plate, the locking piece is assembled on the connecting piece, the hinge shaft is assembled into the hinge hole, and after the locking piece is assembled into the connecting piece and in place, the locking plate is positioned on the side, corresponding to the direction of the inlet, of the hinge shaft so as to prevent the hinge shaft from being separated from the hinge hole from the inlet. The connecting frame can be firmly connected with the connecting frame of the windscreen wiper, and is convenient to use.

title_en: Motor vehicle starting control system and intelligent automobile based on alcohol detection
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a motor vehicle starting control system and an intelligent vehicle based on alcohol detection, wherein a drunk driving judging and managing mechanism is electrically connected with the vehicle starting control mechanism, the vehicle starting control mechanism is electrically connected with a vehicle-mounted starting circuit, a pressure sensor is arranged on a driving seat, an alcohol detection device is used for detecting the alcohol content in the body of a driver, an image acquisition module is used for acquiring image information of the driver on the driving seat, a display module is used for displaying the image information acquired by the image acquisition module and the alcohol content information detected by the alcohol detection device, and the vehicle starting control mechanism comprises a second processor, a first relay and a second communication module, and the first relay is electrically connected with the vehicle-mounted starting circuit. The invention can accurately and conveniently detect drunk driving of a driver, and when alcohol detection exceeds standard, the vehicle cannot be started, so that the personal safety of the driver is ensured.

title_en: Assembly for a tire comprising a three-dimensional textile or knit and a fixing element
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assembly (1) comprising: a first structure (10) formed by a first filiform element, a second structure (12) formed by a second filiform element, a support structure comprising a support filiform element (17) connecting the first filiform element and the second filiform element, and at least one filiform fixing element (18) interwoven with the first filiform element and the second filiform element, one of the ends (18a, 18b) of the at least one fixing element (18) being free to slide with respect to the first filiform element and the second filiform element.

title_en: Stable transportation system of small-section extra-long tunnel and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stable transportation system of a small-section extra-long tunnel and an operation method thereof. This stable transportation system in little section extra long tunnel and operation method thereof can realize assembling outside through the extended design with transportation system, fine reaching not only quick but also convenient expand the purpose of putting up to the transportation system subassembly, simplified transportation system's extension work of putting up greatly, need not to spend a large amount of time will put up the structure and transport to the hole in, fine having saved a large amount of manpower and materials, improved the efficiency of construction greatly, improved transportation system's degree of automation simultaneously greatly.

title_en: Control method and control device of thermal management system, readable storage medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a control method and a control device of a thermal management system, a readable storage medium and a vehicle. In the control method, if the first type of components in a state to be cooled or heated exist in the thermal management system, whether the thermal management system meets a heat exchange condition is determined according to the temperature of the components in the thermal management system, and heat exchange is carried out on the components in the thermal management system when the heat exchange condition is met. That is, for a component in a state to be heated, a component that needs to be heated is preferentially heated by the heat of a component having a higher temperature, and for a component in a state to be cooled, a component having a lower temperature is preferentially cooled. Therefore, the temperature of the part to be heated or cooled can be adjusted to the normal temperature interval to the maximum extent, the heat utilization rate of the heat management system can be improved, the consumption of electric quantity can be reduced, and the driving range of the electric vehicle can be improved.

title_en: Tyre for vehicle wheels
abstract_en: The on-ice performance of the tire is improved while suppressing the chipping of the blocks of the tread portion. The tire has a tread portion provided with blocks (31). The side walls (35) of the block (31) extend in the tire circumferential direction (S) between end walls (36) on both sides of the tire circumferential direction (S). The center sipe (22) of the block (31) is formed in the tire circumferential direction (S) along the tire width direction (H) on the block contact surface (34) of the block center portion (33), and is open to the side wall (35). A side wall angle (P) formed by the tire radial surface (K1) and the side wall (35) of the block (31) increases from the block center portion (33) toward the end wall (36).

title_en: Vehicle control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control device for a vehicle. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: collecting the running state parameters of a target vehicle, wherein the target vehicle runs according to a preset planned route, and the planned route comprises the following steps: longitudinal planning and transverse planning; judging whether to change the transverse planning of the target vehicle based on a target control strategy according to the driving state parameters, wherein the target control strategy is selected from a plurality of preset candidate control strategies; and continuing to control the target vehicle to run according to the judgment result. The invention solves the technical problem of lower automation degree of the unmanned automobile in the prior art.

title_en: Electric power steering apparatus
abstract_en: The motor unit has an electric motor, a control device, a bus bar, a 1 st cover and a 2 nd cover. The electric motor includes a motor case and a motor flange disposed at one end of the motor case. The control device has a control device case facing the motor case and is supported by the electric motor. The bus bar protrudes from the motor flange toward the control device and connects the electric motor and the control device. The 1 st cover is attached to the electric motor and covers at least a part of an upper side surface of the bus bar. The 2 nd cover is mounted to the control device case. The 1 st cover has a groove opened to an upper side. The 2 nd cover overlaps the slot on the upper side.

title_en: Novel brake pedal structure of automobile
abstract_en: Novel brake pedal structure of car, including footboard, footboard arm, brake master cylinder linking arm, first connecting axle, second connecting axle, intermediate link arm. The pedal arm is rotatably connected with the first connecting shaft, the brake main cylinder connecting arm is rotatably connected with the second connecting shaft, and two ends of the middle connecting arm are respectively rotatably connected with the pedal arm and the brake main cylinder connecting arm. Under the non-braking state, the axis of the rotary connection between the intermediate connecting arm and the connecting arm of the brake master cylinder and the axis of the rotary connection between the intermediate connecting arm and the pedal arm are distributed on the lower side and the upper side of a plane determined by the axis of the first connecting shaft and the axis of the second connecting shaft; in a full braking state, the axis of the rotary connection between the intermediate connecting arm and the connecting arm of the brake main cylinder and the axis of the rotary connection between the intermediate connecting arm and the pedal arm are both positioned above a plane defined by the axis of the first connecting shaft and the axis of the second connecting shaft. The beneficial effects are that: it is easy to arrange a relatively ideal automobile brake pedal structure in a relatively small space.

title_en: Vehicle lower part structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle lower part structure which does not apply excessive load to an umbilical member. A wire harness protector (10) is provided with: a main body part (11) which accommodates the wire harness (30) therein; a holding part (12) extending laterally from one side surface (11 a) of the main body part (11) and holding a cleaning liquid pipe (20) between the bottom plate (3); and mounting parts (13, 13) provided on the other side surface (11 b) of the main body part (11) and mounted to the vehicle body via the side sill (2). The cleaning liquid pipe (20) has a lower protrusion (21) which is bent into a valley shape by being bent downward and is located below the lower surface (11 c) of the main body (11). The harness protector (10) has a protruding portion (40) that protrudes downward from a lower end surface (41) of the main body (11) compared to the lower surface (11 c).

title_en: Heat abstractor and AGV dolly
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat dissipation device and an AGV trolley, wherein the heat dissipation device comprises a liquid supply assembly, a refrigeration part, a first cooling part and a second cooling part which are sequentially connected end to form a liquid supply loop; the heat sink further includes: the fan assembly is arranged opposite to the first cooling part so that airflow formed by the fan assembly passes through the first cooling part; temperature detection means for detecting a temperature of the first heating part to control the stop of the cooling part according to the temperature detected by the temperature detection means; wherein the second cooling component is for contacting the second heat generating component; the first heat generating component and the second heat generating component are both positioned on a side of the first cooling component facing away from the fan assembly. The cooling method that this heat abstractor combines together through adopting air-cooled method and liquid cooling method to solve the relatively poor problem of radiating effect of laser guide formula AGV among the prior art.

title_en: Deployment mechanism based on shape memory alloy drive and alloy pretreatment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unfolding mechanism based on shape memory alloy driving, which comprises a main rod, an auxiliary rod and a shape memory alloy wire, wherein the tail end of the main rod is hinged with the head end of the auxiliary rod, the shape memory alloy wire extends from the head end of the main rod to the tail end of the auxiliary rod, and two ends of the shape memory alloy wire are respectively fixedly connected with the main rod and the auxiliary rod. The unfolding mechanism based on shape memory alloy driving is applied to a spacecraft, adopts the shape memory alloy with the characteristic of thermal contraction, can drive the main rod and the auxiliary rod to be converted from a 0-degree fully folded state to a 180-degree fully unfolded state, and has the advantages of small occupied space, simple structure, small quality, stability, controllability, safety, reliability and the like. In addition, the invention also discloses a pretreatment method of the shape memory alloy.

title_en: Parking lock unit and drive assembly with such a parking lock unit
abstract_en: Parking lock unit for a drive assembly, in particular with an electric motor, comprising: a parking lock housing, a parking lock gear which is connected in a rotationally fixed manner to a part of the drive assembly which is rotatably supported about a rotational axis by means of at least one bearing and has a connecting section and a locking section which are connected to one another via a web section; a locking element which is mounted in the parking lock housing and which can lock and release a rotational movement of the parking lock gear about a longitudinal axis of the parking lock gear, and a controllable locking actuator which can reversibly shift the locking element into a position in which the parking lock gear is locked and a position in which the parking lock gear is released, wherein the parking lock gear is designed such that the locking section is axially offset relative to the connecting section.

title_en: Vehicle-to-rear vehicle road condition information prompting system and prompting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a vehicle road condition information prompting system and a prompting method thereof for a rear vehicle. The system comprises a distance measuring radar, a front camera, a display host controller, a central gateway, a vehicle body control module, a vehicle host and a light rainfall sensor; the central gateway, the vehicle host and the vehicle body control module are connected with the display host controller through a CAN bus; the light rainfall sensor is connected with the display host controller through an LIN wire; the display is connected with the display host controller through an LVDS wire harness; the distance measuring radar is connected with the display host controller through a hard wire; the front camera is connected with the display host controller through an LVDS wire harness. The front vehicle can acquire current road condition information in real time through the millimeter wave radar and the front camera, and gives rear vehicle information prompt through a display screen at the trunk, so that a rear vehicle driver can predict the front road condition information in advance to perform pre-operation in advance, and traffic accidents are reduced.

title_en: Electric motor car trades battery website by oneself
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of novel power batteries, in particular to a self-service battery replacement station for an electric vehicle, which comprises a machine body, wherein a charging cavity is arranged in the machine body, the upper end wall of the machine body is fixedly provided with battery replacement columns in a bilateral symmetry manner, the machine body and the lower half parts of the battery replacement columns are buried underground, the charging cavity is positioned in the battery replacement columns and is upwards communicated with a lifting cavity with an upward opening, and a lifting belt cavity is arranged below the two lifting cavities in the machine body; through putting the mode of getting promptly, shortened the battery changing time of vehicle greatly, improved the efficiency of changing the battery.

title_en: Electric vehicle speed limiting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a speed limiting method of an electric vehicle, belonging to the technical field of electric vehicle manufacturing, comprising the steps that firstly, an electric control unit ECM obtains the rotating speed of a motor through a phase signal and calculates the speed Vt of the motor according to the wheel diameter; step two, comparing the Vt with the speed limit V1, and entering step three when the Vt is less than V1; when Vt is more than V1, go to step (iv); step three, the ECM controls the motor to be controlled by the rotating handle; step (iv) the ECM gradually decreases the phase frequency at the start of V1 for a period of time t1 seconds, and compares Vt with V1: if Vt is greater than V1, go forward, if Vt is less than V1, go back to step C and then go to step C; fifthly, changing the speed reduction signal into a 0 duty ratio signal, returning to the third step until Vt is less than V1, and then performing the sixth step; step sixthly, maintaining the step III when the opening degree of the throttle twist grip is smaller than the first opening degree, and if the opening degree is not smaller than the first opening degree, progressing step seventhly; and step (c), controlling the phase frequency to increase progressively, wherein the maximum value is the time phase frequency of V1, and returning to the step (c) after t2 seconds.

title_en: Oblique slide rail type sliding window
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of structural design of helicopters, and discloses an inclined slide rail type sliding window which comprises an upper inclined slide rail and a lower straight slide rail, wherein the upper inclined slide rail and the lower straight slide rail are arranged on a helicopter body structure and are connected with an upper pulley assembly and a lower pulley assembly of the sliding window. The upper part of the sliding window frame is provided with an angle slide rail which is marked as an upper slide rail, and the lower part of the sliding window frame is provided with a lower slide rail which is marked as a lower slide rail. The included angle between the inclined section and the straight line section of the upper slide rail and the lower slide rail is 1-5 degrees. The problem that the straight sliding rail type sliding window cannot realize continuous sealing, and the bent sliding rail type sliding window does not have larger movement space inside the machine body is solved.

title_en: Method for producing spoke stars from continuous fiber/plastic composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing spoke stars (5) from one or more continuous fiber bundles (111), during which method a production device (100) is used to wind a fiber roll (3) and to deform the fiber roll (3) into spoke stars (5), wherein the production device (100) comprises a plurality of deflection devices (2) on the rim side and a plurality of deflection devices (4) on the hub side, wherein the deflection devices (2) on the rim side and the deflection devices (4) on the hub side are arranged around the inside of a layout (10) of the deflection devices (2, 4), wherein, in a first step, the continuous fiber bundles (111) are wound on at least a part of the rim-side deflection devices (2) as a fiber roll (3), and, in a second step, after the above-mentioned winding, at least a part of the hub-side deflection devices (4) is displaced in the direction of the inside of the layout (10), the fiber roll (3) is thereby deformed into a star shape, such that spokes (12) are formed from portions of the fiber roll (3) between the hub-side deflection device (4) and the rim-side deflection device (2), wherein the spokes (12) form at least a part of the closed spoke star (5). The invention further relates to a production device (100), a spoked star (5) and a spoked wheel (11).

title_en: Differential hydraulic combined steering control method and system and engineering vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential hydraulic combined steering control method, a differential hydraulic combined steering control system and an engineering vehicle, wherein a steering wheel angle is obtained, and an expected vehicle body steering angle beta is obtained according to the steering wheel angle; in the steering process, acquiring a real-time steering angle alpha; obtaining the corresponding expected oil cylinder displacement S according to the real-time steering angle alpha Preparation of And the expected left-right wheel speed difference DeltaV Preparation of (ii) a The steering oil cylinder displacement and the left and right wheel differential speed are controlled in real time to carry out reasonable matching, so that the steering is more flexible, the oil cylinder pressure is minimum, the hub motor moment is minimum, the sizes of a hydraulic element and the hub motor are reduced, the tire abrasion is reduced to the maximum extent, the efficiency of a hydraulic system is improved, and the energy consumption of the whole vehicle is reduced. Meanwhile, when one of the differential system or the hydraulic system breaks down in the steering process, the smooth completion of the steering can still be ensured.

title_en: Amphibious sanitation robot and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious sanitation robot, relating to the field of robots and comprising: the robot comprises a moving part, a containing part and a grabbing part, wherein the moving part provides power for the robot when the robot is in the course of land and river, a balancing device arranged inside the moving part utilizes a vertical center swing rod to pour the robot for protection, the containing device arranged above the moving part collects garbage, the grabbing device arranged above the containing device adjusts the position of the manipulator through a telescopic device, the garbage is grabbed through a second telescopic rod and a third telescopic rod of the manipulator, and finally the garbage is transferred through a needle head and stored in the containing device.

title_en: Motor drive control circuit and motor drive control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor drive control circuit and a motor drive control method. The motor drive control circuit includes: a power supply circuit for supplying a first power supply or a second power supply; one end of the control switch circuit is electrically connected with the power supply circuit and is used for controlling the motor drive control circuit to receive the first power supply or the second power supply; the rectifying circuit is electrically connected with one end of the control switch circuit and used for processing the first power supply to generate a first electric signal or processing the second power supply to generate a second electric signal; and the driving control circuit is electrically connected with the other end of the rectifying circuit and is used for controlling the motor to work in a first working state according to the first electric signal or controlling the motor to work in a second working state according to the second electric signal. According to the embodiment of the invention, the working state switching of the motor is integrated with the motor driving, so that the control cost of the system is improved, and the control efficiency of the system is improved.

title_en: Utilize conductive magnetic field driven wireless transmitting plate that charges to counterpoint structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power supply of electric vehicles, and particularly discloses a wireless charging emission plate alignment structure driven by a conductive magnetic field, wherein a guide channel with two open ends and used for the left-right transverse movement of a wireless emission plate is formed in an installation shell; two second stator assemblies are respectively installed in the base corresponding to the two groups of lifting scissors and fork mechanisms, and second rotor assemblies matched with the second stator assemblies are embedded in the driving blocks. According to the invention, the wireless transmitting plate is arranged in an independently transverse moving structure, and the sensors arranged at the two ends of the wireless transmitting plate are utilized for alignment monitoring, so that alignment adjustment can be carried out according to the offset position of the receiving plate, the maximum effective charging receiving area is ensured, and the charging efficiency is improved; the stator assembly and the rotor assembly are matched to form a driving structure, the structure is simple, the controllability is strong, the internal structure of the charging device is greatly simplified, and the space is saved.

title_en: New energy automobile fills electric pile in underground
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground charging pile for a new energy automobile, which comprises a buried box buried in the ground surface and provided with an opening at the upper side, wherein a pile body is arranged in the buried box, two first screw rods are symmetrically and rotatably arranged on the inner bottom wall of the buried box, a first thread groove in threaded connection with the first screw rods is formed in the lower end of the pile body, a limiting mechanism is symmetrically arranged between the pile body and the buried box, first gears are coaxially and fixedly sleeved at positions, close to the inner bottom wall of the buried box, of the first screw rods, a second gear is meshed between the two first gears, and a torque transmission port is formed in the center of the second gear. Has the advantages that: the pile body is arranged under the ground surface, so that the area of a public area is not occupied, and the use is convenient; the main motor is arranged as a single driving source, the square rod or the second gear is determined to be driven through the clutch mechanism, power is provided for the cable winding and unwinding line and the pile body lifting, and the design is ingenious and reasonable.

title_en: Driving safety monitoring system
abstract_en: The application discloses driving safety monitoring system, including casing, vehicle event data recorder, set up key group, public address loudspeaker, turn over the board, inhale the quotation, pronunciation infrared ray distancer, place concave frame, apron, infrared emission head, camera, micro motor and miniature magnetic clutch. This application is rational in infrastructure and sets up the key group through manual operation and carries out the pronunciation broadcast setting to 7 range finding distance sections of voice infrared distance meter under the effect of built-in PCB control panel, be convenient for the vehicle travel in-process measure the dead ahead distance, and whether send out the police dispatch newspaper through public address loudspeaker through surpassing the distance value that sets up and indicate the driver, reach the effect of reminding the keeping vehicle distance, it is fixed through negative pressure and car plantago baffle glass absorption to turn over the sucking disc face on the board, reach the effect of fixing whole and automobile body, can turn over the board forward or rotate backward relatively with the casing through coordinated operation micro motor and micro magnetic powder clutch, be favorable to adjusting the orientation of camera and infrared emission head, reach the nimble effect of adjusting the use.

title_en: Suspension, sightseeing vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a suspension, a sightseeing vehicle and a vehicle, which comprises a plate spring assembly, wherein the plate spring assembly comprises a main plate spring assembly and an auxiliary plate spring assembly, the auxiliary plate spring assembly is positioned above the main plate spring assembly and is connected with the main plate spring assembly, two ends of the main plate spring assembly are respectively provided with a lifting lug, the end part of the auxiliary plate spring assembly is provided with a butting part, the suspension also comprises a holding assembly, the holding assembly comprises a holding part and an elastic part, the elastic part is provided with a fixed end and a free end, the free end of the elastic part is butted with the holding part, the holding part is positioned above the butting part, and the holding part is movably butted with the butting part. The high-speed impact can be effectively reduced through the matching of the retaining piece and the elastic piece, and the impact is prevented from being rapidly transmitted to the frame, so that the overall comfort is improved.

title_en: Hybrid power system and automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid power system and an automobile, relates to the technical field of automobiles, and can solve the problem of high oil consumption of extended range type automobiles when the extended range type automobiles run at high speed. The hybrid power system comprises an engine, a generator, a power battery pack, a driving motor, a first differential mechanism and a second differential mechanism, wherein the output end of the engine is connected with the input end of the generator and the input end of the first differential mechanism respectively, the output end of the first differential mechanism is connected with a front driving shaft, the output end of the generator is connected with the input end of the power battery pack, the output end of the power battery pack is connected with the input end of the second differential mechanism through the driving motor, and the output end of the second differential mechanism is connected with a rear driving shaft. The automobile is applied with the hybrid power system provided by the scheme.

title_en: New energy automobile light anticollision roof beam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light anti-collision beam of a new energy automobile, which comprises a cross beam, wherein the cross beam is of an arc structure, one side of the cross beam is fixedly connected with a fixed crumpling column and a supporting frame, a buffering structure is fixedly connected between the supporting frame and the cross beam, and two ends of the cross beam are fixedly connected with auxiliary beams; the fixed crumpling column comprises a fixed mounting plate, a first fixed column is fixedly connected to the top of the fixed mounting plate, a second fixed column is fixedly connected to the top of the first fixed column, the first fixed column and the second fixed column are rectangular columns of hollow structures, a notch is formed in the top of the first fixed column, a crumpling groove I is formed in the position, close to the side wall, of the top of the inner wall of the first fixed column, a crumpling groove II is formed in the surface of the first fixed column, and a limiting seat is fixedly connected to the surface of the second fixed column. This kind of new energy automobile light anticollision roof beam has solved traditional anticollision roof beam and has been not suitable for new energy automobile's problem, has improved anticollision effect.

title_en: Battery pack heating method
abstract_en: The invention provides a battery pack heating method, and relates to the technical field of batteries. The method is applied to a battery management system and comprises the steps of obtaining state parameters of a battery pack, wherein the state parameters comprise temperature and state of charge, when the temperature is lower than a heating temperature threshold value and the state of charge is lower than a heating state of charge requirement threshold value, the battery management system respectively sends a low-temperature low-power heating request instruction to a vehicle control unit and an auxiliary charging branch control module, the low-temperature low-power heating request instruction is used for controlling the auxiliary charging branch control module to send a first control signal to an auxiliary charging branch and controlling a power supply to transmit energy to the battery pack and/or a motor, and the low-temperature low-power heating instruction is also used for controlling the vehicle control unit to send a third control signal to the battery management system; and responding to a third control signal to control the on-off of the main positive switch, so that the battery pack and the motor mutually transfer energy to heat the battery pack. By utilizing the technical scheme of the invention, the heating efficiency of the battery pack can be improved.

title_en: Special bolt assembly for unhooking of motor home
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bolt assemblies, and discloses a special bolt assembly for unhooking of a caravan, which comprises an upper assembly and a lower assembly, wherein the upper assembly comprises a connecting rod, one end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a first connecting block, the middle part of the first connecting block is provided with a first clamping groove, two sides of the top of the first connecting block are provided with sliding grooves, the inner sides of the sliding grooves are movably connected with a fixed rod, the top of the fixed rod is fixedly connected with a supporting rod, and the tail end of the supporting rod extends to the top of the first connecting block and is movably connected with the sliding. This special bolt assembly of car as a house unhook through a fixture block and a draw-in groove looks joint, can be in the same place upper assembly and lower subassembly are fixed, promote the ejector pad, make dead lever and fixture block joint, can make this subassembly connect more firmly, and this bolt assembly passes through three-layer insurance and connects upper assembly and lower subassembly, and upper assembly and lower subassembly are connected more firmly, also convenient the dismantlement.

title_en: Auxiliary instrument panel armrest, control method of auxiliary instrument panel armrest and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vice instrument board handrail, control method and vehicle of vice instrument board handrail, relate to automotive interior technical field, including the horizontal adjusting device of fixed setting, the link, vertical adjusting device and handrail body, because link movable group locates on horizontal adjusting device, and can be on horizontal adjusting device lateral shifting, vertical adjusting device locates on the link, handrail body movable group locates on vertical adjusting device, and can be along vertical adjusting device longitudinal shifting, therefore accessible horizontal adjusting device drives the link in proper order, the handrail body carries out lateral shifting, and vertical adjusting device can make the handrail body carry out longitudinal shifting again, and then make the driver can carry out the regulation of the height of vice instrument board handrail and front and back position according to self height condition and comfort level requirement, in order to improve the comfort level. Therefore, the embodiment of the application has the advantages that the applicability range is wide, and the comfort level and the practicability of the auxiliary instrument panel handrail are improved.

title_en: Binocular distance measuring method for vehicle blind area detection alarm device
abstract_en: The invention provides a binocular distance measurement method for a vehicle blind area detection alarm device, which comprises the steps of calibrating parameters of a binocular camera; measuring a specific numerical value of a rotation angle of the binocular camera relative to the side face of the vehicle body; inputting the image acquired by the binocular camera into a target detection algorithm, outputting a target by the target detection algorithm, and determining the position information of the target in the image; calling a binocular stereo matching algorithm to determine the parallax of the target in the two frames of images; determining a first distance from a projection point of a target on a plane where a connecting line between an optical axis and lenses is located to a perpendicular point of the connecting line between the lenses based on the focal length, the parallax and the distance between the lenses; obtaining the vertical distance from the target to the vehicle body based on the rotation angle and the roll angle, the coordinate of the target in the image coordinate system, the coordinate of the optical center, the focal length and the first distance of the target; the vertical distance from the target to the vehicle is the shortest distance between the target and the vehicle, and the probability of occurrence of traffic accidents can be effectively reduced by applying the system to the blind area early warning system.

title_en: Buoy type power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buoy type power supply which comprises a support frame, a buoy, an active resonance C-type buoyancy pendulum wave energy power generation device and a storage battery, wherein the support frame comprises a connecting shaft and a rigid frame, the upper part of the connecting shaft is connected with the buoy, the lower part of the connecting shaft is fixed with the rigid frame, the bottom of the rigid frame is provided with a fixed first cross beam, the active resonance C-type buoyancy pendulum wave energy power generation device is hung on the first cross beam, the storage battery is arranged in the buoy and is electrically connected with the active resonance C-type buoyancy pendulum wave energy power generation device, the buoy and waves are tuned, the active resonance C-type buoyancy pendulum wave energy power generation device and the buoy are controlled to rotate in an anti-phase mode, and efficient power generation is realized through relative rotation between the active resonance C-type buoyancy pendulum wave energy power generation device and the buoy.

title_en: Autonomous underwater wireless charging and intelligent alignment guiding system and method for unmanned underwater vehicle with interoperability
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater wireless charging and intelligent alignment guiding system and method for an autonomous unmanned underwater vehicle with interoperability, and belongs to the field of wireless charging of autonomous unmanned underwater vehicles. The autonomous navigation of autonomous formula unmanned underwater vehicle can be realized returning the depressed place, and the docking station of plugging into is equipped with the space that can hold unmanned underwater vehicle body, and the front end of docking station is equipped with horn mouth type guiding mechanism, and hydraulic mechanical arm radially installs on the inside wall of docking the docking station, and insulating rubber jig installs the front end at hydraulic mechanical arm, and transmitting end coil is embedded in insulating rubber jig's inside. The underwater wireless charging and intelligent alignment guiding system and method for the autonomous unmanned underwater vehicle with interoperability can realize autonomous return and accurate alignment guiding and recharging for the unmanned underwater vehicles with different calibers and different coil installation positions, and have higher interoperability and high automation degree.

title_en: Elastic lifting lug
abstract_en: The invention provides an elastic lifting lug which comprises a forming body made of elastic materials and a belt ring made of a fabric belt and embedded in the forming body, wherein the tail end of the fabric belt forming the belt ring is connected in a combined connection mode to form a connecting part positioned on the outer circumference or the inner circumference of the belt ring. The invention increases the lateral rigidity of the elastic lifting lug to the greatest extent, has higher performance requirement and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Magnetic tie-down system for securing cargo within a vehicle cargo compartment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a "magnetic tie-down system for securing cargo within a cargo compartment of a vehicle". The present disclosure details tie-down systems for securing cargo within a cargo compartment of a vehicle. An exemplary tie-down system may include an onboard magnetic assembly and a tie-down member that may be magnetically connected to the magnetic assembly to secure cargo within the cargo compartment. The magnet of the magnetic assembly may be energized to hold the tie member and the cargo in place within the cargo compartment or de-energized to release the tie member and the cargo relative to the cargo compartment.

title_en: Front body structure of vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a front vehicle body structure of a vehicle for suppressing deformation of a floor in an oblique collision. The vehicle body structure is provided with: a floor (60); a side member (30); a floor frame (50) extending in the front-rear direction on the inside of the side member (30) in the vehicle width direction; a 1 st cross member (10) connecting a front portion of the side member (30) and the floor frame (50) in the vehicle width direction; a 2 nd cross member (20) connecting the side member (30) and the floor frame (50) in the vehicle width direction behind the 1 st cross member (10); wherein the floor (60) has a square closed area (80) surrounded by the side beams (30), the floor frame (50), the 1 st cross beam (10) and the 2 nd cross beam (20); a bead (86) is provided in the closed region (80), and the bead (86) extends linearly in a direction intersecting, in plan view, a virtual line L1 connecting a front portion of the closed region (80) on the outside in the vehicle width direction and a rear portion of the closed region on the inside in the vehicle width direction at an angle of 45 DEG or more.

title_en: New forms of energy electric automobile charging plug
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of charging plugs, and particularly relates to a new energy electric vehicle charging plug which comprises a plugging part and a fixing ring; the other end of the holding part is fixedly connected with the rectangular frame; the inner wall of the rectangular frame is provided with a movable extrusion rod through a spring; according to the invention, the stretching rod and the first annular air bag are arranged, so that when charging is carried out, a hand extrudes the movable extrusion rod in the rectangular frame, the movable extrusion rod enables the stretching rod to shrink towards the inside of the first cylindrical empty groove through the pull rope, meanwhile, the first annular air bag is in a collapsed state, the fixing ring can be conveniently inserted into the circular electric socket, when the movable extrusion rod is stopped to be extruded, the stretching rod enables the fixing ring to be tensioned on the inner wall of the circular electric socket, a fixing effect is realized on the connection of the inserting part and the socket, meanwhile, the first annular air bag can expand, external rainwater is prevented from flying into the circular electric socket along with wind in the rainwater weather charging process, and the phenomenon that the inserting part and the inside of the socket enter rainwater is avoided.

title_en: Communication system of power swapping station
abstract_en: The invention provides a power station switching communication system, which comprises: the system comprises an industrial personal computer, a power supply system, a battery replacement system, a video monitoring system, a charging system, a temperature adjusting system, a heat dissipation system and an in-station environment detection system, wherein the industrial personal computer is in communication connection with the power supply system through an RS232 data line; the industrial personal computer is in communication connection with the battery replacement system, the video monitoring system and the charging system through a local area network switch; the industrial personal computer is in communication connection with the temperature adjusting system, the heat dissipation system and the in-station environment detection system through the I/O port adapter plate. This trade power station communication system can guarantee rapidity, stability, the security of communication data transmission, and then can guarantee to fill the safe, smooth, effectual going on of trading the electric process.

title_en: Intelligent paper outlet device for vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent paper outlet device for a vehicle, which comprises a roll paper shaft, a driving mechanism, an induction mechanism and a fixing mechanism; the paper winding shaft and the driving mechanism are respectively fixed on a fixing mechanism, and the fixing mechanism is connected with a beam of an instrument panel of the vehicle; the induction mechanism is fixed on the instrument board and used for inducing the time when the human body is in an induction range; the sensing mechanism is connected with the driving mechanism, and the driving mechanism is used for driving the paper winding shaft to rotate to discharge paper according to the time when the human body is in the sensing range. The utility model provides a vehicle intelligence goes out paper device is connected with the crossbeam of the instrument board of vehicle, arranges the upper portion region that the glove box utilization ratio is not high at the vehicle, is in the hidden space, and this vehicle intelligence device includes induction mechanism and drive arrangement, and induction mechanism and drive arrangement connect, and this vehicle intelligence device can sense the length of operation of human body time's different regulation and control actuating mechanism according to induction mechanism to the length of paper, convenient operation are gone out in the adjustment.

title_en: Rope damping device for berthing freight ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rope damping device for berthing a freight ship, which comprises a bottom mounting base plate, support rods positioned on two sides of the upper surface of the bottom mounting base plate and a top mounting base plate fixed at the tops of the support rods. The device controls the rotating force of the thread rope all the time by utilizing the technical characteristics of oppositely arranged gas compression, so that the ship can stop in a gentle state in a resistance manner, meanwhile, the device generates high-pressure gas by utilizing the rotating state generated by stretching and retracting the thread rope during damping, and then generates a damping effect on the thread rope by utilizing the high-pressure gas, and the device is functionally interactive, does not need other energy sources as a power source, realizes self-sufficiency, does not need manual operation, and has high autonomy degree.

title_en: High-pressure hydraulic pipeline installation structure and method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of hydraulic pipeline installation, and particularly relates to a high-pressure hydraulic pipeline installation structure and method. The structure includes: the machine body comprises a machine body weak frame, a machine body strong frame, a pipeline mounting support and a high-pressure hydraulic pipeline. The machine body weak frame and the machine body strong frame are both arranged on the aircraft skin, and the machine body strong frame is provided with a through hole for a high-pressure hydraulic pipeline to pass through; the pipeline mounting brackets comprise a plurality of pipeline mounting brackets, the pipeline mounting brackets are respectively mounted on the machine body weak frame and the machine body strong frame, metal rubber is arranged at the joint of the pipeline mounting brackets and the machine body strong frame, and pipeline clamps are mounted on the pipeline mounting brackets; the pipe joints are respectively installed at the two ends of the high-pressure hydraulic pipeline, and the high-pressure hydraulic pipeline is sequentially installed on the pipeline hoop of the pipeline installation support at the corresponding position to be connected with the machine body weak frame and the machine body strong frame. This application can reduce the installation stress, reduces the influence of hydraulic system vibration, improves life, ensures aircraft flight safety.

title_en: Moving body and moving body system
abstract_en: The invention provides a moving body and a moving body system. The moving body moves in at least one of water and a water surface in correspondence with a person who alternately takes a foot step on the water, and includes an operation information acquisition unit that acquires information on an operation of the foot of the person or an article worn on the foot of the person, and a control unit that moves the moving body to a step position of the foot based on the information acquired by the operation information acquisition unit when the foot of the person is separated from the moving body. The mobile body system includes a mobile body and a wearing article.

title_en: Support rod for blind-repairing mirror of truck
abstract_en: The utility model provides a truck blind-repairing mirror branch, which comprises a supporting bar, the support, and the branch is the wing section, the contained angle of its branch leading edge and support is less than the contained angle of branch trailing edge and support, the area of one side that branch and support are connected is greater than the area of its offside, the branch offside is equipped with the bent lever, bent lever end connection has the ball, and the curved surface of bent lever is equipped with the strengthening rib A of laminating curved surface and branch upper surface simultaneously, the branch lower floor is open-ended box structure, the inside internal portion of box is equipped with the connection leading edge, the internal surface of trailing edge, and cover the strengthening rib B of strengthening rib A and branch junction simultaneously, the branch is the wing section that the cross-section area changes in proper order from big to small from the one side that is close to the automobile body to the one side that is close to the automobile body that the truck blind-repairing mirror branch bore has been met to the requirement of the required different thickness of load that changes in proper order from big to small to the one side that is kept away from the automobile body.

title_en: Three-section folding type children's carriage
abstract_en: A three-section folding type children cart comprises a front wheel bracket, a rear wheel bracket, a lower push rod, a seat cushion mounting bracket, a first connecting sheet and a second connecting sheet; the top end of the front wheel bracket is rotationally connected with the top end of the rear wheel bracket, and the front end of the seat cushion mounting bracket is rotationally connected with the top end of the rear wheel bracket; the bottom end of the lower push rod is rotatably connected with the middle part of the rear wheel bracket; one end of the first connecting piece is rotatably connected with the bottom end of the lower push rod, and the other end of the first connecting piece is rotatably connected with the middle part of the front wheel bracket; one end of the second connecting sheet is rotatably connected with the rear end of the seat cushion mounting bracket, and the other end of the second connecting sheet is rotatably connected with the middle part of the lower push rod. Therefore, the two sides of the rear wheel bracket are oppositely folded, and the folded rear wheel bracket is small in size and high in reliability.

title_en: Reflective aluminum coil for motor vehicle license plate and production process thereof and reflective aluminum plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reflective aluminum coil for motor vehicle license plates, which comprises an aluminum base layer, wherein the upper end surface of the aluminum base layer is coated with a reflective adhesive layer, the upper end surface of the reflective adhesive layer is coated with a protective adhesive layer, and the reflective adhesive layer contains a plurality of glass beads which are uniformly distributed; the invention also discloses a production process of the reflective aluminum roll for the motor vehicle license plate, which comprises the following steps: unreeling, deoiling, pure water cleaning, dedusting, pure water cleaning, brightening, pure water cleaning, blow-drying, sand blasting, anodizing, coating an adhesive layer, adhering a metal reflective layer, drying, coating a reflective adhesive layer, drying, coating a protective adhesive layer, drying and reeling; the invention also discloses a reflective aluminum plate for the motor vehicle license plate, which has the same layer structure as the reflective aluminum coil for the motor vehicle license plate; the invention has the advantages of simple structure, low production cost, environmental protection and wide application range of products.

title_en: New energy vehicle neutral gear return control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy vehicle neutral gear return control method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring state information of the new energy vehicle; judging whether the new energy vehicle meets a return-to-neutral control condition or not according to the state information; if the requirements are met, the neutral return operation is executed, and through the technical scheme of the invention, the automatic gearbox can be switched from the driving gear to the neutral gear through operations of vehicle voice reminding, forced neutral return by the handle, neutral return of the automatic gearbox and the like.

title_en: Method for controlling a shift to a lower gear with the accelerator pedal released
abstract_en: A method of controlling a shift to a lower gear in a driveline (6) having a dual clutch servo-assisted gearbox (7) with release of an accelerator pedal (22), providing the steps of: at a first time (t) 1 ) Opening the clutch (16A) which is disengaged; at a first time (t) 1 ) Closing an oncoming clutch (16B); completely opening the clutch (16A) at a second time by means of a first linear ramp(ii) a At the second and third time (t) 4 ) Between them, the rotational speed (omega) of the internal combustion engine (4) E ) With the rotational speed (omega) of the oncoming clutch (16B) B ) Synchronizing; from the fourth moment (t) 2 ) Starting to close the clutch (16B) by a second linear ramp, the fourth time being before or coinciding with the second time; at a fifth time (t) 3 ) Fully closing the on-coming clutch (16B), the fifth time coinciding with or being subsequent to the second time; and at a fourth moment (t) 2 ) And a third time (t) 4 ) In order to generate a torque (T) by starting the internal combustion engine (4) E )。

title_en: Portable travel is with supplementary mobile device of children
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable travel auxiliary moving device for children, and relates to the technical field of novel child traveling devices. The invention comprises a displacement supporting leg frame, wherein the top end of the displacement supporting leg frame is fixedly connected with a foundation positioning plate, the lower surface of the foundation positioning plate is fixedly connected with an internal carrying block, and the inner side of the internal carrying block is fixedly connected with a stable supporting sleeping structure. According to the invention, through the design of the stable supporting and sleeping structure, the device avoids the influence of bumping and shaking on children in the displacement process of the traditional baby stroller, and meanwhile, the automatic and stable reciprocating swing driving is completed by utilizing the structural design, so that the baby stroller is convenient for sleeping, the original portability is maintained, and meanwhile, better diversified functionality is obtained, and through the design of the automatic lifting adjusting driving structure, the device is convenient for carrying out automatic and convenient controllable adjustment driving on the position of the pushing handle, so that the height of the handle is convenient to adjust, and different pushing crowds are better adapted.

title_en: Improved handlebar and brake lever of electric vehicle
abstract_en: An improved handlebar and a brake lever of an electric vehicle are characterized in that a section of circular tube with a bayonet or a threaded structure is additionally arranged in circular tubes at two ends of the handlebar after a sealing head of a handle sleeve is removed, then a plug with the same shape as a flat bulb is manufactured, and the plug is connected with a clamping seat or a threaded structure on the section of circular tube additionally arranged in the handlebar into a whole through a clamping head of the buckle or the threaded structure; thereby enlarging the spherical area at the two ends of the handlebar and increasing the elastic deformation capacity at the two ends of the handlebar; the handle of the brake lever in the prior art is made into an elastic oval ring body, and the ring body of the handle of the brake lever after being made is fixedly connected with the base part of the original brake lever into a whole; when the two ends of the handle of the brake handle are impacted by external force which is larger than the braking force, the oval ring body of the handle of the brake handle can generate elastic deformation; therefore, the contact area of the impact point of the elliptic annular body of the brake handle is increased at the moment of impact, and the concentrated release of the impact force is reduced; thereby reducing the damage degree of the handlebar and the brake lever to the legs of the human body when the car falls down due to a car accident.

title_en: Forklift lithium iron phosphate battery charging method
