abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging method of a lithium iron phosphate battery of a forklift truck, which is characterized in that charging data of a battery cell at different temperatures and different charge states SOC are measured, a charging strategy of a BMS battery system at a battery charge state S0C 0-80% is determined and formulated according to the charging data, and a terminal charging strategy described by the invention is executed at a battery charging terminal 90% -100% in order to meet the working time of a whole vehicle and the service life of the battery cell. The invention increases the normal operation time of the forklift. Increase of the charging capacity: according to the constant current mode, the charging capacity is about 95% of the rated capacity of the battery pack, and according to the method disclosed by the invention, the charging capacity is 100% of the rated capacity of the battery pack; the working time of the forklift is increased by 30-40min, and the charging current is reasonably adjusted to better conform to the charging curve of the battery than the charging performance of the battery in a constant current mode according to the charging performance of the battery at different temperatures, so that the service life of the battery is prolonged by 1-3 years.

title_en: Automatic parking method and device for vehicle, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an automatic parking method and device for a vehicle, the vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the driving process of the vehicle, a first parking position within a parking range is determined, first position information of the first parking position and first vehicle position information of the vehicle are acquired, determining candidate parking spaces from the first parking spaces according to the first parking space position information and the first vehicle position information, and the second parking space within the parking range and the second vehicle position information of the vehicle are determined through the display of the vehicle-mounted equipment of the vehicle, detecting the parking position available for parking in the vehicle parking range in real time according to the first parking position information, the first vehicle position information, the second parking position information of the second parking position and the second vehicle position information, detecting the parking position available for parking in the vehicle parking range in real time according to the environment change condition of the candidate parking position or the parking position not becoming the candidate parking position, the candidate parking spaces are updated, so that the waste of parking space resources is avoided, and the success rate of automatic parking is improved.

title_en: Lift truck for erecting power cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting vehicle for erecting power cables, which comprises a supporting plate, a driving assembly and a swinging telescopic mechanism, wherein the driving assembly is installed below the supporting plate, and the swinging telescopic mechanism is rotatably arranged above the supporting plate and is used for erecting cables; the swing telescopic mechanism comprises a swing assembly and a telescopic assembly, and the swing assembly and the telescopic assembly are both connected with the driving assembly; the driving assembly comprises a servo motor arranged below the supporting plate and a worm which is rotatably connected below the supporting plate and connected with the output end of the servo motor. This automobile body passes through the motor and drives the worm and rotate, utilizes the worm to drive worm wheel and bevel gear group work, and wherein, the worm wheel drives carousel and sealed jar with the help of the driving medium and rotates to vertical form from the level form, simultaneously, drives runner and connecting rod drive sealing member through bevel gear group and along pump barrel inner wall reciprocating motion, with external atmosphere pump in the sealed jar, utilizes atmospheric pressure drive piston rod flexible, further improves and erects the height.

title_en: Carbon fire pan auxiliary transportation shallow of protection is emptyd in striking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon fire basin auxiliary transport cart with impact dumping protection, which comprises a transport cart, universal wheels, a vegetable dish storage box and a handheld push rod, wherein the universal wheels are arranged at the bottom of the transport cart in a front-back symmetrical mode, the vegetable dish storage box is arranged on the top end face of the transport cart and used for storing and transporting vegetable dishes, and the handheld push rod is positioned on the left side of the vegetable dish storage box; a storage box sliding groove with a right opening is formed in the end face of the right side of the transport trolley; in the technical scheme, the semi-automatic transport cart capable of accommodating a large number of carbon fire pots can realize the transportation of the large number of carbon fire pots with high efficiency, the work efficiency is improved, the labor and time cost are saved, the abnormity detection assembly is added to enable the cart to be abnormal in transportation, the carbon fire pots with the storage box self-locking and forced extinguishing transportation are prevented, the carbon fire pots prevented from being ignited are overturned outside to cause safety accidents such as personnel scalding or fire disasters, and the safety during the transportation of the carbon fire pots is greatly improved.

title_en: Capacity matching method and system for power system of hybrid power vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a capacity matching method and a system for a power system of a hybrid vehicle, wherein a line condition is used as input, and a shortest path algorithm is adopted to solve the rated output power of an energy storage system and the rated output power of a diesel generator set when the total energy loss is minimum; the problem that the power required by the vehicle cannot be met or the fuel consumption is high due to the fact that the rated power of the diesel generator set is not matched with the capacity of the energy storage system is solved; the shortest path algorithm is a dynamic planning algorithm, can traverse all possible matching relations between the rated power of the diesel generating set and the capacity of the energy storage system, can obtain a global optimal solution, and cannot fall into a local optimal solution; the model selection is carried out according to the rated output power of the energy storage system and the rated output power of the diesel generator set solved by the shortest path algorithm, and theoretically, the total energy loss of the whole vehicle during the running of the line is the minimum.

title_en: B-pillar structure for vehicle body and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of vehicle structures, and particularly relates to a B-pillar structure for a vehicle body and a vehicle. The invention aims to solve the problem that when the B-pillar structure of the traditional automobile is subjected to side collision, the lower end of the B-pillar can collapse, and the upper section of the inner plate of the B-pillar can be torn from the welding spot, so that the requirement on the safety performance of an automobile body is difficult to meet. For the purpose, the B-pillar structure for the vehicle body comprises a roof side rail inner plate, the B-pillar structure comprises the B-pillar inner plate, and the B-pillar structure further comprises a reinforcing piece which is fixedly connected with the roof side rail inner plate and the B-pillar inner plate. According to the B-pillar structure, the reinforcing piece is arranged at the joint of the roof side beam inner plate and the B-pillar inner plate, and when a vehicle encounters side collision, acting force applied to the reinforcing piece can be dispersedly transmitted to the roof side beam inner plate and the B-pillar inner plate, so that acting force applied to the connecting point of the roof side beam inner plate and the B-pillar inner plate is effectively reduced, and the problem that the B-pillar inner plate is torn from a welding spot when the vehicle encounters side collision can be effectively solved.

title_en: Design method of spoiler for weakening tail screen movement of helicopter
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of helicopter pneumatic design, and particularly relates to a spoiler design method for weakening tail screen movement of a helicopter. The method mainly relates to high-precision CFD analysis and Fourier transform, and the scheme of the spoiler is quickly optimized and designed by comparing and analyzing the pressure pulsation frequency characteristics of front and rear pneumatic surface monitoring points of the spoiler, so that the labor and material cost can be greatly reduced, and the development period can be shortened. The invention can effectively weaken the problem of tail sifting in the flight process of the helicopter, and the spoiler has simple structure and simple installation/disassembly process without increasing the maintenance cost. A test flight test is carried out after a spoiler is additionally arranged on a certain type of helicopter, and the vibration data result analysis shows that the design method of the spoiler effectively solves the problem of tail part sifting of the helicopter.

title_en: Brake sucker device contracted below automobile chassis and braking method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brake sucker device contracted below an automobile chassis and a braking method thereof. The braking distance of the automobile braking system is too long in emergency braking. The pressure sensor is fixed on the upper surface of the foot brake; the high-pressure pump is used for supplying air to an air inlet of the outer cylinder of the telescopic rod; the piston of the contraction rod is fixed with the inner end of the inner rod; two ends of the spring are respectively fixed with the piston cavity and the inner end surface of the inner rod; the first ball hinge support of the first ball hinge is connected with the bottom surface of the automobile chassis through a connecting piece; a first ball head of the first ball hinge is fixed with the outer barrel, an inner rod is fixed with a second ball head of the second ball hinge, and a second ball hinge support of the second ball hinge is fixed with the sucker; an ultrasonic detector is fixed in the inner cavity of the sucker; the vacuum pump and the inflating pump respectively pump air and inflate the inner cavity of the sucking disc. When the automobile runs at a high speed and suddenly steps on a brake, the sucker is popped out to the ground along with the contraction rod, and an adsorption force is generated between the sucker and the ground under the action of the vacuum pump, so that the braking distance of the automobile is greatly shortened.

title_en: Device for decoupling and preventing compensation currents in a redundant system for autopilot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for decoupling and/or preventing a compensation current, for use in a redundant system for automatic driving, in which at least one electrical actuator (5; 15) is shared by a plurality of independently powered controller devices (1, 2). The electric actuators (5; 15) each have: a common connection via which the electrical actuators can be coupled and switched to a common connection of a further electrical actuator (5; 15); and at least one special connection via which the at least one electrical actuator (5; 15) can be individually energized. A number of switching devices (6; 16, 17) corresponding to the number of common and dedicated connections of all electrical actuators (5; 15) is provided for switching the current to or from the at least one electrical actuator (5; 15). The invention provides at least one current blocking device (A, B;18, 19;20; 21) which is configured to inhibit an unintended current flowing to the inactive electronic control units (11, 12) of the first and second controller devices (1, 2).

title_en: Auxiliary mechanism and electric power steering apparatus
abstract_en: The assist mechanism (83) has: an electric motor (10); a shaft-like member (94) in which a worm (94a) that meshes with a worm wheel (96) is formed; and a coupling (16) that connects the output shaft (11) of the motor and the shaft-like member, wherein the minimum number of rotations of the motor and the number of rotations of the worm are mutually equivalent, the minimum number of rotations of the motor and the number of rotations of the coupling are mutually equivalent, the number of rotations of the worm is 3, and the number of rotations of the coupling is 5 or 7.

title_en: Support member for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention provides a support member for a vehicle, which is a die-cast support member for a vehicle, and which is provided with: a fixing portion capable of fixing a device disposed in the power unit chamber; and a fixing portion connecting rib portion that connects an outer peripheral wall portion supported with respect to a pair of front side members that are located on vehicle width direction outer sides of the power unit chamber and that constitute a part of a vehicle body, with the fixing portion.

title_en: Real-time driving system for vehicle steering lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time driving system of a vehicle steering lamp, which comprises: the brightness adjusting mechanism is arranged in the vehicle and used for adjusting the flickering brightness of the front steering lamp structure and the rear steering lamp structure based on the received target brightness; a frequency control mechanism for adjusting the flicker frequency of the front turn light structure and the rear turn light structure based on the received target frequency; the multi-direction acquisition equipment is arranged at the top of the vehicle, consists of a plurality of image acquisition units in charge of different visual fields and is used for executing image acquisition operation on the periphery of the vehicle in a plurality of directions so as to obtain a plurality of sub-visual-field pictures; and a third operating mechanism for determining the target brightness and the target frequency based on the imaging depth of field of the vehicle object with the shallowest imaging depth of field. The real-time driving system for the vehicle steering lamp is timely in detection and flexible in operation. Because the flicker brightness and the flicker frequency of various steering lamps can be automatically adjusted based on the proximity degree of surrounding vehicles, different requirements of far and near vehicles are considered.

title_en: Electric vehicle propulsion system
abstract_en: An electric vehicle propulsion system (1) comprising: -a first electric propulsion motor (10) comprising a stator and a rotor having a first output shaft rotationally movable about a first axis, -a second electric propulsion motor (11) comprising a stator and a rotor having a second output shaft rotationally movable about a second axis, -a first reduction gearbox (21) adapted to receive the torque provided by the first electric motor (10) suitably via a first selective or non-selective coupling system (20), the first reduction gearbox (21) having a first reduction ratio, -a second reduction gearbox (23) adapted to receive the torque provided by the second electric motor (11) suitably via a second selective or non-selective coupling system (22), the second reduction gearbox (23) having a second reduction ratio, and-a third coupling system (35) for coupling the first output shaft and the second output shaft, which may or may not be optional, the first and second axes are not coincident.

title_en: Information display device and reflector used for the same
abstract_en: An information display device for displaying image information of a virtual image on a windshield of a vehicle and an information display method for the information display device, the information display device comprising: the display displays the image information; and a virtual image optical system that reflects light emitted from the display by the windshield glass to display a virtual image in front of the vehicle, the virtual image optical system including a concave mirror and an optical element, wherein a reflective film is formed on a reflective surface of the concave mirror, and a protective film that prevents moisture absorption is formed on an opposing surface. The end face connecting the two faces is formed into a curved surface or an inclined surface and is also formed on the end face, so that moisture is blocked and moisture absorption of the plastic is prevented.

title_en: Integral installation ship for offshore wind turbine
abstract_en: The integral installation ship of the offshore wind turbine is a special ship specially designed for transportation, installation, maintenance and repair of the offshore wind turbine, adopts a rotary tower cylinder technology, can reduce the difficulty of installation and maintenance of the offshore wind turbine to less than half of the height of a tower cylinder, and is fixed at the height of 40 meters. The ship machinery can realize the one-time transportation, installation and maintenance work of the tower drum fan blade, reduce the installation and maintenance difficulty of the offshore wind power and effectively reduce the installation cost and the later maintenance cost of the offshore wind power.

title_en: Electric driving wheel with planetary speed reduction transmission
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric driving wheel for planetary reduction transmission, which comprises a planetary reducer, a direct current motor, a planetary reduction internal gear shell and a rubber tire, wherein the direct current motor is directly arranged on a secondary planet carrier of the planetary reducer, the planetary reducer comprises a primary planet carrier, three primary planet gears, a primary sun gear, a secondary planet carrier, a secondary sun gear and a planetary reduction internal gear shell, and the power of the direct current motor is converted into low-speed high-torque power through an external meshing-internal meshing planetary reduction transmission chain and is output to the rubber tire. According to the electric driving wheel with the planetary reduction transmission, the high-speed stage of the planetary reducer adopts the planetary transmission floating technology, so that the uniform distribution of the load of the planetary gear with the high-speed stage planetary transmission is realized, the transmission noise is reduced, the use of a duplicate gear is avoided due to the adoption of the planetary transmission mode, the manufacturing precision of the gear is favorably improved, the manufacturing cost is reduced, and the electric driving wheel is more suitable for mass production.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted universal serial bus device and vehicle-mounted information display system
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle-mounted universal serial bus device and a vehicle-mounted information display system, and relates to the technical field of automotive electronics. The device includes: the device comprises a control module, a current detection module, a pulse detection module, a display module and at least one USB interface; the control module is respectively in communication connection with the current detection module, the pulse detection module and the display module; the current detection module is connected with each USB interface and used for detecting a current signal of each USB interface and sending the current signal to the control module when the current signal is detected; the pulse detection module is connected with each USB interface and used for detecting pulse signals of the USB interfaces and sending the pulse signals to the control module when the pulse signals are detected; the control module determines the working state information of the mobile equipment connected with each USB interface according to the received current signal and the pulse signal, and sends the working state information to the display module for display. According to the scheme, the driver can know the working state information of the mobile equipment from the display module, and the driving safety is improved.

title_en: Cloud platform, camera carrier and movable platform
abstract_en: A pan/tilt head (100), a camera carrier (2000) and a movable platform (1000) are provided. Cloud platform (100) is used for movable platform (1000), and cloud platform (100) includes support (10), armshaft (20) and elastic vibration damping piece (30), and support (10) are including base member (11) and connect a plurality of installation portions (12) on base member (11). The shaft arm (20) is used for bearing load, and the shaft arm (20) and the bracket (10) are arranged at intervals. The elastic damping member (30) is connected to the mounting portion (12), and the axis of the elastic damping member (30) is inclined with respect to the plane on which the base body (11) is located. The shaft arm (20) is connected to the plurality of mounting portions (12) via an elastic damper (30).

title_en: Vibration reducing device of knob type gear shifting equipment
abstract_en: A chattering reducing device of a knob type gear shifting apparatus includes a damper provided to be fixed to a main housing, and a protrusion formed on a member configured to rotate relative to the main housing and configured to reduce a return rotation speed of a shift knob by contact with the damper when the shift knob is returned to a neutral position from a position of Nd or D or from a position of Nr or R.

title_en: Device for transporting children
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device (1) for transporting a child, such as a pushchair or buggy. More particularly, the present invention relates to a device for transporting a child that can be folded into a compact unit. According to the invention, the lower frame (10) of the device comprises a first lower frame portion (11) to which front wheels (61) are mounted and a second lower frame portion (12) to which rear wheels (60) are mounted, wherein the first and second lower frame portions (11, 12) are hingedly connected to each other, wherein the pusher (30) of the device comprises a first and a second pusher portion which are hingedly connected to each other, and wherein in the folded position the second lower frame portion (12) has been pivoted away from the pusher (30) and towards the front wheels (61) and the second pusher portion has been pivoted towards the lower frame (10) such that the second pusher portion is placed adjacent to the second lower frame portion (12).

title_en: Motion control method, device and equipment of balance car and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motion control method, a motion control device, equipment and a storage medium of a balance car, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current attitude information of the balance car under a preset road condition, and determining a first wheel balance parameter and a second wheel balance parameter of the balance car according to the current attitude information; fusing the first wheel balance parameter and the second wheel balance parameter to obtain a target balance parameter; and driving a motor of the balance car according to the target balance parameters to realize motion control. Compared with the prior art, the left-right balance of the balance car needs to be realized by depending on the control of a body, the acquired first wheel balance parameter and the acquired second wheel balance parameter are subjected to fusion processing to obtain the target balance parameter, and then the motor of the balance car is driven according to the target balance parameter, so that the stable and accurate steering control of the balance car is realized, and the riding experience of a user is further improved.

title_en: Throwing device, unmanned aerial vehicle, control method, control device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a projecting device, an unmanned aerial vehicle, a control method, a control device and a storage medium. Wherein, the projectile device includes: a fixed member and an ejection member; the fixing component is used for fixing a first storage device of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the ejection component under the condition that the unmanned aerial vehicle does not have the risk of crash; and is used for releasing the fixing operation of the first storage device under the condition that the unmanned aerial vehicle has the risk of crash so as to enable the first storage device to be thrown out of the unmanned aerial vehicle by the ejection component; the first storage device is at least used for recording flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the first storage device is provided with a parachute assembly or a multi-rotor flight assembly; the first storage device can communicate with the unmanned aerial vehicle in a wireless communication mode after being thrown.

title_en: Automatic test device for pantograph
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic test device for a pantograph. The pantograph is controlled to ascend and descend through the test host, the pantograph is driven to ascend and descend through the driving module, the running parameters of the pantograph in the ascending and descending process are collected through the sensor, and the detection of the parameters of the pantograph in the ascending and descending process is achieved. In addition, the pantograph and the test host are connected in a bridging mode through the terminal strip, the pantograph type testing device is suitable for various pantograph types, has good universality, and can realize control conversion of the pantograph types.

title_en: Opening structure of bidirectional door
abstract_en: A bi-directional door opening structure comprising: a first door configured to open by rotating about a first end of the vehicle adjacent a roof of the vehicle; a second door configured to open by rotating about a second end of the vehicle adjacent to a roof of the vehicle, the second end being opposite the first end; the vehicle door assembly includes a first door, a second door, and a controller configured to receive a door driving request with respect to the first door or the second door, and apply a driving force to at least one of the first door and the second door, wherein the driving unit includes a spindle unit, a latch lever, and a rotating lever.

title_en: Spherical robot deformation mechanism and deformation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deformation mechanism and a deformation method of a spherical robot, which comprise a spherical shell (1) and a deformation assembly (2) which is arranged in the spherical shell (1) and controls the spherical shell (1) to deform, wherein a pendulum (3) driven by a driving assembly (5) is connected to the deformation assembly (2), the pendulum (3) is used for driving the spherical shell (1) to directionally roll, and the pendulum (3) can enable the spherical shell (1) and the deformation assembly (2) to be suspended and supported in the air when the spherical shell (1) is in an unfolded state; when the driving component (5) indirectly drives the pendulum (3) to swing through driving the deformation component (2) so as to drive the spherical robot to roll, the driving component (5) can adjust the swinging direction and/or the swinging angle of the pendulum (3), so that the spherical robot can roll in a direction-adjustable manner along with the swinging of the pendulum (3) in at least two directions. The invention constructs an internal mechanism of a spherical robot with a novel driving and deformation structure.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing fixed-wing aircraft using coanda effect to increase lift
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical take-off and landing fixed-wing aircraft using coanda effect to increase lift, which relates to the field of aircraft design, in particular to a vertical take-off and landing fixed-wing aircraft using coanda effect to increase lift, and the vertical take-off and landing fixed-wing aircraft comprises: comprises a body, a main wing part, a tail wing part and a power part. The invention has the advantages of fixed wing flight and vertical take-off and landing of rotor wings, when the aircraft takes off and lands vertically, the upward tension is mainly provided by the main propeller of the coaxial reverse propeller, and the front propeller only provides smaller upward tension and is used for adjusting the longitudinal attitude of the aircraft, so that the longitudinal attitude of the aircraft is in a balanced state in the vertical take-off and landing process of the aircraft. The invention adopts the coaxial reverse propeller, reduces the diameter of the propeller under the condition of a certain propeller disc area, and can take off and land on the runway in a fixed wing state when all the power cabins do not tilt, so that the energy consumption for taking off and landing is less, and the load of the aircraft can also be improved.

title_en: Separation method of satellite propulsion module and satellite system
abstract_en: The invention provides a separation method of a satellite propulsion module and a satellite system, comprising the following steps: when the satellite propulsion module provides power for the whole satellite of the main satellite, the module separation control system monitors the fuel allowance in the propellant storage tank of the satellite propulsion module; the module separation control system calculates fuel required by the satellite propulsion module to be out of orbit in real time according to the current orbit of the main satellite; the module separation control system calculates the separation time of the satellite propulsion module and the main satellite according to the fuel allowance and the required fuel; the thruster provides separation power for the satellite propulsion module; after the satellite propulsion module is separated from the main satellite, the module separation control system automatically controls the thrust direction and the thrust magnitude of the thruster so as to adjust the posture of the satellite propulsion module and push the satellite propulsion module to a safe orbit.

title_en: Electric automobile and power battery pulse heating system and heating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile and a pulse heating system and a heating method of a power battery thereof.A motor system enters a pulse heating mode to perform pulse heating on the power battery when a pulse heating entering condition is met; when the pulse heating exit condition is met, the motor system exits the pulse heating mode and stops pulse heating of the power battery; in the pulse heating mode, the quadrature axis voltage is enabled to be equal to zero, the magnitude of the pulse current is adjusted by controlling the direct axis voltage, actual pulse width modulation signals of six power switches are generated by superposing the pulse signals, three-phase current feedback quantity is not used, the output pulse current is stable and small in fluctuation, the pulse heating effect of the power battery can be improved, and unexpected driving or shaking of a vehicle in the pulse heating process of the power battery is avoided.

title_en: Automatic change airport luggage transport vechicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic airport luggage carrier vehicle which comprises a carrier vehicle body, a lifting conveying assembly, a transferring assembly and a conveying assembly, wherein the lifting conveying assembly is arranged on the carrier vehicle body; the lifting conveying assembly, the transferring assembly and the conveying assembly are sequentially arranged on the transport vehicle body along the direction from one end of the transport vehicle body to the other end of the transport vehicle body; the lifting conveying assembly can be lifted to a position where the first end is in butt joint with the airplane luggage compartment, and materials can be received or output; the first end of the transfer component is butted with the second end of the lifting conveying component, and can receive or output materials; the second end of the transfer component is butted with the first end of the conveying component and can receive or output materials. According to the invention, the transfer assembly is used for transferring the luggage, and the conveying assembly and the lifting conveying assembly are used for conveying the luggage, so that the luggage conveying device is convenient and rapid, the efficiency is improved, the manual luggage conveying is avoided, the manpower is saved, and the labor intensity of workers is reduced.

title_en: Error compensation method, error compensation device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of unmanned driving, and provides an error compensation method, an error compensation device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method is applied to an unmanned device, namely an automatic driving device or an unmanned vehicle, and comprises the following steps: establishing a first coordinate system based on a reference point closest to the target point; acquiring a first coordinate of a target point in a first coordinate system and a second coordinate of a reference point in a second coordinate system; and calculating a third coordinate of the target point in the second coordinate system based on the first coordinate and the second coordinate so as to compensate the conversion error from the first coordinate system to the second coordinate system. The method and the device can eliminate the conversion error from the first coordinate system to the second coordinate system and reduce the conversion time.

title_en: Rear axle steering locking valve, hydraulic system and automobile crane
abstract_en: The invention relates to rear axle steering of an automobile crane, and aims to solve the problem of potential safety hazard caused by the fact that an emergency pump is not matched for steering and locking a rear axle of the existing automobile crane. According to the invention, the emergency pump is not arranged in the rear axle steering, the accumulator can provide hydraulic oil to enable the locking oil cylinder to return to the middle position when the main oil pump fails, the rear axle steering is locked, the hidden danger is eliminated, and the driving safety is ensured.

title_en: New energy automobile ECU power-on and power-off abnormity diagnosis and correction system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile ECU power-on and power-off abnormity diagnosis and correction system.A principle library establishing module of the system is used for establishing an ECU power-on and power-off time sequence change principle database; the knowledge base establishing module is used for establishing an ECU power-on and power-off abnormal knowledge database; the ECU power-on and power-off time sequence monitoring module is used for monitoring the ECU power-on and power-off time sequence change in real time based on the Internet of vehicles; and the ECU power-on and power-off timing sequence correction module carries out power-on and power-off timing sequence diagnosis on the real-time ECU power-on and power-off timing sequence according to the ECU power-on and power-off abnormal knowledge data in the ECU power-on and power-off abnormal knowledge database, and carries out power-on and power-off timing sequence correction according to the ECU power-on and power-off timing sequence change principle data in the ECU power-on and power-off timing sequence change principle database. According to the invention, the state backtracking of relevant signals and the automatic locking of problem knowledge can be realized when the new energy automobile fails to power on and off, the power on and off time sequence of the automobile can be corrected on line or manually, and the power on and off time sequence of the automobile is optimized.

title_en: Outer cabin structure for underwater vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses an outer cabin structure for an underwater vehicle, which comprises a shell and a hard frame; the whole shell is in a flat horizontal hexagonal prism-like structure; the two V-shaped end parts of the transverse hexagonal prism-like structure respectively form a bow part and a stern part; the outer peripheral surface of the shell is annularly provided with a raised skirt edge along the horizontal direction; the hard frame is detachably arranged in the middle of the shell. Through the structural design of the shell, the rolling stability can be obviously improved on the premise of improving the lift-drag ratio, and the accuracy of data acquisition is ensured. And the device also has the advantages of stronger navigation maneuverability, more advantage in lift-drag ratio, certain restoring force in unexpected pitching, and the like, can save propulsion or control energy, and improve the endurance mileage. The space requirement of carrying on inside also can be satisfied as far as possible, wholly realize the modularized design, be convenient for wholly unload get and hoist and mount, it is convenient to maintain the change. Meanwhile, the hard frame can also play a supporting role, and is used for enhancing the mechanical strength of the whole structure and resisting larger external pressure.

title_en: Robot braking method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a robot braking method and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring robot running information, wherein the running information comprises a robot running speed; determining a braking deceleration based on the operation speed and a preset deceleration table, wherein the preset deceleration table comprises at least two preset operation speeds and a preset deceleration corresponding to the preset operation speeds, and the preset operation speeds and the preset deceleration are in a direct proportion relation; and controlling the robot to complete braking based on the braking deceleration. The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of robots, and solves the problem that in the prior art, when a robot brakes, the braking effect of the robot is influenced by adopting trapezoidal speed setting.

title_en: Telescopic arm, charging manipulator and charging device
abstract_en: The invention provides a telescopic arm, a charging manipulator and a charging device, and relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles. The telescopic arm provided by the invention can realize switching between a straight extension state and a bidirectional bending state by changing the station of the baffle plate assembly, is convenient to assemble and has a wider application range.

title_en: Method for ensuring charging safety through video recognition of vehicle type
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for ensuring charging safety by video recognition of vehicle types, which comprises an integrated controller, wherein the integrated controller is connected with a camera through a switch, the integrated controller is connected with charging equipment, the integrated controller comprises an image acquisition module, an image recognition module, an alarm module and an information storage module, the image acquisition module acquires vehicle images through the camera, the image recognition module recognizes the acquired vehicle images and compares the recognized vehicle type information with vehicle type data in the information storage module, when the comparison finds that the vehicle type information corresponds to the vehicle type data, the alarm module sends alarm information to the corresponding charging equipment, and the method for ensuring charging safety by video recognition of vehicle types is used for solving the problems of poor accuracy, low efficiency, no difference adjustment of charging strategies, low charging safety and the like existing in manual recognition of charging vehicle types, The charging of the normal vehicle is limited.

title_en: Electric pile fills fast on water with discernment function at night
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water rapid charging pile with a night recognition function, which comprises a base, wherein two supporting plates are symmetrically welded on the upper surface of the base, top plates are welded on the upper surfaces of the two supporting plates, a radar is installed in the middle of the upper surface of each top plate, a signal emitter is installed on one side of each top plate, the electrical output end of the radar is electrically connected with the electrical input end of the signal emitter through a wire, a charging box is fixedly connected in the middle of the upper surface of the base, and cables are communicated with two sides of the charging box; when the ship need charge, drive the casing rotation to the horizontality through the L shaped plate to the pulling L shaped plate slides in the inside of casing, with the inner wall card of L shaped plate in one side of ship, remove about through the push pedal, push pedal and baffle cooperate, thereby fix the ship, avoid the ship to take place the phenomenon of removal when charging, fill electric pile and can carry out quick charge to the ship, improved the work efficiency who fills electric pile greatly.

title_en: Evaluation of perceived performance of ADAS or ADS of vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a perceived performance assessment of a vehicle ADAS or ADS, and relates to a method performed by a perceived comparison system of a vehicle to assess perceived performance of the ADAS or ADS of the vehicle. The perception comparison system establishes communication with the secondary vehicle, derives perception data from a perception system of an ADAS or ADS, receives secondary perception data from a secondary perception system of a secondary ADAS or ADS of the secondary vehicle, determines a difference output based on a comparison of at least a portion of the perception data to at least a portion of the secondary perception data when the secondary vehicle can be located in the perception data, and transmits confirmation data when at least a portion of the difference output satisfies a difference excess condition and/or when the vehicle can be perceived in the secondary perception data but the secondary vehicle cannot be located in the perception data. The present disclosure also relates to a perception comparison system according to the foregoing, a vehicle comprising such a perception comparison system and a corresponding computer program product and non-transitory computer readable storage medium.

title_en: Vehicle control device
abstract_en: A vehicle control device facilitates recognition of an actual vehicle and a host vehicle model when an actuator of an automatic driving system using model predictive control fails. The problem is solved by updating the failure part of the vehicle model to a fixed value based on the failure information and fixing the command value for the coverage state of the actuator control device in which the failure is detected.

title_en: Optimized truck tire
abstract_en: The present invention relates to truck tires and aims to improve the compromise between rolling resistance, opposing properties (for example grip of various types (longitudinal/transverse, on dry/wet ground)) and wear. The tread (2) comprises raised elements (22) and has a volume to void ratio TEV, the radial height Hs of said raised elements (22) being at least equal to 6.5mm and at most equal to 9mm, said volume to void ratio TEV being at least equal to 18% and at most equal to 23%. The at least one elastomeric mixture of the tread (2) has a glass transition temperature Tg at least equal to-18 ℃ and at most equal to-21 ℃, a Shore A hardness at least equal to 64 and at most equal to 65 and a dynamic loss tan delta at 23 ℃ at least equal to 0.15 and at most equal to 0.27. The tire also has an intermediate layer whose elastomer mixture has a dynamic loss tan δ a at 23 ℃ at least equal to 0.05 and at most equal to 0.15, and at most equal to the dynamic loss tan δ of the tread material.

title_en: Device and method for replacing vehicle battery pack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for replacing a vehicle battery pack, and belongs to the field of new energy vehicles. The invention provides a device for replacing a vehicle battery pack, aiming at solving the problems of complexity, heaviness and high cost of the existing battery pack replacing equipment, and the device comprises an underframe, wherein a track for a lifting mechanism to move on the underframe is arranged on the underframe, the lifting mechanism is connected with a lifting platform, a rolling plate for contacting with a battery pack bottom plate is arranged on the lifting platform, butt joint locking pieces are arranged at two ends of one side of the rolling plate contacting with the battery pack bottom plate, a groove is arranged in the middle of the rolling plate, a dragging mechanism for dragging the battery pack is arranged in the groove, and the dragging mechanism is connected with a driving piece to realize the movement of the dragging mechanism in the groove. According to the invention, the rolling plate is butted with the bottom plate of the battery pack to form a plane, the battery pack with wheels can be stably transited to the rolling plate, and then the battery pack is conveyed by the dragging mechanism, so that the conveying stability is higher. The replacement method is low in cost and can realize flexible replacement of the battery pack.

title_en: Assembly structure of B post apron and aluminium door frame panel beating
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assembly structure of a B-pillar cover plate and an aluminum door frame metal plate, which comprises the B-pillar cover plate, wherein a plurality of double-sided adhesive tapes are arranged on an assembly surface on the inner side of the B-pillar cover plate side by side along the length direction, one end of each double-sided adhesive tape is provided with a profile-aid adhesive tape, one end of the assembly surface of the B-pillar cover plate is provided with a single-sided adhesive tape, and one end, close to the single-sided adhesive tape, of the outer side of the B-pillar cover plate is provided with foam. The invention greatly simplifies the assembly structure of the B-pillar cover plate and perfectly overcomes the defects of the traditional structure.

title_en: Robot lower limb with buffering effect
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a lower limb of a robot with a buffering effect, which comprises thigh joints, side joints, a mounting shell, thighs, knee joints, crus, ankle joints and feet. The arc-shaped mounting plate is arranged on the outer side in the friction braking process, so that the heat dissipation performance is good, and the reliability is high.

title_en: Movable body cleaning pad
abstract_en: A movable body cleaning pad for removing an attached matter attached to a movable body, comprising: a pad that receives a pressing force from the moving body; a plurality of fluid passing portions provided on a surface portion of the pad portion; and a plurality of pump chamber portions which are formed inside the pad portion, communicate with the fluid passage portion, and store the fluid, and which deform by a pressing force generated when the moving body presses the surface portion of the pad portion, and eject the fluid to the moving body via the fluid passage portion.

title_en: Bottom door flow control device for railway ballast hopper car
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bottom door flow control device for a railway ballast hopper car, which comprises: limiting baffle, one end is connected with the transmission shaft pendulum piece of end door in the middle of the railway stone tiny fragments of stone, coal, etc. hopper car, a supporting seat, set up in one side of limiting baffle, the interval is provided with a plurality of pinholes from top to bottom on the supporting seat, the supporting pin, can insert and locate in the pinhole, when limiting baffle rotates along with the transmission shaft pendulum piece, the supporting pin can interfere with limiting baffle's the other end, limit limiting baffle and the turned angle of transmission shaft pendulum piece, end door aperture in the middle of the device constitutes a plurality of gear control through a plurality of pinholes and supporting pin, thereby reach the mesh of controlling its flow, easy operation, the application is reliable, whole device simple structure, and be the commonly used piece, the machining subtracts the piece few, conveniently make the purchase, cost expenditure has been saved effectively.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted user account login method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle-mounted user account login method and a system, and the method comprises the steps of responding to the detection that a vehicle is awakened or unlocked, and triggering a plurality of sensing devices in the vehicle to be started simultaneously; acquiring first biological characteristic data of a user in a preset range of a vehicle; matching the historical biological characteristic data with the first biological characteristic data, and determining the historical biological characteristic data with the matching degree meeting a first preset condition as potential biological characteristic data; in response to detecting that the target user is seated in the main driver seat of the vehicle, acquiring second biological characteristic data of the target user; if target biological characteristic data with the matching degree with the second biological characteristic data meeting second preset conditions exist in the potential biological characteristic data, the vehicle-mounted user account corresponding to the target biological characteristic data is logged in, most matching calculation tasks are completed in advance before a driver enters a state of preparing driving, and driving convenience and vehicle using efficiency of the driver are improved.

title_en: Mobile drug detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile drug detection system and a mobile drug detection method, wherein the mobile drug detection system comprises a detection vehicle and a mass spectrometer, and the mass spectrometer comprises an ion sampling device and an ion funnel; the interior of the detection vehicle is divided into a sampling area, a pretreatment area and a detection area; a stool is arranged in the sampling area, and the mass spectrometer is arranged in the detection area; the ion sampling device includes: a plurality of capillary needles are used for sampling and sample ionization; one side of the bearing piece facing the inlet end of the ion funnel is a convex curved surface, and the capillary needle is fixed on the bearing piece and extends into the ion funnel; the distance between the capillary needles becomes larger along the direction from the bearing part to the ion funnel; the imaging module is fixed on one side of the bearing piece facing the ion funnel and used for obtaining an image of the inner side of the ion funnel; the adjusting device is used for adjusting the position of the bearing piece, so that the included angle between any capillary needle and the horizontal plane containing the central axis of the ion funnel is adjusted. The invention has the advantages of rapid detection, high flux and the like.

title_en: Sheep horn structure, integral front axle and refitting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a horn structure, an integral front axle and a refitting method, wherein the horn structure comprises a horn for connecting a main pin and a connecting structure for connecting with the end part of a bridge pipe, the horn is detachably fixed on the connecting structure, the horn has a plurality of fixed states relative to the connecting structure, and under each fixed state, the main pin connecting point on the horn has different positions relative to the connecting structure. The integral front axle can be used for conveniently and independently adjusting the caster angles of the kingpins and the included angles between the claw and the transmission shafts on two sides of the vehicle on the premise of ensuring the supporting strength, and meanwhile, the positions of mounting points of all parts on the axle tube still keep the original mounting angles, so that variables affecting the wheelbase, the direction accuracy and the suspension height of the chassis are not introduced.

title_en: Pure electric vehicle type thermal management system and pure electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a pure electric vehicle type heat management system and a pure electric vehicle.A heating system, a strong electric system cooling system, a battery cooling system and an air conditioning system are integrated into a high-efficiency system, so that the cooling requirements of all parts are met, and when a passenger cabin has heating and defogging requirements or a battery has heating requirements, the waste heat of the strong electric system and the waste heat of the air conditioning system can be fully utilized. The system comprises a thermal management controller, a heating system, a battery cooling system, an air conditioning system and a strong electric system cooling system, wherein a condenser in the air conditioning system adopts a water-cooled condenser, the strong electric system cooling system is used for cooling the air conditioning system, and the water-cooled condenser is adopted to enable a front end cooling module to be more compact and efficient. The system also comprises a four-way valve, a first three-way valve and a second three-way valve, and the heat management controller controls the working modes of the four-way valve and the first three-way valve and the second three-way valve to connect or disconnect the systems according to the collected cooling and heating requirements so as to exert the functions of the system components to the maximum extent.

title_en: Miniaturized servo system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a miniaturized servo system, which comprises a bullet servo controller, a bullet servo actuator and a servo cable network, wherein the bullet servo controller is connected with the bullet servo actuator through a servo cable network; the warhead servo actuator comprises a servo motor, a speed reduction transmission mechanism consisting of a ball screw pair and a gear pair, a linear displacement sensor and a connecting rod assembly; the linear displacement sensor adopts a dual-redundancy linear displacement sensor, an electric brush component of the linear displacement sensor is arranged on a ball screw pair, and a left resistance component and a right resistance component of the dual-redundancy linear displacement sensor are arranged on the same plate; the servo cable network is of a one-to-two structure, one end of the servo cable network is connected with the warhead servo controller end, and the two separated ends of the servo cable network are respectively connected with the servo motor and the electric connector of the linear displacement sensor; the electric connector of the servo motor is a strong and weak current mixed electric connector and is arranged at the top of the servo motor.

title_en: Boarding bridge channel and boarding bridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boarding bridge channel and a boarding bridge. The channel body comprises a top plate and a partition plate which are arranged at intervals, and an interlayer space is formed between the top plate and the partition plate; the air conditioner component is arranged in the interlayer space and comprises an air conditioner indoor unit, a return air pipe and an air outlet pipe; one end of the air return pipe is connected with the air conditioner indoor unit, the other end of the air return pipe is provided with an air return opening, one end of the air outlet pipe is connected with the air conditioner indoor unit, and the other end of the air outlet pipe is provided with an air outlet; wherein, return air inlet and air outlet all are towards the current region of passageway body.

title_en: Control device, ship provided with same, and ship control method
abstract_en: A control device (40) for a ship having two-sided stabilizer fins capable of being stored acquires attitude information, which is either one of the fin movement angle of the stabilizer fins and the ship speed of the ship, from an information measurement device (30) that measures the attitude information of the ship, wherein when the two-sided stabilizer fins are moved, when the attitude information is determined to be smaller than a first predetermined value, the control device controls the fin to store either one of the stabilizer fins, and when the attitude information is determined to be smaller than a second predetermined value, the control device controls the fin to store either one of the stabilizer fins.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted video monitoring device for monitoring tire pressure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of new energy automobiles, and discloses an on-vehicle video monitoring device for tire pressure monitoring, which obtains self-cleaning intermittent time of current road surface humidity corresponding to adjustment camera integration through a humidity detector and the like, judges the distance between the camera integration and a tire table board in real time through an ultrasonic scanner, indirectly detects whether the tire surface bulges, and sends out warning information if necessary, and simultaneously judges whether the section profile of the tire is abnormal or not by utilizing the camera integration, thereby improving the driving safety, and the surface of a hemispherical mud guard is self-cleaned through the arrangement of the hemispherical mud guard and the like, thereby ensuring the visibility and the definition of the hemispherical mud guard, avoiding the indirect influence on the normal operation effect of the camera integration, and effectively avoiding the pollution influence on the surface of the camera integration caused by the self-cleaning of the hemispherical mud guard due to the arrangement of the hemispherical mud guard and the like, the practicability of the whole monitoring device is improved.

title_en: High-safety fuel cell power generation system for green ship and safe working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-safety fuel cell power generation system for a green ship, which comprises a fuel cell power generation device, a hydrogen storage/supply device, a hydrothermal management device, a mechanical ventilation device, a fire fighting device, a safety monitoring device and a control/energy management device, wherein the fuel cell power generation device and the hydrogen storage/supply device are externally provided with self-explosion-proof sealed cabins provided with mechanical ventilation openings and flame detectors and are connected through double-wall pipes provided with emergency cut-off valves, and a safety working method of the fuel cell power generation system is also disclosed; according to the invention, the inner space of the fuel cell power generation module is designed by partitioning and ventilation according to the danger degree of the hydrogen-related environment and mechanical ventilation, so that the hidden danger of explosion caused by high concentration of locally accumulated hydrogen is avoided, and the self-explosion-proof performance of the fuel cell power generation module is effectively improved; through having realized revealing in-process risk degree monitoring and warning to the inside hydrogen of system, improved marine fuel cell system's security performance.

title_en: Single-use jam-free stop module for a rotary drive actuator
abstract_en: A stop module for a seizure-free end-of-stroke stop for a rotary drive actuator includes a timing gear to articulate a stop dog and a low inertia, deformable stop disk arranged to safely dissipate excess rotational kinetic energy of the rotary actuator. The stop module does not rely on friction to stop and dissipate the excess kinetic energy, but on predictable deformation of the metal stop disk that can be provided in the stop cartridge of the stop module. The use of a deformable element to dissipate excess energy allows the disclosed stop die to be lighter and smaller than conventional end-of-stroke stop mechanisms.

title_en: Miniature turbojet engine control system
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a micro turbojet engine control system comprising: the device comprises a control module, an oil pump driving module and a motor rotating speed measuring module; the oil pump driving module comprises a motor driving unit and an induced electromotive force discharge unit; the motor rotating speed measuring module is configured to measure the rotating speed of the oil pump motor through a speed measuring sensor; the control module is configured to adjust a target rotating speed according to rotating speed information of the oil pump motor, generate a first PWM signal and output the first PWM signal to the oil pump driving module; the motor driving unit is configured to output a voltage driving signal to a voltage input terminal of the oil pump motor when the first PWM signal is a first level signal, and stop outputting when the first PWM signal is a second level signal; the induced electromotive force discharge unit is configured to discharge a voltage on a voltage input terminal of the oil pump motor when the first PWM signal is the second level signal. The scheme can improve the sensitivity and the accuracy of oil pump control.

title_en: Vehicle parking path planning method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a vehicle parking path planning method and related equipment, which can be particularly applied to the fields of automatic driving and automatic parking in the field of artificial intelligence, and the method can comprise the following steps: receiving a parking request, and responding to the parking request, and planning a first path from the current position to the target parking space of the target vehicle; dividing the first path into n sections of paths according to the steering wheel angle change rate of the target vehicle, and acquiring path information of the n sections of paths; and calculating a function value of an operability metric function of the first path according to the path information, adjusting the first posture of the target vehicle at the current position to a target posture under the condition that the function value is smaller than a preset threshold value, and replanning a parking path based on the target posture. The parking path planning method and device are applied to intelligent automobiles, internet automobiles, new energy automobiles and the like, and can plan the parking path with high parking success rate so as to control the vehicles to park into the parking spaces accurately.

title_en: Special-effect light-transmitting structure for laser engraving of real wood and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real wood laser engraving special effect light transmission structure and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the real wood laser engraving special effect light transmission structure comprises a real wood layer, a shading film, a light transmission basal layer, a backlight module and an MCU mainboard which are sequentially stacked, wherein the shading film is a sheet made of opaque materials, a hollowed-out area is formed on the shading film, a plane light source of the backlight module is transmitted to the surface of the real wood layer through the basal layer and the hollowed-out area on the shading film, the backlight module is electrically connected with a control circuit on the MCU mainboard, the manufacturing method comprises the steps of firstly manufacturing the transparent basal layer, then pasting the shading film on one side of the basal layer, cutting the real wood bark and pasting the surface of the shading film, sequentially polishing, filling, manually polishing, coloring and spraying finish paint on the surface of the wood bark, then mounting the backlight module on the other side of the basal layer, and connecting the backlight module with the control circuit on the MCU mainboard, the invention forms a soft atmosphere lighting effect on the surface of the real wood interior decoration, and is natural and beautiful.

title_en: Magnetic-electric coupling multiplexing vehicle-mounted charging system with overheat protection function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic-electric coupling multiplexing vehicle-mounted charging system with an overheat protection function, which relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted charging and comprises a base, wherein a charger and a water tank are fixedly arranged on the base, a heat dissipation cover is fixedly arranged at one end of the charger, and the magnetic-electric coupling multiplexing vehicle-mounted charging system also comprises a thermistor and is used for detecting the temperature during charging; the water cooling assembly is used for introducing cooling water when the temperature is higher than a preset threshold value to carry out cooling; the blade heat dissipation assembly and the water cooling assembly simultaneously perform heat dissipation operation; the plug control assembly is used for controlling the separation of the charging plug and the charging socket after the charging is finished; the buckling assembly is used for limiting the matching of the charging head and the charging socket. The invention solves the technical problem of poor heat dissipation effect of the current vehicle-mounted charging device, replaces a closely matched plug-in mode adopted in common charging, has high reaction speed, and achieves the purpose of overheat protection by utilizing the cooling water and the blades for heat dissipation and simultaneously performing heat dissipation operation.

title_en: Train-following inspection communication system and method and train dynamic condition index estimation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication system and a communication method for polling along with a train and a train dynamic condition index estimation method, wherein the system comprises a state monitor, a state detection module and a state estimation module, wherein the state monitor is used for acquiring train state monitoring data in real time; the wireless communicators are respectively arranged at the tops of the carriages and comprise transmitting ends, receiving ends and wireless CPE modules, wireless forward paths are formed among the receiving ends of the adjacent wireless communicators, and wireless reverse paths are formed among the transmitting ends; the receiving end of one of the wireless communicators is connected with the state monitor and is used for receiving the train state monitoring data in real time; each wireless forward path and each wireless reverse path are used for transmitting the train state monitoring data in real time; the mobile intelligent terminal is used for carrying out bidirectional wireless communication with a wireless CPE module in a wireless communicator of a carriage where the mobile intelligent terminal is located so as to obtain train state monitoring data in real time; wherein each wireless communicator communicates in a wireless laser communication mode or a wireless CPE communication mode. The system has high transmission rate.

title_en: Gap compensation mechanism of worm gear speed reducing mechanism of steering system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gap compensation mechanism of a worm and gear speed reducing mechanism of a steering system, which comprises an output shaft, a sliding sleeve, a worm wheel and a spiral spring; the output shaft comprises an output shaft body, a plurality of axial sliding grooves are formed in the surface of the output shaft body, which is used for installing the worm wheel, a spacing rib is formed between two adjacent axial sliding grooves, a flange is arranged on the output shaft, which is close to the large end side, and a flange groove is formed in the surface of the flange, which is opposite to the axial sliding grooves; the sliding sleeve is sleeved at the axial sliding groove of the output shaft, and the worm wheel is sleeved on the sliding sleeve; one side of the worm wheel, which is close to the flange, is provided with a worm wheel groove, and the spiral spring is arranged between the worm wheel groove and the flange groove. According to the technical scheme, through a worm wheel compensation technology, the worm wheel is connected with the output shaft through the sliding sleeve, the worm wheel is pushed to move while torque is transmitted, the meshing point is changed, the action point of the compensation force is located on the worm wheel, and therefore the influence caused by abrasion of the worm wheel is eliminated.

title_en: Vehicle mass correction method based on vehicle mass recognition ramp gradient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle mass correction method based on vehicle mass recognition ramp gradient, which comprises the following steps: storing the initial total mass of the vehicle in a mass memory unit, and storing the initial ramp slope in a ramp slope memory unit; when the vehicle speed is greater than the vehicle running standard value V1, correcting the current total vehicle mass according to the ramp gradient information in the ramp gradient storage unit, and storing the result of the vehicle mass correction in the mass memory unit; when the vehicle speed is smaller than a calibration value V0 for stopping the vehicle, calculating the current slope according to the corrected total mass of the vehicle, and storing the calculated current actual slope into a slope memory unit; the correction process is repeatedly performed each time the vehicle is started. The invention can ensure the accuracy of the slope identification of the ramp and prevent the phenomenon of inaccurate slope identification of the ramp caused by the change of the load of the vehicle.

title_en: Explosion impact resistant and inward cutting separating device
abstract_en: A separation device resistant to explosion impact and capable of cutting inwards belongs to the technical field of spacecraft structures. The invention provides a cutting and separating device and a protective structure which are suitable for high explosive impact magnitude (about 150000g impact in 8000Hz frequency range) with large loading (linear density is not more than 31 g/m) and wide frequency, adopts a form of cutting high-strength steel from outside to inside, can realize cutting and separating of high-strength steel with strength of at least 6mm and not less than 1400MPa in the working process, and can ensure that a protective cover shell and a protective cover plate have good structures. Meanwhile, numerical analysis and calculation research are carried out on the process of detonation energy growth and transmission, and fine design of detonation energy is realized.

title_en: Rotor unmanned aerial vehicle top surface bistable state perches mechanism based on subtend claw thorn unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicle top surface bistable inhabitation mechanism based on opposite claw thorn units, which is arranged on the top surface of a rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicle and comprises claw thorn units, bistable mechanisms, a mounting seat, a rack, a steering engine and a flexible connecting mechanism; the mount pad will perch the mechanism and fix on rotor unmanned aerial vehicle. The rotor unmanned aerial vehicle can grab and attach a common mineral wool board ceiling in a room through a claw thorn unit on the perching mechanism, so that the endurance time of the rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is prolonged, and the functions of repeatedly perching, shooting and other tasks in the room by the rotor unmanned aerial vehicle are realized; when rotor unmanned aerial vehicle need return to the navigation, steering wheel drive bistable mechanism unblock, the claw thorn unit is changed into the state of outside motion by inside to the state of grabbing, and the adhesion state between claw thorn unit and the mineral wool board is relieved this moment, and rotor unmanned aerial vehicle carries the subassembly of perching and breaks away from the mineral wool board furred ceiling. This rotor unmanned aerial vehicle perches mechanism simple structure, small, light in weight, easily control, good reliability, repeatedly usable and disguised strong.

title_en: Seat height adjusting structure, automobile seat and hydrogen energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention provides a seat height adjusting structure, an automobile seat and a hydrogen energy automobile, wherein an air spring is arranged below the seat, the air spring comprises a base, a rotating shaft, an adjusting device and a poking piece, the base is provided with an installing cavity, and a through hole is formed in the left side wall and the right side wall of the installing cavity in a penetrating manner; the rotating shaft is rotatably arranged in the through hole; the adjusting device comprises a rotating assembly, an elastic resetting piece and a stay wire, wherein the rotating assembly is rotationally connected with the rotating shaft, the elastic resetting piece is used for driving the rotating assembly to return, one end of the stay wire is connected with the rotating assembly, and the other end of the stay wire is connected with an air inlet valve of the air spring; the toggle piece comprises a rotating end fixedly connected with the rotating assembly and a free end with a movable stroke along the up-down direction. The invention has the beneficial effects that: through pressing the free end, the rotation end drives the rotation subassembly and revolutes the rotation to drive the inlet opening of stay wire control air inlet valve, and then promote or reduce the seat height, this kind of mode simple convenient of adjusting the seat height has improved the convenience that the seat was adjusted.

title_en: Method for removing dust of solar sailboard of Mars detector
abstract_en: The application provides a method for removing dust of a solar array panel of a Mars detector, wherein a detection device is arranged on the Mars detector, a dust removal device is installed on the solar array panel of the Mars detector, a dust removal control device is installed inside a Mars detector main body and used for controlling the dust removal device to remove dust of the solar array panel, and the solar array panel is connected with the Mars detector main body through a connecting device. The method for removing dust from the solar sailboard of the Mars detector can timely remove dust on the solar sailboard of the Mars detector, ensure that the conversion efficiency of the solar sailboard is in a high-efficiency state, and prolong the service life of the Mars detector.

title_en: Industrial machine system, control device, control method for industrial machine system, and computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: Ensure the safety of industrial machinery. The industrial machinery system (500) comprises: an industrial machine (100); a zone information acquisition device (2) for acquiring information of an operation zone in which an industrial machine performs an operation; and a control device (3) for determining whether the industrial machine can perform work in the work area, the control device comprising: a storage unit (310) that stores information of a registration area acquired in advance; and a determination unit (32) that determines whether or not the industrial machine can operate, based on whether or not a region corresponding to the operation region can be specified from the registration region stored in the storage unit.

title_en: Interaction method and interaction system for multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of interaction between devices, in particular to an interaction method and an interaction system of a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a vehicle, wherein the interaction system comprises an acquisition unit and a processing unit. The acquisition unit is used for acquiring a platform deck image of a platform deck of a vehicle, a rear image of a rear environment of the vehicle, a front image of the vehicle and two side images of the vehicle, wherein the platform deck image of the vehicle is shot by an onboard camera of a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, the front image of the vehicle is shot by a front camera of the vehicle, and the two side images of the vehicle are shot by two side cameras. The system comprises a processing unit, a platform image acquisition module, a platform, a regulation module, a synthesis module and a display module, wherein the processing module of the processing unit is used for determining the relative positions of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and the vehicle to be landed according to the platform image, the regulation module is used for regulating the relative positions of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and the vehicle in the landing process of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and the synthesis module is used for synthesizing the front image, the rear image and the two side images so as to obtain a panoramic image.

title_en: Control method for hybrid vehicle and control device for hybrid vehicle
abstract_en: A hybrid vehicle has an adsorption tank (38) for adsorbing evaporated fuel generated in a fuel tank (35) of an internal combustion engine (10). The hybrid vehicle can drive the drive wheels even when the internal combustion engine (10) is stopped. When the internal combustion engine (10) is stopped, if a predetermined condition is satisfied, the hybrid vehicle rotates the internal combustion engine (10) by the generator (9). When the internal combustion engine (10) is rotated by the generator (9), the hybrid vehicle supplies vaporized fuel adsorbed to the canister (38) to the upstream side of the upstream side exhaust catalyst device (41). The hybrid vehicle adsorbs the introduced vaporized fuel as a reducing agent to the upstream side exhaust catalyst device (41) and the downstream side exhaust catalyst device (42).
