title_en: Integrated channel device for non-heat pump heat management integrated module and electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric vehicles, in particular to an integrated channel device for a non-heat pump heat management integrated module and an electric vehicle. The integrated channel device comprises a first component and a second component, wherein a channel group penetrating through the first component along the thickness direction and a groove not penetrating through the first component are arranged on the first component, and the channel group and the groove are used for accommodating connecting pipes. A plurality of strip-shaped grooves are formed in the second component, and each strip-shaped groove is correspondingly arranged with two channels to enable the two channels to be communicated. In the use, install in non-heat pump heat management collection moulding piece, the connecting pipe that will communicate is put into two passageways and is corresponded the bar inslot that communicates these two passageways, when the upgrading repacking is heat pump management system, dismantles the integrated channel device, installs three-way valve or cross valve on the connecting pipe. The electric vehicle can be rapidly upgraded from a non-heat pump system to a heat pump system, and meanwhile, the cost and the dead weight of the whole vehicle cannot be excessively increased.

title_en: Accessory mounting frame for vehicle seat base
abstract_en: The accessory mounting frame is connectable to various vehicle seat bases and allows for connection of vehicle accessories when the vehicle seat is removed. The accessory mounting frame includes a first seat attachment projection, a second seat attachment projection, and an accessory fastener coupled to the first seat attachment projection and the second seat attachment projection. The first seat attachment protrusion has a first bearing surface configured to abut a first portion of a vehicle seat base. The second seat attachment protrusion has a second support surface configured to abut a second portion of the vehicle seat base. The first seat attachment projection and the second seat attachment projection are adjustable relative to the accessory fastener.

title_en: Unmanned helicopter and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned helicopter and a control system thereof, wherein the control system comprises a controller, a main rotor, a first control mechanism for controlling the variable pitch of the main rotor and wings arranged on two sides of the unmanned helicopter, wherein the wings on the two sides are provided with a propulsion mechanism; when the unmanned helicopter is in a lifting or hovering state, the controller controls the propulsion mechanisms on the two sides of the unmanned helicopter to perform differential motion, and the horizontal differential moment generated by the propulsion mechanisms on the two sides is balanced with the torque generated by the rotation of the main rotor. In the practical application process, when the unmanned helicopter is in a lifting or hovering state, the controller controls the propulsion mechanisms on the two sides of the unmanned helicopter to perform differential motion, and the horizontal differential moment generated by the propulsion mechanisms on the two sides is balanced with the torque generated by the rotation of the main rotor, so that the unmanned helicopter can keep balance when lifted or hovered.

title_en: Motor unit
abstract_en: A motor unit mounted on a vehicle for driving the vehicle includes a motor having a rotor and a stator, the rotor being rotatable about a motor axis, a transmission mechanism that transmits power of the motor and outputs the power from an output shaft, a housing having a motor housing portion that houses the motor and a gear housing portion that houses the transmission mechanism, an inverter unit that supplies power to the motor, oil that circulates through an oil passage provided in the housing, and an oil cooler that is provided in a path of the oil passage for cooling the oil, at least a portion of the inverter unit overlapping the oil cooler when viewed in an axial direction of the motor axis.

title_en: Folding type solar cell array secondary compression releasing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a folding type solar cell array secondary compression release mechanism which can move after being released and keep fixed at a set position, and meets the requirements of the secondary compression release mechanism on function and performance. The method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a pressing cap, a limiting mechanism, a pressing rod, a pressing seat and an initiating explosive cutter; the pressing base is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the spacecraft, the pressing rods sequentially penetrate through the pressing bushings of the outer middle solar panel, the inner middle solar panel and the inner solar panel and then are fixedly connected with the pressing base, and pretension is applied through the pressing rods; the firer cutter is used for cutting off the pre-tensioned pressing rod; a limiting section matched with the limiting mechanism is arranged above the cut-off position of the compression rod; the limiting mechanism is fixed in the pressing bush of the outer and middle solar panels; when the pressing rod is cut off by the firer cutter, the cut pressing rod slides towards the outer middle solar panel; when the limiting section on the pressing rod moves to the position of the limiting mechanism, the pressing rod is fixed at the current position through the limitation of the limiting section by the limiting mechanism.

title_en: Tire wear change monitoring device with image acquisition function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tire wear change monitoring device with an image acquisition function, which comprises an installation frame and a comparison assembly, wherein the installation frame is provided with a plurality of positioning holes; mounting frame: the inner part of the wheel hub is rotatably connected with a wheel hub, a tire is arranged on the circumferential surface of the wheel hub, three corresponding annular grooves are formed in the circumferential surface of the tire, two corresponding strip-shaped openings are formed in the front side and the rear side of the mounting frame, second electric telescopic rods are arranged in the strip-shaped openings, connecting plates are fixed on telescopic arms of the two second electric telescopic rods, a detection assembly is arranged on the side surface of each connecting plate, and a shooting assembly and a moving assembly are arranged in the mounting frame; a comparison component: contain hexagonal prism, fixed block, leading wheel, infrared receiver and connecting strip, set up three corresponding hexagonal hole on the last side of connecting plate, can be very convenient detect the tire wearing and tearing condition to can in time remind user's tire wearing and tearing serious.

title_en: Control method, device, medium and electronic equipment for vehicle parking
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicle control, and discloses a control method, a control device, a control medium and an electronic device for vehicle parking. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring boundary information of a target parking space area through the camera device, and determining a parking track of the vehicle based on the boundary information; controlling the vehicle to move to the target parking space area according to the parking track; when a magnetic induction lead located in the target parking space area is detected through the magnetic induction device, acquiring magnetic field information of the magnetic induction device relative to the magnetic induction lead; and controlling the vehicle to move to the target position of the target parking space area based on the magnetic field information. According to the parking method and the parking device, the parking is carried out by referring to the magnetic field information of the magnetic conductance leads, and the parking precision of the vehicle can be improved.

title_en: Lane change system for lanes with different speed limits
abstract_en: Embodiments disclose a method and system for operating an autonomous vehicle (ADV). In one embodiment, the system determines a Source Lane Speed Limit (SLSL) for a Source Lane (SL) and a Target Lane Speed Limit (TLSL) for a Target Lane (TL), where SLSL is greater than TLSL. The system generates a first trajectory of the autonomous vehicle along the SL having a modified speed corresponding to the TLSL instead of the SLSL. The system generates a second trajectory for the autonomous vehicle to change from SL to TL, the second trajectory having a speed corresponding to TLSL. The system determines a first cost of the first track and a second cost of the second track, respectively, based on a cost function for the comparison. The system controls the autonomous vehicle according to the trajectory at a minimum cost.

title_en: Rearrangement type PCS garage uses intelligent handling device based on AGV parks fast
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional mechanical garages, and particularly discloses an intelligent carrying device for a tandem PCS garage based on AGV rapid parking. The invention carries out carrying operation on the automobile by utilizing the AGV body, can carry the vehicle for storing and taking in the garage from the front row/the rear row to the rear row/the front row, avoids the problem that a driver passes through the front row to the rear row for parking/taking the automobile, solves the problem that the driver needs to enter and exit the garage when parking and taking the automobile, ensures the safety of the driver when parking and taking the automobile, adopts the AGV body to carry the automobile, omits the time of manual parking and taking the automobile, improves the parking and taking efficiency of the automobile, avoids the phenomenon of traffic jam, avoids the fussy action of passing through the front row to the rear row for storing/taking the driver when driving the automobile, and can greatly improve the efficiency, rapidness and safety when the automobile enters and exits.

title_en: High-voltage on-board electrical system for a vehicle and method for setting up such a system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: an HV on-board electrical system of a vehicle, wherein the HV on-board electrical system comprises a high voltage source, a central intermediate circuit capacitance and at least two high voltage components, wherein positive connection ends of the high voltage components are connected with positive connection ends of the central intermediate circuit capacitance, respectively, and negative connection ends of the high voltage components are connected with negative connection ends of the central intermediate circuit capacitance, respectively, wherein connection ends of the central intermediate circuit capacitance and connection ends of at least one of the high voltage components are electrically connected via a low inductance conductor arrangement having an inductance value per unit length of less than 0.2 [ mu ] H/m, wherein the at least one high voltage component is electrically connected with the central intermediate circuit capacitance such that a capacitance resulting from a joint capacitance of the high voltage component and a connection capacitance of an electrical connection between the high voltage component and the central intermediate circuit capacitance is less than or equal to 100 [ mu ] F; and a method for setting up such a high-voltage on-board electrical system.

title_en: Unmanned ship of collecting of surface of water floater
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of water surface floater collection, and provides a water surface floater unmanned collection ship, which comprises: the water storage device comprises a ship body, wherein a storage chamber for storing water and a storage chamber for storing floaters are arranged in the ship body; the floating body is movably connected with the ship body; the driving assembly is connected with the ship body, the driving assembly is connected with the piston assembly, and the piston assembly is connected with the cleaning assembly; open the control valve, water gets into the deposit room makes the hull sink to preset the position, close the control valve, the floater gets into in the hull through collecting the subassembly, drive assembly drive piston assembly sends the water in the deposit room to clearance subassembly department, the hull come-up makes the floater remain on the body, the body receives floater and self gravity influence, open the storage compartment around the hull is rotatory, piston assembly drive clearance subassembly reciprocal swing simultaneously, clearance subassembly sprays water and dashes into the storage compartment with remaining floater on the body, accomplish the collection of floater, and has low strength, efficient and advantage with low costs.

title_en: Power transmission system and vehicle with same
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission system and a vehicle with the same, wherein the power transmission system comprises: the front main reducer assembly is connected with the front wheel assembly; the rear main reducer assembly is connected with a rear wheel assembly; the transmission is arranged between the front main speed reducer assembly and the rear main speed reducer assembly; the transfer case is integrated on the rear main reducer assembly; one end of the inter-axle transmission shaft is connected with the front main reducer assembly, and the other end of the inter-axle transmission shaft is connected with the rear main reducer assembly; one end of the first transmission shaft is connected with the transfer case, and the other end of the first transmission shaft is connected with the speed changer. According to the power transmission system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the transfer case and the rear main reducer assembly are integrated into a whole, so that the arrangement space is saved, the weight of the power transmission system is reduced, and the transmission torque value and the bearing capacity of the power transmission system per unit weight are improved.

title_en: Marine sidelight safety cover
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of illuminating lamps, in particular to a ship sidelight protective cover. The ship sidelight protection cover comprises a shell and a movable screen plate. Wherein, the casing has been seted up uncovered, and the sidelight can be placed in the casing through uncovered. The movable screen plate is rotatably connected to the shell, so that when the movable screen plate is in a first state, the movable screen plate can cover the opening, and when the movable screen plate is in a second state, the movable screen plate can open the opening. The ship sidelight protection cover is simple in structure, convenient to detach and replace, time-saving and labor-saving; can 360 degrees all-round protect the sidelight, improve the security performance of sidelight, practice thrift the cost.

title_en: Communication controller, communication method, and electric vehicle
abstract_en: Provided are a communication device and a communication method for exchanging messages with a charging apparatus, and an electric vehicle including the communication device. The communication device includes: a communication unit provided to be coupled to the charging device through a first communication channel; and a control unit coupled to the communication unit through a second communication channel. When the request message is sent to the communication unit at the first point in time, the control unit determines a target polling time based on a value set to a timeout flag associated with the request message. Then, the control unit periodically checks at each target polling time whether the communication unit has received a response message from the charging device within a waiting period from a first time point to a second time point at which a timeout associated with the request message has elapsed from the first time point.

title_en: Vehicle braking prompting method and system, terminal equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle braking prompting method, a vehicle braking prompting system, terminal equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring pressure information of a brake master cylinder in a target vehicle; if the pressure information meets the braking condition, the braking deceleration of the target vehicle is obtained, and the braking type of the target vehicle is determined according to the braking deceleration and the pressure information; and if the determined braking type of the target vehicle is the emergency braking type, controlling a brake lamp on the target vehicle to give an emergency braking prompt. According to the invention, the braking type of the target vehicle is determined according to the braking deceleration and the pressure information, and whether the target vehicle is in emergency braking can be effectively judged based on the braking type of the target vehicle, namely, when the braking type of the target vehicle is the emergency braking type, the emergency braking prompt is carried out by controlling the brake lamp on the target vehicle so as to prompt other vehicles to pay attention to deceleration or avoidance, so that the other vehicles can effectively distinguish the emergency braking of the target vehicle, and the vehicle running safety is improved.

title_en: Semi-closed automatic car washer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of car washers, and particularly relates to a semi-closed automatic car washer which comprises a protective wall, a mechanical arm, a brush, a lateral cleaning module and a base, wherein the protective wall is arranged on the protective wall; the top end of the inside of the protective wall is fixedly connected with a mechanical arm, the bottom end of the mechanical arm is provided with a hairbrush, two sides of the inside of the protective wall are provided with lateral cleaning modules, the bottom end of the inside of the protective wall is provided with a base, and a connecting mechanism is arranged between the hairbrush and the mechanical arm; the connecting mechanism comprises a fixed shaft, a sleeve block, an inserting block, a slot, a connecting shaft, a limiting assembly and a positioning assembly, one side of the fixed shaft is fixedly connected to two sides of the brush, one side of the fixed shaft, far away from the brush, is arranged inside the mechanical arm, the sleeve block is fixedly connected with the fixed shaft, the sleeve block is inserted into the connecting shaft, and the connecting shaft is fixedly connected with the mechanical arm; the connecting mechanism plays a role in conveniently disassembling and replacing the brush used for a long time.

title_en: Indoor airplane test micro-pressure control system and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor airplane test micro-pressure control system and a control method, and belongs to the technical field of airplane tests. The control system includes: pressure balancing unit, first fresh air fan group, temperature sensor and differential pressure sensor, control method includes the following step: s1, before the test starts, starting the micro-pressure control system; s2, setting a pressure difference control target value of the airplane climate laboratory, and judging the test working condition of the airplane climate laboratory; s3, adjusting the micro-pressure in the airplane climate laboratory according to the working conditions; and S4, after the test is finished, closing the micro-pressure control system. The invention solves the problem that the prior art can not meet the requirement of an airplane climate laboratory with large volume and wide temperature and humidity change range on the micro-positive pressure environment, and has the advantages of good regulation effect and quick response.

title_en: Air base recovery device and method for flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an empty foundation recovery device of a flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein an upper foldable guide rod and a lower foldable guide rod are arranged at the gravity center of the flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle, and the head of the unmanned aerial vehicle is also provided with a locking mechanism; the recovery device comprises a collecting, releasing and transporting integrated mechanism, an unmanned aerial vehicle docking frame and a buffer mechanism for connecting the collecting, releasing and transporting integrated mechanism and the unmanned aerial vehicle docking frame; four rhombic convergent channels which are continuously narrowed from back to front are formed on the unmanned aerial vehicle docking frame, the left convergent channel and the right convergent channel are matched with two wings of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the upper convergent channel and the lower convergent channel are matched with a foldable guide rod of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and an electromagnetic lock is arranged at the convergent tail end of the upper convergent channel; the integrated mechanism for collecting, releasing and transporting is used for collecting and releasing the unmanned aerial vehicle docking frame and transporting the captured unmanned aerial vehicle to the carrier in a traction mode. The invention also discloses a method for recovering the empty base of the flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention can realize the low-precision butt-joint recovery of the flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle and has the advantages of high recovery success rate and high recovery speed.

title_en: Pressure detection device for vehicle seat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pressure detection device for a vehicle seat, which belongs to the technical field of automobiles and comprises a bottom frame, wherein the upper surface of the bottom frame is fixedly connected with a base, the upper surface of the base is provided with a soft layer, and the inner wall of the base is slidably connected with the same pull rope through a plurality of slide holes. This a pressure detection device for automobile seat through setting up stay cord, ceramic post and gangbar, synchronous stay cord can realize with the good cooperation of toughness steel sheet according to the suction of negative pressure, realizes that the seat can not be too soft and keep good elasticity and comfort level, has better cushioning effect to jolting of vehicle, has fine protection effect to personnel's lumbar vertebrae to great jolting and use in the freight train, makes it can realize the weight monitoring to the low-quality object under the whole application state, simultaneously to the monitoring that the human body took, synchronous can play good laminating and cushioning effect to the vehicle.

title_en: Lamp for vehicle
abstract_en: The scanning light source (100) comprises a semiconductor light source (110) and a motor (120), and the outgoing light of the semiconductor light source (110) is scanned in front of the lamp according to the movement of the motor (120). The constant current driver (220) supplies a drive current (I  LED ) corresponding to the light source control signal (S6) to the semiconductor light source (110). A light source control signal generator (210) generates a light source control signal (S6) so as to obtain a light distribution pattern corresponding to the light distribution instruction data. A delay time measuring device (260) measures a delay time (tau) required for a change in the ON/OFF state of the semiconductor light source (110) from a change in the light source control signal (S6).

title_en: Speed control device and method for electric bicycle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a speed control device of an electric bicycle and a method thereof, according to the present invention, a torque of a motor driving wheels is controlled such that the speed of the wheels follows the speed of pedals driven by a user, and an assist level is applied to control the torque of the pedals according to the torque of the motor, thereby having the effect that the electric bicycle without a chain can feel the same feeling of pedals as a bicycle with a chain, and the force applied to the pedals can be adjusted according to the assist level.

title_en: Hybrid vehicle thermal management method, storage medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid vehicle thermal management method, a storage medium and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting the running condition information of the vehicle; the operation condition information comprises at least one of an accelerator signal, a vehicle speed signal, a gear signal, a brake signal, a clutch signal, an engine rotating speed signal, an in-cylinder brake switch signal, a battery electric quantity signal, a temperature signal of an exhaust post-processing system and a temperature signal of engine coolant of the vehicle; determining the current driving state of the vehicle according to the operation condition information; and determining the working modes of the power-assisted recovery motor and the engine of the vehicle according to the current driving state and the running condition information. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the power-assisted recovery motor of the vehicle and the working mode of the engine can be controlled according to the current driving state of the vehicle and the working condition information of the vehicle, so that the temperature of the engine and an exhaust aftertreatment system of the vehicle can be quickly raised in different driving states.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle pesticide spraying amount monitoring and processing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for monitoring and processing pesticide spraying amount of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the area of a region to be sprayed and the degree of plant diseases and insect pests of the region to be sprayed; determining a first usage amount of the pesticide according to the area and the degree of the plant diseases and insect pests; acquiring the length of a path for spraying the unmanned aerial vehicle in the area to be sprayed; determining the speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle flying along the path according to the spraying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the using amount of the pesticide and the length of the path, wherein the spraying of the pesticide is carried out when the unmanned aerial vehicle flies on the path. Through this application, solved prior art and used unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out the problem that the airspeed planning leads to when spraying pesticide to improve airspeed's rationality, improved the scientificity that the pesticide sprayed.

title_en: Horizontal guest room air conditioner with guiding device
abstract_en: The invention provides a horizontal guest room air conditioner with a flow guide device, comprising: the waste heat recovery device comprises longitudinal beams, an evaporation cavity, a compressor cavity, a condensation cavity and a waste discharge cavity, wherein end beams are arranged at two ends of each longitudinal beam, a first separator, a second separator and a third separator are arranged between the longitudinal beams, end plates are arranged on the end beams, and air guide covers are arranged on the end plates; and side wing plates are arranged outside the longitudinal beams. The invention discloses a horizontal guest room air conditioner with a flow guide device, which optimizes and improves the internal structure of the air conditioner and improves the reliability of long-time continuous operation of an air conditioning unit; the chambers are separated by the separating bodies, the chambers are mutually independent in structure and mutually related in function, and the influence of the external environment on the air conditioning unit is reduced under the cross-region operation environment; the air guide sleeve and the side wing plates are arranged, so that the wind resistance of the air conditioning unit is reduced, the impact of high-speed airflow on the air conditioning unit is reduced, and the safety and the stability of operation are improved.

title_en: Cardiovascular internal medicine is clinical with respirator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of respirators, in particular to a cardiovascular internal medicine clinical respirator; comprises a base, a lifting component, a respirator body and a moving component; the moving assembly is arranged below the base, the lifting assembly comprises an installation seat, a rotating worm, two supporting seats, an adjusting member and an auxiliary member, the installation seat is fixedly connected with the base, the rotating worm is rotatably connected with the installation seat, the supporting seats are fixedly connected with the base, the two supporting seats are respectively distributed on two sides of the rotating worm in parallel, the adjusting member is arranged inside the supporting seats, the auxiliary member is arranged on the base, and the respirator body is arranged on the adjusting member; the rotation of worm drives the adjusting member and rotates, and then realizes altitude mixture control to the respirator body, and auxiliary component makes the firm respirator body that supports behind the altitude mixture control, makes the result of use better, and then makes things convenient for medical staff to use, and it is better to use experience the sense.

title_en: Steering control method and steering control device
abstract_en: In a steering control method, a first steering reaction force that corresponds to a steering angle (theta s) of a steering wheel (31a) is applied to the steering wheel (31a)(Tr1) and a steering angular acceleration (d) with the steering wheel (31a)  2  θs/dt  2  ) The added steering reaction force (S6) of the corresponding second steering reaction force (Tr2) determines the possibility of an urgent steering operation of the steering wheel (31a) by the driver (S2), and when it is determined that there is a possibility of an urgent steering operation, the second steering reaction force is further reduced (Tr2) as compared with a case where it is not determined that there is a possibility of an urgent steering operation (S2 to S4).

title_en: Automatic composite universal axis turning device and aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic composite universal axis turning device and an aircraft, which comprise a spherical universal joint, a three-section type universal shaft, a driving device and a control system, wherein the spherical universal joint is formed by hinging two parts capable of realizing relative spatial swing; the three-section type universal shaft is arranged in the spherical universal joint, two ends of the three-section type universal shaft can respectively and movably penetrate through two parts on the spherical universal joint, and two ends of the three-section type universal shaft can rotate relative to the parts; the driving device is arranged on the spherical universal joint and used for adjusting and locking the spatial swing angle of the two components; the control system is arranged on the driving device or the ball joint and is used for controlling the action of the driving device. The automatic composite universal axis turning device has the advantages of small structure, large transmission range and stable transmission; the aircraft can realize the turning adjustment of the driving power, and the adjusting process is stable and reliable.

title_en: Electromagnetic brake pedal simulator and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic brake pedal simulator and a vehicle. The electromagnetic brake pedal simulator comprises a shell, an electromagnet, a permanent magnet, a force conversion mechanism and a pedal; the electromagnet and the permanent magnet are arranged in the shell, the electromagnet is fixed in the shell, the permanent magnet and the electromagnet are arranged oppositely, and the magnetic direction of the electromagnet and the magnetic direction of the permanent magnet are mutually exclusive; the permanent magnet is connected with the output end of the force conversion mechanism, the input end of the force conversion mechanism is connected with the pedal, and the force conversion mechanism is used for converting input force of the pedal into output force; the permanent magnet moves according to the output force; wherein the output force is less than the input force. Under the conditions that the pedal force is unchanged and the simulation effect of the pedal is the same, the current on the electromagnet corresponding to the output force can be smaller than the current on the electromagnet corresponding to the pedal force, so that the requirement of the electromagnetic brake pedal simulator on electric energy can be reduced, the power consumption of the electromagnetic brake pedal simulator is reduced, and the power consumption of a vehicle is further reduced.

title_en: Tire comprising a tread
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tyre comprising a tread (10) having at least one series (12) of rubber blocks (13 i-1, 13i, 13i+1, 13i+2), these rubber blocks (13 i-1, 13i, 13i+1, 13i+2) being delimited in pairs by a series of cuts (14 i-1, 14i, 14i+i, 14i+2, 14i+3), said blocks (13 i-1, 13i, 13i+1, 13i+2) extending in succession along a circumferential direction (X), each block (13 i-1, 13i, 13i+1, 13i+2) of the series (12) of rubber blocks having a circumferential length (Li+1, li, li+1, li+2), each cut (14 i-1, 14i+i, 14i+2, i+3) having a circumferential width (Ei-1, ei+1, ei+2, ei+3). The series (12) of rubber blocks comprises blocks belonging to at least two different block categories ((13 i-1, 13 i); (13i+1, 13i+2)), blocks of the same category having substantially the same circumferential length, blocks of two different block categories having different circumferential lengths.

title_en: Peroxide generating air purification element
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to peroxide generating air purification elements. A system includes an airflow path and an air purification element. The airflow passage is configured to restrict airflow and direct the airflow toward a space. An air cleaning element is positioned in the airflow path and is configured to generate peroxide to oxidize contaminants in the air flowing through the airflow path. The air purification element includes a peroxide generating structure and a matrix including a peroxide activation catalyst configured to activate a generated peroxide. The air purification element is configured to generate peroxide from water vapor and oxygen in the air within the airflow path when energized by the energy source, and the substrate is configured to allow the contaminants to contact the peroxide activated by the peroxide activation catalyst.

title_en: Method for detecting tire pressure of vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting tire pressure of a vehicle (1) having a body (2) which is elastically supported on wheels (3) and having at least one wheel (3) which comprises a tire (7) filled with gas and which is placed on the ground (8) with the tire, wherein the body (2) is loaded with an additional mass and thus the body is excited to mechanical vibrations (16) relative to the ground (8), and a response signal (A) which characterizes the mechanical vibrations (16) is measured and evaluated, whereby at least one response value which characterizes the current gas pressure in the tire is determined.

title_en: Automobile high-voltage controller capable of independently controlling upper power supply and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile high-voltage controller capable of independently controlling the power supply of an upper device and a control method thereof, wherein the high-voltage controller comprises: the insulation detector and the upper motor driving circuit are arranged; the insulation detector is connected between the anode and the cathode of the power battery; the upper motor driving circuit comprises an upper contactor, an upper pre-charging circuit and an upper interface; the input end of the upper contactor is connected with the positive end of the power battery, the output end of the upper contactor is connected with the positive end of the upper interface, and the negative end of the upper interface is connected with the negative end of the power battery; when the insulation detector detects that the vehicle has insulation faults of more than three levels, the vehicle control unit controls the upper device to independently supply power. This application can realize the independent power supply of electric automobile facial make-up part, when electric fault appears in the facial make-up, keeps apart facial make-up circuit and main car circuit, and when electric fault appears in especially trucd mixer, can realize cutting trouble circuit, for the trucd mixer supplies power alone, avoids a jar body to solidify.

title_en: Wind tunnel background noise correction method for rotating blade sound signal extraction
abstract_en: The application discloses a wind tunnel background noise correction method for extracting sound signals of rotating blades, which can accurately acquire pneumatic sound signals of a rotating mechanical power type aircraft model in a wind tunnel when the method is applied. The method solves the problem that when the periodic acoustic signals with wind tunnel background noise are extracted by adopting a signal processing method such as time domain synchronization average and the like, the signal synchronization average result in a plurality of time segments is deteriorated due to the existence of phase difference, so that larger errors are brought to acoustic measurement results.

title_en: Single-arm bottom fork type electric motorcycle power system and electric motorcycle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-arm flat fork type electric motorcycle power system and an electric motorcycle, wherein the power system comprises a front transmission case, a rear transmission case, a transmission shaft and a driving motor, wherein the rear transmission case is provided with a rotary power output member connected with a rear wheel hub; a rigid protective cover is arranged outside the transmission shaft, the rear end of the rigid protective cover is fixedly connected to the box body of the rear transmission case, the front end of the rigid protective cover is fixedly connected or integrally formed with a motor mounting seat, and a driving motor is fixedly connected to the motor mounting seat; the shell of the driving motor is fixedly connected with or integrally formed with a bottom fork joint. The electric motorcycle comprises the power system. The invention has the advantages that the power system has simple structure and long service life; the electric motorcycle has the same beneficial effects as a power system, and is compact in layout.

title_en: Anti-torsion structure of external linear displacement sensor of actuator
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-torsion structure of an external linear displacement sensor of an actuator, which comprises the following components: the positioning lining is fixedly connected with the piston rod and the sensor iron core rod and used for connecting the piston rod and the sensor iron core rod to form a linkage structure, and the piston rod is parallel to the sensor iron core rod; the movable end of the connecting rod assembly is connected to the positioning lining, and the fixed end of the connecting rod assembly is connected to the actuator; the invention can effectively resist the axial torque acted on the piston rod and prevent the piston rod from axially rotating, thereby avoiding the damage or deformation of the sensor iron core rod connected with the piston rod end along with the axial rotation of the piston rod.

title_en: Map bag and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a map bag and a vehicle, wherein the map bag comprises: the map bag body is flexible; the map bag body is connected with the vehicle door plate through the connecting structure; the map bag body is provided with a first side used for limiting the storage cavity with the vehicle door plate; or, a containing cavity is formed in the map bag body. The technical scheme of the invention aims to reduce noise generated when the map bag collides with an article.

title_en: Track transporter integrating hoisting, weighing and remote control start and stop
abstract_en: The invention discloses a track transporter integrating hoisting, weighing and remote control starting and stopping, and relates to the technical field of track transporters. This collect hoist and mount and weigh, remote control open and stop integrative track transportation machine, including the track transportation mechanism that is used for transporting the goods, be used for rotatory clearance mechanism that carries out the clearance and be used for blowing off the rotatory mechanism that blows off of air current to track clearance, the inside of track transportation mechanism is provided with the transport plate, the rotatory clearance mechanism of transport plate right side fixedly connected with that track transportation mechanism passes through the setting. This collect hoist and mount and weigh, remote control open and stop integrative rail transport machine, through the setting of scraper blade arc, when the card goes into stone or mango, can bounce away respectively and scrape down to guaranteed the security of traveling of cargo airplane, when the gravity piece extrusion in the sponge piece, press the storehouse and bulge and make the fixed plate carry out the chucking to the scraper blade, make the dynamics that the scraper blade was stirred bigger moreover, with the mango of getting rid of the adhesion of the track laminating more.

title_en: Mobile trolley
abstract_en: A mobile trolley comprises a body, a first butt joint component and a second butt joint component; the first butt joint component and/or the second butt joint component are respectively positioned at two sides of the body and can transversely move relative to the body so as to be in butt joint with the installation guide rail of the catheter bed body. The movable trolley is provided with the first butt joint component and the second butt joint component which can transversely move relative to the body, so that one movable trolley can be in butt joint with catheter bed bodies with different widths, the secondary vessel intervention operation equipment can be stably carried, the secondary vessel intervention operation equipment is protected, and the secondary vessel intervention operation equipment is prevented from being vibrated and damaged; meanwhile, the medical staff can conveniently carry the high-quality blood vessel intervention operation equipment from the end.

title_en: Muck truck monitoring and management system
abstract_en: The application relates to a muck truck monitoring and management system. The system comprises: the vehicle-mounted video terminal carries out blind area alarm based on a preset alarm mode when shelters exist in the blind area of the muck car, so that traffic accidents are avoided. The driving auxiliary module monitors the state of the driver in real time, and when the driver has an illegal behavior, the vehicle-mounted video terminal gives an alarm for the illegal behavior based on a preset alarm mode, so that the driver is reminded to standardize the driving behavior of the driver, and further traffic accidents are avoided. The driving auxiliary module monitors bad driving behaviors of a driver in real time, and when the driver has the bad driving behaviors, the vehicle-mounted video terminal gives an alarm for the illegal behaviors based on a preset alarm mode, so that the driver is reminded to standardize the driving behaviors, and traffic accidents are avoided.

title_en: Rigid contact net modeling method based on absolute node coordinates and additional constraint method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rigid contact net modeling method based on absolute node coordinates and an additional constraint method, which comprises the steps of dispersing a rigid contact net structure into units and nodes, adopting an ANCF unit to simulate a busbar and a contact line, adopting a spring unit to simulate a suspension structure, calculating and assembling a system rigidity matrix, a tangent matrix and a node force imbalance vector according to a unit connection relation, constructing a system increment balance equation by taking the node coordinates and the original length of the spring unit as unknowns, applying additional constraint to the system increment balance equation according to the design requirement of positioning point coordinates, and accurately solving the initial form of the rigid contact net by adopting a Newton iteration method. The method can accurately calculate the initial form of the rigid contact net, and is suitable for the problem of accurate modeling of the rigid contact net in a three-dimensional space; the method solves the problem of inaccurate initial form of the overhead line system in the traditional rigid overhead line system modeling, so that the rigid overhead line system model is more accurate, and the subsequent dynamic simulation result deviation caused by inaccurate initial form is avoided.

title_en: One-stop type rail car cleaning operation assembly line device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rail car cleaning, and particularly relates to a one-stop rail car cleaning operation assembly line which comprises a separation workshop and a cleaning workshop; a carriage body cleaning area, a sewage treatment area, a bogie cleaning area and a part cleaning area are respectively arranged in the cleaning room; the carriage cleaning area is used for cleaning the carriage, and a first track is arranged at the carriage cleaning area, and one end of the first track is vertically intersected with the vehicle moving track; the bogie cleaning room is provided with a second track, and the sewage treatment area is used for collecting and uniformly treating sewage in the carriage cleaning area, the bogie cleaning room and the part cleaning area. The scheme can separate the structure of railcar, improves the clean degree that the track was removed, in addition, utilizes the cooperation of moving platform and false platform truck in this scheme, can make the railcar of different specifications all can use the cleaning room in this scheme to wash to improve railcar cleaning operation's commonality and compatibility.

title_en: Unloading device for logistics transportation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of logistics transportation, and particularly discloses an unloading device for logistics transportation, which comprises a box body; the box body is fixedly arranged on the base, a retracting wheel is rotatably arranged in an inner cavity at the bottom of the box body, an object placing plate is arranged in the box body in a vertically supporting and sliding manner, one ends of two steel wire ropes are respectively connected with two ends of the object placing plate in a supporting manner, and the other ends of the two steel wire ropes are wound on the retracting wheel in the same direction; four corners of the lower surface of the base are provided with movable trundles. In the unloading device for logistics transportation provided by the embodiment of the invention, the unloading device can be moved to a designated position through the arranged movable trundles, the forward and reverse servo motors drive the retractable wheels to rotate, so that the retractable wheels are wound on the steel wire ropes connected to the retractable wheels, the object placing plate can be continuously lifted upwards, the trouble of continuously bending down during unloading can be avoided, and the labor intensity of workers is reduced.

title_en: Box is transported to equipment for disinfection supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transferring box body of equipment for disinfection supply, which comprises a base, wherein two object carriers are symmetrically placed on the upper side of the base, the two object carriers respectively comprise a fixed supporting plate, the fixed supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the upper side surface of the base, two sides of the fixed supporting plate are respectively hinged with a pair of mutually parallel connecting rods, a plurality of movable supporting plates are hinged on the connecting rods, the upper ends of the connecting rods are hinged with movable top plates, and baskets for loading medical equipment are placed on the fixed supporting plate and the movable supporting plates. The manpower consumption is greatly reduced.

title_en: Method and device for preventing vehicle door from being collided and vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method and a device for preventing collision of a vehicle door and a vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: determining an expected risk of collision with an object external to the vehicle when a first door of the vehicle is open; determining a risk range of the first in-vehicle person from the expected risk based on the sight line detection, wherein the first in-vehicle person is located on the first door side, and the risk range is a spatial range affected by the expected risk; and forbidding the opening of the first vehicle door under the condition that the sight line of the first vehicle occupant deviates from the risk range.

title_en: Soft rescue escape device and rescue method for turnbuckle ship
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water emergency equipment, in particular to a soft rescue escape device and a rescue method for a turnbuckle ship. Comprises an air compressor, an inflatable rescue cabin and a plurality of floating stable structures arranged on the side of the ship. The inflatable rescue cabin comprises a rescue cabin body, an escape passage and a magnetic fixing base, wherein the escape hole and the inflatable hole are formed in the side wall of the rescue cabin body, the escape passage is in sealing connection with the escape hole, the magnetic fixing base is detachably fixed at the bottom of a ship, the air outlet of the air compressor is in sealing connection with the inflatable hole, and the bottom of the rescue cabin body is in sealing connection with the magnetic fixing base. An inlet is formed in one end, close to the escape hole, of the escape passage, an outlet is formed in the other end of the escape passage, and airtight zippers are arranged on the inlet and the outlet. The main body of the invention is made of soft material, is folded and stored when not inflated, has small volume and light weight, is convenient to transport, can be rapidly transported to an accident site in emergency, and can be used for emergency rescue, thereby greatly reducing the delay time on transportation.

title_en: Vibration-static force-excitation three-comprehensive test device
abstract_en: A vibration-static force-excitation three-comprehensive test device comprises a vibration test system, a static force test system, an excitation test system and a test piece; the vibration test system and the excitation test system respectively apply vibration and excitation load to the test piece, and the static test system applies tension to the test piece and carries out real-time measurement; the three systems work simultaneously and do not interfere with each other, and the environmental adaptability of the test piece is comprehensively evaluated. By adopting the scheme of the invention, the load application sequence of the three systems is not limited, the load loading of different parts of the test piece can be realized, and the test reliability is improved.

title_en: Coaxial double-motor electric drive axle and gear control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coaxial double-motor electric drive axle and a gear control method, wherein the coaxial double-motor electric drive axle comprises an axle housing, a differential mechanism arranged in the axle housing, a left hub, a small motor, a group I planetary mechanism and a group II planetary mechanism which are coaxially arranged on the left side of the differential mechanism in sequence from left to right, and a right hub, a large motor, a group IV planetary mechanism and a group III planetary mechanism which are coaxially arranged on the right side of the differential mechanism in sequence from right to left, wherein the small motor, the group I planetary mechanism and the group II planetary mechanism are all provided with left hollow shaft holes which are coaxially arranged, the large motor, the group IV planetary mechanism and the group III planetary mechanism are all provided with right hollow shaft holes which are coaxially arranged, a left half shaft of the differential mechanism is coaxially connected with the left hub in sequence, and a right half shaft of the differential mechanism sequentially coaxially penetrates the right hollow shaft holes and is coaxially connected with the right hub. The gear control method can realize the switching of eight gear modes of the double motors, smooth the output power of the motors and greatly increase the economy of the mining card.

title_en: Battery replacing equipment unlocking device, battery replacing equipment and battery box quick battery replacing system
abstract_en: The invention provides a battery replacing equipment unlocking device, battery replacing equipment and a battery box quick battery replacing system. The transmission mechanism comprises a transmission rod, the transmission rod comprises a driving element, a force transmission element and a driven element, the driving element is connected with the driving element, the driven element drives the unlocking rod to stretch, the force transmission element is movably connected with the driving element, and the force transmission element is fixedly connected with the driven element. The battery replacing equipment unlocking device, the battery replacing equipment and the battery box quick battery replacing system provided by the invention have high unlocking precision and high battery replacing efficiency; the transmission rod adopts a three-part structure, and the strength of the transmission rod can be improved through a force transmission element at the middle section, so that the stress of the transmission rod is dispersed in the three parts in the torque transmission process of the transmission rod, the transmission rod is protected, and the service life of the transmission rod in the long-term repeated operation process is prolonged.

title_en: Vehicle, braking control method and device thereof, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle and a brake control method, a brake control device and a storage medium thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring image information of a driver who wants to drive a vehicle; determining a current braking mode according to the image information; and controlling the vehicle to brake according to the brake expectation of the driver and the current brake mode. The embodiment of the invention can adopt different braking modes aiming at different drivers, meet the individual requirements of different drivers and achieve the effect of thousands of people.

title_en: Motor vehicle, in particular passenger car
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motor vehicle (1) having a chassis (8) on which vehicle wheels (4, 5) of an axle (3) of the motor vehicle (1) which are located rearwardmost in a vehicle longitudinal direction (2) are rotatably held, the chassis (8) having longitudinal beams (13, 24) which are arranged at a rear portion (12) of the motor vehicle (1) and are spaced apart from one another in a vehicle transverse direction (11), wherein the longitudinal beams (13, 14) each have at least one length region (L1, L2) which extends in the vehicle longitudinal direction (2) behind a respective center point (M1, M2) of the vehicle wheel (4, 5) obliquely to the vehicle longitudinal direction (2) and rearwardly and inwardly.

title_en: Pull rod type aircraft folding wing tip and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pull rod type aircraft folding wing tip and an operation method thereof, wherein the wing tip comprises a fixed end, a folding end, a connecting part and a power conversion part; the fixed end and the folding end comprise an upper airfoil surface and a lower airfoil surface; the connecting component is connected with the fixed end and the folding end; the folding end is driven by the power conversion component to rotate, and the folding end can rotate in the range of 0-90 degrees around the connecting component, so that wing tips are folded, and the aircraft meets the requirements of airport runways, taxiways and parking places on the width of the aircraft.

title_en: Overwater hydraulic transmission system, control method and amphibious vehicle comprising system
abstract_en: The overwater hydraulic transmission system, the control method and the amphibious vehicle comprising the system comprise a variable pump, a main control hydraulic valve, a quantitative motor, an electromagnetic directional valve, a controller and an electric control handle; the variable pump is connected with the free end of the engine, converts mechanical energy into hydraulic energy, and converts the hydraulic energy into mechanical energy through the main control hydraulic valve and the quantitative motor, and transmits the mechanical energy to the two waterborne propelling devices symmetrically arranged at the tail part of the vehicle body and enables the waterborne propelling devices to run; the controller controls the reversing of the main control hydraulic valve in an electro-hydraulic proportional control mode, and the flow entering the quantitative motor is controlled by changing the opening amount of the valve core; the controller controls the generated feedback signal to be transmitted to the variable pump so as to dynamically adjust the displacement of the variable pump according to the feedback signal. The invention adopts the electro-hydraulic proportional control technology to ensure simple, convenient and accurate control of operation; the controller carries out logic control on the action of each executing mechanism, and the coordination and the safety are ensured; and the system is communicated with a vehicle information system through a bus technology to realize human-computer interaction.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted optical measurement system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted optical measurement system, which comprises: the device comprises a vehicle body, optical measurement equipment, an isolation platform and a control processing system. The vehicle body is provided with a skylight, the internal optical measurement equipment of the optical measurement equipment is arranged on an isolation platform, the isolation platform is arranged on a chassis of the vehicle body through a fastener, four corners of the isolation platform are respectively provided with a linkage supporting mechanism, and the linkage supporting mechanisms penetrate through the chassis and are suspended below the vehicle body; the control processing system is connected with the linkage supporting mechanism through a data line; when the vehicle body stops, the control processing system controls the linkage supporting mechanism to extend, the bottom end of the linkage supporting mechanism is in contact with the ground, the support isolation platform is separated from the chassis, and the optical measurement device starts to shoot when extending out of the vehicle body through the skylight. The problem of vertical axis inclination dynamic disturbance is solved, and the vehicle-mounted optical measurement system can realize measurement with higher precision under the condition of not falling to the ground.

title_en: Brake master cylinder for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brake master cylinder for a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic brakes. Including connecting the vertical pole, two top fixedly connected with axis of rotation between the vertical pole, axis of rotation outer wall fixedly connected with spacing ring, axis of rotation outer wall rotate and are connected with rotating-structure, and bolt fixedly connected with rotor plate is passed through to rotating-structure bottom, and rotor plate bottom fixedly connected with footboard structure, rotation helping hand structure and pushing structure are installed respectively in the rotor plate left side, pushing structure left side fixedly connected with brake pump, and the brake pump left side is provided with the catheter. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the pedal structure and the rotary power-assisted structure, when braking is carried out, a driver steps on the pressure pedal in the pedal structure, the pressure sensor detects pressure change, and then the electric push rod in the rotary power-assisted structure is started to shorten, so that the rotary plate is subjected to downward rotary force, the driver can more save labor when stepping on the brake pedal, and the effects of short braking distance and labor saving are realized.

title_en: Vehicle control method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: According to the vehicle control method, the vehicle control device, the vehicle and the storage medium, the first coordinate information corresponding to the center point of the tail end of the trailer is obtained, and the second coordinate information corresponding to the target point on the expected reversing track of the vehicle is obtained; determining an expected hinge angle of the vehicle according to the first coordinate information and the second coordinate information; the current front wheel steering angle of the vehicle is determined according to the actual hinge angle and the expected hinge angle of the vehicle, so that the vehicle runs according to the front wheel steering angle. According to the method and the device for controlling the front wheel steering angle of the vehicle, the expected hinging angle of the vehicle is calculated in real time through the target point on the expected reversing track and the current coordinate of the vehicle, so that the front wheel steering angle of the vehicle is regulated in real time according to the expected hinging angle, the stability of the vehicle in the reversing process can be effectively improved, the trailer is prevented from deviating from the expected reversing track, and the safe and accurate expected reversing position of the vehicle is further ensured.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle wing folding mechanism and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wing folding mechanism of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises: a mandrel; the first rotating part and the second rotating part are respectively used for connecting two folding parts of a foldable wing of the unmanned aerial vehicle, one end of the first rotating part and one end of the second rotating part are respectively provided with a first rotating ring and a second rotating ring, and the first rotating ring and the second rotating ring are sleeved on the mandrel in a rotating mode; the first elastic component is connected with the first rotating part and the second rotating part and can drive the first rotating part and the second rotating part to rotate around the axial direction of the core in opposite directions; the self-locking structure is arranged between the first rotating part and the second rotating part and can lock the relative positions of the first rotating part and the second rotating part when the first rotating part and the second rotating part rotate to a set position; the foldable wing can be folded for use, and the self-locking structure can realize the locking of the unfolded state after the foldable wing is unfolded.

title_en: Intelligent automobile screen display control method, device and system and intelligent automobile
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent automobile screen display control method, device and system and an intelligent automobile. The intelligent automobile screen display control method comprises the following steps: acquiring detection information; and controlling display content to be displayed at a set position of a front windshield of the vehicle according to the detection information, wherein the front windshield of the vehicle is displayable glass with set transparency. The scheme provided by the application can improve the screen display effect and control convenience of the vehicle and improve the driving safety.

title_en: On-orbit calibration method and system for force arm of magnetic suspension actuator
abstract_en: The invention provides an on-orbit calibrating method and system for a moment arm of a magnetic suspension actuator. The invention solves the problem that the moment arm measurement of the magnetic suspension actuator is inaccurate due to the influence of ground installation precision errors, stress release, space environment thermal deformation and the like, thereby influencing the attitude control of the load cabin. The method adopted by the patent is simple and scientific, and is suitable for measuring and calibrating the action force arm of most of the on-orbit actuating mechanisms; the invention has reasonable structure and convenient use, and can overcome the defects of the prior art.

title_en: Vehicle running gear, vehicle and vehicle running system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle running gear, a vehicle and a vehicle running system, wherein the vehicle running gear is used for running on a track (30), the vehicle running gear comprises a vehicle frame (10) and a wheel (20), the wheel (20) is rotatably arranged on the vehicle frame (10), the rotating axis of the wheel (20) is inclined relative to a running plane provided by the track (30), so that the wheel (20) is simultaneously contacted with two guide surfaces with included angles of the track (30) to realize the guide effect on the vehicle running gear. The vehicle includes a vehicle running gear. The vehicle running system includes a vehicle and a track (30). The wheels are the travelling wheels and the guide wheels, so that the guide wheels specially used for guiding are omitted, the problem that the wrench is shielded by the rail can be effectively solved during maintenance, and the convenience of operation is improved.

title_en: Shock-absorbing device and boats and ships are shocked resistance to boats and ships side
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship side impact-resistant damping device and a ship, wherein the damping device comprises a shell, a first buffering component and a second buffering component, a plurality of air bags are arranged on the outer wall of the shell, the first buffering component comprises a sleeve, a first spring and a buffering rod, the first spring is positioned in an inner hole of the sleeve, the sleeve is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the shell, one end of the buffering rod is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the ship, and the other end of the buffering rod is positioned in the inner hole of the sleeve and is abutted against the first spring; the second buffering subassembly includes dead lever, two sliding seat, second spring, two connecting rods and two fixing bases, and the dead lever is fixed at the outer wall of boats and ships, and two sliding seat sliding connection are in the dead lever, and the second spring suit is in the dead lever to a sliding seat is connected respectively at the both ends of second spring, and the one end of every connecting rod articulates in the sliding seat, and the other end articulates in the fixing base, and fixing base fixed connection is in the inner wall of casing. Damping device has triple buffering at least, improves the security.

title_en: Dynamic superconducting magnet and magnetic levitation train
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of superconducting magnets, and discloses a dynamic superconducting magnet and a maglev train. The dynamic superconducting magnet comprises an outer Dewar, an inner Dewar, a force transmission framework back plate, a superconducting coil, a coil framework and a magnetic source body, wherein the inner Dewar is arranged inside the outer Dewar, a vacuum layer is arranged between the inner Dewar and the outer Dewar, the force transmission framework back plate is arranged on the inner wall of the inner Dewar close to the track side, the superconducting coil is wound on the coil framework and arranged on the force transmission framework back plate, the magnetic source body is arranged on the inner wall of the outer Dewar far from the track side and is not connected with the inner Dewar, and the magnetic pole of the magnetic source body is the same as the excitation magnetic pole of the superconducting coil. Therefore, the dynamic superconducting magnet coil can be fixed in a non-contact strengthening mode without adding a connecting and restraining component, the rigidity of the coil is improved, and meanwhile heat leakage of a system can be avoided.

title_en: Underwater target capturing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater target capturing system, which comprises a ship body and a capturing device connected through a rope, wherein the rope is connected with a receiving and releasing control system, the receiving and releasing control system is used for controlling the telescopic length of the rope to realize receiving and releasing of the capturing device, an image acquisition device is arranged on the capturing device, the image acquisition device is connected with a controller and a display on the ship body, the controller performs calculation according to images acquired by the image acquisition device, so that the action of the capturing device is controlled, and the display displays the images acquired by the image acquisition device in real time. The invention can accurately judge the target object, quickly approach the target object and can capture the target object without damage.

title_en: Mountain area road section electric vehicle protection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mountain area road section electric vehicle protection system and method, comprising the following steps: judging whether the electric vehicle is in a mountain section downhill mode according to the current vehicle speed and the opening degree of a brake pedal; in the downhill mode, when the temperature of the single power battery exceeds a set threshold range, heating or refrigerating is started; when the air brake is in the set threshold range, controlling the air brake to be started according to the speed of the whole vehicle and the opening degree of a brake pedal; in the air brake starting state, when the actual torque of the motor is less than the set motor reference braking torque, sending out warning information and simultaneously executing heating or refrigerating according to the temperature information of the single power battery; and when the actual torque of the motor is more than or equal to the set motor reference braking torque, sending out prompt information. Judging whether the electric braking performance can be fully exerted according to the actual torque of the motor and the set reference braking torque, if the electric braking performance cannot be fully exerted, giving out early warning information in time, starting a heating and refrigerating program, and keeping the braking force reliable.

title_en: Floating photovoltaic system and offshore wind power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a floating photovoltaic system and an offshore wind power system. The floating photovoltaic system comprises a floating platform, the floating platform comprises a photovoltaic installation platform, a plurality of semi-submersible pontoons and a lifting support piece for connecting the semi-submersible pontoons with the photovoltaic installation platform, and the height of the lifting support piece can be adjusted; a plurality of photovoltaic panels disposed on the photovoltaic mounting platform; the anchoring device comprises an anchoring foundation and a mooring cable, wherein the anchoring foundation is fixedly arranged on the seabed, and the mooring cable is used for connecting the semi-submersible buoy and the anchoring foundation. The floating photovoltaic system provided by the invention can adjust the height of the floating platform according to the water area characteristics, so that the height between the photovoltaic panel and the sea surface is adjusted, the floating photovoltaic system can be used in offshore sea areas with small storms and deep and distant sea areas with large storms, and the application range of the floating photovoltaic system is widened.

title_en: Battery control strategy
abstract_en: The application discloses battery control strategy is applied to the battery that is provided with heating element, battery control strategy includes: step S10, monitoring the real-time temperature of the battery, and comparing the real-time temperature with the first temperature; and step S20, judging whether the heating element needs to be started to heat the battery or not according to the comparison result. The battery control strategy meets the low-temperature charging requirement of the lithium battery, and avoids cycle life attenuation and potential safety risk caused by low-temperature charging.

title_en: Vehicle counterweight control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile control, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for controlling a vehicle counterweight, which are used for determining the deviation between the actual gravity center position and the actual axle load parameter and the standard parameter of a vehicle in the running process by acquiring the gravity center position and the axle load parameter of the vehicle in the running process, therefore, the weights at the front end and the rear end of the vehicle are adjusted according to the deviation, and the loads at the front end and the rear end of the vehicle are controlled, so that the technical problem that potential safety hazards exist due to the fact that in the running process of the vehicle in the prior art, the gravity center position and the axle load at the front end and the rear end of the vehicle are affected by different loads at the front end and the rear end is avoided.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle that possesses dustproof function trades power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle battery replacement station with a dustproof function, which comprises a box body, a machine connecting mechanism, a replacement mechanism, a dustproof mechanism, a sealing cover mechanism and a charging mechanism, wherein the space in a groove of the box body is a battery replacement cavity, strip-shaped notches arranged at the upper left end and the upper right end of the box body are sliding grooves, and a control system is arranged on the side wall of the battery replacement cavity; the cover sealing mechanism is arranged at the top port of the box body; the machine connecting mechanism is arranged on the left side wall and the right side wall in the middle of the electricity changing cavity; the replacing mechanism is arranged at the central line part of the bottom side wall of the electricity replacing cavity; the charging mechanism is arranged on the replacing mechanism. The invention has the dustproof function and is convenient for the unmanned aerial vehicle to fall and position.

title_en: Vehicle seat, headrest, and head support member
abstract_en: A vehicle seat, a headrest, and a head support member are provided. The vehicle seat includes a seat cushion, a seat back, a headrest, and a head support. The seat cushion supports the buttocks of the seated occupant from a seat lower side. The seat back supports a back of the seated occupant from a seat rear side. The headrest supports the head of the seated occupant from a seat rear side. The head support portion is provided on the headrest, and supports a portion of the head of the seated occupant corresponding to the occipital bone from the seat left-right direction and supports the portion from the seat rear side in the forward direction and in the seat obliquely upward direction.

title_en: Vehicle seat with backrest
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle seat with a backrest, comprising a backrest part and a backrest base element, the backrest part comprising a middle backrest element which is pivotably arranged on the backrest base element, wherein the backrest part comprises two lower backrest side elements and two upper backrest side elements which are each mechanically coupled to the middle backrest element, wherein the two lower backrest side elements are pivotably arranged on the backrest base element, wherein in each case at least one joint device is arranged between the lower backrest side element and the upper backrest side element, wherein the lower backrest side element and the upper backrest side element are each at an angle alpha to one another  L  、α  R  An arrangement wherein pivoting of the intermediate backrest element results in an angle alpha  L  、α  R  Is a variation of (c).

title_en: Large-scale multi-communication-domain hybrid floating body configuration and assembling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large-scale multi-communication-domain hybrid floating body configuration and an assembling method; the floating body main body is a hybrid splicing structure combining a semi-submersible type floating body and a barge type floating body, and comprises semi-submersible type floating bodies positioned at two ends and barge type floating bodies connected between the semi-submersible type floating bodies at the two ends.
