According to the invention, the semi-submersible type lower floating bodies are arranged at the two longitudinal ends, and the barge type floating bodies at the connecting section adopt a T-shaped section structure, so that the overall load and the horizontal torque load of the platform can be obviously reduced, the steel consumption is reduced, the lightweight design is realized, and the economy is higher.

title_en: Variable-pitch operation carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a variable-pitch operation carrier which comprises a carrier body and wheels, wherein the bottom of the carrier body is provided with a plurality of sets of quadrilateral double-variable hangers; the quadrilateral pitch-variable mechanism can drive wheels at the rear side of the vehicle body to perform swing motion with the amplitude of 180 degrees relative to the vehicle body, and the positions of the wheels at the rear side of the vehicle body are always parallel to the vehicle body; when the quadrilateral pitch-varying mechanism drives wheels at the rear side of the vehicle body to swing towards the front end of the vehicle body, the wheel base at the rear side of the vehicle body is reduced, and the wheel base at the front and rear sides of the vehicle body is reduced; when the quadrilateral pitch-variable mechanism drives wheels at the rear side of the vehicle body to swing 90 degrees towards the two side ends of the vehicle body, the wheel base at the rear side of the vehicle body is increased, and the wheel base at the front and the rear of the vehicle body is increased; when the quadrilateral pitch-varying mechanism drives wheels at the rear side of the vehicle body to swing towards the rear end of the vehicle body, the wheel base at the rear side of the vehicle body is reduced, and the wheel base at the front and rear of the vehicle body is increased. The variable-pitch operation carrier can change the wheelbase and the wheel base through the quadrilateral double-variable hanging rack, so that the operation vehicle can meet various operation environments.

title_en: Landing buffer device integrating launching and cabin door opening functions
abstract_en: The invention designs a landing buffer device integrating launching and cabin door opening functions, which comprises four multifunctional landing buffer system single-leg structures, wherein each multifunctional landing buffer system single-leg structure is hinged to a cabin deformation mechanism bottom ring of a cabin through a two-way damper fixing pin II and a damping support leg fixing pin respectively; the invention realizes the integration of the functions of opening the air launching cabin door, fixing the air aircraft, releasing and fixing the ground and landing buffering.

title_en: Motorcycle landing device with vertically-arranged auxiliary wheels
abstract_en: The invention provides a motorcycle landing gear with vertically-arranged auxiliary wheels, which is characterized by comprising: the rotary driving unit is fixedly formed by pedals which are tightly close to two sides of the motorcycle and consists of a direct current motor which rotates positively and negatively, a speed reducing module and a motor frame which contains the speed reducing module; first main folding links which are respectively combined with both sides of the motor frame in a rotatable manner, and rotated at a predetermined angle by the dc motor; second main folding links rotatably coupled to inner sides of lower ends of the first main folding links, respectively; auxiliary folding connecting rods which are rotatably and respectively connected with the lower ends of the motor frames oppositely; an auxiliary wheel vertically-arranged link having one side rotatably connected to an inner side of a lower end of the second main folding link and the other side rotatably connected to an inner side of the auxiliary folding link, the inner side being connected with an auxiliary wheel; and a fixing frame for fixing the rotation driving unit adjacent to the pedal, and allowing the first main folding link, the second main folding link, the auxiliary folding link, and the auxiliary wheel vertically-arranged link to be cooperatively folded or unfolded by forward and reverse rotation of the dc motor, and the auxiliary wheels are vertically aligned with respect to the ground when the auxiliary wheels contact and leave the ground.

title_en: Vehicle electronic control device, vehicle electronic control method, and non-transitory storage medium
abstract_en: The vehicle electronic control device includes a detection device configured to detect a state of an occupant, a first control device, and a second control device. The second control device is configured to refer to a database that defines a relationship between the state of the occupant and the first time, and autonomously drive the vehicle at a speed equal to or lower than a maximum allowable speed from a switching time that is a time at which the first control device becomes unable to control the vehicle. The database is set up in such a way that: when the first time corresponding to the second state of the occupant is longer than the first time corresponding to the first state of the occupant, the maximum allowable speed corresponding to the second state is lower than the maximum allowable speed corresponding to the first state.

title_en: Corner structure of liquefied gas storage tank
abstract_en: A corner structure (100) of a liquefied gas storage tank is disclosed, wherein the corner structure (100) is mounted on a corner of a storage tank for containing liquefied gas so as to support a sealing wall (51, 52) that prevents leakage of the liquefied gas. The corner structure (100) comprises: a fixing member (110) fixed on an inner surface of a structural wall of the hull; a movable member (130) mounted on the fixed member (110) and combined with the sealing walls (51, 52); and a thermal insulation member (150) arranged between the sealing wall (51, 52) and the structural wall of the hull. The fixed member (110) includes a fixed member body (112), the fixed member body (112) has a shape bent from a bent portion to an opposite side of the movable member (130), and the movable member (130) includes a movable member body (132), the movable member body (132) has a shape bent from a bent portion to an opposite side of the fixed member (110).

title_en: Seat headrest, vehicle and fatigue level detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seat headrest, a vehicle and a fatigue level detection method, wherein in the seat headrest, one side of a headrest framework, which is far away from a seat back, is fixedly connected with one end, which is far away from the seat back, of a slide bar to form a first connecting part, and the other end of the slide bar is connected with the seat back; one side of the outer headrest panel is fixedly connected to the first connecting part in a lap joint manner, and the other side of the outer headrest panel naturally sags; at least one biosensor is arranged on one side surface of the headrest outer panel away from the headrest framework, contacts the head of the driver, is used for collecting biological signals of the driver, and outputs first electric signals corresponding to the biological signals; the processing chip is configured on the headrest framework and is used for receiving and processing the first electric signal and generating a second electric signal corresponding to the fatigue level based on the preset fatigue level model and the first electric signal; the feedback component is electrically connected with the processing chip and is used for making corresponding feedback actions according to the second electric signal so as to accurately monitor the fatigue level of the driver.

title_en: Differential hydraulic buffer
abstract_en: Hydraulic systems and methods for reducing the propagation of flow and/or pressure pulsations within a hydraulic system are described. In one embodiment, a hydraulic system may include a hydraulic device and a differential damper fluidly connected to the hydraulic device. The differential damper may include pistons exposed to pressure pulsations that propagate along separate flow paths and are at least partially out of phase with each other. The corresponding displacement of the pistons due to out-of-phase pulsations may at least partially mitigate propagation of pulsations within the hydraulic system downstream of the differential damper.

title_en: Vacuum boosting brake system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vacuum boosting brake system, which comprises: the left side of the vehicle control unit is connected with a power control module for circuit control of the vehicle control unit, the upper side and the lower side of the vehicle control unit are both connected with a fault detection module and a data acquisition module, and the fault detection module comprises a vacuum pipeline detection module, a vacuum pump power supply detection module, a vacuum power-assisted system detection module and a pipeline air tightness detection module. The vehicle control unit is provided with a power supply control module, the power supply control module comprises a switch module, the switch module is connected with a first power supply, the first power supply is used for supplying power to the power supply control module, the switch module provides an enabling signal for the power supply control module and is used for awakening the power supply control module, and the vehicle control unit also comprises a fault detection module, a data acquisition module, a control signal output module and a vacuum pump signal acquisition module.

title_en: PVDF resonance driven double gait soft crawling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PVDF resonance driven double-gait soft crawling device. The high-speed bidirectional movement of the soft crawling device can be realized, and the crawling device is inconsistent in contact state with the ground due to inconsistent dead time of the soft crawling device in different frequency bands, so that the bidirectional movement function of the device in different frequency bands is realized; the soft crawling device driven by PVDF layer resonance mainly has a five-layer structure, and comprises a flexible electrode layer, a PVDF layer, a flexible electrode layer, a silica gel adhesive layer and a PET layer from top to bottom in sequence; in addition, the soft crawling device is filled with PDMS material at the folds in order to keep the angle between the body and the feet. The invention realizes the function of high-speed bidirectional movement of the soft crawling device.

title_en: Movement control of tables in aircraft passenger suites
abstract_en: An aircraft passenger suite (200) and method are provided. The aircraft passenger suite includes a console (150) and a table (130) movably mounted to the console, the table being movable along a table path between a first position and a second position; a controller (210) that controls the electromechanical movement of the table along the table path, the controller including an activation input for receiving an indication to activate the electromechanical movement of the table. The suite includes a sensing device for sensing whether any obstacles are present on the table path and providing an indication to the controller of whether any obstacles are present on the table path. The controller is configured to prevent electromechanical movement of the table along the table path if the controller receives an indication that an obstacle is present on the table path.

title_en: Series-parallel connection device for controlling rotor wing of plant protection unmanned helicopter
abstract_en: The invention provides a series-parallel connection device for the rotor wing operation of a plant protection unmanned helicopter, which comprises a base, a non-rotating ring, a rotor hub, a rotor shaft, a spindle motor, three driving branched chains for connecting the base and the non-rotating ring, two constraint branched chains, two torque arm branched chains with the same structure for connecting the rotating ring and the rotor shaft, and two variable-pitch pull rod branched chains with the same structure for connecting the rotating ring and the rotor hub, wherein the three driving branched chains are connected with the base and the non-rotating ring; the movable pair in the driving branched chain is an active driving pair, the driving branched chain is parallel to the rotating pair axis in the constraint branched chain, the rotating pair axis in the variable-pitch pull rod branched chain is collinear and points to the center of the propeller hub, and the rotating pair axis in the torque arm branched chain is parallel to the rotating pair axis in the variable-pitch pull rod branched chain; the initial end of the rotor shaft is connected with the main shaft motor, the middle of the rotor shaft passes through the non-rotating ring and the rotating ring, and the tail end of the rotor shaft is connected with the hub; the rotating ring and the non-rotating ring are connected by a rolling bearing. The invention has symmetrical structure, longitudinal and transverse operation decoupling and flexible operation.

title_en: Arrangement scheme of stern ventilating mast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stern ventilating mast arrangement scheme, which comprises a ventilating mast for a dangerous fuel ventilating outlet; the ship cargo loading device further comprises a boss, wherein the boss is fixedly arranged at the tail part of the ship, the boss is positioned outside a deck cargo loading area, and the ventilating mast is fixedly arranged on the boss; the boss comprises a top plate for fixing the ventilating mast and a side plate for supporting the top plate. The ventilating mast is avoided from a deck cargo piling area, the left-right translation loading and unloading of the crane cannot be hindered when the container is hoisted, inconvenience is not brought to the shore crane work, the loading and unloading efficiency cannot be reduced, the time of a wharf cannot be prolonged, and the risk that the ventilating mast is damaged by collision when the shore crane is loaded and unloaded is reduced.

title_en: Method for operating an electric vehicle and electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for operating an electric vehicle and to an electric vehicle, comprising: an electric travel drive for the travel movement of the vehicle; a control device for controlling a running motion of the vehicle; a first energy storage device, in particular designed as a rechargeable battery device, for supplying a first direct voltage to the control device; a second energy storage device, which is designed in particular as a double-layer capacitor device and/or which is charged and discharged in particular more rapidly than the first energy storage device, for supplying a second dc voltage to the travel drive; and an energy supply unit, in particular intermittently, which supplies a dc output voltage, wherein the first energy storage device is connected, in particular electrically connected, to the second energy storage device via a conversion device, wherein the first energy storage device is connected, in particular electrically connected, to the energy supply unit, in particular such that the dc output voltage is substantially equal to the first dc voltage, wherein the conversion device converts the first dc voltage into the second dc voltage, wherein a power flow from the second energy storage device to the first energy storage device is prevented.

title_en: Steel wire locking and positioning machine for automatic rim of electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steel wire locking and positioning machine for an automatic rim of an electric vehicle, and relates to the technical field of locking and positioning machines. The steel wire locking and positioning machine of the automatic rim of the electric vehicle comprises a positioning ring for placing the rim, a supporting leg is fixed on the bottom surface of the positioning ring, the inner end of a first arm extending plate extends to the center of the positioning ring and is provided with a limiting seat, a second arm extending plate located below the positioning ring is fixed on the supporting leg, the inner end of the second arm extending plate extends to the center of the positioning ring and is provided with a lifting seat, the centers of the positioning seat and the lifting seat and the positioning ring are on the same vertical axis, a wheel hub can be positioned at the center of the wheel rim after the positioning seat moves downwards, the wheel hub at the center of the wheel rim is positioned when the wheel is assembled, and the wheel hub at the center of the wheel is also positioned.

title_en: Trolley is listened with high accuracy qxcomm technology parallel movement intelligence to narrow environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent trolleys, and discloses a high-precision omnidirectional parallel movement intelligent detection trolley for a narrow environment. The invention uses the yaw angle of the gyroscope to correct the attitude, has good compatibility, is not limited to a specific field or a track, has high precision, has sufficient response time when driving at low speed, and can correct the attitude in time; during fast driving, the accumulation of errors can be eliminated by using an overcompensation algorithm.

title_en: Improved acoustic foam profile for pneumatic tires
abstract_en: The present invention provides a tire having an adhesive sealant applied to the belt reinforcement area of the crown radially inward of the tire, wherein a noise suppressing foam ring having circumferential grooves in the radially outer surface of the foam is applied to the adhesive sealant. The groove of the foam is laterally aligned with the circumferential groove of the tire such that the foam contacts the sealant on areas not laterally aligned with the longitudinal groove of the tire.

title_en: Apparatus and method for managing clusters of information transfer equipment to update a digital twin of a turbine engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for managing a cluster of information transfer devices reversibly fixable to an aircraft turbine engine, comprising: associating (S02) an apparatus of the cluster of apparatuses with a turbine engine of the cluster of turbine engines, fixing (S03), acquiring (S04) at least one operating parameter of the turbine engine, generating (S04) at least one indicator allowing updating of a digital twin of the turbine engine based on the acquired operating parameter, transmitting (S05) the indicator allowing updating of the digital twin to an entity for storing the digital twin.

title_en: Electric bicycle concentrated charging and battery replacing system with bidirectional energy transmission function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of centralized charging and battery replacing of electric bicycles, and discloses a centralized charging and battery replacing system of an electric bicycle with a bidirectional energy transmission function, which comprises a main control module, a charging control module, a bidirectional ACDC (alternating current direct current converter) unit and a bidirectional DCDC (direct current converter) unit, wherein the main control module is connected with the charging control module; one end of the bidirectional ACDC conversion unit is connected with a power grid through a circuit breaker, and the other end of the bidirectional ACDC conversion unit is connected with the lithium battery through the bidirectional DCDC conversion unit; one end of the bidirectional ACDC conversion unit is also connected with an external load; the main control module is in communication connection with the smart cloud service platform and the charging control module, and is used for uploading operating data acquired by the charging control module, receiving a remote control instruction of the smart cloud service platform and sending the remote control instruction to the charging control module; the charging control module is used for issuing an energy transmission instruction to control the bidirectional ACDC conversion unit and the bidirectional DCDC conversion unit. The distributed community energy storage/terminal user energy storage unit can be used as a distributed community energy storage/terminal user energy storage unit, plays roles of peak clipping, valley filling and emergency power supply, reduces the load of a power grid, and is beneficial to energy sharing.

title_en: Tread rubber composition, mixing method and application thereof, and tire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of manufacturing of tires, in particular to a tread rubber composition, a mixing method and application thereof and a tire. The composition reduces the influence of different use environment temperatures on the abrasion performance of the tire, particularly the problem of the abrasion performance reduction of the tire when the tire is used in a low-temperature environment, and simultaneously reduces the rolling resistance of the tire and maintains the wet performance of the tire.

title_en: Battery management method, system and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery management method, a system and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the battery management method is applied to an online management device and comprises the following steps: detecting the battery at preset time intervals to obtain detected battery parameters; sending the battery parameters to an offline analysis platform, and receiving a first control signal based on a control strategy, which is sent by the offline analysis platform; and adjusting the charge and discharge strategy of the battery according to the first control signal. Compared with the prior art, the battery management method, the battery management system and the computer-readable storage medium disclosed by the embodiment of the invention have the advantage of improving the accuracy of the management strategy.

title_en: System and method for assisting cardiopulmonary resuscitation of emergency unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a first-aid unmanned aerial vehicle assisted cardio-pulmonary resuscitation system and a method thereof, relating to the technical field of medical care informatics, comprising the following steps: the unmanned aerial vehicle arrives at an emergency site according to a preset route, and emergency medical equipment and a voice-visual module are put in; acquiring a pressing pressure applied by an operator when performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation, an action video when performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation, and an operation video for operating an automatic external defibrillator; extracting a pressing depth according to the action video; and feeding back the pressing pressure, the pressing depth, the action video and the operation video to the remote terminal so that the remote terminal performs voice and video interaction with an emergency site according to the current cardiopulmonary resuscitation state to realize remote guidance of the action of an operator.

title_en: Electric automobile sliding energy recovery reminding system and reminding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for reminding an electric automobile of recovering sliding energy, and belongs to the technical field of automobile driving. An electric vehicle coasting energy recovery reminding system, comprising: the car tail is provided with a brake lamp and a car logo; the warning lamp is arranged on the tail of the vehicle and is spaced from the brake lamp; and the vehicle control unit is in communication connection with the brake lamp and the prompt lamp respectively. After the electric door of the electric automobile is loosened, when the electric quantity meets the requirement of entering the energy recovery state, the whole automobile controller sends a signal to enter the energy recovery state, the electric automobile decelerates, and the prompting lamp flickers to prompt the deceleration of the rear automobile under the condition that the braking system does not intervene and the braking lamp is not lightened, so that the potential safety hazard during sliding energy recovery is reduced.

title_en: Vehicle control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a control device for a vehicle, which eliminates the shortage of the driving force of the vehicle after restarting the constant speed control after performing the override control in the constant speed control mode. A control device for a vehicle is provided with a constant speed control mode capable of switching between a normal mode and a constant speed control mode, wherein a control unit executes constant speed control for calculating a target drive force by integral control based on an integrated value of a deviation between a vehicle speed and a target vehicle speed and controlling the drive force of the vehicle to the target drive force in the constant speed control mode, and the control unit interrupts the constant speed control when a requested drive force corresponding to an accelerator opening degree of the vehicle exceeds the target drive force in the constant speed control, executes override control for controlling the drive force of the vehicle to the requested drive force, and sets a component of the integral control in the target drive force based on the requested drive force in the override control when the override control is ended and the constant speed control for restarting the constant speed control, and when a wheel climbing of the vehicle fails.

title_en: Fusion positioning method in intelligent driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fusion positioning method in intelligent driving, which comprises the following steps: outputting a boundary fitting curve; calculating a lane line fitting curve; obtaining a course angle calculation curve under a global coordinate system; obtaining corresponding line-shaped point information in the lane; obtaining a lane line curve; obtaining a first discrete point set; obtaining a second discrete point set; the curvature first curvature value corresponding to the first discrete point is obtained; obtaining a first curvature set; a second curvature value corresponding to the second discrete point is obtained; obtaining a second curvature set; outputting a datum point; correcting the longitudinal position of the vehicle; correcting the lateral position of the vehicle; and correcting the heading angle of the vehicle. According to the invention, a more accurate fitting model in the prior art is obtained, and the obtained correction points can more accurately correct the abscissa of the current position of the vehicle; estimating longitudinal position correction information of the vehicle which is not provided in the prior art; further correcting the current heading angle of the vehicle.

title_en: Whole car thermal management system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a whole car thermal management system, includes multi-ported valve, battery module, first heat exchanger, second heat exchanger, heater, air-conditioning box. The multi-way valve is communicated with a battery heat exchange loop, an air conditioner heat exchange loop and a motor heat exchange loop of the vehicle. The battery heat exchange loop comprises a battery module, and the air conditioner heat exchange loop comprises a second heat exchanger, a heater and an air conditioner box; the first heat exchanger comprises a first interface, a second interface, a third interface and a fourth interface which are used for circulating cooling liquid; the second heat exchanger comprises a first interface and a second interface for circulating cooling liquid; the first port of the multi-way valve is connected with a battery module, the battery module is connected with a second interface of the first heat exchanger, the first interface of the first heat exchanger is connected with the second port of the multi-way valve, a third interface of the first heat exchanger is connected with a first interface of the second heat exchanger, and the second interface of the second heat exchanger is sequentially connected with a heater and a warm air core of an air conditioner box and then connected with a fourth interface of the first heat exchanger. The invention simplifies the arrangement and reduces the number of the pipeline and the multi-way valve interface.

title_en: Fill electric pile safety monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of charging piles, in particular to a charging pile safety monitoring device which comprises a rack, wherein a charging wire is arranged on the rack, a dustproof seat, a ring seat and a driving motor for driving the ring seat to rotate are arranged on the rack, a wire hole is formed in the ring seat, one end of the charging wire penetrates out of the wire hole and is connected with a charging head, and a dustproof groove for inserting the charging head is formed in the dustproof seat.

title_en: Seal structure and car of frameless door
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seal structure of a frameless vehicle door and an automobile, relating to the technical field of vehicle door design, wherein the device comprises: a support body and sealing lip assembly; the supporting body is used for being assembled on the corner window decorative plate, and a sealing cavity is formed in the inner side of the supporting body; a sealing lip assembly connected to the outside of the support body and forming at least two semi-enclosed structures. The sealing structure of the frameless vehicle door forms at least two sealing cavities with the side window glass through the sealing lip to provide better sealing performance and sound insulation function. Meanwhile, the noise problem is better solved through structural improvement.

title_en: Hydraulic suspension energy recovery system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic suspension energy recovery system and a vehicle, wherein the hydraulic suspension energy recovery system comprises two groups of hydraulic suspensions, a power generation assembly and a power generation assembly, wherein the two groups of hydraulic suspensions are used for installing a power assembly on a vehicle frame, hydraulic cavities of the two groups of hydraulic suspensions are communicated through hydraulic pipelines, the power generation assembly comprises a hydraulic motor and a power generator, the hydraulic motor is connected with the hydraulic pipelines and is positioned between the two groups of hydraulic suspensions, the hydraulic cavities of the two groups of hydraulic suspensions drive the hydraulic motor to apply work when liquid flows through the hydraulic pipelines, and the power generator is driven to generate power when the hydraulic motor applies work. According to the hydraulic suspension energy recovery system, when the pressure difference is formed between the two groups of hydraulic suspension hydraulic cavities, liquid can flow in the hydraulic pipeline to drive the hydraulic motor to rotate, so that the generator is driven to generate electricity, recovery of vibration energy of the power assembly is realized, and reduction of vibration noise of the power assembly is facilitated.

title_en: Parking route determining method, terminal and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a parking route determining method, a terminal and a computer storage medium, wherein the parking route determining method comprises the following steps: acquiring map data of a parking lot, wherein the map data of the parking lot comprises at least two items of a driving road, a driving direction, a parking space state and a parking space pose of the parking lot; and determining a parking route according to the pose of the vehicle in the parking lot and the map data of the parking lot in combination with a parking space selection mode. According to the parking route determining method, the terminal and the computer storage medium, the parking route can be flexibly determined according to the pose of the vehicle in the parking lot and the map data of the parking lot under different parking place selection modes, the flexibility and the accuracy of determining the parking route are improved, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Automobile skylight sun shield
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile skylight sun shield which comprises a sun shield arranged at the position of an automobile skylight opening, wherein the sun shield comprises a plate body frame, an opening cavity is formed in the middle of the plate body frame, more than one middle partition plate is arranged in the opening cavity at equal intervals in parallel, the opening cavity is divided into a plurality of air guide cavities with the same size by the middle partition plates, an elastic sealing ring in a shape of a Chinese character 'kou' is arranged in each air guide cavity, and a light shield sheet is rotatably arranged in the middle of each elastic sealing ring. The invention controls the rotation angle of the shading sheet by opening and closing the shading plate, thus being convenient to control the rotation angle of the shading sheet during the running of a vehicle and further achieving the purpose of controlling the air inlet direction.

title_en: New energy automobile adds power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile power charging station, which relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles and comprises a charging area and a power switching area, wherein the power switching area is arranged separately from the charging area, the power switching area is positioned at one side of the charging area, a vehicle lifting AGV, a battery transferring trolley and a battery unlocking AGV are arranged at one side of the power switching area, the battery unlocking AGV is arranged at the bottom of the battery transferring trolley and is used for pulling the battery transferring trolley, the vehicle lifting AGV and the battery unlocking AGV can operatively enter and leave the power switching area, and the battery unlocking AGV can operatively enter and leave the charging area. In the invention, the charging and the battery replacement are separated, so that the battery replacement is safer, the space requirement on the occupied area of equipment is reduced, and the battery replacement method has high practicability in the scene of a parking lot.

title_en: Parking space identification method based on vision and ultrasonic fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic driving, and particularly relates to an automatic parking method. A parking space identification method based on vision and ultrasonic fusion comprises the following steps: the parking space screening step, after the visual camera identifies the parking space, the parking space information of the target parking space is judged and screened; calculating the parking space overlapping amount, calculating the overlapping condition between the target parking space and the existing parking space in the memory, and if the target parking space does not meet the requirement, finishing the calculation and abandoning the target parking space; storing and updating the parking spaces, namely determining whether the target parking spaces are stored in the memory or updating the existing parking spaces in the memory according to judgment conditions of parking space storage and updating; judging the parking place validity, and determining whether the parking place is valid and available for parking; and (4) processing the obstacle information around the parking space, and when the target parking space is judged to be valid, processing the obstacle information around the parking space, binding the obstacle information with the valid parking space and storing the information together. The invention not only improves the success rate of parking, but also improves the parking efficiency of the automatic parking system, so that a user can obtain good parking experience.

title_en: Combined pressure water tank for ship
abstract_en: A combined pressure water tank for ships belongs to the technical field of pressure water tanks, and aims to solve the problems that water enters and exits by the pressure of internal air, and when the pressure of the air in the pressure water tank is too high or too low, manual pressurization or pressure release is needed, and the operation is too complicated; according to the invention, the first relay connector, the second relay connector and the hydraulic press are used for controlling the channel inside the rotary valve to be communicated with the air inlet pipe through the air outlet pipe, the speed reducing motor controls the piston plate to do piston motion inside the piston cylinder, and the air inside the water tank is pressurized or exhausted in the processes of extraction and compression of the piston plate, so that automatic pressurization is realized when the internal pressure of the water tank is too high, automatic pressure reduction is realized when the internal pressure of the water tank is too low, water delivery is automatically performed after pressure reduction, the service life of a water tank is prolonged by manual operation.

title_en: Aircraft seat and energy absorber
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy absorber, which comprises an energy absorbing element and an actuating rod, wherein the energy absorbing element is long in energy absorbing section length and can expand and deform when being subjected to external stretching acting force so as to absorb energy. When the energy absorber is subjected to external stretching acting force, the starting rod is provided with the notch, stress concentration is easy to generate, and therefore the energy absorber is damaged. The invention also provides an aircraft seat comprising the energy absorber, when the aircraft seat is subjected to external impact force, the energy absorber can absorb the impact force, so that the impact of special conditions such as collision and the like on other structures of the aircraft seat is reduced, the impact resistance of the aircraft seat is improved, and the safety coefficient of the aircraft seat is improved.

title_en: Taxi system
abstract_en: A taxi system (10) is provided with: a plurality of taxi Vehicles (VT) for transporting the user to the destination by automatic driving; and a management center (14), wherein the management center (14) instructs execution of protection driving for one or more unmanned taxi vehicles (VTa) to drive while protecting a manned taxi consist (Gvt) composed of one or more manned taxi vehicles (VTb) when a predetermined protection condition is satisfied, and the unmanned taxi vehicles (VTa) protect the manned taxi consist (Gvt) by driving in front and rear adjacent to the manned taxi consist (Gvt) when the execution instruction of protection driving is received.

title_en: Active pneumatic magnetic vibration isolation and damping protection transfer device for precision equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active air magnetic vibration isolation and damping protection transfer device for precision equipment, which belongs to the technical field of transfer equipment. Three-way vibration isolation is realized by three-way arrangement of the vibration isolation units, the starting vibration isolation frequency is reduced by adopting a positive and negative rigidity parallel connection mode, the vibration isolation performance is improved by adding the damping units and the limiting units, safety protection under the action of strong impact is realized, and the problem that the transportation of three-way precision vibration isolation and impact protection cannot be realized in the transportation process of large-scale precision equipment in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Ship pier falling real-time measurement system and method and dock
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ships, in particular to a ship pier-falling real-time measurement system and method and a dock. The measuring head lifting mechanism comprises a base and a measuring head seat movably assembled on the base, wherein the base is fixed at a target position in a dock, the measuring head seat can lift and move in the Z direction relative to the base in an XYZ three-dimensional space coordinate system, an X measuring head, a Y measuring head and a Z measuring head are arranged on the measuring head seat, and the ship pier falling real-time measuring system further comprises an X measuring target and a Y measuring target.

title_en: Self-excited vibration test method for supercritical floating spline shaft of helicopter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-excited vibration test method of a supercritical floating spline shaft of a helicopter, which is characterized in that a tester of a bench test is improved, a simulation mounting support is designed to simulate the actual mounting structure of the floating spline of a tail transmission system of the helicopter so as to meet self-excited vibration test conditions of a tail shaft, the boundary condition of the self-excited vibration of the supercritical floating spline shaft can be obtained through the bench test, the dynamic characteristic of the supercritical tail shaft of the floating spline can be further determined, the self-excited vibration boundary is clearer, further safety guarantee is provided for later stage iron bird test or outfield flight test, the test process has operability and judgability, if the problem of the self-excited vibration of the tail shaft occurs, the troubleshooting period can be greatly shortened, the troubleshooting cost is reduced, and a safe and reliable test process is provided for the self-excited vibration test of the supercritical floating spline shaft of the helicopter.

title_en: Vehicle control method, device, control terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicle control method, a device, a control terminal, and a storage medium, the vehicle control method, by acquiring a first vehicle parameter of a straight vehicle in a bidirectional lane and a second vehicle parameter of a steered vehicle located behind the straight vehicle, then determining whether the steered vehicle can pass through the bidirectional lane from a side of the straight vehicle according to the first vehicle parameter, the second vehicle parameter, and a lane width of the bidirectional lane, and if the steered vehicle can pass through the bidirectional lane from the side of the straight vehicle, transmitting first instruction information for instructing the straight vehicle to perform a lateral movement to the straight vehicle so that the straight vehicle performs the lateral movement to provide a steering space for the steered vehicle. The vehicle control method provided by the embodiment of the application enables the steering vehicle to steer when the front straight-ahead vehicle is in red light waiting, thereby solving the technical problem that the current motor vehicle lane has low passing efficiency and achieving the technical effect of improving the motor vehicle lane passing efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle parallel connection control method and device, cloud control platform and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method and device for parallel take-over of an unmanned vehicle, a cloud control platform and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of starting an automatic monitoring program, monitoring whether an automatic driving module of the vehicle is abnormal, and reporting the cloud control platform to take over the vehicle in parallel if the automatic driving module of the vehicle is abnormal and the automatic driving module is influenced to execute a preset automatic driving control instruction in the automatic vehicle. According to the application, the fault of the unmanned vehicle is monitored in real time, and parallel connection pipes are carried out when the fault occurs, so that the safe operation of the vehicle is ensured. The application can realize the full automation of the parallel take-over control flow of the unmanned vehicle.

title_en: High stability electric bicycle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stability electric bicycle which comprises a body, wherein a handle device and a supporting device are arranged on the body, the handle device comprises a vehicle handle and a brake handle, a pressing block is arranged on the vehicle handle, the pressing block can be pressed downwards by holding the vehicle handle, the supporting device comprises a telescopic frame, a pendulum bob and a sliding block, the telescopic frame is arranged on the body, the telescopic frame extends out of the body and can support the body, the sliding block is arranged on the body in a sliding mode, and the pendulum bob is arranged on the sliding block in a rotating mode. The invention provides a high-stability electric bicycle which can automatically park vehicles on different road surfaces, enables the direction of the vehicles to be consistent with the gravity direction, enables the vehicles not to easily topple, automatically intervenes to assist braking during braking, protects the vehicles, prevents the vehicles from toppling, improves the use feeling of operators, and simultaneously improves the safety and the stability of the vehicles.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted domain control device and method and vehicle-mounted system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted domain control device, a vehicle-mounted domain control method and a vehicle-mounted system, wherein the vehicle-mounted domain control device comprises a cabin application chip, a gateway application chip, a network switching chip, a DSP module and a 4G communication module, wherein the gateway application chip, the network switching chip, the DSP module and the 4G communication module are respectively in communication connection with the cabin application chip; the gateway application chip is used for receiving the car body data and sending the car body data to the cabin application chip for processing; the network exchange chip is used for providing a data channel for the 4G communication module and selectively acquiring other external electronic control unit ECU data corresponding to the user request according to the user request. Compared with the prior art, the hardware architecture of the domain controller is combined by a plurality of ECUs, so that the application cost of the ECUs of the whole vehicle and the wiring cost among the controllers are reduced while the function is realized.

title_en: Vehicle door windowsill reinforcing structure and vehicle door assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle door windowsill reinforcing structure and a vehicle door assembly. Wherein, door windowsill reinforcing structure includes: the door comprises an inner door upper reinforcing plate, an outer door upper reinforcing plate and an inner door plate; wherein the first connecting portion of the door inner upper reinforcement plate, the third connecting portion of the door outer upper reinforcement plate, and the fifth connecting portion of the door inner plate are connected at a first position; the second connecting portion of the upper reinforcing plate in the door, the fourth connecting portion of the upper reinforcing plate outside the door and the sixth connecting portion of the inner plate of the door are connected at a second position, the first connecting portion, the third connecting portion and the fifth connecting portion extend along a first direction, the second connecting portion, the fourth connecting portion and the sixth connecting portion extend along a second direction, and the first direction and the second direction are arranged in an intersecting manner. The invention solves the problem that the rigidity of the windowsill of the car door is poor due to the unreasonable structural design of the windowsill position of the existing car door.

title_en: Hydrogen-electricity auxiliary drive integrated system and drive method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrogen-electricity auxiliary drive integrated system and a driving method. The hydrogen-electricity auxiliary drive integrated system comprises: the database building module is used for building a driver operation rule database corresponding to the vehicle type aiming at the vehicle type of the hydrogen-electricity energy automobile; the real-time acquisition module is used for acquiring the gear change condition of the vehicle in real time in the starting and running processes of the vehicle; the adjusting module is used for adjusting a vehicle gear rotating scheme in the driver operation rule database when the gear of the hydrogen-electricity energy automobile is changed; performing high-low voltage power-on prejudgment according to a vehicle gear rotating scheme to obtain a high-low voltage power-on prejudgment result; the strategy determining module is used for determining a power-on execution strategy of the hydrogen-electricity auxiliary drive integrated system according to the high-low voltage power-on prejudgment result; and the incremental updating module is used for incrementally updating the driver operation rule database according to the gear change condition of the vehicle acquired in real time.

title_en: Upper building deck structure without strong frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deck structure of a strong frame-free superstructure, which comprises a deck plate, wherein the bottom of the deck plate is fixedly provided with a plurality of transverse aggregates which are transversely distributed, and the transverse aggregates are distributed at the bottom of the deck plate at intervals; the bottom of the deck plate is fixedly provided with a plurality of longitudinally distributed longitudinal girders, and the longitudinal girders are distributed at the bottom of the deck plate at intervals; a plurality of pillars are arranged below the deck plate, and the tops of the pillars are fixedly connected with the joints of the longitudinal girders and the transverse aggregates; the bottom of the deck plate is not provided with a transverse strong frame; the bottom of the deck plate is not provided with longitudinal aggregates. The invention reduces the number of the hull strong components and realizes the weight reduction of the structure; the net height between the deck plates is increased, and the effects of reducing the weight of the structure and lowering the center of gravity of the ship are achieved.

title_en: Patrol and examine unmanned aerial vehicle with air water conservancy diversion function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inspection unmanned aerial vehicle with an air guide function, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an air guide ring, an air guide surface and a monitor, wherein an installation rod is installed on the unmanned aerial vehicle, the air guide ring is installed on the installation rod, the air guide surface is arranged on the outer diameter surface of the air guide ring, the air guide surface is an arc surface, when the unmanned aerial vehicle flies, resistance air flow received in the flying process is guided by the air guide surface on the air guide ring, so that the resistance air flow can be guided downwards, the flying assistance effect on the unmanned aerial vehicle can be realized, downblows formed by fan blades of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be protected and concentrated, the downblows can be enhanced, the cleaning operation of the downblows can be conveniently realized, a fixed component is fixedly installed on one side of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, an air suction component is fixedly connected to the fixed component, a cleaning component is fixedly connected to the air suction component, the cleaning component is fixedly installed on the monitor, and the camera shooting position of the monitor can be cleaned through the cleaning component.

title_en: Electric vehicle body support suitable for bottom battery replacement and electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle body support for an electric vehicle suitable for bottom battery change and the electric vehicle, which is used for installing a battery pack assembly below the vehicle body of the electric vehicle, the vehicle body support comprises a main body frame and a locking mechanism, the main body frame is attached to a vehicle beam of the electric vehicle from a middle portion thereof such that the main body frame is formed with a mounting portion extending to an outside of the vehicle beam, and a locking mechanism for locking or unlocking the battery pack assembly to the main body frame is provided on the mounting portion. This electric vehicle body support and electric vehicle suitable for bottom trades electric sets up locking mechanism in the inboard of main body frame, makes the automobile body support can cooperate wider battery package subassembly to use, has increased the suitability that the chassis traded the electric, has improved the stability of being connected between chassis girder and the battery package subassembly simultaneously.

title_en: Ship casting surface treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses ship casting surface treatment equipment, which relates to the technical field of ship cleaning, and provides the following scheme that the ship casting surface treatment equipment comprises a machine body, wherein a driving mechanism is arranged above the inside of the machine body, a polishing mechanism is arranged on one side of the driving mechanism, a scraping mechanism is arranged on one side of the polishing mechanism, a crushing mechanism is arranged below the inside of the machine body, a transmission mechanism is arranged among the polishing mechanism, the scraping mechanism and the crushing mechanism, the polishing mechanism comprises a first driving rod, a second driving rod and a first belt pulley which is respectively fixedly sleeved with the first driving rod and the second driving rod, and the scraping mechanism comprises two linkage rods and a crankshaft which is fixedly connected between the two linkage rods; the invention can not only carry out quick scraping treatment on the surface of the ship, but also carry out quick grinding and polishing treatment through the grinding disc, and also can carry out crushing treatment on the cleaned impurities through the crushing roller, thereby effectively improving the effect of cleaning the surface of the ship through quick scraping and polishing treatment.

title_en: Linkage unlocking mechanism
abstract_en: The application relates to a linkage unlocking mechanism, which comprises an adjusting handle assembly arranged on the side surface of a seat chassis, a one-key unlocking steel wire rope assembly with one end connected with the adjusting handle assembly, and a branching assembly connected with the other end of the one-key unlocking steel wire rope assembly; the other end of the branching component is respectively connected with a left waistband steel wire rope component, a right waistband steel wire rope component and a shoulder belt steel wire rope component; the other ends of the left side waistband steel wire rope component and the right side waistband steel wire rope component are respectively connected with a left connecting point and a right connecting point of the two-point type safety belt; the other end of the shoulder belt steel wire rope component is connected with a connecting rod mechanism, the connecting rod mechanism is arranged on the seat framework, a shoulder belt locking plate is arranged on the seat framework in a sliding mode, and the connecting rod mechanism is connected with two locking pins of the lifesaving umbrella and the shoulder belt locking plate respectively. This application controls five unblock points of two point type safety belt, lifesaving umbrella and baldric respectively through an adjusting handle, has shortened passenger's unblock time, has realized the effect that the passenger withdrawed fast.

title_en: Integral hoisting device for vehicle body and bogie
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of locomotive production, in particular to an integral hoisting device for a locomotive body and a bogie. The invention provides an integral hoisting device of a vehicle body and a bogie, which comprises hoisting mechanisms symmetrically arranged on two sides of the bogie, wherein each hoisting mechanism comprises: the first connecting assembly comprises a vehicle body underframe hanging beam, a first lifting piece and a connecting bottom box; and the second connecting assembly comprises a framework hanging seat and a second lifting piece. The utility model provides a pair of realize that whole of automobile body and bogie lifts by crane, the assembly method, simple structure, simple to operate can solve the problem that unipolar bogie structure space is compact to be unfavorable for arranging hoisting mechanism, can satisfy the requirement that rail vehicle wholly lifted by crane again, and the handling in-process need not extra equipment or instrument can directly lift by crane, has simplified technology, has improved production efficiency, and economic cost is low, convenient inspection and maintenance work.

title_en: Integrated motor spherical hinge and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated motor spherical hinge and a manufacturing method thereof. The outer diameter of the motor spherical hinge is reduced in a reducing mode, so that the radial precompression of the motor spherical hinge is realized, and the tension of rubber is avoided. And reducing the diameter by using a split arc-shaped fixture. The vulcanizing body jacket and the integral jacket are integrated, so that the vulcanizing body jacket cannot jump up and down relative to the integral jacket, and cannot rotate relative to the integral jacket. The assembled motor spherical hinge has low symmetry percent of pass due to a plurality of processes such as assembly, extrusion, flanging, vulcanization and the like. According to the invention, the vulcanized body outer sleeve and the integral outer sleeve are integrated, a flanging procedure is not needed, the technical problems of cracks and the like of the integral outer sleeve are avoided, and the symmetry qualified rate is high.

title_en: One-way stop valve group for buoyancy adjustment of submersible and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a one-way stop valve group for buoyancy adjustment of a submersible and a using method thereof, and the one-way stop valve group comprises a valve body, wherein the valve body is provided with a vertically through central hole, and the central hole is provided with a through water outlet, a water inlet and an oil return port which are sequentially and laterally extended from top to bottom along the axial direction; a check valve component is assembled at the water inlet, a main valve seat is fixedly arranged in a central hole between the water inlet and the water outlet, a main valve core is assembled above the main valve seat, and the main valve core is pushed by a top driven rod to be attached to the main valve seat below the main valve seat so as to separate the water inlet from the water outlet in the central hole; the driving rod is arranged in the central hole below the main valve seat, the driving rod is pushed by oil at the bottom to move upwards and passes through the main valve seat to apply upward force to the main valve core, so that the main valve core is separated from the main valve seat upwards, water entering from the water inlet through the check valve assembly can upwards pass through the main valve seat and then flow out from the water outlet, the power assisting device is used for realizing buoyancy adjustment, the check valve has the performance of a safety valve, the sealing performance is good in the whole use, and the reliability is high.

title_en: Novel wheel surface closed wheel with variable structure and multiple walking modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel variable-structure multi-walking-mode wheel face closed type wheel, which comprises a wheel hub, a plurality of groups of spoke assemblies, a plurality of rim blocks and a control assembly, wherein the spoke assemblies are hinged with the wheel hub and can rotate along the axial direction of the wheel hub, the groups of spoke assemblies are uniformly distributed along the radial circumferential direction of the wheel hub, the rim blocks are connected with one end, which is far away from the wheel hub, of each spoke assembly, the control assembly is arranged on the wheel hub and is used for driving the spoke assemblies to rotate, when the spoke assemblies rotate to fold the plurality of rim blocks, arc-shaped tread is formed for carrying out wheel type movement, and when the spoke assemblies rotate to separate the plurality of rim blocks, a plurality of mechanical soles are formed for carrying out leg type movement. Simultaneously, a plurality of wheel rim blocks are combined or separated, so that the wheel type movement mode or the leg type movement mode is switched, and the capacity of self-adapting to the environment is improved.

title_en: Vehicle abnormal state reminding method and device, vehicle-mounted terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of automatic control, and discloses a vehicle abnormal state reminding method, a vehicle abnormal state reminding device, a vehicle-mounted terminal and a storage medium, which are used for improving the efficiency of dealing with abnormality. The vehicle abnormal state reminding method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle abnormal information; classifying the abnormal information of the vehicle to obtain an abnormal information set, wherein the abnormal information set comprises at least one of a danger type information subset, a warning type information subset and a prompt type information subset; reading a basic reminding mode corresponding to each subset in the abnormal information set from a preset library to obtain a reminding mode set, wherein each basic reminding mode in the reminding mode set corresponds to each subset in the abnormal information set one by one; determining a reminding strategy of the abnormal information set on a target terminal according to a preset rule and a reminding mode set, and establishing connection between the target terminal and a vehicle; and reminding the abnormal state of the vehicle related personnel through the target terminal by using a reminding strategy.

title_en: Side wall hinge vision feeding and discharging and vision assembling integrated system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a side wall hinge visual loading and unloading and visual assembly integrated system which comprises a 3D visual loading and unloading unit, a 3D visual positioning and assembling unit and an automatic stud screwing unit, wherein the 3D visual loading and unloading unit comprises a hopper conveyor component, a first 3D visual sensor, a first assembling robot, a first gripper tool component, a turn-over component and a secondary transfer table component, and the first gripper tool component is arranged at the tail end of the first assembling robot. The invention can get through the automation and intelligent upgrade of the existing upstream and downstream processes of a factory by the visual sensor technology and the cooperation of the industrial robot and the gripper assembly, can realize automatic feeding and discharging, completely replace the existing manual feeding and discharging, can solve the problems of difficult work recruitment and high labor cost of the factory on one hand, and can realize the real intelligent and automatic upgrade of the factory on the other hand, and improve the production efficiency of a production line.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rotor disturbance correction method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for correcting rotor disturbance of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle wind speed measurement simulation numerical model based on an environmental flight envelope and unmanned aerial vehicle flight parameters; the environment flight envelope is used for setting the mapping relation of unmanned aerial vehicle flight parameters in an environment scene, setting simulation parameters in the unmanned aerial vehicle wind speed simulation numerical model and performing simulation experiments to obtain the estimated quantity of the influence of the rotation of the unmanned aerial vehicle rotor wing caused by the drainage disturbance. According to the method, fluid simulation under different flight envelope conditions is carried out on the unmanned aerial vehicle wind speed measurement system, the disturbance influence of the unmanned aerial vehicle rotor on the anemometer measurement is estimated according to the difference between the wind speed simulation value and the set value at the anemometer position to obtain an estimated value, and then the estimated value is substituted into the unmanned aerial vehicle motion and posture compensation algorithm, so that the influence of rotor disturbance on the anemometer measurement result and the influence caused by the posture, motion and acceleration of the unmanned aerial vehicle are corrected, and a more accurate three-dimensional wind speed measurement result is obtained.

title_en: Laser radar, method and device for measuring movement speed of laser radar and control system
abstract_en: A laser radar, a method and a device for measuring movement speed of the laser radar and a control system of the laser radar respectively obtain detection data through a plurality of receiving and sending modules, and obtain the movement speed of a target to be measured by combining position information of the receiving and sending modules on the basis of the detection data. Due to the fact that the plurality of transceiver modules have preset distances, the obtained motion speed is a vector speed, namely the motion speed comprises a motion speed and a motion direction angle. The vector velocity can be obtained to more accurately reflect the actual motion condition of the target to be detected, and the accuracy and precision of vehicle control can be effectively improved.

title_en: Method and system for controlling oxygenation of parking air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of parking air conditioners, and particularly provides a method and a system for controlling aeration of a parking air conditioner, aiming at solving the problem that a standby oxygen supply device in an existing truck cab cannot be automatically started and intelligently operated. To this end, the control method of the present invention comprises the steps of: determining the concentration of oxygen in the vehicle; judging whether the concentration of oxygen in the vehicle is lower than a critical value; when the concentration of oxygen in the vehicle is lower than a critical value, controlling the oxygen generation module to operate and judging whether the vehicle is in a running state; and selecting a high-power oxygen generation mode or a low-power mute oxygen generation mode of the parking air conditioner according to the judgment result of whether the vehicle is in the running state. The control method of the invention ensures the oxygen supply in the vehicle under different states and also gives consideration to the personal safety and full rest of the personnel in the vehicle.

title_en: Stereo garage new energy automobile electric quantity induction detection technology device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stereo garage new energy automobile electric quantity induction detection technical device, which belongs to the technical field of electric automobile charging and comprises a support frame, wherein a charging table is arranged on the support frame according to the number of garages, the charging table comprises an outer protective cover, a supporting table is arranged in the outer protective cover, the supporting table is connected with an inner cover body through a displacement assembly, the inner side wall of the inner cover body is connected with a data display screen and a detection assembly through a rotating connecting piece, the output end of an electric push rod is connected with a positioning butt joint plate, a protection disc is arranged at the end part of the positioning butt joint plate, and an electric connector is connected onto the protection disc through a telescopic protection piece. According to the invention, the charging platform is arranged on the stereo garage, and the existing positioning parking function of the stereo garage is utilized, so that the charging platform automatically extends out after a vehicle in the garage is stably placed, the effect of charging the electric vehicle is fully automatically realized, the effect of parking and automatically charging in the stereo garage is achieved, and the electric quantity condition of the vehicle can be known in time through the data display screen.

title_en: Compact low-frequency vibration isolation device for regulating positive and negative rigidity by magnetic and air mixing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compact low-frequency vibration isolation device for regulating positive and negative rigidity through magnetic and air mixing, which comprises an upper supporting platform, a base, an elastic air bag positive rigidity mechanism, a central shaft, a vibration isolation box body, two spring positive rigidity modules and an electromagnetic negative rigidity module, wherein the two spring positive rigidity modules and the electromagnetic negative rigidity module are arranged in the vibration isolation box body, the elastic air bag positive rigidity mechanism comprises an elastic air bag, the upper end of the elastic air bag is connected with the upper supporting platform, the lower end of the elastic air bag is connected with the base, the base of the vibration isolation box body is fixed on the base, the two spring positive rigidity modules are symmetrically arranged on the upper part and the lower part of the electromagnetic negative rigidity module, the upper end of the central shaft is connected with the upper supporting platform, and the lower end of the central shaft sequentially penetrates through the spring positive rigidity module, the electromagnetic negative rigidity module and the spring positive rigidity module which are arranged on the lower part in the vibration isolation box body. The vibration isolation device has the beneficial effects that the spring air bag and electromagnetic negative stiffness combined mode is adopted, so that the vibration isolation device is simple and compact in structure and easy to install, and when the load mass or external excitation changes, the stiffness of the vibration isolation system is easier to adjust in real time by utilizing the air bag and the electromagnetic mechanism, and the stability is higher.

title_en: Multi-oil-tank full-oil annunciator and oil level monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full oil annunciator with multiple oil tanks, which comprises an oil tank and an oil level annunciator, wherein an oil level annunciator working point is arranged in the oil level annunciator; the oil level annunciator comprises a shell, an oil leakage hole is formed in the bottom of the shell, the shell is arranged on the second oil tank, the oil leakage hole is located in the second oil tank, an oil filling pipe and a vent hole are arranged on the side wall of the shell, the other end of the oil filling pipe is arranged in the first oil tank, and the oil level annunciator is arranged in the shell. When the oil level annunciator is adopted to monitor two oil tanks, no matter which oil tank reaches the full oil level line, the oil level annunciator is not connected, and only when the fuel oil in the two oil tanks reaches the full oil level line, the oil level annunciator is connected to send out signals, so that the full oil level of the two independent oil tanks can be monitored by one oil level annunciator.

title_en: Vehicle driving control method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle driving control method, a device, a system and a storage medium, wherein the vehicle driving control method comprises the steps of obtaining driving information and environment information of a vehicle, and determining whether to control a steering system of the vehicle to activate an output and input separation function or not at least based on the driving information and the environment information analysis when the vehicle collides with an obstacle so as to separate from a steering wheel of the vehicle and independently control the wheels to generate deflection of a target angle, wherein the target angle is an angle which can enable the obstacle to squeeze the wheels through rotating the wheels, drive the wheels to deflect transversely and further move towards a direction far away from the obstacle.

title_en: Control method and control system for automatic driving vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system for an automatic driving vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current position information of the vehicle, an automatic driving path and lane line length information on two sides in front; determining whether critical obstacles exist in front of the vehicle according to the length information, if so, acquiring the position information of the critical obstacles, judging whether the critical obstacles influence the traffic of the vehicle according to the current position information of the vehicle, the position information of the critical obstacles and the automatic driving path, and sending a control instruction to the vehicle according to the judging result. According to the invention, whether the critical obstacle exists or not is judged by utilizing the shielding state of the lane line, on the basis, whether the critical obstacle influences the traffic of the vehicle is further judged by combining the current position information of the vehicle, the position information of the critical obstacle and the automatic driving path, the obtained result is accurate, the false braking rate and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents are reduced, and the driving safety of the automatic driving vehicle can be greatly improved.

title_en: Directed graph construction and route selection methods, devices, equipment and media
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for constructing a directed graph, wherein in the up-down direction, corresponding up-going nodes and down-going nodes are constructed in the directed graph according to the position information of each axle counting section, each signal machine and each turnout respectively, the connection of each up-going node, the connection of each down-going node and the connection of a target up-going node and a target down-going node corresponding to each turning-back section are established, the weight between every two connecting nodes is set, the subsequent selection of a train route based on the directed graph is facilitated, the workload of a developer is reduced, the directed graph is a bidirectional graph with the up-down direction, and the subsequent requirement of the train route reverse can be realized based on the bidirectional graph.

title_en: Child cart and backrest assembly thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a baby stroller, wherein a frame of the baby stroller comprises a first bracket, a second bracket and a backrest component, wherein the backrest component comprises a backrest plate, a first connecting frame, a second connecting frame and a connecting rod component, the first connecting frame is arranged on the first bracket, the second connecting frame is arranged on the second bracket, and when the frame is in a unfolding state, the first connecting frame and the second connecting frame are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side of the backrest plate; when the frame is in a folded state, the first connecting frame and the second connecting frame are respectively folded relative to the backrest plate along the left-right direction, and the backrest plate moves downwards and is folded with the first connecting frame and the second connecting frame, so that the transverse size of the folded frame is greatly reduced, and the reduction of the overall size of the frame is facilitated.

title_en: Wheel speed signal analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheel speed signal analysis method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining a wheel speed test frequency according to a working frequency range of a wheel speed sensor, testing the wheel speed sensor according to a mechanical air gap of the sensor and the wheel speed test frequency to obtain a plurality of groups of single tooth error data, determining a wheel speed signal jitter value according to the plurality of groups of single tooth error data, and generating a signal analysis result of the wheel speed sensor based on the wheel speed signal jitter value. According to the invention, the wheel speed sensor signal is tested according to the mechanical air gap and the wheel speed test frequency to obtain single tooth error data, so that the wheel speed signal jitter value is calculated, and the wheel speed signal jitter value is analyzed, so that the precision and stability of the wheel speed sensor signal can be improved according to the wheel speed signal jitter value analysis result by a person skilled in the art.

title_en: High sea-adapting shipborne captive balloon system
