abstract_en: The invention discloses a high sea-adapting shipborne captive balloon system, which comprises a ship platform, wherein helium guarantee equipment and a stabilizing platform are arranged on the ship platform, the helium guarantee equipment can be used for inflating a sphere, the anchoring platform is connected with the stabilizing platform through a slewing bearing, a mooring rope collecting and releasing device and a guiding device are arranged on the anchoring platform, the stabilizing platform is used for ensuring that the anchoring platform can normally revolve when the ship platform is swayed under the influence of waves, the mooring rope collecting and releasing device can collect and release a mooring rope to compensate the heave displacement of the ship platform, and the guiding device can be used for guiding the mooring rope. The system has the characteristics of sea adaptability, long reserving time, quick maneuvering deployment and the like, can solve the problems of short monitoring duration and high cost of the existing offshore communication, and meets the functional requirements of offshore communication, search and rescue, offshore monitoring and the like.

title_en: Mobile engineering equipment data control management terminal and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile engineering equipment data control management terminal which comprises a fuel oil monitoring module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the fuel oil monitoring module is arranged at an oil tank of a current engineering vehicle and is used for acquiring the height of residual fuel oil in the oil tank; the vehicle data acquisition module is used for periodically acquiring the running state information and the real-time position information of the current engineering vehicle; the communication module is used for regularly communicating with the remote management master station; the energy storage module is electrically connected with the fuel oil monitoring module, the vehicle data acquisition module and the communication module respectively and is used for storing or releasing electric energy; the output end of the internal combustion engine is connected with an axle or an energy storage module of the current engineering truck, and the output torque drives the current engineering truck to run or converts mechanical energy into electric energy to charge the energy storage module; the vehicle-mounted ECU periodically wakes up the fuel monitoring module, the vehicle data acquisition module or the communication module and guides the output power of the internal combustion engine to an axle or an energy storage module of the engineering truck.

title_en: Data processing method, data processing apparatus, vehicle, and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method, a data processing device, a vehicle and a storage medium, and solves the problem of how to identify manual intervention behaviors such as power battery replacement and repair in the power battery state analysis technology. The method comprises the following steps: under the condition that a power battery of a vehicle is in a constant-current charging state, acquiring voltage values of all single batteries and state parameters corresponding to all the voltage values, selecting proper voltage data of all the single batteries according to the state parameters and relevant threshold values, and cleaning; determining the difference value between the current voltage value and the median of each single voltage according to the median of each single voltage; determining a difference value of each frame of monomer voltage according to the median difference value of each monomer, and further calculating and extracting a characteristic value; calculating a voltage boundary value by combining state parameters based on the differential value of each frame of the monomer voltage of the power battery; and determining whether manual intervention behaviors, specific intervention types and intervention moments exist or not by analyzing the comparison result of the voltage characteristic value and the voltage boundary value of each single battery.

title_en: Method and system for conditioning a vehicle battery interoperable with scheduled air conditioning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for conditioning a vehicle battery interoperable with scheduled air conditioning. The method comprises the following steps: determining, with a controller, whether a reserved departure time and a reserved air-conditioning execution are set after a vehicle is parked; determining, with the controller, whether battery regulation execution of the vehicle is set when it is determined that the reserved departure time and the reserved air conditioning are set; when the battery conditioning execution is set, air conditioning and battery conditioning of the vehicle are executed by the controller before a preset reference time of the reserved departure time.

title_en: Universal propeller protection device for double-wing aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal double-wing aircraft propeller protection device, and belongs to the technical field of aircraft propeller protection devices. The double-wing aircraft comprises a hub and blades, wherein the hub is arranged on a double-wing aircraft main body, and the blades are arranged on two sides of the hub; also comprises: the protective barrel is used for protecting the hub, and is positioned on the outer wall of the hub; the protective sleeve comprises a protective sleeve, a plurality of grooves and a plurality of connecting rods, wherein the grooves are formed in two sides of the protective sleeve; the long rod is arranged inside the groove; the dustproof cloth comprises a first dustproof cloth body and a second dustproof cloth body, wherein the first dustproof cloth body is provided with two dustproof cloth bodies, and the two dustproof cloth bodies are located at the upper end and the lower end of the protective cylinder. The invention solves the problems of complex operation and troublesome disassembly and assembly of the protective device in the prior art, effectively protects and prevents dust for the hub, the blades and the engine compartment by arranging the protective cylinder, the dustproof cloth on the long rod and the dustproof cloth I, and has simple operation and convenient and quick disassembly and assembly.

title_en: Insulation resistance control method and device for fuel cell automobile, vehicle and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fuel cell automobiles, in particular to an insulation resistance control method, an insulation resistance control device, a vehicle and a medium of a fuel cell automobile, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting an actual conductivity of the water thermal management loop; calculating an insulation resistance value of the fuel cell system according to the actual conductivity, and judging whether the insulation resistance value is smaller than a preset resistance value corresponding to the current working state of the fuel cell automobile; if the insulation resistance value is smaller than the preset resistance value corresponding to the current working state, controlling the deionization assembly to work according to the control strategy corresponding to the current working state, and controlling the deionization assembly to stop working until the insulation resistance value is larger than or equal to the preset resistance value corresponding to the current working state. Therefore, the problems that the insulation resistance of the fuel cell automobile is unstable, the ion concentration in a cooling loop is easy to rise, the conductivity is overlarge, the insulation resistance is reduced, potential safety hazards exist in automobile use and the like are solved.

title_en: Can open up many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle platform of receipts
abstract_en: The invention relates to a foldable multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle platform, belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and solves the problems that the folding automation degree of a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is low, and the storage space is not enough. The foldable multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle platform comprises a body part, a horn part, a propeller part, an undercarriage part, a horn folding part and a propeller folding and unfolding part; one end of the machine arm component is hinged on the periphery of the machine body component through a machine arm folding component; a plurality of machine arm components are uniformly distributed on the periphery of the machine body component in the horizontal plane; the propeller part is movably connected to the other end of the machine body part through the propeller folding and unfolding part, and the propeller part is folded or unfolded relative to the machine body part in a vertical plane; a landing gear member is connected to the lower end of the fuselage member. According to the invention, the horizontal folding of the arm controlled by the steering engine and the vertical folding and unfolding of the unpowered propeller are realized, the storage space of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reduced to the greatest extent, the energy is saved in the folding and unfolding process, and the automation degree is high.

title_en: Butyl rubber hot melt adhesive with good high temperature resistance, preparation method and automobile hole plugging patch applying butyl rubber hot melt adhesive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a butyl rubber hot melt adhesive with good high temperature resistance, a preparation method and an automobile hole plugging patch using the same, wherein the butyl rubber hot melt adhesive comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-18 parts of butyl rubber, 1-3 parts of ethylene propylene diene monomer, 2-4 parts of natural rubber, 11-17 parts of polyisobutylene, 10-15 parts of plasticizer, 32-50 parts of filler, 6-9 parts of terpene resin, 10-15 parts of bromotriazine, 4-7 parts of antimony trioxide, 1-3 parts of polyamide wax and 0.5-1.5 parts of antioxidant. The butyl rubber hot melt adhesive disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the thermodynamic stability, high temperature resistance, flame retardance and sagging resistance at high temperature of the butyl rubber hot melt adhesive are greatly improved; the preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in operation steps and high in implementation feasibility, does not need to additionally arrange other equipment in the production process, and is convenient for directly implementing production in the existing high-temperature-resistant flame-retardant hole plugging patch production line.

title_en: Magnetic encoder fault detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fault detection method and a device of a magnetic encoder, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first angular velocity and a second angular velocity of a position sensor at front and rear moments; obtaining a first angular velocity change rate according to the absolute difference value of the two angular velocities; acquiring a target electrical rotating speed of the position sensor at the current moment, and acquiring a second angular speed change rate according to a preset calculation model; and if the absolute difference value of the two angular speed change rates is greater than the threshold value within 10 moments, judging that the position sensor has a fault, and controlling the angle redundancy through the position-free sensor. The method judges whether the absolute difference value of the first angular speed change rate (the absolute difference value of the angular speed of the magnetic coding sensor at the front and the back two moments) and the absolute difference value of the second angular speed change rate (the target rotating speed coefficient (the adjustment and the same dimension of the angular difference value) exceeds the threshold value at 10 moments to judge whether the inductive control is abnormal, and cuts in the non-inductive control angle redundancy when the abnormality is detected, so that the reliability of the power sleeve is improved.

title_en: Aircraft steering engine for high heat flow area and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aircraft steering engine and a preparation method thereof, in particular to an aircraft steering engine for a high heat flow area and a preparation method thereof, and solves the defects that the strength and the rigidity of a rudder shaft are uncertain and the connection part of a horizontal rudder and a rudder cabin is seriously damaged due to the fact that the rudder shaft bears the excessive temperature of gap heat flow under the action of the gap heat flow in the prior art. The aircraft steering engine for the high heat flow area comprises a horizontal rudder, a rudder cabin and a rudder shaft, wherein one end of the rudder shaft is fixedly connected with the horizontal rudder, the other end of the rudder shaft is rotatably connected with the rudder cabin, and an outer heat insulation ring and an inner heat insulation ring are sleeved on the rudder shaft between the horizontal rudder and the rudder cabin; one end face of the outer heat insulation ring is fixedly connected with the bottom surface of the horizontal rudder, a first annular groove is formed in the position, surrounding the rudder shaft, of the other end face of the outer heat insulation ring, the inner heat insulation ring is arranged in the first annular groove, a second annular groove is formed in the outer surface of the rudder cabin, surrounding the rudder shaft, and the other end face of the outer heat insulation ring is matched with the second annular groove.

title_en: Frog-like jumping robot with adjustable energy storage and motion control method
abstract_en: An energy-storage adjustable frog-like jumping robot and a motion control method thereof comprise a driving device, a transmission device, an execution connecting rod mechanism and a triggering device; the transmission device comprises an output shaft, an input pinion, a reduction gear set, an output gear, a torsion spring and a torsion spring support, wherein the input pinion, the reduction gear set and the output gear are all rotatably arranged on the frame, the output shaft is connected with the output end of the driving device, the input pinion is connected with the output shaft and meshed with the reduction gear set, the reduction gear set is meshed with the output gear, the output gear is fixedly connected with the torsion spring support, the torsion spring is sleeved on the outer ring of the torsion spring support, two ends of the torsion spring are fixedly connected with the output gear and an input rod of the execution connecting rod mechanism respectively, the triggering device is arranged on the frame, and the execution connecting rod mechanism is separated from a dead point position to do leg extension jumping motion during actuation. The invention has the advantages of light structure, adjustable energy storage size and better controllability.

title_en: Follow-up folding built-in boarding ladder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a follow-up folding built-in boarding ladder which comprises an outer cylinder, a first inner cylinder, a second inner cylinder, a first pedal, a second pedal, a third pedal, a first supporting rod and a second supporting rod, wherein the upper end of the outer cylinder is hinged with an airplane, the left side of the lower end of the outer cylinder is hinged with the first pedal, the second inner cylinder can slide relative to the first inner cylinder, the first inner cylinder can slide relative to the outer cylinder, the second pedal is hinged with the right side of the lower end of the first inner cylinder, the third pedal is hinged with the left side of the lower end of the second inner cylinder, one end of the first supporting rod is hinged with one end of the second supporting rod, the other end of the first supporting rod is hinged with the front side of the lower end of the first inner cylinder, and the other end of the second supporting rod is hinged with the front side of the lower end of the outer cylinder.

title_en: Vehicle control method and device based on UWB technology, digital key and control terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle control method, a device, a digital key and a control terminal based on UWB technology, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining vehicle information and UWBID, and generating a key by combining the vehicle information and UWBID; and after receiving the UWB data, carrying out decryption matching on the UWB data by utilizing the key, and controlling the vehicle after finishing the decryption matching. According to the invention, the automatic unlocking and locking functions and other control functions are realized through UWB ranging, so that the keyless sensorless control vehicle is realized, and the timeliness and accuracy of unlocking and locking are improved.

title_en: Data processing method, device and medium for vehicle-mounted environment
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method, a device and a medium for a vehicle-mounted environment, wherein after a first vehicle-mounted data set and a pure data set in a noise-free environment are obtained, a vehicle-mounted pure data set aiming at the noise-free environment and a second vehicle-mounted data set aiming at the vehicle-mounted environment can be obtained through a voice synthesis mode according to the first vehicle-mounted data set and the pure data set, a third vehicle-mounted data set aiming at the vehicle-mounted environment is obtained according to the pure data set and the vehicle-mounted noise data contained in the first vehicle-mounted data set, and then a data set for a voice recognition model in the vehicle-mounted environment is obtained according to the first vehicle-mounted data set, the pure data set, the vehicle-mounted pure data set, the second vehicle-mounted data set and the third vehicle-mounted data set.

title_en: Independent corner module
abstract_en: A self-contained corner module is presented. An embodiment independent corner module includes: a knuckle unit positioned on an inner side surface of the wheel; a steering unit disposed to face the pillar coupled to the knuckle unit, the steering unit having a central shaft configured to be fixed to the vehicle body and configured to rotate around the central shaft; a guide rail configured to define a movement path along which the steering unit rotates and moves; and a rack steering unit positioned in the steering unit, secured to the knuckle unit and configured to apply a rotational force to the knuckle unit in response to movement in the longitudinal direction.

title_en: Attitude and orbit control comprehensive startup duration calculation method and apparatus
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for calculating attitude and orbit control comprehensive starting time, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the starting quantity and starting identification of an engine to determine the starting mode of the engine; and calculating the comprehensive starting time length according to the weighting coefficient and the starting mode. According to the method, the comprehensive starting time length is calculated by distributing different weighted parameters according to different starting modes, so that parameter adjustment is simple and flexible, the method is suitable for various spacecraft platforms under the condition of simple design, measurement and control software and the spacecraft platforms are not tightly bound, universality is good, application is convenient, unnecessary software change is reduced, and influence on safety of a software system is reduced.

title_en: Vehicle with a vehicle body having a vehicle body support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle, which comprises: a frame; the cab is arranged on the frame in a turnover way; the upper pedal comprises a main body section and a tread section, the main body section is positioned below the cab and is connected with the cab, and the tread section is exposed from the left side or the right side of the cab; the gear shifter is arranged in the cab; the gearbox is arranged on the frame and is positioned at the rear of the cab; the gear selecting and shifting flexible shaft assembly comprises a first section, a second section and a third section, one end of the first section is connected to the gear shifter and extends out of the cab from the front side of the cab, one end of the second section is connected with the other end of the first section and extends in the direction of an upward pedal, and two ends of the third section are respectively connected with the other end of the second section and the gearbox. The flexible shaft of the vehicle is larger in arrangement space, the follow-up requirement of the gear selecting and shifting flexible shaft assembly can be met, and interference between the gear selecting and shifting flexible shaft and other components is avoided.

title_en: Tunnel target detection and longitudinal control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel target detection and longitudinal control method, and belongs to the field of intelligent networking. The method utilizes the identification illuminance information, the vehicle information and the traffic sign attribute information acquired by the camera to detect the tunnel target, and performs longitudinal control of entering and exiting the tunnel scene without following the target and entering and exiting the tunnel scene with following the target. The invention adopts a pure vision scheme to replace the original camera and radar scheme, realizes the driving auxiliary function, reduces the cost of the whole vehicle, improves the comfort of the driver in using the self-adaptive cruising when entering and exiting the tunnel, and enhances the braking safety.

title_en: Electric propulsion system dynamic test platform for tilting electric aircraft
abstract_en: A dynamic test platform of an electric propulsion system for a tilting electric aircraft comprises a transmission shaft, wherein one end of the transmission shaft is provided with the electric propulsion system, the other end of the transmission shaft is connected with a first push-pull force sensor in a coupling mode, a static torque sensor is arranged on an installation base, the installation base is arranged on a first fixed seat in a sliding mode, the first push-pull force sensor is arranged on the first fixed seat, the first fixed seat is arranged on a driving device of a rotating assembly, the driving device is arranged on a second fixed seat, the second fixed seat is arranged on an X-axis installation seat in a horizontal sliding mode, the X-axis installation seat is arranged on a Y-axis installation seat in a vertical sliding mode, the second push-pull force sensor is arranged on the Y-axis installation seat, and a third push-pull force sensor is arranged on the X-axis installation seat. The test platform can be used for testing and evaluating system parameters in the horizontal, vertical and horizontal-to-vertical angle dynamic conversion process of the electric propulsion system, and simulates the mechanical acting force condition of the electric propulsion system on the electric aircraft fixing device under a complex stress state.

title_en: Unlocking mechanism suitable for seat adjustment and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an unlocking mechanism suitable for seat adjustment and a use method thereof, which can switch electric control and manual control adjustment functions by utilizing an unlocking handle and an adjusting handle, wherein a handle bracket of the unlocking mechanism is provided with a first handle assembly hole, a first unlocking handle assembly hole and a first tension spring assembly hole; the handle comprises a handle support, a handle assembly, a pull rope assembly, a lock tooth, an adjusting handle, a second unlocking handle assembly hole, a second tension spring assembly hole, a third handle assembly hole, a lock tooth and a second tension spring assembly hole, wherein a rectangular through groove is formed in the middle of one end of the handle support, the pull rope assembly is assembled in the rectangular through groove, the second handle assembly hole of the pull rope assembly is matched with the first handle assembly hole, the lock tooth is arranged on one side of the handle support, the first tooth is arranged on one surface of the lock tooth, the adjusting handle sequentially penetrates through the lock tooth, the handle support and the pull rope assembly, the unlocking handle is provided with the second unlocking handle assembly hole matched with the first unlocking handle assembly hole, and the second tension spring assembly hole is arranged below the second unlocking handle assembly hole and is provided with the second tooth matched with the first tooth.

title_en: Car assembly material loading AGV conveyor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile assembly loading AGV conveying device, which comprises an automobile assembly loading AGV conveying device, wherein the automobile assembly loading AGV conveying device comprises an automobile body, a supporting mechanism is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the automobile body, a plurality of lifting mechanisms which are distributed in a rectangular shape are fixedly arranged at the top end of the automobile body, a plurality of buffer mechanisms which are distributed in an annular shape are arranged in the lifting mechanisms, the invention utilizes the deflection of a second rotating arm and a first rotating arm of the supporting mechanism, so that the grinding wheels at the two ends of a swinging rod connected with the first rotating arm and the second rotating arm can be contacted with the ground, make auto-parts can keep stable during the material loading, utilize the normal running fit first articulated seat of the third screw rod of lifting mechanism and second articulated seat can deflect each other to and the axis of rotation can rotate for lifting mechanism can be according to the outside shape of car outside support come angle regulation, carry out stable support, compress the second spring when utilizing buffer gear's depression bar to remove, and stretch first spring, cushion auto-parts on the sleeve.

title_en: Detection unit, steering device, steer-by-wire steering system and detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection unit (7, 34) for detecting that a steering device (1, 33) exceeds a predetermined maximum steering angle, the detection unit having a triggering unit (13, 35) and having a signal transmission section (27, 39), wherein the triggering unit (13, 35) changes the signal transmission section (27, 39) with respect to the transmission of a signal when the predetermined maximum steering angle is exceeded.

title_en: Rack-driven power-assisted steering system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a rack-driven power assisted steering system comprising: a rack bar, an outer circumferential thread groove being provided on an outer circumferential surface of the rack bar; the ball nut is provided with an inner peripheral thread groove corresponding to the outer peripheral thread groove on the inner peripheral surface, and the bearing is combined on the outer peripheral surface of the ball nut; the nut pulley is provided with a supporting end part which is combined with the outer circumferential surface of the ball nut and is used for supporting a bearing at one end part of the inner circumferential surface of the nut pulley, a diameter expanding part is formed at the other end part of the inner circumferential surface of the nut pulley, the diameter expanding part and the supporting end part form a step, the inner diameter of the diameter expanding part is expanded, and a conveying belt combining part is arranged at the outer circumferential surface of the nut pulley.

title_en: Vertical electric tail plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical electric tail plate, which belongs to the technical field of truck lifting tail plates and structurally comprises a lifting assembly, a lower door assembly, a left inner column, a left outer column, an upper door sliding block, an upper door connecting rod, an upper door hinge support, a motor, a speed reducer, a gear box, an upper cross beam, an upper door assembly, a right inner column, a right outer column, a screw rod lower support bearing assembly, a lifting nut assembly, a screw rod, a lower door opening and closing rope, a lower door opening and closing nut assembly, an upper door opening and closing rope, an upper door opening and closing nut assembly, a lifting ring, a screw rod upper support bearing assembly and a stop ring. The invention discloses a novel vertical electric tail plate, which utilizes a screw rod transmission mechanism to respectively control lifting of a lower door, opening and closing of the lower door and opening and closing of an upper door through up-down operation of three nuts on the screw rod, wherein the lifting movement of the lower door is realized by driving the lower door component through a lifting component by a lifting nut component, the opening and closing movement of the lower door is realized by connecting the lower door opening and closing nut component to the lower door component through a rope, and the opening and closing movement of the upper door is realized by connecting the upper door opening and closing nut component to the upper door component through a rope. The invention has an external stop ring structure, and can manually control the opening and closing of the upper door. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the full-electric control and auxiliary manual control system is adopted, the operation is simple, the self-locking performance is good, the safety is high, the service life is long, the transmission is stable, the noise is low, and the compatibility with a truck is good.

title_en: Side-turning unloading system and unloading method
abstract_en: The invention provides a side-turning unloading system and a side-turning unloading method, comprising a frame; the side end of the carriage is rotationally connected with the frame; the car door is movably assembled to one side of the carriage through a linkage rod piece; a rollover wheel connected to one side of the carriage away from the vehicle door; the curved rail frame is arranged on the frame running path; the pinch roller structure is at least partially arranged on the curved rail frame and at least partially arranged on the frame, and the two parts are in rolling contact when the side-turning wheels travel along the path of the curved rail frame so as to keep the frame stable. The system is simple and quick to operate, safe and reliable. The unloading can be automatically finished, the labor is saved, the production efficiency is improved, and the safety risk is reduced; avoid the frame to turn on one's side, guarantee the steady of frame and the security of unloading.

title_en: Semitrailer carriage
abstract_en: The application provides a semitrailer planker relates to the semitrailer field, and it includes the plate body, and the side of plate body is equipped with a plurality of dismouting hole, and the dismouting hole is along controlling the direction and is passed through the plate body, and each dismouting hole parallel arrangement just is equidistant along the fore-and-aft direction, and the semitrailer planker still includes a plurality of bracing piece, and each bracing piece is suitable for pegging graft respectively in each dismouting hole, has the clearance between the lateral surface of bracing piece and the inner wall of dismouting hole. The support rods are inserted into the dismounting holes corresponding to the area right below the lower surface of the goods, the weight of the goods is borne by the plate body and the support rods right below the plate body, and the plate body has no large load outside the lower surface area of the goods, so that the dismounting holes corresponding to the outer side of the lower surface area of the goods are empty, the bearing strength of the area where the goods are distributed on the carriage is improved, the bearing strength of each position of the carriage is adjusted, the whole weight of the carriage is reduced, and the extra load of the semi-trailer is lightened; the disassembly holes are arranged along the short span direction of the carriage, so that the maximum bearing capacity of the carriage can be improved.

title_en: Automotive network partition architecture with fault mitigation features
abstract_en: An electrical power supply network for a set of electrical power consuming nodes is disclosed, the electrical power supply network having fault mitigation features. The network has two or more areas including two or more power consuming nodes, and at least one power switch (110, 120, 130, 140, 150) controlling the entry and exit of power into and from the areas. In case of a partial or complete failure of the power supply network, power is redistributed between the nodes of the area. The "emergency trigger" may result in the execution of a "last command" to maintain and/or execute a secure state.

title_en: Instrument panel structure with knee airbag
abstract_en: The invention provides an instrument panel structure with a knee airbag, which is provided with a knee airbag module (25) and a cover member (30). The cover member (30) is attached to the instrument panel lower (23) and includes a main body (71) and a locking portion (72). The center under cover (36) of the instrument panel lower member (23) is provided with an opening (82) and a cutout (83). The opening (82) is formed to allow the leg portion of the main body (71) and the locking portion (72) to be inserted. The notch (83) is formed to allow the leg to enter and prevent the locking part (72) from coming off.

title_en: Dead pig pickup truck
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dead pig picking vehicle which comprises a vehicle body, wherein wheels capable of steering are arranged at the outer bottom of the vehicle body, a pig shoveling conveying part is hinged to the front end of the vehicle body and used for shoveling and conveying dead pigs into the vehicle body, a liquid collecting box is arranged at the inner bottom of the vehicle body, a control valve is arranged at a liquid outlet at the bottom of the liquid collecting box, when the dead pigs are conveyed, liquid of the dead pigs can flow out by opening the control valve, and pollution caused by random dripping of the liquid when the dead pigs are conveyed is avoided. The dead pig picking vehicle provided by the invention is simple to operate, and dead pigs can be transported without using excessive manpower.

title_en: Vehicle seat control method, control device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a vehicle seat control method, a control device, a vehicle and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of vehicles. The vehicle seat control method includes: receiving a first control signal input by a user handheld terminal device; determining a first adjustment strategy of the vehicle seat from a preset first control signal-vehicle seat position mapping relation; according to a first adjustment strategy of the vehicle seat, the vehicle seat is moved forward to a first target position and the backrest of the vehicle seat is adjusted forward to a first target angle. According to the vehicle seat control method, the vehicle seat is remotely controlled before a passenger enters the vehicle, and the passenger can enter the rear evacuation space of the vehicle without waiting after opening the vehicle opening, so that unnecessary waiting time of the passenger can be reduced, and driving experience of the passenger can be improved.

title_en: Vehicle starting mode control method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application is suitable for the technical field of vehicles and provides a vehicle starting mode control method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a current target starting mode of a vehicle; and when the running state is determined to be an abnormal state, switching the target starting mode from the quick starting to the one-key starting. By adopting the method, the shortcut starting mode and the one-key starting mode are reasonably switched and controlled so as to be compatible with the shortcut and the driving safety of a driver when the driver uses the vehicle.

title_en: Dirt recovery system for underwater cleaning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sewage recovery system for underwater cleaning, which comprises an underwater recovery device and a solid liquid pump which are mutually communicated, wherein the underwater recovery device comprises a fixed plate, and a driving collection unit and an inactivation crushing unit which are respectively arranged at two ends of the fixed plate; the driving collecting unit comprises a hollow collecting bin with two open ends and a propeller with a filtering cover arranged in the collecting bin; the inactivation crushing unit comprises a hollow crushing bin with one end open and an electric crushing assembly, the collecting bin is correspondingly communicated with the crushing bin front and back, and a conveying pipe is arranged between the end part of the crushing bin and the solid-liquid pump; the electric crushing assembly comprises a crushing motor, a crushing cutter and a transmission piece, wherein the crushing motor is arranged above the crushing bin, the crushing cutter is arranged in the crushing bin in a rotating mode, and the crushing motor is connected with the crushing cutter through the transmission piece. The invention relies on the underwater cleaning robot, the underwater cleaning robot is connected with the underwater recovery device into a whole, and the cleaning process can recover the pollutants generated in the cleaning process while cleaning the ship body.

title_en: High-stability filtering device for indoor air pollution treatment and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air pollution treatment and discloses a high-stability indoor air pollution treatment filtering device and a use method thereof. The high-stability filter device for indoor air pollution control and the use method thereof can ensure portability of the device and stably place the device, so that the device can stably run.

title_en: Charging current control method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a charging current control method, a charging current control system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a charging demand current value of a vehicle end based on the sum of the maximum allowable charging current value of the vehicle-mounted battery and the consumption current of the high-voltage accessory; calculating a charging current value based on the charging demand current value, the maximum allowable charging current value of the pile end and the national standard quick charging limit value; obtaining a corresponding charging current coefficient based on the charging port temperature value obtained in real time; and obtaining an actual charging current value according to the charging current value and the charging current coefficient, and charging the vehicle-mounted battery based on the actual charging current value. According to the invention, the charging current value of the pile end is calculated by calculating the charging demand current value of the vehicle end, the charging coefficient is calculated according to the temperature value of the charging port, and the vehicle-mounted battery is charged according to the charging current value and the charging current coefficient, so that the current fault of the vehicle-end pile end caused by mismatching response of the charging current regulation is reduced, the charging efficiency is improved, and the charging duration is reduced.

title_en: Wire harness
abstract_en: The mode of the present disclosure provides a wire harness capable of improving a protection function of a wire member. A wire harness (10) according to one embodiment of the present disclosure includes a wire member (20), a tubular outer member (30) covering the outer periphery of the wire member (20), a1 st path limiting member (40) mounted on the outer periphery side of the outer member (30), and a2 nd path limiting member (50) mounted on the outer periphery side of the 1 st path limiting member (40). The 1 st path limiting member (40) has a1 st main body part (41) covering a part of the outer periphery of the exterior member (30), and a1 st insertion opening (42) formed by the two circumferential ends (44) of the 1 st main body part (41) and configured to be insertable into the exterior member (30). The 2 nd route restriction member (50) has a2 nd main body portion (51) covering a part of the outer periphery of the 1 st route restriction member (40), and a2 nd insertion port (52) formed by both circumferential end portions (54) in the 2 nd main body portion (51) and configured to be insertable into the 1 st route restriction member (40).

title_en: Bearing support plate, reduction gear and electric drive for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a bearing support plate which is of a generally annular structure with a central through hole, wherein the bearing support plate is provided with a relief notch extending a part of the bearing support plate in an axial direction, the relief notch connects the periphery of the annular structure and the central through hole, the relief notch is defined by a first wall and a second wall in a circumferential direction, and a guide part which is continuous with the first wall and protrudes towards the central through hole is formed on the bearing support plate. The invention also relates to a reduction mechanism comprising the bearing support plate and an electric drive for a motor vehicle comprising the reduction mechanism.

title_en: Bogie and steering system suitable for multiple tracks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of suspended track traffic, in particular to a bogie and a steering system suitable for various tracks, and aims to solve the problems that a sensor is needed to be used for positioning in the existing track width changing mode, and reliability and stability are insufficient. The bogie suitable for various tracks comprises a wheel tread changing mechanism, wherein the wheel tread changing mechanism comprises a walking assembly and a gear shifting assembly; the walking assembly comprises a walking wheel and a gear shifting guide wheel; the running wheel can swing in the plane of the axis of the running wheel, and the gear shifting guide wheel is connected with the gear shifting assembly; the gear shifting guide wheels are extruded by the rails and move, so that the gear shifting assembly is extruded to excite gear shifting, and the running wheels swing to enable the distance between the running wheels to be gradually reduced or increased along the running direction. According to the invention, gear switching is triggered by the track, friction during gear switching is reduced by swinging of the running wheels, and the reliability of track switching is improved.

title_en: Driving function switching method, driving function switching device, electronic device and computer readable medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a driving function switching method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable medium. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a driving configuration file, initial configuration information and driving state information; updating the initial configuration information based on the driving configuration file to obtain target configuration information; generating a driving communication registry based on the target configuration information; based on a driving communication registry, receiving a driving function switching request from a parking control terminal; based on the driving function switching request, switching the driving function of the target vehicle and updating the driving state information to obtain target driving state information; and sending the target driving state information to the parking control terminal for generating a driving function switching request again. This embodiment reduces the energy consumption of the target vehicle.

title_en: Hot dip galvanized DH steel, preparation method thereof and automobile structural member
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a hot dip galvanized DH steel, a preparation method thereof and an automobile structural member, and belongs to the technical field of steel preparation, wherein the hot dip galvanized DH steel comprises a steel substrate and a galvanized layer attached to at least part of the surface of the steel substrate; the microstructure of the steel matrix comprises ferrite, martensite, bainite and retained austenite, wherein the martensite comprises fresh martensite and tempered martensite, and the volume fraction of the fresh martensite in the microstructure of the steel matrix is less than 10%. According to the hot dip galvanized DH steel, the contents of fresh martensite and tempered martensite in the microstructure of the steel matrix of the hot dip galvanized DH steel are controlled, most of the fresh martensite in the microstructure of the steel matrix is converted into tempered martensite, and the volume fraction of the fresh martensite is less than 10%, so that the hardness difference between ferrite and martensite is reduced, and the aim of improving the local forming performance of the hot dip galvanized DH steel is fulfilled.

title_en: Orderly automatic charging method for bus station and station system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bus station ordered automatic charging method and station system, comprising the following steps: 1) Acquiring the residual electric quantity of an automatic driving vehicle to be charged in a bus station, and determining the charging duration of the vehicle according to the residual electric quantity; 2) Taking 0 as the charging start time of different vehicles, taking the charging duration of different vehicles as the charging end time of corresponding vehicles, and taking the charging start time and the charging end time of corresponding vehicles as the charging interval of the vehicles; 3) And arranging the charging intervals from long to short according to the interval duration to form a maximum compatible set, waking up vehicles corresponding to the charging intervals according to the sequence of the charging intervals in the maximum compatible set when the charging intervals are idle, setting the idle charging intervals as destinations, and automatically driving the vehicles to the corresponding charging intervals for charging after the initialization of the charging vehicles is completed.

title_en: Method and apparatus for automatic vehicle control
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for automatic vehicle control, the method for automatic vehicle control comprising: acquiring a first acceleration signal of a vehicle and a second acceleration signal of the vehicle; inputting the first acceleration signal into a first filter to generate a third acceleration signal, inputting the second acceleration signal into a second filter to generate a fourth acceleration signal, and enabling the phase delay characteristics of the third acceleration signal and the fourth acceleration signal to be the same; and determining the ramp angle according to the third acceleration signal and the fourth acceleration signal. The ramp angle is determined by the two paths of acceleration signals with the same phase delay characteristics, so that the problem of ramp estimation errors caused by different phase delay characteristics can be solved, and the instantaneity and the accuracy of the ramp angle estimation are improved. And the cooperative control method of the target torque is combined, so that shaking in the starting and stopping process of the vehicle is reduced, the time required for starting and stopping the vehicle is shortened, and the driving experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Seat assembly for vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a seat assembly for a vehicle and the vehicle, and the seat assembly comprises a base, a backrest, a shoulder support, a first adjusting device and a second adjusting device, wherein one end of the backrest is pivotably arranged on the base, the shoulder support is rotatably arranged on the other end of the backrest, the first adjusting device is arranged on the backrest and is suitable for driving the shoulder support to rotate relative to the backrest, and the second adjusting device is arranged on the backrest and is suitable for driving the backrest to rotate relative to the base. According to the application, the first adjusting device is arranged to drive the shoulder supporting piece to rotate relative to the backrest so as to realize the shoulder adjusting function of the seat assembly, and the second adjusting structure is arranged to drive the backrest to rotate relative to the base so as to realize the backrest adjusting function of the seat assembly, so that the first adjusting device and the second adjusting device are simple in structure and convenient to arrange.

title_en: Thermoelectric separation power battery pack and automobile
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermoelectric separation power battery pack which comprises a battery cell module, an isolation insulating sheet, a circuit integrator and an insulating clamping cover, wherein the battery cell module comprises a plurality of single battery cells, the isolation insulating sheet is provided with a plurality of isolation through holes, the circuit integrator is arranged on the isolation insulating sheet, the insulating clamping cover is clamped on the battery cell module in a coating mode, one side of the insulating clamping cover is provided with a plurality of insulation through holes, an explosion-proof valve is arranged on each single battery cell, the isolation through holes correspond to the explosion-proof valve, and when the insulating clamping cover is clamped on the battery cell module, the insulation through holes are communicated with the isolation through holes. According to the thermoelectric separation power battery pack and the automobile, thermoelectric separation of the power battery pack can be achieved, and safety of the power battery pack is improved.

title_en: Bidirectional expansion decontamination cabin and decontamination vehicle for radioactive contamination personnel and decontamination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bidirectional expansion decontamination cabin for radioactive contamination personnel, a decontamination vehicle and a decontamination method, wherein the bidirectional expansion decontamination cabin for the radioactive contamination personnel comprises a cabin body, a cabin top, a cabin tail and a cabin tail plate, wherein the bidirectional expansion decontamination cabin comprises the following components: the cabin body is internally provided with a nuclear contamination decontamination spray head and a water storage tank, and the nuclear contamination decontamination spray head is connected to the water storage tank through a pipeline; the cabin roof is arranged at the top of the cabin body through soft connection, the cabin roof is driven by a pushing and lifting mechanism to lift at the top of the cabin body, the cabin tail is arranged at the tail of the cabin body in a pushing and pulling manner, the top of the cabin tail plate is hinged to the tail of the cabin roof, and the cabin tail plate is driven by a cylinder to be opened. The bidirectional expansion decontamination cabin for the radioactive contamination personnel can rapidly decontaminate the radioactive contamination personnel; the bidirectional expansion radioactive contamination personnel decontamination vehicle has the characteristics of miniaturization, rapid movement and air transportation, and can expand the use space by more than 60% in use, and can rapidly decontaminate more than 100 radioactive contamination personnel per hour.

title_en: Monitoring system, monitoring method and readable storage medium for electronic parking function
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring system and a monitoring method for an electronic parking function. Before unlocking or locking, the off path is always in a trigger state; before unlocking or locking is ready to be executed, the function monitoring layer sends a signal to the shutdown path module to release the shutdown path; after the off path is released, the functional layer driving motor finishes unlocking or locking; after unlocking or locking is completed, the function monitoring layer sends a signal to the shutdown path module to trigger the shutdown path to enter a safe state in advance, so that better safety is achieved. According to the invention, after locking/unlocking is completed, the drive is closed from the circuit by triggering the off path, and the safe state is entered, so that unexpected unlocking/locking is avoided. The invention realizes the monitoring strategy without depending on the outside, thereby greatly shortening the response time after the fault; most designs can be reused, and the cost is low; the requirements on fault diagnosis time and monitoring threshold are low, and the method has better robustness.

title_en: Underwater robot docking recovery device and operation method
abstract_en: The underwater robot docking and recovering device mainly comprises a base, a swinging hydraulic cylinder, a bottom plate, a hydraulic holding claw, an acoustic-optic guiding communication device, a hydraulic valve box, an electronic cabin and the like. The vertical sitting type docking recovery mode is adopted, the hydraulic holding claw capturing type docking recovery mode is adopted, the acoustic beacon and the optical lamp array guiding mode are utilized to enable the autonomous submersible to approach the docking recovery device for sailing, the docking posture of the autonomous submersible is obtained in real time through acoustic and optical communication equipment, before the autonomous submersible approaches the docking device, the vertical height is gradually changed until the autonomous submersible reaches the docking recovery effective range, the hydraulic holding claw is driven to be rapidly closed, the autonomous submersible is clamped under the guiding action of the arc-shaped structure of the holding claw, and when the clamping force detected by the force feedback sensor reaches a preset value, the hydraulic cylinder is automatically stopped to act, the locking state is maintained, and the recovery of the autonomous submersible is completed.

title_en: Underwater target detection equipment and method and floating raft
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses an underwater target detection device, an underwater target detection method and a buoyant raft, wherein the underwater target detection device comprises: the device comprises a floating raft and a near-bottom detection towed body, wherein the near-bottom detection towed body is connected with the lower part of the floating raft through a bearing cable; the buoyant raft is in communication connection with the operation ship; the floating raft is provided with a depth finder, a first positioning module, a first power supply module and a first communication module; the near-bottom detection towed body is provided with a second positioning module, a second power supply module, a second communication module and a detection sensor; the near-bottom detection towed body is reserved with a plurality of installation positions of equipment; in the water surface moving process, the near-bottom detection towed body is towed by the bearing cable, so that the near-bottom detection towed body performs target detection at the preset distance from the bottom to the bottom, and the distance from the bottom to the near-bottom detection towed body is the distance from the near-bottom detection towed body to the bottom.

title_en: Hybrid vehicle heat management system and hybrid vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid electric vehicle heat management system and a hybrid electric vehicle, wherein the hybrid electric vehicle heat management system comprises a battery assembly, a motor electric control assembly, an engine assembly, a refrigeration cycle assembly, a first heat exchanger, a second heat exchanger, a temperature adjusting device, a first four-way assembly, a second four-way assembly and a third four-way assembly, the refrigeration cycle assembly comprises a compressor and a flash evaporator, the first heat exchanger, the second heat exchanger and the flash evaporator all comprise a first pipeline and a second pipeline which can exchange heat with the first pipeline, and the first four-way assembly, the second four-way assembly and the third four-way assembly all comprise a first port, a second port and a third port which can control any two of the first port, the second port and the third port to be communicated.

title_en: Control method and device for improving frequency characteristic of large inertia rudder system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method and a control device for improving the frequency characteristic of a large inertia rudder system, belongs to the technical field of aircraft control, and solves the problem that the volume and the weight of a rudder system are increased and the requirement of a high-speed aircraft cannot be met by matching the rotational inertia of a motor with the rotational inertia of a control surface load through a large motor or increasing a reduction ratio in the conventional method. The method comprises the following steps: judging whether the rudder system performs rapid movement; when the rudder system moves rapidly, determining whether the rudder system is in a normal tracking state or in a hysteresis tracking state through track prediction; predicting a hysteresis error amount when the rudder system is in a hysteresis tracking state; and dynamically enhancing the control parameter to increase rudder system bandwidth based on the trajectory prediction and the amount of hysteresis error. On the premise of not changing system hardware, the frequency characteristic of the large inertia rudder system is improved by adopting a track prediction and dynamic enhancement control algorithm, and the requirements of high altitude high-speed aircrafts on quick response and high bandwidth of the rudder system are met.

title_en: Combination of a refrigerant accumulator and an internal heat exchanger for a refrigerant, connecting part, internal heat exchanger and accumulator
abstract_en: A refrigerant accumulator (14) and internal heat exchanger (16) combination (10) including a central portion (12) having fluid portions (24, 26), the accumulator (14) and heat exchanger (16) being attachable to the central portion (12). A connection part comprising at least four fluid ports (24, 26) and to which parts of a refrigerant circuit, in particular an accumulator (14) and/or a heat exchanger (16), can be mounted on at least two opposite sides.

title_en: Barrier capable of meeting high-load compression working condition and mounting device thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a barrier device capable of meeting a high-load compression working condition and an installation device thereof, wherein the barrier device capable of meeting the high-load compression working condition comprises a barrier removing assembly for removing barriers at the front end of a vehicle body, the barrier removing assembly comprises a first barrier body, two second barrier bodies with the same structure are symmetrically arranged at two ends of the first barrier body, and each second barrier body is obliquely arranged towards one side close to the vehicle body; at least one supporting beam is arranged on the inner end face of each second barrier-removing body, one end of each supporting beam far away from each second barrier-removing body is connected with a supporting seat, one side of each supporting seat far away from each supporting beam is detachably connected with a connecting component, and one end of each connecting component far away from each barrier-removing component is detachably connected with the vehicle body; the device has the beneficial effects of simple structure, easy disassembly, strong flexibility and capability of meeting the working condition of large load compression; the method is suitable for the technical field of railway vehicle equipment.

title_en: Insulator pollution detection device based on hyperspectral camera
abstract_en: The invention discloses an insulator pollution detection device based on a hyperspectral camera, which comprises an unmanned plane, a detection assembly and a protection assembly. The invention is provided with a cleaning pipe and a driving component, wherein wind flow generated by a fan blade of the driving component can rapidly dissipate heat of a detection main body to prevent the detection main body from being damaged due to high temperature generated by work, an air inlet end of the cleaning pipe is positioned below the fan blade, an air outlet end of the cleaning pipe is positioned at the edge of a detection lens of the detection main body, the cleaning pipe transmits hot air to the detection lens to blow off dust on the lens, meanwhile, the surface of the lens is prevented from generating water mist due to low temperature to ensure the detection effect during insulator pollution detection, in addition, an anti-collision plate, a first spring, a second spring, a third spring, a fixing shell, a limiting plate, a sliding rod and a buffer plate are arranged on the outer side of the detection main body, and when two sides of the detection main body are impacted by foreign objects, the first spring, the second spring and the third spring are mutually matched to absorb impact force generated during the impact of the foreign objects to protect the detection component.

title_en: Braking force adjusting and controlling device and method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of braking control, in particular to a braking force adjusting control device and method and a vehicle, wherein the braking force adjusting control device comprises the following components: the device comprises an air reservoir, a foot brake valve and an electric control relay valve group. The inlet end of the foot brake valve is communicated with the air reservoir; the electric control relay valve group comprises a valve group relay valve, a normal control pipeline and a standby control pipeline, a relay air inlet end is communicated with the air storage cylinder, and a relay air outlet end is connected with the brake pipeline; the normal control pipeline is provided with a normal control electromagnetic valve, the inlet end of the normal control pipeline is communicated with the outlet end of the foot brake valve, and the outlet end of the normal control pipeline is communicated with the relay control valve port; the inlet end of the standby control pipeline is communicated with the air reservoir, the standby control pipeline is communicated with the relay control valve port, and when the normal control electromagnetic valve is disconnected, the discharge pressure of the relay air outlet end is controlled. The problem that in the prior art, the ABS has no braking force redundant control, when an ABS system fails, the ABS system is controlled according to the pressure of the output end of a foot brake valve, and the risk of wheel locking exists during vehicle braking can be solved.

title_en: Automatic driving vehicle and remote control request method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an automatic driving vehicle and a remote control request method thereof. Exemplary embodiments of the present application provide an autonomous vehicle including: a processor configured to determine whether the autonomous vehicle is in a state capable of performing remote control when remote control of the autonomous vehicle is required, and request the control system to perform remote control when the autonomous vehicle is in a state capable of performing remote control; and a communication device configured to communicate with the control system under control of the processor.

title_en: Towed underwater robot and navigation depth setting control method thereof
abstract_en: A towed underwater robot and a navigation depth setting control method thereof belong to the technical field of underwater robot control. The depth-setting control method aims at solving the problem of accurate depth-setting control of the underwater robot. The invention discloses a towing type underwater robot, which is characterized in that a communication module and an industrial personal computer are arranged in a sealed cabin, a detection device, an underwater depth sensor, a propeller, a lifting mechanism and a power supply are arranged outside the sealed cabin, the industrial personal computer is connected with the communication module, the detection device, the underwater depth sensor, the propeller, the lifting mechanism and the power supply, the power supply is connected with the detection device, the underwater depth sensor, the propeller and the lifting mechanism, the propeller is a vertical plane propeller and is used for realizing the heave motion of the towing type underwater robot, the detection device is used for receiving and sending signals, and the underwater depth sensor is used for detecting underwater depth data. The invention realizes the depth control under the complex environment by installing the propeller on the vertical plane of the towing type underwater robot to realize the up-and-down adjustment, gives out a dynamic model, designs the active disturbance rejection depth-fixing controller and realizes the depth control function.

title_en: Hinged floating structure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a floating structure comprising a plurality of interconnected frames and a plurality of buoyancy members supporting the structure, wherein the frames are substantially triangular in plan. Adjacent triangular frames may be movably, in particular pivotably, connected. The triangular frames may comprise right triangles, isosceles triangles, or regular triangles. The floating structure may support a facility, such as a solar farm. The invention also relates to a triangular frame for use in such a floating structure.

title_en: Marine propeller
abstract_en: Marine propeller (10) for a propulsion system of a vessel (20), the propeller comprising a plurality of detachable blades (2) and being configured to be fixed to a propeller shaft (4) of the propulsion system of the vessel, wherein the detachable blades (2) forming the propeller (10) are configured to be fixed to an end surface of the propeller shaft (4) or an end surface of a flange (5) formed at an end of the propeller shaft. The invention also relates to a marine propulsion system and a marine vessel (20) using such a marine propeller (10).

title_en: Front structure of vehicle body
abstract_en: A vehicle body front structure which suppresses entry of a travel motor into a vehicle cabin during a collision while sufficiently securing a crush stroke during the collision in the front-rear direction. A vehicle body front structure (A) is provided with a bulkhead (71) that defines a vehicle interior space (R1), a motor arrangement portion (71 a) that is formed by bulging a portion of the bulkhead (71) toward the vehicle interior, a panel reinforcement (100) that is provided on the vehicle interior surface of the bulkhead (71) and that has a portion that extends in the vehicle width direction so as to surround at least a portion of the periphery of the motor arrangement portion (71 a), and a center reinforcement (96) that is provided on the vehicle interior surface of the bulkhead (71) and that extends from the vehicle width direction intermediate portion of the panel reinforcement (100) toward the vehicle rear.

title_en: Whole vehicle semi-active suspension control method, system, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for controlling a semi-active suspension of a whole vehicle, a vehicle and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of vehicle suspension control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring and analyzing a vehicle signal to obtain a vehicle control parameter; judging the roll control state of the current vehicle according to the vehicle control parameters; if the current vehicle belongs to a steady-state roll control state, determining a steady-state roll control damping force according to vehicle control parameters; if the current vehicle belongs to the transient roll control state, determining whether the current vehicle is in the limit ground grabbing control state according to the vehicle control parameters; if the current vehicle is not in the limit ground grabbing control state, determining a transient roll control damping force according to the vehicle control parameters; if the current vehicle is in the limit ground grabbing control state, determining a limit ground grabbing control damping force according to the vehicle control parameters; and determining a shock absorber control target current according to the steady-state roll control damping force, the limit grip control damping force or the transient roll control damping force and the road surface characteristic.

title_en: Base and child safety seat
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a base and a child safety seat, and relates to the field of child safety seats. The base comprises a base body, an ISOFIX assembly, a release driving piece and a release pull rope, wherein the ISOFIX assembly comprises a latch and a connecting piece which are connected, the latch is used for locking a vehicle seat, the release driving piece is arranged on the base body, one end of the release pull rope is connected with the connecting piece, and the other end of the release pull rope is connected with the release driving piece, wherein the release driving piece is used for pulling the release pull rope, and the release pull rope pulls the connecting piece to move so as to enable the latch to move and release the vehicle seat, the latch is used for releasing the vehicle seat in a latch mode by pulling the release pull rope through the release driving piece, the disassembly efficiency of the seat is greatly improved, the disassembly complexity of the seat is reduced, and the disassembly convenience of the child safety seat is improved.

title_en: Method, device and system for determining endurance mileage, electric vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric automobiles, in particular to a method, a device, a system, an electric automobile and a storage medium for determining a endurance mileage. Then, a historical driving sequence of the electric automobile is obtained, and an effective driving sequence is determined according to the historical driving sequence, wherein the historical driving sequence comprises historical driving information arranged in time sequence, and each piece of historical driving information corresponds to mileage and energy consumption. And determining historical average energy consumption according to the effective driving sequence. And finally, determining the endurance mileage according to the historical average energy consumption, the real-time average energy consumption and the available residual energy. The effective driving sequence is updated according to the continuous accumulation of the historical driving sequence, so that the historical average energy consumption can reflect the average energy consumption performance of the recent electric automobile, and the estimation accuracy of the continuous voyage mileage can be improved.

title_en: Cabin air extraction assembly and method for a vehicle
abstract_en: A cabin air extraction assembly for a vehicle utilizes an air extractor input port disposed at the rear of the vehicle cabin that directs cabin air to a vent assembly disposed within a sealed or substantially sealed body panel or side structure, such as near the rear wheel well of the vehicle. The vent assembly includes a one-way relief valve. Because the vent tube assembly is positioned such that it is not prone to being blocked or ingress of water in wading applications, there is no risk of water ingress into the vehicle cabin even if the bottom of the vent tube assembly is below the wading line during vehicle operation. Thus, the cabin air extraction assembly and associated method facilitate passenger comfort by allowing the HVAC system of the vehicle to operate using fresh outside air without creating cabin pressure problems, even during wading applications.

title_en: Emergency braking circuit of railway vehicle and railway vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency braking circuit of a railway vehicle and the railway vehicle, wherein the circuit comprises: two emergency brake circuits of the same structure, symmetrically connected and respectively positioned on the head car and the tail car, each emergency brake circuit comprises: the emergency brake control device comprises a control loop, an execution loop and an emergency brake relay, wherein the control loop and the execution loop are connected in parallel, the control loop is connected with a plurality of brake non-release relays in series, the execution loop is connected with a plurality of brake release relays and electromagnetic valves in series, and the emergency brake relay is connected in series in the control loop and the execution loop; any brake does not relieve the relay to open, the rail vehicle applies the emergency brake which does not relieve before stopping; any brake release relay is opened and the rail vehicle applies the emergency brake released before stopping. The method is used for solving the defect that whether emergency braking can be relieved before stopping is difficult to distinguish in the prior art, and the speed is not required to be reduced to zero when the emergency braking of the railway vehicle caused by non-vehicle faults is relieved, so that the running efficiency of the motor train unit is effectively improved.

title_en: Steering control mechanism for vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vehicle steering control mechanism, includes axle assembly and spacing subassembly, the axle assembly includes first axis body, second axis body and outer tube, first axis body is used for being connected with the steering wheel, the second axis body with first axis body coaxial coupling, and with steering wheel synchronous motion, the second axis body with spacing subassembly is connected, spacing subassembly is used for the restriction steering wheel rotatory number of turns, the outer tube with first axis body with second axis body coaxial coupling, the second axis body install in the outer tube, spacing subassembly at least partial package is located in the outer tube, can restrict the rotation number of turns of steering wheel, guarantee to use and experience, and whole small, be convenient for arrange.

title_en: Hydraulic system of water supply and drainage vehicle and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydraulic system of a water supply and drainage vehicle and a control method thereof, wherein a first oil cylinder is communicated with a hydraulic oil tank through an oil way and is used for driving an arm support mechanism on the water supply and drainage device to slide in a telescopic manner so as to be close to a water taking point or far from the water taking point; the second oil cylinder is communicated with the hydraulic oil tank through an oil way and is used for driving a multi-stage first telescopic drain pipe of a first water supply and drain mechanism on water supply and drain equipment to slide in a telescopic manner so as to be close to a water supply point or far from the water supply point; and the oil way communication mechanism is used for communicating an oil way between the first oil cylinder and the second oil cylinder, so that the first oil cylinder drives the cantilever crane mechanism on the water supply and drainage device to stretch and slide and simultaneously unlock the second oil cylinder, the cantilever crane mechanism drives the second oil cylinder to stretch and slide simultaneously, and the second oil cylinder drives the multistage first telescopic drain pipe of the first water supply and drainage mechanism to stretch and slide when stretching.

title_en: Two-switch function activation assembly and method for preventing accidental activation
abstract_en: A two-switch function activation assembly and a method of preventing accidental activation. A switch assembly (22) for a vehicle includes a first switch (40) and a second switch (46) adjacent the first switch. Actuation of one of the first switch and the second switch can be independent of actuation of the other switch. A switch actuator (24) presents a surface inside the vehicle for a user to press/contact to selectively actuate the first and second switches. The processor (50) is configured to initiate a communication function, such as an emergency call, based on determining when the first switch (40) and the second switch (46) have been actuated in a predetermined manner, including the first switch and the second switch being actuated simultaneously or independently within a predetermined time.

title_en: System and method for sipe pattern
abstract_en: A tire tread is provided. The tire tread includes a plurality of tread elements positioned on a tire tread surface to include a tread pattern. The tire tread further includes a plurality of grooves disposed between the plurality of tread elements. The tire tread is provided with a first set of sipes extending from a longitudinal axis of the tire tread and toward a first edge of the tire tread at a first non-zero angle relative to a lateral axis of the tire tread.
