The tire tread is also provided with a second set of sipes extending from the longitudinal axis and toward the first edge of the tire tread at a second non-zero angle relative to the lateral axis, the second set of sipes intersecting the first set of sipes.

title_en: Storage battery mounting structure and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of batteries of electric automobiles, and particularly discloses a storage battery mounting structure and a vehicle. The invention has simple structure, convenient disassembly and assembly and high material utilization rate, and can simultaneously install a plurality of storage batteries with different specifications so as to meet the requirements of different starting forces of the electric automobile, thereby having more practicability.

title_en: Vehicle control device
abstract_en: When the vehicle control device executes the steering reaction force control, the vehicle control device sets the steering reaction force provided for the steering operation in the direction of changing the lane of the vehicle to a reaction force smaller in value than the reaction force of the reference value when changing the lane of the vehicle. When a vehicle approach condition is satisfied that another vehicle traveling on a lane on the side where the own vehicle is to make a lane change approaches the own vehicle from behind and is traveling, the vehicle control device does not set the steering reaction force provided for the steering operation in the direction where the own vehicle is to make a lane change to a reaction force smaller than the reference value.

title_en: Self-adaptive adjustable lift force simulation device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of landing gear drop tests, and particularly relates to a self-adaptive adjustable lift force simulation device. The device comprises a gas tank (1), an inner cylinder (2), a piston (3), a piston rod (4), a flexible air bag (5) and a small air chamber (6); the inner cylinder (2) is fixed in the gas tank (1), the piston (3) is positioned in the inner cylinder (2), the inner cylinder (2) below the piston (3) is communicated with the inner cavity of the gas tank (1), and a piston rod penetrates through the gas tank (1) of the inner cylinder (2) and is connected with the test body (15) outside the gas tank (1) through an elastic connecting piece (14); the small air chamber (6) is connected to the outer side of the air tank (1) and is connected with the inner cavity of the air tank (1), the flexible air bag (5) is positioned in the small air chamber (6), the flexible air bag (5) is provided with an air bag exhaust valve (8), and the flexible air bag (5) is connected with the air tank (1) by an air source (10). The application can obviously improve the lift simulation accuracy in landing gear drop test and aircraft complete machine drop test.

title_en: Commercial vehicle lane keeping control method considering roll stability
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobiles, in particular to a commercial vehicle lane keeping control method considering roll stability, which comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a vehicle dynamics model required by the research of transverse control and stability control, researching the control mechanism of the transverse control and the roll stability control of a vehicle and creating conditions for the construction of related controllers; secondly, designing a lane keeping controller of the commercial vehicle based on a related vehicle dynamics model and a vehicle state and combining with improved MPC, and calculating an optimal control amount to realize lane keeping control; finally, a commercial vehicle roll stability controller is designed based on the differential braking principle, wherein the upper controller is used for calculating an additional yaw moment required by the vehicle to maintain stability, and the lower controller is used for selecting a target braking wheel and calculating the target braking moment based on the differential braking principle. The invention solves the technical problems of poor lane keeping and roll stability control effects of the commercial vehicle and easy instability of the vehicle in the prior art.

title_en: Automobile charging flap structure and automobile
abstract_en: An automobile charging port cover structure and an automobile relate to the technical field of electric automobile accessories. The automobile charging port cover structure comprises a charging port box body (1), a hinge box body (2), a hinge box cover plate (3) and an actuator (4), wherein the hinge box body (2) is connected to the side wall of the charging port box body (1), the hinge box body (2) comprises a first accommodating cavity with a first opening, the hinge box cover plate (3) is detachably matched with the hinge box body (2), the hinge box cover plate (3) is used for being covered on the first opening, one end of the actuator (4) is connected with the charging port box body (1), and the other end of the actuator (4) is embedded on a body mounting metal plate of an automobile. Through setting up the executor on the car panel beating, reduced the transverse dimension of car charge flap structure, through the independent demolding of hinge box body and hinge lid board split, can reduce the degree of depth of car charge flap structure to it is great to have solved car charge flap overall dimension among the prior art, occupy and arrange the space and insert the poor problem of robbery man-machine perception.

title_en: Heat pump compressor and heat pump system for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heat pump compressor for a new energy automobile, which comprises an air inlet section, a body section and an exhaust section, wherein an air inlet is arranged on the air inlet section; the exhaust section is provided with an exhaust port, the exhaust port is connected with a condenser in the heat pump system, the compressor is provided with a hot gas bypass assembly, and the hot gas bypass assembly comprises: the upper end of the mixing cavity is connected with an air suction port which is connected with an evaporator in the heat pump system; and one end of the bypass branch, which is far away from the exhaust section, is connected with the mixing cavity. The gas-liquid separator in the system can be replaced by the arrangement of the mixing cavity; the liquid part entering from the air suction port is stored at the bottom of the mixing cavity due to gravity, so that liquid can be prevented from directly entering the compressor to cause liquid impact, and the liquid at the bottom of the mixing cavity is vaporized along with the temperature rise, so that the liquid can enter the compressor along with the air entering from the air suction port, the liquid is prevented from being accumulated, and the liquid impact is further avoided.

title_en: Heat management method, device and system for battery replacement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat management method, a heat management device and a heat management system for a battery. The battery is changed into a battery with insufficient power after the vehicle end discharges and a battery with full power after the station end charges, the battery with insufficient power exchanges with the battery with full power at the station end to realize power exchange, the battery with proper temperature range for discharging and proper temperature range for charging is provided at the vehicle end, the thermal management module of the battery at the vehicle end is provided at the station end, and the thermal management module of the battery at the station end is provided at the station end; the thermal management method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring temperature information of a power-deficient battery and a full-power battery, and determining the temperature of the power-deficient battery and the temperature of the full-power battery; before power exchange, controlling a vehicle-end battery thermal management module to adjust the temperature of the battery with insufficient power to a proper temperature range for charging; and/or before the power is replaced, the control station side battery thermal management module adjusts the temperature of the full-power battery to a proper discharge temperature range. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can reduce the cost of the whole vehicle and improve the battery turnover rate of the battery.

title_en: Active derailment prevention device for clamping rail constraint type high-speed railway train
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active derailment prevention device of a clamping rail constraint type high-speed railway train, which comprises a fixed seat, a rail pressing wheel frame, a clamping arm, a rail pressing wheel and a rail clamping wheel; the fixing seat is provided with a cross groove, two ends of a transverse groove of the cross groove are respectively and elastically provided with a rail pressing wheel frame, a pair of clamping arms which are positioned in a longitudinal groove of the cross groove and can be opened and closed are hinged between the two rail pressing wheel frames, the rail pressing wheels are arranged at the bottom of the rail pressing wheel frame, and rail clamping wheels are arranged at the tail ends of the clamping arms. The fixing seat is fixed on the bottom plate of the side beam of the bogie of the train, and the device does not influence the normal running of the train. When derailing tends, under the premise that the rail pressing wheels press the top surface of the rail, the two rail clamping wheels simultaneously clamp and buckle the two sides of the top of the rail, so that the omnibearing rapid and safe braking is realized, and the stable stop of the train on the rail is ensured. When the train is running normally, the wheel bogie is reset upwards, the rail pressing wheels are separated from the top surface of the rail, the rail pressing wheel frame is restored to the initial state downwards, and the clamping arms are opened to the initial state, so that the normal running of the train is not affected.

title_en: Sliding door threshold device and automobile comprising same
abstract_en: The application provides a sliding door threshold device and an automobile comprising the same, wherein the sliding door threshold device comprises a side wall outer plate; the front section of the threshold outer plate is higher than the rear section of the threshold outer plate in height, and is provided with a first vertical edge; the guide rail box is arranged at the rear section of the threshold outer plate and is positioned at the transverse inner side of the threshold outer plate, an opening of the guide rail box faces to the transverse outer side, a sliding door guide rail is hung on the top plate, a second vertical edge is arranged on the top wall of the opening of the guide rail box, and the second vertical edge is in parallel butt joint with the first vertical edge in the front-rear direction and is used for forming a sealing edge; the door sill inner plate is arranged on the inner side of the transverse direction of the door sill outer plate, and the sliding door sill device can realize a smooth and flat sliding door main sealing structure and an attractive door opening effect.

title_en: Child safety seat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a child safety seat which has forward and reverse use states, wherein the child safety seat comprises a base, a seat body rotatably arranged on the base and a state indicating piece rotatably or slidingly arranged on the base, the state indicating piece at least has first indicating information and second indicating information, an indicating window is arranged on the base, one of the first indicating information and the second indicating information can be aligned with the indicating window by the action of the state indicating piece relative to the base, when the child safety seat is in the forward and reverse use states, the first indicating information is aligned with the indicating window, and when the child safety seat deviates from the forward and reverse use states, the second indicating information is aligned with the indicating window. In the reversing process of the child safety seat, whether the child safety seat is in a forward or reverse use state can be judged according to the information indicated by the state indicator, so that the problems that the seat body is not rotated in place and the installation of the seat body is unstable can be avoided, and the safety of the child safety seat can be improved.

title_en: Steering lock shell collapsing mechanism and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a steering lock shell collapsing mechanism and a vehicle, wherein the collapsing mechanism comprises a lock shell assembly, a lock shell cover plate and a guide piece, the lock shell assembly is coated on the outer side of a steering column assembly and is positioned between the steering wheel assembly and an instrument board assembly, a first end of the lock shell cover plate is movably connected with the instrument board assembly, a second end of the lock shell cover plate is abutted against the outer surface of the lock shell assembly, the guide piece is fixed on the inner side of the lock shell cover plate, and the lock shell assembly is used for abutting against the guide piece when being extruded along the axial direction of the steering column assembly so as to enable the second end of the lock shell cover plate to move in a direction away from the outer surface of the lock shell assembly. The application can reduce the reverse impact of the lock shell cover plate on the steering wheel assembly, thereby greatly reducing the secondary injury of the steering wheel assembly to the driver when the vehicle collides accidentally.

title_en: Coaxial bilateral operation spacer
abstract_en: The application discloses a coaxial double-side operation spacer iron, which relates to the technical field of transportation steel rails and comprises a double-side operation spacer iron, a rollaway nest steel beam, a first upright post, a second upright post and a rocker, wherein the double-side operation spacer iron is arranged on the rollaway nest steel beam, the rollaway nest steel beam is arranged on the first upright post and the second upright post, the first upright post and the second upright post are fixed on a rail transportation vehicle, the rollaway nest steel beam can be rotated around the first upright post for 90 degrees to open, and a cross-shaped bulge is arranged at the connecting end of the rocker. The application has reasonable structure, realizes the composition of the spacer iron, the spacer iron shaft, the spacer iron operating lever and the like, the spacer iron is welded and fixed with the spacer iron shaft, the spacer iron operating lever is fixed on the upright post through the mounting plate and is connected with the spacer iron shaft through the connecting shaft, the spacer iron operating lever can drive the spacer iron shaft to rotate 90 degrees, the spacer iron can be flatly placed and lifted, and the spacer iron operating lever can be locked during the lifting process to prevent the spacer iron from being freely flatly placed.

title_en: Foldable miniature solar unmanned aerial vehicle of many flight modes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-flight-mode foldable miniature solar unmanned aerial vehicle which adopts a vector double-rotor wing flying wing layout, wherein flexible solar panels are arranged on the upper surfaces of a fuselage and wings, one side surface of the wings is rotatably connected with one side surface of the fuselage, and the wings are driven to unfold or fold around the fuselage through a second steering engine. The multi-flight mode comprises a hovering mode, a low-speed accompanying flight mode, a high-speed flat flight mode, a perching charging mode, a take-off mode and a landing mode, and different flight modes or combinations of different flight modes can be selected according to different task demands. Based on the above, the flight control intelligent management control system can complete autonomous decisions including flight state alternation, whole-machine appearance maintenance, autonomous landing decisions, autonomous charging decisions and the like.

title_en: Wireless charging system of automobile mobile phone and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a wireless charging system of an automobile mobile phone and a control method thereof, wherein a second adjusting assembly is rotationally connected to a first adjusting assembly; the first adjusting assembly is used for rotating the second adjusting assembly in the length direction of the vehicle at a rotating point; the second adjusting component is rotationally connected with the support frame, the support frame rotates in the vehicle width direction at a rotation point, the support frame is arranged at the bottom of the wireless charging panel, and an installation space is arranged in the support frame; a wireless charging module is arranged in the installation space; the above structure can make the wireless charging panel rotate leftwards and rightwards and also rotate forwards and backwards; the first adjusting component and the second adjusting component are controlled simultaneously according to the generation control instruction of the automatic adaptation of the detection information of the road surface, so that the posture adjustment of the wireless charging panel is realized, and the wireless charging panel is always in a horizontal stable state, so that the wireless charging panel cannot fall off, namely, the vehicle can automatically adjust to be in a horizontal state when running under the conditions of turning and uneven road surface, and the modeling design is convenient to carry out.

title_en: Electric and gas-electric dual power driving device
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric and gas-electric dual-power driving device which comprises a first power system, a second planetary gear mechanism, an output member, a second power system, a first planetary gear mechanism, a clutch assembly and a brake assembly, wherein the first power system comprises a first electric machine and a first gas motor, the second power system comprises a second electric machine and a second gas motor, the first planetary gear mechanism is connected with the second planetary gear mechanism, the second planetary gear mechanism is connected with the output member, and the engagement of the clutch assembly and the brake assembly is selectively controlled to provide a continuous transmission ratio between the first electric machine and/or the second gas motor and the output member. The invention adopts a reasonable mixing mode by the mixed power composed of the pneumatic power and the electric power, so that the advantages of the two power systems are complemented.

title_en: Vehicle control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a vehicle control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the vehicle is in a sliding state, acquiring an initial speed of the vehicle; determining a target vehicle speed of the vehicle at the current moment based on the initial vehicle speed, the actual vehicle speed of the vehicle at the current moment and the target vehicle speed of the vehicle at the moment which is the last of the current moment; comparing the target speed of the vehicle at the current moment with the actual speed of the vehicle at the current moment, and determining the ramp scene of the vehicle according to the comparison result; the output torque of the power source of the control vehicle is a target recovery torque matched to the ramp scenario. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the intensity of the sliding energy recovery can be adaptively adjusted according to different ramp scenes.

title_en: Driver assistance system and driver assistance method
abstract_en: The driver assistance system includes: a camera having a front view of the vehicle and acquiring image data, a radar having a surrounding detection view of the vehicle and acquiring radar data, and a control unit electrically connected to the camera and the radar; the control unit predicts a future travel path of the own vehicle based on the image data and/or the radar data and based on a traveling direction of the own vehicle, predicts a future travel path of the own vehicle based on a traveling direction of the crossing vehicle traveling in a direction crossing the traveling direction of the own vehicle, determines a point where the future travel path of the own vehicle crosses the future travel path of the crossing vehicle as a predicted collision position, estimates whether or not a driver of the crossing vehicle has a route giving intention when the crossing vehicle approaches the predicted collision position, and prevents collision with the crossing vehicle based on the route giving intention of the driver of the crossing vehicle.

title_en: Operating vehicle position positioning technical scheme for customizing travel traffic system
abstract_en: The technical scheme of the position positioning of the running vehicle of the customized travel traffic system fully utilizes the existing conditions that the distance between the track supports supporting the non-roadbed track is close and the track supports extend over all corners of the running vehicle, changes each track support into a 'position positioning datum point', sets unique 'address codes' in the customized travel traffic system and accurately measures the position coordinates in a 'traffic position system'. Any "position locating datum point" of the "monograph" approach can be used for calculating the accurate position of the running vehicle through the vector product of the datum point accurate coordinate parameter plus the vehicle running vector speed and time increment. According to the technical scheme, the existing equipment of the system is fully utilized, the positioning accuracy in the movement is high, the aim of the invention is achieved, the structure is simple, the implementation is easy, the operation is reliable, and the system can be widely applied to customizing travel traffic systems.

title_en: Car body side wall structure, tail lamp assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle, in particular to a vehicle body side wall structure, a tail lamp assembly and a vehicle, and aims to solve the problem that a black edge area of an existing tail lamp is visible and a pure luminous area is difficult to present to a user. For this purpose, the vehicle body side wall structure is used for installing a tail lamp assembly, the tail lamp assembly is provided with a black edge area, the vehicle body side wall structure comprises a side wall outer plate and a tail lamp mounting plate, the tail lamp mounting plate is fixedly connected with the side wall outer plate, the tail lamp mounting plate forms a tail lamp mounting cavity, the tail lamp mounting cavity is provided with an inner cavity, one end of the inner cavity is provided with an end opening, and the tail lamp mounting cavity is configured such that the height of the end opening is smaller than the height of the inner cavity, so that the black edge area of the tail lamp assembly is hidden in the tail lamp mounting cavity. Under the condition of adopting the technical scheme, the invention achieves the tail lamp modeling of the pure tail lamp without the peripheral non-luminous area, and simultaneously achieves a finer visual effect, thereby improving the modeling freedom degree and improving the aesthetic perception of users.

title_en: Mountain transportation vehicle-mounted object cabin structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain transportation vehicle-mounted object cabin structure, and relates to the technical field of mountain transportation vehicles. The mountain transportation vehicle-mounted object cabin structure comprises a vehicle head and an object cabin body, wherein a protective impact fence is arranged at the bottom of the vehicle head in a surrounding manner, the protective impact fence is formed by welding 6-10cm steel plates, the front side of the protective impact fence is integrally connected with a collision part, the outer wall of the object cabin body is provided with a lifting mechanical arm for loading and unloading cargoes, and the two side edges of the front end of the protective impact fence are provided with open-circuit mechanisms; the carrying cabin body is arranged at the rear side of the vehicle head, the bottom of the carrying cabin body is surrounded by the protective impact fence, and the vehicle head and the carrying cabin body are formed by welding steel plates with the thickness of 2.5-3.5 mm. This mountain region transportation vehicle-mounted object cabin structure can be when causing vibration between power equipment and the transport vechicle because of jolting to hoist and mount, transport power equipment and the transportation on the transport vechicle, provides the buffering protection for power equipment and the object cabin body that carries, alleviates the impact vibration between the two.

title_en: Ground contactor and method of operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for operating a rail vehicle having a ground contact (20), a ground contact and a monitoring system, wherein the rail vehicle has a ground contact on a wheel set having a wheel axle and a wheel, wherein the ground contact has a housing unit (22), a contact device (26) and a sensor device (61), wherein the contact device has a contact piece (28) arranged on a contact surface of the wheel axle, wherein an electrical sliding contact is formed between the contact surface and the contact piece, wherein the ground contact comprises a measuring unit having a measuring device (63), wherein at least one sensor (65) of the sensor device (61) of the measuring device is arranged on and/or adjacent to the contact device, wherein a measured value of the contact device is detected by means of the sensor device, wherein the measured value is processed by means of a processing device (62) of the measuring device, and a characteristic value is determined which describes the operating state of the wheel set and/or the rail.

title_en: Subway ventilation air conditioner drainage mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway ventilation air conditioner drainage mechanism, which relates to the technical field of subway ventilation and comprises a carriage and ultraviolet lamps, wherein an air conditioner body is arranged on the upper surface of the carriage, a flow guide pipe is communicated with the side wall of the air conditioner body, a water storage tank is communicated with the other end of the flow guide pipe, the water storage tank is fixedly connected with the carriage, a liquid level sensor is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the water storage tank, an electromagnetic valve is communicated with the side wall of the water storage tank, a controller is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the water storage tank, and the liquid level sensor and the electromagnetic valve are both electrically connected with the controller.

title_en: Control method, control system and computer readable medium for vehicle steer-by-wire
abstract_en: The application relates to a control method, a control system and a computer readable medium for vehicle steer-by-wire. The control method of the vehicle steer-by-wire comprises the steps of obtaining an operating torque of a steering wheel, obtaining a value of a target torque output to a steering gear according to the operating torque and a transmission ratio, and outputting the target torque, wherein the target torque is a product of the operating torque and a first transmission ratio A1 when the corresponding vehicle speed is lower than a first speed, the target torque is a product of the operating torque and a second transmission ratio A2 when the corresponding vehicle speed is between the first speed and a second speed, the target torque is a product of the operating torque and a third transmission ratio A3 when the corresponding vehicle speed is higher than a second speed, and the relation among the first transmission ratio A1, the second transmission ratio A2 and the third transmission ratio A3 is a transmission ratio of a planetary gear mechanism, wherein A1 = 1+alpha, A2 = alpha, A3 = 1+1/alpha, and alpha is greater than 1.

title_en: Equipment for increasing down force of automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment for increasing downward pressure of an automobile, which relates to the technical field of automobiles and comprises an automobile chassis, wherein an air compressor is arranged at one end of the automobile chassis, a high-pressure air tank is arranged at the other end of the automobile chassis, and the air compressor and the high-pressure air tank are communicated through a conducting pipe. According to the invention, the high-pressure gas stored in the high-pressure gas tank is discharged through the gas outlet main pipe, and is split into the gas flow pipes at four corners through the split pipes, and is sprayed out through the outlets of the gas flow pipes, when the automobile chassis is in a sharp-turn or large-angle ascending slope, the high-pressure gas at the gas outlets of the four gas flow pipes can enable the automobile to generate an extra downward pressure, so that the friction between the tires of the automobile chassis and the ground is increased, and the problem that the automobile body is inclined to a certain side due to the sharp-turn or the sharp-turn, so that the tail of the automobile body is thrown, and the tires on a certain side of the automobile are separated from the ground, so that the automobile is turned over, and a larger traffic accident is caused is avoided.

title_en: Intelligent cabin starting method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent cabin starting method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of controlling an intelligent cabin of a vehicle to enter a standby state from a deep sleep state through a shallow sleep state under the condition that a user is detected to enter a first area distant from the vehicle, starting a first timer to count time, controlling the intelligent cabin to enter a temporary sleep state from the standby state through the shallow sleep state under the condition that the user is detected not to enter a second area distant from the vehicle and the count time of the first timer is smaller than or equal to a first preset time, and controlling the intelligent cabin to enter the standby state from the temporary sleep state through the shallow sleep state if the user is detected to enter the second area under the condition that the count time of the first timer is longer than the first preset time and smaller than a second preset time, wherein the power consumption of the intelligent cabin is sequentially increased from the deep sleep state, the temporary sleep state and the shallow sleep state to the standby state.

title_en: New energy vehicle utilizing solar energy for energy storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy vehicle utilizing solar energy to store energy, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein a solar panel is arranged on the vehicle body, a motor electrically connected with the solar panel is arranged in the vehicle body, the motor is connected with a first transmission rod, the first transmission rod is respectively connected with an automobile input shaft and an energy storage structure input end in a transmission way, the energy storage structure comprises a first substrate and a second substrate, at least one group of torsion spring components are arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate, each torsion spring component comprises a first ratchet wheel and a first limiting wheel, a torsion spring is arranged between the first ratchet wheel and the first limiting wheel, the first ratchet wheel is positioned on the first substrate, a first pawl is arranged on the first substrate, the first limiting wheel is positioned on the second substrate, the first limiting component is positioned on the second substrate, and the energy storage structure output end is in transmission connection with the automobile input shaft. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the mechanical energy storage structure is realized to replace the chemical energy storage of the lithium battery.

title_en: Low-impact ejection mechanism for releasing and recovering tethered satellites
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-impact ejection mechanism for releasing and recovering tethered satellites, which comprises at least one ejection assembly, wherein the ejection assembly comprises a sub-satellite, an ejection module, a locking module, a tethered retraction module and a speed limiting module. The invention can realize ejection release and recovery locking of the subsatellite, can be repeatedly used for ground simulation experiments of tethered satellite release and recovery, is beneficial to adjusting the attitude of the subsatellite and completing recovery, can eject and separate the subsatellite according to a certain speed, can not generate too large resistance during recovery locking, can autonomously and repeatedly perform ejection-recovery experiments through a control system, and can automatically lock the speed limiting module according to a set acceleration value so as to avoid impact during release of the subsatellite.

title_en: Anti-carsickness control method and device, vehicle, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The specification provides a carsickness prevention control method, device, vehicle, medium and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a target carsickness prevention mode selected by a user from a plurality of carsickness prevention modes, enabling the plurality of carsickness prevention modes to correspond to different carsickness inducements respectively, and enabling corresponding carsickness prevention facilities in the vehicle based on the target carsickness prevention modes. By the method, the user is prevented from entering the carsickness state.

title_en: Hinged safety hanging device
abstract_en: The present invention provides an articulating safety hitch that is a more reliable and flexible alternative to conventional hitch and spherical traction systems for long-term use in light to heavy traction, thereby improving safety, longevity, strength, usability and ease of manufacture. Instead of a single ball typically used in conventional hitch and ball traction systems, the articulating safety hitch of the present invention can move in all directions, the bearings are widely separated, and do not bind or slip. Furthermore, the articulating safety hitch of the present invention is easy to construct and uses available existing components as wear items such as existing trailer tongue and ball-joint designs.

title_en: Vehicle driving control system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of driving control, in particular to a vehicle driving control system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a driving control module and an adjusting module, wherein the data acquisition module, the data processing module, the driving control module and the adjusting module are used for acquiring driving information data of an unmanned vehicle in real time when the unmanned vehicle runs on a curved slope, processing the driving information data, acquiring a safe direction driving data packet and an abnormal direction driving data packet of the vehicle in the curved slope according to a processing result, carrying out driving control on the driving speed and the driving angle of the unmanned vehicle in the curved slope according to the safe direction data packet and the abnormal direction driving data packet, generating a driving alarm signal according to the driving control data packet, adjusting the driving information data of the unmanned vehicle in the curved slope according to the driving alarm signal, and adjusting the safe driving direction and the driving speed of the unmanned vehicle on the curved slope.

title_en: Method and device for identifying connection state of connection device and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for identifying the connection state of a connecting device and a vehicle, and the vehicle, wherein the method for identifying the connection state of the connecting device and the vehicle comprises the following steps: acquiring view information of the position of a vehicle connection port; and confirming the connection state of the vehicle connection device and the vehicle according to the view information. Under the condition that the connecting device is connected with the vehicle, a signal for reminding a user to take down the connecting device after parking can be sent, the problem that the oil gun or the charging gun is damaged when the vehicle drags the gun is avoided, and the driving safety is ensured on the basis of improving the recognition rate of the connecting state of the connecting device and the vehicle.

title_en: Air purification method and air purification device in rail transit vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an air purification method and an air purification device in a rail transit vehicle, which are used for determining the air pollution degree in a passenger room in real time according to passenger room air detection data and determining the filter screen pollution degree of a return air filter screen in real time according to unit air detection data; when the air pollution degree is monitored to exceed a first preset threshold value, controlling first air purifying equipment to purify air in the mixed air chamber; after the first air purifying device is controlled to purify the air in the mixed air chamber, the second air purifying device is controlled to purify the air in the air supply cavity according to the air pollution degree or the filter screen pollution degree. Therefore, the air conditioner controller can timely and accurately monitor the air pollution degree in the passenger room and the filter screen pollution degree in the air conditioner unit, and automatically control the air purifying equipment to respectively perform air purification on the mixed air chamber and the air supply cavity according to the air pollution degree and the filter screen pollution degree so as to ensure the air quality safety of the passenger room.

title_en: Display device, energy management system, and schedule display method
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a display device, an energy management system, and a schedule display method. A portable terminal functioning as a display device is provided with: a 1 st acquisition unit that acquires a 1 st time table indicating a time period during which the predetermined power storage device is charged or discharged; a 2 nd acquisition unit that acquires a 2 nd time table indicating a time period in which a demand response for charging or discharging of the power storage device is scheduled; and a display unit for displaying the schedule screen. The display unit displays the 1 st schedule and the 2 nd schedule on the schedule screen at the same time so as to be identifiable.

title_en: Lane departure early warning processing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and a device for processing lane departure warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of updating a local map by using road side equipment in the driving process, collecting the width of a vehicle body, coordinates of a mass center point, linear speed, acceleration and included angles of a driving direction at a moment t, determining approaching and departing lane lines and an outermost offset point based on the departure state of the vehicle and the driving direction of a lane, predicting the transverse distance (d  s1,t 、d s2,t ) between the outermost offset point and the approaching lane line after the vehicle moves in a uniform circumferential movement mode or a uniform straight movement mode according to collected data, collecting the running state of a vehicle-mounted system and the driving-in state of an adjacent lane close to the lane line at d  s1,t ≤d s2,t , obtaining a vehicle data set of the adjacent lane by using the road side equipment, identifying the lane departure warning state based on the obtained data, and warning the identification state. The invention can improve the early warning real-time performance and the early warning precision.

title_en: High-voltage device mounting structure for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention provides a high-voltage device mounting structure of a vehicle, which can properly protect a high-voltage device or a housing thereof by a relatively simple structure at the time of collision of the vehicle. A first inclined portion (41) and a second inclined portion (11) which are inclined inward in the vehicle width direction as it goes rearward are provided on a surface (40 c) of a cover member (40) covering an opening (34) of a housing (30) which is outward in the vehicle width direction and a surface (10 d) of a side frame (10) which is inward in the vehicle width direction, respectively. At least a part of the first inclined portion (41) and the second inclined portion (11) are located at positions opposite to each other, and the degree of inclination of the first inclined portion (41) is greater than that of the second inclined portion (11), and the rear end portion (40 b) of the first inclined portion (41) in the cover member (40) extends to a position rearward of the joint surface (35) with the cover member (40) in the housing (30).

title_en: Automobile charging flap assembly and electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile charging flap assembly and an electric automobile, and belongs to the technical field of automobiles. Through being equipped with at least one bolster on the rotor arm to when the rotor arm drives the lid and rotates, the rotor arm drives the sustainable extrusion casing of bolster rotation, when the lid was opened to the biggest angle process, last compress tightly between casing and the bolster, realize the linear absorption to the impact energy, can not shake when the lid is opened to the biggest position, and does not have more obvious striking sound, promotes the comfort that the user used.

title_en: Loading method and device for fuel cell engine, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loading method and a loading device of a fuel cell engine, a vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the loading method of the fuel cell engine comprises the following steps: obtaining a target required current; and comparing the target required current with a current loading threshold value, and adjusting the current loading rate of the fuel cell engine according to the comparison result so as to load the current of the fuel cell engine to the target required current, wherein the current loading threshold value is the maximum limit value of the current loading current of the fuel cell engine. The technical scheme provided by the invention is used for reducing the influence of loading on the fuel cell engine.

title_en: Door frame decoration assembly of vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a door frame decoration assembly of a vehicle and the vehicle, wherein the door frame decoration assembly comprises: the bottom of the door frame decorative strip is open and is provided with an accommodating groove, and the accommodating groove extends along the length direction of the door frame decorative strip; the sealing strip, the part of sealing strip is established in the holding tank, and the sealing strip has head end portion and tail end portion, all is equipped with first limit structure between head end portion and the holding tank, all is equipped with second limit structure between tail end portion and the holding tank. According to the invention, the head and tail limiting constraint of the sealing strip can be realized through the first limiting structure and the second limiting structure, the phenomenon that the door frame decorating strip and the sealing strip are moved in the using process of the vehicle can be prevented, the step difference between the door frame decorating strip and the sealing strip caused by the self tolerance or assembly factors is eliminated, the problems of poor appearance and poor quality feeling caused by the step difference are solved, and the appearance effect is ensured.

title_en: Low-power-consumption operation method and terminal of charging pile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-power-consumption operation method and a terminal of a charging pile, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the charging main control board detects the communication condition of each module in the charging pile in real time, when communication abnormality occurs, the charging pile is controlled to enter a low-power consumption mode, otherwise, the charging main control board detects whether a gun inserting signal of a charging gun changes every preset time, and if the gun inserting signal does not change, the charging pile is controlled to enter a sleep mode; after the charging pile enters the sleep mode, if the charging main control board detects whether the gun inserting signal changes in real time, if so, the charging pile is controlled to exit the sleep mode and enter normal operation; repeating the steps, and adjusting the preset time for detecting the gun inserting signals at intervals before the next day enters the sleep mode according to the working information and the sleep information of the current day of the charging pile. The invention can effectively save the power consumption of the charging pile, and simultaneously realize the intelligent adjustment of the time of the charging pile entering into dormancy, thereby improving the intelligent design of the charging pile.

title_en: Two-way carrying robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned mine cars, and particularly relates to a bidirectional carrying robot. The bidirectional carrying robot includes: the chassis comprises two sets of power units, and the two sets of power units respectively drive the front wheels and the rear wheels; and the bidirectional discharging mechanism is arranged on the chassis. The invention adopts two sets of power units to drive the front wheel and the rear wheel respectively, can switch the front wheel drive, the rear wheel drive and the four-wheel drive according to the actual working conditions, and can adapt to more complex working conditions. The power unit comprises a motor and a gearbox, so that the problem of insufficient power can be solved, and the loading capacity can be improved. The bidirectional unloading mechanism can realize bidirectional unloading.

title_en: Crawler tensioning device of crawler type hydraulic excavator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crawler tensioning device of a crawler hydraulic excavator, which relates to the technical field of crawler tensioning and comprises a crawler wheel frame, crawler wheels, a crawler, a fixed seat, a fixed cylinder, an elastic supporting sleeve, an empty-avoiding groove and a floating seat, wherein the floating seat is provided with a tensioning riding wheel capable of freely rotating, and the tensioning riding wheel is in rolling contact with the crawler; the driving unit is used for driving the elastic supporting sleeve to generate elastic shrinkage deformation when the tensioning supporting wheel is subjected to downward extrusion force; and the buffer unit is arranged in the fixed cylinder and is used for buffering the elastic supporting sleeve when the elastic supporting sleeve elastically contracts. The buffer unit is used for generating elastic expansion deformation for the elastic supporting sleeve generates upward elastic propping force for the tensioning riding wheel, and then the tensioning riding wheel is used for generating elastic propping force for the crawler belt, so that the crawler belt can be tensioned, compared with the prior art, the tensioning mode is carried out by adopting a spring singly, the fatigue loss is reduced, and the service life of the tensioning device is prolonged.

title_en: Industrial chain system for generating liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen by geothermal well temperature difference chip
abstract_en: An industrial chain system for generating liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen by geothermal well temperature difference chip mainly comprises six parts: the system comprises a geothermal transformation part, a geothermal temperature difference chip power generation part, a large energy storage power station, a liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen preparation part by catalytic electrolysis, a liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen storage and transportation allocation part and a hydrogen fuel cell power generation part in a mining area; an artificial trap is cut in a geothermal transformation part of an air mining area, air is communicated with the artificial trap through an air compressor and a supercharger, and an outlet of the artificial trap is communicated with a geothermal temperature difference chip power generation part in a device building to generate power by utilizing temperature difference; the electric energy generated by the power generation part of the geothermal temperature difference chip is subjected to frequency modulation and pressure regulation through a large energy storage power station and then is connected into a liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen preparation part for catalytic electrolysis to produce liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen; the liquid oxygen and the liquid hydrogen enter a hydrogen fuel cell stack for generating electricity through a liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen storage and transportation allocation part. The invention creates an industrial chain for producing liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen with low cost, and can continuously provide low-price liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen green energy for the market.

title_en: Intelligent control method for vehicle seat, intelligent cabin and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle seat intelligent control method, an intelligent seat, an intelligent cabin and a vehicle, comprising the following steps: executing corresponding seat movement instructions according to the preset priority; acquiring a seat position when the scene mode is first entered, and after the seat position changes or the scene mode is switched, restoring the seat position to the position when the scene mode is first entered: the personalized driving position is configured, the seat position memory calling instruction is received, and the corresponding seat position memory calling instruction is executed. The invention divides the control modules aiming at seat adjustment, defines the priority and the control logic, adjusts the seat percentage of the SOA service and adapts to different user demands. Meanwhile, the driving position of the seat can be recommended by combining big data, the scene modes are switched without exiting the scene mode first and entering a new scene mode, the operation steps of a user are saved, and the scene mode interface of the central control screen is optimized.

title_en: Electric power steering system and aligning device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile steering alignment, in particular to an electric power steering system and an alignment device thereof, comprising an alignment device, wherein the alignment device comprises a steering rod, an adjusting mechanism arranged on the steering rod, and an alignment mechanism arranged on the adjusting mechanism, wherein the adjusting mechanism comprises a containing part arranged on the steering rod and an adjusting part arranged on the steering rod, the alignment mechanism comprises an alignment part arranged on the adjusting part, and a power storage part arranged on the alignment part.

title_en: Low-noise sea door device
abstract_en: The application relates to a low noise sea chest device, includes: the submarine box is used as a main body frame, a grid door is arranged on one side, close to a ship body, of the submarine box, an in-box partition plate is fixedly arranged in the middle of an inner cavity of the submarine box, an in-box reinforcing rib is arranged on one side, far away from the ship body, of the inner cavity of the submarine box, and a sound absorption wedge is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the submarine box; porous medium materials are laid on the plate wall surfaces of the partition plates in the box and the reinforcing ribs in the box. According to the device provided by the embodiment of the application, the underwater sound absorption material can be a porous medium material, a sound absorption wedge and the like, and can effectively absorb noise. The porous medium material water flow can penetrate, large-scale vortex is avoided, the reinforcing rib plate machine partition plate is prevented from being directly impacted by the water flow, noise can be effectively reduced, the sound absorption wedges belong to polyurethane matrix materials, sound waves can be oscillated back and forth between the wedges, the sound energy consumption is increased, and the efficient noise elimination effect is achieved.

title_en: Pneumatic heat protection structure of ultra-low orbit aircraft solar cell array
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of satellite heat protection, and particularly relates to a pneumatic heat protection structure of a solar cell array of an ultra-low orbit aircraft. And (3) carrying out a substrate protection design and a single battery protection design on the front surface of the solar cell array, and carrying out an electric connector and grounding resistor protection design and a diode protection design on the back surface of the solar cell array. Through ground test verification and on-orbit verification, the protection effect of the patent design on the front and the back of the solar cell array is remarkable, the solar cell array can be effectively protected at a higher temperature caused by pneumatic friction in the process of 160 km-120 km derailment, and the solar cell array can be ensured to work normally in the severe environment of an ultralow orbit.

title_en: Drunk driving prevention safety management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drunk driving prevention safety management system, and belongs to the technical field of drunk driving prevention. The drunk driving prevention safety management system comprises an identification module, a setting module, a detection module, a limiting module and a data recording module, wherein a driver drives a vehicle in two set time periods, an alcohol detection function is started, the driver can utilize a breath tester to conduct alcohol concentration test according to requirements, if the alcohol concentration of the test exceeds legal limit, an alarm is triggered, the limiting function in the safety management system is started, then the output power of an engine is controlled through an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) of the vehicle, the speed or acceleration of the vehicle is limited, the driver cannot start the vehicle, and therefore the driver can be prevented from driving the vehicle under the drunk condition, the frequency of traffic accidents can be reduced, normal running of the road surface vehicle is guaranteed, and meanwhile the probability of road surface congestion is reduced.

title_en: Underwater gun salvaging equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater salvage, in particular to underwater gun salvage equipment, which comprises a water surface boat floating on the water surface, a buoyancy and auxiliary power device and a salvage device, wherein the water surface boat is electrically connected with the buoyancy and auxiliary power device through a cable line, the buoyancy and auxiliary power device is connected with the salvage device through a flexible chain and a cable, the buoyancy and auxiliary power device is submerged in the water, and the salvage device is positioned at the bottom of the water. According to the invention, the buoyancy and auxiliary power device and the salvaging device are separately arranged, the buoyancy and auxiliary power device is submerged in water, and the salvaging device is positioned at the water bottom, so that the problem that the water bottom is stirred due to the propelling power of the salvaging main body, and the visibility is further deteriorated can be effectively avoided; the buoyancy and auxiliary power device and the salvaging device are connected through a flexible chain and a cable, so that the problem of salvaging the complex underwater topography is solved.

title_en: Heat pump system for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat pump system for a vehicle, comprising: a cooling device including a radiator and a multi-way valve connected through a first cooling water line, and circulating cooling water in the first cooling water line; a second cooling water line including a first end and a second end connected to the multi-way valve and equipped with a first water pump and an electrical component; a third cooling water line including a first end and a second end connected to the multi-way valve and equipped with a second water pump and a battery module; a cooler provided on the third cooling water line, connected to a refrigerant line of the air conditioner through a refrigerant connection line, and adjusting a temperature of cooling water circulating in the third cooling water line; and a gas injection device that selectively expands the refrigerant and selectively supplies some of the refrigerant to the compressor.

title_en: Thermal management system and method for operating such a thermal management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermal management system (10) for an electrically driven motor vehicle (1) and to a method for operating the thermal management system (10), wherein the thermal management system (10) has a heat pump circuit (15) which can be filled with a refrigerant (55) and which has an ambient heat exchanger (80), a first interior space heat exchanger (65), a cooling circuit heat exchanger (75) and a first three-way valve (535), wherein the first three-way valve (535) has a first connection (545), a second connection (550) and a third connection (555), wherein the first connection (545) is fluidically connected to a first output side (135) of the first interior space heat exchanger (65), wherein the second connection (550) is fluidically connected to a fourth input side (270) of the cooling circuit heat exchanger (75), wherein the third connection (555) is fluidically connected to a third input side (175) of the ambient heat exchanger (80), wherein in a first three-way valve position the third connection (545) is fluidically connected to the third connection (545) and is fluidically disconnected from the first connection (55) and the third connection (555) between the first connection (545) and the third connection (555) with respect to the refrigerant (55), wherein in the second three-way valve position the first fitting (545) is fluidly connected with the second fitting (555) and the third fitting (550) is shut off with respect to the first fitting (545) and second fitting (555) such that the refrigerant (55) is depressurized between the first fitting (545) and second fitting (545) on the first three-way valve (535).

title_en: Automobile brake pedal state monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the state of an automobile brake pedal, which detects two paths of switch electric signals and a brake master cylinder pressure signal of the brake pedal in real time; judging the adhesion state of the brake pedal according to the two paths of switch electric signals; judging the braking state of the vehicle according to the brake master cylinder pressure signal; the braking state of the brake pedal is determined based on the stuck state of the brake pedal and the braking state of the vehicle. According to the invention, two paths of redundant brake pedal switch signals and brake master cylinder pressure signals are simultaneously used as inputs of a brake state used by an ECU (electronic control unit) in calculation, so that the monitoring of the brake pedal state signals is realized.

title_en: Intelligent automobile air conditioner control method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for judging the response of personnel to the environment temperature in an automobile based on a convolutional neural network and adjusting a controlled air conditioner based on the response, which relates to the technical and artificial intelligence fields of the image recognition field, in particular to an intelligent automobile air conditioner control method based on the convolutional neural network, comprising the following steps: calling a camera in the vehicle to take a picture to obtain a corresponding picture; preprocessing and reinforcing the photo; the photo is imported into a person identification model for judgment, and the photo passing through the person identification model is imported into an expression judgment model adopting an S-ReLU (x) activation function; the expression judgment model carries out character recognition judgment on the input photo, and outputs the reaction of the person in the photo to the internal environment temperature of the automobile; according to the method, the intelligent regulation and control of the air conditioner in the automobile are realized by identifying the facial expression of the person in the automobile.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted battery charging control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted battery charging control system which comprises a battery pack, a controller and a vehicle-mounted charger, wherein the positive electrode of a power unit of the controller is communicated with the positive electrode of discharge of the battery pack; the battery pack comprises a battery cell module and a power management module communicated with the battery cell module, the emergency power-off switch is arranged to control the vehicle to charge, the safety of the vehicle is doubly ensured, the battery is charged as required through the collection of charging current, voltage and temperature of the battery by the power management module, and various conditions such as insufficient charging, overcharging, overheating and low-temperature charging of the battery in the charging process and the like of the lithium battery in a blind charging state are effectively avoided.

title_en: Connection structure of steering column and road sensing motor or booster motor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a connecting structure of a steering column and a road sensing motor or a booster motor. The steering device comprises a steering column, a road sensing motor or a power-assisted motor, wherein a shell of the steering column is connected with the shell of the road sensing motor or the power-assisted motor through bolts, the road sensing motor or the power-assisted motor is connected with one end of an output shaft through a bearing, the other end of the output shaft is connected with one end of a steering shaft, and the other end of the steering shaft is inserted into a steering tube of the steering column. This application uses longer steering spindle among shorter output shaft and the steering spindle replacement prior art, will divide into two steering spindle, makes the length of steering spindle shorten greatly to reduced the processing degree of difficulty of steering spindle effectively, the reduction of steering spindle makes its and the assembly position degree of motor also obtain guaranteeing more easily, thereby avoids the clamping stagnation phenomenon that appears in the rotation or the slip in-process because of the spline fit part axiality of steering tube and steering spindle is not good.

title_en: High-safety cab tipping system circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-safety cab tipping system circuit, which solves the problems that the existing tipping function circuit and the prompting function circuit are weak in relevance and have potential safety hazards. The intelligent control system comprises a storage battery pack (1), a power supply main switch (2), a cab rollover switch (3), a rollover detection switch (4), a diode (5), a rollover oil pump relay (6), a rollover oil pump switch (7), a rollover oil pump (8), an instrument (9) and a related wire harness, wherein one end of the diode (5) is connected to the rear of the cab rollover switch (3) of a rollover oil pump relay control circuit, and the other end of the diode is connected to the rear of the rollover detection switch (4) of a cab position detection circuit. The invention integrates the tipping function circuit and the prompt function circuit, thereby enhancing the relevance between the tipping function circuit and the prompt function circuit; the detection range of the rollover indicator lamp on the instrument is enlarged, so that whether the cab falls in place or not can be detected, and whether the rollover function circuit is closed or not can be detected.

title_en: Hydropower plant garbage collection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of adsorption, in particular to a garbage collection device of a hydropower plant, which comprises an adsorption tower; the accommodating assembly comprises a carrier and a circulating piece, wherein the carrier is arranged on the adsorption tower, and the circulating piece is arranged on the adsorption tower; and the control assembly comprises an inner part, a moving part and a jacking part, wherein the inner part is arranged on the carrier, the moving part is arranged on the inner part, the jacking part is arranged on the moving part, firstly, through the interaction between the accommodating assembly and the control assembly, the flow control when a product enters the adsorption tower can be realized, thereby the adsorption effect of the molecular sieve is improved, secondly, the molecular sieve can be effectively prevented from being impacted and damaged excessively before entering the adsorption tower due to the control of the flow, the service life of the molecular sieve is prolonged, and in addition, the production cost can be reduced and the production efficiency is improved due to the waste of material resources is reduced.

title_en: Special robot folding and unfolding device and special robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special robot folding and unfolding device and a special robot, comprising a base, a driving gear, a steering arm, a rack, a connecting rod mechanism and a connecting rod drive, wherein the driving gear is rotationally assembled on the base; one end of the steering arm is rotatably assembled with the seat body and meshed with the driving gear, and the frame is fixed at the other end of the steering arm; the connecting rod mechanism comprises a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a third connecting rod, a fourth connecting rod and a fifth connecting rod, the power conversion device comprises a rotor wing and a wheel set, and the axial direction of the fourth connecting rod is coaxially arranged with the axial direction of the rotor wing and the wheel set; the connecting rod drive is assembled between the frame and the connecting rod mechanism. The folding and unfolding device can enable the special robot to have functions of flying and walking, and is simple in overall structure and convenient to switch between modes.

title_en: Motor vehicle with hydrogen-powered internal combustion engine
abstract_en: The invention provides a motor vehicle (1), comprising: two front wheels (2); two driving rear wheels (4); an internal combustion engine (5) powered by hydrogen, having a plurality of cylinders (18) inside which respective pistons (19) slide, and a drive shaft (20) connected to the pistons (19), and being arranged longitudinally in the center or rear; connecting a drive shaft (20) of an internal combustion engine (5) to a transmission system (6) driving a rear wheel (4); and two cans (15) arranged beside the engine block of the internal combustion engine (5) on opposite sides of the internal combustion engine (5).

title_en: Anhydrous sodium sulfate centrifugal machine
abstract_en: The invention provides an anhydrous sodium sulfate centrifuge, which comprises a fixed plate, and is characterized in that a fixed sleeve is longitudinally and integrally connected to the middle part of the upper part of the fixed plate, a rotating shaft is connected to the upper side bearing inside the fixed sleeve, and a driven gear is fixedly connected to the lower side of the outer wall of the rotating shaft; the right upper side of the fixed sleeve is fixedly connected with a U-shaped bracket, the right part of the U-shaped bracket is fixedly connected with a driving motor, and the upper end of an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a driving gear. Because the sodium sulfate storage box can move on the external ground through the universal moving wheel, and the electric carrying component can lift the sodium sulfate storage box, operators are not required to carry the sodium sulfate storage box when the sodium sulfate storage box is installed, the effect of carrying and installing the box body for containing sodium sulfate without manual work is achieved, the labor intensity of operators can be effectively reduced, and the use is more convenient.

title_en: Automatic driving control method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic driving control method, an automatic driving control device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the automatic driving control method adopts a cognitive decision model, the cognitive decision model comprises a cognitive layer and a plurality of decision layers, and the decision layers are connected in series; the automatic driving control method includes the steps of: acquiring in-vehicle and out-of-vehicle monitoring data; extracting environmental cognitive characteristics and user demand characteristics from the in-vehicle and in-vehicle monitoring data through the cognitive layer; and sequentially inputting the environmental cognition characteristics and the user demand characteristics into each decision layer to perform multi-layer decision reasoning and determine automatic driving control parameters. The method and the device improve the interactivity between the automatic driving vehicle and the user, reduce the negative moods of the user such as confusion, panic, anxiety and the like, and improve the user experience.

title_en: Balance beam convenient for adjusting suspension height of sensor and used for paver
abstract_en: The invention discloses a balance beam for a paver, which is convenient for adjusting the suspension height of a sensor, and belongs to the technical field of pavers, and the balance beam comprises a beam body, wherein two groups of mounting frames are arranged on the outer wall of the beam body, three groups of sliding sleeves are sleeved on the outer wall of the beam body, a spacing adjusting component is arranged at the top of the beam body, mounting blocks are arranged on the front side walls of the three groups of sliding sleeves, hanging rods are movably arranged at the tops of the three groups of mounting blocks in a penetrating manner, sensor mounting plates are arranged at the bottoms of the three groups of hanging rods, ultrasonic sensors are arranged on the sensor mounting plates, a movable groove is formed above the side wall of a transmission plate, and a movable rod is arranged in sliding connection in the movable groove; the distance between the ultrasonic sensors can be adjusted under the action of the distance adjusting component.

title_en: Vehicle energy management method, device, VCU, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle energy management method, a device, a VCU, a vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining first power according to the recharging current and voltage information of the power battery and vehicle braking energy recovery power; determining a second power according to a power battery state of charge (SOC) of the power battery; acquiring allowable loading power of the hydrogen fuel cell system as third power; determining a target power of the hydrogen fuel cell system based on the first power, the second power, and the third power, and transmitting the target power to the hydrogen fuel cell system 。 The invention can reasonably distribute the power output of the fuel cell system and the power cell system, optimize the power distribution between the hydrogen fuel cell system and the power cell system and reduce the hydrogen consumption; the change rate of the output power and the frequent start-stop phenomenon of the hydrogen fuel cell system during operation can be reduced, and the service life of the hydrogen fuel cell system is prolonged.

title_en: Storage battery new energy locomotive refitted from diesel locomotive
abstract_en: The technical scheme of the invention provides a new energy locomotive of a storage battery modified by an internal combustion locomotive, which comprises an internal combustion locomotive part, a motor driving part and a wheel set transmission part, wherein the internal combustion locomotive part comprises an original frame, a bogie and a wheel set of the internal combustion locomotive, a power battery pack, a storage battery combiner box, a high-voltage distribution box and a traction inverter are arranged in the frame, and the power battery pack, the storage battery combiner box, the high-voltage distribution box and the traction inverter are electrically connected in sequence and used for providing power supply for motor driving; the motor driving part comprises traction motors, and the number of the traction motors is one or more according to the traction tonnage. According to the invention, the motor driving part is matched with the wheel set transmission part, and one or more motors are transversely distributed according to different traction power requirements, so that the traction motors meeting the traction requirements can be installed in a more effective space under the vehicle, more original structures are reserved, the transformation cost is saved, and the transformation time is saved.

title_en: Foldable aircraft cabin handrail with weapon manipulation function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foldable aircraft cabin handrail with a weapon control function, which comprises a foldable handrail and a weapon control mechanism; the weapon operating mechanism comprises a protective cover, a weapon operating button, a handle mounting table, an energizing switch and a cable; the handle mounting table is fixed right in front of the upper support; the lower end of the handle mounting table is provided with a cable hole communicated with the upper support; a weapon operating button is fixedly connected to the middle part of the handle mounting table; grooves for placing the side edges of the protective cover are formed in two sides of the surface of the handle mounting table; the protective cover is hinged with the handle mounting table; an induction power-on switch is arranged on the handle mounting table and the protective cover; the weapon control button is connected with the induction energizing switch and the weapon system through a wire; the foldable aircraft cabin handrail with the weapon control function solves the problem that a pilot is inconvenient to timely launch a weapon when in a high-difficulty overturning state.

title_en: Car light control method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a vehicle lamp control method, a vehicle lamp control device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: collecting lane coordinates along a forward direction of the vehicle; determining the type of the ramp according to the change data of the lane coordinates; according to the angle indicated by the lane coordinates, adjusting the initial irradiation range along the direction indicated by the ramp type to obtain an adjusted irradiation range; and controlling the lamps of the vehicle to irradiate according to the adjusted irradiation range. The method can improve the robustness so as to accurately control the angle of the light used by the complex road surface.

title_en: Automatic dispersion method, equipment and medium for train operation diagram turn-back occupation conflict
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic dispersion method, equipment and medium for train operation diagram turn-back occupation conflict, wherein the method is realized by adjusting the operation time or stop time of a turn-back station part, and the method comprises the following steps: step S1, carrying out turn-back occupation conflict check on a train operation diagram after automatic hooking, and belonging to common turn-back occupation conflict or turn-back nesting conflict; step S2, judging whether a turn-back nesting conflict exists or not based on the checking result of the step S1, and if so, entering the step S3; otherwise, entering step S4; s3, converting the fold-back nested conflict into a common fold-back occupied conflict; and S4, automatically separating common foldback occupation conflicts. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of detecting the fold-back occupation conflict, automatically resolving the fold-back occupation conflict by matching with the hooking program, reducing the workload of manually modifying the operation diagram, improving the mapping efficiency and the like.

title_en: Vehicle cruise control method, system, medium, electronic equipment and vehicle machine
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle cruise control method, a vehicle cruise control system, a vehicle cruise control medium, electronic equipment and a vehicle machine.
