The vehicle cruise control method includes: calculating according to the preset speed and the self-vehicle speed of the vehicle to obtain a speed deviation; selecting variable control parameters according to the speed deviation partition where the speed deviation is, and carrying out sectional control on the request acceleration; the speed deviation partition is a partition divided according to the speed deviation, and comprises a negative bias area, a negative bias cell, a positive bias cell and a positive bias area; and calculating and obtaining the PID control quantity of the constant-speed cruising of the vehicle according to the variable control parameter and the speed deviation. The application can improve the control precision of constant-speed cruising and reduce the speed fluctuation generated in the control process.

title_en: Method for correcting influence of yaw rate on minimum operation speed in air
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of aircraft flight mechanics design, and discloses a method for correcting the influence of yaw rate on minimum operation speed in air, which comprises the steps of reversely pushing out the slope angle of an actual state of an aircraft according to the slope angle required by balancing the yaw rate and the current slope angle of test flight, then carrying out data point linear fitting on the new slope angle through the lateral components of lift coefficients corresponding to different flight states of the aircraft, thus correcting a test curve, reversely solving the minimum operation speed in air under a given flight state through the correction test curve, and finally comparing the corrected minimum operation speed in air with the tested minimum operation speed in air to obtain the difference of the two, wherein the method is clear and simple in analysis and simple in use; meanwhile, an accurate, effective and simple analysis means is provided for determining the minimum safe take-off speed of the aircraft, and theoretical support and technical support are provided for guaranteeing safe flight in the failure state of the engine.

title_en: Parking support device and parking support method
abstract_en: A parking support device (5) is provided with a path generation unit (55) that generates a Target Path (TP) through which a vehicle should pass when the vehicle is parked, based on path information including the travel path of the vehicle when a user performs a parking operation on the vehicle (V) and information on the surroundings of the vehicle on the travel path. The parking support device is provided with a following control unit (57) for performing following control processing for automatically moving the vehicle to a parking scheduled position along a target path, and an information providing unit (58) for providing information to a user. The information providing unit visually provides information on the scheduled parking position included in the route information to the user before the start of the following control process.

title_en: Charging regulation and control method for charging pile and related device
abstract_en: The application provides a charging regulation and control method for a charging pile and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a charging reservation request from equipment to be charged, wherein the charging reservation request comprises charging demand information and driving parameters of a target object; acquiring a reference regulation strategy for at least one charging pile; determining a target charging pile from the at least one charging pile according to the charging demand information and the driving parameter; determining the charging priority of the equipment to be charged according to the charging demand information; and determining a target regulation strategy according to the target charging pile, the charging priority and the reference regulation strategy, so that the charging is performed when the equipment to be charged arrives at the target charging pile. The efficiency of configuration charging pile regulation and control tactics has been improved to this application for charging equipment charges when arriving.

title_en: Control method and device for tractor and semitrailer, electronic equipment and readable medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of transport vehicles, and particularly relates to a control method and device for a tractor and a semitrailer, electronic equipment and a readable medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining tractor motor parameters and semitrailer motor parameters, calculating to obtain first required torque according to the tractor motor parameters and the semitrailer motor parameters, obtaining tractor battery parameters and semitrailer battery parameters, adjusting the first required torque according to the tractor battery parameters and the semitrailer battery parameters to obtain second required torque which represents motor torque required by the tractor and the semitrailer as a whole, calculating second tractor required torque and second semitrailer required torque based on the second required torque, controlling the tractor through the second tractor required torque, and controlling the semitrailer through the second semitrailer required torque. The application is used for improving the driving force distribution effect of tractors and semi-trailers.

title_en: Photoelectric guiding device, aircraft and guiding method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of aircraft landing assistance, aims to solve the problem of improving the measurement accuracy and efficiency of landing assistance guiding, and provides photoelectric guiding equipment, an aircraft and a guiding method. The photoelectric guiding device comprises a seat component, an azimuth component, a pitching component and a sensor component. The seat member includes a mounting base. The pitching assembly comprises a pitching bracket and a connecting flange, and the pitching bracket is connected with the azimuth assembly through the connecting flange. The sensor assembly comprises a sensor support, and a medium wave infrared sensor, a zooming visible light camera, a laser sensor and a short wave infrared sensor which are fixedly connected with the sensor support, wherein after the medium wave infrared sensor and the zooming visible light camera capture an aircraft, the laser sensor emits laser towards the aircraft, and the short wave infrared sensor receives echoes. The photoelectric guiding device provided by the embodiment can accurately track the aircraft through the laser sensor and the shortwave infrared sensor by roughly tracking the aircraft so as to achieve the effect of improving the measurement precision and efficiency of the landing assisting guide.

title_en: Radioactive source storage, transfer and control device for teaching and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to medical radiation protection, in particular to a radioactive source storage, transfer and control device for teaching and a use method thereof, which aim to solve the defects that in the existing teaching process, a radioactive source is exposed to the outside in the transfer process, and a test container cannot effectively shield rays due to size limitation, so that test staff are easy to expose to a ray environment. The invention relates to a radioactive source storage, transfer and control device for teaching, which comprises a test bin, a movable bin cover and a power unit; the test bin is provided with a first counter bore, the movable bin is arranged in the first counter bore, and the movable bin is provided with a second counter bore for arranging a radioactive source, and the side walls of the first counter bore and the second counter bore are respectively provided with a first through hole and a second through hole; the second through hole and the corresponding first through hole are the same in direction and located in the same axial section, and when the movable bin cover and the movable bin are driven by the power unit to axially move until the second through hole and the first through hole are communicated with each other, and the test is performed.

title_en: Rear-mounted rear-drive three-in-one electric drive system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric drive, in particular to a rear-drive three-in-one electric drive system, which comprises an integrated main shell, and a controller module, a motor module and a transmission module which are arranged in the integrated main shell, wherein the controller module is arranged on the integrated main shell; the outer side of the integrated main shell is respectively provided with an oil cooling component and a water cooling component, and the oil cooling component and the water cooling component are adjacently arranged; the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: through being provided with oil cooling subassembly and water-cooling subassembly in the outside of integral type main casing, can carry out effectual heat dissipation cooling to controller module, motor module and the derailleur module in the integral type main casing.

title_en: Magnetic suspension track inspection system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a magnetic suspension track inspection system, which relates to the field of magnetic suspension track detection, and comprises an inspection vehicle and an inspection station, wherein the inspection vehicle runs along a track, the inspection vehicle comprises a vehicle body, a magnetic suspension frame, a control terminal and an inspection device, the inspection device is positioned between the magnetic suspension frame and the vehicle body, the inspection device is in communication connection with the control terminal and is used for carrying out vibration coupling inspection on the track and the inspection vehicle on the track, the inspection device is in communication connection with the inspection station, and the inspection device is arranged for carrying out an inspection process on the track so as to inspect the coupling inspection process of the track of the vehicle, thereby solving the problem of vibration detection between the magnetic suspension train and the track.

title_en: Vehicle turbulent flow structure and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle spoiler structure and a vehicle, comprising a hollowed spoiler and a spoiler device; the hollow spoiler is assembled on the vehicle back door sheet metal, and hollow areas are formed between the middle mounting support posts of the hollow spoiler and between the mounting support posts and the mounting support seats on the two sides; the turbulence device is assembled on the back door sheet metal and is positioned in front of the hollowed-out area of the hollowed-out turbulence plate. The turbulence device in the vehicle turbulence structure provided by the invention can change the flow direction of air flow, further change the interaction of the air flow and the hollow turbulence plate, further reduce wind noise, and has the noise reduction effect almost equal to that of the traditional non-hollow turbulence plate, the vehicle turbulence structure solves the wind noise problem caused by the assembly of the hollow turbulence plate on the roof, not only maintains the hollow characteristics of the model, but also controls the cost, so that the wind noise source generated by the hollow turbulence plate is obviously reduced, thereby reducing the noise level in the vehicle, especially at the rear passengers, and achieving the purpose of improving the comfort of the whole vehicle.

title_en: Redundancy management method, system, equipment and medium for landing gear proximity sensor signals
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aircraft landing gear control systems, and relates to a redundancy management method of landing gear proximity sensor signals, which comprises the following steps: the two landing gear retraction control units demodulate the acquired proximity sensor data of the channel, and transmit the acquired proximity sensor data to the other channel through the data transmission of the cross channel, so that the two channels of the landing gear retraction control units can acquire two redundancy landing gear proximity sensor signals; in each channel, selecting a landing gear database according to whether the landing gear handle signal is on or off; the landing gear database stores a landing gear on-state transition matrix and a landing gear off-state transition matrix which are built according to the state change of each proximity sensor; if the landing gear handle signal is on, selecting a landing gear on-state transition matrix; if the landing gear handle signal is put down, selecting a landing gear down state transition matrix; and in a preset time period, monitoring the state of the acquired landing gear proximity sensor signal, and judging whether the proximity sensor fails according to whether the proximity sensor signal is consistent with a transition matrix value of the next state. The problem that a traditional dual-redundancy undercarriage retraction control system is difficult to conduct redundancy management on signals of an access sensor is solved.

title_en: Rotary mechanism for car moving robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slewing mechanism for a car moving robot, which belongs to the technical field of slewing mechanisms for car moving robots and comprises a plate frame, wherein four corners of the lower part of the plate frame are respectively and rotatably connected with a torsion bar, the outer parts of the torsion bars are connected with an outer gear ring in a clamping way, the torsion bars are installed in pairs at the bottom of the plate frame, the torsion bars are distributed in a rectangular mode, a first rack is arranged at the left end of the front part of the plate frame, a second rack is arranged at the right end of the front part of the plate frame, a third rack is arranged at the left end of the rear part of the plate frame, a fourth rack is arranged at the right end of the front part of the plate frame, and through the matched use of the fourth rack, the third rack, the first rack and an adjusting rack, the effect of rotating four wheels to be in the same round direction as the four shafts is achieved, meanwhile, driving control is applied to the two rear wheels, and the whole car moving robot can complete the effect of steering in place under the condition of limited space so as to effectively turn around.

title_en: Method for solving charging reactance interference problem and charging anti-interference gun head
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for solving the problem of charging anti-interference and a charging anti-interference gun head, wherein the method for solving the problem of charging anti-interference comprises the following steps: s100, determining a path of a charging harness according to a charging mode of a charging anti-interference experiment; s200, dividing coupling areas on paths of the charging harness, and determining coupling paths of interference signals on the charging harness by shielding the coupling areas respectively; s300, determining parameters of an anti-interference element on the access coupling path according to the impedance requirement of shielding interference signals on the coupling path; s400, determining an integrated circuit of the charging harness based on the parameters of the anti-interference element. The invention completes the solving method of the whole charging anti-interference problem by the problems of problem positioning, scheme determination and device selection in turn based on the principle of charging interference resistance, and provides a charging gun head suitable for alternating current, which is suitable for solving the subsequent low-cost and simplified charging interference resistance problem.

title_en: Anti-lock control method for wheel speed sensor fault scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-lock control method for a wheel speed sensor fault scene, which is mainly designed in that after the wheel speed sensor fault is detected, the braking working condition of a vehicle is monitored, and once the emergency braking working condition is monitored, the braking oil pressure corresponding to each wheel is collected; then determining an anti-lock control strategy of the failed wheel by comparing the brake oil pressure of the wheel coaxial with the failed wheel according to the number of the wheel speed sensor faults, if only a single wheel speed sensor is failed; if a plurality of wheel speed sensors fail, according to the number of different failed wheels, an anti-lock control strategy of the wheels coaxial with and/or on the same side as the failed wheels is correspondingly adopted. The invention effectively eliminates the potential safety hazard when emergency braking occurs on the premise that a single or a plurality of wheel speed sensors are failed and cannot be maintained in time, thereby obviously improving the safety and driving experience of the vehicle.

title_en: Butt-joint device of primary-secondary separated underwater vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a docking device of a primary-secondary separated underwater vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of underwater vehicles and comprises a primary machine docking assembly and a secondary machine docking piece; the main machine butt joint assembly comprises a first butt joint sleeve, and an annular step protruding inwards is arranged at the inner end of the inner side wall of the first butt joint sleeve; the sub-machine butting assembly comprises a second butting sleeve which can be inserted into the first butting sleeve, the end part of the second butting sleeve is provided with a clamping claw part, the clamping claw part comprises a plurality of clamping claws which are uniformly arranged along the circumferential direction, and the radial outer end of the clamping claw far away from the second butting sleeve is provided with a clamping protrusion which is used for being matched with the annular step; the second butt joint sleeve is internally provided with a locking component used for pressing all the clamping protrusions on the annular step. The butt joint device provided by the invention can realize quick and accurate butt joint between the son machine and the mother machine through the integral structure arrangement, and is simple in structure and convenient to operate.

title_en: Easy-to-install bulk cargo ship translation type hatch cover rail extension beam strut
abstract_en: The invention provides a bulk cargo ship translational hatch cover rail extension beam support easy to install, and belongs to the technical field of bulk cargo ship extension beam supports; the device comprises a device rail, wherein a support post is inserted into the lower surface of the device rail, and a support frame, a movable frame, a lengthening plate and a compression spring are sleeved on the surface of the support post. The invention achieves the effect of using the adjustable movable frame and the telescopic box by arranging the supporting frame, avoids the problem that the extruding plate and the friction plate are inconvenient to use because the movable frame and the telescopic box cannot be adjusted, achieves the effect of adjusting the extruding plate to a proper position for use when the whole equipment is installed and used by the buttons and the compression springs, achieves the effect of reducing the opening speed of the hatch after the roller of the hatch enters the inside of the equipment track and limiting the speed of the hatch by the extruding plate and the friction plate, and avoids the problem that the whole equipment shakes or the hatch derails on the surface of the equipment track because the opening speed of the hatch is too fast.

title_en: Data processing method and device and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a data processing method and device and a vehicle. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the position of a roll center of a vehicle based on the roll angle speed, a pre-constructed corrected roll dynamics model and a volume Kalman filtering algorithm after obtaining the roll angle speed of the vehicle. By adopting the mode, the position of the vehicle roll center can be obtained based on the acquired roll angle speed, the corrected roll dynamics model and the volume Kalman filtering algorithm, and the corrected roll dynamics model characterizes the mapping relation between the roll angle speed and the position of the vehicle roll center after noise is introduced, so that the position of the vehicle roll center after noise is introduced can be corrected based on the volume Kalman filtering, the position of the vehicle roll center can be accurately estimated, and more accurate basis is provided for algorithms such as roll stability control and vehicle roll early warning of the vehicle.

title_en: Charging system, vehicle including charging system, and charging method
abstract_en: The charging system for an electric vehicle includes: a rechargeable energy storage device adapted to store electrical energy and to supply the stored electrical energy to at least one electric motor of the vehicle to propel the vehicle; a charger adapted to supply electrical energy to the energy storage device according to a selectable one of the at least two power ratings to charge and/or recharge the energy storage device based on the selected one of the power ratings; and a controller adapted to select one of the power ratings of the charger to set the charger to charge and/or recharge the energy storage device based on the selected one of the power ratings.

title_en: Insulation resistance detection circuit, method and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an insulation resistance detection circuit, an insulation resistance detection method and a vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of insulation resistance detection, wherein the circuit comprises: the device comprises a voltage division detection circuit, a totem pole inverter circuit and a zero crossing signal detection circuit; wherein the partial pressure detection circuit includes: the device comprises a detection port, a voltage dividing resistor and a control unit, wherein the detection port is used for being connected with a load, and the load is simulated by an insulation resistor and a Y capacitor in parallel; the detection port is also connected with the output end of the totem pole inverter circuit, the divider resistor is connected between the detection port and the control unit in series, the control unit is also respectively connected with the control end of the totem pole inverter circuit and the output end of the zero-crossing signal detection circuit, and the input end of the zero-crossing signal detection circuit is connected with the output end of the totem pole inverter circuit; the insulation resistance detection circuit provided by the invention can avoid electric shock of people nearby the vehicle in the process of charging the load by the vehicle.

title_en: Energy management control method and system for extended-range loader and extended-range loader
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for controlling energy management of a range-extending loader and the range-extending loader, wherein the method comprises the following steps: updating a predicted pedal opening, a vehicle speed and an energy storage device SOC according to the system state parameters to obtain a pedal opening sequence in a prediction window and a vehicle speed and energy storage device SOC sequence set; obtaining a required power sequence of the driving motor according to a pre-calibrated pedal opening and required power mapping curve; calculating an optimal control sequence set in a prediction window according to the vehicle speed and energy storage device SOC sequence set, the required power sequence of the driving motor, the vehicle system model and the energy consumption optimization objective function; and controlling the loader according to the optimal control sequence at the current moment, and controlling the loader by using the optimal control sequence at the current moment in the newly acquired optimal control sequence set after the loader generates a new state. The invention reduces the instantaneous calculation amount of the strategy and the dependence on the working condition information, and has good strategy instantaneity and high energy optimization consistency.

title_en: Multi-working-point real-time switching control method and device for range extender
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of new energy automobiles, and provides a real-time switching control method and device for multiple working points of a range extender. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a first multi-objective optimization function; determining an optimal working interval of the range extender when the overall performance of the whole vehicle is optimal based on the expected rotating speed, the expected torque and the first multi-objective optimization function; and controlling the range extender to switch among low-load, medium-load and high-load working points based on the real-time whole vehicle demand power value and the real-time battery SOC value of the vehicle, and controlling the duration working time of the low-load working point not to exceed the first minimum maintenance working time, the duration working time of the medium-load working point not to exceed the second minimum maintenance working time and the duration working time of the high-load working point not to exceed the third minimum maintenance working time during the switching working point of the range extender. The application not only optimizes the energy distribution management mode of the extended range automobile, but also can improve the comprehensive performance of the whole automobile.

title_en: Capturing device for testing quality in space gravitational wave detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a capturing device for testing quality in space gravitational wave detection, which aims to meet the requirement of low disturbance release of testing quality and comprises a capturing plunger, a hollow shaft ultrasonic motor, a screw nut component, a strain amplifying structure, an end cover and a base, the middle part in the base is installed to the lead screw nut subassembly, and the upper end of strain amplification structure and lead screw nut subassembly catches the lower extreme of plunger and passes behind strain amplification structure, the lead screw nut subassembly cartridge in cavity axle supersound motor in proper order, catches the upper end of plunger and inlays in the draw-in groove of strain amplification structure, and the upper surface fixed connection of end cover and strain amplification structure. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, reliable performance, small occupied space and reusability, and ensures the accuracy and stability of the test quality capturing process. The invention belongs to the technical field of aerospace.

title_en: System and method for enhancing occupant awareness
abstract_en: A system for enhancing awareness of a vehicle occupant includes a display for displaying information to the vehicle occupant and a controller in electrical communication with the display. The controller is programmed to determine the activation state of the system. The activated state includes an activated state and a deactivated state. The controller is further programmed to determine a clearance distance between the vehicle and an object in the vehicle's surroundings in response to determining that the activation state is an activated state. The controller is further programmed to display a notification to a vehicle occupant based at least in part on the gap distance.

title_en: Aircraft cabin capable of being actively cooled and forming method
abstract_en: The application provides an actively-cooled aircraft cabin and a forming method thereof, comprising the following steps: a front end frame, a barrel section inner skin, an I-beam, a barrel section outer skin and a rear end frame; the front end frame, the barrel section inner skin, the barrel section outer skin and the rear end frame surround to form an interlayer cavity, the interlayer cavity is divided into a plurality of closed cavity units through I-shaped stringers, each cavity unit is provided with a filling opening and an outlet, and working mediums in the cavity units flow in and flow out through the filling opening and the outlet respectively. The active cooling configuration adopted by the application can reduce or replace a passive heat-proof structure, so that the risk of damage to internal equipment caused by failure stripping of a local heat-proof structure is reduced while cooling of the cabin is realized.

title_en: Vehicle windshield definition control method and system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle windshield definition control method, a system, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a vehicle. Comprising dividing the windshield into at least one viewable area based on a current driver's line-of-sight landing relative to the windshield in response to a vehicle driving condition; based on each visual area, constructing a real-time image difference evaluation matrix inside and outside the vehicle, and quantifying the definition of each visual area; responding to the acquired real-time images inside and outside the vehicle, acquiring image difference values of all the visible areas according to a preset image difference algorithm based on an image difference evaluation matrix; based on each image difference value, acquiring a definition evaluation value of the windshield according to a defined definition evaluation algorithm; and based on the definition evaluation value, evaluating the definition of the windshield, and adaptively improving the definition of the windshield according to the evaluation result. The method can accurately evaluate the definition of the windshield, and can cope with scenes with insufficient definition, thereby improving driving safety.

title_en: Dangerous chemical gas telemetering imaging alarm device based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous chemical gas telemetering imaging alarm device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, relates to the technical field of dangerous chemical gas monitoring, and solves the technical problems of low sensitivity and limited coverage range of a dangerous chemical gas leakage monitoring device in the prior art; the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a host computer loaded on an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a cradle head scanning head for pitching and horizontal scanning rotation is installed at the bottom of the host computer, and the host computer is in communication connection with a main control computer positioned at a ground control center; the host is internally provided with a signal processing module, a main control module and an infrared spectrum detection module, wherein the infrared spectrum detection module is used for analyzing and processing infrared spectrum signals of hazardous gas. The invention adopts the passive Fourier transform infrared imaging technology to acquire richer spectral information, improves the resolution and sensitivity of imaging, can accurately identify hazardous gas leakage with low concentration or weak illumination, is carried on an unmanned plane platform, can realize monitoring of a large-range area and covers wider scenes.

title_en: Intelligent logistics transport vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics storage, in particular to an intelligent logistics transport vehicle, which solves the problem that the existing equipment is difficult to automatically pick up goods with different heights due to design defects; comprising the following steps: the number of the walking components is two and the walking components are arranged at intervals and used for steering and moving; the conveying belt is arranged above the walking assembly; the rotating clamping assemblies are arranged on two sides of the conveying belt, and one end of each rotating clamping assembly is rotatably connected to the conveying belt; the telescopic component is arranged between the intervals of the walking components and is used for matching the rotary clamping component and the conveyer belt to place cargoes on the conveyer belt; according to the invention, the automatic goods taking and transporting of goods is realized through the cooperation of the walking assembly, the transporting belt and the telescopic assembly, no additional manpower or equipment participation is needed, and the intelligent degree is high.

title_en: Heat pump management system capable of actively adjusting heat dissipation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat pump management system capable of actively regulating heat dissipation, which belongs to the technical field of heat pump management systems and comprises a heat pump system, a temperature-losing and curing unit, a gas management system, a fire extinguishing assembly and a treatment unit, wherein the heat pump system is connected with the temperature-losing and curing unit and the gas management system, and the gas management system is connected with the fire extinguishing assembly and the treatment unit; the heat pump system is used for adjusting the temperature in the ambulance; the temperature-losing treatment unit is used for exchanging heat with the heat pump system and treating a patient suffering from temperature loss; the gas management system is used for storing and supplementing carbon dioxide gas in the heat pump system, and the treatment unit is used for treating the carbon dioxide provided by the gas management system for a patient. Through the mode, the heat pump system realizes the heat management of the heat pump system taking carbon dioxide as the refrigerant, and combines the heat pump system with the heat loss treatment, the vehicle fire extinguishment and the medical treatment.

title_en: Hill starting anti-slip control method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method, a system, a storage medium and equipment for hill start anti-slip, wherein a vehicle comprises a plurality of sensors for detecting a vehicle body and a vehicle body environment; the control method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of parameters detected by a plurality of sensors when the current vehicle is starting, wherein the plurality of parameters at least comprise a gradient parameter and a vehicle self acceleration parameter; inputting the gradient parameter and the vehicle acceleration parameter into a preset torque calculation formula to obtain a predicted torque value; acquiring an actual torque value of a current vehicle in real time when the current vehicle starts, and judging whether an error between the current actual torque value and a predicted torque value is in a preset interval or not; if yes, the current vehicle is controlled to exit the parking state and enter the starting state. According to the invention, whether the current actual torque value of the vehicle can normally start the vehicle on the ramp is comprehensively judged by fusing a plurality of parameters acquired by a plurality of sensors, so that the accuracy and the reliability of the anti-slip system of the vehicle are improved.

title_en: Copper powder and carbon powder oxidation-reduction inerting aircraft oil tank device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper powder and carbon powder oxidation-reduction inerting aircraft oil tank device, and belongs to the technical field of aircraft fireproof and explosion prevention. The device comprises an aircraft oil tank, a first fan, a second fan, a carbon powder storage tank, a heat exchanger and a reaction device, wherein the aircraft oil tank comprises an air inlet and an air outlet; an outlet of the first fan is provided with a vent pipeline, and an electric regulating valve I is arranged on the vent pipeline and is communicated with the heat exchanger; the heat exchanger is communicated with the reaction device; the copper powder is filled in the reaction device, a carbon powder storage box is arranged on one side of the copper powder storage box, a discharge hole is formed in the carbon powder storage box, a discharge pipeline is arranged in the carbon powder storage box, and the discharge pipeline is communicated with the reaction device. The invention solves the technical problems of low speed, high cost and the like of the inerting aircraft fuel tank.

title_en: Anti-impact anti-torsion car frame assembly
abstract_en: The invention provides an impact-resistant anti-torsion vehicle frame assembly, which comprises a front suspension front section beam assembly and a front suspension rear section beam assembly, wherein a first transverse connecting beam and a second transverse connecting beam are symmetrically arranged between the front suspension front section beam assembly and the front suspension rear section beam assembly, two ends of the front suspension front section beam assembly and the front suspension rear section beam assembly, which are close to one ends of the first transverse connecting beam and the second transverse connecting beam respectively, are respectively provided with a detachable left connecting longitudinal beam assembly and a detachable right connecting longitudinal beam assembly, guide limiting assemblies are respectively arranged between the left connecting longitudinal beam assembly and the right connecting longitudinal beam assembly, the front suspension front section beam assembly and the first light-weight through holes, the left connecting longitudinal beam assembly and the right connecting longitudinal beam assembly are respectively connected by the guide limiting assemblies, the connecting positions of the left connecting longitudinal beam assembly and the right connecting longitudinal beam assembly can be adjusted, and the left connecting longitudinal beam assembly and the right connecting longitudinal beam assembly can be disassembled, so that the vehicle frame assembly is prevented from generating torsion deformation in the welding process.

title_en: System on chip, autopilot system including the same, and method of operating the same
abstract_en: A system-on-chip (SoC), an autopilot system including the system-on-chip, and a method of operating the same are provided. The automatic driving system includes: a first SoC configured to control an autopilot function of a vehicle and including a first secure parking module configured to control parking of the vehicle in accordance with first fault information; and a second SoC configured to be driven with a higher operation performance than that of the first SoC, configured to control the autopilot function of the vehicle, and including a second safety parking module configured to control the parking according to the provided second failure information, wherein the first SoC or the second SoC is configured to: selectively driven according to level information corresponding to an autopilot level, and the second secure parking module is further configured to: based on the occurrence of the fault in the first SoC, parking or stopping of the vehicle is controlled in response to receiving the second fault information.

title_en: Charging pile for alpine region and protective shell thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging pile for alpine regions and a protective shell thereof, which belong to the technical field of charging piles, and comprise a shell and a charging pile body, wherein the side wall of the shell is connected with a cold-proof door through a hinge, the heat dissipation and ventilation in the charging pile body are respectively communicated with an insulation box and a heating pipe, the bottom end of the heat preservation box is connected with a heat preservation ring, a plurality of soaking components are arranged in an inner cavity of the heat preservation ring, the top end of the shell is connected with four mounting bases through sealing plates, and the top ends of the mounting bases are connected with hinge plates through wheel bar components. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the heat preservation ring and the soaking impeller, the rubber at the charging port of the charging pile body can be preserved after the charging is completed, the hardening is avoided in a low-temperature environment, meanwhile, the arrangement of the racks and the plurality of turning plates is regulated, the frozen snow at the top of the shell body can be quickly and independently cleaned, the damage of the frozen snow to the shell body structure in the alpine region is reduced, the use safety of the charging pile body is ensured, and the maintenance cost of the outdoor charging pile body in the alpine region is reduced.

title_en: Integration method, integration device, electronic apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integration method, which is used for integrating software components of a non-automobile open system architecture in a battery management system into a domain controller of the automobile open system architecture, and comprises the following steps: acquiring a first configuration template, wherein the first configuration template is a configuration template of an automobile open system architecture and comprises configuration attributes of the automobile open system architecture; substituting the software component of the non-automobile open system architecture into a first configuration template to obtain a first software component; and extracting configuration information of the first software component, and carrying out component configuration on the first software component according to the configuration information of the first software component and the configuration requirement of the automobile open system architecture, so that the configuration of the first software component accords with the configuration of the automobile open system architecture, and integrating the software components of the non-automobile open system architecture is completed. The invention can integrate the software components of the non-automobile open system architecture into the domain controller of the automobile open system architecture. An integrated apparatus, an electronic device, and a computer-readable storage medium are also disclosed.

title_en: Refrigerated container for semi-trailer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of refrigerated containers, in particular to a refrigerated container for a semi-trailer transport vehicle, which comprises a carriage, a physical refrigerating system, a mechanical refrigerating system and a power generation system, wherein the physical refrigerating system is used for reducing the temperature in the carriage in the early stage, the power generation system provides power for the mechanical refrigerating system, ice residues are paved in U-shaped grooves on two sides of the carriage, then strip-shaped grooves at the bottom of the carriage are paved with ice residues, a large amount of ice residues exchange heat with air in the carriage, the temperature in the carriage is reduced together with the mechanical refrigerating system, the initial refrigerating speed of the refrigerated container is accelerated, and the refrigerating duration when the expected temperature is reached is shortened; the photovoltaic panel at the top of the carriage converts solar energy into direct current, the whole process is clean and environment-friendly, no pollution is caused to the environment, the direct current is converted into alternating current through the inverter and then is used by a mechanical refrigerating system, electric energy can be provided at any time, a large-capacity standby battery does not need to be arranged on a vehicle, and the burden of a tractor is reduced.

title_en: Energy-saving device for nacelle propeller
abstract_en: The invention relates to an energy-saving device for a nacelle propeller, comprising: the hub cap fin, the hub cap, the hub, the propeller and the underwater structure of the pod propeller are fixedly connected with the hub cap and the hub cap fin at the front end of the hub of the propeller, and the hub cap fin can coaxially rotate along with the propeller; the radius of the hub cap fin is 0.25 times of the radius of the propeller; the geometric pitch angle of the propeller blade root is epsilon, and the pitch angle alpha-epsilon of the fin blade of the hub cap fin is approximately equal to 0; the fin inclination angle gamma of the hub cap fin is formed by fixing the fin of the hub cap fin after rotating along the rotation direction +/-30 degrees. By adopting the energy-saving device for the nacelle propeller, the pressure drop at the rear part of the propeller hub is reduced, the resistance of the whole propeller is reduced, and the propeller thrust is increased; in addition, the hub cap fin can reduce the torque of the propeller, increase the action of thrust, and achieve the effect of energy conservation.

title_en: Vehicle charging system and control method for vehicle charging system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle charging system and a control method of the vehicle charging system, and relates to the technical field of vehicles. The vehicle charging system comprises a first power battery pack, a second power battery pack, a third power battery pack, a load circuit, an electric drive system and a direct current charging seat, wherein the first power circuit comprises a first power battery pack, a second power battery pack and a switch circuit, the switch circuit comprises a parallel negative electrode switch, a parallel positive electrode switch and a series switch, the lowest parallel voltage of the first power battery pack and the second power battery pack after being connected in parallel is smaller than or equal to a first voltage threshold value, the switch circuit is used for controlling the electric connection relation of the first power battery pack and the second power battery pack, the second power circuit comprises a boost relay, a fast charge positive electrode switch and a fast charge negative electrode switch, and the working voltage of any load in the load circuit is larger than a preset voltage threshold value. The invention solves the technical problem of high cost caused by the fact that the motor and the motor controller are used for carrying out high-power boosting charging on the vehicle in the related technology.

title_en: Wireless sharing charging system and method for electric bicycle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless shared charging system of an electric bicycle, which comprises a rear terminal system, at least one front terminal system and at least one charging shed system, wherein the rear terminal system is connected with the front terminal system; the rear terminal system comprises a rear end communication module, a data storage module, a charging calculation module and an interface module; the front terminal system comprises a front-end communication module, a user registration login module, a user account module, a user order module, a charging pile switch module and a charging position inquiry module; the charging shed subsystem comprises a charging shed communication module and at least one charging pile; the charging pile comprises a charging transmitting end coil for wireless charging and an electric bicycle identification module. The invention also discloses a wireless shared charging method of the electric bicycle. The wireless shared charging system and method for the electric bicycle have the characteristics of ingenious design, complete functions and convenience in use.

title_en: Voltage type detection circuit, battery, charging interface and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a voltage type detection circuit, a battery, a charging interface and a vehicle. The detection circuit is used for detecting the output voltage type of the charging pile, and the charging pile comprises an anode and a cathode; the circuit comprises: the device comprises a voltage processing module, an isolation optocoupler and an output module; the input end of the voltage processing module is connected with the anode of the charging pile, and the output end of the voltage processing module is connected with the input end of the isolation optocoupler; the output end of the isolation optocoupler is connected with the input end of the output module; the voltage processing module is used for outputting a voltage signal according to the output voltage type of the charging pile, wherein the output voltage type of the charging pile comprises an alternating current source or a direct current source; the isolation optocoupler is turned on or off under the control of the voltage signal, and the output module outputs a voltage type signal under the control of the turning on or off of the isolation optocoupler. The detection circuit provided by the application has a simple structure, and can realize the effect of efficiently detecting the type of the power supply voltage.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, vehicle and medium for estimating state of charge of power battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of battery management, in particular to a method, a device, equipment, a vehicle and a medium for estimating the state of charge of a power battery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring discharge related data of a power battery at a target moment; determining the reference overpotential of the power battery at the target moment according to the discharge related data of the power battery at the target moment and the overpotential mapping relation, wherein the overpotential mapping relation is the mapping relation between the overpotential of the power battery and the discharge related data at any moment; and calculating the state of charge of the power battery at the target moment according to the actual overpotential and the reference overpotential of the power battery at the target moment, and estimating the state of charge of the power battery at the current moment based on the state of charge of the power battery at the target moment. Therefore, the problems that in the related art, the application range of the estimation of the discharging state of the power battery is smaller, the estimation result is easily influenced by battery materials, the estimation accuracy is lower and the like are solved.

title_en: Pressure distribution valve structure suitable for full-active suspension
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of full-automatic suspensions of vehicles, and particularly relates to a pressure distribution valve structure suitable for a full-active suspension, which comprises a rotary pressure distribution valve and a driving motor which are integrally installed together, wherein the rotary pressure distribution valve comprises a valve body, a valve sleeve and a valve core, and three pump body valve ports and two shock absorber valve ports are arranged on the valve body; three oil inlet chambers and two oil outlet chambers are formed between the valve sleeve and the valve body, and a plurality of valve sleeve oil grooves are formed in the circumferential direction of the valve sleeve; the circumference of the valve core is provided with a plurality of valve core oil grooves, and the driving motor is arranged in the valve body and is in transmission connection with the valve core to drive the valve core to rotate, so that the valve port of the pump body is communicated or blocked with the corresponding valve sleeve oil grooves, the valve core oil grooves and the corresponding valve ports of the shock absorber. The invention adopts the rotary pressure distribution valve to switch the oil way, realizes continuous pressure control, controls the shock absorber to provide continuous and adjustable damping force for the vehicle body, and has simple structure and low use and maintenance cost.

title_en: Motor control method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method and device of a motor, a vehicle and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a target sounding mode of sounding of the motor; the motor is controlled to emit sound corresponding to the target sounding mode, so that sounding is performed through the motor, on one hand, no additional sounding equipment is required to be configured on a vehicle, cost is effectively reduced, and on the other hand, sounding is performed through the motor controlled based on the target sounding mode, and diversity of sounding contents of the motor is enriched.

title_en: Vehicle running speed intelligent display system and method based on power supply of multiple generators
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent display method for the running speed of a vehicle based on power supply of a multiple generator, and an intelligent display system and an intelligent display method for the running speed of the vehicle based on power supply of the multiple generator, which relate to the field of automobile electronics and electronic measurement. The method comprises the steps of driving a plurality of power generation motors to rotate through wheel rotation, outputting a plurality of three-phase alternating currents, converting a plurality of alternating current power supplies into a plurality of direct current power supplies through a plurality of three-phase direct current conversion modules, connecting the plurality of direct current power supplies in series to obtain a power supply of a system, taking a Microcontroller (MCU) as an acquisition and control core, acquiring voltage values output by the power generation motors through an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) in the microcontroller, obtaining the running speed of a current automobile according to a wheel rotation speed relation model of the acquired voltage values, and controlling a pulse width modulation module (PWM) to output voltages with different duty ratios by the MCU so that a plurality of RGB-LEDs display different brightness and color effects, thereby achieving intelligent display of the running speed of the wheels.

title_en: Kinetic energy recovery system
abstract_en: The application relates to a kinetic energy recovery system, in particular an energy recovery system (100) for a vehicle is proposed. The energy recovery system (100) comprises: a kinetic energy recovery system KERS (110) for connection to a propulsion shaft (14) of the vehicle; an internal energy storage device (130) configured to receive and store energy from the KERS (110); and a processing circuit (120) configured to: energy (E) is distributed from the internal energy storage device (130) to the propulsion shaft (14) of the vehicle (10) and/or to at least one non-propulsion battery (17) of the vehicle (10) based on an energy level of the non-propulsion battery (17).

title_en: Power supply device and electric power steering device
abstract_en: The power supply device is provided with: a DC power supply (13); inverters (42A, 42B) that supply power from a DC power supply; capacitors (CA 1, CA2, CB1, CB 2) connected in parallel with the inverter between the DC power supply and the inverter; reverse connection protection circuits (44A, 44B) connected between the DC power supply and the capacitor, for preventing a current flowing from the capacitor to the DC power supply in a positive-side power supply line (Lpa) of the DC power supply; and overvoltage protection circuits (45A, 45B) for controlling the voltage across the capacitor to be equal to or lower than a predetermined voltage when the voltage across the capacitor is equal to or higher than the predetermined voltage.

title_en: Vehicle side protection assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicles, in particular to a vehicle side protection assembly, which comprises a main frame and a side protection plate group. The main frame comprises two main beams arranged at intervals and a plurality of auxiliary beams arranged at intervals, and each auxiliary beam is connected with the two main beams. The side protection plate group comprises a plurality of protection plates, the plurality of protection plates are spliced in sequence to form the side protection plate group, and the main frame is connected to one side face of the side protection plate group. Vehicles with different axle lengths can be adapted by increasing the number of the protection plates or changing the lengths of part of the protection plates in the plurality of protection plates, so that the universality of the vehicle side protection assembly is improved, the design waste is avoided, and the cost is reduced. The invention also provides a vehicle, which comprises a front end vehicle body structure, a rear end vehicle body structure and the vehicle side protection assembly, wherein the front end vehicle body structure, the vehicle side protection assembly and the rear end vehicle body structure are sequentially connected. The vehicle can avoid design waste and reduce cost.

title_en: Light control method, device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a light control method, a light control device, a vehicle and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of light control. The method comprises the following steps: receiving light control information of a vehicle control unit to a target bulb; determining a to-be-processed control event of the target bulb according to the lamplight control information; according to the multiple data packets, the control event to be processed is processed step by step to obtain at least one sub event; processing at least one sub-event in at least one event processing cycle, each event processing cycle corresponding to processing one or more of the at least one sub-event; and according to the sub-event correspondingly processed by each event processing period, controlling the GPIO port in the light controller to overturn and delay to obtain an analog PWM signal so as to control the target bulb. The application can control the duty ratio of the PWM signal to control the brightness of the target bulb, thereby ensuring the brightness stability of the target bulb, and simultaneously simulating the port of the GPIO as the PWM port, thereby reducing the use of the light controller and the light control cost.

title_en: Transmission assembly, vehicle-mounted display terminal and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of automobile manufacturing, and discloses a transmission assembly, which comprises a rotating shaft; the rotating piece is rotationally connected with the rotating shaft, and the driving piece is used for driving the rotating piece to rotate; the moving part and the second driving part are arranged on one side of the rotating part, the moving part is axially and movably connected with the rotating shaft, the rotating shaft is in synchronous rotation connection with the moving piece, and the second driving piece is used for driving the moving piece to be close to or far away from the rotating piece; the first limiting piece comprises a first limiting structure and a second limiting structure, the first limiting structure is arranged on the rotating piece, and the second limiting structure is arranged on the moving piece. The transmission assembly, the vehicle-mounted display terminal and the vehicle can drive the display assembly to move manually and automatically.

title_en: Chair seat
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to seats. The present disclosure relates to a seat provided with a movable device, the seat comprising: a frame that constitutes a framework of the seat and is made of metal; a pin which constitutes a part of the movable mechanism and is made of metal, and which is capable of sliding in a hole provided in the frame; and a collar made of resin and capable of elastic deformation, the collar being disposed between an inner peripheral surface of the hole and an outer peripheral surface of the pin, and the collar being capable of sliding contact with at least one of the inner peripheral surface and the outer peripheral surface.

title_en: Vehicle start assist device and start assist method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle starting assisting method and an assisting unit. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an accelerator pedal parameter in response to receiving a function activation signal of a starting auxiliary function; determining a part of four wheels of the vehicle as brake control wheels to apply braking force and another part of the four wheels as drive reserve wheels to reserve driving force; and adjusting the braking force of at least one brake control wheel based on the state of each brake control wheel and each drive reserve wheel.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for preventing impact of vehicle air suspension
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for preventing impact of an air suspension of a vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of judging whether a vehicle state meets the condition of starting the anti-impact operation of the air suspension when a loading starting signal or a unloading starting signal of the vehicle is received, and controlling a preset telescopic supporting arm to extend out to form a support between a frame cross beam and an axle housing if the vehicle state meets the condition of starting the anti-impact operation of the air suspension, so that impact load caused by loading or unloading is transmitted among the frame cross beam, the telescopic supporting arm and the axle housing, and increasing the stress point between a frame and an axle under the condition that the impact load possibly occurs, thereby locking the space distance between the frame and the axle, enabling the load to be transmitted between the frame and the axle, and avoiding the impact effect of the impact load on the air suspension by the air suspension.

title_en: Range extender generation power control method and device, readable storage medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of range extender control, in particular to a range extender generated power control method, a range extender generated power control device, a readable storage medium and a vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the starting of a range extender of a vehicle is detected, determining the basic power generation of the range extender according to the state of the vehicle; acquiring a range extender power generation power adjustment proportion parameter input by a user, and determining a power generation power correction coefficient of the range extender corresponding to the range extender power generation power adjustment proportion parameter and a vehicle state; calculating and obtaining a first target power according to the basic power and the power correction coefficient of the range extender; and controlling the range extender to work by adopting the first target generated power. The method can combine user input with the vehicle state, dynamically adjust the power generation power of the range extender, thereby optimizing the NVH performance or the power performance of the vehicle, and realizing the definition of the power generation power of the range extender by the user so as to meet the demands of different users when using the vehicle in different scenes.

title_en: Automatic lane changing method and equipment for vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to an automatic lane changing method for a vehicle, which comprises the following steps: receiving scene information; receiving lane change suggestions; based on the scene information and the lane change recommendation, one or more parameters of a PID controller are adjusted to simulate a driving style of a driver when changing lanes. The application also relates to a vehicle automatic lane changing device, a computer storage medium and a computer program product.

title_en: Truck carriage, carriage mass center control system and method and carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boxcar, a carriage mass center control system, a method and a carrier, wherein the boxcar is arranged at the top of a boxcar chassis, and a suspension oil cylinder assembly is arranged at the bottom of the boxcar chassis; the boxcar includes: the auxiliary frame, the movable carriage, the first lifting oil cylinder and the second lifting oil cylinder; when the first lifting oil cylinder stretches, the front end of the auxiliary frame lifts; when the second lifting oil cylinder stretches, the carriage is moved to lift the rear end; the carriage mass center control system comprises: the pressure sensor is arranged on the suspension oil cylinder assembly, the inclination angle sensor is arranged on the movable carriage, and the controller outputs the oil cylinder expansion and contraction amounts of the first lifting oil cylinder and the second lifting oil cylinder according to the pressure of the suspension oil cylinder and the inclination angle of the movable carriage, and adjusts the pressure of the suspension oil cylinder through the oil cylinder expansion and contraction amounts. The invention balances the axial stress of each suspension cylinder and reduces the lateral force born by the suspension cylinder.

title_en: Device for projecting an image to a user
abstract_en: An apparatus, comprising: at least one light reflector; a light guide configured to: providing the received image to a user and also to at least one light reflector, wherein the at least one light reflector is configured to: reflecting at least a portion of the image toward a user; and a reflection control means for alternately enabling and disabling reflection of light from the at least one light reflector.

title_en: Telescopic adjusting device and tread cleaner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway vehicles, and particularly discloses a telescopic adjusting device and a tread cleaner. The telescopic adjusting device comprises a shell, a telescopic rod which is arranged in a telescopic way along the front-back direction relative to the shell, and an adjusting component arranged between the shell and the telescopic rod, wherein the adjusting component comprises a sleeve piece, a nut piece positioned at the front side of the sleeve piece, a first elastic piece positioned at the rear side of the sleeve piece, a first stop surface positioned between the sleeve piece and the nut piece and used for blocking the front movement of the sleeve piece relative to the shell, a second stop surface positioned at the front side of the nut piece and used for blocking the front movement of the nut piece relative to the shell, and a third stop surface positioned between the sleeve piece and the nut piece or positioned at the rear side of the sleeve piece and used for blocking the rear movement of the nut piece or the sleeve piece relative to the shell. When the telescopic adjusting device and the tread cleaner are used, the abrasion loss of the grinding block can be compensated, so that the distance between the grinding block and the tread of the wheel can be adjusted, and the telescopic adjusting device and the tread cleaner are simple in structure and easy to manufacture.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for controlling air suspension height
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for controlling the height of an empty suspension, which relate to the technical field of automobile engineering and comprise the following steps: calculating a desired height variation value based on the current height and the target height of the air spring; acquiring an actual height change value of the air spring in a preset control period, and calculating a height change compensation value based on the expected height change value and the actual height change value; and controlling the electromagnetic valve to charge and discharge the air spring based on the height change compensation value so as to control the air suspension height. The application realizes the rapid and accurate control of the height of the air suspension, avoids the phenomenon of over-charge or over-discharge caused by improper charging and discharging speed, and reduces the height oscillation and energy waste of the suspension system.

title_en: Control circuit and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a control circuit and a vehicle. The control circuit includes: the vehicle control system comprises a vehicle control module and a light controller, wherein the light controller comprises an IMMO controller and an AVAS, the vehicle control module is used for sending light control signals to control the light controller, the vehicle control module is used for sending anti-theft control signals to control the IMMO controller, and the vehicle control module is used for sending warning control signals to control the AVAS. In the embodiment of the invention, the integrated light controller can realize the functions of the light controller, the IMMO controller and the AVAS controller, and reduces the resource consumption when the IMMO controller, the AVAS and the light controller are applied to the automobile.

title_en: Underwater hull cleaning robot capable of automatically detecting and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous detection underwater hull cleaning robot and a method thereof, wherein the autonomous detection underwater hull cleaning robot comprises a frame, at least two mechanical arms, a propeller, a cleaning module, a camera and a control module which are arranged on the frame, the vacuum pump is connected with the cavitation jet nozzle through a water pipe, an electromagnetic adsorption device is arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm, the control driving module is connected with the camera, the mechanical arm, the propeller and the electromagnetic adsorption device, and the cleaning module comprises the cavitation jet nozzle. The invention can flexibly adsorb and climb on the hull, is applicable to the uneven hull surface, and ensures the smooth proceeding of the cleaning process; the flexibility is high; the ship has no absolute requirement on the environment where the ship body is located, the application range is enlarged, and whether important parts are adsorbed and attached or not can be checked and cleaned in time during long voyage.

title_en: Charging cabinet, charging method, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a charging cabinet, a charging method, an apparatus, a storage medium, and a program product. The cabinet that charges includes: the charging grids are provided with charging interfaces which are used for being electrically connected with batteries placed in the charging grids; the plurality of chargers are connected with the plurality of charging interfaces to form a plurality of charging paths, and each charging path is provided with a switch device; and the controller is connected with the switch equipment on each charging path and is used for determining the charging priority of the battery in the target charging grid according to the charging information of the multi-item target charging path corresponding to the target charger connected by the target charging interface in the target charging grid after the battery is placed in the target charging grid in the plurality of charging grids, and controlling the on-off of the switch equipment in the multi-item target charging path according to the charging priority so as to charge the battery placed in the target charging grid according to the charging priority. The method can meet various charging requirements.

title_en: Front engine room assembly of vehicle, manufacturing method thereof and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a front engine room assembly of a vehicle, a manufacturing method thereof and the vehicle, wherein the front engine room assembly comprises the following components: the left wheel cover, the right wheel cover, the left longitudinal beam, the right longitudinal beam, the front coaming lower cross beam and the front auxiliary frame are of an integral die-casting molding structure; the left longitudinal beam and the right longitudinal beam are oppositely arranged along the track direction of the vehicle, the front coaming lower cross beam is arranged between the left longitudinal beam and the right longitudinal beam, the left wheel cover is arranged above the left longitudinal beam along the height direction of the vehicle, and the right wheel cover is arranged above the right longitudinal beam along the height direction of the vehicle; the front auxiliary frame comprises a frame body part and a plurality of base parts, and the base parts are connected between the left longitudinal beam and the frame body part and between the right longitudinal beam and the frame body part; the base part is in an arch structure. By applying the technical scheme of the application, the number of parts of the front lower vehicle body and chassis front auxiliary frame assembly can be reduced, and the total assembly production beat can be accelerated.

title_en: Boarding bridge
abstract_en: The invention relates to a boarding bridge comprising: radiation subassembly, boarding bridge body and backup pad. The radiation assembly comprises a radiation plate and a fixing strip, the radiation plate is fixedly arranged on the fixing strip, and the fixing strip is fixedly arranged on the boarding bridge body; the heat exchange device comprises a radiation plate, wherein a first heat exchange channel and a second heat exchange channel are arranged in the radiation plate, the first heat exchange channel and the second heat exchange channel are mutually attached, the first heat exchange channel is a closed cavity, a heat exchange medium is arranged in the first heat exchange channel, and an inlet pipe and an outlet pipe which are communicated with the second heat exchange channel are respectively arranged on the first side edge and the second side edge of the radiation plate. A boarding passage is arranged in the boarding bridge body, and radiation components are arranged at the top and the bottom of the boarding passage. The heat exchange is performed between the second heat exchange channel and the heat exchange medium in the first heat exchange channel, and the radiating plate uniformly radiates heat or cold into the boarding channel, so that cold and hot air in the boarding channel is uniformly distributed, and boarding experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Jolt degree detection method, jolt reminding method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent driving, in particular to a bumpy degree detection method, a bumpy reminding method, a system, equipment and a medium, and aims to solve the technical problems that the change of road state causes bumpy of a vehicle body, the driving comfort and stability are affected and the driving difficulty is increased. For this purpose, the jolt degree detection method of the present application comprises: acquiring an acceleration signal of the driving device, wherein the acceleration signal at least comprises a data characteristic and a time sequence characteristic; obtaining a single-side bump index based on the data characteristic and the time sequence characteristic of the acceleration signal; and obtaining a whole vehicle bump index based on the single-side bump index, wherein the whole vehicle bump index is used for representing the bump degree of driving equipment. Through the embodiment, the driving jolt degree and the comfort level can be effectively detected according to the data characteristics and the time sequence characteristics of the acceleration signals, a driver is helped to more intuitively know the state of driving equipment, and stable driving consciousness is improved.

title_en: Prevent belt cleaning device who skids on boats and ships surface
abstract_en: The invention provides a cleaning device for preventing skidding on the surface of a ship, which comprises a cleaning robot, a guiding robot, a traction device and a control system. The free end of the cable of the traction device is fixedly connected with the guiding robot, and the lower end of the guiding robot is connected with the cleaning robot through a traction rope. The control system respectively sends control instructions to the second driving motor and the first motor based on the cleaning path and the actual measurement moving speed of the cleaning robot, so that the moving direction and the speed of the base of the traction device on the guide rail are adapted to the cleaning track of the cleaning robot, and the speed of winding and unwinding the cable of the winding drum is adapted to the actual measurement moving speed of the cleaning robot. According to the invention, the cleaning robot is hung on the cable, and the traction direction of the cable to the cleaning robot is adjusted to be parallel to the wall surface of the ship by the guide robot, so that the traction effect to the cleaning robot is realized, the sliding on a smooth paint surface is prevented, and the working stability of the cleaning vehicle is greatly improved.

title_en: Floating type fan foundation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a floating fan foundation platform, which relates to the technical field of offshore power generation and comprises a platform base, three pontoon columns and a middle column; the three pontoon columns are respectively and fixedly arranged at the end part of the upper end surface of the platform base, and are distributed in a triangle shape; a transverse truss rod is connected between every two adjacent pontoon columns, and damping rods are arranged on the transverse truss rods at equal intervals; the damping rod is sleeved with a freely movable floater, and through hole groups are uniformly distributed on the floater; the center pillar is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end face of the platform base. The device solves the technical problems that the prior structure is simpler, and most of the device can only control the vibration response of the floating type platform in a single direction, can not adapt to the complex wind-wave-current combined action environment of the offshore floating type fan, and reduces the stability of the offshore floating type fan platform.
