title_en: Method for optimizing blocked track based on reachable domain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing a blocked orbit based on a reachable domain, and belongs to the technical field of aerospace. The method comprises the steps of constructing a time-varying reachable domain of a given track according to an initial state of the blockade and the maneuverability of the blockade, intercepting an evade track in the reachable domain by the blockade according to the time-varying reachable domain of the blockade constructed by the given track, collecting the interception capability of the blockade to intercept the evade track in the reachable domain, and obtaining an evaluation index to obtain the optimal blockade track. The invention establishes a path for cutting off the evasion party from the critical area by analyzing the task execution capacity of the blocking party and the dominant area/dominant phase of the evasion party.

title_en: Intelligent heat-dissipation and exhaust bus skylight
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent heat-dissipation and air-exhaust passenger car skylight, and in particular relates to the technical field of passenger car skylights, which comprises a passenger car skylight frame body, a heat-dissipation and air-exhaust assembly and an intelligent detection assembly, wherein the heat-dissipation and air-exhaust assembly comprises a moving block which is arranged in the passenger car skylight frame body in a sliding manner, a rotating cavity and an air cavity which are distributed up and down are arranged in the moving block, a rotating rod is rotationally arranged in the air cavity, a plurality of fan blades I and a plurality of fan blades II which are distributed up and down are fixedly arranged on the rotating rod, and the plurality of fan blades I and the plurality of fan blades II are distributed in the rotating cavity and the air cavity. The invention monitors the temperature, smoke, oxygen and carbon dioxide content in the carriage of the passenger car in real time through the temperature sensor, the smoke alarm, the oxygen sensor and the carbon dioxide sensor, automatically controls the lifting of the moving block by utilizing the single-chip microcomputer to perform heat dissipation and exhaust, and changes the position by means of the moving plate at the same time, thereby being capable of improving the detection range and further improving the control precision of the single-chip microcomputer.

title_en: Agricultural aquatic product cultivation auxiliary equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural cultivation, and mainly discloses agricultural aquatic product cultivation auxiliary equipment which comprises a ship body, cabin boards, monitoring components, a stabilizing mechanism, a bow component and a stern component. The stabilizing mechanism can be unfolded at two sides of the ship body, so that the floating plates are horizontally arranged and then are contacted with the water surface, the contact area of the whole ship body on the water surface is enlarged, the stability of the ship body is ensured, the whole weight of the ship body can be increased by supplementing water through the water supplementing hose, the draft of the ship body is increased, the stability of the ship body can be further ensured by matching with the stabilizing mechanism, and the height of the unfolded floating plates can be regulated by the hydraulic cylinder, so that the floating plates can always be contacted with the water surface.

title_en: Shockproof support of automobile LED lens module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shockproof support of an automobile LED lens module, in particular to the technical field of shockproof supports, which comprises a support shell, wherein three lamp shades are linearly distributed and fixedly connected at the upper part of the front end of the support shell, the three lamp shade internal surface rear portions all annular distribution fixedly connected with a plurality of lamp pearl, and the three lamp shade internal surface rear portions all fixedly connected with convex lens, support shell internal surface lower part front side fixed mounting has control module, support shell lower extreme is provided with the centre gripping buffer assembly. According to the shockproof support of the automobile LED lens module, the support shell can be stably mounted on the luggage rack at the top of an automobile through the clamping buffer assembly, so that the situation that the support shell falls down due to jolt generated by the support shell in the running process of the automobile can be effectively avoided, meanwhile, the support shell can be buffered, damage to the lamp beads and the convex mirrors on the support shell is avoided, and further the shockproof support is convenient for a user to mount and dismount, and further convenient to use.

title_en: Train fault monitoring method, device, equipment, train and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a train fault monitoring method, device, equipment, a train and a storage medium, and relates to the field of fault monitoring. The method comprises the steps of locating fault bits corresponding to a current fault of a train from communication data, inquiring a fault protocol file corresponding to a current communication protocol according to the fault bits, determining fault information of the current fault, wherein the fault protocol file is pre-constructed, comprises a fault frame file and a fault data file, the fault frame file comprises a fault frame number and a fault frame length which characterize a communication data transmission port, the fault data file comprises a fault frame number, a fault protocol bit and fault information, the fault information comprises any one or more of a fault name, a fault reason, a solution and a fault grade, and generating a fault prompt according to the fault information and sending the fault prompt to a terminal. The decoupling of fault data and fault logic can be realized, the flexibility and reusability of fault data configuration are improved, various communication protocols are compatible, and the fault monitoring capability of the train is improved.

title_en: Model training method, data processing method, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a model training method, a data processing method, a vehicle and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of utilizing target equipment to collect data from a plurality of directions around a target vehicle to obtain a target data set, and training an initial convolutional neural network model based on the target data set to obtain a target convolutional neural network model. The application solves the technical problems of low positioning precision and poor user experience in the Bluetooth positioning mode provided in the related technology.

title_en: Control method and device for pedal in railway vehicle, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a control method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a pedal in a railway vehicle, wherein vehicle stop information of a target vehicle on which an auxiliary passenger is to be taken is determined in response to receiving an auxiliary riding request, the vehicle stop information is analyzed, a riding carriage on which the auxiliary passenger is to be located and a stop platform on which the auxiliary passenger is to be stopped after entering the stop platform are determined, a passenger compartment door of the riding carriage is opened in the stop platform in response to the target vehicle, a first pedal edge of a liftable pedal is controlled to be obliquely lifted up to a target inclined height which is flush with a door edge of the passenger compartment door, a first interval gap between the first pedal edge and the door edge is determined under the target inclined height, a lifting gap compensation pedal is overturned between the liftable pedal and the passenger compartment door, and the first interval gap is filled by the gap compensation pedal so that the liftable pedal is connected with the passenger compartment door. In this way, the passengers to be assisted can get on or off the vehicle by means of the liftable pedal and the gap filling pedal.

title_en: Gas generator and airbag
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of automobile safety airbags, in particular to a gas generator and an air bag. According to the invention, the gas generating part is arranged in the guide pipe, and the electric explosion unit is utilized to ignite the gas generating part, so that gas is rapidly generated. When the gas generating part is not ignited, the blocking part blocks the cylinder, so that the tightness of the gas generator is ensured, and gas leakage is avoided. When the gas generating part burns rapidly to generate gas, the plugging part is stressed to cause the plugging part to be destroyed under the action of force, so that the cylinder body is communicated with the outside, and the gas flows to the outside. The gas generator reduces the structures such as the rupture disk and the like, has simpler structure and lower cost, improves the tightness, and avoids gas leakage, thereby realizing the rapid inflation of the air bag.

title_en: Intelligent network-connected automobile safety control method and system based on active and passive safety information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent network-connected automobile safety control method and system based on active and passive safety information fusion. The system comprises an environment detection module, a risk prediction module, a cooperative control module and a control execution module, wherein the environment detection module comprises three parts of passenger state monitoring, vehicle system monitoring and traffic environment sensing, the risk prediction module comprises two parts of vehicle collision risk prediction and passenger damage risk prediction, the cooperative control module comprises a control execution part of an intelligent restraint system, a vehicle steering system and a brake system in a vehicle, the early warning capability of an active safety system on potential risks is fully utilized, and the vehicle collision risk probability and the passenger damage probability are calculated in real time according to an established vehicle risk prediction model and an established passenger damage risk prediction model. When the unavoidable dangerous working condition is encountered, the system adjusts the state of the restraint system to achieve the current optimal state of occupant protection, and the risk that the additional occupant is caused by the uncooperation of the active safety system and the restraint system is avoided.

title_en: Compact type efficient filtering device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compact type efficient filter device, which is formed by combining two groups of efficient filter devices through connecting sections, so that the installation and maintenance space can be effectively reduced, and the narrow space installation requirement on a special ship can be met. The high-efficiency filter device comprises an outer box body and a high-efficiency filter, wherein the high-efficiency filter is installed in the outer box body, an air inlet of the outer box body is connected with a flexible hose through a connecting flange, and a pairing flange is arranged at an air outlet. The invention is mainly improved in that two high-efficiency filters are integrated, and the two high-efficiency filters are connected through the connecting section, so that the installation space of the high-efficiency filters can be effectively reduced, and the installation requirement of a special ship in a narrow space is met. When the filter is required to be installed and maintained or replaced, any one side of the cover plates on two sides can be opened, the high-efficiency filter is installed or removed, and the connecting section is connected with the high-efficiency filter by using a buckle, so that the high-efficiency filter is convenient to detach.

title_en: Drainage system for ship
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drainage, in particular to a drainage system for a ship, which comprises a ship body, a water inlet and a water outlet, wherein the water inlet and the water outlet are formed in two sides of the ship body, when the ship is required to be weighted and stable in the sailing process, the water inlet discharges water into the ship body to increase the weight of the ship body, when the ship is required to be weighted and reduced in the sailing process, the water outlet discharges water from the ship body, a water storage tank is connected in the ship body and is used for storing rainwater, waste water and the like in the ship body, a monitoring assembly, a locking assembly and a drainage assembly are arranged in the ship body, the monitoring assembly is used for monitoring the water accumulation in the ship body, and the water level in the ship body is monitored by the monitoring assembly, so that the water inflow and the water outflow of the ship body are controlled, and the water outflow amount of the water into the ship body are controlled, and the ship body can be stably driven in the sailing process, and the safety of workers on the ship body is ensured.

title_en: Method and device for detecting insulators by multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for detecting an insulator by a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, which relate to the field of insulator detection and comprise a basic parameter acquisition module, an environment information monitoring module, a path preliminary analysis module and a comprehensive detection path analysis module, wherein by comprehensively analyzing the environment information and the performance parameters of a target unmanned aerial vehicle, the actual flight distance of the target unmanned aerial vehicle corresponding to each power transmission line and the inspection total path of each power transmission line corresponding to each carrying device are obtained, the comprehensive influence of the factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the environmental factors is fully considered, a powerful data base is provided for planning of the follow-up detection path, and the detection efficiency and the detection precision of the insulators are improved.

title_en: Control method, device, equipment and medium of charging module
abstract_en: The application provides a control method, a device, equipment and a medium of a charging module, and relates to the technical field of charging. The method comprises the steps of generating and sending a first control signal to a charging module according to a set voltage value and a set current value, so that the charging module executes a voltage establishment flow based on the set voltage value and the set current value, and if the current output voltage of the charging module reaches a preset proportion of the set voltage value, regenerating and sending a second control signal to the charging module according to a preset minimum output current value and the set voltage value of the charging module, so that after the output voltage of the charging module reaches the given voltage value, executing the current establishment flow according to the preset minimum output current value, and enabling the output current to reach a maximum output current value corresponding to the set voltage value. Therefore, the output current is controlled according to the comparison between the current output voltage of the charging module and the set voltage value, the current overshoot is avoided, the equipment safety is protected, and the charging efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Vehicle shift control method, device, vehicle and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle gear shifting control method, a device, a vehicle and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicle control, wherein the method comprises the steps of switching a first forward gear to a neutral gear and acquiring a plurality of detection data under the condition that a gear shifting condition of switching the first forward gear to a second forward gear is met; the method comprises the steps of calculating the motor rotation speed according to each detection data, determining target data from the detection data according to the priority, determining the target rotation speed of the driving motor according to the target data, adjusting the rotation speed of the driving motor according to the target rotation speed, and switching from neutral to a second forward gear under the condition that the rotation speed of the driving motor reaches the target rotation speed. The application can improve the gear shifting success rate of the new energy vehicle.

title_en: APU air inlet throttle system
abstract_en: An APU air intake damper system is capable of increasing the length of the air intake damper without changing the opening of the aircraft skin. The APU air inlet air door system comprises an air passage, an air inlet air door which enables the air passage to be opened or closed, and an actuator which enables the air inlet air door to be opened or closed, wherein the air inlet air door comprises an air door fixing section and an air door moving section which can stretch and retract relative to the air door fixing section, when the air inlet air door is closed, the actuator enables the air door moving section to retract relative to the air door fixing section to shorten the whole length of the air inlet air door, and when the air inlet air door is opened, the actuator enables the air door moving section to extend relative to the air door fixing section to increase the whole length of the air inlet air door.

title_en: Sports training system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a physical training system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a plurality of gripping devices, wherein each gripping device comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle and a gripper, the top of the gripper is fixedly connected to the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and a processing device which is in communication connection with the gripping devices and is configured to transmit training information to the gripping devices so that the gripping devices move to a target position and throw out objects in a specified mode, and the training information comprises position information and release information. The training system provided by the application can effectively improve the training efficiency of athletes, has lower cost and is suitable for popularization.

title_en: Pane module for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pane module (1), in particular a roof pane module (2), for a motor vehicle (50), comprising a transparent base pane (3) and at least one light source (7) which generates light during operation and emits the light in the direction of the inner side (4) of the base pane. Improved illumination is achieved by providing at least one reflective portion (10) on the base pane inner side (4), which reflective portion reflects light of at least one of the at least one light sources (7) back. The invention also relates to a motor vehicle (50) having such a pane module (1).

title_en: Heat management system of power exchange station
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat management system of power conversion station, includes refrigerant circuit, battery circuit and charger circuit, the refrigerant circuit includes first heat exchange piece, the battery circuit with the accessible between the refrigerant circuit first heat exchange piece carries out the heat exchange, the battery circuit is used for realizing the heat exchange with the battery assembly, the charger circuit with can communicate between the battery circuit, the charger circuit is used for realizing the heat exchange with the charger assembly, the refrigerant circuit the battery circuit reaches the cooperation of charger circuit makes the heat management system has at least one mode of operation, the mode of operation includes battery cooling mode, battery heating mode, charger cooling mode, battery and charger cooling mode and defrosting mode, when the mode of operation is two kinds or more, switchable between the mode of operation is favorable to promoting the efficiency of heat management, has reduced the energy loss.

title_en: Automatic charging mechanical arm of electric automobile and robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric automobile charging, in particular to an automatic charging mechanical arm and a robot of an electric automobile, wherein the automatic charging mechanical arm comprises a pose adjusting mechanism and an automatic charging gun head, and the automatic charging gun head is integrated at the free end of the pose adjusting mechanism and is used for being connected with a charging port of the electric automobile; the pose adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the pose according to the position of the electric automobile so that the automatic charging gun head and the charging port of the electric automobile are positioned in the same plugging direction. The automatic charging gun is integrated on the mechanical arm based on the characteristic that an automatic charging automobile and a parking place are relatively fixed, and the mechanical arm is optimized, so that the mechanical arm with six active degrees of freedom is optimized into the mechanical arm with five active degrees of freedom, the volume and the cost of the mechanical arm can be reduced, and the automatic charging gun is better oriented to different environments.

title_en: Combined submarine driving device for inhibiting gap leakage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined submarine driving device for inhibiting gap leakage, which comprises a pump shell, blades and a pump inlet, wherein a circle of blade front cover plate is arranged on the periphery of each blade, the blade front cover plate is fixedly connected with the periphery of each blade without gaps, the blade front cover plate rotates together with the blades, the blade front cover plate and the pump shell are provided with gaps in the radial direction, a leakage flow channel is formed at the gaps, a plurality of groups of outer magnet assemblies are uniformly arranged on the pump shell along the flow direction of the leakage flow channel, a plurality of groups of inner magnet assemblies are uniformly arranged on the blade front cover plate along the flow direction of the leakage flow channel, and the positions of the outer magnet assemblies and the inner magnet assemblies are corresponding and have opposite polarities, so that magnetic induction lines are generated. According to the invention, the front cover plate is added to the impeller component for transformation, the magnetic structure is added, the electromagnetic induction principle is utilized to inhibit the leakage flow of the submarine driving device, the leakage quantity and noise are reduced, and the efficiency and the concealment of the submarine driving device are improved.

title_en: Independent suspension system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vehicles, in particular to an independent suspension system and a vehicle. The independent suspension system comprises a suspension bracket, a thrust rod support, a thrust rod assembly, a guide shock absorber, an air spring and an air spring, wherein the suspension bracket is suitable for being fixedly connected with a wheel end of a vehicle, the thrust rod support is suitable for being detachably connected with an axle of the vehicle, the thrust rod assembly is connected with the suspension bracket and the thrust rod support, and is in hinged fit connection with the suspension bracket and the thrust rod support, the guide shock absorber is arranged on the suspension bracket, one end of the guide shock absorber, which is far away from the suspension bracket, is suitable for being arranged on a frame of the vehicle in a swinging mode, and the air spring is fixedly connected with the suspension bracket at one end and is suitable for being abutted against the frame at the other end. According to the independent suspension system, through designing the suspension bracket, the thrust rod support and the thrust rod assembly, the independent suspension system can be conveniently fixed on the wheel end and detachably connected with the axle, so that the weight of the axle is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent automobile instrument convenient to assemble and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent automobile instrument convenient to assemble and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of automobile instruments, wherein the intelligent automobile instrument comprises a main body and a fastening device, a circuit board is arranged in the main body, a data processing module, a first driving module and a wireless transmission module are arranged on the circuit board, after the wireless transmission module receives an external wireless control instruction, the data processing module transmits a corresponding operation instruction to the first driving module, so that the first driving module drives the fastening device to be externally fixed or folded and released for fixation; when a user uses navigation software in the mobile phone, the current road condition speed limit information can be acquired, the current road condition speed limit information is marked as first speed information, the speed information on the instrument panel is acquired, the second speed information is marked as second speed information, and if the second speed information is larger than the first speed information, the ring lamp lights a red lamp.

title_en: Power saving mode control method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a power saving mode control method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicle control, wherein the method comprises the steps of controlling a part of a plurality of energy consumption units of a vehicle to enter an energy saving state according to current state information of the vehicle and use habit information of a user when the vehicle enters the power saving mode; the current state information of the vehicle indicates the current state of each energy consumption unit in the plurality of energy consumption units, and the usage habit information of the user indicates the historical usage information of each energy consumption unit. The embodiment of the application can realize throttling and improve the throttling efficiency, thereby improving the endurance of the whole vehicle, improving the diversity of throttling modes and providing personalized throttling modes for users.

title_en: New energy charging pile charging control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging control method and a charging control system for a new energy charging pile, which relate to the technical field of new energy, and comprise the steps of collecting historical charging data of a user, power grid load data, fixed electricity price information and weather forecast data in real time, and identifying charging habits and requirements of the user; the method comprises the steps of generating an individualized charging scheduling strategy according to a user charging habit and a real-time power grid state, monitoring the availability of multiple energy sources in real time, evaluating the power generation capacity and the cost of each energy source, adjusting the priority of energy source selection by using the individualized charging scheduling strategy, automatically selecting an optimal charging mode, executing charging operation based on the charging mode selected by the user, adjusting according to the power grid load and the energy source consumption condition, monitoring the availability of multiple energy sources in real time, evaluating the power generation capacity and the cost, dynamically adjusting the priority of the energy sources, improving the response capability of the charging pile to environmental changes, reducing the charging cost of the user and fully utilizing renewable energy sources.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted display system
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle-mounted display system, and belongs to the field of intelligent cabins. The system comprises a host computer, a display screen and a flexible wire harness, wherein the host computer is used for outputting image signals. In the application, the transmission of the image signal and the touch signal between the host and the display screen is realized by adopting two USB-C modules, two chips based on the same serial bus protocol and a flexible wire harness matched with the USB-C modules and the chips based on the serial bus protocol. The host comprises a USB-C module and a chip, the display screen comprises the USB-C module and the chip, and the flexible wiring harness is used for connecting the two USB-C modules and the two chips. The scheme not only can remarkably reduce the cost, but also can effectively reduce the weight of the wire harness.

title_en: Foldable unmanned aerial vehicle rapid deployment system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foldable unmanned aerial vehicle rapid deployment system and method, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle deployment. According to the system disclosed by the invention, the carrier system and the unmanned aerial vehicle storage device are arranged, the high-speed carrier system provides thrust and energy in the rapid deployment process, and the unmanned aerial vehicle storage device provides the protection function in the deployment process, so that the rapid response and long-distance accurate and reliable deployment of the unmanned aerial vehicle are realized, the time for the unmanned aerial vehicle to reach a designated area is greatly shortened, the technical problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle deployment mode is poor in timeliness is solved, the time for the unmanned aerial vehicle to reach the designated area is greatly shortened through the high-speed accurate deployment process, and the burden of the unmanned aerial vehicle to carry the energy required for take-off climbing is also avoided, thereby prolonging the unmanned aerial vehicle task execution time.

title_en: Tail rotor test bed and natural frequency measurement verification method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a tail rotor test bed and a natural frequency measurement verification method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, adjusting the axial distance between an upper rack and an upper transmission shaft on the upper rack; step 2, realizing the self-positioning function of the coaxiality of the upper transmission shaft and the output shaft of the speed reducer in the process of adjusting the natural frequency of the bench, step 3, adjusting the natural frequency, and step 4, measuring the natural frequency by adopting a pulse hammering method. The application solves the problem that the natural frequencies of the tail rotor platform are different due to the fact that the tail rotor platform is provided with different blades.

title_en: False alarm prevention vehicle monitoring system and method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a false alarm prevention vehicle monitoring system, a false alarm prevention vehicle monitoring method and a vehicle, wherein the false alarm prevention vehicle monitoring system comprises a whole vehicle controller, a sensing module and an alarm module, the sensing module at least comprises a wake-up device, an image acquisition device and a vehicle-mounted sensor, the alarm module at least comprises an alarm, the whole vehicle controller is respectively connected with the sensing module and the alarm module, the whole vehicle controller is used for receiving a wake-up signal acquired by the wake-up device, an operation signal acquired by the vehicle-mounted sensor and a face image acquired by the image acquisition device, and vehicle alarm operation is performed under the condition that the wake-up signal, the operation signal and the face image all meet alarm conditions. The monitoring system provided by the application solves the problem of frequent false alarm of the existing vehicle monitoring system in different use scenes and environments.

title_en: Automatic forming method and forming equipment for cap-shaped structure of composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite material forming, in particular to an automatic forming method and forming equipment for a cap-shaped structure of a composite material. The method comprises the steps of arranging separable supporting components on a first bulge and a second bulge of forming equipment, arranging air guide layers on air holes, transferring a blank to the supporting components, arranging an inner isolation film unit and an air guide unit on the blank in sequence, arranging separable sealing units on the outer sides of the first bulge, the outer sides of the second bulge and a supporting part of the forming equipment, arranging vacuum film units on the separable sealing units and sealing to form a vacuum bag, vacuumizing the vacuum bag, and sequentially completing preforming and solidification on the blank. According to the method, the separable supporting component is arranged on the forming equipment, so that the two processes of preforming and curing are finished by one-time bag making, the consumption of auxiliary materials and the labor hour are obviously reduced, the risk of sealing quality is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Light energy storage charging three-dimensional device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of light energy storage charging, and discloses a light energy storage charging three-dimensional device which comprises a three-dimensional garage mechanism and a light energy storage charging mechanism, wherein a vehicle access auxiliary mechanism is arranged in the three-dimensional garage mechanism, the three-dimensional garage mechanism comprises a high-strength supporting plate, a pavement, a top plate, a lifting table and a charging socket, and the pavement is arranged outside the high-strength supporting plate. This three-dimensional device that charges of light energy storage goes up and down to with the road surface parallel and level through screw post drive elevating platform to the constant head tank on road surface and elevating platform's spout intercommunication, through servo motor drive threaded rod rotation, rotate the drive through the threaded rod and remove the parking stall and slide to the constant head tank inside, inside the constant head tank is got into to the removal parking stall, fill the constant head tank, make road surface upper surface parallel and level, the vehicle that needs to charge is driven into the inside removal parking stall upper surface on road surface, because the space of road surface upper surface is greater than the inside space of stereo garage, make things convenient for the adjustment of parking and position of vehicle.

title_en: Method and device for controlling maintenance of electric push dip angle in north and south
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling the maintenance of a south-north electric push dip angle. According to the invention, the long term and the half-year period term of the GEO satellite orbit inclination angle are separated, and a motion equation is respectively constructed, so that the relationship between the half-year period term perturbation law and the north-south maintaining range is fully utilized to construct a maintaining constraint condition, so that the maintaining strategy calculated based on the maintaining constraint condition not only takes the advantage of high control stability of the electric propulsion method into consideration, but also the accuracy of the control moment and the ignition moment is improved by respectively calculating the control strategy through the long term and the half-year period, the electric propulsion ignition time can be effectively reduced, the influence of the electric propulsion method on the satellite longitude is reduced on the premise that the orbit inclination angle meets the maintaining requirement, the fuel consumption is reduced, and the right-hand warp fluctuation of the ignition point in the control strategy period is small.

title_en: Hybrid power system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid power system and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of vehicles, wherein the hybrid power system comprises an engine, a generator, a driving motor, a clutch, a differential mechanism, a speed regulating mechanism, an intermediate gear pair, a driving gear pair, an input shaft, a first intermediate shaft and an output shaft, wherein the engine is in transmission connection with the input shaft, the input shaft is sleeved with the speed regulating mechanism, the engine is in transmission connection with the generator through the speed regulating mechanism, the driving motor is in transmission connection with the driving gear pair, the driving gear pair is in transmission connection with the output shaft, the first intermediate shaft is in transmission connection with the output shaft through the intermediate gear pair and the driving gear pair, the output shaft is in transmission connection with the differential mechanism, and the clutch is used for controlling the combination or disconnection of the input shaft and the first intermediate shaft so as to control the coupling or decoupling of the engine and the driving motor. The technical scheme provided by the invention improves the efficiency of the hybrid power system and reduces the energy consumption.

title_en: Automobile charging pile and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of charging piles and discloses an automobile charging pile and a method thereof, wherein the automobile charging pile comprises a pile body, at least four groups of fan modules are arranged on the side of the pile body, each group of fan modules comprises a spiral pipe, an ash storage bin, a plurality of air holes and a plurality of centrifugal holes, the ash storage bin is arranged on the side wall of the pile body, the inside of the ash storage bin is circular, when the fan modules work, air enters the spiral pipe through the air holes, and because the air holes are distributed at one side of the spiral pipe far away from the center of the pile body and at equal distance, spiral airflow is formed in the pipe after the air enters the spiral pipe, under the action of the spiral airflow, impurities such as dust and the like mixed in the air are influenced by centrifugal force, at the moment, the centrifugal holes play a role, the impurities such as the dust and the like are thrown out into the ash storage bin through the centrifugal holes under the action of the centrifugal force, so that preliminary dust separation on the air entering the charging pile is realized, and the influence of the dust on the inner elements of the charging pile is reduced.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, medium and forklift for driving outside vehicle image assistance
abstract_en: The application relates to an off-vehicle image assisted driving method, an off-vehicle image assisted driving device, equipment, a medium and a forklift, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving current image data acquired by each camera, wherein the current image data acquired by different cameras are image data acquired from different angles outside a vehicle body; splicing the current image data to obtain a panoramic image outside the vehicle body; and sending the panoramic image to a visual display so that the visual display provides the panoramic image for a driver in the vehicle body. According to the application, the driving operation of the driver is assisted by the panoramic image outside the vehicle, so that the problem of the blind area of the field outside the vehicle by the driver is greatly solved, a wider visual angle is provided, the driver can observe the surrounding situation in real time, and the possibility of collision in the driving process is reduced.

title_en: Unmanned surface vehicle with annular anti-collision structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water surface unmanned ship with an annular anti-collision structure, which comprises a water surface unmanned ship body, wherein an anti-collision mechanism is arranged at the bow of the water surface unmanned ship body, and an interception mechanism is arranged at the outer side of the water surface unmanned ship body; according to the invention, the extension and the resetting of the extension end of the air cylinder enable the annular pipe to spray water above the annular anti-collision plate, so that the outer wall of the annular anti-collision plate is effectively cleaned, the adhesion of garbage is prevented, the cleaning and the attractiveness of the annular anti-collision plate are maintained, the difficulty in recycling due to the adhesion of garbage is avoided, meanwhile, the ice breaking hammer breaks the thin ice on the bank, the convenience is provided for recycling the unmanned surface vehicle body, the damage or the interference of the thin ice to the unmanned surface vehicle body is avoided, and the stability and the safety of the unmanned surface vehicle body under a complex environment are ensured.

title_en: Parking method, medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a parking method, a medium and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of vehicles, wherein the parking method comprises the steps of determining a drivable area corresponding to a target parking space, wherein the drivable area represents an area which does not comprise an obstacle and surrounds the target parking space, and the target parking space is a parallel parking space; when the length of the target parking space is greater than the length of the vehicle body and less than or equal to a preset length threshold value, the vehicle is controlled to park into the target parking space from a drivable area according to a target reference point, wherein the vehicle can steer around the target reference point through four-wheel independent driving, and the turning radius of the vehicle when the vehicle steers around the target reference point is smaller than the turning radius of the vehicle when the vehicle steers at the maximum turning angle of the front wheels. Therefore, for a parallel parking space with a smaller size, the vehicle can rotate at a larger angle by steering around the target reference point, the posture of the vehicle body can be easily adjusted in a narrow drivable area, and the vehicle can be parked in the parking space, so that the automatic parking efficiency is improved.

title_en: Seedling throwing mechanism, seedling throwing machine and unmanned aerial vehicle seedling throwing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seedling throwing mechanism, a seedling throwing machine and unmanned aerial vehicle seedling throwing equipment, which comprises a seedling taking unit, a seedling taking driving unit and a seedling taking driving unit, wherein the seedling taking unit comprises a seedling cutter support, a rotary driving unit and a cutter head, the rotary driving unit and the cutter head are arranged on the seedling cutter support, the cutter head is provided with a seedling clamping groove, the rotary driving unit is connected with the cutter head, the cutter head is driven to rotate through the rotary driving unit, the cutter head is in a seedling taking state at a seedling taking position and is in a seedling throwing state at a seedling throwing position, seedlings can be clamped into the seedling clamping groove in the seedling throwing position in the seedling throwing state, the seedling throwing state is opposite to the seedling taking state, the cutter head is turned upwards, the cutter head is prevented from obstructing the seedlings from being thrown out of a notch of the seedling clamping groove, and the seedling taking driving unit is connected with the seedling cutter support and is used for driving the seedling taking unit to reciprocate between the seedling taking position and the seedling throwing position. According to the scheme, the loss of throwing force caused by the obstruction of the cutter head when the seedlings are thrown out can be avoided, the soil entering depth after the seedlings are thrown out is increased, and the growth of the seedlings is facilitated.

title_en: Braking control method and mower
abstract_en: The application provides a braking control method and a mower, wherein the braking control method comprises the following steps of obtaining a parking signal, starting timing when the parking signal is in an enabling state, judging whether a preset braking condition is met according to the current rotating speed of a driving motor and/or the timing duration, and controlling a braking piece to perform braking operation if the preset braking condition is met. The application can reduce the abrasion generated on the brake piece and the friction heat generated on the friction surface in the braking process of the brake, thereby prolonging the service life of the brake piece.

title_en: Driving wheel for four-way vehicle of three-dimensional garage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving wheel for a three-dimensional garage four-way vehicle, which comprises a wheel main body, wherein the wheel main body is connected with a clutch flange shaft fixed on a power shaft through a clutch pin, the clutch pin is movably connected with the clutch flange shaft, the connection between the wheel main body and the power shaft is controllably disconnected through the clutch pin, and the wheel main body disconnected with the power shaft can freely rotate relative to the power shaft. The advantage utilizes the cooperation of clutch flange axle fixed on the power shaft of clutch mechanism middle clutch pin, link together wheel main part and power shaft, the power shaft drives the wheel main part rotation during the use, guarantee the normal power take off and the operation of four-way car, when four-way car trouble, rotatory clutch pin, clutch pin can withdraw from clutch flange axle, disconnection wheel main part and power shaft's connection, turn into the wheel main part and do not receive the power shaft constraint and the free rotatory "free wheel", conveniently drag four-way car and shift out, solve current four-way car and move out in the three-dimensional storehouse after the trouble, the wheel is unable, the problem that four-way car is difficult to shift out.

title_en: Building block type upper vehicle body and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle body structures, and particularly discloses a building block type upper vehicle body and a vehicle, wherein the upper vehicle body comprises a side wall reinforcing inner frame assembly, a rear side wall inner frame assembly, a top cover rear cross beam assembly and a top cover front cross beam assembly, wherein the side wall reinforcing inner frame assembly comprises an A column upper reinforcing plate, a B column reinforcing plate and a threshold outer reinforcing plate which are connected in pairs, the rear side wall inner frame assembly is arranged at the rear side of the side wall reinforcing inner frame assembly, the rear side wall inner frame assembly comprises a C column lower reinforcing plate and a rear wheel cover outer plate, a surrounding space is formed between the C column lower reinforcing plate and the rear wheel cover outer plate, the top cover rear cross beam assembly is arranged above the rear side wall inner frame assembly, and the top cover front cross beam assembly is arranged at the front side of the top cover rear cross beam assembly and above the side wall reinforcing inner frame assembly. The building block type upper vehicle body and the vehicle improve the structural strength of the vehicle body and reduce the development cost.

title_en: Constant-speed cruise control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of constant-speed cruising, in particular to a constant-speed cruising control method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps that a multifunctional steering wheel sends a pulse signal of a constant-speed cruising switch to an engine controller through a CAN bus in response to the pulse signal of the constant-speed cruising switch to control a vehicle to enter a pre-cruising state; when the vehicle is in the constant-speed cruising state, the vehicle speed adjusting signal is generated according to the set vehicle speed adjusting step length in the set constant-speed cruising vehicle speed range, and the cruising vehicle speed is adjusted. The invention can effectively identify the cruising operation intention of the driver on the basis of canceling the button wiring harness loop of the constant-speed cruising button of the multifunctional steering wheel, and efficiently and stably realize the constant-speed cruising function.

title_en: Large buoy throwing device
abstract_en: The application discloses a large buoy throwing device which comprises a buoy main body and an anchor chain main body, wherein a first anchor chain segment is arranged below the buoy main body, a first connecting piece is arranged at the end part of the first anchor chain segment, a second connecting piece is arranged at one end of the anchor chain main body, the large buoy throwing device comprises a buoyancy main body with a conical limiting hole, the buoyancy main body comprises two semi-ring pieces, the connecting ends of the two semi-ring pieces are in rotary fit, the upper end face of the matching end of one semi-ring piece is provided with a limiting notch, the limiting notch is used for hanging the first anchor chain segment, the matching ends of the two semi-ring pieces are provided with locking and unlocking structures, when the locking and unlocking structures are in a locking state, the two semi-ring pieces can be mutually rotated and opened, and when the locking and unlocking structures are in an unlocking state, the buoy main body can be separated from the buoyancy main body. According to the application, the buoy body can be placed through the buoyancy body, so that the buoy body is protected, and the buoyancy body and the buoy body can be separated through the locking and unlocking structure.

title_en: Thermal management system and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a thermal management system and a vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of vehicles. The thermal management system includes a first control valve assembly connected between each of the battery sub-water circuits and the passenger compartment water circuit, a second control valve assembly connected between each of the battery sub-water circuits and each of the motor sub-water circuits, wherein the first control valve assembly is configured to control each of the battery sub-water circuits to selectively communicate with the passenger compartment water circuit, and the second control valve assembly is configured to control each of the battery sub-water circuits to selectively communicate with each of the motor sub-water circuits to selectively exchange heat between each of the sub-refrigerant circuits, each of the battery sub-water circuits, each of the motor sub-water circuits, and the passenger compartment water circuit. According to the thermal management system provided by the application, the battery water loop, the motor water loop and the passenger cabin water loop are coupled, so that the comprehensive management of heat of a plurality of modules is realized, the energy consumption of a vehicle is further reduced, and the cruising time of the vehicle is improved.

title_en: Lidar device and vehicle with lidar device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lidar device (10 a;10 b) having a lidar unit (12 a;12 b), at least one cover element (14 a;14 b) covering the lidar unit (12 a;12 b), and a cleaning unit (16 a;16 b) comprising a wiper arm (18 a;18 b) for cleaning the cover element (14 a;14 b), a drive unit (20 a;20 b) for providing a drive force, and a transmission unit (22 a;22 b) for transmitting the drive force from the drive unit (20 a;20 b) to the wiper arm (18 a;18 b). It is proposed that the transmission unit (22 a;22 b) has at least one compensation element (24 a;24 b) for transmitting a driving force to the wiper arm (18 a;18 b) and for compensating a distance between a drive shaft (26 a;26 b) of the drive unit (20 a;20 b) and the wiper arm (18 a;18 b) that varies during a wiping movement.

title_en: Lane center line determining method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent driving, in particular to a lane center line determining method, a lane center line determining device, lane center line determining equipment and a lane center line determining medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a left lane line and a right lane line output by a current camera; the method comprises the steps of determining the longest length of a first length of a left lane line and a second length of a right lane line as sampling distances, determining the first transverse distance of each first sampling point on a target lane line according to the sampling distances and the number of preset sampling points, determining the transverse distance variance of the target lane line according to the first transverse distance of each first sampling point on the target lane line, determining a reference lane line from the left lane line and the right lane line according to the transverse distance variance of the left lane line, the transverse distance variance of the right lane line and a first preset variance threshold, wherein the reference lane line is used for determining a lane center line. The method and the device can accurately determine the lane center line.

title_en: Energy consumption method for consuming air flow and noise of high-speed vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy consumption method for consuming air flow and noise of a high-speed vehicle, which comprises a box chamber, a plurality of enclosing structures and an energy consumption chamber, wherein the box chamber is arranged along the running direction of the box chamber, the enclosing structures are arranged in the box chamber at intervals along the extending direction of the box chamber, the outer walls of the enclosing structures and the inner walls of the box chamber form the energy consumption chamber together, when the high-speed vehicle runs through the enclosing structures, the air flow and noise generated by the high-speed vehicle form inflow and backflow mutual interference and collision in the energy consumption chamber so as to consume the air flow and noise of the high-speed vehicle.

title_en: Steel-aluminum hybrid vehicle body structure of unmanned vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle body structures, in particular to a steel-aluminum hybrid vehicle body structure of an unmanned vehicle, which comprises a chassis, side wing plates, a front baffle plate, a rear baffle plate and a skylight connecting plate; the side wing plates are respectively connected to two sides of the underframe, the two side wing plates are respectively provided with hub avoidance areas, the front baffle plate is connected to the front ends of the two side wing plates and is close to the bottoms of the two side wing plates, the rear baffle plate is connected to the rear ends of the two side wing plates and is close to the bottoms of the two side wing plates, the rear baffle plate is obliquely arranged, the top of the rear baffle plate is behind the bottom of the rear baffle plate, the bottom of the rear end of the skylight connecting plate is connected to the top of the rear baffle plate, the top surface of the skylight connecting plate is a cambered surface, and the skylight connecting plate and the rear baffle plate form smooth transition. The inclined design of the rear baffle and smooth transition of the skylight connecting plate can improve aerodynamic characteristics, effectively guide airflow, reduce air resistance and turbulence at the tail of a vehicle and improve stability during high-speed running.

title_en: Synchronization method, equipment, pattern synchronization display method and display device
abstract_en: The application relates to a distributed equipment communication technology and discloses a synchronization method, equipment, a pattern synchronization display method and a display device, wherein the synchronization method comprises the following steps of periodically broadcasting own count values, wherein the own count values come from counters contained in the equipment, the count values of the counters are increased at a fixed speed, receiving count values broadcasted by other equipment in a time period when the own count values are not broadcasted, comparing each count value with the current own count value, updating the count values of the counters contained by the own by using the received count values if the count values are larger than the sum of the current own count values plus a set threshold value, and not updating the own count values if the count values are smaller than or equal to the sum of the current own count values plus the set threshold value, wherein the threshold value is zero or positive. The method has the advantages of simple synchronization mode and less occupied resources, and can be applied to the scene of dynamic change of equipment.

title_en: Driver and passenger monitoring fusion method, system and related products
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and related products for monitoring and fusing drivers and passengers, relates to the technical field of intelligent driving monitoring systems, and solves the problems that control signal lines between a CIS sensor and a vehicle-mounted system are increased, the requirement on the computing capacity of the vehicle-mounted system is increased and the integration difficulty is improved due to a conventional DMS/OMS system fusion scheme; the method has the technical scheme that the method adopts an image sensor to realize the monitoring fusion of the driver area image and the panoramic image in the cabin, reduces the connection with a control line of a vehicle-mounted system, reduces the operation capability requirement on the vehicle-mounted system, reduces the integration difficulty, obtains the panoramic image in the cabin with low frame rate and the driver area image with high frame rate by switching the pixel reading mode in one frame interval, meets the passenger state monitoring requirement and the high-precision driver behavior monitoring requirement, and reduces the occurrence of waste frames/bad frames by switching the pixel reading mode in the field blanking interval, thereby ensuring the smoothness and the stability of the image picture.

title_en: Side-exhausting motor car heating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor car heating device with lateral exhaust, which comprises a heating box, wherein a heating part is arranged in the heating box, the output end of the heating part is connected with a conveying part, a filter box is arranged in the heating box, a partition plate is arranged in the filter box, a through hole is formed in the partition plate, the filter box is connected to the heating part through a pipeline, the input gas is treated through filter particles in the filter box, a filter assembly is arranged at the side end of the heating box, and the filter assembly comprises a water storage tank arranged at the side end of the heating box. This side direction exhaust motor car heating device uses the inside filter granule of filter box to filter the impurity in the air for outside air handles, makes things convenient for the later stage to heat the operation, and the gas of carrying heats it through the heating member, conveniently carries the inside use of motor car carriage, has improved the inside comfort level in carriage, has reduced the burden of overall heating, has improved holistic life.

title_en: Leather-coated ceiling, preparation method thereof and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a dermis cladding ceiling, a preparation method thereof and a vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle components. The leather coating ceiling provided by the embodiment of the invention can avoid the defects of infirm adhesion and cracking of the leather surface layer and the framework layer, and simultaneously, the leather coating ceiling is matched with other leather coating components, the overall texture and touch of a vehicle are improved, and meanwhile, various different leather fabrics can be used for coating, so that the diversity is increased.

title_en: Ship surface attached organism cleaning mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ship cleaning mechanical arms, in particular to a ship surface attached organism cleaning mechanical arm, which comprises a mechanical arm mounting base, wherein magnetic adsorption movable crawler belt components are arranged on two sides of the mechanical arm mounting base, and a control mounting box is fixedly arranged above the mechanical arm mounting base, and has the beneficial effects that: through clearance arm, water jet pipe, water suction pipe and the cooperation of water suction ring pipe, the combination is for having the arm of water jet and rotatory doctor-bar clearance, strike off after the biological shovel of adhering to the boats and ships surface, reduce the damage to the boats and ships surface when improving boats and ships surface cleaning efficiency, simultaneously with water suction pipe and water suction ring pipe combined design waste water recovery subassembly, the rivers that make water jet pipe spray all are intercepted by water suction ring pipe and retrieve, avoid waste water everywhere splash to influence the surrounding environment, utilize cleaning brush roller rotation to clear up the easy problem that the biological clean of boats and ships surface is not in place or clean excessively damage boats and ships surface that appears in the solution prior art.

title_en: High-propulsion underwater bionic robot with asymmetric rigidity swimming arms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-propulsion underwater bionic robot with asymmetric rigidity swimming arms, which comprises a guide cover, a waterproof cabin body, the swimming arms and a swimming power device. The water-proof cabin body comprises a base and a water-proof shell, wherein the base and the water-proof cabin body are fixed by bolts and nuts, are sealed and waterproof by O-shaped rings and silica gel, and bear a buoyancy adjusting device, a gravity center adjusting device, a power storage device, a load and a control panel. The four swimming arms are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the base and driven by the swimming power device to swing reciprocally. The power storage power device comprises a main power motor, a main rotary table, a main stop block, a screw bearing and a driven connecting rod, and drives the swimming power device and the swimming arm to move by storing and releasing kinetic energy through a spring. The invention realizes stable and efficient underwater movement performance through innovative mechanical structure and power design, and simultaneously has excellent gravity center adjusting capability and load capacity.

title_en: Fire-fighting rescue combined device for water falling rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting and rescue combined device for water-falling rescue, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting and rescue and comprises a mounting plate, wherein the mounting plate is fixedly connected to a rescue boat, a rescue mechanism for rescuing water-falling personnel is arranged above the mounting plate, a transmitting mechanism for transmitting the rescue mechanism to the water-falling personnel is arranged above the mounting plate, an ejection mechanism for moving the rescue mechanism to one side of the transmitting mechanism is arranged above the mounting plate, after a life buoy is thrown into the body of a person under water together with a life buoy, if the person under water has a certain strength, the person under water can drill into the life buoy, a second winding roller above the rescue boat winds up a second life rope, the person under water can drag out the person under water, if the person under water does not have a certain strength, the person under water can wind up the first life rope by controlling the first winding roller, the connection rope can be driven to move, the life buoy is gathered through a counterweight lead block to form a bottom, and the person under water is directly fished out through the life buoy.

title_en: Eight-stay-rod main speed reducer mounting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for installing an eight-stay-rod main speed reducer, which belong to the technical field of helicopters, wherein the method for installing the eight-stay-rod main speed reducer comprises the following steps of determining an initial inclination angle, an initial pitching angle and an initial position of the helicopter main speed reducer; the method comprises the steps of adjusting the distance between the bottom of the main speed reducer and a table frame based on the initial position, primarily adjusting the main speed reducer based on the initial inclination angle and the initial pitching angle after the distance is adjusted, secondarily adjusting the main speed reducer, and fixing the main speed reducer. The eight-stay-rod main speed reducer installation method has the advantages of good installation repeatability, effective shortening of the main speed reducer vehicle table installation time, avoidance of repeated installation, reduction of labor intensity of installation staff, improvement of working efficiency, solving of the problem of difficulty in installation coordination among stay rods, simple installation flow, and quick installation by a staff newly contacting with the main speed reducer installation.

title_en: Automobile driving behavior analysis method and system integrating voice recognition
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field, in particular to an automobile driving behavior analysis method and system integrating voice recognition. The method comprises the steps of obtaining voice input content, analyzing the voice input content, identifying vehicle driving problems, determining driving links according to the vehicle driving problems, calling real-time driving data according to the driving links, analyzing the real-time driving data, determining problem relevance, and determining a solution according to the problem relevance. By extracting the voice input content, the problems described by the user are quickly positioned, and a clear direction is provided for diagnosis and analysis. The voice input content is associated with a specific driving link, real-time driving data is called to provide the actual running state of the vehicle when the vehicle driving problem occurs, the root cause of the vehicle driving problem is identified, and the real-time driving data is combined with environmental factors, vehicle component performances and other factors to improve the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of diagnosis.

title_en: Intelligent tracked vehicle for mine safety monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent tracked vehicle for mine safety monitoring, which comprises a running main body, wherein the running main body consists of a protective shell, a protection plate, a driving motor, a transmission gear, an all-terrain track, a mounting port, a mounting head and a searchlight camera, the protection plate is fixedly connected to the left outside of the protective shell, and a plurality of driving motors are respectively and fixedly arranged on the front side wall and the rear side wall inside the protective shell. This intelligent tracked vehicle is used in mine safety control carries out safety monitoring to the internal security environment of ore deposit mainly based on highly integrated monitoring facilities. The invention also has the functions of data analysis, data visualization, equipment autonomous fault investigation, night vision and audible and visual alarm, can greatly improve the mining efficiency and the safety monitoring capability of the mine, is beneficial to improving the production efficiency of the mine, ensures the safety of mine operators and effectively reduces the production and operation risks of the mine.

title_en: Vehicle air conditioner control method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle air conditioner control method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicles. The method comprises the steps of responding to an air conditioner starting instruction, collecting the temperature of the outside environment of the vehicle, determining whether the temperature of the outside environment of the vehicle is in a preset working condition temperature range, starting a compressor if the temperature is in the preset working condition temperature range, determining the target air outlet temperature of the indoor heat exchanger according to temperature control information contained in the air conditioner starting instruction, and determining the opening degree of a second expansion valve according to the actual air outlet temperature and the target air outlet temperature so as to control the air outlet temperature. According to the application, the dynamic distribution of refrigerant circulation is realized through the multi-heat exchanger cooperative architecture and the intelligent algorithm, and the evaporation temperature stability and the air outlet temperature are synchronously optimized and precisely controlled on the premise of no PTC intervention.

title_en: Control method, device, equipment and medium for output power of charging system
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method, a device, equipment and a medium for output power of a charging system, belonging to the technical field of charging automobiles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a charging request of the equipment to be charged is received, determining target required power of the equipment to be charged, and determining the maximum power which can be born by a battery pack in the equipment to be charged; the method comprises the steps of determining a target constraint condition for safe operation of the charging system according to power grid load, distribution capacity, component temperature and component state, generating an adjustment instruction for adjusting output power of the charging system according to target required power, maximum power born by a battery pack and the target constraint condition, and controlling a power adjustment module of the charging system according to the adjustment instruction so as to adjust the output power of the charging system. The method can not only greatly improve the safety of the charging system in the running process, but also ensure the maximization of the output power of the charging system.

title_en: Information configuration method and device of trackside equipment monitoring unit system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an information configuration method and device of a track side equipment monitoring unit system and related equipment, wherein the method can be applied to a server and comprises the steps of obtaining equipment information of an information tuning matching unit of each track equipment monitoring acquisition extension on a target power carrier line in the track side equipment monitoring unit system; the method comprises the steps of determining a target configuration track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set from each track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set on a target power carrier line, and transmitting equipment information of an information tuning and matching unit of the target configuration track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set to the target configuration track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set through a preset interaction channel so as to realize information configuration of the target configuration track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set, namely, the method can remotely realize information configuration work of each track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set in a track side equipment monitoring and collecting unit system through a PC (personal computer), does not need to go on a track, and configuration writing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Safety monitoring system and method for new energy automobile battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety monitoring system and method for a new energy automobile battery, the system comprises a conventional vibration monitoring module, an impact capturing module, a cross verification module, an accumulated influence module, an early warning module and a storage and learning module. The conventional vibration monitoring module obtains a vibration characteristic baseline through multi-scale analysis, and the impact capturing module captures instantaneous impact and extracts characteristics such as peak value, duration time, energy concentration degree and the like. If the loosening risk is judged to exist, electromagnetic field, acoustic and temperature information are further collected through a cross verification module, whether substantial loosening is generated or not is comprehensively estimated, and if the loosening is not generated, a residual influence value is calculated through an accumulation influence module and accumulated in a historical impact parameter so as to capture fatigue effects caused by small impact accumulation for many times. The storage and learning module records the impact and evaluation results each time and optimizes the threshold value through a self-learning algorithm, so that the detection precision and the safety guarantee of the battery fixing structure loosening risk are improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for planning speed running curve of heavy-duty train
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of rail transit, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for planning a speed running curve of a heavy-duty train. According to the method, the energy consumption factors are comprehensively considered, the train is guided to select a more energy-saving speed running path through the pheromone and the heuristic information, and the running energy consumption of the train is effectively reduced. Compared with some optimization algorithms with low convergence speed, the method can find out a better running curve faster and improve the optimization efficiency. The method and the system can adapt to different line conditions by discretizing the data and establishing the incidence matrix, and provide an effective speed operation curve optimization scheme for heavy-duty trains on different lines.

title_en: Charging conversion system, battery system and water area movable equipment
abstract_en: The charging conversion system provided by the embodiment of the application comprises a charging main circuit and a control circuit of the charging main circuit. The charging main circuit comprises a charging pile charging module and a charging module of a chargeable charger which are connected in parallel. The control circuit comprises a selection circuit, a charging pile control circuit and a chargeable battery control circuit, wherein the charging pile control circuit and the chargeable battery control circuit are electrically connected with the selection circuit. The selection circuit has a first mode and a second mode. The first mode is used for conducting the control loop of the chargeable battery to control the conduction of the charging module of the chargeable battery, and disconnecting the control loop of the charging pile to control the disconnection of the charging module of the charging pile. The second mode is used for conducting the charging pile control loop to control the charging pile charging module to be conducted, and disconnecting the chargeable charging pile control loop to control the chargeable charging module to be disconnected. The system provided by the application is used for realizing the switching between the charging of the charging pile and the charging of the chargeable battery, has high integration degree, and is convenient for the switching management of the charging mode.

title_en: Non-pneumatic tire and small-sized mobile vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention provides a non-pneumatic tire having high visibility regardless of day and night while securing sufficient durability and the like, and a small-sized mobile vehicle equipped with the non-pneumatic tire. The non-pneumatic tire includes an inner tube mounted on an axle, an outer tube surrounding the inner tube from a radial outer side, and a tread member mounted on an outer circumferential surface of the outer tube, and a plurality of connecting members connecting the outer circumferential surface of the inner tube and an inner circumferential surface of the outer tube, wherein a visual recognition region having an optical characteristic such that a reflectance of light in a first wavelength region having a wavelength of 500nm to 510nm is 40% to 80% inclusive and a reflectance ratio of light in a second wavelength region having a wavelength of 420nm to 650nm inclusive is 0.4 or less is formed on a surface of at least one of the inner tube, the outer tube, and the connecting members intersecting an axial direction of the outer tube.

title_en: Ship liquid cargo conveying device and installation and use method thereof
