abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ship engineering and discloses a ship liquid cargo conveying device and an installation and use method thereof, wherein the ship liquid cargo conveying device comprises a receiving assembly, a receiving assembly and a control assembly, wherein the receiving assembly is used for being installed on a wharf; the device comprises a winch, a jumper, a compensation assembly, a receiving assembly and a conveying pipe, wherein the winch is arranged on a replenishment ship, the jumper is fixedly connected to the winch, the jumper can be wound on the winch, the compensation assembly can be arranged on the replenishment ship, the second end of the jumper passes through the compensation assembly and is detachably connected to the receiving assembly, the compensation assembly is used for releasing or accommodating the jumper to compensate relative movement between the replenishment ship and a wharf, and the conveying pipe is hung on the jumper and is used for conveying liquid cargoes. The ship liquid cargo conveying device and the installation and use method thereof provided by the invention can effectively compensate the relative movement between the replenishment ship and the wharf, ensure that the conveying pipe is in a safe state and improve the conveying safety and reliability.

title_en: Seed manure simultaneously-sowing equipment and unmanned aerial vehicle provided with same
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of sowing equipment, and provides a fertilizer simultaneous sowing device and an unmanned aerial vehicle provided with the same, which comprises a material box, wherein the material box comprises a sowing box and a fertilizer box which are mutually isolated, the sowing box and the fertilizer box are respectively provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet, a transmission mechanism comprises a transmission shaft rod, two blanking rotating shafts connected to the transmission shaft rod, and a driving motor for driving the transmission shaft rod to rotate, the driving motor is connected to the outside of the material box, the transmission shaft rod penetrates through the sowing box and the fertilizer box, the two blanking rotating shafts are respectively positioned in the sowing box and the fertilizer box, and the two blanking rotating shafts synchronously rotate and respectively push materials in the sowing box and the fertilizer box to drop from the corresponding discharge outlets during rotation. The rotation speed of the driving motor is adjusted to synchronously control the blanking amount of the seeding box and the fertilizer box, so that the seed and fertilizer are simultaneously sowed, and the seeding effect and the seeding efficiency are improved.

title_en: Display control device, display control method, display control program, and display system for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention provides a display control device for a vehicle, a display system for a vehicle, a display control method for a vehicle, and a display control program for a vehicle, wherein the display control device for a vehicle includes a memory and a processor connected to the memory, and when a grip of a steering wheel by a passenger is required, the processor causes a display unit provided in a vehicle cabin to display a guidance image for the grip of the passenger to request the steering wheel, and when the grip of the passenger to request the steering wheel is before switching from automatic driving to manual driving during continuation of automatic driving of the vehicle, the processor causes the display unit to highlight the guidance image, as compared with a case where the grip of the passenger to request the steering wheel is continued during continuation of automatic driving of the vehicle.

title_en: European standard type steel container flatcar chassis and railway container flatcar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an European standard type steel container flatcar underframe and a railway container flatcar, which comprise two side beams, wherein a plurality of cross beams, two split carrying beams and two traction beams are fixedly arranged between the two side beams, the cross beams are arranged along the length direction of the side beams, end beams are arranged at two ends of the side beams, two ends of the end beams are fixedly connected with the two side beams respectively, a sleeper beam is arranged between the end beams and the cross beams at two ends of the side beams, the two traction beams are respectively arranged between the end beams and the sleeper beams at the end parts of the side beams, two ends of the traction beams are respectively connected with the end beams and the sleeper beams, and split carrying beams are arranged between the sleeper beams and the cross beams. The modularized manufacturing of the underframe is realized, the problem that the post-welding repair operation is needed in the traditional manufacturing mode is solved, and the manufacturing and transportation cost of the vehicle is reduced through modularized assembly.

title_en: Light unmanned aerial vehicle braking system for running, taking off and landing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a running take-off and landing light unmanned aerial vehicle braking system which comprises balance rods fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the tail of an unmanned aerial vehicle body, tail wings fixedly connected to the end parts of the two balance rods, embedded mounting grooves formed in the lower surfaces of the two balance rods, and braking devices arranged in the embedded mounting grooves. The inside sliding connection of spout has the slider, and the surface fixedly connected with support arm of slider, and the left side of slider is connected with swing arm two through the pivot, and the inside swing joint of holder has friction disc installation movable seat. Through the connection of two swing arms and lead to baffle and guide pulley as the direction, finally make friction disc installation movable seat drive the friction disc and be close to the runway of taking off and land to produce frictional force, brake unmanned aerial vehicle, the device braking point is located unmanned aerial vehicle's latter half, makes it produce great drag system power, helps unmanned aerial vehicle short distance to stop when the landing, and the device makes it effectively avoid unmanned aerial vehicle route of marcing to appear beat and drift when braking through the symmetry cloth.

title_en: Fill electric pile swing arm device and fill electric pile
abstract_en: The application provides a charging pile swing arm device and a charging pile, wherein the charging pile swing arm device comprises a base, a main shaft, a coil spring balancer, a swing arm and a spring balancer, wherein a first bearing is arranged on the top surface of the base, the first end of the main shaft is connected with the base, the main shaft is configured to rotate in the base, the coil spring balancer is connected with the second end of the main shaft, an abutting structure abutting against the first bearing is arranged at the bottom of the coil spring balancer, the swing arm is connected with the coil spring balancer, and the swing arm drives the coil spring balancer to rotate when swinging so as to drive the main shaft to rotate. According to the charging pile swing arm device and the charging pile, the coil spring balancer is arranged at the second end of the main shaft, so that the effective length of a gun wire can be increased, the waste of the length of the gun wire is reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Steering assistance control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a steering power-assisted control method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of determining steering differential driving force and driving main shaft length based on steering parameters when steering is performed under a differential driving working condition; and controlling the steering assistance of the vehicle based on the corrected steering assistance torque. The steering power assisting moment is compensated by correcting the steering power assisting moment, so that the steering hand feeling of a driver when driving a vehicle can be kept consistent, and the steering stability is ensured.

title_en: All-terrain vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses an all-terrain vehicle which comprises a frame, a container system, an electric system, a hydraulic device and a lock device, wherein the electric system is supported by the frame and connected to the power system, the hydraulic device is supported by the frame and electrically connected to the electric system, the lock device is supported by the frame and connected to the hydraulic device in a transmission manner, the frame comprises a rear support frame and a rotating support frame which are positioned behind the all-terrain vehicle, the rotating support frame is at least partially positioned above the rear support frame and is in rotating connection with the rear support frame, the container system is connected with the rotating support frame and is supported by the rear support frame, the rear support frame and the rotating support frame are locked through the lock device, the lock device comprises a pushing piece which is communicated with the hydraulic device, the pushing piece has a telescopic function, and the hydraulic device can open or close the lock device through adjusting the length of the pushing piece. Through the arrangement, the intelligent degree of the all-terrain vehicle can be improved.

title_en: Parking assist method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a parking assisting method and a vehicle, which are characterized in that scene data of a current parking scene of the vehicle and parking proficiency information of a driver are obtained, the current parking assisting level is determined according to the scene data and the parking proficiency information, a parking assisting function is provided for the driver according to the current parking assisting level, personalized parking assistance is realized, the method describes the parking capability of the driver through the parking proficiency information, according to the method, the device and the system, the parking capability of a driver and scene data of a current parking scene are combined, corresponding parking auxiliary functions are dynamically provided for the driver, the parking accuracy, the parking efficiency and the use rate of the parking functions of the driver can be improved, the self-parking pressure is reduced, the parking safety risk is reduced, the overall satisfaction degree and the trust degree of the user on the parking auxiliary functions are improved, and the parking auxiliary functions can meet the differentiated requirements of users with incapacity of skills.

title_en: Battery system and vehicle
abstract_en: A battery system and a vehicle comprise a first battery cell group, wherein a first polarity end of the first battery cell group is connected with a first input/output port of the battery system through a second switching device, a second polarity end of the first battery cell group is connected with a second input/output port of the battery system, the second battery cell group is connected with the first input/output port, a second polarity end of the second battery cell group is connected with the second input/output port through a third switching device, and a second polarity end of the second battery cell group is connected with the first polarity end of the first battery cell group through the first switching device, wherein the battery cell type of the first battery cell group is different from the battery cell type of the second battery cell group. According to the battery system provided by the embodiment of the disclosure, through selecting a proper battery cell type, such as selecting a battery cell with good low-temperature discharge performance, the battery system can be discharged to work without heating in a low-temperature environment.

title_en: Rearview mirror, vehicle rearview mirror regulation and control method, system, vehicle, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rearview mirror, a vehicle rearview mirror regulation and control method, a system, a vehicle, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of automobiles. The specific implementation mode of the rearview mirror comprises a display mirror surface and a plurality of driving units arranged at the rear of the display mirror surface, wherein at least one driving unit controls one mirror surface area of the display mirror surface, the mirror surface area is a partial area of the display mirror surface, any driving unit responds to a received regulation and control signal and regulates and controls the curvature of the controlled mirror surface area according to a control parameter indicated by the regulation and control signal and the target curvature of the mirror surface area, and at least one mirror surface area of the display mirror surface changes the curvature under the driving of the corresponding driving unit so as to regulate the visible area range of the display mirror surface. This embodiment enables a change in the range of the viewable area by adjusting the rearview mirror.

title_en: On-load travel control method, on-load travel control device, work machine, and machine-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load running control method, a device, a working machine and a machine-readable storage medium, wherein the load running control method comprises the steps of determining a load running mode according to the current load working condition of the working machine, wherein the load running mode comprises a low-speed heavy-load mode, an equilibrium load mode and a high-speed light-load mode; under the condition that the loading running mode is confirmed to be entered and the loading running condition is met, the suspension arm is locked in a turning mode; the current travel speed of the work machine is controlled according to the load travel mode. The on-load running control method ensures the stability of the suspension arm in the on-load running process by determining that the suspension arm meets the on-load running condition and locking the turning movement of the suspension arm, determines that the working machine is in a low-speed heavy-load mode, an equilibrium on-load mode or a high-speed light-load mode through the current on-load working condition, adaptively adjusts and controls the current running speed according to the on-load running mode of the working machine, reduces the vehicle speed adjusting difficulty and improves the running stability.

title_en: Multi-step claw type spider robot and motion control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-step claw type spider robot and a motion control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of claw type spider robots, wherein the claw type spider robot comprises a main body component, a claw type four-limb component and a driving component, the main body component comprises an upper body shell and a lower bottom plate, the upper body shell is connected with the lower bottom plate through a clamping plate, and a cavity is formed between the upper body shell and the lower bottom plate; the claw type four-limb assembly comprises a shoulder joint, a connecting rod and a lower arm, wherein the shoulder joint is connected with the connecting rod, the connecting rod is connected with the lower arm, the tail end of the claw type four-limb assembly is connected with an arc-shaped clamp holder, the driving assembly comprises a claw steering engine, a shoulder joint external steering engine, a shoulder joint steering engine and a rotary steering engine, the multi-step design is adopted, and flexible and various motion control is realized by adjusting the opening and closing angle of the claw and the rotation angle of the shoulder joint. Meanwhile, the solar panel and the friction nano generator are combined, so that the energy source supplementing problem in long-term operation is effectively solved.

title_en: Wireless network infrastructure, aircraft, and method for wireless communication on an aircraft
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to wireless network infrastructure, aircraft, and methods for wireless communication on an aircraft. The present invention provides a wireless network infrastructure for an aircraft comprising a first communication unit configured to receive data signals from and transmit data signals to a control system located in a secure domain of the aircraft, configured as a first network node of a wireless communication network, a second communication unit located in a non-secure domain of the aircraft, configured as a second network node, of corresponding aircraft devices configured to be operated by and transmit control signals transmitted thereto from the control system through the wireless communication network, each of the aircraft devices having communication units further comprising additional control means for independently operating the aircraft devices dissimilar to the control signals transmitted through the wireless communication network. The invention provides an aircraft including a wireless network infrastructure and a method for wireless communication on an aircraft.

title_en: Method and device for shooting through mobile vehicle and mobile vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicles and discloses a method and a device for shooting through a mobile vehicle and the mobile vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of controlling a touch screen of the mobile vehicle to display a virtual mobile vehicle image according to a first trigger instruction if the first trigger instruction is received; the method comprises the steps of receiving clicking operation, long-press operation or sliding touch operation on a touch screen of a mobile vehicle, matching at least one corresponding first camera according to the clicking operation position, the long-press operation position or the sliding touch operation track, starting the at least one first camera to shoot, obtaining at least one picture or video shot by the at least one matched first camera, and displaying at least one picture frame or video frame through the touch screen. The method realizes simple touch operation selection and enables different cameras, improves operation convenience, and solves the problems of inconvenient and untimely shooting of the cameras in the driving process of the vehicle.

title_en: Multistage vibration damper with hysteresis adjustment means
abstract_en: A multi-stage vibration damping device having a mechanical stop is disclosed. A vibration damping device includes a first damping unit having a first input member, a first output member, and a first spring, a second damping unit having a second input member, a second output member, and a second spring, and disposed axially outside the first damping unit, a rotor unit including a rotor sleeve, and a mechanical limiter for limiting relative rotation between the first input member and the first output member or the second input member beyond a predetermined range.

title_en: Control method of wheel-foot robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a wheel foot robot, which comprises the steps of S1, switching the wheel foot robot from a first posture to a second posture, S2, acquiring posture information of a frame body in real time, and S3, controlling a second rotating piece to rotate around a second rotating shaft according to the posture information of the frame body so as to keep dynamic balance of the wheel foot robot. In the invention, when the wheel foot robot is in the second posture, the second rotating shaft is in an angle parallel to the Z-axis direction or approximately parallel to the Z-axis direction, so that the first wheel foot can be driven to generate displacement along the X-axis direction when the second rotating piece rotates around the second rotating shaft, the deflection of the balance frame body along the X-axis direction is facilitated, and the dynamic balance of the whole wheel foot robot along the X-axis direction is kept when the whole wheel foot robot advances along the Y-axis direction.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle power management and information monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle power supply management and information monitoring system which comprises power supply management and information monitoring equipment, wherein the power supply management and information monitoring equipment is connected among an unmanned aerial vehicle power supply, an unmanned aerial vehicle flight control and an unmanned aerial vehicle load set, a unified power supply management module is integrated in the power supply management and information monitoring equipment and is used for receiving electric energy of the unmanned aerial vehicle power supply and providing one or more kinds of transformed stable power supply for the unmanned aerial vehicle load set, and an information and control hub module is used as an information and control relay between the unmanned aerial vehicle flight control and unmanned aerial vehicle load set and a sensor. The invention aims to solve the problems of complex flight control interface, excessive operation load, low system integration and insufficient reliability caused by power supply decentralized management caused by direct data and control interaction between a plurality of airborne devices and a flight controller in the existing unmanned aerial vehicle system.

title_en: Subway shield door
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway shielding door which comprises two opposite side fixed doors, wherein the fixed doors are respectively provided with a shielding sliding door in a sliding manner, and one opposite ends of the two shielding sliding doors are provided with blocking plates for blocking passengers at the side from entering a carriage. The device can effectively prevent abnormal people from flowing into the carriage from the side, and ensure the normal operation of the subway.

title_en: Vehicle energy mode planning method and device, electronic equipment, medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first energy mode corresponding to each road section of a target driving route and a first starting SOC corresponding to each first energy mode according to initial SOCs of a battery and target SOCs when the battery reaches an end point of the target driving route, determining an SOC range corresponding to each road section by taking the first starting SOCs corresponding to each road section as a center and taking a first preset value as a radius, performing discretization processing on the SOC range corresponding to each road section to obtain a plurality of first SOC discrete values, determining a second energy mode corresponding to each road section and a second starting SOCs corresponding to the second energy mode according to the initial SOCs, the target SOCs and the first SOC discrete values, taking the second starting SOCs corresponding to each road section as the center, updating the SOC range corresponding to each road section by taking the second preset value as a radius, obtaining a plurality of second SOC discrete values, and iterating preset times to obtain the target energy modes corresponding to each road section.

title_en: Fruit grading and picking integrated machine based on visual detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fruit grading and picking integrated machine based on visual detection, which relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery and comprises a fixed bottom plate, wherein a conveying seat is arranged at the top of the fixed bottom plate, a conveying mechanism for conveying fruits is arranged in the conveying seat, a visual marking component for sorting the fruits is arranged at the top of one side of an output port of the conveying seat relative to the conveying mechanism, a moving component is arranged at the front side and the rear side of the fixed bottom plate through a supporting rod, and a picking mechanical arm for picking the fruits is arranged on the moving component. The fruit picking machine is flexibly moved and rotated by the aid of the moving assembly through the picking mechanical arm, the second camera rapidly recognizes the maturity and picks fruits, the visual marking assembly accurately marks the fruits, and the sorting assembly accurately sorts the fruits according to the marks. The automatic operation of the picking and sorting machine greatly improves the picking and sorting efficiency, reduces the labor cost and the human error, can rapidly process a large amount of fruits, and is suitable for mass production rhythm.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing integrated flying car and sea, land and air three-purpose aircraft based on same
abstract_en: The invention provides a vertical take-off and landing integrated aerocar, which belongs to the technical field of aerocars, wherein a through hole is formed in a chassis, a rotor wing device is arranged above the through hole, a front rotor wing device is a fixed rotor wing device, a rear rotor wing device is a movable rotor wing device, the movable rotor wing device can change from a horizontal state to a vertical state, air can be blown out to the rear in the vertical state, a plurality of wheels are arranged under the chassis, the front wheels can realize steering through steering devices, the number of the movable rotor wing devices is at least two, and wind speeds blown out to the rear by the two movable rotor wing devices can be different, so that the aerocar can realize steering through wind speed differential in a land mode, further, the aerocar turns more smoothly, a cabin is arranged on the chassis, and an air bag is arranged on the cabin, and is filled with gas with density smaller than the air. The invention has the beneficial effects that the aerocar is suitable for roads and parking lots, and a runway is not needed.

title_en: Range data determining method and device for range-extended automobile, vehicle and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mileage data determining method and device for an extended range automobile, a vehicle and a product. The method comprises the steps of determining the reading sequence of electric data according to the working state of a range extender of a vehicle in a current period, wherein the electric data comprise the accumulated charge quantity of the range extender in the current period and the charge and discharge data of a battery, sequentially reading the electric data according to the reading sequence of the electric data, determining the fuel mileage and the pure electric mileage of the vehicle in the current period according to a mileage determination model corresponding to the read electric data and the read electric data if the current read electric data meets the corresponding value range requirement in the reading process, and updating the accumulated fuel mileage and the accumulated pure electric mileage in accumulated mileage information of the vehicle according to the fuel mileage and the pure electric mileage of the vehicle in the current period. The method improves the accuracy of calculating the fuel mileage and the pure electric mileage.

title_en: Ship board variable balance wing structure for yacht
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of marine equipment, in particular to a ship-board variable balance wing structure for a yacht, which comprises a ship-board body and a ship-board, wherein the ship-board is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the ship-board body, containing grooves are formed in two sides of the ship-board body, balance wing plates are rotatably arranged in the containing grooves, mounting grooves are formed in the ship-board body, an opening and closing driving assembly for controlling the expansion or closure of the balance wing plates is arranged in the mounting grooves, a mounting shell is arranged in the ship-board body, the mounting shell is fixedly connected to the bottom of the ship-board body, L-shaped piston tubes are symmetrically arranged at two ends of the inside of the mounting shell, and buoyancy air bags are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the balance wing plates. The inclined plane damping block of the invention can slightly swing reversely with the swing direction of the ship under the action of mass inertia, can effectively counteract vibration energy, and meanwhile, the piston rods at the two ends are arranged between a push and a pull, so that buoyancy effect difference is generated between buoyancy air bags at the two ends, the side body is easier to overcome the swinging and tilting effect, and the inclination trend of the side body is favorably inhibited.

title_en: Grid reinforced wallboard for aircraft structure and forming mold and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of grid reinforced wall plates, and particularly relates to a grid reinforced wall plate for an aircraft structure, a forming die and a forming method thereof, wherein the grid reinforced wall plate comprises a grid frame, a skin plate is arranged on the grid frame, the skin plate comprises an outer skin arranged on the bottom surface of the grid frame and inner skin arranged on the grid frame, the grid frame comprises a transverse rib core material and a longitudinal rib core material which are connected, the inner skin is positioned between the transverse rib core material and the longitudinal rib core material, the joint between the transverse rib core material and the longitudinal rib core material is called a connecting node, and forming blocks are arranged on each connecting node; the molding blocks effectively enhance the strength and stability of the grid frame. In addition, through the turn-ups cladding of interior covering, horizontal muscle core and indulge muscle core and can closely fix to show the intensity and the structural efficiency that have promoted grid reinforcement wallboard. The special requirements of the aircraft wall plate structure such as an airplane and the like in the aspects of transferring and bearing larger loads are met.

title_en: Optimized electrical head and manufacturing process for ergonomic battery pack assembly and potting leakage prevention
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to optimized electrical heads and manufacturing processes for ergonomic battery pack assembly and potting leakage prevention. An optimized electrical head design for ergonomic cell assembly and potting leakage prevention, a method for making/using such an electrical head, and a vehicle powered by a battery pack equipped with such an electrical head are presented. The electrical head assembly includes interconnect terminals formed with an insulating polymer and coupled to a set of terminal connectors electrically connected to a set of battery cells inside a protective housing of the battery cell. A head seal formed with a compressible polymer is mounted to the interconnect terminal and compressed on the protective housing. The main head formed with the insulating polymer is coupled to the interconnection terminal or is integrally formed with the interconnection terminal. The main head is coupled to the connector plug to thereby electrically connect the terminal connector in the interconnection terminal to an external load. The main head is mounted to an outer surface of the unit housing.

title_en: Anti-blocking cleaning device for sea door
abstract_en: The application discloses a sea chest anti-blocking cleaning device which comprises a sea chest, a compressed air purging unit, a fire valve, a flow regulating valve and a pressure gauge, wherein the sea chest is arranged on a hull plate, one side, close to the hull plate, of the sea chest is provided with the sea chest, the compressed air purging unit is communicated with the inlet end of the sea chest through a first pipeline, the inlet end of the fire valve is detachably connected with a cabin fire water unit, the inlet end of the flow regulating valve is detachably connected with the outlet end of the fire valve, the outlet end of the flow regulating valve is communicated with the inlet end of the sea chest through a second pipeline, and the pressure gauge is arranged on the second pipeline and is positioned at the outlet end of the flow regulating valve.

title_en: High-precision synchronous control lifting device of direct-current motor driven ground penetrating radar instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision synchronous control lifting device of a direct current motor driven type ground penetrating radar instrument, which comprises a trolley main body, a moving assembly, a navigation unit, a hand rest, a mounting bracket and an upper computer, wherein the moving assembly is arranged on the trolley main body, the trolley main body is provided with the mounting station, the mounting station is of a 匚 type structure, the placing assembly is connected to the mounting station in a sliding manner, the ground penetrating radar instrument is placed in the placing assembly, the top of the placing assembly is provided with the top plate, the lifting mechanism is arranged on the trolley main body and fixed with the top plate and used for controlling the placing assembly to lift, the transmission mechanism is arranged on the trolley main body, the navigation unit is arranged on the top surface of the top plate, the hand rest is arranged on the top of the front side of the trolley main body, and the mounting bracket is arranged on the hand rest and provided with the upper computer. The invention improves the automation degree of the detection process of the ground penetrating radar instrument, effectively reduces human errors and is beneficial to acquiring more accurate detection image data.

title_en: Display method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a display method and a display system, wherein the display system comprises windshield glass, a display device, a rotating mechanism and a detecting device, the display method comprises the steps of detecting whether a driver wears polarized sunglasses or not by the detecting device, switching the polarization direction of light rays emitted by the display device through the rotating mechanism based on a detection result, and projecting images by the display device based on the switched polarization direction and reflecting the images through the windshield glass to form a polarized light path which is matched with the vision of the driver. According to the application, through cooperative control of the detection device and the rotating mechanism, automatic adaptation of the polarization direction of the HUD is realized.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering operation and maintenance monitoring method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a hydraulic engineering operation and maintenance monitoring method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a monitoring value coefficient of a target water conservancy monitoring parameter of a target area of a river channel, obtaining a monitoring task set according to the monitoring value coefficient, obtaining residual mileage information of an unmanned aerial vehicle for monitoring the river channel and configuration information of a carried sensor, matching a monitoring task in the monitoring task with the unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle according to distances from the unmanned aerial vehicle to different areas of the river channel, the residual mileage information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the configuration information of the carried sensor, and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to execute the monitoring task set of the river channel according to a matching result to obtain the monitoring information, and obtaining a target digital twin model according to the monitoring information. Through the technical scheme, more accurate monitoring on hydraulic engineering such as river channels can be realized.

title_en: Active adjusting method and system for preventing passenger from diving
abstract_en: The application provides an occupant anti-diving active adjusting method and system. The method comprises the steps of establishing a person-vehicle-chair simulation model, setting a plurality of virtual collision scenes, adjusting safety parameters of a seat and a vehicle to obtain a virtual collision scheme, determining the minimum damage scheme of each scene through simulation and damage evaluation, constructing a database, collecting current person-chair-vehicle information, matching the current person-chair-vehicle information with the database, searching a collision damage optimal scheme after estimating the collision information, and driving an executing mechanism to adjust the safety parameters of the seat and the vehicle according to the collision damage optimal scheme before the vehicle collides, so as to realize the anti-submergence active adjustment of passengers. The system comprises a virtual passenger injury simulation module, a virtual injury evaluation module and a passenger injury evaluation module, wherein the executing mechanism comprises a cushion airbag, a seat damping adjusting mechanism and a turbine worm type seat rotating mechanism. The application can quickly adjust the inclination angle of the cushion and the orientation of the seat, optimize the posture of the passenger, effectively prevent the passenger from diving and improve the safety.

title_en: Light battery bracket structure for electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric automobiles, in particular to a lightweight battery bracket structure for an electric automobile, aiming at the problem that the weight of the bracket is increased by adopting too many bolts to fixedly connect the bracket, the invention provides the following scheme. According to the invention, the two sides of the circumference of the positioning gear are engaged and clamped with the first rack and the second rack, and then the bevel gear assembly is driven to rotate by the external drive so as to enable the two clamping frames to move from the two sides of the U-shaped plate to the middle until the rectangular protrusions arranged in the middle of the inner sides of the horizontal sections of the two clamping frames are clamped with the locking grooves arranged on the circumference of the locking wheel, so that the locking sleeve is limited, and the middle frame, the upper tray and the lower tray are locked to form the battery bracket, thereby avoiding the use of a large number of screws.

title_en: Multi-battery pack charging management system, method and engineering machinery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-battery pack charging management system, a multi-battery pack charging management method and engineering machinery, which comprise VCUs, battery packs, a PDU relay, a DCDC (direct current to direct current) and a charging gun, wherein the VCUs are configured to execute whole vehicle starting control, charging flow logic scheduling, high-voltage component collaborative management and abnormal state processing, the battery packs are provided with a plurality of battery packs, each battery pack is internally provided with an independent BMS (battery management system), the BMS is configured to monitor the running state of the battery pack in real time, the PDU relay is integrated with a positive and negative contactor corresponding to each battery pack and a PDU auxiliary loop contactor connected in series with a DCDC high-voltage power supply loop, the DCDC is configured to convert high-voltage direct current output by the battery pack into low-voltage direct current, the working state of the DCDC is regulated by the VCU, and the charging gun is provided with an anti-misplug mechanical structure and a safety locking function. The invention can realize the parallel charging function of multiple battery packs of the vehicle under any working condition, ensure the cooperative work and safe operation of each battery pack and high-voltage component in the charging process, and effectively improve the charging efficiency and the system reliability.

title_en: Variable-configuration security inspection explosion venting device for bionic unmanned aerial vehicle and application method of variable-configuration security inspection explosion venting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety inspection and explosion venting of a bionic unmanned aerial vehicle, and discloses a variable-configuration safety inspection and explosion venting device for the bionic unmanned aerial vehicle and a use method thereof, comprising a bionic unmanned aerial vehicle body, an extension rod is arranged on the surface of the bionic unmanned aerial vehicle body, the top fixedly connected with power device of extension pole, power device's output fixedly connected with flabellum, visual detection device is installed at the top of bionical unmanned aerial vehicle organism, and the surface fixedly connected with support frame of extension pole, bionical unmanned aerial vehicle organism's bottom fixedly connected with transport frame. According to the invention, the electric telescopic frame is started to push the two inclined plates to move close to each other, when the inclined plates move, the inclined plates are used for shoveling explosives, after the explosives are shoveled, the two inclined plates continue to move close to each other, so that the surfaces of the positioning plates are in contact with the explosives, the positioning plates are used for limiting the explosives, the electric push rod is started to push the inclined plates to move upwards, and when the inclined plates move upwards, the explosives are pushed to enter the transportation frame.

title_en: Vehicle occupant protection system with an airbag and method for operating a vehicle occupant protection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle occupant protection system (12) comprising an airbag (10) having two releasable depth limiting elements (22, 24) which define a variable final depth of the airbag (10) by way of their state in a fully inflated state of the airbag (10), wherein one depth limiting element (22) is designed to be passively releasable by an internal pressure (p) of the airbag (10) and the other depth limiting element (24) is designed to be actively releasable by a signal of a control unit (26). The balloon is capable of assuming at least three different final depths in the depth direction (R) in a fully inflated state, wherein at a minimum final depth (t  1 ) both depth limiting elements (22, 24) remain intact, at an intermediate final depth greater than the minimum final depth (t  1 ) one of the depth limiting elements (22, 24) is released and the other depth limiting element (24, 22) is intact, and at a maximum final depth both depth limiting elements (22, 24) are released. The air bag (10) is inflated at a minimum final depth (t  1 ) when the vehicle is moving in manual mode, and inflated at an intermediate or maximum final depth when the vehicle is moving in autonomous mode.

title_en: Control method for damping of shock absorber
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of vibration absorber damping, which belongs to the technical field of vibration absorption of vehicle suspensions, and comprises the steps of obtaining a current calculation value output by each sub-module of a vibration absorber control model, wherein the sub-module at least comprises one of a canopy module, a ground canopy module, a steering module, a pitching module and a suspension travel module, selecting a current arbitration scheme according to the number and standard deviation of extreme current values of the current calculation values, wherein the current arbitration scheme at least comprises one of outputting the extreme current values, outputting an average current calculation value and outputting a corrected average current calculation value after calculating the average current calculation value, and processing the current calculation value according to the current arbitration scheme for controlling the current of the vibration absorber control model. The invention also provides a control system, electronic equipment and storage medium for the damping of the shock absorber. The invention optimizes the current arbitration scheme through the number of the extreme current values of the current calculated values and the standard deviation, thereby realizing more proper current output control.

title_en: Control method and control system of range-extended vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a control method and a control system of a range-extending vehicle and the vehicle. The control method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant parameters of a vehicle during the operation of the range extender, pre-judging whether the driver has an emergency braking intention or not based on the relevant parameters of the vehicle, and pre-restraining the power of the range extender in advance under the condition that the driver has the emergency braking intention. The application can reduce the power of the range extender in advance through the pre-judgment of the emergency braking of the vehicle, thereby improving the response speed of the emergency braking and guaranteeing the recovery capacity of the braking to the greatest extent.

title_en: Aircraft arm locking mechanism and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aircrafts, in particular to an arm locking mechanism for an aircrafts and a use method thereof, and the arm locking mechanism comprises an airframe, wherein rotating columns are rotatably arranged at four corners of the upper surface of the airframe, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the upper end of each rotating column, a flying fan is fixedly connected to one end of each connecting rod, which is far away from the corresponding rotating column, and the arm locking mechanism further comprises: the locking mechanism is used for automatically locking the rotating column and is arranged at the bottom end of the rotating column. According to the horn locking mechanism for the aircraft and the application method thereof, when the aircraft is in flight, the connecting plate cannot rotate any more due to air pressure, so that the dislocation of the aircraft is prevented, meanwhile, a separate power supply is not required for driving, the cost is saved, air is used for limiting, the whole weight can be lightened, the aircraft can be lighter, the aircraft can be prevented from shaking when being stored, and the non-Newtonian fluid is arranged, so that sundries such as branches can be prevented from fiercely touching the insert ring when the aircraft is in flight, and the horn is unlocked.

title_en: Multi-point unmanned aerial vehicle docking platform
abstract_en: The application provides a multipoint unmanned aerial vehicle connection platform, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle logistics and comprises a building, wherein a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle connection structures are arranged on the building, each unmanned aerial vehicle connection structure comprises a first lifting structure, a charging structure and a transferring structure, the first lifting structure is arranged on the building, one end of the transferring structure extends into the first lifting structure, a plurality of second lifting structures positioned at the transferring structure are further arranged on the building, a plurality of protection structures are arranged at the top of the building, and the positions of the protection structures correspond to the positions of the second lifting structures. According to the application, through the cooperative operation of the first lifting structure, the transfer structure and the second lifting structure, the automatic transportation of goods from the ground to the unmanned aerial vehicle is realized, the manual intervention is reduced, the efficiency is improved, the unmanned aerial vehicle power supply structure is used for fixing packages and supplying and charging the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the charging structure is used for charging the unmanned aerial vehicle power supply structure.

title_en: Vehicle information display method, system chip, electronic device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle information display method, a system chip, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which are applied to the system chip, wherein the system chip comprises a CPU, a GPU and a memory unit which are mutually connected through a system bus. In the embodiment of the application, when the GPU fails, the CPU takes over the display processing of the vehicle information, and performs two-dimensional display processing and output display on the vehicle information in a simplified drawing mode, so that the output display function of the vehicle information is finished, and the negative influence of excessive CPU resource occupation caused by 3D rendering processing on the vehicle information is avoided.

title_en: Vehicular charging pile based on liquid medium cooling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of charging piles, in particular to a vehicular charging pile based on liquid medium cooling, which comprises a pile seat, wherein the outer surface of the pile seat is connected with a gun handle for charging a vehicle, the pile seat is fixedly connected with the gun handle through a cable, the cable is internally provided with a cable for power transmission, an output pipe and a return pipe for cooling the cable through liquid medium are also arranged, the inner end of the gun handle is fixedly provided with a radiating surface shell, the inner end of the gun handle is fixedly provided with a charging head, and a secondary cooling device for reducing heat accumulation in a contact area is arranged between the charging head and the radiating surface shell.

title_en: Thermal management system, defrosting control method and device, vehicle, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a thermal management system, a defrosting control method, a device, equipment and a medium, which relate to the technical field of vehicles, and selecting a target heat source which can participate in defrosting from a plurality of candidate heat sources of the thermal management system, and transferring the heat of the target heat source to a low-temperature radiator for defrosting in a liquid-liquid heat exchange mode and/or a cooling liquid flowing heat transfer mode. And the defrosting loop determined based on the target heat source is utilized to realize heat transfer of the target heat source, so that the heat in different branches/loops in the thermal management system is recycled, and the defrosting energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Method and system for identifying and intercepting abnormal instructions of electric vehicle controller
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying and intercepting an abnormal instruction of an electric vehicle controller, which relate to the technical field of electric vehicle control safety and comprise the steps of calculating execution deviation probability by constructing an instruction dependency graph and an instruction state migration characteristic, and judging the abnormal instruction by adopting an instruction check matrix; the method comprises the steps of storing abnormal instructions into an isolation sandbox, identifying related instructions to form an instruction cluster based on an instruction dependency graph, simulating an expected state, calculating a compensation control sequence and sequencing, and executing after functional completeness verification, so that the control safety of the electric vehicle is effectively improved, and the robustness of a system and the capability of responding to the abnormal instructions are enhanced.

title_en: Built-in safety monitoring device for new energy automobile battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a built-in safety monitoring device of a new energy automobile battery, which comprises a battery box, a box cover and a built-in safety monitoring mechanism, wherein a battery installation cavity is formed in the battery box, the box cover is positioned above the battery box, the edge of the box cover is fixedly installed through bolts, the built-in safety monitoring device comprises a divided safety frame, a down-pressing type monitor and a split-type tight fire extinguishing and cooling assembly, the divided safety frame comprises a plurality of groups of longitudinally arranged partition plates and air guide side plates uniformly installed on one side of the partition plates, a battery unit groove is formed between two adjacent groups of air guide side plates, the down-pressing type monitor is provided with a plurality of groups of air guide cover uniformly installed at the bottom of the box cover, and the down-pressing type monitor comprises a contact plate and an air guide cover positioned above the contact plate. The built-in safety monitoring device arranged in the battery box can realize independent monitoring and quick information feedback of each battery, and can quickly treat the problem of high temperature or ignition of the battery, thereby improving the safety of the automobile battery in the use process.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle shooting device for security inspection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle shooting, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle shooting device for security inspection, which comprises: the unmanned plane is used for carrying out security inspection; the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a shooting device, a radiating pipe, a first bracket and a second bracket, wherein the shooting device is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for shooting, the radiating pipe is arranged at the rear side of the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for radiating heat, and the first bracket is connected to the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, when the temperature of the area where the unmanned aerial vehicle is located reaches the freezing temperature, the cooling pipe can be sealed, and then heat is guided to the rotating shaft of the driving piece, so that the rotating shaft can be heated, the situation that the rotating shaft is frozen can be avoided, the normal use of the driving piece is ensured, the angle of shooting equipment can be adjusted normally, the shooting requirement is met, the cleaning of an air outlet for radiating the heat can be realized, the smoothness of the air outlet is ensured, and the normal radiation of the heat in the unmanned aerial vehicle is ensured.

title_en: Hidden dynamic active heat dissipation four-foot robot body configuration
abstract_en: The application discloses a hidden type dynamic active heat dissipation four-foot robot body structure, which comprises a heat dissipation module, wherein the heat dissipation module comprises a body trunk main frame, an upper duct bottom cover plate, an upper heat dissipation centrifugal turbofan, a lower heat dissipation centrifugal turbofan, a semiconductor heat dissipation sheet, a side heat dissipation centrifugal turbofan, a first heat source, a second heat source, an upper duct top cover plate, a motion motor module, a trunk side cover plate and a heat dissipation system controller, two heat sources are arranged at the center position of the heat dissipation module up and down, the semiconductor heat dissipation sheet is respectively arranged at the upper and lower sides of the heat sources, the heat dissipation system controller is arranged between the two heat sources, the side heat dissipation centrifugal turbofan is respectively arranged at two sides of the heat sources, and the motion motor module is arranged at the side heat dissipation centrifugal turbofan close to the outer side. The application has high integration degree and compact structure, and can realize light weight and modularized design.

title_en: Ship lifesaving device for personnel falling into water
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ship auxiliary equipment, and particularly relates to a ship life saving device for personnel falling into water. After the main hull is close to personnel that fall into water, the rotating motor rotates 90 degrees with the rotating frame, simultaneously hydraulic push rod promotes the rotating frame and rotates downwards, the winding motor controls the wind-up roll to release and pull the hawser, the lifeboat slides to the surface of water along the spacing groove, spacing ball breaks away from the spacing groove, accomplish the release of lifeboat, after personnel get into the lifeboat, the wind-up roll winding pulls the hawser, pull the lifeboat back to the rotating frame, hydraulic push rod drives the rotating frame and changes back horizontal position afterwards, the rotating motor drives the rotating frame and rotates 90 degrees, personnel that fall into water gets into the main hull, realize the safety rescue to personnel that fall into water, compare safer stability with the mode that traditional release the lifeboat through hoist device.

title_en: Lane distance estimation method, system, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a lane line distance estimation method, a lane line distance estimation system, a vehicle, and a storage medium. The lane line distance estimation method comprises the steps of obtaining an original image comprising a vehicle body edge and a lane line, conducting noise reduction processing on the original image to obtain a linear image, wherein the linear image comprises a straight line representing the vehicle body edge and the lane line, converting the linear image into a bird's eye view, wherein the bird's eye view comprises image data of the vehicle body edge and the lane line, and calculating the distance between the vehicle body edge and the lane line based on the image data according to an estimated mapping relation, and the estimated mapping relation represents the mapping relation between the pixel distance of the lane line and the actual distance. According to the lane line distance estimation method and system, accuracy and stability of recognition detection and distance measurement of lane lines can be improved, and meanwhile cost and complexity of vehicle manufacturing can be reduced.

title_en: Series-parallel hybrid system and commercial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobiles, in particular to a series-parallel hybrid system and a commercial vehicle. The series-parallel hybrid system comprises an engine, a first motor, a second motor, a clutch, a gearbox, a first planetary gear set, a first reduction gear set and a torque distribution unit, wherein the engine is connected with the gearbox through the clutch, the output end of the gearbox is connected with the first transmission end of the torque distribution unit through the first planetary gear set, the first motor is connected with the second transmission end of the torque distribution unit through the first reduction gear set, the third transmission end of the torque distribution unit drives a middle axle wheel, the second motor is connected with a rear axle wheel through the second reduction gear set, and the direct drive mode, the pure electric mode, the hybrid mode, the sliding energy recovery mode and the braking energy recovery mode are switched by switching the states of the clutch and the working modes of the first motor and the second motor. The invention realizes the switching of multiple working modes, reduces the reconstruction cost and prolongs the service life.

title_en: Train positioning method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a train positioning method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a product, which comprise the steps of determining a horizontal precision factor and the number of visible satellites based on received satellite signal information to determine GNSS signal availability, switching between different positioning modes based on the GNSS signal availability, switching to a normal positioning mode when the signal is currently available, performing multi-source data fusion processing based on position information acquired from a GNSS receiver, an INS and an orbit map to obtain first train positioning information, switching to an emergency positioning mode when the signal is not currently available, matching current orbit irregularity characteristics with pre-stored orbit irregularity characteristics, correcting the position information acquired from the INS based on a matching result to obtain second train positioning information, optimizing the train positioning information, and outputting the optimized train positioning information. The invention can improve the positioning precision, reliability and continuity of the train in a complex environment.

title_en: Laser radar washs assembly
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser radar cleaning assembly, wherein a sweep actuating mechanism moves on a base platform along a first direction through a sweep control assembly, the cleaning actuating mechanism is integrated on a movable platform, so that the cleaning actuating mechanism can synchronously sweep along the first direction along with the movable platform, the cleaning actuating mechanism can conveniently clean fixed points and designated areas in the first direction aiming at stubborn stains, the cleaning actuating mechanism comprises a nozzle assembly and a wiper assembly, the nozzle assembly and the wiper assembly can extend out or retract from a cover plate mechanism according to requirements under the common driving of the sweep control assembly and the cleaning control assembly, when the designated areas of a receiving and transmitting module need cleaning, the nozzle assembly and the wiper assembly work cooperatively, and the wiper assembly can continuously reciprocate in the designated areas of the receiving and transmitting module through the cooperation of the sweep actuating mechanism and the wiper assembly, so that a continuous cleaning function is realized.

title_en: Observation marking equipment and method for water quality prediction of blue algae prevention and control area
abstract_en: The invention provides observation marking equipment and method for water quality prediction of a blue algae prevention and control area, which relate to the technical field of water quality detection and comprise a mounting plate, wherein a buoy is fixed at the bottom of the mounting plate, a lifting rope is wound at the center of the bottom of the mounting plate, a balancing weight is fixed at the bottom of the lifting rope, a control box is fixed at the center of the top of the mounting plate, three groups of photovoltaic panels are equidistantly arranged at the top of the control box, an antenna is arranged at the upper end of the control box, A plurality of mixing tanks are symmetrically arranged on the surface of the mounting plate in circle center, the inner ring of the mounting plate positioned in the mixing tank is provided with a swivel through a bearing, water with different depths under water is sampled through the cooperation of the detection component and the sampling component, the mixing tank on the mounting plate is conveyed to be mixed with the coloring agent, the blue algae content is detected by the detector, the detection result can be prevented from being influenced by repeated use by the plurality of mixing tanks and the sampling tube, and meanwhile, the water quality detection device can be arranged on the water surface for a long time.

title_en: Charging and discharging circuit, method and system and walking tool
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a charge and discharge circuit, a charge and discharge method, a charge and discharge system and a walking tool, and relates to the technical field of active discharge. The circuit comprises a power supply, a three-phase inverter circuit, a motor and a first switch tube, wherein the power supply is used for supplying power to the three-phase inverter circuit, the motor and the first switch tube, the three-phase inverter circuit is connected with the motor, the motor is connected with the first switch tube, the first switch tube is connected with a charge and discharge port, the three-phase inverter circuit comprises a plurality of second switch tubes, every two second switch tubes in the plurality of second switch tubes are connected into a switch tube bridge arm, the three-phase inverter circuit and the motor in an electric drive system are multiplexed, only the first switch tube is added in a charge and discharge circuit, the design cost is effectively reduced, and meanwhile, the on-off states of the second switch tubes and the first switch tubes in the three-phase inverter circuit are controlled according to different charge and discharge states, and a bidirectional charge and discharge function is realized.

title_en: Pre-cleaning method, pre-cleaning device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-cleaning method, a pre-cleaning device, computer equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of active safety of automobiles, and aims to solve the problem that braking response is delayed in severe weather in the related technology. The method comprises the steps of calculating friction coefficients of wheels and a road surface based on multi-source sensor data of a vehicle, and starting an actuator to remove pollutants on the contact surface of a brake pad and a brake disc through vibration of the actuator if the friction coefficients are smaller than or equal to preset safety coefficients.

title_en: Tilting-type multi-rotor aircraft system based on adaptive pneumatic optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tilting-type aircraft wing multi-rotor aircraft system based on self-adaptive pneumatic optimization, which relates to the technical field of aircrafts and comprises an aircraft body; the outer wall of the aircraft body is provided with a plurality of protruding wing roots, tilting shafts are arranged in the protruding wing roots through bearings, tilting rotor wings are arranged at the other ends of the tilting shafts, and telescopic mechanisms are arranged in the protruding wing roots; according to the invention, through the cooperative work of the telescopic rear wing, the magnetic coding sliding block, the sliding rail, the tilting rotor wing and other parts, the precise sliding and the position feedback of the telescopic rear wing in the convex wing root are realized, the telescopic rear wing meets the requirements of light weight and high strength, the dynamic adjustment of the telescopic rear wing optimizes the aerodynamic shape of the wing in the flight mode conversion process, the energy loss is reduced, and the autonomous conversion of the vertical take-off and landing and high-efficiency flat flight mode of the aircraft is realized through the tilting rotor wing.

title_en: Air conditioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses air conditioning equipment, which is used for acquiring indoor temperature in a sleep mode, calculating an indoor temperature change rate, calculating a change rate influence factor based on the indoor temperature change rate, calculating a dynamic hysteresis temperature based on an initial hysteresis temperature and the change rate influence factor, calculating a compressor starting temperature and a compressor stopping temperature based on a set temperature and the dynamic hysteresis temperature, and then controlling the starting and stopping of a compressor based on the compressor starting temperature and the compressor stopping temperature. Therefore, according to the air conditioning equipment, the dynamic hysteresis temperature is adjusted according to the indoor temperature change trend, so that the starting temperature and the stopping temperature of the compressor are adjusted, the frequent starting and stopping of the compressor are avoided, the use experience of a user is improved, and the technical problem of the frequency starting and stopping of the compressor in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Intelligent driving system expected function safety analysis method and device and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and a vehicle for analyzing the expected function safety of an intelligent driving system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent driving, the method comprises the steps of constructing a first association score list of potential functional deficiency and endangered behaviors, constructing a second association score list of potential triggering conditions and potential functional deficiency, calculating the association degree of the potential triggering conditions and endangered behaviors based on the first association score list and the second association score list, generating a third association score list, the two-dimensional priority analysis result is obtained, so that the systematicness and the integrity of analysis are ensured, the precise association and the priority ordering of the triggering condition and the hazard of the whole vehicle and the risk scene are realized, a scientific and quantifiable decision basis is provided for the risk identification, the risk management and the system optimization of the intelligent driving system, and the efficiency and the reliability of the safety analysis of the expected function are effectively improved.

title_en: Heavy truck cab damping system, method, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heavy truck cab damping, and particularly discloses a heavy truck cab damping system, a heavy truck cab damping method, a heavy truck cab damping terminal and a heavy truck cab damping medium, wherein the heavy truck cab damping system comprises a support sliding rod which is transversely arranged at the bottom of a cab along a vehicle; the device comprises a support slide rod, a thrust block sleeved on the support slide rod and capable of axially sliding relative to the support slide rod, a mass block group, a spring and a clamping mechanism, wherein the mass block group comprises a plurality of annular mass blocks, the annular mass blocks are coaxially sleeved on the support slide rod and are positioned between the two thrust blocks, and the spring is arranged between the mass block group and the thrust block to enable the mass block group to be clamped in the axial direction. The mass-spring resonance system is formed by the combination of the support sliding rod, the thrust block, the spring and the mass block group, so that vibration energy can be effectively absorbed and counteracted when low-frequency vibration occurs in the cab, and vibration is obviously weakened.

title_en: High-speed running stability analysis method of rear wheel steering control strategy and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed running stability analysis method of a rear wheel steering control strategy and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining vehicle parameters and establishing a nonlinear vehicle model; the method comprises the steps of establishing a control strategy model during high-speed running of the rear wheel steering based on a preset rear wheel steering control strategy, quantitatively analyzing to obtain vehicle anti-interference stability under the action of the rear wheel steering control strategy based on a nonlinear vehicle model and the control strategy model, quantitatively analyzing to obtain the controllability of a driver to the vehicle under the action of the rear wheel steering control strategy based on the nonlinear vehicle model and the control strategy model, and determining the control effect of the rear wheel steering control strategy according to the analysis results of the vehicle anti-interference stability and the controllability of the driver to the vehicle. The invention can realize nonlinear quantitative analysis of the high-speed running stability of the rear wheel steering control strategy, further provides an effective reference basis for the design and development of the rear wheel steering control strategy, and can be widely applied to the technical field of vehicle analysis.

title_en: Intelligent steering blind area early warning system and method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent steering blind zone early warning system and method based on multi-sensor fusion, wherein the system comprises an environment sensing module, a data processing and control module and a man-machine interaction module, the environment sensing module is started only when a steering lamp of a vehicle is activated, targets in a preset area behind and beside the vehicle are detected, target data are collected, the data processing and control module receives and processes the target data, the real-time distance and relative speed between the vehicle and the targets are calculated, the man-machine interaction module is integrated on an external rearview mirror of the vehicle, and early warning prompts are output to a driver in a double mode of digital display and color light switching. The application can accurately transfer key risk information of the blind area target, attach to the observation habit of a driver, effectively strengthen the early warning effect, remarkably improve the active safety performance of the vehicle in the steering process and reduce the collision accident risk caused by the vision blind area.

title_en: Parking path planning method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a parking path planning method and related equipment, and relates to the technical field of vehicle control, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining environment information of a target parking space and a parking start point and a parking end point of a vehicle; the method comprises the steps of constructing a grid map corresponding to environment information, executing a mixed A search algorithm in the grid map, performing node expansion on a parking start point to form a grid index sequence, storing node state information in the node expansion process in a data link list according to grid indexes corresponding to the node state information, and generating a target parking path from the parking start point to a parking end point based on the grid index sequence. According to the application, by introducing the node expansion and index linked list management mechanism based on the mixed A in the grid map, the feasible node states are completely reserved on the premise of meeting the vehicle motion constraint, a continuous, reliable and high-executable parking path can be generated, and the stability and success rate of the planning of the parking path are improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for hanging and transporting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle transportation, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle for hanging transportation, which comprises an aerial vehicle and a mounting bracket, wherein a fixed shaft is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the mounting bracket, the bottom end of the fixed shaft is rotatably provided with a longitudinal shaft through a transverse shaft, two ends of the longitudinal shaft are rotatably provided with a balance ring, and a hook is arranged below the balance ring. According to the invention, the deflection state of the balance ring is detected, and the balance component is utilized to actively apply reverse compensation force, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can restrain the swing of load goods in real time, the initial swing caused by gravity center deviation during the take-off of the unmanned aerial vehicle is effectively avoided, the composite swing caused by disturbance such as acceleration, deceleration or crosswind is continuously counteracted during the flight process, the resistance of the unmanned aerial vehicle to low-frequency large-amplitude vibration is obviously enhanced, the mechanical load and energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle are reduced, the service life of equipment is prolonged, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is suitable for transporting high-value or vulnerable articles.

title_en: Amphibious triphibian aircraft based on power system multiplexing
abstract_en: The application discloses a amphibious aircraft based on power system multiplexing, which relates to the field of aircrafts and comprises an aircrafts body, three supporting legs are arranged on the aircrafts body and distributed on the head and tail sides of the aircrafts body in a triangular shape, a land movement module is arranged at the bottom of the supporting legs to drive the aircrafts body to move on the ground in a rolling mode, a mode switching module is arranged at the top of the supporting legs, a power module is arranged on the mode switching module, a water-air paddle integration module is arranged on the power module to rotate under the driving of the power module and provide power for the aircrafts body to travel under water, air and land, the power module and the water-air paddle integration module can rotate to a vertical gesture to execute an air movement mode under the control of the mode switching module, or rotate to a horizontal gesture to execute the underwater and land movement mode, the seamless multiplexing of the same power system on the sea, the land and air is realized, and the propulsion efficiency is ensured while the medium-crossing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Drive system for vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving system for a vehicle and the vehicle, and relates to the technical field of driving systems, wherein the driving system for the vehicle comprises: the engine comprises a crankshaft, the crankshaft extends along a first direction, the generator comprises a motor shaft, the motor shaft extends along the first direction, the crankshaft and the motor shaft are distributed along the first direction, and the crankshaft and the motor shaft are integrally formed.
