Through with bent axle and motor shaft integrated into one piece, can avoid assembly error, promote the axiality of bent axle and motor shaft, promote the generating efficiency of generator, reduce the noise, can also cancel the transmission structure between bent axle and the motor shaft, and then can alleviate actuating system's weight and reduce the volume, simplified assembly flow.

title_en: Tire burst braking stability control system, method and program product based on electromechanical braking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a burst braking stable control system, method and program product based on electronic mechanical braking, wherein the system comprises a burst identification module and a multi-stage braking module, the burst identification module is used for detecting whether each wheel bursts, the multi-stage braking module comprises a braking controller and a plurality of electronic mechanical calipers used for providing braking force for corresponding wheels, the braking controller is used for controlling the corresponding electronic mechanical calipers to apply first braking force to all non-burst wheels on the sides of the burst wheels, if the deceleration of a vehicle is smaller than target deceleration, an enhancement braking request is sent to the braking controller, and the braking controller controls the corresponding electronic mechanical calipers to additionally apply continuously increased second braking force to all non-burst wheels on the sides of the burst wheels after receiving the enhancement braking request. According to the invention, the brake controller is used for realizing the accurate distribution of the braking force of the wheel without tire burst, so that the problem that the braking and stability of the vehicle after tire burst cannot be effectively controlled is solved.

title_en: Anti-rotation tool, cover assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-rotation frock, cover assembly and vehicle, this anti-rotation frock includes the frock body, the frock body is used for connecting in one side of cover lock and with the cover lock phase-locking fixed, the position that corresponds with the cover hasp on the frock body is provided with anti-rotation limit structure, be formed with spacing space on the anti-rotation limit structure, the cover hasp inserts in the spacing space, spacing space forms spacingly to the relative movement between cover hasp and the frock body, namely through with the frock body connection on the cover lock and with the cover lock phase-locking fixed, thereby make the cover lock and the frock body form a whole and can not take place relative rotation, then the anti-rotation limit structure on the rethread frock body cooperates with the cover hasp, thereby restrict the frock body and rotate for the cover hasp, then can effectively solve the sound that the cover is opened or is closed and the open unsmooth scheduling problem of cover.

title_en: Windscreen wiper control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wiper control system, comprising: the invention receives a wiper control command signal from a driver, calculates the position information of a wiper based on an angle sensor, calculates and decides the movement requirement of the wiper in an MCU processing unit, converts the movement requirement into an electrical control signal to the motor pre-driving module, further completes the operation driving of the wiper motor by the motor power driving module, and finally drives a wiper arm wiper blade to move by the wiper motor to realize the wiping function of front windshield.

title_en: Structure of ring belt reinforcing layer
abstract_en: The invention provides an annular reinforcing layer structure, which comprises a plurality of winding sections, a plurality of inner side sections and a plurality of outer side sections, wherein the winding sections are wound in a central area, a feeding distance of at least part of the winding sections is not smaller than a material width of the winding sections in the central area, so that adjacent winding sections are not overlapped, the feeding distance of at least part of the winding sections is smaller than the material width of the winding sections in the inner side area and the outer side area, so that adjacent winding sections are partially overlapped, and an inner overlapping width of the winding sections is smaller than an outer overlapping width of the winding sections in the inner side area. Therefore, vibration of the tread can be restrained, circumferential rigidity of the tread can be increased, road noise can be reduced, and rolling resistance can be improved.

title_en: Combined tire disassembling mechanism and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined tire disassembling mechanism and a working method thereof, wherein the tire disassembling mechanism comprises a supporting arm, the front end of the supporting arm is connected with a tire disassembling mechanism capable of moving left and right, the tire disassembling mechanism comprises a tire disassembling frame, and the tire disassembling frame is provided with a pressure plate assembly, a tire disassembling prying plate and a bird head assembly. The combined tire disassembling mechanism integrates the functions of the pressure plate, the prying plate and the bird head, is compact in structure, reasonable in layout and free of interference, can move left and right to realize extension and contraction, avoids affecting the installation and disassembly of tires on a tire disassembling machine chuck, is larger in movable stroke, ensures that the tire disassembling mechanism can be suitable for tires with smaller specifications, and is wide in application range, strong in practicability and good in flexibility.

title_en: Driving anti-slip control method for electromechanical braking system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving anti-slip control method of an electromechanical braking system, and belongs to the technical field of new energy vehicle drive-by-wire. The method comprises the steps of evaluating the current maximum allowable driving moment in real time according to vehicle and road surface state information, judging the wheel slip trend according to the wheel acceleration, pre-clamping the EMB when the wheel has an obvious slip trend, applying the pre-clamping moment to eliminate a braking gap, and distinguishing the driving intention of a driver according to the change of the opening degree of an accelerator pedal in t1 time when the actual slip rate is judged to be larger than the optimal slip rate, so that the driving anti-slip control is subjected to power priority or stability priority mode distinction. The invention utilizes the pre-clamping and the rapid and accurate control of the electromechanical braking system to ensure that the slip rate is converged rapidly, the slip rate of the wheels is kept near the optimal slip rate, and meanwhile, if the road surface adhesion condition is changed or an estimation error exists, the dynamic coordination control can also realize the accurate control of the slip rate, and the stability is improved while the dynamic performance is ensured under the road surfaces with different working conditions.

title_en: Automatic emergency braking control method and system based on reverse braking compensation model
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic emergency braking control method and system based on a reverse braking compensation model, and relates to the technical field of road traffic safety. The method comprises the steps of calculating collision time between a self-vehicle and a target object, triggering an automatic emergency braking function and obtaining theoretical braking deceleration when the collision time is smaller than a preset triggering threshold value, inputting the theoretical braking deceleration into a reverse braking compensation model, constructing a simulated running environment based on the current vehicle state, target object information and the theoretical braking deceleration, simulating a process from braking to stopping by the theoretical braking deceleration, obtaining a simulated running distance, and optimizing the theoretical braking deceleration by adjusting a braking coefficient until the simulated running distance is smaller than or equal to the theoretical braking distance, thus obtaining the corrected deceleration. The simulated running environment is built through the reverse braking compensation model, and the unsupervised learning is combined, so that the dynamic checking and accurate compensation of the braking value are realized, the sensing and execution deviation of the traditional AEB system is effectively compensated, and the reliability and safety of the automatic emergency braking of the passenger car are improved.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control method and device, unmanned vehicle, chassis system and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method and a device of an unmanned vehicle, the unmanned vehicle, a chassis system and a product, and relates to the technical field of vehicles, wherein the control method of the unmanned vehicle comprises the following steps: under the condition that the unmanned vehicle triggers steering, acquiring surrounding running environment data of the unmanned vehicle, and determining a steering available area of the unmanned vehicle based on the surrounding running environment data; and determining a target steering strategy of the unmanned vehicle based on the steering available area, wherein the types of the target steering strategy at least comprise head-tail exchange steering, and controlling the unmanned vehicle to execute steering action based on the target steering strategy. Because the head and tail are exchanged for steering, the control right and the function roles of front and rear suspensions of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be switched on the software control logic level, and the direction of the vehicle is redefined, so that the steering operation of turning around the vehicle is directly completed, and road surface redundancy is not needed in the process, so that the maneuverability and the trafficability of the vehicle in a space-limited environment can be greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent electricity protection control method, device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent electricity protection control method, an intelligent electricity protection control device, a vehicle and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicles. The intelligent power-saving control method is applied to a range-extending vehicle and comprises the steps of determining the current driving stage of the vehicle, obtaining battery state-of-charge data, determining the driving strategy of the vehicle according to the driving strategy, driving the vehicle to start or drive, wherein the driving strategy at least comprises a battery driving mode and a range extender driving mode, the battery driving mode is a mode of driving the vehicle to run through a first battery and/or a second battery, the range extender driving mode is a mode of driving the vehicle to run through the range extender, and the working states of the first battery and the second battery are set according to the relative relation between the power of the range extender and the power required by the vehicle. Based on the technical scheme disclosed by the invention, not only can the electricity consumption of the vehicle be reduced and the fuel economy be improved, but also the power response capability of the system can be enhanced, the battery health management optimization can be realized, and the driving experience can be improved.

title_en: Cowling fatigue test loading device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a load test device and a load test method for a fairing fatigue test. The test bench comprises a test bench body (1), a Z-direction load loading mechanism (2), an X-direction load loading mechanism (3-1), a Y-direction load loading mechanism (3-2), a cover plate dummy (4), a connecting shaft (5), a fairing test piece (6) and a fixing support (7), wherein the fixing support (7) is fixed on the test bench body (1) through supporting legs, the base part of the fairing test piece (6) is fixedly connected with the lower surface of a support plate in the fixing support (7) through bolts, one side of the fairing test piece (6) is connected with the cover plate dummy (4) through bolts, the Z-direction load is applied through the connection between the Z-direction load loading mechanism (2) and the center of the cover plate dummy (4), and the X-direction load loading mechanism (3-1) and the Y-direction load loading mechanism (3-2) are respectively connected with the center of the cover plate dummy (4) through the connecting shaft (5) to apply X-direction load and Y-direction load to the fairing test piece (6). The three-way split loading is carried out, the load is directly debugged from the measurement and control angle, and the period required by load debugging is greatly shortened.

title_en: Seat gesture perception user-defined rapid adjustment interaction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle control and man-machine interaction, and discloses a seat gesture perception self-defining rapid adjustment interaction method. The method comprises the steps of establishing an interaction baseline containing a space region and a time rule through initialization, collecting gesture signals, carrying out stability evaluation and light weight recognition, synchronously completing false touch risk evaluation, generating a function call item containing a parameter draft according to recognition result mapping, carrying out safety constraint check and conflict arbitration, outputting final control parameters and arbitration sequence, and finally dynamically updating a user preference portrait and an adjustment threshold through integrated processing of instruction issuing, receipt collection and feedback learning. The method realizes closed-loop self-adaptive control from gesture perception to seat adjustment, and effectively improves individuation level of interaction, operation safety and continuous optimization capability of the system.

title_en: Fuel tank cap integrated with antitheft and locking state recognition functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuel tank cover integrated with anti-theft and locking state identification functions, which comprises an outer cover, a lock shell, a lock cylinder, a key and a fixing part, wherein the fixing part is clamped at a fuel tank opening, the centers of the outer cover and the lock shell are respectively provided with a lower matching part and an upper matching part, the lower matching part is rotatably inserted into the upper matching part, the upper matching part is provided with a cavity and stretches into the fixing part, a lock cylinder sleeve is fixedly arranged in the cavity, the lock cylinder is arranged in the lock cylinder sleeve in a penetrating manner, one end of the lock cylinder is provided with an upper eccentric shaft, the upper eccentric shaft is sleeved with a lock tongue, the inner wall of the fixing part is provided with a slot, the lock cylinder drives the lock tongue to be inserted into or withdrawn from the slot, when the lock shell locks the fuel tank opening, the lock tongue is opposite to the slot, the lock cylinder is provided with an elastic connecting component for connecting or separating the upper matching part from the lower matching part, and a limiting component is arranged between the lock cylinder and the lock cylinder sleeve and is used for limiting the lock cylinder to rotate until a blade is opposite to or leaves. The fuel tank cap provided by the invention can simultaneously provide the functions of theft prevention and locking state identification.

title_en: Power supply method and system for vehicle door, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a power supply method, a power supply system, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a vehicle door, which comprise the steps of controlling an energy collecting device to obtain electric energy and storing the obtained electric energy into the energy storing device; and when the voltage of the vehicle battery is smaller than the working voltage threshold value, controlling the energy storage device to transmit the stored electric energy to a preset device on the vehicle door so as to supply power to the preset device. By adopting the technical scheme provided by the application, the energy utilization efficiency and the vehicle safety are improved.

title_en: Adaptive event trigger model predictive control method and system for intelligent transport vehicle cruising
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive event triggering model predictive control method and a system for cruising of an intelligent transport vehicle, comprising the steps of constructing a vehicle actual system and a nominal system and setting conditions for parameters; calculating state error norms in real time, setting triggering threshold constraint, setting precision threshold for the state error norms, solving model predictive control optimization problem at triggering time to update optimal control sequence, continuing a control command at non-triggering time period, updating unknown parameter estimation value on line, constructing terminal set, switching terminal control law and completing control task. According to the method, the model prediction control updating frequency is adaptively adjusted through the event triggering mechanism, the model error is corrected in real time by combining parameter estimation, and the problems of large calculation load and poor adaptability of a traditional vehicle cruising method based on the trigger model prediction control in a high-dynamic uncertain environment are effectively solved.

title_en: Intelligent damping material prepared from piezoelectric ceramic composite and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent damping material prepared from a piezoelectric ceramic composite body and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of vibration control materials. The material is of a three-layer composite structure of an elastic matrix layer, a piezoelectric ceramic composite layer and a constraint layer, wherein the piezoelectric ceramic composite layer is formed by compounding 30% -50% of piezoelectric ceramic particles, 5% -15% of conductive filler and 35% -65% of polymer binder, the Shore hardness of the elastic matrix layer is 30D-60D, and the elastic modulus of the constraint layer is 20GPa-80GPa. The preparation method comprises the key steps of modification of the piezoelectric ceramic particle silane coupling agent, high-speed mixing of composite slurry, vulcanization molding of an elastic matrix layer, plasma treatment of the surface of the matrix, gradient hot-pressing composite curing and the like. According to the invention, through interface modification and three-dimensional conductive network construction, the interface bonding strength and the energy dissipation efficiency are greatly improved, the damping loss factor tan delta of the material in a wide temperature range of 50 ℃ below zero to 150 ℃ is more than or equal to 0.3, the vibration attenuation rate is more than or equal to 40%, and the material is suitable for vibration control of aerospace, rail transit and precision machinery, and the preparation process is simple and convenient and easy for large-scale production.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted solar cell system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted solar battery system capable of estimating the generated energy taking the roof shape into consideration. A vehicle-mounted solar cell system is provided with a solar cell panel that is disposed along the outer surface of the roof of a vehicle, an acquisition unit that acquires position information that is information relating to the position of the vehicle, shape information that is information relating to the shape of the roof of the vehicle, and time information that is information relating to time, and an estimation unit that estimates the amount of power generation of the solar cell panel using the acquired position information, shape information, and time information.

title_en: Cushion with temperature regulation function
abstract_en: The invention provides a cushion with a temperature adjusting function, which utilizes a semiconductor refrigerating sheet to provide refrigeration or heating, and enables the temperature to be directly conducted on the surface of a sponge body through the conduction of a graphene heat conduction sheet, so that the temperature conduction efficiency is greatly improved, the surface temperature of the cushion is effectively changed, the temperature of the cushion is suitable for a driver, the driving experience of the driver is improved, and a temperature control device is provided with an independent closed air flow circulating heat exchange system.

title_en: Driving device for electric bicycle and assembly of driving device for electric bicycle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drive device for an electric bicycle and an assembly of a drive device for an electric bicycle. In at least one embodiment, the drive (100) comprises a planetary gearbox (2) having a planet carrier (20), wherein the planet carrier is rotatably mounted about a rotational axis (A) by means of a radial bearing (4) and an axial bearing (5).

title_en: Railway track state inspection evaluation method based on internet of things perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway track state inspection evaluation method based on internet of things perception, which comprises the steps of periodically triggering an internet of things sensor to acquire multi-source data such as vibration, images and displacement, extracting rail frequency deviation, rail surface damage level and geometric deformation trend characteristics through frequency spectrum, image recognition and time sequence analysis, fusing the rail frequency deviation, rail surface damage level and geometric deformation trend characteristics into state characteristic vectors, comparing and grading the state characteristic vectors with a standard range, and generating a report pushing service terminal containing positioning, severity and maintenance advice. The method can efficiently and accurately evaluate the state of the railway track, discover potential defects in time and provide targeted maintenance suggestions, improve the inspection efficiency and safety of the railway track, and reduce the manual inspection cost and maintenance risk.

title_en: Unmanned rescue vehicle, rescue system, rescue method and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of emergency rescue equipment, in particular to an unmanned rescue vehicle, a rescue system, a rescue method and a control method. The unmanned rescue vehicle comprises a traveling chassis, a cabin body, at least one moving module, at least one grabbing module and a quick-change module, wherein the cabin body is arranged on the traveling chassis, rescue channels are formed in one side or two sides of the cabin body, the moving module is arranged on one side of the cabin body, the grabbing module comprises a moving platform arranged on the cabin body, a rolling unit arranged on the moving platform, a traction rope wound on the rolling unit and a grabbing unit connected with the traction rope, the grabbing unit is connected with the free end of the moving module through the quick-change module, and the moving platform is arranged to horizontally move along the width direction of the cabin body. The invention moves the grabbing module to the grabbing position of the target wounded person through the moving module, realizes the connection with the grabbing position of the target wounded person through the grabbing module, breaks away from the moving module through the quick-change module and the grabbing module, and then the moving platform and the rolling unit are matched to recycle the target wounded person into the cabin.

title_en: Anti-lock control method and system for automobile braking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-lock control method and system for automobile braking, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a temperature value of a brake disc at the current moment, comparing the temperature value at the current moment with a pre-stored control parameter set mapping table to obtain a control parameter set corresponding to the temperature value at the current moment, and applying the control parameter set to an anti-lock system. The system comprises a temperature acquisition module, a memory, a parameter decision module and an ABS execution module. The invention dynamically adjusts the control strategy of the ABS by establishing a real-time mapping relation between the temperature of the brake disc and the control parameters of the anti-lock braking system. The brake disc temperature is obtained in real time, and is compared or interpolated with the optimal control parameter set corresponding to the pre-stored different temperature intervals, so that the control parameter suitable for the current temperature working condition is selected or generated in a self-adaptive mode, the defect that the performance of the traditional fixed parameter ABS is reduced when the brake disc temperature changes can be effectively overcome, and synchronous optimization of the braking efficiency and the braking stability in the whole temperature range is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle capable of landing and buffering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and particularly discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle capable of landing and buffering, which comprises a body shell, wherein connecting arms are fixedly connected to opposite angles of the side surface of the body shell, one ends of the connecting arms, which are far away from the body shell, are fixedly connected with fan blade guard rings, the inner walls of the fan blade guard rings are fixedly connected with driving motors through brackets, driving shafts of the driving motors are fixedly connected with flying fan blades, the bottom of the body shell is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, the bottom of the inner wall of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a damping device, one ends of the fixing rods, which are far away from the supporting frame, are fixedly connected with a buffering mechanism, and the bottom of the inner wall of the body shell is fixedly connected with a lifting assembly.

title_en: Cross scribing method for ship outer plate bed-jig
abstract_en: The application discloses a ship outer plate jig frame cross marking method which comprises the steps of determining a marking original standard based on a jig frame, wherein the marking original standard comprises a first longitudinal cross line arranged along the ship body direction and a first transverse cross line arranged perpendicular to the ship body direction, hoisting an outer plate to the jig frame, determining an outer plate marking standard on a structural mounting surface of the outer plate based on the marking original standard after positioning and welding are completed, taking a second transverse cross line as a standard, taking a plurality of auxiliary reference lines preset on the outer plate as a standard, respectively measuring profile data of each rib position along the ship body direction, marking a plurality of first data points, connecting the plurality of first data points to obtain rib position lines corresponding to each rib position, taking a second longitudinal cross line as a standard, respectively measuring profile data of each ship longitudinal structure and each deck cross line along each rib position line along the up-down direction of a ship, and marking a plurality of second data points, and connecting the plurality of second data points to obtain a structure mounting position line.

title_en: Vehicle chassis drive-by-wire method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle chassis drive-by-wire method, a system, a medium and equipment, which belong to the technical field of automatic driving, and the method combines road condition information, weather information and vehicle sensor information into input data vectors by acquiring the road condition information, the weather information and the vehicle sensor information, wherein each moment is provided with a group of input data vectors; the method comprises the steps of extracting space-time characteristics in input data vectors by adopting a coding network, wherein the space-time characteristics comprise correlation inside single-moment characteristics and time sequence dependence crossing moment, and obtaining a prediction result comprising vehicle speed and yaw rate at the subsequent moment by adopting a decoding network according to output of the coding network. The method can integrate the vehicle running state data, weather and road recognition results into a neural network, describes the influence of road adhesion by training the space-time relativity between the data, does not directly estimate the road adhesion coefficient, simulates the pre-judging mode of a driver on road conditions, and avoids introducing extra errors caused by estimating the adhesion coefficient.

title_en: Take reduction gear assembly and vehicle of differential mechanism
abstract_en: The application discloses a speed reducer assembly with a differential mechanism and a vehicle, wherein the speed reducer assembly comprises a driven gear and the differential mechanism, a central hole is formed in the driven gear, a containing groove extending along the radial direction is formed in the driven gear, the differential mechanism comprises a differential mechanism shell and a planetary gear shaft, the differential mechanism shell is arranged in the central hole in a penetrating mode and fixedly connected with the driven gear, a shaft hole is formed in the differential mechanism shell, the planetary gear shaft is in clearance fit with the shaft hole and is arranged in the differential mechanism shell in a penetrating mode through the shaft hole, two ends of the planetary gear shaft are exposed out of the differential mechanism shell and are arranged in the containing groove, a first plane is arranged at the end portion of the planetary gear shaft, the first plane is opposite to the side wall of the containing groove, and when the driven gear rotates, the side wall abuts against the first plane to drive the planetary gear shaft and the driven gear to coaxially rotate. Through the scheme, the weight of the differential mechanism can be reduced, and the economical efficiency of the vehicle is improved.

title_en: Suspension type magnetic type automatic charging device for electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a suspension type magnetic automatic charging device for an electric automobile, and belongs to the technical field of electric automobile charging and magnetic charging. The device comprises a suspension type movable charging support, a roller lifting platform, a universal magnetic charging head, an electric automobile magnetic charging receiving end and the like. Through the innovation traditional charging mode, the suspension type magnetic type automatic charging is adopted, remote one-key charging, charging parking space releasing, safety performance improving and technical ordered transition can be realized, the problems of complex wired charging operation and low charging efficiency of the existing electric automobile are solved, and the novel magnetic type automatic charging device is applicable to charging of newly-built electric automobiles and refitted electric automobiles.

title_en: Control instruction determining method and device, electronic equipment, storage medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a control instruction determining method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent automobiles, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting interaction information of a user, a vehicle motion state and a driving environment state based on time; and carrying out safety causal reasoning according to the final intention, the vehicle motion state and the driving environment state, and determining an executed vehicle safety control instruction. The crossing from passive response to active safety intervention is realized, the core problem of disconnection between the existing vehicle-machine interaction and the dynamic safety state of the vehicle is solved, and the interaction naturalness, decision accuracy and driving safety of the intelligent cabin are remarkably improved.

title_en: New energy battery safety box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy battery safety box body, which relates to the field of new energy, and comprises a box body shell, wherein a high-temperature-resistant material heat insulation layer is arranged in the shell, a new energy battery is arranged in the box body, a relatively wide deflagration gas pressure release channel is connected to the box body, a nozzle which is obliquely upwards or upwards is arranged at a position close to the vehicle shell, a notch is arranged at the position of the vehicle shell corresponding to the nozzle and is used for the deflagration gas to pass through, a movable cover plate which is matched with the shape and the color of the rear shell of a vehicle or a disposable cover plate is arranged on the notch of the vehicle shell, and the pressure of the deflagration gas pushes away the cover plate when the battery deflagrates, so that the deflagration gas is sprayed upwards or upwards after the vehicle, the risk of burning other vehicles and objects of the vehicle is reduced, the safety of the new energy battery is improved, the problem that the new energy battery is easy to cause fire is solved, and the safety of drivers is possibly protected.

title_en: Charging guiding method based on Internet of vehicles data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging guiding method based on data driving of the Internet of vehicles, which belongs to the field of the Internet of vehicles and comprises five steps of flow of data acquisition, path optimization, reputation management, double-layer iteration and guiding execution, wherein the method aims at the problems that the traditional static path planning (such as Dijiestra algorithm) does not consider actual traffic factors and the path searching efficiency is low, dynamic path optimization is realized by improving an A-type algorithm, a known item G (i) is introduced into a traffic light mechanism, the waiting time of the traffic light is taken as a node weight to be calculated by taking into the actual cost, the time consumption overestimation problem caused by the waiting of the traffic light is avoided, an estimated item H (i) is added into a return path punishment item, and the method is in accordance with the actual preference of a vehicle owner of less turning around and no return path, reduces invalid path searching, and finally a decision function is passed The optimal path is preferentially selected, roads which have no influence on the optimal result are avoided, the path searching efficiency is obviously improved, and the total time consumption of the user 'road driving time and charging station waiting time' is shortened.

title_en: Vent for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ventilation opening (1) for a vehicle, wherein the ventilation opening (1) comprises a housing (2), a flow guide body (5) which is arranged in the housing (2) and about which an air flow (F) flowing through the housing (2) can flow, and an air guide element arrangement (6) which is designed to be stationary relative to the housing (2) and which has at least one air guide element (7, 7.1), wherein the air guide element arrangement (6) is mounted relative to the housing (2) and relative to the flow guide body (5) such that it can pivot about at least one rotation axis (8) between a neutral position and at least one deflection position. According to the invention, it is provided in particular that the air guiding element arrangement (6) is arranged upstream of the air guiding body (5) at least in its neutral position (as seen in the main flow direction of the air flow (F) flowing through the housing (2)), in particular such that the air guiding element arrangement (6) is optically invisible in a top view of the air outlet region (4) of the housing (2) of the ventilation opening (1).

title_en: Method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product for determining charging
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, methods, apparatuses, devices, storage medium, and program products for charge determination are provided. The method includes acquiring charge state information associated with a charging process of a charging device for a target device, determining respective parameter values of a plurality of charging parameters based on the charge state information, determining a predicted value for the charging device based on the respective parameter values of the plurality of charging parameters, the predicted value indicating a likelihood that the charging device charges the target device via a converter during the charging process, and determining hint information for the charging device based on the determined predicted value, the hint information indicating whether the charging process is a charging process via the converter. Therefore, whether the charging process is the charging process through the converter can be judged based on the charging state information of the charging equipment in the charging process, and prompt information can be determined based on the judging result. The safety of the charging process is improved.

title_en: Automatic parking system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic parking system and a vehicle, wherein the braking system comprises a brake master cylinder, an electronic one-way valve, an ECB module and a vehicle speed signal, wherein one end of the brake master cylinder is connected with a brake pedal, one end of the electronic one-way valve is connected with the brake master cylinder, the other end of the electronic one-way valve is connected with a brake caliper, and the ECB module is used for controlling current applied to the electronic one-way valve according to collected accelerator voltage signals, gear signals, brake pedal signals and vehicle speed signals so as to realize automatic parking of the vehicle. According to the invention, the intelligent one-way oil valve is added in the braking system, and the opening and closing of the oil valve is intelligently controlled by directly acting on the oil valve body through the ECB module, so that the pressure of brake fluid in a brake pipeline to a brake caliper is released to realize automatic parking, a low-configuration vehicle which does not have an automatic parking function can easily realize automatic parking, high requirements on vehicle configuration are not needed, and the basic structure of the vehicle is not needed to be modified, so that the vehicle is simple in implementation mode, wide in application range, low in requirements and low in cost.

title_en: Filling level monitoring device for monitoring a filling level of a fluid container, hydrogen tank and aircraft comprising such a hydrogen tank
abstract_en: A filling level monitoring device (100) for monitoring a filling level (210) of a fluid container (200), a hydrogen tank and an aircraft comprising such a hydrogen tank are provided. The filling level monitoring device comprises an excitation element (10), a sensing element (21), a signal source (30), a suspension element (70) having a defined stiffness, and a processing unit (40). The excitation element (10) is configured to be mounted on the fluid reservoir (200) or the suspension element (70) to activate a particular suspension mode (25) of vibration. The suspension element (70) is rigidly attached to the fluid container (200) such that both vibrate together. The sensing element (21) detects these vibrations and sends data to the processing unit (40). The signal source (30) generates a multi-frequency input signal (31) for energizing the element (10). The processing unit (40) uses the vibration data to identify a suspension mode (25), determine its modal frequency (80) and calculate a current filling level (210) of the fluid container (200) based on the frequency.

title_en: Fatigue loading device and loading method for airplane flap mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aircraft part fatigue and reliability tests, and discloses an aircraft flap mechanism fatigue loading device and a loading method, wherein the loading device comprises a bearing frame, a flap, a swing mechanism compound follow-up loading mechanism and a control system; the swing mechanism is connected with the flap; the composite follow-up loading mechanism comprises a first follow-up loading assembly and a second follow-up loading assembly, wherein the first follow-up loading assembly is used for loading an upper loading point position of a flap, the composite follow-up loading mechanism comprises a first screw rod module assembly, an adjusting pulley, a traction rope and a traction driving piece, the second follow-up loading assembly is used for loading a lower loading point position of the flap, the composite follow-up loading mechanism comprises a second screw rod module assembly, a hinged support and a loading hydraulic cylinder, and a control system is respectively and electrically connected with the first follow-up loading assembly and the second follow-up loading assembly.

title_en: Charging connector for electric vehicles and hybrid vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to a charging connector (1) for electric and hybrid vehicles (24), comprising a housing (6), charging contacts (2) arranged in the housing (6) and capable of contacting corresponding charging contacts (3) of a corresponding charging connector (4) via openings (8) of the housing (6), a movable cover (10) which covers the openings (8) in a closed position and releases the openings (8) in an open position for contact via the corresponding charging contacts (3), and a receptacle (12) arranged on or in the housing (6) into which the cover (10) can be moved into a retracted position from the open position. In this way, a charging connector (1) with a cover (10) suitable for an automated charging process is provided.

title_en: Control surface folding, unfolding and locking mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control surface folding, unfolding and locking mechanism, belongs to the technical field of aircrafts, and solves the problems of complex structure, high operation difficulty and uncontrollable control surface unfolding time of a folding control surface unfolding mechanism in the prior art. The control surface expansion speed regulating device comprises a control surface, a folding locking component, an expansion speed regulating component and a control surface limiting component, wherein the folding locking component is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of a cabin body and close to the folded rear end part of the control surface and used for locking the control surface in a folded state at an initial position, the expansion speed regulating component is arranged at the root part of the control surface and used for regulating the expansion speed of the control surface, and the control surface limiting component is arranged near the root part of the control surface and used for limiting the position of the control surface after expansion. The invention solves the problems of folding, unfolding and locking of the control surface without using additional electric control components and initiating explosive devices and without depending on the cabin design, and realizes the functions of controllable opening moment of the control surface, in-place locking and adjustable opening speed gradient.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted air conditioner control method and device, electronic equipment and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted air conditioner control method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring infrared thermal imaging data and temperature distribution data in a current vehicle and the environment temperature outside the current vehicle; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an occupant body surface area according to infrared thermal imaging data, determining occupant body surface temperature, obtaining an air-conditioning airflow boundary and an air-conditioning airflow type according to infrared thermal imaging data and environmental temperature, determining an airflow flowing track according to the air-conditioning airflow boundary, determining an air quantity adjusting range according to temperature distribution data, occupant body surface temperature and preset target temperature, determining an air-uncovered occupant body surface area according to the airflow flowing track and the occupant body surface area, determining an air direction adjusting angle according to the air-uncovered occupant body surface area, and controlling the vehicle-mounted air conditioner according to the air quantity adjusting range and the air direction adjusting angle. The invention improves the efficiency and accuracy of vehicle air conditioner control and the riding experience of users, and can be applied to the technical field of intelligent cabins.

title_en: Wing overhauling table for aircraft maintenance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wing overhauling table for aircraft maintenance, which belongs to the technical field of wing overhauling equipment and comprises a movable overhauling table, an automatic lifting device, a wing approaching structure and a nondestructive testing structure, wherein the automatic lifting device is arranged on the movable overhauling table in a clamping manner, the wing approaching structure is arranged on the automatic lifting device, the wing approaching structure is lifted along with the lifting of the automatic lifting device, and the nondestructive testing structure is arranged on the wing approaching structure. The invention aims to solve the problems of low automation degree, high dependence on detection personnel, easiness in damage to the surface coating of the wing of the conventional wing maintenance equipment, and the like, and provides a wing maintenance platform for aircraft maintenance, which effectively solves the problems of low automation level, insufficient positioning precision, single detection function and easiness in damage to the surface coating of the wing of the conventional wing maintenance equipment.

title_en: Vehicle deviation early warning method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a vehicle offset early warning method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the vehicle offset early warning method comprises the steps of determining whether a current vehicle is offset or not based on a real-time driving route and a navigation driving route of the current vehicle, executing first offset early warning prompts of different grades based on comparison results of a speed of the current vehicle and a plurality of preset speed thresholds under the condition that the current vehicle is offset, determining whether a first vehicle to be driven over exists in an offset direction of the current vehicle, and executing second offset early warning prompts of different grades based on comparison results of a distance between the current vehicle and the first vehicle and the preset plurality of distance thresholds under the condition that the first vehicle to be driven over exists in the offset direction of the current vehicle. Therefore, no matter whether the vehicle deviates or the vehicle is about to drive, the driver can be timely reminded, and traffic accidents are reduced to the greatest extent.

title_en: Front structure of vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicle front structure. The vehicle front structure includes a front skeleton portion including left and right front structure portions each provided in front of a cabin of a vehicle body and a lower portion of the vehicle body and extending in a vehicle front-rear direction, a cowl portion, left and right arm portions extending upward from front portions of the left and right front structure portions, respectively, and a frame-shaped reinforcing member that couples upper portions of the left and right arm portions, upper portions of the left and right suspension tower portions, and the cowl portion.

title_en: Torque control instruction generation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a torque control instruction generation method, a device, equipment and a medium, which are applied to the technical field of electric automobile control. The method comprises the steps of responding to an opening occurrence change event of an electric valve pedal of a current vehicle, determining a speed change direction and a pedal change rate of the current vehicle, calculating a target torque of the current vehicle according to the speed change direction, the pedal change rate and a linear torque relation, generating first sub-torques corresponding to time points in a future time period according to the target torque, wherein the first sub-torques corresponding to the time points are smaller than or equal to second sub-torques determined at the time points according to the linear torque relation, and generating a torque control instruction according to the first sub-torques corresponding to the time points so as to enable the current vehicle to run. The embodiment of the invention can improve the matching between the actual power output of the vehicle and the operation intention of a driver and improve the control safety of the vehicle.

title_en: High-stability electric suitcase
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of travel appliances, and provides an electric travel suitcase with high stability. Comprises a box body, a steering assembly, a driving wheel assembly and a driven wheel assembly. The box body comprises an annular frame body positioned in the middle in the height direction, an upper open type cover body positioned on the upper side of the frame body and a chassis positioned on the lower side of the frame body, wherein a first reinforcing frame is arranged at the joint of the cover body and the frame body, and a second reinforcing frame is arranged at the joint of the frame body and the chassis or the frame body and the chassis. The upper open type cover body is convenient for taking and placing objects, the three-section structure reduces the size of the die, reduces the die opening cost, and the reinforcing frame greatly increases the structural strength, so that the box body is suitable for riding. The invention solves the problems of easy turnover of the side door of the existing electric suitcase, large integral frame body die and high cost, and has the advantages of high structural strength, convenient use and low manufacturing cost.

title_en: Spliced light auxiliary frame
abstract_en: The spliced lightweight auxiliary frame comprises a longitudinal beam member and a cross beam member, wherein the longitudinal beam member is a metal member, the cross beam member is a polymer composite material member, and the longitudinal beam member and the cross beam member are spliced to form the auxiliary frame. The auxiliary frame provided by the invention has the advantages that the cross beam member is made of the polymer composite material, and the longitudinal beam member is a metal member, so that the longitudinal beam member which needs to bear larger load has higher mechanical strength. While the cross member having a smaller relative load bearing is lightweight. The integral auxiliary frame is formed by simple splicing and welding, and the integrally formed cross beam member and longitudinal beam member can be integrated into a vehicle body connecting interface, so that the auxiliary frame is integrally combined with structural strength and light weight, and is highly integrated.

title_en: Pyrotechnic gas generator
abstract_en: The invention provides a pyrotechnic gas generator, which comprises an ignition assembly, a combustion chamber assembly, a filtering assembly and a shell assembly. The ignition assembly comprises an ignition assembly, a baffle ring, injection molding materials and a short circuit ring, wherein the baffle ring is a cold upsetting piece, the outer side of the baffle ring is provided with a metal straight surface, the baffle ring and the ignition assembly are integrally formed through the injection molding materials, and the short circuit ring is sleeved on the outer side of the ignition assembly matrix. The combustion chamber assembly comprises a cartridge and gas generating and powder transferring agents in the cartridge, and one end of the cartridge is fixedly connected with the ignition assembly. The filter component comprises a cylindrical filter screen and a fixing ring on the filter screen, and a plurality of small holes are arranged on the fixing ring on the filter screen to block the gas production medicine. The housing assembly includes a barrel housing with an exhaust vent for receiving the combustion chamber assembly and the filter assembly, the exhaust vent corresponding to the filter screen outlet. The invention has compact structure, stable gas generation and good filtering effect, realizes electrode short circuit on the premise of not changing the injection molding process, improves the combustion stability and the moisture-proof capacity, and is suitable for an automobile safety airbag system.

title_en: Electronic and electric system of vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The present application relates to an electronic and electrical system of a vehicle and a vehicle. The electronic and electric system of the vehicle comprises a mobile data center, a main area controller and a backup area controller, wherein the different area controllers are deployed in different subareas of the vehicle, the main area controller is connected with a main bus network section, the backup area controller is connected with a backup bus network section, the main area controller is configured to be communicated with the mobile data center, a main brake component and a main steering component in the main bus network section, and the backup area controller is configured to be communicated with the mobile data center, the backup brake component and the backup steering component in the backup bus network section. By adopting the scheme, the redundant control of the vehicle braking and the vehicle steering can be realized, and the running safety of the vehicle is improved.

title_en: Vehicle centroid slip angle estimation method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of vehicle control, and particularly relates to a vehicle centroid slip angle estimation method, a vehicle centroid slip angle estimation device, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining sensor measurement data of a target vehicle, carrying out centroid side deflection angle estimation on the sensor measurement data by using a preset physical information neural network to obtain a centroid side deflection angle estimation result of the target vehicle, wherein the physical information neural network comprises a neural network and a Kalman filtering model, the physical information neural network carries out model training based on a first deflection and a second deflection, the first deflection is a deflection between an actual centroid side deflection of the target vehicle and an output of the neural network, and the second deflection is a deflection between the actual centroid side deflection and the output of the Kalman filtering model. According to the method and the device, the robustness of external disturbance under the complex working condition can be effectively improved, and a more accurate centroid side deviation angle estimation result is obtained.

title_en: High-stability unmanned ship
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of unmanned boats, in particular to a boat body, a mounting rack, a damping component, an air cylinder, a damper, a connecting plate, a lightening hole, an air storage tank, a mounting component, a front connecting rod, a rear connecting rod, a mounting platform, a connecting block, a connecting rod, a searchlight, a camera, a single-beam depth finder and a mounting box; through damper's setting, can effectively cushion unmanned ship navigation in-process because of wave impact, the vibration that the water disturbance produced and jolt, weaken the vibration amplitude that the hull transmitted to mounting platform, reduce the influence of vibration to carrying on all kinds of detection equipment on mounting platform, guarantee detection equipment operating stability and data acquisition precision, mounting platform relies on the mounting bracket to realize firm assembly, combine damper's shock attenuation cushioning effect, can promote the shock resistance of whole carrying structure, reduce the navigation and rock equipment skew that leads to, become flexible problem, extension detection equipment life.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle deicing propeller control method and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a control method of an unmanned aerial vehicle deicing propeller and an unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle deicing. The control method comprises the steps of obtaining geometric parameters and thermophysical parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle deicing propeller, constructing a geometric model of a heating area of a heating film based on Romberg, calculating the heating area of the heating film according to the geometric parameters and the geometric model, determining required heating power according to the heating area of the heating film and the thermophysical parameters, and determining executable parameters according to the required heating power to power up a battery. According to the invention, through determining the specific heating coverage of the front edge of the blade, accurately calculating the required heating power and matching with the special battery parameters and the integrated circuit board, the accurate matching of the battery according to the required supply is ensured, and the temperature regulation and the power supply protection of the PI heating film are realized.

title_en: Longitudinal double-oar area tail pushes away unmanned helicopter body structure of big load
abstract_en: The invention discloses a longitudinal double-oar tail-pushing large-load unmanned helicopter body structure, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises a streamline body, wherein one side of the top of the streamline body is provided with a front rotor wing installation hole site for installing a front rotor wing system, the other side of the top of the streamline body is provided with a rear rotor wing installation hole site for installing a rear rotor wing system, the tail part of the streamline body is provided with a tail-pushing installation position for installing a tail-pushing device, the bottom of the streamline body is provided with a landing gear installation position, a connecting frame is arranged in the streamline body, and a power system, a control system, a transmission system channel and an equipment cabin interface are respectively arranged in the connecting frame. The machine body is integrated with a plurality of standardized interface modules, supports quick assembly and replacement of the detachable wing, the front/rear rotor wings, the tail pushing device, the landing gear and the task equipment, meets flexible configuration under different task demands, and can be assembled and disassembled without tools by adopting a quick-disassembly mechanism, thereby greatly improving transportation, storage and field maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Simulator for testing holding and clamping functions of aircraft tractor
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an aircraft tractor clamping function test simulator which comprises a load simulation mechanism, a simulation nose wheel, a detection control system, a plurality of pressure sensors and a controller, wherein the load simulation mechanism comprises a hydraulic cylinder, a first guide column and a hydraulic station, the first guide column is hinged with a piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder to reduce lateral force, the hydraulic station is connected with the hydraulic cylinder, the simulation nose wheel comprises a supporting shaft and a nose wheel body, the hydraulic cylinder is used for applying a simulation aircraft load in the vertical direction to the simulation nose wheel through the first guide column under the driving of the hydraulic station, the detection control system comprises a controller and a plurality of pressure sensors, the pressure sensors are used for being electrically connected with pressure detection interfaces of all cylinders of a tractor and used for detecting pressure signals of all cylinders of the tractor, and the pressure sensors and the hydraulic station are electrically connected with the controller respectively and are configured to adjust the simulation aircraft load applied by the hydraulic cylinder. According to the technology provided by the application, the reliable test of the tractor clamping mechanism can be realized under the condition of simulating the airplane load, so that the actual performance of the equipment can be accurately reflected.

title_en: Sealing structure, vehicle seat slide rail assembly and vehicle seat system
abstract_en: The application discloses a sealing structure, a vehicle seat sliding rail assembly and a vehicle seat system, which comprise a lower sliding rail, an upper sliding rail, a sealing piece, a first foreign matter groove and a second foreign matter groove, wherein a sliding groove cavity is formed in the upper portion of the lower sliding rail, the upper sliding rail is slidably arranged in the lower sliding rail, the cross section size of the sealing piece is not smaller than the width of an opening above the sliding groove cavity and smaller than the cross section maximum width of the sliding groove cavity, the sealing piece is provided with a jogging section and a avoiding section, and the first foreign matter groove and the second foreign matter groove are respectively arranged at the outer edges of the two sides of the opening along the third direction and are used for temporarily accommodating foreign matters carried on the surface of the sealing piece when the sealing piece is pressed into the sliding groove cavity. This seal structure, the sealing member can realize gapless shielding when static, can realize the clean function of developments through first foreign matter groove and second foreign matter groove simultaneously, has avoided the foreign matter to be taken into spout chamber and lower slide rail inside together with the sealing member.

title_en: Power conversion method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a power conversion method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product, and belongs to the technical field of batteries. According to the embodiment of the application, under the condition of an offline power change mode, the target vehicle data corresponding to the target vehicle identification of the vehicle to be changed can be determined according to the locally stored vehicle data, and under the condition that the vehicle to be changed meets at least one power change condition according to the target vehicle data, the power change operation is carried out on the vehicle to be changed. That is, the present embodiment only performs the power change operation on the vehicle that satisfies the power change condition, and ensures the accuracy and safety of the power change. And support offline power conversion, so, under the circumstances that the communication between the power conversion station and the power conversion cloud platform is unusual, uninterrupted power conversion service can still be provided for the user through the offline power conversion scheme provided by the embodiment, and the power conversion requirement of the user is met.

title_en: Train speed and distance measuring method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a train speed and distance measuring method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting bar code images of bar code sequences arranged on a train track at different moments in the running process of a train to be measured along the train track; each bar code in the bar code sequence is used for representing the milestone information of each coding point of the train track, decoding the bar code image to obtain the milestone information of the corresponding coding point of the train to be tested at different moments, and determining the running distance and the running speed of the train to be tested based on the milestone information of the corresponding coding point at different moments and different moments. The whole speed and distance measuring process is not influenced by the adhesion relation of the wheel rail and the gradient of the rail, the problems of static drift, temperature drift and the like of the accelerometer are avoided, and the accuracy of speed and distance measuring of the train is improved.

title_en: Braking energy recovery method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a braking energy recovery method and a device, wherein the braking energy recovery method comprises the steps of acquiring target braking strength, and if the target braking strength exceeds the maximum braking strength which can be provided by a motor, a cylinder rotor of a rotary piston type high-pressure pump is connected with a driving shaft of a wheel so as to provide braking force for the driving shaft and store energy into an energy accumulator of the rotary piston type high-pressure pump. According to the braking energy recovery method disclosed by the scheme, when the target braking strength exceeds the maximum braking strength of the motor, the cylinder body rotor is actively connected to the driving shaft, and the rotary piston type high-pressure pump is used as braking main force. The rotary piston type high-pressure pump provides a hydraulic recovery path of braking energy, and the energy exceeding the maximum braking intensity of the motor is recovered by the rotary piston type high-pressure pump to replace a mechanical friction brake or a mechanical friction brake as a standby, so that the high-intensity braking energy is effectively recovered while braking, and the recovery rate of the rotary piston type high-pressure pump to the braking energy is improved.

title_en: Multi-mode driving anti-blowing baffle device for bottom of ducted aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode driving blowing-resistant baffle device for the bottom of a ducted aircraft, which comprises a left baffle, a right baffle, a motor driving mechanism, a landing gear transmission mechanism, a left baffle overturning mechanism and a right baffle overturning mechanism, wherein the motor driving mechanism comprises a motor, a first speed reducer and two second speed reducers, the first speed reducer is respectively connected with the two second speed reducers through a third clutch and a fourth clutch, the two second speed reducers are respectively connected with the left baffle overturning mechanism and the right baffle overturning mechanism, the landing gear transmission mechanism comprises two worms, the two worms are respectively connected with the two second speed reducers through the first clutch and the second clutch, and the two worms are respectively meshed with a worm gear. The invention can realize the selective connection and separation of the left baffle plate driving mechanism and the right baffle plate driving mechanism by controlling the on-off of different clutches, so that the left baffle plate and the right baffle plate can realize independent opening, synchronous opening, differential opening angle adjustment, sequential compound control of first linkage and then fine adjustment, and the like.

title_en: Latent type multistage lifting finished product auxiliary assembly equipment and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses auxiliary assembly equipment for a hidden multi-stage lifting finished product and a control method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of aviation assembly. The equipment comprises a carrying mechanism, a gesture adjusting mechanism, a grading lifting mechanism, a quick-change clamping mechanism and an intelligent control system, wherein a hidden low car body, a sinking cavity and a recoverable parking structure are adopted, so that the equipment can be submerged in a narrow space for positioning, the grading lifting mechanism realizes large-stroke heavy-load lifting, the gesture adjusting mechanism completes X/Y two-dimensional precise alignment, and the quick-change clamping mechanism realizes precise pushing and assembly of finished products. The control method comprises the processes of hiding in place, grading lifting, plane gesture adjustment, tool feeding and safe resetting, and integrates laser radar navigation, closed-loop driving control and multistage safety protection. The invention can meet the requirements of hiding and positioning, high-precision alignment and automatic butt joint of large aviation finished products in narrow special-shaped spaces, and improves the assembly precision, efficiency and operation safety.

title_en: Multi-degree-of-freedom quasi-zero stiffness active gravity unloading device for satellite micro-vibration test and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom quasi-zero rigidity active gravity unloading device for satellite micro-vibration test and a control method, wherein the device comprises a flexible joint between an unloading head and a satellite body, a vertical compensation module is arranged below the flexible joint and comprises a voice coil motor, the horizontal decoupling module is arranged below the vertical compensation module and comprises a planar air bearing, each supporting point of the satellite body is provided with a perception feedback module, the perception feedback module comprises a force sensor and a displacement sensor, and the force sensor, the displacement sensor and the voice coil motor are all in communication connection with a controller. The method comprises the steps that a displacement sensor acquires micro displacement of a satellite body in the Z-axis direction in real time, a force sensor monitors residual disturbance force in real time, a controller adjusts output force of a voice coil motor in real time according to a 'position-force' double closed-loop algorithm after acquiring a position feedback signal, and apparent dynamic stiffness is enabled to be approximately zero through active compensation of the voice coil motor, so that quasi-zero stiffness adjustment is achieved.

title_en: Parameter-preset-based parking actuator position self-learning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parameter-based preset self-learning method for the position of a parking actuator, which comprises presetting a P-in reference position when the parking actuator is parked and a P-out reference position when the parking actuator is unlocked, determining the upper limit and the lower limit of the P-in position based on the P-in reference position and a first offset, determining the upper limit and the lower limit of the P-out position based on the P-out reference position and a second offset, determining a third offset based on the P-in reference position and the P-out reference position, collecting the angle and the current of the parking actuator, calculating the rotating speed of the parking actuator, taking the P-in reference position as a target to drive the parking actuator to move in the P-in direction, if the self-learning P-in is judged to be successful, recording the current actual P-in position, determining the theoretical P-out position according to the actual P-in position and the third offset, and taking the theoretical P-out position as the target to drive the actuator to move in the P-out direction. The invention can improve the precision, stability, efficiency and service life of the actuator of self-learning.

title_en: Energy recovery optimization control method and system suitable for automatic driving parking scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy recovery optimization control method and system suitable for an automatic driving parking scene, which comprises responding to a parking energy recovery signal, acquiring a corresponding parking motion state of a vehicle based on parking environment information and a preset parking path, and determining a torque control decision corresponding to the parking motion state, wherein the torque control decision is to apply a torque in a preset direction, and the motor actuator is controlled based on the torque control decision to complete parking energy recovery. According to the invention, the maximum energy recovery and the driving smoothness optimization under the parking scene can be realized according to the parking motion state.

title_en: Self-adaptive gradient loading and unloading device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power rush-repair and discloses a self-adaptive gradient loading and unloading device which comprises a supporting seat, a frame, a sliding rod, a telescopic frame, wheels, an electric push rod and a telescopic frame, wherein the supporting seat is provided with a supporting frame and a movable frame, the bottom end of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with the supporting seat, the bottom end of the movable frame is hinged with the supporting seat, a first sliding rail is arranged on the outer side of the frame, a second sliding rail and the sliding rod which is arranged on the second sliding rail in a sliding manner are arranged on the inner side of the frame, the top end of the movable frame is hinged with the sliding rod, the top end of the supporting frame is hinged with the frame, the telescopic frame is arranged on the first sliding rail in a sliding manner, the telescopic frame stretches along the extending direction of the first sliding rail, the bottom of the trolley is provided with the wheels, and the trolley is erected on the top surface of the telescopic frame. According to the invention, dynamic matching of the transportation angle is realized through the movable frame, so that the adaptability to complex ground and different parking postures is improved, and jolt in the loading and unloading process is effectively reduced.

title_en: Mechanical damping mechanism, cover assembly, charging socket mechanism and vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a mechanical damping mechanism, a cover assembly, a charging socket mechanism, and a vehicle. The mechanical damping mechanism includes a pivotable connection fixedly connected to and pivoting with a pivotable member, a coil spring having a central axis and being compressible in a direction of the central axis, and a slidable element floatably disposed between the pivotable connection and the coil spring. The slidable element comprises a first protrusion extending away from the coil spring in the direction of the central axis, comprising a first profile extending obliquely towards the top end of the first protrusion. The pivotable connection includes a second protrusion including a second profile configured to contact and press against the first profile of the slidable element after the pivotable member is pivoted a first predetermined angle from the initial position of 0 ° such that the slidable element slides in the direction of the central axis towards the coil spring to compress the coil spring, thereby damping the pivoting speed of the pivotable member.

title_en: Shock-resistant vehicle-mounted compressor
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted refrigeration equipment, in particular to an impact-resistant vehicle-mounted compressor, which comprises a compressor body and a connecting structure for connecting the compressor body and a frame, wherein the connecting structure comprises a first mounting plate, a second mounting plate, a horizontal buffer assembly and a limiting assembly. The horizontal buffer assembly comprises three spherical rolling bodies and three first elastic pieces, the spherical rolling bodies roll to abut against the second mounting plate and the first cambered surface pits, the first elastic pieces are used for driving the first mounting plate and the second mounting plate to be close to each other, and the limiting assembly limits that the maximum distance between the first mounting plate and the second mounting plate is smaller than the diameter of the spherical rolling bodies. The application can reduce vibration transmission between the frame and the vehicle-mounted compressor, and improve the running stability, service life and NVH performance of the vehicle-mounted compressor.

title_en: Roof external device and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle roof external connection device and a vehicle, which comprise a power supply base, a shell component and a wire harness component, wherein the power supply base is fixedly arranged at a mounting hole of the vehicle roof, a channel for a wire harness to pass through is formed in the power supply base, the shell component is covered outside the power supply base and is detachably connected with the power supply base, one end of the wire harness component is connected with a low-voltage power supply of the vehicle, the other end of the wire harness component extends from a vehicle D column to the shell component through the vehicle roof, and the wire harness component is used for providing power output for external electric devices.
