The application solves the problem of high potential safety hazard caused by post-assembly remanufacturing in the power supply scheme of the expanded electric device in the prior art.

title_en: Steering auxiliary control method and device and vehicle
abstract_en: A steering assist control method (1200), an apparatus, and a vehicle (100), the steering assist control method (1200) including acquiring a first planned path for the vehicle (100) to avoid a first obstacle (S1210), and speed information of the vehicle (100), determining a front wheel desired turning angle and a rear wheel desired turning angle, respectively, based on a curvature and a position indicated by the first planned path, and speed information when the vehicle (100) is determined to be in an obstacle avoidance phase according to the first planned path, or determining a front wheel desired turning angle and a rear wheel desired turning angle based on the front wheel turning angle and speed information of the vehicle (100) when the vehicle (100) is determined to be in a return phase according to the first planned path (S1220), and controlling the vehicle (100) to execute the front wheel desired turning angle and the rear wheel desired turning angle (S1230). The method (1200) can improve the steering capability of the vehicle (100) in an emergency, widen the capability boundary of active safety of the vehicle (100), and improve the reliability and safety of the vehicle (100).

title_en: Signal fusion platform door control system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a signal fusion platform door control system and a method, comprising a platform door control system and a plurality of door control units, wherein the platform door control system comprises a logic control/communication unit and an input/output unit. The logic control/communication unit directly communicates with the train vehicle-mounted equipment to acquire a door opening and closing instruction, and after the target door control unit is determined, a network door opening and closing signal is issued to the target door control unit through a network, and the input/output unit is informed to output a hard wire door enabling signal to the target door control unit. And the target gate control unit controls the platform gate to be opened after receiving the hard wire gate enabling signal and the network gate opening signal at the same time. The application also provides a corresponding control method. The application shortens the control link through direct communication, realizes accurate control through networking, adopts a hard wire and network signal dual guarantee mechanism, and remarkably improves the response speed, flexibility, safety and reliability of the control of the platform door.

Namely, the defect that the matching mode of the force limiting rod and the spindle head of the spindle is single is overcome on the premise of not replacing other parts of the force limiting spindle.

title_en: Composite structure has oil tank from closing function

The self-sealing layer of the oil tank of the utility model is not easy to fall off, thus greatly improving the self-sealing effect; the elastic holes in the protective framework layer and the blocking layer have certain self-contraction characteristics, the size of the elastic hole is smaller than that of the elastic piece, the elastic hole is smooth and has no petal-shaped flanging, and deformation recovery of the elastic hole of the self-sealing layer is less obstructed; the self-sealing layer is arranged between the protective framework layer and the barrier layer, and is not directly subjected to external scraping, impact, illumination and washing of internal oil, so that the service life is longer.

When a user controls the telescopic rod to extend, the first magnetic ring adsorbs the second gear, the second magnetic ring adsorbs the fourth gear, the gear does not rotate relative to the gear shaft any more, and the differential function of the differential mechanism is suspended. title_en: Integral air-cooled air conditioner for ship container

The utility model can realize the high-precision control of steering under the unmanned scene; and the driver can obtain sufficient assistance under the condition of manual intervention, so that the controllability of the automobile in any driving environment is ensured.

In the scheme, the support and the T-Box form a sliding pair, and when the T-Box is installed, the support and the T-Box slide to a proper position relatively and then are locked by the locking unit, so that the T-Box is installed; when the T-Box is disassembled, the locking unit is firstly released, then the support and the T-Box are moved out in the opposite direction, the T-Box can be disassembled and assembled without a special tool, and the operation is simple.

title_en: Hinge type tractor with marsh escaping mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hinge tractors, and discloses a hinge tractor with a marsh gas escape mechanism, which comprises a tractor rear box, wherein the marsh gas escape mechanism and an escape screening mechanism are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the tractor rear box; the marsh gas escaping mechanism comprises a driving roller, a fixed disc, a connecting ring, a tire, an arc-shaped hole, a first electric telescopic cylinder and an electric slip ring; the tractor rear box bottom left and right sides all rotates and is connected with the drive roller, the equal fixedly connected with fixed disk in both sides around the drive roller, the welding of fixed disk outside has the go-between, go-between outside swing joint has the tire, the arc hole has all been seted up to the inside left and right sides of go-between and upper and lower both sides. The utility model discloses a set up arc and electronic telescoping cylinder in the go-between, can utilize four arcs of expansion when the hinge type tractor is absorbed in the mire, increase the area of contact of tire and mire, avoid absorbing in the mire fast to deviate from in the mire.

title_en: Rain structure is sheltered from to centralized quick charging station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rain shielding structure of a centralized quick charging station, which comprises a base and the centralized quick charging station, wherein the centralized quick charging station is arranged on the upper wall surface of the base, and a rain shielding structure is arranged above the base and positioned outside the centralized quick charging station; wherein, hides rain structure and includes: the device comprises a left vertical plate, a right vertical plate, a back plate, a supporting plate, a cross rod, a pair of fixing blocks, a motor, a rotating shaft, a pair of sliding rails, a pair of sliding blocks, a supporting rod, a piece of rain shielding cloth and a pair of springs; the utility model relates to a centralized quick charging station technical field has solved the problem that current centralized charging station does not possess accurate rain function that hides, and has just been in the riser is installed on the wall on the base, a left side riser is located centralized quick charging station left side, right side riser is installed on the wall on the base, right side riser is located centralized quick charging station right side.

title_en: Automobile bumper with multi-stage energy absorption structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a car bumper of multistage energy-absorbing structure, including the bumper casing, still include buffer block and energy-absorbing frame, the lateral wall welded fastening of bumper casing has coniform buffer block, one side welded fastening that the bumper casing was kept away from to the buffer block has the buffering post, the tip integrated into one piece of buffering post has the plectane, and the lateral wall butt joint of plectane has the buffer spring who is arranged in the inside circular slot of energy-absorbing frame, the one end that the energy-absorbing frame is close to the buffer block is constructed the dashpot with the buffer block adaptation, and has a plurality of breachs along constructing in the dashpot, the equal welded fastening in top and the bottom of buffer block has the pole setting, the inside of pole setting is constructed there is the spout, and sliding connection has the telescopic link in the spout. The bumper shell generates deformation and the buffer column extrudes the buffer spring, impact energy is converted and absorbed, impact effect is reduced, and the buffer column can be prevented from rebounding and resetting to cause secondary damage to pedestrians.

title_en: Mine anti-running speed limiting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine prevents roadster speed limiting device, including connection frame, backup pad, fixed frame, mounting panel, U type frame, commentaries on classics board, deceleration strip, guide frame, fender arm, second motor, second lead screw, rack, first motor, spout, first lead screw, slider, connecting rod, connecting piece, cooperation groove and gear. The utility model discloses can detect the speed of a motor vehicle in the mine to can intercept the vehicle of overspeed, prevent the emergence of incident, the whole device does not need artifical the participation, has reduced practitioner's intensity of labour, has guaranteed workman's life safety in the mine; after the overspeed vehicle is detected, the vehicle speed is buffered by rotating the rotating plate through which the vehicle passes, so that the safety problem caused by the fact that the vehicle speed is too fast is reduced to the maximum extent. The problem of even the sports car is intercepted in the mine, nevertheless because of the speed of a motor vehicle is fast, the striking energy is big, also can cause the damage of mine car and intercepting device and cause great economic loss is solved.

title_en: Landing leg structure and platform truck
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pipeline construction vehicle technical field particularly, relates to a landing leg structure and platform truck. The landing leg structure includes frame, a drive mechanism, coupling assembling and athey wheel, the athey wheel with coupling assembling connects, a drive mechanism's one end with connected to the frame, a drive mechanism's the other end with coupling assembling drive connection, a drive mechanism is suitable for the drive coupling assembling for the frame rotates. The utility model discloses a first actuating mechanism drive coupling assembling rotates for the frame to this realization is located the athey wheel on the coupling assembling and deflects to the frame both sides, thereby realizes that the athey wheel lifts up for the bottom surface, realizes the strideing across of barrier or trench.

title_en: Hybrid power driving system of vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hybrid power driving system and vehicle of vehicle, wherein, first sun gear and the meshing of first planet wheel, the meshing of second planet wheel and second sun gear, first planet wheel and second planet wheel locate the planet carrier; the first driving piece is selectively connected with the gear ring or the first sun gear or the second sun gear; the second driving piece is selectively connected with the gear ring or the planet carrier; the generator is selectively connected with the second sun gear or the planet carrier or the first sun gear; the power take-off shaft is selectively connected to the ring gear or the planet carrier. From this, through the hybrid drive system of this application, can realize the vehicle different driving function demands under different operating modes, can reduce whole car energy consumption, discharge, can promote to drive and experience to, the hybrid drive system compact structure, the volume of this application are less, are convenient for arrange on the vehicle, and in addition, the hybrid drive system simple structure of this application can reduce the production and assemble the degree of difficulty.

title_en: Snow-proof structure of air conditioning unit, overhead air conditioning unit and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an air conditioning unit prevents snow structure, overhead type air conditioning unit and vehicle, but switching snow protection mechanism, snow protection mechanism installs in the space of air conditioning unit shell condensation air outlet below and condensation fan top, snow protection mechanism covers the condensation fan completely and keeps apart condensation fan and condensation air outlet when being in the closed condition, snow protection mechanism is connected with air conditioner controller. The utility model discloses can realize making condensation fan and big snow effectively keep apart at low temperature weather, guarantee air conditioning unit and normally work, prevent snow structural installation in the shell below simultaneously, can not influence air conditioning unit's whole outward appearance effect.

title_en: Oil filling pipe assembly and automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil filling pipe assembly and an automobile, which comprises an oil gas recovery component, an oil filling pipe and a vent pipe, wherein the oil gas recovery component comprises a shell, a rotating shaft, a driving impeller and a recovery impeller, an oil passage is formed in the shell, the shell is also provided with a first oil inlet and a first oil outlet which are communicated with the oil passage, a vent passage is also formed in the shell, the shell is also provided with an air inlet and an air outlet which are communicated with the vent passage, the driving impeller is positioned in the oil passage, the recovery impeller is positioned in the vent passage, the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the shell, one end of the rotating shaft is fixed with the driving impeller, and the other end of the rotating shaft is fixed with the recovery impeller; one end of the oil filling pipe is communicated with the first oil inlet, and one end of the vent pipe is communicated with the gas outlet. The utility model discloses an add oil pipe assembly and can realize vapor recovery system high-efficiently, and simple structure.

title_en: Ground coupling antenna vehicle-mounted towing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an on-vehicle linkage that drags of ground coupling antenna, the on-vehicle linkage that drags of ground coupling antenna includes: a hitch mechanism coupled to the vehicle; the pulling mechanism comprises: the antenna comprises a longitudinal towing part, a transverse towing part, an antenna fixing structure and wheels; the longitudinal traction part comprises a plurality of longitudinal rods which are arranged in parallel; the antenna fixing structure comprises a plurality of antenna fixing rods, the antenna fixing rods are movably connected with the longitudinal towing part, the plurality of antenna fixing rods form a rectangle, and the bottom of the antenna fixing structure is used for mounting a ground coupling antenna; and one side of the longitudinal towing part, which is close to the third transverse rod, is provided with wheels. The utility model discloses rotatable antenna dead lever pull rod adjustment antenna's elevation has alleviateed the damage of antenna in order to adapt to different road conditions.

title_en: Tube bundle clamp for automobile engine compartment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of clamps, and particularly discloses a tube bundle clamp for an automobile engine compartment, which comprises two first arc-shaped tubes, wherein the two first arc-shaped tubes are rotatably connected through a hinge, the left sides of the first arc-shaped tubes are provided with first through holes, first limiting blocks are slidably connected in the first arc-shaped tubes, the left sides of the first limiting blocks are fixedly connected with fixed blocks, the left sides of the fixed blocks are fixedly connected with second arc-shaped tubes penetrating through the first through holes, the left sides of the second arc-shaped tubes are provided with second through holes, second limiting blocks are slidably connected in the second arc-shaped tubes, the left sides of the second limiting blocks are fixedly connected with movable rings penetrating through the second through holes, the left sides of the movable rings are fixedly connected with connecting plates, and the centers of the front sides of the two connecting plates are provided with second threaded holes for threaded connection of third screws.

title_en: Double-fork expansion joint
abstract_en: A double-fork expansion joint belongs to key equipment of urban rail transit for electric locomotive power supply equipment. The technical scheme of the utility model is that a section of steel-aluminum composite rail is divided into left and right bulks with two forks by wire cut electrical discharge machining, and the bulks are processed and assembled to form an expansion joint without floating blocks after being distributed with a current connector and the like, wherein the length of the fork is more than 1.5 times of the maximum clearance caused by thermal expansion and cold contraction, so that a current-feeding device electric brush on an electric locomotive can stably pass through the expansion joint. There are three electrical paths from left to right bulks: 1. directly passes through two fishplates, 2, a large copper ring, 3, a small copper ring, and then passes through another small copper ring. The utility model has high reliability, can enlarge the longitudinal center distance of adjacent expansion joints to 200m, reduces the full length by one third, has good electricity transmission stability, can pass 1.1 times of total rated current, and has the initial sliding force less than 800N.

title_en: Intelligent lane departure early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle active safety, and discloses an intelligent lane departure early warning system, which comprises a front camera, a rear camera, a gyroscope sensor, an early warning display and a controller, and is characterized in that: the front camera is fixed on the front windshield in the cab, the direction of the front camera faces the front, the front camera is electrically connected with a controller of the lane departure early warning system, the rear camera is fixed on an instrument desk in the cab, and the direction of the rear camera faces one side of a driver. This intelligence lane departure early warning system can realize the implementation of lane departure early warning: recognizing fatigue driving of a driver through the rear camera, and recognizing that the vehicle deviates from the current traffic lane or is about to cross the lane to run through the front camera at the moment; the rear camera recognizes that the driver does not actively operate the steering wheel to carry out turning or merging operation on the vehicle.

title_en: Novel automobile foaming seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel automobile foaming seat which comprises a seat body, wherein a fixed plate is fixedly connected to the top inside the seat body, the top of the fixed plate is movably connected with a rotating rod through a bearing, the surface of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a first gear, two sides of the first gear are meshed with a second gear, the inside of the second gear is fixedly connected with a threaded sleeve, the bottom of the threaded sleeve is movably connected to two sides of the top of the fixed plate through the bearing, a screw rod is connected to the inner thread of the threaded sleeve, and a headrest is fixedly connected to the top of the screw rod penetrating through the seat body. According to the utility model, the rotary rotating rod is arranged, and the rotary rod pushes the headrest to move upwards through the first gear, the second gear, the threaded sleeve and the screw, so that the problems that the existing seat headrest adjustment is divided into electric adjustment and manual adjustment, the electric adjustment is usually carried out by adopting a motor, the manufacturing cost is high, and the manual adjustment cannot accurately control the height of the headrest are solved.

title_en: Bicycle jiffy stand convenient for parking bicycle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bicycle parking frame convenient for parking a bicycle, belonging to the technical field of bicycles, this bicycle jiffy stand is used to bicycle of being convenient for park, including two device boards, two device boards lean on the equal fixedly connected with connecting rod of near-end mutually, a plurality of fixed plates of the equal fixedly connected with in upper end of two connecting rods, a plurality of arc gag lever posts of the equal fixedly connected with in upper end of a plurality of fixed plates, two square fixed blocks of the circumference inner wall fixedly connected with of a plurality of arc gag lever posts, the first square spout has all been seted up by the near-end mutually of two square fixed blocks, inner wall sliding connection has the slide bar about square spout, two circular ports have all been seted up at both ends about the slide bar, be close to two first springs of the equal fixedly connected with of inner wall mutually of four circular ports, the fixed mounting panel in circular post upper end of rethread, the draw-in groove of seting up through the mounting panel front end, put into the better propaganda of article.

title_en: Reinforced frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bicycles, in particular to a reinforced frame. The method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a front pipe, an upper pipe, a lower pipe, a seat pipe, a rear upper fork pipe and a rear lower fork pipe; one end of the upper pipe and one end of the lower pipe are respectively connected with the seat pipe; the other ends of the upper pipe and the lower pipe are respectively connected with the front pipe, or the other end of the lower pipe is connected with the front pipe, and the upper pipe is connected with the lower pipe; the upper pipe, the lower pipe and the seat pipe are arranged in a surrounding manner to form a first space, or the upper pipe, the lower pipe, the seat pipe and the front pipe are arranged in a surrounding manner to form a first space; one end of each of the rear upper fork tube and the rear lower fork tube is connected with the seat tube, and the other ends of the rear upper fork tube and the rear lower fork tube are connected with each other; the rear upper fork tube, the rear lower fork tube and the seat tube are enclosed to form a second space; the first space and the second space are respectively arranged on two opposite sides of the seat tube.

title_en: Quick-release type swing arm rear mounting bracket structure of automobile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile equipment, in particular to a quick-dismantling type swing arm rear mounting bracket structure for an automobile, which comprises a side frame and a bending frame arranged on one side of the side frame, wherein a mounting part is arranged at the rear end of the bending frame, a supporting mechanism is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the side frame, a mounting mechanism is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting mechanism, and a clamping mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the mounting mechanism; a bayonet is installed at one end of the side frame, a pulley is arranged inside the bayonet, a limiting part penetrating through the side wall of the side frame is arranged at the circle center part of the pulley, a lead screw is arranged on the side wall of the side frame, and one end of the lead screw penetrates through the bending frame and is externally connected with a handle. Through the structure, the swing arm mounting bracket is convenient to mount and dismount, and the swing arm mounting bracket is easy to operate, smooth in movement and good in using effect.

title_en: Intelligent vehicle is with positioner that has protective capacities
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent vehicle is with positioner that has protective capacities, the cavity has been seted up to shells inner wall, cavity inner wall welded connection has the fixed slot, shells inner wall welded connection has strengthened the wall, shell outer wall bonding is connected with the rubber layer, through the casing, strengthen arm and rubber layer and solved the most not safeguard function of ordinary positioner among the prior art, in use easily receives the problem of damage, the problem of the complicated inconvenient installation of the most structure of ordinary positioner among the prior art has been solved through strong magnetic block, through the fixed slot, elasticity footstock and silica gel pad have solved ordinary positioner among the prior art and have mostly not protected inside, inside electronic components easily suffers vibrations and the problem of damage in the use.

title_en: General intelligent system for simulating acoustic waves of automobile
abstract_en: The utility model provides a general sound wave simulation intelligent system for an automobile, which comprises a sound wave simulation controller, wherein an OBD connector is arranged on the sound wave simulation controller, the OBD connector is connected with an OBD interface of the automobile, the sound wave simulation controller is provided with a sound wave simulation control system, the sound wave simulation control system comprises a network receiving module, an MCU, a data memory, a sound wave main control module and a sound wave output module, the output end of the network receiving module and the output end of the data memory are both connected with the input end of the MCU, the output end of the MCU is respectively connected with the input end of the data memory and the input end of the sound wave main control module, and the output end of the sound wave main control module is connected with the input end of the sound wave output module. The method has the advantages that engine sound simulated after data such as the rotating speed of the engine and the position of the accelerator pedal are directly obtained is more real, and CAN data protocols of corresponding vehicle types CAN be downloaded through small programs or apps, so that one simulated sound wave controller CAN meet the protocol matching function of all vehicle types.

title_en: Pedal structure of excavator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an excavator pedal structure which comprises a base plate and pedals, wherein supporting plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the upper end face of the base plate, a supporting shaft is rotatably connected between the supporting plates, the outer wall of the supporting shaft is fixedly connected with the pedals, the outer side walls of the two supporting plates are rotatably connected with connecting rods through rotating shafts, one ends of the two connecting rods, far away from the supporting plates, are slidably connected with the side walls of the pedals through sliding groove matching sliding blocks, locking mechanisms are installed on the inner side walls of the supporting plates, vertical plates are fixedly connected to the outer walls of the rotating shafts, baffle plates are fixedly connected to the outer side walls of the supporting plates, and anti-skidding protrusions are uniformly and fixedly connected to the upper end face of the pedals. This excavator step structure has solved current step structure and has inconvenient carrying out quick accomodating to it after supplementary getting on bus, has reduced the problem of the flexibility ratio of using.

title_en: Road condition periscope equipment and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides road condition periscopic equipment which comprises a rotatable camera, an electric telescopic rod, a base and a control circuit, wherein the first end of the electric telescopic rod is rotatably connected with the two sides of the base, so that the electric telescopic rod can rotate; the camera is arranged at the second end of the electric telescopic rod and is used for shooting road condition images; the control circuit is installed in the base, with electric telescopic handle and camera all electric connection. In addition, the utility model also provides a vehicle. The method can be used for prejudging the road congestion condition in advance to obtain the optimal driving shortcut lane.

title_en: Novel brake handle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel brake handle, which comprises a brake handle body, wherein the brake handle body is provided with a connecting end part and a grip section which are formed after being bent, and the novel brake handle is characterized in that: the handle section of brake handle body has when the brake with hold the handle contact terminal surface of contact, this handle contact terminal surface processes into the arc terminal surface, this arc terminal surface on the shaping have a plurality of 0.8-1.5 mm's burr, the burr distributes in proper order along the arc terminal surface in proper order, and two liang of burr intervals separately set up and are formed with the interval. The brake handle disclosed by the utility model adopts arc combination and is also provided with crescent lines; when in use, the hand-held curvature accords with the human engineering with the radian of the product, and the hand feeling is good.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for plant protection reconnaissance who possesses real-time image monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for plant protection investigation with a real-time image monitoring function, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein first electric telescopic rods are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the output end of each first electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a protection frame, the middle end of the inner cavity of each protection frame is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, and the bottom of each mounting plate is fixedly connected with a main camera through bolts. According to the utility model, the output end of the first electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the protection frame, the middle end of the inner cavity of the protection frame is fixedly connected with the mounting plate, the bottom of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with the main camera through a bolt, so that the effect of active real-time monitoring is achieved, the motor is fixedly mounted on the outer side of the frame, the output shaft of the motor is in transmission connection with the rotating rod, and the bottom of the rotating rod is fixedly provided with the auxiliary camera through a bolt, so that the effect of auxiliary monitoring is achieved, and the aim of multi-directional monitoring is achieved.

title_en: Storehouse that protecting effect is good trades electric cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent battery changing cabinets, in particular to a bin battery changing cabinet with a good protection effect, which comprises a battery changing cabinet body, a charging bin, a control screen, a cooling assembly and a dust removal assembly, the control screen is arranged on the front surface of the electricity-changing cabinet body, the charging bin is arranged on the front surface of the electricity-changing cabinet body, the front surface of the power exchange cabinet body is provided with a hinged cover which is matched with the charging bins, the charging bins are arranged into a plurality of groups, the warehouse power-exchanging cabinet with good protection effect is internally provided with a cooling component and a dust-removing component, under the coordination control of a temperature sensor and a control screen, the heat dissipation is convenient, the assembly plate is clamped and connected with the dust-removing box, the disassembly and the assembly are convenient, the assembly plate is disassembled, the filter screen is convenient to clean, be provided with the slipmat in the storehouse that charges and set up the auxiliary roller that the cover has the lag on the support, prevent that battery package and the storehouse of charging from appearing colliding with.

title_en: Dual-purpose electric scooter of a key folding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a one-key folding dual-purpose electric scooter, which comprises a pedal with a battery, wherein one end of the pedal is provided with a rear extension part which is integrally formed with the pedal, the other end of the pedal is provided with a front extension part which is integrally formed with the pedal, the rear extension part is provided with a rear wheel installation groove, a rear wheel is installed in the rear wheel installation groove through a connecting lug, one side of the rear wheel is provided with a foldable saddle assembly which is installed on the pedal, the center of the front extension part is fixedly provided with a front wheel assembly which is extended to the position below the front extension part, the top of the front wheel assembly is connected with a headstock assembly in an axial mode, and a positioning mechanism which is installed on the front extension part is arranged on the headstock assembly and is close to the bottom of the headstock assembly; the bicycle seat assembly is unfolded when a rider needs to ride, the bicycle head assembly is unfolded and fixed through the positioning mechanism to be ridden by the rider, and the bicycle seat assembly is folded and stored when the rider needs to ride public transportation.

title_en: Drying oven convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drying oven equipment, in particular to a drying oven convenient to adjust, which comprises a box body, a box door and a heating box, wherein the bottom of the box body is provided with an installation frame, one side of the installation frame is provided with wheels, and the other side of the installation frame is provided with a positioning column, so that the box body can move flexibly and can be firmly fixed; through setting up a plurality of slide rail, and gomphosis piece and regulating block and slide rail looks gomphosis sliding connection, be convenient for lay the mounting bracket according to the general specification of product, pass through bearing and mounting bracket inner chamber wall swing joint through setting up the transfer line both ends again, first gear is connected with the interlock of second gear looks, be convenient for drive four threaded rods through the rotation of connecting rod and rotate, thereby highly finely tune the drying dish, by above structural design, realized drying dish two poles of the earth altitude mixture control, in order to adapt to different product specifications.

title_en: Air duct structure and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air duct structure and a vehicle, wherein the air duct structure comprises a general structure part, the general structure part comprises a door plate for installing a vehicle route board or an electronic advertising screen, a first connecting piece arranged at the upper end of the door plate and connected with a roof frame and a second connecting piece arranged at the lower end of the door plate, and the door plate is obliquely arranged; one end of the bent part is suitable for being connected with the second connecting piece, the other end of the bent part is suitable for being connected with the upper edge of the side window of the vehicle body framework, and the bent part is suitable for being bent and molded in a matching mode with a vehicle type; the universal structure part, the bending part, the roof frame and the upper edge part of the side window of the body frame jointly enclose an air outlet channel. The general structure part can be general in different motorcycle types, only need according to different motorcycle types processing not unidimensional a part of bending can, solved among the prior art need develop different wind channel mould to different motorcycle types and cause the cost to increase and be unfavorable for the problem of manufacturing, reduced development cost, unified product state, be convenient for manufacture.

title_en: Thermoplastic continuous fiber type automobile seat framework mechanism convenient to disassemble and assemble
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermoplastic continuous fiber type automobile seat framework mechanism convenient to disassemble and assemble, which comprises a hollow bottom plate, wherein a backrest adjusting mechanism is fixedly arranged on one side of the hollow bottom plate, the output end of the backrest adjusting mechanism is fixedly connected with a frame, the inner wall of the frame is fixedly connected with a hollow back plate, the back surface of the hollow back plate is fixedly connected with a hollow plate, the upper surface of the hollow plate is fixedly provided with a suction fan, the inner side wall of the hollow plate is fixedly connected with an electrode heating rod, and the bottom of the hollow plate is fixedly connected with the bottom of the hollow back plate through a pipeline. The utility model greatly facilitates the user to disassemble and assemble the butt joint base and the pre-installed base through the matching of the bidirectional threaded rod, the threaded block and the groove, and simultaneously can effectively improve the stability of the butt joint base and the pre-installed base after the butt joint base and the pre-installed base are installed through the matching of the clamping groove and the clamping block, thereby effectively reducing the time required by the user to disassemble and replace equipment and being more beneficial to use.

title_en: Variable-mode crossed single-propeller double-rotor aircraft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a variable-mode crossed single-propeller double-rotor aircraft, which has the technical scheme that the variable-mode crossed single-propeller double-rotor aircraft comprises an aircraft body and an undercarriage arranged on the aircraft body, wings are further arranged on the side part of the aircraft body, rotor wing boxes are symmetrically arranged on the aircraft body, a transmission device is arranged in any rotor wing box, a power source is arranged in the aircraft body and used for driving the transmission device to rotate, the transmission device is connected with a single-propeller rotor wing mechanism, the rotor wing boxes drive the single-propeller rotor wing mechanism to rotate through transmission of the transmission device, the single-propeller rotors symmetrically arranged along the aircraft body are arranged in a crossed mode, a rotating shaft of the single-propeller rotor wing mechanism is coaxially arranged with the rotor wing boxes, propellers are arranged at the wingtips of the single-propeller rotor wing mechanism, a braking limiting component is further arranged in the rotor wing boxes and used for braking the rotation of the single-propeller rotor wing mechanism and controlling the single-propeller mechanism to keep a parallel state with the aircraft body; the device has the effect of improving the cruising speed and the cruising range during flying work.

title_en: Industrial aquaculture does not have rail mounted intelligence navigation machine of throwing fodder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aquaculture, in particular to a factory aquaculture track-free intelligent navigation feeder, which comprises an AGV body, wherein L-shaped mounting plates are arranged at the bottom of the AGV body and near four corners, a driving motor is arranged on the inner side of a vertical plate of each L-shaped mounting plate, the end part of an output shaft of the driving motor penetrates through the inner sides of the L-shaped mounting plates and is connected with a power wheel, a radar is arranged at the bottom of the AGV body and at the middle part of the left end, a depth camera is arranged at the top of the AGV body and near the middle part of the left end, a shell is arranged above the top of the AGV body, and a storage cylinder is arranged at the top of the shell and near the lower right corner. This batch production aquaculture does not have rail mounted intelligent navigation and throws machine of raising through the AGV automobile body that sets up, can realize no track navigation to intelligence planning route, thereby practice thrift the cost, use manpower sparingly, this machine of raising adopts the environmental perception navigation technology based on multisensor fuses, can effectively keep away the barrier.

title_en: Battery case installation component and electric bicycle
abstract_en: The application discloses battery case installation component and electric bicycle relates to electric bicycle technical field. Including battery case and the support that is used for fixed battery case, the battery case includes the casing and sets up fixed ear and buckle on the casing, correspond on the support be provided with fixed ear complex installation department to and with buckle complex joint portion, so that the battery case passes through buckle and support joint, and through fixed ear and support fixed connection. The fixing mode of the battery box can be simplified, so that the purposes of simplifying the support structure and improving the mounting efficiency are achieved.

title_en: Multi-functional car washer based on ultrasonic wave
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional car washer based on ultrasonic waves, and relates to the technical field of car washers. The utility model provides a transmission mechanism, a cleaning mechanism, an induction device and a drying mechanism, wherein an automobile is moved to a first portal frame through the interior of the transmission mechanism, the automobile is positioned and cleaned through the cleaning mechanism and the induction device, air heated by a ceramic heating wire is blown into a second groove through a fan in the drying mechanism, and is blown out through an air opening in the outer side of a second portal frame, so that undried water stains on the surface of the automobile are dried, the problem that dust is adsorbed on the water stains to cause poor cleaning effect is solved, the automatic automobile washing is realized, and meanwhile, the labor cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Hand self-propelled multifunctional machine
abstract_en: A hand-held self-propelled multifunctional machine comprises: handrail assembly, engine assembly, running gear, quick-connect joint assembly and gear box assembly, its characterized in that: the handrail assembly includes the handrail, handrail one side hand (hold) is connected and is equipped with handrail adjustment handle, advance and retreat switching-over handle, heating handle and throttle switch, and opposite side hand (hold) top is connected and is equipped with separation and reunion handle and heating handle, the handrail front end is connected and is equipped with the upper and lower positioning disk of handrail, the handrail is connected with the handrail linking arm, handrail linking arm upper end and lower extreme all are equipped with handrail fixing device, gear box assembly is connected to handrail assembly lower extreme, engine assembly is connected to gear box assembly rear end, the gear box assembly includes that the handrail that the upper end was equipped with turns to the positioning disk and the overhead gage that is connected and is equipped with on one side of the upper end, the gear box assembly is equipped with driven row's tooth subassembly and initiative variable speed row's tooth subassembly, driven row's tooth subassembly is connected with and is put the fender pole subassembly.

title_en: Road obstacle removing mechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of road rescue, and discloses road obstacle clearing mechanical equipment which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a guide groove is formed in the upper surface of the bottom plate, a fixing plate is welded on the side edge of the upper surface of the bottom plate, a screw rod is connected to the center of the fixing plate in a threaded manner, a bolt head is welded at one end of the screw rod, a clamping plate is rotatably connected to the other end of the screw rod, a sliding block is welded at the lower end of the clamping plate, a sliding rail is slidably connected to the bottom of the sliding block, a lower clamping block is welded at the lower part of the front surface of the clamping plate, an upper clamping block is welded at the upper part of the front surface of the clamping plate, and a motor is fixedly connected to one side of the front part of the upper surface of the bottom plate.

title_en: High-efficient waxing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an efficient waxing device which comprises a shell and a grinding disc, wherein a handle is fixedly arranged outside the shell, a power line is connected to the top of the outside of the shell, a filtering structure is arranged at the top of the shell, a motor is fixedly arranged inside the shell, the bottom end of an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the grinding disc, fan blades are connected to the top end of the output shaft of the motor, a containing structure is arranged between the outside and the bottom of the shell, the filtering structure comprises a cover cap, a first separation net, a convex cover, a second separation net, a step and a filter net, the second separation net is connected to the top of the inner side of the shell, and the convex cover is fixedly arranged at the top of the shell and is positioned outside the second separation net. The efficient waxing device has the filtering function, avoids the influence on the service life caused by the fact that external dust enters the shell during heat dissipation, can conveniently accommodate the power line, and is more convenient to carry.

title_en: Tower-shaped open air filter element and air dust removal device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air dust removal, and discloses a tower-shaped open type air filter element and an air dust removal device, which comprise a mounting frame and a plurality of annular flow deflectors which are parallel to each other and arranged at intervals, wherein hollow parts in the flow deflectors axially form a dust removal channel, a flow guide channel is formed between every two flow deflectors, one end of the dust removal channel is connected with an air inlet, the other end of the dust removal channel is connected with a dust removal opening, the radial cross-sectional area of each flow deflector is gradually increased along the direction close to the air inlet, air enters the dust removal channel from the air inlet so that impurities are discharged back to the atmosphere from the dust removal opening under the action of airflow, and clean air is discharged along the flow guide channel. The utility model has the characteristics of convenient assembly and disassembly, good dust removal effect and high dust removal efficiency.

title_en: Sun-proof car cover for automobile
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of car covers, and solves the technical problems that when the car cover is folded in summer, the temperature in a car is too high, a sun-proof car cover is easily damaged by wind, and the car cover is inconvenient to wear and store in the prior art. The automobile sun-proof car cover has the advantages of good sun-proof and heat-insulating effects in summer parking, strong wind-proof effects and convenience in wearing and storing the car cover.

title_en: Smart city is with intelligent shopping cart
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent shopping cart for a smart city, which comprises a shopping cart, wherein a barrel rod is rotationally connected in the shopping cart, and a convenient bag is sleeved on the barrel rod. The outer side of the shopping cart is connected with a fastener for fixing a cylinder rod; the fastener includes the slider, the spout has all been seted up to the both sides of shopping cart near the position of through-hole, spout and through-hole intercommunication, the socket has all been seted up to the tip of section of thick bamboo pole, the slider slides in the spout and inserts in the socket, the length of slider is longer than the socket, the both ends and the through-hole threaded connection of section of thick bamboo pole, it is connected with the pivot to rotate on the section of thick bamboo pole, the convenient bag cup joints in the pivot. According to the intelligent shopping cart for the smart city, the convenience bag is fixed on the shopping cart by people, the purchased articles are placed in the shopping cart, and then the articles slide into the convenience bag along with the inclined plane, so that the articles are convenient for people to store, and the space on the cash desk can be reasonably utilized.

title_en: Foldable child's carriage seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a baby carriage seat capable of being interlocked and folded, which is detachably connected to a frame, and comprises: the seat plate is provided with a length direction and a width direction, wherein lugs are arranged on two sides in the width direction; the backrest is rotationally matched with the lug and has an unfolding state and a folding state relative to the seat board; the adapter is used for mounting the baby carriage seat on the frame, the adapter is rotatably connected with the lug, the seat plate and the backrest can rotate relative to the adapter around a first rotation axis in a backrest folding state, and a first locking mechanism for limiting the relative rotation of the adapter and the lug is arranged between the adapter and the lug; the armrest is rotatably mounted on the lug around a second rotation axis, a second locking mechanism for limiting the relative rotation of the armrest and the lug is arranged between the armrest and the lug, and the second locking mechanism is unlocked when the seat plate and the backrest rotate relative to the adapter. The backrest and the armrests can be folded by one hand to close the seat board, the folding of the seat is completed, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: Rain shielding device convenient to store for electric bicycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rain shielding device convenient to store for an electric bicycle, and particularly relates to the field of electric bicycles. According to the utility model, the accommodating and rain shielding assembly is arranged, so that the electric bicycle main body is provided with a rain shielding tool, and the electric bicycle is mainly used for shielding rain, and the inside of the electric bicycle is provided with the main support rods in a penetrating manner through the hollow cloth ring, and the three branch support rods are hinged, so that the whole PVC waterproof cloth can be bent along the joint of the branch support rods, and the folding effect is realized.

title_en: Self-locking side top decorative plate for rail transit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rail transit self-locking side top decorative plate, which belongs to the field of rail transit decorative plates and comprises a positioning plate, wherein the top and the bottom of the positioning plate are fixedly connected with support rods which are arranged at equal intervals, clamping strips are respectively and fixedly connected between the opposite ends of the support rods, sliding grooves are respectively formed in the opposite sides of the clamping strips, and a plurality of arc-shaped plates are slidably connected between the two sliding grooves. The utility model discloses a through passing through bolt fixed mounting with the locating plate inside the carriage, then peg graft the arc to two card strips between the spout inside, make it slide along the spout is inside, assemble, convenient operation is swift, the installation of being convenient for to when two fixture blocks are pegged graft to the inside of draw-in groove, fixture block extrusion joint piece makes it promote kelly vertical motion and compression spring, thereby realized the device loading and unloading of being convenient for, and directly carry out local replacement after damaging, practice thrift cost of maintenance's advantage.

title_en: Turnover pedal device and engineering machinery
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of engineering machinery, and particularly provides a turnover pedal device and engineering machinery. Wherein upset footboard device includes: support, footboard, fixed establishment and stop gear. The pedal is rotatably arranged on the support; the fixing mechanism is arranged on the support and used for fixing the pedal rotating to the first inclination angle; the limiting mechanism is used for limiting the rotation range of the pedal to rotate from the first inclination angle to the second inclination angle. When the pedal needs to be retracted, the pedal is rotated to a first inclination angle and is fixed by using a fixing mechanism; when the pedal needs to be used, the fixing mechanism is operated to enable the fixing mechanism to no longer fix the pedal, the pedal is rotated to a second inclination angle, the limiting mechanism prevents the pedal from no longer rotating, and the working personnel can tread the pedal at the moment.

title_en: Manual locking structure for leg support overturning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manual leg support overturning locking structure which comprises a hinge seat and a leg support, wherein the leg support is also connected with a leg support rotating shaft, two ends of the leg support rotating shaft are respectively and rotatably installed on the corresponding hinge seats, a clamping part is assembled on the hinge seat in a sliding manner, a clamping jaw is arranged on the clamping part, a high-position clamping area and a low-position clamping area are arranged on the leg support rotating shaft, the high-position clamping area and the low-position clamping area are communicated through a plurality of transfer grooves, two adjacent transfer grooves are separated through a limiting platform, the clamping jaw is adjusted to be aligned with or staggered with the transfer grooves when the clamping part slides, and the clamping jaw is switched and transferred between the high-position clamping area and the low-position clamping area through the transfer grooves. By adopting the manual leg support overturning locking structure, the clamping jaws can move to the high-position clamping area or the low-position clamping area through the corresponding transfer grooves, so that the rotation angle of the leg support can be adjusted, and the overturning and locking of the leg support can be effectively adjusted by utilizing the corresponding relation between the clamping jaws and the transfer grooves.

title_en: Water area rescue equipment vehicle with living area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to emergency rescue equipment, and provides a water area rescue equipment vehicle with a living area, which comprises a mobile platform, an equipment box body and a living area box body (11), wherein the living area box body (11) is divided into a rest area and a sanitary area by a partition plate (12), the rest area is provided with a rest bed, an air conditioner (4) and a domestic water device, the air conditioner (4) is arranged at the top of the rest area, the sanitary area is provided with washing equipment and sanitary equipment, and the domestic water device can supply water to the washing equipment and the sanitary equipment for use. The water area rescue equipment vehicle with the living area can provide a safe and comfortable rest place for rescuers after exercise and rescue, and guarantees the basic living conditions of the rescuers.

title_en: Front swinging mechanism for motor tricycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a front-mounted swing mechanism for a motor tricycle, which is fixedly connected with a front wheel shaft, so that a front wheel moves up and down along with the swing mechanism, and the swing of the motor tricycle is realized; the front swing mechanism includes: the front wheel shaft connecting part comprises an upper swing arm, a lower swing arm, a rocker arm, a longitudinally arranged shock absorber and a bracket; the support is fixed on the head tube, an upper support arm and a lower support arm on the front wheel shaft, an upper swing arm and a lower swing arm form a parallelogram structure, and the rocker arm, the two shock absorbers and the lower swing arm also form a parallelogram structure; the double-parallelogram mechanism can effectively enhance the safety and the practicability of the motor tricycle; and the swing mechanism is provided with two shock absorbers which are parallel to each other and are longitudinally arranged, so that the shock absorbers adopt a cantilever connection mode, and the lightweight design of the automobile body is facilitated.

title_en: Aircraft part assembly quality
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aircraft component assembling device, which belongs to the field of assembling devices and comprises a bearing frame, wherein a motor A is installed on the outer side wall of the bearing frame, a threaded rod is installed at the output end of the motor A, a frame is installed on the outer side wall of the bearing frame, a bearing is installed on the right side of the inner side wall of the frame, one end of the threaded rod is located on the inner side wall of the bearing, a threaded sleeve is connected to the outer side wall of the threaded rod in a threaded mode, an L-shaped rod is installed on the outer side wall of the threaded sleeve, and a motor B is installed at the other end of the L-shaped rod. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the electromagnetic valve group, the cylinder support, the clamping jaw cylinder, the control panel and the bearing frame, the components can be fixed to avoid shaking during installation, and through the mutual matching of the motor A, the frame, the bearing, the threaded rod, the L-shaped rod, the electric telescopic rod, the motor B, the connector, the rotating head and the conveying belt, the practicability of the device can be increased, so that the device is suitable for being widely popularized and used.

title_en: Rotation sensing device for vehicle
abstract_en: A rotary induction device for a vehicle may include: an upper housing formed of a synthetic resin material and through which the piston rod is disposed; a lower housing formed of a synthetic resin material, disposed below the upper housing, and through which the piston rod is disposed; a center plate formed of a synthetic resin material, disposed between the upper case and the lower case such that the piston rod passes through the center plate, and configured to cause rotation of any one of the upper case and the lower case; and a position guide formed on any one or more of the upper case and the lower case and configured to guide a position of the center plate. The rotation sensing device can prevent the position of the center plate from being changed due to the load.

title_en: Automobile instrument device and automobile
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automobile instrument device and an automobile, and the automobile instrument device comprises a first display screen, a second display screen and a polarizing plate, wherein the polarizing plate is obliquely arranged, the first display screen is positioned behind the polarizing plate, the second display screen is positioned above the polarizing plate, a mirror image of a second image displayed by the second display screen, which is relative to a second side surface of the polarizing plate, is positioned behind the polarizing plate, and the mirror image and a first image displayed by the first display screen are spaced in the front-back direction so as to form a 3D effect in a combined mode. The light rays emitted by the first display screen and the second display screen are linearly polarized light, and due to the arrangement of the polarizing plate, most or all of the light rays refracted into the polarizing plate can be filtered by the polarizing plate after the second light rays of the second display screen are irradiated on the second side face of the polarizing plate, so that the second light rays reflected by the first side face of the polarizing plate are reduced, and the ghost phenomenon is reduced or avoided.

title_en: Portable life-saving throwing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, and particularly discloses a portable life-saving throwing device which comprises a throwing device, wherein an annular groove is formed in the middle section of the outer wall of the throwing device, two fixing rings rotatably connected with the annular groove are arranged outside the throwing device, convex grooves are formed in the centers of the left side and the right side of the two fixing rings, rotating plates are rotatably connected inside the two convex grooves, rotating blocks are rotatably connected to the centers of the two rotating plates, which are far away from one side, through connecting blocks, the back surfaces of the two rotating blocks are respectively connected with an outer cylinder and a supporting rod, the outer cylinder and the supporting rod are used for supporting the throwing device, the rotating plates are designed, and the connecting blocks and the rotating blocks are matched for use, so that the outer cylinder and the supporting rod can rotate in multiple angles, the throwing device can be conveniently supported in multiple angles, and the throwing device can be conveniently used.

title_en: Intelligent automatic retractable wagon tarpaulin assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent and automatic folding and unfolding truck tarpaulin assembly which comprises a connecting piece and a tarpaulin main body, wherein the connecting piece comprises a sliding seat and sliding blocks fixed at two ends of the sliding seat, cross rods and idler wheels are arranged in the two sliding blocks, a connecting block is arranged between the two cross rods and connected with the sliding seat, the sliding seat is arranged between a first support and a second support, circular rings for fixing the tarpaulin main body are arranged on the second support and at the bottom ends of the two sliding blocks, the first support is connected with the two cross rods, the end parts, far away from the first support, of the two cross rods are connected with the second support, fixed with a forward and reverse motor, a bearing seat is fixed in the first support, an output shaft of the forward and reverse motor is connected with the screw rods through a coupler, and one end, far away from the forward and reverse motor, of the screw rod penetrates through the connecting block and is connected with an inner ring of the bearing seat. This automatic freight train tarpaulin subassembly that receive and releases of intelligence, the convenience is received and released, has prolonged life.

title_en: Simple and reliable one-to-two structure of brake cable
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simple and reliable one-to-two structure of a brake cable, which relates to the technical field of braking and comprises a main brake cable connected with one end of a handlebar, wherein a sleeve is sleeved on the main brake cable in a sliding manner, the bottom end of the main brake cable penetrates through the top end of the sleeve and extends into the sleeve, the bottom end of the main brake cable is indirectly connected with two sub brake cables corresponding to each other in position, the two sub brake cables are both positioned in the sleeve, the bottom ends of the two sub brake cables extend out of the sleeve and are respectively used for connecting an external brake disc, and a limiter used for restraining the sub brake cables is arranged in the sleeve. The utility model has reasonable structure, frees the space of the handlebar on the other side in installation, can be reserved for development in other directions and reduces the cost investment, the elastic key has the function of assisting in adjusting the height difference of the limiter so as to meet the initial installation requirement, and also has the function of quickly resetting the brake cable so as to reduce the manual operation.

title_en: Rubber caster
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of casters, and discloses a rubber caster which comprises a connecting piece, wherein a shaft rod is movably connected inside the connecting piece, a clamping rod is fixedly connected to the inner top of the connecting piece, the clamping rod is movably connected with the shaft rod, two hubs are fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the shaft rod, rubber rims are fixedly sleeved on the outer side walls of the two hubs, the bottom of the clamping rod is movably connected with a bottom block, two inner hexagonal flat round head screws are fixedly and movably connected between the clamping rod and the bottom block, the shaft rod is clamped at the position between the clamping rod and the bottom block, and two ends of the shaft rod are respectively and mutually clamped with two opposite outer side walls of the connecting piece. This rubber truckle possesses the dismantled and assembled components of each part advantage such as change, has solved the problem that the integral design change cost of current rubber truckle expends height.

title_en: Eight-direction electric automobile seat framework
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an eight-direction electric automobile seat framework.A seat frame framework structure is connected with an electric backrest framework structure in a way of being capable of rotating and adjusting back and forth, the seat frame framework structure is arranged on an electric sliding rail structure in a way of being capable of being adjusted electrically and up and down, and the electric sliding rail structure can drive the seat frame framework structure to adjust back and forth; the half basin in the seat frame framework structure can be adjusted in an up-and-down rotating mode, and the seat frame framework structure comprises a half basin, a half basin support rod, a motor three bracket, a motor three, a front connecting rod, a rear connecting rod, a seat cushion side plate, a half basin connecting assembly and a seat cushion net frame assembly; the two ends of the rear part of the half basin are respectively hinged with the two cushion side plates through the half basin connecting assembly, the motor III is connected with the cushion side plates, the half basin supporting rods are hinged with the cushion side plates on the two sides, the half basin is connected with the half basin supporting rods through the plastic cushion blocks, and the motor III drives the half basin supporting rods to rotate so as to drive the half basin to rotate. Half basin can rotate the regulation, and then lifts up passenger's foot or puts down, has increased riding comfort.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted wireless charging device, vehicle door and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an on-vehicle wireless charging device, door and vehicle belongs to vehicle technical field. The vehicle-mounted wireless charging device is arranged on an interior trim panel of the vehicle door; the wireless charging device includes: the wireless panel that charges, the wireless panel that charges inlay in the interior plaque of door. The wireless charging device is arranged on the interior trim panel of the vehicle door, so that the use space of a driver is not occupied, and the operation of the driver is facilitated. The vehicle-mounted wireless charging device can provide wireless charging for equipment to be charged in a vehicle, provides convenience for vehicle passengers, and improves vehicle configuration.

title_en: Valve pipeline arranged in oil tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a valve pipeline arranged in an oil tank, which comprises a first ROV valve, wherein one side of the top of the first ROV valve is connected with a first nylon pipe, one end of the first nylon pipe is connected with an FLVV valve, one side of the top of the FLVV valve is connected with a first corrugated pipe, one end of the first corrugated pipe is connected with a four-way joint, one end of the four-way joint is connected with a second corrugated pipe, and one end of the second corrugated pipe is connected with a steam joint. The device is installed inside the oil tank, and then the first ROV valve, the FLVV valve, the first pipe clamp, the second nylon pipe and the second ROV valve are clamped inside the oil tank for fixing, so that the pipeline seals the inside of the oil tank, and oil is prevented from being diffused into air to cause pollution.

title_en: Amphibious swimming teaching robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an amphibious swimming teaching robot, the loach carrying platform comprises a supporting fram, the welding of one side of support frame outer wall has the connecting rod, the connecting rod top is provided with the atmospheric pressure groove, atmospheric pressure inslot wall is provided with the lifter, the welding of lifter top has main solid fixed ring, the constant head tank has been seted up to main solid fixed ring outer wall, main solid fixed ring top is provided with assists solid fixed ring, it is provided with the block board to assist solid fixed ring bottom, the support frame top is provided with floats the board. The utility model discloses a support frame will float the board and install at the top of support frame, fixes swimming teaching robot at the bank, then lies prone at the top of floating the board, then laminates thigh and main solid fixed ring, and main solid fixed ring is fixed the thigh, then swings thigh and both hands, and the thigh promotes the lifter and goes up and down in the atmospheric pressure inslot to teaching the swimming appearance in the swimming teaching, can prevent swimming teaching robot slope through the support frame simultaneously.

title_en: High-strength transportation protective net for tobacco leaf transferring
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-strength transportation protective net for tobacco leaf calling, which comprises a carriage, a flexible steel wire rope net and a moving frame, wherein the upper end and the lower end of the inner wall of two sides of the carriage are fixedly connected with fixed blocks, the moving frame is in contact with the fixed blocks and is movably connected with the fixed blocks, a T-shaped moving groove is formed in one surface, away from the inner wall of the carriage, of each fixed block, a T-shaped moving block is arranged at the contact part of the moving frame and the T-shaped moving groove, each T-shaped moving block is matched with the T-shaped moving groove and is in sliding connection with the T-shaped moving groove, the flexible steel wire rope net is arranged inside the moving frame, mounting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the flexible steel wire rope net, and the mounting plates are fixedly connected with the frame of the moving frame through an upper first bolt and a lower bolt. According to the utility model, the flexible steel wire rope net with certain strength can be arranged on the movable frame through the first bolt and the mounting plate, so that tobacco leaves in the carriage are protected.

title_en: High-lithium iron electric self-propelled vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobiles and railway vehicles, in particular to a high-lithium iron electric self-propelled vehicle.A stone spreading mechanism is arranged at the front end of a vehicle bottom plate; the stone spreading mechanism comprises a front blocking plate, a front supporting plate, a first air cylinder, a first air push rod, a connecting block, a second air cylinder and a second air push rod, the arc-shaped spreading plate and the spreading harrow are welded at the front end of the car bottom plate, the front blocking plate is welded at the side part of the front blocking plate, the front supporting plate is welded at the side part of the front blocking plate, and the bottom of the front supporting plate is fixedly connected to the base of the first air cylinder through a connecting piece; a first air push rod is arranged in the first air cylinder in a sliding manner, the pushing end of the first air push rod is connected with a connecting rod through a fixing piece, and the other end of the connecting rod is connected with a connecting block; the both sides wall of connecting block is fixed in the base of second cylinder respectively through the mounting, and slides in the second cylinder and is provided with second gas push rod, and second gas push rod propelling end links to each other through the connecting piece has the arc stand board and sets up in the stand harrow of arc stand board lower extreme to this inconvenient problem of bringing when patrolling and monitoring road conditions of solving current high-lithium iron electricity self-traveling.

title_en: Plaque buckle spare, car door and car in door
abstract_en: The application provides plaque buckle spare, car door and car in door. Plaque buckle spare includes block portion and assembly portion in the door, and block portion includes main part and card foot, and the main part has the block space, and the block space is used for holding the door panel beating, and the card foot has first end and the second end that carries on the back mutually, and first end is connected in the main part, and the second end suspends in the block space. The assembly portion is connected with the main part, and the assembly portion is used for assembling in plaque in the door, so after plaque buckle spare locates the block space with the door panel beating in the door, the second end of card foot can carry out the butt to the door panel beating for the door panel beating can the chucking in the block space, then plaque buckle spare is difficult to take place relative rotation with the door panel beating in the door, thereby it is difficult to rock, produce abnormal sound etc. at the car in-process in the plaque in helping the door, be favorable to improving and take experience.

title_en: Wheel hub of vacuum spoke wheel for electric vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hub of a vacuum spoked wheel for an electric vehicle, which comprises a rim, spokes and a fixing ring, wherein the fixing ring is hollow and is used for being installed in a matching manner with a hub motor of the electric vehicle, fixing heads are arranged on two side edges of the rim in a protruding manner, fixing edges are arranged on two side edges of the fixing ring, one ends of the spokes are installed on the fixing edges, and the other ends of the spokes are installed on the fixing heads which are not on the same side as the fixing edges. Above-mentioned wheel hub of vacuum spoke wheel for electric motor car has designed new-type wheel hub to current electric motor car wheel structure, and the suitability is high, is convenient for install the vacuum child, improves vehicle security to arrange through unique spoke, improved the anti-seismic performance of electric motor car, guarantee the stationarity, whole light has opened up new research and development thinking for the electric motor car trade.

title_en: Afforestation is conveyer for discarded object processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transportation devices, in particular to a transportation device for treating landscaping waste, which comprises a transportation box, wherein four corners of the bottom of the transportation box are respectively provided with a traveling wheel, the top of the right side of the transportation box is symmetrically provided with a pushing handle in front and back, the left side of the transportation box is provided with a garbage feeding hopper above the center, the front side of the transportation box is provided with a box door, and the bottom of the transportation box is provided with a water drain valve. The efficiency of the treatment is improved.

title_en: Electrochromic anti-dazzling rearview mirror assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electrochromic anti-glare rearview mirror assembly, which comprises a mirror shell, an electrochromic mirror element and a concave shell, wherein the mirror shell is provided with a concave surface; the mirror shell comprises an opening surrounded by a side wall, and a plurality of first clamping bulges are arranged on the inner surface of the side wall at intervals; the electrochromic lens element is accommodated at the opening of the lens housing, the front side of the electrochromic lens element faces the observer, and the back side of the electrochromic lens element faces away from the observer; the concave shell comprises a transparent outer cover and an opaque connecting piece, the transparent outer cover is attached to the front face of the electrochromic lens element, one end of the opaque connecting piece extends to the peripheral area of the front face of the electrochromic lens element, the other end of the opaque connecting piece extends towards the back face of the electrochromic lens element along the edge surface of the electrochromic lens element, and a plurality of raised first bayonets are arranged at intervals on the end face; the first bayonet is arranged corresponding to the first clamping protrusion, and the first clamping protrusion is clamped at the first bayonet. The rearview mirror assembly has the advantages of attractive appearance, wide visual field, safety, collision prevention, low possibility of being broken and the like.

title_en: Reservoir water level monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reservoir water level monitoring device which comprises a floating block, a line roller positioned at the top of the floating block and a movable plate positioned above the top of the line roller, wherein the floating block comprises a through hole arranged in the middle of the inside of the floating block, the top of the floating block is provided with a working bin, one end of one side of the bottom of the working bin is provided with a motor, and the output end of the motor is connected with a rotating shaft penetrating into the line roller.
