The monitoring device can float on the water surface through the floating groove in the floating block, the rotating roller and the working bin can rotate through the rotating rod, the nylon rope can be driven to rotate by the nylon rope due to the gravity applied to the nylon rope through the balancing weight, the rotating roller is driven to rotate by the nylon rope, the number of rotating circles of the measuring ring is measured through the total number sensor, the release length of the nylon rope is monitored, the water level of a reservoir is monitored, the rotating shaft is driven to rotate by the motor, the rotating shaft drives the thread roller to rotate, and the nylon rope is convenient to store.

title_en: Automobile tyre chain convenient to assemble and disassemble
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the tyre chain, especially, be a car tyre chain convenient to loading and unloading, including the chain net, the upper and lower end of chain net all articulates there is a plurality of articulated piece, the one end that articulated piece leaned on outside is connected with the lantern ring, the upper and lower end all is connected with the connecting block on the middle part of chain net left side, the connecting block below threaded connection has spacing bolt, in the connecting block above the spacing bolt upper end was twisted, chain net right side articulates there is the ring, the lantern ring inside that is located the rightmost side runs through and is provided with the installation pole, the installation pole left end is connected with the connecting rope, the connecting rope left end runs through a plurality of lantern rings of homonymy from right side to left side in proper order, the installation pole right end is connected with the right mounting panel, the outside of connecting rope left end has thread bush one and thread bush two from left side to right side in proper order, thread bush one outside has left mounting panel, be detachable connection between left mounting panel and the right mounting panel; the utility model discloses effectively avoid the chain net to deviate from the tire when the installation, it is all comparatively convenient that the installation with dismantle the tyre chain.

title_en: Trolley with protection mechanism for outer wall construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hopper car for outer wall construction with protection machanism, including the hopper car body, the laminating of hopper car body front side is glued there is the crashproof protection pad, hopper car body left and right sides symmetry fixed mounting has spacing branch, the hopper car body left and right sides corresponds spacing branch and is provided with the arc limiting plate, hopper car body bottom is provided with the guard box, the inside movable mounting of guard box has the connecting plate, connecting plate lower part movable mounting has the telescopic link. The anticollision protection pad guarantees to take place the striking at the hopper car body in the transportation and causes the front side collision to cause the damage to the hopper car body, and the parcel installation of anticollision protection pad can also effectively protect the object by the impact of hopper car body to prevent to cause the damage to the personnel simultaneously, and the arc limiting plate can play spacing supporting role, receives when the striking at the hopper car body, prevents the position change of hopper car body, and the guard box is spacing to connecting plate and telescopic link, guarantees that the operation of hopper car body is stable.

title_en: Fixing structure for automobile seat slide rail decorative cover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing structure of a decorative cover of an automobile seat sliding rail, which comprises a seat sliding rail bracket and a seat sliding rail decorative cover, wherein the seat sliding rail bracket and the seat sliding rail decorative cover are matched and fixedly connected through a plurality of connecting components. The structure of the seat slide rail decorative cover and the seat slide rail bracket is improved, the seat slide rail decorative cover and the seat slide rail bracket are fixedly connected through a plurality of connecting components, the connecting components are simple in structure, the stability of the structure of the connecting components can be guaranteed, the reliability of the installation and the use of the seat slide rail decorative cover is improved, extra metal accessories are not needed for fixing, and the installation and the disassembly of the seat slide rail decorative cover are facilitated; the seat slide rail decorating cover can be suitable for a plurality of slide rail brackets with different shapes, has good universality, can be remounted even if the seat slide rail decorating cover falls off, is not easy to deform, and is fixedly fixed for the second time; meanwhile, the seat slide rail decorative cover can be repeatedly used after being detached, and the manufacturing cost and the maintenance cost are greatly reduced.

title_en: Counter weight type gas cylinder carrying tool
abstract_en: The utility model provides a counterweight type gas cylinder carrying tool, which belongs to the technical field of gas production and comprises: the device comprises a connecting frame, rollers, a supporting frame, a baffle, a handrail, a supporting plate, a first limiting plate, a second limiting plate, a first positioning groove, a second positioning groove, a reinforcing rod, a transport box, a limiting groove and a partition plate; compared with a common two-wheeled cart, the structure is provided with the connecting frame and the transportation box, the large air bottle is placed on the supporting plate, the small air bottle is placed in the transportation box, and the two air bottles are transported simultaneously. Four gyro wheels support the device simultaneously during transportation, through bearing little gas cylinder, the gravity of balance support board and gas cylinder prevents the device upset, guarantees the stability of device to prevent that the gas cylinder from empting, damaging. The four wheels are supported simultaneously, the device is lifted upwards without force application by hands, and labor is saved during use. The connecting frame is supported by the four rollers simultaneously, so that the user can be guaranteed to walk stably only by applying thrust in the carrying process without lifting upwards, and the stress of the arm is reduced.

title_en: Tandem underwater propeller without propeller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of underwater propulsion, in particular to a tandem type underwater paddle-free propeller which comprises a propeller body, a supercharging device, a water inlet assembly and a water outlet assembly. Wherein, the inside cavity that is formed with of fuselage, supercharging device locate the cavity in, the subassembly ring of intaking is located the fuselage outer lane to with the cavity intercommunication, the subassembly ring of going out water is located the fuselage outer lane, and with the cavity intercommunication. Wherein, supercharging device passes through the water inlet assembly with the outside water of fuselage and sucks in the cavity, provides the drive power after going out through the ejection of water subassembly. The water inlet assembly and the water outlet assembly are arranged in the axial direction of the machine body, so that the water inlet assembly and the water outlet assembly are connected to the machine body in a series connection mode, the size of the machine body is reduced, and the machine body is convenient to carry by a user.

title_en: Building data acquisition equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building data acquisition, in particular to building data acquisition equipment which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two sliding grooves are vertically arranged at four corners of the bottom plate in a penetrating manner, two rectangular grooves are vertically arranged at the front end and the rear end of the bottom plate in a penetrating manner, the rectangular groove at the front end is arranged between the two sliding grooves at the front end, the rectangular groove at the rear end is arranged between the two sliding grooves at the rear end, a circular sliding groove is transversely arranged at the front end of the bottom plate in a penetrating manner, and the circular sliding groove is communicated with the two rectangular grooves. According to the utility model, the protection box moves up and down in the sliding groove II formed in the bottom plate, so that the equipment can be well protected when not in use, and the four pulleys can be lifted up by the protection box when in use, so that the building data acquisition equipment can be conveniently fixed, and the condition that the interior of the building data acquisition equipment is damaged due to movement of the building data acquisition equipment in the use process is prevented.

title_en: Angle adjusting device for armrest of aviation seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an angle adjusting device for an aviation seat armrest, which comprises: the handrail support, the armset subassembly and panel subassembly, the armset subassembly includes support arm and first drive division, the one end and the handrail support of support arm are articulated, first drive division has stiff end and expansion end, the stiff end of first drive division is articulated mutually with the handrail support, the expansion end is articulated mutually with the support arm, be used for driving the support arm and rotate around its axis of rotation with the articulated department of handrail support, the panel subassembly includes panel and second drive division, the panel is articulated with the other end of support arm, the second drive division has stiff end and expansion end, the stiff end of second drive division is articulated mutually with the support arm, the expansion portion is articulated mutually with the panel, a rotation axis for driving the panel rotates around its articulated department with the support arm. The utility model can solve the technical problems that the prior art can only realize the angle adjustment of the armrest relative to the seat and can not realize the further angle adjustment of the armrest upper cover relative to the outer side framework and the inner side framework.

title_en: Temperature measurement screening portrait identification thermal imaging system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a temperature measurement screening human image recognition thermal imager, which relates to the technical field of temperature measurement equipment and comprises a main thermal imager body, wherein an unmanned aerial vehicle mounting plate is mounted at the top of the main thermal imager body through a clamping component, two support plates are mounted on one side of the unmanned aerial vehicle mounting plate, a bidirectional screw rod is arranged between the two support plates, clamping plates are mounted at two ends of the bidirectional screw rod in a threaded penetrating manner, and a knob is mounted at one end of the bidirectional screw rod; according to the clamping assembly, the knob is firstly rotated to enable the bidirectional screw to rotate, the clamping plate is driven to move to take out the clamping plate from the clamping groove, then the bolt is unscrewed and stirred, the bolt drives the sliding plate to slide on the sliding rod, the spring contracts to be in contact with the limiting column, and the fixing rod is taken out from the fixing groove.

title_en: Automobile wire harness
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wire harnesses, in particular to an automobile wire harness, which comprises an automobile wire harness main body, wherein one end of the automobile wire harness main body is fixedly connected with a first wire harness port, the other end of the automobile wire harness main body is fixedly connected with a second wire harness port, port jacks are respectively formed in one ends of the first wire harness port and the second wire harness port, port plugs are respectively fixedly connected inside the port jacks, a plurality of port plugs are respectively arranged, a wire harness receiving and releasing pipe is arranged in the middle of the automobile wire harness main body, control handles are respectively arranged at two ends of the wire harness receiving and releasing pipe, the control handles are distributed in a mirror image mode, a clamping block is fixedly connected to one side of each control handle, a wire harness through hole is formed in each clamping block, and the automobile wire harness main body is embedded in the wire harness through hole. The device can carry out the length of pencil and deposit through being equipped with pencil receipts and release pipe, can conveniently carry out tailorring when maintaining, avoids the pencil short to cause the waste.

title_en: Multifunctional folding bed chair
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional folding bed chair, and belongs to the technical field of household articles. It has solved the problem that current cloth deck chair and cloth bed do not possess the wholeness. This multi-functional foldable bed chair includes cloth part and is used for supporting a plurality of member bars that are "U" font of cloth part, is respectively: the bed chair comprises a main rod piece, a shape rod piece, a front inclined rod piece, a rear inclined rod piece, a leaning rod piece, a fixing rod piece and a pushing rod piece, wherein after the bed chair is assembled by the plurality of rod pieces, the symmetrical surfaces of the rod pieces are overlapped, the U-shaped opening direction end part of the main rod piece is connected with the U-shaped opening direction end of the shape rod piece through an adjusting fastener, and the U-shaped opening direction end of the leaning rod piece is rotatably connected to the main rod piece. Compared with the prior art, the folding bed chair can be freely changed into four shapes of storage, a deck chair, a trolley and a lying bed, and has multiple functions and excellent storage performance.

title_en: Intelligent trolley suspension device stable in operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a suspension device for an intelligent trolley, which runs stably, relates to the technical field of suspension devices and comprises a mounting plate and a fastening assembly; mounting a plate: a fixing frame is fixed on the lower side surface, and two corresponding connecting components are installed on the left side and the right side of the mounting plate; a fastening component: the connecting frame comprises a motor, two moving plates, clamping columns and two-way screws, wherein the motor is installed on the right side surface of the fixed frame, the two corresponding moving plates are connected to the inside of the fixed frame in a sliding mode, the two corresponding clamping columns are fixed to the side surfaces of the moving plates, threaded holes are formed in the side surfaces of the moving plates, the two-way screws are connected to the inner threads of the two threaded holes in a threaded mode and are formed by welding two threaded rods with opposite threads, and the connecting frame is fixed through a fastening assembly; wherein: the input end of the motor is electrically connected with the output end of the external control switch group, so that the occurrence of fracture can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Novel foldable scooter for children
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel foldable child scooter, and relates to the field of child scooters. Scooter main part, the inner wall of scooter main part runs through there is first rotation axis, the both ends outer wall nestification of first rotation axis has two sets of first gyro wheels, the outer wall fixedly connected with backup pad of scooter main part, the outer wall of backup pad has connect first rotary rod soon, the bottom of first rotary rod has connect the second rotary rod soon, through being provided with the fly leaf, when baby does not play, makes the handle to the laminating of scooter main part, under the joint action of connecing piece, sleeve and lifter soon, makes the fly leaf drive two sets of second rotary rods and two sets of second movable rod motion to make the second rotary rod drive first rotary rod rotatory along the outer wall of backup pad rotatory, second movable rod and second rotary rod drive first movable rod rotatory along the outer wall of backup pad simultaneously, so that fly leaf and scooter main part laminating have realized children's scooter purpose.

title_en: Hand-held multifunctional boat tractor
abstract_en: A walking multifunctional boat tractor, wheels are arranged below a pontoon and a buoyancy tank, a detachable bucket is arranged above the pontoon, the detachable bucket is hinged with the pontoon, an engine and a transmission system are arranged on the pontoon, and the engine and the transmission system are connected with the wheels below the pontoon; a front seat is arranged on the detachable cargo bucket, and a steering system is connected with wheels below the floating pontoon; the telescopic steering control system is arranged on the handrail on the floating pontoon and is connected with the steering system; the front and the rear of the pontoon are provided with double-share adjustable hanging racks; the buoyancy tank is connected with the pontoon, a rear seat is arranged on the buoyancy tank, a drain hole is arranged below the rear end of the buoyancy tank, a foot-operated resistance plate is arranged at the front end of the buoyancy tank, and the foot-operated resistance plate is hinged with the buoyancy tank. The utility model has the advantages that: the multifunctional device has the advantages that farmers can meet multifunctional requirements only by one device, and the multifunctional device is reasonable in structure, firm, durable, easy to maintain, easy to operate, efficient, flexible and perfectly multifunctional.

title_en: Waste material conveying device for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste material transportation device for coal mines, which comprises a base, wherein a fixing mechanism is arranged in an inner cavity of the base, vertical plates are fixedly connected to the bottom of the base close to four corners, and rollers are arranged on one sides of the vertical plates close to the center of the bottom of the base, through arranging an adjusting mechanism, through mutual matching of parts of a rotary disc, a fixing rod, a rectangular frame, a limiting plate, a pushing rod, a servo motor and a supporting plate, the collection tank is conveniently driven to tilt and pour materials, the operation is convenient and fast, through arranging the fixing mechanism, through mutual matching of parts of a clamping gear, a connecting rod, a movable gear, a moving rod, a transmission rod, a second spring, a T-shaped rod, a rotating handle, a connecting sheet, a driving conical gear and a driven conical gear, the device is convenient to move and the rollers can be fixed when needed, thereby avoiding the occurrence of the slipping phenomenon.

title_en: Filter group
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a filter group, passable by a fluid during filtration, comprising a filtering area extending between an inlet zone through which the fluid to be filtered flows and an outlet zone through which the filtered fluid flows, along a longitudinal axis, along a transverse axis and in height along a vertical axis; further comprising: -a filter plate extending relative to an imaginary plane on which both the longitudinal axis and the lateral axis lie, wherein the filter plate is passable by a fluid in a direction substantially orthogonal to the imaginary plane, substantially parallel to the vertical axis, during filtration; -a baffle which is fluid impermeable; -an inlet chamber defined between the filter plate and the baffle, which is open in a region adjacent to the inlet zone and closed in a region adjacent to the outlet zone; wherein the filter panel comprises side edges and the baffle comprises side baffle surfaces adapted to extend between the inlet zone and the outlet zone; wherein the side dam surfaces sealingly engage the filter plate.

title_en: Oil drain plug assembly, rear axle assembly and automobile
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oil drain plug assembly, a rear axle assembly and an automobile, and relates to the technical field of automobiles. The oil drain plug subassembly includes: the oil drain plug, the joint and the capacitance sensor; the oil drain plug is inserted into an oil drain hole on the rear axle housing body to plug the oil drain hole; the joint is fixedly arranged on the free end of the oil drain plug and is electrically connected with the controller; the capacitance sensor comprises two metal tubes which are arranged side by side and at intervals, the connecting end of each metal tube is arranged at the connecting end of the oil drain plug, each metal tube is electrically connected with the joint and is in insulation fit with the oil drain plug, and the axis of each metal tube is parallel to the axis of the oil drain plug; the free end of the metal tube is adapted to extend into the rear axle housing and contact the gear oil within the rear axle housing. The rear axle assembly includes: the rear axle housing body and the oil drain plug component; the oil drain plug of the oil drain plug assembly is tightly inserted into the oil drain hole of the rear axle shell. The automobile includes: the rear axle assembly and the controller are electrically connected, so that the real life of the gear oil can be detected.

title_en: Air purification air conditioner and car
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of vehicle air conditioners, and discloses an air purification air conditioner and a vehicle. The shell comprises an air inlet end and an air outlet end along the air flowing direction; the air conditioning assembly comprises a blower, an evaporator, a first heater and a second heater; the air inlet end comprises the front side of the air blower or the front side of the evaporator, and the air outlet end comprises the rear side of the evaporator or the rear side of the first heater or the rear side of the second heater. According to the air purification air conditioner, the air inlet filtering component arranged on the front side of the air blower or the front side of the evaporator filters and purifies external environment pollutants, the air outlet filtering component arranged on the rear side of the evaporator or the rear side of the first heater or the rear side of the second heater filters and purifies pollutants in the air conditioning system, the purification effect is good, and the quality of purified air is high. The automobile comprises the air purification air conditioner, the air quality of the whole automobile is improved, and the customer experience is improved.

title_en: Charging device for electric bicycle
abstract_en: A charging device for an electric bicycle comprises a frame body, a charging pile and a plurality of sockets, wherein the frame body comprises a transverse wiring rod, a vertical wiring rod and a plurality of support legs, the support legs are respectively arranged on two sides of the transverse wiring rod, the transverse wiring rod and the vertical wiring rod are hollow, the plurality of sockets are arranged in a line along the length direction of the transverse wiring rod, the sockets are in sliding connection with the transverse wiring rod, the charging pile comprises a shell, a strong current main control board, a first strong current cable and a plurality of second strong current cables, the shell is fixedly arranged on the transverse wiring rod, the strong current main control board is arranged in the shell, the first strong current cable is inserted into the vertical wiring rod, the main control strong current board is connected with a power supply through the first strong current cable, the second strong current cables are inserted into the transverse wiring rod, each strong current socket is connected with the main control board through the second strong current cable, the sockets are in a sliding design, and a user can automatically pull the sockets to the sides of the electric bicycle for charging, the socket is not influenced by the placing position of the electric bicycle, and the utilization rate of the socket is high.

title_en: Electromagnetic compatibility system in narrow space
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electromagnetic compatibility system in a narrow space. Wherein, this system includes: the motor controller comprises a first conductive loop formed by the anode of a power supply, a first direct current contactor, a fuse, a motor controller, a second direct current contactor and the cathode of the power supply which are connected in sequence; a DC-DC converter is connected in series between the positive pole of the power supply and the negative pole of the power supply; a first filter and a second filter are connected in series between a power supply and the DC-DC converter in sequence. Two filters are connected in series at the input end of the DC-DC converter, two first capacitors are connected in parallel, and two magnetic rings are connected in series at the output end of the DC-DC converter, so that filtering and high-frequency noise suppression can be performed; all control lines and CAN lines are set as twisted-pair shielded lines, connecting lines of a power supply are set as five-way parallel twisted-pair lines, and connecting lines of a motor controller are set as four-way parallel twisted-pair lines, so that attenuation and noise CAN be effectively reduced, cleaner electronic signals CAN be provided, and interference CAN be further prevented.

title_en: Fixing device and car of transmission shaft
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixing device of a transmission shaft and an automobile, wherein the fixing device of the transmission shaft comprises: a tool body; at least one supporting arm is fixedly connected to the tool body; still fixedly connected with locating plate on the frock body. The scheme of the utility model can simplify the structure and operation, save manpower, reduce the cost and improve the efficiency.

title_en: Torque sensor in automobile electric power steering system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile electric power steering systems, and discloses a torque sensor in an automobile electric power steering system, which comprises a hollow input shaft, a hollow output shaft, a torsion bar, a multistage magnetic ring group connected with the input shaft, a magnetic conductive toothed ring connected with the output shaft, two magnetizers and an induction chip, wherein the two magnetizers are oppositely arranged on the outer side of the magnetic conductive toothed ring, and the induction chip is arranged between the two magnetizers. The magnetic conductive gear ring is provided with the magnetic conductive body, and the set interval is arranged between the magnetic conductive body and the magnetic conductive gear ring, so that the assembly of each part is simpler, relative friction does not exist, the abrasion between the magnetic conductive body and the magnetic conductive gear ring is avoided, and the service life of the magnetic conductive gear ring is prolonged; the bracket is arranged and can assist the assembly of the two magnetizers, so that the positions of the two magnetizers are kept stable, and the two magnetizers can accurately conduct the change of the magnetic field; the magnetizers of different types are arranged, the assembling method is suitable for assembling the torque sensor in different installation environments, and the applicability is higher.

title_en: Crank gear disc type power assisting device for electric vehicle
abstract_en: A crank gear disc type power assisting device for an electric vehicle comprises a five-way joint, a tooth cup bearing, a tooth disc, a crank, a tooth disc, a connecting plate, a driving device, a flywheel and a transmission device, wherein a middle shaft is transversely arranged in the five-way joint through the tooth cup bearing on two sides, the tooth disc is arranged at the right end of the middle shaft, the crank is integrally arranged on the surface of the right side of the tooth disc, the tooth disc is arranged at the left end of the middle shaft, the crank is also arranged at the left side of the tooth disc, the connecting plate is arranged on the left and right sides of the five-way joint, the driving device is arranged between the rear sides of the connecting plates, an output shaft is arranged at the left end of the driving device, the flywheel is connected with the tooth disc through the transmission device, the driving device is moved from the side beside the tooth disc to the rear side of the connecting plate, the transmission device is placed at the left side, the normal installation and use of the existing bicycle chain are not influenced, the installation cost is saved, and the transmission ratio can be changed through the arrangement of a plurality of the tooth discs and the flywheel, gear shifting device can realize gear shifting through the switching of a bicycle chain shifter, can be easily adapted to the road sections needing larger power, such as uphill roads and the like.

title_en: Integrated stop collar component
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an integrated limiting ring component, and belongs to a brake master cylinder component in the technical field of automobile brake systems. The rubber part of the limiting ring part is injected into the limiting ring framework, the outer wall of the rubber part of the limiting ring part is provided with a limiting ring outer lip edge, and the inner wall of the rubber part of the limiting ring part is provided with a limiting ring inner lip edge. The advantage is novel structure, through the structure of adjustment spacing ring, mould plastics rubber on the skeleton of spacing ring, replace 3 parts of O type sealing washer, vice leather cup, the spacing ring of original structure with an integrative spacing ring part, compare with conventional compensation hole and the master cylinder oral area leakproofness structure of center valve brake, its installation is simple, sealed reliable, be applicable to the master cylinder assembly of compensation hole, center valve, a chamber compensation hole and a chamber center valve, promote the sealed efficiency of product, alleviate product weight, improve whole car braking system security.

title_en: Hanging seat for railway vehicle bogie
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rail vehicle bogie is with hanging seat, including hanging the bedplate, the top fixedly connected with clamping screw of hanging the bedplate, the standing groove has been seted up on the last surface that is close to the middle part of hanging the bedplate, the top of hanging the bedplate is connected with the locking subassembly, the locking subassembly is connected with the gallows, the gallows is located the inside of standing groove, the lower fixed surface of gallows is connected with the lug, the inside of hanging the bedplate is seted up flutedly, the inner wall of recess rotates through the bearing and is connected with the threaded rod, the surperficial threaded connection of threaded rod has the removal frame, the surface that removes the frame is connected with spacing subassembly, the side fixedly connected with steadying plate of removal frame. The utility model discloses an above-mentioned isotructure's cooperation has realized the whole fastness of reinforcing hanging seat, and the maintenance personal of being convenient for carries out the installation of the different specifications of lug, has increased the emergency protection alarming function of hanging seat, has brought the facility for maintenance personal's work.

title_en: Terrain self-adaptive unmanned aerial vehicle undercarriage based on SMA (shape memory alloy) locking and releasing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a topography self-adaptation unmanned aerial vehicle undercarriage based on SMA locking release, this undercarriage have shrink when many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle normal flight and the ability that the landing expanded two kinds of operating condition down conversion. The size of whole undercarriage is adjustable, can supply not unidimensional unmanned aerial vehicle to use. The landing gear is provided with a locking function of the landing gear supporting column during normal flight by the SMA locking and releasing device, the landing gear supporting column is released under the auxiliary action of the cylindrical helical compression spring, the whole unlocking process is high in speed, small in impact and low in power consumption, and the landing gear can be repeatedly used. When falling to the ground, the cylinder helical compression spring in the bracing piece with ground contact earlier provides shock-absorbing function under the extension state, reduces impact and vibrations that receive when unmanned aerial vehicle falls to the ground, until other bracing pieces and ground contact, unmanned aerial vehicle accomplishes the descending task, realizes that unmanned aerial vehicle steadily descends under various topography circumstances, greatly reduces the unnecessary loss.

title_en: Front windshield locating hole structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a front windshield positioning hole structure which comprises a top cover, wherein a top cover flanging is arranged on the top cover, front windshield positioning holes are formed in the left end part and the right end part of the top cover flanging, the top cover flanging comprises a first widening section, a second widening section, a flanging body section, a third widening section and a fourth widening section which are sequentially connected from left to right, the second widening section and the third widening section are widened forwards relative to the flanging body section, the first widening section is widened forwards relative to the second widening section, the fourth widening section is widened forwards relative to the third widening section, the first widening section is used for being in lap joint with a left side periphery, the fourth widening section is used for being in lap joint with a right side periphery, the front windshield positioning hole in the left end part of the top cover flanging is arranged on the second widening section, and the front windshield positioning hole in the right end part of the top cover flanging is arranged on the third widening section. The utility model is beneficial to increasing the angle of the upper sight line by reasonably arranging the position of the front windshield positioning hole and reasonably arranging the structure of the top cover flanging.

title_en: Adjustable outdoor charging pile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable charging pile for outdoor charging, which comprises a base, wherein a protective frame is arranged on the top surface of the base close to the side edge, a charging pile main body is arranged in the middle of the top surface of the base, an extending plate is arranged on one side of the protective frame, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the lower end of the charging pile main body close to the side edge, two groups of clamping grooves are symmetrically arranged on the front side of the base, two groups of rollers are symmetrically arranged on the bottom surface of the charging pile main body, limiting rods are arranged on the outer sides of the rollers, an extending groove is arranged in the middle of one side of the extending plate, clamping blocks are arranged at one end of the extending plate close to four vertex angles, the fixing mechanism comprises a driving motor, and a gear is arranged at one end of the driving motor. The charging pile for the adjustable outdoor charging reduces the difficulty in fixing and adjusting the charging pile, facilitates the detection and maintenance of charging, can shorten the charging distance, and improves the practicability of the charging pile.

title_en: Surfboard with detachable tail fin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a surfboard with a detachable tail fin, which comprises: surfboard base member, antiskid ribbed tile and tail fin, the antiskid ribbed tile sets up at surfboard base member top surface tail section, the vertical setting of tail fin is in surfboard base member bottom surface and is located the below of antiskid ribbed tile, the antiskid ribbed tile bottom sets up the guide pin bushing that downwardly extending to in the surfboard base member, the tail fin top is provided with the carousel with the laminating of surfboard base member bottom surface, be provided with the inserted bar that upwardly extends to in the guide pin bushing on the carousel. The surfboard with the detachable tail fin is particularly provided with the antiskid plate and the tail fin, the antiskid plate and the tail fin are assembled through the matching of the guide sleeve and the inserted rod, the disassembly is convenient, the tail fin can be independently replaced after being damaged, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Grid type front floor assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grid type front floor assembly which comprises a floor body, a cross beam assembly and a longitudinal beam assembly, wherein the cross beam assembly is arranged on the back surface of the floor body; the crossbeam subassembly is formed with the crossbeam installation department for cavity formula structure and crossbeam subassembly tip, the longeron subassembly is cavity formula structure, be provided with the longeron reinforcing plate of perpendicular to longeron subassembly on the floor body, this technical scheme's preceding floor assembly, through arranging of crossbeam subassembly and longeron subassembly, the spatial arrangement of many net has been formed, the crossbeam passes through the crossbeam installation department that the tip set up and is connected with the threshold longeron and seal, whole formation forms confined cavity structures, the longeron passes through the longeron reinforcing plate and is connected with the threshold longeron and seal, overall structure forms the cubical space network skeleton additional strengthening that two violently four indulge, make the rigidity intensity of preceding floor assembly obtain huge promotion, provide safer space of riding for driving and riding for driver and passenger.

title_en: Automobile air filter element with multi-layer filtering function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multilayer-filtering automobile air filter element, which relates to the technical field of air filter elements and comprises a shell body, wherein a filter element body is arranged inside the shell body, a top cover is arranged above the filter element body, the filter element body and the top cover are fixed through a screw rod, two upper buffer mechanisms which are symmetrical are arranged between the filter element body and the top cover, and two symmetrical clamping mechanisms are arranged on the inner wall of the shell body. The filter element body is reasonable in design structure, the side face of the filter element body can be fixed and buffered through the clamping mechanism through the arrangement of the shell body, the filter element body, the top cover, the upper buffering mechanism, the clamping mechanism and the upward pushing mechanism, the hinged plate is rotated to be above the filter element body, the hinged plate can be supported and buffered from the up-down direction through the buffering spring, the filter element body can be well buffered, and the filter element body can be conveniently replaced.

title_en: Cart and hub mechanism for cart
abstract_en: The present application relates to a cart and a hub mechanism for a cart. The cart may include: a stroller frame including a handle member, a front leg member, and a rear leg member; and a hub mechanism, wherein the handle member, the front leg member and the rear leg member are coupled to each other via the hub mechanism. The hub mechanism includes: a handle arm operable to be connected to a lower portion of the handle member; a front leg arm operable to connect to a front leg member; and a rear leg arm operable to connect to the rear leg member; and a linkage operable to coordinate movement of the handle arm, the front leg arm and the rear leg arm; wherein when the upper portion of the handle member is manipulated toward the lower portion of the handle member, the hub mechanism releases the linkage, causing the linkage to: rotating the front leg arm to fold the front leg member toward the rear leg member; rotating the handle arm to fold a lower portion of the handle member toward the rear leg member; wherein the front leg member, the upper portion of the handle member, and the lower portion of the handle member are retainable in a folded configuration relative to the rear leg member.

title_en: Electric battery replacing vehicle for charging and replacing integrated mobile battery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of new energy vehicles. A charging and battery replacing integrated mobile battery electric power replacing vehicle comprises a load-carrying truck and a battery grabbing mechanism; the bidirectional telescopic pallet fork is characterized by further comprising a driving mechanism, wherein the driving mechanism comprises a supporting top frame, a rotating disc mechanism, a horizontal linear sliding mechanism, a bidirectional telescopic pallet fork and four vertically arranged telescopic rods; the top of the telescopic rod is connected with a supporting top frame, a horizontal linear sliding mechanism is installed on the supporting top frame, a sliding table of the horizontal linear sliding mechanism slides left and right, an installation seat of a bidirectional telescopic fork is installed on the sliding table of the horizontal linear sliding mechanism, an installation seat of a rotary disc mechanism is installed on a telescopic arm of the bidirectional telescopic fork, and a battery grabbing mechanism is installed on a rotary disc of the rotary disc mechanism; at least three battery charging bases which are arranged from left to right are also arranged on the vehicle body. The utility model realizes that the vehicle needing to be subjected to battery replacement can be taken down from the vehicle needing to be subjected to battery replacement and transported to the battery replacement vehicle when the vehicle needing to be subjected to battery replacement stops at any side of the battery replacement vehicle.

title_en: High-efficient collection device of construction dregs
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a construction technical field, and a high-efficient collection device of construction dregs is disclosed, including the transport vechicle, the front side upper end fixedly connected with diaphragm of transport vechicle, fixed plug bush has two electric putter around the surface of diaphragm, the same installing frame of two electric putter's lower extreme output shaft fixedly connected with, fixed mounting has belt transmission machine in the installing frame, the shovel board that the inboard fixedly connected with slope of lower extreme of installing frame set up, the feed inlet that is used for the installing frame to stretch into is seted up to the front side of transport vechicle, the inner wall top fixedly connected with actuating mechanism of transport vechicle, symmetry two spinal branch vaulting poles of drive mechanism's lower extreme output front and back symmetry set up about the installing frame, the same scraping wings of lower extreme fixedly connected with of two spinal branch vaulting poles, the inner wall bottom of transport vechicle is hugged closely to the scraping wings. This application can realize carrying out the sediment collection to the high-efficient operation of collecting of sediment, need not the manual work and uses the spade to carry out the sediment and collect, has improved sediment collection efficiency.

title_en: Railway signal protective equipment

title_en: Environment-friendly vehicle air conditioner filter core
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly vehicle air conditioner filter core, including the filter core installing frame, the centre of filter core installing frame is provided with the filter core, the front side upper surface of filter core installing frame is provided with accomodates the draw-in groove, the centre of accomodating the draw-in groove is provided with clean scraper blade, the inside of clean scraper blade is run through for cavity and bottom surface and is provided with the venthole, the both ends upper surface of clean scraper blade all is provided with high-pressurepipe connection port, high-pressurepipe connection port can be connected with high-pressurepipe, the rear of clean scraper blade is provided with the direction backup pad, the top of direction backup pad is provided with the sealing strip. The utility model discloses a can be along the gliding clean scraper blade of filter core surface, and the bottom curve of clean scraper blade is unanimous completely with the surface curve of filter core, and blows off perpendicular decurrent high-pressure draught from the bottom surface of clean scraper blade, and the dust that leaves over in the filter core gap that can be quick cleans, improves abluent effect and the speed of filter core.

title_en: Rearview mirror indicator lamp, rearview mirror and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rear-view mirror pilot lamp, rear-view mirror and vehicle, rear-view mirror pilot lamp include lamp source and light guide, and the lamp source has the luminous mode of two kinds at least different colours, and a terminal surface and the lamp source of light guide are relative. The utility model provides a rearview mirror pilot lamp can send indicator light and autopilot sign light, and then has that fender molding wholeness is good, advantage that whole car economy is good.

title_en: Clamping structure, connecting device, ceiling mounting assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a clamping structure, a connecting device, a ceiling mounting assembly and a vehicle, wherein the clamping structure comprises at least two clamping pieces which are oppositely arranged and used for clamping a structural piece; at least one clamping piece is provided with a convex anti-falling part, and the end part of the anti-falling part is prismatic or pointed; when the clamping piece clamps the structural piece, the end part of the anti-falling part can interfere with the structural piece. The application provides a clamping structure, connecting device, ceiling installation component and vehicle, set up convex anticreep portion on at least one holder, and the tip of anticreep portion sets up to arris form or point form, when holder centre gripping structure, this arris form or point form anticreep portion tip can take place to interfere with the structure, and then make in the tip embedding structure of anticreep portion, in order to realize the firm centre gripping of holder to the structure, reach and prevent to take place the effect of relative slip or even slippage between holder and the structure.

title_en: A turnover carrier for test
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turnover carrier for test technical field, including the loading board, the lower surface four corners department of loading board is equipped with removes the wheel, the upper surface both sides of loading board all are equipped with the grudging post, and two sets of grudging posts are vertical direction distribution, the spout has been seted up at the medial surface middle part of every grudging post of group, sliding connection has the multiunit movable block in the spout, control and install the backup pad between the adjacent movable block, the multiunit standing groove has been seted up in the backup pad, the fluting of intercommunication spout is seted up to the lateral surface of grudging post, and sliding connection has the removal strip in the fluting, the outside of removal strip is connected with positioning mechanism, and the medial surface and the movable block of removal strip are connected, the utility model discloses can adjust the space size according to different model test product, make full use of the space of turnover carrier, and can prevent that the test product from dropping in the turnover process, stability is good.

title_en: Camera support, A post assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera support, A post assembly and vehicle, camera support includes: the mounting part is used for being fixedly connected with the A column decorative plate; the supporting part is arranged on one side of the mounting part and is used for being connected with a camera; the clamping part is arranged on the other side of the mounting part, a clamping groove is formed in the clamping part, and a clamping piece is clamped in the clamping groove and used for being clamped with the A column. The camera support simultaneously integrates the mounting structure of camera and the joint structure of A post, realizes the mounting structure of camera and the structural effect of the joint structure stack load of A post, and the regional structural strength of mounting point is big, rigidity is high to and the stand space product power of realization motorcycle type promotes, arranges more scientific and technological products.

title_en: Portable mobile water supply device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable mobile water supply device, which belongs to the technical field of water supply equipment, wherein a water pump is arranged in the portable mobile water supply device, one end of the water pump is fixedly connected with a filtering mechanism, the other end of the water pump is fixedly connected with a water storage tank, the filtering mechanism is fixedly connected with a water inlet, the water storage tank is fixedly connected with a water outlet, the water inlet and the water outlet are positioned on the side wall of the water supply device and are both provided with a check valve; the water supply device is internally provided with a plurality of universal wheel devices, the universal wheel devices are positioned at four corners of the bottom of the water supply device, vertical rods of the universal wheel devices are hollow devices with openings at the lower parts, telescopic devices and controllers are arranged in the vertical rods, the bottom ends of the telescopic devices are fixedly connected with the universal wheels, the controllers are electrically connected with the telescopic devices, and the controllers control the telescopic devices to operate so as to drive the universal wheels to stretch; relate to water supply equipment technical field, solve the unable flexible of bottom universal wheel, and the unable technical problem who directly drinks of water resource.

title_en: Parallel shaft helical tooth transmission electric driving wheel
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electric driving wheel driven by parallel shaft helical teeth, which comprises a speed reducer shell, a motor, a secondary transmission component and a tertiary transmission component; the motor is fixed on one side of the speed reducer shell, one end of the motor is provided with a driving gear shaft, and the end part of the driving gear shaft is provided with a first helical tooth part; the secondary transmission assembly comprises a secondary driven gear shaft which is rotatably arranged on one side of the driving gear shaft; one side of the secondary driven gear shaft is provided with a first helical gear meshed with the first helical gear part, and the other side of the secondary driven gear shaft is provided with a second helical gear part; the third-stage transmission assembly comprises a third-stage driven shaft which is rotatably arranged on the other side of the driving gear shaft, and a second helical gear which is meshed with the second helical gear is arranged on the third-stage driven shaft; the output end of the three-stage driven shaft extends to the outer side of the shell of the speed reducer and is used for being connected with an external tire; the electric driving wheel overcomes the defect that the size of a driving tire is large due to the fact that an inner gear shell is used as power output of the existing electric driving wheel.

title_en: Automobile chassis guard plate mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automobile chassis guard plate mounting structure, relating to the technical field of mounting structures and comprising a bolt body; the bolt body is provided with the locking screw of direction from top to bottom, the locking screw lower part is provided with the screw thread post, locking screw's screw thread post top end face is provided with regular hexagonal prism, the groove of splining of direction from top to bottom is all seted up to locking screw's the outside circumference left and right sides of screw thread post, the screw thread blind hole has been seted up to locking screw's screw thread post bottom terminal surface, all set up the bar hole of direction from top to bottom on the wall around locking screw's screw thread post bottom, locking screw's setting, conveniently spline the gasket suit and carry out the splining, conveniently spline the chassis board and carry out the splining to locking screw, locking screw produces the rotation when preventing rotatory lock nut from this, need prevent through the spanner that the screw rod from rotating in the bolt installation and just can carry out rotatory locking to the nut, inconvenient seting up on the screw rod and suit splines the problem that the chassis board was detained and carry out the splining.

title_en: Mounting device matched with kettle hole
abstract_en: The utility model provides an installation device with kettle hole matching, including the backup pad, set up respectively at the clamp structure one and the clamp structure two at backup pad both ends, the lateral part of backup pad sets up the waist hole, sets up the fixed orifices in both ends and the backup pad that are close to the waist hole, and the backup pad passes through waist hole and kettle jogged joint, and clamp structure one includes tightening strip one, sets up the lock head one at a tightening strip both ends junction, sets up a plurality of card holes one on tightening strip one. The utility model provides a with the mounting structure of kettle hole matching, the mounting hole of having avoided former dress can not satisfy the problem of mounting hole distance, makes the installation back kettle or low tube group battery be difficult for rocking, and the mounting panel is difficult for splitting during the vibrations, the better former mounting hole of having protected, this product also can be installed to the motorcycle type that does not have the kettle mounting hole.

title_en: Plant protection spraying unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plant protection equipment, in particular to a plant protection spraying unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a flying mechanism, wherein a spraying mechanism is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the flying mechanism. According to the agricultural chemical spraying device, the agricultural chemical and powder can be added into the water inlet pipe, the stirring plate can be driven by the output end of the driving motor to stir and mix the agricultural chemical, so that manual stirring can be replaced, the unmanned aerial vehicle can fly to the air with the spraying mechanism, the solar panel can convert the received solar energy into electric energy required by the unmanned aerial vehicle, before pesticide spraying is carried out on crops, the sliding sleeve can be stirred according to the row spacing density of the crops, the sliding sleeve can be positioned by the magnetic attraction of the magnetic blocks and the magnetic strips in the sliding sleeve, the distance between the two sliding sleeves and the atomizing spray heads can be adjusted, the plurality of atomizing spray heads can be adjusted according to the spacing of the crops, and the waste of the chemical can be avoided.

title_en: Cantilever type guardrail
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cantilever type guardrail, which comprises a fixed round hall and a machine connecting opening, wherein a pull rod assembly is arranged between the upper end of the machine connecting opening and the center of the top of the fixed round hall, one end of the pull rod assembly is rotationally connected to the center of the top surface of the fixed round hall, the other end of the pull rod assembly is fixed on the machine connecting opening, the cantilever type guardrail further comprises a maintenance guardrail, the maintenance guardrail comprises at least two fixed upright posts which are respectively fixed on the two sides of the rear part of the top surface of the fixed round hall, one side of each fixed upright post is provided with an arc-shaped railing which is connected with the fixed upright posts and is arranged around the periphery of the top surface of the fixed round hall, the other side of each fixed upright post is provided with an opening of the railing, the railing is suspended above the pull rod assembly, the pull rod assembly or the machine connecting opening is provided with a movable upright post, and the upper end of the movable upright post is always supported below the railing. The utility model has the advantage of avoiding the interference of the rotating moving parts.

title_en: Wall climbing robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wall climbing robot. The wall climbing robot comprises a frame, a crawler assembly and travelling wheels are respectively rotatably arranged on the front side and the rear side of the frame, a first driving mechanism for driving the crawler assembly to travel is arranged on the frame, a rotating shaft with an axis extending along the front-rear direction is rotatably arranged on the frame, a second driving mechanism for driving the rotating shaft to rotate is arranged on the frame, air pawls are respectively arranged at the two ends of the rotating shaft, a sucking disc is arranged on the lower side of the frame, a vacuum pump is arranged on the frame, an air inlet of the vacuum pump is connected with the sucking disc through a connecting pipe, and a propelling fan for providing oblique lower propelling force for the wall climbing robot is arranged on the frame. Compared with the prior art, the wall climbing robot adopts the mode that the crawler belt is combined with the travelling wheels, so that the adaptability of different walls of the wall climbing robot is greatly improved. According to the wall climbing robot, the propelling fan is added to provide oblique upward thrust for the robot, so that the propelling capacity is improved.

title_en: Trolley wire rod structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a trolley wire rod structure, which comprises: the protective box and the movable plate I, the inner chamber symmetry of protective box connects baffle I, and the first recess of corresponding seting up of the position of movable plate I relative baffle I, and the first lead screw sliding connection of movable plate through the spiro union is in the inner chamber of protective box, baffle I sliding connection in recess I, and the collection groove is seted up to the position that the upper surface of movable plate is close to lead screw I simultaneously, and the oil filler point is seted up to the position of the relative collection groove in protective box top, the fixed block I is connected to the both ends symmetry of movable plate I, and fixed block one sliding connection is in the spout one that the protective box surface was seted up, and the fixed block one is through the guide way one sliding connection guide bar of seting up. According to the utility model, the first screw rod is in a relatively sealed environment through the cooperation of the protective box and the first baffle, and is not directly exposed in the external environment, so that external foreign matters can be effectively prevented from adhering to the surface of the first screw rod.

title_en: Child's cycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a baby carrier which comprises a frame body, a car roof, a theme component and at least one pattern component, wherein the car roof is detachably arranged on the frame body to form a basic car body, the pattern component is connected to the outer surface of the basic car body, a mounting device is arranged at the top of the car roof, and the theme component is detachably connected to the mounting device. The frame main body and the roof are detachably connected, so that the vehicle can be installed and detached, and is convenient to carry and use; meanwhile, the mounting device is used for connecting and replacing different theme parts and matching pattern parts on the basic car body, so that the baby carriage with different types and different themes can be assembled, and the production cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Inflation and deflation connecting device and brake cylinder debugging platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of test equipment, in particular to a charging and discharging connecting device and a brake cylinder debugging platform. The inflation and deflation connecting device comprises a bracket, a fixing piece and a quick connector, wherein the bracket is detachably arranged on a brake cylinder of the axle assembly through the fixing piece. The quick connector is adjustably arranged on the bracket, and one end of the quick connector can be inserted into an air hole of the brake cylinder so as to be communicated with the inner cavity of the brake cylinder. The other end of the quick connector can be communicated with an air pipe of the air compressor, so that the air compressor can charge or discharge air to the inner cavity of the brake cylinder. The brake cylinder debugging platform comprises the air compressor and the inflation and deflation connecting device, the quick connector is mounted on the bracket, the bracket is fixedly mounted on the brake cylinder by the fixing piece, the bracket can play a role in supporting and fixing the quick connector, looseness in the inflation and deflation process of the brake cylinder is avoided, the stability and reliability of air hole connection of the quick connector and the brake cylinder are improved, and accordingly the assembly and adjustment efficiency of the axle assembly is improved.

title_en: Automobile air conditioner pipeline pressing plate structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressing plate structure of an automobile air conditioner pipeline, and relates to the technical field of automobile air conditioner assembly. The utility model comprises an end face radial pressing plate and a condenser inlet pressing plate fixedly connected to a collecting pipe of an air conditioner condenser; the condenser inlet pressing plate penetrates through a condenser inlet communicated with a collecting pipe of the air conditioner condenser; the end surface radial pressing plate also penetrates through a through hole matched with the inlet of the condenser, and a metal pipe is connected in the through hole in a tight fit manner; the radial clamp plate of terminal surface compresses tightly on the condenser import clamp plate through compressing tightly the piece, has avoided the smooth tooth that bolted connection led to, and the tubular metal resonator is linked together with the condenser import. The automobile air conditioner pipeline pressing plate structure is applied to a narrow automobile air conditioner installation space, the end face radial pressing plate is pressed on the condenser inlet pressing plate through the pressing type plug connector with an elastic function, the direct plug-in installation is realized, the screwing action of bolts is not needed, the operation is convenient and labor-saving, and meanwhile, the refrigerant overflow caused by the sliding teeth of the bolts is avoided.

title_en: Motor car locomotive covering piece
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor car head covering part, and relates to the field of motor car machining. The motor car head covering piece comprises a head and a front car body arranged at the back of the head; the bottom of the front automobile body is provided with a front automobile bottom, the front automobile bottom is provided with a mounting mechanism, the mounting mechanism comprises a groove arranged at one end of the front automobile bottom, a plurality of groups of springs are arranged, one end of each spring is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the corresponding groove, one end of each plugboard is fixedly connected with the other end of each spring, two groups of bolts are arranged, and the bolts are matched; the bottom of back automobile body is provided with back car bottom, and the one end of back car bottom is provided with the draw-in groove, is provided with the spout above the draw-in groove, and the spout is provided with two sets of picture peg and is connected with back automobile body. The mounting mechanism of the locomotive covering piece of the motor car can be used for reinforcing the mounting of the covering piece, is convenient to detach during subsequent repair, and is also provided with the bayonet to facilitate the subsequent mounting of visual glass.

title_en: Rotorcraft and rotor section
abstract_en: The present utility model can provide a rotorcraft and a rotor section having a functional section that can be applied to a flying body having a rotor of either a push-in type or a pull-out type while suppressing a decrease in efficiency of the flying body. The gyroplane of the present utility model comprises: a rotor section including a motor and a propeller; a connection part connected to the rotation part of the rotor part and rotated together with the rotation part; and a functional unit that is held at least partially by the connection unit and that is held at a rotation speed lower than that at which the connection unit rotates.

title_en: Vehicle and tunnel safety system with drive-by-wire chassis
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle and tunnel safety system with a drive-by-wire chassis, which relates to the technical field of road safety and comprises a vehicle and tunnel safety system; the tunnel safety system is fixedly arranged on a tunnel, the vehicle is provided with a chassis domain controller, the chassis domain controller is in communication connection with the tunnel safety system, the chassis domain controller can acquire speed limit information and lane layout information in the tunnel through the tunnel safety system, the chassis domain controller is provided with a vehicle positioning module, the vehicle positioning module can acquire the position of the vehicle, and the chassis domain controller can switch the vehicle from a driver driving mode to an automatic driving mode when the vehicle runs to an entrance of the tunnel; the vehicle and tunnel safety system with the drive-by-wire chassis can effectively avoid dangerous driving behaviors such as manual lane changing, manual overspeed and the like of a driver in a tunnel at will.

title_en: Instrument panel assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an instrument panel assembly and a vehicle. Wherein, instrument board subassembly is used for including first seat, the second seat vehicle that sets up side by side, includes: a first portion for being disposed opposite to the first seat; a second portion for being disposed opposite to the second seat; the middle part is arranged opposite to the area between the first seat and the second seat and comprises a body and a bracket which can be opened relative to the body, the body provides an accommodating space, and the bracket comprises a door body and a bearing part; the instrument board component is provided with a first structure or a second structure, the door body and the body are closed in the first structure, and the bearing part is positioned in the accommodating space; in the second configuration, the door is opened relative to the body, and the receiver extends from the accommodation space to a region between the first seat and the second seat. So as to optimize the space in the vehicle and improve the use convenience.

title_en: Compartment space separating device, compartment and logistics vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a compartment space separation device, a compartment and a logistics vehicle, relates to the technical field of boxcars, and solves the technical problems of serious damage to goods backlog and insufficient utilization of compartment space in the prior art. The compartment space separation device comprises a separation plate, a lifting mechanism, first supporting legs and locking pieces, wherein the lifting mechanism is arranged on two sides of the separation plate in the length direction, the separation plate is horizontally and slidably erected on the lifting mechanism, the locking pieces are detachably connected to the separation plate and the lifting mechanism, and the first supporting legs are detachably or foldably arranged on the lower portion of one end of the separation plate in the length direction. The utility model realizes the separation of the carriage space through the lifting and drawing action of the separation plate, and the separation plate is lifted after goods are piled up, so that the backlog condition of the goods can be lightened, and the top space of the carriage can be utilized by lifting as much as possible, thereby improving the space utilization rate.

title_en: Adjustable whiteboard
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of teaching whiteboards, and discloses an adjustable whiteboard, which comprises a base, a telescopic rod, a mounting seat, a damping rotating shaft and a cross rod, wherein vertical rods are fixedly connected to two ends of the cross rod, a color development substrate is fixedly connected to one side of a metal backboard, and a toughened glass plate is fixedly connected to one side of the color development substrate. Through the setting of multiple fixed mode, this device can be adapted to the fixed of different teaching materials, thereby increase the usable material scope of staff, the practicality of this device has been improved, and the setting of pull rod and clamping piece, it is more convenient when the installation is made this device, the transport and depositing, the flexibility of this device has been increased, moreover, the height of panel is write in the adjustment that this device can be nimble, thereby make the shorter student of height also touch the writing panel, thereby make the staff carry out diversified teaching time, the student can more participate in, the teaching effect decline that leads to because of teaching aid's reason is reduced.

title_en: Ore transfer device for coal mining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal mining, in particular to an ore transfer device for coal mining, which comprises a transfer frame, wherein a driving head is arranged on one side of the transfer frame, side support plates are symmetrically arranged at the top end of the transfer frame, and carriage bodies are rotatably arranged in the two side support plates. According to the utility model, the tire body, the anti-pricking metal wrapping chain, the extension strip and the limit hooks are arranged, the anti-pricking metal wrapping chain is tightly attached to the tire body and wrapped on the surface of the tire body, in order to prevent the anti-pricking metal wrapping chain from shifting, the limit hooks on the extension strip are clamped on the return type fixing blocks to fix the anti-pricking metal wrapping chain, the tire body rotates to drive the anti-pricking metal wrapping chain to integrally rotate, so that the anti-pricking metal wrapping chain is contacted with the ground, broken stone can be prevented from directly impacting the tire body by adopting metal materials, normal operation of the tire body is protected, the tire body is meshed, and the anti-pricking metal wrapping chain is formed by orderly splicing a plurality of metal blocks, so that the anti-pricking metal wrapping chain has certain anti-slip property, and the service life of equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Yacht convenient to charge
abstract_en: The utility model provides a yacht convenient to charge, which comprises a yacht body (1), a battery pack (2), a sunshade, a solar charging device and a storable charging device, wherein the yacht comprises a yacht body; the solar energy charging device is characterized in that the battery pack (2) and the storable charging device are arranged inside the ship body (1), the battery pack (2) is connected to the solar energy charging device and the storable charging device so as to charge and use, the sunshade is arranged on the upper portion of the ship body (1), and the solar energy charging device is arranged on the upper surface of the sunshade and used for absorbing solar energy to charge the yacht. Its structural design is simple, can improve the duration of yacht, and simultaneously when the yacht charges on the shore, can accomodate charging device and make the user accurately insert the electric pile that fills, and charging device can accomodate the practical area that the design improved the yacht.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant warm air water tank with built-in throttle plate for automobile
abstract_en: The utility model provides a corrosion-resistant warm air water tank with a built-in throttle plate for an automobile, which comprises a main support outer frame, a heat dissipation conduit, heat dissipation fins, a throttle plate structure and a stable support structure, wherein: the heat dissipation conduit is embedded in the main support outer frame, the heat dissipation fins are embedded on the surface of the heat dissipation conduit, and two ends of the throttle plate structure are welded in the heat dissipation conduit; the stable supporting structure is arranged on the back of the main supporting outer frame through bolts. The throttle plate structure and the outer wrapping shell are arranged, so that the throttle plate can be quickly installed, and the throttle plate is convenient to detach and maintain after cavitation occurs.

title_en: Building brick transfer device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of constructional engineering, in particular to a building brick transferring device which comprises a bottom plate and rollers, wherein both sides of the bottom plate are provided with vertical clamping holes and horizontal clamping holes, the rollers are arranged on the bottom plate, and a pushing handle is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate; the material carrying box is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate and arranged on one side of the push handle, and one side of the material carrying box is opened; the rotating mechanism is rotatably arranged on the bottom plate, the rotating mechanism is fixedly connected with a sealing plate, the sealing plate is matched with the opening of the material carrying box, and the rotating mechanism is used for enabling the sealing plate to seal or open the opening through the vertical clamping holes and the horizontal clamping holes; the pushing mechanism is arranged on the material carrying box and used for rapidly pushing out bricks in the material carrying box through the opening so as to finish discharging. The building brick transferring device provided by the utility model not only can transfer bricks, but also can conveniently control the opening and closing of the loading box opening, is convenient for loading, can push out the bricks from the loading box, and is simple to operate and high in practicability.

title_en: Charging gun with lighting function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile charging, and discloses a charging gun with an illumination function, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein an electric box is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the supporting frame, a mounting groove is formed in the side face of the electric box, a gun main body is clamped and mounted in the mounting groove, a connecting wire is fixedly arranged on the side face of the gun main body and fixedly connected to the side face of the supporting frame, energy-saving lamps are fixedly arranged on the side face of the electric box at equal intervals, a switch is fixedly arranged on the side face of the electric box, a soft light lamp is fixedly sleeved on the side face of the gun main body, and an inductor is arranged on the side face of the gun main body far away from the electric box. According to the utility model, when the side face of the gun main body is held, the soft light lamp and the lamp tube are controlled to work and emit light through the inductor in an induction way, meanwhile, the lighting effect is enhanced through the reflection of the reflecting plate, and meanwhile, the energy-saving lamp is turned on through the switch to enhance the lighting effect, so that a good lighting effect is improved for the charging gun to be mounted on a vehicle for use.

title_en: Underwater detection robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater detection robot which comprises a main cabin module, a dorsal fin, a signal transmitting and receiving device, a motor and an acrylic glass cover, wherein a searchlight is arranged on the rear side face of the main cabin module, the dorsal fin is arranged on the left side of the searchlight, one end of the dorsal fin is connected with the main cabin module, the signal transmitting and receiving device is arranged on the left side of the dorsal fin, one end of the signal transmitting and receiving device is connected with the main cabin module, the motor is fixed in a tail cabin, second three propelling devices are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the main cabin module, each second three propelling device consists of a second propeller, a second blade cover, a second fixing support and a rotary connecting rod, and the second propeller is connected with the motor through a rotating shaft.
