Compared with the traditional frame-type underwater robot, the underwater robot with the underwater detection function has the advantages that due to the streamline appearance, the received water resistance is small, the propulsion efficiency is high, and the cruising speed is higher.

title_en: Vehicle driving control system based on intelligent accelerator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle driving control system based on an intelligent accelerator, which comprises a vehicle real-time information acquisition system, a navigation system, a signal processor and an intelligent accelerator control system, wherein the vehicle real-time information acquisition system is used for acquiring real-time information of a vehicle; the vehicle real-time information acquisition system and the navigation system are both connected with the signal processor, and the signal processor issues power control information to the intelligent accelerator control system according to the comprehensive processing result to perform power control. According to the utility model, the signal processor performs data analysis and processing according to the information of the real-time information acquisition system and the navigation system of the vehicle, and issues the result to the intelligent accelerator control system for automatic power control, so that the driving labor intensity is reduced; the driving strategy is optimized, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved; the accelerator pedal is omitted, misoperation is avoided, and driving safety is improved; the driving technical requirements are reduced, and the social driving level and the driving cooperative efficiency benefit are improved conveniently.

title_en: Stainless steel pipe traction carrying device convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stainless steel pipe traction carrying device convenient to maintain, which comprises a connecting plate, wherein a plurality of rollers are arranged at the lower end of the connecting plate, a bottom plate is arranged at the upper end of the connecting plate, a mounting groove is arranged at the lower end of the bottom plate, the upper end of the connecting plate is positioned in the mounting groove, a moving cavity is arranged in the bottom plate, a limiting mechanism for limiting the connecting plate is arranged in the moving cavity and the mounting groove together, a placing box is fixedly connected at the upper end of the bottom plate, and a plurality of placing grooves are arranged at the left side of the placing box. The device adopts split type setting for the maintenance is comparatively simple, and in the handling, adopts the layering to place, effectually avoided the accumulational condition of steel pipe to take place.

title_en: Shield constructs machine back and joins in marriage trailer mill equipment protection frock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a factory assembly protection tool for a rear trailer of a shield machine, which relates to the technical field of shield machines and comprises a steel pipe, wherein one side of the steel pipe is provided with a connecting steel pipe, the outer side of the steel pipe is provided with an ear plate, two sides of the steel pipe are provided with connecting plates, the inner side of each connecting plate is provided with a connecting pin, the outer side of each connecting plate is abutted with a lifting lug, the outer side of each lifting lug is connected with a sealing plate, the outer side of each sealing plate is provided with a first bolt, and the inner side of each lifting lug is provided with a second bolt. According to the utility model, after the trailer frame is assembled, the protection tool is fixed on the lifting lugs at the two ends of the trailer frame through the first bolts, and then the lifting lugs are arranged at the top of the trailer frame through the second bolts, so that the installation of the protection tool is completed, when the protection tool is required to be dismantled subsequently, the first bolts can be taken down from the sealing plates, the lifting lugs can be dismantled from the outer sides of the connecting plates, and the subsequent lifting lugs can be dismantled from the trailer frame through the second bolts.

title_en: Insulating board with water drainage tank structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an insulating plate with a drainage groove structure, which belongs to the technical field of insulating plates for subway platforms and comprises a platform surface, wherein a groove is formed in the top surface of the platform surface, an insulating floor is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the groove, a plurality of drainage grooves are formed in the upper surfaces of the two ends of the insulating floor, one side of the bottom surface of each drainage groove opening is provided with an arc surface, a sewage drain port is formed between the arc surface and the platform surface, a sewage groove is formed below the platform surface, and the sewage drain port is communicated with the sewage groove. Through setting up the top surface both ends of insulating floor and all having seted up the drain notch, can make insulating floor surface's water stain have the effect that can directly handle at insulating floor surface, can lead into sewage sewer mouth through the drain notch, sewage sewer mouth still is linked together with the sewage groove in addition, can pass the drain notch after sewage, directly lead into the sewage groove and be collected.

title_en: Combined waist rest
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lumbar support and discloses a combined lumbar support, which comprises a cushion sleeve, wherein the top of the cushion sleeve is fixedly connected with a connecting belt, the inner wall of the connecting belt is movably connected with a hanging ring, the outer wall of the hanging ring is fixedly connected with a binding belt, the inner wall of the cushion sleeve is movably connected with a left lumbar support, one side of the left lumbar support is provided with a bump, the inner wall of the cushion sleeve is movably connected with a right lumbar support, one side of the right lumbar support is provided with a groove, the top of the right lumbar support is fixedly connected with a buckle, the top of the left lumbar support is fixedly connected with a fixing belt, the back of the cushion sleeve is fixedly connected with a cover cloth, the back of the cover cloth is provided with a rough magic tape, and the back of the cushion sleeve is provided with a thorn magic tape. This combination formula lumbar support, convenient to use person dismantles the lumbar support to avoid pad cover outer stain infiltration into the lumbar support, and avoid the integrated lumbar support to bring inconvenient condition for the clearance, thereby effectively improved the convenience of clearance, and satisfied the use needs.

title_en: Steering wheel for competition
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of AGV trolleys, in particular to a steering wheel for competition. The axes of the first motor, the second motor and the synchronous pulley are along the first direction, the axes of the tensioning wheels are along the second direction, the second direction is perpendicular to the first direction, the axes of the driving wheels are along the third direction, and the third direction is perpendicular to the first direction and the second direction. The second motor is connected with an expansion sleeve on the rotary table through a first flange shaft, the rotary table is arranged on the lower bottom plate, the fourth synchronous pulley and the fifth synchronous pulley are rotatably sleeved on the first flange shaft, the expansion pulley is rotatably supported on the rotary table, the selection limitation of an electric slip ring component is avoided, and the vertical transmission of the motor is realized to control the steering of the hub; the motor output is transmitted through a first synchronous pulley, a second synchronous pulley, a third synchronous pulley, a fourth synchronous pulley and a fifth synchronous pulley, so that reasonable and more excellent rotating speed and torque are obtained, and the competition or market demands are better met; the first flange shaft and the fourth and fifth synchronous pulleys realize respective rotation through the shaft sleeve, and coordination and cooperation between rotation of the hub and forward movement of the hub are realized.

title_en: Upper rocker arm ball pin boss forging structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ball pin seats, and particularly discloses an upper rocker arm ball pin seat forging structure which comprises a seat body, wherein a concave fixing plate is arranged on the outer wall of the seat body, connecting blocks are arranged at two ends of one side of the fixing plate, which is far away from the seat body, an upper rocker arm is arranged at one end of each connecting block, which is far away from the seat body, of each connecting block, an inclined surface is arranged at one end of each connecting block, which is close to the fixing plate, reinforcing plates are arranged at two sides of the top of each fixing plate, limiting blocks are arranged at the side surfaces of one end, which is close to the seat body, of each fixing plate, and reinforcing mechanisms are arranged at two ends of the top of each fixing plate. The reinforcing plate can simultaneously reinforce the connection among the base body, the fixing plate and the connecting block, so that the connection among the fixing plate, the base body and the connecting block is more stable.

title_en: Telescopic heat-insulating automobile sun shield
abstract_en: The utility model provides a telescopic heat-insulating automobile sun shield, which comprises: main sunshading board, vice sunshading board and sunshade curtain, be provided with the axostylus axostyle on the main sunshading board, sunshade curtain one end is fixed and is convoluteed on the axostylus axostyle, and vice sunshading board is connected to the other end, vice sunshading board detachable connects main sunshading board, the tip of axostylus axostyle still is provided with automatic winding structure for with the sunshade curtain rolling to the axostylus axostyle. The detachable main sunshade board and the detachable auxiliary sunshade board are arranged, and the two sunshade boards are connected through the sunshade curtain capable of being automatically curled, so that a large-range sunshade function can be realized when a driver stops for rest, the sunshade curtain and the auxiliary sunshade board can be conveniently retracted, and the original functions of the main sunshade board in the driving process are ensured.

title_en: Multipurpose carrier flexible supporting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multipurpose carrier flexible supporting device, comprising: the support for placing the automobile water tank and locate a plurality of locating components on the support, wherein the locating component is including being used for pressing from both sides in order to prevent its first locating component and the second locating component that rocks along the Y axle direction of automobile water tank top, is used for supporting tightly the third locating component of automobile water tank middle part one side, is used for supporting tightly the fourth locating component of automobile water tank middle part opposite side, is used for the location the fifth locating component of automobile water tank bottom, is used for supporting tightly the sixth locating component of automobile water tank bottom one side. Compared with the prior art, the utility model is suitable for assembling water tanks of various vehicle types, and has simple structure and high movement accuracy.

title_en: Novel net wire roller moving vehicle for protective film
abstract_en: A novel net wire roller moving vehicle for a protective film comprises a frame and two supporting rollers. The frame includes roof and base. A lifting device is arranged between the base and the top plate. The top of roof has seted up first spout, sliding connection has positive and negative tooth lead screw in the first spout. The front and back tooth screw rods are sleeved with nut seats. The top of the nut seat is provided with a bearing seat. The driving structure comprises a mounting plate, a motor and two driving wheels, wherein the left end of each of the two positive and negative screw rods penetrates out of the first sliding groove, the left end of one of the driving wheels is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the motor through a coupler, the two driving wheels are fixedly sleeved at the left ends of the two positive and negative screw rods respectively, and the driving wheels are connected through belt transmission. The utility model can adjust the distance between the two supporting rollers according to the diameter of the net wire roller, thereby expanding the application range.

title_en: Adjustable externally hung protective frame for locomotive
abstract_en: An adjustable externally hung protective frame for a locomotive, comprising: a right front bumper, a left front bumper, a right rear bumper, and a left rear bumper; the right front adjusting rod is connected with the right front anti-collision rod through a double-head screw cap; the left front adjusting rod is connected with the left front anti-collision rod through another double-head screw cap.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted circuit board, which comprises: a mounting box; a support assembly; a main plate member; and, a positioning damper assembly, the positioning damper assembly comprising: the positioning cylinder is fixedly connected to the mounting side wall, the damping spring is arranged in the positioning cylinder, the first connecting column is movably assembled to the positioning cylinder, the second connecting column is rotatably assembled to the side wall of the main board piece, and the first connecting column is detachably connected with the second connecting column. In the utility model, when the main plate is installed, the main plate is firstly placed on the supporting component, and then the first connecting column and the second connecting column are connected and matched, so that the main plate can be positioned and installed quickly, and the installation is convenient and quick; the damping spring absorbs the vibration force received by the main plate, after long-time use, the first connecting column can be directly taken out and then replaced, so that the main plate is protected in a damping manner, and meanwhile, the cost is reduced.

title_en: Mounting structure of air conditioner condenser for engineering vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of engineering vehicles, in particular to an installation structure of an air conditioner condenser for an engineering vehicle, which comprises an installation plate, wherein the installation plate is a main installation part of the installation structure of the air conditioner condenser for the engineering vehicle; the spring grooves are formed in two sides of the inner part of the bottom plate, and reset springs are distributed in the inner part of the spring grooves at equal intervals; the cross bars are arranged in the bottom plate and are connected with the reset springs; and one end of the connecting plate is arranged in the bottom plate and connected with the cross rod. The utility model overcomes the defects of the prior art, and the transverse rod, the reset spring and the connecting plate are arranged, and the transverse rod is pushed inwards at the same time, so that the transverse rod inwards extrudes the reset spring, the reset spring can deform, the connecting plate at one end is driven to be separated from the connecting groove in the connecting box, and the condenser main body is lifted upwards, thereby completing the disassembly and assembly of the condenser main body, and the process is convenient for overhauling and cleaning the condenser without using external tools.

title_en: Steel-based nickel alloy shaft sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a steel-based nickel alloy shaft sleeve, which belongs to the technical field of shaft sleeves and comprises an outer barrel, a first clamping sleeve and a second clamping sleeve, wherein a fastening mechanism is arranged in the first clamping sleeve and the second clamping sleeve, the fastening mechanism comprises a first stud penetrating through two sides of the first clamping sleeve and the second clamping sleeve, a nut is connected with the outer wall of the first stud in a threaded manner, a detachable sleeve is arranged at the outer end of the first stud, and a counter bore is formed in the detachable sleeve. Compared with the traditional shaft sleeve design, the steel-based nickel alloy shaft sleeve provided by the utility model has the advantages that the split two-section design is adopted on the basis of the traditional fastener to enable the first stud and the detachable sleeve to be in a split design, so that if the situation of sliding abrasion of the inner hexagon occurs in the installation process, a user can rapidly disassemble and replace the detachable sleeve, and four clamping plates in linkage movement are adopted to control the detachable sleeve to be matched with the first stud more closely and stably.

title_en: Electric transmission device for freight transportation high-speed rail
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric transmission device for a freight transportation high-speed rail, which comprises a transmission wheel, a mounting plate, a lifting structure, a rotating structure and a driving structure, wherein the lifting plate is arranged below the mounting plate, the lifting structure is arranged on two sides of the bottom of the mounting plate, first through holes are formed in the middle of the mounting plate and the middle of the lifting plate in a penetrating manner, the transmission wheel is arranged in the first through holes correspondingly, the upper top of the transmission wheel is higher than the top of the mounting plate, and the rotating fluted disc is rotatably connected to the bottom of the mounting plate. When the material assembling device is transmitted, the contact degree of the material assembling device and a transmission platform is reduced, the automatic transmission capacity is improved, so that the transmission efficiency of the material assembling device is improved, the transmission wheels are provided with a plurality of transmission wheels and are distributed at the transmission platform, when the material assembling device is transmitted to a designated position, the transmission horizontal angle of the transmission wheels is changed, so that the material assembling device is transmitted in different directions, and the operation convenience is improved.

title_en: Electric vehicle goods shelves and electric motor car that assembly is simple and easy
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vehicle accessories, and provides an electric vehicle shelf and an electric vehicle, wherein the electric vehicle shelf is easy to assemble, the shelf comprises a front shelf and a rear shelf, the front shelf is fixedly connected with an electric vehicle frame, the front shelf is provided with a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod which are arranged side by side, the rear shelf is provided with a protruding connecting end, the connecting end is in plug-in connection with the corresponding first connecting rod and second connecting rod, the front shelf and the rear shelf are provided with matched through holes, after the front shelf and the rear shelf are inserted and connected, the front shelf and the rear shelf can be further reinforced by using a bolt connecting piece, compared with the original shelf, the novel shelf is easy to assemble, and the shelf can be assembled without disassembling a seat barrel.

title_en: Quick drainage low resistance racing boat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick drainage low-resistance racing boat, which comprises a racing boat body, wherein the racing boat body comprises a left side plate and a right side plate, the left side plate and the right side plate are connected to form a shell with an opening at the upper end and a cavity, a deck is arranged on the upper cover of the opening, the lower edge of the front end of the shell is inclined upwards and forms an included angle of 15-30 degrees with the horizontal plane, the front end of the shell is of a V-shaped structure, a seat cabin is arranged in the shell through the deck, the seat cabin is close to the rear end of the deck, a convex edge is arranged around the outer edge of the seat cabin, and the quick drainage racing boat has the technical characteristics of simple structure, low resistance, capability of quickly draining water on the deck and the like.

title_en: Lifting type new energy charging pile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting type new energy charging pile, and relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles. This over-and-under type new forms of energy fills electric pile, including burying the case, the plectane, fill electric pile and coupling assembling, circular tang has been seted up at the top of burying the case, the equal fixed mounting in both sides inner wall of burying the case has the fixed plate, rotate between the inboard top of fixed plate and burying the case and install the threaded rod, the bottom fixed mounting of a set of fixed plate has the motor, plectane slidable mounting is buried the incasement in the ground, the outer wall of two sets of threaded rods is located to plectane thread bush, be provided with the backing plate on the plectane, fill electric pile's top fixed mounting has trapezoidal sealed disc and is located circular tang, fill electric pile sets up on the plectane, coupling assembling sets up on filling electric pile and plectane. This over-and-under type new forms of energy fills electric pile, conveniently hide the protection with filling electric pile, and be convenient for adjust the angle that fills electric pile, prevent that the vehicle from filling electric wire and the phenomenon that charges the end position and take place to involve easily with filling electric pile deviation angle great.

title_en: Hub assembly and wheel end assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hub assembly and a wheel end assembly, wherein a hub shell of the hub assembly is detachably and fixedly connected with a flange end cover body, a first bearing is arranged at a first bearing chamber, a second bearing is arranged at a second bearing chamber, an inner ring of the first bearing is fixedly connected with an inner ring of the second bearing, lubricating grease is filled in an oil storage cavity, a first oil seal is fixed between a large-diameter end of the inner ring of the first bearing and the hub shell, a second oil seal is fixed between a large-diameter end of the inner ring of the second bearing and the hub shell, the first bearing and the second bearing are sleeved on a steering knuckle, a locking nut is connected at an outer end of the steering knuckle in a threaded manner, a sealing ring is arranged between the inner part of the large-diameter end of the inner ring of the second bearing and the steering knuckle, and an ABS gear ring is fixed on the periphery of the inner end of the hub shell. When the wheel end assembly brake drum or brake disc needs to be replaced, the flange end cover body is detached to replace the built-in brake drum or brake disc, and the assembly precision and the service life of the hub assembly are not affected.

title_en: Automobile exhaust pipe fixing support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile tail gas pipe fixing support, which belongs to the field of automobile accessories and comprises a base, wherein the upper end surface of the base is fixedly connected with an automobile chassis, fixing pieces are respectively arranged on two side surfaces of the base, and a limiting disc and a rotary disc are arranged on the outer vertical surface of each fixing piece. According to the automobile exhaust pipe fixing bracket, the limiting disc is stirred by external force to drive the turntable and the clamping piece to rotate, and the clamping head is continuously closed to the middle part of the fixing hole in the rotating process by matching with the eccentric arrangement of the rotating shaft, so that the extrusion of the exhaust pipe is formed through the three clamping heads, the caliber of the exhaust pipe is adapted to the clamping of the exhaust pipe in the oiling process, the fixing of the exhaust pipe is completed, the sliding groove is arranged for sliding of the chassis, and the rotation of the clamping piece and the clamping stability of the clamping head are kept; through synchronous drawing and extrusion of the three clamping heads, automatic adaptation to tail gas pipes with different calibers and models is realized, and the applicability and the application range of the fixing support are improved.

title_en: Mine unloading trolley power supply device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power supply device of a mine unloading trolley, and belongs to the technical field of mine power supply. The power supply device comprises a fixing frame, wherein the fixing frame is used for installing power supply equipment, and the power supply equipment is used for supplying power to the unloading trolley; the fixing frames are located between the guard rails and the rails for the discharging trolley to walk, wherein the fixing frames are arranged in a plurality, and the fixing frames are distributed at equal intervals along the extending direction of the rails. The utility model sets the fixing frame in the area between the guard rail and the driving track, and the fixing frame is directly fixed on the rail of the track. On the basis of fully utilizing the field space, the interference between the fixing frame and other field mobile equipment is reduced; meanwhile, the height of the fixing frame can be reduced, so that the fixing frame is more convenient and quick to install, and the construction cost is lower.

title_en: Windshield defroster
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile parts, in particular to a windshield defroster, which has the technical scheme that: the defrosting device comprises an arc-shaped frame body, wherein a defrosting assembly is arranged on the arc-shaped frame body, and a moving assembly for driving the defrosting assembly to reciprocate is also arranged on the arc-shaped frame body; the outer wall of the arc-shaped frame body is provided with a clamping block for connecting a wiper, the defrosting assembly comprises a defrosting sheet, the moving assembly comprises a reciprocating screw rod arranged in the arc-shaped frame body and a defrosting block arranged on the reciprocating screw rod and used for installing the defrosting sheet; the motion assembly further comprises roller pieces arranged at two ends of the arc-shaped frame body in the length direction, each roller piece comprises a first connecting block arranged at one end of the arc-shaped frame body in the length direction, and a first driving roller used for driving the reciprocating screw rod to rotate is arranged on each first connecting block; the application has the technical effects of quickly defrosting the automobile windshield, improving the travel efficiency and helping a driver to easily remove the frosting of the windshield outdoors in winter.

title_en: Building materials transfer device for construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building material transfer device for building construction, which comprises a transfer trolley, wherein a discharge opening is formed at one end of the transfer trolley, round grooves are formed at one ends, facing the discharge opening, of two sides in the transfer trolley, discharge components are installed in the round grooves in a rotating mode, two hinging seats are symmetrically constructed at one side, facing the discharge opening, of the top end of the transfer trolley, hinging lugs are installed in the two hinging seats in a rotating mode, discharge doors matched with the discharge opening are jointly constructed at the bottom ends of the two hinging lugs, the discharge components comprise an inner box main body, supporting shafts are respectively constructed at one ends of two sides of the inner box main body, the supporting shafts are installed in the round grooves in a rotating mode, and two installation seats are symmetrically constructed at one side, far away from the discharge opening, of the top end of the inner box main body. This building materials transfer device for construction possesses and emptys the function of unloading, can realize unloading to the deflection of inner box main part, has reduced the residual of inside material by a wide margin, labour saving and time saving when unloading, and the practicality is stronger.

title_en: Double-gun direct current charging pile with waterproof structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a double-gun direct current charging pile with a waterproof structure, which comprises a rain shield, wherein the top of the rain shield is provided with a sliding groove, the inner wall of the sliding groove is rotationally connected with a threaded rod, the outer side of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a threaded block, the bottom of the threaded block is in sliding connection with the sliding groove, and the top of the threaded block is fixedly connected with a concave plate. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the charging box is placed in the rain shield plate, so that the charging box has the effects of rain prevention, water prevention and sun protection when in raining, the servo motor is started when in raining, the output shaft of the servo motor drives the threaded rod to rotate, the threaded block can move, the concave plate is driven to extend outwards, the charging box is still not influenced by rainwater when in raining, the filter plate can be driven to move when the concave plate extends outwards, the rainwater is filtered, and sundries in the rainwater are prevented from being deposited in the chute.

title_en: Battery collision detection device, battery pack, frame and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery collision detection device which comprises a sensing component and a battery management system, wherein the sensing component is used for being connected with the battery management system, the sensing component is arranged on one side of a battery facing the ground and is electrically connected with the battery management system, and the sensing component generates an electric signal according to the deformation stress of one side of the battery facing the ground and sends the electric signal to the battery management system. The utility model also discloses a battery pack, a frame and a vehicle. The utility model can timely detect the collision condition of the battery pack.

title_en: External equipment fixing structure of track geometry state measuring instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an external equipment fixing structure of a track geometry measuring instrument, which belongs to the technical field of track geometry measuring instruments and comprises a base, wherein one side of the top of the base is fixedly connected with a fixing plate through a bolt, an inner cavity of the fixing plate is provided with an adjusting mechanism, the top of the fixing plate is hinged with a computer frame through a first hinged support, the top of the computer frame is open, two sides of the computer frame are respectively connected with a threaded rod through a threaded sleeve in a threaded manner, the inner side of the threaded rod is respectively connected with a clamping plate through a bearing in a rotating manner, and the outer side of the threaded rod is respectively fixedly connected with a first handle through a bolt. Can drive the computer frame and use first free bearing to carry out the luffing motion as the center through the movable lever to can change the angle of computer frame, make inclination can adjust wantonly, can be more convenient when checking data when the survey person of different heights from this, make the information on the computer screen look over more convenient.

title_en: Steel transfer device for part manufacturing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel material transferring device for part manufacturing, which comprises a transferring main body, wherein a fixed plate is arranged on one side of the transferring main body, an armrest is welded on one side of the fixed plate, and the transferring main body comprises a rolling mechanism, a discharging mechanism and an adjustable extruding plate; the rolling mechanism comprises a rolling plate, rolling rollers and rolling grooves, the rolling grooves are formed in the rolling plate, and two sides of the rolling rollers are rotatably connected with the inner walls of the rolling grooves; the unloading mechanism comprises a transfer flat plate, a lifting rod, a rotating shaft, a first supporting rod and a second supporting rod. According to the utility model, by installing the unloading mechanism and the rolling mechanism, steel on the transfer flat plate can rapidly slide from the transfer flat plate to the rolling mechanism and slide to the ground, so that the manpower consumption is greatly reduced; through the adjustable stripper plate of installation, can make the steel more stable in the transportation process, reduce the friction, reduce the wearing and tearing consumption of steel.

title_en: Adjustable base angle structure and refrigerator with same
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable base angle structure and a refrigerator with the same, comprising a base plate, wherein the base plate is provided with a first abutting part; the bottom wheel assembly is positioned below the base plate; the adjusting assembly comprises a second abutting part which is in abutting fit with the first abutting part, the second abutting part is movably connected with the base plate or the bottom wheel assembly, and when the second abutting part moves along the horizontal direction under the action of external force, the first abutting part is matched with different heights of the second abutting part, and/or the second abutting part is matched with different heights of the first abutting part, so that the height of the base plate relative to the bottom wheel assembly is adjusted. According to the utility model, the first abutting part is in abutting fit with the second abutting part, and the abutting height position of the second abutting part with the first abutting part is changed when the second abutting part is horizontally moved, so that the height adjustment of the base plate relative to the bottom wheel assembly is realized.

title_en: Fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixing device, which comprises a base, a first movable block and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the first movable block is in sliding connection with the base, the first movable block can move relative to the width direction of the base, the adjusting mechanism is connected with the base and is in movable fit with the first movable block, and the adjusting mechanism is used for driving the first movable block to protrude from one side or two sides of the width direction of the base so as to fix the base and an external member; the fixing device has the advantages of reasonable structure and convenient disassembly and assembly.

title_en: Automobile-used air curtain structure and car
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air curtain structure for a vehicle and a vehicle, wherein the air curtain structure for the vehicle comprises an air curtain body and a suspension assembly, and the air curtain body is arranged on a ceiling in the vehicle through the suspension assembly; the inflatable curtain is characterized in that the inflatable curtain body is provided with an inflation inlet, and a diversion channel is arranged in the inflatable curtain body and used for diverting air flow entering the inflatable curtain body through the inflation inlet. According to the utility model, the air curtain body is arranged on the ceiling in the vehicle through the suspension assembly, when the vehicle collides, the air curtain body is inflated through the inflation inlet, and is inflated and unfolded, so that the air curtain body is endowed with a certain Y-direction thickness, and the air curtain body can be covered on the door plate of the driving cabin, so that the head of the driving passenger is prevented from being impacted on the door plate, and good protection is provided for the driving passenger; the air curtain body is internally provided with the diversion channel which is used for diverting the air flow entering the air curtain body, reducing the impact on the interior decoration of the vehicle when the air curtain body is unfolded and increasing the balance of the in-place unfolding time of the air curtain body.

title_en: Liquid nitrogen tank conveyer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid nitrogen tank transportation device, which comprises two first side plates, wherein two second side plates are symmetrically arranged between the two first side plates, a top plate is arranged above the two second side plates, a bottom plate is arranged below the two second side plates, a plurality of pulleys are arranged below the bottom plate, a movable shaft is arranged at one end of the top plate, two buckles are arranged at one end of the top plate, far away from the movable shaft, of the second side plate, a pushing handle is arranged on the side surface of the second side plate, a plurality of first clamping devices are arranged between the two second side plates, a second clamping device is arranged on the side surface of each of the plurality of first clamping devices, a connecting device is arranged between the first clamping devices and the second clamping devices, a plurality of adsorption devices are arranged above the bottom plate, two ventilation holes are formed in the bottom plate in a penetrating manner, and ventilation devices are arranged in the ventilation holes; when the liquid nitrogen tank is used, the first clamping device, the second clamping device, the connecting device and the adsorption device are matched with each other, so that the liquid nitrogen tank can be fixed to prevent damage caused by shaking in the transportation process.

title_en: Headrest mounting device, headrest assembly, seatback, seat, and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a headrest mounting device, a headrest assembly, a seat back, a seat and a vehicle, wherein the headrest mounting device is suitable for the seat back and is used for mounting a headrest. The backrest main body or the headrest component of the backrest is provided with an adjusting space and an adjusting opening which are communicated. The headrest mounting device comprises a headrest bracket and a covering piece which are connected. The headrest bracket is connected between the cover and the headrest. The cover member is movable in the up-down direction relative to the seat back in the adjustment space, and isolates the adjustment opening. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, when the upper and lower positions of the headrest support relative to the seat backrest are adjusted, the covering piece can synchronously move, the adjusting opening is always isolated by the covering piece, the adjusting space of the seat backrest is better shielded, the effect of better shielding the rat hole is achieved, and the overall aesthetic property of the seat is ensured.

title_en: Novel compound wheel leg type stair climbing robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel composite wheel leg type stair climbing robot, which comprises a vehicle body capable of bearing a load, a front wheel with driving capability, a main wheel with self-balancing driving capability, a tail wheel with lifting capability and telescopic wheel legs, wherein the front wheel is provided with a plurality of wheels; the front wheels are connected with the vehicle body through front wheel brackets with adjustable lengths; the wheel leg is provided with a driving arm, the driving arm is connected with a servo motor, the servo motor is fixed on the vehicle body and used for driving the wheel leg to stretch out and draw back, and the main wheel is arranged at the tail section of the wheel leg and can rotate freely; the tail wheel is a driven universal wheel, and lifting in the height direction can be realized through a lifting mechanism. The stair climbing robot disclosed by the utility model realizes the actions of linear motion, steering, ascending stair climbing, descending stair climbing, rugged road walking and the like of the stair climbing robot by adjusting the front wheel, the main wheel, the tail wheel and the wheel legs to be matched with each other, maintains the balance performance and the stability of the stair climbing process, and has the advantages of flexible motion, high load ratio, strong adaptability and low cost.

title_en: Mobilizable breed water regulation and control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water purification, in particular to movable culture water regulation equipment, which aims at the problems of low efficiency and large labor capacity of the culture water regulation equipment in the prior art. The utility model can conveniently clean the floating objects on the surface of the culture water body, not only can effectively reduce the labor burden of operators, but also can effectively improve the cleaning efficiency.

title_en: Adjustable tooling structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable tool structure, and belongs to the technical field of automobile tools. This frock structure includes: the first adjusting seat is provided with a first adjusting end with a spiral structure; the second adjusting seat is provided with a second adjusting end of the spiral structure at one end opposite to the first adjusting seat, and the first adjusting end and the second adjusting end are matched with each other so as to adjust the relative distance between the first adjusting seat and the second adjusting seat when the first adjusting seat and the second adjusting seat rotate relatively. The utility model solves the technical problems that the height of the tooling in the prior art cannot be adjusted and the tooling cannot be mutually and commonly used in different vehicle types.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle nest
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle nest, which comprises a cavity with a hollow structure, wherein a power supply capable of charging an external unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged in the cavity, the unmanned aerial vehicle nest also comprises a positioning device, a horizontally movable apron is arranged in the cavity, an access opening is arranged on the side surface of the cavity, a baffle capable of opening and closing is arranged on the access opening, the apron can move from the interior of the cavity to the exterior of the cavity from the access opening, when the unmanned aerial vehicle is parked on the apron, the unmanned aerial vehicle can horizontally move along with the apron and move into the cavity from the access opening, and the external unmanned aerial vehicle is parked at a designated position of the apron through the positioning device to realize the electric connection between the power supply and a charging port of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle nest is small in size, simple in structure, small in weight and convenient to move.

title_en: Signaler based on image recognition technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a signal machine based on an image recognition technology, which belongs to the technical field of rail transit, wherein the signal machine is provided with at least two lamp positions, signal lamps with corresponding colors are correspondingly arranged on each lamp position, the signal machine is provided with at least two signal lamp positioning identifiers corresponding to the at least two lamp positions, and the signal lamp positioning identifiers are used for determining the ROI (region of interest) of the signal machine in image information of the signal machine and determining the position of a lighting lamp position. When the signal machine image is processed by adopting the image processing and identifying technology, the signal machine ROI area and the position of the lighting lamp position in the image information of the signal machine can be determined through the signal lamp positioning mark, so that the signal lamp and the corresponding lighting state and the signal lamp color can be accurately identified, and the reliability and the safety of the signal machine identifying function are improved.

title_en: Handcart for building construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handcart for building construction, which comprises a movable base, wherein the top of the movable base is fixedly connected with a base through a damping shock absorber, the top of the base is provided with a scissor fork type lifter, the top of the scissor fork type lifter is provided with a carrying carriage, the scissor fork type lifter can drive the carrying carriage to lift, so that the handcart can be used as a lifting platform, a worker can stand in the carrying carriage to construct a building at a high position, can lift the carried building materials, is convenient to carry the building materials to the high position, is convenient for building construction, and is convenient for loading and unloading the building materials by arranging a cargo unloading door.

title_en: Rear axle structure of model car
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of model vehicles, and particularly relates to a rear axle structure of a model vehicle, which comprises an axle bracket; the two ends of the axle bracket are respectively provided with a first wheel box, and the first wheel box comprises a top shell and a bottom shell which are connected; the top shell and the bottom shell are enclosed together to form a cavity, and an output wheel is rotationally arranged in the cavity; a transmission shaft is rotationally arranged in the axle bracket, and two ends of the transmission shaft respectively extend into the cavity and are in transmission connection with the output wheel; the two bottom shells are all connected to the two ends of the axle bracket through the connecting piece in a detachable mode, when the parts of the model car are damaged or the gear components with different sizes are required to be replaced, the first wheel boxes are detached from the axle bracket, so that the first wheel boxes with different sizes are replaced, the whole axle bracket is not required to be replaced, and consumables are saved. One end of the connecting piece is penetrated through the bottom shell and connected to the axle bracket, and the other end of the connecting piece is provided with a limiting block which is accommodated in the cavity, so that the connecting piece is not leaked outside the axle bracket, and the aesthetic property of the axle of the model car is improved.

title_en: Highway construction hand push loading attachment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of trolleys and discloses a highway construction hand-push loading device which comprises a vehicle body, wherein the vehicle body comprises a hopper, wheels and a handle, supports are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the hopper, a balancing mechanism is arranged on the supports and can be used for adjusting the overall balance of the hopper when uneven ground is formed, one side of each support is connected with an anti-falling mechanism, and the anti-falling mechanism can ensure the stability of the balancing mechanism. According to the utility model, the balance mechanism is arranged, when the hopper is used for carrying out material loading on uneven ground, the connecting shafts at the two sides are rotated according to the ground leveling condition, and synchronously, the connecting shafts rotate to drive the gears to rotate and are meshed with the tooth blocks to realize that the movable frame drives the balance legs to move up and down, and the two balance legs at the two sides are properly adjusted up and down according to the ground leveling to ensure the overall balance of the hopper when the material is loaded, so that the hopper is not easy to turn on one side when the ground is uneven.

title_en: Car stopping device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a car stopping device, belongs to the field of coal mining, and aims to reduce the movement range of a car stopping railing. The vehicle-stopping rail comprises a left upright post, a right upright post and a vehicle-stopping rail which spans between the left upright post and the right upright post, wherein supporting seats and rails are respectively fixed on the front sides of the left upright post and the right upright post, the bottom ends of the rails extend to the bottoms of the supporting seats, and the top ends of the rails extend upwards along the vertical direction and are bent to be fixed on the top ends of the left upright post or the right upright post; the left end of the car stopping railing is freely inserted between the left upright post and the rail on the left upright post, the right end of the car stopping railing is freely inserted between the right upright post and the rail on the right upright post, and a driving mechanism for driving the car stopping railing to move vertically is arranged. According to the utility model, under the drive of the driving mechanism and in combination with the limit function of the rail, the vehicle barrier is enabled to realize opening and closing along the vertical linear motion, the movement range is small, the opening and closing time is reduced, the requirement on the clearance height of the installation space is smaller, and the adaptability is better.

title_en: Railway roadbed safety inspection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a railway roadbed safety detection device, and belongs to the technical field of railway roadbed disease investigation. Railway roadbed safety inspection device, including rotating piece, brace table, drive component and spacing subassembly, the rotation piece sets up in the bottom center department of this railway roadbed safety inspection device, the rotation piece is the cylinder structure, and its circumference is equipped with the screw thread, the gyro wheel is installed at brace table both ends, and the brace table is located this railway roadbed safety inspection device's below, drive component sets up on the brace table, and drive component and rotation piece threaded connection, spacing subassembly includes spacing sleeve, locating part and limiting plate, the locating part is installed on rotating piece, spacing sleeve symmetry installs at the top of brace table, and spacing sleeve is located same vertical face with the rotation piece, the bottom shape of locating part and spacing sleeve's cavity shape size assorted. The utility model has the advantage of automatic steering.

title_en: Integrated snapshot type hyperspectral Lidar multi-element remote sensing system holder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated snapshot hyperspectral Lidar multi-element remote sensing system holder which comprises a holder shaft platform with a data processing platform, a host and a sub-equipment system; the cloud shaft platform with the data processing platform comprises a multi-shaft cloud platform main body, a data processing platform, an unmanned aerial vehicle communication interface, a load coaxial cable routing via hole and a load coaxial cable routing hole; the host comprises a second sub-equipment system, a data synchronization module, a data caching and transmission module, inertial navigation and an interface. The sub-systems of the utility model use the same quick-release mechanical connection, the same electrical interface and the communication protocol, and the processor identifies each sub-system by means of the ID number in the sub-system communication protocol, so that the random combination of each sub-system can be realized; and using the same RTK/PPK inertial navigation system fixedly connected with the three subsystems, recording trigger and feedback signal moments of the three subsystems by inertial navigation, and settling out the posture and position information of the working moment.

title_en: Induction plate mounting piece and induction plate mounting structure formed by same
abstract_en: The utility model provides an induction plate mounting part and an induction plate mounting structure formed by the same, which relate to the technical field of rail transit and comprise the following components: the bolt comprises a bolt head and a screw; the installation accuracy adjustment fastener comprises a fastener body, an adjustment through hole, a sensing plate buckling part and a sleeper buckling part, wherein the sensing plate buckling part is used for buckling a sensing plate, the sleeper buckling part is used for buckling a sleeper, the adjustment through hole is formed in the fastener body, a screw rod penetrates through the adjustment through hole, an adjustment gap is formed between the periphery of the screw rod and the hole walls on two sides of the adjustment through hole, the sensing plate buckling part is arranged on one side of the fastener body, and the sleeper buckling part is arranged on the other side of the fastener body. The utility model can adjust the position of the induction plate through the adjusting through holes arranged on the fastener body, thereby ensuring that the installation position of the induction plate on the sleeper is more accurate and avoiding the situation that the installation accuracy of the induction plate cannot be adjusted after the induction plate is installed on the sleeper.

title_en: Preassembled double door and processing equipment for same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a preassembled double-door and processing equipment for the same. According to the preassembled double-door, the first door framework, the first door inner plate, the second door framework and the second door inner plate are all arranged on the one door outer plate, so that the door can be manufactured and arranged more conveniently, the production efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the door structure of the left front door and the right front door which are symmetrical left and right is more consistent and orderly in the door processing process, and the overall appearance quality, the aesthetic degree and the assembly precision of the door are better improved.

title_en: Anti-collision beam and unmanned vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-collision beam and an unmanned vehicle, wherein the anti-collision beam comprises: an anti-collision contact edge, a connecting piece and an anti-collision beam bracket; the anti-collision contact edge is transversely arranged and is arranged at one end of the anti-collision beam bracket through the connecting piece; the other end of the anti-collision beam bracket is used for being connected with an unmanned vehicle; the anti-collision beam support is vertically arranged, so that two ends of the anti-collision beam support are located at different heights. According to the anti-collision beam and the unmanned vehicle, when collision occurs, the impact force generated by the collision is not directly and completely fed back to the unmanned vehicle, but is absorbed by a part of the anti-collision beam bracket, so that the anti-collision beam and the unmanned vehicle can play a role in buffering and absorbing energy, and the unmanned vehicle can be better protected; the space occupied by the anti-collision beam is smaller, and the size influence on the unmanned vehicle is smaller after the anti-collision beam is additionally arranged.

title_en: Sunroof pencil convenient to fix and dismantlement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile skylight wire harness convenient to fix and detach, which comprises a wire harness body, wire harness connectors fixedly connected to two ends of the wire harness body, and a plurality of fixing mechanisms sleeved outside the wire harness body, wherein each fixing mechanism comprises a fixing plate and a fixing seat, a sleeve is fixedly arranged on the top end surface of each fixing plate, sliding grooves are formed in two sides of each fixing plate, sliding blocks are movably arranged in the sliding grooves, buckles are fixedly arranged at the bottoms of the sliding blocks, a containing groove is formed in the top end surface of each fixing seat, and clamping grooves matched with the corresponding buckles are formed in the inner bottom wall of each containing groove. When fixing or dismantling the wire harness through this structure, need not to accomplish fixedly or dismantle with the help of other instruments, it is more convenient to use, has greatly improved the efficiency of fixing and dismantling the wire harness installation, and avoids seting up more hole sites in the skylight frame inboard, has guaranteed the bulk strength of skylight frame.

title_en: Leakage protection device of charging pile
abstract_en: The utility model provides a leakage protection device of a charging pile, which belongs to the technical field of leakage prevention of charging piles, and comprises a charging pile body, wherein the charging pile body is relatively fixed on the ground through a stand column arranged below the charging pile body; the charging port is arranged on the charging pile body and extends along the front-back direction; the accommodating cavity is arranged in the charging pile body, is positioned at the rear side of the charging port and is communicated with the charging port; the sealing mechanism is arranged in the accommodating cavity to seal or open the charging port; inserting the charging head into the charging port, and driving the sealing mechanism to move by the triggering mechanism, so that the charging port is completely opened, and the charging head is connected with the charging pile body; after charging, under the effect of torsional spring, sealing mechanism will charge the mouth and shutoff, prevent that the mouth of charging from exposing outside, receive the wind to blow insolatedly or artificial destruction easily, appear the electric leakage, take place the problem of unexpected accident.

title_en: Colliery factory vehicle positioner
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of positioning devices and discloses a vehicle positioning device in a coal mine factory, which comprises a box body, a lathe and a chute, wherein a first support column is arranged in the box body, a motor is fixedly connected to the top end of the first support column, a first rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a first bevel gear is fixedly connected to the first rotating shaft, a second bevel gear is connected to the first bevel gear in a meshed manner, a second rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the middle part of the second bevel gear, the second rotating shaft penetrates through and is rotationally connected with the box body, an incomplete gear is fixedly connected to the middle part of the second rotating shaft, and a second support column is rotationally connected to one side, far away from the box body, of the second rotating shaft. According to the vehicle positioning device, the adjustment workload of the butt joint between the vehicle and the platform or between the vehicle and the carriage is reduced, the butt joint time is shortened, the structure is simple, the design is ingenious, the manufacturing cost is low, and the vehicle positioning device is suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: Control box and wide body car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control box and a wide vehicle, which relate to the field of wide vehicle control.

title_en: Multifunctional water environment monitoring buoy
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water environment monitoring and discloses a multifunctional water environment monitoring buoy which comprises a monitoring buoy body, wherein an electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged in the monitoring buoy body, a monitoring plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the electric telescopic rod, and a pH sensor, a dissolved oxygen sensor, a conductivity sensor, a temperature sensor, a turbidity sensor and a chlorophyll sensor are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the monitoring plate. According to the utility model, the buoy can monitor different substances in water quality, meanwhile, a user can observe the position of the buoy conveniently, the buoy is prevented from being lost, meanwhile, the detachable filter box is arranged, the cleaning and the replacement are convenient, suspended matters, algae and particulate matters are effectively prevented from directly contacting with the internal structure of the buoy and the sensor, the damage and the fault risk of the buoy are reduced, the service life of the buoy is prolonged, and the versatility and the accuracy of the buoy are improved.

title_en: Valve port sealing device and electronic expansion valve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a valve port sealing device and an electronic expansion valve, wherein the valve port sealing device comprises: a valve needle armature assembly and a seal assembly; the valve needle armature assembly is connected with the sealing assembly, the sealing assembly is used for opening or closing the valve port, and the valve needle armature assembly can move along the axial direction of the valve needle armature assembly so as to drive the sealing assembly to be close to or far away from the valve port; the sealing component comprises a sealing element and a shell, wherein the sealing element is accommodated in the shell, a notch is formed in the end part, far away from the valve needle armature component, of the shell, the sealing element is partially exposed out of the shell at the notch, and the distance between the bottom of the sealing element and the notch when the valve port is closed is smaller than the distance between the bottom of the sealing element and the notch when the valve port is opened. So configured, the housing is capable of providing kinetic energy to the seal member when opening the valve port, so that the seal assembly can also open or close the valve port without increasing the electromagnetic force of the electromagnetic coil, thereby reducing the coil size, reducing the installation space of the expansion valve, and further reducing the manufacturing cost.

title_en: Vacuum breaking structure of injection molding part
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of workpiece injection molding and processing, and discloses a vacuum breaking structure of an injection molding piece. The utility model has the beneficial effects of improving the production quality and the production efficiency of injection molding products and reducing the production cost.

title_en: Portable yacht driving console
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable yacht driving console which comprises a shell, wherein a rotating display screen is arranged on the shell, a plurality of screens are arranged on the display screen, a rotating device in rotating connection is arranged on the shell, the rotating device comprises an electric push rod, one end of the electric push rod is in rotating connection with the display screen, and a plurality of detachable rear cover plates are arranged on the back of the display screen. The pivoted display screen can avoid outside light reflection, avoids sunshine to disturb the image display on the display screen to effectively avoid the incident that the operator leads to because the display screen watches unclear. The display screen can rotate relative to the shell, so that the position of the display screen is adjusted to adapt to the viewing angle of the user, the whole body is not required to be moved or the position of the seat is not required to be changed, the operation is convenient, and the display screen has a large popularization value.

title_en: Embedded vehicle-mounted device easy to dissipate heat
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle navigation, in particular to an embedded vehicle-mounted device easy to dissipate heat, which comprises a mounting box, wherein a heat dissipation box is arranged on the left side and the right side of the mounting box, a blue light prevention film is fixedly connected inside the mounting box, a mounting groove is formed in the mounting box, two groups of support frames are fixedly connected inside the mounting box, damping mechanisms are arranged in the mounting groove and at positions corresponding to the two groups of support frames, a plurality of heat dissipation fins are fixedly connected inside the mounting groove and between the two groups of support frames, and a display screen is arranged inside the mounting groove and in front of the damping mechanisms and the heat dissipation fins; the damping mechanism comprises a damping block, the damping block is arranged in the mounting groove and positioned in front of the supporting frame, and the damping block is connected with the mounting box through a plurality of dampers.

title_en: A balanced suspension auxiliary fixtures for on assembly line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a balanced suspension auxiliary tool for an assembly line, which comprises a transferring underframe, wherein two groups of leaf spring supports are arranged on the transferring underframe, each group of leaf spring supports is used for positioning a leaf spring at one side of a balanced suspension, and a self-locking traction mechanism is arranged on the bottom surface of the transferring underframe; the structure of the self-locking traction mechanism is as follows: the device comprises a connecting plate, a traction block, a left limiting block, a right limiting block, a hinge pin shaft and a torsion spring, wherein the top of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a transferring underframe; the intelligent conveying device realizes intelligent conveying, liberates labor input, can flexibly and efficiently meet production requirements, and reduces production cost.

title_en: Wear mark for assisting tire wheel position switching of medium-large rigid-clamping engineering machinery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wear mark for assisting tire wheel position switching of a medium-large rigid-card engineering machine, which comprises a first film and a second film which are arranged in a tread, wherein the second film is positioned below the first film, the first film and the second film are circumferentially arranged in a circle, the width of the first film is the same as that of the tread, and the colors of the first film and the second film are different and are also different from that of tread rubber; when TKPH actually used on site of the tire is more than or equal to rated TKPH of the tire, D1 is more than 0 and less than or equal to 20 percent TD; d2 More than or equal to 35 percent of TD; when TKPH of the tire actually used on site is smaller than rated TKPH of the tire, D1 is larger than 0 and smaller than or equal to 30 percent TD; d2 More than or equal to 40 percent of TD; a plurality of grooves are respectively arranged on the tire sidewall corresponding to the first film and the second film at intervals. The first and second films with different colors are arranged up and down in the tire tread to serve as wear marks, so that the wear marks are convenient for workers to observe, and the wheel position is switched in time.

title_en: Carrier for motor home
abstract_en: The utility model provides a car as a house carrier, has effectively solved the easy problem of corroding, difficult maintenance of lift carrier; the device comprises two square tubes which are spliced with a trailer bar, wherein the square tubes are of an L-shaped structure, a fixed rod is connected between the square tubes, a fixed plate is arranged on the fixed rod, the fixed plate is provided with a worm gear and a worm, the worm is connected with a driving arm, a worm wheel is coaxially and threadedly connected with a lead screw, the lower end of the lead screw is fixedly provided with a carrying plate, a guide rod is arranged on the carrying plate, and a first guide tube sleeved outside the guide rod is fixedly arranged on the square tube; the utility model has simple and ingenious structure and convenient use, and the steel wire rope is replaced by the worm and gear structure, so that the transmission mechanism is simple, difficult to corrode and easy to maintain, and the rigid transmission structure enables the carrier to act as a parking support leg, thereby increasing the stability of the caravan.

title_en: Rectangular pipe for agricultural machinery frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery vehicle frames, in particular to a rectangular tube for an agricultural machinery vehicle frame, which comprises a rectangular tube body, wherein a reinforcing connecting plate is arranged at a contact position of the rectangular tube body, welding slots are arranged at opposite positions of four sides of the reinforcing connecting plate, bolt holes are formed in the rectangular tube body, limiting protrusions are arranged on the inner side of the rectangular tube body, an anti-corrosion coating is arranged on the inner side of the rectangular tube body, and supporting pieces are arranged in two adjacent rectangular tube bodies. According to the utility model, through the reinforcing connecting plate and the welding slot, when the rectangular pipe for the frame is used, the contact area of the rectangular pipe connecting position is increased through the reinforcing connecting plate, the welding strength of the rectangular pipe connecting position is improved, and the connecting strength of the rectangular pipe is ensured.

title_en: Life boat
abstract_en: The lifeboat comprises a lifeboat body, wherein an anti-collision pad is arranged at the head and tail positions of the lifeboat body, and a lifting handle is arranged at the head and tail positions of the lifeboat body; a front baffle plate is arranged at the front part in the boat body main body, the front baffle plate and the boat body main body form a front sealed cabin, and foam is filled in the front sealed cabin; a rear partition plate is arranged at the rear part in the boat body main body, a rear sealed cabin is formed by the rear partition plate and the boat body main body, and a water outlet and a water drain plug matched with the water outlet are arranged on the rear partition plate; the hull main part includes deck and hull, the deck middle part is equipped with the hatch, be equipped with the seat in the hatch, the rear portion intermediate position of deck is sunken, forms protruding edge all around, and protruding edge is equipped with a plurality of gripping handles, the front portion of deck is equipped with the life-saving rope. The lifeboat is designed based on the sea canoe, and has good maneuverability, good stability and strong loading capacity.

title_en: Bionic landing gear of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle bionic landing gear, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein dampers are fixedly connected to the front end, the middle part and the two sides of the rear end of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, connecting plates are fixedly connected to the bottom of the dampers, and the number of the connecting plates is three; according to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the damper, the connecting plates, the threaded sleeves, the pull rods and the supporting rods are arranged, the unmanned aerial vehicle body is matched with the damper and the springs, and the three connecting plates are also supported by the six supporting rods, so that a multi-foot biological bionic structure is formed, better support is provided when the unmanned aerial vehicle body descends, meanwhile, each connecting plate is matched with the damper and the springs to buffer the unmanned aerial vehicle body well, according to different outdoor terrains, the damper and the springs adapt to the heights of terrains where the supporting rods are located, and therefore the situation that the unmanned aerial vehicle body inclines or even turns on one's side due to uneven outdoor terrains is reduced.

title_en: Anti-eccentric wear rubber tire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-eccentric wear rubber tire, and particularly relates to the field of tires. The utility model provides an anti-eccentric wear rubber tire, which comprises a tread, a tire shoulder and a tire side, wherein the tread, the tire shoulder and the tire side form the surface of the tire, a first longitudinal groove, a second longitudinal groove and a third longitudinal groove are sequentially formed in the tread from left to right, a first pattern block is arranged between the first longitudinal groove and the second longitudinal groove, a second pattern block is arranged between the second longitudinal groove and the third longitudinal groove, pattern grooves are formed in the first pattern block and the second pattern block, the pattern grooves comprise a plurality of pattern grooves, the pattern grooves are uniformly arranged on the first pattern block and the second pattern block, anti-wear steel rings are arranged on two sides of the tread, and the diameter of the outermost circle of each anti-wear steel ring is smaller than the diameter of the tread.

title_en: Rescue assembly and transportation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue assembly, which comprises a mounting seat, a height adjusting mechanism and a movable wheel, wherein the mounting seat is used for being detachably connected with a transport vehicle, the height adjusting mechanism is arranged on the mounting seat, the movable wheel is arranged on the height adjusting mechanism, the height adjusting mechanism can be switched between a rescue position and a preparation position, and the distance of the movable wheel protruding from the mounting seat in the rescue position is larger than the distance of the movable wheel protruding from the mounting seat in the preparation position. The utility model further provides a transportation device comprising the rescue assembly.

title_en: Night parking delay closing circuit for vehicle headlight
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automatic switching of vehicle lamplight, and particularly relates to a night delay closing circuit of a vehicle headlight. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the following advantages: the master control chip for controlling the driving operation by utilizing the existing voice recognition is improved on the basis of the existing circuit, the function of stopping the vehicle headlight at night in a delayed manner can be realized, the operation is convenient, the vehicle headlight is realized by software on the basis of the original vehicle headlight, and the cost is not increased.

title_en: Aromatherapy machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aromatherapy machine, which comprises a bottle with a bottle opening, an upper cover in threaded connection with the outside of the bottle opening, and a fan arranged in the upper cover, wherein a cotton core sleeve is arranged in the bottle opening, a liquid suction cotton core with one end extending into the bottle is arranged in the middle of the cotton core sleeve in a penetrating manner up and down, the other end of the liquid suction cotton core is arranged below the fan, a fragrance dispersing hole communicated with an air outlet of the fan is arranged at the top of the upper cover, an air inlet communicated with an air inlet of the fan is also arranged at the bottom or the side surface of the upper cover, a lamp panel irradiating towards the bottle is arranged in the upper cover, and a light guide surface for light transmission is arranged at the bottom of the upper cover. According to the utility model, the fan is directly arranged in the aromatherapy machine, and the air inside and outside the aromatherapy machine is circulated by utilizing the power of the fan, so that the fragrance dispersing effect of the aromatherapy machine is improved, and the lamp panel irradiating towards the bottle is additionally arranged inside, so that the lamplight effect is formed, and the novel, fashionable and attractive lamplight effect is realized.

title_en: Wire harness assembly for automobile front bumper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wire harness assembly for an automobile front bumper, which comprises two circular plate pieces, wherein the outer ends of the two circular plate pieces are fixedly connected with a plurality of C-shaped ring plates, a stretching folding strip is fixedly connected between the two C-shaped ring plates corresponding to the front and the back, openings are formed in the stretching folding strip and the side edges of the C-shaped ring plates, a wire body is arranged at the inner end of the C-shaped ring plate, and a joint is fixedly connected at the front end of the wire body.

title_en: Self-unloading ship cockpit and self-unloading ship
