abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-unloading ship cockpit, which comprises a lower deck, an upper deck, stairs, balconies and guardrails, wherein the lower deck is used for a restaurant and a bedroom, the upper deck is used for a driving space, the floor of the upper deck is provided with a stair opening, the stairs are arranged at the stair opening and extend from the floor of the lower deck to the floor of the upper deck, beds are respectively arranged at two sides of the stair opening in the upper deck, a driving control table is arranged in the upper deck and in front of the beds, a corridor is formed between the beds and the driving control table, transparent windows are respectively arranged on the upper deck and in front of and behind the driving control table for a driver to observe road conditions in front of and behind, balconies and guardrails are arranged around the upper deck, driving doors are arranged on walls at the left side and the right side of the upper deck, and the space in the upper deck is communicated with the balcony through the driving doors. The self-unloading ship cockpit is reasonable in arrangement, and is beneficial to improving the use convenience and the comfort.

title_en: Leg support structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a leg support structure which comprises a fixed part and a rotating part, wherein the rotating part is rotationally connected with the fixed part, an elastic piece is arranged between the fixed part and the rotating part, one elastic end of the elastic piece is arranged on the fixed part, the other elastic end of the elastic piece is arranged on the rotating part, and when a user places a leg on the rotating part to press the rotating part to rotate relative to the fixed part, the elastic piece is suitable for elastic deformation to generate elastic restoring force to act on the rotating part so as to realize the support of the leg of the user by the rotating part. The leg support structure only comprises a fixing part, a rotating part and an elastic piece arranged between the fixing part and the rotation, through elastic deformation of the elastic piece, the rotating part can rotate to different angles according to the external force applied by the legs of the user so as to support the legs of the user, and the leg support structure has good supporting effect and simple overall structure.

title_en: Brick transferring trolley
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a brick transferring trolley, which relates to the technical field of transferring trolleys and comprises a base frame, wherein two handles are arranged at one end of the base frame, side plates are arranged at two sides of the other end of the base frame, rollers are arranged at one sides of the side plates, mounting plates are arranged at one sides of the side plates, mounting frames are arranged at one sides of the mounting plates, a placing plate is arranged above the two mounting frames, and lifting assemblies are arranged at one sides of the mounting frames. According to the utility model, the placing plate is supported by the mounting frame, after the device reaches a destination, the mounting frame is lowered until the supporting feet at the bottom end of the placing plate contact the ground, then the mounting frame is moved away to two sides, so that the mounting frame is no longer matched with the placing plate, the placing plate is stably placed on the ground, and the brick is positioned above the placing plate, so that the unloading of the brick can be rapidly completed, and the placing plate can be reused after the brick is taken out.

title_en: Wheel suspension and shuttle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent storage logistics conveying equipment, in particular to a wheel suspension system and a shuttle, wherein the wheel suspension system comprises a support, a handle, a rod, a sliding bearing seat, a guide shaft, a spring, a bearing fixing seat and a bearing clamping rail seat, wherein the handle, the rod, the sliding bearing seat and the guide shaft are used for installing wheels; the shuttle comprises a vehicle body and wheels, wherein the wheels are arranged on the vehicle body through a wheel suspension system. Compared with the prior art, the self-adaptive track height difference of the wheels is realized through the suspension system, vibration and noise are reduced, the goods are stably transported, and meanwhile, the cost of the frame structure of the vehicle body and the whole space of the vehicle body are saved.

title_en: Novel high-speed railway EMUs outer windscreen structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rail transit, in particular to a novel high-speed rail motor train unit outer windshield structure, which comprises a windshield assembly body, wherein two ends of the windshield assembly body are detachably connected with a carriage through a connecting structure, the connecting structure comprises a plurality of mounting seats fixedly arranged on the carriage and a plurality of mounting inserts in plug-in fit with the mounting seats, each mounting insert comprises two limiting blocks fixedly arranged on the windshield assembly body, a fixing rod fixedly connected with the two limiting blocks and two buckles movably connected on the fixing rod, a spring surrounding the fixing rod is further arranged between the two buckles, and clamping holes matched with the buckles are formed in the mounting seats. According to the utility model, through the installation grafting arranged on the windshield assembly and the installation seat matched with the windshield assembly arranged on the train, the windshield assembly is simply and rapidly assembled by a worker during installation, and the problems that bolts are required to be screwed during traditional installation and the installation efficiency of the windshield is reduced are solved.

title_en: Antitheft electricity changing cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of battery changing cabinets, and provides an anti-theft battery changing cabinet which comprises a battery changing cabinet body, wherein a controller is arranged on the battery changing cabinet body, a battery changing bin is further arranged on the battery changing cabinet body, a cabinet door is hinged to one side of the battery changing bin, batteries are movably arranged in the battery changing bin, grooves are formed in two sides of the inner wall of the battery changing bin, a driving piece is arranged in the grooves, a rotating shaft is arranged at the output end of the driving piece, a gear is sleeved on the rotating shaft, the gear is in meshed connection with a rack, and a movable plate is fixedly connected with the rack.

title_en: Charging pile capable of being charged for long distance
abstract_en: The utility model provides a charging pile capable of charging in a long distance, which comprises: the charging pile comprises a charging pile shell and a charging cable assembly, wherein a supporting piece is arranged on the lower side surface of the charging pile shell, a square groove is formed in the right side surface of the charging pile shell in a recessed mode, and an operation platform is arranged in the square groove. Through setting up charging cable assembly, because the length that charging cable body can be rolled up at the outside surface of rolling spare makes its charging cable body is great increases to can arrange more nimble charging pile and by the distance between the battery charging outfit, can provide the service of charging for the battery charging outfit far away from the charging pile, improve charging outfit's availability and charging distance, through setting up baffle assembly, can be preliminary prevent that the rainwater from dripping to plug or cable, like this can effectively reduce the interference of rainwater to the normal work of charging pile, reduce the trouble risk that electrical component wets and leads to.

title_en: Transportation and lifting device with automatic crucible loading and unloading and automatic crucible transportation functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transportation lifting device with automatic crucible loading and unloading and automatic crucible transportation functions, which relates to the technical field of crucible transportation and comprises an electric ground flat car and a bracket arranged on the electric ground flat car, wherein a rotating seat is rotatably arranged at the end part of an extension frame through a rotating shaft, a transmission rod and a compression rod are fixedly connected to the outer surface of the rotating seat respectively, one end of a push-pull rod, which is far away from the transmission rod, is rotatably connected with a sliding frame through the rotating shaft, a gear meshed with an outer gear is fixedly arranged at the output end of a first servo motor, and a screw nut fixedly connected with a connecting frame is arranged on the outer transmission of a screw rod. The utility model can realize the purpose of automatic loading and unloading of the crucible, thereby improving the automation degree of the device, reducing the dependence of the taking, loading and unloading of the crucible on manual work, reducing the operation amount of manual participation, improving the transportation and carrying efficiency of the crucible to a certain extent, and realizing the purpose of flexibly adjusting the height and the orientation angle of the crucible according to the actual use requirement.

title_en: Car membrane and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a car film and a vehicle, wherein the car film comprises a wear-resistant coating, a self-repairing coating, an ultraviolet absorbing layer, a first adhesive layer, a base film layer and a second adhesive layer which are sequentially laminated; wherein the second adhesive layer is configured to adhere to an outer surface of the vehicle. When the vehicle film is used, the whole vehicle film can be attached to the surface of a vehicle through the adhesion effect of the second adhesive layer, and the operation is convenient, simple and quick. The base film layer has the function of supporting the whole car film, so that the deformation of the car film can be reduced; the wear-resistant coating is arranged on the outer surface of the automobile film, has excellent weather resistance, high temperature resistance and wear resistance, has an excellent self-repairing function, can be automatically repaired for slight scratch, abrasion and bruise, has excellent anti-fouling performance, and is easy to clean; the ultraviolet absorbing coating has a good ultraviolet aging resistance function so as to increase the ultraviolet aging resistance of the whole automobile film; through the lamination cooperation of the film layers, the environment adaptability of the car film can be improved.

title_en: Bushing with anti-falling structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bushings, in particular to a bushing with an anti-falling structure, which comprises an inner ring and a rubber sleeve, wherein the outer side of the inner ring is adhered with the rubber sleeve, the surface of the rubber sleeve is fixedly provided with an outer ring, two sides of the outer ring are respectively provided with an anti-falling assembly, and the fixing rings are symmetrically attached to the surfaces of two sides of the outer ring. This bush with anti-drop structure dock butt joint board and butt joint groove for butt joint groove constitutes sealing state with the sealing washer, thereby makes the rubber sleeve be difficult for corroding with ponding, fluid and snow melt agent contact, makes the rubber sleeve of bush be difficult for broken breaking away from, dock stop ring and mounting groove, makes stop ring restriction in stop bolt's the outside, makes dirty such as mud be difficult for blockking up the mounting hole of solid fixed ring and the mounting hole of go-between, is difficult for influencing follow-up stop bolt's dismantlement, makes the bush be convenient for change and prevent breaking away from the subassembly and protect the rubber sleeve.

title_en: Ship instrument panel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ship instrument panel. The instrument panel of the ship comprises: a gyroscope; the method comprises the steps of determining rudder angle information, balance angle information and speed information according to triaxial acceleration information and triaxial angular speed information of a ship; a CAN transceiver; the rudder angle information, the balance angle information and the speed information are respectively sent to a rudder angle table, a balance table and a speed table; a rudder angle gauge; the gyroscope is in communication connection with the rudder angle gauge through the CAN transceiver; a rudder angle gauge configured to display rudder angle information; a balance table; the gyroscope is in communication connection with the balance meter through the CAN transceiver; a balance table configured to display balance angle information; a speedometer; the gyroscope is in communication connection with the speedometer through the CAN transceiver; a speedometer configured to display speed information; according to the scheme, the gyroscope is used for realizing high-precision measurement of the ship position, and meanwhile the problems that in the prior art, the precision of measuring various information by adopting various resistance sensors is low, wiring from various resistance sensors to various instruments is complex and the cost is high are avoided.

title_en: Transport trolley for limiting space area in nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transport trolley for limiting a space area in a nuclear power plant, which comprises a moving assembly, a driving system, a frame and an auxiliary bracket, wherein the moving assembly is arranged on the frame; the auxiliary bracket is detachably arranged on the frame; the moving assembly comprises at least two driven wheel groups which are longitudinally arranged along the frame and respectively connected with the frame and are composed of a plurality of driven wheels, and at least 1 driving wheel group which is composed of a plurality of driving wheels; the driven wheel sets are arranged at least at two ends of the frame, and the driving wheel set is arranged in the middle of the frame; the driving system comprises driving motors and at least one battery, wherein the number of the driving motors is matched with that of the driving wheels in the driving wheel sets, and the driving motors are electrically connected with the batteries; each driving wheel is connected with a driving motor; the grounding area of each driving wheel is larger than or equal to 44000mm  2 ; the ground contact area of each driven wheel of the driven wheel group is larger than or equal to 19800mm  2 . The transport trolley is not limited by factory building space and bearing, and can normally transport a motor/hydraulic coupler.

title_en: Anti-falling structure for electric automobile charging plug
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric automobiles and discloses an anti-falling structure for an electric automobile charging plug, which comprises a main body mechanism, a clamping mechanism and a detection mechanism, wherein the clamping mechanism is positioned on the upper surface of the main body mechanism, and the detection mechanism is positioned on the upper surface of the main body mechanism; the main body mechanism comprises a lower circular shaft, the upper surface of the lower circular shaft is fixedly connected with a main body connecting shaft, the lower surface of the main body connecting shaft is fixedly connected with a handle, the front surface of the main body connecting shaft is fixedly connected with a first sleeve shaft, the front surface of the first sleeve shaft is fixedly connected with a second sleeve shaft, and the wire harness pipeline is arranged below the lower circular shaft through the handle which is arranged on the front surface of the lower circular shaft in the main body mechanism and the lower surface of the main body connecting shaft.

title_en: Wire harness fixing device of mining dump truck
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wire harness fixing device of a mining dump truck, which relates to the technical field of wire harness fixing, and comprises a truck frame, wherein a wire harness support is arranged on one side of the truck frame, an upper rubber tube bank and a lower rubber tube bank are respectively arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the wire harness support, wire harness holes are respectively formed in the side surfaces of the upper rubber tube bank and the lower rubber tube bank, an upper cover plate is arranged on the upper part of the upper rubber tube bank, a lower cover plate is arranged on the lower part of the lower rubber tube bank, the upper cover plate, the upper rubber tube bank, the wire harness support, the lower rubber tube bank and the lower cover plate are connected and fixed into a whole through fastening bolts and fastening nuts, a wire harness is arranged on the upper rubber tube bank and the lower rubber tube bank above and below the wire harness support, the upper cover plate and the lower cover plate are matched and are fixed on the upper side and the lower side of the wire harness support through the fastening bolts and the fastening nuts, the influence of vibration energy of the truck frame on the wire harness is reduced, the friction force of the wire harness corrugated pipe is increased, the movement in the axial direction of the wire harness is reduced, and the protection of the wire harness is improved.

title_en: Back door structure and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a back door structure and a vehicle, comprising: the device comprises an inner plate, an outer plate, a first supporting structure, a second supporting structure and a third supporting structure, wherein the first supporting structure, the second supporting structure and the inner plate are integrated into a whole, and the third supporting structure and the outer plate are integrated into a whole; wherein, the inner panel is including relative medial surface and the lateral surface that sets up, the inner panel is equipped with a plurality of lightening holes that set up along the length direction interval of inner panel, first bearing structure, second bearing structure all are located the medial surface of inner panel, one of a plurality of lightening holes is close to the one end of first bearing structure and sets up, the one end of second bearing structure is close to another of a plurality of lightening holes and sets up, first bearing structure, the one end and the planking welding of medial surface are kept away from to second bearing structure, third bearing structure is connected with the second bearing structure. The back door structure of this scheme assembly efficiency is high, with low costs and have sufficient rigidity and intensity.

title_en: Protective frame device, container and pick-up
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protective frame device, a container and a pick-up, wherein the protective frame device comprises a protective frame and a locking assembly, and the protective frame is provided with a fastening end; the locking assembly comprises a lock tongue, a lock body and a locking piece, wherein the locking piece is arranged on the container, the lock body is arranged at the fastening end, and one end of the lock tongue is fixed with a lock cylinder arranged on the lock body, so that the lock tongue has a locking state and an unlocking state; in the locking state, the lock tongue is locked with the locking piece so as to limit the protective frame and the container to be released; in the unlocking state, the lock tongue is separated from the locking piece, so that the protection frame can be loosened with the container. The technical scheme of the utility model can improve the dismounting efficiency of the protective frame.

title_en: Novel car side footboard
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel vehicle-side pedal which comprises a pedal body, wherein one side of the pedal body is of a stepped structure, a metal ornamental plate is arranged on the stepped top surface of the pedal body, a first ornamental plate and a second ornamental plate are inserted into the top surface of the metal ornamental plate, a framework is fixedly embedded into the bottom surface of the pedal body, a plurality of supports are arranged on the bottom surface of the framework, blind rivet nuts are riveted on the bottom surface of the framework, bolts are connected inside the supports, and the top ends of the bolts are connected inside the blind rivet nuts. According to the utility model, the plurality of brackets arranged on the bottom surface of the framework are arranged on the automobile body, the U-shaped structural brackets and the mounting plate are adopted for fixing, and the fixing strength is improved through the connecting plate and the clamping plate, so that the safety of the pedal arranged on the automobile body is improved; the structural strength of the pedal can be increased by adopting the metal decorative plate and the decorative strip, the friction force of the pedal surface can be effectively increased, and the skid resistance of the pedal is improved.

title_en: Storage device for automobile seat and automobile
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of automobile interiors, and provides a storage device for an automobile seat and an automobile, wherein the storage device for the automobile seat comprises: the storage box is provided with mounting positions on the side walls at two sides respectively; the support rod assembly comprises a fixing section which is fixedly connected with the seat connecting support, and the support rod assembly is partially accommodated in the installation position so that the storage box can slide relative to the support rod assembly. According to the technical scheme, parts required by sliding fit of the storage box and the automobile seat can be reduced, so that production cost is reduced.

title_en: Trunk universal wheel convenient to change
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trunk universal wheel convenient to replace, which is characterized in that a connecting frame is fixedly connected with a transverse bracket, the lower end of the transverse bracket is connected with a rotating seat, the rotating seat is rotationally connected with a supporting wheel frame, the supporting wheel frame is connected with a supporting wheel through a bearing, and the trunk universal wheel convenient to replace is improved in the prior art by arranging a replaceable rotating seat, a supporting wheel frame and a supporting wheel structure.

title_en: Drawing tea table for limousine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a drawing tea table for a limo, and belongs to the technical field of limo. The utility model provides a pull tea table for limousine, includes tea table main part and supporting table leg, the tea table main part includes connecting block, first tea table board, tea table, pull board and the heating platen of fixed connection in tea table one side, the supporting table leg has chassis, fixed cover, telescopic link, fixedly connected with telescopic link on the chassis, the outside cover of telescopic link is equipped with fixed cover, the upper end fixedly connected with fixed plate of telescopic link, fixedly connected with connecting block on the fixed plate to fix fixed plate and connecting block through limit bolt; the tea table is characterized in that a first tea table plate is fixedly connected to the upper portion of the connecting block, a heating table plate and a tea making table are fixedly connected to the first tea table plate, and the heating table plate is arranged above one side of the first tea table plate. The utility model has the advantages of good practicability and convenient storage.

title_en: Table and chair robot and intelligent table and chair system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a table chair robot, including intelligent movement chassis and the desk that can autonomous navigation remove, the desk includes the support frame, the fly frame, the table, third adjustment mechanism and fourth adjustment mechanism, the support frame is connected on intelligent movement chassis, the fly frame is followed first direction movably and is connected on the support frame, the table is followed the second direction movably and is connected on the fly frame, third adjustment mechanism connects between fly frame and support frame, and be used for driving fly frame and table along first direction removal, fourth adjustment mechanism connects between fly frame and table, be used for driving the table along the second direction removal, first direction has an contained angle with the second direction. The table and chair robot can autonomously move and transfer the table, and the table plate can move, so that the use experience is good. The utility model also relates to an intelligent table and chair system.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle landing gear of adaptable complicated topography
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle landing gear adaptable to complex terrains, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle; the connecting mechanisms are arranged on the bottom surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and N are more than or equal to 3; the supporting mechanism is arranged on the connecting mechanism; one end of the buffer mechanism is arranged on the connecting mechanism, and the other end of the buffer mechanism is connected with the supporting mechanism; when supporting mechanism and bottom surface contact, supporting mechanism rotates on coupling mechanism to accomplish the extrusion action to buffer gear, just supporting mechanism takes place deformation with the contact surface on ground, in order to accomplish the laminating action, and whole device is owing to supporting mechanism and buffer gear's design, can the automatic adjustment be in order to adapt to uneven topography, this makes unmanned aerial vehicle can both stabilize on various complicated topography and rises and falls.

title_en: Crumple mechanism of automobile air conditioner controller button
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crumple mechanism of an automobile air conditioner controller button, which comprises a shell, wherein a control knob is arranged on one side of the shell, two through grooves are symmetrically formed on one side of the shell, which is far away from the control knob, of the shell, crumple mechanisms are arranged in the two through grooves, each crumple mechanism comprises a connecting plate fixedly connected with the inner wall of the shell and a fixing plate connected with a vehicle body, a first spring is arranged between the connecting plate and the fixing plate, and two ends of the first spring respectively prop against opposite sides of the connecting plate and the fixing plate; according to the utility model, after the shell is collided by the first spring, the shell is pressed to approach the fixed plate, the connecting plate is driven to approach the fixed plate, the connecting plate and the fixed plate which approach each other can squeeze the first spring, and the impact on passengers is gradually reduced by the resilience force generated when the first spring contracts, so that the injury on the passengers is reduced.

title_en: Adjustable display screen
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of display equipment, and particularly relates to an adjustable display screen, a console main body, wherein a storage groove is formed in the surface of the console main body, a folding support is rotationally arranged in the storage groove, one end of the folding support is rotationally connected with the bottom of the storage groove, the other end of the folding support is rotationally provided with the display screen, and the display screen is in clearance fit with the storage groove. The display screen is supported on the control console main body through the folding bracket, the folding bracket is arranged between the control console main body and the display screen and is provided with a plurality of rotatable connection points and rotating joints which axially rotate, so that the display screen can be adjusted in height and angle in a large range, and therefore, the display screen can be conveniently operated by a person when a vehicle travels, and meanwhile, the user can observe more conveniently.

title_en: Clothing wholesale transport vechicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clothing wholesale transport vehicle, and relates to the technical field of clothing wholesale. The clothing wholesale transport vehicle comprises a transport vehicle, a first box body, an auxiliary assembly and a fixing assembly, wherein the first box body is arranged on the transport vehicle, a second box body is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the first box body, and a group of rectangular cavities are formed between the first box body and the second box body. The utility model discloses a sawtooth slot, barrel, spring, stretching rod and trapezoidal inserted block's cooperation is used, can adjust the height of framework and riser, framework and riser can be placed in the rectangle cavity, also can pull out and then increase its accommodation space, can retrieve in the rectangle cavity when not needing to use, avoid occupation in space, through the cooperation use of rotation post, mounting panel, lead screw and holding down plate, can compress tightly fixedly in the dress that is located the top, the condition that drops appears in avoiding the transportation, causes the dress to become dirty or lose.

title_en: Electric transfer trolley for disinfection supply center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric transfer vehicle for a disinfection supply center, which comprises a bottom plate and a driving motor, wherein a group of wheels are symmetrically arranged on the front side and the rear side of the lower end surface of the bottom plate respectively, the driving motor is connected with the group of wheels on the front side, the electric transfer vehicle also comprises a box body, a stud, a transverse bracket and a storage basket, the box body is arranged on the upper end surface of the bottom plate, the stud is vertically arranged in the box body, the lower end of the stud is fixedly connected with the box body, a plurality of sleeves are connected with the stud in a threaded manner, the sleeves are arranged at intervals up and down along the stud, the transverse bracket is sleeved on the stud, the sleeves are blocked at the lower end of the transverse bracket, and the storage basket is arranged on the transverse bracket and is in sliding connection with the transverse bracket; the distance between the upper layer of object placing basket and the lower layer of object placing basket can be adjusted through the sleeves which are connected with the studs in a threaded mode, and then the devices with different heights are adapted, so that more devices can be loaded and transported as soon as possible, and the transportation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Vehicle body rear corner window assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle body rear corner window assembly and a vehicle, wherein the vehicle body rear corner window assembly is suitable for being mounted on a vehicle body side wall assembly and comprises: the rear corner window glass, the rubber coating frame and the decoration piece are suitable for being connected with the vehicle body side wall assembly; the rubber coating frame is arranged on the periphery of the rear angle window glass; the decoration is established on the encapsulation frame, and the decoration is located one side of rear angle window glass and with rear angle window glass interval arrangement, wherein, the decoration parcel encapsulation frame's at least a portion. According to the vehicle body rear corner window assembly provided by the embodiment of the utility model, the decoration is arranged on the encapsulation frame, so that the decoration and the rear corner window glass are arranged at intervals, the height of the protruding rear corner window glass of the decoration can be reduced, the outer surface of the decoration and the outer surface of the rear corner window glass are approximately positioned on the same plane as much as possible, and wind resistance and wind noise are reduced.

title_en: Portable vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle library
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable vehicle-mounted Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) which comprises a hangar, wherein cover plates are arranged on two sides of the top of the hangar, an opening and closing mechanism is fixedly connected to the front end of the inner side of each cover plate, a fixed plate is fixedly connected to the front end of the bottom of the inner wall of the hangar, a motor is fixedly connected to the front end of the bottom of the inner wall of the hangar, belt pulleys are movably connected to two sides of the front face of each fixed plate, belts are movably connected to the surfaces of the belt pulleys, and the front face of each belt pulley is fixedly connected with the output end of the motor. According to the utility model, the belt pulley is driven by the motor to rotate, the belt pulley drives the positive and negative tooth screw rods on two sides to rotate through the belt, the positive and negative tooth screw rods drive the screw sleeves to mutually approach, and the screw sleeves drive the clamping rods to mutually approach, so that the clamping rods fix the supporting legs, the large unmanned aerial vehicle can be stored, a user can conveniently fix the large unmanned aerial vehicle, and the normal use of the user is ensured.

title_en: Independent double-air-duct rotational molding ceiling with built-in air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides an independent double-air-duct rotational molding ceiling with an air conditioner inside, which relates to the technical field of agricultural machine accessories and comprises an agricultural machine ceiling, wherein a protective box is arranged at the bottom of the agricultural machine ceiling, a mounting frame is arranged on the outer wall of the protective box, a rainwater storage box is arranged at the top of the agricultural machine ceiling, a mounting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the protective box and the inner side of the mounting frame, a movable net door is arranged on the outer wall of the protective box, a limiting mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the mounting frame, the air conditioner is arranged inside the protective box, a pipeline mechanism is arranged at the top of the air conditioner, a screw is arranged inside the protective box, the mounting mechanism comprises sliding plates symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the protective box, a plug rod penetrates through the sliding plates and is inserted into the mounting frame, and the limiting mechanism comprises a fixing frame which is arranged on the outer wall of the mounting frame and is opposite to the plug rod. The utility model has the advantages of convenient stable support and installation of the rotational moulding ceiling, convenient rainwater prevention for the air conditioner, and the like.

title_en: Automatic control system of pneumatic car lifting jack of railway vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic control system of a pneumatic car lifting jack of a railway vehicle, which comprises the following components: the car lifting jack piston rod, safe bolt still includes: the device comprises a diffusion laser ranging module, an infrared curtain sensing module, a video monitoring module and an automatic control module; the diffuse laser ranging module is used for accurately measuring and controlling the lifting height and the lifting speed of the piston rod of the car lifting machine and the inserting and withdrawing state of the safety bolt in real time, automatically comparing and measuring the lifting height and the lifting speed of the piston rod of the two groups of car lifting machines at one end of the same maintenance platform, ensuring the lifting synchronization and the height consistency, and simultaneously monitoring the inserting and withdrawing working state of the safety bolt in real time. According to the utility model, the working state of the safety bolt is monitored in real time through the arrangement, the actions of preventing operators from missing insertion and withdrawing and monitoring and early warning the operators from entering the forbidden area in a illegal way are avoided, the personal safety is ensured, the whole process of field operation is monitored, and the technical level of automation, informatization and digitization of the whole system is greatly improved.

title_en: Novel two-sided car side door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel side door of a two-sided vehicle, and relates to the technical field of logistics turnover transportation equipment. A novel side door of a two-sided vehicle comprises a side door and a shaft sleeve assembly; the shaft sleeve assembly comprises a first shaft sleeve and a second shaft sleeve which are mutually spliced; the first shaft sleeve vertically penetrates through the first hole, one side of the first shaft sleeve is provided with a channel communicated with the first hole, and the inner side of the channel is provided with a limiting notch connected with the first hole; a second hole II is vertically penetrated through the second sleeve, one side of the second sleeve is fixedly connected with a connecting block, and the outer side of the connecting block is provided with a limiting block; the connecting block of the second shaft sleeve is arranged on the channel of the first shaft sleeve in a penetrating way, and the limiting block of the second shaft sleeve is limited on the limiting notch of the first shaft sleeve. The utility model designs the side door of the two-sided vehicle, which can be normally assembled on the two-sided vehicle on the basis of not changing the structure of the existing two-sided vehicle, does not influence the functional use of the existing two-sided vehicle, and can avoid the situation that articles fall off from the side surface of the two-sided vehicle by adding the side door of the two-sided vehicle.

title_en: Transfer device for mineral casting machine tool assembly
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of casting processing, in particular to a transfer device for mineral casting machine tool assembly, which comprises a frame body and a plurality of feed boxes, wherein the feed boxes are stacked on the frame body; the stable structure comprises a block groove, a connecting block, a pressing plate, a T-shaped screw rod and a screw groove, wherein the block groove is formed in the inner wall of the frame body, the connecting block is arranged in the block groove, the pressing plate is connected to the lower end face of the connecting block, the T-shaped screw rod is inserted into the block groove, and the screw groove is formed in the connecting block. By arranging the stable structure, the utility model can effectively enlarge the contact area between the transfer device and the ground when the transfer device is placed after the transfer device is moved to the area, effectively improve the stability when the transfer device is placed, and solve the problem that the existing clamping and locking assembly which is self-contained by the moving wheel is unstable to cause the placement to displace when the transfer device is assembled and disassembled, thereby not influencing the assembling and disassembling progress.

title_en: Wind power transportation ship
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wind power transportation ship, which comprises a ship body, wherein a positioning groove is formed in the outer wall surface of the ship body, a battery unit is contacted in the positioning groove, a lifting device is arranged on one side of the ship body, a plurality of charging ends are formed in the outer wall surfaces of two sides of the ship body, a sliding groove and a lifting through hole are formed in the surface of the positioning groove, a positioning support rod is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding manner, the positioning support rod extends out of the sliding groove, and a cavity is formed in the bottom of the positioning groove. This transportation wind-powered electricity generation boats and ships through set up the constant head tank at the boats and ships body surface, and through setting up locating component in the constant head tank for when hoisting accessory is hanging battery unit, through placing battery unit into the constant head tank in, can correct battery unit through locating component, need not to assist through many personnel can accomplish the correction to battery unit.

title_en: Simple European standard power supply socket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of new energy electric vehicles, in particular to a simple European standard power supply socket which comprises a rubber shell, a connecting plate, a circuit board and a plurality of terminals, wherein the terminals are arranged on the connecting plate; the rubber shell is arranged on one side of the connecting plate and is fixedly connected with the connecting plate, a plurality of hollow inserting columns are arranged in the rubber shell, one end of the terminal is arranged in the inserting columns, a sealing ring is sleeved outside the terminal, and the sealing ring is tightly contacted with the inner side wall of the inserting columns; the circuit board is arranged on one side, far away from the rubber shell, of the connecting plate, assembly holes corresponding to the terminals one by one are formed in the circuit board, and the terminals are arranged in the assembly holes and welded with the circuit board. The utility model solves the problem that the existing European standard power supply socket is not suitable for the small-size charging pile.

title_en: Dual-air door temperature regulating system with independent control of cold air and warm air
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cold and hot air independently controlled double-air-door temperature regulating system, which comprises an air conditioning box body, wherein a cold air channel and a hot air channel are arranged in the air conditioning box body, an evaporator is arranged in the cold air channel, a heating core body is arranged in the hot air channel, a cold air door is rotatably arranged in the cold air channel, a hot air door is arranged in the hot air channel, two groups of driving components are arranged on the air conditioning box body and are respectively used for driving the cold air door and the hot air door to rotate, and under the action of the two groups of driving components, the cold air door and the hot air door can independently control the opening and the closing of the cold air channel and the hot air channel. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: through two independent control's air door, can realize the function to quick heating up or rapid cooling, two independent air doors are short for traditional single fan-shaped air door, and the power arm that rotates, this makes two air doors close inseparabler, and then guarantees the whole gas tightness of air conditioner.

title_en: D post inner panel with butt joint anti-migration structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a D-pillar inner plate with a butt joint anti-offset structure, and relates to the technical field of D-pillar inner plates. This D post inner panel with butt joint anti-migration structure, when needs carry out butt joint installation with D post and D post inner panel, can insert the butt joint groove through the spliced pole with D post in, then drive the connecting block through spacing spring and remove to one side in the expansion tank, make the connecting block drive the clamping strip and carry out the centre gripping to the spliced pole of D post, in the butt joint, the bracing piece of D post inserts in the mounting hole, insert the mounting hole with spacing bolt afterwards, carry out spacingly to the bracing piece of D post, in other bracing pieces reinsertion jack of D post, be convenient for D post and D post inner panel carry out quick butt joint installation, stop gear and spacing bolt improve the stability of butt joint, prevent that the butt joint from taking place the skew.

title_en: Vacuum booster brake device for tractor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural vehicle manufacturing, in particular to a vacuum power-assisted braking device of a tractor, wherein a vacuum power-assisted component of the vacuum power-assisted braking device enables a braking execution component to perform braking operation, after the braking operation is finished, a pedal is loosened, and a spring component enables the pedal to reset rapidly; including frame, running-board, riser, pivot, diesel engine intake pipe and opening, the frame top is provided with the diesel engine, the diesel engine inlet end is provided with the diesel engine intake pipe, be provided with the opening on the frame, the frame bottom is provided with two sets of risers, it is provided with the pivot to rotate between two sets of risers, be provided with the running-board in the pivot, the top of running-board extends to the frame top through the opening, still include spring assembly, link assembly, vacuum assistance assembly and braking execution assembly, the frame bottom is provided with vacuum assistance assembly, vacuum assistance assembly output is provided with braking execution assembly, be provided with link assembly between running-board and the vacuum assistance assembly, be provided with spring assembly between frame and the running-board bottom.

title_en: Plastic car hopper with anti-sprinkling function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of handcart hoppers, in particular to a plastic hopper with an anti-sprinkling function, which comprises a handcart frame and a hopper part; the trolley frame and the hopper part are rotationally connected through an A hinge; the hopper part comprises a hopper, a hopper cover and a lock; the hopper cover is inserted into a hollow column fixedly arranged on one side of the hopper through a hopper cover bolt fixedly arranged on one side of the hopper cover, so that rotary connection is realized; the lock is rotationally connected with the car hopper through a first rotating shaft and abuts against the car hopper cover; the second lock rod is clamped through the baffle column, so that the lock is integrally propped against the hopper cover, and the aim of covering the hopper and preventing spilling is fulfilled.

title_en: Photovoltaic module transfer device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic module transferring device, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic modules, and structurally comprises a protection box, wherein the left upper end of the front side of the protection box is fixedly connected with the rear side of a controller, a stable fixing mechanism is arranged, an air pump in the stable fixing mechanism works to clamp photovoltaic modules placed on a placing box, so that the photovoltaic modules with different lengths can be conveniently clamped and fixed, and the photovoltaic modules with different lengths can be conveniently transferred together, the photovoltaic module transferring device is more convenient to use, the placing box can be limited by arranging a limiting sliding block and a limiting block in the protection mechanism, the placing box can be prevented from excessively shaking, the placing box can slide up and down, the photovoltaic modules can be conveniently taken and placed, the photovoltaic modules can be comprehensively protected when being transferred, and the photovoltaic modules are easy and convenient to take and place.

title_en: Building block unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of building block machinery, and provides a building block unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a main body, wherein driving installation pieces for installing driving assemblies are fixedly connected to four corners at the outer end of the main body, one end of each driving installation piece, which is far away from the main body, is connected with a flight driving assembly or a land driving assembly, and the flight driving assembly or the land driving assembly can be installed on the main body through the driving installation pieces so as to realize different movement modes, so that unmanned aerial vehicles with different movement modes can be experienced, assembly conversion of different flight modes can be experienced through splicing the flight driving assemblies or the land driving assemblies, and different movement effects formed by different splicing modes can be learned.

title_en: Automobile alternating-current charging pile shell
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automobile alternating-current charging pile shell, which comprises a main body and a mounting rod; the side edge of the main body is provided with a rotating cavity, and the bottom of the rotating cavity is provided with an opening; the side wall of the rotating cavity is provided with a folding groove, the folding groove is communicated with the inside of the rotating cavity and the outside of the main body, each corner of the folding groove is provided with a hanging groove, and the length direction of the hanging groove is arranged along the up-down direction; the radial pole of setting up that is equipped with on the peripheral wall of installation pole soon, the pole of setting up and the width looks adaptation in turn of roll over the groove to make to set up the pole and hang to establish groove joint cooperation, when installing the main part, need not to set up the stand of a take the altitude in advance like traditional electric pile shell, but can realize the regulation to main part altitude through the cooperation of roll over groove, overlap joint groove and overlap joint pole, the in-process main part of regulation can also take place certain rotation relatively the installation pole moreover, in order to satisfy the user demand of main part.

title_en: Heating device for steering wheel of automobile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steering wheel heating devices, and discloses an automobile steering wheel heating device, which comprises a center mounting bracket, wherein an operation ring is fixedly connected to the end part of the center mounting bracket, heating mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the outer side of the operation ring, fixing through holes are formed in the surfaces of symmetrical end parts of the center mounting bracket, the heating mechanisms comprise a connecting mounting sleeve block, a heating block is arranged on the surface of the connecting mounting sleeve block, and a movable cover block is movably sleeved on the outer side of the surface of the connecting mounting sleeve block; the heating mechanism and the central mounting bracket are connected and fixed, so that the heating mechanism and the operating ring are kept in a stable state, the operating ring can be stably driven to rotate while heating is carried out, mutual sliding is prevented, and meanwhile, the whole heating mechanism can be quickly disassembled when the heating mechanism is not needed to be used, and the operation is convenient and quick.

title_en: Anti-collision beam assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses an anti-collision beam assembly and a vehicle. The anti-collision beam assembly comprises a sleeve, an anti-collision beam and an energy absorption box, wherein the sleeve is used for connecting the traction hook; a connecting piece is arranged in the energy absorption box and connected with the side wall of the energy absorption box, and a first connecting port is arranged at one end, facing the anti-collision beam, of the connecting piece; the sleeve comprises a first connecting portion and a second connecting portion which are axially arranged along the sleeve body, the first connecting portion is arranged on the anti-collision beam, and the second connecting portion extends into the first connecting port and is connected with the inner wall of the first connecting port in a fitting mode. The vehicle comprises a vehicle body and an anti-collision beam assembly, and the energy absorption box is arranged on the vehicle body. The anti-collision beam assembly and the vehicle provided by the application have the advantages that the stability and the bearable traction force of the whole sleeve and the anti-collision beam are increased, and the towed performance is improved.

title_en: New energy vehicle battery quick replacement mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of new energy automobiles, in particular to a quick replacement mechanism for a battery of a new energy automobile, which comprises a lifting table, wherein two air pumps are fixedly connected to the side wall of the lifting table, the two air pumps are oppositely arranged, an air pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the air pump, an air box is fixedly connected to the end part of the air pipe, a first piston plate is slidably connected to the inside of the air box, the middle part of the first piston plate penetrates through the top of the air box, a second piston plate is slidably connected to the inside of the first piston plate, the middle part of the second piston plate penetrates through the top of the first piston plate, the first piston plates and the second piston plates on two sides are lifted by air pressure, the top of the second piston plate is attached to the bottom of the new energy automobile, water or moisture can be effectively prevented from entering the inside of the battery when the battery is replaced, the short circuit or damp of the battery caused by the moisture or the water is reduced, the inside of the battery can be kept dry when the battery is replaced, thus the influence on the performance of the battery is reduced, and the safety of the use of the battery is increased.

title_en: Pitaya picking machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dragon fruit picking machine which comprises a single fruit picking device, a multi-fruit shearing device, a fruit screening device and a chassis moving device, wherein the single fruit picking device comprises a grabbing and cutting mechanism, a pushing mechanism, a visual identification system, a lifting mechanism, an information conversion output device and a fruit receiving pipeline; the multi-fruit shearing device comprises a multi-degree-of-freedom shearing mechanism a multi-degree-of-freedom base and a multi-fruit collecting frame; the fruit screening device comprises a first pushing cylinder, a moving component fixing plate, a second pushing cylinder, OPenMV visual identification modules, a dragon fruit suction mechanism, a dragon fruit suction rotating mechanism, a moving component and an overripe fruit collecting box; the chassis movement device is used for moving and bearing the single fruit picking device, the multi-fruit shearing device and the fruit screening device. The device can meet the requirements of picking single fruits and picking multiple fruits, remove overripe or damaged fruits, realize accurate shearing, realize rapid movement in the picking process, reduce the loss and the picking cost in the picking process and improve the picking efficiency.

title_en: Vehicle skylight hanging type tissue box with sundry box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the design field of a paper towel box product with a sundry box hung on a vehicle skylight, in particular to a paper towel box with a sundry box hung on a vehicle skylight, which solves the problems of short service life and single function in the prior art, and comprises a paper towel box body and two symmetrically arranged steel sheet hooks, wherein the paper towel box body is fixedly provided with the sundry box, four symmetrically arranged sliding blocks and four symmetrically arranged clamping blocks are respectively and slidably arranged in the sundry box body, the one end of fixture block is the slope form, the one side of fixture block is through screw fixedly connected with horizontal pole, fixed cover is equipped with the connecting rod on the horizontal pole, connecting rod sliding fit is in the inside of slider, through the setting of slider and fixture block isotructure, inserts the locating piece alignment mounting groove during the installation, until the fixture block owing to the second spring catapult get into in the draw-in groove, the pulling draws the piece can when dismantling, has realized the effect that stability is good.

title_en: Sun shield assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a sun shield assembly and a vehicle, relates to the technical field of vehicle parts, and can solve the problems of small head space and poor practicability. The visor assembly includes a visor body and a mirror lamp assembly. The front projection of the sun shield body on the front windshield falls into the front windshield, and the front projection of the sun shield body on the vehicle running surface and the front projection of the vehicle seat on the vehicle running surface are staggered; the mirror lamp assembly is integrated on the sun shield body, and the mirror lamp assembly includes the light and with the sun shield pencil of light switch-on, the sun shield pencil has the pencil that draws forth outside the sun shield body and draws forth the end, and the pencil draws forth the end and is used for installing on the roof decoration assembly that is located front windshield. The sun visor assembly of the present application is used in a vehicle.

title_en: Automobile touch-control interior trim part with flexible light-transmitting surface
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automobile touch-control interior trim part with a flexible light-transmitting surface, which comprises a framework, a flexible light-transmitting surface, a lower shell, a touch switch and a PCB (printed circuit board), wherein the framework is provided with a mounting opening; the flexible light-transmitting epidermis is pasted in the front of skeleton with glue, and flexible light-transmitting epidermis covers in touch switch's front. The beneficial effects are that: install the lower casing in the installing port of skeleton, install touch switch in the front opening part of lower casing, paste the front at the skeleton with flexible printing opacity epidermis to make flexible printing opacity epidermis cover in touch switch's front, flexible printing opacity epidermis can select according to automotive interior style collocation scheme, makes the region of installing touch switch and automotive interior style coordinate, still is convenient for the car owner later stage change flexible printing opacity epidermis.

title_en: Bicycle brake crank structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bicycle brake crank structure, which comprises a handle assembly and a brake crank member, wherein one end of the brake crank member is detachably connected to a handle bar, the other end of the brake crank member is provided with a U-shaped groove, the handle assembly is rotatably connected into the U-shaped groove, a power-off switch module is arranged in the brake crank member, an execution end of the power-off switch module is positioned at the bottom of the U-shaped groove, one side of the handle assembly can touch the execution end, one side of the brake crank member is provided with a steering wheel, and one end of a brake cable is detachably connected to one end of the handle assembly after extending along the periphery of the steering wheel. The bicycle brake handle structure disclosed by the utility model is characterized in that the brake cable is tightly attached to the handle bar to be led out, and is arranged on a bicycle type of a bicycle handle full bag with a safety protection requirement, so that full bag components become small and smooth, the whole bicycle is not influenced in appearance, and meanwhile, a brake power-off switch can be arranged to provide an electric signal of a brake action.

title_en: Passenger car interior luggage rack with anti-drop function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a passenger car inner luggage rack with an anti-falling function, which relates to the technical field of luggage racks and comprises the following components: the lock catch assembly is arranged at the top of the carriage, the protection assembly is arranged at the middle part of one side of the carriage, wherein, the protection assembly comprises a sloping plate, a second groove, a third groove, a first rotating roller, a partition plate, a winding motor, a second rotating roller, protection cloth and a fixed rod, wherein the sloping plate is arranged on one side of the carriage, and the second groove and the third groove are formed in one side of the lower surface of the sloping plate; according to the utility model, the handle drives the fixing rod to move, the fixing rod drives the protective cloth to move, the luggage exceeding the luggage rack is wrapped, the lifting motor is started to drive the stud to descend, the stud drives the lock catch at the bottom end of the stud to descend, the handle and the lock catch are conveniently clamped, and after the clamping is finished, the luggage can be fixed.

title_en: Column weakening groove structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a column weakening groove structure, which comprises a decoration plate body, wherein the decoration plate body adopts a structure with two weakening grooves, a first weakening groove and a second weakening groove are arranged on the decoration plate body 2, the non-transition depth of the first weakening groove is 1.2mm, and the second weakening groove is formed by the following steps: 30 and is connected with the other side of the first weakening groove, relates to the technical field of low-pressure injection molding of the upright post in the automotive interior trim part, adopts the structure of two weakening grooves on the trim plate, one of the two parts is added with a transition area to 1/30 of the two sides, so that the situation that the material thickness is suddenly changed to cause surface defects due to the fact that the groove depth of one weakening groove is too deep is optimized, and the appearance quality of a product is not affected; the utility model adopts a structural mode of two weakening grooves, and solves the problem that the reduction of the groove depth cannot meet the explosion test.

title_en: Pedestrian protection structure and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a pedestrian protection structure and a vehicle, wherein the pedestrian protection structure comprises a first beam, a second beam and a supporting structure, wherein the first beam and the second beam are arranged at intervals, one end of the supporting structure is connected with the end part of the first beam, the other end of the supporting structure is connected with the end part of the second beam, so that the supporting purpose of the supporting structure is realized through the first beam and the second beam, simultaneously, the supporting structure comprises a first plate body and a second plate body which are connected with each other, the second plate body extends along the direction of keeping away from first crossbeam and second crossbeam and sets up to be used for playing the support protection effect to pedestrian's shank, and the second plate body includes first region, and first region sets up in the axis of second plate body and is close to one side of crossbeam, and wherein, the projection of first plate body on the second plate body is located first region, with the mode through the expansion second plate body supporting area, realizes more effectual support protection effect, and saved the cost of manufacturing the vehicle and avoided the problem of secondary injury pedestrian shank.

title_en: Chassis supporting structure and supply device with same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a chassis supporting structure and a supply device with the same. The chassis supporting structure comprises a shell, a bracket and a chassis body, wherein the shell is of a frame structure, the bracket is arranged at the bottom of the chassis supporting structure, the chassis body is positioned in the shell, a first installation position and a second installation position are arranged on the chassis body, the first installation position is positioned on one side of the chassis body, and the second installation position is far away from the other side of the first installation position; the chassis body is fixed on the bracket; wherein the mechanical leg is detachably connected to the first mounting position or the second mounting position. Through setting up first mounted position and second mounted position on the chassis body, a plurality of mounted positions are used for the bottom of fixed mechanical leg, are suitable for the vehicle to the different tank bit in left and right sides and refuel, have the commonality more.

title_en: Steering knuckle of passenger car
abstract_en: The utility model provides a passenger car knuckle, including the knuckle body, the upper and lower lug of knuckle body is provided with main pin hole and lower main pin hole respectively, main pin is being installed in main pin hole and the downthehole rotatable cartridge of main pin down, upper shutoff lid and lower shutoff lid are being covered respectively to the external orifice department of main pin hole of upper and lower, the external screw thread of upper shutoff lid outer lane corresponds with the internal thread of the external orifice department of main pin hole, hollow main shaft is being fixed in the middle part of upper shutoff lid in the form of running through, the setting element is being settled to the axial slip on the body of rod of the hollow main shaft in upper shutoff lid outside, be provided with anti-rotation structure between setting element and the hollow main shaft, the periphery of the outer drill way of upper main pin hole is provided with the spacing pit corresponding with spacing arch on the setting element, lock nut is being settled to the spiral on the hollow main shaft in the setting element outside. The positioning structure is additionally arranged on the passenger car steering knuckle for the plugging cover on the upper main pin hole, and the positioning structure can effectively prevent the main pin from driving the plugging cover to rotate loose, so that the passenger car steering knuckle has outstanding practicability.

title_en: Front unhooking pipe and automobile front beam connecting structure
abstract_en: The application relates to a front unhooking pipe and automobile front beam connecting structure, in particular to a front unhooking pipe and automobile front beam connecting structure, which comprises: the automobile front beam is provided with a mounting through hole; the reinforcement is fixed on the front beam of the automobile and provided with a reinforcement through hole; the front unhooking pipe penetrates through the mounting through hole and the reinforcing through hole, and the outer wall of the front unhooking pipe is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the mounting through hole on the automobile front beam and the inner wall of the reinforcing through hole on the reinforcing member; and the limiting bulge is formed at one end of the front unhooking pipe and is fixedly connected with the reinforcement. According to the application, the reinforcement is arranged between the front unhooking pipe and the automobile front beam, so that the front unhooking pipe is fixed with the automobile front beam and is connected and fixed with the reinforcement, and the limit bulge is also connected and fixed with the reinforcement, thereby improving the connection strength of the front unhooking pipe and the automobile front beam, reducing the risk of the front unhooking pipe falling off from the automobile front beam, and simultaneously reducing the phenomena of strain and tearing of the automobile front beam.

title_en: Fill electric pile and insert rifle subassembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging pile gun inserting assembly in the technical field of charging piles, which comprises a shell and a charging head, wherein the charging head is positioned in an inner cavity of the shell, first springs are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the bottom of the inner cavity of the shell, sliding blocks are fixedly connected to the upper sides of the left side and the right side of the inner cavity of the shell, a sealing cover is rotationally connected to the top of the shell, a buckle is fixedly connected to the left side wall of the sealing cover, a fixing sleeve is fixedly connected to the bottom of the shell, the top of the fixing sleeve penetrates through the bottom of the shell and extends to the inner cavity, second springs are fixedly connected to the periphery of the outer side wall of the shell, and the charging pile gun inserting assembly is reasonable in structural design, can prevent the inner charging head from being damaged even when a gun is inserted in severe weather, reduces loss, can prevent the gun inserting from falling from a charging port when the gun is charged, and is high in charging quality.

title_en: Directional tracking unmanned aerial vehicle capable of bearing multiple mobile communication devices
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a directional tracking unmanned aerial vehicle capable of bearing a plurality of mobile communication devices, which comprises a body, wings, a supporting frame, a fixing unit, a shooting unit, a control unit, a signal transmission unit and an energy storage unit. The body is provided with a plurality of slots for placing mobile communication equipment. The fixing unit is arranged in the slot and used for fixing and releasing the mobile communication equipment. The shooting unit is arranged on the machine body and used for executing shooting tasks. The control unit is electrically connected with the shooting unit to control shooting actions of the shooting unit. The signal transmission unit is electrically connected with the shooting unit and the control unit to transmit shooting contents to the cloud end, and receives a control instruction of the cloud end and transmits the control instruction to the control unit. The energy storage unit is respectively and electrically connected with the shooting unit, the control unit and the signal transmission unit so as to provide electric energy. Compared with the prior art, the directional tracking unmanned aerial vehicle can provide a plurality of mobile communication devices for people to be rescued, so that rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Logistics transport vehicle collision avoidance device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-collision device of a logistics transport vehicle, which comprises: the device comprises a vehicle fixing component, a damping component, a connecting component and a collision component; the outer side of the vehicle fixing component is provided with a damping component, the center of the outer side of the vehicle fixing component is provided with a connecting component, and the damping component and the outer end of the connecting component are provided with collision components; the anti-collision device for the logistics transport vehicle has the advantages of reasonable structural design, multi-layer buffering, better buffering effect, firm device body and the like, and therefore the problems and the defects of the conventional device are effectively solved.

title_en: Integrated relay valve with ABS electromagnetic valve assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of vehicle braking systems, and discloses an integrated relay valve with an ABS electromagnetic valve assembly, wherein a valve cavity is arranged in a valve body of the integrated relay valve with the ABS electromagnetic valve assembly, the relay valve assembly is arranged in the valve cavity, the integrated relay valve with the ABS electromagnetic valve assembly further comprises a piston group, the piston group comprises a first piston and a second piston, a control port (40) is arranged on the valve body, the control port (40) is communicated with the valve cavity, the upper side of the first piston is a cavity I, the lower side of the second piston is a cavity II, the first piston is abutted against the upper end of the second piston, and the lower end of the second piston is used for controlling the opening and closing of the relay valve assembly; the first piston and the second piston are in sealing contact with the inner wall of the valve cavity; compressed air of the control port (40) can push the second piston to axially slide by pushing the first piston, and the second piston can axially move to push the relay valve assembly to work; the outer diameter of the second piston is smaller than the outer diameter of the first piston. The assembly can design the pressure ratio of the control port (40) to the air outlet to be 1 to 1.5 according to the requirement, so that the pressure can be built more quickly and the response is faster.

title_en: Automobile pedal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile pedal, and mainly relates to the technical field of automobile accessories; the pedal comprises a pedal body, wherein the middle part of the surface of the pedal body is provided with a mounting groove for mounting a protection plate, both ends of the mounting groove are respectively provided with a connecting groove, the bottom surface of the protection plate is provided with a connecting block matched with the connecting groove, a bolt and a translation mechanism for driving the bolt to horizontally move are arranged in the pedal body, the connecting block is provided with a through hole matched with the bolt, and the inner wall of the connecting groove is provided with a jack matched with the bolt; the utility model can facilitate the replacement of the protection plate and does not affect the beauty of the automobile pedal.

title_en: New energy automobile pencil separated time structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a new energy automobile wire harness branching structure, which relates to the technical field of automobiles, wherein the wire harness branching structure comprises a branching sleeve, a heat insulation sleeve, a sealing sleeve, an elastic protective sleeve, a sealing gasket, a fixing sleeve and a wire harness guide ring, wherein the branching sleeve divides wire harnesses into three groups, the wire harnesses are wrapped by the heat insulation sleeve, the heat insulation sleeve not only can isolate heat, the metal woven shielding net and the corrosion-resistant sleeve on the inner side of the wire harness sealing device can shield external interference and protect the wire harness, the wire harness guiding ring can seal gaps between the wire harness and the fixing sleeve, and meanwhile, the sealing gasket and the elastic protective sleeve fix the position of the wire harness and double-seal the wire harness, so that the sealing effect is better, gaps are reserved at the wire harness after the time is prolonged, and the wire harness is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Steering wheel mechanism for AGV trolley
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of AGV steering wheel structures, and discloses a steering wheel mechanism for an AGV trolley, which comprises a top plate and a steering wheel main body arranged at the bottom of the top plate, wherein a bottom plate parallel to the top plate is arranged below the top plate, a through hole for the steering wheel main body to pass through is formed in the middle position of the bottom plate, a floating assembly capable of enabling the top plate and the bottom plate to relatively float along the Z-axis direction is arranged between the top plate and the bottom plate, a chain protection assembly is further arranged at the bottom of the top plate, and a steering assembly for steering is arranged on the steering wheel main body; the floating assembly can ensure that the top plate and the bottom plate can float relatively along the Z-axis direction, so that the problem that the steering wheel mechanism cannot be contacted with the ground when encountering uneven ground is solved, the situations of slipping and stalling are avoided, and the trolley can run stably.

title_en: Lying type swim ring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of swim rings, and provides a lying swim ring. The technical scheme adopted is as follows: the novel hook-and-loop type hook-and-loop fastener comprises a loop body, wherein a notch is formed in the rear part of the loop body, a groove is formed in the upper edge of the inner side of the front part of the loop body, circular arc grooves are formed in the lower surfaces of the two rear parts of the loop body, a supporting pocket is arranged in the middle of the loop body, a tail floating block is stuffed in the notch, cloth sleeves are wrapped outside the loop body and the tail floating block, and magic tapes are respectively arranged on the tail end cloth sleeves of the rear part of the loop body and the two end cloth sleeves of the tail floating block; the upper edge cloth sleeve at one end of the tail floating block is connected with the upper edge cloth sleeve at the tail end of one rear part of the ring body to form a connecting edge, and a top fixing belt is arranged at the joint of the upper edge at the other end of the tail floating block and the upper edge at the tail end of the other rear part of the ring body. The scheme improves wearing convenience, wearing comfort and use experience.

title_en: Plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle medicine storage tank
