abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plant protection unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle medicine storage tank, which comprises a medicine storage tank body, wherein a charging pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the outer surface of the medicine storage tank body, one end of the charging pipe, which is far away from the medicine storage tank body, is in threaded connection with a charging cover, the outer surface of the charging pipe is fixedly connected with a wind breaking block, the top end of the medicine storage tank body is provided with a mounting opening, the top end of the outer surface of the medicine storage tank body is fixedly provided with a miniature water suction pump, the outer top surface of the miniature water suction pump is connected with a power line, one end of the miniature water suction pump, which is far away from the medicine storage tank body, is fixedly provided with a medicine pumping pipe, the outer bottom surface of the medicine pumping pipe is fixedly provided with a high-pressure atomizer, and the center inside the medicine storage tank body is provided with a partition plate. According to the utility model, the miniature suction pump is light and reliable, the high-pressure atomizer can pressurize, atomize and spray the liquid medicine in the medicine storage tank, and the partition plate in the medicine storage tank can greatly reduce the inertia generated by the liquid in the unmanned aerial vehicle in the direction-changing flight, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle is prevented from being out of control due to overload.

title_en: Automobile seat surface sleeve fixing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing structure of a car seat surface cover, which comprises a foam assembly and a surface cover attached to the foam assembly, wherein a foam hanging steel wire is horizontally arranged in the middle of the foam assembly, the upper surface of the foam assembly is provided with a surface cover fixing groove corresponding to the foam hanging steel wire, the surface cover is sequentially connected with felt cloth, non-woven fabrics and cloth clamping adhesive tapes from outside to inside corresponding to the surface cover fixing groove, the felt cloth is adhered to the inner side of the surface cover, the bottom of the surface cover fixing groove is provided with a plurality of positioning grooves along the foam hanging steel wire at intervals, thereby make the foam hang and expose when tight steel wire passes positioning groove, the fixed column of clamp cloth adhesive tape and the foam that exposes hang and be parallel from top to bottom and the snare is fixed, the foam assembly bilateral symmetry bonds has the magic to paste the hook face, the face cover corresponds the hook face and bonds has the magic to paste the hair face, the magic is pasted the hair face and is pasted the hook face with the magic and bond, have design benefit, the clean and tidy flow of face cover outward appearance, strengthen seat aesthetic property by a wide margin, the laminating of face cover and foam assembly is inseparable, improve advantages such as seat life.

title_en: Sunroof transfer device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile skylight transfer device, and relates to the technical field of automobile accessory transfer equipment. The utility model comprises a base; the upper side wall of the base is provided with a protection component, the protection component comprises a protection plate and a pneumatic rod inserted in the temporal part of the protection plate, and the outer walls of the upper side and the lower side of the protection plate are provided with connecting plates; the inner side of the protection component and the upper side wall of the base are provided with bearing components, the bearing components comprise a bottom plate and an inclined plate welded on the bottom plate, the bottom side wall of the bottom plate is provided with damping parts, the bottom plate and the inclined plate are provided with rubber wheels, and the damping parts comprise miniature dampers and fixing rings at the shaft ends of the miniature dampers. According to the automobile skylight, the protection assembly is utilized to adjust the protection height according to actual requirements, and the bearing assembly is utilized to bear the automobile skylight and simultaneously play roles in damping and avoiding the occurrence of the phenomena of scratching.

title_en: Aluminum alloy skylight guide rail for automobile
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aluminum alloy skylight guide rail for car, including the guide rail body, the guide rail body form by aluminum alloy section bar integrated into one piece, guide rail body right side upper portion be equipped with first support arm, lower part and be equipped with the second support arm, the left side of guide rail body is equipped with U-shaped guide rail chamber, and the upper and lower distance in U-shaped guide rail chamber is the same with the distance between first support arm and the second support arm, the guide rail body be located U-shaped guide rail chamber top and be equipped with first guide rail, U-shaped guide rail intracavity upper portion be equipped with the second guide rail, be located the second guide rail below and be equipped with the third guide rail that is the I-shaped. The utility model discloses a design of first guide rail, second guide rail, the different shapes of third guide rail three-layer has increased guidance quality and gliding stability, has promoted the leakproofness simultaneously.

title_en: In-car ceiling lamp set with gap filling function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of automobile illumination, in particular to an in-car ceiling lamp set with a gap filling function, which comprises a car roof, side grooves and a magnetic attraction sleeve, wherein the side grooves are respectively arranged on two sides of the interior of the car roof, the inner wall of each side groove is in adsorption connection with the magnetic attraction sleeve, the interior of each magnetic attraction sleeve is fixedly connected with a sliding lamp body, one side of each sliding lamp body is movably connected with a lamp rod, one side of each magnetic attraction sleeve is provided with a notch, the inside of each notch is movably connected with the outer side of each lamp rod, two ends of each sliding lamp body penetrate through each magnetic attraction sleeve and are movably connected onto the inner wall of each side groove, a plurality of bottom grooves are formed in the lower side of the interior of the car roof, one side of each reading lamp belt is fixedly connected with the interior of each bottom groove, a driver can put the sliding lamp body into each side groove, the magnetic attraction sleeve on the inner wall of each side groove is adsorbed on the outer side of each sliding lamp body, and a passenger can push the lamp rod on one side of the sliding lamp body to rotate in each side groove according to own requirements, so that the lamplight of the sliding lamp body can be conveniently adjusted at multiple angles.

title_en: General type vehicle sun gear with high reliability and high convenience
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a general type vehicle sun gear with high reliability and high convenience, which comprises a first adjusting rod and a second adjusting rod, wherein the first adjusting rod is connected with the second adjusting rod through a connecting block in an adjusting way; the middle part of the first adjusting rod is provided with a first storage groove, the middle part of the second adjusting rod is provided with a second storage groove, and sun-proof pull curtains which can be pulled out outwards are arranged in the first storage groove and the second storage groove; wherein, one side of first regulation pole is equipped with the head rod, and one side of second regulation pole is equipped with the second connecting rod, and the head rod is connected with the one end of connecting block, and the second connecting rod is connected with the other end of connecting block, rotates the connecting block and makes head rod and second connecting rod be close to each other or mutually separate. The utility model is suitable for the installation of instrument tables with different shapes, is convenient to install and detach as a whole, can realize the adjustment of different lengths and different angles, and has convenient operation and use and good shading effect.

title_en: Active air inlet grille
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an active grille shutter. The active intake grille includes: a frame; an actuator secured to the frame; a drive shaft capable of receiving torque output from the actuator; a vane fixed to the driving shaft to move between an open position and a closed position under the driving of the driving shaft; the driving air inlet grille further comprises a gear kinematic pair, and the gear kinematic pair is connected with the actuating mechanism and the driving shaft so as to transmit torque output by the actuating mechanism to the driving shaft. The design of the present disclosure can increase the torque output by the actuating mechanism through the gear kinematic pair and transmit the increased torque to the driving shaft, thereby avoiding the defects of small selectivity, poor product stability, complex moving parts and high cost caused by adopting a high-cost large-torque motor or adopting a plurality of small-torque motors in the prior art.

title_en: Boiler installation overhead hoist
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boiler installation lifting device, and relates to the technical field of boiler installation. The boiler comprises symmetrically arranged fixing plates, wherein boiler stabilizing parts are arranged on the fixing plates, and lifting parts and movement control parts are arranged at the lower ends of the boiler stabilizing parts and used for adjusting the positions of the boilers. The length of the electric telescopic rod can be adjusted flexibly, so that the condition that the boiler installation overhead hoist needs to be moved or fixed when in use is met. Furthermore, set up the centre gripping hole on two splint, two centre gripping holes can splice into a circular hole and be used for fixed boiler stability in the transportation, and splint interval distance can be adjusted to the boiler of adaptation equidimension. The efficiency of workers is high when the crane is matched with the lifting installation work of the boiler, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Detachable lifting type ship shelf
abstract_en: The application discloses a detachable liftable ship shelf, which comprises: two fixed plates of symmetry and movable setting set up side by side and set up in the fixed plate below that corresponds and a plurality of elevating gear of upper end and the mutual articulated of fixed plate that corresponds, wherein, a plurality of elevating gear that set up side by side can go up to gradually increase gradually or gradually decrease highly drive the fixed plate swing that corresponds to different angles and the ship bottom side butt of different shapes in order to fix this ship, still include: the supporting base is arranged below the lifting device and connected with the lifting device; according to the application, the two fixing plates with swinging angles are arranged, and the plurality of lifting devices are arranged below the fixing plates side by side, so that the two fixing plates can be controlled to swing to different inclination angles to be matched with the bottoms of ships with different shapes, the universality is good, the utilization rate is high, the bottoms of the ships can be clamped by mutually matching the two fixing plates, the ships can be stably fixed, and the damage to the bottoms of the ships is reduced.

title_en: Two-way release mechanism of car headrest
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automobile seats, and in particular relates to a two-way unlocking mechanism of an automobile headrest, which comprises a headrest assembly, a backrest framework and an unlocking component, wherein the headrest assembly comprises a headrest body and two headrest rods, and a plurality of locking grooves are formed in the headrest rods; the unlocking component comprises a mounting block and a locking piece, wherein two first through holes are formed in the mounting block, two headrest rods are respectively and slidably mounted in the two first through holes, a first mounting hole is further formed in the mounting block, two sliding blocks are slidably mounted in the first mounting hole, second through holes are formed in one ends, far away from each other, of the two sliding blocks, the two headrest rods are respectively located in the two second through holes, and clamping blocks are respectively arranged in the two second through holes; the locking piece can drive the two sliding blocks to approach each other, so that the clamping blocks on the sliding blocks are withdrawn from the locking grooves of the headrest rods, or drive the two sliding blocks to be far away from each other, so that the clamping blocks on the sliding blocks are clamped into the locking grooves of the headrest rods; the problems of complex structure and inconvenient assembly in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Tool for loading jacket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tool for loading a jacket, which comprises a baffle frame structure, a locking structure, a supporting structure and a protecting structure, wherein the baffle frame structure is fixedly connected to two ends of the supporting structure, a plurality of locking structures are arranged between or on the upper ends of the supporting structure, the locking structure is an arc locking buckle, the radius of an arc of the arc locking buckle is consistent with the radius of an arc of the upper end surface of the supporting structure, the arc locking buckle and the supporting structure are locked through bolts, and the protecting structure is arranged on the inner wall of the locking structure. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use, reduces the requirement of the jacket of the wind power booster station on the ship, greatly reduces the transportation cost, can reduce the gravity center position of the jacket, improves the stability of ship transportation, and reduces the safety risk of jacket transportation.

title_en: Spray set water pipe support and surface of water photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to a spray device water pipe support and a water surface photovoltaic system. This spray set water pipe support includes flexible mounting, adjusts pole and installed part, and the one end of adjusting the pole is fixed mutually with the one end of flexible mounting, and the other end of flexible mounting is the free end, and flexible mounting can produce plastic deformation, and the free end can drive flexible mounting and remove and the winding is fixed in the periphery of water pipe for adjusting the pole, and the other end and the fixed base member installation of adjusting the pole are fixed, have realized the fixed of water pipe and fixed base member, easy operation, fixed effectual, the installation and the dismantlement of the water pipe of being convenient for moreover. This surface of water photovoltaic system has realized the fixed of water pipe and fixed base member through using this spray set water pipe support, easy operation, and fixed effectual is convenient for the installation and the dismantlement of water pipe moreover.

title_en: Mining dump truck brake spraying system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mining dump truck brake spraying system which comprises an air circuit assembly and a water circuit assembly, wherein the air circuit assembly comprises an air tank, the water circuit assembly comprises a first water tank, a second water tank and a plurality of nozzles, the air tank is communicated with the second water tank of the first water tank through an air pipe, a sequence valve, a pressure reducing valve and a three-way ball valve are sequentially arranged on the air pipe along the air inlet direction, a first ball valve is arranged on the first water tank, a second ball valve is arranged on the second water tank, the second water tank is communicated with the plurality of nozzles through a water pipe, and an electromagnetic valve for controlling the opening and closing of the nozzles is arranged on the nozzles. The mining dump truck brake spraying system provided by the utility model adopts the two plastic water tanks of the first water tank and the second water tank to replace the metal water tank, so that the mining dump truck brake spraying system is lighter in weight, convenient to install, low in price of the water tank and cost-saving, and the sequential valve and the three-way ball valve are additionally arranged on the air path part, so that the situation that water in the water tank flows back into the air tank due to misoperation of a driver and the functions of a liquid buffer, a brake valve and the like are influenced is avoided.

title_en: Power supply redundancy control system and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of new energy automobiles, and provides a power supply redundancy control system and a vehicle, wherein the system comprises a DCDC (direct current to direct current) converter, a power distribution module, a plurality of key loads and a low-voltage power supply module; the power distribution module comprises a first power distribution unit and a second power distribution unit which can supply power to each key load simultaneously and are mutually and electrically isolated, the DCDC converter is connected with the first power distribution unit, and the low-voltage power supply module is connected with the second power distribution unit. The utility model forms a power supply redundancy control system of the whole vehicle by a DCDC converter, a power distribution module, a low-voltage power supply module and a power supply loop thereof, ensures that at least one power supply loop connected with a key load can work normally, and aims to provide a power supply redundancy supply scheme with high functional safety level requirements for a plurality of key loads. The number of parts is simplified, the vehicle manufacturing cost of the whole vehicle is reduced, and meanwhile, the reliability of a power supply redundancy supply scheme is improved.

title_en: Electric off-road sightseeing vehicle anti-slip device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-slide slope device of an electric off-highway sightseeing vehicle, which comprises a disc body, a concave surface, a gear, a wheel transmission shaft, an arc block, a tooth block and an oil cylinder. The utility model has reasonable structural design, the two cylinders are in an extending state to push the arc blocks connected with each other to approach the gear on the vehicle transmission shaft, so that the tooth blocks on the arc blocks are inserted into the tooth grooves corresponding to the gear, and the tooth holding stop structure is adopted, so that the locking action points are more, the strength is high, the gear is bound and fixed from two sides, the stability is high, the wheel transmission shaft and the wheels are prevented from rotating, and the anti-slip effect is achieved.

title_en: Load type unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a load type unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a main body and a support frame, wherein a limiting frame and a load base are arranged on the support frame, connecting rods are respectively arranged on the periphery of the load base, the connecting rods penetrate through the limiting frame, a height adjusting piece for fixing the connecting rods is arranged on the limiting frame, a plurality of concave clamping grooves are formed in the connecting rods, the height adjusting piece comprises a shell, a movable block and a mounting cover, the shell is provided with the movable groove, the movable block is mounted in the movable groove by the mounting cover, and a clamping block matched with the clamping groove is arranged at one end, facing the connecting rods, of the movable block. According to the utility model, through the structure, after the articles are placed on the load base through the cooperation of the limit frame and the load base, the load base is pushed towards the limit frame to clamp the articles, and the load base is fixed on the limit frame through the cooperation of the clamping blocks and the clamping grooves, so that the articles with different sizes can be clamped between the limit frame and the load base, and the articles with different sizes can be loaded.

title_en: Floater collection device for water pollution treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floater collecting device for water pollution treatment, relates to the technical field of water pollution treatment, and aims to solve the problems that floccules can only be sucked, equipment is possibly damaged due to the fact that large Bowman and objects are sucked, and functions are imperfect. The ship comprises a ship body, wherein an object placing groove is formed in the ship body, the object placing groove is fixed in the ship body, the stirring structure is arranged in the object placing groove, the stirring structure comprises a second driving motor, a driving gear is arranged at one end of the second driving motor, one end of the driving gear is connected with the output end of the second driving motor, driven gears are arranged on two sides of the driving gear, the driven gears and the driving gears are in meshed transmission, a connecting rod is connected with the upper end of each driven gear, the connecting rod is fixedly connected with the corresponding driven gear, a rotating shaft is arranged on the outer surface of each connecting rod, and the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the corresponding connecting rod.

title_en: Gilt heat dissipation conveyer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gold stamping heat dissipation conveying device which comprises a lower mounting base, a mesh lower bottom plate arranged on the lower mounting base, a cuboid frame fixed on the mesh lower bottom plate, a plurality of fans arranged at the bottom of the lower mounting base and used for blowing cold air into the cuboid frame, and a plurality of universal wheels arranged at the bottom of the lower mounting base, wherein gold stamping printing paper is inserted into the cuboid frame along the longitudinal direction and is distributed along the length direction of the cuboid frame, and the cold air blown by the fans passes through between adjacent gold stamping printing paper. Through the scheme, the printing device has the advantages of simple structure, reliable heat dissipation, convenience in carrying and the like, and has high practical value and popularization value in the technical field of printing.

title_en: Outboard engine rudder stock assembly, outboard engine and water surface carrier
abstract_en: The utility model provides an outboard motor rudder stock assembly, an outboard motor and a water surface carrier, wherein the outboard motor rudder stock assembly comprises a rudder stock body, a connecting part and a connecting part, wherein the rudder stock body is provided with a working position and a storage position; the rudder stock fixing piece is used for being arranged on the rudder stock body and/or the outboard engine body, and when the rudder stock body rotates to the accommodating position, the rudder stock fixing piece fixes the relative position between the rudder stock body and the outboard engine body. The outboard motor rudder stock assembly solves the technical problem that the storage structure of the outboard motor rudder stock assembly in the related art is complex.

title_en: Tire rim strip convenient to assemble
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tire rim strips, in particular to a tire rim strip convenient to assemble, which comprises a rim strip main body, wherein the rim strip main body comprises a flat part with an annular structure, both sides of the outer wall of the flat part are respectively provided with an inclined part, and the inclined parts and the flat parts are connected through suture lines. Because connect through the seam between tilting part and the flat portion, when the rim strip main part assembly, compare traditional integrated into one piece rubber molding's rim strip, the tilting part of its both sides turns over when folding over is light more convenient, the assembly of being convenient for, labour saving and time saving. And the seam is nylon wire, improves the joint strength of tilting part and flat portion, avoids tearing the deformation, further improves the joint strength between tilting part and flat portion through the connecting band, and the outer wall fixedly connected with a plurality of evenly distributed's of flat portion anti-skidding arris, anti-skidding arris further improve the rim main part assembly after with the anti-skidding effect between the inner tube, make rim main part installation more firm, fully protect the inner tube.

title_en: Car logo lampshade and luminous car logo lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a car logo lamp cover and a luminous car logo lamp, which comprise a lamp cover body, a shading piece and a semi-permeable membrane, wherein the lamp cover body is provided with a first area and a second area, the first area is an area where a car logo is located, the second area is other areas except the area where the car logo is located, the shading piece is arranged on the inner side of the lamp cover body and corresponds to the second area, and the semi-permeable membrane is arranged on the outer side of the lamp cover body and corresponds to the first area. According to the utility model, the semi-permeable membrane is added on the basis of the traditional lampshade body, and when the lamp does not need to emit light in daytime, the semi-permeable membrane is arranged on the outer side of the lampshade body, so that the inner part of the car logo lamp cover is shielded by the semi-permeable membrane under the condition that the lamp is not bright, the inner structure of the car logo lamp cover can not be observed in daytime, and the car logo effect is improved. And the semi-transparent film is in a semi-transparent state, so that the area where the vehicle logo is positioned presents a matte effect, and the texture of the vehicle logo lampshade when the vehicle logo does not emit light is improved.

title_en: Driving mechanism of children handcart and children handcart
abstract_en: The application discloses a driving mechanism of a children handcart and the children handcart. The main gear is rotatably arranged on the shell, the main gear is used for driving the wheels to rotate, the transmission gear is rotatably arranged on the shell, the transmission gear can be meshed with the main gear, the motor is arranged on the shell, the rotating shaft of the motor is connected with a worm, and the worm is meshed with the transmission gear. The driving mechanism of the application adopts a transmission matching mode of the gear worm to reduce the power output of the motor, the worm transmission has a larger reduction ratio than pure gear transmission, can realize larger output torque, can reduce the use of gears, can reduce noise generated in the transmission process, and has better durability than all-gear reduction.

title_en: Transfer device suitable for batch coating back roller
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transfer device suitable for batch coating back rollers, which belongs to the field of rotation of coating cloth rollers and aims to solve the problem that the contact surface between the transfer device and the coating back rollers is damaged due to a fixing mode, and comprises a transfer base; the transfer device for the batch coating back rollers is characterized in that universal wheels are fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom end face of the transfer base, a transfer support is inserted on the top end face of the transfer base, two fixing buckling frames are symmetrically hinged to the top of the transfer support, rubber ring pads are sleeved on a bottom cross rod of the fixing buckling frames, fixing draw hooks are connected to the left side and the right side of the top end face of the transfer base, rubber ring pads are coated at the contact positions of the cross rod of the fixing buckling frames and the coating back rollers, so that the coating back rollers are prevented from being damaged, the fixing buckling frames penetrate through connecting notches after being buckled, and the positions of the fixing buckling frames are fixed.

title_en: Ferrosilicon transfer car (buggy)
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of transfer vehicles, and particularly discloses a ferrosilicon transfer vehicle which comprises a base, wherein a transfer box is arranged at the top of the base, two symmetrical fixing plates are fixedly connected inside the transfer box, two symmetrical sliding grooves are formed in the two fixing plates, a connecting frame extending to the outside of the sliding grooves is connected inside the sliding grooves in a sliding manner, and telescopic plates are fixedly connected to one side of the connecting frame, and the number of the telescopic plates is two.

title_en: Oil-electricity hybrid power system for crawler-type material distributor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hybrid power system of oil and electricity for a crawler-type material distributor, which comprises an electric driving system, a hydraulic system, a fuel power system and a battery energy storage system, wherein a three-phase alternating current power interface is arranged, three modes of providing power sources of fuel, a battery and alternating current are arranged together, hybrid power driving is realized, a fuel engine is adopted for driving when the material distributor moves for a long distance or is not in power supply condition, concrete is moved or conveyed for operation for a short distance, when the power supply condition exists, the material distributor is switched to work by replacing a diesel engine with a field three-phase alternating current power source, the energy is stored through the arranged battery energy storage system, and when a construction site is in short time or suddenly power failure, an AC/DC charging and discharging unit is utilized to rapidly discharge the battery energy storage unit to provide electric energy supply for a material feeding belt conveyor driving motor and a material distribution belt conveyor driving motor, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved in a hybrid power driving mode, and no pollution is caused, and the energy conservation and emission reduction targets are realized.

title_en: Movable oxygen generator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oxygen production and discloses a movable oxygen production device, which comprises a movable platform, wherein oxygen production equipment is arranged on the upper surface of the movable platform, a handle is fixedly connected to one side of the upper surface of the movable platform, universal wheels are rotatably connected to the bottom of the movable platform, a storage groove is formed in the upper surface of the movable platform, a driving motor is fixedly connected to one side of the upper surface of the movable platform, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a driving wheel, a first driving belt is connected to the surface of the driving wheel in a transmission manner, and a driven wheel is connected to the other end of the first driving belt in a transmission manner. This kind of portable oxygenerator is through setting up drive plate, auxiliary slide, steering seat for when carrying out lifting transport installation to oxygenerator, can effectively use manpower sparingly, and after accomplishing the transport lifting work to oxygenerator, can accomodate drive plate and auxiliary slide again to the inside of accomodating the groove, practiced thrift the space.

title_en: Steering shaft dust cover assembly for vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steering shaft dust cover assembly for a vehicle and the vehicle, wherein the steering shaft dust cover assembly comprises a bearing assembly, a first bearing and a second bearing, wherein the bearing assembly is suitable for being sleeved on the periphery of a steering shaft; the dust cover is suitable for being arranged on a vehicle body of the vehicle and forms a flexible connection part, the flexible connection part is connected with the bearing assembly, and the flexible connection part is suitable for being deformed to adjust the position of the bearing assembly relative to the vehicle body. According to the dust cover assembly, the flexible connecting part is arranged between the vehicle body and the dust cover and is connected with the bearing assembly, when the steering shaft drives the bearing assembly to shake along the radial direction, the flexible connecting part can absorb radial deflection and impact, and the durability and the reliability of the dust cover assembly are improved.

title_en: Green case of planting for transport
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green planting box for green planting and carrying, which comprises a bottom plate, a transverse plate and a box body which are horizontally arranged, wherein the transverse plate is arranged above the bottom plate, a damping mechanism is arranged between the bottom plate and the transverse plate, four clamping rings which are distributed in an array are arranged on the inner side wall of the box body, four clamping rods which are in one-to-one correspondence with the four clamping rings are arranged at the bottom of the box body, the box body is arranged above the transverse plate, a connecting mechanism is arranged between the transverse plate and the box body, a bearing plate is horizontally arranged on the inner side wall of the box body, a plurality of front-to-back distributed placing openings are formed in the top of the bearing plate, and a fixing mechanism is arranged on the bearing plate.

title_en: Deposit mechanism and instrument transfer trolley
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a storage mechanism and a tool transfer trolley, which relate to the technical field of tool storage and transfer and comprise a storage component, the novel electric appliance storage device comprises a storage plate, wherein a crank storage area, an electric appliance storage area and a sign board storage area are sequentially arranged on the storage plate. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the crank appliance, the insulating megger, the screwdriver and the test pencil with irregular shapes can be placed in the corresponding groove of the crank storage area on the storage plate, the electroscope is placed in the storage groove of the electric appliance storage area on the storage plate, and the small tools such as the signboards, the keys, the access cards and the employee cards are placed in the corresponding groove of the signboards storage area on the storage plate, so that the storage and the transportation of various tools are convenient, the problem that the transportation in a tool box or a bag is easy to wear is avoided, the tools are placed in order and attractive, the height of the storage plate can be lifted, and the tools can be taken by workers conveniently.

title_en: Speed regulation rotating handle of electric vehicle with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vehicle rotating handles, and discloses a speed-regulating rotating handle of an electric vehicle with a protection structure. The speed regulation rotating handle of the electric vehicle with the protection structure comprises a connecting assembly, wherein a handle assembly is arranged on the right side of the connecting assembly, a fixing groove is arranged at the upper end of the handle assembly, a connecting sleeve is arranged at the upper end of the fixing groove, a friction plate is arranged at the upper end of the connecting sleeve, an insertion block is arranged in the connecting sleeve, a protection assembly is arranged on the right side of the handle assembly, a rebound rod is arranged in the protection assembly, a fixing ring is fixed in the rebound rod, a penetrating rod is arranged in the fixing ring, a damper is arranged on the left side of the upper end of the penetrating rod, the electric vehicle is easy to collide with the ground when the electric vehicle is toppled, and the upper end of the traditional electric vehicle handle is free of the protection structure, so that the subsequent electric vehicle handle is damaged by collision, and the service life of the electric vehicle handle is reduced.

title_en: Cabin device, bogie mechanism and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cabin device, a bogie mechanism and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of equipment cabin overhaul. The cabin device comprises a main shell, an access door and a locking piece, wherein the access door is arranged on the lower surface of the main shell and can be slidably arranged on the access door in a first position and a second position, the access door seals the access door when the access door is positioned in the first position, the access door is opened to the maximum state when the access door is positioned in the second position, and the locking piece is used for locking and fixing the access door when the access door is positioned in the first position. The cabin device provided by the utility model does not need to disassemble the shell or the access door of the cabin device in the maintenance process, and is convenient in maintenance process and easy to operate. In addition, the access opening can be adjusted to a proper opening degree according to actual requirements so as to adapt to different access conditions.

title_en: Novel children tricycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel child tricycle, which relates to the technical field of child tricycles and comprises a frame and a vehicle body, wherein the vehicle body is movably arranged on the frame, a rear wheel rod is arranged on the vehicle body in a foldable manner, a rear wheel is arranged on the rear wheel rod in a foldable manner through a double-pressing locking device, the rear wheel rod comprises an upper shell and a lower shell, the upper shell and the lower shell are fixedly arranged, an upper pressing groove and a lower pressing groove are respectively formed in the end parts of the upper shell and the lower shell, the double-pressing locking device comprises a first button arranged in the upper pressing groove, a second button arranged in the lower pressing groove, a folding body arranged between the upper shell and the lower shell, and a first limiting block, a second limiting block, a first spring and a second spring which are arranged on the folding body, and the child tricycle can be unlocked only by pressing the first button and the second button at the same time, so that the possibility of rollover of the child tricycle caused by carelessly touching the unlocking button is avoided.

title_en: Electric motor car mouth structure that charges
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of charging ports, in particular to an electric vehicle charging port structure, which comprises a charging seat and a charging head, wherein two sides of the inside of the charging seat are provided with a longitudinal sliding groove, a first pneumatic telescopic rod is fixedly arranged in the longitudinal sliding groove, the charging head is inserted into the charging seat, the charging head can extrude a stop lever at the moment, so as to drive a connecting rod to inwards slide in the longitudinal sliding groove, a hinge rod at two sides pushes a dustproof slide plate to slide and open towards two sides of a transverse sliding groove, at the moment, the first pneumatic telescopic rod is extruded and contracted by the connecting rod, internal air enters a second pneumatic telescopic rod, the second pneumatic telescopic rod stretches to drive a butt joint plug to extend out, the charging head is convenient to insert, at the moment, a triangular clamping block of the charging head is clamped in a clamping groove at the inner side of a main charging seat under the action of an elastic sheet to complete fixation, when a rotating plate of the charging head is pulled out, at the moment, the spring drives the connecting rod and the stop lever to reset, the charging head is pushed out, and the dustproof slide plate is driven to reset and closed at the same time, and the electric vehicle charging port is convenient and quick to use.

title_en: Aircraft spare part aperture detection mechanism
abstract_en: The application relates to an aircraft part aperture detection mechanism, which comprises a chassis, a conveyor belt and a vision sensor, wherein a controller is arranged on one side of the front surface of the chassis, the conveyor belt is arranged at the top of the chassis, a bracket is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the top of the chassis, the vision sensor is arranged above the front surface of the bracket, a display screen is arranged on one side of the top of the chassis through a mounting bracket, and a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the display screen through the mounting bracket.

title_en: Mining fuel tank structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of engineering machinery, in particular to a fuel tank structure for mining. The fuel tank structure comprises a coaming with a cross-section of a II shape, an outer plate is connected to the opening of the coaming, a bottom plate is connected between the coaming and the lower end of the outer plate, a top plate is connected between the coaming and the upper end of the outer plate, a plurality of reinforcing transverse plates are connected to the inner walls of two side plates of the coaming, and a reinforcing vertical plate is connected to the inner wall of the middle plate of the coaming. When the novel panel is used, the coaming, the outer plate, the bottom plate and the top plate enclose a box body, the outer plate serves as an outer vertical surface of the whole machine, the structural strength is required to be good, the flatness is required to be good, no obvious welding marks exist, and the thickness of the outer plate and the bottom plate is larger than that of the coaming and the top plate. The reinforcing vertical plate strengthens the left-right direction strength, the reinforcing transverse plate strengthens the overall strength, and the impact caused by less oil shaking is assisted.

title_en: Electric vehicle charger
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vehicle chargers, in particular to an electric vehicle charger which comprises a charger main body and a ventilation device, wherein the charger main body comprises a heating piece, the heating piece is arranged on the side wall of the charger main body, one side of the charger main body provided with the heating piece is connected with one side of the ventilation device, and the ventilation device is used for radiating heat of the charger main body. According to the utility model, the ventilation device is arranged on one side of the charger main body provided with the heating element, the side walls of the ventilation device and the charger main body are directly connected, and the ventilation device is used for radiating heat of the charger main body, so that the whole volume of the charger can be effectively reduced, and the portable charger is convenient to carry.

title_en: Frame, box, battery changing device and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a frame, a box body, a battery replacing device and a vehicle, wherein the frame is used for the box body and comprises a bottom frame and a top frame which are oppositely arranged at intervals, the width of the bottom frame is larger than that of the top frame in the width direction of the frame, and a containing cavity is enclosed by the frame and is suitable for containing a battery pack.

title_en: Battery pack and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a battery pack and a vehicle, wherein the battery pack comprises a shell and a quick-change connector socket arranged on the shell, and the quick-change connector socket is used for being spliced with a quick-change connector plug of a whole vehicle end; the quick-change connector socket is provided with an equipotential interface, and the equipotential interface is connected with the shell through a first conductive piece. The battery pack can be directly connected through the quick-change connector to be quickly inserted when the vehicle is powered on, so that the battery pack can be quickly connected with the equipotential of the whole vehicle end, and the overall power-change efficiency of the vehicle can be improved by improving the equipotential connection efficiency.

title_en: High-strength low-glossiness fiber automobile interior trim part
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength low-glossiness fiber automobile interior trim part, which belongs to the technical field of automobile interior trim, and comprises a connecting rod, wherein the shape of the connecting rod is U-shaped, two ends of the top of the connecting rod are fixed at a roof, a sun shield is rotatably arranged at the bottom end of the connecting rod, and a through hole matched with the connecting rod is formed in the sun shield. According to the utility model, the glass fiber layer, the dermis surface layer and the matte surface layer are arranged on the outer side of the sun shield to form the protection mechanism, so that the strength and comfort level of the surface of the sun shield can be improved, in addition, the arrangement of the matte surface layer can effectively avoid reflection of light, the safety of vehicles meeting in the driving process is ensured, and the positioning mechanism formed by the sliding groove, the inserting block, the spring, the pull rope, the pulling block and the inserting groove on the connecting rod is arranged at the middle position of the sun shield, so that the stability of the position of the sun shield after folding can be ensured, and the sagging of the sun shield can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Piston transfer equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transfer equipment, in particular to piston transfer equipment. The lifting mechanism comprises a frame, a first power assembly, two groups of limiting mechanisms and a plurality of placing plates, wherein the frame comprises a bottom frame, a top plate arranged above the bottom frame and two mounting side plates arranged between the bottom frame and the top plate side by side, the bottom end of the bottom frame is provided with a plurality of universal wheels, the upper ends of the placing plates are provided with a plurality of placing grooves, the placing plates are arranged between the bottom frame and the top plate side by side, a plurality of lifting ropes are connected between every two adjacent placing plates, the upper ends of the placing plates are provided with clamping mechanisms, the first power assembly is arranged on the top plate and used for driving the placing plates at the top to lift, the two groups of limiting mechanisms respectively penetrate through the mounting side plates at the two sides in a movable mode, and the bottom frame is provided with a second power assembly used for driving the two groups of limiting mechanisms to be close to or far away from each other. The utility model can conveniently place the piston at the top end of the frame, and can conveniently take down the piston placed at the top, and has simple structure and strong practicability.

title_en: Via hole gum cover for wire harness and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wire harness through hole rubber sleeve and a vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle accessories. The wire harness sealing device comprises a mounting frame, a sealing disc, a rubber sleeve and a wire harness, wherein the mounting frame is connected to a wire passing hole of a metal plate, the sealing disc is connected to the mounting frame, a first through hole for passing through the wire harness is formed in the sealing disc, the sealing disc is used for sealing the wire passing hole, the rubber sleeve is connected to the sealing disc, the rubber sleeve is communicated with the first through hole, and the rubber sleeve is used for restraining the wire harness. When the wire harness through hole rubber sleeve provided by the utility model is used, the wire harness passes through the rubber sleeve, the sealing disc and the mounting frame, and the whole structure is mounted at the wire through hole of the metal plate through the mounting frame. The sealing disc is arranged at the position of the wire through hole and seals the wire through hole. The wire harness can be restrained in the rubber sleeve through the rubber sleeve, and the trend of the wire harness can be controlled through the rubber sleeve.

title_en: Two-stage synchronous overturning pedal device and control system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two-stage synchronous turning pedal device and a control system thereof, comprising a turning pedal fixing frame, a primary turning pedal assembly and a secondary turning pedal assembly, wherein the front side of the turning pedal fixing frame is provided with the primary turning pedal assembly and the secondary turning pedal assembly which are rotatably installed with the turning pedal fixing frame, the inner sides of the primary turning pedal assembly and the secondary turning pedal assembly are provided with driving structures, the driving structures comprise telescopic rods and driving connecting rods, the telescopic rods are electrically connected with the control system, and the control system comprises a pedal controller.

title_en: Lower supporting structure of railway vehicle through passage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lower supporting structure of a through channel of a railway vehicle, which comprises two vehicle bodies, wherein the opposite surfaces of the two vehicle bodies are respectively provided with a channel body, the two channel bodies are mutually matched, the opposite surfaces of the two vehicle bodies are respectively provided with a plurality of symmetrically arranged transmission grooves, the transmission grooves are respectively L-shaped, two ends of the transmission grooves are respectively provided with a positioning mechanism for positioning the channel bodies, and a moving mechanism for moving the positioning mechanism is arranged between the two opposite transmission grooves. According to the utility model, under the reaction force of the two high-elastic springs, the two high-elastic springs apply pressure to the extrusion block, so that the plurality of support blocks provide support force for the channel body, and the stability of the channel body is ensured.

title_en: Automobile rearview mirror convenient for replacing lenses
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile accessories, in particular to an automobile rearview mirror convenient for replacing a lens, which comprises a lens body and a lens shell, wherein the rear end of the lens body is fixedly connected with a mounting mechanism, the front end of the lens shell is provided with a mounting groove, the left part of the inner wall of the mounting groove, the right part of the inner wall of the groove and the lower part of the inner wall of the groove are respectively provided with a clamping groove, the middle part of the upper end of the lens shell is provided with a through limit groove, the limit groove is communicated with the inside of the mounting groove, the right part of the upper end of the lens shell is fixedly connected with a plugging mechanism, and the contact surface of the lens body and the lens shell is provided with a sealing ring. The automobile rearview mirror with the lenses convenient to replace can prevent external impurities from entering the limiting groove to block the limiting groove, so that replacement of the automobile rearview mirror lens body is prevented from being influenced, the lenses of the automobile rearview mirror are convenient to install and replace, the observation function of the rearview mirror is recovered in time, and normal use of a vehicle is not influenced.

title_en: Lifting type logistics equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building electrical equipment, in particular to lifting type logistics equipment, which comprises a carrying plate, wherein first vertical rods are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the carrying plate along the width direction of the carrying plate, penetrating sliding grooves are formed in the opposite surfaces of the first vertical rods, second guide rods are arranged in the sliding grooves along the height direction of the sliding grooves, sliding blocks are slidably arranged on the outer surfaces of the second guide rods, second springs are sleeved outside the second guide rods, two ends of the second springs respectively abut against the inner top wall of the sliding blocks and the inner top wall of the sliding grooves, first clamping plates are arranged on the opposite surfaces of the sliding blocks, penetrating rotating holes are formed in the first clamping plates along the axes of the first clamping plates, rotating rods are rotatably arranged in the rotating holes, second clamping plates are arranged at the bottom ends of the rotating rods, screwing rings are arranged at the top ends of the rotating rods, the outer wall diameters of the second clamping plates and the screwing rings are larger than the outer wall diameters of the rotating rods, goods on the carrying plates are limited on the carrying plate by the first clamping plates and the second clamping plates symmetrically arranged in pairs, and the second clamping plates clamp the goods on the carrying plate.

title_en: Electric roller sunshade curtain for automobile skylight
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric roller sunshade for an automobile skylight, which relates to the technical field of electric windowing and comprises a frame, a driving assembly and a roller assembly, wherein the driving assembly and the roller assembly are connected to the frame, the frame is connected to a ceiling, the roller assembly controls the sunshade to be rolled and unrolled, two ends of a sliding handle rod are fixedly connected with a left sliding connecting piece and a right sliding connecting piece, and the driving assembly drives the left sliding connecting piece and the right sliding connecting piece to move along a track. The roller assembly can roll and spread the sunshade curtain in the automobile skylight smoothly, and meanwhile, the side strips arranged on the left side and the right side of the sunshade curtain are embedded into the grooves corresponding to the tracks, so that the sunshade curtain can be ensured to be smooth.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with unmanned aerial vehicle horn fixed knot constructs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle with an unmanned aerial vehicle horn fixing structure, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein four placing plates are fixedly connected to the upper end of the bottom plate, an arm seat is placed in each placing plate, a connecting block is fixedly connected to one side of each arm seat, a threaded rod is fixedly connected to each placing plate, one end of each threaded rod penetrates through each connecting block and extends to one side of each connecting block, a first nut is connected to each threaded rod in a threaded manner, a first horn is fixedly connected to the other side of each arm seat, a second horn is slidably arranged in each first horn, a support is fixedly connected to the lower end of each first horn, a first bolt is arranged on each support, one end of each first bolt penetrates through each support and each first horn and is screwed into a threaded hole in each second horn, and the second horns can be completely retracted and contained in the corresponding first horns through the device, so that inconvenient carrying of the unmanned aerial vehicle horn can be avoided.

title_en: Shock attenuation mounting structure of on-vehicle GPS
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle accessories, in particular to a shock absorption mounting structure of a vehicle-mounted GPS. The technical problem is that when the existing vehicle-mounted GPS is installed on an automobile, the vehicle-mounted GPS is usually fixed at the installation position of the automobile by using an installation tool, the vibration reduction of the vehicle-mounted GPS is inconvenient to realize, the installation is performed by using the installation tool, the rapid disassembly and the installation of the vehicle-mounted GPS are inconvenient to realize, and the vibration reduction effect of the existing vehicle-mounted GPS is poor. The technical scheme is that the shock absorption mounting structure of the vehicle-mounted GPS comprises a mounting seat. According to the utility model, the GPS can be fixed by arranging the fixing component, and the GPS can be fixed only by rotating the knob, so that the problems that the common vehicle-mounted GPS is fixed by depending on a specific tool, the difficulty and time consumption of installation are increased, the tool is needed to assist in disassembly and assembly during disassembly and assembly, and occasions where the GPS equipment is required to be frequently moved are solved.

title_en: Novel automobile front anti-collision beam assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel automobile front anti-collision beam assembly, which comprises an anti-collision beam main body formed by processing a strip-shaped continuous steel coil through a rolling process, wherein a pedestrian protection beam with a cavity type structure made of cold-rolled steel plates is welded on the front side of the anti-collision beam main body, a crumple hole is formed in the pedestrian protection beam, a sponge buffer layer and a bubble cotton buffer layer are sequentially arranged on the front side of the pedestrian protection beam, and the rear side of the anti-collision beam main body is connected with an automobile body through an energy absorption box. The utility model has simple structure, low cost, easy manufacture and convenient installation, not only can enhance the anti-collision performance of the vehicle, but also can ensure the personnel safety of both drivers and pedestrians to the greatest extent when the accident happens, has more optimized performance, and can give up a large space for modeling and arrangement, thereby optimizing the whole structure.

title_en: Novel vehicle-mounted reversing buzzer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel vehicle-mounted reversing buzzer which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a rotating shaft is bolted to the top of the bottom plate, a support is sleeved on the surface of the rotating shaft, a first bolt is sleeved in the support, an arc-shaped groove I matched with the first bolt is formed in the support, rotating rods are sleeved on two sides of the support, and a user can install the novel vehicle-mounted reversing buzzer through the matching of the fourth bolt and a mounting hole. And then the bracket is rotated, so that the bracket rotates on the surface of the rotating shaft, and the first screw bolt is screwed to limit and fix the bracket through the second screw hole, so that the device can be effectively and conveniently rotated and adjusted. The user can rotate the roof-rack, makes the roof-rack rotate on the surface of dwang. Meanwhile, the top frame drives the second bolt to slide in the second arc-shaped groove, and then the second bolt is screwed to limit the top frame through the third threaded hole, so that the device can be effectively and conveniently adjusted in angle.

title_en: Full decoupling type wire control actuator
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automobile braking, and particularly discloses a full-decoupling type linear control brake which comprises a brake controller, a liquid storage tank, a booster cylinder, a manual simulation cylinder, an electric cylinder, a motor and a pedal push rod. The technical scheme can realize fully-isolated double-pipeline braking only by one electric cylinder and three electromagnetic valves, and has the advantages of few electromagnetic valves, simple structure, low cost, low failure rate and good safety. The end of the brake-by-wire can realize complete decoupling capacity, thereby creating conditions for realizing higher energy recovery of the whole vehicle. Because of the full decoupling braking, no matter whether the energy recovery exists during braking, the foot feeling during braking is not affected. During normal braking and energy recovery braking, the human-powered simulation cylinder can provide a first-class brake pedal feel by utilizing the damping force of oil flowing through the throttle valve.

title_en: Movable workpiece transfer box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable workpiece transfer box, which comprises an auxiliary conveying mechanism and a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is arranged below the auxiliary conveying mechanism, moving wheels are symmetrically arranged below the bottom plate, one end, close to the auxiliary conveying mechanism, of the top of the bottom plate is provided with a storage groove, the side wall, far away from the auxiliary conveying mechanism, of the storage groove is upwards extended, a push rod is arranged on the side wall, far away from the auxiliary conveying mechanism, of the storage groove, a notch structure is arranged in the middle of the side wall, close to the auxiliary conveying mechanism, of the storage groove.

title_en: Armrest screen assembly
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automobile seat armrests, and particularly relates to an armrest screen assembly, which comprises an armrest seat, wherein an installation groove is formed in the armrest seat, electronic equipment and an adjusting device are arranged in the installation groove, the adjusting device is used for adjusting the inclination angle of the electronic equipment to enable the electronic equipment to be horizontally arranged or incline upwards, the adjusting device comprises a servo electric cylinder fixed on the armrest seat, a lead screw is fixed at the output end of the servo electric cylinder, a screw nut is matched on the lead screw, two sides of the screw nut are respectively and rotatably connected with a first connecting rod, one end of each of the two first connecting rods, which is far away from a connecting plate, is fixedly connected with a shell, two sides of the shell are respectively and rotatably connected with a second connecting rod, one end of each of the two second connecting rods, which is far away from the shell, is rotatably connected with two sides of the installation groove, the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod on the same side are arranged in an intersecting manner, and a clamping groove for placing the electronic equipment is arranged on the shell, so that the problems of complex structure, difficult to grasp the inclination angle adjustment precision and poor stability in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Tire pressure sensor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile accessories, in particular to a tire pressure sensor which comprises a sensor main body and an inflating valve connected with the sensor main body, wherein the sensor main body comprises a shell and a cover plate, a PCB assembly is arranged in a cavity formed by the shell and the cover plate, a circle of welding ribs are arranged on the edge of one side of the shell, which is close to the cover plate, a welding groove is arranged on the surface, facing to the PCB assembly, of the cover plate, the welding ribs can be clamped into the welding groove, a guide groove corresponding to the position of the welding groove is arranged on the surface, facing away from the PCB assembly, of the cover plate, and the guide groove is formed by encircling two raised ribs.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle is with throwing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a throwing device for an unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises a high-definition camera fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the outer wall of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is sequentially and fixedly connected with a mounting cover and a resisting plate, a plurality of throwing mechanisms distributed at equal intervals are arranged in the mounting cover, the throwing mechanism comprises a telescopic suspension shaft, a connecting piece, a rack, a guide assembly and a gear meshed with the rack, the telescopic suspension shaft is movably inserted on one side of the mounting cover, the rack is fixedly connected to the side wall of the connecting piece, the guide assembly and the gear meshed with the rack are fixedly arranged on the mounting cover, and the driving mechanism comprises a servo motor, a worm fixedly sleeved on an output shaft of the servo motor, a transmission shaft rotatably arranged in the mounting cover and a worm gear fixedly sleeved on the transmission shaft. In the process of throwing, the utility model can realize the linkage of all throwing mechanisms by only arranging one driving source, and can effectively reduce the space occupation and the use cost of the equipment.

title_en: Split steering gear, steering system and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a split steering gear, a steering system and a vehicle, wherein the split steering gear comprises a shaft body, a sensor mounting shell and a steering gear main shell, the shaft body is adapted to be mounted on the sensor mounting housing, which is detachably connected with the steering gear main housing. According to the split steering gear, the steering system and the vehicle provided by the utility model, the shaft body is arranged on the sensor mounting shell, and then the sensor mounting shell is detachably connected with the steering gear main shell, so that the assembly connection of the shaft body and other components on the sensor mounting shell and then the steering gear main shell can be realized, the development difficulty of a die of the steering gear main shell can be greatly reduced, the development cost is reduced, and the platformization and the light weight of a product are realized.

title_en: Rear axle assembly structure of electric vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sightseeing electric vehicles, in particular to a rear axle assembly structure of an electric vehicle. According to the rear axle assembly structure of the electric vehicle, through the arrangement of the rear axle shell and the damping mechanism of the electric vehicle, shaking impact force generated by the bump road surface of the sightseeing vehicle in the running process is transmitted to the mounting plate, the telescopic loop bar below the mounting plate and the external damping springs are utilized for primary damping, then the damping reset bars on two sides below the mounting plate also play a role in certain buffering and damping, and when most of impact force is reduced by the telescopic loop bar and the damping reset bars, the rest impact force is counteracted by the damper below the connecting plate, so that the buffering and damping performance between the whole electric vehicle and the rear axle is enhanced, and the service life of the rear axle is prolonged.

title_en: Gas monitoring equipment suitable for water-gas interface
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of greenhouse gas monitoring, in particular to gas monitoring equipment suitable for a water-gas interface, which comprises a gas analysis device and a plurality of collecting covers with bottom openings, wherein the collecting covers are arranged around the gas analysis device, the tops of the collecting covers are communicated with the gas analysis device through gas pipes, the collecting covers are rigidly connected with the gas analysis device, when the gas monitoring equipment is used, the openings of the collecting covers extend below the water surface, and the collecting covers support the gas analysis device above the water surface. The gas monitoring equipment provided by the utility model ensures the overall stability of the gas monitoring equipment and improves the wind wave resistance of the gas monitoring equipment.

title_en: Portable battery mounting trolley
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable battery mounting trolley, which relates to the field of battery mounting and comprises a frame, a hydraulic device, a tray, a plurality of groups of bearing supports and limit stops, wherein wheels are arranged at the bottom of the frame, an armrest is arranged on one side of the frame, the hydraulic device is arranged on one side of the frame, which is close to the armrest, and is used for driving a telescopic support on the frame to move up and down, the tray is arranged at the top of the telescopic support, a plurality of rolling bearings are rotatably connected in each group of bearing supports at intervals on the tray, so that a power battery assembly is placed on the rolling bearings along the transverse direction or the longitudinal direction, and the limit stops are arranged on the tray between the adjacent bearing supports and are used for blocking the limit power battery assembly. According to the utility model, the rolling bearings are arranged on the tray, so that the requirements of transverse and longitudinal battery installation can be met, the universality is stronger, the compatibility of the battery installation trolley at the side part and the rear part is solved, and the efficiency, the labor intensity and the safety are improved.

title_en: AGV wheel self-cleaning device
abstract_en: The application relates to an AGV wheel self-cleaning device, which relates to the technical field of AGV trolley cleaning and aims to solve the problem that AGV wheels are easy to leave wheel marks, and the self-cleaning device comprises a cleaning mechanism arranged on the AGV trolley, wherein the cleaning mechanism comprises a vehicle-mounted cleaning unit and an auxiliary cleaning station, the vehicle-mounted cleaning unit is arranged on one side of the wheels of the AGV trolley, the auxiliary cleaning station is arranged on the ground, the auxiliary cleaning station comprises a base, a water storage tank, a cleaning nozzle and a circulating conveyor belt, wherein the base is arranged on the ground, the circulating conveyor belt is arranged on the surface of the base, the water storage tank is arranged inside the base and is communicated with the cleaning nozzle, the cleaning nozzle is connected on the surface of the base, and the cleaning nozzle is arranged towards the direction of the circulating conveyor belt. The application has the effect of realizing deep cleaning of the surface of the AGV wheel and effectively solving the problem of wheel marks on the ground with different materials.

title_en: Charging power cabinet and charging system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging power cabinet and a charging system, wherein the charging power cabinet is suitable for being connected with a plurality of charging terminals, the plurality of charging terminals at least comprise a super-charging terminal, the rest is a quick-charging terminal, the charging power cabinet comprises a power supply module, a power distribution module and a charging control module, the power distribution module comprises output buses and a plurality of switches, the number of the output buses is consistent with that of the power supply units in the power supply module, each quick-charging terminal is connected with an output bus, the output buses are quick-charging buses, each super-charging terminal is connected with two output buses, the two output buses are super-charging buses, and at least one disconnected bus is not connected with any charging terminal. The charging power cabinet can improve the power allocation capacity of the super-charging terminal to the power supply unit.

title_en: Automobile cabin cover sealing structure and automobile
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an automobile cabin cover sealing structure and an automobile, wherein the automobile cabin cover sealing structure comprises a front cabin cover, a penetrating lamp and a sealing element, the penetrating lamp is arranged on one side of the front cabin cover along the opening and closing direction, a spacing space is formed between the front cabin cover and the penetrating lamp when the front cabin cover is in a closed state, the sealing element is used for sealing the spacing space, one side of the sealing element, which is close to the front cabin cover, is provided with at least a first sealing surface and a second sealing surface, the first sealing surface is positioned on the front side of the second sealing surface along the advancing direction of the automobile, and the first sealing surface and the second sealing surface are respectively in sealing contact with the front cabin cover when the front cabin cover is in the closed state. The sealing structure of the automobile engine cabin cover can effectively reduce wind noise.

title_en: Swing arm structure convenient to assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a swing arm structure convenient to assemble, which comprises a swing arm body, wherein a through hole is formed in the outer surface of the swing arm body, a hinge shaft is arranged on the front surface of the swing arm body, a hinge sleeve is sleeved on the outer surface of the hinge shaft, a through slot is formed in the outer surface of the swing arm body, a speed reduction driving device mounting rod is mounted on the inner ring of the through slot, a driving wheel is mounted at the right end of the speed reduction driving device mounting rod, a speed reducer is mounted at the left end of the speed reduction driving device mounting rod, and angle ribs are mounted on the front surface of the swing arm body and the back surface of the swing arm body. Through the cooperation that is equipped with a plurality of parts, change swing arm integration into driving structure for driving structure's size is littleer, the assembly is easier and reduced the use of part, thereby the cost is reduced, consequently can effectually solve current swing arm structure through the device when using, because the part that uses is more, consequently lead to its size great, cause the inconvenient problem of installation.

title_en: Folding functional comfort boot pad
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding functional comfortable trunk pad which comprises a trunk pad body, wherein one side of the trunk pad body is integrally connected with a folding pad, two groups of fixing assemblies are arranged, a placing groove is formed in one side, far away from the folding pad, of the bottom of the trunk pad body, the two groups of fixing assemblies are symmetrically arranged, the two groups of fixing assemblies are arranged in the placing groove, and the trunk pad body is detachably arranged in the trunk through the fixing assemblies. The folding trunk pad has the advantages that the folding trunk pad can be unfolded and used in a whole piece in a seat falling state, the folding trunk pad can be folded and used when the seat is lifted, the production cost is reduced, the time and labor waste of a customer are avoided, meanwhile, the nondestructive rapid assembly and disassembly of the trunk pad can be realized through the mutual cooperation of the two groups of fixing components, and the practicability of the trunk pad is further improved.

title_en: Offshore wind power operation and maintenance boarding system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of offshore wind power operation and maintenance, in particular to an offshore wind power operation and maintenance boarding system which comprises a fixed anchor point, a traction rope and a traction machine, wherein the fixed anchor point is fixed on a wind power operation and maintenance platform, the traction machine is arranged on an operation and maintenance ship, two ends of the traction rope are respectively connected with the fixed anchor point and the traction machine, a tension detector is arranged on the traction machine and is used for monitoring tension of the traction rope in real time, and the traction machine is used for winding and unwinding the traction rope according to a monitoring result of the tension detector, and operation and maintenance personnel can pass through the traction rope to and fro the wind power operation and maintenance platform and the operation and maintenance ship. The wind power operation and maintenance platform and the operation and maintenance ship can safely and efficiently move by fixing the anchor point, the high-strength traction rope and the traction machine with the tension detector, so that the influence of a marine complex environment is effectively resisted, the safety in the operation and maintenance process is ensured, and the operation and maintenance efficiency is improved.

title_en: Heat exchange module, heat management device and vehicle
