abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat exchange module, a heat management device and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of vehicle heat management, wherein the heat exchange module is applied to the vehicle and comprises a flow passage plate, a liquid storage dryer, a heat exchanger and a throttling element, wherein a refrigerant flow passage is arranged in the flow passage plate, connecting ports communicated with the refrigerant flow passage are arranged on two opposite sides of the flow passage plate in the thickness direction, the liquid storage dryer, the heat exchanger and the throttling element are arranged on two sides of the flow passage plate in the thickness direction, and the liquid storage dryer, the heat exchanger and the throttling element are communicated with the connecting ports and are used for forming a refrigerant loop with a compressor. According to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the liquid storage dryer, the heat exchanger and the throttling element are arranged on the two sides of the flow passage plate along the thickness direction, so that the compactness of the heat exchange module is improved, and the arrangement space of the front engine room is saved.

title_en: Multifunctional baby carriage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of baby carriages and discloses a multifunctional baby carriage which comprises a carriage frame, wherein front wheels are arranged at the bottom of the carriage frame close to the front side of the carriage frame, rear wheels are arranged at the bottom of the carriage frame close to the rear side of the carriage frame, a first seat and a second seat can be fixedly arranged on the carriage frame, the baby carriage is provided with a single seat mode, a double seat mode and a play yard mode, one of the first seat and the second seat is fixedly arranged on the carriage frame when the baby carriage is in the single seat mode, the first seat and the second seat are fixedly arranged on the carriage frame when the baby carriage is in the double seat mode, and the first seat and the second seat are not arranged on the carriage frame when the baby carriage is in the play yard mode, so that the baby carriage can be used for a child to sleep. The baby carrier has the advantages that the modes can be switched, a user can select the car mode according to the actual use scene, the car cost of the user can be effectively reduced, and the baby carrier is small in size after being folded and convenient to carry and transport.

title_en: Wing static test tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wing tests and discloses a wing static test tool, which comprises a wing, wherein one side of the wing is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, one side of the mounting plate is provided with a far-end pin hole, the inside of the far-end pin hole is connected with an L plate through a bolt, the bottom of the L plate is connected with a fixing frame through a bolt, the other side of the mounting plate is provided with a near-end pin hole, the inside of the near-end pin hole is provided with a bolt, two ends of the bolt are respectively connected with a steel wire rope, the top end of the steel wire rope is connected with a hanging scale, the top of the hanging scale is provided with a gantry crane, and the other side of the wing is provided with a rear edge. According to the utility model, the wing is fixed through the fixing frame, the force applied to the wing is simulated during loading through the operation of the gantry crane, the loaded force is displayed through the operation of the hanging scale, and the deformation of the wing can be read through the arrangement of the displacement measuring device, so that a static test can be performed on the wing.

title_en: Battery compacting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery compressing structure, which is characterized in that a lifting column is designed to integrate the functions of driving a pressing sleeve to rotate and lift, the structure is simple and practical, an elastic clamping structure which can be disconnected when being stressed in the circumferential direction is arranged between the pressing sleeve and the lifting column, and compression grooves with different heights of two circumferential side walls are correspondingly arranged at the top of a battery, so that the operation of locking the battery and unlocking the battery can be realized only by rotating the lifting column, the operation is simple, the problem that the battery compressing structure of the traditional electric motorcycle is inconvenient to use can be effectively solved, the use experience and the product competitiveness of a user can be improved, the battery compressing structure has better compatibility of the size, the size and the shape of the battery, and can realize better compressing effect under the condition of inaccurate battery installation position, and the battery compressing structure can be used for riding type electric motorcycles, and also can be used for compressing the battery under a cushion of a pedal type electric motorcycle, and has better practicability.

title_en: Underwater construction operation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underwater operation equipment, in particular to an underwater construction operation device which comprises a frame, a working cabin, a clear water replacement mechanism and underwater operation equipment, wherein the bottom surface of the working cabin is provided with an opening, at least one clear water replacement mechanism communicated with the working cabin is arranged on the working cabin, movable underwater operation equipment is arranged in the working cabin, the working cabin is positioned on the inner side of the frame, a pressing driving mechanism is arranged between the upper end of the working cabin and the frame, the working cabin is connected with the frame through the pressing driving mechanism, the pressing driving mechanism comprises a pressing driving cylinder, two sides of the upper end of the working cabin are provided with pressing driving cylinders, one end of each pressing driving cylinder is hinged with the frame, the other end of each pressing driving cylinder is hinged with the working cabin, a pressing guide mechanism is arranged between the working cabin and the frame, a water purification flocculation device is arranged on the working cabin, and an operation equipment driving and moving mechanism is arranged between the underwater operation equipment.

title_en: Rear-row adjusting platform for vehicle-mounted office entertainment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rear-row adjusting platform for vehicle-mounted office entertainment, which relates to the technical field of automobiles and has the technical key points that the rear-row adjusting platform for vehicle-mounted office entertainment comprises a fixed base, a mounting base is arranged above the fixed base, a first plane bearing, a second plane bearing, a turntable and a motor are arranged above the mounting base, a disc is arranged on the inner side of the second plane bearing, and a fluted disc support is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the disc. The motor drives the driving gear to rotate, the driven gear is matched with the driving gear and the fluted disc respectively to realize the rotation adjustment of the platform, the office entertainment requirements of different angles are met, the first plane bearing, the second plane bearing, the first limiting frame and the second limiting frame improve the rotation stability, and the sliding rail is matched with the connecting rail to enable the mounting base to slide in parallel, so that the platform is suitable for different scenes.

title_en: High-safety panoramic sunroof for automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-safety automobile panoramic sunroof, which comprises an upper layer sunroof and a lower layer sunroof, wherein windows are arranged at the central positions of the upper layer sunroof and the lower layer sunroof, fixed grooves are arranged on two sides of the windows, rolling grooves are arranged on one side of each fixed groove, pulleys are arranged in the rolling grooves, a connecting shaft is arranged on one side of each pulley, a sliding block is arranged on one side of each connecting shaft, curved glass is arranged at the top of each sliding block, and planar glass is arranged at the bottom of each sliding block. According to the high-safety panoramic sunroof for the automobile, the outer-layer curved glass and the inner-layer planar glass are separated, the curved glass is broken when the outer-layer panoramic sunroof is impacted, and the planar glass and the curved glass are not contacted, so that the subsequent impact received is reduced, and the safety of passengers in the automobile is protected.

title_en: Fork truck hydraulic steering axle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of forklifts, in particular to a hydraulic steering axle of a forklift. The shell is internally provided with an installation area, the oil cylinder is horizontally installed in the installation area, the two ends of the oil cylinder are both provided with curved bars, the claw crutch is connected with the extending end of the oil cylinder through the curved bars, the shaft of the claw crutch is provided with a hub, and the hub is provided with a tire. The structure is simple, the operation is convenient, the welding is adopted between all parts, the left turn and the right turn of the forklift are controlled by the oil cylinder, the turning angle is small, the turning diameter is small, the forklift can work in a narrow space, the operation is convenient and fast, the operation difficulty is reduced, the flexibility, the working efficiency and the safety of the forklift are improved, the space utilization rate is improved, the operation blind area is reduced, the tire abrasion is reduced, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Pedal telescoping device, threshold footboard and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a pedal telescopic device, a threshold pedal and a vehicle, wherein the pedal telescopic device is applied to the threshold pedal, the threshold pedal comprises a pedal body, the threshold pedal is provided with a first direction and a second direction, the first direction is intersected with the second direction, and the pedal telescopic device comprises: a driving member and a plurality of crank block mechanisms. The crank slider mechanisms are arranged at intervals along the first direction, each crank slider mechanism comprises a crank, a sliding part and a universal connecting piece, one end of each crank is connected with one end of each sliding part through the universal connecting piece, the driving piece is connected with one end of at least one crank, which is far away from each sliding part, and the driving piece is used for driving the corresponding crank to rotate around the first direction, so that the corresponding crank drives the corresponding sliding parts to move along the second direction, and one end, which is far away from each sliding part, is used for being connected with the pedal body. The pedal telescopic device can improve the smoothness of pedal body telescopic.

title_en: New energy automobile fills electric pile that possesses cable protection resistance to compression function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of charging pile auxiliary devices, and discloses a new energy automobile charging pile with a cable protection and compression resistance function, which comprises a charging station, wherein an extension station is connected to the charging station, and a touch screen and an acoustic are connected to the extension station; the automatic charging device comprises a charging platform, a placing mechanism fixedly connected to one side of the charging platform, a power box fixedly connected with the charging platform, a winding roller connected between the two power boxes, a containing mechanism connected to the winding roller in an inner connecting mode, a communication cable sleeved on the containing device, a charging head arranged on the outer side of the winding roller and an external frame sleeved with a movable plate, wherein an auxiliary mechanism is arranged in the external frame.

title_en: Evaporator of engineering machinery and engineering machinery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of engineering machinery, and discloses an evaporator of engineering machinery and the engineering machinery. The evaporator comprises an upper shell, a lower shell and a filter element, wherein a drawing opening is formed in the top of the upper shell, a slide way communicated with the drawing opening is arranged in the upper shell, the lower shell is fixedly connected with the upper shell, the filter element is arranged corresponding to the slide way, and the filter element is movably arranged in the slide way through the drawing opening. Set up the pull mouth at the top of last casing and set up the slide in last casing, when maintaining the filter core of evaporimeter, pull the mouth at the top of follow last casing with the filter core and draw out, then maintain the filter core, after the filter core maintenance, push the filter core in the slide from the pull mouth, and then accomplish the maintenance of filter core, realize the push of filter core or take out through the push-and-pull filter core, need not to dismantle parts such as casing, the convenience when having improved the maintenance of evaporimeter filter core has saved manpower and man-hour, the wearing and tearing and the inefficacy risk that the part caused because of dismantling repeatedly have been reduced simultaneously.

title_en: Door lock detection indicating device for rail transit and emergency evacuation door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a door lock detection and indication device for track traffic and an emergency evacuation door, wherein the door lock detection and indication device for track traffic comprises a mounting seat and a sliding rod which is in sliding connection with a support, the sliding rod is provided with a first indication mark, and the support is provided with a second indication mark and a third indication mark for displaying that the door leaf is just closed and excessively tightened. In the front door recovery process, the front door recovery device is used for identifying the lock tongue to the lock gear position, so that the locking failure caused by manual operation of the front door lock when the front door is closed in a transitional mode or the front door is not closed in place is avoided.

title_en: Air inlet channel assembly and vehicle with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air inlet channel assembly and a vehicle with the same, which comprise a main body pipeline, an air inlet grid, an air deflector and a flexible baffle edge, wherein the main body pipeline is suitable for being installed in a cab, the main body pipeline is provided with an air inlet, the air inlet is towards the outer side face of the cab, the air inlet grid is installed in the main body pipeline and covers the air inlet, the air deflector is installed in the air inlet of the main body pipeline, the air deflector is provided with an air guiding edge extending towards the outer side of the cab on the outer peripheral side of the air inlet grid, the flexible baffle edge surrounds the air deflector and is installed on the air guiding edge, and the flexible baffle edge is suitable for covering a gap between the outer side face of the cab and the air deflector, or the flexible baffle edge and the air deflector jointly cover a gap between the outer side face of the cab and the air deflector. According to the air inlet channel assembly provided by the embodiment of the utility model, the problem of sucking hot air is solved, and the air inlet channel assembly has the advantages of avoiding temperature rise surge, protecting an engine, being high in reliability and the like.

title_en: Steel structural part conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transportation and discloses a steel structure component transportation device which comprises a rectangular bottom plate, wherein upright posts are fixedly arranged at four corners of the upper surface of the rectangular bottom plate, shielding plates are hinged to the side walls of the periphery of the rectangular bottom plate, two ends of each shielding plate are connected with adjacent upright posts through handle buckles, a containing groove is formed in the rectangular bottom plate, a folding ladder is rotatably arranged in the containing groove through a pin, a cross beam is uniformly and fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the containing groove, a clamping assembly is arranged at one end of the folding ladder, far away from the pin, guide grooves are formed in two sides of the inside of the containing groove, positioning holes are formed in two ends of each guide groove, and the clamping assembly is assembled with a pair of aligned positioning holes in a plugging manner. The folding ladder is positioned in the accommodating groove when unfolded into a straight shape, forms a flat bearing foundation with the rectangular bottom plate, does not influence the loading and transportation of the steel structural parts, can be folded into a V shape after being unloaded, and provides stable ascending operation conditions.

title_en: Carbon fiber bicycle wheel rim reinforced structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carbon fiber bicycle wheel rim reinforcing structure, which relates to the field of wheels and comprises a wheel rim body and reinforcing pieces, wherein the wheel rim body is made of carbon fiber products, a plurality of grooves are arranged on the left and right outer side walls of a cavity of the wheel rim body, the cross section of each reinforcing piece is U-shaped, the reinforcing pieces are fixedly connected to the wheel rim body through strong glue, and the strong glue fills the grooves, so that the reinforcing pieces are wrapped on the left and right outer side walls of the cavity and transversely span the inner circumferential surface of the wheel rim body. The cavity of the wheel rim body is wrapped by the reinforcing piece, so that the impact of the wheel spokes to the wheel rim body can be shared, and the wheel rim body is prevented from being broken due to local overload or impact. The groove can ensure the strength of the wheel rim body while saving materials, and can increase or decrease the contact area of the strong adhesive and the wheel rim body. Under the condition of thickness reduction of the strong adhesive, the connection strength of the rim body and the reinforcing piece is ensured, so that the structure of the product is more compact and the thickness is thinner.

title_en: Clamp applied to aircraft landing gear position end-point electric valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamp applied to an end-point electric valve at the position of an aircraft landing gear, which is technically characterized by comprising an arc frame, a pressing block and a moving rod, wherein the arc frame comprises an arc back, a first end rod and a second end rod which are fixedly connected to two ends of one side of the arc back, the first end rod and the second end rod are respectively positioned at one side of the landing gear, which is far away from the end-point electric valve, and one side of the landing gear, which is provided with the end-point electric valve, when the clamp is used, the pressing block is arranged at one side of the second end rod, which is close to the end-point electric valve, and can be pressed on the end-point electric valve, the moving rod is in threaded connection with the first end rod, the moving rod can be close to and far away from the pressing block through rotation of the first end rod, the moving rod and the pressing block are moved to two sides of the landing gear through rotation of the moving rod, so that the moving rod and the pressing block are respectively pressed on two sides of the landing gear, the pressing block is controlled to be pressed on the end-point electric valve, manual pressing is not required, and the investment of manpower is saved.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted tactical fixing device
abstract_en: The application relates to a vehicle-mounted tactical fixing device which is applied to the field of fixing devices and comprises a supporting belt, wherein the supporting belt is provided with a connecting structure at the waist of an operator, and the supporting belt is provided with a fixing mechanism for connecting with a carrier. The application has the technical effects that the supporting belt is fixed at the waist of an operator by utilizing the connecting structure, and when the operator performs vehicle-mounted combat, the supporting belt is connected with the carrier by the fixing structure, so that the possibility of shaking the body of the operator in the running process of the carrier is reduced, and the riding comfort and shooting stability of the operator are improved.

title_en: Oil tank simulation test piece
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an oil tank simulation test piece, which comprises a main body frame formed by a frame plate, a stringer and a skin, wherein the frame plate is accurately positioned according to a station line of a machine body, a central line of a longitudinal section line of the machine body and a zero line of a waterline, so that the structural stability and the simulation precision are ensured. The stringers comprise longitudinal stringers and grid stringers, 304 stainless steel is adopted, and the joints of the stringers and the frame plates are reinforced with bending angle bars to form a stable structure. The skin wraps the outer side of the main body frame, so that the overall strength is enhanced. And an observation window, a pipeline connecting hole and a sensor connecting hole are formed in the test piece, so that the test equipment can be observed and connected conveniently. The oil tank simulation test piece is reasonable in design, stable in structure, high in simulation precision, convenient and flexible in test, suitable for oil tank simulation test requirements of different models and specifications, powerful in support for oil tank design and performance evaluation, and wide in application prospect and remarkable in economic value.

title_en: Vehicle thermal management system and all-terrain vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle thermal management system and an all-terrain vehicle, wherein the vehicle thermal management system comprises a liquid heater, a first water pump, a liquid-liquid exchanger, a warm air exchanger, a power battery assembly, a second water pump, an engine and a first radiator, wherein first chambers of the liquid heater, the first water pump, the warm air exchanger and the liquid-liquid exchanger are connected in series to form a first circulating waterway, a heat exchange pipeline of the power battery assembly, a second water pump and a second chamber of the liquid-liquid exchanger are connected in series to form a second circulating waterway, and a heat exchange pipeline of the engine, the first radiator and the liquid heater are connected in series to form a third circulating waterway. The vehicle thermal management system provided by the utility model has the advantages of simple pipeline layout and small occupied vehicle space.

title_en: Electric motor car seat cushion of liftable angle regulation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vehicle seat cushions, and discloses an electric vehicle seat cushion with a lifting and adjusting angle, which comprises a bottom shell and a cushion body; the cushion body is arranged on the top surface of the cushion body along the direction of the cushion shaft for the electric vehicle in a reciprocating lifting manner, and can perform reciprocating rotary motion along the direction of the x axis at any lifting position of the cushion shaft for the electric vehicle. Through setting up along but electric motor car is with cushion axis direction reciprocating elevating motion ground set up in the top surface of the pad body, can all follow the cushion body of x axis direction reciprocating rotation motion at the arbitrary elevating position of electric motor car is with cushion axis, according to different user's height, position of sitting custom etc. different, through liftable and rotatable angle's regulation, can let the cushion body adapt to different user individual condition better, make more users can both find relative comfortable cushion state.

title_en: Steering mechanism, angle module device and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a steering mechanism, an angle module device and a vehicle, which comprise a first driving mechanism and a second driving mechanism, wherein the first driving mechanism is used for driving wheels to rotate, the second driving mechanism is in driving connection with the first driving mechanism and is used for driving the first driving mechanism to move so as to drive the wheels to rotate, when any one of the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism works independently, the wheels rotate in a first angle range, and when the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism work cooperatively, the wheels rotate in a second angle range, and the second angle range is larger than the first angle range. Through the technical scheme, the applicability and the application range of the steering mechanism are improved.

title_en: Vehicle fuming early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle smoke early warning device which comprises a storage box, a smoke generating mechanism and two wires, wherein the storage box is provided with an inner cavity, the top of the storage box is fixedly connected with an automobile main body, a through hole is formed in one inner side end wall of the inner cavity, the smoke generating mechanism comprises a resistance wire and a wire rope, the wire rope is arranged in the inner cavity, the resistance wire is spirally wound on the wire rope, the number of the two wires is two, the two wires are respectively arranged on the top wall of the storage box in a penetrating mode, and two ends of the resistance wire are respectively electrically connected with one ends of the two wires. Through the arrangement, when the vehicle cannot continue running due to accident or faults on the road, the vehicle uploading operator electrifies the resistance wire by using the lead wire, so that a large amount of heat is generated, a large amount of smoke is further caused, and the vehicle uploading operator can timely draw attention of the vehicle after running on the lane without running on the lane.

title_en: Automobile center console armrest box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile center console armrest box which comprises a rear positioning support and a cover body, a left button, a right button, a linkage support, two first shaft rods, two first protruding blocks, a first shaft rod and a second shaft rod, wherein the left button is arranged on the left side of the cover body, the right button is arranged on the right side of the cover body, the linkage support is arranged in an installation cavity, the left side of the linkage support is connected with the left button, the right side of the linkage support is connected with the right button, the left side and the right side of the linkage support are respectively provided with a first guide slot hole, the front ends of the two first shaft rods are provided with first protruding blocks which are vertical upwards, the first protruding blocks are arranged in the first guide slots, and the rear ends of the first shaft rods penetrate through the wall surface of the first recessed cavity to be spliced with the fixed support.

title_en: Compact electric vehicle battery device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vehicles, in particular to a battery device for pressing an electric vehicle, which comprises a vehicle head vertical pipe, a left vehicle frame, a right vehicle frame, a battery mounting box, a battery cabin cover, a mounting frame and a battery mounting box pressing device, wherein two sides of one end of the battery cabin cover, which is close to the vehicle head vertical pipe, are respectively hinged with the front sections of the left vehicle frame and the right vehicle frame, the mounting frame is arranged on the battery cabin cover, mounting holes are formed in the joint positions of the lower sections of the mounting frame and the battery cabin cover, mounting lugs are arranged at the lower ends of the two sides of the mounting holes, the mounting holes are fixedly connected with the battery mounting box pressing device, the battery mounting box pressing device comprises an L-shaped cover plate and a buffer rubber cylinder, the proximal end of the bending position of the L-shaped cover plate is hinged with the mounting lugs, and the distal end of the bending position of the L-shaped cover plate is hinged with the buffer rubber cylinder. The technical scheme mainly comprises the steps of pressing the battery mounting box by using the battery mounting box pressing device to fix the battery mounting box, and solving the problem of attaching and loosening between a battery cabin cover and the battery mounting box of the existing electric vehicle.

title_en: Electric vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vehicles, in particular to an electric vehicle which comprises a motor, a battery assembly, a vehicle frame, a rear bottom fork and a rear bottom fork shaft, wherein a motor power output chain wheel and a rear wheel power input chain wheel are arranged at the rear section of the rear bottom fork, the rear wheel power input chain wheel is connected to a hub of the rear wheel, power is transmitted between the motor power output chain wheel and the rear wheel power input chain wheel through a chain or a belt, the motor comprises an inner stator and an outer rotor, an axial inner stator through hole is arranged in the center of the inner stator, the motor power output chain wheel is axially fixed on the side surface of the outer rotor, the rear bottom fork shaft is assembled in the inner stator through hole in a matched mode, and the central axis of the motor power output chain wheel, the central axis of the inner stator and the central axis of the rear bottom fork shaft are arranged on the same straight line.

title_en: Folding cart with linkage mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding trolley with a linkage mechanism, which comprises a folding underframe, a first side frame, a second side frame and the linkage mechanism, wherein the first side frame comprises a bearing upright rod, two ends of the folding underframe are respectively hinged with the two first side frames, the second side frame comprises a first folding rod group and a second folding rod group which are mutually hinged, and a connecting rod, the linkage mechanism comprises a linkage member which is arranged below the connecting rod at intervals and is hinged with the first side frame, and a cantilever part for suspending the linkage member, the upper end of the cantilever part is hinged with the connecting rod, the lower end of the cantilever part is hinged with the linkage member, and a polygonal linkage structure for linking the folding or unfolding of the first side frame and the second side frame is formed around the linkage member, the cantilever part, the connecting rod and the first side frame. The folding cart can further drive the first side frame and the second side frame to fold or unfold in a linkage manner through the linkage mechanism in the use process, is beneficial to the integral rapid folding and unfolding of the folding cart, and is simple in structure and convenient to use.

title_en: Sealing ring for charging port of electric automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing ring for an electric automobile charging port, which comprises a clamping ring, wherein the outer wall of the clamping ring is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the inner wall surface of the clamping ring is respectively and fixedly connected with a first sealing ring and a second sealing ring, and a cavity is formed between the first sealing ring and the second sealing ring. According to the utility model, the connecting blocks are arranged on the outer wall of the clamping ring, so that the cooperation between the connecting blocks and the clamping ring can be clamped in the clamping grooves on the inner wall of the charging port, and meanwhile, the first circular arc angles are formed on the surfaces of the first sealing ring and the second sealing ring, so that the problems in the background art are effectively solved by combining the cooperation of the structures.

title_en: Ultrahigh-pressure horizontal bottom rust removal operation vehicle for ship maintenance
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ultrahigh-pressure horizontal bottom rust removing operation vehicle for ship maintenance, which comprises a rust removing mechanism, a support column, an adjusting mechanism and a frame, wherein the rust removing mechanism is arranged at the top of the support column, the adjusting mechanism comprises two sets of connecting frames and adjusting components which are arranged in parallel up and down, two ends of each connecting frame are respectively hinged with the support column and the frame, the bottom end of each adjusting component is connected to the frame, the top end of each adjusting component is connected with the middle part of the connecting frame, and the adjusting mechanism adjusts the angle between the connecting frames and the frame. The operation angle of the ultrahigh pressure water rust removing head can be adjusted, and the ultrahigh pressure water rust removing head slightly inclines along with the angle of the ship bottom, so that the ultrahigh pressure water rust removing head is in close contact with the ship bottom, and the rust removing effect is improved. Through the setting of link and guiding mechanism, can be with the operation altitude mixture control to the superhigh pressure water rust cleaning head, simple and practical improves work efficiency. The waste water and scraps produced by rust removal can be discharged and treated through a waste discharge channel.

title_en: High-voltage loop conduction control device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-voltage loop conduction control device which comprises a cooperative pin, a push plate, a pin linkage rod and a movable insert, wherein the top end of the cooperative pin is provided with the push plate matched with a product to be demolded, a pin horizontal movement hole penetrating along the horizontal direction and an insert hole perpendicular to the pin horizontal movement hole in the horizontal direction are arranged near the push plate, the pin linkage rod is penetrated and connected in the pin horizontal movement hole, and the movable insert is vertically inlaid on the pin linkage rod along the horizontal direction and penetrates out of the insert hole. In the mode, the utility model provides the high-voltage loop conduction control device, and the position degree control of the inner rotor is realized through the rotation of the middle rotating shaft, so that the output control of the high-voltage circuit is realized. And the relay is replaced, the application control of an intermediate process is saved, and the integral control is realized through the position degree limitation.

title_en: High-integration induction device two-wheel vehicle electronic lock system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-integration induction device two-wheel vehicle electronic lock system which is provided with a knob, a lock shell, a lock pin, a rotating shaft positioned in the lock shell, a signal control unit and a deflector rod control unit, wherein the signal control unit and the deflector rod control unit are coaxially connected with the rotating shaft. The driving lever control unit consists of a driving lever mechanism, a sliding block and a sliding block sensing device. Compared with the prior art, the trigger structure of the sliding block sensing device is arranged on the sliding block, the corresponding trigger unit sliding block is provided with the sensing device, and the signal control unit PCB above the sliding block is directly arranged on the PCB, so that the aim of integrating all the electronic lock sensing devices on one PCB is fulfilled, and the integration of the electronic lock system sensing devices of the two-wheeled vehicle is greatly improved.

title_en: Electrochromic device of automobile reflector
abstract_en: The electrochromic device of the automobile reflector comprises an upper layer, a middle layer and a lower layer, wherein the middle layer and the lower layer are formed by electrochromic liquid enclosed by frame glue, the frame glue is of a complete annular structure, a through hole is formed in the lower layer and close to the position of the frame glue, and a sealing plug capable of sealing the through hole is filled in the through hole. The utility model has the advantages that the liquid filling port is the through hole arranged on the lower layer, so that a notch is not required to be arranged on the frame adhesive for enclosing the electrochromic liquid, therefore, the frame adhesive is of a complete annular structure during manufacturing, the sealing consistency is good, the frame adhesive is convenient to manufacture, the sealing performance of the frame adhesive is better, the leakage of the electrochromic liquid at the frame adhesive can be effectively avoided, and the product quality is improved.

title_en: Quick assembly disassembly structure of power battery
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quick dismounting structure of a power battery, which comprises a quick dismounting connector and a positioning pin, wherein the quick dismounting connector comprises a vehicle body end connector, a battery end connector and a sleeve. The vehicle body end connector is provided with a locking spring, steel balls and an elastic retainer ring, and a plurality of cylindrical holes are distributed at equal intervals around the center of the vehicle body end connector in an annular array mode and used for accommodating the steel balls. The end part of the vehicle body end joint is provided with an annular semicircular groove for fixing the elastic retainer ring and preventing the steel ball and the sleeve from falling off. The battery end connector is provided with an annular trapezoid groove for accommodating the steel ball. When the battery is installed, the sleeve is pushed upwards, and the pressing force on the steel ball is relieved. The power battery quick-disassembly structure is simple and convenient to operate, and can realize quick power change of the power battery and quick detachment of the power battery when the power battery fires.

title_en: Transport vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a transport vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of battery pole piece production. The transport vehicle comprises a vehicle frame main body, a plurality of wheels, at least one bearing part and a plurality of magnetic attraction devices, wherein the vehicle frame main body comprises a bottom frame and a support fixedly connected with one side of the bottom frame, the wheels are fixed on one side of the bottom frame, which is away from the support, at least one bearing part is fixed on the support and used for bearing pole piece coil stock, the magnetic attraction devices are connected with the vehicle frame main body, and at least part of the magnetic devices in the magnetic attraction devices are distributed on the bottom frame. According to the application, the plurality of magnetic attraction devices are arranged on the frame main body of the transport vehicle, so that a magnetic field coverage area can be formed around the transport vehicle, the pole piece coil stock is positioned in the magnetic field coverage area after being loaded on the transport vehicle, and the magnetic attraction devices can adsorb metal dust in the process of transporting the pole piece coil stock into the oven for baking, so that the cleanliness of the pole piece and the quality of a final product are improved.

title_en: Rotatable folding table
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable folding table plate which comprises a table plate main body and a cup groove arranged on the table plate main body, wherein the bottom end of the table plate main body is connected with a rotating seat, and a first expansion plate is connected to the outer part of the rotating seat in a rotating mode. This rotatable folding table, through being provided with first extension board, rotate out first extension board from table main part bottom, thereby the usable floor area of table main part has been enlarged, use through the cooperation friction ring, resistance when increasing first extension board rotation, thereby improve the rotatory stability of back of first extension board, through being provided with first connecting seat, connecting rod and second connecting seat, can make first extension board and second extension board fold, after the second extension board is overturned through the user, second extension board can keep the horizontality with first extension board, thereby further enlarged the usable floor area that the user placed the article, cooperation through first extension board and second extension board is used, further improved the result of use of table main part.

title_en: BMS integrated support
abstract_en: The utility model provides a BMS integrated bracket which is used for battery limiting and fixing equipment and comprises a base, wherein a supporting seat is welded on the base, a movable seat is movably installed on the supporting seat, a fixed plate is welded at one end of the movable seat, fixing grooves are formed in the fixed plate and the base, a limiting plate is welded on the base and matched with the movable seat, a weight reducing opening is formed in the movable seat, and a heat radiating opening is formed in the base. According to the wire arranging device, the wire arranging plate in the wire arranging device moves downwards under the pushing of the supporting mechanism, the wire arranging plate moves upwards to extrude and fix the wire harness, the wire harness is convenient to arrange in the later period after being extruded and fixed, the baffle plate is matched with the supporting seat to protect the side of the wire harness, and damage to the wire harness caused by external collision force is avoided.

title_en: Rail locomotive backstop installation component
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rail locomotive backseat and discloses a rail locomotive backseat mounting assembly, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a mounting groove is formed in one side end surface of the mounting frame, a first clamping block is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the rear side in the mounting groove, four first positioning holes are formed in the mounting frame, the rail locomotive backseat mounting assembly aligns the first clamping groove and the second clamping groove formed in the first fixing block and the second fixing block into the first clamping block and the second clamping block in the mounting frame, thereby make first fixed block and second fixed block all by the block in the mounting bracket, later the staff also can insert second locating hole and third locating hole after inserting the locating bolt in the first locating hole to in with first fixed block and second fixed block are fixed the mounting bracket, so this just makes when installing it comparatively simple also comparatively swift, also is convenient for follow-up staff come to dismantle it simultaneously.

title_en: Railway track line inspection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway track line inspection device which comprises a steel rail and a walking platform, wherein a plurality of walking mechanisms are arranged at the top angle of the bottom of the walking platform, an installation table is fixed at the front end of the top of the walking platform, a controller is arranged in the middle of the top of the walking platform, a wireless transmission module is fixed at the tail end of the top of the walking platform, an installation baffle is arranged between the installation table and the wireless transmission module, a fault displacing mechanism is arranged on the walking platform, a cleaning mechanism is arranged in front of the walking mechanism at the front end of the walking platform, and a marking assembly is arranged on the walking platform. The utility model aims to clean foreign matters on the steel rail, also can block the foreign matters flying backwards, prevent the foreign matters from obstructing the normal movement of the walking platform, and can cross a railway track with damage failure, and paint marks are made near the railway track with breakage or failure, so that the steel rail is convenient to repair by subsequent staff.

title_en: Fatigue test loading device of main landing gear
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fatigue test loading device of a main landing gear, which relates to the technical field of detection of airplane components, and comprises the following steps of 1) arranging a driving device to drive an upper seat to slide up and down along an upright post, extruding the main landing gear through an upper workbench and a lower workbench, and adjusting the load size of the main landing gear, 2) arranging a first sliding plate sliding along the rolling direction of a wheel to simulate the sliding landing load of the main landing gear and the sliding load of the main landing gear, 3) arranging a second sliding plate sliding along the rolling direction of a vertical wheel to drive the wheel to turn and simulate the turning load of the main landing gear, 4) controlling the wheel to brake through a control piece to simulate the braking load of the main landing gear, and arranging various load test conditions by the fatigue test loading device, so that the test efficiency is improved, and the fatigue test loading device is convenient for workers to use.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted bracket
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle-mounted support, which comprises a base assembly, a rotating assembly, a folding assembly and a connecting assembly, wherein the base assembly comprises a supporting seat and a sucker, the rotating assembly is connected with the supporting seat in a rotating mode, the folding assembly is connected with the rotating assembly in a rotating mode, the folding assembly comprises a first connecting structure and a second connecting structure, the first connecting structure is connected with the second connecting structure in a rotating mode, the second connecting structure is connected with the rotating assembly in a rotating mode, the connecting assembly is connected with the first connecting structure in a rotating mode, the folding assembly is in a folding state and an extending state, the first connecting structure can be folded and contained in the second connecting structure to enable the height of the connecting assembly to be reduced, and the first connecting structure extends out of the second connecting structure to enable the height of the connecting assembly to be increased in the extending state. Compared with the prior art, the vehicle-mounted support provided by the application is convenient to adjust the height and is convenient to carry and use.

title_en: Light curtain type automobile anti-pinch electric skylight
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of skylights, in particular to a light curtain type automobile anti-pinch electric skylight. The technical scheme includes that the automobile mounting frame comprises a mounting frame and further comprises a skylight, the skylight is fixedly installed on the mounting frame, a sealing mechanism for sealing the edge of the mounting frame and the joint of the automobile is arranged on the mounting frame, the sealing mechanism comprises a mounting groove fixedly installed on the mounting frame, a sealing groove is formed in the periphery of the mounting frame, a sealing air bag is fixedly installed in the sealing groove, a sealing cabin is fixedly installed in the mounting groove, and the sealing cabin is a cavity. The utility model realizes the improvement of the tightness between the vehicle body and the skylight, prevents dust from entering the vehicle, improves the cleanliness of the skylight, and prevents dust accumulation from affecting lighting.

title_en: Mobile platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile platform, which comprises a supporting frame and a mounting plate arranged at the top of the supporting frame, wherein a plurality of fixing components are arranged at the bottom of the supporting frame, a plurality of moving components are arranged at the bottom of the supporting frame, each moving component comprises a rotating shaft which is connected at the bottom of the supporting frame in a matched mode, a hinge piece is arranged at the bottom of each rotating shaft, a mobile wheel is movably connected at the bottom of each hinge piece, a brake mechanism is arranged on one side of each mobile wheel, the mobile wheels are connected with the corresponding hinge piece in a matched mode through the rotating shafts, universal rotation of the mobile wheels is achieved, 360-degree rotation of the mobile platform is achieved, moving flexibility is improved, and in addition, the bottom of the supporting frame is provided with the fixing components with adjustable heights, and after the mobile platform moves to a set position, the mobile platform can be firmly fixed.

title_en: A frame car for rocket body structure butt joint
abstract_en: The application discloses a trolley for butt joint of rocket body structures, which belongs to the technical field of rocket body structure butt joint equipment and has the technical scheme that the trolley comprises a trolley body, a bearing frame, a horizontal adjusting assembly and a lifting assembly, wherein the trolley body is connected with a sliding rail through rollers in a sliding manner, the trolley body is connected with a brake assembly, the bearing frame is connected with the trolley body and is used for supporting the rocket body structures, the horizontal adjusting assembly is arranged between the bearing frame and the trolley body and is connected with the bearing frame and the trolley body and is used for adjusting the bearing frame in the horizontal direction, and the lifting assembly is arranged between the horizontal adjusting assembly and the bearing frame and is connected with the horizontal adjusting assembly and the bearing frame and is used for adjusting the bearing frame in the vertical direction so as to achieve the effect of high-efficiency butt joint of the rocket body structures.

title_en: Structure for opening fuel tank cover by mechanical and electric combined inhaul cable
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of motorcycle parts, in particular to a mechanical and electric combined type inhaul cable opening fuel tank cap structure, which comprises a motorcycle frame, wherein a helmet box is fixedly arranged on the top side of the inside of the motorcycle frame, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on the right side of the inside of the motorcycle frame, a mounting plate is fixedly arranged on the front side of the bottom of the motorcycle frame, an electric control assembly is arranged on the mounting plate, the second inhaul cable core wire is pulled by the control of an electric signal through the electric control assembly, thereby the pulling joint board is on the round pin pole two, gets into and makes the joint board break away from the fuel tank cap latch hook, realizes the electronic unlocking to the fuel tank cap, and this unblock mode guarantees the convenience in the daily use, also can be under the circumstances that automatically controlled subassembly became invalid, thereby through the manual subassembly of installation on the helmet case, through manual operation pulling cable heart yearn one, and then pulling cable heart yearn two, realizes the manual unblock to the fuel tank cap, ensures the functionality of whole motorcycle fuel tank cap opening structure.

title_en: Formation placing device for unmanned aerial vehicle clusters
abstract_en: The application provides a formation placing device for unmanned aerial vehicle clusters, which belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle placing and solves the problem of inconvenient intermittent movement blanking, and comprises a storage box and a protective box, the storage box is internally provided with a protective box, a first bevel gear is fixedly connected to the transmission gear, a second bevel gear is connected with the first bevel gear in a meshed mode, and the connecting shaft is rotatably connected in the supporting box. The application is provided with the half gear, when the equipment is moved, the second motor can be started to drive the half gear to rotate, the transmission gear can be driven to rotate when the half gear rotates, the transmission gear can drive the first conical gear to rotate, the connecting shaft can be driven to rotate by the second conical gear, the connecting shaft can drive the equipment to move by using the moving gear, the half gear rotates for one circle to drive the connected moving gear to rotate, the equipment can be stopped from moving by the half gear, and the intermittent movement of the equipment is facilitated.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted modularized box system
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle-mounted modularized box body system which comprises a mother box and a child box, wherein the mother box is adapted to the tail of an automobile, the mother box comprises at least two drawers, each drawer comprises a cabinet body, a sliding rail and a supporting bracket, the sliding rail is connected with the cabinet body and the supporting bracket at the same time, the supporting bracket can move along the opening direction of the cabinet body, the child box is detachably connected with the supporting bracket through a fixing device, and at least one child box can be installed on each drawer. According to the application, the main box and the sub box are arranged, so that the main box can be placed or fixed on the tail box, and can be used as a large-sized closeable cabinet body to protect objects stored in the main box well, and the overall attractiveness is maintained. The sub-boxes are used for storing or combining material appliances and facility equipment, and users can match the sub-box modules according to needs and fix the sub-box modules to the main box, and the effects of being combined according to needs, safe and easy to use are achieved through the combination of the main box and the sub-box.

title_en: Lithium tantalate single crystal rod travelling bogie
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a lithium tantalate single crystal rod transportation trolley which comprises an underframe, a first vertical frame, a second vertical frame, at least one hand-pushing assembly, at least one first supporting rod and at least one second supporting rod, wherein the first vertical frame and the second vertical frame are fixedly connected to the underframe and are perpendicular to the underframe, the first vertical frame and the second vertical frame are respectively provided with at least one hand-pushing assembly, the first supporting rod is fixedly connected to the first vertical frame, the second supporting rod is fixedly connected to the second vertical frame, the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod are located at the same height and are mutually parallel, and the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod jointly support the lithium tantalate single crystal rod.

title_en: Fixing device for accommodating touch pen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fixing device for accommodating a touch pen, which comprises a fixing component, a bearing unit, the touch pen and an automatic wire collector, wherein the fixing component is used for being fixed on a mounting piece, the bearing unit is rotatably arranged on the fixing component, the bearing unit is provided with a cavity communicated with the outside, the touch pen is locally inserted into the cavity, the touch pen is provided with a touch pen head and a combination end part far away from the touch pen head, the automatic wire collector is arranged in the bearing unit, the automatic wire collector is provided with a stretchable wire and extends into the cavity, the wire is connected with the combination end part, and therefore a user can take out the touch pen from the cavity for use, and when the touch pen is not used, the combination end part is pulled by the wire to enable the touch pen to return to the cavity.

title_en: Offshore hoisting maintenance platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of offshore maintenance platforms, in particular to an offshore hoisting maintenance platform, which comprises a base, four supporting plates, two adjusting mechanisms, two guide rails, two movable blocks, a movable platform and a protection mechanism, wherein the number of the supporting plates is four and the supporting plates are respectively positioned on the four sides outside the base, the adjusting mechanisms are respectively arranged below the base and below each supporting plate, the number of the guide rails is two and are respectively positioned on the left side and the right side of the base, the movable blocks are slidably arranged on the guide rails, the movable platform is movably arranged on the movable blocks, the protection mechanism is arranged on the movable platform and is used for protecting the movable platform, and the movable platform can be moved by longitudinally moving the movable platform above the base, rotating the movable platform on the movable block and adjusting the height of the movable platform, so that the use range of the movable platform is further improved, and the practicability of the movable platform is further improved.

title_en: Agricultural auxiliary operation machinery vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of agricultural machinery, in particular to an agricultural auxiliary operation mechanical vehicle, which comprises an auxiliary operation vehicle body, wherein a seat support is arranged at the front end of the auxiliary operation vehicle body, a seat is fixedly connected to the top end of the seat support, universal wheels are symmetrically arranged at the rear end of the auxiliary operation vehicle body, motors are symmetrically arranged on a middle platform of the operation vehicle body, an accelerator pedal I is arranged at the top end of the auxiliary operation vehicle body, and a brake pedal is arranged on one side of the accelerator pedal I. Through seat support and the seat that sets up, carry out suitable adjustment according to the crowd of different physique, provide a relative comfortable position of sitting position operation for operating personnel, through setting up the universal wheel, accelerator pedal one, brake pedal for auxiliary operation car main part avoids the action such as the frequent work of operator, low level removal to work in narrow field ridge or the irregularly shaped operation region of shape, can easily change the direction of travel.

title_en: Pallet feeding trolley
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pallet loading trolley, which comprises a storage frame body for stacking pallets, wherein the bottom of the storage frame body is fixedly connected with a bottom frame body through a side bracket, at least two rollers are uniformly arranged at the bottom of the bottom frame body, a handle is arranged on one side of the pallet loading trolley, a limiting block group uniformly used for supporting the pallets is arranged at the top of the storage frame body, the limiting block group surrounds a loading position matched with the size of the pallets, the pallets are stacked in the loading position, and the limiting block group can simultaneously support the pallets and limit the pallets without separating from the trolley, so that the pallets are kept stable in transportation. The trolley bottom is provided with the roller wheels, the tray feeding trolley can easily move on the ground, and the trolley is particularly suitable for moving the tray along the long line distance. And the pallet is moved by the trolley, so that the equipment cost is lower.

title_en: Portable electric pile probe electricity taking device that fills
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile charging pile probe electricity taking device which is characterized by comprising a guide rail, wherein a robot trolley is assembled on the guide rail, a charging box is assembled at the bottom of the robot trolley, a copper sheet mounting plate is assembled on the charging box, a truss is hung on an external wall, one side of the truss is built on the top of the robot trolley, a charging seat is assembled at the bottom of the truss, and a probe electricity taking mechanism is assembled on the charging seat. Because the traditional male and female heads require accurate butt joint of the male and female heads in butt joint power taking, after multiple plugging and unplugging, the accurate butt joint cannot be accurately performed due to low precision of shaking, processing and assembling, the utility model adopts the probe electricity taking mode to allow certain deviation of the butt joint position, greatly reduces the processing difficulty and the assembly difficulty of the charging pile, reduces the production cost to a certain extent, and improves the charging efficiency and the stability of the charging box and the charging seat.

title_en: Compound magnetism is inhaled formula and is pressed and prevent drawing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable pull-up prevention, in particular to a compound magnetic pressing pull-up prevention device which comprises at least one unit device, a magnetic clamping head, a binding belt, a magnetic clamping seat and a magnetic clamping seat, wherein the unit device comprises a shell, the shell is arranged on a matched vehicle body or equipment of a charging cable, the mounting hole is formed in the side wall of the shell, the magnetic clamping head is arranged in the shell and extends out of the shell through the mounting hole, the binding belt is provided with a fixed end and a movable end and is arranged on the vehicle body or equipment matched with the charging cable, the fixed end and the shell of the binding belt are respectively positioned on two sides of the charging cable, and the magnetic clamping seat is arranged at the movable end of the binding belt. According to the utility model, the binding bands covering the two sides of the charging cable are mutually clamped together through the magnetic attraction matching pressing of the magnetic attraction type clamping seat and the magnetic attraction type clamping head, so that the operation efficiency and the safety of binding the charging cable are greatly improved.

title_en: Integrated automobile child safety seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated automobile child safety seat, which comprises a first backrest, a second backrest, a seat rotationally connected with the second backrest and pedals which can be rotationally or detachably arranged relative to the seat, wherein the integrated automobile child safety seat has a first use state and a second use state, and when in the first use state, the second backrest is close to the seat, and the pedals are close to the seat or the pedals are detached; in the second use state, the second backrest is away from the seat and the footrests are away from the seat. The integrated automobile child safety seat is used for taking an adult in a first use state and taking a child in a second use state. This integrated form car child safety seat is in the same place child safety seat and car seat integration setting, has avoided the problem that often dismouting child safety seat brought, also need not to consider child safety seat and does not use the problem of depositing moreover. And the utilization rate is high, and the waste can be avoided.

title_en: Environment-friendly dust falling device for building construction management
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building construction dust fall, and discloses an environment-friendly dust fall device for building construction management, which comprises a base, wherein a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged in the middle of the top of the base, a second U-shaped part is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a liquid storage tank is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the rotating shaft, a first U-shaped part is symmetrically and fixedly connected with the two sides of the front part and the rear part of the liquid storage tank, a plurality of atomizing nozzles are arranged in the first U-shaped part, a servo motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the second U-shaped part, and a reciprocating screw rod and a sliding block are rotatably arranged and slidingly connected in the second U-shaped part respectively. According to the utility model, the servo motor can drive the atomizing nozzle to rotate in a reciprocating manner in the horizontal direction and can drive the spraying angle of the atomizing nozzle to rotate in a reciprocating manner, so that the range of spraying dust fall is greatly increased, a pipeline is not wound, a large amount of water is not required to be used for dust fall in the same range, and the environmental protection is realized.

title_en: Buckled automobile cushion
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a buckled automobile seat cushion, it includes that flexible rectangular magnetism is inhaled and is detained, flexible rectangular magnetism is inhaled the lower surface laminating of detaining and is had the flexible concatenation cushion, the both ends surface of flexible concatenation cushion is fixedly connected with cushion flexible magnetism respectively and is inhaled detaining area two and cushion flexible magnetism and inhale detaining area one, the lower extreme surface fixedly connected with flexible magnetism of flexible concatenation cushion is inhaled detaining area, the inner surface laminating of detaining area is inhaled to flexible magnetism of lower floor has the ventilative sleeve cushion of magnetic, the lower extreme surface laminating of ventilative sleeve cushion of lower floor has cushion flexible magnetism to inhale detaining area two and cushion flexible magnetism to inhale detaining area one, the flexible magnetism of cushion is inhaled detaining area two and cushion flexible magnetism and is inhaled detaining area one's inner surface joint fixedly connected with can extend concatenation cushion, through the cooperation use of above part, realized the quick installation and the dismantlement function of cushion in addition, also realized the nimble increase and decrease of cushion, better adaptation different specification seat's installation demand.

title_en: Air suspension dust cover convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air suspensions, and discloses an air suspension dust cover convenient to maintain, which comprises a dust cover main body, shaft bodies are arranged at two ends of the dust cover main body, the both sides of axis body all rotate and are connected with first end cover and second end cover, the gasbag has been placed to the inside of dust cover main part. This air suspension dust cover convenient to maintain, through twisting the knob, it is rotatory rather than fixed stopper to drive, make the stopper keep away from the fly leaf, the promotion of fly leaf through reset spring resilience force later takes the fixed block away from the inside of fixed slot, remove the fixed between gasbag and the first casing, simultaneously, user rotatable first end cover or second end cover, remove the zonulae occludens between other parts, can take off the dust cover main part from the gasbag, maintain the operation, need not to disassemble on a large scale whole air suspension, maintenance degree of difficulty and time cost have been reduced.

title_en: Instrument panel display screen for electric scooter
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric scooter, and discloses an instrument panel display screen for an electric scooter. According to the application, the outer protection frame is fixedly arranged in the upper shell, the inner fixing frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the outer protection frame, the protective glass is embedded in the inner fixing frame, the waterproof membrane is wrapped on the periphery of the inner fixing frame, the display screen is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the protective glass, the outer protection frame is arranged in the upper shell of the instrument panel, the inner fixing frame is arranged in the outer protection frame, the protective glass with a protection function is arranged in the inner fixing frame, three-level protection is formed, the waterproof membrane shoulder connected with the protective glass is used for preventing the inner display screen from being damaged, the waterproof and rainproof functions are carried out, the outer protection frame and the protective glass are fixed through threads from the bottommost part, and the protective glass can be directly detached for reinstallation when maintenance and replacement are needed, so that the working time and the cost are saved.

title_en: Speed regulating instrument for electric bicycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric bicycle speed regulation instrument, which comprises a main body mounting piece, wherein the top of the main body mounting piece is provided with an instrument, the middle part of the front surface of the main body mounting piece is rotatably provided with a speed regulation handle, the instrument comprises a transparent surface shell, a middle shell, a bottom shell, a circuit board, a display screen and waterproof silica gel keys, the bottom shell is arranged at the top of the main body mounting piece, the transparent surface shell is arranged on the bottom shell, the middle shell is arranged between the transparent surface shell and the bottom shell, the edge connection part of the transparent surface shell and the middle shell is provided with sealant, the circuit board is arranged in the middle shell, the display screen is arranged between the circuit board and the middle shell, a visible window is formed in the position of the middle shell opposite to the display screen, and a key mounting groove is formed in the middle shell. According to the utility model, through the cooperation among the transparent surface shell, the middle shell and the bottom shell and the arrangement of the sealing glue and the waterproof silica gel keys at the edge connection part, the integral waterproof capability of the instrument is greatly enhanced.

title_en: Sliding rail structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric sliding rails and discloses a sliding rail structure which comprises a lower rail, an upper rail module, a shielding belt and a shielding belt, wherein an opening is formed upwards along the length direction of the lower rail, a first winding belt wheel is arranged at one end, close to the lower rail, of the lower rail, a second winding belt wheel is arranged at the other end, close to the lower rail, of the lower rail, the upper rail module is arranged on the lower rail and can slide along the opening, one end of the shielding belt is connected to the upper rail module, the other end of the shielding belt bypasses the first winding belt wheel and the second winding belt wheel and is connected to the upper rail module, and when the upper rail module slides along the opening, the shielding belt is driven to always keep shielding the opening. The utility model has the advantages that the sliding rail structure can prevent foreign matters from entering the lower rail, has good safety performance, high aesthetic degree and strong bearing capacity of the shielding belt.

title_en: Crawler-type engineering machinery drag chain wheel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler-type engineering machinery towing sprocket which comprises a towing sprocket body, wherein one end of the towing sprocket body is provided with a towing sprocket rim, the towing sprocket rims are symmetrically arranged at two ends of the towing sprocket body, and one end of the towing sprocket body is provided with a towing sprocket shaft; according to the utility model, the guide block is matched with the guide groove, so that accurate installation is ensured, offset shaking is reduced, the L-shaped clamping block is rotationally clamped with the arc-shaped groove, circumferential preliminary positioning is realized, the limiting block is locked, loosening and falling are prevented, the limiting block is operated to withdraw through the pulling block during replacement, the locking is conveniently released, the reverse rotation and sliding can be completed, the disassembly is completed, the whole process is easy and convenient to operate, the positioning is accurate, the connection is stable, the installation and replacement efficiency and the equipment reliability are effectively improved, the wheel rim of the drag chain wheel and the wheel body of the drag chain wheel are disassembled, the rapid replacement can be realized when the wheel body of the drag chain wheel is worn, and the condition that a great amount of waste is caused to the whole replacement of the support chain wheel is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent driving trolley
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent driving trolley, which relates to the technical field of intelligent driving, wherein the intelligent driving trolley comprises a trolley body and a tail cover, the trolley body comprises a trolley cover, the trolley cover is provided with a first magnetic attraction part and a connecting port, the tail cover is combined with one side of the trolley cover, the tail cover is provided with a second magnetic attraction part corresponding to the first magnetic attraction part, the tail cover is also provided with a first convex part corresponding to the connecting port, the first convex part is in clamping connection with the connecting port, and the first magnetic attraction part is in magnetic attraction connection with the second magnetic attraction part.

title_en: Automobile side apron board turnover mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile side apron board turnover mechanism, which relates to the technical field of automobiles and comprises a fixed support, a main body support rod, a turnover support, a first support, a second support, a third support, a fourth support and a third support, wherein the fixed support is arranged on a frame longitudinal beam of an automobile, one end of the main body support rod is hinged with a first end of the fixed support, the other end of the main body support rod is fixedly connected with a first support arranged on a side apron board of the automobile, the turnover support comprises a first telescopic rod and a second telescopic rod, the first end of the first telescopic rod is hinged with a second end of the fixed support, the second end of the first telescopic rod is hinged with a second support arranged on the main body support rod, the first end of the second telescopic rod is hinged with a third support arranged on the side apron board, the second end of the second telescopic rod is hinged with a fourth support arranged on the main body support rod, and the second support and the first telescopic rod, the fourth support and the second telescopic rod are respectively positioned on two sides of the main body support rod. The utility model has simple structure, easy manufacture and installation, convenient operation, easy turnover of the side skirt board and improved working efficiency.

title_en: Guard board assembly, A column and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a guard plate assembly, an A column and a vehicle. The backplate assembly includes camera, backplate and apron, and the backplate is formed with the holding tank, and the camera sets up in the holding tank, and apron swing joint is in the backplate, and the apron can be for backplate motion to switch between first position and second position, in first position, the holding tank is established to the apron lid, in order to shelter from the camera, in the second position, the apron exposes at least part holding tank, in order to make the camera that exposes can shoot the driver. According to the guard board assembly provided by the embodiment of the application, the protruding structure at the guard board due to the installation of the camera can be effectively avoided, so that the structure of the guard board assembly is prevented from being locally raised or obvious external modules are formed, the overall aesthetic property of the vehicle interior is ensured, and the privacy of a user is ensured.

title_en: Lightweight motorcycle frame
