abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lightweight motorcycle frame which comprises an aluminum alloy fixing frame, wherein a movable hole is formed in the fixing frame, a pressure spring is arranged in the movable hole, the fixing frame and an extension rod are movably connected, a movable groove is formed in the outer surface of the fixing frame, a connecting block is rotatably connected in the movable groove, a movable plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the connecting block, a limiting plate is fixedly connected to one end of the extension rod, the surface of the limiting plate is fixedly connected with one end of the pressure spring, the strength and toughness of the fixing frame are enhanced, the vibration and impact resistance are improved, the fixing looseness is avoided, the loading capacity of the frame is improved, the limitation of a traditional fixed tailstock is improved, the flexibility and the adaptability of the structure are improved, the overall firmness and the operation convenience are improved, and the lightweight motorcycle frame is more suitable for various use scenes, tailstocks with different sizes or carrying requirements.

title_en: Power distribution device, main unit cabinet and charging system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electric power distribution device, a mainframe cabinet and a charging system, which comprises a bracket and an electric power distribution module, wherein the bracket comprises a mounting plate and a first support plate, a chute is arranged on the first surface of the mounting plate, the first support plate is fixed on the mounting plate and is positioned at the end part of the chute, the electric power distribution module is supported on the first support plate, and the electric power distribution module is slidably arranged at the chute.

title_en: Self-adaptive safety airbag device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of safety airbags, in particular to a self-adaptive safety airbag device which comprises an airbag main body, wherein an inner bag is arranged in the airbag main body, the inner part of the airbag main body is divided into a high-pressure area and a low-pressure area by the inner bag, the inner part of the inner bag is a high-pressure area, the outer part of the inner bag is a low-pressure area, a plurality of air holes are formed in the side wall of the inner bag, and a sealing structure is arranged in the air holes.

title_en: Anti-skid grain structure for motorcycle pedal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-skid grain structure for a motorcycle pedal, which comprises a first pedal, wherein an anti-skid mechanism is arranged on the surface of the first pedal, the anti-skid mechanism comprises a second pedal, a through hole, fixing columns, rubber protrusions and threaded holes, the lower end of the first pedal is provided with the second pedal, the surfaces of the outer sides of the first pedal and the second pedal are mutually matched, so that the second pedal can be attached to the first pedal for installation, a plurality of through holes are uniformly formed in the surface of the outer side of the first pedal, and a plurality of fixing columns are uniformly and fixedly arranged on the surface of the second pedal. The pedal part of the utility model adopts a split design, when the antiskid effect is reduced due to the fact that a large amount of soil is clamped at the upper end of the pedal, the device can quickly disassemble the pedal part to facilitate cleaning work, and meanwhile, the device can disassemble and replace the rubber bulge part according to the requirement after the rubber bulge is worn, so that the whole pedal can be prevented from being replaced.

title_en: Anti-collision rear axle of electric vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-collision rear axle of an electric vehicle, which comprises a rear axle body, arc-shaped anti-collision shells, a supporting buffer assembly and a supporting buffer assembly, wherein the arc-shaped anti-collision shells are arranged below the rear axle body and are matched with the rear axle body in shape, the supporting buffer assembly is arranged above the rear axle body and comprises a group of U-shaped hanging plates arranged above the rear axle body, a sliding frame connected to each U-shaped hanging plate in a sliding mode, and the bottom ends of the sliding frames are connected with the arc-shaped anti-collision shells. Through the cooperation of the support buffer assembly that sets up with the arc anticollision shell, can stabilize the arc anticollision shell in rear axle body below, not only can form the protection to the rear axle body, can avoid transmitting the collision force to the rear axle body when receiving the collision moreover on to guarantee the normal use of rear axle body, and can buffer the collision force that the arc anticollision shell received, effectively avoid it to appear warping the damage condition, further guarantee its effect that continuously protects the rear axle body.

title_en: Multi-section bending equipment for awning of tricycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-section bending device for a tricycle hood, which comprises four hood bending frames, wherein a square structure is formed by encircling a plurality of hood bending frames, the tops of the hood bending frames are fixedly provided with connecting arc plates, a hood main body is fixedly arranged between the tops of the connecting arc plates, the right end of the outer side of the hood main body is fixedly provided with a front baffle hood, the front baffle hood is integrally and obliquely arranged, the bottoms of the hood bending frames are respectively provided with a protection component, the protection components are used for protecting a buffer protection cushion, the buffer protection cushions are respectively fixed at the bottoms of the hood bending frames, the buffer protection cushion is fixedly provided with a buffer support outer plate, the inner side of the buffer support outer plate is matched with the outer side of the buffer protection cushion, and the light weight, wind resistance and long-term stable use of the hood are realized through the synergistic effect of the multi-section bending frames, the buffer components and rigid connecting pieces, so that the safety and the durability are improved.

title_en: Seat small table plate with cosmetic mirror and magnetic attraction support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile seat small table plates, in particular to a seat small table plate with a cosmetic mirror and a magnetic attraction bracket, which adopts a table plate body and a bracket assembly hinged to the top of the table plate body through a stepless hovering rotating shaft, wherein a magnet sheet is arranged in the bracket assembly, and the cosmetic mirror is fixedly attached to the bracket assembly; if the user needs the support to support cell-phone or Ipad, the support assembly is opened in the upset, but utilize the magnet piece in the support assembly to inhale fixed cell-phone or Ipad magnetism, avoid cell-phone or Ipad landing, satisfy the user to cosmetic mirror or support demand, and the support assembly articulates in desk body top through the pivot that infinitely hovers, avoids cosmetic mirror or support to have the landing risk.

title_en: Folding shopping cart with sliding cover plate and storage box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding shopping cart with a sliding cover plate and a storage box, which comprises the storage box, a pull rod and wheels, wherein the wheels are arranged at the bottom of the storage box, the storage box comprises a box body and a cover plate, the box body comprises a bottom plate, a left folding side plate, a right folding side plate, a rear plate and a front plate, the folding shopping cart consists of the storage box, the pull rod and the wheels, the upper ends of the inner sides of the left folding side plate and the right folding side plate of the storage box are provided with horizontal sliding grooves, an upper chute and an extension chute which are in butt joint with the horizontal chute are arranged on the front plate, a concave part is formed forward beyond the front surface, sliding parts are arranged on two sides of the front end of the cover plate, and the cover plate can move forward to the extension chute along the chute and then rotate 90 degrees, so that the cover plate is wholly suspended and hidden in the concave part, and the folded cover plate is not exposed, is more compact and convenient to store and carry.

title_en: Shower vehicle with drainage filtering structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shower vehicle with a drainage filtering structure, and relates to the technical field of shower vehicles. The shower bath device comprises a shower bath body, wherein a shower bath room body is arranged in the shower bath body, a drainage mechanism for shower bath is arranged on the shower bath room body, the drainage mechanism comprises a filtering component, a standing frame is arranged at the lower end of the shower bath room body, a convex surface is arranged at the bottom of the standing frame, an annular groove is formed in the edge of the lower end of the convex surface, a first drainage groove is formed in the four ends of the annular groove, and a mounting component comprises a second drainage groove corresponding to the first drainage groove and is arranged at the bottom of the shower bath body.

title_en: Oil separation assembly, compressor with same and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil separation assembly, a compressor with the same and a vehicle, wherein the oil separation assembly comprises a shell, a compressor body and a compressor body, wherein the shell defines an oil separation cavity, and the oil separation cavity is provided with an air inlet channel; the liquid stabilizing piece is arranged in the oil cavity and is positioned between the air inlet channel and the bottom wall of the oil cavity. According to the oil separation assembly provided by the embodiment of the utility model, the problem of unstable liquid level of oil at the bottom of the oil cavity can be solved by arranging the liquid stabilizing piece in the oil cavity, so that refrigerant gas in the oil cavity is prevented from flowing into the oil return channel through a gap between the oil and the oil cavity, and then flows into the low-pressure side of the compressor, and the performance and reliability of the compressor are prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Material loading device for vehicle assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a material loading device for vehicle assembly, which comprises a main body frame and a heightened movable chassis, wherein the main body frame is of a multi-layer rectangular frame structure and comprises rectangular bottom plates and vertical beams, a plurality of vertical beams are symmetrically arranged on the front side and the rear side of each layer of rectangular bottom plates, the distance between two adjacent vertical beams positioned on the left side of the main body frame is larger than the distance between two adjacent vertical beams positioned on the right side of the main body frame, and the heightened movable chassis is arranged at the bottom of the main body frame.

title_en: Backrest and tricycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a backrest, which relates to the technical field of electric vehicle accessories and comprises a support frame and a backrest cushion, wherein the support frame comprises a first support and a second support, the first support is fixedly connected with the second support, one end of the first support, which is far away from the second support, is fixedly connected to the side part of a seat barrel of a tricycle, one end of the second support, which is far away from the first support, is fixedly connected with the backrest cushion, the first support extends from the side part of the seat barrel towards the rear of the tricycle and is fixedly connected with the second support, the second support extends from a position of a connection point with the first direct connection point towards the upper part of the tricycle and is fixedly connected with the backrest cushion, and the connection point is positioned at the rear edge of the seat barrel. The utility model also discloses a tricycle, which comprises a seat barrel and the backrest. The utility model makes the passengers get on and off conveniently, and improves the convenience of use.

title_en: High-speed wire harness connector for electronic rearview mirror
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile wire harnesses, in particular to a high-speed wire harness connector for an electronic rearview mirror, wherein an inner hole is formed in a plug-in end of a connector body, a terminal assembly is arranged in the middle of the inner hole, one side surface of the connector body is an arc-shaped side surface, the other three side surfaces are planes, one side edge of the plug-in end of the connector body is provided with a protrusion extending outwards, the protrusion faces the arc-shaped side surface, a notch is formed in the side edge of the plug-in end of the connector body, the inner hole is communicated with the protrusion through the notch, three side edges of the notch extend outwards to form an outer protruding part, the outer protruding part positioned on the protruding part is in contact with the inner wall of the protrusion, a fan-shaped through hole is formed by surrounding the protrusion, the outer protruding part and the connector body, a cover is arranged on the side surface of the connector body, the cover is arranged on the same side surface of the connector body, the cover is arranged on the notch, and a gap is formed between the cover and the protrusion. Realize that asymmetric structure prevents slow-witted, accurate butt joint of direction inserted bar, occupation space is less, light in weight.

title_en: Dismounting equipment for helicopter tail rotor blade assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of helicopter maintenance, in particular to a dismounting device for a helicopter tail vane assembly, which comprises a base, wherein an electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged on the base, a mounting column is fixedly arranged at the top end of a driving shaft of the electric telescopic rod, an annular opening is formed in the surface of the mounting column, a rotary drum is rotatably arranged in the annular opening, a plurality of connecting rods are arranged on the surface of the rotary drum, a mounting block is fixedly arranged on the connecting rods, a rotary rod is rotatably arranged in the mounting block, a gear is fixedly sleeved on the rotary rod, a mounting frame is slidably arranged in the mounting block, and a rack rod is fixedly arranged on the surface of the mounting frame. Through the cooperation between rotary drum and the multiple installation frame, can assemble multi-disc paddle simultaneously to accomplish the dismouting work to multi-disc paddle in proper order, can only assemble a tail paddle once for traditional dismouting equipment, carry out the dismouting to a tail paddle, avoided a large amount of repeated labors, promoted work efficiency.

title_en: AGV dolly suitable for multiple box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an AGV trolley suitable for various boxes, which comprises a main body, a driving device arranged at the bottom end of the main body, a telescopic structure arranged at the front side of the main body and a lifting structure arranged at the front side of the main body, wherein a clamping device is arranged at the front side of the lifting structure, mounting mechanisms are arranged at the inner sides of the end parts of the clamping device, each mounting mechanism consists of a silica gel pad, a base and symmetrically arranged limiting components, each silica gel pad is arranged at the front side of the base, the symmetrically arranged limiting components are arranged between the base and the clamping device, an anti-slip component is arranged on the surface of each silica gel pad, each anti-slip component consists of a plurality of wavy silica gel strips and a plurality of silica gel columns, and the AGV trolley suitable for various boxes can be disassembled and replaced under the condition that the silica gel blocks are worn after being used for a long time, so that the AGV trolley suitable for various boxes is ensured to be suitable for clamping goods.

title_en: Mobile traveling crane for producing multilayer composite floor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a movable crane for producing a multilayer composite floor, which comprises a base, a supporting part and a moving part, wherein the supporting part and the moving part are arranged on the base, the supporting part comprises two supporting frames which are symmetrically arranged, each supporting frame comprises at least one fixing support and a plurality of supporting pieces, the fixing supports are vertically arranged, the plurality of supporting pieces are vertically arranged on the fixing supports in parallel at equal intervals along the vertical direction, the supporting pieces arranged on different fixing supports are correspondingly arranged in parallel along the horizontal direction, the upper surfaces of the supporting pieces are flush, the supporting pieces are vertically arranged on the fixing supports along the horizontal direction, one end of each supporting piece is connected with the fixing support, a plurality of equidistant gaps are formed between any two adjacent supporting pieces, the supporting frames are slidingly arranged on the base, the sliding direction of each supporting frame is perpendicular to the extending direction of each supporting piece, the moving part is arranged in a gap area between the two supporting frames, and the sliding direction of each moving part is parallel to the extending direction of the supporting pieces.

title_en: Bicycle for rehabilitation training of children
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rehabilitation bicycles and discloses a children rehabilitation training bicycle which comprises a support, wherein a transmission part is arranged at the middle part of the support, a pedal assembly is rotatably arranged on the transmission part, the pedal assembly comprises a pedal plate for placing orthopedic shoes, two side plates are arranged at the upper end of the pedal plate, a rotating rod is movably arranged along the inner side of each side plate, elastic contacts are respectively arranged on one surface of each rotating rod, which is close to the orthopedic shoes, along the sides of each shoe and used for clamping the sides of the orthopedic shoes, clamping blocks are detachably and fixedly arranged at the upper ends of the side plates and used for fixing the two sides of each rotating rod, a training assembly used for an upper limb is further arranged at the front end of the support, and the pedal assembly can fix the feet worn with the orthopedic shoes through the pedal assembly and the training assembly, so that the rehabilitation training efficiency of the lower limbs of patients can be conveniently provided, and the training assembly can rotate in the horizontal and vertical directions, and the upper limbs can be trained more flexibly.

title_en: Four-bar linkage type screening-up curtain structure of automobile seat
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a four-bar blind structure of an automobile seat, which comprises a four-bar shielding plastic piece, carpet cloth, thorn felt and an automobile body carpet, wherein the four-bar shielding plastic piece is connected with a four-bar structure on a back row seat framework of an automobile, shielding flanges are arranged on two sides of the four-bar shielding plastic piece and used for shielding the four-bar structure, the front end of the four-bar structure is integrally covered by the shielding flanges and rotates along with the four-bar structure in the rotating process of the seat, the upper end of the carpet cloth is connected with the four-bar shielding plastic piece through a hot melting column, the thorn felt is arranged at the lower end of the carpet cloth, the carpet cloth is adhered with the automobile body carpet through the thorn felt, and a carpet cloth groove is formed in the rear of the automobile body carpet and is used for accommodating the carpet cloth. The shielding curtain structure can be compatible with various car body environments, and has the advantages of improving the attractive smoothness of the seat, improving the quality of the seat, being high in practical value and the like.

title_en: Portable folding type small training unmanned aerial vehicle wing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to a portable folding type small-sized training unmanned aerial vehicle wing device. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the mounting seat, the folding groove, the rotating shaft, the butterfly bolt, the limiting hole, the first fixing hole and the second fixing hole, when an operator twists the butterfly bolt, one end of the butterfly bolt is sequentially separated from the first fixing hole and the limiting hole, the wing main body can slide in the folding groove through the rotating shaft, so that the wing main body can be folded outside the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the butterfly bolt penetrates through the limiting Kong Ningge to enter the second fixing hole, the position of the folded wing main body can be fixed, and thus, the occupied space of the unmanned aerial vehicle body can be reduced by performing folding fixing operation on the wing main body by the operator, and convenience is brought to carrying and transferring of the unmanned aerial vehicle body.

title_en: AGV car that modularization can splice and extend
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularized splice-expandable AGV which comprises a first module, a second module and a splicing module, wherein the first module comprises a first vehicle body and a first telescopic assembly which can extend from one end of the second vehicle body, the second module comprises a second vehicle body and a second telescopic assembly which can extend from one end of the second vehicle body, the splicing module comprises a third vehicle body, a first matching part is arranged at one end face of the third vehicle body, a second matching part is arranged at the other end face of the third vehicle body, the telescopic assembly comprises a plurality of telescopic rods, a butt joint plate and a butt joint assembly, and the butt joint assemblies are matched with each other or the corresponding matching parts, so that the butt joint of the first module and the second module or the splicing of the first module, the second module and the splicing module is realized. Thereby realizing the elastic expansion of length and load, realizing multiple purposes of one vehicle and reducing the redundancy of equipment.

title_en: Drum brake rocker arm for scooter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stopper technical field discloses a rocking arm is stopped to drum for scooter, include the cavity type rocking arm body that interval set up from top to bottom by lower main part and last main part, rocking arm body one end is equipped with the camshaft hole that link up, and the other end is equipped with the line of stopping of lining up and joins in marriage the dress hole, and the rocking arm body is close to camshaft hole one side top and is equipped with the open slot with the camshaft hole communicating, and the lock nut of locking screw adaptation has been set firmly with last main part side to the lower main part of open slot one side. The problem that the drum brake for the scooter is inconvenient to assemble and disassemble and stroke adjustment operation and is easy to cause component loss due to the limitation of adjustment operation space when the drum brake is used for repairing the normal use of the drum brake by adjusting the stroke of a rocker arm in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a robot, which comprises a body and a foot component. The robot comprises a robot body, N foot components, a first foot component and a second foot component, wherein the N foot components are sequentially arranged in the front-back direction of the robot body, each foot component comprises a first foot and a second foot, the first foot and the second foot are respectively connected with two opposite sides of the robot body in the left-right direction of the robot body, N is more than or equal to 3, when the robot walks, the first foot and the second foot are used for alternately contacting the ground, and when the first foot of any two adjacent foot components contacts the ground, the second foot of the other foot contacts the ground. The utility model aims to improve the stability of the robot during walking, thereby reducing the occurrence of the toppling of the robot.

title_en: Integrated machine convenient for discharging mud
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of piling machinery and discloses an integrated machine convenient for sludge discharge, which comprises a chassis, wherein a main arm is arranged on the chassis, a power head is arranged on the main arm, and two pairs of walking tracks for driving the chassis to walk are also arranged on the chassis, wherein one pair of walking tracks is positioned below the chassis and is rotationally connected with the chassis. The two pairs of walking tracks are arranged in parallel, the conventional arrangement of the walking tracks in the shape of a Chinese character 'kou' in the prior art is broken, and mud discharge channels with two communicated sides are formed. Mud and construction wastewater generated in drilling operation can be smoothly discharged to the outer side of the integrated machine along a mud discharging channel, and cannot be deposited below a chassis, so that the problem that the mud deposition affects the walking and operation of the integrated machine is fundamentally solved, special people do not need to be arranged for dredging, the construction cost can be greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the personal safety risk of manual dredging is eliminated.

title_en: Hub decorative cover assembly, hub assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of automobile engineering, in particular to a hub decorative cover assembly, a hub assembly and a vehicle. The main structure of the hub decorative cover assembly comprises a decorative cover and a mark cover, wherein a mounting hole surrounded by a limiting wall is formed in the middle of the decorative cover, a mounting plate and a positioning block connected with the limiting wall are formed in the mounting hole, a through hole is formed at the joint of the mounting plate and the limiting wall, an elastic claw extending into the through hole is fixed on the mounting plate, the mark cover comprises a body and a clamping plate, the edge of the body is bent inwards to form a bending part, the clamping plate is connected to the bending part and extends along the axial direction, and the body is buckled at the opening of the mounting hole and the bending part is clamped in a first groove. The mark cover and the decorative cover can be stably assembled without depending on additional fasteners, accurate limiting is realized in the axial direction and the radial direction, and the structure is compact, and the aluminum wheel decorative structure is suitable for aluminum wheel decorative structures influenced by wind pressure, vibration and disassembly and assembly for a long time.

title_en: Anti-theft fixing device for motor vehicle license plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor vehicle license plate theftproof is put admittedly, the utility model relates to a solid sealing device technical field. The fixing device comprises a fixing bolt, wherein the fixing bolt is made of medium carbon steel, grooves are circumferentially arrayed on the outer wall of the fixing bolt, the fixing device is in threaded connection with the fixing bolt, the fixing device comprises a fixing nut, a clamping tongue is rotationally connected to the inner wall of the fixing nut, a reset spring is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the fixing nut, and one side, away from the fixing nut, of the reset spring is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the clamping tongue. It should be noted that the latch adopts an inclined plane design, and the design enables the fixing bolt to rotate inwards but not outwards, so that a certain anti-theft effect is achieved.

title_en: Easy-to-clean meal heating vehicle with liner convenient to be quickly disassembled and assembled
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of meal heating vehicles, and discloses an easy-to-clean meal heating vehicle with an inner container convenient to be quickly disassembled and assembled, which comprises a shell and an inner container, wherein a bottom plate is fixedly connected with the inner bottom of the shell, the middle part fixedly connected with mount of upper end of bottom plate, the outside upper end of mount evenly interval fixedly connected with a plurality of fixed frames, a plurality of inside one side of fixed frame all is provided with electric telescopic handle. According to the utility model, the first electric telescopic rod automatically pushes the limiting plate to complete locking through the contact trigger signals of the first contact and the second contact, so that the installation is ensured to be stable and reliable, the reverse operation is only required to complete during the disassembly, the whole disassembly process is free from tool assistance, the operation is convenient and labor-saving, the maintenance efficiency and the use convenience are greatly improved, meanwhile, the servo motor is adopted to drive the gear rack mechanism, the heating plate is tightly attached to the outer wall of the inner container, the air gap is eliminated, the efficient and uniform heating is realized, and the heat preservation quality of food is remarkably improved.

title_en: Front structure of vehicle
abstract_en: The present utility model provides a vehicle front structure capable of setting the temperature of a space (chamber) provided in a front cabin to an appropriate temperature. A vehicle front structure (10) is provided with a dividing unit (30) that is provided in a front compartment (S1) and that divides a storage chamber (S3) at a portion of the front compartment (S1), an air conditioning device (40) that is provided outside the storage chamber (S3) in the front compartment (S1) to regulate the temperature of air in a vehicle cabin, and a duct (60) that connects the air conditioning device (40) and the storage chamber (S3) and that guides the air temperature-regulated by the air conditioning device (40) to the storage chamber (S3).

title_en: Undercarriage and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landing gear and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The landing gear comprises a lock catch, a landing gear main body and a locking mechanism, wherein the lock catch is connected to a horn, the landing gear main body is arranged in a rotating mode relative to the horn, and the locking mechanism is arranged in a sliding mode relative to the landing gear main body and is used for being matched with the lock catch so as to lock or unlock the landing gear main body relative to the horn. According to the landing gear, the locking mechanism and the lock catch arranged on the horn are locked in a matched mode, so that the locking strength is ensured, and meanwhile, the damage to the horn is avoided.

title_en: Carry subassembly and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a mounting assembly and an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the mounting assembly comprises a base body, a limiting mechanism and a limiting structure, the base body can comprise a bearing piece, the bearing piece is used for bearing a transfer part of a piece to be transferred, the limiting mechanism can comprise a limiting piece, the limiting piece can be movably connected to the base body and/or the bearing piece and used for limiting the movement range of the transfer part relative to the bearing piece, the limiting structure is arranged on at least one of the base body, the bearing piece and the limiting piece, and the limiting structure is used for abutting against the transfer part. Like this, can make through the locating part mount wait to transport the piece on base member and/or carrier when receiving external force or environmental factor's influence, for example receive external wind-force's influence, wait to transport the transfer portion of piece and offset with limit structure, from this, reduce wait to transport the swing range of piece, based on this for wait to transport the piece and can stably mount on the mount assembly, and then improved delivery quality and delivery efficiency.

title_en: Combined switch adopting novel ejector rod structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined switch adopting a novel ejector rod structure, which comprises a base, wherein a gear module and a handle piece matched with the gear module are arranged in the base, the gear module is fixedly arranged at the base, a connecting sleeve piece is sleeved at the handle piece, the connecting sleeve piece is movably connected with the base in a transferring way, the handle piece is suspended above the gear module through the connecting sleeve piece, the lower end of the handle piece is provided with a cavity part, the gear ejector rod piece is arranged at the cavity part of the handle piece in a sliding way, a spring is arranged in the cavity part, one end of the spring is in contact with the handle piece, and the other end of the spring is in contact with the gear ejector rod piece. The utility model can effectively avoid certain blocking sense and jerk sense in the gear shifting process, thereby realizing the technical effect of reducing noise.

title_en: Stress dispersion structure of light frame cementing interface
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of frame manufacturing, in particular to a stress dispersion structure of a light frame gluing interface, which comprises a frame, a connecting layer and an inner shell, wherein the connecting layer is fixedly connected to the inner side of the frame, the inner side of the connecting layer is fixedly connected with the inner shell, a first connecting groove is formed between the frame and the inner shell, and a first connecting pipe positioned at the inner side of the first connecting groove is connected with the inner side of the frame in a threaded manner.

title_en: Automotive interior spare and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to an automotive interior part and a vehicle, belonging to the technical field of automotive interior parts, comprising a base, a storage bin and a storage box, wherein the storage bin is arranged in the base; the top of the storage bin is provided with an opening, the panel is movably connected with the base and used for closing or opening the storage bin, the two ends of the base are respectively provided with a first end wall and a second end wall, a first movable point and a second movable point are arranged on the panel, the panel is embedded into the opening when in a closing position, the first movable point moves upwards the base and simultaneously moves in a direction away from the second movable point when moving from the closing position to the opening position, and the second movable point moves towards the first end wall. According to the application, under the condition that the panel is embedded into the opening so that the surface of the interior trim part is smooth and attractive, the panel is separated from the opening upwards, meanwhile, the displacement in the horizontal direction is realized, and finally, the panel stays above the base on one side of the opening, so that on one hand, the obstruction of the inner wall of the opening to the opening of the panel is eliminated, and on the other hand, the panel does not occupy the internal space of the storage bin after being opened.

title_en: Feeding device for production of cosmetic brushes
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cosmetic brush production, and discloses a feeding device for cosmetic brush production, which comprises a feeding box, wherein a hanging rod is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the feeding box, a hook is movably connected to the outer wall of the hanging rod, a spice bag is fixedly connected to one end of the hook, an ultraviolet lamp tube is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the feeding box, and a shell is fixedly connected to the top of the feeding box. This feedway is used in cosmetic brush production is through feed box, air vent, spices package, peg, fresh air inlet, defeated wind net, fan main part, ultraviolet tube and ventilation hole that set up, when transporting the feed to the required brush hair raw materials in the cosmetic brush production process, can reduce the peculiar smell of brush hair raw materials, also can disinfect and disinfect the brush hair raw materials simultaneously to avoid the too big follow-up production and processing that can influence of brush hair raw materials peculiar smell, provide convenience for people's use.

title_en: Clamp brake for bicycle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bicycle brakes, and discloses a bicycle clamp-shaped brake which comprises a left arm, a right arm, a central shaft, a return spring, a brake cable assembly, a side shaft and a connecting rod arm, wherein one end of the left arm is pivotally connected with one end of the connecting rod arm through the central shaft, the other end of the right arm is pivotally connected with one side of the central shaft through the side shaft, one end of the left arm is arranged between the right arm and the connecting rod arm, the brake cable assembly is symmetrically arranged at the lower ends of the left arm and the right arm, a brake cable fastening structure is arranged at the other end of the right arm and is matched and matched with a brake cable threading structure arranged on the left arm, and the return spring is arranged at the front end of the central shaft, and two ends of the return spring are respectively in butt joint limit with the left arm and the connecting rod arm. The two brake arms of the clamp brake all use a single central rod as a rotation center, and a rider needs larger braking force to achieve an ideal braking effect.

title_en: Simple and easy conveyer suitable for in pit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a simple and easy conveyer suitable for in pit, includes the assembly base bottom surface be provided with running gear assembly base upper be domatic assembly base upper body coupling be provided with steel pipe fixed base, just steel pipe fixed base perpendicular to assembly base's domatic setting. The utility model solves the problem of short-distance transportation of underground steel pipes in the prior art, can greatly save labor, and can be flexibly adapted to steel pipes with various pipe diameters. In particular, the equipment has simple structure, small submission, low cost and easy maintenance, and is beneficial to underground popularization and use.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle is used in survey and drawing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for surveying and mapping, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The novel wing-mounted aircraft comprises a frame and a fuselage, wherein the fuselage is arranged outside the frame, four groups of wings are arranged at the bottom end of the fuselage, a protective box is arranged at the top end of the fuselage, a servo motor is arranged on the side wall of the protective box, a first threaded rod is arranged at the output end of the servo motor, and the first threaded rod extends to the interior of the protective box and is movably connected with the interior of the protective box. The utility model not only realizes the convenient protection of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the surveying instrument, avoids damaging the surveying instrument due to touching an external object, facilitates the convenient angle position adjustment for surveying and mapping, increases the surveying range, but also facilitates the elastic buffer support during landing, reduces the vibration amplitude of electrical elements and prolongs the service life of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Refrigeration system for hydrogen and long tube trailer for gas hydrogen
abstract_en: The utility model provides a refrigeration system for hydrogen and a long tube trailer for gas hydrogen. The refrigeration system for hydrogen is used for being loaded on a hydrogen carrier. The low-temperature liquid stored in the liquid storage tank is conveyed to the heat exchanger through the pipeline system, the fan is arranged in the pipeline system to convey air to the heat exchanger and then send the air into a carriage of the hydrogen transporting vehicle, and therefore the low-temperature liquid is evaporated after acquiring heat at the heat exchanger, and meanwhile the air is cooled after acquiring cold energy at the heat exchanger, so that hydrogen stored in the carriage is cooled. The refrigerating system for hydrogen can effectively avoid the overhigh temperature in the carriage of the hydrogen transporting vehicle under the condition of avoiding excessive weight increment.

title_en: Transfer device for processing water-based resin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transfer device for processing water-based resin, which relates to the technical field of water-based resin transfer and comprises a fixed bottom plate, wherein a plurality of rolling wheel mechanisms are arranged at the bottom of the fixed bottom plate, a holding handle is arranged on the fixed bottom plate, a clamping bottom shell mechanism is arranged on the fixed bottom plate, a lifting pressing plate mechanism is arranged on the clamping bottom shell mechanism, and a deflection adjusting mechanism is arranged between the fixed bottom plate and the lifting pressing plate mechanism.

title_en: A loading and securing system and method for semi-trailer
abstract_en: A loading and securing system for semi-trailers 21 on a 1520 mm railway gauge platform wagon 22 comprises a crane for lifting the semi-trailer 21 from the ramp 4 and a crossbar 1, the slings 20 of which are attached to the lifting means 2, 3 together with the lower lifting crossbar 3 and two wheels grippers for the lower lifting crossbars 2 of the semi-trailer. The lower lifting crossbar 3 of the semi-trailer, which is designed to secure kingpin of the semi-trailer's saddle, is equipped with an automatic locking mechanism that locks the kingpin of the semi-trailer saddle and prevents detachment of the lower lifting crossbar 3, and locking means for fixing the semi-trailer onto the 1520 mm gauge railway platform wagon 22, the fastening means with locking devices detachably attached to the railway platform wagon 22, which are intended for securing the lower semi-trailer lifting crossbars 2, the rear wheels of the semi-trailer; and for inserting and locking the lower lifting crossbar 3 into the support frame 5 with a socket 16 adapted for lower liting crossbar 3, whereas the support frame 5 is removably attached to the designated points on the platform wagon 22, and therefore, there is no need for modernization of the wagon by changing its technical characteristics.

title_en: Number plate holder
abstract_en: A number plate holder (1) is described that is suitable for being coupled to a number plate (2) comprising a perimetric rim (3), formed by an upper first edge (30), a lower second edge (31) and two lateral third edges (32, 33); a central plate portion (4) delimited by the perimetric rim (3) and comprising a first face (4a) adapted to be coupled to the number plate (2) and a second face (4b), opposite to the first face (4a), adapted to be coupled to a vehicle; and a damping element (6); the damping element (6) comprising, in turn, a first portion (60a) and a second portion (60b), arranged respectively on the first and second faces (4a, 4b), at the central portion (4) and a third portion (60), arranged around the perimetric rim (3).

title_en: Controller device for a motor vehicle, and motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a controller device for a motor vehicle, particularly for an autonomously operable motor vehicle, comprising a controller (3) for operating the motor vehicle, and a protective device (9) for protecting the controller (3) from electromagnetic interference fields or interfering signals. According to the invention, the protective device (9) comprises a receiving device (10) for detecting electromagnetic interference fields or interfering signals, a processing device (11) for providing information about an electromagnetic interference field or interfering signal detected by the receiving device (10), and a control unit (8) which evaluates the detected field and/or interfering signal according to the detected information.

title_en: Improved system for displaying information
abstract_en:
Described is a self-propelled operating machine (1) equipped with a cabin (13) and a system for displaying information to an operator (O) present in the cabin (13). 
     The display system includes at least one mobile display element (3).

title_en: Wireless charging transmission apparatus, transmission method and wireless charging system
abstract_en: This application provides a wireless charging transmitting apparatus, a transmitting method, and a wireless charging system that are mainly used for electric vehicles. The apparatus includes: a DC-to-AC inverter circuit, for inverting a direct current output by a direct current power supply to an alternating current, where the DC-to-AC inverter circuit includes an advancing bridge arm and a lagging bridge arm, and in one period, a voltage phase of the advancing bridge arm precedes a voltage phase of the lagging bridge arm; a compensation circuit, for compensating the alternating current output by the DC-to-AC inverter circuit and sending the alternating current obtained after the compensation to a transmitting coil; the transmitting coil, for receiving the alternating current and generating an alternating current magnetic field; an impedance adjustment circuit, including at least one inductive branch, where each inductive branch includes an inductor and a switch that are connected in series, all inductive branches are connected in parallel to form an adjustment branch, a first end of the adjustment branch is connected to an output port of the direct current power supply, and a second end of the adjustment branch is connected to a midpoint of the lagging bridge arm; and a controller, configured to control on or off of the switch in the inductive branch to change a current flowing out of the lagging bridge arm, so that a controllable switching transistor of the lagging bridge arm implements zero-voltage switching.

title_en: Control device, control method and non-transitory storage medium
abstract_en: A control device (10) includes: an acquisition unit (12) configured to acquire, from a driving assist system, a requested acceleration and ending information indicating an end of a deceleration control; and a control unit (11) configured to control a powertrain and a brake based on the requested acceleration, and perform a prescribed process of stabilizing a driving force and a braking force that are generated in an ending process of the deceleration control based on the requested acceleration when the acquisition unit (12) acquires the ending information.

title_en: Power supply connection for power long rail assembly
abstract_en: A long rail assembly for use in a vehicle includes a fixed rail, a movable rail, a power strip, a latch power connector, and a channel power connector. The fixed rail extends longitudinally along a floor of the vehicle. The movable rail is slidably coupled to the fixed rail. The power strip is coupled to the fixed rail. The latch power connector is removably coupled to the movable rail. The channel power connector is fixedly coupled to the movable rail and is in constant sliding contact with the power strip. When the latch power connector is coupled to the movable rail, the latch power connector frictionally engages the channel power connector thereby generating an electrical bridge between the power strip and the latch power connector to provide power to the long rail assembly.

title_en: Battery driven ground power unit with improved construction, operability, durability and maintenance
abstract_en: An airport ground power unit for supplying electric current to an aircraft parked on the ground, a method of operating the ground power unit, a system for supplying electric current to an aircraft parked on the ground, a method of operating such system, and a Y-adaptor.

title_en: Rounding of drop-stitch elements
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drop-stitch element in which at least one glued fold (9, 10) of variable depth is introduced into a flat drop-stitch component (8) such that the outer skin of the drop-stitch component can be folded on one side of the drop-stitch component or, according to the position of the fold, alternately on both sides of the drop-stitch component.

title_en: System and device for affecting drag properties of an object
abstract_en: A vortex generator (10) might be attached to various types of articles to reduce the drag. For example, vortex generators might be attached to a garment or to adhesive tape. In addition, vortex generators might be attached to various types of athletic equipment. A mapping can suggest placement of a vortex-generator arrangement on an article, as well as prescribe particular vortex-generator arrangements for regions of a person.

title_en: Cover for an upholstered part of a vehicle seat, upholstered part for a vehicle seat, and vehicle seat
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cover (100) for an upholstered part (50) of a vehicle seat (1), said cover (100) having at least one opening (130), in particular a through opening for a locking device (12) for a child seat (10), wherein an edge area (132, 134, 136, 138) of the cover (100) arranged around the at least one opening (130) is reinforced at least in sections with a reinforcing frame (140) made from a plastic material. The invention also relates to an upholstered part (50) for a vehicle seat (1), in particular a motor vehicle seat, having said type of covering (100) and to a vehicle seat (1) having at least one such upholstered part (50).

title_en: Motor vehicle display system and method
abstract_en: A motor vehicle display system (100) comprising: a vehicular information retriever (110) configured to retrieve vehicular information of a motor vehicle (140) ; and an image stream selector (120) configured to select an image stream source from at least two image stream sources based on the vehicular information retrieved, in order to display an image stream from the image stream source selected by the image stream selector (120).

title_en: A spring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a spring system comprising a spring section 22 and a stop section 20, the spring section 22 and stop section 20 being arranged to pivot with respect to each other. The spring section 22 carries a first leaf spring 240 and the stop section 20 carries two first stops 212, 218. One of the spring section 22 and stop section 20 carries a second leaf spring 242 and the other carries two second stops 214, 216, so that when the stop section 20 is pivoted with respect to the spring section 22 in one direction, the first leaf spring 240 engages with one first stop 212 and resists the pivoting movement, and after a certain angle of pivoting the second leaf spring 242 engages with a second stop 216 and resists the pivoting movement, and correspondingly when the stop section 20 is pivoted with respect to the spring section 22 in the opposite direction, the second leaf spring 242 engages with the other second stop 214 and resists the pivoting movement, and after a certain angle of pivoting the first leaf spring 240 engages with the other first stop 218 and resists the pivoting movement.

title_en: Methods and systems for assembly and installation of airframe floor grids
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for assembling an aircraft (10). One such method includes receiving a lower half barrel section (118) of fuselage (12) that is inverted to a keel-up orientation (563-3); and installing a floor grid (365) into the lower half barrel section (118) while inverted. One such system (500) comprises a plurality of work stations that install floor grid components onto a floor grid (365), a track (541) that advances the floor grid (365) in a process direction (199) through the work stations, and at least one feeder line associated with one of the work stations, the feeder line operable to provide a floor grid component to the work station just in time for installation onto the floor grid (365).

title_en: Vehicle charging control method and device
abstract_en: A vehicle control method and device. The vehicle control method comprises the steps of generating a first control instruction and a second control instruction when a vehicle is in a parking state, so that a fuel cell control unit (FCU) is controlled to perform charging control on a battery management system (BMS) through the first control instruction, a vehicle control unit (VCU) is controlled to perform power-off control on a target component through the second control instruction, and the target component is a non-essential operation component when the vehicle is charged in a parking state; and generating a third control instruction when the vehicle is in a normal operating state, so that the VCU controls the BMS according to the third control instruction. According to the method, under different vehicle states of the BMS, the control instructions are sourced from different control units; after the vehicle enters the parking charging mode, the non-essential components are enabled to stop working to lower a parasitic load, thereby improving the charging efficiency of the system.

title_en: Electric propeller and ducted fan propulsion unit
An unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A hybrid aerial vehicle (HAV) comprising: a fuselage of the HAV; a first mechanism within the fuselage for accepting a plurality of wings of the HAV, the first mechanism allowing coordinated contraction of the plurality of wings essentially into the fuselage such that tips of the wings are position in proximity of the fuselage and coordinated extension of the wings such that tips of each wing are positioned away from the fuselage; a first wing extending from the port side of the fuselage and connected to the first mechanism; a second wing extending from the starboard side of the fuselage and connected to the first mechanism; a second mechanism placed within the fuselage in proximity to its front end, the second mechanism allowing motion of propellers of the HAV affixed there to between a first plain and a second plain; a first set of propellers affixed at the port side of the fuselage to the second mechanism; a second set of propellers affixed at the starboard side of the fuselage to the second mechanism; a third mechanism placed within the fuselage in proximity to its rear end, the third mechanism allowing motion of propellers of the HAV affixed there to between a first plain and a second plain, and further placing the propellers affixed thereto to be at a vertical displacement with respect to the propellers affixed to the second mechanism; a third set of propellers affixed at the port side of the fuselage to the third mechanism; and a fourth set of propellers affixed at the starboard side of the fuselage to the third mechanism.

title_en: Propulsion system for an aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to a propulsion system (1, 1') for an aircraft, comprising a rotor (2) and a nacelle fairing (3) that extends around said rotor in relation to an axis (X) and includes an upstream portion forming an inlet section of the nacelle fairing as well as a downstream portion (20), a downstream end (21) of which forms an outlet section (BF) of the nacelle fairing (3); and characterized in that the downstream portion (20) includes a radially inner wall (20a) and a radially outer wall (20b), both of which are made of a deformable shape memory material, and in that the wall (20b) has piston actuator mechanisms (23, 23'), each actuator mechanism being actuatable independently of the others and being designed to cooperate with means (24, 24') built into an inner surface (20b') of the wall (20b) so as to deform the wall (20b) in a radial direction in relation to said axis (X) under the effect of a predetermined displacement command.

title_en: Wiper frame, in particular for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wiper frame (10), in particular for a motor vehicle, comprising a wiper blade (14), a liquid channel (30, 32) for carrying a cleaning liquid, and a heating unit (38). According to the invention, the heating unit (38) is substantially located inside the liquid channel (30, 32).

title_en: Brake resistor for a vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a brake resistor for a vehicle fitted with an electrodynamic braking device, wherein the brake resistor has at least one elongated heating cartridge (1), which has cold regions (6) without a heating element (4) at the ends and a hot region (7) between the cold regions (6) and thermally expanding in the longitudinal direction of the heating cartridge (1) when a current flows through a heating element (4) extending over the length of the hot region (7), and which is retained by means of a bearing assembly, which has a fixed bearing (8) and at least one floating bearing (9), wherein the brake resistor has a monitoring device which deactivates the brake resistor when a maximum permissible heating cartridge temperature is identified based on a detected maximum thermal longitudinal expansion of the heating cartridge (1).

title_en: Child safety seat
abstract_en: A child safety seat comprising a seat shell comprising a seat portion and a back portion, an adjustable backrest configured to be moveable with respect to the seat shell between a first position, where at least a portion of the backrest is moved away from the back portion and closer to a front edge of the seat portion, reducing the available seating area for an occupant of the seat, and a second position, where at least a portion of the backrest is moved toward the back portion and further from the front edge of the seat portion, increasing the available seating area for the occupant of the seat.

title_en: Compact battery for electric bicycles
abstract_en: The invention relates to a battery (1) for electric bicycles comprising a total number N of cells (2) distributed in an optimized way, a management system (4) and at least one connector (5). The battery (1) is characterized in that it comprises a distribution with at least one additional semi-block (3b), created by at least one cell (2) separated from a block (3) or semi-block (3a) at one end (1a) of the battery (1), creating at least two spaces (6, 7). The previous space (6) is located in the semi-block (3a) of the end (1a) of the battery (1) created by the absence of at least one cell (2) and intended to connect the management system (4), and the new space (7) is in the additional semi-block (3b) created by the absence of at least a number n-1 of cells (2) and destined to house the connector (5).

title_en: Battery control
abstract_en: A battery control system and method selectively connect battery strings to one or more conductive buses by plural electrically controllable switches. The switches are controlled to one or more of (a) connect the strings with one or more of the load or the power source via the one or more conductive buses in a first sequence and/or (b) disconnect the strings from one or more of the load or the power source via the one or more conductive buses in a second sequence. The first sequence and the second sequence are based on one or more of states of charge between the strings, different charge capacities between the strings, different electric currents conducted through the strings, different polarities of the electric currents conducted through the strings, and/or a speed of a vehicle that is powered by the one or more loads.

title_en: In-vehicle power supply system
abstract_en: An auxiliary device system battery and a small electric power load are connected to a first power supply line, and power supply power stepped up by a DC/DC converter in a zone ECU is supplied to a second power supply line. A large electric power load and a capacitor are connected to the second power supply line, and when the large electric power load is driven, the capacitor is connected to supply necessary power supply power, and voltage fluctuation is prevented. When an ignition is OFF, a switch circuit is closed, a dark current is supplied from the capacitor, and electric charge is discharged to prevent deterioration. Alternatively, the auxiliary device system battery is connected to a second power supply line side, and a dark current is supplied to a first power supply line side when the ignition is OFF using a capacitor or a dedicated circuit.

title_en: Motor vehicle having a reinforcement at the front pillar for a frontal impact with low overlap
abstract_en: Body structure (3) for a motor vehicle (1), comprising: a floor (11), and two longitudinal lower body beams (13), on either side of the floor (11), each extending from a front pillar (15) to a rear pillar, said body structure (3) further comprising: a reinforcement (19) forming an L-section pressing attached to the floor (11) and to one of the two longitudinal lower body beams (13), at the front pillar (15).

title_en: Self-healing containment gels for aircraft fuel tanks
abstract_en: A fuel cell containing fuel for an aircraft includes an innermost layer configured to contact the fuel, an outermost layer and a containment gel formed from isocyanate and polyol interposed between the innermost and outermost layers. The containment gel is configured to self-seal a ballistically formed hole therein, thereby reducing leakage of the fuel from the fuel cell.

title_en: A device for unmanned aerial vehicle to install rainfall catalytic bomb
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application and artificial rainfall, and discloses a device for unmanned aerial vehicle to install rainfall catalytic bomb which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a cannonball for artificial precipitation and a cylinder, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the cannonball for artificial precipitation through a soft lock, the cannonballs for artificial precipitation are multiple and are wrapped in the cylinders, a second sensor is arranged in the cylinder, wing surfaces are arranged on the outer side of the cylinder, the wing surfaces are multiple and are arranged at one end of the cylinder in the long shaft direction, and one end of the soft lock is connected to the other end of the cylinder in the long shaft direction. The unmanned aerial vehicle carries the cannonball for artificial precipitation to carry out rainfall, the unmanned aerial vehicle does not need to enter a cloud layer, the unmanned aerial vehicle can safely run to reduce the accident rate, the operation is simple, and the rainfall cost is low. The position of the cannonball for artificial precipitation can be accurately monitored in real time, so that it can be conveniently and accurately thrown in and detonated. The wing surface is arranged, so that the stability and the posture adjustment of the cannonball for artificial precipitation can be controlled conveniently.

title_en: Land vehicles incorporating electric motors and methods therefor
abstract_en: Land vehicles (100) and methods of operating land vehicles (100) are disclosed. A land vehicle (100) includes a frame structure (200), a plurality of wheels (212; 214, 216; 218, 220), and a plurality of electric motors (800; 802, 804; 806, 808). The frame structure (200) includes a front cage (204) that at least partially defines an operator cabin (206) and a rear compartment (208) positioned rearward of the front cage (204) in a longitudinal direction (210). The plurality of wheels (212; 214, 216; 218, 220) are supported by the frame structure (200). The plurality of wheels (212; 214, 216; 218, 220) includes a pair of front wheels (214, 216) and a pair of rear wheels (218, 220) positioned rearward of the pair of front wheels (214, 216) in the longitudinal direction (210).

title_en: Electric commercial vehicle comprising an impact device safety arrangement
abstract_en: A commercial vehicle, comprising an electric power module, a high voltage system, a control circuit, and an impact device arranged to protect a unit of the vehicle in case of a collision, by absorbing collision energy. The control circuit at least partially passes through the impact device. The impact device comprises an electrical conductor arranged for disconnecting by a relative movement between the chassis and the unit. When disconnected, the control circuit is interrupted, thereby switching the electric power module from an active state, in which electric power is provided to the high voltage system, to a passive safe state, in which electric power to the high voltage system is switched off.

title_en: Vehicle control for user safety and experience
abstract_en: A system and method of vehicle control for user safety and experience is provided. The system receives sensed information associated with a first vehicle, detects a state of the first vehicle, and determines activities of a person or a second vehicle in proximity of the first vehicle. Such activities are determined based on the sensed information. The system triggers actions based on whether or not the determined activities are unsafe for the first vehicle or for users of the first vehicle in the detected state. The system controls devices associated with the first vehicle based on the triggered actions. The devices include a light-based projector device that is controlled to project a visual alert, included in the triggered actions, directly onto a physical surface. The physical surface is a window portion of the first vehicle or a physical structure which is external to and separate from the first vehicle.

title_en: System for the automatic connection and/or disconnection of the electric power supply and/or data connection for refrigerated containers
abstract_en: System for the automatic connection and/or disconnection of the electric power supply and/or data connection for refrigerated containers (3) by means of at least one mechanical arm (2), comprising a transportable support structure (1) and provided with electric power supply means and/or connection to a data transmission network. The support structure (1) is provided with said mechanical arm (2), and said mechanical arm (2) is positioned so as to define an operating area (20) outside said support structure (1) and at least partially superimposed on a position of said refrigerated container (1).

title_en: Driving assistance method and driving assistance device
abstract_en:
The purpose of the present invention is to encourage travel based on appropriate driving assistance by lowering a driving assistance level when alerting a driver is necessary in a lane-keeping travel scenario with a raised driving assistance level. 
     A driving assist method includes a vehicle speed/headway control function and a lane-keeping function as driving assist functions to assist driving operations by a driver, and comprising: assessing whether or not a traveling condition has been met during lane-keeping travel in which a hands-off mode has been selected as the lane-keeping assist mode; and switching the mode from the hands-off mode to a hands-on mode that has as a condition that the driver has their hands on the steering wheel upon assessing that the traveling condition that the actual vehicle speed exceeds the speed limit has been met; characterized by: determining whether or not the driver has performed an accelerator-depressing operation during lane-keeping travel in which the hands-off mode has been selected; requesting the driver to hold the steering wheel upon determining that the driver has performed the accelerator-depressing operation; and the switching of the mode from the hands-off mode to the hands-on mode being performed upon confirming that the driver is holding the steering wheel.

title_en: Method and system for controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: Method and system for controlling an unmanned vehicle (1), which allow the vehicle to operate with full autonomy without the involvement of a human pilot by means of automatic remote guiding from a control station (2). The vehicle transmits data (6) captured by its peripheral devices to the control station (2), which processes the data (6) together with information (8) received from external entities (9) and generates response actions orders (10) for the vehicle (1) to avoid obstacles (7) or perform operational tasks, the control station (2) also generating data (11) and information (13) destined for external entities (12, 14), all communications being carried out in real time using a low-latency communication protocol.

title_en: System and method for detecting railway track anomalies
Aircraft system controller and associated method
abstract_en: Controllers and methods for enabling an operator to interface with an aircraft system are provided. A method includes receiving a first input to the aircraft system via angular displacement of a rotatable knob in a first direction away from a neutral angular position of the rotatable knob, causing the rotatable knob to automatically return to the neutral angular position, and annunciating, via the rotatable knob, a first state of the aircraft system associated with the first input. The method also includes receiving a second input to the aircraft system from a source different from the rotatable knob, and annunciating, via the rotatable knob, a second state of the aircraft system associated with the second input.

title_en: Lighting electronics cooling using high temp tec with integrated heat sink
abstract_en: An aircraft light unit is disclosed herein. The aircraft light unit includes a housing (302) having a first side and an opposing second side, a light coupled to the first side of the housing (302), a circuit board assembly (306) coupled to second side of the housing (302), a thermoelectric cooler coupled to the circuit board assembly (306) and configured to dissipated heat from the circuit board assembly (306), and a heat sink (312) disposed over the thermoelectric cooler and configured to dissipate heat from the thermoelectric cooler.

title_en: Additive material integrated heater deposited or embedded within an ice detector
abstract_en: A strut of a magnetostrictive oscillator includes a strut body (26) which includes an airfoil with a first end (28), a second end (30), a leading edge (52), a trailing edge (54), a first side (56), and a second side (58). The strut further includes a heater element (38) within the first side and second side, wherein the heater element connects from the first side to the second side. The strut further includes an electrically insulative layer (40) between the heater element and the strut body. The heater element and the electrically insulative layer are integral with the strut body.

title_en: Performance testing for autonomous vehicles
abstract_en: A computer system for testing the performance of a stack for planning ego vehicle trajectories in real or simulated driving scenarios, the computer system comprising: at least a first input configured to receive (i) scenario ground truth and (ii) internal state data of the stack, the scenario ground truth and internal state data generated using the stack to control an ego agent responsive to at least one other agent in the simulated driving scenario; at least a second input configured to receive a defined operational design domain (ODD); a test oracle configured to apply one or more driving rules to the scenario ground truth for evaluating the performance of the stack in the scenario, and provide an output for each of the driving rules indicating whether that driving rule has been complied with; wherein the one or more driving rules include at least one ODD-based response rule, the test oracle configured to apply the ODD-based response rule by: processing the scenario ground truth over multiple time steps, to determine whether or not the scenario is within the defined ODD at each time step, and thereby detecting a change in the scenario that takes the scenario outside of the defined ODD, and processing the internal state data, to determine whether a required state change occurred within the stack, within a required time interval, the output for the at least one ODD-based response rule indicating whether or not the required state change occurred within the required time interval.

title_en: Camera system, method for controlling the same, and computer program
abstract_en: A camera system includes a clipping unit configured to clip, from an image captured by an imaging unit, a side rear area of a vehicle that is a part of the captured image, a display unit configured to display an image of the side rear area of the vehicle, and a detection unit configured to detect an object in a blind spot area of the vehicle that is a part of the captured image and is determined in advance. The clipping unit further clips a clipping area from the captured image so as to include an area where the object is detected. The camera system further includes a generation unit configured to generate a display image based on the side rear area of the vehicle and the clipping area. The display unit further displays the display image.

title_en: Eddy current magnetic braking device, braked vehicle wheel and aircraft landing gear equipped with such a wheel
abstract_en: Disclosed is an eddy current magnetic braking device that comprises stationary elements (2) and movable elements (3) having opposite surfaces (2.1), wherein one element (2) of the stationary and movable elements comprises a plurality of magnets (11, 12, 13, 14) capable of generating eddy currents in the other element (3), the latter being made of electrically conductive material. The plurality of magnets includes first magnets (11, 13) that have a first magnetization vector substantially perpendicular to the opposite surfaces (2.1, 3.1) and are separated in pairs by a second magnet (12, 14) having a second magnetization vector substantially perpendicular to the first magnetization vectors of the two first magnets between which the second magnet is located. The magnets (11, 12, 13, 14) have widths such that the first magnets (11, 13) are spaced apart in pairs by a first distance less than a second distance by which the second magnets (12, 14) are separated in pairs. The invention further relates to an aircraft wheel and landing gear comprising such a device.

title_en: Eddy current magnetic braking device, braked vehicle wheel and aircraft landing gear equipped with such a wheel
abstract_en: Disclosed is an eddy current magnetic braking device that comprises stationary elements (2) and movable elements (3) having opposite surfaces (2.1), wherein one element (2) of the stationary and movable elements comprises a plurality of magnets (11, 12, 13, 14) capable of generating eddy currents in the other element (3), the latter being made of electrically conductive material. The plurality of magnets includes first magnets (11, 13) that have a first magnetization vector substantially perpendicular to the opposite surfaces (2.1, 3.1) and are separated in pairs by a second magnet (12, 14) having a second magnetization vector substantially perpendicular to the first magnetization vectors of the two first magnets between which the second magnet is located. The magnets (11, 12, 13, 14) have widths such that the first magnets (11, 13) are spaced apart in pairs by a first distance less than a second distance by which the second magnets (12, 14) are separated in pairs. The invention further relates to an aircraft wheel and landing gear comprising such a device.

title_en: Seat pan, in particular for an aircraft seat, provided with a kinetic energy absorbing tube
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seat pan comprising a seat pan structure (11) that includes: -	a first longitudinal member (12.1) having a front end portion (13.1) and a rear end portion (14.1); -	a second longitudinal member (12.2) having a front end portion (13.2) and a rear end portion (14.2); -	a front cross member (15.1) mechanically interconnecting the front end portion (13.1) of the first longitudinal member (12.1) and the front end portion (13.2) of the second longitudinal member (12.2); and -	a rear cross member (15.2) mechanically interconnecting the rear end portion (14.1) of the first longitudinal member (12.1) and the rear end portion (14.2) of the second longitudinal member (12.2); -	said seat pan structure (11) further comprising a kinetic energy absorbing tube (27) extending between the first longitudinal member (12.1) and the second longitudinal member (12.2).

title_en: A rotorcraft with a tail boom having a ducted tail rotor
abstract_en: The invention is related to a rotorcraft (1) with at least one main rotor (1a) and a fuselage (2), comprising: a tail boom (2a) connected to the fuselage, the tail boom extending in a longitudinal direction (2c) from the fuselage toward a duct-type portion (7); a shroud (3) provided at the duct-type portion and forming a transverse duct (6) comprising a circumferential direction (14) and a longitudinal extension (6a) oriented at least essentially perpendicular to the circumferential direction and the longitudinal direction of the tail boom; and at least one ducted tail rotor (8a) rotatably arranged in the transverse duct; wherein the shroud comprises a first section (9) connected to the tail boom and a second section (10) spaced apart from the tail boom and diametrically opposed to the first section, the first section comprising an airfoil-like aerodynamic profile (9a).

title_en: System and method for railroad personnel safety assurance
abstract_en: A system for enhancing personnel safety on a railroad track is presented.
