The system can receive data from sensors and/or a PTC system to determine positions of clients/worker and/or vehicles, and further utilize such data to determine if a vehicle is within a certain proximity of the client/worker location. The system can further generate geofences around clients/vehicles to and determine when such geofences intersect one another. Additionally, the present disclosure can assign severity levels and generate alerts with the assigned severity levels, and such severity levels can indicate how close a vehicle is to a particular location. It is an object of the invention to provide a system for generating alerts to notify personnel when they much retreat to a place of safety.

title_en: Adapter for a wiping system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adapter (6) for attaching a wiper (2) to an arm of a wiping system, the adapter (6) comprising at least one base (16) and a cover (18), the base (16) being configured to be pivotably mounted around a rotational axis (R1) on the connector (8), the base (16) comprising at least one area for receiving (34) the arm of the wiping system, the receiving area (34) comprising at least two housings separated from one another by a central wall (36) which mainly extends in the longitudinal direction (L), each of the housings being configured to receive the arm of the wiping system and the housings being symmetrical along a main plane (L, V) of the central wall (36), the cover (18) being movable on the base (16).

title_en: A rotating bicycle joint assembly and a method for preventing ingress of dirt in a bearing
abstract_en:
Disclosed is a rotating bicycle joint assembly (22) comprising a rotating joint part (23), a fixed joint part (24), and a bearing located between the rotating joint part and the fixed joint part with an outer part of the bearing fixed in relation to one of the rotating joint part and the fixed j oint part, and wherein an inner part of the bearing is fixed in relation to the other of the rotating joint part and the fixed joint part. The rotating bicycle joint assembly also comprises a dust cover (6) having an outer cover diameter being bigger than an outer bearing diameter of the bearing, so that an outer periphery of the dust cover is extending radially past the outer part. Furthermore, the rotating bicycle joint assembly comprises an impeller (9) arranged at the outer periphery of the dust cover, wherein the impeller is fixed in relation to the rotating joint part and wherein the dust cover is fixed in relation to the inner part of the bearing. 
     Furthermore, a method for preventing ingress of dirt in a bearing of a rotating bicycle joint assembly and use of a rotating bicycle joint assembly is disclosed.

title_en: Structure for use in lashing a shipping container to a support
abstract_en: There is provided a pin structure for use in lashing a shipping container to a support. The pin structure has a base and a projection extending from the base. The pin structure is insertable into an internal cavity of a shipping container corner casting compliant with ISO 1161:2016 and is thereafter manipulatable so that the projection extends to an exterior of the corner casting via an aperture through a wall of the corner casting while the base remains in the internal cavity. Also disclosed is a lock device for locking together first and second shipping containers.

title_en: Tire elastomeric compositions comprising a precipitated silica
abstract_en: The present invention relates to tire elastomeric compositions comprising at least one precipitated silica having small sized particles. The invention further relates to a semi-finished article and to a tire comprising such tire elastomeric compositions.

title_en: Suspension attachment structure for a motor vehicle and frame assembly for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: A suspension attachment structure (10) for a motor vehicle (1) is described, comprising a main body (11) adapted to be fixed to a frame (2) of the motor vehicle (1) and adapted to support one or more suspensions of the motor vehicle (1); and a fluidic path (12) adapted to be crossed, in use, internally by a fluid. The fluidic path (12) comprises, in turn, an opening (13) for the inlet of the fluid, an opening (14) for the outlet of the fluid and a heat exchange portion (15) fluidly interposed between the inlet opening (13) and the outlet opening (14) and supported by the main body (11). The heat exchange portion (15), in addition, is adapted to be hit, in use, on the outside by an air flow.

title_en: Battery management software reset
abstract_en: A computer system (100) of a vehicle (10) comprising processing circuitry (102) configured to: send a verification request message (M) to an electrical energy storage system (104) of the vehicle, receive a response message from the electrical energy storage system (104) that depends on the existence of a correct digital key (106) in a memory (108) of the electrical energy storage system (104); when the digital key (106) is correctly verified, allow electrical systems (110) of the vehicle to use the electrical energy storage system, when the digital key (106) cannot be correctly verified, limit the use of the electrical energy storage system (104) for the electrical systems (110) of the vehicle.

title_en: Hydrofoil comprising a retractable foil assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrofoil with a hull and an internal structure, which comprises: - a foil assembly comprising a mast rigidly connected to a foil; - a hole drilled through the hull and housing the mast; and - a joining part rigidly connected to the mast, the joining part forming a sliding connection with a frame rigidly connected to the internal structure of the hydrofoil so that the foil assembly is movable between at least one raised position and one lowered position and so that the considerable mechanical forces to which the foil assembly is exposed during the sailing of the hydrofoil are transmitted to the internal structure via the frame. The invention also relates to a ship appendage, in particular a foil assembly suitable for being installed on a hydrofoil according to the invention.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling steering, storage medium, and vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of vehicles, in particular to a method and an apparatus for controlling steering, a storage medium, and a vehicle. The method for controlling steering includes: determining (S201) that a vehicle is in a steer-by-wire mode; determining (5202) whether a first motor system and a second motor system fail, where the first motor system is in transmission fit with a steering column, and the second motor system is in transmission fit with a steering gear rack; controlling (5203) a clutch to be engaged on a condition that at least one of the first motor system and the second motor system fails; and switching (5204) the first motor system to a column electric power steering (CEPS) system on a condition that the second motor system fails.

title_en: Vehicle seat assembly and subassemblies thereof
abstract_en: Seat assemblies and subassemblies to provide massaging effects are disclosed. The subassembly may include massage bladders, fluid lines, and/or a pump such as an air compression. The seat assemblies may include features to enhance the massaging effect to an occupant such as weakened or strengthened portion aligned with fluid bladders. The seat assemblies may also receive a remote authorization for operating the massaging assembly or features thereof. The fluid bladders may be spherical or hemispherical. The massage assembly may operate the various bladders to scan an occupant.

title_en: Electric work vehicle
abstract_en: An electric work vehicle 1 includes a rear housing 12, a first motor 19 to drive a first rear wheel 4L, the first motor 19 being supported by the rear housing 19, and a second motor to drive a second rear wheel 4R, the second motor being supported by the rear housing 19. A first oil path 550 is defined within the rear housing 12. The first oil path 550 includes a first inlet opening 551 which is provided in a front portion of the rear housing 12 in a front-rear direction of the electric work vehicle 1.

title_en: Systems and methods for managing ice accretions during flight of aircraft
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide systems and methods for averting, shedding, or otherwise managing ice accretions that may develop during flight of an aircraft. Example systems and methods selectively modulate propeller parameters in a way that does not disrupt a flight trajectory; direct oil from a lubrication and cooling path to targeted sections of ice-prone surfaces to manage ice accretion in a way that does not unduly increase the total volume of oil, require larger pumps, or complicate the system; or generate heat at targeted areas of a propeller assembly by electric heating systems that utilize propeller motion.

title_en: Hybrid cord, rubber-fiber composite, and tire
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to providing a cord that can reduce environmental load while maintaining physical properties at high temperatures. The solution is a hybrid cord including a polyamide 4,10 fiber and a fiber A with a break elongation of 7% or less.

title_en: Control device, system, and method
abstract_en: A control device that is mounted on a moving object that is able to be moved by unmanned driving includes: an acquisition unit that acquires update information transmitted from outside of the moving object according to a process from manufacturing to sales of the moving object; a storage unit that stores unmanned driving information used for the unmanned driving; and an update unit that updates the unmanned driving information stored in the storage unit according to the update information.

title_en: Engine torque pulsation cancellation method and hybrid power system
abstract_en: A method for canceling engine torque pulsation and a hybrid power system are disclosed. The method is applied to a hybrid power system and comprises: acquiring a pulsation function in which an engine torque pulsation changes with a crank connecting rod angle; constructing a torsional vibration offset function in which an offset torque changes with the crank connecting rod angle, and adding control parameters to the torsional vibration offset function to optimize it, so that a sum of the offset torque and the engine torque pulsation is equal to or close to 0; acquiring state data of the hybrid power system and correcting the control parameters based on the state data; and when the engine and the motor work, determining a corresponding offset torque command for the motor based on the torsional vibration offset function, and superimposing the offset torque command on an output control of the motor during normal operation. According to the present disclosure, feedback adjustment of pulsation cancellation can be achieved, a closed-loop control logic can be formed, so that the canceling engine torque pulsation can achieve the best effect in reducing the rotation speed fluctuation and vibration of the hybrid power system throughout the entire lifetime of vehicle.

title_en: Brake system for a vehicle, in particular utility vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a brake system (1) for a vehicle (100), in particular for a utility vehicle, with a plurality of electromechanical brakes (5) for braking the vehicle (100), the brake system being designed to control the electromechanical brakes (5) in such a manner that application processes for carrying out a parking brake function (B P ), a service brake function (B B ) and an emergency brake function (B N ) are ensured by the system. It is proposed that the brake system (1) has a dedicated electric energy storage subsystem (9) for the brake system (1), which is designed to be connected to an electrical system of the vehicle (100) and which is designed to store a reserve charge (q R ) for at least one final application process for carrying out the emergency brake function (B N ) in the brake system (1).

title_en: Movable charging vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a movable charging vehicle (10) comprising a battery module comprising electrical batteries (40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45), a power converter module comprising a converter device (20, 21) electrically connected to the electrical batteries (40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45), the converter device of the power converter module being configured to convert the direct current to alternating current, a power distribution unit (30) comprising a power outlet (33) electrically connected to the converter device (20, 21), the power outlet (30) of the power distribution module (30) being configured to output alternating current from the movable charging vehicle (10), and the battery module comprises two or more electrical batteries (40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45) arranged in parallel electrical connection with each other and electrically connected to the converter device (20, 21).

title_en: An electric drive axle and an automobile
abstract_en: An electric drive axle and an automobile are disclosed. The electric drive axle is transversely arranged on a chassis, and comprises a motor assembly (1), a reducer assembly, and a differential assembly (4). The motor assembly (1) and the differential assembly (4) are respectively arranged on two sides of the reducer assembly. The reducer assembly comprises a three-stage reduction mechanism. When operating in electric drive mode, a motor power is transmitted to the differential assembly (4) after being decelerated by the three-stage reduction mechanism, and the differential assembly (4) distributes and outputs the power to left and right wheels of a vehicle. The electric drive axle in the present disclosure occupies a smaller space, the overall weight is evenly distributed, thereby improving the safety of the automobile. The three-level reduction mechanism prevents the high-speed motor shaft (13) from directly transmitting power to the gear set (44) of the differential assembly (4), thereby improving the stability and reliability of the electric drive axle.

title_en: Weapon targeting training system and method therefor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a training system for training of a forward controller. The training system utilises a pod housing that can be attached to a hardpoint under an 5 aircraft wing. The pod is configured to receive communications from the forward controller on the ground (or in another aircraft) and communicate wirelessly with an HMD and/or electronic device in the cockpit of the aircraft. This allows cheaper, less expensive aircraft to be used for training purposes.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling switchable glass and vehicle and electronic device
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for controlling switchable glass and a vehicle and an electronic device. The method for controlling switchable glass comprises: acquiring distance information between a target object and a vehicle (S101); controlling an input signal of switchable glass of the vehicle according to the distance information (S 102); and changing the light transmittance of the switchable glass by means of the input signal (S103). Distance information between a target object and a vehicle is acquired, and an input signal of switchable glass is controlled according to the distance information, so that flexible regulation of the light transmittance of the switchable glass is realized, thereby improving the user experience.

title_en: Electric vehicle
abstract_en:
Embodiments of this application provide an electric vehicle. 
     The electric vehicle (12) includes a power battery (411), a heat exchanger (420), a coolant storage tank (430), an in-vehicle pipeline (M), a coolant injection channel (441), and a coolant discharge channel (442). The power battery (411) includes a liquid cooling runner (412). The in-vehicle pipeline (M) is configured to connect one of an in-vehicle cooling loop, an off-vehicle cooling loop, and an off-vehicle coolant supplement channel. The in-vehicle cooling loop is configured to: deliver coolant flowing out of a liquid cooling runner (412) to the heat exchanger (420), and deliver coolant flowing out of the heat exchanger (420) to the liquid cooling runner (412). The off-vehicle cooling loop is configured to: deliver, through the coolant injection channel (441), coolant provided by an off-vehicle liquid cooling device (520) to the liquid cooling runner (412), and deliver, through the coolant discharge channel (442), coolant flowing out of the liquid cooling runner (412) to the off-vehicle liquid cooling device (520), so that the off-vehicle liquid cooling device (520) dissipates heat for the power battery (411). The off-vehicle coolant supplement channel is configured to deliver, through the coolant injection channel (441), coolant provided by the off-vehicle liquid cooling device (520) to the coolant storage tank (430), to implement coolant supplement for the coolant storage tank (430) by the off-vehicle liquid cooling device (520).

title_en: Gear shifting arrangement vehicle driving assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure concerns a gear shifting arrangement (8) for a gearbox. The arrangement (8) comprises a rotatable barrel cam (52) with a first track (60) and a shifting shaft (26) connected to the gearbox (14) and provided with a track follower (56) to follow along the first track (60). The first track (60) comprises a first inclined portion (601) configured to cause a first partial movement (PM1) of the shifting shaft (26) in a first axial direction (A1) from a neutral position (NP) to a first intermediate position (IP1) as the track follower (56) follows along the first inclined portion (601). A displacement mechanism (70) is configured to be activated at the first intermediate position (IP1) to cause a second partial movement (PM2) of the shifting shaft (26) in the first axial direction (A1) to a first gear engaging position (GP1).

title_en: Method for operating an automated vehicle, and automated vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for operating an automatically driving vehicle (1), comprising: - determining predefined vehicle parameters of the automatically driving vehicle (1) by a determination device (2) of the automatically driving vehicle (1), - determining a first vehicle parameter of the automatically driving vehicle (1) by a control device (3) of the automatically driving vehicle (1), - determining a first surroundings parameter of surroundings (U) of the automatically driving vehicle (1) by the control device (3), - determining, by the control device (3), whether a predefined trigger criterion is met by the combination of the first vehicle parameter and the first surroundings parameter, and - further processing the determined predefined vehicle parameters by the control device (3) if the trigger criterion is met. The invention further relates to an automatically driving vehicle (1).

title_en: Robust energy- or range-aware adaptive state-of-charge (soc) window control
abstract_en: A computer system (200) for adaptive state-of-charge (SoC) window control is provided, including processing circuitry (210) configured to: obtain a minimum required usable energy value (220) for an electric energy storage system (ESS, 240); obtain indications (230) of uncertainties for ESS usable energy estimation associated with at least one of i) aging of the ESS, ii) usage of the ESS, and iii) measurement errors of one or more parameters of the ESS; adapt, based on the indicated uncertainties, the minimum required usable energy value to a most likely minimum required usable energy value and/or a range of minimum required usable energy values for the ESS; define a SoC window for the ESS to match the most likely minimum required usable energy value and/or a value within the range of minimum required usable energy values, and control a discharging and/or charging (260) of the ESS in accordance with the SoC window.

title_en: Drone and arm
abstract_en: A drone includes a main body, an arm structure, and a stand. The arm structure is disposed on an outer side of the drone body. The stand has an antenna module. The antenna module is disposed in the stand and extends along an inner wall of the arm structure into the main body. The stand is detachably assembled to the arm structure.

title_en: Work machine
abstract_en: For example, in a work machine equipped with an input device that can selectively assign plurality functions, provide a work machine that can present information indicating the current function assignment without misidentifying the assigned functions and without reducing the visibility of other display information during operation. In a work machine equipped with an input device that can selectively assign any of plurality functions, and a display that shows either a first display screen containing the current function assignment information of the input device or a second display screen that does not contain the current function assignment information of the input device, the controller, when the first display screen is shown on the display and the input device is operated, executes processing according to the current function assignment of the input device. When the second display screen is shown on the display and the input device is operated, it does not execute processing according to the current function assignment of the input device, but instead controls the display to switch the display screen from the second display screen to the first display screen.

title_en: Vehicle thermal management system
abstract_en: A thermal management system S includes a refrigerant circuit 20, a chiller 30, a first circuit 100 that performs temperature adjustment of a battery B, a second circuit 200 that performs temperature adjustment of a drive device E, a third circuit 300 including a radiator 301, and a fourth circuit 400 connected to the chiller 30. A control unit 600 causes battery cooling in which the first circuit 100 and the fourth circuit 400 are connected and drive device cooling in which the second circuit 200 and the third circuit 300 are connected to be executed. During the execution of the battery cooling and the drive device cooling, the control unit 600 executes heat absorption inhibition control that inhibits heat dissipated from the outdoor condenser 23 from being absorbed by the radiator 301.

title_en: Pneumatic vehicle tyre with indicator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pneumatic vehicle tyre (1), preferably of radial construction, having a profiled tread (10) with at least one indicator (13) having a radially raised indicator part (13a). The pneumatic vehicle tyre (1) is characterised in that at least portions of at least the indicator part (13a) of the indicator (13) have a marking (13d), the surface of which has a higher roughness than its immediate surroundings.

title_en: SUPPORT DEVICE FOR LICENSE PLATE FOR A VEHICLE (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: A license plate holder device for automobiles, comprising a main support member (1) suitable for receiving a license plate (2) of a vehicle (10); an electronic ink display (3) fixed to the main support member (1); a main processor (4) configured to transmit and receive internet data and send presentation data to the electronic ink display (3); and a location assembly (5) comprising a first Bluetooth Low Energy locator and a second Ultra Wideband locator, the location assembly being configured to send data to the main processor (4).  (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title_en: FIRE PROTECTION SYSTEM AT ELECTRIC BUS CHARGING POINTS (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: A fire protection system for electric bus charging points, characterized in that it comprises a hydraulic circuit with a main supply pipe (1) directly connected to a water tank (7) associated with a pressure group (8). The main pipe (1) includes a plurality of branches (2.2', 2'',...) equipped with bulbless automatic sprinklers (3). Each branch is located above each of the electric bus (4) parking spaces (5) to be protected against fire. Each branch is assisted by a solenoid valve (6) for opening the branch. These solenoid valves (6) are automatically controlled by a central signaling and control unit, which is associated with a circuit of thermographic cameras distributed over the area to be protected. The main pipe (1) is connected to a parallel or bypass circuit (9), to which a tank containing a special additive for lithium-ion battery fires is connected. (10), assisted by a dosing equipment (11).  (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title_en: Methods and assemblies for mounting equipment to an aircraft fuselage
abstract_en: There is provided a method of mounting equipment, such as sensors, to an aircraft, comprising permanently attaching a mounting structure to the fuselage of the aircraft, by irremovably attaching a plurality of planar frames 102 to the exterior of the fuselage, orthogonal to a longitudinal axis of the fuselage and irremovably attaching a plurality of intercostal ribs 104 between pairs of adjacent frame, parallel to the longitudinal, then mounting equipment to or within the mounting structure; and covering the mounting structure and the equipment with a cover (116, figure 5) which may be a removable cover. The ribs and frames may define compartments within which the equipment may be stored or mounted.

title_en: Collision avoidance systems and methods
abstract_en: A system 100B to provide navigation control and/or docking assist for a marine vessel 101. A user input 120/130 device receives navigation control parameters input by a user, such as a target docking position, track, destination or orientation of a boat 101. A perimeter ranging system 148a,b, which may include sensors such as an ultrasonic sensor array, radar systems, visible spectrum and/or infrared/thermal imaging modules or cameras or LIDAR systems, is used to detect collision hazards within the vicinity of the vessel. A processor receives the user input destination and perimeter sensor data, and outputs control signals to a collision avoidance thruster 172 or steering actuator 150, the control signals manoeuvre the yacht into the desired position whilst evading objects in or on the water that pose a collision risk. Preferably, a 2D map is generated, the map displays areas/regions where a risk of collision has been detected, each area is assigned a thruster or velocity demand to limit the thrust/velocity to minimise a risk of collision. A cost function / linear regression model may be used to determine an optimal thrust/velocity attenuation based on an estimated collision risk. Preferably, voxels / volumetric pixels are used to estimate collision risk, wherein overlapping voxels are assigned a weighting according to set criteria.

title_en: Composite material layer and manufacture of sandwich panels
abstract_en: A composite material layer, the composite material layer comprising a curable resin which is in the form of a solid layer at 20°C, wherein the composite material layer comprises a prepreg comprising at least one ply of fibrous reinforcement material which is at least partly impregnated by the curable resin or the composite material layer comprises a film of the curable resin which is optionally carried on a support layer, wherein at least 50 wt% of the curable resin comprises at least one polymerisable vinyl ester prepolymer having at least two carbon-carbon unsaturated functional groups, the prepolymer being polymerisable by reaction of the unsaturated functional groups to form a cured resin, wherein the curable resin further comprises a free-radical curing system for polymerizing the polymerisable vinyl ester prepolymer. In a preferred embodiment, the prepolymer is the reaction product of an epoxy resin and 2-hydroxyethyl methacrylate phthalate.

title_en: Aircraft landing gear arrangement
abstract_en: An aircraft landing gear arrangement comprising a wheel with a brake 6, one or more fan blades 7a, 7b to cool the brake, and a brushless DC motor 8 for rotating the fan blade(s). An aircraft comprising such a landing gear arrangement and a method of cooling an aircraft landing gear brake are also provided. The motor may be powered by energy harvested from kinetic energy of the rotating wheels, or from the heat energy emitted from the brakes captured by a photovoltaic material. The motor may be located adjacent or within a wheel hub 3 with an outer portion on which a tyre is mounted, and within a volume 17 defined by a cover 14 mounted on the wheel. A lid 16 may prevent debris entering the volume 17. The motor may operate dependent on the phase of flight of the aircraft, or a sensed parameter such as temperature.

title_en: A method of determining a tire performance characteristic of a tire
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method of determining a tire performance characteristic of a tire including querying, using a processing system, a memory as to a presence of a first set of values indicative of a tire parameter of a tire in the memory, and determining, using the processing system, that the first set of values is insufficient to determine the tire performance characteristic of the tire, The method includes performing steps, using the processing system, comprising one or more of providing an indication that a second set of values indicative of the tire parameter is required to determine the tire performance characteristic of the tire, and retrieving, from the memory, a performance coefficient of the tire corresponding to performance of the tire associated with the first set of values, and determining, based on the performance coefficient, the tire performance characteristic of the tire.

title_en: A trailer braking system
abstract_en: A trailer braking system including: a supply line 44, a spring brake (connected to lines 102), which is released by pneumatic pressure and applied by spring when there is a lack of pressure; a spring brake control valve 10, which controls the flow of fluid to the spring brake; an immobiliser 80 (e.g. valve 84) which controls fluid flow to the spring brake control valve 10; and an auxiliary control valve 200, having a system enabled configuration and a system disabled configuration. In a brake release position the immobiliser permits fluid flow to the spring brake control valve 10, whereas in the immobiliser’s immobilise position fluid is not permitted to the spring brake control valve 10. In the system enabled configuration, the immobiliser 80 is operable to move between its two positions. In the system disabled configuration, the immobiliser 80 is automatically placed in the immobilise position and fluid is not permitted to the spring brake control valve 10. Also claimed is a method in which immobilisation is caused by an electronic control unit (ECU) sending a signal to the auxiliary control valve 200, and mobilisation is caused by the ECU sending a signal to an override valve 54.

title_en: Steering angle control
abstract_en: A control system receives a position signal at least partly based on data from a first sensor such as a camera 104 indicating a vehicle’s position relative to an obstacle (300, Figure 5) such as a kerb. A first path is determined that will cause at least a first wheel 202 of vehicle 200 to avoid the obstacle; and a second path is determined that will cause wheel 202 vehicle to encounter the obstacle at or above a minimum predefined approach angle, for example to allow the obstacle to be safely mounted. Either a steering control signal may be output for controlling a steering angle of at least one steerable wheel of the vehicle, such that the vehicle follows a trajectory on the first path or on the second path; and/or an instruction signal for causing a user to steer at least one steerable road wheel of the vehicle to follow the first path or the second path. A vehicle system, vehicle and method are also provided.

title_en: Handtool for changing bicycle tyres
abstract_en: In some examples, a tool for fitting and removing a tyre on a wheel rim comprises an elongate body forming a handle for the tool, wherein the elongate body is generally planar in form, having a plane and a longitudinal axis, a tyre-engagement portion arranged to, in use, engage with an outer side wall of the tyre to thereby facilitate fitting of the tyre, the tyre- engagement portion having a plane which is co-planar with the plane of the elongate body, and a hook portion, orthogonal to the longitudinal axis of the elongate body, arranged to, in use, engage with an inner side wall of the tyre to thereby facilitate removal of the tyre.

title_en: Active linear throttle
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for controlling an active throttle assembly. The method comprises receiving parameter data from a parameter sensing mechanism which may be configured to measure one of the position, velocity or force applied to a linearly moveable grip. The parameter is used to determine the linear movement of the grip and a transducer is used to convert this to a current value. The method then outputs control data based on the current value to a linear actuator associated with a carriage of the moveable grip. The method may be used to provide haptic feedback to a user of the active linear throttle assembly to indicate an operating condition of an engine of a vehicle containing the active throttle assembly and may be used as part of an aircraft fly by wire system.

title_en: Electric coupler for railroad vehicle
abstract_en: To secure high security without bringing on deterioration in communication speed regarding an electric coupler for a railroad vehicle provided with signal connection means of a non-contact method.SOLUTION: An electric coupler 1A for a railroad vehicle is arranged facing a coupling unit of the railroad vehicle, and connects at least a part of a communication system between train formations or between vehicles by a pair of transmission/reception means of a non-contact method. The transmission/reception means is provided with plane antennas 5a, 5b, 5c having the surfaces facing the coupling direction, and carries out transmission/reception by radio connection in a non-contact state with the surfaces facing each other to be overlapping between the plane antennas of the coupling electric couplers and with the surfaces in parallel and in a non-contact state at close proximity of closer than a prescribed distance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fuel cell system
abstract_en: To provide a fuel cell system capable of appropriately discharging residual voltage.SOLUTION: A fuel cell system comprises a fuel cell stack and a voltage converter for boosting output voltage of the fuel cell stack. The voltage converter comprises an input terminal, an output terminal, a ground line, a reactor, a diode, a switching element, and a driver circuit. The driver circuit is connected to a gate of the switching element. The driver circuit gradually increases voltage to be applied to the gate and, when current flowing through the reactor reaches threshold current, holds voltage to be applied at a constant level. The fuel cell system disclosed in the specification determines gate voltage while monitoring current flowed from a fuel cell, so the fuel cell system is capable of discharging residual voltage with constant current (threshold current) at all times regardless of the magnitude of residual voltage and variation in a characteristics of the switching element.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Side door opening/closing device for vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a side door opening/closing device for a vehicle which is capable of smoothly opening/closing operation by simplifying its structure.SOLUTION: A side door opening/closing device for a vehicle is provided in which a side door can be moved in the door opening direction by pushing a rack 14 in the longitudinal direction by rotation of an output gear 22, and also the side door can be moved in the door closing direction by pulling the rack 14 in the longitudinal direction by rotation of the output gear 22. A meshing holding unit 23 is rotatably connected to a gear case 18 around the rotation center of the output gear 22, and rotates around the rotation center of the output gear 22 by swing movement of the rack 14 accompanying the opening/closing operation of the side door.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Work amount calculation system
abstract_en: To provide a work amount calculation system that can suppress the possibility that distribution works will not be done as planned in a destination airport.SOLUTION: The work amount calculation system according to the present invention includes: an imaging unit for acquiring an image of a cargo in an airplane before the airplane arrives at a destination airport; a feature detection unit for detecting the feature of the cargo by recognizing the image acquired by the imaging unit; and a work amount calculation unit for calculating the work amount to be needed to carry the cargo in the destination airport by checking the feature of the cargo detected by the feature detection unit against work amount information recorded in advance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Motor control device
abstract_en: To provide a motor control device preventing erroneous determination of an overcurrent abnormality by a regenerative current.SOLUTION: A command calculation unit 401 of a motor control device 101 calculates a command value controlling energization of a motor 80 by operating an invertor (power converter) 60. When currents Iu, Iv, and Iw flowing through the inverter 60 or motor winding 84 exceed an overcurrent threshold value, an abnormality determination unit 55 determines an overcurrent abnormality. A power source current estimating unit 51 estimates or detects a power source current Ib being a DC current flowing between a battery (DC power source) 11 and the inverter 60, in which a direction of being supplied from the battery 11 to the inverter 60 is defined as positive, and a direction of being regenerated from the inverter 60 to the battery 11 is defined as negative. When the power source current Ib is smaller than a negative power source current threshold value (-X), the abnormality determination unit 55 stops the determination of the overcurrent abnormality.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Defense device, defense system and program for defense device
abstract_en: To enable a user to instruct a moving object to be protected from disturbances, such as rain, snow, hail, sunlight, and ultraviolet light from a prest tracking start position only by transmitting start information.SOLUTION: A defense system includes: a defense device; and an external device to be connected by radio. The defense device includes: an umbrella part for defensing a moving object from prescribed disturbances; an aerial movement mechanism for causing the umbrella part to perform aerial movement; a tracking start position storage part for storing information of a tracking start position in association with information for identifying the tracking start position; and a control part. The external device transmits start information including information for identifying the tracking start position to the defense device. The control part of the defense device reads and acquires the tracking start position stored in the tracking start position storage part on the basis of the information for identifying the tracking start position included in the start information received through a communication part, and controls the aerial movement mechanism so as to move to the acquired tracking start position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Air conditioner for vehicle
abstract_en: To provide an air conditioner for a vehicle capable of effectively improving heating efficiency in a cabin by further effectively using waste heat of a heating apparatus mounted on the vehicle.SOLUTION: An air conditioner has a first waste heat recovery heating mode of absorbing heat by a waste heat recovery heat exchanger 64 after decompressing a heat-radiated refrigerant by radiating heat of the refrigerant discharged from a compressor 2 by a heat radiator 4 so that a heat medium temperature Tw becomes a waste heat recovery proper temperature range and a second waste heat recovery heating mode of absorbing heat by the waste heat recovery heat exchanger 64 after decompressing the heat-radiated refrigerant by radiating heat of the refrigerant discharged from the compressor 2 by the heat radiator 4 even if the heat medium temperature Tw is less than a lower limit value of the waste heat recovery proper temperature range.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Skid information generating device, skid predicting device, brake device control device and skid information generating method
abstract_en: To predict a position where a wheel of a rail vehicle skids.SOLUTION: A control device 80 for controlling a brake device 50 includes an acquisition unit 87 for acquiring positional information of a vehicle 10 on a rail. The control device 80 includes a skid determination unit 81 for determining whether a wheel 43 of the vehicle 10 skids on the basis of a shaft rotation speed X2 that is a rotation speed of a wheel 42 detected by a rotation sensor 72. The control device 80 includes a storage unit 82 for storing the positional information of the vehicle 10 on the rail when the wheel 43 of the vehicle 10 skids, as skid information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Operation prediction method of steering wheel, and operation prediction device of the steering wheel
abstract_en: To provide an operation prediction method of a steering wheel and an operation prediction device of the steering wheel which acquire a potential signal of an occupant without arranging an electrode on a part of a body of the occupant and predict operation of the steering wheel by the occupant by using the acquired potential signal.SOLUTION: An operation prediction device includes: a palm potential detection part 10 which is arranged on a steering wheel 11 and detects a potential signal of a palm of an occupant when the occupant holds the steering wheel 11; and a controller 20 which extracts a before-operation signal generated before operation of the steering wheel 11 by the occupant from a potential signal detected by the palm potential detection part 10 and predicts the operation of the steering wheel 11 by the occupant on the basis of the extracted before-operation signal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: tire
abstract_en: To provide a tire that can further effectively remove a water film entering between a tread and a road surface.SOLUTION: A tire includes a rib-like or block-like land part 100 coming into contact with a road surface. The land part 100 includes multiple sipes 101. An end 102 of each sipe 101 positioned on a first-landing side of coming into contact with a road surface first with the rotation of the tire terminates inside the land part 100. An end 103 of the sipe 101 positioned on a later-landing side of coming into contact with a road surface later with the rotation of the tire is open at a side wall of the land part 100.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Electric vehicle
abstract_en: To provide an electric vehicle which can prevent the breakage like disconnection on a harness at the collision by arranging a harness.SOLUTION: A transaxle 2, a PCU 5 and a high voltage battery 6 are arranged in this order from the front side in the front-to-back direction. In the PCU 5, a portion 7 whose height is relatively high is provided on the right side with respect to the center in the vehicle width direction, and a portion 8 whose height is low is provided on the left side. A harness 11 connected to the high voltage battery 6 and an electric compressor 9 arranged on the right side of the transaxle 2 is routed on the upper side of the low portion 8 of the PCU 5. The harness 11 is inserted to a cross member 4 from a hole 12 on the left side of the cross member 4 extending in the vehicle width direction between the transaxle 2 and the PCU 5, penetrates through the cross member 4, is withdrawn to the outside of the cross member 4 from a hole 13 on the right side of the cross member 4 and is connected to the electric compressor 9 from the rear side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle driving support system, and electronic control device
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle driving support system and an electronic control device that make an occupant in a vehicle recognize an object to be recognized in a direction of traveling and suppress excessive warnings.SOLUTION: A correlation acquisition unit 3 acquires a correlation between an object to be recognized in front of a vehicle detected by a recognition object detection unit 15 and a driver's line-of-sight direction detected by a line-of-sight detection unit 18. Based on the correlation, an occupant characteristics determination unit 4 determines that the driver has, as visual recognition characteristics, either central visual characteristics in which the driver tries to recognize the object to be recognized in a central vision or peripheral visual characteristics in which the driver tries to recognize the object to be recognized in a peripheral vision, and makes a storage unit 9 store the determination result in association with the driver's occupant information by an occupant information acquisition unit 5. After that, a gaze determination unit 6 reads out the visual recognition characteristics corresponding to the driver's occupant information from the storage unit 9, and if the visual recognition characteristics are the central visual characteristics, it is determined whether or not the driver is gazing at the object to be recognized based on the object to be recognized and the detection result of the line-of-sight direction, and if not, a warning device 22 gives a warning.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Inverter control device
abstract_en: To provide an inverter control device that can stabilize a vehicle at an early stage.SOLUTION: An inverter control device includes an inverter, an electric motor, driving force transmission means installed between the electric motor and a drive wheel, and a control unit. The control unit short-circuits the inverter in three phases when the control unit detects abnormality in the inverter and shuts off driving force transmission by the driving force transmission means after a rotation speed of the electric motor falls below a predetermined speed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Vehicular drive control device
abstract_en: To provide a vehicular drive control device capable of preventing the torque of a motor from rapidly decreasing while preventing a vehicular behavior from being unstable in detecting abnormality.SOLUTION: A drive control device applied to a vehicle including a first motor for driving a first wheel and a second motor for driving a second wheel includes a sensor (21a) for detecting information on the drive control device, a torque setting part (32) for setting the upper limit of torque which can be generated by the first motor and the second motor on the basis of the information detected by the sensor, an abnormality detection part (52) for detecting abnormality of the drive control device, and an information output part (51) for outputting setting information for setting the upper limit of the torque of the first motor and the second motor at a common prescribed value as information to the torque setting part in the case where the abnormality detection part detects abnormality.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Water circulation apparatus for preventing anoxia at water bottom
abstract_en: To suppress anoxia in deep layers with less power, and to suppress anoxia in a wide range of deep layers.SOLUTION: A water circulation apparatus 1 for preventing anoxia at a water bottom, comprises an intermediate layer pumping pipe 4, a deep layer pumping pipe 5, a metering tank 8, and a water return pipe 9. By supplying air from an intermediate air pipe (first air pipe) 6 to the intermediate layer water pumping pipe 4, water rises in the intermediate layer water pumping pipe 4, and the water in the intermediate layer flows from the water return pipe 9 to the water bottom through the metering tank 8 (first circulation operation). When air is supplied from a deep layer air pipe (second air pipe) 7 to the deep layer pumping pipe 5, the water rises in the deep layer pumping pipe 5, and the water at the water bottom flows from the water return pipe 9 to the water bottom through the metering tank 8 (second circulation operation). The first circulation operation and the second circulation operation are alternately performed by control by a control device 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Contact force measurement method and current collector
abstract_en: To provide a contact force measurement method, etc., capable of further accurately measuring a contact force between a slider body and an overhead power line in a simple structure in a current collector comprising the slider body of a flexural plate type.SOLUTION: A current collector comprises: a slider body 30 including a plurality of slider pieces 31 abutted to an overhead power line T and arrayed in a tie direction; a connection member 40 which connects the slider pieces and has flexibility; a plurality of connection member support parts 52 and 60 supporting a plurality of parts of the connection member discrete in the tie direction; a load transmission member 51 to which ends of the connection member support parts are connected; and a collector head 10 mounted to the load transmission member in collector head mounting parts 12 and 13 disposed separately from the connection member support parts in the tie direction. A method of measuring contact force between the slider body and the overhead power line comprises: measuring distortion in a region between the collector head mounting part and the connection member support part in the load transmission member; and the calculating a contact force using the distortion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disembarkation support device
abstract_en: To provide a disembarkation support device that can reduce the possibility of the user feeling annoyed with the disembarkation support.SOLUTION: A control ECU 20 of a disembarkation support device, if there is a caution object (approaching object) in the surrounding area of the vehicle upon detection of a door open request operation, performs door open operation restriction processing to maintain a sliding door 11 in its fully closed position without performing door open operation processing of the sliding door 11. If the door open request operation is detected after such door open operation restriction processing has been performed for a predetermined number of times, the control ECU 20 performs the door open operation processing to move the sliding door to its fully open position even if there is the caution object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle interior assembly structure
abstract_en: To assemble a panel material forming a vehicle cabin interior of a vehicle smoothly from a vehicle fore and aft direction in such a manner that the panel material covers a body including an electronic device.SOLUTION: A guide structure (GM) which guides a panel material (20) to a predetermined assembly position from a vehicle fore and aft direction is provided in at least one of a panel material (20) and bodies (7, 8, 10). The guide structure (GM) is configured to guide the panel material (20) in another direction different from the vehicle fore and aft direction so as to avoid an electronic device (10) in a process in which the guide structure (GM) guides the panel material (20) to the predetermined assembly position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Vehicle seat
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle seat that can improve quality while reducing the manufacturing cost of a walk-in mechanism.SOLUTION: A vehicle seat comprises a slide device having a slide lock, and a walk-in mechanism. The walk-in mechanism has an actuation link 96 for displacing the slide lock to a release state by rotating in conjunction with forward reclining of a back frame, and a hinge pin 97 for rotatably supporting the actuation link. The hinge pin has a groove part 97C which is arranged between a tip part 97A and a root part 97B in an axial direction and in which at least a part in a circumferential direction from the tip part and the root part is recessed in a radial direction. The actuation link has an insertion part 961 into which the tip part can be inserted, and a sliding part 962 having an inner surface which communicates with the insertion part and slides into the groove part when the actuation link rotates.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Driving support device and driving support method
abstract_en: To present information on other vehicles that may intersect with a self vehicle in an easy-to-understand manner.SOLUTION: A driver support device includes: a reception circuit that receives information on one or more other vehicles travelling on a road that intersects a road on which a self vehicle travels; a calculation circuit that calculates a point where the self vehicle and the one or more other vehicles intersect and a timing of the intersection on the basis of the information on traveling of the self vehicle and the information on the one or more other vehicles; and a display that displays an image generated based on the timing of the intersection that includes the road on which the one or more other vehicles travel starting from the point of intersection and the one or more other vehicles.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Information providing device
abstract_en: To provide an information providing device capable of providing landscape information which does not make an occupant feel discomfort, even when the occupant views alternately, a landscape and a landscape image related to a same front view field.SOLUTION: An information providing device 300 comprises: an estimation part 313 for estimating a coordinate of a first lower parting part 331 related to a landscape related to a front view field of an occupant, on the basis of a seated state of an occupant acquired by an information acquiring part 311; and a conversion part 315 for, on the basis of a coordinate of the first lower parting part 331 estimated by the estimation part 313, converting the landscape image related to the front view field acquired by the information acquiring part 311, into a landscape image having a parting area 335 in which a second lower parting part 333 related to the landscape image is partitioned on the basis of the first lower parting part 331 related to the landscape. A display control part 171 displays, on an MIP 87, a landscape image having the parting area 335 converted by the conversion part 315.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Vehicle charge control system
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle charge control system capable of securing electric energy sufficient for a travel to a destination of the travel and proposing a charging schedule easy to utilize for a user.SOLUTION: An arithmetic unit of a server device sets a recommended travel route from a current place to a destination (step S2), determines a condition for the recommended travel route to be a route that a vehicle has been traveled in the past (step S3), determines a condition for a remaining capacity of a battery to be less than required electric energy (step S5), and determines a condition for a charging stand having a history of utilization to be present in the recommended travel route (step S11). In the case where all the conditions of the steps S3, S5 and S11 are satisfied, the arithmetic unit proposes a charging schedule including positional information of the charging stand that a user has utilized in the past.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Movable body
abstract_en: To provide a movable body which enables movement in a lateral direction (a vehicle width direction) and tilting in a roll direction of a rear wheel relative to a front vehicle body to be performed properly with a simple structure.SOLUTION: A rear wheel support mechanism 20 of a movable body 1A having a front wheel 3f and a rear wheel 3r has: a four node linkage 23 serving as a multi-node linkage which supports the rear wheel 3r on the vehicle body 2 so that the rear wheel 3r can move in a lateral direction of the vehicle body 2 relative to the vehicle body 2 and tilt in a roll direction relative to the vehicle body 2; and an actuator 28 which drives the four node linkage 23.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Railway vehicle automatic broadcasting system, terminal connection device, terminal, automatic broadcasting control method and program
abstract_en: To enable automatic broadcasting based on information from a train information management system, using a terminal loaded on a railway vehicle and a connection device of the terminal.SOLUTION: An automatic broadcasting system includes: a terminal loaded on the railway vehicle; and a connection device provided on the railway vehicle to communicate with the terminal. The connection device includes: a transmitter unit which transmits to the terminal the start information of the automatic broadcasting based on the operation information and the vehicle information of the railway vehicle from the train information management system; a receiver unit which receives, from the terminal having received the start information, voice information for the automatic broadcasting and an automatic broadcasting activation request; and a processing unit which, based on the automatic broadcasting activation request, performs processing to make activate an output amplifier which amplifies a voice signal based on the voice information, and processing to connect the voice signal to the output amplifier. The terminal includes a control unit which performs processing to generate voice information based on the start information and processing to transmit the generated voice information and the automatic broadcasting activation request to the connection device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electric actuator and electric braking device of vehicle using electric actuator
abstract_en: To provide an electric actuator that is used in an electric braking device of a vehicle, whose dimensions in a radial direction and in an axial direction can be reduced and whose size can be reduced.SOLUTION: An electric actuator DN comprises: an input member BI that is rotationally driven by an electric motor MT and has a first baffle part Ma at an inner periphery part Mn; an output member BO having, at an outer periphery part Mg, a second baffle part Mb that can engage with the first baffle part Ma and a first screw part Na; and a direct-acting member BH having a second screw part Nb that can engage with the first screw part Na. At the outer periphery part Mg of the output member BO are formed both a screw mechanism and a baffle mechanism. This can reduce dimensions in a radial direction and in an axial direction of the electric actuator DN.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle including a drive unit with an engine and a motor, that suppresses propagation of vibration from the drive unit to an inverter, and that is capable of securing cooling performance of the motor and the inverter.SOLUTION: A drive unit 10 includes an engine 13 and a motor 14. A torque tube 47 is connected at a rear part of the drive unit 10. A condensation part 442 and a boiling cooler fan 444 of a boiling cooler are attached to an upper part of the torque tube 47. A radiator 276 and a fan 278 for cooling a circuit substrate 273 of an inverter 27 are attached to a portion on a rear side of the condensation part 442, at an upper part of the torque tube 47. The fan 278 flows air (Flow 1) taken-in from a gap G3, to a rear side from a gap G2 between the fan and the torque tube 47 (Flow 3, 4) via (Flow 2) the radiator 276.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Head-up display device
abstract_en: To provide a head-up display device that can improve safety at an intersection.SOLUTION: A head-up display device 10 comprises: an image projection unit 12 that projects a first image PI1 which becomes a virtual image VI1 and a second image PI2 which becomes a virtual image VI2; and a control unit 20. The control unit 20 causes the image projection unit 12 to project the first image PI1 at a first timing when a vehicle 1 approaches an intersection CS to a predetermined distance. Also, the control unit 20 causes the image projection unit 12 to project the second image PI2 instead of the first image PI1 at a second timing when the vehicle 1 approaches the predetermined intersection CS more than the first timing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Information processor, information processing method, program, information processing system, and vehicle control system
abstract_en: To reduce time required for generating a locus.SOLUTION: An information processing apparatus according to an embodiment includes a generation unit, a retrieval unit, and a selection unit. Based on one or more avoidance patterns respectively indicating one or more motions of a moving body for avoiding an object, the generation unit generates a plurality of nodes at positions corresponding to motions indicated by the avoidance patterns in order to avoid a first object on a first locus. The retrieval unit retrieves, for the respective one or more avoidance patterns, for one or more locus candidates whose movements cost are each less than other locus candidates among a plurality of locus candidates connecting the plurality of nodes. The selection unit selects a locus candidate whose movement cost is less than other locus candidates among the one or more locus candidates retrieved for the respective avoidance patterns.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Vehicle guide system, vessel and vehicle guide method
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle guide system, a vessel and vehicle guide method vehicle guide system, and a vessel and vehicle guide method capable of reducing the number of staff for guiding a vehicle.SOLUTION: A vehicle guide system includes: a vehicle information acquirement unit for acquiring vehicle information (hereafter called vehicle information); a path calculation unit for calculating a path for a vehicle based on the vehicle information; and information projection unit for projecting on a deck the information for guiding by a plurality of projectors installed in a plurality of positions in the vessel based on the calculation result of the path.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle travel management system, control center, vehicle control device, vehicle travel management program, and vehicle travel management method
abstract_en: To realize a smooth travel by efficiently collecting information contributing to a travel of an automatic driving vehicle.SOLUTION: A vehicle travel management system for managing travels of a plurality of automatic driving vehicles includes: a control center for transmitting the settings related to a travel to the plurality of automatic driving vehicles; sensor control sections respectively installed in the plurality of automatic driving vehicles so as to control ON/OFF of various sensors mounted on self vehicles based on the settings received from the control center; and information collection sections respectively installed in the plurality of automatic driving vehicles so as to collect the outputs of the sensors which have been set to be ON by the sensor control sections. The control center selects a setting object vehicle from the plurality of automatic driving vehicles, selects an auxiliary information provision vehicle from the other automatic driving vehicles traveling in the neighborhood of a travel route of the setting object vehicle, and configures the settings related to the setting object vehicle with the use of the auxiliary information received from the information collection section of the auxiliary information provision vehicle.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Pneumatic tire
abstract_en: To provide a pneumatic tire whose both sides in a tire width direction can secure a grounding area at the time of braking.SOLUTION: In a pneumatic tire according to an embodiment, which is provided with a first belt 13 inside in a tire radial direction and a second belt 14 outside in the tire radial direction as belts in which a plurality of metal cords 23 and 24 is coated with rubber, a region where the first belt 13 overlaps with the second belt 14 is formed at a center in a tire width direction, a region where only the first belt 13 is arranged as the belt is formed at one side in the tire width direction, a region where only the second belt 14 is arranged as the belt is formed at the other side in the tire width direction, and the cords 23 and 24 are inclined in a direction in which the cords widen to outside in the tire width direction toward a normal rotation direction, in the first belt 13 and the second belt 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: To provide a display device that has an excellent visibility.SOLUTION: The display device according to an embodiment displays a display image in a display screen 45 having a display region and a non-display region. The display device includes: an LED 32 for emitting light; a sub-display panel 50, driven by a passive matrix driving system and transmitting light of the LED 32 from the display region; and a main display panel 40, driven by an active matrix driving system and having the display screen 45, the main display panel transmitting light of the LED 32 that transmits through the sub-display panel 50, from the display region.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: In-vehicle switching device
abstract_en: To more easily realize a device capable of switching a plurality of batteries between a series connection state and a parallel connection state and detecting a current flowing between the batteries in both the series connection state and the parallel connection state.SOLUTION: An in-vehicle switching device 1 includes: a switching circuit 14; a first conductive path 11 through which a current flows in a series connection state and does not flow in a parallel connection state; a second conductive path 12 through which a current flows in the parallel connection state and does not flow in the series connection state; a third conductive path 13 that forms a path between a negative electrode BL of a first battery 10A and a positive electrode BH of a second battery 10B in the series connection state, or forms a path between both the positive electrodes BH of the first battery 10A and the second battery 10B or both negative electrodes BL in the parallel connection state; and a current detection unit 14H that detects the current flowing through the third conductive path 13.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Shock absorption device
abstract_en: To provide a technology that can change a strength of a shock absorption device for absorbing collision energy of a vehicle.SOLUTION: A first shock absorption member provided between a frame forming a framework of a vehicle and an outer structure located outside the frame in the vehicle includes: a first shock absorption member installed to deform preferentially over the frame in an impact situation where the outer structure is displaced or deformed toward the frame by an impact load on the outer structure; a second shock absorption member provided between the frame and the outer structure; and a switching part capable of switching an installation state of the second shock absorption member between a first installation state in which the second shock absorption member receives the impact load under the impact situation and a second installation state in which the second shock absorption member receives the impact load under the impact situation and deforms together with the first shock absorption member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Electric connection box
abstract_en: To provide an electric connection box capable of preventing liquid from flowing into a case with a simpler configuration.SOLUTION: A vehicular electric connection box 100 includes a case member 30 in which a first fuse 11 is mounted, a connection/disconnection port 32 that is formed at a front side surface 313 and allows the first fuse 11 to be attached and detached from the case member 30, and a groove 31 that is recessed on surroundings of the connection/disconnection port 32 and directs liquid flowing down the front side surface 313 away from the connection/disconnection port 32.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: steering device
abstract_en: To provide a steering device that is able to set a use condition for an auxiliary power source appropriately according to the circumstances.SOLUTION: A steering device includes: a turning motor that generates a turning force, which is a force for turning a turning wheel of a vehicle; an auxiliary power source for a main power source that supplies power to the turning motor; and a turning control device that controls power supply from the auxiliary power source to the turning motor. The steering control device has a plurality of determination criteria (MRK1, MK2) for an output of the turning motor as determination criteria for starting power supply from the auxiliary power source to the turning motor and changes the determination criteria according to the circumstances. The steering control device selects a first determination criterion when a clutch for interrupting power transmission between the steering wheel and the turning wheel of the vehicle is connected thereto. The steering control device selects a second determination criterion when the clutch is not connected thereto.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Electrical junction box
abstract_en: To disclose an electrical junction box capable of achieving a connectin between a circuit board and a plurality of apparatuses in a space-saving manner by reducing man-hours and number of components, the circuit board and the plurality of apparatuses being accommodated in a housing.SOLUTION: An electrical junction box 10 includes: a circuit board 130; a branch circuit structure 12 for distributing power to each apparatus; a housing 14 for accommodating the circuit board and the branch circuit structure; and a board-side connector module 128 which is mounted on the circuit board 130 and in which a plurality of board-side connectors 140a-140d are integrated. The branch circuit structure 12 has: an internal circuit configured to include bus bars 78a-78d and an electrical component 82; a case 76 to accommodate the internal circuit inside; and a plurality of relay connectors 98a-98d protruded from the case 76 to be conductive to the internal circuit and connected to the plurality of board-side connectors 140a-140d, respectively. The board-side connectors 140a-140d are connected to the corresponding relay connectors 98a-98d in a state in which the branch circuit structure 12 and the circuit board 130 are assembled in the housing 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Electric transport vehicle
abstract_en: To enable a short-circuit brake of an electric transport vehicle to be appropriately controlled.SOLUTION: An electric transport vehicle in one aspect of the present disclosure comprises a motor and a control circuit. The motor comprises a plurality of terminals. The control circuit causes the motor to generate braking force according to a state that motor drive condition is not satisfied, through a short-circuit brake in which two or more terminals among the plurality of terminals are short-circuited each other. The control circuit gradually decreases the braking force through the short-circuit brake according to change from a state that the drive condition is not satisfied to a state that the drive condition is satisfied.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Rubber composition for tire and pneumatic tire
abstract_en: To provide a rubber composition for a tire excellent in on-ice brake performance and fracture properties, and a pneumatic tire.SOLUTION: A rubber composition for a tire includes 1-20 pts.mass of liquid polybutadiene whose glass transformation temperature is -80°C or below, and 1-30 pts.mass of a vegetable granular material whose particle diameter is 0.1-500 μm, on the basis of 100 pts.mass of a solid rubber composition.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Automatic driving method, automatic driving system, and automatic driving program
abstract_en: To provide an automatic driving technique capable of accelerating an own vehicle at a timing that does not give an occupant uncomfortable feeling when a preceding vehicle changes a lane during own vehicle's travel following a preceding vehicle.SOLUTION: While an own vehicle is traveled following a preceding vehicle traveling in the same lane as the own vehicle, a display of intention of changing a lane to an adjacent lane transmitted from the preceding vehicle is detected. When the display of intention of changing the lane is detected, it is detected that the preceding vehicle has departed toward the adjacent lane from an occupied area occupied by the own vehicle traveling in the lane. Then, when the departure of the preceding vehicle from the occupied area is detected, acceleration restriction for causing the own vehicle to follow the preceding vehicle is cancelled.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Vibration power generator and movable body
abstract_en: To further improve power generation efficiency.SOLUTION: A vibration power generator 10 comprises: a vibration exciter 11 that vibrates because of a fluid flowing along a wall surface 26; an arm part 12c of an oscillable frame 12 connected to the vibration exciter 11; a magnetostrictive plate 13 and a coil 14 that generate power because of an oscillation of the arm part 12c. The vibration exciter 11 is arranged close to the wall surface 26.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Driving support device
abstract_en: To provide a driving support device for preventing a wrong determination of a wrong-way drive when a vehicle is not allowed to travel on a driving lane in an originally specified direction in a traffic regulation section.SOLUTION: A driving support device 1 includes: an outside recognition device 11 for acquiring driving environment information around an owned vehicle M; a locator unit 10 for storing road map information and detecting the position of the vehicle on the basis of a positioning signal; and an operation control unit 25 for controlling the vehicle M on the basis of front driving environment information obtained by the outside recognition device 11. The operation control unit 25 performs wrong-way driving detection processing of the owned vehicle on the basis of the driving environment information and traffic regulation section determination processing of detecting a traffic regulation section of an owned vehicle driving lane 101 and determines the possibility that the owned vehicle M is driving in a wrong direction on an opposing lane 102.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Vehicular periphery monitoring device
abstract_en: To provide a vehicular periphery monitoring device which can prevent a driver from mistaking a state of an underfloor space of the own vehicle.SOLUTION: A vehicle periphery monitoring device 10 includes: a camera 80 which captures images of a periphery of an own vehicle 100; and a control device 90 which stores the images of the periphery of the own vehicle captured by the camera, uses the stored images to generate a current image of the underfloor space of the own vehicle as an underfloor image, and displays the generated underfloor image on a display 52. The control device is configured to end the display of the underfloor image on the display when a time period that the own vehicle is stopped reaches a predetermined first time period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 23

title_en: Control method of attitude of flight vehicle and flight vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a control method of a flight vehicle that can keep even an airframe having odd-number of propelling rotors in a horizontal attitude, and a flight vehicle.SOLUTION: In a control method of a flight vehicle UVA, which controls the fight vehicle UVA having an airframe B and odd-number of propelling rotors R, rotation speeds of the odd-number propelling rotors R and inclinations of rotating shafts of the odd-number of propelling rotors R with respect to the airframe B are adjusted so that component force in a horizontal direction, which generates torque FB that offsets torque FA for rotating the airframe B around a gravity center caused by reaction torque generated by the odd-number of propelling rotors, is generated, where the odd-number of propelling rotors R are provided so that inclinations of rotating shafts of the propelling rotors R with respect to the airframe B can be changed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Airbag device and deploying method of airbag device
abstract_en: To provide a technique for improving reliability of an airbag device.SOLUTION: An airbag device includes: a gas generator which has a first gas generating agent for generating combustion gas by ignition and an ignition section for igniting the first gas generating agent; and an airbag which receives supply of the combustion gas from the gas generator and is deployed. The airbag has an inflow section which is connected to the gas generator and makes the combustion gas supplied from the gas generator flow into an internal space of the airbag, a bag-like section which is bag-like member demarcating the internal space into which the combustion gas flows from the inflow section as an external section, is made a folded state at the time before receiving the supply of the combustion gas and becomes a deployed state by receiving the supply of the combustion gas, and a second gas generating agent which is arranged at a prescribed position on an inside surface of the bag-like section and generates gas without accompanying combustion reaction utilizing heat energy of the combustion gas.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle display apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle display apparatus which can improve the designability.SOLUTION: A vehicle display apparatus 1 comprises: an image display device which is arranged such that an upper display region 30u is opposed to an eye point of a vehicle; a combiner 5; a storage part which stores a lower display region of the image display device and has an opening; and a reflection member which reflects the lower display region toward the combiner. When viewed from the eye point, a first image 63 being an image of the opening reflected in the combiner overlaps the upper display region, and a boundary line of the first image has gaps G1, G2 with the first width Wd1 between the upper display region and itself.
