When viewed from the eye point, the first image overlaps a second image 36 being the image of the lower display region reflected on the combiner, and a boundary line of the first image has gaps G3, G4 with the second width Wd2 between the second image and itself. The shape of the upper display region and the shape of the lower display region are the shapes in which the first width is the same as the second width.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Electronic apparatus
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electronic apparatus which enables simplification of a registration work of a loading position. 
     SOLUTION: Input signals St are input to terminals 9 of an electronic apparatus 2 by input patterns set for each of loading positions. When the electronic apparatus 2 is installed in an object to be assembled such as a vehicle, a loading position registration part 15 confirms a loading position of the electronic apparatus 2 with reference to a table 16 stored in a storage part 17 based on the input patterns of the input signal St input to the terminal 9, and registers it as the loading position of an own machine in the storage part 17. Each of the electronic apparatuses 2 performs similar determination of the loading position whenever it is mounted on the object to be assembled such as the vehicle, and determines and registers the loading position of the own machine. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Vehicular drawing device
abstract_en: To stop drawing of an inappropriate notice display.SOLUTION: A vehicle drawing device 10 is installed on a vehicle and draws, using light, a notice display of a predetermined shape on a road surface in a traveling direction of the vehicle. When a direction indicator 24 is operated or the vehicle is steered, the vehicle drawing device 10 draws the notice display on the road surface. However, drawing of the notice display is stopped or a direction in which the notice display is drawn is changed under predetermined conditions.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Hybrid vehicle control device
abstract_en: To provide a hybrid vehicle control device which secures start-up performance of an engine while the same is in inertial rotation.SOLUTION: In a hybrid vehicle in which a clutch and a motor are arranged in this order on a power transmission path from an engine to wheels, a control device comprises: a start-up control section which causes combustion in an engine to be started by cranking the engine with the motor through the clutch when a request is made for starting up the engine by cranking the same in inertial rotation with the clutch released and the combustion stopped; and a throttle control section which makes pressure in an intake passage at a downstream side of a throttle valve higher when the request is made for starting up the engine in the inertial rotation than the same when the request is not made for starting up the engine in the inertial rotation by increasing an opening of the throttle valve of the engine before starting the combustion in the engine.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Vehicle component
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle component which can simplify a manufacturing process and can be reduced in weight.SOLUTION: There is provided a vehicle component 1 which is formed only of a fiber 11 element made of a core-sheath structure with the heat resistance, in which a soft part 10b with the flexibility is provided on the outer side and a cured part 10a that has been cured is provided on the inner side. The soft part 10b at least serves as a buffer for a vehicle. The cured part 10a at least serves to keep the shape of the vehicle component. The cured part 10a is formed by applying heat to a sheath part 11b to soften the sheath part and applying the prescribed pressure thereto.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electric connection box for vehicle
abstract_en: To secure normal operation by suppressing an influence due to dew condensation or freezing even in the case where a vehicle is used in an environment such as a cold district.SOLUTION: In an electric connection box 10, two type of relays such as PCB relay modules 12 and 13 or plug-in relays 14 to 17 are mounted. A power source supply to a load of an engine start system on-vehicle device 31 that requires a countermeasure on dew drop and freezing is controlled by the PCB relay module 12. In a circumference of an electric coil as a heat source in the PCB relay module 12, since a change of a heat distribution becomes looseness, normal operation can be secured because the dew drop hardly occurs even in the case of high humidity. In the load that the countermeasure on the dew drop is not important, the power source supply is controlled by using the plug-in relay or the like.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Transport system and unmanned transport vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a transport system and an unmanned transport vehicle which can enhance safety when transporting a transportation object by an unmanned transport vehicle.SOLUTION: A transport system according to the present disclosure comprises: a transportation object; and an unmanned transport vehicle that transports the transportation object. The unmanned transport vehicle includes: a coupling portion that detachably couples to a portion to be coupled which is installed on the transportation object; a pair of electrodes which are energized by the coupling portion coupling to the portion to be coupled; an energization state detection unit capable of acquiring information related to an energization state of an electric circuit including the pair of electrodes; and a determination unit that determines a coupling state between the unmanned transport vehicle and the transportation object, on the basis of the information related to the energization state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle control device
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle control device which sets reduction speed when reducing regenerative brake force to be gentle.SOLUTION: A vehicle control device 10 is applied to a vehicle having a regenerative brake device. The vehicle control device 10 brakes a vehicle on the basis of a target value of deceleration of the vehicle according to a brake request for braking the vehicle. The vehicle control device 10 includes a brake determination part 11 for determining that the vehicle is being braked on the basis of the brake request. The vehicle control device 10 includes a target deceleration calculation part 12 for calculating first target deceleration as a target value of deceleration of the vehicle, on the basis of the brake request, when the vehicle is being braked. The vehicle control device 10 includes an adjustment processing part 13 for executing deceleration adjustment processing of calculating second target deceleration obtained by adjusting the first target deceleration so that the magnitude of a change rate is reduced when the first target deceleration is brought close to "0".SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Transporting instrument
abstract_en: To provide a transporting instrument configured to enhance energy consumption efficiency while securing running stability thereof.SOLUTION: An automobile 1 is equipped with: a front output part 3 and a rear output part 4 which output power of a driving source 2; a clutch 14 provided in a power transmission path 13 extending from the driving source 2 to the rear output part 4; an electric pump 15 that can supply the clutch 14 with working pressure which enables the clutch 14 to be connected thereto to be able to transmit the power of the driving source 2; and a control device 20 that controls the driving source 2 and the electric pump 15. The control device 20 has, as a mode of controlling the driving source 2, a first mode and a second mode that is higher in energy consumption efficiency in the driving source 2 than in the first mode; and has, as a mode of controlling the electric pump 15, a high-output mode in which output of the electric pump 15 is below output at the time when the clutch 14 generates working pressure and a low-output mode that is lower in the output than in the high-output mode, which operates the electric pump 15 in the low output mode, in the second mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle control device
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle control device that can suppress a road from deteriorating.SOLUTION: A vehicle control device according to one embodiment comprises: a target route setting part that sets a target route; an offset amount determining part that determines an amount of offset with respect to the target route; a target route correcting part that generates a corrected target route offset in a lateral direction by the mount of the offset with respect to the target route; and a control part that controls a steering angle of a vehicle so that a vehicle travels along the corrected target route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: vehicle seat
abstract_en: To fix a belt guide to a seat frame without using a tool in a vehicle seat.SOLUTION: A seat 1 includes: a seat frame 7 which has right and left first portions 7A and a second portion 7B; a base member 21 which has a plate section 25 having a first belt hole 31, right and left first locking sections 27 which project downward from the plate section and lock each of the first portions, and second locking sections 28 which project downward from the plate section and abut on a front end and a lower end of the second portion; and a belt guide 13 which has a body section 41 which is arranged to face the plate section and has a second belt hole 44, a plurality of locking claws 53 which project downward from the body section and are locked to the plate section, and an edge wall 47 which extends from an edge section of the second belt hole to the inside of the first belt hole. In a vertical direction, the second portion is arranged between the second locking section and the body section. In a longitudinal direction, the second portion is arranged between the second locking section and the edge wall.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: detection device
abstract_en: To suppress influence of presence/absence of steering wheel warming.SOLUTION: A detection device 1 has: a heater wire 2 provided on a steering wheel SW; a series circuit 10 for connecting the heater wire 2 to a DC power supply PS and a ground EG; switches 51 and 52 provided between the heater wire 2 and the DC power supply PS; switches 53 and 54 provided between the heater wire 2 and the ground EG; a capacitance sensor 30 for detecting a capacitance of the heater wire 2; a sensor circuit 3 for connecting the capacitance sensor 30 between the switch 52 and the switch 53 in the series circuit 10; and a control part 7 for controlling the switches 51, 52, 53 and 54. When detecting the capacitance of the heater wire 2 in a non-driving period different from a non-driving period of the heater when detecting the capacitance, the control part 7 connects the heater wire 2 and the DC power supply PS for a predetermined time in a state where connection of the heater wire 2 and the ground EG is blocked, prior to detection of the capacitance of the heater wire 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicular control device
abstract_en: To provide a vehicular control device which enables reduction of user`s unnatural feeling which a user feels when state of charge of a battery is displayed in a case of changing a charging upper limit value of the battery.SOLUTION: A vehicular control device comprises: a battery; a display portion; a charge processing portion which charges the battery; a charged amount detection portion which detects charged amount of the battery; a charged amount display portion which causes the display portion to display information including the charged amount of the battery; a display conversion portion which converts a chargeable upper limit value of the battery and each of values existing in the range till the charging upper limit from actual values to prescribed display values; and a target value setting portion which sets a charging quantity target value selected by a user within a range of the display values converted by the display conversion portion. When the charged amount display portion is converted to display values by the display conversion portion, the charged amount display portion causes the display portion to display the charging quantity target value and values existing within the prescribed range from the charging quantity target value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicular air conditioner
abstract_en: To provide a vehicular air conditioner that controls a temperature of air in a vehicle interior through a heat medium flowing through a heat medium circuit, using a refrigerant circuit as a heat source, which can properly maintain a temperature of a battery even during exhaust heat recovering and heating.SOLUTION: A vehicular air conditioner is provided with: a refrigerant circuit; a heat medium circuit that has a high-temperature heat medium passage through which a high-temperature heat medium heated by heat radiation of the refrigerant circuit is flowed and a low-temperature heat medium passage through which a low-temperature heat medium cooled by heat absorption of the refrigerant circuit is flowed; and an air conditioning unit in which air heat medium heat exchangers provided in the heat medium circuit are arranged in an air flow passage through which air is supplied into a vehicle interior, and is further provided with an external heat exchanger that makes the heat medium exchange heat with outside air and provided with a heat exchanger for controlling a temperature of an on-vehicle heat generator, which is provided with passage switching means that joints a passage of the heat medium flowing through the external heat exchanger to a passage of a heat medium flowing through the heat exchanger for controlling a temperature of an on-vehicle heat generator, where a heat exchanger for controlling a temperature of a battery is arranged at a downstream side of other heat exchanger for controlling a temperature of an on-vehicle heat generator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: child seat
abstract_en: To provide a child seat which maintains fixing strength of a vehicle seat and strength of the seat and achieves downsizing.SOLUTION: A child seat 10 of the invention includes: a seat 20 on which an infant is seated; and a base 30 which is attached to a vehicle seat and enables one or more actions of the seat selected from rotation around an axis and sliding performed by linear movement. A connector reinforcement part 50 which reinforces strength of connectors 40 and a claw part 70 for holding the seat are disposed between the pair of connectors 40 which fixes the base 30 to the vehicle seat.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: object detection device
abstract_en: To more appropriately estimate road surface height in areas where road surface height is difficult to detect.SOLUTION: An object detection device includes a laser radar that irradiates the inside of a monitoring area with a laser beam and receives reflected light of the laser beam, a map generation unit that generates an unevenness map showing the road surface height for each cell in the monitoring area based on the received reflected light, and an object detection unit that detects objects on the road surface within the monitoring area based on the generated unevenness map and the reflected light received by the laser radar. The map generation unit interpolates the road surface height of an interpolation target cell where the received reflected light does not meet predetermined light reception conditions based on the road surface height of a first cell adjacent to the interpolation target cell on the laser radar side and the road surface height of a second cell adjacent to the interpolation target cell on the opposite side from the laser radar side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Charging system of unattended traveling body
abstract_en: To provide a charging system of an unattended traveling body which protects forgetting operation of charging the unattended traveling body when it becomes possible to charge by a charger.SOLUTION: A charging system 10 of an unattended traveling body has the unattended traveling body which travels with the electric power by power of a battery 17, and a charger 12 capable of charging the battery 17. The charging system comprises: a detection part which detects that a traveling body side charging part and a charging side charging part are in a chargeable state that the battery can be charged; a charging operation part which performs execution of charging the battery 17; a controller which controls the charger 12; and a notification body which can communicate with the controller and has a notification function notifying that it is in a state that the charging of the battery 17 is not executed. When the detection part detects the chargeable state and a preset set time elapsed, the controller transfers a signal indicating that the battery 17 is not charged to the notification body and notifies that the notification body is in a non-charged state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing method and information processing system in computer
abstract_en: To provide a novel method to estimate a state of a subject.SOLUTION: A biological measurement apparatus according to one aspect of the present disclosure is provided with: a first detector that detects and outputs a brain activity signal indicating the state of brain activity of a subject; and a signal processing circuit. The signal processing circuit acquires the brain activity signal, acquires a biological signal of the subject that is different from the brain activity signal, determines which of a wakefulness state, a sleep state, and an impaired consciousness state the subject is in on the basis of the biological signal and the brain activity signal, and generates and outputs a signal indicating the state of the subject.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Driving support device, driving support method and program
abstract_en: To provide a driving support device configured to execute braking control so as to stop a vehicle when a distance between an object located in front of the vehicle and the vehicle becomes a target stopping distance and capable of reducing a possibility of a collision between the object in front of the vehicle and a following vehicle by setting an appropriate target stopping distance.SOLUTION: A driving support device includes: a sensor configured to detect an object located in front of a vehicle and moving in the same direction as the vehicle; and a controller configured to execute braking control of applying braking force to the vehicle until a predetermined termination condition is satisfied when the object satisfies a predetermined start condition. When executing the braking control, the controller sets a target stopping distance such that the target stopping distance is longer as a relative speed of the object to the vehicle is higher. When a distance between the object and the vehicle coincides with the target stopping distance, the controller applies braking force so as to stop the vehicle.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Moving body
abstract_en: To provide a moving body that is able to smoothly shift from one state to the other state, of a control state for stabilizing a posture of a vehicle body by inclination of a rear wheel relative to the vehicle body and a control state for stopping or restricting inclination of the rear wheel relative to the vehicle body.SOLUTION: A control device 40 of a moving body 1 determines a control input for operating inclination of a rear wheel 3r relative to a vehicle body 2, by linear combination of a first control input component for stabilizing a posture of the vehicle body 2 in a rolling direction and a second control input component for converging an inclination angle of the rear wheel 3r relative to the vehicle body 2 on zero. The control device controls an actuator 28 according to the control input and sets a first gain coefficient related to the first control input component and a second gain coefficient related to the second control input component so that, as a value of one gain coefficient increases, a value of the other gain coefficient decreases.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Lock holder
abstract_en: To provide a lock holder capable of solving the problem that different lock holders require different tools for manufacturing the various lock holders since the disadvantage of conventional lock holders is that the lock holders have a one-piece structure.SOLUTION: Provided is a lock holder for an automotive vehicle lock. The lock holder includes a support plate 3 and a shackle 2. The shackle 2 has a U-shape with two legs 7 and a connecting web 8. The shackle 2 has various cross sections. At least a part of the leg 7 has a circular cross section 11. A part of a rotary latch 12 can be engaged with the circular cross section 11. A stopper 10 is provided at an open end of the shackle 2. The stopper 10 connects the two legs 7 of the shackle 2 to each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Pneumatic tire
abstract_en: To provide a pneumatic tire that can reduce vehicle interior noise without increasing the rolling resistance.SOLUTION: A pneumatic tire 1 includes a tread portion 2, sidewall portions 3, bead portions 4, a carcass 6, and an inner rubber 10 extending on an inner side of the carcass 6. The inner rubber 10 includes a first portion 11 extending in the tread portion 2 with a first thickness t1, and a second portion 12 extending in the sidewall portions 3 with a second thickness t2. The first thickness t1 is greater than the second thickness t2. The carcass 6 includes carcass cords 6B, and a twist coefficient K of the carcass cords 6B is from 2000 to 2500.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Battery temperature adjustment device
abstract_en: To provide a battery temperature adjustment device that can reduce power consumption of a battery.SOLUTION: A battery temperature adjustment device 10 cools or heats cooling water using power from a running battery 5 installed in a vehicle and cools by the cooling water or heats the battery 5 to an appropriate temperature to adjust the temperature of the battery 5. If a distance from a current location to a destination of a vehicle is greater than a predetermined distance, the battery temperature adjustment device adjusts the temperature of a battery so that the temperature of the battery is in a second temperature range. If the distance from the current location to the destination of the vehicle is equal to or less than the predetermined distance, the battery temperature adjustment device adjusts the temperature of the battery 5 at the minimum capacity required for the temperature of the battery 5 to be within a first temperature range wider than the second temperature range by the time when the vehicle arrives at the destination from the current location.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Flying robot control system and flying robot control method
abstract_en: To provide a flying robot control system and the like that can easily set a restriction item for manual operation of an autonomously flying flying robot using an operating device.SOLUTION: A flying robot control system has: a mode setting unit that sets, as a flying mode of a flying robot, any one of an autonomous flying mode in which the flying robot autonomously flies and a manual flying mode in which the flying robot flies according to manual operation using an operating device; a storage unit that, in correspondence with a plurality of region attributes, stores a restriction item imposed to the manual flying mode in a region provided with the region attribute; and an acquisition unit that acquires one or more region attributes provided to a predetermined region in a flying area of the flying robot. The mode setting unit sets the restriction item in the predetermined region on the basis of the region attribute of the predetermined region acquired by the acquisition unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Remote automatic driving system, server and vehicle manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide a technique that can manage the charge rate of a secondary battery at an appropriate value in a manufacturing process of a vehicle using automatic driving with remote control.SOLUTION: A remote automatic driving system used in a factory that manufactures a vehicle includes: a remote control unit that remotely controls a vehicle that can run in a factory in a manufacturing process in the factory and has a communication device that has a communication function for remote control and a secondary battery for travel; a charge rate acquisition unit that acquires the charge rate of the secondary battery; and a charge rate adjustment determination unit that acquires a target value of the charge rate and uses the acquired target value and the current charge rate to determine whether or not the charge rate is adjusted. The remote control unit, when the charge rate adjustment determination unit determines that the charge rate is adjusted, executes charge rate adjustment processing including at least one of the discharge processing for discharging the secondary battery and the charge processing for charging the secondary battery with the remote control of the vehicle to bring the charge rate closer to the target value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Washing device
abstract_en: To improve washing quality.SOLUTION: A washing device includes: a washing device body (3) with a jetting mechanism (30); and a control unit (4). The jetting mechanism (30) includes: a nozzle element (31); and a distance sensor (8) that acquires first information on a distance from the nozzle element (31) to a surface to be washed. The nozzle element (31) is configured to be able to adjust a spray angle for regulating spread of jetted washing liquid. The control unit (4) adjusts the spray angle by controlling the nozzle element (31) on the basis of the first information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Upper support and manufacturing method of upper support
abstract_en: To provide a new upper support capable of preventing infiltration of water into an inside through a gap between overlapped surfaces of flange-shaped parts in upper and lower bracket fittings.SOLUTION: An upper support 10 is such that: a bracket 18 is composed of an upper bracket fitting 50 and a lower bracket fitting 52 including flange-shaped parts 46, 48 overlapped on each other; overlapped surfaces 70, 81 of the flange-shaped parts 46, 48 are fastened each other by welding in a plurality of places in the circumferential direction; a plurality of fixing bolts 100 are disposed separately in the circumferential direction in the overlapped portions of the flange-shaped parts 46, 48; an adhesive 106 is applied to outer peripheral edge parts of the flange-shaped parts 46, 48 of the upper and lower bracket fittings 50, 52; and an outer peripheral end between the overlapped surfaces 70, 81 of the flange-shaped parts 46, 48 of the upper and lower bracket fittings 50, 52 is closed by the adhesive 106 in an outer peripheral side region of the fixing bolts 100.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Fixing device and carrier
abstract_en: To provide a fixing device that fixes a cargo receiver to a riding unit in such a manner that the cargo receiver can be unfixed.SOLUTION: A fixing device includes an engagement mechanism provided in one of a cargo receiver and riding unit, and an engagement seat provided in the other one of the cargo receiver and riding unit. The engagement mechanism includes a first lock member capable of moving between a locking position and unlocking position. The engagement seat includes a second lock member capable of being locked to the first lock member. The engagement mechanism is engaged with the engagement seat. When the first lock member is located at the locking position, the first lock member and second lock member are locked to block the engagement mechanism from separating from the engagement seat. When the first lock member is located at the unlocking position, the first lock member and second lock member are unlocked to permit the engagement mechanism to separate from the engagement seat. The engagement mechanism has a retainment junction and an unlocking junction hole. When the engagement mechanism and engagement seat are unlocked, the unlocking junction hole is joined with the retainment junction, whereby the engagement mechanism and engagement seat are retained in an unlocked condition.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Water discharge structure for vehicular pipe material
abstract_en: To positively discharge liquid in a pipe material to outside while suppressing generation of abnormal noise to the extent possible.SOLUTION: In a water discharge structure for a vehicular pipe material 4 including the pipe material 4 provided in a vehicle and a water discharge part 10 for discharging liquid retaining in the pipe material 4 to outside, the water discharge part 10 includes: a hole part 20 for water discharge provided in the pipe material 4; and a covering member 30 mounted to the pipe material 4 so as to cover the hole part 20 from outside. In the case where the pipe material 4 is vertically divided into two portions to set an upper side region 4A and a lower side region 4B and a virtual vertical line VL1 passing through a lowest end 4u of the pipe material 4 is assumed, the water discharge part 10 is provided in the lower side region 4B, and the covering member 30 is mounted to the hole part 20 provided at a position different from the virtual vertical line VL1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Performance pattern generation device, performance pattern generation method and performance pattern generation program
abstract_en: To provide a performance pattern generation device, a performance pattern generation method and a performance pattern generation program capable of generating a performance pattern using a flying object.SOLUTION: A performance pattern generation device includes: a storage part for storing pattern information of a content of movement of a flying object, a content of light emitted by a light emitting part disposed on the flying object, and a content of display of fireworks; an association part for associating a feature content of sound used for the performance with at least one content to be registered in the pattern information to generate association result information; a receiving part for receiving sound information of the sound used for the performance; and an acquisition part referring to the association result information generated by the association part to acquire the content of the movement of the flying object, the content of light emitted by the light emission part disposed on the flying object and the content of the display of the fireworks according to the feature content of the sound based on the sound information received by the receiving part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Mounting structure of head-up display device to vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a mounting structure of a head-up display device to a vehicle capable of reducing displacement of a virtual image due to vibration.SOLUTION: An HUD device 1 includes a casing 70, a display 30, a plane mirror 21, a concave mirror 20 and a control section 60. The concave mirror 20 is rotatably supported by the casing 70. In a mounting structure 101 of the HUD device 1 to a vehicle, a first elastic member 42 and a second elastic member 43 are provided to reduce displacement of a virtual image due to vibration. The first elastic member 42 is provided between a projection part 41 provided in the casing 70 and a vehicle body structure 100. The second elastic member 43 is provided between a rear surface (surface on a side that is not a reflection surface) of the concave mirror 20 and an inner surface of the casing 70.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Door handle device
abstract_en: To provide a door handle device improved in operability when opening a door in an emergency while suppressing unintended handle operation to an emergency operation position in a normal state.SOLUTION: A door handle device 20 includes a handle 30 that can be rotated from an initial position before operation to an emergency operation position via a normal operation position, a detection unit 35 that outputs a signal to electrically operate a door latch device 10 to open, a transmission mechanism 40 that manually operates the door latch device 10 to open by operating the handle 30, and a restriction mechanism 60 that can move to a restriction position where rotation of the handle 30 is restricted and to a release position where the restriction is released. An operating member 44 has a holding portion 44d that holds a restriction member 63 in the release position. When the operating member 44 moves due to rotation of the handle 30 toward the initial position beyond the normal operation position, the holding of the restriction member 63 by the holding portion 44d is released, and the restriction member 63 returns to the restriction position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 18

title_en: Vehicle system
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle system that can transmit detailed contents of assist processing.SOLUTION: A vehicle system 1 supports driving operation by a driver by assist processing for accelerating or decelerating a vehicle on the basis of an environment around the vehicle or changing a steering angle. The vehicle system 1 comprises a seat 10 on which a user is seated, an electric device that moves a portion of a seating surface F of the seat 10, and a control part 100. The electric device includes a vibrating device 23 and/or an air cell. When executing the assist processing, the control part 100 executes device interlock processing for activating the electric device, in response to movement of the vehicle operated by the assist processing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Personal water craft and control method for the same
abstract_en: To provide a personal watercraft capable of suppressing skidding.SOLUTION: A personal watercraft 10 has: a hull 11; an engine 12; a steering device 13; a water injection nozzle 14; a control unit 15; a throttle mechanism 16; and a detector 21 having a six-axis sensor 20. Angular velocity and angular acceleration around a yawing axis is detected by the six-axis sensor 20 when the hull 11 is rotated. Deceleration control is carried out by the control unit 15 to decelerate the engine 12 when at least one of the angular velocity and the angular acceleration exceeds a threshold value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Control device
abstract_en: To suppress fall of a kite.SOLUTION: A control device includes: determination means configured to determine whether a kite is in a dive mode based on a posture of the kite including aerodynamic characteristic changing means capable of changing an aerodynamic characteristic; and control means configured to control the aerodynamic characteristic changing means such that the kite turns in a direction opposite to a current turning direction of the kite when it is determined that the kite is in the dive mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Wiper device
abstract_en: To provide a wiper device capable of further suppressing the occurrence of abnormal noise while maintaining good wiping performance.SOLUTION: An arm head 50 comprises: outer surface portions 51A, 51B; a connecting recess 58 provided between the outer surface portions 51A, 51B; and front head-side abutment surfaces HB1, HB3, and rear head-side abutment surfaces HB2, HB4 which are provided on the outer surface portions 51A, 51B and arranged on both sides of the connecting recess 58 in the longitudinal direction of the arm head 50. An arm shank 40 comprises: inner surface portions 49A, 49B; a connecting shaft 43 provided between the inner surface portions 49A, 49B; and front shank-side abutment surfaces SB1, SB3, and rear shank-side abutment surfaces SB2, SB4 which are provided on the inner surface portions 49A, 49B and arranged on both sides of the connecting shaft 43 in the longitudinal direction of the arm shank 40 so as to abut against the front head-side abutment surfaces HB1, HB3, and the rear head-side abutment surfaces HB2, HB4, respectively.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Vehicle exterior protection device
abstract_en: To improve, in a vehicle, a vehicle exterior protection device for protecting a vehicle exterior moving body such as a pedestrian.SOLUTION: A vehicle exterior protection device of a vehicle having head lamp units provided exposed on a front part of a vehicle body of the vehicle, includes: an airbag device for deploying an airbag for covering an exposed surface of the head lamp unit by being deployed in front of the head lamp unit; tension members connected to the airbag; and actuators for each pulling the tension member. The tension member is pulled by the actuator to pull the airbag toward the exposed surface of the head lamp unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Human-power driven vehicle component or fishing gear
abstract_en: To provide a human-power driven vehicle or a fishing gear that provides improved radiation performance.SOLUTION: A human-power driven vehicle component or a fishing gear includes: a housing; a heat pipe at least partially disposed within the housing and including a heat input section, a heat dissipation section, a flow path extending at least between the heat input section and the heat dissipation section, and a fluid filled within the flow path; and a heat-generating member that is disposed near the heat input section of the heat pipe in the housing. The flow path of the heat pipe has a contact surface with which the fluid comes into contact, and water repellent treatment is applied to the contact surface of the flow path.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Valve Unit
abstract_en: To provide a valve unit to be applied to a refrigeration cycle, capable of reducing energy loss.SOLUTION: A valve unit 1 includes: a first member 12 having a first flow path 141 constituting a high temperature passage connecting a compressor 102 to a radiator 104; a second member 14 having a second flow path 142 including an expansion part of an expansion device 2 and constituting a medium temperature passage connecting the radiator 104 to the expansion part; and a third flow path 143 constituting a low temperature passage connecting the expansion part to the vaporizer 106; and a third member 16 to which the first member 12 and the second member 14 are each fixed so that the first member 12 and the second member 14 are in no direct contact with each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electric power source system
abstract_en: To provide technique enabling proper output of an alarm related to a DC/DC converter and an alternator in a hybrid vehicle.SOLUTION: In an electric power source system 1 mounted in a hybrid vehicle, a DC/DC converter 24 converts the output voltage of a drive battery 18 of the hybrid vehicle and supplies the converted voltage to an auxiliary load 16. An alternator 12 is driven by the engine 10 of the hybrid vehicle to generate electric power and supplies the generated electric power to the auxiliary load 16. The output part 32 outputs an alarm related to the DC/DC converter 24 and the alternator 12 to an occupant of the hybrid vehicle. The output part 32 outputs a first alarm 1 urging stop when both the DC/DC converter 24 and the alternator 12 are abnormal and outputs a second alarm different from the first alarm when either one of the DC/DC converter 24 and the alternator 12 is abnormal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Motor, cooling control method for the same, and mobility device equipped with the same
abstract_en: To provide a motor structure in which heat of the motor which may be generated by a stator coil can be actively controlled.SOLUTION: A motor 100 includes a stator 110 that is disposed in a housing and has a plurality of stator coils repeatedly arranged in a circumferential direction, and a thermoelectric module that is disposed on the housing in order to cool the plurality of stator coils. The thermoelectric module can include a substrate, one or more pairs each consisting of N-type and P-type pellets that are alternately mounted on the substrate, and a coupling electrode that mutually couples the N-type and P-type pellets at side surfaces.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Cylinder Device
abstract_en: To provide a cylinder device capable of generating appropriate thrust according to kinetic viscosity of operation liquid in the cylinder device.SOLUTION: A cylinder device 1 comprises: a hydraulic cylinder A having a cylinder body 2 expanded/contracted by supply of an operation fluid, a pump 13 for supplying the operation fluid to the cylinder body 2, and a motor 14 for driving the pump 13, and capable of functioning as an actuator by driving of the pump 13 and functioning as a passive dumper when the pump 13 is stopped; and a controller C for controlling the motor 14, wherein the controller C comprises: a torque detection part 42 for detecting torque Tm of the motor 14; and a selecting part 44 for selecting either one of an actuator mode for making the hydraulic cylinder A function as the actuator and a passive dumper mode for making it function as the passive dumper on a basis of the torque Tm detected by the torque detection part 42.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Dust scattering prevention m device for operating vehicle or the like
abstract_en: To provide a device for preventing scattering of tires, asphalt, concrete, earth and sand, and brake iron powder dust.SOLUTION: A dust collecting suction cover is installed at a place of a vehicle body floor part, a driving wheel and a caterpillar of a front part, a side part, a rear part and a floor part of a traveling vehicle, and dust mixed in the outside air is collected in a dust collecting main pipe (2), and water spray mist is applied to the dust by a mist water spray generating device after the dust is caught, and water and concentrated dust water are separated by a water droplet liquefying filter into a storage container installed in the vehicle.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Photographing method and camera mounting jig
abstract_en: To record detailed states of a rower and an oar during riding.SOLUTION: The photographing method includes a step of fixing an attachment jig supporting a camera to a metal fitting provided in a boat on which a rower rows and through which an oar used for the rowing is inserted, and photographing the rower and the oar with the camera supported by the attachment jig fixed to the metal fitting.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Construction machine
abstract_en: To provide a construction machine capable of changing from a tilt-down state to a tilt-up state without requiring removal or attachment of a cover member covering a gap between a front end of a floor member in a tilt-down state and a front end of a vehicle body frame.SOLUTION: The hydraulic excavator 1 includes a cab 12 having a floor member 13, and a tilting support member 17 capable of moving the cab 12 between a tilt-up state where a rear side of the cab 12 is moved upward and a tilt-down state where the rear side of the cab 12 is placed on a revolving frame 5, and the hydraulic excavator 1 further includes a movable cover 100 arranged on a front side of the tilting support member 17 and covering a space H between the revolving frame 5 and the floor member 13 in the tilt-down state, and a link 104 rotatably connecting the movable cover 100 to the floor member 13. The link 104 is configured to support the movable cover 100 at a position spaced apart from the floor member 13 when the cab 12 moves between the tilt-down state and the tilt-up state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Head-up display device
abstract_en: To provide a head-up display device capable of displaying information in such a manner that a user can easily perform appropriate situation determination.SOLUTION: The head-up display device displays an image 5 to a user on a virtual plane set in front of a windshield of a vehicle under the control of a control unit. The control unit can divide the region of the image 5 displayed on the virtual plane into a first display region 6 and a second display region 7 which is visually recognized below the first display region 6 for the user and displays information of a type different from the information displayed in the first display region 6. When simultaneously displaying the navigation information acquired from the navigation system and the driving assistance information acquired from the driving assistance system in the region of the image 5, the control unit displays the navigation information in the first display region 6 and displays the driving assistance information in the second display region 7.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Thrust-vector control apparatus and flight vehicle including the same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a thrust-vector control apparatus. The thrust-vector control apparatus includes: an internal nozzle discharging a jet backward; an upper flap placed above the internal nozzle, while provided to be moved forward and backward such that a protruding length of a part protruding more backward than the internal nozzle can be adjusted; and a lower flap placed below the internal nozzle, while provided to be moved forward and backward such that a protruding length of a part protruding more backward than the internal nozzle can be adjusted. The upper flap is provided such that a lower surface of the part protruding more backward than the internal nozzle forms a Coanda surface of the jet discharged from the internal nozzle, and the lower flap is provided such that an upper surface of the part protruding more backward than the internal nozzle forms a Coanda surface of the jet discharged from the internal nozzle. Therefore, the present invention is capable of enabling continuous thrust-vector control without causing hysteresis.

title_en: Smart mobility smart charging system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart charging system which enables a smart mobility to be mounted and charged. The smart mobile smart charging system of the present invention comprises a control box device.

title_en: Buoyancy fixed support device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a buoyancy fixing and supporting device for a floating type marine solar power generation system, and more specifically, to a buoyancy device of a floating type marine solar power generation system, comprising: a coupling bracket which is inserted and installed between an upper housing and a lower housing, both of which accommodate the buoyancy body; and a fluid prevention part, which restricts the movement of the buoyancy body and is located inside the coupling bracket. The present invention can minimize right and left movements of the buoyancy by further forming a flow prevention part inside the coupling bracket, which couples the upper housing and the lower housing, thereby maintaining a stable posture of the buoyancy and increasing the power generation efficiency of the solar power generation system.

title_en: High efficiency driving system for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a driving system for transport means with improved driving performance and energy efficiency, which is installed on a chassis (100) with wheels (110, 120) installed on front and rear sides to supply a rotation driving force to the wheels using power supplied from a battery (not shown). An electric vehicle includes a chassis (100) with wheels (110, 120) installed on front and rear sides, and a driving system (200) installed in the chassis (100) to supply a rotation driving force to the wheels, wherein the driving system (200) includes: a housing (210) fixed to the chassis (100); a first electric motor (220) installed on one side of the housing (210) to provide a rotation driving force; a second electric motor (230) installed on the other side of the housing (210) to provide a rotation driving force; a first gear assembly (240) installed in the housing (210), having a main input shaft (241a) connected to a rotary shaft of the first electric motor (220) and an output shaft (244a) outputting increased torque; and a second gear assembly (250) installed in the housing (210), having a sub input shaft (251a) connected to a rotary shaft of the second electric motor (230), and selectively transmitting the rotation driving force from the second electric motor (230) to the first gear assembly (240).

title_en: System and method of providing responsive waterway information for smart ship
abstract_en: A reactive waterway information providing system for smart ships and a method thereof are disclosed. The reactive waterway information providing system for smart ships comprises: a smart ship configured to request and receive, in real time, reactive waterway information based on a current location for autonomous navigation, and to perform autonomous navigation using the received reactive waterway information and autonomous navigation sensor information; and a smart ship reactive waterway information providing server configured to transmit, in real time, the reactive waterway information to the smart ship in response to the request from the smart ship. The smart ship further comprises a reactive waterway information collection control module configured to perform real-time control so as to collect reactive waterway information based on location information detected by a location information sensor; a smart ship sensing information real-time collection module configured to collect, in real time, smart ship sensing information stored in the smart ship reactive waterway information providing server according to the real-time control of the reactive waterway information collection control module; and a waterway-installed sensor sensing information real-time collection module configured to collect, in real time, waterway-installed sensor sensing information stored in the smart ship reactive waterway information providing server according to the real-time control of the reactive waterway information collection control module.

title_en: Electric automobile capable of charging wind power
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric vehicle capable of being charged by wind energy, reducing air pollution by not using fossil fuel and reducing electric charging costs in an electric charging station. An electric vehicle capable of being charged by wind energy comprises: an air inlet unit formed on a front surface of the electric vehicle driven by rotating a wheel using an electric motor to allow wind to be introduced during driving; a turbine formed at a rear end of the air inlet unit to be rotated by wind power; a power generation unit composed of a rotor coupled to a rotary shaft extended from the turbine and a stator arranged in a ring shape outside the rotor to generate power by rotation of the rotor; a power supply unit converting the power by the power generation unit into a chargeable voltage to charge a battery and supplying a driving voltage from the battery to the electric motor; and a controller electrically connecting the battery and the electric motor through an electric system and controlling charging from the power generation unit to the battery.

title_en: Device For Removing Foreign Substances From Vehicle Parts
abstract_en: An apparatus for removing foreign substances from vehicle parts includes: a part accommodation tank; a water supply unit; an ultrasonic supply unit; a discharge unit; a water level sensor; a control unit; and a camera. The present invention effectively removes foreign substances from vehicle parts using ultrasonic waves and water, thereby improving removal and work efficiency and providing the effect of preventing the use of harmful chemical substances.

title_en: Collision avoidance assistance apparatus
abstract_en: When a collision avoidance target is a pedestrian or a bicycle (S11: Yes), a driving assistance ECU (10) performs automatic braking control (S12). In this case, accelerator override cannot be performed. When the collision avoidance target is an automobile (S11: No) and when an accelerator operation amount (AP) is equal to or larger than a first operation amount threshold (AP1) (S13: Yes), the driving assistance ECU (10) prohibits the automatic braking control (S14). In this case, the accelerator override can be performed. When the accelerator operation amount (AP) is less than the first operation amount threshold (AP1) (S13: No), the driving assistance ECU (10) performs automatic braking control (S12). The present invention can avoid a collision between a driver′s vehicle and an obstacle by performing automatic braking control.

title_en: The dynamic control method for sound output using speaker embedded within headrests
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dynamic control method for sound output using a speaker embedded within a headrest. According to the present invention, an occupant sound source device such as a smartphone carried by a vehicle occupant can be individually connected to a headrest speaker. In addition, it is also possible to dynamically control the sound of the smartphone of the occupant in various configurations so that the sound of the smartphone of the user is output through the headrest speaker of another seat.

title_en: Solar charging system and method for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a solar charging system for a vehicle, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the solar charging system for a vehicle comprises: a vehicle battery mounted on the vehicle; a solar panel mounted on the vehicle to perform solar power generation; and a solar control device operated by receiving electric energy generated from the solar panel and controlling charging of the vehicle battery using the electric energy.

title_en: Diagnosis apparatus and diagnosis method for battery temperature sensor, and electric vehicle
abstract_en: Provided are a diagnosis device and a diagnosis method for a battery temperature sensor, and an electric vehicle. The diagnosis device, which can improve accuracy in diagnosis of a failure in each battery temperature sensor, comprises: first to n^th battery temperature sensors separately disposed in first to n^th zones in a battery pack; and a control unit. The control unit determines first to n^th initial temperatures indicating temperatures detected by the respective battery temperature sensors at a first time point when the battery pack is switched from a used state to an unused state. The control unit determines first to n^th end temperatures indicating temperatures detected by the respective battery temperature sensors at a second time point when the battery pack is switched to the used state. The control unit diagnoses, based on a resting time from the first time point to the second time point, the respective initial temperatures, the respective end temperatures, and a thermal time constant of each zone, a failure of each of the battery temperature sensors.

title_en: Agricultural working machine using hydraulic moters having controllable rotating speed
abstract_en: The present invention suggests an agricultural working machine for operating a crawler by using a pair of hydraulic motors. The agricultural working machine, in order to operate a pair of crawlers, employs a pair of hydraulic motors (42, 44). Moreover, one single main shifting lever (20) for forward and backward movement using the hydraulic motors is installed to be rotatable in forward and backward directions, and one single steering lever (22) for steering using the hydraulic motors is installed to be rotatable in left and right directions. A control part (12) sensing the movement of the main shifting lever (20) and the steering lever (22) controls a hydraulic controller such that accurate straight movement can be performed based on sensing values of a pair of hydraulic motor rpm sensing sensors in case of straight movement, like controlling the hydraulic controller to the amount and direction of oil flowing via the hydraulic controller based on sensing values of first and second position sensing sensors.

title_en: Power swivel apparatus and a method for controlling the same
abstract_en: Content disclosed in the present specification relates to a power swivel device electrically controlling rotation of a seat and preventing a collision, and provision of a power swivel control method using the same. According to one embodiment of the content disclosed in the present specification, the power swivel device comprises: a seat rotation unit rotating the seat through driving of a swivel motor; and control units formed to be electrically connected to the swivel motor. The control unit controls the swivel motor to rotate the seat and senses a current state of the swivel motor or the sensor formed in the seat to stop the swivel motor when sensing a near obstacle.

title_en: Power transmission system of hybrid electric vehicle
abstract_en: Disclosed is a power transmission apparatus for a hybrid electric vehicle. In accordance with an embodiment of the present invention, the power transmission apparatus for the hybrid electric vehicle, which is able to simplify the structure of a transmission as much as possible, add various transmission modes such as a multi-step engine mode, parallel hybrid mode, electronic continuously variable transmission (eCVT) mode, and electric vehicle (EV) mode, reduce the cost, and realize fuel efficiency and power performance higher than that of the equivalent transmission by using an engine and a motor/generator as a power source, comprises: an input shaft; a composite planetary gear set including first, second, third, fourth, and fifth rotary elements by a connection combination of a first planetary gear set and a second planetary gear set sharing a planetary carrier; a first shaft fixed on and connected to the first rotary element, fixed on and connected to the motor/generator, and selectively connected to the input shaft; a second shaft fixed on and connected to the second rotary element, and selectively connected to the input shaft; a third shaft fixed on and connected to the third rotary element, and selectively connected to a transmission housing; a fourth shaft fixed on and connected to the fourth rotary element; a fifth shaft which directly connects the fifth rotary element to an output gear; a sixth shaft selectively connected to the second shaft and the fourth shaft, and selectively connected to the transmission housing; a plurality of engagement elements which include a clutch, which selectively connects shafts with each other, and a brake which connects the shaft to the transmission housing; and a fastening unit which selectively connects the sixth shaft to the second shaft or the fourth shaft by using power.

title_en: Road test method and apparatus for autonomous driving vehicle, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application discloses a road test method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for an autonomous vehicle, relating to the field of artificial intelligence and, in particular, to autonomous driving and intelligent transportation technologies. The specific implementation is: analyzing, based on evaluation baselines corresponding to autonomous driving scenarios in a process during which a vehicle is traveling along a test route, information of test parameters corresponding to the autonomous driving scenarios to determine a first test result of the vehicle; generating a second test result of the vehicle according to experience evaluation data; determining a road test result of the vehicle according to the first test result and the second test result of the vehicle, wherein the road test result includes not only an objective test result based on objective test data, but also a quantitative test result based on subjective evaluation data, such that objectivity, rigorousness, and preciseness of a road test are guaranteed, and an evaluation result on traveling safety, comfort and intelligence and traveling efficiency of a vehicle is reflected from a subjective perspective of a passenger, thereby improving accuracy of a road test result of an autonomous driving vehicle.

title_en: Drones for kids and pets
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone, and more particularly to a drone for infants and companion animals that attracts attention and arouses interest of infants and companion animals to induce natural exercise indoors. Furthermore, snacks or food are put inside a toy so that when an infant or companion animal jumps and touches the toy floating in the air, the snack or food is naturally discharged. Moreover, snack or food can be remotely provided to infants or companion animals when they should be snacking or eating food. The present invention includes a top cover; a drone; a bottom cover; a buffer member; a toy connection member; and a toy for infants and companion animals.

title_en: Vehicle speed control system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a speed control system and a speed control method. The present invention may comprise: a cognition device configured to provide sensing information by sensing an object outside of a host vehicle; a route setting device configured to receive updated map information from the outside of the host vehicle to update a map, plan a driving route to a destination set by a driver, based on the map, and provide information on the planned driving route as driving route information; an offline driving control unit configured to generate, when it is determined that a preceding vehicle in front of the host vehicle is traveling in the driving route of the host vehicle on the basis of the sensing information and the driving route information of the host vehicle, a driving route of the preceding vehicle and generate offline driving control information on the basis of the driving route of the preceding vehicle; and a vehicle control output interface configured to provide the offline driving control information to an engine control system, a braking control system, and a steering control system. According to the present invention, it is possible to increase safety in vehicle driving.

title_en: vehicle, and controlling method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a vehicle and a control method thereof, capable of guiding optimal digital key tag position to a digital key user. The vehicle according to one embodiment comprises: a near field communication module which receives a signal from a digital key within a predetermined distance; a lamp; and a control unit which controls the lamp based on reception signal intensity of the received signal. In addition, the control unit determines a range reference based on the reception signal intensity of the received signal in a first mode, and controls the lamp to provide information related to the position of the digital key based on the reception signal intensity of the received signal in a second mode and the range reference.

title_en: Driving apparatus for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a driving device for a vehicle and relates to a driving device for a vehicle that generates a driving force in a non-contact manner. The driving device for a vehicle according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an interface unit; a driving unit for transmitting a driving force to the interface unit; a switching unit having a plurality of switches to control power supplied to the driving unit; a relay unit selectively short-circuiting the inside of the driving unit; and a control device controlling the operation of the relay unit. The driving unit comprises: a stator generating a magnetic flux; a first rotor having an inner permanent magnet and rotating by the magnetic flux; an outer permanent magnet provided in a different number from the inner permanent magnets; and a second rotor rotating along a magnetic path between the inner permanent magnet and the outer permanent magnet. The control device rotates the first rotor according to whether the interface unit needs to change its attitude or prevents the rotation of the first rotor by operating the relay unit to short-circuit the inside of the driving unit. Accordingly, it is possible to prevent the rotation of the rotor without adding a separate mechanical structure.

title_en: Environment friendly buoy with airbag
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly buoy equipped with an airbag that not only increases productivity by simplifying the structure of forming the buoy by closing an inlet of an open plastic container with a stopper, but also facilitates maintenance as only damaged parts can be replaced and used by separately manufacturing the plastic container and stopper.

title_en: System and method for judging driver′s fatigue
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for judging a passenger's fatigue level. The present invention judges a fatigue level of a driver during driving and relieves the fatigue level of the driver to secure safe driving. The system comprises: a blood flow measurement unit identifying a blood flow of a leg portion of a passenger sitting on a seat; an initial value input unit storing an initial value of the blood flow of the passenger; a fatigue level setting unit setting the fatigue level according to a change amount of the stored initial value of the blood flow; and a control unit enabling safe control to be performed when the blood flow of the passenger is changed and reaches the set fatigue level.

title_en: Method for generating failed code label of control unit for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for generating a label for distinguishing a failure code of a vehicle controller, which generates a predetermined label in a failure code to easily determine whether the failure code is the virtual failure code generated due to functional limitation during an indoor test when the failure code of the controller occurs.

title_en: Method and system for supplying energy of parking vehicle
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for charging a parked vehicle, comprising the steps of: inputting the vehicle information of a vehicle that is parked, parking space information, requested charging information requested by the vehicle, and necessary time information preliminarily secured by the vehicle into a management server; scheduling, by the management server, the charging of the vehicle based on the requested charging information and the necessary time information of the vehicle; controlling, by the management server, the charging start, charging end and charging intensity of charging equipment based on the vehicle information of the vehicle, the parking space information, and a charging schedule; and receiving, by the management server, charging result information from the charging equipment after the charging end of the vehicle and calculating an amount of money to be charged to the user of the vehicle. Therefore, provided are a method and a system for charging a parked vehicle, wherein charging service quality can be improved by improving user convenience, redistributing limited charging equipment, and charging capacity.

title_en: Tire
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a tire mounted on a vehicle, comprising a bead portion including a bead filler and a bead core, and a tag module unit including a wireless recognition chip and an antenna portion connected to the wireless recognition chip and extending in a preset direction, wherein the antenna portion can come into contact with the bead core. Since the antenna portion of the tag module unit comes into contact with the bead portion, the radio range of the tag module unit can be increased.

title_en: Warning triangle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a warning triangle. According to the present invention, the warning triangle comprises: a housing including a pair of bodies; a plurality of supports accommodated in a folded state inside the housing and deployed when installing the warning triangle; a light-emitting unit which irradiates light to the surroundings; a reflector installed on each support and reflecting the light emitted from the light-emitting unit and surrounding light; and a driving unit which folds the plurality of supports and operates them to unfold upon installation. In the event of a car breakdown or accident on the road or during road repair work, the warning triangle warns drivers of approaching vehicles to slow down and improves the visibility of the warning triangle using the light-emitting unit and reflector, and can be installed quickly and easily.

title_en: Convertible seat for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a convertible seat for a vehicle, comprising a base frame having a storage space of a predetermined size, a plurality of individual blocks that are arranged to be liftable in an accommodating space of the base frame and function as seatbacks and seat cushions, and a lift driving device installed inside the individual blocks to lift the individual blocks. With this configuration, the seat position can be converted into various forms.

title_en: Float manufactured by the eva and pe
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a float made by foaming a mixture of ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer (EVA) and polyethylene (PE) in one foaming step. Specifically, the present invention relates to a float manufactured by foaming a mixture of EVA and PE in one foaming process. Accordingly, the present invention facilitates easy manufacturing of a float and prevents the formation of gaps caused by the assembly process used to make existing floats, such that watertight properties and durability are improved.

title_en: Damper for Glove Box
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a damper for a glove box. According to an embodiment, the provided damper for the glove box comprises: a cylinder wherein a space is formed at the interior; a piston which is reciprocally received in the space of the cylinder and divides the cylinder into a first space and a second space; and a valve disposed at one end part of the cylinder and forming a third space in communication with the second space through at least one variable orifice. An objective of the present invention is to provide the damper for the glove box, a cover of which can be moved at a constant speed.

title_en: Electric kickboard rental system and rental method using the system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric kickboard rental system and rental method using the system. According to the present invention, the electric kickboard rental system includes a shock detection sensor which can selectively park in a parking area, can communicate with a management server and one or more smartphones, and receives member information through a smartphone to the management server, and when an external shock occurs, detect the shock.

title_en: Electric scooter and controlling method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric scooter and a control method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the electric scooter comprises: a driving unit having a large number of switch elements to output three-phase power; a motor into which the three-phase power is input; and a control unit controlling the on/off of the large number of switch elements. The first-phase power line among the three-phase power is arranged between the first through fourth switch elements of the driving unit. The second-phase power line among the three-phase power is arranged between the second through fifth switch elements of the driving unit. The third-phase power line among the three-phase power is arranged between a third through sixth switch elements of the driving unit. The control unit is able to control the large number of switch elements so that the lines of the three-phase power can be short-circuited, and thereby perform an auto-hold function to interfere with the rotation of the motor. Therefore, accidents can be prevented.

title_en: Ship with a protector capable of turning left and right
abstract_en: A task to be solved by the present invention is to provide a ship equipped with a protector capable of turning left and right in which equipment or containers on a sign can be prevented from being damaged by waves, while allowing easy access to the side of the ship via the deck. The ship equipped with a protector capable of turning left and right according to the present invention comprises: a protector part provided on the deck, having a certain area to block green water, and including one or more plates; and a driving part that rotates the plate in the left and right directions so that the space of the deck is opened to the outside from one or more of the plates or the plate is variable depending on the direction of the wave.

title_en: Fish angling apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fish angling device capable of continuing to forward rotation of a film drum (74) by a torque motor (70b); hooking a film (40) by a boundary ball (23) depending on the forward rotation of a wire winding device (60); securing backward rotation slip torque of the film drum (74) when force of unrolling the film (40) from the film drum (74) is greater to be wound around the wire winding device (60) with a fishing line (21); and unrolling the film (40) in a tight state. The fish angling device rolls the film (40) wound with the fishing line (21) around the film drum (74) tightly with guarantee of the forward rotation torque of the film drum (74) depending on backward rotation of the wire winding device (60) while continuing to the forward rotation of the film drum (74) by a torque motor (70b); and maintains tension of the film (40) by guaranteeing rotation stop of the film drum (74) with the tension of the fishing line (21) when the fishing line (21) passes through a through hole (41) depending on the backward rotation of the wire winding device (60) in a state of allowing the film (40) to be completely rolled around the film drum (74). By completely eliminating a phenomenon of too tightly winding or loosely releasing the film (40) from the film drum (74), fishing activities are easily and safely realized in the sea.

title_en: Air pollution detection device of vehicle
abstract_en: Disclosed is an air pollution detection device for a vehicle. The air pollution detection device for a vehicle according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a measuring unit that measures an indoor air pollution level of a vehicle; and a display unit provided in a cabin room of the vehicle to display the measurement information of the measuring unit, wherein the measuring unit includes a vent formed through an interior part of the vehicle and a detection sensor provided on the interior part to measure the degree of pollution of the air delivered through the vent and the display unit includes a display that displays measurement information from the detection sensor and an operation unit containing a distance sensor. Accordingly, vehicle passengers can easily perceive air pollution levels.

title_en: Seat folding device for vehicle
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a seat folding device for a vehicle is disclosed, which includes: a folding locking part coupled to a rotation axis of a seatback to lock or unlock the seatback to a seat cushion; a connecting part having a first ring provided at one end and the other end connected to the folding locking part so that the folding locking part is unlocked when the first ring moves; and a main strap having a shape that is bent in the vertical direction, having one end connected to a seatback structure, extending downward, passing through the first ring and then being bent upward, and having the other end connected to the seatback structure so that the first ring moves upward when one end or the other end moves.

title_en: Power reception device and non-contact power transmission system
abstract_en: The present invention aims to suppress an increase in power when a short circuit is formed by the operation of a switching element. A power receiving device comprises: a receiving coil which receives power transmitted in a contactless method from a transmitting coil; and a control device which executes a short-circuit mode for short-circuiting between output terminals of the receiving coil by switching a switching element formed between the receiving coil and a load. The control device determines the switching timing of the switching element in the short-circuit mode so that, when the phase of the current and the phase of the voltage in the power receiving device are misaligned, the phase of the voltage shifts in a direction in which the power factor of the power supplied to the load worsens due to the short-circuit mode.

title_en: Swible inner seat for car
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a vehicle trunk inner seat which can be applied to various types of automobiles such as sedans and SUVs. The vehicle trunk inner seat includes: a lift part which is supported and installed on the rear floor of a vehicle; a seat part which is lifted and lowered by the lift part and extended towards the rear of the vehicle; and a rail part which is connected to the seat part and is fastened to the upper end of the lift part to move the seat part forward and backward towards the rear of the vehicle and to be introduced and discharged. According to the present invention, the vehicle trunk inner seat having the lift part, the rail part, and the seat part can be simply fixed to the floor or trunk portion at the rear of the vehicle, making installation simple.

title_en: Apparatus and method for recognizing passenger using point cloud-based radar
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a device and method for recognizing a passenger using a point cloud-based radar capable of determining whether a passenger is present in each seat of a vehicle using a point cloud-based radar module.
