abstract_en: The invention relates to a rotary slide valve (1) to be used for controlling or regulating a cooling fluid flow in a motor vehicle, having a primary spur gear (3) that is able to be driven via an actuator (2) and having a second spur gear (4) that is able to be driven by the primary spur gear, each of the spur gears being coupled to a rotary slide, wherein both the primary spur gear and the secondary spur gear (4) are each provided with a first spur gearing (5) and a second spur gearing (6), wherein each spur gearing is circumferentially interrupted, the spur gearings (5, 6) of each spur gear are arranged in two mutually axially offset planes and are mutually offset circumferentially per spur gear and mesh with one another in pairs.

title_en: Urea tank and fuel tank assembly
abstract_en: A urea tank and a fuel tank assembly. The fuel tank assembly comprises: a casing, wherein the casing comprises an upper casing (11), a middle casing (31) and a lower casing (51), and the upper casing (11), the middle casing (31) and the lower casing (51) are separately welded so as to form a cavity which comprises a fuel cavity. The urea tank and the fuel tank assembly are formed by welding after injection molding, so that not only does the casing have uniform wall thickness and high mechanical strength, but the stress of welding is also dispersed at the upper and lower ends of the casing by means of providing the upper casing, the middle casing and the lower casing and welding the three casings separately. On one hand, the stress concentration of the welded part of the casing is reduced, and the cracking of the welded part is prevented. On the other hand, since a middle region of the casing is subject to the maximum flow impact force of a sloshing liquid such as fuel oil, welding seams in the middle part of the casing are avoided, which not only improves the overall strength of the casing, but also prevents the welded part of the casing from cracking due to the impact force, thereby improving the service life of a fuel tank.

title_en: A connector
abstract_en: A connector for fitting and removing, without use of tools. The connector has first and second closable jaws. Each jaw is adapted to close around an item or unit, the jaws are connected together by way of a bar, at least one of the jaws is rotatable with respect to the bar and has a twist lock closure means which comprises two relatively rotatable parts. When rotated in a first sense the rotatable parts engages a lock means which prevents the jaws from opening by arresting a ratchet and pinion in place. When rotated in an opposite sense the lock means unlocks the jaws. The jaws are sprung apart by a resilient means which includes at least one O-ring which, when in a relaxed (unstretched) state retains the jaws in an open configuration. The connector includes an attachment member that is sufficiently firm and stable, for the attachment of at least two units, such as push chairs.

title_en: Display device for vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a display device for a vehicle. A display device for a vehicle, according to one embodiment of the present disclosure, comprises: a display panel; a backlight unit including a plurality of blocks composed of light sources; a viewing angle adjustment panel including a plurality of liquid crystal layers composed of liquid crystals; and a control unit, wherein the control unit can change, on the basis of the configuration of a predetermined mode of adjusting a viewing angle, the arrangement of liquid crystals arranged in a restricted region of the viewing angle adjustment panel corresponding to a predetermined region of the display panel, and adjust, on the basis of the difference between a preset reference brightness level and the brightness level of the predetermined region according to the configuration of the predetermined mode, the intensity of light emitted from blocks corresponding to the restricted region from among the plurality of blocks. Various other embodiments are possible.

title_en: A lightened strut mount
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightened shock strut mount (1) suitable for use in a suspension system, comprising at least one locking tab (11) having a hook (110) for locking the cover (10) to the body (30), at least one locking tab guide (33) suitable with the locking tab (11), and a method of obtaining the strut mount (1). A method of obtaining a strut mount (1) comprising of a pin tab (13) with a pin slot (131) on it and pins (14) used for fixation, instead of the locking tab (11) to the body (30).

title_en: Steering control device and steering control method
abstract_en: This steering control device (40) is configured to execute an operation-amount calculation process, a correction process and an operation process. In the operation-amount calculation process, an operation amount is calculated for control in which steering torque is used as a controlled amount and a target steering torque is used as a target value for the controlled amount. In the correction process, the steering torque and the operation amount are used as inputs, and the operation amount is corrected by a correction amount based on the difference between the steering torque as assumed by a nominal model and the actual steering torque. In the operation process, a motor of the steering device is operated so as to generate a torque based on the operation amount after being corrected by the correction process.

title_en: Axle structure for a utility vehicle chassis, comprising an axle bridge
abstract_en: The invention relates to an axle structure (6) for a utility vehicle chassis, comprising control arms (8), each of which has a pivot bearing (10) at a first end, an interface (18) at a first distance to the pivot bearing (10) for attaching a wheel carrier (12) to the respective control arm (8), and a support section (20) at a second distance to the pivot bearing (10) for connecting the respective control arm (8) to a spring element (14). The aim of the invention is to provide an axle structure which leaves sufficient installation space to provide the utility vehicle with an electric drive in the region of the axle structure. This is achieved in that the control arms (8) are connected together via an axle bridge (22) on the wheel axle (R) side facing away from the pivot bearings (10), said axle bridge (22) being screwed to the control arms (8).

title_en: Battery swappable vehicle and battery
abstract_en: Disclosed in the embodiments of the present application are a battery swappable vehicle and a battery. The battery swappable vehicle (100) comprises a battery compartment (10); the battery compartment (10) is arranged in the battery swappable vehicle (100); the battery compartment (10) is used for accommodating a plurality of batteries (20), and each battery (20) can independently supply power to the battery swappable vehicle (100). By means of the battery swappable vehicle (100), diversified battery swapping schemes can be provided for a user, improving battery swapping flexibility and optimizing user experience.

title_en: Electric vehicle
abstract_en: An electric vehicle (1) comprises: a current collector (2); one or more charging devices (3) charged by an auxiliary power supply device (4) which is connected to the current collector (2); a travel inverter (5) for driving a main electric motor (9); and a switch (61) that switches the connection between the charging device (3) and the travel inverter (5) from OFF to ON when the current collector (2) is disconnected from a power supply.

title_en: Tire for passenger car
abstract_en: In this tire for a passenger car, a tread rubber (T07) is made of a cap rubber (T07C) and a base rubber (T07B), the cap rubber is located on the outer side in the tire radial direction with respect to the base rubber and is located on both outer sides in the tire width direction with respect to the base rubber, the base rubber is composed of rubber having the same composition throughout, the width of the base rubber in the tire width direction is less than the width of the cap rubber in the tire width direction, and the storage modulus E' of the base rubber is 2.0 times or more the storage modulus E' of the cap rubber.

title_en: Valve assembly for a fuel tank
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a valve assembly for a liquid tank system includes a valve house and a cover. The valve assembly includes an orifice frame structure defining an orifice in a first shape therethrough, and a ribbon having a movable end. The ribbon is configured to seal or unseal the orifice along a first axis of the orifice when the movable end of the ribbon moves with the float. The orifice is asymmetrical across a second axis perpendicular to the first axis and passing through a middle point of the orifice. A first area of the orifice on a first side of the second axis is smaller than a second area of the orifice on the second side of the second axis. The first area of the orifice is configured to be unsealed earlier than the second area of the orifice by the ribbon.

title_en: Door checker for vehicle
abstract_en: This door checker for a vehicle is provided with a check plate, a housing, a sliding guide, and an elastic body. The housing is formed so as to allow insertion of the check plate, and is attached to the other of the body and the door. The housing has a first housing member and a second housing member. The first housing member is formed of a resin material by integrally forming a base part in which one main surface abuts the other of the body and the door, and an arch part formed so as to rise from the other main surface on the opposite side to the one main surface in the base part. The second housing member is formed of a resin material, houses the sliding guide and the elastic body, and is fixed to the first housing member by being inserted into a cavity part formed between the base part and the arch part of the first housing member.

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: The present technology relates to an information processing device, an information processing method, and a program that enable information for avoiding danger to be more suitably presented to a user of a moving body such as a vehicle. The information processing device according to the present technology comprises: a predicting unit that predicts movement information indicating a future movement of an object in the vicinity of the moving body and accident information indicating the movement of the object were an accident to occur; a calculating unit that calculates a degree of danger of the object on the basis of the movement information and the accident information; and a presentation control unit that presents danger prediction information indicating the degree of danger of the object to a user of the moving body. The present technology is applicable to moving bodies such as vehicles, for example.

title_en: Battery saving device for motor vehicles
abstract_en: A motor vehicle having a battery for powering on-board electrical equipment and a device for isolating a pole of the battery from said electrical equipment, wherein said device includes a disconnector associated with said pole of the battery and a switch (5) designed to be operated manually to control said disconnector, said switch being positioned inside the passenger compartment of the vehicle in a position not directly visible but immediately accessible.

title_en: Front damping structure of scooter
abstract_en: Disclosed is a front damping structure of a scooter. The front damping structure comprises a front fork (1) and a wheel (2), wherein the front fork comprises an upper support (11) and side rods, which are located on two sides of the bottom of the upper support; the side rods have built-in damping assemblies; the wheel is located between the two side rods and is connected to the two side rods by means of a connecting shaft (3); the lower end of each side rod is provided with a connecting hole (12); two ends of the connecting shaft pass through the connecting holes and are exposed; nuts are provided to adapt to the connecting shaft, thereby connecting the connecting shaft to the side rods; a side slot (13) in communication with the connecting hole is provided in a side wall of each side rod; a mounting hole (14) in communication with the side slot is provided on each of two sides of the side slot in each side rod; each fastener I passes through the mounting holes and the side slot; and there is an included angle between each fastener I and the connecting shaft, such that the connecting shaft is clamped and tightly connected, thereby preventing the connecting shaft from loosening.

title_en: Vehicle body structure of hybrid vehicle
abstract_en: Provided is a vehicle body structure of a hybrid vehicle that uses a vehicle frame including: a first mount for fixing a first engine at a position overlapping the first engine; and a second mount for fixing a first driving force transmission mechanism at a position overlapping the first driving force transmission mechanism. The vehicle body structure includes: a second engine disposed at a location of the vehicle frame where the first engine can be mounted; a power generation mechanism that generates power by means of the driving force of the second engine; a drive motor; and a second driving force transmission mechanism that transmits the driving force of the drive motor to a drive shaft. The second engine, the power generation mechanism, the drive motor, and the second driving force transmission mechanism are unitarily combined to form a drive unit. The drive unit is disposed so as to overlap the first mount and the second mount. A section of the drive unit corresponding to the second engine is fixed to the first mount, and a section of the drive unit other than the section corresponding to the second engine is fixed to the second mount.

title_en: Vehicle control device and vehicle control program
abstract_en: A vehicle control device (70) comprises: an acquiring unit (91) that acquires a target curvature, which is the curvature of a target trajectory; an actual curvature calculating unit (92) that calculates an actual curvature, which is the curvature of a travel trajectory of a vehicle; an instructed steering angle calculating unit (93) that calculates an instructed steering angle such that the instructed steering angle increases as the target curvature increases; and an instructed steering angle correcting unit (94) that, if the target curvature is greater than or equal to a curvature determination value, corrects the instructed steering angle by feedback control based on the target curvature and the actual curvature, and if the target curvature is less than the curvature determination value, does not correct the instructed steering angle by feedback control based on the target curvature and the actual curvature.

title_en: Child seat structure
abstract_en: A child seat structure, comprising a seat body and seat connector bases (1). The seat body comprises a backrest frame (2) which can be adjusted front and back relative to the seat connector bases (1), and a cushion frame (3) which can rotate relative to the seat connector bases (1) and is folded with the backrest frame (2); a limiting block (4) capable of sliding relative to the corresponding seat connector base (1) and extending out is provided on the side of the seat connector base (1) close to the cushion frame (3); a first reset member (5) is provided between each limiting block (4) and the corresponding seat connector base (1); a first limiting slot (6) allowing the corresponding limiting block (4) to be snap-fitted in is formed in the side of the cushion frame (3) close to the seat connector base (1); and when the cushion frame (3) is at a folded position, the limiting blocks (4) are snap-fitted in the first limiting slots (6) to limit the folding of the cushion frame (3). When the cushion frame (3) of the structure is folded with the backrest frame (2), the folded cushion frame (3) is limited by means of the limiting blocks (4), preventing the folded cushion frame (3) from being automatically unfolded under the action of self-weight to affect the subsequent folding operation of a stroller frame.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted storage box having soft cushion
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of storage boxes. Disclosed is a vehicle-mounted storage box having a soft cushion, comprising a box body, the box body comprising a side wall extending upwards from the periphery of a bottom plate; and further comprising a soft cushion, the soft cushion and the upper surface of the bottom plate being connected to each other by means of injection molding. The soft cushion and the upper surface of the bottom plate are connected to each other by means of injection molding so as to form an integral body, such that the orderly combination of the soft cushion and the storage box avoids displacement in using and cleaning processes and avoids dust collection.

title_en: Work vehicle
abstract_en: A work vehicle 1 according to the present disclosure comprises: an FC module 24; a vehicle body 11 on which the FC module 24 is mounted; and a discharge pipe 50 which has a discharge port 56 that discharges waste water from the FC module 24 to the outside. The discharge pipe 50 includes an upright pipe 52 which guides waste water upwards and discharges the guided waste water from the discharge port 56.

title_en: Work vehicle
abstract_en: A work vehicle 1 according to the present disclosure comprises: an FC module 24; a motor 31 that is driven by power outputted from the FC module 24; a hydrogen tank 13 that stores hydrogen which is fuel of the FC module 24; and an FC system ECU 71 that calculates power which is generatable by the FC module 24 in a case where hydrogen is used until the hydrogen amount in the hydrogen tank 13 reaches a prescribed amount from the present amount.

title_en: A method for generating test scenarios for testing a vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for generating test scenarios for testing a vehicle. According to the method, user data including one or more of riding parameters and demographic data of one or more riders is procured from one or more first databases. The procured user data is analysed to classify each of the one or more riders into one or more predefined profiles. Real-time environmental parameters pertaining to one or more of a geographical location, a traffic condition, and a weather condition are procured. A plurality of test scenarios is generated based on the classification of the one or more riders and the real-time environmental parameters. Advantageously, the method of the present ensures generation of a broad and realistic set of test scenarios, thereby addressing the problem of limited scenario coverage encountered in manual test scenario generation in the conventional art.

title_en: Rearview mirror heater assembly
abstract_en: A dimmable rearview mirror assembly includes an electro-optic ("EO") device including an EO medium that is variably transmissive in response to an applied voltage. A heating element includes a positive temperature coefficient ("PTC") substrate, and a heater anode trace is located on and electrically coupled with the PTC substrate. An EO anode trace is located on and electrically coupled with the PTC substrate with the EO anode trace extending between an EO anode terminal and an EO anode contact.

title_en: Hydraulic steering control system
abstract_en: The present inventions relates to a system that has a short production time, reduces the time required for maintenance and repair, can be retrofitted, and can be adapted to vehicles with different steering geometries with software changes.

title_en: Compressed air supply system, pneumatic system, vehicle and operating method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compressed air supply system (100), comprising: - a compressor (101) having a first and a second compressor stage (110, 120) for compressing compressed air (D) at two different pressure levels (D1, D2), - a compressed air supply system (201, 202, 203, 204, 205) having a main compressed air connection (1.1) connected to the compressor (101), a pneumatic main line (210) having an air dryer (220) for drying and conducting compressed air (D) from the main compressed air connection to a main compressed air supply connection (2.1), a supply line (251) for conducting compressed air (D) to an ancillary compressed air supply connection (2.2) having a switchable pneumatic element (150) for releasing and blocking the supply line (251). The invention proposes that the main compressed-air connection is connected to the second compressor stage (120) and the compressed-air supply system (201, 202, 203, 204, 205) has a ancillary compressed air connection (1.2) connected to the first compressor stage (110), wherein the supply line (251) conducts compressed air (D) from the ancillary compressed air connection (1.2) to the ancillary compressed air supply connection (2.2), and at least one secondary supply line (251.2) connected to the primary supply line (251.1) and having a secondary pneumatic switch element (250.2) for connecting to a compressed air source (Q), supplied by the main compressed air connection (1.1), for providing compressed air (D, D') with a third pressure level (D3) that is higher than the first pressure level, wherein the secondary pneumatic switch element (250.2) allows for at least one unidirectional compressed air flow from the compressed air source (Q) into the primary supply line (251.1). The invention also relates to a pneumatic system, a vehicle and an operating method.

title_en: Covering and vehicle seat
abstract_en: The invention relates to a covering (10) for a motor vehicle, which covering comprises an outer skin (12) and a first layer (14) arranged thereon and is designed to be pulled over a component and comprises fastening means for fastening the component, wherein at least one further second layer (16), which is different from the first layer (14) and is designed as a comfort layer, is arranged in addition to the first layer (14) which is designed as a ventilation layer and/or laminating layer. The invention also relates to a vehicle seat (20).

title_en: Vehicular imaging device
abstract_en: Vehicular imaging devices 10A to 10C each comprise an imaging unit 18 that includes a lens 19 for imaging a side part rearward of a vehicle 1, and a housing 12 that accommodates the imaging unit 18 so that the lens 19 is exposed to the outside, the housing being attached to the vehicle 1. When viewed from the vehicle height direction, an outer peripheral part of the housing 12 includes an inner side part 12a that is disposed so as to be in contact with the vehicle 1 and extends in the vehicle length direction, and a rear side part 12e that is continuous with the rear side of the inner side part 12a in the vehicle length direction and extends outward in the vehicle width direction. An inclined part 12g that is inclined rearward in the vehicle length direction from the outside to the inside in the vehicle width direction, is formed in at least a portion of the rear side part 12e.

title_en: Autonomous driving method, computer device, storage medium, program product and mobile platform
abstract_en: An autonomous driving method, a computer device, a storage medium, a program product and a mobile platform. The method comprises: on the basis of environmental perception data, determining a topological path and a curb outer contour line within a perception range; generating a road centerline on the basis of the topological path and the curb outer contour line; and at least on the basis of the road centerline, generating a traveling trajectory for autonomous driving.

title_en: Wheel brake device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wheel brake device (1) for a brake system of a motor vehicle, having a brake holder (2), a brake caliper (3) mounted displaceably on the brake holder (2), a drivable actuator (4), in particular an electric machine, connected to the brake caliper (3), a first brake lining (5) displaceable by means of the actuator (4), a second brake lining (6) displaceable by means of the brake caliper (3), in particular connected with the brake caliper (3), and a brake disc (7), wherein the brake linings (5, 6) are associated with different sides (10, 11) of the brake disc (7) and are mounted so as to be displaceable towards one another in order to produce a braking force. According to the invention, the wheel brake device (1) has at least one first path-reversing linkage (12), and the brake linings (5, 6) are coupled resiliently to one another by means of the linkage (12).

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles and systems and methods for using same
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is disclosed. The UAV has a longitudinal body extending along a longitudinal axis. The longitudinal body has a rear opening and a closed end opposite the rear opening. At least one lifting body is fixedly, non-pivotably coupled to the longitudinal body and extending outwardly from the longitudinal axis on opposite sides of the longitudinal body. A motor can surround the longitudinal body, and a propeller can be rotatable about the longitudinal body and operatively coupled to the motor.

title_en: Tyre having optimized rolling resistance performance
abstract_en: The invention describes a tyre (1) comprising a crown (7) and a carcass reinforcement (9), the crown (7), the crown reinforcement (8) comprising a hooping reinforcement (19), a first working layer (15) and a second working layer (17), the first working layer (15) having a point E1 at each axial end of the first working layer (15), the second working layer (17) having a point E2 at each of the axial ends of the second working layer (17), the point E1 being axially outside the point E2, the crown (7) comprising a volume of filler (21) arranged between the first working layer (15) and the hooping reinforcement (19), the volume of filler (21) comprising a decoupling portion (22) extending axially from the point E1 to the point E2, the hooping reinforcement (19) having a bearing portion (18) vertically in line with the decoupling portion (22), the inter-cord distance D1 between the textile reinforcing elements (31) of the bearing portion (18) of the hooping reinforcement (19) being less than a threshold.

title_en: Charging device for electric vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to a charging device for electric vehicles (1), having a charging station (2) comprising a converter (4) connected to a mains connection (3) on the input side and to a distributor (5) on the output side, wherein the distributor (5) is connected both to a charging connection (6) and to a DC bus (7) guided out of the charging station (2). In order to provide an improved load balance across the charging connections (6) of a charging device in the event of uneven distribution of electric vehicles (1), it is proposed that the DC bus (7) is guided through the charging station (2) from a DC bus input (8) via a separating unit (9) to a DC bus output (10).

title_en: A heat exchanger assembly
abstract_en: The object of the invention is, among others, a heat exchanger assembly (1), comprising -a first heat exchanger (10), -at least one second heat exchanger (20), -at least one intermediate member (50) arranged between the first heat exchanger (10) and the second heat exchanger (20), wherein said intermediate component (50) further comprises a first face (50A) having a fixation surface for fixation to the first heat exchanger (10), a second face (50B), opposite to the first face (50A), and having a fixation surface for fixation to the second heat exchanger (20), at least one channel (55) extending between the first face (50A) and the second face (50B), wherein the channel (55) is configured to provide a fluidal communication between the first heat exchanger (10) and the second heat exchanger (20), wherein the intermediate component (50) further comprises at least one thermal insulating zone (59) delimited at least by the first face (50A) and the second face (50B).

title_en: Thermal management system and vehicle
abstract_en: A thermal management system and a vehicle. The thermal management system comprises a solid-state cooling module (104) and a compressor (101), wherein the solid-state cooling module is used for releasing heat to a thermal management loop in which the compressor is located when the thermal management system is executing a heating function; and/or, the solid-state cooling module is used for absorbing heat from the thermal management loop in which the compressor is located when the thermal management system is executing a cooling function. The solid-state cooling module comprises a first metal plate (201), a solid-state cooler (203) and a second metal plate (202), wherein the first metal plate is internally provided with a flow channel that allows a fluid to flow therethrough, and the solid-state cooler is used for implementing heat exchange between the first metal plate and the second metal plate. By means of such a configuration, the thermal management system can maintain efficient operation even in an overly cold or overly hot environment.

title_en: Saddle-type electric vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention achieves a lower floor design while using a battery case as a part of a vehicle body frame, and is capable of ensuring a stroke amount for a rear suspension.　Provided is saddle-type electric vehicle comprising: a swing arm (16) that rotatably supports a rear wheel (12); a battery case (33) that is provided between a front wheel (14) and the rear wheel (12) as at least a portion of a vehicle body frame (11); and a drive battery (40) that is accommodated in the battery case (33). One end (17a) of a link-type rear suspension (17) that suspends the swing arm (16) is supported by the battery case (33).
